/-!
# The acceptance suite: files of statements in the language

`#cas_tests "tests/acceptance/f.cas"` runs a file of the language, and `#cas_tests "dir"` every
`.cas` file of `dir`. An item is `test id "source": statement`, a statement admitted permanently
(`scripts/check_acceptance_permanent.py`), whose expected value comes from `source`; or a bare
`let`. The file's `let`s scope over the items after them, and each retains its computed value.

Each statement runs through `CasRuntime.KernelSession.run`: the source reader, the lowerer and
the kernel executor, over the registrations of the installed leaves' manifest
(`CasRuntime.installedManifest`; `#cas_tests "dir" manifest "path"` names another). The
registrations not admitted are reported. A statement that holds, a gap (no registration, an
ambiguous one, an unfinished source form) and an unavailable backend are recorded; every other
outcome (`Outcome.fails`) fails the build. A leaf never sees the suite.
`#cas_tests "dir" reporting "out.json"` also writes every result as JSON (`cas-harness` runs it
over a given manifest).

The optional `computing` suffix computes every question through the kernel, with no discharge
in Lean. Each result records the registrations actually dispatched during that statement.

`#cas "statement"` runs one statement of the language the same way (a notebook cell): its outcome
is reported, and an outcome that fails the suite is an error.
-/

open Lean Elab Command Term CasRuntime CasCompiler

namespace CasCatalogue.Language

meta section

/-- The outcome of one test of the suite. -/
structure TestResult where
  file : String
  id : String
  /-- The outcome's kind (`Outcome.kind`). -/
  kind : String
  /-- The original classified failure, separate from the legacy outcome kind. -/
  stratum : Option String := none
  detail : String := ""
  /-- Whether the outcome fails the suite (`Outcome.fails`). -/
  fails : Bool := false
  /-- Whether this original item entered execution; false for an unexecuted continuation. -/
  attempted : Bool := true
  /-- Whether the item's owning runtime cell committed. Pure source observations have no cell. -/
  published : Bool := false
  /-- Original failing item in this file when an enclosing scope withheld this result. -/
  blockedBy : Option String := none
  /-- The proposition that the reader formed; empty when the statement was not read. -/
  question : String := ""
  proposition : String := ""
  /-- Original checked native terms, scopes, selections and supplied evidence. These source
  observations remain available when execution fails or the owning cell does not publish. -/
  conclusions : Array Json := #[]
  /-- Registrations actually dispatched during this statement; not mathematical evidence. -/
  dispatches : Array Json := #[]
  /-- Wall time of this statement, in milliseconds (constitution C24, timing history). -/
  milliseconds : Nat := 0
  /-- Wall time of the definitions before this statement that are not reported themselves: the
  setup that this statement uses, in milliseconds. -/
  setupMilliseconds : Nat := 0
  deriving ToJson, FromJson, Inhabited

-- The native source and failure-stratum fields are additive. Lean's derived decoder does not
-- use structure defaults, so preserve older reports by supplying only absent fields. Present values
-- still pass through the complete generated decoder, including its normal type checks.
attribute [-instance] instFromJsonTestResult

instance instFromJsonTestResultCompatible : FromJson TestResult where
  fromJson? json :=
    let normalized := match json with
      | .obj fields =>
        let fields := if (fields.get? "conclusions").isSome then fields
          else fields.insert "conclusions" (.arr #[])
        let fields := if (fields.get? "stratum").isSome then fields
          else fields.insert "stratum" .null
        .obj fields
      | _ => json
    @fromJson? TestResult instFromJsonTestResult normalized

/-- Report a completed statement. `-DstderrAsMessages=false` enables live stderr output. -/
private def TestResult.writeProgress (result : TestResult)
    (position : Option Position := none) : CommandElabM Unit := do
  let output ← if Core.stderrAsMessages.get (← getOptions) then IO.getStdout else IO.getStderr
  let detail := if result.detail.isEmpty then "" else s!": {result.detail}"
  let location := match position with
    | some position => s!"{result.file}:{position.line}:{position.column + 1}"
    | none => result.file
  output.putStrLn s!"{location}: {result.id}: {result.kind} \
    ({result.milliseconds} ms){detail}"
  output.flush

private def dispatchJson (registration : Registration) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("operation", toJson registration.operation), ("input", toJson registration.input),
    ("backend", toJson registration.backend)]

/-- Run one parsed statement in its own heartbeat budget and report its dispatches.
A statement of a file is read against that file's original positions. -/
private def runOne (session : KernelSession) (statement : TSyntax `cas_stmt)
    (source : Option SourceFile := none) (owningCell : Option CellTransaction := none)
    (diagnostics : Option CasTools.Diagnostics.Scope := none) :
    CommandElabM (StatementRun × Array Json) := do
  let start := (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).size
  let computation : TermElabM StatementRun := withoutErrToSorry <| withCurrHeartbeats <|
    match source with
    | some file => file.withContext (session.run statement owningCell)
    | none => session.run statement owningCell
  let result ← liftTermElabM <| match diagnostics with
    | some scope => CasTools.Diagnostics.withScope scope computation
    | none => computation
  let calls ← session.kernel.dispatches.get
  return (result, (calls.extract start calls.size).map dispatchJson)

private partial def unexecutedScope (statement : TSyntax `cas_stmt) :
    Array StatementObservation := Id.run do
  let some items := sourceContextItems? statement | return #[]
  return items.flatMap unreadSourceItems

/-- Runs the file `path` of the suite in `session`: the outcome of each test, and the session
after the file. A `let` or statement that does not hold is reported as a statement of the file.
An exception outside a statement's own outcome is that statement's internal error. -/
def runFile (session : KernelSession) (path : System.FilePath) :
    CommandElabM (Array TestResult × KernelSession) := do
  let file := path.toString
  let log := session.kernel.log
  let fileBegan ← IO.monoMsNow
  let fileEntry ← log.write #[] "file.begin" (Json.mkObj [("file", toJson file)])
  let fileRun := s!"{log.session}/{fileEntry}"
  let contents ← try IO.FS.readFile path
    catch error =>
      discard <| log.write #[fileEntry] "file.failed" <| Json.mkObj [
        ("fileRun", toJson fileRun), ("file", toJson file), ("stage", toJson "read"),
        ("detail", toJson (← error.toMessageData.toString))]
      return (#[{ file, id := "(statement) infrastructure", kind := "internal"
                  detail := s!"cannot read selected input: {← error.toMessageData.toString}"
                  fails := true }], session)
  let sourceSha256 ← sha256Hex contents
  let source ← try liftCoreM <| SourceFile.parse file contents
    catch error =>
      discard <| log.write #[fileEntry] "file.failed" <| Json.mkObj [
        ("fileRun", toJson fileRun), ("file", toJson file), ("stage", toJson "parse"),
        ("sourceSha256", toJson sourceSha256),
        ("detail", toJson (← error.toMessageData.toString))]
      -- A syntactically unreadable file is invalid input, not an interpreter crash.
      return (#[{ file, id := "(statement) parse", kind := "invalid", stratum := some "invalid"
                  detail := s!"reader parser failure: {← error.toMessageData.toString}"
                  fails := true }], session)
  let sharedFileSetupMilliseconds := (← IO.monoMsNow) - fileBegan
  discard <| log.write #[fileEntry] "file.started" <| Json.mkObj [
    ("fileRun", toJson fileRun), ("file", toJson file),
    ("sourceSha256", toJson sourceSha256), ("statements", toJson source.items.size),
    ("sharedFileSetupMilliseconds", toJson sharedFileSetupMilliseconds)]
  let mut session := session
  let mut results : Array TestResult := #[]
  let mut setupMilliseconds := 0
  let mut cumulativeSetupMilliseconds := sharedFileSetupMilliseconds
  let mut executed := 0
  for item in source.items, ordinal in [:source.items.size] do
    let (id?, statement) : Option String × TSyntax `cas_stmt := match item with
      | `(cas_item| test $id:ident $_:str : $statement:cas_stmt) =>
        (some id.getId.toString, statement)
      | `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) => (none, statement)
      | _ => (none, ⟨item.raw⟩)
    let id := id?.getD s!"(statement) {item.raw.reprint.getD ""}"
    let position := statement.raw.getPos?.map source.context.fileMap.toPosition
    let computation := s!"{fileRun}/{ordinal}"
    let computationSetupMilliseconds := cumulativeSetupMilliseconds
    let start ← IO.monoMsNow
    let computationEntry ← log.write #[fileEntry] "computation.started" <| Json.mkObj [
      ("computation", toJson computation), ("fileRun", toJson fileRun),
      ("file", toJson file), ("sourceSha256", toJson sourceSha256),
      ("ordinal", toJson ordinal), ("id", toJson id),
      ("source", toJson (statement.raw.reprint.getD "")),
      ("cumulativeSetupMilliseconds", toJson computationSetupMilliseconds),
      ("position", SourceSnapshot.spanJson ⟨file, statement.raw.getPos?, statement.raw.getTailPos?⟩)]
    let recordTiming (result : TestResult) (children : Array Json) : IO Unit := do
      discard <| log.write #[fileEntry, computationEntry] "computation.timing" <| Json.mkObj [
        ("computation", toJson computation), ("fileRun", toJson fileRun),
        ("file", toJson file), ("sourceSha256", toJson sourceSha256),
        ("ordinal", toJson ordinal), ("id", toJson id),
        ("milliseconds", toJson (result.milliseconds + computationSetupMilliseconds)),
        ("executionMilliseconds", toJson result.milliseconds),
        ("setupMilliseconds", toJson computationSetupMilliseconds),
        ("cumulativeSetupMilliseconds", toJson computationSetupMilliseconds),
        ("reportSetupMilliseconds", toJson result.setupMilliseconds),
        ("sharedFileSetupMilliseconds", toJson sharedFileSetupMilliseconds),
        ("result", toJson result), ("children", toJson children)]
    executed := executed + 1
    let execution ← try
        let run ← runOne session statement (some source)
          (diagnostics := some { log, parents := #[fileEntry, computationEntry] })
        pure (some run)
      catch error =>
        let result : TestResult := {
          file, id, kind := "internal"
          detail := s!"statement execution failed: {← error.toMessageData.toString}"
          fails := true, milliseconds := (← IO.monoMsNow) - start, setupMilliseconds }
        result.writeProgress position
        recordTiming result #[]
        results := results.push result
        setupMilliseconds := 0
        pure none
    let milliseconds := (← IO.monoMsNow) - start
    let some (run, dispatches) := execution | continue
    let retainsSetup := run.session.source.context.entries.size > session.source.context.entries.size
    session := run.session
    for output in run.inspectionOutput do logInfo output
    let result : TestResult := {
      file, id, kind := run.outcome.kind, detail := run.outcome.detail
      stratum := run.outcome.stratum?
      fails := run.outcome.fails, attempted := run.attempted, published := run.published,
      question := run.proposition, proposition := run.proposition
      conclusions := run.conclusions.map CasTools.QuestionExport.observeConclusion
      dispatches, milliseconds, setupMilliseconds }
    result.writeProgress position
    let scopedObservations :=
      if run.observations.isEmpty && (sourceContextItems? statement).isSome then
        unexecutedScope statement
      else run.observations
    recordTiming result <| scopedObservations.mapIdx fun ordinal child => Json.mkObj [
      ("ordinal", toJson ordinal),
      ("id", toJson (match child.item with
        | `(cas_item| test $name:ident $_:str : $_:cas_stmt) => name.getId.toString (escape := false)
        | _ => s!"(statement) {child.item.raw.reprint.getD ""}")),
      ("source", toJson (child.item.raw.reprint.getD "")),
      ("position", SourceSnapshot.spanJson ⟨file, child.item.raw.getPos?, child.item.raw.getTailPos?⟩),
      ("attempted", toJson child.attempted),
      ("kind", toJson (child.outcome.map (·.kind))),
      ("stratum", toJson (child.outcome.bind (·.stratum?))),
      ("detail", toJson (child.outcome.map (·.detail))),
      ("milliseconds", toJson child.milliseconds),
      ("conclusions", toJson (child.conclusions.map CasTools.QuestionExport.observeConclusion)),
      ("dispatches", toJson (child.dispatches.map dispatchJson))]
    if retainsSetup then
      cumulativeSetupMilliseconds := cumulativeSetupMilliseconds + milliseconds
    if !scopedObservations.isEmpty then
      -- Child time/calls are measured by the same shared execution cell. Source preflight
      -- and block overhead are charged once as setup, never invented per-question timings.
      let elapsed := scopedObservations.foldl (fun total child => total + child.milliseconds) 0
      setupMilliseconds := setupMilliseconds + (milliseconds - elapsed)
      let beforeRows := results.size
      let failedChild := scopedObservations.find? fun child =>
        child.outcome.any (fun outcome => !(outcome matches .holds))
      let cause := match failedChild with
        | some child => match child.item with
          | `(cas_item| test $name:ident $_:str : $_:cas_stmt) =>
            name.getId.toString (escape := false)
          | _ => s!"(statement) {child.item.raw.reprint.getD ""}"
        | none => id
      for child in scopedObservations do
        let childId := match child.item with
          | `(cas_item| test $name:ident $_:str : $_:cas_stmt) =>
            some (name.getId.toString (escape := false))
          | _ => none
        if childId.isNone && child.outcome.any (fun outcome => outcome matches .holds) then
          setupMilliseconds := setupMilliseconds + child.milliseconds
          continue
        if childId.isNone && child.outcome.isNone then
          setupMilliseconds := setupMilliseconds + child.milliseconds
          continue
        let availability :=
          if child.attempted then "attempted but not published" else "not executed"
        let outcome := child.outcome.getD (.unavailable
          s!"{availability}; stopped at {cause}: {run.outcome.kind}: {run.outcome.detail}")
        let row : TestResult := {
          file, id := childId.getD s!"(statement) {child.item.raw.reprint.getD ""}",
          kind := outcome.kind, detail := outcome.detail, fails := outcome.fails,
          stratum := outcome.stratum?,
          attempted := child.attempted, published := run.published,
          blockedBy := if child.outcome.isNone then some cause else none,
          question := child.proposition, proposition := child.proposition,
          conclusions := child.conclusions.map CasTools.QuestionExport.observeConclusion,
          dispatches := child.dispatches.map dispatchJson,
          milliseconds := child.milliseconds, setupMilliseconds }
        row.writeProgress (child.item.raw.getPos?.map source.context.fileMap.toPosition)
        results := results.push row
        setupMilliseconds := 0
      -- Source-only observations do not replace the actual root failure when no child
      -- reported it. They carry typed readings, not evidence that a child executed.
      if id?.isSome || (results.size == beforeRows && !(run.outcome matches .holds)) ||
          (failedChild.isNone && !(run.outcome matches .holds)) then
        results := results.push result
      continue
    if id?.isNone && run.outcome matches .holds then
      setupMilliseconds := setupMilliseconds + milliseconds
      continue
    results := results.push result
    setupMilliseconds := 0
  discard <| log.write #[fileEntry] "file.finished" <| Json.mkObj [
    ("fileRun", toJson fileRun), ("file", toJson file),
    ("sourceSha256", toJson sourceSha256), ("executed", toJson executed),
    ("milliseconds", toJson ((← IO.monoMsNow) - fileBegan))]
  return (results, session)

/-- The report of a file's results. -/
def report (file : String) (results : Array TestResult) : String :=
  let tests := results.filter (!·.id.startsWith "(statement)")
  let passing := (tests.filter (·.kind == "holds")).size
  let lines := results.filter (·.kind != "holds") |>.map fun r => s!"  {r.id}: {r.kind}: {r.detail}"
  s!"{file}: {passing} of {tests.size} hold\n{"\n".intercalate lines.toList}"

/-- Start a kernel session in a scratch runtime Environment, run `action`, close every started
backend and restore the Environment. Registrations not admitted are reported. -/
def withSession (manifest? : Option System.FilePath) (computationOnly : Bool)
    (action : KernelSession → CommandElabM α) : CommandElabM α := do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    liftCoreM KernelSession.clear
    let session ← liftTermElabM <| KernelSession.start manifest? computationOnly
    for rejected in session.kernel.rejected do
      logWarning m!"registration not admitted: {rejected}"
    try action session finally (session.close : IO Unit)
  finally setEnv environment

/-- Runs `path`, a file of the suite or a directory of `.cas` files. Each file is one session:
its `let`s do not scope over another file. -/
def runSuite (manifest? : Option System.FilePath) (computationOnly : Bool)
    (path : System.FilePath) (inventory? : Option System.FilePath := none) :
    CommandElabM (Array TestResult) := do
  let mut results : Array TestResult := #[]
  let files ← try
      if ← path.isDir then
        pure ((← path.readDir).filter (·.path.extension == some "cas") |>.map (·.path))
      else pure #[path]
    catch error =>
      results := results.push {
        file := path.toString
        id := "(statement) infrastructure"
        kind := "internal"
        detail := ← error.toMessageData.toString
        fails := true }
      pure #[]
  if files.isEmpty && results.isEmpty then
    results := results.push {
      file := path.toString
      id := "(statement) infrastructure"
      kind := "internal"
      detail := "the selected suite contains no .cas files"
      fails := true }
  for file in files.qsort (·.toString < ·.toString) do
    try
      results := results ++
        (← withSession manifest? computationOnly fun session => do
          return (← runFile session file).1)
    catch error =>
      results := results.push {
        file := file.toString
        id := "(statement) infrastructure"
        kind := "internal"
        detail := ← error.toMessageData.toString
        fails := true }
  let mut identities : Array String := #[]
  for result in results do
    if result.id.startsWith "(statement)" then continue
    if identities.contains result.id then
      results := results.push {
        file := result.file
        id := s!"(statement) duplicate {result.id}"
        kind := "internal"
        detail := s!"duplicate named assertion identity: {result.id}"
        fails := true }
    else
      identities := identities.push result.id
  if let some inventory := inventory? then
    try
      let .ok document := Json.parse (← IO.FS.readFile inventory)
        | throwError "cannot read the fixed assertion inventory {inventory}"
      let .ok (.obj assertions) := document.getObjVal? "assertions"
        | throwError "missing assertion inventory in {inventory}"
      for (identity, _) in assertions.toList do
        unless results.any (·.id == identity) do
          results := results.push {
            file := path.toString
            id := identity
            kind := "internal"
            detail := "required assertion produced no result"
            fails := true }
    catch error =>
      -- Preserve the outcomes already executed even when inventory I/O fails.
      -- This is an infrastructure failure, not a verdict on those assertions.
      results := results.push {
        file := inventory.toString
        id := "(statement) inventory infrastructure"
        kind := "internal"
        detail := ← error.toMessageData.toString
        fails := true }
  return results

/-- Runs one statement of the language, given as text, in `session`. -/
def runStatement (session : KernelSession) (text : String)
    (owningCell : Option CellTransaction := none) : CommandElabM StatementRun := do
  let parsed ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
    | .ok statement => pure statement
    | .error error => do
      let reference ← getRef
      let log := session.kernel.log
      let parents := match ← liftCoreM CasTools.Diagnostics.current? with
        | some active => if active.log.session == log.session then active.parents else #[]
        | none => #[]
      discard <| log.write parents "statement.parseFailed" <| Json.mkObj [
        ("source", toJson text), ("kind", toJson "invalid"),
        ("stratum", toJson (some "invalid")), ("detail", toJson error),
        ("position", SourceSnapshot.spanJson ⟨← getFileName,
          reference.getPos?, reference.getTailPos?⟩)]
      throwError "not a statement of the language: {error}\n{text}"
  return (← runOne session ⟨parsed⟩ none owningCell).1

syntax (name := casTestsCommand)
  "#cas_tests " str (&" manifest " str)? (&" reporting " str)? (&" inventory " str)?
  (&" computing")? : command

@[command_elab casTestsCommand] def elabCasTests : CommandElab := fun stx => do
  let some path := stx[1].isStrLit? | throwUnsupportedSyntax
  let manifest? := stx[2][1].isStrLit?.map fun s => (s : System.FilePath)
  let computationOnly := stx[5].getNumArgs > 0
  let inventory? := stx[4][1].isStrLit?.map fun s => (s : System.FilePath)
  let results ← runSuite manifest? computationOnly path inventory?
  let files := results.foldl (fun fs r => if fs.contains r.file then fs else fs.push r.file) #[]
  for file in files do logInfo (report file (results.filter (·.file == file)))
  if let some out := stx[3][1].isStrLit? then
    IO.FS.writeFile out (toJson results).pretty
  let failures := results.filter (·.fails)
  unless failures.isEmpty do
    throwError "the suite fails:\n{"\n".intercalate (failures.toList.map fun r =>
      s!"  {r.file}: {r.id}: {r.kind}: {r.detail}")}"

syntax (name := casStatementCommand) "#cas " str (&" manifest " str)? : command

@[command_elab casStatementCommand] def elabCasStatement : CommandElab := fun stx => do
  let some text := stx[1].isStrLit? | throwUnsupportedSyntax
  let manifest? := stx[2][1].isStrLit?.map fun s => (s : System.FilePath)
  let owningCell ← liftCoreM KernelSession.active?
  let session ← match ← liftCoreM KernelSession.current? with
    | some session =>
      if manifest?.isSome then
        throwError "the session manifest is frozen at startup"
      if owningCell.isSome then pure session else session.fork
    | none => liftTermElabM <| KernelSession.start manifest?
  let run ← runStatement session text owningCell
  let outcome := run.outcome
  let shown := if outcome matches .holds then outcome.kind else s!"{outcome.kind}: {outcome.detail}"
  if outcome.fails || (owningCell.isSome && !(outcome matches .holds)) then
    if owningCell.isSome then
      Worker.Cell.reportFailure { stratum := outcome.stratum?, reason := outcome.detail }
    throwError shown
  else
    liftCoreM (KernelSession.install run.session)
    if let some transaction := owningCell then
      let definitions ← liftTermElabM (CasRuntime.Inspect.newBindings session run.session transaction)
      let rendered := if run.proposition.isEmpty then shown else s!"{shown}: {run.proposition}"
      let rendered := "\n".intercalate (rendered :: run.inspectionOutput.toList)
      let metadata := Json.mkObj [
        ("cas_source", toJson text),
        ("cas_definitions", toJson definitions),
        ("conclusions", toJson (run.conclusions.map CasTools.QuestionExport.observeConclusion))]
      let bundle : Worker.Output :=
        { data := [("text/plain", toJson rendered)], metadata }
      Worker.emitOutput bundle
    else
      logInfo shown
      for output in run.inspectionOutput do logInfo output

end

end CasCatalogue.Language

module

import CasRuntime.PreparedRequest
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.PreparedRequest

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasRuntime

private def reject (expected : String) (action : MetaM α) : MetaM Unit := do
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    discard action
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure | throwError "callable preparation accepted invalid runtime arguments"
  unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith expected do throw failure

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let leftRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkNatLit 2))
  let rightRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkNatLit 3))
  let callableRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkConst ``Nat.add))
  let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let (graph, leftValue) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role := leftRole, parameters := #[] } (.portable "2".toUTF8)
  let (graph, rightValue) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence, role := rightRole, parameters := #[] } (.portable "3".toUTF8)
  let (graph, callable) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence, role := callableRole, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
  withLocalDeclD `left (mkConst ``Nat) fun left =>
    withLocalDeclD `right (mkConst ``Nat) fun right => do
      let bindings : Array LocalBinding := #[
        { id := ⟨"application-context", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := left },
        { id := ⟨"application-context", 1⟩, role := .parameter, expression := right }]
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let .ok leftParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph bindings[0]!.id leftValue
        | throwError "the actual left source parameter is absent"
      let .ok rightParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph bindings[1]!.id rightValue
        | throwError "the actual right source parameter is absent"
      let parameters := #[leftParameter, rightParameter]
      let argument (index : Nat) (value : ValueBinding) : MetaM RuntimeArgument := do
        let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph index value
          | throwError "the actual application argument is absent"
        return argument
      let arguments := #[← context.close left, ← context.close right]
      let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable arguments
        #[← argument 1 rightValue, ← argument 0 leftValue] parameters
      let .apply original formal actual := request.action
        | throwError "the application lost its original prepared action"
      unless original.value == callable.value && formal.size == 2 && actual.size == 2 &&
          (actual[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some leftValue.value &&
          (actual[1]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some rightValue.value &&
          request.scope.map (·.value) == #[callable.value, leftValue.value, rightValue.value] do
        throwError "callable preparation changed the complete source argument order or actual values"
      for source in arguments, value in actual do
        let some value := value | throwError "a supplied source operand is absent"
        unless (← value.role.source.inContext context) == (← source.inContext context) do
          throwError "callable preparation changed the native consuming source argument"
      let .ok rightAlias := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph bindings[1]!.id leftValue
        | throwError "the aliased source parameter is absent"
      let aliased ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable arguments
        #[← argument 1 leftValue, ← argument 0 leftValue] #[leftParameter, rightAlias]
      let .apply _ formal actual := aliased.action
        | throwError "aliased argument preparation changed its action"
      unless actual.size == 2 && formal[0]?.map (·.expression) != formal[1]?.map (·.expression) &&
          (actual[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some leftValue.value &&
          (actual[1]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some leftValue.value &&
          aliased.scope.map (·.value) == #[callable.value, leftValue.value, leftValue.value] do
        throwError "callable preparation merged aliased values in distinct source arguments"
      reject "the source argument has no retained runtime binding" do
        discard <| PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable arguments
          #[← argument 0 leftValue] #[rightParameter]
      reject "the runtime argument does not retain its specified source value" do
        discard <| PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable arguments
          #[← argument 0 rightValue, ← argument 1 leftValue] parameters
      reject "a callable source argument has duplicate runtime bindings" do
        discard <| PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable arguments
          #[← argument 0 leftValue, ← argument 0 leftValue] parameters
      reject "a runtime argument is outside the complete callable argument list" do
        discard <| PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable arguments
          #[← argument 2 leftValue] parameters
      reject "the runtime argument does not retain its specified source value" do
        discard <| PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable
          #[← context.close (mkNatLit 2), ← context.close (mkNatLit 3)]
          #[← argument 0 rightValue, ← argument 1 leftValue] parameters
      let function ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize (← `(fun (_h : True) (n : Nat) => n)) none
      let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close function)
      let (graph, function) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence, role := layout, parameters := #[some leftValue, some rightValue] }
        (.closure program #[])
      let formal := #[← context.close (mkConst ``True.intro), ← context.close left]
      let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context function formal
        #[← argument 1 leftValue] parameters
      let some layout := request.application
        | throwError "proof-bearing application lost its complete source argument layout"
      unless layout.arguments.map (·.wireIndex) == #[none, some 0] &&
          layout.arguments[0]?.map (·.source.kind) == some .proof do
        throwError "formal proof erasure changed the native application's wire positions"
      let .apply _ _ actual := request.action
        | throwError "proof erasure changed the application action"
      unless actual.size == 2 && (actual[0]?.bind id).isNone &&
          (actual[1]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some leftValue.value do
        throwError "a formal proof displaced a later actual application argument"
      let admitted ← request.admitInputs graph
      let .ok values := admitted.arguments graph
        | throwError "the proof-bearing input map is incomplete"
      let some proofRole := request.roles.arguments[0]?
        | throwError "the source proof role was erased from its telescope"
      let some valueRole := request.roles.arguments[1]?
        | throwError "the source data role is absent"
      let .ok bound := admitted.lookup graph valueRole.role.id
        | throwError "the source data role lost its actual binding"
      unless values.map (·.value) == #[leftValue.value] &&
          valueRole.role.id.address == .argument 1 && bound.source == .argument 1 do
        throwError "proof erasure changed the admitted source argument position"
      if (admitted.lookup graph proofRole.role.id).isOk then
        throwError "a formal proof acquired a computational input binding"
      let .ok suppliedProof := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 leftValue
        | throwError "the proof-position rejection control is absent"
      reject "a formal proof argument has no runtime value binding" do
        discard <| PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context function formal
          #[suppliedProof, ← argument 1 leftValue] parameters

-- A source callable and its let alias retain their own native application heads.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkConst ``Nat.add))
  let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let (graph, original) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
  withLocalDeclD `f (← inferType (mkConst ``Nat.add)) fun f => do
    withLetDecl `g (← inferType f) f fun g => do
      let bindings : Array LocalBinding := #[
        { id := ⟨"callable-source", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := f },
        { id := ⟨"callable-source", 1⟩, role := .definition, expression := g }]
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let mut parameters := #[]
      for binding in bindings do
        let .ok parameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id original
          | throwError "the source callable parameter is absent"
        parameters := parameters.push parameter
      let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker context parameters
      for binding in bindings do
        let .ok (some callable) := environment.lookup binding.id
          | throwError "the source callable binding is absent"
        unless callable.value == original.value &&
            (← callable.role.source.inContext context) == binding.expression do
          throwError "runtime capture changed the native source callable binding"
        let arguments := #[← context.close (mkNatLit 2), ← context.close (mkNatLit 3)]
        let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable arguments
          #[] parameters
        let application ← request.source.source.inContext context
        unless application.getAppFn == binding.expression do
          throwError "callable preparation changed the native source application head"
      let some node := graph.find original.value
        | throwError "the original callable node is absent"
      unless (← node.origin.role.source.inContext context) == mkConst ``Nat.add do
        throwError "source association changed the original callable producer"

-- Formal argument dependency survives substitution of a closed source index.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  withLocalDeclD `point (mkApp (mkConst ``Fin) (mkNatLit 7)) fun point => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[{
      id := ⟨"application-dependencies", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := point }]
    let function ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (n : Nat) (x : Fin n) => x)) none
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close function)
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
    let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
    let (_, callable) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
      (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[none] } (.closure program #[])
    let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable
      #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7), ← context.close point] #[] #[]
    let some layout := request.application
      | throwError "application preparation lost its native argument telescope"
    unless request.source.contextDependencies.isEmpty && layout.arguments.size == 2 &&
        layout.arguments[0]?.map (·.precedingDependencies) == some #[] &&
        layout.arguments[1]?.map (·.precedingDependencies) == some #[0] &&
        layout.arguments.map (·.wireIndex) == #[some 0, some 1] &&
        layout.resultDependencies == #[0] do
      throwError "source index substitution erased an actual argument's dependent role"
    layout.resultTypeFamily.withOpen fun _ family =>
      lambdaTelescope family fun arguments result => do
        unless arguments.size == 2 && result.isAppOf ``Fin &&
            result.appArg! == arguments[0]! do
          throwError "application preparation changed its complete native result-type family"
    let partialRequest ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable
      #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7)] #[] #[]
    let some partialLayout := partialRequest.application
      | throwError "partial application lost its native argument telescope"
    unless partialRequest.source.kind == .function && partialLayout.arguments.size == 1 &&
        partialLayout.resultDependencies == #[0] do
      throwError "partial application erased a retained argument from its remaining function type"

-- Equal source terms and packets retain distinct scoped input roles and actual occurrences.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let scalar ← context.close (mkNatLit 7)
  let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm scalar
  let function ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkConst ``Nat.add))
  let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
  let firstOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let secondOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let (graph, callable) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence := firstOccurrence, role := function, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
  let (older, first) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence := firstOccurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let (graph, second) ← liftM (m := IO) <| older.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence := secondOccurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let .ok left := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 first
    | throwError "the first equal-term input is absent"
  let .ok right := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 1 second
    | throwError "the second equal-term input is absent"
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable
    #[scalar, scalar] #[right, left] #[]
  let admitted ← request.admitInputs graph
  let some firstRole := request.roles.arguments[0]?
    | throwError "the first scoped role is absent"
  let some secondRole := request.roles.arguments[1]?
    | throwError "the second scoped role is absent"
  let .ok firstBinding := admitted.lookup graph firstRole.role.id
    | throwError "the first role lost its input"
  let .ok secondBinding := admitted.lookup graph secondRole.role.id
    | throwError "the second role lost its input"
  unless firstRole.role.source.expression == secondRole.role.source.expression &&
      firstRole.role.id != secondRole.role.id && first.value != second.value &&
      firstBinding.value.value == first.value && secondBinding.value.value == second.value do
    throwError "the role map merged equal source terms or distinct actual occurrences"
  if (admitted.lookup older firstRole.role.id).isOk then
    throwError "a role map recovered an input outside its visible snapshot"
  let .ok aliasedArgument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 1 first
    | throwError "the explicit input alias is absent"
  let next ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let aliases ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program next context callable
    #[scalar, scalar] #[left, aliasedArgument] #[]
  let aliasMap ← aliases.admitInputs graph
  let .ok values := aliasMap.arguments graph
    | throwError "explicitly aliased inputs could not be admitted"
  unless values.map (·.value) == #[first.value, first.value] do
    throwError "the role map merged explicitly aliased input positions"
  let some foreignRole := aliases.roles.arguments[0]?
    | throwError "the other occurrence lost its declared role"
  match admitted.lookup graph foreignRole.role.id with
  | .error message =>
    unless message == "the computational role belongs to a different scope" do throwError message
  | .ok _ => throwError "equal source roles escaped their computational scope"

module

public import CasCompiler.SelectionData
import all CasCompiler.SelectionData

public import CasCatalogue.Admission
public import CasContract.Port
public import CasCompiler.SourceCell
public import CasCompiler.SourceCartesian
public import CasCompiler.PointPath
public import CasCompiler.PointFamily

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend


def CategoricalPointOwner.operation : CategoricalPointOwner → String
  | .named owner => owner.operation
  | .component entry constructors _ => ConstructedCellComponent.address {
      constructors := constructors.map (·.raw)
      component := { cell := entry.id.raw, parameters := #[], receiver := .null, inverse := false } }
  | .cartesian entry => entry.id.raw ++ "#cartesian"
  | .binder entry => entry.id.raw
  | .action (.functor id) => id.raw ++ "#map"
  | .action edge => "action:" ++ (edgeImageDescriptor edge).compress ++ "#map"

def CategoricalPointOwner.input (owner : CategoricalPointOwner) : String :=
  match owner with
  | .action (.functor id) => id.raw ++ "#input"
  | .action edge => "action:" ++ (edgeImageDescriptor edge).compress ++ "#input"
  | _ => owner.operation


def CategoricalPointFamily.operation (family : CategoricalPointFamily) : String :=
  family.owner.operation

private def categoryStructure (bundle : Expr) : MetaM (Expr × Expr) := do
  let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]
  let instanceValue ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.str #[bundle]
  return (carrier, ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct
    #[some carrier, some instanceValue])

/-- Native categorical identity at the caller's actual object. It supplies the whole-arrow
case of the same generalized application; no scalar or terminal convention is substituted. -/
def categoricalPointIdentity (bundle object : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let (carrier, structureValue) ← categoryStructure bundle
  mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id #[some carrier, some structureValue, some object]

/-- Read the original native Hom endpoints; no search or declaration identity is inferred. -/
def categoricalPointEndpoints (arrow : Expr) : MetaM (Expr × Expr) := do
  let original ← inferType arrow
  let type ← if original.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure original else whnfR original
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    throwError "the selected point action requires its complete native Hom interface"
  return (← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[2]!, ← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[3]!)

private def finish (owner : CategoricalPointOwner) (declaration : Name)
    (universes : List Name) (declaredCount : Nat) (parameters : Array Expr)
    (category : CategoryExpr) (bundle arrow : Expr)
    (references : Array SelectedSourceReference)
    (component : Option NativeSourceCellComponent := none)
    (cartesian : Option NativeSourceCartesian := none) : MetaM CategoricalPointFamily := do
  let close := fun value => do
    let value ← instantiateMVars (← mkLambdaFVars parameters value
      (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false))
    if value.hasFVar || value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then
      throwError "the categorical point template lost its complete original parameter scope"
    check value
    return value
  let (source, target) ← categoricalPointEndpoints arrow
  let (carrier, structureValue) ← categoryStructure bundle
  let family ← withLocalDeclD `pointDomain carrier fun domain => do
    let composition ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
      #[some carrier, some structureValue, some domain, some source, some target]
    let .forallE _ pointType _ _ ← whnfR (← inferType composition)
      | throwError "categorical composition lost its original first map"
    withLocalDeclD `point pointType fun point => do
      let result := mkAppN composition #[point, arrow]
      check result
      mkLambdaFVars (parameters ++ #[domain, point]) result
        (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
  let family ← instantiateMVars family
  let arrowFamily ← instantiateMVars (← close arrow)
  let categoryFamily ← instantiateMVars (← close bundle)
  if family.hasMVar || family.hasLevelMVar || arrowFamily.hasMVar ||
      categoryFamily.hasMVar || categoryFamily.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the categorical point family has undetermined native parameters"
  return ⟨owner, declaration, universes, declaredCount, parameters.size, category,
    categoryFamily, arrowFamily, family, ← inferType family, false, true, references,
    ← component.mapM (·.mapM close), ← cartesian.mapM (·.mapM close)⟩

private def fixedPointCategory (state : SemanticState) (id : CategoryId) (arrow : Expr) :
    MetaM (NamedCategoryEntry × Expr) := do
  let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == id)
    | throwError "the point family lost its original named category"
  let bundleFamily ← nativeCategoryFamily state category.expression fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  let (arguments, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType bundleFamily)
  let bundle := mkAppN bundleFamily arguments
  let identity ← categoryIdentity bundle
  let map ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map #[identity]
  let (inputs, binders, _) ← forallMetaTelescope (← inferType map)
  let some index := binders.findIdx? (·.isExplicit)
    | throwError "the point category identity lost its native arrow slot"
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType inputs[index]!) (← inferType arrow) do
    throwError "the point arrow has another complete selected category"
  return (category, ← instantiateMVars bundle)

/-- Read the accepted native family before any specialization or runtime availability.
All cases construct ordinary native categorical applications from their original source. -/
opaque CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (owner : CategoricalPointOwner) :
    MetaM CategoricalPointFamily := withLCtx {} #[] do
  let state ← semanticState
  let declaration ← match owner with
    | .named (.morphism entry) => pure entry.declaration
    | .named (.application entry) => do
      let some declaration := entry.application
        | throwError "the original object has no published application"
      pure declaration
    | .component entry _ _ => pure entry.declaration
    | .cartesian entry => pure entry.declaration
    | .binder entry => pure entry.operation
    | .action edge => sourceActionDeclaration state edge
  let info ← checkedDeclaration declaration
  let head := mkConst declaration (info.levelParams.map Level.param)
  forallTelescopeReducing info.type fun parameters _ => do
    let application := mkAppN head parameters
    match owner with
    | .named selected => do
      match selected with
        | .morphism entry => do
          let #[original] := state.morphisms.filter (·.id == entry.id)
            | throwError "the point family lost its original morphism row"
          unless reprStr original == reprStr entry do
            throwError "the point family changed its original morphism owner"
        | .application entry => do
          let #[original] := state.objects.filter (·.id == entry.id)
            | throwError "the point family lost its original application row"
          unless reprStr original == reprStr entry do
            throwError "the point family changed its original application owner"
      let (category, bundle) ← fixedPointCategory state selected.category application
      let reference := match selected with
        | .morphism entry => SelectedSourceReference.named (.registered (.inr entry) category)
        | .application entry => SelectedSourceReference.named (.registered (.inl entry) category)
      finish owner declaration info.levelParams parameters.size parameters category.expression bundle
        application #[reference]
    | .component entry constructors inverse =>
      let mut cell ← nativeSourceCell entry application inverse
      for constructor in constructors.reverse do cell ← cell.construct constructor
      let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[cell.sourceBundle]
      withLocalDeclD `receiver carrier fun receiver => do
        let arrow ← cell.component ⟨receiver, none⟩
        let some original := arrow.cell
          | throwError "the component point family lost its complete native source"
        finish owner declaration info.levelParams parameters.size (parameters.push receiver)
          cell.target cell.targetBundle arrow.value cell.references (some original)
    | .cartesian entry =>
      let .familyReindex family := entry.expression.registrationKind
        | throwError "the cartesian point family is not a reindexing"
      let (source, _) ← functorCategoryBundles (← sourceFunctorValue application)
      let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[source]
      withLocalDeclD `receiver carrier fun receiver => do
        let arrow ← sourceCartesian entry application receiver
        let some original := arrow.cartesian
          | throwError "the cartesian point family lost its complete native source"
        finish owner declaration info.levelParams parameters.size (parameters.push receiver)
          (.familyTotal family) original.totalBundle arrow.value #[.functor entry]
            none (some original)
    | .binder entry =>
      let #[original] := state.binders.filter (·.id == entry.id)
        | throwError "the binder point family requires its exact accepted row"
      unless reprStr original == reprStr entry do
        throwError "the binder point family changed its accepted declaration or category"
      let (category, bundle) ← fixedPointCategory state entry.category application
      finish owner declaration info.levelParams parameters.size parameters category.expression bundle
        application #[.binder entry, .category category]
    | .action edge =>
      let (functor, category) ← categoricalActionValue state edge application
      let (sourceBundle, targetBundle) ← functorCategoryBundles functor
      let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[sourceBundle]
      withLocalDeclD `sourceObject carrier fun source =>
        withLocalDeclD `targetObject carrier fun target => do
          let map ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map
            #[none, none, none, none, some functor, some source, some target]
          let .forallE _ arrowType _ _ ← whnfR (← inferType map)
            | throwError "the functor point action lost its complete native arrow"
          withLocalDeclD `sourceArrow arrowType fun arrow => do
            let mapped := mkApp map arrow
            finish owner declaration info.levelParams parameters.size
              (parameters ++ #[source, target, arrow]) category targetBundle mapped
                (← sourceActionReferences state edge)

def CategoricalPointFamily.instantiate (family : CategoricalPointFamily) :
    MetaM (Expr × List Level) := do
  let levels ← family.universeParams.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  return (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels, levels)

/-- Preserve the actual native arrow in the whole-map case. The original domain and
identity-point slots remain explicit request inputs; no category law replaces the result
by a propositionally equal composite. -/
opaque CategoricalPointFamily.asWhole (family : CategoricalPointFamily) :
    MetaM CategoricalPointFamily := withLCtx {} #[] do
  if family.whole then return family
  let expression ← forallTelescopeReducing family.familyType fun inputs _ => do
    unless inputs.size == family.parameterCount + 2 do
      throwError "the whole point family lost its complete original input telescope"
    let arrow := mkAppN family.arrowFamily (inputs.extract 0 family.parameterCount)
    mkLambdaFVars inputs arrow (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
  check expression
  return { family with family := expression, familyType := ← inferType expression, whole := true }

/-- Formation of a native arrow retains its callable family, as formation of a named
morphism does. A later actual point or explicit whole-map request supplies the demand. -/
opaque CategoricalPointFamily.asReference (family : CategoricalPointFamily) :
    MetaM CategoricalPointFamily := do
  let familyType ← inferType family.arrowFamily
  return { family with
    family := family.arrowFamily
    familyType
    whole := true
    invocation := false }

/-- The exact selected arrow and complete category at the caller's original parameter slots. -/
def CategoricalPointFamily.arrowAt (family : CategoricalPointFamily) (levels : List Level)
    (parameters : Array Expr) : MetaM (Expr × Expr) := do
  unless levels.length == family.universeParams.length && parameters.size == family.parameterCount do
    throwError "the categorical point changed its original complete parameter telescope"
  let arrow := mkAppN (family.arrowFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels) parameters
  let category := mkAppN (family.categoryFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels) parameters
  return (arrow.headBeta, category.headBeta)

/-- A scalar continuation exists only when the accepted whole category has a native carrier
action on this exact arrow field. Full categorical maps do not require such a carrier. -/
def CategoricalPointFamily.carrierFamily? (family : CategoricalPointFamily) :
    MetaM (Option NativePointFamily) := do
  let routes ← SourceRoutes.forOwner family.category (.atom CategoryId.sets)
  let some candidates ← routes.finiteRoutes | return none
  if candidates.isEmpty then return none
  try
    return some (← NativePointFamily.prepare family.family family.universeParams
      fun parameters _ => do
        let bundle := (mkAppN family.categoryFamily
          (parameters.extract 0 family.parameterCount)).headBeta
        return ⟨.morphism, family.category, bundle, none, none⟩)
  catch error =>
    if CasCatalogue.Exception.isUnsupportedSource error ||
        CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity error then return none
    throw error

/-- The original complete native carrier action, when the caller has already checked its
whole-family path. It never manufactures a named category for a constructed bundle. -/
def CategoricalPointFamily.function (family : CategoricalPointFamily) (levels : List Level)
    (parameters : Array Expr) (arrow : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let (_, bundle) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
  sourceFunction ⟨arrow, some ⟨.morphism, family.category, bundle, none, none⟩⟩


/-- Project a checked replacement of the original declared family through the same native
arrow producer. The runtime supplies its selected checked derivation; this function preserves
that term and every prerequisite marker, and validates only its already fixed source type. -/
def CategoricalPointFamily.realizedArrow (family : CategoricalPointFamily) (levels : List Level)
    (parameters : Array Expr) (replacement : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let (expected, _) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
  let declaration := mkAppN (mkConst family.declaration levels)
    (parameters.extract 0 family.declarationParameterCount)
  checkRegisteredDomains (← inferType replacement) (← inferType declaration)
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType replacement) (← inferType declaration) do
    throwError "the selected derivation changed its original complete declaration family"
  let value ← match family.owner with
    | .named _ => pure replacement
    | .action (.functor _) => do
      let functor ← sourceFunctorValue replacement
      mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map #[none, none, none, none, some functor,
        some parameters[family.declarationParameterCount]!,
        some parameters[family.declarationParameterCount + 1]!,
        some parameters[family.declarationParameterCount + 2]!]
    | _ => throwError "the selected point owner has no checked computation derivation"
  checkRegisteredDomains (← inferType value) (← inferType expected)
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) (← inferType expected) do
    throwError "the selected derivation changed its original native arrow interface"
  return value

/-- The ordinary native postcomposition at the fixed complete category. Whole requests
preserve their original arrow; generalized requests retain the supplied domain and point. -/
def CategoricalPointFamily.resultAt (family : CategoricalPointFamily) (levels : List Level)
    (parameters : Array Expr) (arrow domain point : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let (expected, bundle) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
  checkRegisteredDomains (← inferType arrow) (← inferType expected)
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType arrow) (← inferType expected) do
    throwError "the point result changed its complete selected native arrow type"
  if family.whole then return arrow
  let (source, target) ← categoricalPointEndpoints arrow
  let (carrier, structureValue) ← categoryStructure bundle
  mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp #[some carrier, some structureValue,
    some domain, some source, some target, some point, some arrow]

/-- Retain the complete original generalized-point inputs beside its native map. -/
def CategoricalPointFamily.withRequest (family : CategoricalPointFamily) (levels : List Level)
    (parameters : Array Expr) (arrow domain source target point : Expr)
    (context : Option OpenContext := none) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let (expectedArrow, _) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
  let (expectedSource, expectedTarget) ← categoricalPointEndpoints expectedArrow
  let (expectedDomain, pointTarget) ← categoricalPointEndpoints point
  let inputs := #[arrow, domain, source, target, pointTarget,
    expectedArrow, expectedDomain, expectedSource, expectedTarget]
  let check : Array Expr → MetaM Unit := fun inputs => do
    checkRegisteredDomains inputs[1]! inputs[6]!
    checkRegisteredDomains inputs[2]! inputs[7]!
    checkRegisteredDomains inputs[3]! inputs[8]!
    checkRegisteredDomains inputs[4]! inputs[7]!
    unless ← isDefEq inputs[0]! inputs[5]! <&&> isDefEq inputs[1]! inputs[6]! <&&>
        isDefEq inputs[2]! inputs[7]! <&&> isDefEq inputs[3]! inputs[8]! <&&>
        isDefEq inputs[4]! inputs[7]! do
      throwError "the generalized point changed its complete original native inputs"
  match context with
  | some context => context.withOriginalSources inputs check
  | none => check inputs
  return { value := point, pointRequest := some (.categorical family
    ⟨arrow, domain, source, target, point⟩) }

/-- Check the scalar carrier and original domain of an explicit categorical point request. -/
def CategoricalPointFamily.checkScalarRequest (family : CategoricalPointFamily) (levels : List Level)
    (parameters : Array Expr) (arrow domain source target point originalDomain : Expr)
    (context : Option OpenContext := none) : MetaM Unit := do
  let (expectedArrow, _) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
  let (expectedSource, expectedTarget) ← categoricalPointEndpoints expectedArrow
  let function ← family.function levels parameters expectedArrow
  let .forallE _ expected _ _ ← whnfR (← inferType function)
    | throwError "the categorical arrow has no original scalar carrier interface"
  let inputs := #[← inferType point, arrow, domain, source, target,
    expected, expectedArrow, originalDomain, expectedSource, expectedTarget]
  let check : Array Expr → MetaM Unit := fun inputs => do
    checkRegisteredDomains inputs[0]! inputs[5]!
    checkRegisteredDomains inputs[2]! inputs[7]!
    checkRegisteredDomains inputs[3]! inputs[8]!
    checkRegisteredDomains inputs[4]! inputs[9]!
    unless ← isDefEq inputs[0]! inputs[5]! <&&> isDefEq inputs[1]! inputs[6]! <&&>
        isDefEq inputs[2]! inputs[7]! <&&> isDefEq inputs[3]! inputs[8]! <&&>
        isDefEq inputs[4]! inputs[9]! do
      throwError "the scalar categorical request changed its original complete native inputs"
  match context with
  | some context => context.withOriginalSources inputs check
  | none => check inputs

/-- Scalar requests retain the reader-authored point domain and every original input. -/
def CategoricalPointFamily.withScalarRequest (family : CategoricalPointFamily) (levels : List Level)
    (parameters : Array Expr) (arrow domain source target : Expr) (point : SourceSelection Expr)
    (context : Option OpenContext := none) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let some original := point.pointOrigin
    | throwError "a scalar categorical request requires its original generalized point"
  family.checkScalarRequest levels parameters arrow domain source target point.value original.domain context
  return { point with pointRequest := some (.categorical family
    ⟨arrow, domain, source, target, point.value⟩) }

/-- Original explicit nonproof declaration slots in the released parameter array. -/
opaque CategoricalPointFamily.explicitParameters (family : CategoricalPointFamily) :
    MetaM (Array Nat) := sourceDeclarationParameters family.declaration

/-- Retain the selected family, its complete original parameters, and the exact point
request as typed data. The value remains the original native categorical application. -/
def CategoricalPointFamily.selected (family : CategoricalPointFamily) (levels : List Level)
    (parameters : Array Expr) (domain : Expr) (point : SourceSelection Expr)
    (whole : Bool := false) (context : Option OpenContext := none) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let originalFamily := family
  let family ← if whole then family.asWhole else pure family
  let (arrow, bundle) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
  if family.whole then
    let (source, _) ← categoricalPointEndpoints arrow
    let inputs := #[domain, source, point.value, ← categoricalPointIdentity bundle source]
    let check : Array Expr → MetaM Unit := fun inputs => do
      checkRegisteredDomains inputs[0]! inputs[1]!
      unless ← isDefEq inputs[0]! inputs[1]! <&&> isDefEq inputs[2]! inputs[3]! do
        throwError "the whole native arrow requires its original source and identity point"
    match context with
    | some context => context.withOriginalSources inputs check
    | none => check inputs
  let arguments := if family.invocation then #[domain, point.value] else #[]
  let expression := mkAppN
    (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels) (parameters ++ arguments)
  check expression
  let original := mkAppN (mkConst family.declaration levels)
    (parameters.extract 0 family.declarationParameterCount)
  let pointRequest ← match point.pointRequest with
    | none => pure none
    | some (.categorical selected request) => do
      unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.point originalFamily).exactlyMatches (.point selected) do
        throwError "the point request changed its original selected family"
      pure (some (.categorical family request))
    | some (.named ..) =>
      throwError "a categorical point application requires its original categorical input record"
  return {
    value := expression
    originalApplication := some original
    application := some { family := .point family, universes := levels, parameters, arguments }
    category := some ⟨.morphism, family.category, bundle, none, none⟩
    pointRequest }

/-- Reopen the original selected arrow and its complete native descriptors through the
same declared parameter telescope. No category, constructor, or receiver is rediscovered. -/
def CategoricalPointFamily.arrowSelection (family : CategoricalPointFamily)
    (levels : List Level) (parameters : Array Expr) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let (arrow, bundle) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
  let instantiate := fun template => do
    let value := (mkAppN
      (template.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels) parameters).headBeta
    check value
    return value
  let component ← family.componentTemplate.mapM (·.mapM instantiate)
  let cartesian ← family.cartesianTemplate.mapM (·.mapM instantiate)
  let (source, target) ← categoricalPointEndpoints arrow
  let identity ← categoricalPointIdentity bundle source
  let selected ← if (← family.carrierFamily?).isSome then family.asReference else family.asWhole
  let point ← selected.withRequest levels parameters arrow source source target identity
  let result ← selected.selected levels parameters source point
  return { result with value := arrow, cell := component, cartesian }

/-- Attach the common point boundary at the original component producer. The complete
supplied cell and receiver remain its native data; a checked template never replaces them. -/
def NativeSourceCell.selectedComponent (cell : NativeSourceCell)
    (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let original ← cell.component receiver
  let some originalComponent := original.cell
    | throwError "the selected component lost its complete original cell"
  let application := cell.application.consumeMData
  let .const declaration levels := application.getAppFn
    | throwError "the selected cell lost its original declared application"
  let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner
    (.component cell.entry cell.constructors cell.inverse)
  unless declaration == family.declaration &&
      application.getAppNumArgs == family.declarationParameterCount do
    throwError "the selected cell changed its complete original declaration telescope"
  let parameters := application.getAppArgs.push receiver.value
  let prepared ← family.arrowSelection levels parameters
  let some expectedComponent := prepared.cell
    | throwError "the component family lost its original checked native template"
  let originalData : SourceSelection Expr := { value := original.value, cell := some originalComponent }
  let expectedData : SourceSelection Expr := { value := prepared.value, cell := some expectedComponent }
  unless originalData.exactlyMatches (fun _ _ => true) expectedData do
    throwError "the selected component changed an original cell, route, or constructor row"
  let terms := fun (component : NativeSourceCellComponent Expr) =>
    ((component.mapM fun term => do
      modify (·.push term)
      pure ()) : StateM (Array Expr) (NativeSourceCellComponent Unit)).run #[] |>.2
  let originalTerms := terms originalComponent
  let expectedTerms := terms expectedComponent
  unless originalTerms.size == expectedTerms.size do
    throwError "the selected component changed its complete native field table"
  for originalTerm in originalTerms, expectedTerm in expectedTerms do
    unless ← isDefEq originalTerm expectedTerm do
      throwError "the selected component changed an original native cell field"
  let some application := prepared.application
    | throwError "the selected component lost its original point application"
  let .point selected := application.family
    | throwError "the selected component changed its original point owner"
  let (source, target) ← categoricalPointEndpoints original.value
  let identity ← categoricalPointIdentity cell.targetBundle source
  let point ← selected.withRequest levels parameters original.value source source target identity
  let arguments := if selected.invocation then #[source, identity] else #[]
  return { original with
    application := some { application with arguments }
    pointRequest := point.pointRequest }

end CasCompiler
