public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.CategoricalPointSource
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Foundation.Lists
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.ConstructorRegistration
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Modules.CatalogueRegistration
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.FiniteSums
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.PolynomialPresentations
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.Polynomials

open Lean Meta Elab Command CasCatalogue CasCompiler

/-- Use the original native formals and one actual typed selection binder in each control. -/
private def withPointSelection {α : Type} (inputs : Array Expr)
    (selection : SourceSelection Expr)
    (action : OpenContext → SourceSelectionScope Expr → Expr → TermElabM α) :
    TermElabM α := do
  let identities ← CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let bindings ← inputs.mapM fun expression => do
    let allocated ← identities.fresh .sourceBinding
    return ({ id := ⟨allocated.worker, allocated.serial⟩,
      role := .parameter, expression } : LocalBinding)
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
  ({} : SourceSelectionScope Expr).withBinding identities context selection action

-- Ordinary list components, their inverse, and their Arrow-induced component retain
-- arbitrary generalized domains. The Arrow case must not require a named category row
-- or a fabricated carrier functor to Sets. Every assertion is on the actual native term.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[unit] := state.cells.filter (·.id == NaturalTransformationId.listUnit)
    | throwError "the independently accepted list unit is absent"
  let #[reverse] := state.cells.filter (·.id == NaturalTransformationId.listReverse)
    | throwError "the independently accepted list reversal is absent"
  let #[cartesian] := state.functors.filter (·.id == FunctorId.modulesReindex)
    | throwError "the independent incompatible owner fixture is absent"
  let otherOwner ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.cartesian cartesian)
  for owner in #[CategoricalPointOwner.component unit #[] false,
      .component reverse #[] false, .component reverse #[] true,
      .component reverse #[ConstructorId.arrow] false,
      .component reverse #[ConstructorId.arrow] true] do
    let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner owner
    checkWithKernel family.family
    checkWithKernel family.arrowFamily
    checkWithKernel family.categoryFamily
    for levels in #[family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
        family.universeParams.map Level.param] do
      let type := family.familyType.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
      forallTelescopeReducing type fun inputs _ => do
        unless inputs.size == family.parameterCount + 2 do
          throwError "a component lost its complete generalized-map telescope"
        let parameters := inputs.extract 0 family.parameterCount
        let domain := inputs[family.parameterCount]!
        let point := inputs[family.parameterCount + 1]!
        let (arrow, bundle) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
        let arrowSource ← family.arrowSelection levels parameters
        let some original := arrowSource.cell
          | throwError "the component family lost its original native cell envelope"
        unless original.receiver == parameters.back! do
          throwError "the component family replaced its actual selected receiver"
        let (source, target) ← categoricalPointEndpoints arrow
        withPointSelection inputs arrowSource fun context selections supplied => do
          let some wholeNative ← categoricalPointSource? context selections supplied
            | throwError "the native component did not enter the common point source"
          unless ← isDefEq wholeNative.value arrow do
            throwError "native component preparation replaced the original arrow"
          let identities ← CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
          let allocated ← identities.fresh .sourceBinding
          context.withLocalBinding ⟨allocated.worker, allocated.serial⟩ .result
              `retainedComponent (← inferType arrow) fun context retained => do
            if (← categoricalPointSource? context selections retained.expression).isSome then
              throwError "an already retained component was reconstructed as a new primitive family"
        let request ← family.withRequest levels parameters arrow domain source target point
        let some (.categorical selectedFamily retained) := request.pointRequest
          | throwError "the component lost its complete generalized request"
        unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.point family).exactlyMatches (.point selectedFamily) &&
            retained.domain == domain && retained.point == point && retained.arrow == arrow do
          throwError "the component replaced an original generalized-map input"
        let result ← family.selected levels parameters domain request
        let composite := (mkAppN
          (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels) inputs).headBeta
        withPointSelection inputs result fun context selections supplied => do
          let some originalComposite ← categoricalPointSource? context selections supplied
            | throwError "the native generalized component did not enter the common source"
          unless ← isDefEq originalComposite.value composite do
            throwError "native component preparation changed the original preceding map"
          let some binding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression == supplied)
            | throwError "the component lost its exact original source binder"
          let reference ← family.asReference
          let some originalApplication := result.application
            | throwError "the component lost its original application"
          for changed in #[otherOwner, reference] do
            let changedSelection := { result with
              application := some { originalApplication with family := .point changed } }
            let rejected ← try
                discard <| selections.merge
                  (({} : SourceSelectionScope Expr).insert binding.id changedSelection)
                pure false
              catch _ => pure true
            unless rejected do
              throwError "a source component changed its fixed owner or generalized request mode"
        checkWithKernel result.value
        let (resultDomain, resultTarget) ← categoricalPointEndpoints result.value
        unless ← isDefEq resultDomain domain <&&> isDefEq resultTarget target do
          throwError "the component changed the original generalized domain or target"
        let some (restored, actualLevels, parametersAgain) ←
            CategoricalPointFamily.ofSelection? result
          | throwError "the component lost its original application"
        let some application := result.application
          | throwError "the component lost its original application"
        let actual := parametersAgain ++ application.arguments
        unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.point restored).exactlyMatches (.point family) &&
            actualLevels == levels && actual.extract 0 family.parameterCount == parameters &&
            actual[family.parameterCount]? == some domain &&
            actual[family.parameterCount + 1]? == some request.value do
          throwError "the component did not retain the exact actual source positions"
        let identity ← categoricalPointIdentity bundle source
        let whole ← family.selected levels parameters source { value := identity } (whole := true)
        checkWithKernel whole.value
        unless ← isDefEq whole.value arrow do
          throwError "the whole component request replaced its actual native arrow"
        let some (wholeFamily, _, originalParameters) ← CategoricalPointFamily.ofSelection? whole
          | throwError "the whole component request lost its original native source"
        unless wholeFamily.whole do throwError "the whole component became a generalized composite"
        checkWithKernel wholeFamily.family
        let some wholeApplication := whole.application
          | throwError "the whole component request lost its original native application"
        unless originalParameters ++ wholeApplication.arguments == parameters ++ #[source, identity] do
          throwError "the whole component request replaced an original native input"
        let rejected ← try
            discard <| family.selected levels parameters domain { value := point } (whole := true)
            pure false
          catch _ => pure true
        unless rejected do throwError "an arbitrary original point was accepted as the whole arrow"

-- The canonical family transport retains the actual selected base map even under
-- rigid independent source-ring, target-ring and module parameters.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let #[entry] := (← semanticState).functors.filter (·.id == FunctorId.modulesReindex)
    | throwError "the independently accepted module reindexing is absent"
  let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.cartesian entry)
  checkWithKernel family.family
  checkWithKernel family.arrowFamily
  checkWithKernel family.categoryFamily
  for levels in #[family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
      family.universeParams.map Level.param] do
    let type := family.familyType.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
    forallTelescopeReducing type fun inputs _ => do
      let parameters := inputs.extract 0 family.parameterCount
      let (arrow, _) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
      let arrowSource ← family.arrowSelection levels parameters
      let some original := arrowSource.cartesian
        | throwError "the cartesian family lost its original native envelope"
      unless original.entry.id == entry.id && original.receiver == parameters.back! do
        throwError "the cartesian family replaced its reindexing or receiver"
      let explicit ← family.explicitParameters
      let #[baseIndex] := explicit
        | throwError "the original module reindexing changed its actual base-map interface"
      unless original.baseMap == parameters[baseIndex]! do
        throwError "the cartesian family recovered a different base map from its endpoints"
      withPointSelection inputs arrowSource fun context selections supplied => do
        let some wholeNative ← categoricalPointSource? context selections supplied
          | throwError "the native cartesian arrow did not enter the common point source"
        checkWithKernel wholeNative.value
        unless ← isDefEq wholeNative.value arrow do
          throwError "the cartesian whole request replaced the original native lift"
      let result ← family.selected levels parameters inputs[family.parameterCount]!
        { value := inputs[family.parameterCount + 1]! }
      checkWithKernel result.value
      unless result.value.containsFVar parameters[baseIndex]!.fvarId! do
        throwError "the generalized cartesian request discarded its actual base-map input"

-- A derived action keeps both actual original endpoints and its source arrow as
-- separate inputs. The classifier and constructor cases use the unchanged native
-- action mechanism; no finite published-path inventory bounds their formation.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  for edge in #[EdgeRef.functor FunctorId.setsList,
      .classifierForget ClassifierId.setsFinite,
      .constructMap ConstructorId.arrow (.functor FunctorId.setsList)] do
    let objectFamily ← SourceActionFamily.forEdge edge
    checkWithKernel objectFamily.family
    for levels in #[objectFamily.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
        objectFamily.universeParams.map Level.param] do
      forallTelescopeReducing
          (objectFamily.familyType.instantiateLevelParams objectFamily.universeParams levels)
          fun inputs _ => do
        let parameters := inputs.extract 0 objectFamily.parameterCount
        let receiver := inputs[objectFamily.parameterCount]!
        let selected ← objectFamily.selected levels parameters receiver
        checkWithKernel selected.value
        let some (restored, actualLevels, originalParameters, originalReceiver) ←
            SourceActionFamily.ofSelection? selected
          | throwError "the object action lost its complete native source witness"
        unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.objectAction restored).exactlyMatches
            (.objectAction objectFamily) && actualLevels == levels &&
            originalParameters.push originalReceiver == inputs do
          throwError "the canonical object action changed an original parameter or receiver"
    let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.action edge)
    checkWithKernel family.family
    checkWithKernel family.arrowFamily
    checkWithKernel family.categoryFamily
    for levels in #[family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
        family.universeParams.map Level.param] do
      let type := family.familyType.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
      forallTelescopeReducing type fun inputs _ => do
        unless family.parameterCount == family.declarationParameterCount + 3 do
          throwError "a derived map discarded its actual source, target or arrow input"
        let parameters := inputs.extract 0 family.parameterCount
        let domain := inputs[family.parameterCount]!
        let point := inputs[family.parameterCount + 1]!
        let result ← family.selected levels parameters domain { value := point }
        checkWithKernel result.value
        let some (original, actualLevels, actualParameters) ←
            CategoricalPointFamily.ofSelection? result
          | throwError "a derived map lost its complete original owner"
        let some application := result.application
          | throwError "a derived map lost its complete original input table"
        let actual := actualParameters ++ application.arguments
        unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.point original).exactlyMatches (.point family) &&
            actualLevels == levels &&
            actual.extract family.declarationParameterCount family.parameterCount ==
            parameters.extract family.declarationParameterCount family.parameterCount do
          throwError "a derived map replaced an original input by an equal endpoint"

-- Public field admission checks the original native field, never an arbitrary suffix.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let state ← semanticState
  unless (← PublishedPorts.family? state "fun.sets.list#map") == some (.functor FunctorId.setsList) do
    throwError "the public list map lost its accepted native family"
  if (← PublishedPorts.family? state "fun.sets.list#invented").isSome then
    throwError "an unregistered suffix acquired a native operation"
  let failed ← try
      let #[entry] := state.cells.filter (·.id == NaturalTransformationId.listUnit)
        | throwError "the original noninvertible cell is absent"
      discard <| CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.component entry #[] true)
      pure false
    catch error =>
      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? error == some .invalid do throw error
      pure true
  unless failed do throwError "a noninvertible native component acquired an inverse"

-- Binders use their independently accepted complete operation family. The actual
-- bound/range parameters and supplied admitted map remain native source inputs.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  for id in #["bind.sets.finite_sum", "bind.sets.finite_product"] do
    let #[entry] := (← semanticState).binders.filter (·.id.raw == id)
      | throwError "the original finite binder is absent"
    let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.binder entry)
    checkWithKernel family.family
    checkWithKernel family.arrowFamily
    for levels in #[family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
        family.universeParams.map Level.param] do
      forallTelescopeReducing
          (family.familyType.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels) fun inputs _ => do
        let parameters := inputs.extract 0 family.parameterCount
        let (arrow, _) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
        let arrowSource ← family.arrowSelection levels parameters
        withPointSelection inputs arrowSource fun context selections supplied => do
          let some whole ← categoricalPointSource? context selections supplied
            | throwError "the original binder did not enter the common native source"
          checkWithKernel whole.value
          unless ← isDefEq whole.value arrow do
            throwError "the native binder was replaced by another arrow"
        let result ← family.selected levels parameters inputs[family.parameterCount]!
          { value := inputs[family.parameterCount + 1]! }
        let some (restored, actualLevels, actualParameters) ←
            CategoricalPointFamily.ofSelection? result
          | throwError "the binder lost its original point selection"
        let some application := result.application
          | throwError "the binder lost its original application inputs"
        unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.point restored).exactlyMatches (.point family) &&
            actualLevels == levels && actualParameters ++ application.arguments == inputs do
          throwError "the binder changed a complete original parameter"

-- Whole named morphisms and object applications use the same native categorical family;
-- their existing scalar carrier path remains a separately checked consumer of that family.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let state ← semanticState
  let mut owners : Array PointFamilyOwner := #[]
  for declaration in #[
      ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.PolynomialPresentations.firstConstants,
      ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.PolynomialPresentations.secondConstants] do
    let #[entry] := state.morphisms.filter (·.declaration == declaration)
      | throwError "the original named map fixture is absent"
    owners := owners.push (.morphism entry)
  let #[application] := state.objects.filter (·.id.raw == "obj.sets.polynomials")
    | throwError "the original polynomial application is absent"
  owners := owners.push (.application application)
  for owner in owners do
    let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.named owner)
    unless family.operation == owner.operation do
      throwError "the whole named map acquired another public operation"
    checkWithKernel family.family
    checkWithKernel family.arrowFamily
    checkWithKernel family.categoryFamily
    for levels in #[family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
        family.universeParams.map Level.param] do
      forallTelescopeReducing
          (family.familyType.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels) fun inputs _ => do
        let parameters := inputs.extract 0 family.parameterCount
        let (arrow, bundle) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
        let (source, _) ← categoricalPointEndpoints arrow
        let identity ← categoricalPointIdentity bundle source
        let whole ← family.selected levels parameters source { value := identity } (whole := true)
        checkWithKernel whole.value
        unless ← isDefEq whole.value arrow do
          throwError "the whole named request changed the original native map"
        let some (restored, actualLevels, originalParameters) ←
            CategoricalPointFamily.ofSelection? whole
          | throwError "the whole named map lost its source selection"
        let some application := whole.application
          | throwError "the whole named map lost its original native inputs"
        unless restored.whole && actualLevels == levels &&
            originalParameters ++ application.arguments == parameters ++ #[source, identity] do
          throwError "the whole named map replaced its original complete input slots"

module

public import CasCompiler.CategoricalPointFamily
public import CasCompiler.PublishedPorts
public import CasCompiler.SelectionScope

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue

/-- Consume the complete family retained by the exact selected source producer. The actual
native expression supplies no owner, operation address, or replacement argument table. -/
def CategoricalPointFamily.ofSelection? (selection : SourceSelection Expr) :
    MetaM (Option (CategoricalPointFamily × List Level × Array Expr)) := do
  let some application := selection.application | return none
  let .point family := application.family | return none
  unless selection.formalBindings.isEmpty &&
      application.universes.length == family.universeParams.length &&
      application.parameters.size == family.parameterCount &&
      application.arguments.size == (if family.invocation then 2 else 0) do
    throwError "the categorical point lost its complete original argument telescope"
  if let some request := selection.pointRequest then
    let .categorical original _ := request
      | throwError "the categorical point changed its original request kind"
    unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.point family).exactlyMatches (.point original) do
      throwError "the categorical point changed its original selected request family"
  return some (family, application.universes, application.parameters)

/-- Resolve only an explicitly bound selection, specializing every retained field at the
same original formal positions. An unselected native arrow does not create a new request. -/
def categoricalPointSource? (context : OpenContext) (scope : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
    (expression : Expr) : MetaM (Option (SourceSelection Expr)) := do
  let some selected := scope.findAt? context expression.getAppFn | return none
  let selected ← selected.specialize expression.getAppArgs
  let some _ ← CategoricalPointFamily.ofSelection? selected | return none
  return some selected

/-- The original object action retains its accepted complete edge family and actual receiver
beside the native term. This boundary checks that carried table without interpreting its body. -/
def SourceActionFamily.ofSelection? (selection : SourceSelection Expr) :
    MetaM (Option (SourceActionFamily × List Level × Array Expr × Expr)) := do
  let some application := selection.application | return none
  let .objectAction family := application.family | return none
  unless selection.formalBindings.isEmpty &&
      application.universes.length == family.universeParams.length &&
      application.parameters.size == family.parameterCount do
    throwError "the object action lost its complete original argument telescope"
  let #[receiver] := application.arguments
    | throwError "the object action changed its exact original receiver slot"
  return some (family, application.universes, application.parameters, receiver)

end CasCompiler

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let categoryEntry ← selectCategory (← semanticState) "Sets"
  let levels := (← checkedDeclaration categoryEntry.declaration).levelParams.map Level.param
  let sets ← empty.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Sets" levels #[]
  let objectType ← empty.elaborate Syntax.missing fun context => do
    mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[← sets.value.source.inContext context]
  let session ← empty.assume `h (← `(True))
  let cases := #[
    (NaturalTransformationId.listUnit, false),
    (NaturalTransformationId.listJoin, false),
    (NaturalTransformationId.listReverse, false),
    (NaturalTransformationId.listReverse, true)]
  for (id, inverse) in cases do
    let cell ← session.cell Syntax.missing id #[] sets inverse
    unless cell.transformation.source.context.entries.size == session.context.entries.size do
      throwError "whole source cell formation changed its complete formal scope"
    let objects ← session.assumeTerm `X objectType
    let object ← objects.term (← `(term| $(mkIdent `X):ident))
    let selected ← objects.cellComponent Syntax.missing cell object
    let .registered entry arguments direction := selected.cell.derivation
      | throwError "the original source cell lost its registered derivation"
    unless entry.id == id && direction == inverse && arguments.isEmpty &&
        selected.value.source.context.entries.size == objects.context.entries.size do
      throwError "source cell formation changed its role, direction or complete scope"
    selected.value.source.withOpen fun bindings value => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let transformation ← selected.cell.transformation.source.inContext context
      let left ← selected.cell.left.source.inContext context
      let right ← selected.cell.right.source.inContext context
      let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans #[left, right]
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType transformation) expected do
        throwError "the retained transformation has different complete native endpoints"
      let actualObject ← selected.object.source.inContext context
      let component ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[transformation, actualObject]
      unless ← isDefEq value component do
        throwError "source component formation replaced its actual directed action"
      let declaration := Lean.mkConst entry.declaration levels
      let original ← if entry.invertible then
          mkAppM (if inverse then ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv else ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom)
            #[declaration]
        else pure declaration
      let originalComponent ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[original, actualObject]
      unless ← isDefEq value originalComponent do
        throwError "source component formation changed the independently declared component"
      unless value.getUsedConstants.contains entry.declaration &&
          value.containsFVar bindings[1]!.expression.fvarId! do
        throwError "source component formation discarded its declaration or generic object"
      checkWithKernel value
  let rejected ← try
    discard <| session.cell Syntax.missing NaturalTransformationId.listUnit #[] sets true
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do throwError "a noninvertible source cell acquired an inverse"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let rings ← empty.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Rings" [.param `u] #[]
  let ringType ← empty.elaborate Syntax.missing fun context => do
    mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[← rings.value.source.inContext context]
  let parameters ← empty.assumeTerm `R ringType
  let ring ← parameters.term (← `(term| $(mkIdent `R):ident))
  let modules ← parameters.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Modules" [.param `u, .param `u] #[ring]
  let arrows ← parameters.unaryCategory Syntax.missing ConstructorId.arrow modules
  let arrowType ← parameters.elaborate Syntax.missing fun context => do
    mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[← arrows.value.source.inContext context]
  for inverse in #[false, true] do
    let cell ← parameters.cell Syntax.missing ⟨"cell.modules.coimage_image"⟩ #[ring] arrows inverse
    let shadowed ← parameters.assumeTerm `R ringType

    let object ← objects.term (← `(term| $(mkIdent `f):ident))
    let selected ← objects.cellComponent Syntax.missing cell object
    selected.value.source.withOpen fun bindings value => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let scalar := bindings[0]!.expression

      let iso ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Modules.Operations.coimageImageIso #[scalar]

      let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[transformation, object]
      unless ← isDefEq value expected do
        throwError "the module comparison replaced its original scalar or directed component"
      unless value.containsFVar scalar.fvarId! && value.containsFVar object.fvarId! &&
          !value.containsFVar bindings[1]!.expression.fvarId! do
        throwError "the module comparison rebound an original source parameter after shadowing"
      let target ← selected.cell.target.value.source.inContext context
      let (_, actualTarget) ← functorCategoryBundles
        (← selected.cell.left.source.inContext context)
      unless ← isDefEq target actualTarget do
        throwError "the module comparison discarded its complete native target category"
      checkWithKernel value
    let otherRing ← objects.term (← `(term| $(mkIdent `R):ident))
    let otherModules ← objects.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Modules"
      [.param `u, .param `u] #[otherRing]
    let otherArrows ← objects.unaryCategory Syntax.missing ConstructorId.arrow otherModules
    let otherType ← objects.elaborate Syntax.missing fun context => do
      mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[← otherArrows.value.source.inContext context]
    let otherObjects ← objects.assumeTerm `g otherType
    let otherObject ← otherObjects.term (← `(term| $(mkIdent `g):ident))
    let rejected ← try
      discard <| otherObjects.cellComponent Syntax.missing cell otherObject
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless rejected do throwError "a source comparison changed its independently chosen scalar"
    let otherCell ← otherObjects.cell Syntax.missing ⟨"cell.modules.coimage_image"⟩
      #[otherRing] otherArrows (!inverse)
    let invalidComposition ← try
      discard <| otherObjects.composeCells Syntax.missing cell otherCell
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless invalidComposition do
      throwError "cell composition identified two independently chosen scalar categories"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let entry ← selectCategory (← semanticState) "Sets"
  let levels := (← checkedDeclaration entry.declaration).levelParams.map Level.param
  let sets ← empty.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Sets" levels #[]
  let objectType ← empty.elaborate Syntax.missing fun context => do
    mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[← sets.value.source.inContext context]
  let join ← empty.cell Syntax.missing NaturalTransformationId.listJoin #[] sets
  let reverse ← empty.cell Syntax.missing NaturalTransformationId.listReverse #[] sets
  let composite ← empty.composeCells Syntax.missing join reverse
  let .vertical (.registered first _ _) (.registered second _ _) := composite.derivation
    | throwError "vertical composition lost its original directed derivations"
  unless first.id == NaturalTransformationId.listJoin &&
      second.id == NaturalTransformationId.listReverse do
    throwError "vertical composition reordered its original source cells"
  let reversed ← empty.inverseCell Syntax.missing reverse
  let invertible ← empty.composeCells Syntax.missing reverse reversed
  let inverted ← empty.inverseCell Syntax.missing invertible
  let horizontal ← empty.horizontalCells Syntax.missing join reverse
  let .horizontal (.registered horizontalFirst _ _) (.registered horizontalSecond _ _) :=
      horizontal.derivation
    | throwError "horizontal composition lost its original ordered source derivations"
  unless horizontalFirst.id == NaturalTransformationId.listJoin &&
      horizontalSecond.id == NaturalTransformationId.listReverse do
    throwError "horizontal composition changed its original source cells"
  let horizontalIso ← empty.horizontalCells Syntax.missing reverse reversed
  let horizontalInverse ← empty.inverseCell Syntax.missing horizontalIso
  for (whole, inverse) in #[(invertible, inverted), (horizontalIso, horizontalInverse)] do
    let some iso := whole.isomorphism
      | throwError "invertible composition lost its actual native isomorphism witness"
    iso.source.withOpen fun bindings value => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let left ← whole.left.source.inContext context
      let right ← whole.right.source.inContext context
      let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[left, right]
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) expected do
        throwError "the retained isomorphism has different complete native endpoints"
      let hom ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[value]
      let inv ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv #[value]
      unless ← isDefEq hom (← whole.transformation.source.inContext context) <&&>
          isDefEq inv (← inverse.transformation.source.inContext context) do
        throwError "the native isomorphism does not witness the retained directed actions"
      checkWithKernel value
  let objects ← empty.assumeTerm `X objectType
  let object ← objects.term (← `(term| $(mkIdent `X):ident))
  for (cell, invert) in #[(composite, false), (inverted, true)] do
    let component ← objects.cellComponent Syntax.missing cell object
    component.value.source.withOpen fun bindings value => do
      let join := Lean.mkConst ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Lists.listJoinCell levels
      let reverse := Lean.mkConst ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Lists.listReverseCell levels
      let hom ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[reverse]
      let inv ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv #[reverse]
      let expected ← if invert then
          mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp #[hom, inv]
        else mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp #[join, hom]
      let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[expected, bindings[0]!.expression]
      unless ← isDefEq value expected do
        throwError "cell composition changed its actual source action or inverse order"
      checkWithKernel value
  let horizontalComponent ← objects.cellComponent Syntax.missing horizontal object
  horizontalComponent.value.source.withOpen fun bindings value => do
    let join := Lean.mkConst ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Lists.listJoinCell levels
    let reverse := Lean.mkConst ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Lists.listReverseCell levels
    let hom ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[reverse]
    let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.hcomp #[join, hom]
    let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[expected, bindings[0]!.expression]
    unless ← isDefEq value expected do
      throwError "horizontal composition changed the original source actions"
    checkWithKernel value
  let invalidOrder ← try
    discard <| empty.composeCells Syntax.missing reverse join
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless invalidOrder do throwError "cell composition ignored its complete middle functor"
  let otherSets ← empty.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Sets"
    (levels.map fun _ => .param `otherUniverse) #[]
  let otherReverse ← empty.cell Syntax.missing NaturalTransformationId.listReverse #[] otherSets
  let invalidCategory ← try
    discard <| empty.horizontalCells Syntax.missing reverse otherReverse
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless invalidCategory do
    throwError "horizontal composition specialized incompatible rigid category universes"
  for noninvertible in #[composite, horizontal] do
    let invalidInverse ← try
      discard <| empty.inverseCell Syntax.missing noninvertible
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless invalidInverse do
      throwError "a composite acquired an inverse of a noninvertible source cell"

public import CasCompiler.LimitFamily
import all CasCompiler.SelectionData

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue

/-- One compiler-prepared construction component keeps the exact retained owner,
complete actual cone and original typed index beside its unchanged native arrow. -/
structure NativeConstructionLeg where
  private mk ::
  owner : Expr
  selection : NativeLimitSelection
  cone : Expr
  index : Expr
  value : Expr

/-- Form only the source-native component; ownership remains with the original
runtime callback. No returned endpoint or diagram object is evaluated here. -/
opaque NativeConstructionLeg.prepare (owner : Expr) (selection : NativeLimitSelection)
    (cone index : Expr) : MetaM NativeConstructionLeg := do
  let value ← selection.legAt cone index
  return ⟨owner, selection, cone, index, value⟩

/-- Carry the authenticated original owner and complete construction into the typed source
record. The supplied cone and native index are the ones used by prepare; no endpoint or
equal native descriptor chooses an owner at this boundary. -/
opaque NativeConstructionLeg.selected (leg : NativeConstructionLeg) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let construction ← NativeLimitSelection.ofSource leg.selection.source leg.owner
  check leg.value
  return {
    value := leg.value
    leg := some ⟨construction, leg.index, leg.value⟩
    category := some {
      role := .morphism
      expression := leg.selection.source.category
      bundle := leg.selection.source.bundle } }

/-- Open the original full owner telescope. This supports both a raw presentation
and a created source cone; each caller supplies its already retained owner family.
All implicit, computational and proof positions stay in their original order. -/
opaque withConstructionParameters (ownerFamily : SelectedLimitOwner Expr) (construction : Name)
    (count : Nat) (action : Array Expr → NativeLimitSelection → MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  check ownerFamily.selection.receiver
  if ownerFamily.selection.receiver.hasMVar || ownerFamily.selection.receiver.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "a construction endpoint has an unresolved original owner telescope"
  forallTelescope (← inferType ownerFamily.selection.receiver) fun parameters _ => do
    unless parameters.size == count do
      throwError "a construction endpoint changed its complete original parameter positions"
    let selected ← ownerFamily.specialize parameters
    unless selected.source.construction == construction && !construction.isAnonymous do
      throwError "a construction endpoint changed its original construction selection"
    action parameters selected

/-- Validate a supplied original parameter position against the diagram-side endpoint
of this exact native leg. The check takes place under the full rigid original owner
telescope. The original typed index is retained by exact positional back-substitution.
Native conversion checks a Hom interface; it never produces an endpoint value,
chooses a runtime operand, or evaluates a diagram object for later storage. -/
opaque checkConstructionLegEndpointAt (ownerFamily : SelectedLimitOwner Expr)
    (selected : NativeLimitSelection) (parameters : Array Expr)
    (indexFamily index : Expr) (target : Bool) (position : Nat)
    (path : Array Name := #[])
    (alternatives : Array (Nat × Array Name) := #[]) : MetaM Unit := do
  let rebound ← ownerFamily.specialize parameters
  unless rebound.source.construction == selected.source.construction &&
      rebound.source.row == selected.source.row &&
      rebound.source.declaration == selected.source.declaration &&
      rebound.source.colimit == selected.source.colimit &&
      rebound.source.diagram.equal selected.source.diagram &&
      rebound.source.cone.equal selected.source.cone do
    throwError "a construction endpoint changed its original complete source interface"
  unless target != selected.source.colimit do
    throwError "the original construction parameter check requires its diagram-side endpoint"
  check indexFamily
  if indexFamily.hasMVar || indexFamily.hasLevelMVar ||
      index.hasMVar || index.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "a construction endpoint has an unresolved original typed index"
  let originalIndex := indexFamily.betaRev parameters.reverse (preserveMData := true)
  check originalIndex
  unless originalIndex.equal index do
    throwError "a construction endpoint changed its original typed index position"
  withConstructionParameters ownerFamily selected.source.construction parameters.size
    fun formals formal => do
      -- Every listed route belongs to the same independently supplied actual
      -- binding. Validate all routes before trying native conversion, so an
      -- invalid original position cannot be hidden by another matching route.
      let mut candidates := #[]
      for (originalPosition, originalPath) in #[(position, path)] ++ alternatives do
        let some parameter := formals[originalPosition]?
          | throwError "a construction endpoint has no such original declaration position"
        if ← isProof parameter then
          throwError "a formal hypothesis is not a computational endpoint supplier"
        let mut candidate := parameter
        for projection in originalPath do
          unless ((← getEnv).getProjectionFnInfo? projection).isSome do
            throwError "a construction endpoint path is not an original native projection"
          candidate ← mkAppM projection #[candidate]
          if ← isProof candidate then
            throwError "a formal native field is not a computational endpoint supplier"
        candidates := candidates.push candidate
      let formalIndex := indexFamily.betaRev formals.reverse (preserveMData := true)
      check formalIndex
      let arrow ← formal.legAt formal.source.cone formalIndex
      let type ← instantiateMVars (← inferType arrow)
      unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
        throwError "the construction component lost its complete native Hom interface"
      let slot := if target then 3 else 2
      let some endpoint := type.getAppArgs[slot]?
        | throwError "the construction component lost its native endpoint position"
      let mut matched : Option Expr := none
      for candidate in candidates do
        if matched.isNone && (← withoutModifyingState (isDefEq endpoint candidate)) then
          matched := some candidate
      let some candidate := matched
        | throwError "the construction endpoint differs from every supplied original declaration position"
      let expected := mkAppN type.getAppFn (type.getAppArgs.set! slot candidate)
      -- A checked identity at the required Hom type checks native conversion in
      -- the kernel. The term is transient interface validation, not a computation.
      let checked ← mkAppOptM ``id #[some expected, some arrow]
      let locals := (← getLCtx).foldl (fun values declaration =>
        values.push (mkFVar declaration.fvarId)) (#[] : Array Expr)
      let closed ← mkLambdaFVars locals (← instantiateMVars checked)
        (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
      if closed.hasFVar || closed.hasMVar || closed.hasLevelMVar || closed.hasSorry then
        throwError "the construction endpoint did not close over its full rigid native scope"
      checkWithKernel closed

end CasCompiler

module

import CasCompiler.ConstructionEndpoint
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Limits.Registration
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.ConstructionEndpoint
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Limits.Registration

open Lean Meta Elab Command CasCompiler CasCatalogue

-- Both declared parameter positions specialize to the same native object. Only
-- the original rigid position, not that specialized equality, validates the leg.
-- The existing native diagram and index are used for limits and colimits.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  for identifier in #["lim.sets.product", "colim.sets.coproduct"] do
    let family ← LimitFamily.forId ⟨identifier⟩
    for levels in #[family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
        family.universeParams.map Level.param] do
      let declaration := family.presentationFamily.instantiateLevelParams
        family.universeParams levels
      forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration) fun actual _ => do
        unless actual.size == 2 do
          throwError "the original binary presentation changed its complete input telescope"
        let some first := actual[0]?
          | throwError "the binary presentation lost its first original input"
        let parameters := actual.set! 1 first
        let construction ← mkFreshUserName `originalEndpointControl
        let original ← family.prepareOwner identities levels construction
        let whole ← family.selectedAtOwner original levels parameters
        let some application := whole.application
          | throwError "the original whole cone lost its source selection"
        let some ownerFamily := application.ownerSelection
          | throwError "the original whole cone lost its complete selected owner"
        let some selected := whole.limit
          | throwError "the original whole cone lost its native construction selection"
        unless application.family.exactlyMatches (.limit family) &&
            application.universes == levels &&
            application.parameters.size == parameters.size &&
            (application.parameters.zip parameters).all (fun (left, right) => left.equal right) do
          throwError "the original whole cone changed its complete native parameter positions"
        let expectedOwner : SourceSelection Expr := {
          value := original.selection.receiver, limit := some original.selection,
          formalBindings := original.formalBindings }
        let retainedOwner : SourceSelection Expr := {
          value := ownerFamily.selection.receiver, limit := some ownerFamily.selection,
          formalBindings := ownerFamily.formalBindings }
        unless retainedOwner.exactlyMatches Expr.equal expectedOwner &&
            (← family.ownerFamily ownerFamily).equal original.selection.receiver do
          throwError "the endpoint checker replaced the original formal owner family"
        let left ← instantiateMVars
          (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Discrete.mk
            #[mkConst ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair.left])
        let right ← instantiateMVars
          (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Discrete.mk
            #[mkConst ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair.right])
        let indexFamily ← withConstructionParameters ownerFamily construction parameters.size
          fun formals _ => mkLambdaFVars formals left
            (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
        checkConstructionLegEndpointAt ownerFamily selected parameters indexFamily left
          (!family.entry.colimit) 0
        -- Runtime may authenticate the same actual binding at both original
        -- parameter slots. The explicit alias table admits the matching slot.
        checkConstructionLegEndpointAt ownerFamily selected parameters indexFamily left
          (!family.entry.colimit) 1 #[] #[(0, #[])]
        let invalidAlias ← try
            checkConstructionLegEndpointAt ownerFamily selected parameters indexFamily left
              (!family.entry.colimit) 0 #[] #[(2, #[])]
            pure false
          catch _ => pure true
        unless invalidAlias do
          throwError "a matching endpoint hid an invalid original alias position"
        let wrongPosition ← try
            checkConstructionLegEndpointAt ownerFamily selected parameters indexFamily left
              (!family.entry.colimit) 1
            pure false
          catch _ => pure true
        unless wrongPosition do
          throwError "equal specialized objects selected another original endpoint position"
        let wrongIndex ← try
            checkConstructionLegEndpointAt ownerFamily selected parameters indexFamily right
              (!family.entry.colimit) 0
            pure false
          catch _ => pure true
        unless wrongIndex do
          throwError "the endpoint checker replaced the original typed native index"
        let changed ← family.prepareOwner identities levels (← mkFreshUserName `anotherEndpointControl)
        let wrongOwner ← try
            checkConstructionLegEndpointAt changed selected parameters indexFamily left
              (!family.entry.colimit) 0
            pure false
          catch _ => pure true
        unless wrongOwner do
          throwError "an equal native construction replaced the original retained owner"
