run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let entry ← selectCategory (← semanticState) "Sets"
  let levels := (← checkedDeclaration entry.declaration).levelParams.map Level.param
  let sets ← empty.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Sets" levels #[]
  let session ← empty.assume `h (← `(True))
  let original ← session.cell Syntax.missing NaturalTransformationId.listReverse #[] sets
  let noninvertible ← session.cell Syntax.missing NaturalTransformationId.listJoin #[] sets
  for id in #[ConstructorId.arrow, ConstructorId.core] do
    let transformed ← session.constructCell Syntax.missing id original
    let .constructed constructor (.registered cell _ _) := transformed.derivation
      | throwError "constructor comparison lost its actual source derivation"
    unless constructor.id == id && cell.id == NaturalTransformationId.listReverse &&
        transformed.source.expression.syntacticEq (.construct id #[.category sets.expression]) do
      throwError "constructor comparison changed its exact symbolic source or registered action"
    let objectType ← session.elaborate Syntax.missing fun context => do
      mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[← transformed.source.value.source.inContext context]
    let objects ← session.assumeTerm `X objectType
    let object ← objects.term (← `(term| $(mkIdent `X):ident))
    let inverse ← objects.inverseCell Syntax.missing transformed
    for (directed, backwards) in #[(transformed, false), (inverse, true)] do
      let component ← objects.cellComponent Syntax.missing directed object
      component.value.source.withOpen fun bindings value => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let some action := constructor.comparisonAction
          | throwError "the actual source constructor lost its comparison action"
        let some iso := original.isomorphism
          | throwError "the actual source comparison lost its native isomorphism"
        let category ← sets.value.source.inContext context
        let expectedIso ← applyConstructorInterface action #[category, category]
          #[← iso.source.inContext context]
        let transformation ← mkAppM
          (if backwards then ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv else ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom) #[expectedIso]
        let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app
          #[transformation, bindings[1]!.expression]
        unless ← isDefEq value expected do
          throwError "constructor comparison replaced the source-owned directed component"
        checkWithKernel expectedIso
        checkWithKernel value
    let rejected ← try
      discard <| session.constructCell Syntax.missing id noninvertible
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless rejected do
      throwError "an isomorphism-only source constructor acquired a new cell action"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let rings ← empty.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Rings" [.param `u] #[]
  let ringType ← empty.elaborate Syntax.missing fun context => do
    mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[← rings.value.source.inContext context]
  let parameters ← empty.assumeTerm `R ringType
  let session ← parameters.assume `h (← `(True))
  let ring ← session.term (← `(term| $(mkIdent `R):ident))
  let modules ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Modules" [.param `u, .param `w] #[ring]
  let first ← session.namedFunctor Syntax.missing FunctorId.modulesFibreInclusion #[ring] modules
  let second ← session.namedFunctor Syntax.missing FunctorId.modulesUnderlying #[] first.target
  for id in #[ConstructorId.arrow, ConstructorId.core] do
    for input in #[ConstructorCoherence.identity modules, .composition first second] do
      let cell ← session.constructorCoherence Syntax.missing id input
      let .coherence constructor retained := cell.derivation
        | throwError "constructor coherence lost its original source role"
      unless constructor.id == id &&
          cell.transformation.source.context.entries.size == session.context.entries.size do
        throwError "constructor coherence changed its constructor or complete formal scope"
      let objectType ← session.elaborate Syntax.missing fun context => do
        mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[← cell.source.value.source.inContext context]
      let objects ← session.assumeTerm `X objectType
      let object ← objects.term (← `(term| $(mkIdent `X):ident))
      let inverse ← objects.inverseCell Syntax.missing cell
      for (directed, backwards) in #[(cell, false), (inverse, true)] do
        let component ← objects.cellComponent Syntax.missing directed object
        component.value.source.withOpen fun bindings value => do
          let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
          let pairs : Array (SourceFunctor × SourceFunctor) ← match input, retained with
            | .identity expected, .identity actual => do
              unless expected.expression.syntacticEq actual.expression &&
                  (← isDefEq (← expected.value.source.inContext context)
                    (← actual.value.source.inContext context)) do
                throwError "constructor coherence changed its original complete category"
              pure #[]
            | .composition expectedFirst expectedSecond, .composition actualFirst actualSecond =>
              pure #[(expectedFirst, actualFirst), (expectedSecond, actualSecond)]
            | _, _ => throwError "constructor coherence changed its original source law role"
          for (expected, actual) in pairs do
            let .registered expectedEntry _ := expected.derivation
              | throwError "the expected source functor role changed"
            let .registered actualEntry _ := actual.derivation
              | throwError "constructor coherence discarded a registered source functor role"
            unless expectedEntry.id == actualEntry.id &&
                (← isDefEq (← expected.functor.source.inContext context)
                  (← actual.functor.source.inContext context)) do
              throwError "constructor coherence changed an original parameterized source functor"
          let expectedIso ← match input with
            | .identity category =>
              let some law := constructor.identityComparison
                | throwError "the source identity comparison is absent"
              let category ← category.value.source.inContext context
              applyConstructorInterface law #[category] #[category]
            | .composition first second =>
              let some law := constructor.compositionComparison
                | throwError "the source composition comparison is absent"
              let categories := #[← first.source.value.source.inContext context,
                ← first.target.value.source.inContext context,
                ← second.target.value.source.inContext context]
              applyConstructorInterface law categories
                #[← first.functor.source.inContext context,
                  ← second.functor.source.inContext context]
          let transformation ← mkAppM
            (if backwards then ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv else ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom)
            #[expectedIso]
          let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app
            #[transformation, bindings[2]!.expression]
          unless ← isDefEq value expected do
            throwError "constructor coherence changed the original directed source comparison"
          checkWithKernel expectedIso
          checkWithKernel value
  let otherModules ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Modules"
    [.param `u, .param `otherObjects] #[ring]
  let otherInclusion ← session.namedFunctor Syntax.missing FunctorId.modulesFibreInclusion
    #[ring] otherModules
  let otherUnderlying ← session.namedFunctor Syntax.missing FunctorId.modulesUnderlying
    #[] otherInclusion.target
  let rejected ← try
    discard <| session.constructorCoherence Syntax.missing ConstructorId.arrow
      (.composition first otherUnderlying)
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do
    throwError "constructor coherence identified independently rigid intermediate categories"

module

public import CasCompiler.Layout
public import CasCompiler.LimitInterface

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta

/-- One original argument of an accepted dependent data constructor. Native and wire
positions remain distinct, and proof slots keep their binding identity without a payload. -/
structure ConstructorPort where
  private mk ::
  binding : BindingId
  argument : ArgumentLayout

/-- The complete source telescope of one already accepted data constructor. These formal
locals describe its ports; no returned data is substituted into the native constructor. -/
structure ConstructorPorts where
  private mk ::
  interface : LimitInterface ClosedTerm
  originalContext : ContextTelescope
  context : ContextTelescope
  contextInputs : Array BindingId
  ports : Array ConstructorPort
  application : ApplicationLayout

/-- Prepare every remaining native argument in its original order, including proof and
implicit positions. Reuse: the accepted LimitInterface.dataConstructor, ContextTelescope,
ApplicationLayout.ofSource and its original argument type families. The caller supplies
fresh source identities from the current preparation; the compiler owns no runtime graph. -/
opaque ConstructorPorts.prepare (interface : LimitInterface ClosedTerm)
    (freshBinding : MetaM BindingId)
    (selections : SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm := {}) : MetaM ConstructorPorts := do
  let some constructor := interface.dataConstructor
    | throwError "the accepted construction has no complete native data constructor"
  constructor.withOpen fun originalBindings expression => do
    let originalContext ← ContextTelescope.capture originalBindings
    -- All parts of the accepted interface must remain in this exact original source scope.
    discard <| interface.presentation.inContext originalContext
    discard <| interface.diagram.inContext originalContext
    if let some standardization := interface.standardization then
      discard <| standardization.inContext originalContext
    forallTelescope (← inferType expression) fun arguments _ => do
      let mut bindings := originalBindings
      let mut portBindings := #[]
      for argument in arguments do
        let id ← freshBinding
        let proof ← isProof argument
        let declaration ← getFVarLocalDecl argument
        let role := if proof then BindingRole.hypothesis
          else if declaration.binderInfo == .instImplicit then .instance
          else .parameter
        bindings := bindings.push { id, role, expression := argument }
        portBindings := portBindings.push id
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let function ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close expression)
        (← (← selections.inContext context).close context)
      let sources ← arguments.mapM context.close
      let (_, application) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource function context sources
      unless application.arguments.size == portBindings.size do
        throwError "the accepted constructor changed its complete native port telescope"
      let ports := portBindings.zipWith (fun binding argument =>
        (⟨binding, argument⟩ : ConstructorPort)) application.arguments
      let mut contextInputs := #[]
      for binding in bindings do
        unless ← isProof binding.expression do contextInputs := contextInputs.push binding.id
      return ⟨interface, originalContext.telescope, context.telescope, contextInputs,
        ports, application⟩

/-- Follow only a source-authored native result projection back to its original constructor
argument/context position. Matcher-defined components remain delayed; no ordinal is guessed. -/
def ConstructorPorts.projectionAt (ports : ConstructorPorts) (path : Array Name) :
    MetaM (Option InputProjection) :=
  ports.application.inputProjectionAt path ports.contextInputs

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.ConstructorPorts

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta

/-- One accepted constructor result projection and its original argument/context position.
The complete producer telescope remains unchanged. Only type schemas may use the explicitly
selected port as the corresponding native result field. -/
structure ConstructorProjectionTransport where
  private mk ::
  plan : ConstructorPorts
  result : SourceLayout
  path : Array Name
  selected : InputProjection
  binding : BindingId
  source : SourceLayout
  target : SourceLayout

private def nativeLayoutAt (source : SourceLayout) (path : Array Name) :
    MetaM SourceLayout := do
  let mut current := source
  for projection in path do
    let some field := current.fields.find? (·.projection == projection)
      | throwError "a constructor transport selected an undeclared native field"
    if field.wireIndex.isNone then
      throwError "a constructor transport selected a formal proof field"
    current ← field.toLayout
  return current

/-- Seal the native route before any returned data is inspected. The source-only constructor
projection determines its original slot; native conversion checks only the result interface. -/
opaque ConstructorPorts.projectionTransport (plan : ConstructorPorts) (result : SourceLayout)
    (path : Array Name) : MetaM ConstructorProjectionTransport := do
  let some selected ← plan.projectionAt path
    | throwError "the accepted constructor has no source-prescribed port for this result field"
  let (binding, root) ← match selected.target with
    | .argument index =>
      let some port := plan.ports[index]?
        | throwError "the constructor projection selected an undeclared native argument"
      unless port.argument.wireIndex.isSome do
        throwError "a constructor projection selected a formal proof argument"
      pure (port.binding, port.argument.source)
    | .context id =>
      let source ← plan.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let some binding := bindings.find? (·.id == id)
          | throwError "the constructor projection lost its original context binding"
        SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close binding.expression)
          (← (← plan.application.result.selections.inContext context).close context)
      pure (id, source)
  let source ← nativeLayoutAt root selected.path
  let target ← nativeLayoutAt result path
  plan.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let produced ← plan.application.result.source.inContext context
    let expected ← result.source.inContext context
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType produced) (← inferType expected) do
      throwError "the constructor transport changed its complete native result interface"
    let original ← source.source.inContext context
    let consuming ← target.source.inContext context
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType original) (← inferType consuming) do
      throwError "the selected constructor port has another native result-field interface"
  return ⟨plan, result, path, selected, binding, source, target⟩

/-- Extend the checking scope by every original producer declaration that is absent from
the consumer. Shared entries are joined only by their stable BindingId, then checked in their
original order, role, type and definition. No context entry is dropped. -/
opaque ConstructorProjectionTransport.withContext
    (transport : ConstructorProjectionTransport) (current : OpenContext)
    (action : OpenContext → MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  transport.plan.context.ensureDeclarations
  let rec visit (entries : List ContextEntry) (original : Array Expr)
      (all : Array LocalBinding) (previous : Option Nat) : MetaM α := do
    match entries with
    | [] =>
      let mut instances ← getLocalInstances
      for selected in transport.plan.context.instances do
        let some binding := all.find? (·.id == selected.binding)
          | throwError "constructor transport lost an original selected instance"
        unless instances.any (fun selectedInstance =>
            selectedInstance.className == selected.className &&
            selectedInstance.fvar == binding.expression) do
          instances := instances.push ⟨selected.className, binding.expression⟩
      withLCtx (← getLCtx) instances do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture all
        -- ClosedTerm transport rechecks the complete original telescope, including unused
        -- port and proof declarations, against this exact stable-identity extension.
        discard <| transport.source.source.inContext context
        action context
    | entry :: rest =>
      if let some index := all.findIdx? (·.id == entry.id) then
        if let some previous := previous then
          unless previous < index do
            throwError "constructor transport changed the original native binder order"
        let binding := all[index]!
        let declaration ← getFVarLocalDecl binding.expression
        unless binding.role == entry.role && declaration.binderInfo == entry.binderInfo &&
            declaration.kind == entry.kind && declaration.isNondep == entry.nondep do
          throwError "constructor transport changed an original native binding role"
        unless ← isDefEq declaration.type (entry.type.instantiateRev original) do
          throwError "constructor transport changed an original native binder type"
        match entry.originalSource, binding.originalSource with
        | none, none => pure ()
        | some expected, some actual =>
          unless actual.equal (expected.instantiateRev original) do
            throwError "constructor transport changed an original source correspondence"
        | _, _ => throwError "constructor transport changed an original source correspondence"
        match entry.value, declaration.value? true with
        | none, none => pure ()
        | some expected, some actual =>
          unless ← isDefEq actual (expected.instantiateRev original) do
            throwError "constructor transport changed an original native definition"
        | _, _ => throwError "constructor transport changed an original declaration kind"
        visit rest (original.push binding.expression) all (some index)
      else
        unless transport.plan.ports.any (·.binding == entry.id) do
          throwError "constructor transport lost an original request context binding"
        let type := entry.type.instantiateRev original
        let next := fun expression =>
          visit rest (original.push expression)
            (all.push {
              id := entry.id
              role := entry.role
              expression := expression
              originalSource := entry.originalSource.map (·.instantiateRev original) }) (some all.size)
        match entry.value with
        | some value =>
          withLetDecl entry.userName type (value.instantiateRev original) next
            (nondep := entry.nondep) (kind := entry.kind)
        | none => withLocalDecl entry.userName entry.binderInfo type next (kind := entry.kind)
  visit transport.plan.context.entries.toList #[] current.bindings none

private partial def sourceBinderPath? (expression : Expr) :
    MetaM (Option (FVarId × Array Name)) := do
  if let .fvar id := expression then return some (id, #[])
  if let .mdata _ body := expression then return ← sourceBinderPath? body
  let some projection ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? expression | return none
  let some (id, path) ← sourceBinderPath? projection.parent | return none
  return some (id, path.push projection.declaration)

private partial def substitutePortSchema (binding : FVarId) (path : Array Name)
    (replacement : Expr) (expression : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  if let some (original, selected) ← sourceBinderPath? expression then
    if original == binding && selected == path then return replacement
  match expression with
  | .mdata data body => return .mdata data (← substitutePortSchema binding path replacement body)
  | .app function argument =>
    return .app (← substitutePortSchema binding path replacement function)
      (← substitutePortSchema binding path replacement argument)
  | .lam name type body info =>
    return .lam name (← substitutePortSchema binding path replacement type)
      (← substitutePortSchema binding path replacement body) info
  | .forallE name type body info =>
    return .forallE name (← substitutePortSchema binding path replacement type)
      (← substitutePortSchema binding path replacement body) info
  | .letE name type value body nondep =>
    return .letE name (← substitutePortSchema binding path replacement type)
      (← substitutePortSchema binding path replacement value)
      (← substitutePortSchema binding path replacement body) nondep
  | .proj name index parent =>
    return .proj name index (← substitutePortSchema binding path replacement parent)
  | _ => return expression

private def ConstructorProjectionTransport.schemaView
    (transport : ConstructorProjectionTransport) (context : OpenContext)
    (expression replacement : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let some original := context.bindings.find? (·.id == transport.binding)
    | throwError "constructor type transport lost its exact original native slot"
  let target ← transport.target.source.inContext context
  unless ← context.withOriginalSources #[← inferType replacement, ← inferType target]
      (fun types => isDefEq types[0]! types[1]!) do
    throwError "constructor type transport changed its selected native slot type"
  let result ← substitutePortSchema original.expression.fvarId! transport.selected.path
    replacement expression
  check result
  return result

/-- Instantiate a type schema already opened in the combined checking scope. This composes
several retained constructor scopes without exposing a mathematical term substitution API. -/
opaque ConstructorProjectionTransport.instantiateSchema
    (transport : ConstructorProjectionTransport) (context : OpenContext)
    (schema replacement : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  forallTelescope (← inferType schema) fun _ result => do
    unless result.isSort do
      throwError "constructor transport is restricted to native type schemas"
  transport.schemaView context schema replacement
/-- A type-only view of the original source. Its mathematical term remains in the immutable
producer telescope; only the selected declared dependency slot is instantiated for checking. -/
opaque ConstructorProjectionTransport.typeInContext
    (transport : ConstructorProjectionTransport) (context : OpenContext)
    (source : ClosedTerm) (replacement : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let original ← source.inContext context
  let type ← inferType original
  transport.schemaView context type replacement

/-- The same explicit slot transport for an original dependent field/type family.
A computational term cannot use this entry: its native codomain must be a sort. -/
opaque ConstructorProjectionTransport.schemaInContext
    (transport : ConstructorProjectionTransport) (context : OpenContext)
    (source : ClosedTerm) (replacement : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let original ← source.inContext context
  let type ← inferType original
  forallTelescope type fun _ result => do
    unless result.isSort do
      throwError "constructor transport is restricted to native type schemas"
  transport.schemaView context original replacement

/-- Derive a native descendant by its original declaration path. No packet position enters
this traversal; runtime retains the corresponding stored child of the same original port. -/
opaque ConstructorProjectionTransport.targetAt (transport : ConstructorProjectionTransport)
    (path : Array Name) : MetaM SourceLayout :=
  nativeLayoutAt transport.target path

end CasCompiler

module

public import Lean.Meta.Basic
public import Lean.Meta.Check
public import Lean.Meta.Coe
public import Lean.Util.CollectLevelParams
public import CasCompiler.NativeDeclarations
public import CasTools.Diagnostics

@[expose] public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta

structure BindingId where
  session : String
  serial : Nat
  deriving BEq, Hashable, Repr, Inhabited

inductive BindingRole
  | parameter | definition | hypothesis | instance | selectedStructure | result
  deriving BEq, Repr, Inhabited

structure LocalBinding where
  id : BindingId
  role : BindingRole
  expression : Expr
  /-- The producer's original source, used only for mathematical source/type checking. -/
  originalSource : Option Expr := none
  deriving Inhabited

structure ContextEntry where
  id : BindingId
  role : BindingRole
  userName : Name
  binderInfo : BinderInfo
  kind : LocalDeclKind
  type : Expr
  value : Option Expr
  nondep : Bool
  /-- Closed over preceding bindings; distinct from an authored native let definition. -/
  originalSource : Option Expr := none

structure ContextInstance where
  className : Name
  binding : BindingId

structure ContextTelescope where
  private mk ::
  entries : Array ContextEntry
  instances : Array ContextInstance
  nativeDeclarations : NativeDeclarations

/-- Compare every captured declaration and selected instance without native conversion.
This is an exact closed-context check: binder names, annotations and source metadata count.
It only permits reuse of data that is already checked in that same complete telescope. -/
opaque ContextTelescope.exactlyMatches (left right : ContextTelescope) : Bool := Id.run do
  unless left.entries.size == right.entries.size &&
      left.instances.size == right.instances.size &&
      left.nativeDeclarations.exactlyMatches right.nativeDeclarations do
    return false
  for first in left.entries, second in right.entries do
    unless first.id == second.id && first.role == second.role &&
        first.userName == second.userName && first.binderInfo == second.binderInfo &&
        first.kind == second.kind && first.nondep == second.nondep &&
        first.type.equal second.type do
      return false
    match first.value, second.value with
    | none, none => pure ()
    | some original, some current =>
      unless original.equal current do return false
    | _, _ => return false
    match first.originalSource, second.originalSource with
    | none, none => pure ()
    | some original, some current =>
      unless original.equal current do return false
    | _, _ => return false
  for first in left.instances, second in right.instances do
    unless first.className == second.className && first.binding == second.binding do
      return false
  return true

structure OpenContext where
  private mk ::
  telescope : ContextTelescope
  bindings : Array LocalBinding

structure ClosedTerm where
  private mk ::
  context : ContextTelescope
  expression : Expr
  type : Expr
  universeParams : Array Name
  nativeDeclarations : NativeDeclarations

private def resolve (expression : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let expression ← instantiateMVars expression
  if expression.hasExprMVar || expression.hasLevelMVar || expression.hasLooseBVars then
    throwError "context publication requires a resolved expression in its local scope"
  return expression

private def closeOver (locals : Array Expr) (expression : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let expression := (← resolve expression).abstract locals
  if expression.hasFVar then
    throwError "context publication contains an escaping local variable"
  return expression

private def ContextTelescope.withOpenCore [Monad m] [MonadControlT MetaM m]
    (context : ContextTelescope) (interpretSources : Bool)
    (action : Array LocalBinding → m α) : m α := do
  let rec visit (entries : List ContextEntry) (bindings : Array LocalBinding) : m α := do
    match entries with
    | [] => mapMetaM (fun action => do
        let mut instances : LocalInstances := #[]
        for selected in context.instances do
          let some binding := bindings.find? (·.id == selected.binding)
            | throwError "the reopened source telescope lost a selected instance"
          instances := instances.push ⟨selected.className, binding.expression⟩
        withLCtx (← getLCtx) instances action) (action bindings)
    | entry :: rest =>
      let locals := bindings.map (·.expression)
      let type := entry.type.instantiateRev locals
      let originalSource := entry.originalSource.map (·.instantiateRev locals)
      let next := fun expression =>
        visit rest (bindings.push {
          id := entry.id, role := entry.role, expression,
          originalSource := if interpretSources then none else originalSource })
      if interpretSources then
        if let some source := originalSource then
          return ← mapMetaM (fun action => do
            check source
            unless ← isDefEq (← inferType source) type do
              throwError "an opaque source binding changed its original mathematical type"
            action) <| withLetDecl entry.userName type source next
              (nondep := entry.nondep) (kind := entry.kind)
      match entry.value with
      | some value =>
        withLetDecl entry.userName type (value.instantiateRev locals) next
          (nondep := entry.nondep) (kind := entry.kind)
      | none => withLocalDecl entry.userName entry.binderInfo type next (kind := entry.kind)
  mapMetaM (fun action => do
    context.nativeDeclarations.ensure
    action) <| withLCtx {} #[] <| visit context.entries.toList #[]

/-- Capture every local declaration in order; the caller supplies stable binding identities.
The exact ordered local-instance environment uses those same stable identities.
Uses Lean's abstraction and local-context APIs at v4.33.0, with no expression-based identity.
Source/reuse record: lean-cas-dsl#66, issuecomment-6693525290. -/
opaque ContextTelescope.capture (bindings : Array LocalBinding) : MetaM OpenContext := do
  let declarations := (← getLCtx).foldl (fun result decl => result.push decl) #[]
  unless declarations.size == bindings.size do
    throwError "context capture requires a complete ordered binding map"
  let mut identities : Std.HashSet BindingId := {}
  let mut localIds : Std.HashMap FVarId BindingId := {}
  let mut locals : Array Expr := #[]
  let mut entries : Array ContextEntry := #[]
  for decl in declarations, binding in bindings do
    unless binding.expression.isFVar && binding.expression.fvarId! == decl.fvarId do
      throwError "context capture binding does not denote its ordered local declaration"
    if binding.id.session.isEmpty || identities.contains binding.id then
      throwError "context capture requires distinct session binding identities"
    identities := identities.insert binding.id
    localIds := localIds.insert decl.fvarId binding.id
    let type ← closeOver locals decl.type
    let value ← (decl.value? true).mapM (closeOver locals)
    let originalSource ← binding.originalSource.mapM (closeOver locals)
    if originalSource.isSome && value.isSome then
      throwError "an original runtime source cannot replace an authored let definition"
    entries := entries.push {
      id := binding.id, role := binding.role, userName := decl.userName,
      binderInfo := decl.binderInfo, kind := decl.kind, type, value, nondep := decl.isNondep,
      originalSource }
    locals := locals.push binding.expression
  let mut instances : Array ContextInstance := #[]
  for selected in ← getLocalInstances do
    unless selected.fvar.isFVar do
      throwError "a selected local instance must denote a source declaration"
    let some binding := localIds[selected.fvar.fvarId!]?
      | throwError "a selected local instance is outside the complete source telescope"
    unless (← isClass? (← inferType selected.fvar)) == some selected.className do
      throwError "a selected local instance has an incompatible source class"
    instances := instances.push ⟨selected.className, binding⟩
  let declarations ← NativeDeclarations.capture <|
    entries.flatMap fun entry => #[entry.type] ++ entry.value.toArray ++ entry.originalSource.toArray
  let telescope : ContextTelescope := ⟨entries, instances, declarations⟩
  if entries.any (·.originalSource.isSome) then
    telescope.withOpenCore true fun _ => pure ()
  return ⟨telescope, bindings⟩

/-- Extend the complete ordered context by one actual local binder. Its identity is supplied
by the caller; the native variable has no definition to erase during reduction. Existing
definitions, selected instances and native declarations remain in the captured telescope. -/
opaque OpenContext.withLocalBinding [Monad m] [MonadLiftT MetaM m] [MonadControlT MetaM m]
    (context : OpenContext) (id : BindingId) (role : BindingRole) (userName : Name)
    (type : Expr) (action : OpenContext → LocalBinding → m α)
    (originalSource : Option Expr := none) (binderInfo : BinderInfo := .default) : m α := do
  let type ← liftM (m := MetaM) (resolve type)
  discard <| liftM (m := MetaM) (getLevel type)
  withLocalDecl userName binderInfo type fun expression => do
    let binding : LocalBinding := { id, role, expression, originalSource }
    let extended ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| ContextTelescope.capture (context.bindings.push binding)
    action extended binding

/-- Close a checked term and its full type over the captured ordered telescope. -/
opaque OpenContext.close (context : OpenContext) (expression : Expr) : MetaM ClosedTerm := do
  let expression ← resolve expression
  check expression
  let type ← resolve (← inferType expression)
  let locals := context.bindings.map (·.expression)
  let expression ← closeOver locals expression
  let type ← closeOver locals type
  let mut levels : CollectLevelParams.State := {}
  for entry in context.telescope.entries do
    levels := levels.collect entry.type
    if let some value := entry.value then levels := levels.collect value
    if let some original := entry.originalSource then levels := levels.collect original
  levels := (levels.collect expression).collect type
  let declarations ← NativeDeclarations.capture #[expression, type]
  return ⟨context.telescope, expression, type, levels.params, declarations⟩

/-- Make this original telescope's native dependencies available without replacing the
caller's environment or its runtime snapshot extensions. -/
def ContextTelescope.ensureDeclarations (context : ContextTelescope) : MetaM Unit :=
  context.nativeDeclarations.ensure

/-- Preserve the exact native meaning of the term and its complete source telescope. -/
def ClosedTerm.ensureDeclarations (term : ClosedTerm) : MetaM Unit := do
  term.context.ensureDeclarations
  term.nativeDeclarations.ensure

/-- Reopen with fresh Lean locals, preserving stable identities, definitions and instances. -/
opaque ContextTelescope.withOpen [Monad m] [MonadControlT MetaM m] (context : ContextTelescope)
    (action : Array LocalBinding → m α) : m α :=
  context.withOpenCore false action

/-- Interpret only explicitly recorded source correspondences for native mathematical
checking. The entire context is reopened in order, so dependent declarations and selected
instances have the interpreted types. Runtime lookup and execution never use this view. -/
opaque OpenContext.withOriginalSources (context : OpenContext) (expressions : Array Expr)
    (action : Array Expr → MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  let locals := context.bindings.map (·.expression)
  let expressions ← expressions.mapM (closeOver locals)
  context.telescope.withOpenCore true fun bindings =>
    action (expressions.map (·.instantiateRev (bindings.map (·.expression))))

/-- Open the stored term only within the scope of its freshly reopened context. -/
def ClosedTerm.withOpen (term : ClosedTerm)
    (action : Array LocalBinding → Expr → MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  term.ensureDeclarations
  term.context.withOpen fun bindings =>
    action bindings (term.expression.instantiateRev (bindings.map (·.expression)))

private def ContextEntry.checkBinding (entry : ContextEntry) (binding : LocalBinding)
    (locals : Array Expr) : MetaM Unit := do
  let declaration ← getFVarLocalDecl binding.expression
  unless binding.role == entry.role && declaration.binderInfo == entry.binderInfo &&
      declaration.kind == entry.kind && declaration.isNondep == entry.nondep do
    throwError "the target context changed a captured binding role"
  unless ← isDefEq declaration.type (entry.type.instantiateRev locals) do
    throwError "the target context changed a captured binding type"
  match entry.value, declaration.value? true with
  | none, none => pure ()
  | some expected, some actual =>
    unless ← isDefEq actual (expected.instantiateRev locals) do
      throwError "the target context changed a captured definition"
  | _, _ => throwError "the target context changed a captured declaration kind"
  match entry.originalSource, binding.originalSource with
  | none, none => pure ()
  | some expected, some actual =>
    unless actual.equal (expected.instantiateRev locals) do
      throwError "the target context changed an original source correspondence"
  | _, _ => throwError "the target context lost an original source correspondence"

/-- Transport into an existing scope by stable identity, preserving the ordered telescope.
Lean checks the substituted types and definitions; names and expression matches do not bind locals. -/
opaque ClosedTerm.inContext (term : ClosedTerm) (target : OpenContext) : MetaM Expr := do
  term.ensureDeclarations
  let mut available : Std.HashMap BindingId (Nat × LocalBinding) := {}
  for binding in target.bindings, index in [:target.bindings.size] do
    available := available.insert binding.id (index, binding)
  let mut locals : Array Expr := #[]
  let mut previous : Option Nat := none
  for entry in term.context.entries do
    let some (index, binding) := available[entry.id]?
      | do
        let identity := fun (id : BindingId) => Json.mkObj [
          ("session", toJson id.session), ("serial", toJson id.serial)]
        liftM (m := CoreM) <| CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "source.contextMissingBinding"
          (Json.mkObj [
            ("missing", identity entry.id),
            ("source", .arr (term.context.entries.map (identity ·.id))),
            ("target", .arr (target.bindings.map (identity ·.id)))])
        throwError "the target context is missing a captured binding"
    if let some priorIndex := previous then
      if index ≤ priorIndex then throwError "the target context changed captured binding order"
    previous := some index
    entry.checkBinding binding locals
    locals := locals.push binding.expression
  let expression ← resolve (term.expression.instantiateRev locals)
  check expression
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType expression) (term.type.instantiateRev locals) do
    throwError "context transport changed the captured result type"
  return expression

/-- Import an entire captured telescope into the current native scope by stable identity.
Shared declarations pass the same checks as ClosedTerm.inContext; missing declarations are
opened in their original order. Both ordered instance selections remain explicit. The
continuation runs inside every added binder, so closed values can retain this complete scope. -/
opaque ContextTelescope.withInContext (source : ContextTelescope) (current : OpenContext)
    (action : OpenContext → MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  source.ensureDeclarations
  let rec visit (entries : List ContextEntry) (original : Array Expr)
      (all : Array LocalBinding) (previous : Option Nat) : MetaM α := do
    match entries with
    | [] =>
      let mut selected := current.telescope.instances
      let mut previous : Option Nat := none
      for instanceEntry in source.instances do
        let index ← match selected.findIdx? (fun entry =>
            entry.binding == instanceEntry.binding && entry.className == instanceEntry.className) with
          | some index => pure index
          | none => do
            let index := selected.size
            selected := selected.push instanceEntry
            pure index
        if let some priorIndex := previous then
          unless priorIndex < index do
            throwError "context import changed an original selected-instance order"
        previous := some index
      let instances : LocalInstances ← selected.mapM fun entry => do
        let some binding := all.find? (·.id == entry.binding)
          | throwError "context import lost an original selected instance"
        return ⟨entry.className, binding.expression⟩
      withLCtx (← getLCtx) instances do
        action (← ContextTelescope.capture all)
    | entry :: rest =>
      if let some index := all.findIdx? (·.id == entry.id) then
        if let some previous := previous then
          unless previous < index do
            throwError "context import changed an original native binder order"
        let binding := all[index]!
        entry.checkBinding binding original
        visit rest (original.push binding.expression) all (some index)
      else
        let type := entry.type.instantiateRev original
        let originalSource := entry.originalSource.map (·.instantiateRev original)
        let next := fun expression =>
          visit rest (original.push expression)
            (all.push { id := entry.id, role := entry.role, expression, originalSource })
            (some all.size)
        match entry.value with
        | some value =>
          withLetDecl entry.userName type (value.instantiateRev original) next
            (nondep := entry.nondep) (kind := entry.kind)
        | none => withLocalDecl entry.userName entry.binderInfo type next (kind := entry.kind)
  visit source.entries.toList #[] current.bindings none

/-- Apply complete source arguments in the current native scope, including callable coercions.
Reuse: ClosedTerm.inContext, Lean.Meta.coerceToFunction? and Lean.mkAppN at v4.33.0.
Callers close the resulting expression through the checked source publication boundary. -/
opaque OpenContext.apply (context : OpenContext) (function : ClosedTerm)
    (arguments : Array ClosedTerm) : MetaM Expr := do
  let expression ← function.inContext context
  let expression ← if (← whnf (← inferType expression)).isForall then
      pure expression
    else do
      let some coerced ← coerceToFunction? expression
        | throwError "source application requires a callable interface"
      pure coerced
  let arguments ← arguments.mapM (·.inContext context)
  return mkAppN expression arguments

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.Context
public import CasTools.NativeExpression

@[expose] public section

namespace CasCompiler.ContextSnapshot

open Lean CasTools

/-- Stable source identity, shared by the closed telescope and its selected instances. -/
def bindingJson (id : BindingId) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("session", toJson id.session), ("serial", toJson id.serial)]

def instancesJson (context : ContextTelescope) : Json :=
  toJson <| context.instances.map fun selected => Json.mkObj [
    ("class", toJson (selected.className.toString (escape := false))),
    ("nativeClass", NativeExpression.nameJson selected.className),
    ("binding", bindingJson selected.binding)]

def retainedDeclarations (terms : Array ClosedTerm) : Array ConstantInfo := Id.run do
  let mut declarations := #[]
  for term in terms do
    for declaration in term.context.nativeDeclarations.constants ++
        term.nativeDeclarations.constants do
      unless declarations.any (nativeConstantExactlyMatches declaration) do
        declarations := declarations.push declaration
  return declarations

def declarationFields [Monad m] (encode : Expr → m Nat) (terms : Array ClosedTerm) :
    m (List (String × Json)) := do
  let declarations := retainedDeclarations terms
  if declarations.isEmpty then return []
  let declarations ← declarations.mapM (NativeExpression.constantInfoJson encode)
  return [("declarations", Json.arr declarations)]

/-- Preserve the existing question-export schema and each ordered native context entry.
Expression indices belong to the caller's shared NativeExpression builder. -/
def contextJson (context : ContextTelescope) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let entries ← context.entries.mapM fun entry => do
    let type ← NativeExpression.Builder.add entry.type
    let value ← entry.value.mapM NativeExpression.Builder.add
    let originalSource ← entry.originalSource.mapM NativeExpression.Builder.add
    let fields := [
      ("id", bindingJson entry.id), ("name", toJson (entry.userName.toString (escape := false))),
      ("nativeName", NativeExpression.nameJson entry.userName),
      ("role", toJson <| match entry.role with
        | .parameter => "parameter" | .definition => "definition" | .hypothesis => "hypothesis"
        | .instance => "instance" | .selectedStructure => "selectedStructure"
        | .result => "result"),
      ("binderInfo", toJson (reprStr entry.binderInfo)),
      ("nativeBinderInfo", toJson entry.binderInfo),
      ("kind", toJson (reprStr entry.kind)), ("type", toJson type),
      ("value", toJson value), ("nondep", toJson entry.nondep)]
    return Json.mkObj (fields ++ originalSource.toList.map fun original =>
      ("originalSource", toJson original))
  return toJson entries

/-- Assemble the exact term document from its already encoded context and native roots. -/
def termJson (term : ClosedTerm) (context : Json) (expression type : Nat) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [
    ("context", context), ("instances", instancesJson term.context),
    ("universeParams", Json.arr (term.universeParams.map NativeExpression.nameJson)),
    ("expression", toJson expression), ("type", toJson type)]

/-- The exact closed term, its complete type, telescope, selected instances and universes.
The ordered telescope supplies the de Bruijn scopes of all stored native expressions. -/
def closedTermJson (term : ClosedTerm) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let context ← contextJson term.context
  let expression ← NativeExpression.Builder.add term.expression
  let type ← NativeExpression.Builder.add term.type
  let native := termJson term context expression type
  let declarations ← declarationFields NativeExpression.Builder.add #[term]
  return declarations.foldl (fun document (key, value) => document.setObjVal! key value) native

end CasCompiler.ContextSnapshot

import CasCompiler.Context
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.Context

open Lean Meta CasCompiler

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let u := Level.param `u
  let saved ← withLocalDeclD `α (.sort u) fun α =>
    withLocalDecl `chosen .instImplicit (mkApp (mkConst ``Inhabited [u]) α) fun chosen =>
      withLocalDeclD `x α fun x =>
        withLetDecl `y α x fun y => do
          let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[
            { id := ⟨"context-test", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := α },
            { id := ⟨"context-test", 1⟩, role := .instance, expression := chosen },
            { id := ⟨"context-test", 2⟩, role := .parameter, expression := x },
            { id := ⟨"context-test", 3⟩, role := .definition, expression := y }]
          context.close y
  if saved.expression.hasFVar || saved.expression.hasMVar then
    throwError "published context contains a local variable or metavariable"
  unless saved.universeParams.contains `u do
    throwError "published context lost its universe parameter"
  saved.withOpen fun bindings value => do
    unless bindings.size == 4 do throwError "reopened context has the wrong arity"
    unless bindings[3]!.id == ⟨"context-test", 3⟩ do
      throwError "reopened definition lost its binding identity"
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) bindings[0]!.expression do
      throwError "reopened value lost its dependent type"
    unless ← isDefEq value bindings[2]!.expression do
      throwError "reopened definition lost its value"
    let dictionary ← synthInstance (mkApp (mkConst ``Inhabited [u]) bindings[0]!.expression)
    unless dictionary == bindings[1]!.expression do
      throwError "reopened context lost its selected local instance"

  saved.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    withLocalDeclD `later bindings[0]!.expression fun later => do
      let target ← ContextTelescope.capture (bindings.push {
        id := ⟨"context-test", 4⟩, role := .parameter, expression := later })
      let imported ← saved.inContext target
      unless ← isDefEq imported bindings[3]!.expression do
        throwError "a later context lost the original definition binding"

  saved.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let changed := bindings.set! 3 { bindings[3]! with id := ⟨"context-test", 5⟩ }
    let target ← ContextTelescope.capture changed
    let mut rejected := false
    try
      discard <| saved.inContext target
    catch _ => rejected := true
    unless rejected do throwError "a different binding identity replaced a captured definition"

  saved.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    withLocalDeclD `later bindings[0]!.expression fun later =>
      withLetDecl `replacement bindings[0]!.expression later fun replacement => do
        let changed := bindings.set! 3 { bindings[3]! with id := ⟨"context-test", 5⟩ }
        let target ← ContextTelescope.capture <| changed.push
          { id := ⟨"context-test", 4⟩, role := .parameter, expression := later } |>.push
          { id := ⟨"context-test", 3⟩, role := .definition, expression := replacement }
        let mut rejected := false
        try
          discard <| saved.inContext target
        catch _ => rejected := true
        unless rejected do throwError "a captured definition changed under the same binding identity"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let unresolved ← mkFreshExprMVar (mkConst ``Nat)
  let mut rejected := false
  try
    discard <| context.close unresolved
  catch _ => rejected := true
  unless rejected do throwError "publication accepted an unresolved term"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  withLocalDeclD `x (mkConst ``Nat) fun _ => do
    let mut rejected := false
    try
      discard <| ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    catch _ => rejected := true
    unless rejected do throwError "context capture accepted an incomplete binding map"

-- The selected instance environment can exclude or reorder class-typed declarations.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let saved ← withLocalDeclD `α (.sort (Level.succ Level.zero)) fun α => do
    let type ← mkAppM ``Inhabited #[α]
    withLocalDeclD `first type fun first =>
      withLocalDeclD `second type fun second => do
        let declarations ← getLCtx
        let bindings : Array LocalBinding := #[
          { id := ⟨"instance-selection", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := α },
          { id := ⟨"instance-selection", 1⟩, role := .instance, expression := first },
          { id := ⟨"instance-selection", 2⟩, role := .parameter, expression := second }]
        let mut saved : Array ClosedTerm := #[]
        let selections : Array LocalInstances := #[
          #[{ className := ``Inhabited, fvar := first }],
          #[{ className := ``Inhabited, fvar := second },
            { className := ``Inhabited, fvar := first }]]
        for selected in selections do
          let source ← withLCtx declarations selected do
            let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
            context.close (← synthInstance (← mkAppM ``Inhabited #[α]))
          saved := saved.push source
        return saved
  for source in saved do
    source.withOpen fun bindings selected => do
      let current ← synthInstance (← mkAppM ``Inhabited #[bindings[0]!.expression])
      unless current == selected do
        throwError "context reopening changed the actual ordered local-instance selection"

-- Equal original source terms do not identify opaque runtime binders. Their exact
-- recorded sources still justify dependent mathematical types and survive complete
-- closure/import without turning the native declarations into reducible definitions.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let saved ← empty.withLocalBinding ⟨"opaque-context", 0⟩ .result `first (mkConst ``Nat)
    (fun context first =>
      context.withLocalBinding ⟨"opaque-context", 1⟩ .result `second (mkConst ``Nat)
        (fun context second => do
          if ← withoutModifyingState (isDefEq first.expression second.expression) then
            throwError "equal source terms collapsed two opaque binding identities"
          let sameSource ← context.withOriginalSources #[first.expression, second.expression]
            fun sources => isDefEq sources[0]! sources[1]!
          unless sameSource do
            throwError "source interpretation lost an explicitly retained original term"
          let original ← mkAppM ``Fin.last #[mkNatLit 6]
          let dependent := mkApp (mkConst ``Fin) first.expression
          context.withLocalBinding ⟨"opaque-context", 2⟩ .result `point dependent
            (fun context point => do
              check point.expression
              if (← getFVarLocalDecl point.expression).value?.isSome then
                throwError "a runtime occurrence acquired a native let definition"
              let sameType ← context.withOriginalSources #[← inferType original, dependent]
                fun types => isDefEq types[0]! types[1]!
              unless sameType do
                throwError "source interpretation lost the original dependent field type"
              context.close (← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[first.expression, point.expression]))
            (originalSource := some original))
        (originalSource := some (mkNatLit 7)))
    (originalSource := some (mkNatLit 7))
  unless saved.context.entries.size == 3 &&
      saved.context.entries.all (fun entry => entry.value.isNone && entry.originalSource.isSome) do
    throwError "closed opaque context lost an original source or changed its declaration kind"
  saved.context.withInContext empty fun imported => do
    unless imported.telescope.exactlyMatches saved.context do
      throwError "context import changed a complete opaque source telescope"
    let expression ← saved.inContext imported
    check expression
    unless imported.bindings[0]!.id != imported.bindings[1]!.id &&
        imported.bindings[0]!.expression.fvarId! != imported.bindings[1]!.expression.fvarId! do
      throwError "context import identified distinct equal-source occurrences"

module

public import CasCompiler.SelectionData
import all CasCompiler.SelectionData

public import CasCompiler.CreationInterface
public import CasCompiler.SourceReference
public import CasCompiler.Layout
public import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Registry.Semantic

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue


private def creationResolved (value : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let value ← instantiateMVars value
  if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar || value.hasLooseBVars then
    throwError "the selected creation requires all original native parameters"
  check value
  return value

/-- The instance is the selected evidence's own field at D, never an instance search. -/
private def creationInstance (evidence diagram : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType evidence)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.CreatesLimitsOfShape 7 do
    throwError "the selected creation evidence has another native interface"
  mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CreatesLimitsOfShape.CreatesLimit
    ((type.getAppArgs.map some) ++ #[some evidence, some diagram])

/-- Exact native argument order in Creates.lean: C, its category, D, its category, J,
its category, K, F, the selected CreatesLimit, the target cone, and its IsLimit data. -/
private def creationArguments (diagram functor instance_ cone universal : Expr) :
    Array (Option Expr) :=
  #[none, none, none, none, none, none, some diagram, some functor, some instance_,
    some cone, some universal]

/-- Read the complete evidence family under rigid universes before specializing any actual
diagram or result. Reuse: CreatesLimitsOfShape.CreatesLimit and liftsToLimitOfCreates at the
pinned native source; layout retains LiftableCone.validLift and LiftsToLimit.makesLimit. -/
opaque CreationFamily.forLift (entry : LiftEntry) : MetaM CreationFamily := withLCtx {} #[] do
  let .createsLimits _ := entry.kind
    | throwError "a native creation family requires an accepted creates-limits lift"
  let information ← checkedDeclaration entry.evidence
  let evidenceFamily := mkConst entry.evidence (information.levelParams.map Level.param)
  discard <| checkedDeclaration ``CategoryTheory.liftsToLimitOfCreates
  forallTelescope information.type fun parameters result => do
    let result ← whnfR result
    let #[source, sourceInstance, _, _, shape, shapeInstance, functor] :=
        result.getAppArgs
      | throwError "the creation evidence changed its complete native family"
    unless result.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.CreatesLimitsOfShape 7 do
      throwError "the creation evidence is not CreatesLimitsOfShape"
    let diagramType ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Functor
      #[some shape, some shapeInstance, some source, some sourceInstance]
    withLocalDeclD `diagram diagramType fun diagram => do
      let evidence := mkAppN evidenceFamily parameters
      let instance_ ← creationInstance evidence diagram
      let image ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.comp #[diagram, functor]
      let coneType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone #[image]
      withLocalDeclD `cone coneType fun cone => do
        let universalType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[cone]
        withLocalDeclD `universal universalType fun universal => do
          let value ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.liftsToLimitOfCreates
            (creationArguments diagram functor instance_ cone universal)
          let family ← mkLambdaFVars (parameters ++ #[diagram, cone, universal]) value
            (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
          check family
          if family.hasMVar || family.hasLevelMVar then
            throwError "the whole native creation family has unresolved parameters"
          return ⟨entry, information.levelParams, parameters.size, evidenceFamily,
            information.type, family, ← inferType family⟩

/-- Resolve only the explicit accepted lift identity before preparing its complete native family. -/
opaque CreationFamily.forId (id : LiftId) : MetaM CreationFamily := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[entry] := state.lifts.filter (·.id == id)
    | throwError "the selected creation lost its unique original lift registration"
  CreationFamily.forLift entry

/-- Read this exact declared evidence at the chosen native functor and source diagram.
Only ordinary whole-type applicability is tested; no provider or result data participates. -/
opaque CreationFamily.evidenceAt? (family : CreationFamily) (functor diagram : Expr) :
    MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  let levels ← family.universeParams.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  let head := family.evidenceFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
  let (parameters, _, type) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType head)
  let type ← whnfR type
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.CreatesLimitsOfShape 7 do
    throwError "the creation evidence lost its prepared native interface"
  let diagramType ← whnfR (← inferType diagram)
  unless diagramType.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Functor 4 do
    throwError "the selected creation diagram has no complete native functor interface"
  let expected ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CreatesLimitsOfShape
    #[some diagramType.getAppArgs[2]!, some diagramType.getAppArgs[3]!, none, none,
      some diagramType.getAppArgs[0]!, some diagramType.getAppArgs[1]!, some functor]
  unless ← isDefEq type expected do return none
  return some (← creationResolved (mkAppN head parameters))

/-- Apply the exact prepared native family to its original evidence argument positions.
The supplied IsLimit remains a data input, independently of the cone and of proof fields. -/
opaque CreationFamily.atEvidence (family : CreationFamily)
    (evidence diagram cone universal : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let evidence ← creationResolved evidence
  let .const declaration levels := evidence.consumeMData.getAppFn
    | throwError "the selected creation lost its original evidence declaration"
  unless declaration == family.entry.evidence &&
      evidence.getAppNumArgs == family.parameterCount &&
      levels.length == family.universeParams.length do
    throwError "the selected creation changed its complete evidence application"
  let function := family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
  creationResolved (mkAppN function (evidence.getAppArgs ++ #[diagram, cone, universal]))

/-- Elaborate only the original declaration's explicit argument positions. Type comparison
checks applicability; the resulting application keeps each actual source expression at that
same slot, rather than substituting a diagram projection found by type conversion. -/
private def creationApplication? (declaration : Name) (arguments : Array Expr)
    (checkResult : Expr → MetaM Bool) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
  let function ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels declaration
  let (parameters, binders, result) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType function)
  unless (binders.filter (·.isExplicit)).size == arguments.size do return none
  let mut actual := parameters
  let mut argumentIndex := 0
  for parameter in parameters, binder in binders, index in [:parameters.size] do
    if binder.isExplicit then
      let some argument := arguments[argumentIndex]?
        | throwError "the source construction lost an explicit original argument"
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType parameter) (← inferType argument) do return none
      unless ← isDefEq parameter argument do return none
      actual := actual.set! index argument
      argumentIndex := argumentIndex + 1
  unless ← checkResult (← instantiateMVars result) do return none
  return some (← creationResolved (mkAppN function actual))

private def creationRestoreBinders : List BinderInfo → Expr → MetaM Expr
  | [], value => pure value
  | info :: rest, .lam name type body _ => do
    return .lam name type (← creationRestoreBinders rest body) info
  | _, _ => throwError "the creation source telescope lost an original binder"

/-- Specialize only the diagram constructor parameters fixed by its original full Functor
type. The remaining original slots, including implicit data and proofs, stay in native order.
Metavariable identity records declared source indices; no actual expression selects a supplier. -/
opaque CreationFamily.sourceTelescope (diagram : Expr) : MetaM (Expr × Array Nat) :=
    withNewMCtxDepth do
  let .const declaration levels := diagram.consumeMData.getAppFn
    | throwError "the created source diagram lost its original constructor"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
  let constructor := mkConst declaration levels
  let (parameters, binders, result) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType constructor)
  unless parameters.size == diagram.getAppNumArgs do
    throwError "the created source diagram changed its complete original argument telescope"
  unless ← isDefEq result (← inferType diagram) do
    throwError "the source diagram constructor changed its complete native category or shape"
  let applied ← instantiateMVars (mkAppN constructor parameters)
  let abstracted ← abstractMVars applied
  let mut positions : Array Nat := #[]
  let mut annotations : Array BinderInfo := #[]
  let mut previous : Option Nat := none
  for parameter in abstracted.mvars do
    let some index := parameters.findIdx? (· == parameter)
      | throwError "the creation source telescope introduced an undeclared parameter"
    if let some earlier := previous then
      unless earlier < index do
        throwError "the creation source telescope changed original binder order"
    let some binder := binders[index]?
      | throwError "the creation source telescope lost an original binder annotation"
    positions := positions.push index
    annotations := annotations.push binder
    previous := some index
  let family ← creationRestoreBinders annotations.toList abstracted.expr
  let family ← creationResolved family
  return (family, positions)

private def creationDiagramCategory (bundle result : Expr) : MetaM Bool := do
  let result ← whnfR result
  unless result.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Functor 4 do return false
  let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]
  let instance_ ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.str #[bundle]
  (isDefEq result.getAppArgs[2]! carrier) <&&>
    (isDefEq result.getAppArgs[3]! instance_)

/-- Read the diagram constructor from the accepted standardization's original target.
No shape string, native enumeration order or result-apex recognition chooses a diagram. -/
opaque CreationFamily.diagramAt? (entry : LimitEntry) (bundle : Expr)
    (arguments : Array Expr) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  let some name := entry.standardization
    | throwError "the selected creation requires its declared diagram constructor standardization"
  let information ← checkedDeclaration name
  let constructor ← forallTelescope information.type fun _ result => do
    let result ← whnfR result
    unless result.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
      throwError "the declared diagram standardization is not a complete native isomorphism"
    let .const constructor _ := result.getAppArgs[3]!.consumeMData.getAppFn
      | throwError "the declared diagram standardization has no native constructor target"
    return constructor
  creationApplication? constructor arguments (creationDiagramCategory bundle)

/-- The target presentation receives the actual mapped source arguments at its original
explicit positions; the standardization later checks the complete mapped diagram. -/
opaque CreationFamily.presentationAt? (entry : LimitEntry) (bundle : Expr)
    (arguments : Array Expr) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  unless !entry.colimit do
    throwError "a creates-limits witness cannot supply a colimit creation"
  creationApplication? entry.declaration arguments fun result => do
    let result ← whnfR result
    unless result.isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone do
      throwError "the target creation presentation has another native result family"
    let some diagram := result.getAppArgs.back?
      | throwError "the target creation presentation lost its complete diagram"
    creationDiagramCategory bundle (← inferType diagram)

/-- Build the accepted native transport as source, preserving both original data inputs.
These expressions describe the fixed provider action; they are not computed port values. -/
private def creationStandardizedInputs (standardization cone universal : Expr) :
    MetaM (Expr × Expr) := do
  let inverse ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv #[standardization]
  let postcompose ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.postcompose #[inverse]
  let standardizedCone ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.obj #[postcompose, cone]
  let equivalence ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.postcomposeInvEquiv
    #[standardization, cone]
  let inverseEquivalence ← mkAppM ``Equiv.symm #[equivalence]
  let standardizedUniversal ← mkAppM ``Equiv.toFun #[inverseEquivalence, universal]
  let expectedUniversal ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[standardizedCone]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType standardizedUniversal) expectedUniversal do
    throwError "the creation changed its exact standardized universal interface"
  return (standardizedCone, standardizedUniversal)

/-- One fixed source-derived request on the original target data. The selected evidence,
source diagram and comparison remain captured in their original context. In particular no
runtime source evaluation is needed to invent the standardized cone or its universal data.
The complete native output is LiftsToLimit, including validLift and makesLimit. -/
opaque CreationFamily.requestAt (family : CreationFamily)
    (evidence functor diagram : Expr) (target : NativeLimitInterface) : MetaM Expr := do
  let some standardization := target.standardization
    | throwError "the selected creation requires its declared diagram standardization"
  let image ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.comp #[diagram, functor]
  let expectedComparison ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[image, target.diagram]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType standardization) expectedComparison do
    throwError "the creation changed its original mapped-diagram comparison"
  let coneType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone #[target.diagram]
  withLocalDeclD `targetCone coneType fun cone => do
    let universalType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[cone]
    withLocalDeclD `targetUniversal universalType fun universal => do
      let (standardizedCone, standardizedUniversal) ←
        creationStandardizedInputs standardization cone universal
      let result ← family.atEvidence evidence diagram standardizedCone standardizedUniversal
      let request ← mkLambdaFVars #[cone, universal] result
        (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
      creationResolved request

/-- Complete rigid signature for publication of the existing standardized creation action.
The comparison is an explicit native context slot in this schema. A selected runtime request
captures its already accepted comparison with requestAt; providers do not choose this slot. -/
opaque CreationFamily.standardizedTemplate (family : CreationFamily) : MetaM Expr :=
    withLCtx {} #[] do
  lambdaTelescope family.family fun original _ => do
    unless original.size == family.parameterCount + 3 do
      throwError "the creation template lost its complete original native telescope"
    let parameters := original.extract 0 family.parameterCount
    let diagram := original[family.parameterCount]!
    let evidence := mkAppN family.evidenceFamily parameters
    let evidenceType ← whnfR (← inferType evidence)
    let #[_, _, target, targetInstance, shape, shapeInstance, functor] :=
        evidenceType.getAppArgs
      | throwError "the creation template lost its complete native category interface"
    let targetDiagramType ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Functor
      #[some shape, some shapeInstance, some target, some targetInstance]
    let image ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.comp #[diagram, functor]
    withLocalDeclD `targetDiagram targetDiagramType fun targetDiagram => do
      let comparisonType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[image, targetDiagram]
      withLocalDeclD `standardization comparisonType fun standardization => do
        let coneType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone #[targetDiagram]
        withLocalDeclD `targetCone coneType fun cone => do
          let universalType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[cone]
          withLocalDeclD `targetUniversal universalType fun universal => do
            let (standardizedCone, standardizedUniversal) ←
              creationStandardizedInputs standardization cone universal
            let result ← family.atEvidence evidence diagram standardizedCone standardizedUniversal
            let template ← mkLambdaFVars
              (parameters ++ #[diagram, targetDiagram, standardization, cone, universal]) result
              (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
            if template.hasFVar then
              throwError "the complete creation template retained an undeclared native input"
            creationResolved template

/-- Prepare the existing selected standardization and creation actions without evaluating them.
The target cone and its universal interface are projected independently from the same exact
original presentation. Neither returned cone data nor an equal native type selects the latter. -/
opaque CreationFamily.interfaceAt (family : CreationFamily) (evidence functor diagram : Expr)
    (target : NativeLimitInterface) : MetaM NativeLimitCreationInterface := do
  let some standardization := target.standardization
    | throwError "the selected creation requires its declared diagram standardization"
  let targetCone ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.cone #[target.presentation]
  let targetUniversal ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.isLimit #[target.presentation]
  let image ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.comp #[diagram, functor]
  let expectedComparison ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[image, target.diagram]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType standardization) expectedComparison do
    throwError "the creation changed its original mapped-diagram comparison"
  let (standardizedCone, standardizedUniversal) ←
    creationStandardizedInputs standardization targetCone targetUniversal
  let createsLimit ← creationInstance evidence diagram
  let requestFamily ← family.requestAt evidence functor diagram target
  let result ← creationResolved (mkAppN requestFamily #[targetCone, targetUniversal])
  return {
    lift := family.entry.id
    declaration := family.entry.evidence
    edge := family.entry.edge
    evidence, createsLimit, functor, diagram, targetCone, targetUniversal, standardization,
    standardizedCone, standardizedUniversal, requestFamily, result }

/-- Keep the original source presentation's native liftLimit spelling while retaining the
complete liftsToLimitOfCreates result beside it. This is the same fixed accepted selection. -/
opaque NativeLimitCreationInterface.presentation (selected : NativeLimitCreationInterface) :
    MetaM Expr := do
  let arguments := creationArguments selected.diagram selected.functor selected.createsLimit
    selected.standardizedCone selected.standardizedUniversal
  let cone ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.liftLimit arguments
  let universal ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.liftedLimitIsLimit arguments
  creationResolved (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.mk #[cone, universal])

end CasCompiler

/-- The complete fixed creation chosen at the original source boundary. The target cone and
its universal data are separate original inputs. In particular, neither a Cone value nor an
existence proposition supplies the target mediator. Every term travels in the same full source
context; these are retained source fields, not mathematical inhabitants reconstructed from JSON. -/
structure LimitCreationInterface (term : Type) where
  lift : LiftId
  declaration : Name
  edge : EdgeRef
  evidence : term
  createsLimit : term
  functor : term
  diagram : term
  targetCone : term
  targetUniversal : term
  standardization : term
  standardizedCone : term
  standardizedUniversal : term
  /-- Fixed source-derived action on the original target cone and universal data.
  The diagram transport stays inside this action; it is never evaluated by the kernel. -/
  requestFamily : term
  result : term

abbrev NativeLimitCreationInterface := LimitCreationInterface Expr

/-- Preserve the exact ordered native fields through closure and substitution. -/
def LimitCreationInterface.mapM [Monad m] (original : LimitCreationInterface α)
    (f : α → m β) : m (LimitCreationInterface β) := do
  return {
    lift := original.lift
    declaration := original.declaration
    edge := original.edge
    evidence := ← f original.evidence
    createsLimit := ← f original.createsLimit
    functor := ← f original.functor
    diagram := ← f original.diagram
    targetCone := ← f original.targetCone
    targetUniversal := ← f original.targetUniversal
    standardization := ← f original.standardization
    standardizedCone := ← f original.standardizedCone
    standardizedUniversal := ← f original.standardizedUniversal
    requestFamily := ← f original.requestFamily
    result := ← f original.result }

/-- The typed owner envelope stores all eleven native fields in this declared order. -/
def LimitCreationInterface.terms (original : LimitCreationInterface α) : Array α :=
  #[original.evidence, original.createsLimit, original.functor, original.diagram,
    original.targetCone, original.targetUniversal, original.standardization,
    original.standardizedCone, original.standardizedUniversal, original.requestFamily,
    original.result]

/-- Decode only the exact typed field table of the original owner envelope. -/
def LimitCreationInterface.ofTerms (lift : LiftId) (declaration : Name) (edge : EdgeRef)
    (terms : Array α) : Except String (LimitCreationInterface α) := do
  let #[evidence, createsLimit, functor, diagram, targetCone, targetUniversal,
      standardization, standardizedCone, standardizedUniversal, requestFamily, result] := terms
    | throw "the selected creation lost its complete original typed interface"
  return {
    lift := lift, declaration := declaration, edge := edge
    evidence := evidence, createsLimit := createsLimit, functor := functor, diagram := diagram
    targetCone := targetCone, targetUniversal := targetUniversal
    standardization := standardization, standardizedCone := standardizedCone
    standardizedUniversal := standardizedUniversal, requestFamily := requestFamily
    result := result }

end CasCompiler
