public import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Registry.Semantic

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue


def LimitFamily.operation (family : LimitFamily) : String := family.entry.id.raw

def LimitFamily.coneProjection (family : LimitFamily) : Name :=
  if family.entry.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone.cocone
  else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.cone

def LimitFamily.apexProjection (family : LimitFamily) : Name :=
  if family.entry.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.pt
  else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt

def LimitFamily.legProjection (family : LimitFamily) : Name :=
  if family.entry.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.ι
  else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.π

/-- Resolve the supplied public identity before specializing its complete rigid native
telescope. Native projection selects the cone interface, without evaluating the presentation.
The independently accepted data constructor remains the sole authority for reply ports. -/
opaque LimitFamily.forId (id : LimitId) : MetaM LimitFamily := withLCtx {} #[] do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[entry] := state.limits.filter (·.id == id)
    | throwError "the selected limit lost its unique public registration"
  let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == entry.category)
    | throwError "the selected limit lost its registered category"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration category.declaration
  if let some constructor := entry.dataConstructor then
    discard <| checkedDeclaration constructor
  if let some standardization := entry.standardization then
    discard <| checkedDeclaration standardization
  let declaration ← checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
  let presentationFamily := mkConst declaration.name (declaration.levelParams.map Level.param)
  forallTelescopeReducing declaration.type fun parameters result => do
    let result ← whnfR result
    let expected := if entry.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone
      else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone
    unless result.isAppOf expected do
      throwError "the selected limit has another native universal-presentation family"
    let some diagram := result.getAppArgs.back?
      | throwError "the selected limit lost its complete native diagram"
    let presentation := mkAppN presentationFamily parameters
    let cone ← mkAppM (if entry.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone.cocone
      else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.cone) #[presentation]
    let family ← mkLambdaFVars parameters cone (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
    let diagramFamily ← mkLambdaFVars parameters diagram
      (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
    check family
    check diagramFamily
    if family.hasMVar || family.hasLevelMVar || diagramFamily.hasMVar ||
        diagramFamily.hasLevelMVar then
      throwError "the selected limit has an unresolved native family parameter"
    return ⟨entry, category, declaration.levelParams, parameters.size, presentationFamily,
      diagramFamily, family, ← inferType family⟩

/-- The original presentation application at a complete caller-supplied argument table.
Only ordinary native application and rigid universe substitution are performed. -/
opaque LimitFamily.presentationAt (family : LimitFamily) (universes : List Level)
    (context : OpenContext) (arguments : Array ClosedTerm) : MetaM Expr := do
  unless universes.length == family.universeParams.length &&
      arguments.size == family.parameterCount do
    throwError "the limit request changed its complete native parameter telescope"
  let source ← withLCtx {} #[] do
    let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    empty.close (family.presentationFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams universes)
  context.apply source arguments

/-- Validate the retained producer's interface without replacing it by a newly prepared one.
Creation selections may retain a distinct source presentation, while this exact accepted
interface still names the original target presentation and its diagram. -/
opaque LimitFamily.requireInterface (family : LimitFamily)
    (selection : NativeSourceLimitSelection) : MetaM Unit := do
  unless selection.row == family.entry.id.raw && selection.declaration == family.entry.declaration &&
      selection.colimit == family.entry.colimit do
    throwError "the limit request changed its original selected presentation"
  let presentation := selection.interface.presentation
  unless presentation.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf family.entry.declaration &&
      presentation.consumeMData.getAppNumArgs == family.parameterCount do
    throwError "the limit interface lost its complete original declaration application"
  let result ← whnfR (← inferType presentation)
  let expected := if family.entry.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone
    else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone
  unless result.isAppOf expected do
    throwError "the limit interface changed its original universal-presentation type"
  let some diagram := result.getAppArgs.back?
    | throwError "the limit interface lost its native diagram"
  unless ← isDefEq diagram selection.interface.diagram do
    throwError "the retained limit interface has another complete native diagram"
  match family.entry.dataConstructor, selection.interface.dataConstructor with
  | none, none => pure ()
  | some declaration, some constructor => do
    lambdaTelescope constructor fun _ body => do
      unless body.getAppFn.isConstOf declaration do
        throwError "the retained limit interface changed its original data constructor"
    check constructor
  | _, _ => throwError "the retained limit interface changed its accepted data-constructor presence"


/-- Read the original native diagram head and every explicit nonproof field in declaration
order. The public tag is only that already selected head's name; it never selects a diagram. -/
opaque LimitFamily.diagramPorts (diagram : Expr) : MetaM (String × Array Expr) := do
  let diagram := diagram.consumeMData.headBeta
  let .const declaration _ := diagram.getAppFn
    | throwError "the selected native diagram has no original declaration constructor"
  let information ← getFunInfoNArgs diagram.getAppFn diagram.getAppNumArgs
  let mut fields := #[]
  for field in diagram.getAppArgs, index in [:diagram.getAppNumArgs] do
    if (information.paramInfo[index]?.map (·.isExplicit)).getD false then
      unless ← isProof field do fields := fields.push field
  return (declaration.getString!, fields)

/-- Prepare the complete native owner before any actual parameter is substituted.
Every original declaration formal receives its own stable identity from the caller's supply. -/
opaque LimitFamily.prepareOwner (family : LimitFamily) (identities : CasRuntime.IdentitySupply)
    (levels : List Level) (construction : Name) : MetaM (SelectedLimitOwner Expr) := do
  unless levels.length == family.universeParams.length && !construction.isAnonymous do
    throwError "the cone owner requires its complete universes and original construction identity"
  let declaration :=
    family.presentationFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
  forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration) fun formals _ => do
    unless formals.size == family.parameterCount do
      throwError "the whole cone lost its original complete formal telescope"
    let formalBindings ← formals.mapM fun _ => do
      let allocated ← identities.fresh .sourceBinding
      return (⟨allocated.worker, allocated.serial⟩ : BindingId)
    let formalPresentation := mkAppN declaration formals
    let interface ← prepareLimitInterface family.entry formalPresentation
    let diagram := interface.diagram
    let (_, bundle) ← functorCategoryBundles diagram
    let cone ← mkAppM family.coneProjection #[formalPresentation]
    let apex ← mkAppM family.apexProjection #[cone]
    let source : NativeSourceLimitSelection := {
      row := family.entry.id.raw
      declaration := family.entry.declaration
      cone
      colimit := family.entry.colimit
      category := family.category.expression
      bundle
      presentation := formalPresentation
      diagram
      interface
      construction }
    let selected ← NativeLimitSelection.ofSource source apex
    let selected ← selected.mapM fun value =>
      mkLambdaFVars formals value (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
    return ⟨selected, formalBindings⟩

/-- The explicit original receiver family supplies native telescope typing only. -/
opaque LimitFamily.ownerFamily (family : LimitFamily) (owner : SelectedLimitOwner Expr) :
    MetaM Expr := do
  unless owner.formalBindings.size == family.parameterCount do
    throwError "the whole cone lost its original owner formal table"
  check owner.selection.receiver
  return owner.selection.receiver

/-- Specialize every typed field at the original declaration positions. No native body,
equal receiver or registered-row search supplies an absent construction selection. -/
opaque LimitFamily.ownerAt (family : LimitFamily) (owner : SelectedLimitOwner Expr)
    (parameters : Array Expr) : MetaM NativeLimitSelection := do
  unless parameters.size == family.parameterCount do
    throwError "the cone owner view requires every original native parameter position"
  let selected ← owner.specialize parameters
  family.requireInterface selected.source
  unless !selected.source.construction.isAnonymous &&
      selected.source.construction == owner.selection.source.construction do
    throwError "the cone owner view changed its original construction identity"
  return selected

/-- Form the whole-cone request from the explicitly retained complete owner template. -/
opaque LimitFamily.selectedAtOwner (family : LimitFamily) (owner : SelectedLimitOwner Expr)
    (levels : List Level) (parameters : Array Expr) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  unless family.entry.dataConstructor.isSome do
    throwStratum .noImplementation
      m!"the selected limit {family.operation} has no accepted computational data constructor"
  unless levels.length == family.universeParams.length &&
      parameters.size == family.parameterCount do
    throwError "the whole cone request changed its complete native parameter telescope"
  let presentation := mkAppN
    (family.presentationFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels) parameters
  check presentation
  if presentation.hasMVar || presentation.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the whole cone request has unresolved native parameters"
  let selected ← family.ownerAt owner parameters
  unless selected.source.presentation.equal presentation do
    throwError "the whole cone request changed its original selected presentation"
  return {
    value := selected.source.cone
    observation := some (.limit family.entry)
    originalApplication := some presentation
    application := some {
      family := .limit family, universes := levels, parameters,
      owner := some selected.receiver, ownerSelection := some owner }
    limitFamily := some family
    limit := some selected }

/-- New source formation prepares its whole owner once and retains the exact typed result. -/
opaque LimitFamily.selected (family : LimitFamily) (identities : CasRuntime.IdentitySupply)
    (levels : List Level) (parameters : Array Expr) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let construction ← mkFreshUserName `rawLimitConstruction
  let owner ← family.prepareOwner identities levels construction
  family.selectedAtOwner owner levels parameters

/-- Rebind the same original formal construction by its explicit owner template. -/
opaque LimitFamily.formalAt (family : LimitFamily) (context : OpenContext) (original : NativeLimitSelection)
    (owner : SelectedLimitOwner Expr)
    (parameters : Array Expr) : MetaM (Option NativeLimitSelection) := do
  unless original.source.presentation.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf
      original.source.declaration do return none
  family.requireInterface original.source
  let selected ← family.ownerAt owner parameters
  let samePresentation ← context.withOriginalSources
    #[selected.source.presentation, original.source.presentation] fun presentations =>
      isDefEq presentations[0]! presentations[1]!
  unless selected.source.construction == original.source.construction && samePresentation do
    throwError "the formal construction changed its original selected presentation"
  return some { selected with
    source := { selected.source with
      ownerFamily := original.source.ownerFamily
      creation := original.source.creation
      creationFamily := original.source.creationFamily
      creationInputs := original.source.creationInputs } }

/-- Demand the exact whole cone using the selected owner supplied by source formation. -/
opaque LimitFamily.wholeFrom (family : LimitFamily) (original : NativeLimitSelection)
    (owner : SelectedLimitOwner Expr) :
    MetaM (Option (SourceSelection Expr)) := do
  family.requireInterface original.source
  unless original.source.presentation.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf
      original.source.declaration do
    throwStratum .noImplementation
      "the selected creation of a limit requires its accepted computational lift"
  let presentation := original.source.interface.presentation.consumeMData
  let .const declaration levels := presentation.getAppFn
    | throwError "the formal construction lost its original full native presentation"
  unless declaration == family.entry.declaration do
    throwError "the formal construction changed its original registered presentation"
  return some (← family.selectedAtOwner owner levels presentation.getAppArgs)

end CasCompiler

public import CasCompiler.Declaration
public import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Registry.Entry
public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.HasLimits
public import Lean.Meta.AbstractMVars

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue

/-- A selected universal presentation and its accepted computational interface.
The diagram is the presentation's own diagram. A creation lift separately retains its source
diagram and source presentation. The data constructor retains its complete dependent telescope,
including formal proof arguments; its non-Prop arguments are the computational data ports. -/
structure LimitInterface (term : Type) where
  presentation : term
  diagram : term
  standardization : Option term
  dataConstructor : Option term

abbrev NativeLimitInterface := LimitInterface Expr

/-- Transport all parts of one interface through the same checked source context. -/
def LimitInterface.mapM [Monad m] (interface : LimitInterface α) (f : α → m β) :
    m (LimitInterface β) := do
  return {
    presentation := ← f interface.presentation
    diagram := ← f interface.diagram
    standardization := ← interface.standardization.mapM f
    dataConstructor := ← interface.dataConstructor.mapM f }

private def resolved (value : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let value ← instantiateMVars value
  if value.hasExprMVar || value.hasLevelMVar || value.hasLooseBVars then
    throwError "a selected limit interface requires its complete source parameters"
  check value
  return value

/-- Restore the declared binder annotations after native metavariable abstraction.
Lean.Meta.abstractMVars preserves dependency order but creates explicit local binders. -/
private def restoreBinders : List BinderInfo → Expr → MetaM Expr
  | [], value => pure value
  | info :: rest, .lam name type body _ => do
    return .lam name type (← restoreBinders rest body) info
  | _, _ => throwError "the limit data constructor lost a declared argument"

/-- Specialize only the constructor parameters fixed by the complete declared diagram.
Reuse: Registry.validateLimit, Lean's native telescope and abstractMVars at v4.33.0.
Every remaining argument, including proofs and implicit object ports, stays in declaration
order. The accepted constructor supplies the dependencies; no cone field is guessed. -/
private def prepareDataConstructor (row : LimitEntry) (diagram : Expr) (name : Name) :
    MetaM Expr := withNewMCtxDepth do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration name
  let constructor ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels name
  let (parameters, binders, conclusion) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType constructor)
  let expected ← mkAppM (if row.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone
    else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone) #[diagram]
  unless ← withTransparency .all <| isDefEq conclusion expected do
    throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: its data constructor changes the selected diagram"
  let applied ← instantiateMVars (mkAppN constructor parameters)
  let abstracted ← abstractMVars applied
  let mut retainedBinders := #[]
  let mut previous : Option Nat := none
  for parameter in abstracted.mvars do
    let some index := parameters.findIdx? (· == parameter)
      | throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: its data constructor has an undeclared argument"
    if let some prior := previous then
      unless prior < index do
        throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: its data constructor changed argument order"
    let some binder := binders[index]?
      | throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: its data constructor lost an argument annotation"
    retainedBinders := retainedBinders.push binder
    previous := some index
  let value ← restoreBinders retainedBinders.toList abstracted.expr
  -- Universes that the diagram does not fix remain rigid parameters of this interface.
  -- Fresh names avoid identifying them with universes of another selected interface.
  let levels ← abstracted.paramNames.mapM fun _ => do
    return Level.param (← mkFreshUserName `limitDataUniverse)
  let value ← resolved (value.instantiateLevelParamsArray abstracted.paramNames levels)
  forallTelescope (← inferType value) fun _ result => do
    unless ← withTransparency .all <| isDefEq result expected do
      throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: its data constructor lost the fixed result diagram"
  return value

private def prepareStandardization (row : LimitEntry) (diagram requested : Expr) :
    MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  match row.standardization with
  | none =>
    unless ← withTransparency .all <| isDefEq requested diagram do
      throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: the requested diagram needs a declared standardization"
    return none
  | some name =>
    discard <| checkedDeclaration name
    let comparison ← mkAppM name #[requested]
    let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[requested, diagram]
    unless ← withTransparency .all <| isDefEq (← inferType comparison) expected do
      throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: its standardization changes the selected diagram"
    return some (← resolved comparison)

/-- Reuse the already prepared native data constructor at the original selected target
presentation. A creation lift supplies its mapped source diagram only to the independently
accepted standardization; no constructor telescope or rigid universe is prepared again. -/
def NativeLimitInterface.withRequestedDiagram (interface : NativeLimitInterface)
    (row : LimitEntry) (requested : Expr) : MetaM NativeLimitInterface := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration row.declaration
  unless interface.presentation.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf row.declaration do
    throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: the retained interface changed its declaration"
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType interface.presentation)
  let family := if row.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone
    else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone
  unless type.isAppOf family do
    throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: the retained interface changed its result family"
  let some diagram := type.getAppArgs.back?
    | throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: the retained interface lost its declared diagram"
  unless ← withTransparency .all <| isDefEq diagram interface.diagram do
    throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: the retained interface changed its complete diagram"
  return { interface with standardization :=
    ← prepareStandardization row interface.diagram (← resolved requested) }

/-- Prepare the interface at the exact presentation selected by source formation.
`requestedDiagram` is the diagram before the accepted standardization; for creation it is
the image of the source diagram under the selected creation functor. The result retains the
presentation application itself, with every original implicit and explicit argument.

Source: LimitEntry and Registry.validateLimit at lean-categories
8c35703b104aca1700b9fb40d1af4164ca31a55d. These declarations determine the interface;
the helper neither evaluates the presentation nor obtains a computational cone. -/
def prepareLimitInterface (row : LimitEntry) (presentation : Expr)
    (requestedDiagram : Option Expr := none) : MetaM NativeLimitInterface := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration row.declaration
  let presentation ← resolved presentation
  unless presentation.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf row.declaration do
    throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: the selected presentation changed its declaration"
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType presentation)
  let family := if row.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone
    else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone
  unless type.isAppOf family do
    throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: its presentation has a different result family"
  let some diagram := type.getAppArgs.back?
    | throwError "limit {row.id.raw}: its presentation has no diagram"
  let diagram ← resolved diagram
  let requested ← resolved (requestedDiagram.getD diagram)
  let standardization ← prepareStandardization row diagram requested
  let dataConstructor ← row.dataConstructor.mapM (prepareDataConstructor row diagram)
  return { presentation, diagram, standardization, dataConstructor }

end CasCompiler

public import CasCompiler.SelectionData
import all CasCompiler.SelectionData
public import CasCompiler.SourceTypeOrigin

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

/-- Resolve only the explicit template binder in the supplied complete typed scope. -/
opaque SelectedLimitOwner.ofBinding (context : OpenContext)
    (scope : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (value : Expr) : MetaM (SelectedLimitOwner Expr) := do
  let some selected := scope.findAt? context value.getAppFn
    | throwError "the construction lost its exact selected owner-template binding"
  let actual := value.getAppArgs
  unless actual.size ≤ selected.formalBindings.size do
    throwError "the construction changed its selected owner-template formal positions"
  let selected ← selected.mapM fun field => do
    let applied := mkAppN field actual
    check applied
    return applied.headBeta
  let some selection := selected.limit
    | throwError "the construction lost its original typed owner template"
  unless selected.value.equal selection.receiver do
    throwError "the owner template changed its original native receiver family"
  return ⟨selection, selected.formalBindings.drop actual.size⟩

/-- Retain a fully prepared owner template in the same binding table as source results.
Its fields are already abstracted over their complete original declaration telescope. -/
def SelectedLimitOwner.bind (owner : SelectedLimitOwner Expr) (family : LimitFamily)
    (creationOwner : Option (CreationFamily × LimitFamily) := none) : SourceReadM Expr :=
  fun _ scope finish => do
    let parameters ← scope.formals.filterM fun binding => do
      return !(← binding.expression.fvarId!.getDecl).isLet
    let owner ← owner.mapM fun field =>
      mkLambdaFVars (scope.formals.map (·.expression)) field
        (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
    let selection : SourceSelection Expr := {
      value := owner.selection.receiver,
      formalBindings := parameters.map (·.id) ++ owner.formalBindings,
      limit := some owner.selection, limitFamily := some family, creationOwner }
    scope.selections.withBinding scope.identities scope.context selection
      (fun context selections value =>
        finish (mkAppN value (parameters.map (·.expression))) { scope with context, selections })

/-- Check the complete source-authored construction before its receiver enters a typed scope. -/
opaque NativeLimitSelection.ofSource (source : NativeSourceLimitSelection) (receiver : Expr) :
    MetaM NativeLimitSelection := do
  unless !source.construction.isAnonymous do
    throwError "the original construction has no shared selection identity"
  check receiver
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType receiver)
      (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[source.bundle]) do
    throwError "the construction receiver has a different complete native category"
  return ⟨source, receiver⟩

/-- Retain the exact selected construction beside its already selected named source. -/
opaque retainLimitConstruction (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let some category := judgement.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a selected construction requires its original category"
  let some source := category.limit
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a selected construction requires its original interface"
  let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? judgement.value
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a selected construction requires its original source reference"
  let some (.limit row) := selected.reference
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the construction changed its original source reference"
  let some family := selected.limitFamily
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the construction lost its complete original limit family"
  unless (SelectedSourceReference.limit row).exactlyMatches (.limit family.entry) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the construction changed its complete original limit family"
  unless row.declaration == source.declaration && row.id.raw == source.row do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the construction changed its original source reference"
  let some _ ← sourceApplication? source.declaration selected
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the construction lost its original registered application"
  let owner ← NativeLimitSelection.ofSource source judgement.value
  let value ← SourceReadM.select { selected with
    value := judgement.value
    category := some category
    limit := some owner }
  return { judgement with value }

/-- The component producer retains its actual selected receiver and its exact native index. -/
opaque retainLimitLeg (category : NativeSourceCategory) (receiver index value : Expr)
    (declaredType : Option Expr := none) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let some source := category.limit
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a selected leg requires its receiver's original construction"
  let some retained ← SourceReadM.selection? receiver
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a selected leg lost its receiver's original selection"
  let some construction := retained.limit
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a selected leg lost its original construction"
  let some family := retained.limitFamily
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a selected leg lost its complete original limit family"
  unless !source.construction.isAnonymous &&
      source.construction == construction.source.construction do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the receiver belongs to a different original construction selection"
  let construction ← NativeLimitSelection.ofSource construction.source receiver
  SourceReadM.select {
    value, leg := some ⟨construction, index, value⟩, limitFamily := some family } declaredType

/-- Read the original typed component by binding identity; no native envelope supplies it. -/
opaque NativeLimitLegSelection.ofExpr? (context : OpenContext)
    (scope : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (value : Expr) :
    MetaM (Option NativeLimitLegSelection) := do
  let some selected := scope.findAt? context value.getAppFn | return none
  return (← selected.specialize value.getAppArgs).leg

/-- Form a component on an explicitly supplied cone and native index. The caller supplies
the actual retained parent; conversion only checks its declared type and never chooses it.
No projection is reduced and no mathematical declaration or matcher is evaluated. -/
opaque NativeLimitSelection.legAt (selection : NativeLimitSelection) (cone index : Expr) :
    MetaM Expr := do
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType cone) (← inferType selection.source.cone) do
    throwError "the retained cone has a different complete native interface"
  let transformation ← mkAppM (if selection.source.colimit then
    ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.ι else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.π) #[cone]
  let component ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[transformation]
  let value := mkApp component index
  check value
  return value

end CasCompiler

public import CasCompiler.SelectionData
import all CasCompiler.SelectionData

public import CasCompiler.LimitFamily

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue


def LimitUniversalFamily.operation (family : LimitUniversalFamily) : String :=
  family.presentation.operation ++ "#" ++ family.projection.getString!

def LimitUniversalFamily.input (family : LimitUniversalFamily) : String :=
  family.operation ++ "#input"

def LimitUniversalFamily.universeParams (family : LimitUniversalFamily) : List Name :=
  family.presentation.universeParams

def LimitUniversalFamily.parameterCount (family : LimitUniversalFamily) : Nat :=
  family.presentation.parameterCount

/-- The native selection from the complete original LimitCone/ColimitCocone. -/
def LimitUniversalFamily.path (family : LimitUniversalFamily) : Array Name :=
  #[family.projection]

/-- Project the already accepted universal data under every original declaration
parameter and rigid universe. IsLimit/IsColimit are data records, not proof fields. -/
opaque LimitUniversalFamily.forId (id : LimitId) : MetaM LimitUniversalFamily :=
    withLCtx {} #[] do
  let presentation ← LimitFamily.forId id
  let projection := if presentation.entry.colimit then
    ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone.isColimit
    else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.isLimit
  forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType presentation.presentationFamily) fun parameters _ => do
    unless parameters.size == presentation.parameterCount do
      throwError "the universal family changed its complete original parameter telescope"
    let selected := mkAppN presentation.presentationFamily parameters
    let universal ← mkAppM projection #[selected]
    if ← isProof universal then
      throwError "the original universal interface was replaced by a proof"
    let family ← mkLambdaFVars parameters universal
      (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
    check family
    if family.hasMVar || family.hasLevelMVar then
      throwError "the universal family has an unresolved original native parameter"
    return ⟨presentation, projection, family, ← inferType family⟩

/-- Form the native universal data with its exact typed owner and actual cone operand.
An omitted cone is supplied by the same selected whole-cone producer inside its scoped binder. -/
def LimitUniversalFamily.selectedAtOwner [Monad m] [MonadLiftT MetaM m]
    (family : LimitUniversalFamily) (owner : SelectedLimitOwner Expr)
    (levels : List Level) (parameters : Array Expr)
    (select : SourceSelection Expr → Option Expr → m Expr)
    (cone : Option Expr := none) : m (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  unless levels.length == family.universeParams.length &&
      parameters.size == family.parameterCount do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the universal request changed its complete native parameter telescope"
  let presentation := mkAppN
    (family.presentation.presentationFamily.instantiateLevelParams
      family.universeParams levels) parameters
  liftM (m := MetaM) <| check presentation
  if presentation.hasMVar || presentation.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the universal request has unresolved original native parameters"
  let selected ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| family.presentation.ownerAt owner parameters
  unless selected.source.interface.presentation.equal presentation do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the universal request changed its original target presentation"
  let universal ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| mkAppM family.projection #[selected.source.interface.presentation]
  let nativeCone ← liftM (m := MetaM) <|
    mkAppM family.presentation.coneProjection #[selected.source.interface.presentation]
  let cone ← match cone with
    | some cone => pure cone
    | none => do
      let cone ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| family.presentation.selectedAtOwner owner levels parameters
      select cone none
  liftM (m := MetaM) <| check cone
  unless ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| isDefEq (← inferType cone) (← inferType nativeCone) do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the retained universal input changed its original native cone interface"
  if cone.hasMVar || cone.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the retained universal cone has unresolved native parameters"
  return {
    value := universal
    observation := some (.limit family.presentation.entry)
    originalApplication := some presentation
    application := some {
      family := .limitUniversal family, universes := levels, parameters,
      arguments := #[cone], owner := some selected.receiver, ownerSelection := some owner }
    limit := some selected }

end CasCompiler

-- Every source binder, including original proof positions and rigid universe parameters,
-- survives selecting the universal record from the complete native presentation. The
-- existing nullary terminal presentation must remain a record with an empty input frame.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let identifiers := #["lim.sets.product", "lim.sets.pullback", "colim.sets.coproduct",
    "lim.sets.diagram", "lim.sets.terminal"]
  for identifier in identifiers do
    let family ← LimitUniversalFamily.forId ⟨identifier⟩
    let information ← getConstInfo family.presentation.entry.declaration
    unless family.universeParams == information.levelParams &&
        family.operation == identifier ++ "#" ++ family.projection.getString! &&
        family.input == family.operation ++ "#input" && family.path == #[family.projection] do
      throwError "the universal family changed its independently selected native owner"
    checkWithKernel family.family
    for levels in #[family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
        family.universeParams.map Level.param] do
      let declaration := mkConst information.name levels
      forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration) fun parameters _ => do
        unless parameters.size == family.parameterCount do
          throwError "the universal family added or removed an original declaration parameter"
        let bindings := parameters.mapIdx fun index expression =>
          { id := { session := "universal-original-telescope", serial := index },
            role := BindingRole.parameter, expression : LocalBinding }
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let closed ← (parameters.mapM context.close : MetaM (Array ClosedTerm))
        let original ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close declaration)
        let (_, application) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource original context closed
        let selected ← application.forProjection family.projection
        unless selected.arguments.size == parameters.size &&
            selected.result.address == application.result.address ++ family.path do
          throwError "native universal selection changed its original telescope or full path"
        for parameter in parameters, argument in selected.arguments, index in [:parameters.size] do
          unless argument.sourceIndex == index &&
              argument.wireIndex.isNone == (← isProof parameter) &&
              argument.binderInfo == (← parameter.fvarId!.getDecl).binderInfo do
            throwError "native universal selection changed an original proof or binder position"
        let presentation := mkAppN declaration parameters
        let expected ← mkAppM family.projection #[presentation]
        let actual := (mkAppN
          (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels) parameters).headBeta
        unless ← isDefEq actual expected do
          throwError "the universal family changed the original selected native projection"
        if ← isProof actual then
          throwError "the data-bearing universal interface was discarded as a proof"
        let actualResult ← selected.result.source.inContext context
        unless ← isDefEq actualResult expected do
          throwError "the application selected another original native result"
        let typeFamily := (mkAppN
          (← selected.resultTypeFamily.inContext context) parameters).headBeta
        unless ← isDefEq typeFamily (← inferType expected) do
          throwError "the projected dependency family changed the complete native result type"
        let dependencies ← application.dependenciesAt family.path
        unless selected.resultDependencies == dependencies.arguments &&
            selected.resultContextDependencies == dependencies.context do
          throwError "the universal projection lost its original dependency positions"
        if identifier == "lim.sets.product" then
          unless selected.resultDependencies.contains 0 && selected.resultDependencies.contains 1 do
            throwError "the universal product interface lost an original endpoint parameter"
        if identifier == "lim.sets.terminal" then
          unless parameters.isEmpty && selected.arguments.isEmpty &&
              selected.resultDependencies.isEmpty && selected.result.kind == .record do
            throwError "the nullary universal presentation lost its empty original record frame"
        let #[nativeUniversal] := application.result.fields.filter
            (·.projection == family.projection)
          | throwError "the complete presentation lost its original universal field"
        let earlier ← application.result.actionInputs context presentation #[nativeUniversal]
        unless earlier.any (·.projection == family.presentation.coneProjection) do
          throwError "the universal interface lost its actual earlier cone input"
        for predecessor in earlier do
          unless predecessor.sourceIndex < nativeUniversal.sourceIndex do
            throwError "the universal interface changed its original source order"
        let liftProjection := if family.presentation.entry.colimit then
          ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit.desc else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.lift
        let #[nativeLift] := selected.result.fields.filter (·.projection == liftProjection)
          | throwError "the native universal continuation is absent"
        unless nativeLift.wireIndex == some 0 do
          throwError "the universal continuation lost its actual data position"
        checkWithKernel (← mkLambdaFVars parameters expected
          (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false))
        checkWithKernel (← mkLambdaFVars parameters actualResult
          (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false))
    let ports ← PublishedPorts.forLimitUniversal family.presentation.entry.id
    unless ports.any (fun port => port.operation == family.operation &&
        port.path == family.path) do
      throwError "publication lost the whole native universal record"
    unless ports.any (fun port => port.operation == family.operation &&
        port.path.size > family.path.size) do
      throwError "publication lost the native universal continuation"
    if ports.any (·.operation == identifier) then
      throwError "a universal native field reused the distinct raw cone address"
    for suffix in #["#leg", "#apex", "#map", "#input"] do
      if (← PublishedPorts.limitUniversal? (← semanticState) (identifier ++ suffix)).isSome then
        throwError "a limit prefix authorized an undeclared universal address"

-- Source formation retains the original construction and every actual parameter position.
-- The default cone is a published whole request; explicit completed-cone binders stay exact.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  for identifier in #["lim.sets.product", "colim.sets.coproduct", "lim.sets.pullback"] do
    let family ← LimitUniversalFamily.forId ⟨identifier⟩
    let levels := family.universeParams.map Level.param
    let declaration := family.presentation.presentationFamily.instantiateLevelParams
      family.universeParams levels
    forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration) fun parameters _ => do
      let construction ← mkFreshUserName `originalUniversalConstruction
      let owner ← family.presentation.prepareOwner identities levels construction
      let bindings ← parameters.mapM fun expression => do
        let allocated ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| identities.fresh .sourceBinding
        return ({ id := ⟨allocated.worker, allocated.serial⟩,
          role := .parameter, expression } : LocalBinding)
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let initial : SourceReadScope := { identities, context, selections := {} }
      let read : SourceReadM (SourceSelection Expr) :=
        family.selectedAtOwner owner levels parameters
          (fun selected expected => SourceReadM.select selected expected)
      read.runK initial fun source scope => do
        checkWithKernel (← mkLambdaFVars parameters source.value
          (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false))
        let some application := source.application
          | throwError "the universal source lost its complete selected application"
        let .limitUniversal restored := application.family
          | throwError "the universal source lost its exact complete native family"
        let some selected := source.limit
          | throwError "the universal source lost its original construction"
        let some originalOwner := application.ownerSelection
          | throwError "the universal source lost its complete typed owner template"
        unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.limitUniversal restored).exactlyMatches
              (.limitUniversal family) &&
            application.universes == levels && application.parameters == parameters &&
            selected.source.construction == construction do
          throwError "the universal source changed its original selected parameter table"
        let #[cone] := application.arguments
          | throwError "the universal source lost its single original cone argument"
        let some rawSource := scope.selections.findAt? scope.context cone
          | throwError "the universal source lost its published whole-cone request"
        let some rawApplication := rawSource.application
          | throwError "the default universal cone lost its complete native parameter table"
        let .limit raw := rawApplication.family
          | throwError "the default universal cone changed its original raw family"
        let some rawOwner := rawApplication.ownerSelection
          | throwError "the default universal cone lost its typed owner"
        let some rawSelected := rawSource.limit
          | throwError "the default universal cone lost its original construction"
        let sameOwner := SourceSelection.exactlyMatches Expr.equal
          ({ value := originalOwner.selection.receiver, limit := some originalOwner.selection,
            formalBindings := originalOwner.formalBindings } : SourceSelection Expr)
          ({ value := rawOwner.selection.receiver, limit := some rawOwner.selection,
            formalBindings := rawOwner.formalBindings } : SourceSelection Expr)
        unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.limit raw).exactlyMatches (.limit family.presentation) &&
            rawApplication.parameters == parameters && rawApplication.owner == application.owner &&
            sameOwner && rawSelected.source.construction == construction do
          throwError "the default universal cone changed its original raw source occurrence"
        for _ in #[41, 42] do
          SourceSelectionScope.withBinding identities scope.selections scope.context rawSource
              fun _ _ actualCone => do
            let explicit ← family.selectedAtOwner originalOwner levels parameters
              (fun _ _ => throwError "the explicitly supplied cone cannot be replaced")
              (some actualCone)
            let some explicitApplication := explicit.application
              | throwError "the explicit completed cone lost its universal application"
            let some original := explicit.limit
              | throwError "the explicit completed cone lost its original construction"
            unless explicitApplication.arguments == #[actualCone] &&
                original.source.construction == construction do
              throwError "the universal source replaced an actual completed-cone occurrence"
        let wrongCone ← try
            discard <| family.selectedAtOwner originalOwner levels parameters
              (fun _ _ => throwError "the explicitly supplied cone cannot be replaced")
              (some (mkNatLit 1))
            pure false
          catch _ => pure true
        unless wrongCone do throwError "the universal source admitted another native cone interface"
        let presentation := mkAppN declaration parameters
        let wrongValue ← mkAppM family.presentation.coneProjection #[presentation]
        let expected ← inferType source.value
        let wrongProjection ← try
            SourceSelectionScope.withBinding identities scope.selections scope.context
              { source with value := wrongValue } (fun _ _ _ => pure ())
              (declaredType := some expected)
            pure false
          catch _ => pure true
        unless wrongProjection do throwError "the universal source admitted another native projection"

-- The root creation port publishes the complete fixed-context template, including
-- target diagram and accepted comparison. Its two actual data inputs remain the
-- original target cone and universal record, not standardized runtime substitutes.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let family ← CreationFamily.forId ⟨"lift.finite_sets.pullbacks"⟩
  let template ← family.standardizedTemplate
  let signature ← inferType template
  let #[port] ← PublishedPorts.forCreation family.entry.id
    | throwError "creation publication changed its single complete-result operation"
  unless port.operation == family.entry.id.raw && port.path.isEmpty &&
      (← isDefEq port.type signature) do
    throwError "the creation port omitted its full original comparison context"
  for levels in #[family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
      family.universeParams.map Level.param] do
    let native := template.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
    let type ← inferType native
    unless !native.hasMVar && !native.hasLevelMVar && !native.hasFVar do
      throwError "the creation publication failed to close its rigid native telescope"
    checkWithKernel native
    checkWithKernel type
    forallTelescopeReducing type fun parameters result => do
      unless parameters.size == family.parameterCount + 5 do
        throwError "the creation signature lost an evidence, diagram or comparison position"
      let some targetDiagram := parameters[family.parameterCount + 1]?
        | throwError "the creation signature lost its original target diagram"
      let some comparison := parameters[family.parameterCount + 2]?
        | throwError "the creation signature lost its accepted comparison"
      let some cone := parameters[family.parameterCount + 3]?
        | throwError "the creation signature lost its actual target cone"
      let some universal := parameters[family.parameterCount + 4]?
        | throwError "the creation signature lost its actual target universal data"
      unless (← whnfR (← inferType comparison)).isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.Iso &&
          (← isDefEq (← inferType cone)
            (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone #[targetDiagram])) &&
          (← isDefEq (← inferType universal)
            (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[cone])) &&
          !(← isProof universal) &&
          (← whnfR result).isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit do
        throwError "the creation signature changed its original inputs or complete native result"

initialize registerTraceClass `cas.lower

/-- A selected leg whose exact source receiver is already an authenticated projection of
one completed cone. Only lowering that receiver constructs this demand. Runtime execution
receives the existing parent and association chain; it never finds a cone by row or diagram. -/
structure NativeLimitLegDemand where
  private mk ::
  selection : NativeLimitLegSelection
  receiver : ValueBinding
  cone : ValueBinding
  /-- Present only when the receiver itself supplied the authenticated native projection. -/
  apexSource : Option SourceLayout
  /-- The compiler-prepared native component at its original typed diagram index. -/
  component : ClosedTerm
  /-- The actual lowering frame, including nested callable captures and local binders. -/
  context : OpenContext
  bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding
  selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr
  contextEnvironment : RuntimeEnvironment

/-- The active cell consumed by compiled source code. `run` interprets each emitted program.
A later demand is prepared from the actual references that an earlier program returned. -/
structure LowerEnvironment where
  ledger : OccurrenceLedger
  transaction : CellTransaction
  codes : IO.Ref (Std.HashMap (RuntimeId .program) ClosureCode)
  sourceSnapshot : Option Json := none
  run : OperationalProgram ValueBinding → MetaM ValueBinding
  /-- Consume released leg data from the actual completed packet. The handler must keep the
  supplied cone, diagram, typed index and owners; it is not an arbitrary apply operation. -/
  limitLeg : NativeLimitLegDemand → MetaM ValueBinding := fun _ =>
    throwStratum .noImplementation "the completed cone requires its native leg-data continuation"

private structure Frame where
  environment : LowerEnvironment
  program : RuntimeId .program
  context : OpenContext
  bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding
  selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr := {}
  /-- A validated membership view of this frame's fixed context and binding table.
  Native associations may be reused within this fixed frame only after validating
  their references against the current graph and capturing the complete source bindings.
  Prepared invocation inputs still undergo their complete admission. -/
  retainedView : IO.Ref (Option RuntimeEnvironment)
  selection : Option Name := none
  selectionBinding : Option BindingId := none

private abbrev LowerM := ReaderT Frame MetaM

private def supply : LowerM IdentitySupply :=
  return (← read).environment.ledger.owners.identities

private def parameters : LowerM (Array RuntimeParameter) := do
  let frame ← read
  let graph ← frame.environment.transaction.view
  let mut result := #[]
  for binding in frame.context.bindings do
    if let some value := frame.bound[binding.id]? then
      let .ok parameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id value
        | throwError "internal: a retained source binding is outside the active graph"
      result := result.push parameter
  return result

private def runtimeEnvironment : LowerM RuntimeEnvironment := do
  let frame ← read
  RuntimeEnvironment.capture (← supply).worker frame.context (← parameters)
    (some (← frame.environment.transaction.view))
    (← frame.retainedView.get)
    (selections := frame.selections)

/-- Continue in the complete native binder scope and its matching value table. -/
private def withScope (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
    (action : LowerM α) (incoming : SourceSelectionScope Expr := {}) : LowerM α := do
  let frame ← read
  let retainedView ← IO.mkRef none
  let mut selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge frame.selections incoming
  for (_, value) in bound.toArray do
    selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections (← value.role.selections.inContext context)
    if value.admittedInterface?.isSome then
      selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections (← value.nativeRole.selections.inContext context)
  withReader (fun frame => { frame with context, bound, selections, retainedView }) action

/-- Import the exact displayed role context owned by this value before using its source. -/
private def withRetained (value : ValueBinding) (action : LowerM α) : LowerM α := do
  let frame ← read
  withBindingContext (← frame.environment.transaction.view) frame.context frame.bound value
    fun context bound => do
      let mut selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge frame.selections
        (← value.role.selections.inContext context)
      if value.admittedInterface?.isSome then
        selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections (← value.nativeRole.selections.inContext context)
      (withScope context bound action).run { frame with selections }

/-- Name one actual occurrence in the native scope before its continuation is lowered.
The complete context and its sole bound-value map travel together; no value is encoded
in the term, and a fresh frame validates captures against this extended scope. -/
private def withValue (source : Expr) (value : ValueBinding)
    (action : Expr → LowerM α) : LowerM α := withRetained value do
  let frame ← read
  withBoundValue (← supply) frame.context frame.bound source value fun context bound scopedSource => do
    (withScope context bound (action scopedSource)).run frame

/-- Source-path selection only asks which original bindings are retained.
The frame's context and binding table do not change during lowering; recursive
execution opens its own frame. Reuse the checked lookup table for this question,
not as authority for admitting a later request. Origin formation revalidates
all references against its actual graph. -/
private def retainedEnvironment : LowerM RuntimeEnvironment := do
  let frame ← read
  -- Even source-path inspection must not continue in a settled transaction.
  discard <| frame.environment.transaction.view
  if let some view ← frame.retainedView.get then return view
  let view ← runtimeEnvironment
  frame.retainedView.set (some view)
  return view

-- Temporary bounded source-cost inspection. The timer never changes or resets the budget.
private def sourceCostHead (expression : Expr) : String :=
  match expression.consumeMData.getAppFn.consumeMData with
  | .const name _ => s!"constant:{name}"
  | .proj name position parent =>
    s!"projection:{name}.{position};parent={reprStr parent.consumeMData.getAppFn.constName?}"
  | .fvar _ => "fvar"
  | .bvar _ => "bound"
  | .sort _ => "sort"
  | .forallE .. => "forall"
  | .lam .. => "lambda"
  | .letE .. => "let"
  | .lit _ => "literal"
  | .mvar _ => "metavariable"
  | .mdata .. => "metadata"
  | .app .. => "application"

private def traceExpensiveLower {α : Type} (phase : String) (expression : Expr)
    (contextSize : Nat) (action : LowerM α) : LowerM α := do
  let started ← IO.getNumHeartbeats
  try
    action
  finally
    -- Diagnostics must not replace the original success, failure or interrupt.
    try
      let finished ← IO.getNumHeartbeats
      let elapsed := finished - started
      if elapsed ≥ 10000000 then
        CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[lower.cost] phase={phase} head={sourceCostHead expression} arguments={expression.getAppNumArgs} context={contextSize} rawTicks={elapsed} start={started} finish={finished}"
    catch _ => pure ()

-- Stamp an already checked source layout with the current actual runtime context.
-- Reusing native layout data never reuses an earlier occurrence or parameter table.
private def originFor (role : SourceLayout) : LowerM ValueOrigin := do
  let frame ← read
  let identities ← supply
  -- The complete native association of this fixed frame was checked by
  -- capture. Recheck every referenced identity in the actual current graph;
  -- do not reuse its graph snapshot as authority for a later origin.
  let checked ← retainedEnvironment
  let graph ← frame.environment.transaction.view
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners checked.references).mapError IO.userError
  let environment ← traceExpensiveLower "origin.refresh" role.source.expression
      frame.context.bindings.size do
    checked.withGraph (some graph)
  traceExpensiveLower "origin.transport" role.source.expression frame.context.bindings.size do
    environment.origin frame.program (← identities.fresh .occurrence) role

private def origin (expression : Expr) : LowerM ValueOrigin := do
  let frame ← read
  traceExpensiveLower "origin.total" expression frame.context.bindings.size do
    let source ← traceExpensiveLower "origin.close" expression frame.context.bindings.size do
      frame.context.close expression
    let role ← traceExpensiveLower "origin.layout" expression frame.context.bindings.size do
      let selected := do
        let .fvar localId := expression | none
        let binding ← frame.context.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == localId)
        if frame.selections.contains binding.id then some binding.id else none
      SourceLayout.ofTerm source (selections := ← frame.selections.close frame.context)
        (selectionBinding := selected)
    originFor role

private def stage (expression : Expr) (payload : ValuePayload) : LowerM ValueBinding := do
  (← read).environment.transaction.stage (← origin expression) payload

private def demand (request : PreparedRequest) : LowerM ValueBinding := do
  let frame ← read
  let request := (request.withSelection frame.selection).withSourceSnapshot
    frame.environment.sourceSnapshot
  frame.environment.run do
    let response ← PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) request
    pure response.root

/-- A published computation cannot be silently evaluated as an ordinary native definition.
This predicate selects no row or address; the reader must supply that original reference. -/
private def isRegisteredComputation (state : SemanticState) (declaration : Name) : Bool :=
  state.operations.any (·.declaration == declaration) ||
  state.functors.any (·.declaration == declaration) ||
  state.constructions.any (·.declaration == declaration) ||
  state.morphisms.any (·.declaration == declaration) ||
  state.objects.any (·.application == some declaration) ||
  state.binders.any (·.operation == declaration)

/-- Native fields of independently registered constant declarations may use their definitions.
Membership is the only result: it never chooses a descriptor ID, even for a unique row. -/
private def isRegisteredDescriptor (state : SemanticState) (declaration : Name) : Bool :=
  state.objects.any (·.declaration == declaration) ||
  state.categories.any (·.declaration == declaration) ||
  state.numerals.any (·.declaration == declaration) ||
  state.literals.any (·.denotation == declaration) ||
  state.graphLiterals.any (·.denotation == declaration) ||
  state.subsetLiterals.any (·.denotation == declaration) ||
  state.classifiers.any (·.declaration == declaration) ||
  state.cells.any (·.declaration == declaration) ||
  state.presentations.any (·.declaration == declaration) ||
  state.constructors.any (·.semantics == declaration)

/-- Reject loss of a public source selection before native reduction can erase its boundary.
Named limit/generator applications are included although their addresses have a distinct form. -/
private def requiresSourceAddress (state : SemanticState) (declaration : Name) : Bool :=
  isRegisteredComputation state declaration || isRegisteredDescriptor state declaration ||
  state.limits.any (·.declaration == declaration) ||
  state.objects.any (fun entry => entry.generator == some declaration ||
    entry.refines.any (·.identification == declaration))

/-- Open an already authorized native definition before substituting its original arguments.
Reuse: Lean's bare-constant unfolding and beta substitution. Opaque source binders retain
their identities and typed selections in the current context. Smart unfolding could execute
a match before the kernel reaches its explicit boundary. -/
private def unfoldSourceApplication? (expression : Expr) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  let .const _ _ := expression.getAppFn | return none
  let some body ← withOptions (fun options => options.setBool `smartUnfolding false) <|
      unfoldDefinition? expression.getAppFn
    | return none
  return some (body.betaRev expression.getAppRevArgs (preserveMData := true))

/-- Read only the exact selected native binder. -/
private def selectionAt? (expression : Expr) : LowerM (Option (BindingId × SourceSelection Expr)) := do
  let frame ← read
  let .fvar localId := expression | return none
  let some binding := frame.context.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == localId)
    | return none
  return frame.selections[binding.id]?.map (binding.id, ·)

/-- Follow only authored proof lets to their exact native result binder. No application,
conversion or search for an equal value supplies an alias. The proof remains in the source. -/
private partial def proofAliasSource (source : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  match source with
  | .letE _ type value body _ =>
    if ← isProp type then
      check value
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) type do
        throwError "the source alias changed its authored proof"
      proofAliasSource (body.instantiate1 value)
    else pure source
  | .mdata _ body => proofAliasSource body
  | _ => pure source

/-- Allocate a fresh selected intermediate in the complete current native scope. -/
private def withSelected (selection : SourceSelection Expr)
    (action : Expr → LowerM α) (declaredType : Option Expr := none) : LowerM α := do
  let frame ← read
  SourceSelectionScope.withBinding (← supply) frame.selections frame.context selection
    (fun context selections expression => do
      let retainedView ← IO.mkRef none
      (action expression).run { frame with context, selections, retainedView })
    (declaredType := declaredType)

/-- Check the supplied complete row against its independent registration. The check does
not select a row by native declaration, type or carrier. -/
private def checkSelectedAddress (reference : SelectedSourceReference) : MetaM Unit := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let require {α : Type} [Repr α] (rows : Array α) (selected : α)
      (identity : α → String) : MetaM Unit := do
    let #[original] := rows.filter (fun original => identity original == identity selected)
      | throwError "the selected source lost its unique original registered address"
    unless reprStr original == reprStr selected do
      throwError "the selected source changed its complete independently registered row"
  match reference with
  | .named (.registered (.inl entry) category) =>
    require state.objects entry (·.id.raw)
    require state.categories category (·.id.raw)
  | .named (.registered (.inr entry) category) =>
    require state.morphisms entry (·.id.raw)
    require state.categories category (·.id.raw)
  | .named (.construction entry) => require state.constructions entry (·.id.raw)
  | .category entry => require state.categories entry (·.id.raw)
  | .operation entry => require state.operations entry (·.id.raw)
  | .method entry functor =>
    require state.methods entry (·.id.raw)
    require state.functors functor (·.id.raw)
  | .functor entry => require state.functors entry (·.id.raw)
  | .classifier entry | .classifierForget entry => require state.classifiers entry (·.id.raw)
  | .constructor entry | .constructorInterface entry _ => require state.constructors entry (·.id.raw)
  | .cell entry => require state.cells entry (·.id.raw)
  | .binder entry => require state.binders entry (·.id.raw)
  | .lift entry => require state.lifts entry (·.id.raw)
  | .presentation entry => require state.presentations entry (·.id.raw)
  | .literal entry => require state.literals entry (·.id.raw)
  | .numeral entry => require state.numerals entry (·.id.raw)
  | .subset entry => require state.subsetLiterals entry (·.id.raw)
  | .graph entry => require state.graphLiterals entry (·.id.raw)
  | .generator entry | .components entry => require state.objects entry (·.id.raw)
  | .limit entry => require state.limits entry (·.id.raw)
  | .refinement entry refinement =>
    require state.objects entry (·.id.raw)
    unless entry.refines.any (fun original => reprStr original == reprStr refinement) do
      throwError "the selected refinement changed its original registered interface"

/-- Expose only the explicit selected native interface at this exact binder or projection.
The full selected record remains in the scope; no native expression supplies an address. -/
private partial def nativeInterfaceSource? (expression : Expr) : LowerM (Option Expr) := do
  if let some (_, selected) ← selectionAt? expression.getAppFn then
    if selected.formalBindings.isEmpty then
      if let some reference := selected.reference then
        if let some declaration := reference.nativeInterface? then
          checkSelectedAddress reference
          if (← selectionAt? selected.value).isSome then
            return ← nativeInterfaceSource? (mkAppN selected.value expression.getAppArgs)
          let native := mkAppN selected.value expression.getAppArgs
          unless native.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf declaration do
            throwError "the selected native interface lost its original declaration application"
          let some body ← unfoldSourceApplication? native.consumeMData
            | throwStratum .noImplementation m!"{declaration} has no native interface definition"
          return some body
  let some projection ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? expression | return none
  let some parent ← nativeInterfaceSource? projection.parent | return none
  let owner := (← getConstInfoCtor projection.info.ctorName).induct
  return some (.proj owner projection.info.i parent)

/-- Closed scalar data in the released literal grammar, read by ScalarLiteral.check.
Reference: CasRuntime/Literal.lean decode; this is its inverse on literal constructor forms.
Only numerals, lists and constructor applications are read. No definition is unfolded. -/
private partial def literal? (expression : Expr) : MetaM (Option Json) := do
  let expression := (← instantiateMVars expression).consumeMData
  if expression.hasFVar || expression.hasMVar then return none
  if let some value := expression.rawNatLit? then return some (toJson value)
  if let .lit (.strVal value) := expression then return some (toJson value)
  -- Lean's native unit notation is a constructor alias (Init/Prelude.lean), with
  -- no arguments or computational fields. Overloaded OfNat/Neg projections are
  -- handled at their actual selected instance; their numeral index is not a value.
  if expression.isConstOf ``Unit.unit then return some (.arr #[])
  if expression.isAppOfArity ``Int.ofNat 1 then
    if let some value := expression.appArg!.rawNatLit? then return some (toJson (Int.ofNat value))
  if expression.isAppOfArity ``Int.negSucc 1 then
    if let some value := expression.appArg!.rawNatLit? then return some (toJson (Int.negSucc value))
  if let some (_, elements) := expression.listLit? then
    let mut packets := #[]
    for element in elements do
      let some packet ← literal? element | return none
      packets := packets.push packet
    return some (.arr packets)
  if expression.isAppOfArity ``Quot.mk 3 then return ← literal? expression.appArg!
  let .const name _ := expression.getAppFn | return none
  let some (.ctorInfo constructor) := (← getEnv).find? name | return none
  let arguments := expression.getAppArgs
  unless arguments.size == constructor.numParams + constructor.numFields do return none
  let some (.inductInfo info) := (← getEnv).find? constructor.induct | return none
  let mut packets := #[]
  for field in arguments.extract constructor.numParams arguments.size do
    if ← isProof field then continue
    let some packet ← literal? field | return none
    packets := packets.push packet
  if info.ctors.length == 1 && info.numIndices == 0 then
    if let #[packet] := packets then return some packet
    return some (.arr packets)
  return some (Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson name.getString!), ("args", .arr packets)])

private def captured (frame : Frame) (graph : ValueGraph) (expression : Expr)
    (found : Array ValueBinding) : MetaM (Array ValueBinding) := do
  return found ++ (← boundSourceReferences (some graph) frame.context frame.bound
    expression frame.selections)

/-- Retain a checked source term as code with its actual captured references.
Its fields and applications are lowered when a demand reaches them. -/
private def closureWith (expression : Expr)
    (build : ClosedTerm → SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm → ClosureCode)
    (retainedRole : Option Expr := none) (retainedValues : Array ValueBinding := #[]) :
    LowerM ValueBinding := do
  let frame ← read
  if let some original := retainedRole then
    frame.context.withOriginalSources #[original, expression] fun source => do
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType source[0]!) (← inferType source[1]!) do
        throwError "the delayed native continuation changed its original source interface"
  traceExpensiveLower "closure.total" expression frame.context.bindings.size do
    let program ← (← supply).fresh .program
    let source ← traceExpensiveLower "closure.close" expression frame.context.bindings.size do
      frame.context.close expression
    let captures ← traceExpensiveLower "closure.captures" expression
        frame.context.bindings.size do
      captured frame (← frame.environment.transaction.view) expression #[]
    let captures := captures ++ retainedValues
    let code := build source (← frame.selections.close frame.context)
    frame.environment.codes.modify (·.insert program code)
    traceExpensiveLower "closure.stage" expression frame.context.bindings.size do
      stage (retainedRole.getD expression) (.closure program captures)

private def closure (expression : Expr) : LowerM ValueBinding :=
  closureWith expression (fun source selections => .term source selections)

mutual

/-- Lower one checked source term to its actual retained value.
Source: mathematical-input contract §2 and plan §2, lean-cas-dsl#10 comment 6664354269.
Variables read their retained bindings. Published computation families become prepared
primitive demands at their actual arguments. Fields and applications of retained values become
projection and application demands. Lambdas and selected instances retain code and captures.
Only retained source definitions and accepted derivation compositions expose their bodies.
Declared native interfaces retain their original fields. No operation is recognized by name. -/
private partial def lower (expression : Expr) : LowerM ValueBinding :=
  withReader (fun frame => { frame with selectionBinding := none }) (lowerCore expression)

private partial def lowerCore (expression : Expr) : LowerM ValueBinding := do
  let expression ← instantiateMVars expression
  match expression with
  | .mdata _ body => lower body
  | .fvar id =>
    let frame ← read
    let some binding := frame.context.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == id)
      | throwError "a source variable is outside its complete binding context"
    if let some value := frame.bound[binding.id]? then return value
    if let some selected := frame.selections[binding.id]? then
      if !selected.formalBindings.isEmpty then return ← closure expression
      let declaredType ← inferType expression
      return ← withSelected selected (fun actual => do
        let some (identity, _) ← selectionAt? actual
          | throwError "the actual selected source lost its native binding"
        withReader (fun frame => { frame with selectionBinding := some identity })
          (selectedSource actual selected)) (some declaredType)
    if binding.role == .result then
      throwError "the source lost a retained runtime binding"
    if binding.role == .selectedStructure then
      throwError "the source lost its retained typed selection"
    match (← id.getDecl).value? with
    | some value =>
      unless binding.role == .definition do
        throwStratum .noImplementation
          m!"the source binding {(← id.getDecl).userName} has no retained computational value"
      lower value
    | none =>
      -- Keep the existing one-string symbolic descriptor. Its opaque identity uses the
      -- same nonce:serial convention as RequestScope.wireId; display names stay in context.
      let packet := Json.mkObj [("ctor", "variable"),
        ("args", .arr #[toJson s!"{binding.id.session}:{binding.id.serial}"])]
      stage expression (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
  | .letE _ _ value body _ =>
    if (← isProof value) || (← isType value) then return ← lower (body.instantiate1 value)
    let bound ← lower value
    withValue value bound fun scopedSource => lower (body.instantiate1 scopedSource)
  | .lam .. => closure expression
  | _ =>
    let frame ← read
    if let some selected ← NativeStructuralMap.ofExpr? frame.context expression
        (frame.bound.toArray.map (·.1)) then
      return ← structuralMap selected
    -- Substitute this exact native application before any further head reduction.
    -- Selected binders on its result or partial body keep their original context entries.
    -- No declaration body, let binding or argument is evaluated by this structural step.
    if expression.getAppFn.isHeadBetaTargetFn false then
      let reduced := expression.getAppFn.betaRev expression.getAppRevArgs
        (preserveMData := true)
      if reduced != expression then return ← lower reduced
    -- Native annotations are transparent. The underlying head still selects its retained
    -- value or complete typed source entry by its original binder.
    if let .mdata _ head := expression.getAppFn then
      return ← lower (mkAppN head expression.getAppArgs)
    if let some (_, selected) ← selectionAt? expression.getAppFn then
      let arguments := expression.getAppArgs
      if !selected.formalBindings.isEmpty then
        if arguments.size < selected.formalBindings.size then return ← closure expression
        let instantiated ← selected.specialize (arguments.extract 0 selected.formalBindings.size)
        let declaredType ← inferType
          (mkAppN expression.getAppFn (arguments.extract 0 selected.formalBindings.size))
        return ← withSelected instantiated (fun value => do
          apply (← lower value) (arguments.extract selected.formalBindings.size arguments.size))
          (some declaredType)
      if selected.application.isSome || selected.endpoint.isSome || selected.field.isSome ||
          selected.leg.isSome then
        return ← apply (← lower expression.getAppFn) arguments
      return ← withSelected { selected with
        value := mkAppN selected.value arguments
        originalApplication := selected.originalApplication.map (mkAppN · arguments) } lower
    if let .const declaration _ := expression.getAppFn then
      if requiresSourceAddress (← semanticState) declaration then
        let frame ← read
        CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[lost-source] declaration={declaration} expression={repr expression}"
        CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[lost-source] context={repr (frame.context.bindings.map (·.id))} retained={repr (frame.bound.toArray.map (·.1))}"
        throwError "the registered source declaration {declaration} lost its selected source address"
    -- Native identity wrappers select their original arguments before further head
    -- reduction. The selected binders keep their complete typed entries; this does
    -- not evaluate any registered declaration or the ignored argument.
    if expression.getAppFn.isConstOf ``id ||
        expression.getAppFn.isConstOf ``Function.const then
      if let some reduced ← unfoldSourceApplication? expression then
        return ← lower reduced
    -- Select a retained native field before head reduction can erase its actual parent.
    -- Both projection syntaxes retain their complete application suffix. Formal class fields
    -- remain definitions until their exact parent has a runtime reference.
    let arguments := expression.getAppArgs
    let nativeEnvironment ← getEnv
    let projectionSource := match expression.getAppFn with
      | .proj .. => expression.getAppFn
      | .const declaration _ =>
        match nativeEnvironment.getProjectionFnInfo? declaration with
        | some info =>
          if info.numParams < arguments.size then
            mkAppN expression.getAppFn (arguments.extract 0 (info.numParams + 1))
          else expression
        | none => expression
      | _ => expression
    if let some projection ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? projectionSource then
      let traced := (expression.find? (·.isConstOf `CasCatalogue.Modules.CatalogueRegistration.modulesFibreInclusionDeclaration)).isSome
      if traced then CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[inclusion.stage] lower projection {projection.declaration}: before environment"
      let frame ← read
      let environment ← retainedEnvironment
      if traced then CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[inclusion.stage] lower projection {projection.declaration}: after environment"
      if ← environment.hasRetainedSource frame.context projection.parent then
        if traced then CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[inclusion.stage] lower projection {projection.declaration}: retained parent"
        let (parent, path) ← projectionSourcePath environment projectionSource
        let selected ← projectPath (← lower parent) path
        return ← apply selected (arguments.extract projectionSource.getAppNumArgs arguments.size)
      let (parent, path) ← projectionSourcePath environment projectionSource
      if let some (_, selected) ← selectionAt? parent then
        if selected.field.isSome then
          let value ← projectPath (← lower parent) path
          return ← apply value (arguments.extract projectionSource.getAppNumArgs arguments.size)
      if let some (_, selected) ← selectionAt? projection.parent.getAppFn then
        if (selected.reference.bind (·.nativeInterface?)).isSome then
          let owner := (← getConstInfoCtor projection.info.ctorName).induct
          let value ← field owner projection.info.i projection.parent m!"{projection.declaration}"
          return ← apply value (arguments.extract projectionSource.getAppNumArgs arguments.size)
        let value ← project (← lower projection.parent) projection.info.i m!"{projection.declaration}"
        return ← apply value (arguments.extract projectionSource.getAppNumArgs arguments.size)
      if traced then CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[inclusion.stage] lower projection {projection.declaration}: unretained parent"
    -- Select the exact native constructor argument before further head reduction.
    -- Its source binder keeps the original value and complete selected interface.
    -- Reuse the structural projection step from Layout.inputProjectionHead.
    let traceInclusion := (expression.find? (·.isConstOf
      `CasCatalogue.Modules.CatalogueRegistration.modulesFibreInclusionDeclaration)).isSome
    if traceInclusion then CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[inclusion.lower] before constructor projection"
    if let some projection ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? projectionSource then
      if traceInclusion then CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[inclusion.lower] constructor projection {projection.declaration}"
      let mut parent := projection.parent
      if let .const declaration _ := parent.getAppFn then
        -- The selected field of an ordinary native record constructor (for example,
        -- Functor.comp.obj) is structural code. Open exactly one unregistered
