            throwError "the universal source lost an original computational parameter"
      let function := mkConst presentation.entry.declaration levels
      actualArguments native (function := some function) fun closed actual => do
        let frame ← read
        let owner ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| owner.mapM frame.context.close
        let request ← PreparedRequest.forBoundary (← supply) frame.program
          (← frame.environment.ledger.allocate) (.limitUniversal family owner) levels
          frame.context closed actual #[cone] (← parameters) (some graph)
          (validatedEnvironment := some (← retainedEnvironment))
          (selections := frame.selections) (selectionBinding := frame.selectionBinding)
        demand request
    ) selections).run frame

/-- Invoke the complete source-prepared creation. The source plan's let-bindings or the
public request provide its actual Cone and IsLimit values at these same native positions. -/
private partial def creationFamily (expression : Expr) (family : CreationFamily)
    (target : LimitFamily) (application : SelectedSourceApplication Expr)
    (selected : Option NativeLimitSelection) : LowerM ValueBinding := do
  let frame ← read
  let some selected := selected
    | throwError "the creation request lost its complete original typed construction"
  let some owner := application.owner
    | throwError "the creation request lost its actual original owner"
  let some prepared ← PreparedCreationFamily.ofSelection frame.context owner selected
      family target frame.selections
    | throwError "the creation request lost its accepted complete family"
  unless application.parameters.isEmpty && application.universes == prepared.universes do
    throwError "the fixed creation changed its original evidence telescope"
  let #[cone, universal] := application.arguments
    | throwError "the fixed creation lost its original cone and universal operands"
  let prepared ← prepared.withArguments frame.context cone universal
  let arguments ← prepared.arguments.mapM (·.inContext frame.context)
  actualArguments arguments (function := some (← prepared.familyIn frame.context)) fun closed actual => do
    let frame ← read
    let request ← PreparedRequest.forBoundary (← supply) frame.program
      (← frame.environment.ledger.allocate) (.creation prepared) prepared.universes
      frame.context closed actual #[] (← parameters)
      (some (← frame.environment.transaction.view))
      (validatedEnvironment := some (← retainedEnvironment))
      (selections := frame.selections) (selectionBinding := frame.selectionBinding)
    let value ← demand request
    let graph ← frame.environment.transaction.view
    let environment ← runtimeEnvironment
    return (← environment.checkResult graph (← origin expression).role value).root

/-- Retain a created object before any provider demand. Its complete original source-input
telescope is lowered once and rebound positionally into both the source and mapped diagrams. -/
private partial def formalCreationDescriptor (prepared : PreparedCreationFamily) :
    LowerM ValueBinding := do
  let frame ← read
  let arguments ← prepared.sourceArguments.mapM (·.inContext frame.context)
  let function ← prepared.sourceOwner.selection.receiver.inContext frame.context
  actualArguments arguments (function := some function) fun closed _ => do
    let frame ← read
    let native ← closed.mapM (·.inContext frame.context)
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| prepared.rebindSource (← supply) frame.context frame.selections native
      fun context selections prepared => do
        let retainedView ← IO.mkRef none
        (show LowerM ValueBinding from do
          let owner ← prepared.owner.inContext context
          closureWith owner fun _ _ => .creationOwner prepared).run
            { frame with context, selections, retainedView }

/-- Lower every original direct-limit declaration parameter once, then positionally bind the
same retained owner family. Explicit wire fields keep those exact bindings; implicit source
parameters remain in node.origin.role.source for later whole-cone and constructor-port use. -/
private partial def formalLimitDescriptor (expression : Expr) (source : SourceSelection Expr)
    (selection : NativeLimitSelection) : LowerM (Option ValueBinding) := do
  let frame ← read
  if let some (family, target) := source.creationOwner then
    let some prepared ← PreparedCreationFamily.ofSelection frame.context expression selection
        family target frame.selections
      | throwError "the formal created object lost its complete original creation"
    return some (← formalCreationDescriptor prepared)
  let some owner := selection.source.ownerFamily | return none
  let some family := source.limitFamily
    | throwError "the formal construction lost its complete selected limit family"
  let owner ← SelectedLimitOwner.ofBinding frame.context frame.selections owner
  let some original ← sourceApplication? selection.source.declaration source
    | throwError "the named element lost its explicitly retained original application"
  unless original.equal selection.source.interface.presentation do
    throwError "the formal construction changed its explicitly retained original application"
  let application := original.consumeMData
  unless selection.source.presentation.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf
      selection.source.declaration do return none
  actualArguments application.getAppArgs (function := some application.getAppFn) fun closed actual => do
    let frame ← read
    let information ← getFunInfoNArgs application.getAppFn closed.size
    let mut native := #[]
    let mut explicitSources := #[]
    let mut explicitValues := #[]
    for source in closed, index in [:closed.size] do
      let source ← source.inContext frame.context
      let original := actual.find? (·.index == index)
      let marked ← match original with
        | some _ => pure source
        | none =>
          unless ← isProof source do
            throwError "the formal construction lost an original computational parameter"
          pure source
      native := native.push marked
      if (information.paramInfo[index]?.map (·.isExplicit)).getD false && !(← isProof source) then
        let some original := original
          | throwError "the formal construction lost its original explicit parameter"
        explicitSources := explicitSources.push marked
        explicitValues := explicitValues.push original.value
    let some selected ← LimitFamily.formalAt family frame.context selection owner native
      | throwError "the direct formal construction lost its original owner family"
    let category := source.category.map fun category =>
      { category with bundle := selected.source.bundle, limit := some selected.source }
    let source := { source with
      value := selected.receiver
      limit := some selected
      originalApplication := some selected.source.presentation
      category := category }
    withSelected source fun value => do
      return some (← descriptor value selection.source.row explicitSources none
        (some explicitValues))

/-- Retain structural map data at the unchanged original native role. The descriptor's
endpoints/operands are actual lowered occurrences; no map implementation is evaluated. -/
private partial def structuralMap (selected : NativeStructuralMap) : LowerM ValueBinding := do
  let values ← if selected.tag == "identity" then do
      let value ← lower selected.source
      pure #[value, value]
    else selected.operands.mapM lower
  let slots := values.mapIdx fun index binding =>
    ({ path := #[.field "args", .index index], binding, fieldIndex := none } : ContainerSlot)
  let packet := Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson selected.tag),
    ("args", .arr (Array.replicate values.size .null))]
  let role := (← origin selected.value).role
  let payload ← if role.kind == .function then do
      let framed ← IO.ofExcept <| (CallablePacket.symbolic packet).mapError IO.userError
      IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.callablePacket framed slots).mapError IO.userError
    else IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.descriptor packet slots).mapError IO.userError
  stage selected.value payload

private partial def application (expression : Expr) : LowerM ValueBinding := do
  let frame ← read
  let arguments := expression.getAppArgs
  let function := expression.getAppFn.consumeMData
  let .const name levels := function
    | return ← apply (← lower function) arguments
  let expression := mkAppN function arguments
  if name == ``List.toFinset then
    if let some (_, elements) := (← instantiateMVars arguments.back!).consumeMData.listLit? then
      return ← array expression elements.toArray
  if let some info := (← getEnv).getProjectionFnInfo? name then
    if info.numParams < arguments.size then
      let some operand := arguments[info.numParams]?
        | throwError "internal: a source projection lost its record"
      let owner := (← getConstInfoCtor info.ctorName).induct
      let selected ← field owner info.i operand m!"{name}"
      return ← apply selected (arguments.extract (info.numParams + 1) arguments.size)
  match (← getEnv).find? name with
  | some (.ctorInfo constructor) =>
    unless arguments.size == constructor.numParams + constructor.numFields do
      return ← closure (← etaExpand expression)
    let fields := arguments.extract constructor.numParams arguments.size
    if isStructure (← getEnv) constructor.induct then return ← record expression fields
    descriptor expression name.getString! (← fields.filterM fun field => return !(← isProof field))
  | some (.inductInfo _) =>
    if (← whnf (← inferType expression)).isProp then
      -- A proposition formed by a type former has no computed truth value of its own (C22).
      throwStratum .noImplementation m!"the proposition {name} has no published predicate"
    -- An unapplied type family retains its native callable code, as other functions do.
    if (← origin expression).role.kind == .function then return ← closure expression
    if name == ``Prod then
      unless arguments.size == 2 do
        throwError "the native object product lost its two ordered components"
      return ← descriptor expression "objectProduct" arguments
    -- A type former at its arguments is an object of the category of sets.
    descriptor expression s!"lean:{name}" (← explicitArguments expression)
  | some (.recInfo _) | some (.quotInfo _) =>
    -- The kernel evaluates no eliminator (constitution C22): branching belongs to the leaf
    -- that implements an operation.
    if name == ``Quot then
      let heads := arguments.map fun argument => match argument.consumeMData with
        | .lam _ type body _ => ("lambda", type.getAppFn.constName?, body.getAppFn.constName?)
        | value => ("value", value.getAppFn.constName?, none)
      CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[basechange.quot] arity={arguments.size} argumentHeads={repr heads}"
    throwStratum .noImplementation m!"{name} is an eliminator with no published operation"
  | _ =>
    if ← isMatcher name then
      throwStratum .noImplementation m!"{name} is a match with no published operation"
    -- User definitions are the retained local bindings handled above; accepted derivation
    -- templates arrive as their checked composition. A remaining constant has neither
    -- authority, even when Lean exposes a reducible body.
    throwStratum .noImplementation m!"{name} has no published operation"

end

/-- Lower a checked source term in its complete context and return its actual retained value.
`bound` is the runtime-binding table of the context, by stable source identity. -/
opaque lowerTerm (environment : LowerEnvironment) (program : RuntimeId .program)
    (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding) (expression : Expr)
    (validatedEnvironment : Option RuntimeEnvironment := none)
    (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr := {}) :
    MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let retainedView ← IO.mkRef validatedEnvironment
  let mut retainedSelections := selections
  for (_, value) in bound.toArray do
    retainedSelections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge retainedSelections
      (← value.role.selections.inContext context)
    if value.admittedInterface?.isSome then
      retainedSelections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge retainedSelections
        (← value.nativeRole.selections.inContext context)
  let mut frame : Frame := {
    environment, program, context, bound, retainedView, selections := retainedSelections }
  -- A request may reopen its already admitted scope. Validate that hint against this
  -- exact frame and current graph before any source-path lookup can use the cache.
  if validatedEnvironment.isSome then
    let admitted ← runtimeEnvironment.run frame
    retainedView.set (some admitted)
    let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge frame.selections
      (← admitted.selections.inContext context)
    frame := { frame with selections }
  (lower expression).run frame

end CasCompiler

public import CasCompiler.CategoricalPointFamily

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta

/-- Read a function's independently stated domain and, when nondependent, its target.
The domain remains available when the result depends on the argument. Only the native
type is inspected; no function body or finite carrier is evaluated. -/
opaque nativeFunctionEndpointTypes (type : Expr) : MetaM (Expr × Option Expr) := do
  let .forallE _ domain range _ ← whnfR type
    | throwError "the native function lost its original dependent function type"
  let source ← declaredEndpoint domain
  let target ← if range.hasLooseBVars then pure none
    else some <$> declaredEndpoint range
  return (source, target)

/-- Read endpoints from the original native Hom or a plain nondependent function type.
The latter is its canonical function interface. No function body is opened or evaluated,
and a dependent function receives no fabricated categorical Hom interpretation. -/
opaque nativeMapEndpoints (arrow : Expr) : MetaM (Expr × Expr) := do
  let original ← inferType arrow
  if original.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
    return ← categoricalPointEndpoints arrow
  let type ← whnfR original
  if type.isForall then
    let (source, some target) ← nativeFunctionEndpointTypes type
      | throwError "a dependent native function has no single categorical target endpoint"
    return (source, target)
  categoricalPointEndpoints arrow

end CasCompiler

-- Native type universes, endpoints and both independent original maps remain arbitrary.
-- This checks the exact Mathlib whole-family adapter equation, without any supplied data.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let level := Level.param `carrierAdapterUniverse
  withLocalDeclD `X (mkSort (.succ level)) fun source =>
    withLocalDeclD `Y (mkSort (.succ level)) fun target => do
      let type ← mkAppM ``TypeCat.Hom #[source, target]
      withLocalDeclD `first type fun first =>
        withLocalDeclD `second type fun second => do
          for original in #[first, second] do
            let before ← mkAppM ``TypeCat.Hom.hom #[original]
            let before ← mkAppM ``TypeCat.Fun.toFun #[before]
            let after ← sourceSetFunction original
            let proposition ← mkEq before after
            let proof ← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl after) proposition
            checkWithKernel proof
            unless after.getAppFn.isConstOf ``TypeCat.Fun.toFun do
              throwError "the native carrier adapter changed its original final field"
            let some hom := after.getAppArgs.back?
              | throwError "the native carrier adapter lost its original hom record"
            unless hom.getAppFn.isConstOf ``TypeCat.Hom.hom' &&
                hom.getAppArgs.back? == some original do
              throwError "the native carrier adapter replaced the actual original map"
            let closed ← mkLambdaFVars #[source, target, first, second] after
              (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
            checkWithKernel closed

module

import CasCompiler.SourceProof
import CasTools.QuestionObservation
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.SourceProof
meta import CasTools.QuestionObservation

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler

private def nativeInput (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | throwError "the native declaration retention control did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

private def proofInput (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the retained source proof control did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

private def checkProof (proof : SourceTerm) : MetaM Unit :=
  withCurrHeartbeats <| proof.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    check expression
    checkWithKernel expression
    unless bindings.size == 1 && bindings[0]!.role == .parameter &&
        (← inferType expression).isConstOf ``True do
      throwError "the retained proof changed its original native scope or proposition"

/- Native match compilation creates checked local helper declarations. Retention must survive
environment rollback while preserving the caller's later additions and callback additions. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `n (← nativeInput "Nat")
  let proposition ← session.proposition (← nativeInput "True")
  let original ← getEnv
  let proof ← withCurrHeartbeats <| session.proof (← proofInput
    "proof(match n, n with | 0, _ => True.intro | _, 0 => True.intro | Nat.succ _, Nat.succ _ => True.intro)")
    proposition.source
  let conclusion ← session.conclusion #[proposition] (some proof)
  let withProof ← session.defineTerm `p proof
  let declarations := proof.source.nativeDeclarations.constants
  unless !declarations.isEmpty && declarations.any (fun info =>
      proof.source.expression.containsConst (· == info.name) && !original.contains info.name) do
    throwError "the proof control did not retain its actual native matcher declaration"
  checkProof proof
  setEnv original
  withProof.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    unless bindings.size == 2 do throwError "the retained native context changed its bindings"
    let some value := (← getFVarLocalDecl bindings[1]!.expression).value?
      | throwError "the retained native proof binding lost its definition"
    check value
    checkWithKernel value
    unless (← inferType value).isConstOf ``True do
      throwError "the retained native proof binding changed its proposition"
  setEnv original
  let beforeName ← mkAuxDeclName `retentionBefore
  addDecl (.defnDecl { name := beforeName, levelParams := [], type := mkConst ``Nat,
    value := mkNatLit 17, hints := .abbrev, safety := .safe })
  let callbackName ← mkAuxDeclName `retentionCallback
  proof.source.withOpen fun _ expression => do
    check expression
    checkWithKernel expression
    unless (← getEnv).contains beforeName do
      throwError "native source restoration replaced the caller's current environment"
    addDecl (.defnDecl { name := callbackName, levelParams := [], type := mkConst ``Nat,
      value := mkNatLit 29, hints := .abbrev, safety := .safe })
  unless (← getEnv).contains beforeName && (← getEnv).contains callbackName do
    throwError "native source inspection discarded a caller or callback environment change"
  for declaration in declarations do
    let actual ← getConstInfo declaration.name
    unless nativeConstantExactlyMatches declaration actual && !actual.isAxiom do
      throwError "native source restoration changed a checked helper or introduced an axiom"
  -- Serialization is inert, including after removal of the helpers from the active environment.
  setEnv original
  let document := CasTools.QuestionExport.observeConclusion conclusion
  let exported ← IO.ofExcept <| (document.getObjVal? "proof").mapError IO.userError
  let native ← IO.ofExcept <| (exported.getObjVal? "native").mapError IO.userError
  let stored ← IO.ofExcept <|
    (native.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "declarations").mapError IO.userError
  let graph ← IO.ofExcept <| (exported.getObjVal? "nativeExpressions").mapError IO.userError
  let nodes ← IO.ofExcept <| (CasTools.NativeExpression.decodeNodes graph).mapError IO.userError
  let mut names : Array Name := #[]
  for entry in stored do
    let name ← IO.ofExcept <| ((entry.getObjVal? "name").bind
      CasTools.NativeExpression.nameFromJson).mapError IO.userError
    names := names.push name
    let some declaration := declarations.find? (·.name == name)
      | throwError "the retained proof report invented a native declaration"
    let type ← IO.ofExcept <| (entry.getObjValAs? Nat "type").mapError IO.userError
    let some type := nodes[type]? | throwError "a retained declaration type is outside its graph"
    unless type.equal declaration.type do
      throwError "the retained proof report changed a native declaration's complete type"
    if let some value := declaration.value? (allowOpaque := true) then
      let root ← IO.ofExcept <| (entry.getObjValAs? Nat "value").mapError IO.userError
      let some stored := nodes[root]?
        | throwError "a retained declaration value is outside its graph"
      unless stored.equal value do
        throwError "the retained proof report changed a native declaration's original body"
  unless names.size == declarations.size && declarations.all (fun info => names.contains info.name) do
    throwError "the retained proof report omitted a local native dependency"
  unless declarations.all (fun info => !original.contains info.name) do
    throwError "the proof control unexpectedly depends on an ambient local declaration"
  let afterSerialization ← getEnv
  unless declarations.all (fun info => !afterSerialization.contains info.name) do
    throwError "inert native proof serialization modified the active environment"
  -- Replay the exported native payload through the kernel, without substituting a proof.
  for entry in stored do
    let declaration ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (CasTools.NativeExpression.valueDeclarationFromJson entry nodes).mapError IO.userError
    addDecl declaration
  for declaration in declarations do
    unless nativeConstantExactlyMatches declaration (← getConstInfo declaration.name) do
      throwError "kernel reconstruction changed an exported native declaration payload"
  let root ← IO.ofExcept <| (native.getObjValAs? Nat "expression").mapError IO.userError
  let some expression := nodes[root]?
    | throwError "the exported native proof is outside its expression graph"
  proof.source.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let expression := expression.instantiateRev (bindings.map (·.expression))
    check expression
    checkWithKernel expression
    unless (← inferType expression).isConstOf ``True do
      throwError "the reconstructed native proof changed its original proposition"

/- Imported primitives remain anchored in the fixed native source environment. They do not
expand the declaration closure or change the existing empty-closure graph format. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let proposition ← session.proposition (← nativeInput "Nat.zero = Nat.zero")
  let proof ← session.proof (← proofInput "proof(rfl)") proposition.source
  for term in #[proposition, proof] do
    unless term.source.nativeDeclarations.constants.isEmpty &&
        term.source.context.nativeDeclarations.constants.isEmpty do
      throwError "imported native primitives inflated a retained declaration closure"
  let expressions := #[proposition.source.expression, proof.source.expression]
  unless CasTools.NativeExpression.encodeWithDeclarations expressions #[] ==
      CasTools.NativeExpression.encode expressions do
    throwError "empty native declaration retention changed the original graph document"
  let document := CasTools.QuestionExport.observeConclusion
    (← session.conclusion #[proposition] (some proof))
  let exported ← IO.ofExcept <| (document.getObjVal? "proof").mapError IO.userError
  let native ← IO.ofExcept <| (exported.getObjVal? "native").mapError IO.userError
  if (native.getObjVal? "declarations").isOk then
    throwError "an empty native declaration closure added a field to the original snapshot"

/- A definitionally equal replacement is still a different checked declaration occurrence.
Retained source restoration rejects it without replacing the current declaration. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  let name ← mkAuxDeclName `retainedIdentity
  let value ← withLocalDeclD `n (mkConst ``Nat) fun n => mkLambdaFVars #[n] n
  let first : DefinitionVal := { name, levelParams := [], type := ← inferType value,
    value, hints := .abbrev, safety := .safe }
  addDecl (.defnDecl first)
  let term ← withLCtx {} #[] do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    context.close (mkConst name)
  setEnv original
  let identity ← withLocalDeclD `originalValue first.type fun value => mkLambdaFVars #[value] value
  let replacement := { first with value := mkApp identity first.value }
  addDecl (.defnDecl replacement)
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    term.ensureDeclarations
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  unless failure.isSome do
    throwError "retained source accepted another body at the same native declaration name"
  unless nativeConstantExactlyMatches (.defnInfo replacement) (← getConstInfo first.name) do
    throwError "retained source overwrote the caller's conflicting native declaration"

module

public import Lean.AddDecl
public import Lean.Meta.Basic

@[expose] public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta

/-- Exact native declarations used by a captured source, excluding imported declarations.
The constructor is private: entries come from the checked native environment, not from
source syntax, a backend response, or an invented axiom. -/
structure NativeDeclarations where
  private mk ::
  constants : Array ConstantInfo

private def sameConstantVal (left right : ConstantVal) : Bool :=
  left.name == right.name && left.levelParams == right.levelParams &&
    left.type.equal right.type

/-- Native declaration identity includes the whole checked payload, not just its name/type. -/
opaque nativeConstantExactlyMatches (left right : ConstantInfo) : Bool :=
  sameConstantVal left.toConstantVal right.toConstantVal && match left, right with
  | .axiomInfo left, .axiomInfo right => left.isUnsafe == right.isUnsafe
  | .defnInfo left, .defnInfo right =>
    left.value.equal right.value && left.hints == right.hints &&
      left.safety == right.safety && left.all == right.all
  | .thmInfo left, .thmInfo right =>
    left.value.equal right.value && left.all == right.all
  | .opaqueInfo left, .opaqueInfo right =>
    left.value.equal right.value && left.isUnsafe == right.isUnsafe && left.all == right.all
  | .inductInfo left, .inductInfo right =>
    left.numParams == right.numParams && left.numIndices == right.numIndices &&
      left.all == right.all && left.ctors == right.ctors && left.numNested == right.numNested &&
      left.isRec == right.isRec && left.isUnsafe == right.isUnsafe &&
      left.isReflexive == right.isReflexive
  | .ctorInfo left, .ctorInfo right =>
    left.induct == right.induct && left.cidx == right.cidx &&
      left.numParams == right.numParams && left.numFields == right.numFields &&
      left.isUnsafe == right.isUnsafe
  | .recInfo left, .recInfo right =>
    left.all == right.all && left.numParams == right.numParams &&
      left.numIndices == right.numIndices && left.numMotives == right.numMotives &&
      left.numMinors == right.numMinors && left.k == right.k &&
      left.isUnsafe == right.isUnsafe && left.rules.length == right.rules.length &&
      (left.rules.zip right.rules).all fun (left, right) =>
        left.ctor == right.ctor && left.nfields == right.nfields && left.rhs.equal right.rhs
  | .quotInfo left, .quotInfo right =>
    match left.kind, right.kind with
    | .type, .type | .ctor, .ctor | .lift, .lift | .ind, .ind => true
    | _, _ => false
  | _, _ => false

def NativeDeclarations.exactlyMatches (left right : NativeDeclarations) : Bool :=
  left.constants.size == right.constants.size &&
    (left.constants.zip right.constants).all fun (left, right) =>
      nativeConstantExactlyMatches left right

private structure CaptureState where
  visited : NameSet := {}
  constants : Array ConstantInfo := #[]

private partial def captureConstant (environment : Environment) (name : Name) :
    StateT CaptureState MetaM Unit := do
  if environment.isImportedConst name || (← get).visited.contains name then return
  let some info := environment.find? name
    | throwError "a retained native source refers to missing declaration {name}"
  modify fun state => { state with visited := state.visited.insert name }
  let mut expressions := #[info.type]
  if let some value := info.value? (allowOpaque := true) then
    expressions := expressions.push value
  match info with
  | .inductInfo declaration =>
    for name in declaration.all ++ declaration.ctors do captureConstant environment name
  | .ctorInfo declaration => captureConstant environment declaration.induct
  | .recInfo declaration =>
    for name in declaration.all do captureConstant environment name
    for rule in declaration.rules do
      captureConstant environment rule.ctor
      expressions := expressions.push rule.rhs
  | _ => pure ()
  for expression in expressions do
    for dependency in expression.getUsedConstants do captureConstant environment dependency
  modify fun state => { state with constants := state.constants.push info }

/-- Freeze the reachable current-module declaration graph in dependency order. Imported
mathematics stays in its original module environment and is never copied or unfolded. -/
opaque NativeDeclarations.capture (expressions : Array Expr) : MetaM NativeDeclarations := do
  let environment := (← getEnv).setExporting false
  let action : StateT CaptureState MetaM Unit := do
    for expression in expressions do
      for name in expression.getUsedConstants do captureConstant environment name
  let (_, state) ← action.run {}
  return ⟨state.constants⟩

private def replayable? : ConstantInfo → Option Declaration
  | .defnInfo declaration =>
    if declaration.safety == .safe then some (.defnDecl declaration) else none
  | .thmInfo declaration => some (.thmDecl declaration)
  | .opaqueInfo declaration =>
    if declaration.isUnsafe then none else some (.opaqueDecl declaration)
  | _ => none

/-- Reattach exact checked value declarations to the current environment. Existing names
must carry identical native payloads. Ambient axioms, inductive families and unsafe
declarations must already be present: this operation never invents or publishes them.
Native addDecl checks every restored definition/proof, preserving the current environment's
runtime extensions. Additions remain available after the caller's inspection finishes. -/
opaque NativeDeclarations.ensure (declarations : NativeDeclarations) : MetaM Unit := do
  for original in declarations.constants do
    match ((← getEnv).setExporting false).find? original.name with
    | some current =>
      unless nativeConstantExactlyMatches original current do
        throwError "a retained source declaration {original.name} has a different native meaning"
    | none =>
      unless (replayable? original).isSome do
        throwError "a retained source requires its original ambient declaration {original.name}"
  for original in declarations.constants do
    if ((← getEnv).setExporting false).contains original.name then continue
    let some declaration := replayable? original
      | throwError "a retained source declaration lost its checked replay form"
    addDecl declaration
    let current ← getConstInfo original.name
    unless nativeConstantExactlyMatches original current do
      throwError "native checking changed a retained source declaration {original.name}"

end CasCompiler

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

/-- Finish only the native recursive declarations formed by the current proof. Native
closure conversion owns their captured locals, instances, recursion and termination hints.
The ordinary declaration pipeline then fixes universes and checks their actual bodies.
Source: Lean v4.33.0 `MutualDef.elabMutualDef` and `PreDefinition.Main.addPreDefinitions`. -/
private def finishProofLetRecs (proof : Expr) : TermElabM Expr := do
  let pending ← getLetRecsToLift
  if pending.isEmpty then return proof
  let docContext := (← getLCtx, ← getLocalInstances)
  let declarations ← MutualClosure.main #[] #[] #[] #[] pending
  let declarations ← withLevelNames [] <| levelMVarToParamTypesPreDecls declarations
  let declarations ← instantiateMVarsAtPreDecls declarations
  let declarations ← shareCommonPreDefs declarations
  let declarations ← fixLevelParams declarations (← getLevelNames) []
  addPreDefinitions docContext declarations
  -- Native declaration elaboration may log an error and recover with a sorry. Preserve
  -- every native error before inspecting the declarations, including an unused let-rec.
  let errors := (← Core.getMessageLog).reportedPlusUnreported.toList.filter fun message =>
    message.severity matches .error
  unless errors.isEmpty do
    throwError (MessageData.joinSep (errors.map (·.data)) Format.line)
  for declaration in declarations do
    discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration.declName
  -- `fixLevelParams` updates predefinitions. A standalone proof is not a new main
  -- declaration, so apply that same exact declaration-name substitution to its original
  -- instantiated expression. No helper body or source local is unfolded or substituted.
  let levels : NameMap (List Level) := declarations.foldl (init := {}) fun result declaration =>
    result.insert declaration.declName (declaration.levelParams.map mkLevelParam)
  let proof ← instantiateMVars proof
  return proof.replace fun expression =>
    match expression with
    | .const name _ => (levels.find? name).map (fun universes => Lean.mkConst name universes)
    | _ => none

/-- Complete one formal proof through Lean's native declaration machinery before it is
closed into a source term. The caller's pending let-recs are isolated and restored; an
invalid proof rolls back its native declarations while retaining its original diagnostics.
Successful completion preserves the current environment and the exact original proof. -/
opaque completeNativeProof (proposition : Expr) (elaborate : TermElabM Expr) : TermElabM Expr := do
  let saved : Term.SavedState ← saveState
  let outerPending ← getLetRecsToLift
  let outerMessages ← Core.getMessageLog
  modify fun state => { state with letRecsToLift := [] }
  Core.resetMessageLog
  try
    let proof ← withoutExporting do
      let name ← mkAuxDeclName (kind := `_sourceProof)
      -- This is a naming scope, so no declaration at `name` will reserve the index.
      setDeclNGen (← getDeclNGen).next
      withDeclName name <| withOptions (Elab.async.set · false) do
        finishProofLetRecs (← elaborate)
    let messages ← Core.getMessageLog
    let errors := messages.reportedPlusUnreported.toList.filter fun message =>
      message.severity matches .error
    unless errors.isEmpty do
      throwError (MessageData.joinSep (errors.map (·.data)) Format.line)
    check proof
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType proof) proposition do
      throwError (← mkTypeMismatchError none proof (← inferType proof) proposition)
    modify fun state => { state with letRecsToLift := outerPending }
    Core.setMessageLog (outerMessages ++ messages)
    return proof
  catch error =>
    let messages ← Core.getMessageLog
    saved.restore
    Core.setMessageLog (outerMessages ++ messages)
    throw error

end CasCompiler

private def native (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | throwError "the native route control did not parse"
  return ⟨stx⟩

private def categoryLevels (name : String) : MetaM (List Level) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let some category := state.categories.find? (·.name == name)
    | throwError "the source category control is absent"
  return (← checkedDeclaration category.declaration).levelParams.map Level.param

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "native-route.cas" "let U := RegularModule(R)\n"
  let some reference := file.items[0]? | throwError "the original route reference is absent"
  let rings ← empty.namedCategory reference.raw "Rings" (← categoryLevels "Rings") #[]
  let ringType ← empty.elaborate reference.raw fun context => do
    mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[← rings.value.source.inContext context]
  let parameters ← empty.assumeTerm `R ringType
  let ring ← parameters.term (← native "R")
  let modules ← parameters.namedCategory reference.raw "Modules" (← categoryLevels "Modules")
    #[ring]
  let sets ← parameters.namedCategory reference.raw "Sets" (← categoryLevels "Sets") #[]
  let session ← parameters.assume `h (← native "R = R")
  let routes ← SourceRoutes.forOwner modules.expression sets.expression
  let some trace := routes.language.grammar.shortest
    | throwError "the actual source has no selected underlying-set route control"
  let selected ← file.withContext <| routes.prepareFunctor session reference.raw trace modules
  let original ← routes.reconstruct trace
  unless selected.route.refs == original.refs && selected.target.expression.syntacticEq
      original.target do
    throwError "native route formation replaced the actual selected source derivation"
  unless selected.functor.source.context.entries.size == 2 &&
      selected.target.value.source.context.entries.size == 2 &&
      selected.functor.span.fileName == "native-route.cas" do
    throwError "native route formation discarded unused source scope or the original file"
  selected.functor.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    unless expression.containsFVar bindings[0]!.expression.fvarId! do
      throwError "native route formation discarded its actual scalar parameter"
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let (source, target) ← functorCategoryBundles expression
    unless ← isDefEq source (← modules.value.source.inContext context) <&&>
        isDefEq target (← selected.target.value.source.inContext context) do
      throwError "native route formation changed a complete category bundle"
  for level in modules.value.source.universeParams do
    unless selected.functor.source.universeParams.contains level do
      throwError "native route formation discarded a rigid source universe"
  let identitiesRoute ← SourceRoutes.forOwner modules.expression modules.expression
  let identity ← identitiesRoute.prepareFunctor session reference.raw #[] modules
  identity.functor.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let (source, target) ← functorCategoryBundles expression
    let category ← modules.value.source.inContext context
    unless ← isDefEq source category <&&> isDefEq target category do
      throwError "the empty route changed the selected category structure"
  let objectType ← session.elaborate reference.raw fun context => do
    mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[← modules.value.source.inContext context]
  let objects ← session.assumeTerm `R objectType
  let object ← objects.term (← native "R")
  let image ← file.withContext <| objects.functorImage reference.raw selected.asFunctor object
  let .structural retained := image.functor.derivation
    | throwError "the source image discarded its original structural route"
  unless retained.route.refs == selected.route.refs do
    throwError "the source image changed its original ordered source edges"
  unless image.value.source.context.entries.size == 3 do
    throwError "the source image discarded the actual object binding"
  image.value.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    unless expression.containsFVar bindings[0]!.expression.fvarId! &&
        expression.containsFVar bindings[2]!.expression.fvarId! do
      throwError "the source image replaced its scalar or actual source object"
  let state ← semanticState
  let some constructor := state.constructors.find? (·.functorialAction.isSome)
    | throwError "the actual source supplies no unary action control"
  let derivedSource ← session.unaryCategory reference.raw constructor.id modules
  let derivedTarget ← session.unaryCategory reference.raw constructor.id selected.target
  let derivedRoutes ← SourceRoutes.forOwner derivedSource.expression derivedTarget.expression
  let some derivedTrace := derivedRoutes.language.grammar.shortest
    | throwError "the actual source supplies no constructor-image route control"
  let derived ← derivedRoutes.prepareFunctor session reference.raw derivedTrace derivedSource
  unless derived.route.refs.any (fun ref => match ref with
      | .constructMap id _ => id == constructor.id
      | _ => false) do
    throwError "the native constructor-image route lost its actual source action"
  derived.functor.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let (source, target) ← functorCategoryBundles expression
    unless ← isDefEq source (← derivedSource.value.source.inContext context) <&&>
        isDefEq target (← derivedTarget.value.source.inContext context) do
      throwError "native constructor action changed a complete category parameter"
    unless expression.containsFVar bindings[0]!.expression.fvarId! do
      throwError "native constructor action discarded the actual scalar parameter"
  let rejected ← try
    discard <| routes.prepareFunctor session reference.raw trace rings
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do throwError "native route formation ignored its exact source category"

private partial def withRigidArguments {α : Type} (arguments : Array Expr)
    (infos : Array BinderInfo) (start stop : Nat)
    (action : Array Expr → MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  let rec visit (index : Nat) (rigid : Array Expr) : MetaM α := do
    if index >= stop then return ← action rigid
    let argument ← instantiateMVars arguments[index]!
    if !argument.isMVar then return ← visit (index + 1) rigid
    let declaration ← argument.mvarId!.getDecl
    withLocalDecl declaration.userName infos[index]! (← instantiateMVars declaration.type)
        fun parameter => do
      argument.mvarId!.assign parameter
      visit (index + 1) (rigid.push parameter)
  visit start #[]

/-- A complete declaration family and the position of its original source object. -/
structure NativeOwnedFamily where
  value : Expr
  objectIndex : Nat
  reference : Option SelectedSourceReference := none

/-- Route a whole declaration at a rigid source object, retaining independent parameters.
Reuse: nativeOperationFamily's source telescope and withRigidArguments; the actual operation
or numeral signature determines its object position. -/
def nativeOwnedFamily (state : SemanticState) (source : CategoryExpr)
    (categoryFamily : Expr) (route : Route) (declaration : Name)
    (objectPosition : Array BinderInfo → Option Nat)
    (reference : Option SelectedSourceReference := none) : MetaM NativeOwnedFamily := do
  unless source.syntacticEq route.source do
    throwError "the declaration family has a different complete symbolic source"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
  forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType categoryFamily) fun parameters _ => do
    let category := mkAppN categoryFamily parameters
    let selected ← nativeRouteFunctor state route category
    let functor := selected.functor
    let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[category]
    withLocalDeclD `sourceObject carrier fun object => do
      let image ← functorObject functor object selected.target (some category)
      let constant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels declaration
      let (arguments, infos, result) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType constant)
      let some position := objectPosition infos
        | throwError "the whole declaration family has no object parameter"
      unless (← whnfR result).isAppOf ``Quiver.Hom do
        throwError "the declaration family does not retain its whole morphism result"
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType arguments[position]!) (← inferType image) <&&>
          isDefEq arguments[position]! image do
        throwError "the declaration family has a different complete routed object"
      withRigidArguments arguments infos 0 position fun prefixParameters => do
        withRigidArguments arguments infos (position + 1) arguments.size
            fun suffixParameters => do
          -- Definitional equality fixes the argument's type and metavariables, but
          -- its assignment is not a source-selection transport. The actual image
          -- contains the selected route applications and the rigid original object.
          let arguments := arguments.set! position image
          let body ← instantiateMVars (mkAppN constant arguments)
          check body
          let value ← mkLambdaFVars
            (parameters ++ prefixParameters ++ #[object] ++ suffixParameters) body
          return ⟨value, parameters.size + prefixParameters.size, reference⟩

/-- Form the whole native operation before selecting its source object or operands.
Reuse: validateOperation's object/numeral boundary and nativeOwnedFamily. -/
def nativeOperationFamily (state : SemanticState) (source : CategoryExpr)
    (categoryFamily : Expr) (route : Route) (binding : OperationEntry) : MetaM Expr := do
  let family ← nativeOwnedFamily state source categoryFamily route binding.declaration
    (fun infos =>
      if infos.size > binding.numerals then some (infos.size - 1 - binding.numerals) else none)
    (some (.operation binding))
  return family.value

end CasCompiler

private def levels (name : String) : TermElabM (List Level) := do

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← session.assume `h (← `(True))
  let cases : Array (String × String × List Level × Nat) := #[
    ("Rings", "·", [.zero], 1), ("Rings", "^", [.zero], 2),
    ("Modules", "•", [.param `u, .param `u], 2)]
  for (categoryName, operationName, universes, minimumBinders) in cases do
    let category ← session.categoryFamily Syntax.missing categoryName universes
    let routes ← SourceRoutes.forOperation category.expression operationName
    let families ← routes.operationFamilies session Syntax.missing #[] category
    unless families.size == 1 do throwError "the actual initial operation binding is not retained"
    for family in families do
      unless family.binding.name == operationName && family.route.steps.isEmpty &&
          family.source.expression.syntacticEq category.expression do
        throwError "whole-family preparation changed its source binding or route"
      family.term.source.withOpen fun _ expression => do
        lambdaTelescope expression fun parameters body => do
          unless parameters.size >= minimumBinders && parameters.all (·.isFVar) do
            throwError "whole-family preparation specialized a source object or parameter"
          unless !(body.hasExprMVar || body.hasLevelMVar) &&
              (← whnfR (← inferType body)).isAppOf ``Quiver.Hom do
            throwError "the prepared family is not the complete morphism before operands"
          for parameter in parameters do
            unless body.containsFVar parameter.fvarId! do
              throwError "whole-family preparation discarded an actual rigid source parameter"
      let some agreement ← session.operationConversion Syntax.missing family family
        | throwError "a rigid whole source family lost its native reflexivity evidence"
      unless agreement.proof.source.context.entries.size == session.context.entries.size do
        throwError "whole-family evidence discarded the complete source context"
      agreement.proof.source.withOpen fun bindings proof => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let whole ← agreement.left.term.source.inContext context
        let expected ← mkEq whole (← agreement.right.term.source.inContext context)
        unless ← isDefEq (← agreement.proposition.source.inContext context) expected <&&>
            isDefEq (← inferType proof) expected do
          throwError "rigid-family evidence lost a complete generic parameter"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint proof expected)
  for (categoryName, operationName) in #[("Rings", "·"), ("Modules", "•")] do
    let category ← session.categoryFamily Syntax.missing categoryName (← levels categoryName)
    let routes ← SourceRoutes.forOperation category.expression operationName
    let rejected ← try
      discard <| routes.operationFamilies session Syntax.missing #[] category
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless rejected do
      throwError "operation preparation silently specialized an incompatible rigid universe"
  let commutative ← session.categoryFamily Syntax.missing "CommutativeRings" [.zero]
  let inherited ← SourceRoutes.forOperation commutative.expression "·"
  let some traces := inherited.language.grammar.finiteWords
    | throwError "the imported finite operation routes became infinite"
  unless !traces.isEmpty do throwError "the actual inherited operation route control is absent"
  let mut nonemptyRoute := false
  for trace in traces do
    let families ← inherited.operationFamilies session Syntax.missing trace commutative
    unless !families.isEmpty do throwError "an actual first-hit binding lost its whole family"
    for family in families do
      nonemptyRoute := nonemptyRoute || !family.route.steps.isEmpty
      family.term.source.withOpen fun _ expression => do
        lambdaTelescope expression fun parameters body => do
          unless !parameters.isEmpty && parameters.all (·.isFVar) &&
              body.getUsedConstants.contains family.binding.declaration &&
              (← whnfR (← inferType body)).isAppOf ``Quiver.Hom do
            throwError "an inherited operation lost its generic object or original declaration"
  unless nonemptyRoute do throwError "the operation control did not use its actual structural route"
  let inheritedFamilies ← traces.flatMapM fun trace =>
    inherited.operationFamilies session Syntax.missing trace commutative
  let some comparisons ← inherited.finiteOperationConversion session Syntax.missing commutative
    | throwError "the complete finite operation family lost its native conversion evidence"
  unless comparisons.families.size == inheritedFamilies.size &&
      comparisons.agreements.size == inheritedFamilies.size do
    throwError "finite operation comparison omitted an original reading"
  for family in inheritedFamilies do
    unless comparisons.families.any (fun retained => retained.binding.id == family.binding.id &&
        retained.route.refs == family.route.refs) do
      throwError "finite operation comparison discarded an actual binding or ordered route"
  for left in inheritedFamilies do
    for right in inheritedFamilies do
      unless comparisons.agreements.any (fun row => row.any fun agreement =>
          agreement.left.binding.id == left.binding.id &&
          agreement.left.route.refs == left.route.refs &&
          agreement.right.binding.id == right.binding.id &&
          agreement.right.route.refs == right.route.refs) do
        throwError "finite operation comparison omitted evidence for an actual ordered pair"
  for row in comparisons.agreements do
    unless row.size == inheritedFamilies.size do
      throwError "finite operation comparison omitted an entire-family pair"
    for agreement in row do
      agreement.proof.source.withOpen fun bindings proof => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let goal ← agreement.proposition.source.inContext context
        unless ← isDefEq (← inferType proof) goal do
          throwError "the retained agreement proof has a different complete proposition"
        let left ← agreement.left.term.source.inContext context
        let right ← agreement.right.term.source.inContext context
        unless ← isDefEq goal (← mkEq left right) do
          throwError "the agreement proposition discarded its original whole families"
        checkWithKernel proof
  let rings ← session.categoryFamily Syntax.missing "Rings" [.zero]
  let additions ← SourceRoutes.forOperation rings.expression "+"
  let multiplications ← SourceRoutes.forOperation rings.expression "·"
  let #[addition] ← additions.operationFamilies session Syntax.missing #[] rings
    | throwError "the actual ring addition family is absent"
  let #[multiplication] ← multiplications.operationFamilies session Syntax.missing #[] rings
    | throwError "the actual ring multiplication family is absent"
  unless (← session.operationConversion Syntax.missing addition multiplication).isNone do
    throwError "different whole ring operations received conversion evidence"
  let modules ← session.categoryFamily Syntax.missing "Modules" (← levels "Modules")
  let state ← semanticState
  let some constructor := state.constructors.find? (·.functorialAction.isSome)
    | throwError "the source constructor family control is absent"
  let constructed ← session.unaryCategoryFamily Syntax.missing constructor.id modules
  unless constructed.expression.syntacticEq
      (.construct constructor.id #[.category modules.expression]) do
    throwError "the constructed family lost its actual symbolic argument"
  constructed.family.source.withOpen fun _ expression => do
    lambdaTelescope expression fun parameters body => do
      unless !parameters.isEmpty && parameters.all (·.isFVar) do
        throwError "the constructor family specialized the source category parameters"
      for parameter in parameters do
        unless body.containsFVar parameter.fvarId! do
          throwError "the constructor family discarded a rigid source argument"

  let programs ← SourceProgram.forTarget (.operation ⟨"op.rings.mul"⟩)
  let some family := programs[0]? | throwError "the published family is unavailable"
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let targetRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close family.source.target)
  let planRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close family.source.plan)
  let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let (graph, input) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role := targetRole, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
  let .ok retained := graph.rebind input planRole | throwError "the input role could not be retained"
  let request ← PreparedRequest.forBoundary owners.identities program occurrence (.target family)
    (family.source.universeParams.map Level.param) context #[] #[] #[input, retained] #[]
  let some first := request.scope[0]? | throwError "the first scope slot is missing"
  let some second := request.scope[1]? | throwError "the second scope slot is missing"
  unless request.reference == some family.source.entry.target && request.scope.size == 2 &&
      first.value == second.value do
    throwError "request preparation changed an exact family reference or aliased scope slots"
  unless first.role.source.expression == targetRole.source.expression &&
      second.role.source.expression == planRole.source.expression do
    throwError "request preparation merged distinct consuming roles"
  unless request.outputs.size == 1 && request.source.kind == .function do
    throwError "the whole source family lost its callable result role"
  unless ← isDefEq request.source.source.expression family.source.target do
    throwError "request preparation changed the checked source family"
  for index in [:family.source.prerequisites.size] do
    if bound : index < family.source.prerequisites.size then
      let slot ← PreparedRequest.forBoundary owners.identities program occurrence
        (.prerequisite family ⟨index, bound⟩) (family.source.universeParams.map Level.param)
        context #[] #[] #[] #[]
      unless slot.reference == some family.source.prerequisites[index].reference do
        throwError "request preparation changed an ordered primitive reference"
    else throwError "the prerequisite index is outside the checked family"
  let other ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let foreignProgram ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (other.identities.fresh .program)
  let rejected ← try
    discard <| PreparedRequest.forBoundary other.identities foreignProgram occurrence (.target family)
      (family.source.universeParams.map Level.param) context #[] #[] #[] #[]
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do throwError "request preparation mixed worker identities"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let reference : ComputationRef := .operation ⟨"op.monoids.mul"⟩
  let family ← SourceFamily.forReference reference
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let request ← PreparedRequest.forBoundary owners.identities program occurrence (.registered family)
    (family.universeParams.map Level.param) context #[] #[] #[] #[]
  unless request.reference == some reference && family.source.reference == reference do
    throwError "direct source intake changed the registered primitive address"
  forallTelescope family.source.familyType fun arguments _ => do
    let declarations := (← getLCtx).foldl (fun result declaration => result.push declaration) #[]
    let bindings := declarations.mapIdx fun index declaration => ({
      id := ⟨"primitive-application", index⟩, role := .parameter,
      expression := mkFVar declaration.fvarId } : LocalBinding)
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let specified ← arguments.mapM fun argument => liftM (m := MetaM) (context.close argument)
    let applied ← PreparedRequest.forBoundary owners.identities program occurrence (.registered family)
      (family.universeParams.map Level.param) context specified #[] #[] #[]
    let some layout := applied.application
      | throwError "registered source application lost its native argument telescope"
    unless layout.arguments.size == arguments.size &&
        layout.arguments.map (·.sourceIndex) == Array.range arguments.size &&
        layout.resultDependencies.contains 0 do
      throwError "registered source application changed its complete formal dependency slots"
    let resultFamily ← layout.resultTypeFamily.inContext context
    let actual ← applied.source.source.inContext context
    unless ← isDefEq (mkAppN resultFamily arguments).headBeta (← inferType actual) do
      throwError "registered source application changed the original result-type family"
  unless ← isDefEq request.source.source.expression family.source.family do
    throwError "direct request preparation changed the published family"
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType family.source.family) family.source.familyType do
    throwError "direct source intake changed the complete family type"
  if family.source.family.hasFVar || family.source.family.hasExprMVar ||
      family.source.family.hasLevelMVar || family.source.family.hasLooseBVars then
    throwError "direct source intake retained an unresolved or free parameter"
  let info ← getConstInfo family.source.declaration
  unless family.universeParams == info.levelParams do
    throwError "direct source intake dropped rigid declaration universes"
  let rejected ← try
    discard <| SourceFamily.forReference (.operation ⟨s!"unregistered.{owners.worker}"⟩)
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do throwError "direct source intake accepted an unregistered address"
  let polymorphic ← SourceFamily.forReference (.functor FunctorId.ringsMultiplicative)
  unless !polymorphic.universeParams.isEmpty do
    throwError "the polymorphic source control has no universe parameter"
  let renamed := polymorphic.universeParams.map fun name => Level.param (name.str "actual")
  let specialized ← PreparedRequest.forBoundary owners.identities program occurrence (.registered polymorphic)
    (universeArguments := renamed) context #[] #[] #[] #[]
  let expected := polymorphic.source.family.instantiateLevelParams polymorphic.universeParams renamed
  unless ← isDefEq specialized.source.source.expression expected do
    throwError "request preparation lost the explicit universe substitution"
  unless specialized.universeArguments == some renamed do
    throwError "request preparation lost its original-to-actual universe correspondence"
  let some output := specialized.outputs[0]?
    | throwError "the source functor field is missing"
  unless specialized.source.kind == .record && specialized.outputs.size == 1 &&
      output.address == #[``CategoryTheory.Cat.Hom.toFunctor] do
    throwError "the record response lost its exact source projection address"
  let badArity ← try
    discard <| PreparedRequest.forBoundary owners.identities program occurrence (.registered polymorphic)
      (renamed ++ [.zero]) context #[] #[] #[] #[]
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless badArity do throwError "request preparation accepted the wrong universe arity"
  let unresolved ← mkFreshLevelMVar
  let rejectedUniverse ← try
    discard <| PreparedRequest.forBoundary owners.identities program occurrence (.registered polymorphic)
      (polymorphic.universeParams.map fun _ => unresolved) context #[] #[] #[] #[]
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejectedUniverse do throwError "request preparation retained an unresolved universe"

/-- The exact source input and every parsed item, before interpretation or provider selection. -/
structure SourceFile where
  private mk ::
  context : Parser.InputContext
  items : Array (TSyntax `cas_item)

/-- Translate native normalized positions back through the original file map.
Reference: Lean/Parser/Extension.lean mkInputContext uses this map composition for endPos;
Lean/Syntax.lean rewriteBottomUp preserves the tree while updating source metadata. -/
private def originalPositions (normalized original : FileMap) (stx : Syntax) : Syntax :=
  let position := fun pos => original.ofPosition (normalized.toPosition pos)
  let substring := fun (text : Substring.Raw) =>
    { str := original.source, startPos := position text.startPos,
      stopPos := position text.stopPos : Substring.Raw }
  let info : SourceInfo → SourceInfo := fun
    | .original leading start trailing stop =>
      SourceInfo.original (substring leading) (position start) (substring trailing) (position stop)
    | .synthetic start stop canonical => .synthetic (position start) (position stop) canonical
    | .none => .none
  stx.rewriteBottomUp fun
    | .node source kind args => .node (info source) kind args
    | .atom source value => .atom (info source) value
    | .ident source raw name resolved => .ident (info source) (substring raw) name resolved
    | .missing => .missing

/-- Parse all items using Lean's native tokenizer, grammar and source positions.
Reuse: Lean 4.33.0 Lean/Parser/Extension.lean, runParserCategory.
The input context retains original line endings so byte positions refer to the actual file. -/
opaque SourceFile.parse (fileName input : String) : CoreM SourceFile := do
  let parser := Parser.andthenFn Parser.whitespace
    (Parser.manyFn (Parser.categoryParserFnImpl `cas_item))
  let context := Parser.mkInputContext input fileName
  let state := parser.run context { env := ← getEnv, options := ← getOptions }
    (Parser.getTokenTable (← getEnv)) (Parser.mkParserState input)
  unless state.allErrors.isEmpty do throwError "{state.toErrorMsg context}"
  unless context.atEnd state.pos do
    throwError "{(state.mkError "end of input").toErrorMsg context}"
  let items : Array (TSyntax `cas_item) := state.stxStack.back.getArgs.map (⟨·⟩)
  let original := Parser.mkInputContext input fileName (normalizeLineEndings := false)
  let items := if context.inputString == original.inputString then items else
    items.map fun item => ⟨originalPositions context.fileMap original.fileMap item.raw⟩
  return ⟨original, items⟩

/-- Elaborate parsed syntax against its original file map and diagnostic source identity.
Reuse: Lean's Core.Context reader, as in Lean/Elab/DocString.lean. -/
def SourceFile.withContext [Monad m] [MonadWithReaderOf Core.Context m]
    (source : SourceFile) (action : m α) : m α :=
  withTheReader Core.Context (fun context =>
    { context with fileName := source.context.fileName, fileMap := source.context.fileMap }) action

end CasCompiler

private def jsonFile (path : String) : CommandElabM Json := do
  let .ok document := Json.parse (← IO.FS.readFile path)
    | throwError "the retained source inventory is not valid JSON"
  return document

private def sourceIdentities (entries : Array Json) : CommandElabM (Std.HashSet String) := do
  let mut identities : Std.HashSet String := {}
  for entry in entries do
    let .ok path := entry.getObjValAs? String "source"
      | throwError "the retained input has no original source path"
    let text ← IO.FS.readFile path
    let source ← liftCoreM <| SourceFile.parse path text
    unless source.context.inputString == text && source.context.fileName == path do
      throwError "parsing changed the original source bytes or file identity"
    for item in source.items do
      unless item.raw.getPos?.isSome && item.raw.getTailPos?.isSome do
        throwError "a parsed original item lost its byte positions"
      match item with
      | `(cas_item| test $identity:ident $_:str : $_:cas_stmt) =>
        let identity := identity.getId.toString
        if identities.contains identity then throwError "a retained source identity occurs twice"
        identities := identities.insert identity
      | `(cas_item| $_:cas_stmt) => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "an original item changed its public syntax category"
  return identities
