def PointFamilyOwner.operation : PointFamilyOwner → String
  | .morphism entry => entry.id.raw
  | .application entry => entry.id.raw ++ "#application"

def PointFamilyOwner.category : PointFamilyOwner → CategoryId
  | .morphism entry => entry.category
  | .application entry => entry.category


def PointFamily.operation (family : PointFamily) : String := family.owner.operation

/-- Retain the exact accepted family and original complete native application. -/
def PointFamily.selected (family : PointFamily) (levels : List Level)
    (parameters : Array Expr) (arrow : Expr) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  unless levels.length == family.universeParams.length do
    throwError "the named point action changed its original universe arguments"
  let expected := mkAppN (mkConst family.declaration levels) parameters
  check expected
  unless ← isDefEq arrow expected do
    throwError "the named point action changed its complete original declaration application"
  match family.owner with
  | .morphism entry =>
      return {
        value := arrow
        reference := some (.named (.registered (.inr entry) family.category))
        originalApplication := some expected }
  | .application _ =>
      return {
        value := arrow
        originalApplication := some expected
        application := some {
          family := .application family, universes := levels, parameters } }

private def pointCategory (category : NamedCategoryEntry) (arrow : Expr) :
    MetaM NativeSourceCategory := do
  let declaration ← checkedDeclaration category.declaration
  let levels ← declaration.levelParams.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  let family := mkConst category.declaration levels
  let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
  let bundle := mkAppN family parameters
  let identity ← categoryIdentity bundle
  -- mkAppM checks at a new metavariable depth. Constrain the selected category's
  -- original parameters here from the complete native arrow type before that check.
  let mapFunction ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map #[identity]
  let (arguments, binders, _) ← forallMetaTelescope (← inferType mapFunction)
  let some index := binders.findIdx? (·.isExplicit)
    | throwError "the native identity map lost its original arrow argument"
  unless index + 1 == arguments.size do
    throwError "the native identity map changed its complete arrow telescope"
  let some argument := arguments[index]?
    | throwError "the native identity map lost its complete arrow type"
  unless ← withAtLeastTransparency .default
      (isDefEq (← inferType argument) (← inferType arrow)) do
    throwError "the named point arrow is outside its complete registered category"
  let bundle ← instantiateMVars bundle
  let identity ← instantiateMVars identity
  discard <| mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map #[identity, arrow]
  if bundle.hasMVar || bundle.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the named point action requires its complete selected category"
  return ⟨.morphism, category.expression, bundle, none, none⟩

private def unchangedPoint (argument : InputArgumentRef) (arrow : BindingId) : MetaM Bool := do
  match argument with
  | .slot index => return index == 0
  | .expression source =>
    match ← source.inputProjectionThrough #[] #[] #[arrow] with
    | some (.projection route) =>
      match route.target with
      | .argument index => return index == 0 && route.path.isEmpty
      | .context _ => return false
    | _ => return false

/-- Reuse the registered declaration checks and the existing native carrier action under
the complete rigid parameter telescope. No field suffix or actual scalar selects a port. -/
private def pointFamily? (owner : PointFamilyOwner) (declarationName : Name) :
    MetaM (Option PointFamily) := withLCtx {} #[] do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == owner.category)
    | throwError "the named callable requires its original registered category"
  let declaration ← checkedDeclaration declarationName
  let family := mkConst declarationName (declaration.levelParams.map Level.param)
  let path? ← forallTelescopeReducing declaration.type fun parameters result => do
    let result ← whnfR result
    unless result.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
      throwError "the named point action requires a complete native morphism family"
    withLocalDeclD `arrow result fun arrow => do
      let bindings := (parameters.push arrow).mapIdx fun index expression =>
        { id := { session := "point-action-path", serial := index },
          role := BindingRole.parameter, expression : LocalBinding }
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let arrowId := bindings.back!.id
      let function ← sourceFunction ⟨arrow, some (← pointCategory category arrow)⟩
      let source ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close function)
      let (_, application) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource source context #[]
      let some (.callable route steps) ←
          application.inputProjectionThrough #[(#[], 1)] #[] #[arrowId]
        | return none
      let .context original := route.target
        | throwError "the named carrier function changed its original arrow"
      unless original == arrowId do
        throwError "the named carrier function lost its actual arrow input"
      let #[step] := steps
        | throwUnsupportedSource "the named carrier requires another source action"
      let #[argument] := step.arguments
        | throwUnsupportedSource "the named carrier changed its complete point argument"
      unless step.selection.isEmpty && (← unchangedPoint argument arrowId) do
        throwUnsupportedSource "the named carrier does not apply its unchanged original point"
      return some route.path
  let some path := path? | return none
  return some ⟨owner, declarationName, category, family, declaration.type, declaration.levelParams, path⟩

private def pointFamily (owner : PointFamilyOwner) (declarationName : Name) :
    MetaM PointFamily := do
  let some family ← pointFamily? owner declarationName
    | throwUnsupportedSource "the named morphism has no native input-function path"
  return family

/-- Prepare the original named point action, retaining absence only when the registered
carrier has no native input-function path. All malformed family and carrier checks remain. -/
opaque PointFamily.forEntry? (entry : MorphismEntry) : MetaM (Option PointFamily) :=
  pointFamily? (.morphism entry) entry.declaration

opaque PointFamily.forEntry (entry : MorphismEntry) : MetaM PointFamily :=
  pointFamily (.morphism entry) entry.declaration

/-- Prepare only the original published application field of the selected object row. -/
opaque PointFamily.forApplication (entry : ObjectEntry) : MetaM PointFamily := do
  let #[original] := (← semanticState).objects.filter (·.id == entry.id)
    | throwError "the object application requires its exact registered owner"
  let some declaration := original.application
    | throwError "the selected object has no published application"
  unless original.declaration == entry.declaration && original.category == entry.category &&
      entry.application == some declaration do
    throwError "the object application changed its original selected owner"
  pointFamily (.application original) declaration

/-- The authored native endpoints of this already selected complete declaration. -/
opaque PointFamily.endpoints (family : PointFamily) (arrow : Expr) : MetaM (Expr × Expr) := do
  unless arrow.consumeMData.getAppFn.constName? == some family.declaration do
    throwError "the named point action changed its released morphism family"
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType arrow)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    throwError "the named point action requires its complete declaration parameters"
  return (← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[2]!, ← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[3]!)

/-- Name each whole authored endpoint family through the caller's typed selection scope.
Native products retain their actual ordered components and ordinary product constructor. -/
private def pointEndpoint [Monad m] [MonadLiftT MetaM m]
    (category : CategoryId) (value : Expr) (select : SourceSelection Expr → m Expr) : m Expr := do
  if value.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 then
    let first ← select (← liftM (m := MetaM) <|
      sourceNamedObjectAlias category { value := value.getAppArgs[0]! })
    let second ← select (← liftM (m := MetaM) <|
      sourceNamedObjectAlias category { value := value.getAppArgs[1]! })
    return ← select { value := mkAppN value.getAppFn #[first, second] }
  select (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| sourceNamedObjectAlias category { value })

/-- Retain the original named endpoint selections under the caller's complete continuation. -/
opaque PointFamily.withEndpoints [Monad m] [MonadLiftT MetaM m] (family : PointFamily)
    (arrow : Expr) (select : SourceSelection Expr → m Expr) : m (Expr × Expr) := do
  let (source, target) ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| family.endpoints arrow
  return (← pointEndpoint family.owner.category source select,
    ← pointEndpoint family.owner.category target select)

/-- The checked native carrier action of the actual original arrow. -/
opaque PointFamily.function (family : PointFamily) (arrow : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  sourceFunction ⟨arrow, some (← pointCategory family.category arrow)⟩


/-- Validate the explicit point domain and endpoints against this already selected family. -/
def PointFamily.checkRequest (family : PointFamily) (arrow domain source target originalDomain : Expr)
    (context : Option OpenContext := none) : MetaM Unit := do
  let inputs := #[arrow, domain, source, target, originalDomain]
  let check : Array Expr → MetaM Unit := fun inputs => do
    let (expectedSource, expectedTarget) ← family.endpoints inputs[0]!
    checkRegisteredDomains inputs[1]! inputs[4]!
    checkRegisteredDomains inputs[2]! expectedSource
    checkRegisteredDomains inputs[3]! expectedTarget
    unless ← isDefEq inputs[1]! inputs[4]! <&&>
        isDefEq inputs[2]! expectedSource <&&> isDefEq inputs[3]! expectedTarget do
      throwError "the named point request changed its complete native domain or endpoints"
  match context with
  | some context => context.withOriginalSources inputs check
  | none => check inputs

/-- Retain every invocation-local input beside the unchanged point. The original domain
comes from its explicit point record; native conversion only validates these supplied inputs. -/
opaque PointFamily.withRequest (family : PointFamily) (arrow domain source target : Expr)
    (point : SourceSelection Expr) (context : Option OpenContext := none) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let some original := point.pointOrigin
    | throwError "a named point request requires its original source point map"
  family.checkRequest arrow domain source target original.domain context
  let request : NativePointRequest := ⟨arrow, domain, source, target, point.value⟩
  return { point with pointRequest := some (.named family request) }

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.SourceCarrier
public import CasCompiler.Layout

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue

/-- A native carrier-function path checked for an entire rigid source family. -/
structure NativePointFamily where
  private mk ::
  family : Expr
  universeParams : List Name
  path : Array Name

/-- The same checked path at one exact complete source result layout. -/
structure NativePointPath (source : SourceLayout) where
  private mk ::
  path : Array Name

private def unchangedPoint (argument : InputArgumentRef) (arrow : BindingId) : MetaM Bool := do
  match argument with
  | .slot index => return index == 0
  | .expression source =>
    match ← source.inputProjectionThrough #[] #[] #[arrow] with
    | some (.projection route) =>
      match route.target with
      | .argument index => return index == 0 && route.path.isEmpty
      | .context _ => return false
    | _ => return false

/-- Check the same unchanged point action in its complete original native context. -/
private def nativePointPath (bindings : Array LocalBinding) (result : Expr)
    (category : Expr → MetaM NativeSourceCategory) : MetaM (Array Name) := do
  let result ← if result.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure result else whnfR result
  unless result.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    throwUnsupportedSource "the point action requires a complete native morphism family"
  withLocalDeclD `arrow result fun arrow => do
    let session := (← mkFreshUserName `nativePointPath).toString
    let arrowId : BindingId := ⟨session, 0⟩
    let bindings := bindings.push
      { id := arrowId, role := BindingRole.parameter, expression := arrow }
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let function ← sourceFunction ⟨arrow, some (← category arrow)⟩
    let source ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close function)
    let (_, application) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource source context #[]
    let some (.callable route steps) ←
        application.inputProjectionThrough #[(#[], 1)] #[] #[arrowId]
      | throwUnsupportedSource "the morphism has no native input-function path"
    let .context original := route.target
      | throwError "the carrier function changed its original arrow"
    unless original == arrowId do throwError "the carrier function lost its actual arrow input"
    let #[step] := steps
      | throwUnsupportedSource "the carrier requires another source action"
    let #[argument] := step.arguments
      | throwUnsupportedSource "the carrier changed its complete point argument"
    unless step.selection.isEmpty && (← unchangedPoint argument arrowId) do
      throwUnsupportedSource "the carrier does not apply its unchanged original point"
    return route.path

private def requirePointPath (source : SourceLayout) (path : Array Name) : MetaM Unit := do
  let mut selected := source
  for projection in path do
    let #[field] := selected.fields.filter (·.projection == projection)
      | throwError "the native carrier path lost its exact result projection"
    unless field.wireIndex.isSome do
      throwError "the native carrier path selected a proof-only field"
    selected ← field.toLayout
  unless selected.kind == .function do
    throwError "the native carrier path does not end at its original function"

/-- Reuse PointFamily's native input-function check under the whole rigid parameter
telescope. The selected complete category is supplied by the original source owner. -/
opaque NativePointFamily.prepare (family : Expr) (universes : List Name)
    (category : Array Expr → Expr → MetaM NativeSourceCategory) :
    MetaM NativePointFamily := withLCtx {} #[] do
  let path ← forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType family) fun parameters result => do
    let bindings := parameters.mapIdx fun index expression =>
      { id := { session := "point-action-path", serial := index },
        role := BindingRole.parameter, expression : LocalBinding }
    nativePointPath bindings result (category parameters)
  return ⟨family, universes, path⟩

/-- Prepare a carrier path for this exact source result, using its independently retained
complete category and bundle. All source binders, selected instances and rigid universes stay
in the original context; no whole-family claim or matching-field search is introduced. -/
opaque NativePointPath.prepare (source : SourceLayout) (category : CategoryExpr)
    (bundle : ClosedTerm) : MetaM (NativePointPath source) := do
  let path ← source.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let bundle ← bundle.inContext context
    nativePointPath bindings (← inferType expression) fun _ =>
      pure { role := .morphism, expression := category, bundle }
  requirePointPath source path
  return ⟨path⟩

/-- Specialize only that original already checked family and path. Native conversion checks
the caller's fixed application; it never searches another family or a matching output field. -/
opaque NativePointFamily.specialize (family : NativePointFamily) (source : SourceLayout)
    (levels : List Level) (arguments : Array ClosedTerm) : MetaM (NativePointPath source) := do
  unless levels.length == family.universeParams.length do
    throwError "the native carrier path lost its complete universe substitution"
  source.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let actual ← arguments.mapM (·.inContext context)
    let expected := mkAppN
      (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels) actual
    unless ← isDefEq expression expected do
      throwError "the native carrier path changed its complete original source application"
  requirePointPath source family.path
  return ⟨family.path⟩

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.CreationFamily
public import CasCompiler.LimitFamily

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue

/-- Original declaration argument positions for the selected creation's source descriptor.
Every native/proof slot is retained by ApplicationLayout; only the actual diagram's explicit
nonproof arguments are diagram ports. These schemas do not demand evaluation of evidence or
of the accepted standardization. -/
structure CreationInputPlan where
  private mk ::
  evidence : ApplicationLayout
  diagram : ApplicationLayout
  standardization : ApplicationLayout
  target : ApplicationLayout
  diagramTag : String
  diagramPorts : Array ArgumentLayout

/-- The fixed creation request in its original complete source scope. Its two data arguments
are the actual target Cone and IsLimit record. The source-selected transport and creation stay
inside requestFamily; no intermediate computed c′ or t′ is represented as a runtime value. -/
structure PreparedCreationFamily where
  private mk ::
  family : CreationFamily
  target : LimitFamily
  context : ContextTelescope
  owner : ClosedTerm
  selectionData : NativeLimitSelection ClosedTerm
  selections : SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm
  targetOwner : SelectedLimitOwner ClosedTerm
  interface : LimitCreationInterface ClosedTerm
  universes : List Level
  targetUniverses : List Level
  construction : Name
  inputs : CreationInputPlan
  arguments : Array ClosedTerm
  sourceOwner : SelectedLimitOwner ClosedTerm
  sourceArguments : Array ClosedTerm
  sourcePositions : Array Nat

def PreparedCreationFamily.operation (prepared : PreparedCreationFamily) : String :=
  prepared.family.entry.id.raw

def PreparedCreationFamily.input (prepared : PreparedCreationFamily) : String :=
  prepared.operation ++ "#input"

def PreparedCreationFamily.requestFamily (prepared : PreparedCreationFamily) : ClosedTerm :=
  prepared.interface.requestFamily

/-- All original computational capture slots, including implicit data parameters. Proof slots
remain in the three complete application layouts. Repeated occurrences are never deduplicated. -/
def PreparedCreationFamily.captureSources (prepared : PreparedCreationFamily) : Array ClosedTerm :=
  (prepared.inputs.evidence.arguments ++ prepared.inputs.standardization.arguments ++
    prepared.inputs.target.arguments).filterMap fun argument =>
      if argument.wireIndex.isSome then some argument.source.source else none

/-- Prepare the complete original native constant application. Nullary record families use
the ordinary retained-whole-family path; no synthetic publication marker is introduced. -/
private def creationInputApplication (context : OpenContext)
    (selections : SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm) (application : Expr) :
    MetaM (List Level × ApplicationLayout) := do
  let .const declaration levels := application.consumeMData.getAppFn
    | throwError "the creation source input lost its original declaration application"
  let information ← checkedDeclaration declaration
  unless levels.length == information.levelParams.length do
    throwError "the creation source input changed its original universe arguments"
  let head := mkConst declaration levels
  let original ← context.close head
  let source ← SourceLayout.ofTerm original (selections := selections)
  let arguments ← application.getAppArgs.mapM context.close
  let (_, prepared) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource source context arguments
  return (levels, prepared)

/-- Close an already retained selected construction. Every selected mathematical field is
checked at its original source position; native result data never chooses this selection. -/
opaque PreparedCreationFamily.ofSelection (context : OpenContext) (owner : Expr)
    (selected : NativeLimitSelection) (family : CreationFamily) (target : LimitFamily)
    (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr) : MetaM (Option PreparedCreationFamily) := do
  let some creation := selected.source.creation | return none
  unless creation.lift == family.entry.id && selected.source.row == target.entry.id.raw do
    throwError "the selected creation changed its complete original accepted families"
  unless creation.declaration == family.entry.evidence && creation.edge == family.entry.edge &&
      !selected.source.colimit && !selected.source.construction.isAnonymous do
    throwError "the selected creation changed its original lift or construction"
  target.requireInterface selected.source
  unless creation.diagram.equal selected.source.diagram do
    throwError "the selected creation changed its exact source diagram"
  let .const declaration universes := creation.evidence.consumeMData.getAppFn
    | throwError "the selected creation lost its exact original evidence application"
  unless declaration == family.entry.evidence &&
      creation.evidence.getAppNumArgs == family.parameterCount &&
      universes.length == family.universeParams.length do
    throwError "the selected creation changed its complete original evidence telescope"
  let some standardization := selected.source.interface.standardization
    | throwError "the selected creation lost its accepted original comparison"
  let some comparisonDeclaration := target.entry.standardization
    | throwError "the selected creation has no independently accepted diagram comparison"
  unless standardization.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf comparisonDeclaration &&
      creation.standardization.equal standardization do
    throwError "the selected creation changed its declared original comparison"
  let expected ← family.interfaceAt creation.evidence creation.functor creation.diagram
    selected.source.interface
  unless (creation.terms.zip expected.terms).all
      (fun (actual, original) => actual.equal original) do
    throwError "the selected creation changed one of its original native interface fields"
  let presentation ← NativeLimitCreationInterface.presentation creation
  unless presentation.equal selected.source.presentation do
    throwError "the selected creation changed its original source presentation"
  let closedSelections ← selections.close context
  let (_, evidence) ← creationInputApplication context closedSelections creation.evidence
  let (_, diagram) ← creationInputApplication context closedSelections creation.diagram
  let (_, standardization) ← creationInputApplication context closedSelections creation.standardization
  let (targetUniverses, targetApplication) ←
    creationInputApplication context closedSelections selected.source.interface.presentation
  let (diagramTag, ports) ← LimitFamily.diagramPorts creation.diagram
  let diagramPorts := diagram.arguments.filter fun argument =>
    argument.binderInfo.isExplicit && argument.wireIndex.isSome
  unless diagramPorts.size == ports.size do
    throwError "the creation diagram changed its original explicit computational positions"
  let inputs : CreationInputPlan := ⟨evidence, diagram, standardization, targetApplication,
    diagramTag, diagramPorts⟩
  let some sourceOwner := selected.source.creationFamily
    | throwError "the selected creation lost its original source-input owner family"
  let sourceOwner ← SelectedLimitOwner.ofBinding context selections sourceOwner
  let some targetOwner := selected.source.ownerFamily
    | throwError "the selected creation lost its complete target owner template"
  let targetOwner ← SelectedLimitOwner.ofBinding context selections targetOwner
  let sourcePositions := selected.source.creationInputs
  let mut sourceArguments : Array ClosedTerm := #[]
  let mut previous : Option Nat := none
  for index in sourcePositions do
    if let some earlier := previous then
      unless earlier < index do
        throwError "the creation source owner changed original argument order"
    let some argument := diagram.arguments[index]?
      | throwError "the creation source owner names an absent original argument"
    unless argument.sourceIndex == index do
      throwError "the creation source owner changed an original native argument position"
    sourceArguments := sourceArguments.push argument.source.source
    previous := some index
  forallTelescope (← inferType sourceOwner.selection.receiver) fun parameters _ => do
    unless parameters.size == sourcePositions.size do
      throwError "the creation source owner lost its full native/proof input telescope"
    let formal ← sourceOwner.specialize parameters
    unless formal.source.construction == selected.source.construction &&
        formal.source.row == selected.source.row &&
        formal.source.diagram.consumeMData.getAppFn.equal creation.diagram.consumeMData.getAppFn do
      throwError "the creation source owner changed its original constructor or selection"
    for parameter in parameters, index in sourcePositions do
      let some original := formal.source.diagram.getAppArgs[index]?
        | throwError "the creation source owner lost a formal original argument"
      unless original.equal parameter do
        throwError "the creation source owner changed its declared positional input relation"
  return some {
    family, target, context := context.telescope, owner := ← context.close owner
    selectionData := ← selected.mapM context.close, selections := closedSelections
    targetOwner := ← targetOwner.mapM context.close
    interface := ← creation.mapM context.close, universes, targetUniverses
    construction := selected.source.construction, inputs
    arguments := #[← context.close creation.targetCone, ← context.close creation.targetUniversal]
    sourceOwner := ← sourceOwner.mapM context.close, sourceArguments, sourcePositions }

/-- Rebind the original source inputs once before descriptor production. The complete retained
source owner determines both D and the mapped target's arguments from these same positions.
Neither a declaration lookup nor native expression equality discovers an input occurrence. -/
opaque PreparedCreationFamily.rebindSource [Monad m] [MonadLiftT MetaM m] [MonadControlT MetaM m]
    (prepared : PreparedCreationFamily) (identities : CasRuntime.IdentitySupply)
    (context : OpenContext) (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (arguments : Array Expr)
    (action : OpenContext → SourceSelectionScope Expr → PreparedCreationFamily → m α) : m α := do
  let (selected, selections) ← liftM (m := MetaM) do
    unless arguments.size == prepared.sourceArguments.size do
      throwError "the creation source binding changed its complete original argument count"
    let family ← prepared.sourceOwner.mapM (·.inContext context)
    let selected ← family.specialize arguments
    let original ← prepared.selectionData.mapM (·.inContext context)
    unless selected.source.construction == prepared.construction &&
        selected.source.row == original.source.row do
      throwError "the creation source binding changed its original selected presentation"
    context.withOriginalSources #[selected.source.presentation, original.source.presentation] fun source => do
      unless ← isDefEq source[0]! source[1]! do
        throwError "the creation source binding changed its complete native presentation"
    let source := { selected.source with
      creationFamily := original.source.creationFamily
      ownerFamily := original.source.ownerFamily
      creationInputs := prepared.sourcePositions }
    let selected ← NativeLimitSelection.ofSource source selected.receiver
    let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections (← prepared.selections.inContext context)
    pure (selected, selections)
  let source : SourceSelection Expr := {
    value := selected.receiver, reference := some (.limit prepared.target.entry)
    originalApplication := some selected.source.interface.presentation, limit := some selected
    creationOwner := some (prepared.family, prepared.target)
    category := some {
      role := .object
      expression := selected.source.category
      bundle := selected.source.bundle
      limit := some selected.source } }
  SourceSelectionScope.withBinding identities selections context source
    fun context selections owner => do
      let rebound ← liftM (m := MetaM) do
        let some rebound ← PreparedCreationFamily.ofSelection context owner selected
            prepared.family prepared.target selections
          | throwError "the rebound source lost its complete selected creation"
        pure rebound
      action context selections rebound

/-- Retain the actual original data inputs supplied at this source boundary. This checks only
their complete dependent native interfaces. Runtime admission separately checks their exact
selected occurrences against the original source input map; native conversion is not identity. -/
opaque PreparedCreationFamily.withArguments (prepared : PreparedCreationFamily)
    (context : OpenContext) (cone universal : Expr) : MetaM PreparedCreationFamily := do
  let original ← prepared.interface.targetCone.inContext context
  let expectedCone ← inferType original
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType cone) expectedCone do
    throwError "the fixed creation argument changed its original target cone interface"
  let expectedUniversal ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[cone]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType universal) expectedUniversal do
    throwError "the fixed creation argument changed its actual target universal interface"
  let request ← prepared.requestFamily.inContext context
  let result := mkAppN request #[cone, universal]
  check result
  if result.hasMVar || result.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the fixed creation arguments have unresolved native parameters"
  return { prepared with arguments := #[← context.close cone, ← context.close universal] }

/-- Reopen the already captured contextual request. ClosedTerm transports the original complete
BindingId telescope; callers must not use the empty-context global-family preparation path. -/
opaque PreparedCreationFamily.familyIn (prepared : PreparedCreationFamily)
    (context : OpenContext) : MetaM Expr :=
  prepared.requestFamily.inContext context

/-- Reopen the exact retained original owner, without rediscovering an apex or target by type. -/
opaque PreparedCreationFamily.selection (prepared : PreparedCreationFamily)
    (context : OpenContext) : MetaM NativeLimitSelection := do
  let selected ← prepared.selectionData.mapM (·.inContext context)
  unless selected.source.construction == prepared.construction &&
      selected.source.row == prepared.target.entry.id.raw do
    throwError "the prepared creation changed its original construction or target"
  return selected

/-- Retain the exact fixed native request and its complete selected owner beside the term. -/
opaque PreparedCreationFamily.selectedArguments (prepared : PreparedCreationFamily)
    (context : OpenContext) (owner cone universal : Expr) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let selected ← prepared.selection context
  context.withOriginalSources #[owner, ← prepared.owner.inContext context] fun values => do
    unless ← isDefEq values[0]! values[1]! do
      throwError "the fixed creation changed its original selected owner"
  let checked ← prepared.withArguments context cone universal
  let result := mkAppN (← checked.familyIn context) #[cone, universal]
  check result
  if result.hasMVar || result.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the fixed creation has unresolved native inputs"
  return {
    value := result
    application := some {
      family := .creation prepared.family prepared.target
      universes := prepared.universes
      parameters := #[]
      arguments := #[cone, universal]
      owner := some owner }
    limit := some selected, creationOwner := some (prepared.family, prepared.target) }

/-- Reopen the exact complete fixed request in its captured context. -/
opaque PreparedCreationFamily.selected (prepared : PreparedCreationFamily)
    (context : OpenContext) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let owner ← prepared.owner.inContext context
  let #[cone, universal] ← prepared.arguments.mapM (·.inContext context)
    | throwError "the fixed creation request lost an original data input"
  prepared.selectedArguments context owner cone universal

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.SelectionData
import all CasCompiler.SelectionData

public import CasCompiler.SourceCarrier
public import CasCompiler.Layout
public import CasCompiler.SourceReference

@[expose] public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue


private def originalPoint (argument : InputArgumentRef) (iso : BindingId) : MetaM Bool := do
  match argument with
  | .slot index => return index == 0
  | .expression source =>
    match ← source.inputProjectionThrough #[] #[] #[iso] with
    | some (.projection route) =>
      match route.target with
      | .argument index => return index == 0 && route.path.isEmpty
      | .context _ => return false
    | _ => return false

/-- Read exactly the existing selected carrier action, then trace its unchanged point argument
to the original abstract Iso. Reuse: sourceFunction and ApplicationLayout.inputProjectionThrough.
This does not identify a callable by a field suffix or by equality of actual input values. -/
private def carrierPath (context : OpenContext) (isoId : BindingId) (iso : Expr)
    (category : NativeSourceCategory) (inverse : Bool) : MetaM (Array Name) := do
  let selected ← if inverse then mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.symm #[iso] else pure iso
  let hom ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[selected]
  let function ← sourceFunction ⟨hom, some category⟩
  let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close function)
  let (_, application) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource layout context #[]
  let some (.callable route steps) ←
      application.inputProjectionThrough #[(#[], 1)] #[] #[isoId]
    | throwUnsupportedSource "the presentation carrier has no native input-function path"
  let .context original := route.target
    | throwError "the presentation carrier function changed its original isomorphism"
  unless original == isoId && !route.path.isEmpty do
    throwError "the presentation carrier function lost its exact isomorphism field"
  let #[step] := steps
    | throwUnsupportedSource "the presentation carrier requires an additional source action"
  let #[argument] := step.arguments
    | throwUnsupportedSource "the presentation carrier changed its complete point application"
  unless step.selection.isEmpty && (← originalPoint argument isoId) do
    throwUnsupportedSource "the presentation carrier does not apply its unchanged original point"
  return route.path

/-- Retain the already registered native Iso family under the release declaration checks.
The registered endpoint declarations and category are checked before deriving its two carrier
paths. Only supplied structural carrier actions participate. -/
opaque PresentationFamily.forEntry (row : PresentationComparisonEntry) :
    MetaM PresentationFamily := withLCtx {} #[] do
  let state ← semanticState
  validatePresentation { state with presentations := state.presentations.filter (·.id != row.id) } row
  let some source := state.objects.find? (·.id == row.source)
    | throwError "the presentation source is not registered"
  let some target := state.objects.find? (·.id == row.target)
    | throwError "the presentation target is not registered"
  let some category := state.categories.find? (·.id == source.category)
    | throwError "the presentation category is not registered"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration source.declaration
  discard <| checkedDeclaration target.declaration
  discard <| checkedDeclaration category.declaration
  let info ← checkedDeclaration row.declaration
  let family := mkConst row.declaration (info.levelParams.map Level.param)
  let (forwardPath, inversePath) ← forallTelescopeReducing info.type fun parameters result => do
    let result ← whnfR result
    unless result.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
      throwError "the registered presentation has no complete native isomorphism result"
    let bundle ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Cat.of
      #[some result.getAppArgs[0]!, some result.getAppArgs[1]!]
    withLocalDeclD `presentation result fun iso => do
      let bindings := (parameters.push iso).mapIdx fun index expression =>
        { id := { session := "presentation-path", serial := index },
          role := BindingRole.parameter, expression : LocalBinding }
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let isoId := bindings.back!.id
      let selected : NativeSourceCategory := ⟨.morphism, category.expression, bundle, none, none⟩
      return (← carrierPath context isoId iso selected false,
        ← carrierPath context isoId iso selected true)
  unless forwardPath != inversePath do
    throwError "the presentation carrier paths lost their distinct Iso directions"
  return ⟨row, source, target, category, family, info.type, info.levelParams,
    forwardPath, inversePath⟩

def PresentationFamily.instantiate (family : PresentationFamily) : MetaM (Expr × List Level) := do
  let levels ← family.universeParams.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  return (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels, levels)

/-- The original, un-oriented native endpoints at these complete declaration parameters.
The supplied registry already requires these named families; the native terms retain every
parameter, and source references identify their exact rows without choosing runtime values. -/
def PresentationFamily.endpoints (family : PresentationFamily) (applied : Expr) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr × SourceSelection Expr) := do
  unless applied.getAppFn.constName? == some family.entry.declaration do
    throwError "the selected presentation changed its declared native family"
  let result ← whnfR (← inferType applied)
  unless result.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
    throwError "the selected presentation requires its complete declaration parameters"
  let source := result.getAppArgs[2]!.headBeta
  let target := result.getAppArgs[3]!.headBeta
  unless source.isAppOf family.source.declaration && target.isAppOf family.target.declaration do
    throwError "the selected presentation lost its declared native endpoint families"
  return (sourceReference (.named (.registered (.inl family.source) family.category)) source,
    sourceReference (.named (.registered (.inl family.target) family.category)) target)

/-- Retain the original named Iso family and complete selected presentation row. -/
def PresentationFamily.selected (family : PresentationFamily) (applied : Expr) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  discard <| family.endpoints applied
  let .const _ levels := applied.getAppFn
    | throwError "the selected presentation lost its original native declaration"
  unless levels.length == family.universeParams.length do
    throwError "the selected presentation changed its complete universe telescope"
  return {
    value := applied, reference := some (.presentation family.entry)
    originalApplication := some applied
    application := some {
      family := .presentation family, universes := levels
      parameters := applied.getAppArgs } }

/-- Check the supplied native endpoints and retain their exact original occurrences.
The original-source view is used only for this mathematical compatibility check. -/
def PresentationFamily.withEndpoints (family : PresentationFamily) (applied source target : Expr)
    (context : Option OpenContext := none) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let selected ← family.selected applied
  let verify := fun (terms : Array Expr) => do
    let (expectedSource, expectedTarget) ← family.endpoints terms[0]!
    checkRegisteredDomains terms[1]! expectedSource.value
    checkRegisteredDomains terms[2]! expectedTarget.value
    unless ← isDefEq terms[1]! expectedSource.value <&&>
        isDefEq terms[2]! expectedTarget.value do
      throwError "the presentation request changed its complete declared endpoints"
  match context with
  | some context => context.withOriginalSources #[applied, source, target] verify
  | none => verify #[applied, source, target]
  return { selected with presentationEndpoints := some (source, target) }

/-- The one declared direction selected by an exact native carrier-function path. -/
def PresentationFamily.direction? (family : PresentationFamily) (path : Array Name) : Option Bool :=
  if path == family.forwardPath then some false
  else if path == family.inversePath then some true
  else none

/-- The ordinary native carrier function of this actual selected Iso, retaining its complete
category dictionary. The caller supplies the exact original Iso occurrence. -/
def PresentationFamily.function (family : PresentationFamily) (iso : Expr) (inverse : Bool) :
    MetaM Expr := do
  let result ← whnfR (← inferType iso)
  unless result.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
    throwError "the presentation action requires its actual native Iso"
  let bundle ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Cat.of

  let hom ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[selected]
  sourceFunction ⟨hom, some ⟨.morphism, family.category.expression, bundle, none, none⟩⟩

end CasCompiler

/-- One formal callable slot. Its ordinal and published reference are independent of its type. -/
structure PrerequisiteSlot where
  index : Nat
  source : CheckedComputationPrerequisite
  expression : Expr

/-- Read every published alternative through the upstream safety and axiom checks.
The upstream checked packet is retained intact, including rigid universes and equality.
Source: LeanCategories/Catalogue/Registry/Computation.lean at
8c35703b104aca1700b9fb40d1af4164ca31a55d. -/
opaque SourceProgram.forTarget (target : ComputationRef) : MetaM (Array SourceProgram) := do
  let targetReference ← SelectedSourceReference.forComputation target
  (← checkedComputationDerivations target).mapM fun source => do
    let prerequisites ← source.prerequisites.mapM fun prerequisite =>
      SelectedSourceReference.forComputation prerequisite.reference
    return ⟨source, targetReference, prerequisites⟩

/-- Open only the prerequisite prefix with fresh locals; keep the entire target family.
Lean's telescope and application operations retain dependent binder types and slot order. -/
def SourceProgram.withPrerequisites (program : SourceProgram)
    (action : Array PrerequisiteSlot → Expr → MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  let source := program.source
  forallBoundedTelescope (← inferType source.template) (some source.prerequisites.size)
      fun locals _ => do
    unless locals.size == source.prerequisites.size do
      throwError "checked source program has an incomplete prerequisite telescope"
    let slots := source.prerequisites.mapIdx fun index prerequisite =>
      { index, source := prerequisite, expression := locals[index]! : PrerequisiteSlot }
    action slots (mkAppN source.template locals).headBeta

/-- Instantiate the accepted template with its original ordered primitive families.
Only the independently checked template supplies composition; each prerequisite keeps its
own public reference. No declaration search or source equality selects a primitive. -/
opaque SourceProgram.instantiate [Monad m] [MonadLiftT MetaM m] [MonadControlT MetaM m]
    (program : SourceProgram) (universes : List Level) (identities : CasRuntime.IdentitySupply)
    (context : OpenContext) (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
    (action : OpenContext → SourceSelectionScope Expr → Expr → m α) : m α := do
  unless universes.length == program.source.universeParams.length do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the source program lost its complete universe substitution"
  let template := program.source.template.instantiateLevelParams
    program.source.universeParams universes
  let rec visit (remaining : List (Fin program.source.prerequisites.size))
      (context : OpenContext) (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
      (arguments : Array Expr) : m α := do
    match remaining with
    | [] =>
      let value := (mkAppN template arguments).headBeta
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| check value
      action context selections value
    | index :: remaining =>
      let source := program.source.prerequisites[index.val]
      let value := source.family.instantiateLevelParams program.source.universeParams universes
      let some reference := program.prerequisiteReferences[index.val]?
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the accepted program lost an original full prerequisite row"
      let selected : SourceSelection Expr := { value, reference := some reference, application := some {
        family := .prerequisite program index, universes, parameters := #[] } }
      SourceSelectionScope.withBinding identities selections context selected
        fun context selections value => visit remaining context selections (arguments.push value)
  visit (List.finRange program.source.prerequisites.size) context selections #[]


/-- Resolve the exact public address and retain the entire rigid family.
Reuse: ComputationRef.declaration, the release AxiomAudit.permitted budget and native context closure. -/
opaque SourceFamily.forReference (reference : ComputationRef) : MetaM SourceFamily := do
  let selectedReference ← SelectedSourceReference.forComputation reference
  let some declaration := selectedReference.declaration
    | throwError "the accepted source family lost its original declaration"
  let info ← checkedDeclaration declaration
  let family ← withLCtx {} #[] do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    context.close (mkConst declaration (info.levelParams.map Level.param))
  let source : CheckedComputationPrerequisite :=
    { reference, declaration, family := family.expression, familyType := family.type }
  let pointFamily ← match selectedReference with
    | .named (.registered (.inr entry) _) => PointFamily.forEntry? entry
    | _ => pure none
  return ⟨source, info.levelParams, selectedReference, pointFamily⟩

/-- Apply the exact accepted family. Its typed boundary and complete selected scope remain
beside the native term throughout request preparation, including the nullary case. -/
opaque SourceFamily.applyIn (family : SourceFamily) (universes : List Level)
    (context : OpenContext) (arguments : Array ClosedTerm) :
    MetaM (SourceLayout × ApplicationLayout) := do
  unless universes.length == family.universeParams.length do
    throwError "the selected family lost its complete universe substitution"
  let original ← withLCtx {} #[] do
    let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let original := family.source.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams universes
    empty.close original
  ApplicationLayout.ofSource (← SourceLayout.ofTerm original) context arguments (some original)

/-- A complete accepted source interface: a registered family, checked derivation target,
ordered primitive slot, selected lift/presentation/method, or native property observation. -/
inductive ProgramBoundary
  | registered (family : SourceFamily)
  | target (program : SourceProgram)
  | prerequisite (program : SourceProgram) (index : Fin program.source.prerequisites.size)
  | lift (family : LiftFamily)
  | presentation (family : PresentationFamily)
  | routedMethod (family : RoutedMethodFamily)
  | property (family : PropertyFamily)
  | application (family : PointFamily)
  | point (family : CategoricalPointFamily)
  | objectAction (family : SourceActionFamily)
  | limit (family : LimitFamily) (owner : SelectedLimitOwner ClosedTerm)
  | limitUniversal (family : LimitUniversalFamily) (owner : SelectedLimitOwner ClosedTerm)
  | creation (family : PreparedCreationFamily)

/-- A published computation-family address, when this boundary has one. Other accepted
source interfaces retain their own exact registered address in the boundary witness. -/
def ProgramBoundary.reference : ProgramBoundary → Option ComputationRef
  | .registered family => some family.source.reference
  | .target program => some program.source.entry.target
  | .prerequisite program index => some program.source.prerequisites[index.val].reference
  | .lift _ | .presentation _ | .routedMethod _ | .property _ | .application _
  | .point _ | .objectAction _ | .limit _ _ | .limitUniversal _ _ | .creation _ => none

def ProgramBoundary.universeParams : ProgramBoundary → List Name
  | .registered family => family.universeParams
  | .target program | .prerequisite program _ => program.source.universeParams
  | .lift family => family.universeParams
  | .presentation family => family.universeParams
  | .routedMethod family => family.universeParams
  | .property family => family.universeParams
  | .application family => family.universeParams
  | .point family => family.universeParams
  | .objectAction family => family.universeParams
  | .limit family _ => family.universeParams
  | .limitUniversal family _ => family.universeParams
  | .creation family => family.family.universeParams

/-- Open the accepted family in the caller's original complete source context. Global
declarations retain their rigid universe substitution; a fixed creation request reopens its
already captured native context and is never reinterpreted in an empty local context. -/
def ProgramBoundary.familyIn (boundary : ProgramBoundary) (universes : List Level)
    (context : OpenContext) : MetaM Expr := do
  unless universes.length == boundary.universeParams.length do
    throwError "the source boundary changed its complete universe telescope"
  let instantiate : Expr → MetaM Expr := fun source =>
    pure (source.instantiateLevelParams boundary.universeParams universes)
  match boundary with
  | .registered family => instantiate family.source.family
  | .target program => instantiate program.source.target
  | .prerequisite program index => instantiate program.source.prerequisites[index.val].family
  | .lift family => instantiate family.family
  | .presentation family => instantiate family.family
  | .routedMethod family => instantiate family.family
  | .property family => instantiate family.family
  | .application family => instantiate family.family
  | .point family => instantiate family.family
  | .objectAction family => instantiate family.family
  | .limit family _ => instantiate family.family
  | .limitUniversal family _ => instantiate family.family
  | .creation family => do
    unless universes == family.universes do
      throwError "the fixed creation changed its original evidence universe arguments"
    family.familyIn context

end CasCompiler

    for index in #[0, 1, 2] do
      let some prepared := layout.fields[index]?
        | throwError "the lazy dependent source lost a prefix field layout"
      let some baseline := originalFields[index]?
        | throwError "the lazy dependent source lost a captured prefix field"
      unless baseline.projectionAccesses.isEmpty do
        throwError "the captured baseline already carries a lazy projection access"
      let (next, _) ← projectionGraph.bindProjection owners.identities
        { program, occurrence, role := prepared.layout, parameters := #[none],
          access := some lazyParent, accessPath := #[prepared.field.projection] }
        baseline #[]
      projectionGraph := next
    let .ok retainedParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue projectionGraph binding.id lazyParent
      | throwError "the published lazy source is outside its graph"
    let retained ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker context #[retainedParameter]
    discard <| retained.checkResult projectionGraph valueField.layout value
    for changed in #[0, 1, 2] do
      let some prepared := layout.fields[changed]?
        | throwError "the changed source lost a prefix field layout"
      let (graph, replacement) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence, role := prepared.layout, parameters := #[none] }
        (.closure program #[])
      -- A returned container must retain its own actual prefix, in addition to satisfying
      -- the original external context. These stored views keep their original associations.
      let (mixedGraph, mixed) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence, role := layout.source, parameters := #[none] }
        (.product (originalFields.set! changed replacement))
      let mixedFailure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| environment.checkResult mixedGraph layout.source mixed
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some mixedFailure := mixedFailure
        | throwError "the returned record accepted a changed actual prefix at {changed}"
      unless (← mixedFailure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
          "the runtime value has a different consuming dependent reference" do throw mixedFailure
      let (graph, replaced) ← retain graph (originalFields.set! changed replacement)
      let .ok parameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id replaced
        | throwError "the changed chained source record is outside its graph"
      let changedEnvironment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker context #[parameter]
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| changedEnvironment.checkResult graph valueField.layout value
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure
        | throwError "the dependent final field accepted a changed prefix at {changed}"
      unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
          "the runtime value has a different consuming dependent reference" do throw failure
    let missing ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker context #[]
    let failure : Option Exception ← try
      discard <| missing.checkResult graph valueField.layout value
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
    let some failure := failure
      | throwError "the dependent final field accepted a missing source record"
    unless missingValueOf failure binding.id do throw failure

module

import CasCompiler.Parse
import CasCompiler.SourceProof
import CasCompiler.Layout
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.Parse
meta import CasCompiler.SourceProof
meta import CasCompiler.Layout

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue.Language

private def nativeSyntax (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | throwError "the source obligation control did not parse"
  return ⟨stx⟩

private def suppliedProof (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the explicit source proof control did not parse"
  return ⟨stx⟩

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let parameters ← empty.assume `n (← nativeSyntax "Nat")
  let propositions ← parameters.assume `P (← nativeSyntax "Prop")
  let session ← propositions.assume `h (← nativeSyntax "P")
  let obligation ← session.proposition (← nativeSyntax "P")
  let input := "-- source evidence\n\nlet evidence := proof(h)\n"
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "formal-evidence.cas" input
  let some item := file.items[0]? | throwError "the original evidence declaration is absent"
  let `(cas_item| let $_:ident := $evidence:cas_term) := item.raw
    | throwError "the original evidence declaration changed syntax"
  let checked ← file.withContext <| session.proof evidence obligation.source
  unless checked.source.expression == mkBVar 0 && checked.source.type == mkBVar 1 &&
      checked.source.context.entries.size == 3 &&
      checked.span.fileName == "formal-evidence.cas" do
    throwError "formal proof checking changed the obligation, source scope or original file"
  let some position := checked.span.start | throwError "the formal proof lost its source position"
  unless (file.context.fileMap.toPosition position).line == 3 do
    throwError "formal proof checking changed the original source line"
  let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm checked.source
  unless layout.kind == .proof && layout.kind.actions.isEmpty do
    throwError "source evidence acquired a computational interface"
  for text in #["proof(True.intro)", "h"] do
    let rejected ← try
      discard <| session.proof (← suppliedProof text) obligation.source
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless rejected do throwError "source evidence bypassed its wrapper or actual obligation: {text}"
  let dataType ← session.term (← nativeSyntax "Nat")
  let rejected ← try
    discard <| session.proof (← suppliedProof "proof(7)") dataType.source
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do throwError "a non-proposition was accepted as a formal proof obligation"

private def checkOriginalProof (session : SourceSession) (obligation proof : SourceTerm) :
    MetaM Unit := withCurrHeartbeats do
  unless proof.source.context.exactlyMatches session.context do
    throwError "native proof completion changed an original source declaration"
  proof.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let expected ← obligation.source.inContext context
    check expression
    checkWithKernel expression
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType expression) expected do
      throwError "native proof completion changed the independently prepared proposition"

/- The original standalone proof has a native recursive helper. Term synthesis alone leaves
its let-rec placeholder unresolved; the proof owner must complete it before source closure. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `n (← nativeSyntax "Nat")
  let obligation ← session.proposition (← nativeSyntax "True")
  let original ← getEnv
  let proof ← withCurrHeartbeats <| session.proof (← suppliedProof
    "proof(by\n  let rec witness (k : Nat) : True :=\n    match k with\n    | 0 => True.intro\n    | Nat.succ k => witness k\n  exact witness n)") obligation.source
  let declarations := proof.source.nativeDeclarations.constants
  unless !declarations.isEmpty && declarations.any (fun declaration =>
      proof.source.expression.containsConst (· == declaration.name)) do
    throwError "the standalone let-rec proof lost its actual checked helper"
  checkOriginalProof session obligation proof
  setEnv original
  checkOriginalProof session obligation proof
  for declaration in declarations do
    unless nativeConstantExactlyMatches declaration (← getConstInfo declaration.name) do
      throwError "reopening changed the completed native recursive helper"

/- The shared formal-evidence owner also serves constrained-point proofs. Its recursive
helper must retain rigid universe parameters, formal assumptions and native let definitions. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let type ← empty.elaborate Syntax.missing fun _ =>
    pure (mkSort (.succ (.param `nativeProofScope)))
  let session ← empty.assumeTerm `α type
  let session ← session.assume `x (← nativeSyntax "α")
  let session ← session.assume `n (← nativeSyntax "Nat")
  let session ← session.define `xAlias (← nativeSyntax "x")
  let obligation ← session.proposition (← nativeSyntax "xAlias = x")
  let evidence ← nativeSyntax
    "by\n  let rec witness (k : Nat) : xAlias = x :=\n    match k with\n    | 0 => rfl\n    | Nat.succ k => witness k\n  exact witness n"
  let proof ← withCurrHeartbeats <| session.elaborate evidence fun context => do
    sourceFormalProof evidence (← obligation.source.inContext context)
  unless proof.source.universeParams.contains `nativeProofScope &&
      proof.source.nativeDeclarations.constants.any (fun declaration =>
        declaration.levelParams.contains `nativeProofScope) do
    throwError "native let-rec completion lost the source's rigid universe parameter"
  checkOriginalProof session obligation proof

/- Native closure conversion handles nested and mutually recursive local proofs, rather
than replacing them by another proof of the same proposition. Repeated user spellings in
separate source proofs must receive distinct native declaration occurrences. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `n (← nativeSyntax "Nat")
  let session ← session.assume `P (← nativeSyntax "Prop")
  let session ← session.assume `h (← nativeSyntax "P")
  let obligation ← session.proposition (← nativeSyntax "P")
  let nested ← withCurrHeartbeats <| session.proof (← suppliedProof
    "proof(by\n  let rec witness (k : Nat) : P :=\n    let rec inner (j : Nat) : P :=\n      match j with\n      | 0 => h\n      | Nat.succ j => inner j\n    match k with\n    | 0 => inner n\n    | Nat.succ k => witness k\n  exact witness n)") obligation.source
  let mutualProof ← withCurrHeartbeats <| session.proof (← suppliedProof
    "proof(let rec witness (k : Nat) : P := match k with | 0 => h | Nat.succ k => partner k, partner (k : Nat) : P := match k with | 0 => h | Nat.succ k => witness k; witness n)") obligation.source
  checkOriginalProof session obligation nested
  checkOriginalProof session obligation mutualProof
  let nestedDeclarations := nested.source.nativeDeclarations.constants.filter fun declaration =>
    nested.source.expression.containsConst (· == declaration.name)
  let mutualDeclarations := mutualProof.source.nativeDeclarations.constants.filter fun declaration =>
    mutualProof.source.expression.containsConst (· == declaration.name)
  unless !nestedDeclarations.isEmpty && !mutualDeclarations.isEmpty &&
      nestedDeclarations.all (fun first =>
        mutualDeclarations.all (fun second => first.name != second.name)) do
    throwError "separate source proofs reused a checked native helper occurrence"

/- Native termination and evidence failures remain failures, even when an invalid local
helper is unused by the final proof. Expected negative controls restore their test state. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `n (← nativeSyntax "Nat")
  let obligation ← session.proposition (← nativeSyntax "True")
  for text in #[
      "proof(by\n  let rec invalid (k : Nat) : True := invalid k\n  exact invalid n)",
      "proof(by\n  let rec invalid (k : Nat) : True := invalid k\n  exact True.intro)",
      "proof(by\n  let rec invalid (k : Nat) : True := False.elim (by exact True.intro)\n  exact invalid n)"] do
    let saved : Term.SavedState ← saveState
    let failure : Option Exception ← try
      discard <| withCurrHeartbeats <| session.proof (← suppliedProof text) obligation.source
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
    saved.restore
    unless failure.isSome do
      throwError "native formal evidence accepted an invalid recursive declaration: {text}"
  let proof ← withCurrHeartbeats <| session.proof (← suppliedProof "proof(True.intro)")
    obligation.source
  checkOriginalProof session obligation proof
  unless (← getLetRecsToLift).isEmpty do
    throwError "failed native proof completion left pending local recursive declarations"
