public import CasCompiler.SelectionData
import all CasCompiler.SelectionData

public import CasCompiler.RoutedMethodFamily
public import CasCompiler.SourceReference

@[expose] public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue


/-- Retain an exact accepted property, classifier and structural route before specialization.
Reuse: PropertyEntry, nativeRouteFunctor, Classifier.Holds and whole-family universe closure. -/
opaque PropertyFamily.forSelection (source : CategoryExpr) (id : PropertyId)
    (refs : Array EdgeRef) : MetaM PropertyFamily := withLCtx {} #[] do
  let state ← semanticState
  let some entry := state.properties.find? (·.id == id)
    | throwError "the selected property is absent from the source registry"
  unless entry.receiver.all (·.syntacticEq source) do
    throwError "the property has a different complete source category"
  let some classifier := state.classifier? entry.classifier
    | throwError "the property lost its accepted classifier"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration classifier.declaration
  discard <| checkedDeclaration ``CasCatalogue.Classifier.Holds
  let query ← SourceRoutes.forOwner source classifier.host
  let some routes ← query.finiteRoutes
    | throwUnsupportedSource "the property route family requires its supplied uniform comparison"
  let #[route] := routes.filter (fun route => route.refs == refs &&
      route.target.syntacticEq classifier.host)
    | throwError "the property lost its exact complete source route"
  let actionFamilies ← route.refs.mapM SourceActionFamily.forEdge
  let receiverViews ← sourceReceiverViewPlans state route
  let categoryFamily ← nativeCategoryFamily state source fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  let (family, actions, count) ←
      forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType categoryFamily) fun parameters _ => do
    let bundle := mkAppN categoryFamily parameters
    let selected ← nativeRouteFunctor state route bundle
    let classifierValue ← classifierInstance classifier
    let rigid := (← getMCtx).levelMVarToParam (fun _ => false) (fun _ => false)
      classifierValue `propertyUniverse
    setMCtx rigid.mctx
    let classifierValue := rigid.expr
    let declared ← inferType classifierValue
    let declared ← if declared.isAppOfArity ``LeanCategories.Classifier 1 then pure declared
      else whnfR declared
    unless declared.isAppOfArity ``LeanCategories.Classifier 1 do
      throwError "the accepted property declaration lost its complete native classifier type"
    -- The accepted declaration fixes these universe arguments. The source route's host
    -- levels are constrained by the whole-type comparison below, before final closure.
    let expected := mkApp declared.getAppFn selected.target
    unless ← withoutModifyingState <| isDefEq (← inferType classifierValue) expected do
      unless ← expandSourceStructures ((← getMVars classifierValue).map mkMVar) do
        throwError "the property's classifier has inconsistent native category parameters"
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType classifierValue) expected do
      throwError "the property classifier has a different complete native host"
    let classifierValue ← instantiateMVars classifierValue
    let sourceType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]
    let callable ← withLocalDeclD `propertyReceiver sourceType fun receiver => do
      let image ← if route.refs.isEmpty then pure receiver
        else functorObject selected.functor receiver selected.target
      let proposition ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Classifier.Holds #[classifierValue, image]
      mkLambdaFVars #[receiver] proposition (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
    let close := fun term => do
      mkLambdaFVars parameters (← instantiateMVars term)
        (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
    return (← close callable, ← selected.actions.mapM close, parameters.size)
  let (expressions, universes) ← closeRoutedUniverses (#[categoryFamily, family] ++ actions)
  return ⟨entry, classifier, route, expressions[0]!, expressions[1]!,
    expressions.drop 2, actionFamilies, receiverViews, universes, count⟩

def PropertyFamily.instantiate (family : PropertyFamily) : MetaM (Expr × List Level) := do
  let levels ← family.universeParams.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  return (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels, levels)

/-- Retain the complete accepted property family and its original positional application.
The native proposition remains Holds applied to its original image. -/
def PropertyFamily.selected (family : PropertyFamily) (levels : List Level)
    (parameters : Array Expr) (receiver : Expr) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  unless levels.length == family.universeParams.length &&
      parameters.size == family.parameterCount do
    throwError "the property lost its complete original source application"
  let applied := mkAppN (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels)
    (parameters.push receiver)
  let proposition := applied.headBeta
  unless proposition.isAppOfArity ``CasCatalogue.Classifier.Holds 3 do
    throwError "the property family lost its native Holds proposition"
  check proposition
  return {
    value := proposition
    originalApplication := some applied
    observation := some (.classifier family.classifier)
    application := some {
      family := .property family
      universes := levels
      parameters
      arguments := #[receiver] } }

/-- Specialize one already selected complete property family at its original source object.
This is the common native producer for source competition and deferred property calls. -/
opaque PropertyFamily.atReceiver (family : PropertyFamily) (selected : NativeSourceCategory)
    (receiver : Expr) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  unless selected.role == .object do
    throwError "a property requires its selected source object category"
  unless family.route.source.syntacticEq selected.expression do
    throwError "the property changed its complete selected source category"
  let (head, levels) ← family.instantiate
  let category := family.categoryFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
  let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType category)
  unless ← isDefEq (mkAppN category parameters) selected.bundle do
    throwError "the property changed its complete selected category parameters"
  let domain ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[selected.bundle]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType receiver) domain do
    throwError "the property receiver has a different complete native source category"
  let applied ← instantiateMVars (mkAppN head (parameters.push receiver))
  if applied.hasMVar || applied.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the property leaves a complete source parameter undetermined"
  family.selected (← levels.mapM instantiateLevelMVars)
    (← parameters.mapM instantiateMVars) (← instantiateMVars receiver)

/-- The source reader and deferred children form the same complete native proposition.
Route alternatives are compared before specializing any category parameter or receiver.
An admitted preferred route selects only its actual family, without asserting an equality. -/
opaque PropertyFamily.forReceiver (selected : NativeSourceCategory) (id : PropertyId)
    (receiver : Expr) : MetaM (PropertyFamily × SourceSelection Expr) := do
  unless selected.role == .object do
    throwError "a property requires its selected source object category"
  let state ← semanticState
  let some entry := state.properties.find? (·.id == id)
    | throwError "the selected property is absent from the source registry"
  let some classifier := state.classifier? entry.classifier
    | throwError "the property lost its accepted classifier"
  let query ← SourceRoutes.forOwner selected.expression classifier.host
  let some routes ← query.finiteRoutes
    | throwUnsupportedSource "the property route family requires its supplied uniform comparison"
  let preferred ← preferredRoute? state selected.expression entry.name routes
  let routes := match preferred with
    | none => routes
    | some route => routes.filter (·.refs == route.refs)
  let some route := routes[0]?
    | throwError "the property is not reachable from the receiver's category"
  let agreements ← sourceRouteAgreements state selected routes
  let family ← PropertyFamily.forSelection selected.expression entry.id route.refs
  let selected ← family.atReceiver selected receiver
  let mut proposition := selected.value
  for proof in agreements.reverse do
    proposition ← withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `propertyRouteAgreement)
      (← inferType proof) proof fun binding => mkLetFVars #[binding] proposition
        (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
  return (family, { selected with value := proposition })

def PropertyFamily.specializeActions (family : PropertyFamily) (levels : List Level)
    (arguments : Array Expr) : MetaM (Array Expr) := do
  unless levels.length == family.universeParams.length &&
      arguments.size == family.parameterCount do
    throwError "the property changed its complete category parameter telescope"
  return family.actions.map fun action =>
    (mkAppN (action.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels) arguments).headBeta


/-- Read a proposition only through its explicitly retained value aliases and authored
proof lets. Operand binders remain opaque, so equal values cannot replace their identities. -/
private partial def originalPropertyProposition (context : OpenContext)
    (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (expression : Expr)
    (seen : Array BindingId := #[]) : MetaM Expr := do
  if let .fvar localId := expression then
    if let some binding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == localId) then
      if let some selected := selections[binding.id]? then
        unless selected.formalBindings.isEmpty && !seen.contains binding.id do
          throwError "the property source lost its complete original value alias"
        return ← originalPropertyProposition context selections selected.value (seen.push binding.id)
    if let some value := (← localId.getDecl).value? then
      return ← originalPropertyProposition context selections value seen
    return expression
  match expression with
  | .mdata _ body => originalPropertyProposition context selections body seen
  | .letE _ type value body _ =>
    unless ← isProp type do
      throwError "the property source introduced a data-bearing proposition alias"
    originalPropertyProposition context selections (body.instantiate1 value) seen
  | _ => pure expression

/-- Authenticate the original property application before any runtime operand is rebound.
The full accepted family, all positional inputs and the native Holds body must agree
exactly; definitional equality of a different supplied occurrence does not authenticate it. -/
opaque PropertyFamily.checkSelection (family : PropertyFamily) (context : OpenContext)
    (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (selected : SourceSelection Expr) : MetaM Unit := do
  let some application := selected.application
    | throwError "the property source lost its complete original application"
  unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.property family).exactlyMatches application.family &&
      application.universes.length == family.universeParams.length &&
      application.parameters.size == family.parameterCount &&
      application.arguments.size == 1 && application.owner.isNone &&
      application.ownerSelection.isNone do
    throwError "the property source changed its complete selected family or input positions"
  let applied := mkAppN
    (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams application.universes)
    (application.parameters ++ application.arguments)
  let some original := selected.originalApplication
    | throwError "the property source lost its original native application"
  unless original.equal applied do
    throwError "the property source witness changed its original native proposition"
  let expected := applied.headBeta
  unless expected.isAppOfArity ``CasCatalogue.Classifier.Holds 3 do
    throwError "the property source lost its original Holds proposition"
  let actual ← originalPropertyProposition context selections selected.value
  unless actual.equal expected do
    throwError "the property source witness changed its original native proposition"
  check expected

end CasCompiler

module

import CasCompiler.PublishedSource
import CasCompiler.CategoricalPointSource
import LeanCategories.Catalogue
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.PublishedSource
meta import CasCompiler.CategoricalPointSource
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue

namespace CasCompiler.PublishedCategoricalRequestTests

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

-- The public seven-field entrance consumes the complete original native parameter table.
-- No provider is available in this source-only context; every read reference is its exact
-- original local slot, and the returned source retains the arbitrary generalized point.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[component] := state.cells.filter (·.id == NaturalTransformationId.listReverse)
    | throwError "the original component is absent"
  let #[cartesian] := state.functors.filter (·.id == FunctorId.modulesReindex)
    | throwError "the original family reindexing is absent"
  let mut owners : Array CategoricalPointOwner := #[
    .component component #[] false, .component component #[] true,
    .component component #[ConstructorId.arrow] false, .cartesian cartesian,
    .action (.functor FunctorId.setsList),
    .action (.classifierForget ClassifierId.setsFinite),
    .action (.constructMap ConstructorId.arrow (.functor FunctorId.setsList))]
  for identifier in #["bind.sets.finite_sum", "bind.sets.finite_product"] do
    let #[entry] := state.binders.filter (·.id.raw == identifier)
      | throwError "the original binder is absent"
    owners := owners.push (.binder entry)
  for owner in owners do
    let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner owner
    let levels := family.universeParams.map Level.param
    let type := family.familyType.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
    forallTelescopeReducing type fun inputs _ => do
      let parameters := inputs.extract 0 family.parameterCount
      let domain := inputs[family.parameterCount]!
      let point := inputs[family.parameterCount + 1]!
      let (arrow, _) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
      let (source, target) ← categoricalPointEndpoints arrow
      let table := inputs ++ #[source, target]
      let reference := fun (index : Nat) =>
        Json.mkObj [("ctor", .str "scopeRef"), ("args", .arr #[toJson index])]
      let publicParameters := (← family.explicitParameters).map reference
      let node := fun (tag : String) (arguments : Array Json) =>
        Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson tag), ("args", .arr arguments)]
      let (packets, descriptor) ← match owner with
        | .component entry constructors inverse =>
          let receiver := reference family.declarationParameterCount
          let descriptor : ConstructedCellComponent := {
            constructors := constructors.map (·.raw)
            component := { cell := entry.id.raw, parameters := publicParameters, receiver, inverse } }
          pure (#[.arr publicParameters, receiver, toJson inverse],
            if constructors.isEmpty then descriptor.component.encode else descriptor.encode)
        | .cartesian entry =>
          let receiver := reference family.declarationParameterCount
          pure (#[.arr publicParameters, receiver],
            ({ reindex := entry.id.raw, parameters := publicParameters, receiver } : CartesianMap).encode)
        | .binder entry =>
          pure (publicParameters, node entry.id.raw publicParameters)
        | .action edge =>
          let action := routedActionDescriptor edge publicParameters
          let packets := match edge with
            | .functor _ => publicParameters
            | _ => #[action]
          pure (packets, node "map" #[action, TypedMap.encode {
            source := reference family.declarationParameterCount
            target := reference (family.declarationParameterCount + 1)
            callable := reference (family.declarationParameterCount + 2) }])
        | .named owner =>
          pure (publicParameters, node owner.operation publicParameters)
      let packet : PointInvocation := {
        operation := family.operation
        parameters := packets
        arrow := descriptor
        domain := reference family.parameterCount
        source := reference inputs.size
        target := reference (inputs.size + 1)
        argument := reference (family.parameterCount + 1) }
      let bindings := inputs.mapIdx fun index expression =>
        ({ id := ⟨"published-original-native-request", index⟩, role := .parameter, expression } : LocalBinding)
      let unavailable : {α : Type} → MetaM α := fun {_} =>
        throwError "source formation attempted to execute or recover a provider result"
      let scope ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let identities ← CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
      let selectSource : SourceSelection Expr → Option Expr →
          StateCpsT (OpenContext × SourceSelectionScope Expr) TermElabM Expr :=
        fun selection declaredType _ current continuation =>
          controlAt MetaM fun run =>
            current.2.withBinding identities current.1 selection
              (fun context selections supplied => run (continuation supplied (context, selections)))
              (declaredType := declaredType)
      let context : PublishedSourceContext (OpenContext × SourceSelectionScope Expr) := {
        scope := (·.1)
        identities := fun _ => identities
        selections := (·.2)
        select := selectSource
        actionSource := fun _ => liftM (m := MetaM) unavailable
        retained := fun _ packet => do
          unless (packet.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "scopeRef" do
            return none
          let #[position] ← ofExcept <| (packet.getObjVal? "args").bind Json.getArr?
            | throwError "the public reference lost its original positional field"
          let index ← ofExcept <| position.getNat?
          let some value := table[index]?
            | throwError "the public input changed an original source position"
          unless packet == reference index do
            throwError "the public input changed its released reference fields"
          pure (some value)
        literal := fun _ _ => pure none
        bind := pure
        bindAt := fun source declaredType => do
          let current ← get
          let selected := current.2.findAt? current.1 source |>.getD { value := source }
          selectSource { selected with value := source } (some declaredType)
        rebind := fun _ value => pure value
        methodParameters := fun _ _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) unavailable
        checkInput := fun _ expected actual => do
          checkRegisteredDomains expected actual
          unless ← isDefEq expected actual do
            throwError "the public input changed its complete native endpoint"
        admitMethod := fun _ _ _ _ => unavailable
        admitProperty := fun _ _ _ _ => unavailable
        admitPoint := fun _ _ _ => unavailable
        admitCategorical := fun _ _ _ _ => unavailable
        projection := fun _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) unavailable }
      let call := fun (packet : PointInvocation) => Json.mkObj [("op", toJson family.operation),
        ("input", toJson family.operation), ("args", packet.encode)]
      (PublishedSource.prepare context (call packet)).runK (scope, {}) fun result current => do
        let some selected := current.2.findAt? current.1 result
          | throwError "the public categorical request lost its native source boundary"
        let some (restored, actualLevels, actualParameters) ←
            CategoricalPointFamily.ofSelection? selected
          | throwError "the public categorical request lost its original family"
        let some application := selected.application
          | throwError "the public categorical request lost its original native argument table"
        let actual := actualParameters ++ application.arguments
        unless actualLevels == levels && restored.operation == family.operation &&
            actual.extract 0 family.parameterCount == parameters do
          throwError "the public request changed an original declaration parameter position"
        let some (.categorical retainedFamily retained) := selected.pointRequest
          | throwError "the public request lost its complete generalized request envelope"
        unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.point restored).exactlyMatches (.point retainedFamily) &&
            retained.domain.equal domain && retained.point.equal point &&
            retained.source.equal source && retained.target.equal target do
          throwError "the public request replaced one of its actual generalized-point fields"
        current.1.withOriginalSources #[result] fun checked => do
          let locals := (← getLCtx).foldl
            (fun result declaration => result.push (mkFVar declaration.fvarId)) #[]
          checkWithKernel (← mkLambdaFVars locals checked[0]!
            (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false))
      let rejected ← try
          (PublishedSource.prepare context
            (call { packet with target := reference family.parameterCount })).runK (scope, {})
              fun _ _ => pure ()
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
      unless rejected do throwError "the public request accepted a changed native target"

end CasCompiler.PublishedCategoricalRequestTests

-- Pure packet framing preserves all seven actual fields in both the original action and
-- a later complete-map continuation. It supplies no source or realization authority.
run_cmd do
  let node := fun (tag : String) (arguments : Array Json) =>
    Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson tag), ("args", .arr arguments)]
  let reference := fun (index : Nat) => node "scopeRef" #[toJson index]
  let functor := "fun.protocol.parameterized"
  let parameters := #[toJson false, node "category" #[toJson "cat.protocol", toJson #[7]]]
  let source := node "object" #[toJson "source"]
  let target := node "object" #[toJson "target"]
  let domain := node "object" #[toJson "domain"]
  let point := reference 8
  let action := node functor parameters
  let original : PointInvocation := {
    operation := functor ++ "#map"
    parameters
    arrow := node "map" #[action, TypedMap.encode {
      source := node "object" #[toJson "before"]
      target := node "object" #[toJson "after"]
      callable := reference 1 }]
    domain
    source
    target
    argument := point }
  let accepted := fun packet => PointInvocation.decodeFunctorMap functor packet
  let .ok decoded := accepted original.encode | throwError "the original map action was rejected"
  unless decoded.encode == original.encode do throwError "the original action changed its fields"
  for data in #[node "finiteGraph" #[toJson #[0, 1], toJson #[#[0, 2], #[1, 3]]],
      node "identity" #[source, target],
      node "compose" #[reference 2, reference 3],
      node "opaqueData" #[toJson "actual-original-owner-token"]] do
    let actual := TypedMap.encode { source, target, callable := data }
    let continued := { original with arrow := actual }
    let decoded ← match accepted continued.encode with
      | .ok value => pure value
      | .error reason => throwError "an actual returned map was rejected by native framing: {reason}"
    unless decoded.encode == continued.encode && decoded.arrow == actual do
      throwError "the actual returned map or one of its seven fields was reconstructed"
    for changed in #[{ continued with operation := "fun.other#map" },
        { continued with arrow := TypedMap.encode { source := target, target := source, callable := data } },
        { continued with arrow := node "typedMap" #[source, target] }] do
      if (accepted changed.encode).isOk then
        throwError "changed map operation, endpoints or missing data passed framing"
  let wrongAction := node functor (parameters.set! 0 (toJson (0 : Nat)))
  let changedOriginal := { original with arrow := node "map" #[wrongAction,
    TypedMap.encode { source, target, callable := point }] }
  if (accepted changedOriginal.encode).isOk then
    throwError "a Boolean action parameter was replaced with numeric data"

-- A recursive action continuation retains the exact nested identity and all actual
-- parameter slots, independently from the opaque or portable representation of its map.
run_cmd do
  let node := fun (tag : String) (arguments : Array Json) =>
    Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson tag), ("args", .arr arguments)]
  let reference := fun (index : Nat) => node "scopeRef" #[toJson index]
  let identity := Json.mkObj [("constructorMap", .arr #[toJson "ctor.arrow",
    Json.mkObj [("constructorMap", .arr #[toJson "ctor.core",
      Json.mkObj [("classifierForget", toJson "cls.protocol")]])]])]
  let .ok address := actionAddress identity | throwError "the canonical recursive action failed"
  let action := node "constructorMap" #[toJson "ctor.arrow",
    node "constructorMap" #[toJson "ctor.core",
      node "classifierForget" #[toJson "cls.protocol",
        .arr #[toJson false, reference 2]]]]
  let source := reference 3
  let target := reference 4
  let actual := TypedMap.encode {
    source
    target
    callable := node "finiteGraph" #[toJson #[0], toJson #[#[0, 1]]] }
  let continued : PointInvocation := {
    operation := address ++ "#map"
    parameters := #[action]
    arrow := actual
    domain := reference 5
    source
    target
    argument := reference 6 }
  let accepted := fun packet => PointInvocation.decodeActionMap address packet
  let decoded ← match accepted continued.encode with
    | .ok value => pure value
    | .error reason => throwError "the recursive action rejected its actual returned map: {reason}"
  unless decoded.encode == continued.encode do
    throwError "the recursive action changed a native continuation field"
  let original := { continued with arrow := node "map" #[action, TypedMap.encode {
    source := reference 0
    target := reference 1
    callable := reference 7 }] }
  unless (accepted original.encode).isOk do throwError "the recursive original map was rejected"
  let changed := node "constructorMap" #[toJson "ctor.arrow",
    node "constructorMap" #[toJson "ctor.product",
      node "classifierForget" #[toJson "cls.protocol",
        .arr #[toJson false, reference 2]]]]
  for bad in #[{ continued with parameters := #[changed] },

      { continued with arrow := TypedMap.encode { source := target, target := source, callable := .arr #[] } }] do

-- The already released creation envelope keeps each original source diagram and target
-- packet unchanged. Framing introduces no alternative owner, proof, or operation selector.
run_cmd do

namespace CasCompiler.PublishedPorts

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- One native computational role at its original complete family. The source
path and type remain explicit even when several roles share an operation address. -/
structure Port where
  operation : String
  path : Array Name
  type : Expr

def references (state : SemanticState) : Array ComputationRef :=
  (state.operations.map (ComputationRef.operation ∘ (·.id))) ++
  (state.methods.map (ComputationRef.method ∘ (·.id))) ++
  (state.functors.map (ComputationRef.functor ∘ (·.id))) ++
  (state.constructions.map (ComputationRef.construction ∘ (·.id))) ++
  (state.morphisms.map (ComputationRef.morphism ∘ (·.id)))

/-- The released complete-input address, also used by native demand preparation. -/
def inputAddress (reference : ComputationRef) : String :=
  match reference with
  | .morphism _ => computationAddress reference
  | _ => computationAddress reference ++ "#input"

private partial def recordPorts (owner : String) (layout : SourceLayout)
    (path : Array FieldLayout) : MetaM (Array Port) := do
  let mut ports := #[]
  for field in layout.fields do
    if field.wireIndex.isNone then continue
    let selected := path.push field
    ports := ports.push ⟨nativeRecordActionAddress owner selected,
      selected.map (·.projection), field.source.type⟩
    if field.kind == .record then
      ports := ports ++ (← recordPorts owner (← field.toLayout) selected)
  return ports

/-- Derive field addresses from the same whole checked family and native layouts
that prepare runtime record actions. No suffix, type spelling or backend adds a field. -/
opaque forReference (reference : ComputationRef) : MetaM (Array Port) := withLCtx {} #[] do
  let family ← SourceFamily.forReference reference
  let root : Port := ⟨computationAddress reference, #[], family.source.familyType⟩
  -- Routed methods expose their complete object invocation at their authored id.
  -- Their native functor record is retained in that source family's metadata.
  if reference matches .method _ then return #[root]
  forallTelescopeReducing family.source.familyType fun parameters _ => do
    let bindings := parameters.mapIdx fun index expression =>
      { id := { session := "published-family-signature", serial := index },
        role := BindingRole.parameter, expression : LocalBinding }
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let source ← context.close (mkAppN family.source.family parameters)
    let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm source
    return #[root] ++ (← recordPorts (computationAddress reference) layout #[])

/-- Resolve all exact native owners. A shared prefix is only a candidate filter;
the original native field address is checked before an owner is admitted. -/
opaque family? (state : SemanticState) (address : String) :
    MetaM (Option ComputationRef) := do
  let possible := (references state).filter fun reference =>
    address == computationAddress reference ||
      address.startsWith (computationAddress reference ++ "#")
  let mut selected := #[]
  for reference in possible do
    if address == computationAddress reference then
      selected := selected.push reference
      continue
    if (← forReference reference).any (·.operation == address) then
      selected := selected.push reference
  match selected with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[reference] => return some reference
  | _ => throwError "the published address has several distinct native source owners"

/-- The separately published universal record retains its path within the complete
original presentation. Its first computational field aliases this subfamily address,
never the distinct raw cone port. -/
opaque forLimitUniversal (id : LimitId) : MetaM (Array Port) := withLCtx {} #[] do
  let family ← LimitUniversalFamily.forId id
  let root : Port := ⟨family.operation, family.path, family.familyType⟩
  forallTelescopeReducing family.familyType fun parameters _ => do
    let bindings := parameters.mapIdx fun index expression =>
      { id := { session := "published-limit-universal-signature", serial := index },
        role := BindingRole.parameter, expression : LocalBinding }
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let source ← context.close (mkAppN family.family parameters)
    let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm source
    let ports ← recordPorts family.operation layout #[]
    return #[root] ++ ports.map fun port =>
      { port with path := family.path ++ port.path }

/-- Resolve only an exact native universal subfamily or one of its actual data fields.
A limit-id prefix alone never authorizes a field or an arbitrary suffix. -/
opaque limitUniversal? (state : SemanticState) (address : String) :
    MetaM (Option LimitUniversalFamily) := do
  let mut selected := #[]
  for row in state.limits do
    unless address.startsWith (row.id.raw ++ "#") do continue
    let family ← LimitUniversalFamily.forId row.id
    if address == family.operation ||
        (← forLimitUniversal row.id).any (·.operation == address) then
      selected := selected.push family
  match selected with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[family] => return some family
  | _ => throwError "the universal address has several distinct original presentations"

/-- The accepted creation computation supplies one complete native result. Its
actual field paths remain result interface metadata, not independent supplier ports. -/
opaque forCreation (id : LiftId) : MetaM (Array Port) := withLCtx {} #[] do
  let family ← CreationFamily.forId id
  let template ← family.standardizedTemplate
  return #[⟨family.entry.id.raw, #[], ← inferType template⟩]

/-- A creation registration names only its original accepted lift identity.
Subfield availability cannot replace the complete supplied creation result. -/
opaque creation? (state : SemanticState) (address : String) :
    MetaM (Option CreationFamily) := do
  let rows := state.lifts.filter fun row =>
    row.id.raw == address && match row.kind with | .createsLimits _ => true | _ => false
  match rows with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[row] => return some (← CreationFamily.forLift row)
  | _ => throwError "the creation address has several distinct original lift owners"

/-- Canonical identity from the existing component packet's address encoder. -/
def componentAddress (id : NaturalTransformationId) (constructors : Array ConstructorId) : String :=
  ConstructedCellComponent.address {
    constructors := constructors.map (·.raw)
    component := { cell := id.raw, parameters := #[], receiver := .null, inverse := false } }

/-- The complete registered comparison and ordered constructor path of an address. -/
def component? (state : SemanticState) (address : String) :
    Except String (Option (CellEntry × Array ConstructorId)) := do
  let direct := state.cells.filter (fun row => componentAddress row.id #[] == address)
  if let #[entry] := direct then return some (entry, #[])
  unless direct.isEmpty do throw "the component address has several registered cells"
  unless address.startsWith "component:" do return none
  let json ← Json.parse (address.drop 10).toString
  let #[.str id, .arr encoded] ← json.getArr?
    | throw "a component address requires its cell and ordered constructor path"
  let constructors ← encoded.mapM fun value => ConstructorId.mk <$> value.getStr?
  if constructors.isEmpty then throw "an empty constructor path uses the direct component address"
  let #[entry] := state.cells.filter (·.id.raw == id)
    | throw "the component address has no unique registered cell"
  unless entry.invertible do throw "constructor-induced components require an invertible cell"
  unless componentAddress entry.id constructors == address do
    throw "the component address changed its canonical complete constructor path"
  for id in constructors do
    let #[constructor] := state.constructors.filter (·.id == id)
      | throw "the component path has no unique registered constructor"
    unless constructor.signature == #[.category] &&
        constructor.functorialAction.isSome && constructor.comparisonAction.isSome &&
        constructor.identityComparison.isSome && constructor.compositionComparison.isSome do
      throw "the component constructor lacks its complete published comparison interface"
  return some (entry, constructors)

/-- A cartesian address is published only by the accepted reindexing action. -/
def cartesian? (state : SemanticState) (address : String) : Except String (Option FunctorEntry) := do
  let rows := state.functors.filter (fun row => row.id.raw ++ "#cartesian" == address)
  if rows.isEmpty then return none
  let #[row] := rows | throw "the cartesian address has several registered functors"
  let .familyReindex family := row.expression.registrationKind
    | throw "the cartesian address does not name a family-reindex action"
  let #[_] := state.categoryFamilies.filter (·.id == family)
    | throw "the cartesian action has no unique accepted category family"
  return some row

private partial def edgeFromIdentity (state : SemanticState) (identity : Json) :
    Except String EdgeRef := do
  checkActionIdentity identity
  let fields ← identity.getObj?
  match fields.toList with
  | [("functor", .str id)] =>
    let #[row] := state.functors.filter (·.id.raw == id)
      | throw "the action has no unique registered functor"
    return .functor row.id
  | [("classifierForget", .str id)] =>
    let #[row] := state.classifiers.filter (·.id.raw == id)
      | throw "the action has no unique registered classifier"
    return .classifierForget row.id
  | [("constructorMap", .arr #[.str id, inner])] =>
    let #[row] := state.constructors.filter (·.id.raw == id)
      | throw "the action has no unique registered constructor"
    unless row.signature == #[.category] && row.functorialAction.isSome do
      throw "the constructor has no published unary functor action"
    return .constructMap row.id (← edgeFromIdentity state inner)
  | _ => throw "the action lost its checked public identity"

/-- Resolve the released recursive derived-action grammar without a finite
inventory bound. The complete actual parameters are checked at source formation. -/
def edge? (state : SemanticState) (address : String) : Except String (Option (EdgeRef × Bool)) := do
  unless address.startsWith "action:" do return none
  let isMap := address.endsWith "#map"
  let base := if isMap then (address.dropEnd 4).toString else address
  let identity ← actionIdentity base
  return some (← edgeFromIdentity state identity, isMap)

end CasCompiler.PublishedPorts

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- External operands supply data or an original retained native expression. These hooks
carry no operation lookup, dependent application, route selection or mathematical proof.
Runtime ownership and scoped references stay outside the compiler. -/
structure PublishedSourceContext (σ : Type) where
  scope : σ → OpenContext
  identities : σ → CasRuntime.IdentitySupply
  selections : σ → SourceSelectionScope Expr
  select : SourceSelection Expr → Option Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr
  retained : σ → Json → MetaM (Option Expr)
  actionSource : Json → StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Option Expr)
  literal : Expr → Json → MetaM (Option Expr)
  bind : Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr
  bindAt : Expr → Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr
  rebind : Expr → Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr
  methodParameters : RoutedMethodFamily → Array Expr → Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Array Expr)
  checkInput : σ → Expr → Expr → MetaM Unit
  admitMethod : σ → RoutedMethodFamily → Expr → String → MetaM Unit
  admitProperty : σ → PropertyFamily → Expr → String → MetaM Unit
  admitPoint : σ → PointFamily → Expr → MetaM Unit
  admitCategorical : σ → CategoricalPointFamily → Array Expr → Expr → MetaM Unit :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => throwError "a retained categorical arrow requires its original runtime owner"
  constructionCone : Json → StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Option (Expr × NativeLimitSelection × Expr)) :=
    fun _ => pure none
  creationOwner : Json → StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Option (NativeLimitSelection × Expr)) :=
    fun _ => pure none
  constructionEndpoint : σ → NativeConstructionLeg → Bool → Expr → MetaM Bool :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => pure false
  projection : Json → Nat → StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Expr × Name)
  withLocal : Name → Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr :=
    fun _ _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
      throwError "this source context cannot introduce a symbolic native parameter"

namespace PublishedSource

/-- Read the current complete scope only after preceding binding effects have finished. -/
private def checkInput (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (expected actual : Expr) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM Unit := do
  context.checkInput (← get) expected actual

private def malformed {m : Type → Type _} [Monad m] [MonadLiftT MetaM m]
    {α : Type} (reason : MessageData) : m α :=
  liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwStratum .malformed m!"published source request: {reason}"

/-- Read only the actual selected head binding and its complete positional template. -/
private def selection? (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (value : Expr) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Option (SourceSelection Expr)) := do
  let state ← get
  let some selected := (context.selections state).findAt? (context.scope state) value.getAppFn
    | return none
  unless selected.formalBindings.size == value.getAppNumArgs do return none
  return some (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| selected.specialize value.getAppArgs)

/-- Close the actual source and complete selected table in the same current telescope. -/
private def sourceLayout (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (value : Expr) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM SourceLayout := do
  let state ← get
  let scope := context.scope state
  let selections := context.selections state
  let selectionBinding := match value with
    | .fvar localId => do
      let binding ← scope.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == localId)
      if selections.contains binding.id then some binding.id else none
    | _ => none
  liftM (m := MetaM) <| SourceLayout.ofTerm (← scope.close value)
    (← SourceSelectionScope.close selections scope) selectionBinding

private def arrayField (packet : Json) (key : String) : TermElabM (Array Json) := do
  match (packet.getObjVal? key).bind (·.getArr?) with
  | .ok values => pure values
  | .error reason => malformed reason

/-- An external name selects an exact source row; equal native declarations or categories
are not alternative suppliers. Ordinary named syntax calls this same selected-row producer
once its public spelling and qualification have selected the row. -/
def namedApplicable (entry : ObjectEntry ⊕ MorphismEntry) (category : NamedCategoryEntry)
    (select : SourceSelection Expr → Option Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr)
    (apply : Expr → Option Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Except MessageData Expr)) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Except MessageData (Expr × Expr)) :=
  registeredExpressionsApplicableScoped entry category select apply

private def namedSelection? (address : String) :
    MetaM (Option ((ObjectEntry ⊕ MorphismEntry) × NamedCategoryEntry)) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let entries := (state.objects.filter (·.id.raw == address)).map Sum.inl ++
    (state.morphisms.filter (·.id.raw == address)).map Sum.inr
  if entries.isEmpty then return none
  let #[entry] := entries
    | throwStratum .semanticAmbiguity m!"the published source address {address} has several owners"
  let owner := match entry with | .inl entry => entry.category | .inr entry => entry.category
  let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == owner)
    | throwError "the published source input lost its complete registered category"
  return some (entry, category)

mutual

/-- Read data only at the complete declared source type. Named objects and maps use the
ordinary selected-row producer; native records use their actual constructor telescope.
The shared application elaborator preserves each actual retained operand at its original
position, including repeated equal-valued but independently owned operands. -/
private partial def readOperand (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (domain : Expr) (packet : Json) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := do
  if let some source ← context.retained (← get) packet then
    let type ← inferType source
    checkRegisteredDomains type domain
    if ← isDefEq type domain then return source
    let compatible ← (context.scope (← get)).withOriginalSources #[type, domain] fun original => do
      checkRegisteredDomains original[0]! original[1]!
      isDefEq original[0]! original[1]!
    unless compatible do malformed "a retained operand has a different declared type"
    let source ← context.bindAt source domain
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType source) domain do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "the retained operand binding changed its original dependent native type"
    return source
  if let .ok address := packet.getObjValAs? String "ctor" then
    if let some (entry, category) ← namedSelection? address then
      match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] packet with
      | .error reason => malformed reason
      | .ok () => pure ()
      let fields ← arrayField packet "args"
      let formed ← namedApplicable entry category context.select fun head expected => do
        let value ← explicit context head fields expected
        unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) domain do
          return .error m!"the named input has a different complete declared type"
        return .ok value
      let (_, value) ← match formed with
        | .ok value => pure value
        | .error reason => malformed reason
      return value
  let isArrow := (packet.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "arrow"
  let packet ← if isArrow then do
      match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] packet with
      | .error reason => malformed reason
      | .ok () => pure ()
      let fields ← arrayField packet "args"
      unless fields.size == 3 do malformed "an Arrow operand requires both endpoints and its hom"
      pure (.arr fields)
    else pure packet
  let domain ← whnfR (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars domain)
  if let (.arr components, .const owner levels) := (packet, domain.getAppFn) then
    if (getStructureInfo? (← liftM (m := MetaM) getEnv) owner).isSome then
      let constructor := getStructureCtor (← liftM (m := MetaM) getEnv) owner
      let head := mkAppN (.const constructor.name levels) domain.getAppArgs
      let computational ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType head) fun fields _ => do
        return (← fields.filterM fun field => return !(← isProof field)).size
      unless components.size == computational do
        malformed "the structure operand has a different number of computational fields"
      let value ← complete context head components
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) domain do
        malformed "the structure operand changed its complete declared type"
      if isArrow then
        let hom ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Comma.hom #[value]
        let arrow ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk #[hom]
        unless ← isDefEq (← inferType arrow) domain do
          malformed "the Arrow packet belongs to another complete native record"
      return value
  let some value ← context.literal domain packet
    | malformed "an inline operand has no scalar reading at its declared type"
  return value

/-- Ordinary explicit source arguments and external named parameters share one native
application producer, including the registered source-instance inference view. -/
private partial def explicit (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (head : Expr) (packets : Array Json)
    (expected : Option Expr := none) (resolved : Bool := true) : StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := do
  let value ← applySourceDataArgumentsScoped head packets.size expected fun index domain => do
      let some packet := packets[index]? | malformed "the source input lost an original parameter"
      readOperand context domain packet
  let value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars value
  if resolved && (value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar) then
    malformed "the source input leaves a complete native parameter undetermined"
  return value

/-- A complete-interface request exposes all computational positions, while formal proof
positions remain source hypotheses. It uses the same native producer as ordinary syntax. -/
private partial def complete (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (head : Expr) (packets : Array Json) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr :=
  applySourceArgumentsScoped head (Array.replicate packets.size Syntax.missing) fun index domain => do
    let some packet := packets[index]? | malformed "the source input lost an original parameter"
    readOperand context domain packet

end

/-- Read one external operand at its complete original native type. The recursive reader
and application machinery remain compiler implementation details. -/
opaque operand (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (domain : Expr) (packet : Json) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := readOperand context domain packet

private partial def actionParameters (edge : EdgeRef) (descriptor : Json) :
    TermElabM (Array Json) := do
  let fields ← arrayField descriptor "args"
  let parameters ← match edge with
    | .functor _ => pure fields
    | .classifierForget _ =>
      let #[_, .arr parameters] := fields
        | malformed "classifier forgetting lost its complete parameter array"
      pure parameters
    | .constructMap _ inner =>
      let #[_, action] := fields
        | malformed "the constructor action lost its complete inner action"
      actionParameters inner action
  unless routedActionDescriptor edge parameters == descriptor do
    malformed "the action descriptor differs from its exact selected edge"
  return parameters

/-- Select and apply a method through the same whole-family producer and C6 agreement
as native source. The released action descriptors retain their explicit route; provider
availability never selects it. Runtime callbacks only bind already typed original inputs. -/
private def method (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (entry : MethodEntry)
    (input : String) (arguments : Json) : StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let registry : RegistryState := { toSemanticState := state }
  let some form := registry.form? input | malformed "the explicit input form is not published"
  let some category := state.categories.find? (·.id == form.category)
    | malformed "the input form lost its original source category"
  match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args", "receiver"] arguments with
  | .error reason => malformed reason
  | .ok () => pure ()
  let packet ← match ConstructionInvocation.decodeMethod entry.id.raw entry.functor.raw arguments with
    | .ok packet => pure packet
    | .error reason => malformed reason
  let identities ← packet.parameters.mapM fun descriptor =>
    match descriptorActionIdentity descriptor with
    | .ok identity => pure identity
    | .error reason => malformed reason
  let families ← RoutedMethodFamily.atSource category.expression entry.name
  let #[family] := families.filter (fun family => family.entry.id == entry.id &&
      (family.route.refs.push (.functor family.functor.id)).map edgeImageDescriptor == identities)
    | malformed "the residual actions are not one complete first-hit method route"
  let mut evidence := #[]
  for declaration in ← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx do
    if ← isProp declaration.type then evidence := evidence.push (mkFVar declaration.fvarId)
  let agreements ← family.agreements evidence
  let (_, levels) ← family.instantiate
  let categoryFamily := family.categoryFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
  let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType categoryFamily)
  let domain ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[mkAppN categoryFamily parameters]
  let receiverPacket ← if (packet.receiver.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "arrow" then do
      let .construct constructor #[.category _] := category.expression
        | malformed "an Arrow receiver requires its published Arrow source category"
      unless (state.constructors.find? (·.id == constructor)).any
          (·.semantics == `CasCatalogue.Constructors.arrow) do
        malformed "the receiver descriptor does not belong to this source constructor"
      match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] packet.receiver with
      | .error reason => malformed reason
      | .ok () => pure ()
      let fields ← arrayField packet.receiver "args"
      unless fields.size == 3 do malformed "the Arrow receiver requires both endpoints and its hom"
      pure (Json.arr fields)
    else pure packet.receiver
  let receiver ← operand context domain receiverPacket
  let receiver ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars receiver
  let parameters ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| parameters.mapM instantiateMVars
  let levels ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| levels.mapM instantiateLevelMVars
  if receiver.hasMVar || receiver.hasLevelMVar ||
      parameters.any (fun parameter => parameter.hasMVar || parameter.hasLevelMVar) then
    malformed "the receiver leaves the complete method category undetermined"
  context.admitMethod (← get) family receiver input
  let receiver ← context.bind receiver
  let edges := family.route.refs.push (.functor family.functor.id)
  let actions ← family.specializeActions levels parameters
  let routes ← family.actionParameterInputs
  let mut selected := parameters
  let mut supplied : Array (Array Expr) := #[]
  let mut selectedSlots : Std.HashSet Nat := {}
  unless family.actionFamilies.size == edges.size do
    malformed "the selected method lost its complete original action-family table"
  for edge in edges, actionFamily in family.actionFamilies, action in actions,
      descriptor in packet.parameters, inputs in routes do
    let expected ← routedActionParameters actionFamily action
    let packets ← actionParameters edge descriptor
    unless packets.size == expected.size && inputs.size == expected.size do
      malformed "an action changed its complete native parameter arity"
    let mut values := #[]
    for (_, source) in expected, packet in packets, route in inputs do
      let term ← operand context (← inferType source) packet
      let term ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars term
      if term.hasMVar || term.hasLevelMVar then
        malformed "an action parameter leaves its native type undetermined"
      let value ← context.bind term
      values := values.push value
      if let some index := route then
        unless selectedSlots.contains index do
          let some original := selected[index]?
            | malformed "the action lost its original category parameter position"
          selected := selected.set! index (← context.rebind original value)
          selectedSlots := selectedSlots.insert index
    supplied := supplied.push values
  selected ← context.methodParameters family selected receiver
  let checkedActions ← family.specializeActions levels selected
  let mut retainedInputs := #[]
  for actionFamily in family.actionFamilies, action in checkedActions, values in supplied do
    let expected ← routedActionParameters actionFamily action
    let mut inputs := #[]
    for (_, source) in expected, value in values do
      checkInput context source value
      inputs := inputs.push value
    retainedInputs := retainedInputs.push inputs
  let (result, _) ← family.applyAt levels selected receiver context.select retainedInputs
  let mut term := result
  for proof in agreements.reverse do
    let mut proof := proof.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
    for parameter in selected do proof ← mkAppM ``congrFun #[proof, parameter]
    checkWithKernel proof
    term ← liftM (m := MetaM) <|
      withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `methodFamilyAgreement) (← inferType proof) proof
        fun binding => mkLetFVars #[binding] term
          (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
  return term

private def property (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (entry : PropertyEntry)
    (input : String) (arguments : Json) : StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let registry : RegistryState := { toSemanticState := state }
  let some form := registry.form? input | malformed "the explicit input form is not published"
  if let some reason := registry.rejects (.property entry) form then malformed reason
  let some category := state.categories.find? (·.id == form.category)
    | malformed "the input form lost its original source category"
  let categoryFamily ← nativeCategoryFamily state category.expression fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType categoryFamily)
  let bundle := mkAppN categoryFamily parameters
  let domain ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]
  let receiver ← operand context domain arguments
  let receiver ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars receiver
  let bundle ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars bundle
  if receiver.hasMVar || receiver.hasLevelMVar || bundle.hasMVar || bundle.hasLevelMVar then
    malformed "the receiver leaves the complete property category undetermined"
  let (family, source) ← PropertyFamily.forReceiver
    ⟨.object, category.expression, bundle, none, none⟩ entry.id receiver
  context.admitProperty (← get) family receiver input
  context.select source none

private def namedPoint (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (operation : String)
    (arguments : Json) : StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let morphisms := state.morphisms.filter (·.id.raw == operation)
  let applications := state.objects.filter fun entry =>
    entry.application.isSome && entry.applicationAddress == operation
  let family ← match morphisms, applications with
    | #[row], #[] => PointFamily.forEntry row
    | #[], #[row] => PointFamily.forApplication row
    | #[], #[] => malformed "the point request does not name a released callable"
    | _, _ => malformed "the point request has several released callable owners"
  match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] arguments with
  | .error reason => malformed reason
  | .ok () => pure ()
  let packet ← match PointInvocation.decode arguments with
    | .ok packet => pure packet
    | .error reason => malformed reason
  unless packet.operation == operation do malformed "the point packet changed its released operation"
  let head ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels family.declaration
  let expectedArrow ← explicit context head packet.parameters
  let (expectedSource, expectedTarget) ← family.endpoints expectedArrow
  let expectedFunction ← family.function expectedArrow
  let .forallE _ pointType _ _ ← whnfR (← inferType expectedFunction)
    | malformed "the named morphism has no complete point-function interface"
  let point ← operand context pointType packet.argument
  let some selectedPoint ← selection? context point
    | malformed "the operand has no retained original generalized-point domain"
  let some original := selectedPoint.pointOrigin
    | malformed "the operand has no retained original generalized-point domain"
  let domain ← operand context (← inferType original.domain) packet.domain
  let source ← operand context (← inferType expectedSource) packet.source
  let target ← operand context (← inferType expectedTarget) packet.target
  let arrow ← if let some arrow ← context.retained (← get) packet.arrow then do
      context.admitPoint (← get) family arrow
      pure arrow
    else do
      match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] packet.arrow with
      | .error reason => malformed reason
      | .ok () => pure ()
      unless (packet.arrow.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some operation do
        malformed "the arrow descriptor belongs to a different released family"
      let value ← explicit context head (← arrayField packet.arrow "args")
      let .const declaration levels := value.getAppFn
        | malformed "the named arrow lost its original declaration spine"
      unless declaration == family.declaration do
        malformed "the named arrow changed its original declaration"
      context.select (← family.selected levels value.getAppArgs value) none
  let scope := context.scope (← get)
  let selectedPoint ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <| do
    try
      family.withRequest arrow domain source target
        { selectedPoint with value := point } (some scope)
    catch error =>
      malformed m!"the complete named point inputs disagree: {error.toMessageData}"
  let function ← family.function arrow
  let (result, _) ← elabSourceApplicationScoped function #[Syntax.missing] none
    fun _ domain => context.select selectedPoint (some domain)
  return result

private def presentation (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (row : PresentationComparisonEntry)
    (arguments : Json) : StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := do
  match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] arguments with
  | .error reason => malformed reason
  | .ok () => pure ()
  let packet ← match PresentationInvocation.decode arguments with
    | .ok packet => pure packet
    | .error reason => malformed reason
  let family ← PresentationFamily.forEntry row
  let (head, _) ← family.instantiate
  let iso ← explicit context head packet.parameters
  let (first, second) ← family.endpoints iso
  let (source, target) := if packet.inverse then (second, first) else (first, second)
  let source ← operand context (← inferType source.value) packet.source
  let target ← operand context (← inferType target.value) packet.target
  let (first, second) := if packet.inverse then (target, source) else (source, target)
  let scope := context.scope (← get)
  let selected ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <| do
    try family.withEndpoints iso first second (some scope)
    catch error => malformed m!"the comparison endpoints do not match the selected family: {error.toMessageData}"
  let iso ← context.select selected none
  let function ← family.function iso packet.inverse
  let (result, _) ← elabSourceApplicationScoped function #[Syntax.missing] none fun _ domain =>
    operand context domain packet.argument
  return result

/-- Decode the released complete component packet, then invoke the same native cell producer
as ordinary source syntax. The ordered constructor path acts on the entire selected cell. -/
private def component (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (operation : String)
    (entry : CellEntry) (constructors : Array ConstructorId) (arguments : Json) : StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := do
  match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] arguments with
  | .error reason => malformed reason
  | .ok () => pure ()
  let packet ← match if constructors.isEmpty then
      (CellComponent.decode arguments).map (fun cell => (⟨#[], cell⟩ : ConstructedCellComponent))
    else ConstructedCellComponent.decode arguments with
    | .ok packet => pure packet
    | .error reason => malformed reason
  unless packet.address == operation && packet.component.cell == entry.id.raw &&
      packet.constructors == constructors.map (·.raw) do
    malformed "the component changed its selected cell or complete constructor path"
  let application ← explicit context (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration)
    packet.component.parameters (resolved := false)
  let mut cell ← nativeSourceCell entry application packet.component.inverse
  for constructor in constructors.reverse do cell ← cell.construct constructor
  let domain ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[cell.sourceBundle]
  let receiver ← operand context domain packet.component.receiver
  context.select (← cell.selectedComponent ⟨receiver, none⟩) none

/-- Form an explicitly selected action from the actual native declaration inputs. The
recursive constructor interface is the same one used by sourceEdgeFunctor and native cells. -/
private partial def action (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (edge : EdgeRef)
    (descriptor : Json) : StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Expr × CategoryExpr) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let parameters ← actionParameters edge descriptor
  match edge with
  | .functor id =>
    let some entry := state.functor? id | malformed "the selected action functor is absent"
    let view ← viewExpressionsScoped (.inl entry) none context.select fun head =>
      explicit context head parameters (resolved := false)
    return (view.functor, view.target)
  | .classifierForget id =>
    let some entry := state.classifier? id | malformed "the selected action classifier is absent"
    let view ← viewExpressionsScoped (.inr entry) none context.select fun head =>
      explicit context head parameters (resolved := false)
    return (view.functor, view.target)
  | .constructMap id inner =>
    let some entry := state.constructor? id | malformed "the selected action constructor is absent"
    let some declaration := entry.functorialAction
      | malformed "the selected constructor has no declared functor action"
    let #[_, descriptor] ← arrayField descriptor "args"
      | malformed "the constructor lost its complete original action"
    let (inner, target) ← action context inner descriptor
    let (sourceBundle, targetBundle) ← functorCategoryBundles inner
    discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
    let value ← applyConstructorInterface declaration #[sourceBundle, targetBundle] #[inner]
    let selected ← sourceReferenceAt (.constructorInterface entry .functorialAction) value value
    return (← context.select selected none, .construct id #[.category target])

private def selectedAction (descriptor : Json) : TermElabM EdgeRef := do
  let identity ← match descriptorActionIdentity descriptor with
    | .ok identity => pure identity
    | .error reason => malformed reason
  let state ← semanticState
  if let .ok id := identity.getObjValAs? String "functor" then
    let #[entry] := state.functors.filter (·.id.raw == id)
      | malformed "the action descriptor has no unique original functor"
    return .functor entry.id
  let address ← match actionAddress identity with
    | .ok address => pure address
    | .error reason => malformed reason
  let .ok (some (edge, false)) := PublishedPorts.edge? state address
    | malformed "the action descriptor has no complete published native edge"
  return edge

/-- Form the supplied native action on its actual typed operand without selecting a provider. -/
opaque actionOperand (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (descriptor : Json) (arrow : Expr) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := do
  let edge ← selectedAction descriptor
  let (functor, _) ← action context edge descriptor
  let value ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map #[functor, arrow]
  check value
  return value

private def nativeHomType (value : Expr) : TermElabM Expr := do
  let type ← inferType value
  let type ← if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure type else whnfR type
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    malformed "the symbolic map has no complete original native Hom interface"
  return type

/-- Read the actual parent of this Hom's Quiver projection, without category search. -/
private def nativeHomStructure (type : Expr) : TermElabM Expr := do
  let quiver := type.getAppArgs[1]!.consumeMData
  if quiver.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver 2 then
    return quiver.getAppArgs[1]!
  if let .proj owner 0 value := quiver then
    if owner == ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct then return value
  malformed "the symbolic map lost its original complete category structure"

/-- A retained native object, or one explicitly shared inline endpoint position. -/
inductive NativeSymbolicEndpoint
  | value (expression : Expr)
  | inline (position : Nat)

/-- Existing native values and the explicit endpoint interfaces of inert inline map data. -/
inductive NativeSymbolicOperand
  | value (expression : Expr)
  | objectData (endpoint : NativeSymbolicEndpoint)
  | mapData (source target : NativeSymbolicEndpoint)

/-- One supplied symbolic node in a single complete packet's endpoint namespace. -/
structure NativeSymbolicNode where
  expected : Expr
  tag : String
  operands : Array NativeSymbolicOperand
  descriptor : Option Json
  framed : Option (NativeSymbolicEndpoint × NativeSymbolicEndpoint) := none
  inputActions : Array Json := #[]

/-- Zero is available only from the structure at this Hom's actual complete Category. -/
private def nativeZero (type source target : Expr) : TermElabM Expr := do
  let structureValue ← nativeHomStructure type
  let structureValue := structureValue.consumeMData
  let category ← if structureValue.isAppOfArity
      ``CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct 2 then
      pure structureValue.getAppArgs[1]!
    else if let .proj owner 0 value := structureValue then
      if owner == ``CategoryTheory.Category then pure value
      else malformed "zero lost its original complete category structure"
    else malformed "zero lost its original complete category structure"
  let carrier := type.getAppArgs[0]!
  let classType ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms
    #[some carrier, some category]
  let some zeros := (← trySynthInstance classType).toOption
    | malformed "the original complete category has no zero-morphism structure"
  let instanceValue ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.zero
    #[some carrier, some category, some zeros, some source, some target]
  let hom := mkAppN type.getAppFn
    (type.getAppArgs.set! 2 source |>.set! 3 target)
  mkAppOptM ``Zero.zero #[some hom, some instanceValue]

/-- Preserve the particular descriptor occurrence's original construction and typed
index while preparing its native component. The same parser serves direct operands
and the whole symbolic-tree constraint check. -/
private def readConstructionLeg (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (packet : Json) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM NativeConstructionLeg := do
  match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] packet with
  | .error reason => malformed reason | .ok () => pure ()
  let #[identity, diagramPacket, conePacket, indexPacket] ← arrayField packet "args"
    | malformed "the construction leg requires its complete diagram, cone and typed index"
  let operation ← match identity.getStr? with
    | .ok value => pure value
    | .error reason => malformed reason
  let some (owner, selected, cone) ← context.constructionCone conePacket
    | malformed "the construction leg lost its original completed native selection"
  unless selected.source.row == operation do
    malformed "the construction leg changed its original registered construction"
  let (nativeTag, fields) ← LimitFamily.diagramPorts selected.source.diagram
  match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] diagramPacket with
  | .error reason => malformed reason | .ok () => pure ()
  unless (diagramPacket.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some nativeTag do
    malformed "the construction leg changed its original native diagram constructor"
  let packets ← arrayField diagramPacket "args"
  unless packets.size == fields.size do
    malformed "the construction leg changed its complete native diagram arity"
  for expected in fields, packet in packets do
    let actual ← operand context (← inferType expected) packet
    checkInput context expected (← context.bind actual)
  let transformation ← mkAppM (if selected.source.colimit then
    ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.ι else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.π) #[cone]
  let component ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[transformation]
  let .forallE _ domain _ _ ← whnfR (← inferType component)
    | malformed "the selected cone lost its original native diagram-object telescope"
  let index ← operand context domain indexPacket
  NativeConstructionLeg.prepare owner selected cone (← context.bind index)

/-- Named symbolic arrows use their original published declarations and complete parameters. -/
private def descriptorArrow (context : PublishedSourceContext σ) (tag : String)
    (packet : Json) : StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := do
  match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] packet with
  | .error reason => malformed reason | .ok () => pure ()
  let state ← semanticState
  if tag == "constructionLeg" then
    return ← context.select (← (← readConstructionLeg context packet).selected) none
  if tag == "objectField" then
    let parsed ← match ObjectField.decode packet with
      | .ok parsed => pure parsed | .error reason => malformed reason
    let #[entry] := state.objects.filter (·.id.raw == parsed.object)
      | malformed "the object field has no unique original object declaration"
    let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == entry.category)
      | malformed "the object field lost its complete original registered category"
    let formed ← namedApplicable (.inl entry) category context.select fun head expected => do
      return .ok (← explicit context head parsed.parameters expected)
    let .ok (_, object) := formed
      | malformed "the object field changed its complete original declared object"
    let some selectedObject ← selection? context object
      | malformed "the object field lost its exact selected object binding"
    let some original ← sourceApplication? entry.declaration selectedObject
      | malformed "the object field lost its original declaration parameter table"
    let field ← match parsed.field with
      | "constants" => pure entry.constants
      | "inclusion" => pure entry.inclusion
      | "presentation" | "inversePresentation" =>
        pure (entry.functorPresentation.map (·.identification))
      | "refinement" | "inverseRefinement" => pure (entry.refines.map (·.identification))
      | _ => pure none
    let some declaration := field
      | malformed "the original object has no selected published map field"
    discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
    let value ← applyObjectParameters entry.id.raw declaration original.getAppArgs
    let value ← if parsed.field == "constants" || parsed.field == "inclusion" then pure value
      else do
        let inverse := parsed.field == "inversePresentation" || parsed.field == "inverseRefinement"
        mkAppM (if inverse then ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv else ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom) #[value]
    let selected := sourceDerivedReference (.named (.registered (.inl entry) category)) value
    return ← context.select { selected with originalApplication := some original } none
  if tag == "cellComponent" || tag == "constructedCellComponent" then
    let parsed ← match if tag == "cellComponent" then
        (CellComponent.decode packet).map fun value =>
          ({ constructors := #[], component := value } : ConstructedCellComponent)
      else ConstructedCellComponent.decode packet with
      | .ok parsed => pure parsed
      | .error reason => malformed reason
    let .ok (some (entry, constructors)) := PublishedPorts.component? state parsed.address
      | malformed "the symbolic component has no original accepted owner"
    return ← component context parsed.address entry constructors packet
  if tag == "cartesianMap" then
    let parsed ← match CartesianMap.decode packet with
      | .ok parsed => pure parsed
      | .error reason => malformed reason
    let .ok (some entry) := PublishedPorts.cartesian? state parsed.address
      | malformed "the symbolic cartesian map has no original family-reindex owner"
    let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.cartesian entry)
    let application ← explicit context (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels family.declaration)
      parsed.parameters (resolved := false)
    let .const _ levels := application.getAppFn.consumeMData
      | malformed "the cartesian descriptor lost its complete declaration spine"
    let head := family.arrowFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
    let partialArrow := mkAppN head application.getAppArgs
    let .forallE _ domain _ _ ← whnfR (← inferType partialArrow)
      | malformed "the cartesian descriptor lost its native receiver"
    let receiver ← operand context domain parsed.receiver
    return ← context.select (← family.arrowSelection levels (application.getAppArgs.push receiver)) none
  if tag == "presentation" then
    let #[identity, .arr parameters, direction] ← arrayField packet "args"
      | malformed "a presentation arrow requires its original id, parameters and direction"
    let id ← match identity.getStr? with
      | .ok id => pure id | .error reason => malformed reason
    let inverse ← match direction.getBool? with
      | .ok inverse => pure inverse | .error reason => malformed reason
    let #[entry] := state.presentations.filter (·.id.raw == id)
      | malformed "the presentation arrow has no unique accepted comparison"
    discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
    let iso ← explicit context (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration) parameters
    let family ← PresentationFamily.forEntry entry
    let iso ← context.select (← family.selected iso) none
    return ← mkAppM (if inverse then ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv else ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom) #[iso]
  if let some (Sum.inr entry, category) ← namedSelection? tag then
    match checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] packet with
    | .error reason => malformed reason | .ok () => pure ()
    let formed ← namedApplicable (.inr entry) category context.select fun head expected => do
      return .ok (← explicit context head (← arrayField packet "args") expected)
    let .ok (_, value) := formed
      | malformed "the named symbolic arrow changed its complete native declaration"
    return value
  if let #[entry] := state.binders.filter (·.id.raw == tag) then
    discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.operation
    let value ← explicit context (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.operation)
      (← arrayField packet "args")
    return ← context.select (← sourceReferenceAt (.binder entry) value value) none
  malformed "the symbolic arrow has no supplied original native declaration"

private def symbolicEndpoint (fresh : Expr → TermElabM Expr)
    (carrier : Expr) (endpoint : NativeSymbolicEndpoint)
    (known : IO.Ref (Array (Nat × Expr))) : TermElabM Expr := do
  match endpoint with
  | .value expression =>
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType expression) carrier do
      malformed "an actual endpoint belongs to another declared category carrier"
    return expression
  | .inline position =>
    if let some (_, expression) := (← known.get).find? (·.1 == position) then
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType expression) carrier do
        malformed "one inline endpoint changed its original native category carrier"
      return expression
    let expression ← fresh carrier
    known.modify (·.push (position, expression))
    return expression

private partial def withSymbolicOperands (carrier : Expr)
    (domain : Expr → Expr → TermElabM Expr) (operands : Array NativeSymbolicOperand)
    (index : Nat) (actual : Array Expr) (known : IO.Ref (Array (Nat × Expr)))
    (fresh : Expr → TermElabM Expr)
    (finish : Array Expr → TermElabM Unit) : TermElabM Unit := do
  let some operand := operands[index]? | return ← finish actual
  match operand with
  | .value value =>
    withSymbolicOperands carrier domain operands (index + 1) (actual.push value) known fresh finish
  | .objectData endpoint =>
    let object ← symbolicEndpoint fresh carrier endpoint known
    withSymbolicOperands carrier domain operands (index + 1) (actual.push object) known fresh finish
  | .mapData source target =>
    let source ← symbolicEndpoint fresh carrier source known
    let target ← symbolicEndpoint fresh carrier target known
    let type ← domain source target
    check type
    withLocalDeclD (← mkFreshUserName `inlineMapInterface) type fun arrow =>
      withSymbolicOperands carrier domain operands (index + 1) (actual.push arrow) known fresh finish

/-- Compare the complete native category interface independently of packet endpoint positions. -/
private def checkSymbolicCategory (actual expected : Expr) : TermElabM Unit := do
  let actualArgs := actual.getAppArgs
  let expectedArgs := expected.getAppArgs
  checkRegisteredDomains actualArgs[0]! expectedArgs[0]!
  unless ← isDefEq (mkAppN actual.getAppFn (actualArgs.extract 0 2))
        (mkAppN expected.getAppFn (expectedArgs.extract 0 2)) <&&>
      isDefEq (← nativeHomStructure actual) (← nativeHomStructure expected) do
    malformed "the symbolic operands use another full native category or Hom interface"

/-- A nested map's input category follows only its supplied complete action descriptors. -/
private partial def withSymbolicCategory (type : Expr)
    (actions : Array Expr) (index : Nat) (finish : Expr → TermElabM Unit) : TermElabM Unit := do
  let some functor := actions[index]? | return ← finish type
  let (source, target) ← functorCategoryBundles functor
