namespace CasCompiler.PublishedSourceTests

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

-- The complete external entrance and ordinary source entrance must substitute the same
-- actual arguments. Equal native values do not identify two original source occurrences.
-- These native local functions test application preservation; they publish no mathematics.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  withLetDecl `first (mkConst ``Nat) (mkNatLit 7) fun first =>
    withLetDecl `second (mkConst ``Nat) (mkNatLit 7) fun second => do
      let type ← mkArrow (mkConst ``Nat) (← mkArrow (mkConst ``Nat) (mkConst ``Nat))
      withLocalDeclD `originalFunction type fun function => do
        let operands := #[first, second]
        let seen ← IO.mkRef (#[] : Array Nat)
        let complete ← applySourceArguments function #[Syntax.missing, Syntax.missing]
          fun index _ => do
            seen.modify (·.push index)
            pure operands[index]!
        let (ordinary, actual) ← elabSourceApplication function
          #[Syntax.missing, Syntax.missing] none fun index _ => pure operands[index]!
        unless complete.getAppFn == function && complete.getAppArgs == operands &&
            ordinary.getAppArgs == operands && actual == operands &&
            (← seen.get) == #[0, 1] do
          throwError "the shared native entrance replayed or replaced an original operand"
        unless ← isDefEq first second do
          throwError "the occurrence control lost its equal-valued original inputs"

-- A source hypothesis has no provider wire slot. It remains the original proof variable
-- in the actual native application. Without that source hypothesis the same request is
-- NoImplementation; no provider packet or native decision manufactures the premise.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  withLocalDeclD `original (mkConst ``Nat) fun original => do
    let proposition ← mkEq original original
    let functionType ← mkArrow proposition (← mkArrow (mkConst ``Nat) (mkConst ``Nat))
    withLocalDeclD `originalFunction functionType fun function => do
      withLocalDeclD `originalPremise proposition fun premise => do
        let result ← applySourceArguments function #[Syntax.missing]
          fun _ _ => pure original
        unless result.getAppFn == function && result.getAppArgs == #[premise, original] do
          throwError "the published application changed its actual source hypothesis"
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
          discard <| applySourceArguments function #[Syntax.missing] fun _ _ => pure original
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure
        | throwError "a published request manufactured its missing formal premise"
      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .noImplementation do throw failure

-- Scoped references are supplied as already retained native source values. The common
-- operand gate rejects a changed native type before any occurrence binding or execution.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  withLocalDeclD `original (mkConst ``Nat) fun original => do
    let untouched : {α : Type} → MetaM α := throwError "the source input executed before typing"
    let binding : LocalBinding := {
      id := ⟨"published-source-input", 0⟩
      role := .parameter
      expression := original }
    let scope ← ContextTelescope.capture #[binding]
    let identities ← CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
    let context : PublishedSourceContext OpenContext := {
      scope := id
      identities := fun _ => identities
      selections := fun _ => {}
      select := fun _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) untouched
      actionSource := fun _ => liftM (m := MetaM) untouched
      retained := fun _ packet => pure (if packet == toJson (0 : Nat) then some original else none)
      literal := CasRuntime.ScalarLiteral.readAt
      bind := fun _ => liftM (m := MetaM) untouched
      bindAt := fun _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) untouched
      rebind := fun _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) untouched
      methodParameters := fun _ _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) untouched
      checkInput := fun _ _ _ => untouched
      admitMethod := fun _ _ _ _ => untouched
      admitProperty := fun _ _ _ _ => untouched
      admitPoint := fun _ _ _ => untouched
      projection := fun _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) untouched }
    let result ← (PublishedSource.operand context (mkConst ``Nat) (toJson (0 : Nat))).run' scope
    unless result == original do throwError "the source input replaced its original scoped operand"
    let failure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| (PublishedSource.operand context (mkConst ``Int) (toJson (0 : Nat))).run' scope
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
    let some failure := failure | throwError "the source input accepted a different declared type"
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .malformed do throw failure

-- A public complete request retains the original n and the supplied Fin 7 operand.
-- The latter is abstracted at the actual dependent slot Fin n inside the continuation.
-- Native conversion cannot identify the opaque n with its recorded source value.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let natural := mkConst ``Nat
  let functionType ← withLocalDeclD `n natural fun n => do
    let type ← mkArrow (← mkAppM ``Fin #[n]) natural
    mkForallFVars #[n] type
  withLocalDeclD `originalFunction functionType fun function => do
    let initial ← ContextTelescope.capture #[{
      id := ⟨"published-dependent-input", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := function }]
    initial.withLocalBinding ⟨"published-dependent-input", 1⟩ .result `originalN natural
      (fun scope n => do
        let original ← mkAppM ``Fin.last #[mkNatLit 6]
        scope.withLocalBinding ⟨"published-dependent-input", 2⟩ .result `originalPoint
          (← inferType original) (fun scope point => do
            let domain ← mkAppM ``Fin #[n.expression]
            if ← withoutModifyingState <| isDefEq (← inferType point.expression) domain then
              throwError "the dependent input control did not preserve its opaque index"
            let external ← mkFreshExprMVar natural
            let externalBefore ← external.mvarId!.getDecl
            let unavailable : {α : Type} → MetaM α := fun {_} =>
              throwError "the dependent source control requested an unrelated runtime operation"
            let identities ← CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
            let context : PublishedSourceContext OpenContext := {
              scope := id
              identities := fun _ => identities
              selections := fun _ => {}
              select := fun _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) unavailable
              actionSource := fun packet =>
                pure (if packet == toJson (0 : Nat) then some function else none)
              retained := fun _ packet => pure <|
                if packet == toJson (0 : Nat) then some function
                else if packet == toJson (1 : Nat) then some n.expression
                else if packet == toJson (2 : Nat) then some point.expression
                else none
              literal := fun _ _ => pure none
              bind := pure
              bindAt := fun source type _ scope finish =>
                scope.withLocalBinding ⟨"published-dependent-input", 3⟩ .result `typedPoint type
                  (fun scope binding => finish binding.expression scope)
                  (originalSource := some source)
              rebind := fun _ value => pure value
              methodParameters := fun _ _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) unavailable
              checkInput := fun _ _ _ => unavailable
              admitMethod := fun _ _ _ _ => unavailable
              admitProperty := fun _ _ _ _ => unavailable
              admitPoint := fun _ _ _ => unavailable
              projection := fun _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) unavailable }
            let call := Json.mkObj [("op", toJson "$cas.apply"),
              ("args", Json.mkObj [("value", toJson (0 : Nat)),
                ("arguments", toJson (#[1, 2] : Array Nat))])]
            let originalLocals := (← getLCtx).foldl
              (fun result declaration => result.push declaration.fvarId) #[]
            (PublishedSource.prepare context call).runK scope fun result completed => do
              let some binding := completed.bindings.back?
                | throwError "the dependent request lost its complete final native scope"
              unless result.getAppFn == function &&
                  result.getAppArgs == #[n.expression, binding.expression] &&
                  binding.id == ⟨"published-dependent-input", 3⟩ &&
                  binding.originalSource == some point.expression &&
                  binding.expression != point.expression do
                throwError "the public request changed an original dependent operand position"
              unless ← isDefEq (← inferType binding.expression) domain do
                throwError "the public request did not retain its dependent native binder type"
              let externalAfter ← external.mvarId!.getDecl
              unless (externalBefore.lctx.foldl
                  (fun result declaration => result.push declaration.fvarId) #[]) ==
                  (externalAfter.lctx.foldl
                    (fun result declaration => result.push declaration.fvarId) #[]) &&
                  !externalAfter.lctx.contains binding.expression.fvarId! do
                throwError "the source producer extended an external metavariable scope"
              checkWithKernel result
              discard <| completed.close result
            unless (← getLCtx).foldl (fun result declaration => result.push declaration.fvarId) #[] ==
                originalLocals do
              throwError "the public dependent request leaked a scoped native binder")
          (originalSource := some original))
      (originalSource := some (mkNatLit 7))

-- A rejected reader unwinds every appended native local before the mismatch returns.
-- Its original caller metavariable and native context survive without changed authority.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let natural := mkConst ``Nat
  let type ← mkArrow natural (← mkArrow natural natural)
  withLocalDeclD `originalFunction type fun function => do
    let external ← mkFreshExprMVar natural
    let before ← getMCtx
    let locals := (← getLCtx).foldl
      (fun result declaration => result.push declaration.fvarId) #[]
    let read : Nat → Expr → StateCpsT Unit TermElabM (Except MessageData Expr) :=
      fun index domain _ state finish =>
        withLocalDeclD `scopedOperand domain fun value =>
          finish (if index == 0 then .ok value else .error m!"the original reader rejected its second slot") state
    (elabSourceApplicationApplicableScoped function #[Syntax.missing, Syntax.missing] none read).runK ()
      fun result _ => do
        unless result matches .error _ do
          throwError "the source application suppressed its original reader mismatch"
        unless (← getLCtx).foldl (fun result declaration => result.push declaration.fvarId) #[] == locals do
          throwError "the rejected source reader leaked a native operand scope"
        let after ← getMCtx
        unless before.decls.toArray.size == after.decls.toArray.size &&
            !(← external.mvarId!.isAssignedOrDelayedAssigned) do
          throwError "the rejected source reader changed the original metavariable context"
        let original ← external.mvarId!.getDecl
        unless original.lctx.foldl (fun result declaration => result.push declaration.fvarId) #[] == locals do
          throwError "the rejected source reader changed an external native scope"

end CasCompiler.PublishedSourceTests

module

import CasCompiler.PublishedSource
import CasCompiler.CategoricalPointSource
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.Ports
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.FiniteSums
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Foundation.Lists
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Modules.CatalogueRegistration
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.PublishedSource
meta import CasCompiler.CategoricalPointSource
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.Ports
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.FiniteSums
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Foundation.Lists
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Modules.CatalogueRegistration

namespace CasCompiler.PublishedSymbolicSourceTests

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

private def symbolicContext (bindings : Array LocalBinding) :
    MetaM (PublishedSourceContext (OpenContext × SourceSelectionScope Expr) ×
      (OpenContext × SourceSelectionScope Expr)) := do
  let unavailable : {α : Type} → MetaM α := fun {_} =>
    throwError "a symbolic interface control attempted to execute or recover a runtime input"
  let scope ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
  let identities ← CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let selectSource : SourceSelection Expr → Option Expr →
      StateCpsT (OpenContext × SourceSelectionScope Expr) TermElabM Expr :=
    fun selection declaredType _ current continuation =>
      controlAt MetaM fun run =>
        current.2.withBinding identities current.1 selection
          (fun context selections supplied => run (continuation supplied (context, selections)))
          (declaredType := declaredType)
  let context : PublishedSourceContext (OpenContext × SourceSelectionScope Expr) := {
    scope := (·.1)
    identities := fun _ => identities
    selections := (·.2)
    select := selectSource
    actionSource := fun _ => liftM (m := MetaM) unavailable
    retained := fun _ _ => pure none
    literal := fun _ _ => pure none
    bind := pure
    bindAt := fun source type _ current finish =>
      controlAt MetaM fun run =>
        current.1.withLocalBinding ⟨"published-symbolic-local", current.1.bindings.size⟩ .parameter
          `typedSymbolicParameter type
          (fun scope binding => run (finish binding.expression (scope, current.2)))
          (originalSource := some source)
    rebind := fun _ value => pure value
    methodParameters := fun _ _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) unavailable
    checkInput := fun _ expected actual => do
      checkRegisteredDomains expected actual
      unless ← isDefEq expected actual do throwError "the original source input changed"
    admitMethod := fun _ _ _ _ => unavailable
    admitProperty := fun _ _ _ _ => unavailable
    admitPoint := fun _ _ _ => unavailable
    projection := fun _ _ => liftM (m := MetaM) unavailable
    withLocal := fun name type _ current finish =>
      controlAt MetaM fun run =>
        current.1.withLocalBinding ⟨"published-symbolic-local", current.1.bindings.size⟩ .parameter
          name type (fun scope binding => run (finish binding.expression (scope, current.2))) }
  return (context, (scope, {}))

-- A nested source map follows the supplied native RingCat→MonCat action back into
-- RingCat. Its actual native arrow is rejected at the outer MonCat interface.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.action (.functor FunctorId.ringsMultiplicative))
  let descriptor := Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson FunctorId.ringsMultiplicative.raw),
    ("args", .arr #[])]
  for levels in #[family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
      family.universeParams.map Level.param] do
    let type ← inferType (family.arrowFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels)
    forallTelescopeReducing type fun parameters _ => do
      let bindings := parameters.mapIdx fun index expression =>
        ({ id := ⟨"symbolic-source-route", index⟩, role := .parameter, expression } : LocalBinding)
      let (context, scope) ← symbolicContext bindings
      let (expected, _) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
      let sourceArrow := parameters[family.declarationParameterCount + 2]!
      let (_, target) ← categoricalPointEndpoints sourceArrow
      let operands := #[PublishedSource.NativeSymbolicOperand.value sourceArrow,
        .mapData (.value target) (.value target)]
      PublishedSource.validateSymbolic context scope expected "compose" operands none #[descriptor]
      let rejected ← try
          PublishedSource.validateSymbolic context scope expected "compose" operands none
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
      unless rejected do throwError "a nested source arrow used the outer target category"
      PublishedSource.validateSymbolic context scope expected "identity"
        #[.objectData (.inline 0)] none #[descriptor]
      PublishedSource.validateSymbolic context scope expected "compose"
        #[.mapData (.inline 0) (.inline 1), .mapData (.inline 1) (.inline 2)]
        none #[descriptor]
      checkWithKernel (← mkLambdaFVars parameters expected
        (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false))

-- Two independently supplied category dictionaries on the same object carrier
-- remain separate. Carrier equality cannot authorize their identity or composition.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let carrierLevel := Level.param `symbolicCarrier
  withLocalDeclD `C (mkSort (.succ carrierLevel)) fun carrier => do
    let declaration ← getConstInfo ``CategoryTheory.Category
    let categoryType := mkApp (mkConst ``CategoryTheory.Category
      (declaration.levelParams.map (fun _ => carrierLevel))) carrier
    check categoryType
    withLocalDeclD `firstCategory categoryType fun firstCategory => do
      withLocalDeclD `secondCategory categoryType fun secondCategory => do
        withLocalDeclD `X carrier fun object => do
          let firstStructure ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct
            #[some carrier, some firstCategory]
          let secondStructure ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct
            #[some carrier, some secondCategory]
          let expected ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id
            #[some carrier, some firstStructure, some object]
          let other ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id
            #[some carrier, some secondStructure, some object]
          let expressions := #[carrier, firstCategory, secondCategory, object]
          let bindings := expressions.mapIdx fun index expression =>
            ({ id := ⟨"symbolic-category-dictionaries", index⟩, role := .parameter, expression } : LocalBinding)
          let (context, scope) ← symbolicContext bindings
          PublishedSource.validateSymbolic context scope expected "compose"
            #[.value expected, .value expected] none
          let rejected ← try
              PublishedSource.validateSymbolic context scope expected "compose"
                #[.value other, .value other] none
              pure false
            catch _ => pure true
          unless rejected do
            throwError "a different complete category dictionary passed by carrier equality"

-- The same inline intermediate position keeps constraints from every symbolic node.
-- Independently valid leaves cannot relabel distinct native objects as one composition boundary.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let carrierLevel := Level.param `sharedSymbolicCarrier
  withLocalDeclD `C (mkSort (.succ carrierLevel)) fun carrier => do
    let declaration ← getConstInfo ``CategoryTheory.Category
    let categoryType := mkApp (mkConst ``CategoryTheory.Category
      (declaration.levelParams.map (fun _ => carrierLevel))) carrier
    withLocalDeclD `category categoryType fun category => do
      withLocalDeclD `B carrier fun first => do
        withLocalDeclD `C carrier fun second => do
          let expressions := #[carrier, category, first, second]
          let bindings := expressions.mapIdx fun index expression =>
            ({ id := ⟨"shared-symbolic-position", index⟩, role := .parameter, expression } : LocalBinding)
          let (context, scope) ← symbolicContext bindings
          let structureValue ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct
            #[some carrier, some category]
          let expected ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id
            #[some carrier, some structureValue, some first]
          let node := fun object => ({
            expected, tag := "identity", operands := #[.objectData (.value object)],
            descriptor := none, framed := some (.inline 0, .inline 0)
              } : PublishedSource.NativeSymbolicNode)
          let compare : Expr → Expr → TermElabM Unit := fun left right => do
            unless ← isDefEq left right do
              throwError "the shared symbolic position has different original endpoints"
          PublishedSource.validateSymbolicBatch context scope #[node first, node first] (fun _ => compare)
          let rejected ← try
              PublishedSource.validateSymbolicBatch context scope #[node first, node second] (fun _ => compare)
              pure false
            catch _ => pure true
          unless rejected do
            throwError "independent symbolic nodes forgot their shared endpoint constraint"
          checkWithKernel (← mkLambdaFVars expressions expected
            (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false))


-- Opaque positions are data ports of the accepted native declaration. The finite binder's
-- third port depends on its first; replay must retain that complete dependency with rigid
-- locals, while the same original parameter positions may appear throughout one tree.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let slot := fun (index : Nat) => Json.mkObj [("ctor", .str "nativeParameterTest"),
    ("args", .arr #[toJson index])]
  let position? : Json → MetaM (Option Nat) := fun packet => do
    unless (packet.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "nativeParameterTest" do
      return none
    let #[value] ← ofExcept <| (packet.getObjVal? "args").bind Json.getArr?
      | throwError "the parameter test lost its original position"
    let index ← ofExcept <| value.getNat?
    unless packet == slot index do throwError "the parameter test changed its original fields"
    return some index
  let compare : Expr → Expr → TermElabM Unit := fun first second => do
    checkRegisteredDomains first second
    unless ← isDefEq first second do
      throwError "the opaque parameter changed a shared native endpoint"
  for identifier in #["bind.sets.finite_sum", "bind.sets.finite_product"] do
    let #[entry] := (← semanticState).binders.filter (·.id.raw == identifier)
      | throwError "the original dependent binder is absent"
    let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.binder entry)
    let levels := family.universeParams.map Level.param
    forallTelescopeReducing
        (← inferType (family.arrowFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels))
        fun parameters _ => do
      let bindings := parameters.mapIdx fun index expression =>
        ({ id := ⟨"opaque-dependent-native-parameters", index⟩, role := .parameter,
           expression } : LocalBinding)
      let (context, scope) ← symbolicContext bindings
      let (expected, _) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
      let node := fun (positions : Array Nat) => ({
        expected, tag := identifier, operands := #[],
        descriptor := some (Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson identifier),
          ("args", .arr (positions.map slot))]),
        framed := some (.inline 0, .inline 1) } : PublishedSource.NativeSymbolicNode)
      let original := node #[0, 1, 2]
      PublishedSource.validateSymbolicBatch context scope #[original, original] (fun _ => compare)
        (parameterCount := 3) (parameterPosition? := position?)
      let reject := fun changed count => do
        let rejected ← try
            PublishedSource.validateSymbolicBatch context scope #[original, changed] (fun _ => compare)
              (parameterCount := count) (parameterPosition? := position?)
            pure false
          catch _ => pure true
        unless rejected do throwError "distinct opaque positions erased a native dependency"
      -- The same actual third port cannot be assigned to a different source object.
      reject (node #[3, 1, 2]) 4
      -- Two independently valid third ports still cannot identify different source objects.
      reject (node #[3, 1, 4]) 5
      -- Reusing an object parameter as an arrow is not licensed by packet identity.
      reject (node #[0, 1, 1]) 3
      let outside ← try
          PublishedSource.validateSymbolicBatch context scope #[original] (fun _ => compare)
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
      unless outside do throwError "ordinary symbolic reading admitted an unscoped opaque parameter"

-- Polymorphic source cells use the same transient binder entrance at both a concrete and a
-- truly rigid universe. A second original object position cannot be unified with the first.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let #[entry] := (← semanticState).cells.filter (·.id == NaturalTransformationId.listReverse)
    | throwError "the original polymorphic comparison is absent"
  let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.component entry #[] false)
  let slot := fun (index : Nat) => Json.mkObj [("ctor", .str "nativeParameterTest"),
    ("args", .arr #[toJson index])]
  let position? : Json → MetaM (Option Nat) := fun packet => do
    if packet == slot 0 then return some 0
    if packet == slot 1 then return some 1
    return none
  for levels in #[family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
      family.universeParams.map Level.param] do
    forallTelescopeReducing
        (← inferType (family.arrowFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels))
        fun parameters _ => do
      let bindings := parameters.mapIdx fun index expression =>
        ({ id := ⟨"opaque-rigid-cell-parameter", index⟩, role := .parameter,
           expression } : LocalBinding)
      let (context, scope) ← symbolicContext bindings
      let (expected, _) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
      let node := fun position => ({
        expected, tag := "cellComponent", operands := #[],
        descriptor := some (({
          cell := entry.id.raw, parameters := #[], receiver := slot position, inverse := false
          } : CasCatalogue.Backend.CellComponent).encode),
        framed := some (.inline 0, .inline 1) } : PublishedSource.NativeSymbolicNode)
      let compare : Expr → Expr → TermElabM Unit := fun first second => do
        unless ← isDefEq first second do throwError "the original cell object changed"
      PublishedSource.validateSymbolicBatch context scope #[node 0, node 0] (fun _ => compare)
        (parameterCount := 1) (parameterPosition? := position?)
      let rejected ← try
          PublishedSource.validateSymbolicBatch context scope #[node 0, node 1] (fun _ => compare)
            (parameterCount := 2) (parameterPosition? := position?)
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
      unless rejected do throwError "rigid opaque object positions were merged by their native type"


-- A parameterized functor and its nested source-category view share one original opaque
-- ring position. The native module family still has its full rigid universe telescope.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let edge := EdgeRef.functor FunctorId.modulesFibreInclusion
  let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.action edge)
  let slot := fun (index : Nat) => Json.mkObj [("ctor", .str "nativeParameterTest"),
    ("args", .arr #[toJson index])]
  let position? : Json → MetaM (Option Nat) := fun packet => do
    if packet == slot 0 then return some 0
    if packet == slot 1 then return some 1
    return none
  for levels in #[family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
      family.universeParams.map Level.param] do
    forallTelescopeReducing
        (← inferType (family.arrowFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels))
        fun parameters _ => do
      let bindings := parameters.mapIdx fun index expression =>
        ({ id := ⟨"opaque-native-action-parameter", index⟩, role := .parameter,
           expression } : LocalBinding)
      let (context, scope) ← symbolicContext bindings
      let (expected, _) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
      let descriptor := fun position => routedActionDescriptor edge #[slot position]
      let original : PublishedSource.NativeSymbolicNode := {
        expected, tag := "map", operands := #[.mapData (.inline 0) (.inline 1)],
        descriptor := some (descriptor 0), framed := some (.inline 2, .inline 3) }
      let sourceNode := fun position => ({
        expected, tag := "identity", operands := #[.objectData (.inline 0)],
        descriptor := none, framed := some (.inline 0, .inline 0),
        inputActions := #[descriptor position] } : PublishedSource.NativeSymbolicNode)
      let compare : Expr → Expr → TermElabM Unit := fun first second => do
        checkRegisteredDomains first second
        unless ← isDefEq first second do throwError "the original action parameter changed"
      PublishedSource.validateSymbolicBatch context scope #[original, sourceNode 0] (fun _ => compare)
        (parameterCount := 1) (parameterPosition? := position?)
      let rejected ← try
          PublishedSource.validateSymbolicBatch context scope #[original, sourceNode 1] (fun _ => compare)
            (parameterCount := 2) (parameterPosition? := position?)
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
      unless rejected do throwError "a nested source action selected an independent opaque ring"

end CasCompiler.PublishedSymbolicSourceTests

private def admissionData (context : ReadContext) (body : TSyntax `cas_term)
    (base : Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  -- The admitted declaration supplies the data's type before its syntax is read.
  -- Selected morphisms use ReadDispatch's checked carrier-function conversion at this same
  -- boundary; literals and lambdas receive their declared domain on their only reading.
  return (← readExpression categoryOf body (some base)).value

private def admissionDataApplicable (context : ReadContext) (body : TSyntax `cas_term)
    (base : Expr) : SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) := do
  return (← context.readExpressionApplicable context.categoryOf body (some base)).map (·.value)

def admitted (context : ReadContext) (entry : CasCatalogue.ObjectEntry)
    (body : TSyntax `cas_term) (domain : Expr) : SourceReadM Expr :=
  sourceAdmission entry domain (admissionData context body)

def constrained (context : ReadContext) (body : TSyntax `cas_term)
    (domain : Expr) (evidence : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let proofs ← evidence.mapM fun evidence => do
    let `(cas_term| proof($proof:term)) := evidence
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError (MessageData.tagged `CasCompiler.SourceReader.explicitProof
          "a constrained point requires explicit native proof terms")
    pure proof
  sourceConstrainedPointApplicable domain proofs (admissionDataApplicable context body)
    (context.readExpression context.categoryOf body none)

end SourceReader

namespace SourceReader

def annotated (context : ReadContext) :
    TSyntax `cas_term → TSyntax `cas_term → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let expected := context.expected
  let admitted := admitted context
  let elementOperation := elementOperation context
  fun (body domain : TSyntax `cas_term) => do
    let domain ← sourceCarrier (← readExpression categoryOf domain none)
    discard <| getLevel domain.value
    if let some entry ← sourceAdmissionDomain? domain.value then
      let identifier := body.raw.isIdent &&
        ((← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? body.raw.getId).isSome
      let typed ← if identifier then do
          let value ← readExpression categoryOf body none
          isDefEq (← inferType value.value) domain.value
        else pure false
      unless typed do
        let value ← admitted entry body domain.value
        return (⟨← mkExpectedTypeHint value domain.value, none⟩ : NativeSourceJudgement)
    -- A relation's annotation selects its operand structure, not its truth-value result.
    -- Reuse the same whole-family operation preparation as other element operations.
    match body with
    | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term ≤ $right:cas_term) =>
      return ← elementOperation "≤" #[left, right] #[] #[] (some domain.value)
    | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term < $right:cas_term) =>
      return ← elementOperation "<" #[left, right] #[] #[] (some domain.value)
    | _ => pure ()
    if let some expected := expected then checkRegisteredSourceDomains domain.value expected
    readExpression categoryOf body (some domain.value)

end SourceReader

namespace ReadAnnotationRules

open SourceReader

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let annotated := SourceReader.annotated context
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let expected := context.expected
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| $body:cas_term in $domain:cas_term using ($evidence:cas_term,*)) => do
    let domain ← sourceCarrier (← readExpression categoryOf domain none)
    discard <| getLevel domain.value
    SourceReader.constrained context body domain.value evidence.getElems
  | `(cas_term| $body:cas_term in $category:ident / $base:cas_term) => do
    -- `X in C/Y`: X read in the registered category family C at its base parameter Y.
    let state ← CasCatalogue.semanticState
    let name := category.getId.toString (escape := false)
    -- The family registered as `C/` (`Schemes/`, beside `Schemes`), else `C` itself.
    let some entry := (state.categories.find? (·.name == name ++ "/")).orElse fun _ =>
        state.categories.find? (·.name == name)
      | annotated body (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $category:ident / $base:cas_term))
    let name := entry.name
    discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
    let previous ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
    let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
    let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
    let current ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
    let owned := current.decls.foldl (fun result identity _ =>
      if previous.decls.contains identity then result else result.push identity) #[]
    let some parameter := parameters.back?
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the category {name} has no base parameter"
    let base ← readExpression categoryOf base
      (some (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType parameter)))
    extendSourceApplicationScope owned
    unless ← isDefEq parameter base.value do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the base is not an object of the base category of {name}"
    -- An object already selected elsewhere is in C through C's registered refinement of its
    -- object family, at the same parameters (`ℂ[x₀, …]` as a ℂ-algebra).
    let object ← readExpression categoryOf body none
    let judgement ← if object.category.any (·.expression.syntacticEq entry.expression) then
        pure object
      else do
        let (value, originals) ← registeredSourceDomain object.value
        let #[original] := originals
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the value does not name one registered object"
        let rows := state.objects.filter fun row =>
          row.category == entry.id && (row.refines.any (·.base == original.id) ||
            original.refines.any (·.base == row.id))
        let #[refinement] := rows
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwStratum .invalid m!"{original.name} has no registered object in {name}"
        let arguments ← sourceExplicitArguments value.consumeMData
        let (bundle, refined) ← registeredExpressions (.inl refinement) entry
          fun function expected =>
            elabAppArgs function #[] (arguments.map Arg.expr) expected false false
        pure (⟨refined, some ⟨.object, entry.expression, bundle, none, none⟩⟩ : NativeSourceJudgement)
    let some selected := judgement.category
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source value has no selected category"
    extendSourceApplicationScope owned
    unless ← isDefEq (mkAppN family parameters) selected.bundle do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwStratum .invalid m!"the value is not an object of {name} over this base"
    return judgement
  | `(cas_term| $body:cas_term in $category:ident) => do
    let name := category.getId.toString (escape := false)
    -- A local binding denotes its actual domain. Among unbound names, only a registered
    -- category qualifies the body; named objects such as C supply their declared data type.
    if ((← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? category.getId).isSome then
      annotated body (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $category:ident))
    else if (← CasCatalogue.semanticState).categories.any (·.name == name) then
      let required ← selectCategory (← CasCatalogue.semanticState) name
      if required.expression matches .classifierTotal _ then
        if ← sourcePrincipal body then
          -- A compound or retained object already has its own complete source category
          -- and presentation. Refine that whole value; do not qualify its operands.
          return ← sourcePropertyQualification
            (← readExpression categoryOf body none) required
      readExpression categoryOf body expected (some name)
    else
      annotated body (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $category:ident))
  | `(cas_term| $body:cas_term in $domain:cas_term) =>
    annotated body domain
  | _ => throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadAnnotationRules

end CasCompiler

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

namespace SourceReader

def mapEnds :
    Expr → SourceReadM (Option (Expr × Expr)) :=
  fun (arrow : Expr) => do
    let inferred ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType arrow)
    let type ← if inferred.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure inferred else whnfR inferred
    if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
      let endpoint := fun value => do
        if let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value then
          if let some endpoint := selected.endpoint then return endpoint.value
        declaredEndpoint value
      return some (← endpoint type.getAppArgs[2]!, ← endpoint type.getAppArgs[3]!)
    if type.isAppOfArity ``TypeCat.Hom 2 then return some (type.getAppArgs[0]!, type.getAppArgs[1]!)
    return none

-- Only an unresolved bare object spelling can acquire a registered refinement for a
-- declaration parameter. A retained binding or an explicit qualification already selected
-- its complete source object and must use that object's own outgoing routes.
private partial def bareObjectName? (source : TSyntax `cas_term) :
    SourceReadM (Option String) := do
  if let some name := sourceAtomName? source then return some name
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| ($inner:cas_term)) => bareObjectName? inner
  | `(cas_term| $name:ident) =>
    if ((← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? name.getId).isSome then return none
    return some (name.getId.toString (escape := false))
  | _ => return none

private def applicationApplicableCore (context : ReadContext)
    (preRead : Option NativeSourceJudgement := none) :
    NativeSourceJudgement → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) → Option Expr →
      SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let readArgument := @ReadContext.readExpressionApplicable context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  fun (source : NativeSourceJudgement) (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term))
      (expected : Option Expr) => do
    let readOriginal := fun index argument => do
      if index == 0 then
        if let some original := preRead then return original
      readExpression categoryOf argument none
    let readAt := fun index argument type => do
      if index == 0 then
        if let some original := preRead then
          return ← checkReadJudgementApplicable
            { context with
              source := argument
              expected := type
              qualification := none
              expectedCategory := none } original
      readArgument categoryOf argument type
    let source ← if source.category.any (·.role == .morphism) then do
      let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? source.value).getD { value := source.value }
      let value ← SourceReadM.select { selected with value := source.value, category := source.category }
      pure { source with value }
    else pure source
    -- A map applied to its whole domain is the map's image (`m2(ℕ)`), through the registered
    -- image of the power object of its target (PowerObjectEntry.image).
    if let #[argument] := arguments then
      if argument.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casAtom then
        if let some (domain, codomain) ← mapEnds source.value then
          let object ← readOriginal 0 argument
          if object.category.any (·.role == .object) then
            if ← isDefEq object.value domain then
              let target ← sourcePowerObjectAt codomain
              return .ok (← sourceImageOf target domain source.value expected)
    -- An element with a registered application (a polynomial `p(a)`).
    if let #[argument] := arguments then
      if source.category.isNone then
        let type ← whnfR (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType source.value))
        unless type.isForall || type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 || type.isAppOf ``TypeCat.Hom do
          if let some value ← sourceObjectApplication? source.value (sourceNumeric argument.raw)
              (fun expected => do
                match ← readAt 0 argument expected with
                | .ok value => return value.value
                | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message) then
            return .ok value
    let function ← if arguments.isEmpty then pure source.value else sourceFunction source
    -- Several arguments of a map on a product are the components of one tuple (`gcd(84, 30)`).
    if arguments.size > 1 then
      let hole ← mkFreshExprMVar none
      let unary ← withoutModifyingState do
        discard <| elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr hole] none false false
        let type ← whnfR (← declaredEndpoint (← inferType hole))
        let result ← whnfR (← declaredEndpoint (← inferType (mkApp function hole)))
        return type.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 && !result.isForall
      if unary then
        discard <| elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr hole] none false false
        let type ← declaredEndpoint (← inferType hole)
        let tuple ← sourceTuple arguments type fun component type => do
          return (← readExpression categoryOf component (some type)).value
        return .ok (← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr tuple] expected false false)
    -- A named spelling for the actual declared source of a Sets arrow is checked at the
    -- entire native family before its parameters are applied. This can guide its point's
    -- existing literal reader without choosing another runtime object by carrier equality.
    let namedDomain ← if arguments.size == 1 && source.category.any (fun category =>
        category.role == .morphism &&
          category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CasCatalogue.CategoryId.sets)) then do
        let type ← whnfR (← inferType source.value)
        if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
          let endpoint ← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[2]!
          let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? endpoint).getD { value := endpoint }
          let named ← sourceNamedObjectAlias CasCatalogue.CategoryId.sets selected
          pure (some (← SourceReadM.select named))
        else pure none
      else pure none
    let applied ← elabSourceApplicationApplicableScoped function (arguments.map (·.raw)) expected fun index type => do
      let some argument := arguments[index]?
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source application lost an original argument"
      let formalType := type
      let type ← match namedDomain with
        | some domain =>
          let scope ← get
          let agrees ← scope.context.withOriginalSources #[type, domain] fun original =>
            isDefEq original[0]! original[1]!
          unless agrees do
            liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the Sets point application changed its actual declared source"
          pure domain
        | none => pure type
      -- Domain atoms contain no identifier token, so the numeral-only syntax predicate
      -- alone does not distinguish them from literals. Keep their registered spelling.
      let bareName ← bareObjectName? argument
      -- An object of another selected category is viewed along its structural route.
      let viewed : Option NativeSourceJudgement ← if sourceNumeric argument.raw && bareName.isNone then pure none else do
        let some category ← sourceObjectCategory? type | pure none
        let object ← readOriginal index argument
        let some selected := object.category | pure none
        if selected.role != .object || selected.expression.syntacticEq category.expression then
          pure none
        else
          -- Without a structural route the argument is read at the parameter's own category,
          -- where its name may select that category's row.
          let routes ← SourceRoutes.forOwner selected.expression category.expression
          let routed := (← routes.finiteRoutes).all (! ·.isEmpty)
          -- The surface name of the applied family, for a declared preferred route.
          let state ← CasCatalogue.semanticState
          let head := function.consumeMData.getAppFn.constName?
          let name := head.bind fun head =>
            (state.objects.find? (·.declaration == head)).map (·.name) <|>
            (state.morphisms.find? (·.declaration == head)).map (·.name)
          if routed then pure (some (← sourceStructuralView object category.expression name))
          else if !selected.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CasCatalogue.CategoryId.sets) then
            pure none
          else match bareName with
            | none => pure none
            | some spelling =>
              -- A row already declared in the parameter category keeps ordinary expected-type
              -- selection. Otherwise its exact named base may supply a declared carrier prefix.
              if state.objects.any (fun entry =>
                  entry.name == spelling && entry.category == category.id) then pure none
              else sourceNamedConstantParameter? object.value category.expression
      let value ← match viewed with
        | some value => pure (.ok value)
        | none => readAt index argument (some type)
      let value ← match value with
        | .ok value => pure value
        | .error message => return .error message
      let value ← match ← checkReadJudgementApplicable
          { context with
            source := argument
            expected := some formalType
            qualification := none
            expectedCategory := none } value with
        | .ok value => pure value
        | .error message => return .error message
      let parameter ← match value.category with
        | some category =>
          if category.role == .object then annotateSourceObject category value.value
          else pure value.value
        | none => pure value.value
      return .ok parameter
    let (result, actual) ← match applied with
      | .ok value => pure value
      | .error message => return .error message
    if let #[argument] := actual then
      if source.category.any (·.role == .morphism) then
        if let some original := (← SourceReadM.selection? argument).bind (·.pointOrigin) then
          -- Retain the ordinary native composition of the already selected point and
          -- carrier map. A later application keeps this point's same original domain.
          let mapped ← sourceCarrier source
          let some category := mapped.category
            | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the point action lost its selected carrier category"
          let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[category.bundle]
          let categoryInstance ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.str #[category.bundle]
          let categoryStructure ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct
            #[some carrier, some categoryInstance]
          let composition ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
            #[some carrier, some categoryStructure]
          let point ← elabAppArgs composition #[] #[Arg.expr original.point, Arg.expr mapped.value]
            none false false
          return .ok (← SourceReadM.select (← retainSourcePoint point { value := result }))
    return .ok result

/-- Ordinary application keeps its original positional operand reader. -/
def applicationApplicable (context : ReadContext) (source : NativeSourceJudgement)
    (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) (expected : Option Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) :=
  applicationApplicableCore context none source arguments expected

def application (context : ReadContext)
    (source : NativeSourceJudgement) (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term))
    (expected : Option Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  match ← applicationApplicable context source arguments expected with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

-- A call of an already selected native map has its domain from that receiver. This
-- extends principal reading through nested actual calls without selecting an overloaded
-- declaration from an expected endpoint or turning an interpretation failure into a rule.
private partial def principalApplication (context : ReadContext)
    (source : TSyntax `cas_term) : SourceReadM Bool := do
  if ← sourcePrincipal source then return true
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| ($inner:cas_term)) => principalApplication context inner
  | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term in $_:cas_term using ($_:cas_term,*)) => return true
  | `(cas_term| $name:ident($arguments:cas_term,*)) =>
    if arguments.getElems.isEmpty then return false
    let function ← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $name:ident)
    unless ← principalApplication context function do return false
    SourceReadM.inspect do
      let receiver ← context.readExpression context.categoryOf function none
      return receiver.category.any (·.role == .morphism)
  | `(cas_term| ($function:cas_term)($arguments:cas_term,*))
  | `(cas_term| $function:cas_term($arguments:cas_term,*)) =>
    if arguments.getElems.isEmpty then return false
    unless ← principalApplication context function do return false
    SourceReadM.inspect do
      let receiver ← context.readExpression context.categoryOf function none
      return receiver.category.any (·.role == .morphism)
  | _ => return false

/-- Both native application and whole-point composition complete against the same public
reader contract before unique selection. Original operands are read once by their positions. -/
def applicationResultCompleting (context : ReadContext) (source : NativeSourceJudgement)
    (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) (expected : Option Expr)
    (complete : ReadCompletion) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let supplied ← if let #[argument] := arguments then do
    if source.category.any (·.role == .morphism) && (← principalApplication context argument) then
      let point ← context.readExpression context.categoryOf argument none
      pure (some point)
    else pure none
  else pure none
  let generalized := supplied.any (fun point => point.category.any (·.role == .morphism))
  let ordinary := do
    let formed ← applicationApplicableCore context supplied source arguments
      (if generalized then none else expected)
    match formed with
    | .ok value => complete ⟨value, if arguments.isEmpty then source.category else none⟩
    | .error message => pure (.error message)
  unless generalized do return ← ordinary
  let some point := supplied
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the generalized application lost its original operand"
  let composed := do
    let mapped ← sourceCarrier source
    let supplied ← sourceCarrier point
    let some category := mapped.category
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "generalized application lost its selected carrier category"
    let some suppliedCategory := supplied.category
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the generalized point lost its selected carrier category"
    unless category.role == .morphism && suppliedCategory.role == .morphism &&
        category.expression.syntacticEq suppliedCategory.expression &&
        (← isDefEq category.bundle suppliedCategory.bundle) do
      return .error m!"generalized application has different complete carrier categories"
    let some (_, pointTarget) ← mapEnds supplied.value
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the supplied generalized point lost its native endpoints"
    let some (mapSource, _) ← mapEnds mapped.value
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected map lost its native endpoints"
    match ← registeredSourceDomainsApplicable pointTarget mapSource with
    | .error message => return .error message
    | .ok () => pure ()
    let scope ← get
    let agrees ← scope.context.withOriginalSources #[pointTarget, mapSource] fun original =>
      isDefEq original[0]! original[1]!
    unless agrees do
      return .error m!"the generalized point does not have the selected map's source"
    let pointType ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType supplied.value)
    let mapType ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType mapped.value)
    let stated ← if pointType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 &&
        mapType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
      pure (mkAppN pointType.getAppFn (pointType.getAppArgs.set! 3 mapType.getAppArgs[2]!))
    else do
      let pointType ← whnfR pointType
      let mapType ← whnfR mapType
      unless pointType.isAppOfArity ``TypeCat.Hom 2 &&
          mapType.isAppOfArity ``TypeCat.Hom 2 do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the generalized application lost its complete native Hom types"
      pure (mkAppN pointType.getAppFn (pointType.getAppArgs.set! 1 mapType.getAppArgs[0]!))
    let pointSelection := (← SourceReadM.selection? supplied.value).getD {
      value := supplied.value, category := supplied.category }
    let pointValue ← SourceReadM.select { pointSelection with value := supplied.value } (some stated)
    let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[category.bundle]
    let instanceValue ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.str #[category.bundle]
    let structureValue ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct
      #[some carrier, some instanceValue]
    let composition ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
      #[some carrier, some structureValue]
    let value ← elabAppArgs composition #[]
      #[Arg.expr pointValue, Arg.expr mapped.value] none false false
    let value ← SourceReadM.select { value, category := some category }
    complete ⟨value, some category⟩
  SourceReadM.chooseApplicable #[ordinary, composed]
    m!"no application of the selected source accepts its original operand"
    m!"the selected source admits distinct completed ordinary and generalized applications"

/-- Compatibility callers still receive the actual provided expected-type completion.
Qualification belongs to the assembled reader and is not replayed by this wrapper. -/
def applicationResultApplicable (context : ReadContext) (source : NativeSourceJudgement)
    (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) (expected : Option Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  applicationResultCompleting context source arguments expected
    (checkReadJudgementApplicable { context with expected, qualification := none })

/-- Required application preserves actual operand and native construction failures. -/
def applicationResult (context : ReadContext) (source : NativeSourceJudgement)
    (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) (expected : Option Expr) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  match ← applicationResultApplicable context source arguments expected with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

end SourceReader

end CasCompiler

def ruleCompleting (context : ReadContext) (complete : ReadCompletion) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let expected := context.expected
  let application := fun function arguments expected =>
    applicationResultCompleting context function arguments expected complete
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| ($function:cas_term)($arguments:cas_term,*)) => do
    let function ← readExpression categoryOf function none
    application function arguments.getElems expected
  | `(cas_term| $function:cas_term($arguments:cas_term,*)) => do
    let function ← readExpression categoryOf function none
    application function arguments.getElems expected
  | _ => do
    if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casMatrix then
      let some expected := expected
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource "source matrix default-domain interpretation is not implemented"
      let rows := source.raw[1].getSepArgs.map fun row =>
        row.getSepArgs.map fun cell => (⟨cell⟩ : TSyntax `cas_term)
      let value ← sourceMatrix rows expected fun component type => do
        return (← readExpression categoryOf component (some type)).value
      return ← complete ⟨value, none⟩
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource
      m!"source translation is not implemented for expression {source}"

/-- Standalone use retains the same independently provided expected-type check. -/
def ruleApplicable (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  ruleCompleting context (checkReadJudgementApplicable { context with qualification := none })

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  match ← ruleApplicable context with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

namespace ReadBinderNotation

open SourceReader

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let readArgument : TSyntax `cas_term → Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) :=
    fun source type => do
      return (← context.readExpressionApplicable categoryOf source (some type)).map (·.value)
  if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casDefinite then do
    -- `∫_{a}^{b} e dt`: the registered binder `∫` at the bounds, binding `t`.
    let some bound := sourceDifferentialOf? source.raw[6].getId
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a definite integral ends with the differential of its variable"
    let bounds : Array (TSyntax `cas_term) := #[⟨source.raw[1]⟩, ⟨source.raw[3]⟩]
    let value ← sourceBinder "∫" (bounds.map fun bound => readArgument bound)
      bound fun _ => do return (← readExpression categoryOf ⟨source.raw[5]⟩ none).value
    pure ⟨value, none⟩
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casLimit then do
    -- `lim_{t → a} e`: the registered binder `lim` at the point `a`.
    let point : TSyntax `cas_term := ⟨source.raw[3]⟩
    let value ← sourceBinder "lim" #[readArgument point]
      source.raw[1].getId fun _ => do
        return (← readExpression categoryOf ⟨source.raw[5]⟩ none).value
    pure ⟨value, none⟩
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casBig then do
    -- `∑_{t ∈ A} e`, `∏_{t ∈ A} e`: the registered binder at the index set `A`.
    let token := (source.raw[0].find? (·.isAtom)).map (·.getAtomVal) |>.getD "∑"
    let index : TSyntax `cas_term := ⟨source.raw[4]⟩
    let value ← sourceBinder token #[readArgument index]
      source.raw[2].getId fun _ => do
        return (← readExpression categoryOf ⟨source.raw[6]⟩ none).value
    pure ⟨value, none⟩
  else throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadBinderNotation

end CasCompiler

def component (context : ReadContext) (name : Ident)
    (parameters : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) (receiver : TSyntax `cas_term)
    (constructors : Array Ident) (inverse : Bool) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let #[entry] := (← semanticState).cells.filter
      (·.id.raw == name.getId.toString (escape := false))
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid "the selected source cell is not registered"
  let receiver ← context.readExpression context.categoryOf receiver none
  let constant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
  let application ← SourceReader.application context ⟨constant, none⟩ parameters none
  let mut cell ← nativeSourceCell entry application inverse
  for id in constructors.reverse do
    cell ← cell.construct ⟨id.getId.toString (escape := false)⟩
  let selected ← cell.selectedComponent receiver
  let value ← selectMorphism selected
    (fun selected expected => SourceReadM.select selected expected) (some cell.targetBundle)
  return ⟨value, selected.category⟩

  match context.source with
  | `(cas_term| component($name:ident($parameters:cas_term,*), $receiver:cas_term,
      [$constructors:ident,*])) =>
    component context name parameters.getElems receiver constructors.getElems false
  | `(cas_term| inverse_component($name:ident($parameters:cas_term,*), $receiver:cas_term,
      [$constructors:ident,*])) =>
    component context name parameters.getElems receiver constructors.getElems true

public import CasCompiler.Elaborate
public import CasCompiler.Syntax

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

namespace SourceReader
end SourceReader

/-- The typed context of one source-reading rule. Recursive calls return through the assembled
reader; rules retain the actual Lean expressions and selected categories. -/
structure ReadContext where
  categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory)
  source : TSyntax `cas_term
  expected : Option Expr
  qualification : Option String
  expectedCategory : Option NativeSourceCategory
  project : NativeSourceJudgement → String → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) →
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement)
  read : (FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory)) → TSyntax `cas_term →
    Option Expr → Option String → Option NativeSourceCategory →
      SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement)

/-- The result of this operand's own native expected-type check. Recursive source readings
remain ordinary readings: their exceptions cannot reject a containing candidate. -/
def ReadContext.readExpressionApplicable (context : ReadContext)
    (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (source : TSyntax `cas_term) (expected : Option Expr)
    (qualification : Option String := none)
    (expectedCategory : Option NativeSourceCategory := none) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  context.read categoryOf source expected qualification expectedCategory

def ReadContext.readExpression (context : ReadContext)
    (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (source : TSyntax `cas_term) (expected : Option Expr)
    (qualification : Option String := none)
    (expectedCategory : Option NativeSourceCategory := none) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  SourceReadM.withRef source do
    match ← context.readExpressionApplicable categoryOf source expected qualification expectedCategory with
    | .ok value => pure value
    | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

/-- A syntax rule rejects only unmatched syntax with its private dispatch exception.
Errors from a matched construction propagate through the assembled reader. -/
abbrev ReadRule := ReadContext → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement

/-- A matched rule may reject only its own explicit native expected-type comparison.
Unmatched syntax and semantic exceptions keep the ordinary rule contract. -/
abbrev ReadApplicableRule :=
  ReadContext → SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement)

def ReadRule.applicable (rule : ReadRule) : ReadApplicableRule := fun context => do
  return .ok (← rule context)

/-- The ordinary final qualification, carrier and declared-domain check for one produced
judgement. A competing rule invokes it in that candidate's native state. -/
abbrev ReadCompletion :=
  NativeSourceJudgement → SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement)

/-- A rule which carries its completed result directly to the dispatcher. The continuation
is the dispatcher's actual final check; choosing a completed candidate never reruns it. -/
abbrev ReadCompletingRule :=
  ReadContext → ReadCompletion → SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement)

def ReadApplicableRule.completing (rule : ReadApplicableRule) : ReadCompletingRule :=
  fun context complete => do
    match ← rule context with
    | .ok value => complete value
    | .error message => pure (.error message)

def ReadRule.completing (rule : ReadRule) : ReadCompletingRule :=
  ReadApplicableRule.completing (ReadRule.applicable rule)

initialize readRuleMismatch : InternalExceptionId ← registerInternalExceptionId `cas.readRuleMismatch

/-- Used only at a rule's unmatched syntax branch, never for a failed interpretation. -/
def throwReadRuleMismatch : SourceReadM α := throw (Exception.internal readRuleMismatch)

def sourceAtomName? (source : Syntax) : Option String :=
  if source.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casAtom ||
      source.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casDomainAtom then
    -- Lean's alternative-token parser retains a token-kind node around its actual atom.
    some source[0][0].getAtomVal
  else none

-- Reuse Language.numeric's source rule: numeral-only syntax has no chosen set yet.
partial def sourceNumeric (source : Syntax) : Bool :=
  !source.isIdent && !(source.isAtom &&
    (source.getAtomVal == "√" || source.getAtomVal == "|")) && source.getArgs.all sourceNumeric

-- These forms determine their category and type from their own source inputs.
-- Other forms retain expected-type flow, including unqualified registered objects,
-- literals, tuples, lambdas and applications with implicit parameters.
partial def sourcePrincipal (source : TSyntax `cas_term) : TermElabM Bool := do
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| ($inner:cas_term)) => sourcePrincipal inner
  | `(cas_term| $name:ident) =>
    return ((← getLCtx).findFromUserName? name.getId).isSome
  | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term in $_:cas_term)
  | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term → $_:cas_term)
  | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term × $_:cas_term)
  | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term ⊔ $_:cas_term)
  | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term ∘ $_:cas_term)
  | `(cas_term| |$_:cas_term|)
  | `(cas_term| view $_:cas_term along $_:ident)
  | `(cas_term| view $_:cas_term along $_:ident($_:cas_term,*))
  | `(cas_term| map $_:cas_term along $_:ident($_:cas_term,*)) => return true
  | `(cas_term| $name:ident($_:cas_term,*)) =>
    return name.getId == `id && ((← getLCtx).findFromUserName? name.getId).isNone
  | _ => return false

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.ReadContext
public import CasCompiler.SourceSubset
public import CasCompiler.SourceAdmission
public import CasCompiler.SourcePropertyQualification
import CasCompiler.SourceCarrier

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

/-- Complete a source rule's judgement using the ordinary qualification, carrier,
registered-domain and native expected-type checks. Already read numeric inclusion sources
use these same checks without replaying their syntax or suppressing a failed reading. -/
def checkReadJudgementApplicable (context : ReadContext) (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := SourceReadM.withRef context.source do
  let judgement ← match ← retainSourceProjection? judgement.value with
    | none => pure judgement
    | some projected => pure { judgement with
        value := projected.value
        category := judgement.category <|> projected.category }
  let expected := context.expected
  let qualification := context.qualification
  let judgement ← if let some name := qualification then
    let required ← selectCategory (← CasCatalogue.semanticState) name
    match ← sourcePropertyQualificationApplicable judgement required with
    | .ok value => pure value
    | .error message => return .error message
  else pure judgement
  let retain := fun (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) => do
    let some category := judgement.category | return .ok judgement
    let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? judgement.value).getD { value := judgement.value }
    let value ← SourceReadM.select {
      selected with value := judgement.value, category := some category }
    return .ok { judgement with value }
  if let some expected := expected then
    -- A native type parameter consumes the actual selected object's carrier.
    -- Reuse the same checked source action as public function domains.
    let judgement ← if (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars expected).isSort then
      if judgement.category.any (·.role == .object) then sourceCarrier judgement
      else match ← sourceExtent? judgement with
        | some extent => sourceCarrier extent
        | none => pure judgement
    else pure judgement
    -- A native function parameter consumes the actual selected morphism's carrier map.
    -- Its source category was checked above; sourceFunction retains the complete selected
    -- action and map before the ordinary native type and registered-domain checks below.
    let judgement ← if (← whnfR (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars expected)).isForall &&
        judgement.category.any (·.role == .morphism) then
      pure (⟨← sourceFunction judgement, none⟩ : NativeSourceJudgement)
    else pure judgement
    let actual ← inferType judgement.value
    let nativeFits ← withoutModifyingState (isDefEq actual expected)
    let scope ← get
    let sourceFits ← if nativeFits then pure true else
      scope.context.withOriginalSources #[actual, expected] fun original =>
        withoutModifyingState (isDefEq original[0]! original[1]!)
    unless sourceFits do
      -- An element of a related named set is read through the registered maps between them.
      if judgement.category.isNone then
        if let some value ← sourceCoercion? judgement.value
            (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars expected) then
          return .ok ⟨value, none⟩
    match ← registeredSourceDomainsApplicable (← inferType judgement.value) expected with
    | .error message => return .error message
    | .ok () => pure ()
    unless sourceFits do
      return .error (MessageData.tagged `CasCompiler.SourceReader.declaredParameterType
        m!"the source expression does not have its independently declared parameter type; \
        source={context.source}; expected={expected}; actual={← inferType judgement.value}; \
        value={judgement.value}; category={(judgement.category.map (fun selected => (toJson selected.expression).compress)).getD "none"}")
    if nativeFits then
      discard <| isDefEq actual expected
      return ← retain judgement
    let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? judgement.value).getD {
      value := judgement.value, category := judgement.category }
    let value ← SourceReadM.select {
      selected with value := judgement.value, category := judgement.category } (some expected)
    return .ok { judgement with value }
  retain judgement

/-- Native elaborator-style dispatch. Unmatched syntax tries the next rule; a matched rule's
semantic error is retained. No rule registry contains mathematical declarations. -/
def readWithCompletingRules (rules : Array ReadCompletingRule) (context : ReadContext) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := SourceReadM.withRef context.source do
  go rules.toList

where
  go : List ReadCompletingRule → SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement)
    | [] => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource
        m!"source translation is not implemented for expression {context.source}"
    | rule :: rest => do
      -- Native candidate rollback does not turn a matched syntax rule back into an
      -- unmatched one. Once a rule invokes completion, every exception is its actual
      -- failure, including an internal identifier equal to the private mismatch marker.
      let matched ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef false
      try rule context fun judgement => do
        liftM (m := IO) <| matched.set true
        checkReadJudgementApplicable context judgement
      catch exception =>
        match exception with
        | .internal id _ =>
          if id == readRuleMismatch && !(← liftM (m := IO) matched.get) then go rest else throw exception
        | _ => throw exception

/-- Ordinary applicable rules produce one judgement and complete it exactly once. -/
def readWithApplicableRules (rules : Array ReadApplicableRule) (context : ReadContext) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  readWithCompletingRules (rules.map ReadApplicableRule.completing) context

/-- Ordinary rules have no expected-type absence before producing their judgement. -/
def readWithRulesApplicable (rules : Array ReadRule) (context : ReadContext) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  readWithApplicableRules (rules.map ReadRule.applicable) context

/-- Ordinary source reading requires its own native expected-type check to succeed.
The applicability variant returns only that check's explicit mismatch, never an exception
from a matched rule, nested operand, selected carrier, or native type operation. -/
def readWithRules (rules : Array ReadRule) (context : ReadContext) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := SourceReadM.withRef context.source do
  match ← readWithRulesApplicable rules context with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.ReadContext
public import CasCompiler.SourceSubset
public import CasCompiler.SourceRing
import CasCompiler.SourceCarrier

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

namespace SourceReader

def equationOperands (context : ReadContext) :
    TSyntax `cas_term → TSyntax `cas_term → SourceReadM (NativeSourceJudgement × NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  fun (left right : TSyntax `cas_term) => do
    let leftPrincipal ← sourcePrincipal left
    let rightPrincipal ← sourcePrincipal right
    let (left, right) ← if !leftPrincipal && rightPrincipal then do
      -- An annotated operand `x in D` gives the other operand D's carrier with its selected
      -- source object, not only the native type of x (`2 + 3 = 0 in ℤ/5`).
      let domain ← match right with
        | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term in $domain:cas_term) => do
          if domain.raw.isIdent then pure none
          else pure (some (← sourceCarrier (← readExpression categoryOf domain none)).value)
        | _ => pure none
      let right ← readExpression categoryOf right none
      let leftType ← match domain with
        | some domain => pure domain
        | none => inferType right.value
      let left ← readExpression categoryOf left (some leftType) none right.category
      pure (left, right)
    else do
      let left ← readExpression categoryOf left none
      -- A global element `1 ⟶ X` compared with a numeral is compared at its point, where the
      -- numeral reads in X by the numeral rules (`dimension(ℚ) = 0`).
      let pointType ← whnfR (← inferType left.value)
      let mut left := left
      if sourceNumeric right.raw && pointType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
        let source ← declaredEndpoint pointType.getAppArgs[2]!
        if (← whnfR (← inferType source)).isSort then
          if (← synthInstance? (← mkAppM ``Unique #[source])).isSome then
            left := ⟨← sourcePointValue left.value none, none⟩
      let type ← inferType left.value
      -- A set compared with a subset of itself is the whole subset, the image of its identity
      -- (`X = ℕ` for `X` in `𝒫(ℕ)`).
      let wholeSubset := fun (type : Expr) => do
        unless right.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casAtom do return none
        let type ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars type
        let some power ← sourcePowerObject? type | return none
        let object ← readExpression categoryOf right none
        unless object.category.any (·.role == .object) do return none
        unless ← isDefEq object.value power.base do return none
        let identity ← liftM (m := MetaM) <|
          withLocalDeclD `x power.base fun x => mkLambdaFVars #[x] x
        return some (⟨← sourceImage power power.base identity (some type), none⟩ :
          NativeSourceJudgement)
      let whole ← wholeSubset type
      let right ← match whole with
        | some whole => pure whole
        | none =>
          readExpression categoryOf right (if rightPrincipal then none else some type) none
            (if rightPrincipal then none else left.category)
      pure (left, right)
    let (left, right) ← sourceCommonCategory left right
    checkRegisteredSourceDomains (← inferType left.value) (← inferType right.value)
    return (left, right)

end SourceReader

namespace ReadEquationRules

open SourceReader

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let source := context.source
  let equationOperands := equationOperands context
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term = $right:cas_term)
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term is $right:cas_term) => do
    -- Within a term, `=` is the equality predicate of the operands' common domain; `a is b` is
    -- the same statement.
    let (left, right) ← equationOperands left right
    return ⟨← mkEq left.value right.value, none⟩
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term and $right:cas_term) => do
    -- The conjunction of two statements, each read as a proposition. Nothing is decided here.
    let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
    let proposition := some (mkSort .zero)
    let left ← readExpression context.categoryOf left proposition
    let right ← readExpression context.categoryOf right proposition
    return ⟨← mkAppM ``And #[left.value, right.value], none⟩
  | _ => throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadEquationRules
