partial def readExpressionApplicable
    (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (source : TSyntax `cas_term) (expected : Option Expr)
    (qualification : Option String := none)
    (expectedCategory : Option NativeSourceCategory := none) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let scope ← get
  let categoryOf := fun id => do
    if let some selected := scope.selections.findAt? scope.context (mkFVar id) then
      if selected.formalBindings.isEmpty then
        if let some category := selected.category then return some category
    categoryOf id
  readWithCompletingRules sourceRules ⟨categoryOf, source, expected, qualification, expectedCategory,
    readProjection, fun categoryOf source expected qualification expectedCategory =>
      readExpressionApplicable categoryOf source expected qualification expectedCategory⟩

def readExpression
    (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (source : TSyntax `cas_term) (expected : Option Expr)
    (qualification : Option String := none)
    (expectedCategory : Option NativeSourceCategory := none) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  SourceReadM.withRef source do
    match ← readExpressionApplicable categoryOf source expected qualification expectedCategory with
    | .ok value => pure value
    | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

/-- Read a whole source term. Each variable of a ring `R[v]` that the term writes and uses free is
bound to that ring's registered generator for this term only.
Source: the public language contract, "`R[x]`: the polynomials over `R`, whose generator `x`
names". A variable named by two different written rings is ambiguous. -/
partial def withRingVariables
    (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (recorded : Array (Name × Expr × Option Nat))
    (source : TSyntax `cas_term) (read : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let mut written : Array (Name × Syntax × Option Nat) := #[]
  for (name, ring, index) in sourceRingVariables source.raw do
    unless sourceUses name source.raw && !sourceBinds name source.raw do continue
    if let some (_, other, _) := written.find? (·.1 == name) then
      unless other.reprint == ring.reprint do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwSemanticAmbiguity m!"{name} is the variable of several rings"
      continue
    written := written.push (name, ring, index)
  -- The rings of the definitions the term uses supply the variables it does not write.
  let mut inherited : Array (Name × Expr × Option Nat) := #[]
  for (name, carrier, index) in recorded do
    unless sourceUses name source.raw && !sourceBinds name source.raw do continue
    if written.any (·.1 == name) then continue
    if let some (_, other, _) := inherited.find? (·.1 == name) then
      unless other == carrier do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwSemanticAmbiguity m!"{name} is the variable of several rings"
      continue
    inherited := inherited.push (name, carrier, index)
  let mut bindings : Array (Name × Sum Syntax Expr × Option Nat) := #[]
  for (name, ring, index) in written do bindings := bindings.push (name, .inl ring, index)
  for (name, carrier, index) in inherited do bindings := bindings.push (name, .inr carrier, index)
  bind bindings.toList
where
  bind : List (Name × Sum Syntax Expr × Option Nat) → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement
    | [] => read
    | (name, ring, index) :: rest => do
      if ((← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? name).isSome then return ← bind rest
      let carrier ← match ring with
        | .inl ring => pure (← sourceCarrier (← readExpression categoryOf ⟨ring⟩ none)).value
        | .inr carrier => pure carrier
      let some generator ← sourceGeneratorAt? carrier index
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the ring of {name} has no registered generator"
      SourceReadM.withBinder name carrier (some generator) .default
        (fun bound judgement => do
          let close := fun value => mkLetFVars #[bound.expression] value
            (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
          return { judgement with
            value := ← close judgement.value
            category := ← judgement.category.mapM (NativeSourceCategory.mapM close) })
        (fun _ => bind rest)

/-- Read a whole source term with its written rings' variables (`withRingVariables`). -/
def readSourceTerm (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (recorded : Array (Name × Expr × Option Nat))
    (source : TSyntax `cas_term) (expected : Option Expr) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  withRingVariables categoryOf recorded source (readExpression categoryOf source expected)

/-- `a = b` in a question: native equality of the operands at their common domain, as in
SourceEquality and the public claimEqual contract. Formation supplies no proof. -/
def sourceEquation (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (left right : TSyntax `cas_term) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let equation ← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $left:cas_term = $right:cas_term)
  return (← readExpression categoryOf equation (some (mkSort .zero))).value

end CasCompiler

public import CasCompiler.ReadContext

public import CasCompiler.CategoricalPointFamily

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

namespace SourceReader

def readFunctorAction (context : ReadContext) :
    SourceCategoryRole → TSyntax `cas_term → Ident → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let application := application context
  fun (role : SourceCategoryRole) (receiver : TSyntax `cas_term)
      (id : Ident) (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) => do
    let entry ← selectView (id.getId.toString (escape := false))
    let receiver ← readExpression categoryOf receiver none
    if let some category := receiver.category then
      unless category.role == role do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError (MessageData.tagged
          `CasCompiler.SourceReader.actionRole
          m!"the source functor action has a different object or morphism role")
    match entry with
    | .construction entry =>
      sourceConstruction entry receiver (arguments.map fun parameter type => do
          return (← readExpression categoryOf parameter (some type)).value)
    | .registered entry => do
      let selected ← viewExpressions entry
        (receiver.category.map fun category => (category.expression, category.bundle)) fun constant =>
        application ⟨constant, none⟩ arguments none
      let image ← match role with
        | .object => functorObject selected.functor receiver.value selected.targetBundle
        | .morphism => do
          let function ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map #[selected.functor]
          -- AppBuilder protects pre-existing metavariables. Native source application must
          -- solve the selected declaration's levels at the actual arrow in this context.
          let image ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr receiver.value] none false false
          -- The inferred implicit endpoints are convertible, not necessarily the exact
          -- selected occurrences. Retain the original arrow's complete stated Hom type
          -- (including selected Arrow projections) at the very same native action slots.
          let stated ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType receiver.value)
          let type ← if stated.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure stated else whnfR stated
          unless image.getAppFn.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map do
            liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected functor map lost its native arrow interface"
          let arguments := image.getAppArgs
          unless arguments.size >= 3 do
            liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected functor map lost its endpoint slots"
          -- A native implementation of Hom (e.g. a formal TypeCat.Hom or
          -- CommRingCat.Hom parameter) need not have a Quiver.Hom head.
          -- In that case the checked application already supplies the native
          -- endpoints. Do not invent a new category or select a new arrow.
          let arguments := if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
              (arguments.set! (arguments.size - 3) type.getAppArgs[2]!).set!
                (arguments.size - 2) type.getAppArgs[3]!
            else if type.isAppOfArity ``TypeCat.Hom 2 then
              (arguments.set! (arguments.size - 3) type.getAppArgs[0]!).set!
                (arguments.size - 2) type.getAppArgs[1]!
            else arguments
          let retained := mkAppN image.getAppFn (arguments.set! (arguments.size - 1) receiver.value)
          let retained ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars retained
          check retained
          unless ← isDefEq retained image do
            liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected functor map changed its native action"
          pure retained
      let edge := match selected.reference with
        | .inl id => CasCatalogue.EdgeRef.functor id
        | .inr id => CasCatalogue.EdgeRef.classifierForget id
      let carrier : Option NativeSourceCarrierSelection ←
          match receiver.category.bind (·.carrier) with
        | none => pure none
        | some carrier =>
          if role != .object || carrier.refs[0]? != some edge then pure none
          else do
            let some action := carrier.actions[0]?
              | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected carrier prefix has no complete native edge application"
            let action ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars action
            let actual ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars selected.functor
            let agrees ← if action == actual then pure true else do
              if action.hasMVar || action.hasLevelMVar || actual.hasMVar || actual.hasLevelMVar then
                liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource
                  "carrier-prefix comparison requires its complete native view parameters"
              withoutModifyingState <| isDefEq action actual
            pure <| if agrees then
              some { carrier with refs := carrier.refs.drop 1, actions := carrier.actions.drop 1 }
            else none
      let .const declaration levels := selected.application.getAppFn
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected action lost its original declaration"
      unless declaration == selected.declaration do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected action changed its original declaration"
      let parameters := selected.application.getAppArgs
      let result ← match role with
        | .object => do
          let family ← SourceActionFamily.forEdge edge
          family.selected levels parameters receiver.value
        | .morphism => do
          let family ← (← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.action edge)).asReference
          let inferred ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType receiver.value)
          let endpoints ← if inferred.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
              pure (inferred.getAppArgs[2]!, inferred.getAppArgs[3]!)
            else do
              let some endpoints ← mapEnds receiver.value
                | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source map action lost its original endpoints"
              pure endpoints
          let parameters := parameters ++ #[endpoints.1, endpoints.2, receiver.value]
          let (arrow, bundle) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
          let (domain, _) ← categoricalPointEndpoints arrow
          let identity ← categoricalPointIdentity bundle domain
          family.selected levels parameters domain { value := identity }
      let scope ← get
      let agrees ← scope.context.withOriginalSources #[result.value, image] fun original =>
        isDefEq original[0]! original[1]!
      unless agrees do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected action changed its whole native result"
      let category : NativeSourceCategory :=
        ⟨role, selected.target, selected.targetBundle, carrier, none⟩
      let value ← SourceReadM.select { result with value := image, category := some category }
      return ⟨value, some category⟩

end SourceReader

namespace ReadFunctorRules

open SourceReader

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let expected := context.expected
  let readFunctorAction := readFunctorAction context
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term → $right:cas_term) => do
    let left ← sourceCarrier (← readExpression categoryOf left none)
    let right ← sourceCarrier (← readExpression categoryOf right none)
    let value ← mkAppM ``TypeCat.Hom #[left.value, right.value]
    sourceSetJudgement .object value
  | `(cas_term| view $receiver:cas_term along $functor:ident) =>
    readFunctorAction .object receiver functor #[]
  | `(cas_term| view $receiver:cas_term along $functor:ident($arguments:cas_term,*)) =>
    readFunctorAction .object receiver functor arguments.getElems
  | `(cas_term| map $receiver:cas_term along $functor:ident($arguments:cas_term,*)) =>
    readFunctorAction .morphism receiver functor arguments.getElems
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term ∘ $right:cas_term) => do
    let left ← readExpression categoryOf left none
    let right ← readExpression categoryOf right none
    let (left, right) ← sourceCommonCategory left right
    let some category := left.category <|> right.category
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source composition requires its selected category"
    for selected in #[left.category, right.category] do
      if let some selected := selected then
        unless selected.role == .morphism do
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source composition requires morphisms"
        unless selected.expression.syntacticEq category.expression &&
            (← isDefEq selected.bundle category.bundle) do
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source composition has different complete selected categories"
    let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[category.bundle]
    let categoryInstance ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.str #[category.bundle]
    let categoryStructure ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct
      #[some carrier, some categoryInstance]
    let composition ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
      #[some carrier, some categoryStructure]
    -- CategoryStruct.comp takes the earlier arrow first; source writes the later one first.
    let value ← elabAppArgs composition #[] #[Arg.expr right.value, Arg.expr left.value]
      expected false false
    pure ⟨value, some category⟩
  | _ => throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadFunctorRules

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.ReadContext
public import CasCompiler.SourceProof
public import CasCatalogue.Decide
import CasCompiler.SourceCarrier

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

namespace ReadGraphRules

open SourceReader

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| {$pairs:cas_pair,*} : $source:cas_term → $target:cas_term) => do
    -- The map with this graph, through the registered graph literal of the endpoints'
    -- category. Totality and distinct arguments are decided by the kernel on the literal.
    let domain ← readExpression categoryOf source none
    let codomain ← readExpression categoryOf target none
    let (domain, codomain) ← sourceCommonCategory domain codomain
    let some category := domain.category
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a graph literal requires its selected category"
    unless category.role == .object && codomain.category.any (·.role == .object) do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a graph literal maps between objects"
    let state ← CasCatalogue.semanticState
    let rows := state.graphLiterals.filter fun row => state.categories.any fun entry =>
      entry.id == row.category && entry.expression.syntacticEq category.expression
    let #[row] := rows
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource "the selected category has no registered graph literal"
    let sourceCarrierType := (← sourceCarrier domain).value
    let targetCarrierType := (← sourceCarrier codomain).value
    let pairType ← mkAppM ``Prod #[sourceCarrierType, targetCarrierType]
    let mut elements := #[]
    for pair in pairs.getElems do
      let `(cas_pair| $argument:cas_term ↦ $result:cas_term) := pair
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a graph literal lists pairs `x ↦ y`"
      let argument ← readExpression categoryOf argument (some sourceCarrierType)
      let result ← readExpression categoryOf result (some targetCarrierType)
      elements := elements.push (← mkAppOptM ``Prod.mk
        #[some sourceCarrierType, some targetCarrierType, some argument.value, some result.value])
    let graph ← mkListLit pairType elements.toList
    discard <| checkedDeclaration row.denotation
    let constant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels row.denotation
    let before ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
    let (arguments, infos, type) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType constant)
    let owned := (← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx).decls.foldl (fun result identity _ =>
      if before.decls.contains identity then result else result.push identity) #[]
    let type ← whnfR type
    unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered graph literal does not denote a map"
    unless ← isDefEq type.getAppArgs[2]! domain.value <&&>
        isDefEq type.getAppArgs[3]! codomain.value do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered graph literal has different endpoints"
    let explicit := (List.range arguments.size).toArray.filter (infos[·]!.isExplicit)
    let some first := explicit[0]? | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the graph literal takes no graph"
    unless ← isDefEq arguments[first]! graph do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the graph literal does not accept this list of pairs"
    for argument in arguments, info in infos do
      if info.isInstImplicit && (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars argument).isMVar then
        let some instanceValue ← synthInstance? (← inferType argument)
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the graph literal lacks its declared decidable equality"
        discard <| isDefEq argument instanceValue
    for index in explicit.drop 1 do
      let obligation ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType arguments[index]!)
      let proof ← SourceReadM.prove obligation fun original _ => do
        let some proof ← CasCatalogue.Decide.decisionProof original
          | CasCatalogue.throwStratum .invalid m!"the graph does not list each element once: {original}"
        return proof
      extendSourceApplicationScope owned
      discard <| isDefEq arguments[index]! proof
    let value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN constant arguments)
    let category := { category with role := .morphism, carrier := none, limit := none }
    let selected ← sourceReferenceAt (.graph row) value value
    let value ← selectMorphism { selected with category := some category }
      (fun selected expected => SourceReadM.select selected expected) (some category.bundle)
    return ⟨value, some category⟩
  | _ => throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadGraphRules

end CasCompiler

public import CasCompiler.ReadContext
public import CasCompiler.SourcePattern
public import CasCompiler.SourceRing

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

namespace SourceReader

def lambda (context : ReadContext) :
    TSyntax `cas_term → TSyntax `cas_term → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let expected := context.expected
  fun (pattern body : TSyntax `cas_term) => do
    let some expected := expected
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source lambda requires its independently declared function type"
    let type ← whnf expected
    if type.isAppOf ``TypeCat.Hom then
      -- Mathlib's set-map constructor wraps this exact native function. It supplies
      -- no structured-map laws; the complete declared Hom type fixes both endpoints.
      let constructor ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``TypeCat.ofHom
      let hole ← mkFreshExprMVar none
      discard <| elabAppArgs constructor #[] #[Arg.expr hole] (some expected) false false
      let function ← readExpression categoryOf source (some (← inferType hole))
      let value ← elabAppArgs constructor #[] #[Arg.expr function.value]
        (some expected) false false
      return ← sourceSetJudgement .morphism value
    let .forallE _ domain codomain binderInfo := type
      | do
        -- `x ↦ e` in `R[x]`: the element `e` with `x` the ring's registered generator.
        let `(cas_term| $name:ident) := pattern
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource
              "source lambda formation is not implemented for this declared map type"
        let some generator ← sourceGeneratorAt? expected none
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource
              "source lambda formation is not implemented for this declared map type"
        let value ← SourceReadM.withLet name.getId expected generator fun _ => do
          return (← readExpression categoryOf body (some expected)).value
        return ⟨value, none⟩
    let value ← sourcePatternLambda pattern domain binderInfo fun parameter => do
      return (← readExpression categoryOf body (some (codomain.instantiate1 parameter))).value
    return ⟨value, none⟩

end SourceReader

namespace ReadLambdaRules

open SourceReader

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let source := context.source
  let lambda := lambda context
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| $name:ident ↦ $body:cas_term) => do
    lambda (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $name:ident)) body
  | `(cas_term| ($first:cas_term, $rest:cas_term,*) ↦ $body:cas_term) => do
    lambda (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| ($first:cas_term, $rest:cas_term,*))) body
  | _ => throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadLambdaRules

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.ReadContext
public import CasCompiler.ReadApplication
public import CasCompiler.SourcePresentation
public import CasCompiler.SourceLift

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

namespace ReadLiftRules

open SourceReader

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let application := application context
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| map $point:cas_term along $name:ident) => do
    let selected ← sourcePresentation name.getId.toString false fun declaration =>
      application ⟨declaration, none⟩ #[] none
    return ⟨← application selected #[point] context.expected, none⟩
  | `(cas_term| map $point:cas_term back along $name:ident) => do
    let selected ← sourcePresentation name.getId.toString true fun declaration =>
      application ⟨declaration, none⟩ #[] none
    return ⟨← application selected #[point] context.expected, none⟩
  | `(cas_term| presentation($name:ident($arguments:cas_term,*))) =>
    sourcePresentation name.getId.toString false fun declaration =>
      application ⟨declaration, none⟩ arguments.getElems none
  | `(cas_term| inverse_presentation($name:ident($arguments:cas_term,*))) =>
    sourcePresentation name.getId.toString true fun declaration =>
      application ⟨declaration, none⟩ arguments.getElems none
  | `(cas_term| lift($receiver:cas_term) along $id:ident($arguments:cas_term,*)
      with $input:cas_term using $evidence:cas_term) => do
    let state ← CasCatalogue.semanticState
    let #[row] := state.lifts.filter
      (·.id.raw == id.getId.toString (escape := false))
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "selected source lifting requires one registered lift"
    discard <| checkedDeclaration row.evidence
    if let some computation := row.computation then discard <| checkedDeclaration computation
    checkEdgeDeclarations state row.edge
    CasCatalogue.validateLift state row
    let receiver ← readExpression categoryOf receiver none
    let selected ← application ⟨← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels row.evidence, none⟩
      arguments.getElems none
    let input ← readExpression categoryOf input none
    let `(cas_term| proof($proof:term)) := evidence
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a selected lift requires explicit native monicity evidence"
    let proof ← elabTermEnsuringType proof none
    sourceSelectedLift row receiver input selected proof
  | `(cas_term| factor($base:cas_term) through $lift:cas_term with $source:cas_term
      using $evidence:cas_term) => do
    let lift ← readExpression categoryOf lift none
    let base ← readExpression categoryOf base none
    let source ← readExpression categoryOf source none
    let `(cas_term| proof($proof:term)) := evidence
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source factor requires its explicit native equation"
    let proof ← elabTermEnsuringType proof none
    sourceLiftFactor lift base.value source.value proof
  | _ => throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadLiftRules

public import CasCompiler.ReadContext

public import CasCompiler.SourceMethod

import CasCompiler.SourceCarrier

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

namespace SourceReader

/-- The actual producer of a typed member reading, retained for competition and observation. -/
inductive MemberEvidence where
  | projection
  | image
  | method (choice : SourceMemberChoice SourceMethodEvidence)
  | family (row : MorphismEntry) (slot : Nat)
  | property (choice : SourceMemberChoice SourcePropertyEvidence)
  | element (row : MorphismEntry)

private def memberChoice (choice : SourceMemberChoice α) (evidence : MemberEvidence) :
    SourceMemberChoice MemberEvidence :=
  { path := choice.path
    evidence := evidence
    judgement := choice.judgement
    nativeState := choice.nativeState
    sourceScope := choice.sourceScope
    localContext := choice.localContext
    localInstances := choice.localInstances }

-- A family was already formed at its complete source parameters. Its additional operands
-- are read once at their declared domains; the result's common final check runs afterward.
private def applyMemberFamily (context : ReadContext) (family : NativeSourceJudgement)
    (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  if arguments.isEmpty then return .ok family
  if arguments.size == 1 then
    return ← applicationResultApplicable context family arguments none
  let function ← sourceFunction family
  let applied ← elabSourceApplicationApplicableScoped function #[Syntax.missing] none
    fun _ type => sourceTupleApplicable arguments type fun source type => do
      match ← context.readExpressionApplicable context.categoryOf source (some type) with
      | .ok value => return .ok value.value
      | .error message => return .error message
  match applied with
  | .ok (value, _) => return .ok ⟨value, none⟩
  | .error message => return .error message

/-- Resolve the actual candidate states. Discovery uses this same selection boundary,
without rerunning the receiver or its candidate producers. -/
def completeMemberChoices (context : ReadContext) (complete : ReadCompletion)
    (name : String) (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term))
    (considered : Array NativeSourceCategory)
    (choices : Array (SourceMemberChoice MemberEvidence))
    (priorMismatches : Array MessageData := #[]) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let (readings, completedMismatches) ← SourceMemberChoice.collectApplicable <|
    choices.map fun choice => choice.withScope do
      let applied ← match choice.evidence with
        | .method _ | .family .. => applyMemberFamily context choice.judgement arguments
        | _ => pure (.ok choice.judgement)
      let value ← match applied with
        | .error message => return .error message
        | .ok value => pure value
      match ← complete value with
      | .error message => return .error message
      | .ok value =>
        return .ok (some (← SourceMemberChoice.capture choice.path choice.evidence value))
  let mismatches := priorMismatches ++ completedMismatches
  let considered := considered ++ choices.filterMap (·.path.receiver.category)
  let preferred ← sourceMemberPreference name considered (readings.map (·.path))
  let surviving : Array (SourceMemberChoice MemberEvidence × Option Route) := match preferred with
    | none => readings.map fun choice => (choice, none)
    | some selected => selected.filterMap fun (selection : Nat × Route) =>
        readings[selection.1]?.map fun choice => (choice, some selection.2)
  let some (first, preference) := surviving[0]?
    | if let some message := mismatches[0]? then return .error message
      else liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError (MessageData.tagged `CasCompiler.SourceReader.memberReceiver
          m!"no declared member family accepts this complete selected receiver")
  first.withScope do
    let methods := surviving.filterMap fun (choice, _) =>
      match choice.evidence with | .method original => some original | _ => none
    let properties := surviving.filterMap fun (choice, _) =>
      match choice.evidence with | .property original => some original | _ => none
    let judgement ← if methods.size == surviving.size then
      let result ← retainSourceMethodAgreements methods first.judgement
      checkSourceMemberSelections (surviving.map (·.1))
      pure result
    else if properties.size == surviving.size then
      let result ← retainSourcePropertyAgreements name properties first.judgement
      checkSourceMemberSelections (surviving.map (·.1))
      pure result
    else if surviving.size == 1 then
      pure first.judgement
    else if surviving.all (fun (choice, _) =>
        match choice.evidence with | .family .. => true | _ => false) then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwSemanticAmbiguity "several declared member parameters accept this selected receiver"
    else if surviving.all (fun (choice, _) =>
        match choice.evidence with | .element _ => true | _ => false) then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwSemanticAmbiguity s!"several registered morphisms {name} accept this element"
    else if surviving.size == 2 && methods.size == 1 && surviving.any (fun (choice, _) =>
        match choice.evidence with | .family .. => true | _ => false) then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwSemanticAmbiguity "a method and a member family both accept this selected receiver"
    else
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwSemanticAmbiguity
          "several declared member readings accept this complete selected receiver"
    return .ok (← retainMemberPreference judgement preference)

/-- Notation which explicitly denotes an inherited method (for example cardinality bars)
uses the same completed choices without rereading its already formed receiver. -/
def methodCompleting (context : ReadContext) (complete : ReadCompletion)
    (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (name : String) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let methods ← sourceMethodChoices receiver name
  if methods.isEmpty then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected source object has no declared {name} method"
  completeMemberChoices context complete name #[] receiver.category.toArray
    (methods.map fun choice => memberChoice choice (.method choice))

/-- The uncompleted readings of an actual receiver. The considered category data
also retain those source routes whose native candidate was rejected. -/
structure MemberCandidates where
  choices : Array (SourceMemberChoice MemberEvidence)
  considered : Array NativeSourceCategory
  mismatches : Array MessageData

/-- Collect the same alternatives for ordinary source reading and discovery.
No receiver is reread and no additional argument is manufactured. -/
def memberChoicesAtReceiver (context : ReadContext)
    (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (name : String)
    (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term))
    (readArguments : Option (Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr))) :
    SourceReadM MemberCandidates := do
  let object ← match ← sourceExtent? receiver with
    | some extent => pure extent
    | none => pure receiver
  let direct : Array (SourceReadM
      (Except MessageData (Option (SourceMemberChoice MemberEvidence)))) := #[
    do
      let some value ← context.project receiver name arguments | return .ok none
      return .ok (some (← SourceMemberChoice.capture ⟨receiver, none⟩ .projection value)),
    do
      unless name == "image" && arguments.isEmpty do return .ok none
      let some (domain, codomain) ← mapEnds receiver.value | return .ok none
      let value ← sourceImageOf (← sourcePowerObjectAt codomain) domain receiver.value none
      return .ok (some (← SourceMemberChoice.capture ⟨receiver, none⟩ .image ⟨value, none⟩))]
  let (direct, _) ← SourceMemberChoice.collectApplicable direct
  let methods ← sourceMethodChoices object name
  let families ← sourceMemberFamilyChoices object name context.qualification
  let properties ← if arguments.isEmpty then sourcePropertyChoices object name else pure #[]
  let (elements, mismatches) ← sourceElementMemberChoices name (some receiver)
    (fun _ => pure (.ok receiver.value)) readArguments
  let choices := direct ++
    methods.map (fun choice => memberChoice choice (.method choice)) ++
    families.map (fun choice => memberChoice choice (.family choice.evidence.1 choice.evidence.2)) ++
    properties.map (fun choice => memberChoice choice (.property choice)) ++
    elements.map (fun choice => memberChoice choice (.element choice.evidence))
  return ⟨choices, receiver.category.toArray ++ object.category.toArray, mismatches⟩

/-- All actual member kinds compete with their complete native source and route data.
The dispatcher's common completion runs once in each candidate state. C6 then selects
only among the surviving readings, and the exact chosen state is returned without replay. -/
def memberCompleting (context : ReadContext) (complete : ReadCompletion)
    (receiverSource : TSyntax `cas_term) (name : String)
    (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let readArguments : Option (Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr)) :=
    if arguments.isEmpty then none else some fun type => do
      if let #[argument] := arguments then
        return (← context.readExpressionApplicable context.categoryOf argument (some type)).map
          (·.value)
      sourceTupleApplicable arguments type fun source type => do
        return (← context.readExpressionApplicable context.categoryOf source (some type)).map
          (·.value)
  -- A numeral has no selected source object until an actual declared element map supplies
  -- its domain. Number-system atoms still name objects and enter the ordinary competition.
  if sourceNumeric receiverSource.raw &&
      !receiverSource.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casAtom then
    let (elements, mismatches) ← sourceElementMemberChoices name none
      (fun type => do
        return (← context.readExpressionApplicable context.categoryOf receiverSource
          (some type)).map (·.value)) readArguments
    if elements.isEmpty && mismatches.isEmpty then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "no registered morphism {name} accepts this numeral"
    return ← completeMemberChoices context complete name arguments #[]
      (elements.map fun choice => memberChoice choice (.element choice.evidence)) mismatches

  let receiver ← context.readExpression context.categoryOf receiverSource none
  let candidates ← memberChoicesAtReceiver context receiver name arguments readArguments
  completeMemberChoices context complete name arguments candidates.considered
    candidates.choices candidates.mismatches

/-- Compatibility entrance for a rule which leaves final completion to its caller. -/
def member (context : ReadContext) (receiver : TSyntax `cas_term) (name : String)
  (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  match ← memberCompleting context
      (checkReadJudgementApplicable { context with qualification := none, expectedCategory := none })
      receiver name arguments with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

end SourceReader

end CasCompiler

        (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $(mkIdentFrom source `abs):ident($operand:cas_term)))
        context.expected context.qualification context.expectedCategory)

      methodCompleting context complete receiver "cardinality"

module

public import CasCompiler.ReadContext

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

namespace ReadNameRules

open SourceReader

def ruleCompleting (context : ReadContext) (complete : ReadCompletion) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let expected := context.expected
  let qualification := context.qualification
  let expectedCategory := context.expectedCategory
  let registered := registeredCompleting context complete
  let member := memberCompleting context complete
  -- `m(X)` for a registered method or property `m` is `X.m()`. The rule applies when the name
  -- names no object, map, construction or limit shape, so no kind takes priority.
  let registeredOrMember : TSyntax `ident → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) →
      SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := fun name arguments => do
    let state ← CasCatalogue.semanticState
    let spelling := name.getId.toString (escape := false)
    let memberName := state.methods.any (·.name == spelling) ||
      state.properties.any (·.name == spelling)
    let otherKind := state.objects.any (·.name == spelling) ||
      state.morphisms.any (·.name == spelling) ||
      state.constructions.any (·.name == spelling) ||
      state.limits.any (·.shape == spelling)
    match memberName && !otherKind, arguments with
    | true, #[receiver] => member receiver spelling #[]
    | _, _ => registered name arguments
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| $name:ident) =>
    if let some declaration := (← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? name.getId then
      complete ⟨mkFVar declaration.fvarId, ← categoryOf declaration.fvarId⟩
    else if let some generator ← (sourceDifferentialOf? name.getId).filterM fun generator =>
        return ((← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? generator).isSome then
      -- `dv` for a bound variable `v` is its differential `d(v)` (public language contract).
      return .ok (← readExpression categoryOf
        (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $(mkIdentFrom name `d):ident($(mkIdentFrom name generator):ident)))
        expected qualification
        expectedCategory)
    else if name.getId == `false then complete ⟨mkConst ``False, none⟩
    else if name.getId == `true then complete ⟨mkConst ``True, none⟩
    else registered name #[]
  | `(cas_term| $name:ident($arguments:cas_term,*)) =>
    if ((← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? name.getId).isSome then
      registered name arguments.getElems
    else if let .str receiver field := name.getId then do
      if !receiver.isAnonymous &&
          ((← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? receiver).isSome then
        member (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $(mkIdentFrom name receiver):ident)) field arguments.getElems
      else
        -- `ℤ.is_finite()` lexes as one identifier. When the whole dotted name is not
        -- registered, the receiver is a term of the language read before the member.
        let state ← CasCatalogue.semanticState
        let spelling := name.getId.toString (escape := false)
        let named := state.objects.any (·.name == spelling) ||
          state.morphisms.any (·.name == spelling)
        let parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← liftM (m := MetaM) getEnv) `cas_term
          (receiver.toString (escape := false))
        match named || receiver.isAnonymous, parsed with
        | false, .ok source => member ⟨source⟩ field arguments.getElems
        | _, _ => registeredOrMember name arguments.getElems
    else registeredOrMember name arguments.getElems
  | _ => throwReadRuleMismatch

def ruleApplicable (context : ReadContext) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  ruleCompleting context (checkReadJudgementApplicable { context with qualification := none })

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  match ← ruleApplicable context with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

end ReadNameRules

end CasCompiler

public import CasCompiler.ReadContext
public import CasCompiler.PublishedSource
public import CasCompiler.ReadApplication
public import CasCompiler.SourceLimit
public import CasCompiler.SourceConstruction
public import CasCompiler.SourceRing
public import CasCompiler.SourceMember
public import CasCompiler.SourceAdmission

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

namespace SourceReader

def objectApplicable (context : ReadContext) :
    String → Option String → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) →
      SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  let expected := context.expected
  let application := application context
  fun (name : String) (category : Option String)
      (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) => do
    let selected ← selectObjectApplicable name category expected
    let (entry, categoryEntry) ← match selected with
      | .ok selected => pure selected
      | .error message => return .error message
    let (bundle, value) ← registeredExpressions (.inl entry) categoryEntry fun function expected =>
      application ⟨function, none⟩ arguments expected
    return .ok (⟨value, some ⟨.object, categoryEntry.expression, bundle,
      ← objectCarrierSelection entry bundle value, none⟩⟩ : NativeSourceJudgement)

def object (context : ReadContext) :
    String → Option String → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  fun name category arguments => do
    match ← objectApplicable context name category arguments with
    | .ok value => pure value
    | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

def registeredCompleting (context : ReadContext) (complete : ReadCompletion) :
    Ident → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) → SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let expected := context.expected
  let qualification := context.qualification
  let application := applicationApplicable context
  fun (name : Ident) (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) => do
    if let some declaration := (← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? name.getId then
      let selected ← categoryOf declaration.fvarId
      return ← applicationResultCompleting context ⟨mkFVar declaration.fvarId, selected⟩
        arguments expected complete
    -- `pullback(f, g)`: a registered universal construction named by its shape.
    let spelling := name.getId.toString (escape := false)
    if !arguments.isEmpty && (← CasCatalogue.semanticState).limits.any (·.shape == spelling) then
      let maps ← arguments.mapM (readExpression categoryOf · none)
      if let some limit ← sourceNamedLimit spelling maps then return ← complete limit
    if name.getId == `id then
      let #[argument] := arguments
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source identity requires one object"
      let object ← readExpression categoryOf argument none
      let object ← if object.category.isSome then pure object
        else sourceSetJudgement .object object.value
      let some category := object.category
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source identity requires its complete selected category"
      unless category.role == .object do liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source identity requires an object"
      let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[category.bundle]
      let instanceValue ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.str #[category.bundle]
      let structureValue ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct
        #[some carrier, some instanceValue]
      let function ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id
        #[some carrier, some structureValue]
      let value ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr object.value] expected false false
      return ← complete ⟨value, some { category with role := .morphism, carrier := none, limit := none }⟩
    let spelling := name.getId.toString (escape := false)
    let (spelling, arguments) ← do
      let state ← CasCatalogue.semanticState
      let some (base, number) := CasCatalogue.Language.subscripted? spelling
        | pure (spelling, arguments)
      if state.objects.any (·.name == spelling) || state.morphisms.any (·.name == spelling) ||
          !state.objects.any (·.name == base) then
        pure (spelling, arguments)
      else
        -- The documented leading parameter enters the same dependent application once.
        -- Exact lexical and registered spellings have already retained their own identity.
        let literal : TSyntax `num := ⟨Syntax.mkNumLit (toString number)⟩
        let leading ← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $literal:num)
        pure (base, #[leading] ++ arguments)
    let readNamed : SourceNamedEntry → SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := fun selected => do
     match selected with
     | .construction entry => do
       let some receiver := arguments.back?
         | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source construction requires its actual receiver"
       let receiver ← readExpression categoryOf receiver none
       return ← complete (← sourceConstruction entry receiver
         ((arguments.pop).map fun parameter type => do
           return (← readExpression categoryOf parameter (some type)).value))
     | .registered entry categoryEntry => do
       let declaration := match entry with
         | .inl entry => entry.declaration
         | .inr entry => entry.declaration
       let parameterCount ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState do
         let info ← checkedDeclaration declaration
         let (_, binders, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing info.type
         pure (binders.filter (·.isExplicit)).size
       -- `d(f)`: a named map applied to one element whose set fixes its declaration parameters,
       -- rather than one source argument per parameter (`rev(3, 2)`).
       if let (.inr row, #[argument]) := (entry, arguments) then
         if parameterCount > 0 && !sourceNumeric argument.raw then
           let element ← readExpression categoryOf argument none
           let type ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType element.value)
           let parameterMatches ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState do
             let info ← checkedDeclaration declaration
             let (parameters, binders, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing info.type
             let some (first, _) := (parameters.zip binders).find? (·.2.isExplicit)
               | throwError "the named map lost its declaration parameter"
             isDefEq type (← inferType first)
           -- An object argument instead indexes a family of global elements
           -- (`dimension(ℚ[x, y])`): it is read at the declared parameter type below.
           let indexing := element.category.any (·.role == .object)
           unless indexing || parameterMatches do
             let some morphism ← sourceMorphismFrom? row.name type (some row)
               | return .error m!"the named map {row.name} does not leave the set of its argument"
             let function ← sourceSetFunction morphism
             return ← complete ⟨← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr element.value] none false false, none⟩
       if arguments.size < parameterCount then
         return .error m!"the registered source declaration requires {parameterCount} explicit parameters"
       let formed ← PublishedSource.namedApplicable entry categoryEntry
         (fun selected expected => SourceReadM.select selected expected) fun function expected =>
           application ⟨function, none⟩ (arguments.take parameterCount) expected
       let (bundle, value) ← match formed with
         | .ok value => pure value
         | .error message => return .error message
       let role := match entry with
         | .inl _ => SourceCategoryRole.object
         | .inr _ => SourceCategoryRole.morphism
       let carrier ← match entry with
         | .inl object => objectCarrierSelection object bundle value
         | .inr _ => pure none
       let result : NativeSourceJudgement :=
         ⟨value, some ⟨role, categoryEntry.expression, bundle, carrier, none⟩⟩
       -- A named global element `1 ⟶ X` (`i`, `π`) read where an element of a set is expected
       -- is its value at the terminal point.
       if role == .morphism && parameterCount == arguments.size then
         if let some expected := expected then
           let expected ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars expected
           let type ← whnfR (← inferType value)
           if !expected.isSort && type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 &&
               !(← whnfR expected).isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
             let source ← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[2]!
             if (← synthInstance? (← mkAppM ``Unique #[source])).isSome then
               return ← complete ⟨← sourcePointValue value (some expected), none⟩
       if parameterCount < arguments.size then
         return ← applicationResultCompleting context result (arguments.drop parameterCount) expected complete
       return ← complete result
    let selection ← selectNamedApplicable spelling qualification expected
    let candidates ← match selection with
      | .ok selected => pure selected
      | .error message => return .error message
    SourceReadM.chooseApplicable (candidates.map readNamed)
      m!"no registered reading of source name {spelling} accepts its actual arguments"
      m!"source name {spelling} requires a category qualification"

/-- Direct compatibility callers keep the provided expected-type contract without replaying
the assembled rule's qualification. -/
def registeredApplicable (context : ReadContext) :
    Ident → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) → SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  registeredCompleting context
    (checkReadJudgementApplicable { context with qualification := none })

/-- Required named readings keep actual operand and construction errors at their source. -/
def registered (context : ReadContext) :
    Ident → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  fun name arguments => do
    match ← registeredApplicable context name arguments with
    | .ok value => pure value
    | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

def notationObject (context : ReadContext) :
    String → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) → SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  let application := application context
  fun (form : String) (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) => do
    let state ← CasCatalogue.semanticState
    let rows := state.objects.filter (·.notations.contains form)
    let #[entry] := rows
      | if rows.isEmpty then return none
        else liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwSemanticAmbiguity s!"several objects declare the notation {form}"
    let #[categoryEntry] := state.categories.filter (·.id == entry.category)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the notation object requires one complete category"
    let (bundle, value) ← registeredExpressions (.inl entry) categoryEntry fun function expected =>
      application ⟨function, none⟩ arguments expected
    return some (⟨value, some ⟨.object, categoryEntry.expression, bundle,
      ← objectCarrierSelection entry bundle value, none⟩⟩ : NativeSourceJudgement)

def objectPower (context : ReadContext) :
    TSyntax `cas_term → TSyntax `cas_term → SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let notationObject := notationObject context
  let registered := registered context
  fun (base power : TSyntax `cas_term) => do
    let `(cas_term| $_:num) := power | return none
    if let `(cas_term| ($inner:cas_term)) := base then
      if let `(cas_term| $atom:cas_term / $modulus:cas_term) := inner then
        if let some name := sourceAtomName? atom then
          if let some object ← notationObject s!"({name}/)^" #[modulus, power] then
            return some object
    let named := base.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casAtom || base.raw.isIdent ||
      (match base with
        | `(cas_term| $_:ident) => true
        | `(cas_term| $_:ident($_:cas_term,*)) => true
        | `(cas_term| ($_:cas_term)) => true
        | _ => false)
    unless named do return none
    let object ← readExpression categoryOf base none
    unless object.category.any (·.role == .object) do return none
    return some (← registered (mkIdentFrom source `Vec) #[base, power])

def relatedObject (context : ReadContext) :
    TSyntax `cas_term → (String → String) → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  fun (base : TSyntax `cas_term) (derived : String → String) => do
    let base ← readExpression categoryOf base none
    let state ← CasCatalogue.semanticState
    let (original, entries) ← registeredSourceDomain base.value
    let #[entry] := entries
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the derived object is formed of one registered object"
    let rows := state.objects.filter (·.name == derived entry.name)
    let #[target] := rows
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource s!"no registered object {derived entry.name}"
    let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == target.category)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the derived object requires one complete category"
    let arguments ← sourceExplicitArguments original
    let (bundle, value) ← registeredExpressions (.inl target) category fun function expected =>
      elabAppArgs function #[] (arguments.map Arg.expr) expected false false
    return (⟨value, some ⟨.object, category.expression, bundle,
      ← objectCarrierSelection target bundle value, none⟩⟩ : NativeSourceJudgement)

end SourceReader

end CasCompiler

namespace CasCompiler

namespace ReadNumeralRules

open SourceReader

/-- Numeric syntax has explicit absence only when its original point producer and every
registered inclusion have no reading. Admissions and object literals keep their existing
priority, and failed proof, domain or family checks never become absence. -/
private partial def numeralReading? (context : ReadContext) (number : Nat) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let some expected := context.expected
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source numeral requires its independently declared parameter type"
  if let some entry ← sourceAdmissionDomain? (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars expected) then
    return some ⟨← admitted context entry context.source expected, none⟩
  if let some category := context.expectedCategory then
    if let some value ← sourceObjectNumeral number category expected then return some value
  let direct ← SourceReadM.inspect do
    return (← sourceNumeral? context.categoryOf number expected).isSome
  if direct then
    return some ⟨← sourceNumeral context.categoryOf number expected, none⟩
  -- Inclusion sources use exactly the ordinary unqualified numeric rule order, followed
  -- by the assembled reader's same complete input checks on that successful judgement.
  let included ← sourceIncludedNumeral expected fun type => do
    let inner := { context with
      expected := some type
      qualification := none
      expectedCategory := none }
    let some judgement ← numeralReading? inner number | return none
    match ← checkReadJudgementApplicable inner judgement with
    | .ok judgement => return some judgement.value
    | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message
  return included.map fun value => ⟨value, none⟩

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let expected := context.expected
  let expectedCategory := context.expectedCategory
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| generator($object:cas_term)) => do
    let object ← readExpression categoryOf object none
    return ⟨← sourceObjectGenerator object, none⟩
  | `(cas_term| $number:num in $domain:cas_term using ($evidence:cas_term,*)) => do
    let domain ← readExpression categoryOf domain none
    let some category := domain.category
      | throwReadRuleMismatch
    unless category.role == .object do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source numeral evidence requires a domain object"
    discard <| getLevel domain.value
    if let some expected := expected then
      checkRegisteredSourceDomains domain.value expected
    let proofs ← evidence.getElems.mapM fun evidence => do
      let `(cas_term| proof($body:term)) := evidence
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source numeral evidence requires the explicit proof wrapper"
      pure body
    pure ⟨← sourceNumeral categoryOf number.getNat domain.value proofs, none⟩
  | `(cas_term| ℵ₀) => do
    let some expected := expected
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a named object literal requires its selected category"
    let some category := expectedCategory
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a named object literal requires its selected category"
    let some value ← sourceObjectNamedLiteral `«ℵ₀» category expected
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected category has no registered named literal form"
    return value
  | `(cas_term| $number:num) => do
    if let some value ← numeralReading? context number.getNat then return value
    let some expected := expected
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source numeral requires its independently declared parameter type"
    pure ⟨← sourceNumeral categoryOf number.getNat expected, none⟩
  | _ => throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadNumeralRules

end CasCompiler

/-- Reuse an already read operand at its declared operation input. The same registered
coercions and exact-domain checks as ordinary operations apply; only their own explicit
native mismatch is a rejected candidate. The source expression is never read again. -/
private def retainedOperandApplicable (reference : Syntax) (value expected : Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) := SourceReadM.withRef reference do
  unless ← withoutModifyingState (isDefEq (← inferType value) expected) do
    if let some mapped ← sourceCoercion? value expected then return .ok mapped
  match ← registeredSourceDomainsApplicable (← inferType value) expected with
  | .error message => return .error message
  | .ok () => pure ()
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) expected do
    return .error m!"the retained operand has a different declared domain"
  return .ok value

private def elementOperationCore (context : ReadContext) :
    String → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) → Array (Option Expr) → Option Expr → ExceptT MessageData SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let expected := context.expected
  fun (name : String) (operands : Array (TSyntax `cas_term))
      (numerals : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) (known : Array (Option Expr))
      (domainHint : Option Expr) => do
    let mut retained : Array (Option Expr) := Array.replicate operands.size none
    let mut hints : Array Expr := #[]
    for operand in operands, index in [:operands.size] do
      if let some (some value) := known[index]? then
        retained := retained.set! index (some value)
        hints := hints.push (← inferType value)
        continue
      if let `(cas_term| $identifier:ident) := operand then
        if ((← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? identifier.getId).isSome then
          let value ← readExpression categoryOf operand none
          retained := retained.set! index (some value.value)
          hints := hints.push (← inferType value.value)
    let contextual ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| expected.mapM instantiateMVars
    let contextual := contextual.filter (! ·.headBeta.consumeMData.getAppFn.isMVar)
    let inputContext := contextual.filter (! ·.headBeta.consumeMData.isSort)
    -- Actual typed operands determine the input domain before the expected result.
    -- Relations land in Ω; that result must not replace their selected operand owner.
    let domain ← match domainHint.or (← sourceCommonDomain hints) |>.or inputContext with
      | some type => pure type
      | none => do
        let mut domain := hints[0]?
        if domain.isNone then
          for operand in operands, index in [:operands.size] do
            if let `(cas_term| $_:num) := operand then continue
            let value ← readExpression categoryOf operand none
            retained := retained.set! index (some value.value)
            hints := hints.push (← inferType value.value)
          domain ← sourceCommonDomain hints
        if let some selectedDomain := domain then pure selectedDomain
        else do
          let defaults := (← CasCatalogue.semanticState).objects.filter
            (·.notations.contains "literal.integral.domain")
          let #[entry] := defaults
            | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwSemanticAmbiguity "the source operation requires its scalar domain"
          discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
          mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
    let originalOperand := retained
    let operationHints := if domainHint.isSome then #[domain] else hints
    let operation ← sourceOperation categoryOf name domain contextual operationHints operands.size
      (numerals.map fun numeral type => do
        return (← readExpression categoryOf numeral (some type)).value)
    let function ← sourceSetFunction operation.value
    let argument ← mkFreshExprMVar none
    discard <| elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr argument] none false false
    let cursor : IO.Ref Nat ← liftM (m := IO) (IO.mkRef 0)
    let readOperand : TSyntax `cas_term → Expr → ExceptT MessageData SourceReadM Expr := fun source type => do
      let index : Nat ← liftM (m := IO) cursor.get
      liftM (m := IO) (cursor.set (index + 1))
      let some transport := operation.inputTransports[index]?
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source operation lost its declared operand position"
      let read : Expr → ExceptT MessageData SourceReadM Expr := fun expected => do
        if let some (some value) := originalOperand[index]? then
          return ← ExceptT.mk <| retainedOperandApplicable source value expected
        let result ← ExceptT.mk <|
          context.readExpressionApplicable categoryOf source (some expected)
        return result.value
      if transport then
        let some comparison := operation.comparison
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source operand lost its supplied comparison"
        let iso ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
        let value ← read iso.getAppArgs[3]!
        let inverse ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv #[comparison]
        let inverse ← sourceSetFunction inverse
        elabAppArgs inverse #[] #[Arg.expr value] (some type) false false
      else if operation.inputDomains[index]?.getD false then read domain
      else read type
    let type ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType argument)
    let value ← if operands.size == 1 then do
        let some operand := operands[0]?
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source operation requires its original operand"
        readOperand operand type
      else ExceptT.mk <| sourceTupleApplicable operands type fun source type =>
        (readOperand source type).run
    let value ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr value] none false false
    let value ← if operation.outputTransport then do
        let some comparison := operation.comparison
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source result lost its supplied comparison"
        let forward ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[comparison]
        let forward ← sourceSetFunction forward
        elabAppArgs forward #[] #[Arg.expr value] expected false false
      else if operation.outputDomain then mkExpectedTypeHint value domain
      else pure value
    return (⟨value, none⟩ : NativeSourceJudgement)

/-- Ordinary operation formation with explicit applicability of its own typed operands.
Selected family, evidence, instance and recursive-reader errors remain exceptions. -/
def elementOperationApplicable (context : ReadContext)
    (name : String) (operands numerals : Array (TSyntax `cas_term))
    (known : Array (Option Expr)) (domainHint : Option Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  (elementOperationCore context name operands numerals known domainHint).run

def elementOperation (context : ReadContext)
    (name : String) (operands numerals : Array (TSyntax `cas_term))
    (known : Array (Option Expr)) (domainHint : Option Expr) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  match ← elementOperationApplicable context name operands numerals known domainHint with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

def action (context : ReadContext) :
    TSyntax `cas_term → TSyntax `cas_term → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let expected := context.expected
  let elementOperation := elementOperation context
  fun (left right : TSyntax `cas_term) => do
    let rightExpected := if sourceNumeric right.raw then expected else none
    let value ← readExpression categoryOf right rightExpected
    elementOperation "•" #[left, right] #[] #[none, some value.value]
      (some (← inferType value.value))

/-- All declared juxtaposition readings compete at the same original typed operands.
Every successful native state is retained, so the unique chosen reading is not replayed.
An exception from a matched reader is never discarded to choose another interpretation. -/
def juxtapose (context : ReadContext) :
    TSyntax `cas_term → TSyntax `cas_term → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let expected := context.expected
  fun (left right : TSyntax `cas_term) => do
    let rightExpected := if sourceNumeric right.raw then expected else none
    let rightValue ← readExpression categoryOf right rightExpected
    let leftValue ← if sourceNumeric left.raw then pure none
      else pure (some (← readExpression categoryOf left none))
    let names ← sourceJuxtapositionNames categoryOf leftValue rightValue
    let unavailable : MessageData :=
      "no declared juxtaposition reading accepts the original operands"
    let direct : Array (SourceReadM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement)) :=
      leftValue.toArray.flatMap fun originalLeft => #[do
        let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod #[← inferType originalLeft.value, ← inferType rightValue.value]
        let some action ← sourceMorphismFrom? "•" pair | return .error unavailable
        let function ← sourceSetFunction action
        let argument ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[originalLeft.value, rightValue.value]
        return .ok ⟨← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr argument] none false false, none⟩,
      do
        let result ← sourceDirectApplicationApplicable? originalLeft.value fun domain =>
          retainedOperandApplicable right rightValue.value domain
        match result with
        | .ok (some value) => return .ok ⟨value, none⟩
        | .ok none | .error _ => return .error unavailable]
    let trials := direct ++ names.map fun name => do
        let owner ← if name == "•" then pure (some (← inferType rightValue.value)) else pure none
        elementOperationApplicable context name #[left, right] #[]
          #[leftValue.map (·.value), some rightValue.value] owner
    match ← SourceReadM.chooseApplicable trials unavailable
        m!"juxtaposition has several declared readings of its original operands" with
    | .ok value => return value
    | .error _ =>
      if let some left := leftValue then
        let type ← inferType left.value
        let domains ← sourceOperationDomains categoryOf type none #[type]
        if domains.isEmpty && (left.category.any (·.role == .morphism) ||
            (← whnf type).isForall) then
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource
            "callable juxtaposition requires its declared action and application comparison"
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwStratum .invalid
        "no declared juxtaposition reading accepts the original operands"

def relation (context : ReadContext) :
    String → TSyntax `cas_term → TSyntax `cas_term → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let elementOperation := elementOperation context
  fun (name : String) (left right : TSyntax `cas_term) => do
    -- The public precedence grammar places a trailing domain on the right operand.
    -- Its actual selected structure types both operands through the registered map.
    match right with
    | `(cas_term| $operand:cas_term in $domain:cas_term) =>
      let domain ← sourceCarrier (← readExpression categoryOf domain none)
      elementOperation name #[left, operand] #[] #[] (some domain.value)
    | _ => elementOperation name #[left, right] #[] #[] none

end SourceReader

end CasCompiler

namespace CasCompiler

namespace ReadOperationRules

open SourceReader

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let expected := context.expected
  let qualification := context.qualification
  let expectedCategory := context.expectedCategory
  let elementOperation := elementOperation context
  let action := action context
  let relation := relation context
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term + $right:cas_term) =>
    elementOperation "+" #[left, right] #[] #[] none
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term - $right:cas_term) => do
    -- `x - y` is `x + -y` in the selected structure (public language contract).
    -- The expansion is read once through the same registered addition and negation.
    return ← readExpression categoryOf (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $left:cas_term + (-$right:cas_term)))
      expected qualification expectedCategory
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term ∪ $right:cas_term) =>
    elementOperation "∪" #[left, right] #[] #[] none
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term ∩ $right:cas_term) =>
    elementOperation "∩" #[left, right] #[] #[] none
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term \ $right:cas_term) =>
    elementOperation "\\" #[left, right] #[] #[] none
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term △ $right:cas_term) =>
    elementOperation "△" #[left, right] #[] #[] none
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term ⊆ $right:cas_term) => relation "⊆" left right
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term ≤ $right:cas_term) => relation "≤" left right
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term < $right:cas_term) => relation "<" left right
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term · $right:cas_term) =>
    elementOperation "·" #[left, right] #[] #[] none
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term • $right:cas_term) => action left right
  | `(cas_term| -$operand:cas_term) =>
    elementOperation "-" #[operand] #[] #[] none
  | `(cas_term| $operand:cas_term⁻¹) =>
    elementOperation "⁻¹" #[operand] #[] #[] none
  | _ => throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadOperationRules

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let expected := context.expected
  let qualification := context.qualification
  let expectedCategory := context.expectedCategory
  let elementOperation := elementOperation context
  let registered := registered context
  let notationObject := notationObject context
  let objectPower := objectPower context
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| $base:cas_term²) => do
    if let some object ← objectPower base (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| 2)) then return object
    readExpression categoryOf (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $base:cas_term ^ 2)) expected qualification
      expectedCategory
  | `(cas_term| $base:cas_term³) => do
    if let some object ← objectPower base (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| 3)) then return object
    readExpression categoryOf (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $base:cas_term ^ 3)) expected qualification
      expectedCategory
  | `(cas_term| √$operand:cas_term) =>
    -- `√x` is `sqrt(x)` (public language contract).
    registered (mkIdentFrom source `sqrt) #[operand]
  | `(cas_term| 𝒫($operand:cas_term)) =>
    registered (mkIdentFrom source (.mkSimple "𝒫")) #[operand]
  | `(cas_term| 2 ^ $power:cas_term) => do
    -- `2^X` of an object is its power set; of an element, the element power.
    if power.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casAtom || power.raw.isIdent then
      let object ← readExpression categoryOf power none
      if object.category.any (·.role == .object) then
        return ← registered (mkIdentFrom source (.mkSimple "𝒫")) #[power]
    elementOperation "^" #[← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| 2)] #[power] #[] none
  | `(cas_term| $base:cas_term ^ $power:cas_term) => do
    if let some object ← objectPower base power then return object
    elementOperation "^" #[base] #[power] #[] none
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term / $right:cas_term) => do
    -- `d/dx`: the registered derivative of the ring whose variable `x` is.
    let identifier := fun (term : TSyntax `cas_term) => match term with
      | `(cas_term| $name:ident) => some name.getId
      | _ => none
    if identifier left == some `d then
      if let some generator := (identifier right).bind sourceDifferentialOf? then
        if let some declaration := (← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? generator then
          let some morphism ← sourceMorphismFrom? "derivative" declaration.type
            | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the ring of {generator} has no registered derivative"
          return ⟨morphism, none⟩
    -- `ℤ/n`: the object whose registered notation is the atom followed by `/`.
    if let some atom := sourceAtomName? left then
      if let some object ← notationObject s!"{atom}/" #[right] then return object
    -- `a / b`: the registered division at the monoid of the operands' object.
    let mut hints := #[]
    for operand in #[left, right] do
      if let `(cas_term| $identifier:ident) := operand then
        if ((← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx).findFromUserName? identifier.getId).isSome then
          hints := hints.push (← inferType (← readExpression categoryOf operand none).value)
    let some domain := (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| expected.mapM instantiateMVars).orElse fun _ => hints[0]?
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource "source division requires the set of its operands"
    let owners ← sourceOperationDomains categoryOf domain none (#[domain] ++ hints)
    let value ← sourceDivision owners left right fun operand => do
      return (← readExpression categoryOf operand (some domain)).value
    return ⟨value, none⟩
  | _ => throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadPowerRules

end CasCompiler
