private def scaled : TSyntax `cas_term → Syntax → SourceReadM (TSyntax `cas_term) :=
  fun (factor : TSyntax `cas_term) (power : Syntax) => do
    let factor ← match power.find? (·.isAtom) |>.map (·.getAtomVal) with
      | some "²" => liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $factor:cas_term ^ 2)
      | some "³" => liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $factor:cas_term ^ 3)
      | _ => pure factor
    return factor

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let expected := context.expected
  let qualification := context.qualification
  let expectedCategory := context.expectedCategory
  let juxtapose := juxtapose context
  if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casTimes then
    juxtapose ⟨source.raw[0]⟩ ⟨source.raw[2]⟩
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casActed then
    juxtapose ⟨source.raw[0]⟩ (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $(⟨source.raw[1]⟩):ident))
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casScaled then do
    -- `2n`, `3x²`: the numeral times the variable (public language contract).
    let factor ← scaled (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $(⟨source.raw[1]⟩):ident)) source.raw[2]
    readExpression categoryOf (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $(⟨source.raw[0]⟩):num · $factor:cas_term))
      expected qualification expectedCategory
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casScaledRoot then do
    -- `2√2`: the numeral times the square root.
    let factor ← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| √$(⟨source.raw[2]⟩):cas_term)
    readExpression categoryOf (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $(⟨source.raw[0]⟩):num · $factor:cas_term))
      expected qualification expectedCategory
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casCoefficient then do
    -- `(a)x²`: the parenthesized coefficient times the variable.
    let factor ← scaled (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $(⟨source.raw[3]⟩):ident)) source.raw[4]
    let coefficient : TSyntax `cas_term := ⟨source.raw[1]⟩
    readExpression categoryOf (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| ($coefficient:cas_term) · $factor:cas_term))
      expected qualification expectedCategory
  else throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadProductNotation

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.ReadContext
public import CasCompiler.SourceLift
public import CasCompiler.SourceLimit
public import CasCompiler.SourceSubobject

public section

namespace CasCompiler
open Lean Meta Elab Term

/-- Projection syntax consumes the independently registered construction interface. -/
def readProjection (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (name : String)
    (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) : SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  if let some value ← sourceLiftMember? receiver name then
    unless arguments.isEmpty do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a selected lift projection takes no additional source arguments"
    return some value
  if let some value ← sourceSubobjectMember? receiver name then
    unless arguments.isEmpty do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a selected subobject projection takes no additional source arguments"
    return some value
  -- `K.leg(j)`: a defining leg of a registered limit or colimit.
  if name == "leg" then
    if let #[index] := arguments then
      if let `(cas_term| $ordinal:num) := index then
        if let some leg ← sourceLimitLeg? receiver ordinal.getNat then return some leg
  return none

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.ReadContext
public import CasCompiler.ReadNamed
public import CasCompiler.SourceMember

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

namespace ReadRingNotation

open SourceReader

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let registered := registered context
  let relatedObject := relatedObject context
  if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casCoefficientOf then do
    -- `[tⁿ]f`, `[t^n]f`, `[t]f`: the registered coefficient of `f` at the exponent `n`.
    let monomial : TSyntax `cas_term := ⟨source.raw[1]⟩
    let exponent ← match monomial with
      | `(cas_term| $_:ident ^ $power:num) => pure power
      | `(cas_term| $_:ident²) => liftM (m := TermElabM) `(num| 2)
      | `(cas_term| $_:ident³) => liftM (m := TermElabM) `(num| 3)
      | `(cas_term| $_:ident) => liftM (m := TermElabM) `(num| 1)
      | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a coefficient is of a monomial `[tⁿ]`"
    let series ← readExpression categoryOf ⟨source.raw[3]⟩ none
    let some value ← sourceElementMember? "coefficient" (some series)
        (fun _ => pure series.value) (some fun type => do
          return (← readExpression categoryOf (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $exponent:num)) (some type)).value)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the series has no registered coefficient"
    pure ⟨value, none⟩
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casInfinity then
    registered (mkIdentFrom source (.mkSimple "∞")) #[]
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casIntegral then
    registered (mkIdentFrom source (.mkSimple "∫")) #[⟨source.raw[1]⟩]
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casNonzero then do
    -- `X ∖ 0` for `X = N(…)`: the registered object `N∖0` at the same parameters.
    unless source.raw[2].isNatLit? == some 0 do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "`X ∖ n` is written for n = 0 only, the nonzero elements"
    relatedObject ⟨source.raw[0]⟩ fun name => s!"{name}∖0"
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casSpec then
    relatedObject ⟨source.raw[1]⟩ fun name => s!"Spec {name}"
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casRing then
    registered (mkIdentFrom source `Poly) #[⟨source.raw[0]⟩]
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casMvRing then do
    -- `R[x, y]`, `R[x_0, …, x_9]`: `MvPoly(n, R)` in its `n` listed variables.
    let names ← match sourceRingVariableNames source.raw with
      | .ok names => pure names
      | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message
    let count : TSyntax `cas_term ← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| $(⟨Syntax.mkNumLit (toString names.size)⟩):num)
    registered (mkIdentFrom source `MvPoly) #[count, ⟨source.raw[0]⟩]
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casSeries then
    registered (mkIdentFrom source `PowerSeries) #[⟨source.raw[0]⟩]
  else throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadRingNotation

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.ReadExpression
public import CasCompiler.SourceProof
import CasCompiler.SourceCarrier

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

def SourceSession.openCategory (session : SourceSession) (context : OpenContext)
    (id : FVarId) : TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory) := do
  let some binding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == id)
    | return none
  let some category := session.categoryFor binding.id | return none
  let carrier ← category.carrier.mapM fun carrier => do
    return (⟨carrier.refs, carrier.target, carrier.identifications,
      ← carrier.actions.mapM (·.inContext context),
      ← carrier.comparisons.mapM (·.inContext context)⟩ : NativeSourceCarrierSelection)
  let limit ← category.limit.mapM fun limit => do
    return (⟨limit.row, limit.declaration, ← limit.cone.inContext context, limit.colimit,
      limit.category, ← limit.bundle.inContext context,
      ← limit.presentation.inContext context, ← limit.diagram.inContext context,
      ← limit.interface.mapM (·.inContext context), limit.construction,
      ← limit.ownerFamily.mapM (·.inContext context),
      ← limit.creation.mapM (fun creation => creation.mapM (·.inContext context)),
      ← limit.creationFamily.mapM (·.inContext context), limit.creationInputs⟩ :
        NativeSourceLimitSelection)
  return some ⟨category.role, category.expression, ← category.bundle.inContext context,
    carrier, limit⟩

/-- The ring variables of the session's definitions that `stx` names, in `context`. -/
private def recordedRings (session : SourceSession) (stx : Syntax) :
    SourceReadM (Array (Name × Expr × Option Nat)) := do
  let context := (← get).context
  let mut found := #[]
  for binding in context.bindings do
    unless sourceUses (← binding.expression.fvarId!.getUserName) stx do continue
    for ring in session.ringsFor binding.id do
      found := found.push (ring.name, ← session.readClosed stx ring.carrier ring.selections, ring.index)
  return found

/-- The variables of the rings that the definition `stx` writes, with their carriers, retained by
the session for the statements that use this definition. -/
private def writtenRings (session : SourceSession) (stx : Syntax) :
    TermElabM (Array SourceRingVariable) := do
  let mut found := #[]
  for (name, ring, index) in sourceRingVariables stx do
    if found.any (fun (written : SourceRingVariable) => written.name == name) then continue
    let carrier ← session.elaborateScoped ring do
      let context := (← get).context
      let object ← readExpression (session.openCategory context) ⟨ring⟩ none
      return (← sourceCarrier object).value
    found := found.push ⟨name, carrier.source, index, carrier.selections⟩
  return found

/-- Insert a definition and retain the ring variables its source wrote. -/
private def SourceSession.defineWritten (session : SourceSession) (stx : Syntax) (name : Name)
    (value : SourceTerm) : TermElabM SourceSession := do
  let rings ← writtenRings session stx
  return (← session.defineTerm name value).recordRings rings

private def SourceSession.readAt (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (stx : TSyntax `cas_term)
    (expected : Option ClosedTerm := none)
    (expectedSelections : SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm := {}) : TermElabM SourceTerm := do
  let #[term] ← session.elaborateJudgementsScoped reference do
    let expected ← expected.mapM (session.readClosed reference · expectedSelections)
    let rings ← recordedRings session stx
    let context := (← get).context
    return #[← readSourceTerm (session.openCategory context) rings stx expected]
    | throwError "source reading returned an invalid number of judgements"
  return term

/-- Read public source syntax directly in the retained native context.
Reuse: Lean's term elaborator supplies dependent parameter types and local bindings. -/
opaque SourceSession.read (session : SourceSession) (stx : TSyntax `cas_term)
    (expected : Option ClosedTerm := none)
    (expectedSelections : SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm := {}) : TermElabM SourceTerm :=
  session.readAt stx stx expected expectedSelections

-- Assertion equality uses native Eq, as in SourceEquality and the public claimEqual
-- contract. Logical conjunction uses native And. Neither operation supplies a proof.
-- Reuse: Lean.Meta.mkEq, Lean.Meta.mkAppM and the single native source reader.
private partial def questionExpression
    (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (stx : TSyntax `cas_term) : SourceReadM Expr := SourceReadM.withRef stx do
  match stx with
  | `(cas_term| ($body:cas_term)) => questionExpression categoryOf body
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term and $right:cas_term) =>
    mkAppM ``And #[← questionExpression categoryOf left, ← questionExpression categoryOf right]
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term = $right:cas_term)
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term is $right:cas_term) => sourceEquation categoryOf left right
  | _ =>
    let value ← readExpression categoryOf stx (some (mkSort .zero))
    unless ← isProp value.value do liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source question must be a proposition"
    return value.value

/-- Form the proposition asked by public source, in its complete original context.
Source: mathematical-input contract §1 and ContextTelescope; equality and conjunction
retain the actual terms. Formation does not decide the question or add a hypothesis. -/
opaque SourceSession.readQuestion (session : SourceSession) (stx : TSyntax `cas_term) :
    TermElabM SourceTerm :=
  session.elaborateScoped stx do
    let rings ← recordedRings session stx
    let categoryOf := session.openCategory (← get).context
    return (← withRingVariables categoryOf rings stx do
      return ⟨← questionExpression categoryOf stx, none⟩).value

/-- A definition extends the native scope. A question retains that scope without extending it.
An implementation request asks that the installed computations produce the value. A typing
question (`x ∈ Y` or `x in Y` for an object `Y`) is settled by reading `x` in `Y`. -/
inductive SourceStatement where
  | definition (session : SourceSession) (value : SourceTerm)
  | question (proposition : SourceTerm)
  | implemented (value : SourceTerm)
  | settled (values : Array SourceTerm)
  | assumption (session : SourceSession)
  | proved (proposition : SourceTerm) (proof : SourceTerm)
  | inspection (scope : SourceContextObservation)
  /-- Every child has already been read in its actual preceding lexical scope. The syntax
  is retained only for original item identity/span reporting, never runtime replay. -/
  | contextBlock (items : Array (TSyntax `cas_item × SourceStatement))

/-- The actual source-preflight result. A failed block retains its completed children,
the original failed child result and every remaining original item in order. `none` means
that item's source was not read; it carries no inferred judgement. The exception is the
reader's original exception, not a replacement interpretation or runtime outcome. -/
inductive SourceStatementRead where
  | complete (statement : SourceStatement)
  | failed (error : Exception)
      (items : Array (TSyntax `cas_item × Option SourceStatementRead))

/-- Original item syntax of a lexical block, shared by statement preparation and source
observation. These exact nodes retain question labels and original file positions. -/
def sourceContextItems? (statement : TSyntax `cas_stmt) : Option (Array (TSyntax `cas_item)) :=
  if statement.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casContextBlock then
    some (statement.raw[2].getArgs.map (⟨·⟩))
  else none

/-- The original statement node of one parsed item, without reading or rewriting it. -/
def sourceItemStatement? (item : TSyntax `cas_item) : Option (TSyntax `cas_stmt) :=
  match item with
  | `(cas_item| test $_:ident $_:str : $statement:cas_stmt)
  | `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) => some statement
  | _ => none

/-- Read an asserted membership or annotation. Membership in a subset is a proposition; in an
object it is the element's reading there, whose success settles the question.
Source: mathematical-input contract §1; the original reader's settled typing judgements. -/
private def typingQuestion (session : SourceSession) (stx : TSyntax `cas_term) :
    TermElabM SourceStatement := do
  -- Retain the original selected category, carrier and cone of fresh values too.
  let term ← session.read stx
  let proposition ← term.source.withOpen fun _ expression => isProp expression
  return if proposition then .question term else .settled #[term]

/-- `X ⊆ Y` for two named sets: the map that a chain of registered inclusions of `X` in `Y`
gives (`sourceCoercion?`: registered inclusions and registered constants; several chains are a
competing reading). With no chain the judgement is not established. `none` when a side is not an
object: `⊆` is then the order of subsets, a proposition. -/
private def inclusionJudgement? (session : SourceSession) (stx left right : TSyntax `cas_term) :
    TermElabM (Option SourceTerm) := do
  try
    return some (← session.elaborateScoped stx do
      let rings ← recordedRings session stx
      let categoryOf := session.openCategory (← get).context
      let source ← readSourceTerm categoryOf rings left none
      let target ← readSourceTerm categoryOf rings right none
      unless source.category.any (·.role == .object) && target.category.any (·.role == .object) do
        throwReadRuleMismatch
      unless (← whnfR (← inferType source.value)).isSort &&
          (← whnfR (← inferType target.value)).isSort do
        throwReadRuleMismatch
      SourceReadM.withLambda `x source.value .default fun element => do
        let some included ← sourceCoercion? element target.value
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwStratum .invalid
              m!"no chain of registered inclusions gives {left} ⊆ {right}"
        return included)
  catch error =>
    match error with
    | .internal id _ => if id == readRuleMismatch then return none else throw error
    | _ => throw error

/-- The typing judgements of an assertion, when every conjunct is one and each is settled:
`x ∈ Y` or `x in Y` for an object `Y`, and `X ⊆ Y` for named sets. `none` when a conjunct is a
proposition; the assertion is then read as a question. -/
private partial def settledJudgements? (session : SourceSession) (stx : TSyntax `cas_term) :
    TermElabM (Option (Array SourceTerm)) := do
  match stx with
  | `(cas_term| ($body:cas_term)) => settledJudgements? session body
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term and $right:cas_term) =>
    let some first ← settledJudgements? session left | return none
    let some second ← settledJudgements? session right | return none
    return some (first ++ second)
  | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term ∈ $_:cas_term)
  | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term in $_:cas_term) =>
    match ← typingQuestion session stx with
    | .settled values => return some values
    | _ => return none
  | `(cas_term| $left:cas_term ⊆ $right:cas_term) =>
    return (← inclusionJudgement? session stx left right).map fun value => #[value]
  | _ => return none

private partial def patternFunction (pattern body : TSyntax `cas_term) :
    TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) :=
  match pattern with
  | `(cas_term| $name:ident) => `(cas_term| $name:ident ↦ $body:cas_term)
  | `(cas_term| ($first:cas_term, $rest:cas_term,*)) =>
    `(cas_term| ($first:cas_term, $rest:cas_term,*) ↦ $body:cas_term)
  | `(cas_term| ($inner:cas_term)) => patternFunction inner body
  | _ => throwErrorAt pattern "a source function parameter must be a name or tuple pattern"

/-- A category spelling is selected before interpreting its arguments. A local binding
shadows a catalogue spelling, so ordinary subset membership keeps its existing meaning. -/
private partial def categoryApplication? (session : SourceSession) (source : TSyntax `cas_term) :
    TermElabM (Option (CasCatalogue.NamedCategoryEntry × Array (TSyntax `cas_term))) := do
  let (name, arguments) ← match source with
    | `(cas_term| ($inner:cas_term)) => return ← categoryApplication? session inner
    | `(cas_term| $name:ident) => pure (name, #[])
    | `(cas_term| $name:ident($arguments:cas_term,*)) => pure (name, arguments.getElems)
    | _ => return none
  if session.context.entries.any (·.userName == name.getId) then return none
  let spelling := name.getId.toString (escape := false)
  let state ← CasCatalogue.semanticState
  unless state.categories.any (·.name == spelling) do return none
  return some (← selectCategory state spelling, arguments)

/-- Seal only unresolved native universe levels after the complete actual application.
Existing context parameters remain rigid; no mathematical universe is defaulted to zero. -/
private def closeDeclarationUniverses (context : OpenContext) (values : Array Expr) :
    MetaM (Array Expr) := do
  let mut used : CollectLevelParams.State := {}
  for binding in context.bindings do
    let declaration ← binding.expression.fvarId!.getDecl
    used := used.collect declaration.type
    if let some value := declaration.value? then used := used.collect value
  for value in values do used := used.collect (← instantiateMVars value)
  for value in values do
    let generalized := (← getMCtx).levelMVarToParam used.params.contains (fun _ => false)
      (← instantiateMVars value) `sourceScopeUniverse
    setMCtx generalized.mctx
    used := used.collect generalized.expr
  let values ← values.mapM instantiateMVars
  if values.any (fun value => value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar) then
    throwError "a source declaration requires its complete native category parameters"
  return values

private def categoryBundle (session : SourceSession) (context : OpenContext)
    (source : TSyntax `cas_term) (entry : CasCatalogue.NamedCategoryEntry)
    (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
  let reader : ReadContext := ⟨session.openCategory context, source, none, none, none,
    readProjection, fun categoryOf source expected qualification expectedCategory =>
      readExpressionApplicable categoryOf source expected qualification expectedCategory⟩
  let value ← SourceReader.application reader
    ⟨← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration, none⟩ arguments none
  discard <| categoryIdentity value
  discard <| SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt (.category entry) value value)
  return value

private def abstractDeclaration (session : SourceSession) (name : Name)
    (domain : TSyntax `cas_term) : TermElabM SourceStatement := do
  if let some (entry, arguments) ← categoryApplication? session domain then
    let category ← session.elaborateScoped domain do
      let context := (← get).context
      let bundle ← categoryBundle session context domain entry arguments
      let #[bundle] ← closeDeclarationUniverses (← get).context #[bundle]
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the abstract category lost its native bundle"
      return bundle
    return .assumption (← session.assumeObject name entry.expression category)
  let type ← session.elaborateScoped domain do
    let context := (← get).context
    let selected ← readExpression (session.openCategory context) domain none
    let domain ← sourceCarrier selected
    discard <| getLevel domain.value
    return domain.value
  return .assumption (← session.assumeTerm name type)

/-- Unicode category-qualified definitions use the same selected catalogue judgement as
`in`. A non-category right side remains the original membership expression. -/
private def definedValue (session : SourceSession) (body : TSyntax `cas_term) :
    TermElabM SourceTerm := do
  -- Inspect through transparent grouping while retaining the complete original source span.
  let mut qualification := body
  while true do
    let `(cas_term| ($inner:cas_term)) := qualification | break
    qualification := inner
  let `(cas_term| $value:cas_term ∈ $domain:cas_term) := qualification
    | return ← session.read body
  let some (entry, arguments) ← categoryApplication? session domain
    | return ← session.read body
  let #[term] ← session.elaborateJudgementsScoped body do
    let context := (← get).context
    let bundle ← categoryBundle session context domain entry arguments
    let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]
    let selected : NativeSourceCategory := ⟨.object, entry.expression, bundle, none, none⟩
    let actual ← readExpression (session.openCategory context) value (some carrier)
      (some entry.name) (some selected)
    let some category := actual.category
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the defined object lost its explicitly selected category"
    unless category.role == .object && category.expression.syntacticEq entry.expression &&
        (← isDefEq category.bundle bundle) do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the defined object has a different complete selected category"
    discard <| closeDeclarationUniverses (← get).context #[actual.value, category.bundle]
    return #[actual]
    | throwError "the defined object returned an invalid number of judgements"
  return term

/-- Read public statements through the checked source session, retaining actual let bindings.
Reuse: SourceSession.read/defineTerm and native expected-type checking. Source annotations
are read in the preceding scope; the new name is inserted only after its value is checked. -/
private def readStatementLeaf (session : SourceSession) (stx : TSyntax `cas_stmt) :
    TermElabM SourceStatement := withRef stx do
  -- Public let-function syntax expands once. The native value retains its actual preceding
  -- bindings; its span refers to the original statement, not generated syntax.
  let defineFunction := fun (name : TSyntax `ident) (parameter value : TSyntax `cas_term) => do
    let translated ← match value with
      | `(cas_term| $body:cas_term in $domain:cas_term) => do
        let function ← patternFunction parameter body
        `(cas_term| $function:cas_term in $domain:cas_term)
      | _ => patternFunction parameter value
    let value ← session.readAt stx translated
    return SourceStatement.definition (← session.defineWritten translated name.getId value) value
  match stx with
  | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident ∈ $domain:cas_term)
  | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident in $domain:cas_term) =>
    abstractDeclaration session name.getId domain
  | `(cas_stmt| assume $name:ident : $proposition:cas_term) =>
    let proposition ← session.readQuestion proposition
    return .assumption (← session.assumeTerm name.getId proposition)
  | `(cas_stmt| inspect assumptions) => return .inspection session.observation
  | `(cas_stmt| assert $body:cas_term using ($evidence:cas_term)) =>
    let proposition ← session.readQuestion body
    return .proved proposition (← session.proof evidence proposition.source proposition.selections)
  | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident := $body:cas_term) =>
    let value ← definedValue session body
    return .definition (← session.defineWritten body name.getId value) value
  | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident : $annotation:cas_term := $body:cas_term) =>
    let type ← session.read annotation
    type.source.withOpen fun _ expression => discard <| getLevel expression
    let value ← session.read body (some type.source) type.selections
    return .definition (← session.defineWritten annotation name.getId value) value
  | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident($parameter:cas_term) := $value:cas_term) =>
    defineFunction name parameter value
  | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident($first:ident, $rest:ident,*) := $value:cas_term) =>
    -- Several parameters are one tuple pattern: `let f(x, y) := e` is `let f := (x, y) ↦ e`.
    let first ← `(cas_term| $first:ident)
    let rest ← rest.getElems.mapM fun parameter => `(cas_term| $parameter:ident)
    defineFunction name (← `(cas_term| ($first:cas_term, $rest:cas_term,*))) value
  | `(cas_stmt| assert implemented $body:cas_term) =>
    return .implemented (← session.read body)
  | `(cas_stmt| assert $body:cas_term) =>
    match body with
    | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term ∈ $_:cas_term)
    | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term in $_:cas_term) => typingQuestion session body
    | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term ⊆ $_:cas_term)
    | `(cas_term| $_:cas_term and $_:cas_term) =>
      match ← settledJudgements? session body with
      | some values => return .settled values
      | none => return .question (← session.readQuestion body)
    | _ => return .question (← session.readQuestion body)
  | _ =>
    CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource
      "source translation is not implemented for this statement form"

/-- The same reader retains successful source work when a later child fails. A block
advances only through its completed stored source sessions and stops at its first error;
no suffix is read, no source is replayed, and no child session escapes its lexical block. -/
private partial def readStatementCore (session : SourceSession) (stx : TSyntax `cas_stmt) :
    TermElabM SourceStatementRead := withRef stx do
  if let some children := sourceContextItems? stx then
    let mut current := session
    let mut items : Array (TSyntax `cas_item × SourceStatement) := #[]
    for item in children, index in [:children.size] do
      let result : SourceStatementRead ← try
          let some child := sourceItemStatement? item
            | throwError "a context block changed its original item syntax"
          readStatementCore current child
        catch error => pure (.failed error #[])
      match result with
      | .complete prepared =>
        items := items.push (item, prepared)
        match prepared with
        | .definition next _ | .assumption next => current := next
        | _ => pure ()
      | .failed error _ =>
        let completedItems := items.map fun (item, statement) =>
          (item, some (SourceStatementRead.complete statement))
        let suffix : Array (TSyntax `cas_item × Option SourceStatementRead) :=
          (children.drop (index + 1)).map fun item => (item, none)
        return .failed error (completedItems ++ #[(item, some result)] ++ suffix)
    return .complete (.contextBlock items)
  try
    return .complete (← readStatementLeaf session stx)
  catch error =>
    return .failed error #[]

/-- Read once and expose the actual completed prefix if source preflight fails. Consumers
may observe these original typed terms, but a failed result cannot enter execution. -/
opaque SourceSession.readStatementObserved (session : SourceSession) (stx : TSyntax `cas_stmt) :
    TermElabM SourceStatementRead := readStatementCore session stx

/-- Read one complete source statement before any computational cell is opened. Context
blocks retain typed children in order, including their original item labels and spans.
The ordinary API still throws the exact original error when any child fails. -/
opaque SourceSession.readStatement (session : SourceSession) (stx : TSyntax `cas_stmt) :
    TermElabM SourceStatement := do
  match ← session.readStatementObserved stx with
  | .complete statement => return statement
  | .failed error _ => throw error

end CasCompiler

def membership (context : ReadContext) :
    TSyntax `cas_term → TSyntax `cas_term → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  fun (element container : TSyntax `cas_term) => do
    let container ← readExpression categoryOf container none
    let type ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType container.value)
    let some power ← sourcePowerObject? type
      | do
        -- Membership in an object is the element's reading in that object, settled when the
        -- statement is read (`-3 ∈ ℤ`, `p ∈ ℤ[x]`).
        let domain ← sourceCarrier container
        discard <| getLevel domain.value
        return ← readExpression categoryOf element (some domain.value)
    let element ← readExpression categoryOf element (some power.base)
    return (⟨← sourceMembership power element.value container.value, none⟩ :
      NativeSourceJudgement)

def boundIn (context : ReadContext) :
    Ident → TSyntax `cas_term → (Expr → Expr → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement) → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  fun (bound : Ident) (domain : TSyntax `cas_term)
      (body : Expr → Expr → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement) => do
    let domain ← sourceCarrier (← readExpression categoryOf domain none)
    SourceReadM.withBinder bound.getId domain.value none .default
      (fun _ judgement => pure judgement) fun parameter => body domain.value parameter

def asObject :
    NativeSourceJudgement → SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  fun (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) => do
    return (← sourceExtent? judgement).getD judgement

end SourceReader

end CasCompiler

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let expected := context.expected
  let qualification := context.qualification
  let expectedCategory := context.expectedCategory
  let registered := registered context
  if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casProgression then do
    -- `{a₀, a₁, …, ...}`: the progression `{a₀ + d·k | k ∈ ℕ}` its numerals begin, with
    -- `d = a₁ - a₀` constant (public language contract).
    let numerals ← source.raw[1].getSepArgs.mapM fun numeral => do
      let `(cas_term| $value:num) := (⟨numeral⟩ : TSyntax `cas_term)
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a progression `…, ...` is of numerals"
      pure value.getNat
    let (some first, some second) := (numerals[0]?, numerals[1]?)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a progression `…, ...` begins with two numerals"
    unless first ≤ second do liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a progression `…, ...` in ℕ increases"
    let difference := second - first
    unless (numerals.toList.zip numerals.toList.tail).all fun (x, y) => y = x + difference do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwStratum .invalid
        m!"{numerals.toList}, ... is not an arithmetic progression"
    let first : TSyntax `num := ⟨Syntax.mkNumLit (toString first)⟩
    let difference : TSyntax `num := ⟨Syntax.mkNumLit (toString difference)⟩
    readExpression categoryOf
      (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| {$first:num + $difference:num · index | index ∈ ℕ}))
      expected qualification expectedCategory
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casMultiples then do
    -- `2ℕ`: the multiples `{2·n | n ∈ ℕ}` of the numeral in the named set.
    let factor : TSyntax `num := ⟨source.raw[0]⟩
    let set : TSyntax `cas_term := ⟨mkNode ``CasCatalogue.Language.casAtom #[source.raw[1]]⟩
    readExpression categoryOf (← liftM (m := TermElabM) `(cas_term| {$factor:num · index | index ∈ $set:cas_term}))
      expected qualification expectedCategory
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casUnits then
    registered (mkIdentFrom source `Units) #[⟨source.raw[0]⟩]
  else if source.raw.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casFiniteSubsets then
    registered (mkIdentFrom source (.mkSimple "𝒫_fin")) #[⟨source.raw[2]⟩]
  else throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadSubsetNotation

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

namespace ReadSubsetRules

open SourceReader

def rule (context : ReadContext) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let readExpression := @ReadContext.readExpression context
  let categoryOf := context.categoryOf
  let source := context.source
  let expected := context.expected
  let admitted := admitted context
  let membership := membership context
  let boundIn := boundIn context
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| $element:cas_term ∈ $container:cas_term) => membership element container
  | `(cas_term| $element:cas_term ∉ $container:cas_term) => do
    return ⟨mkNot (← membership element container).value, none⟩
  | `(cas_term| {$elements:cas_term,*}) => do
    let expected ← match expected with
      | some expected => pure expected
      | none => do
        -- With no declared power object, the set in which the elements meet determines it
        -- (`span({u₁, u₂})` for vectors of ℚ³).
        let types ← elements.getElems.mapM fun element => do
          inferType (← readExpression categoryOf element none).value
        let some base ← sourceCommonDomain types
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source set literal requires its declared power object"
        let power ← sourcePowerObjectAt base
        let some object := (← CasCatalogue.semanticState).objects.find? (·.id == power.row.object)
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered power object has no object family"
        let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels object.declaration
        elabAppArgs family #[] #[Arg.expr base] none false false
    -- A literal in an admitted subobject of a power object (`𝒫_fin(X)`) is admitted there.
    let expected ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars expected
    if let some entry ← sourceAdmissionDomain? expected then
      return ⟨← admitted entry source expected, none⟩
    let some power ← sourcePowerObject? expected
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source set literal requires a subset of a registered power object"
    -- Elements are read in the registered form of the base set (`Poly(ℤ)` for `Polynomial ℤ`).
    let base ← sourceRegisteredForm power.base
    let elements ← elements.getElems.mapM fun element => do
      return (← readExpression categoryOf element (some base)).value
    return ⟨← sourceSubsetLiteral power elements expected, none⟩
  | `(cas_term| {$bound:ident ∈ $domain:cas_term | $body:cas_term}) => do
    -- Over a subset `A ⊆ X`: `{t ∈ X | t ∈ A and P}`, through `A`'s power object.
    let subset ← readExpression categoryOf domain none
    let type ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType subset.value)
    if let some power ← sourcePowerObject? type then
      return ← SourceReadM.withBinder bound.getId power.base none .default
          (fun _ judgement => pure judgement) fun parameter => do
        let predicate ← readExpression categoryOf body (some (mkSort .zero))
        let member ← sourceMembership power parameter subset.value
        let predicate ← mkLambdaFVars #[parameter] (mkAnd member predicate.value)
        return (⟨← sourceComprehension power predicate expected, none⟩ : NativeSourceJudgement)
    boundIn bound domain fun base parameter => do
      let predicate ← readExpression categoryOf body (some (mkSort .zero))
      let predicate ← mkLambdaFVars #[parameter] predicate.value
      let power ← sourcePowerObjectAt base
      return (⟨← sourceComprehension power predicate expected, none⟩ : NativeSourceJudgement)
  | `(cas_term| {$body:cas_term | $bound:ident ∈ $domain:cas_term}) =>
    boundIn bound domain fun base parameter => do
      let value ← readExpression categoryOf body none
      let target ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType value.value)
      if target.containsFVar parameter.fvarId! then
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source image has a codomain that depends on its bound variable"
      let function ← mkLambdaFVars #[parameter] value.value
      let power ← sourcePowerObjectAt target
      return (⟨← sourceImage power base function expected, none⟩ : NativeSourceJudgement)
  | _ => throwReadRuleMismatch

end ReadSubsetRules

end CasCompiler

@[expose] public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue

/-- Availability belongs to the original family, independently of its data layout. -/
inductive RecordActionOwner
  | computation (reference : ComputationRef)
  | lift (id : LiftId)
  | limit (id : LimitId)

/-- A required invocation value at its original native field slot. -/
structure RecordActionInput where
  private mk ::
  sourceIndex : Nat
  projection : Name
  source : ClosedTerm
  selectedField : Option (SelectedSourceField ClosedTerm) := none

/-- A source-selected action and its declared invocation inputs. Native type dependencies
and additional released packet inputs remain separate: ordinary records use their sparse
FieldLayout dependencies; a published ordered packet retains its prescribed value inputs. -/
structure RecordAction where
  private mk ::
  owner : RecordActionOwner
  address : String
  familyAddress : String
  inputs : Array RecordActionInput
  /-- Exact outer native predecessor slots retained by this selected subfamily. -/
  predecessors : Array RecordActionInput := #[]

/-- Original registered family identity, shared by source ports and admission. -/
def computationAddress : ComputationRef → String
  | .operation id => id.raw
  | .functor id => id.raw
  | .method id => id.raw
  | .construction id => id.raw
  | .morphism id => id.raw

/-- The released ordinary-family address of an already validated native field path. -/
opaque nativeRecordActionAddress (owner : String) (path : Array FieldLayout) : String :=
  match path.back? with
  | some field =>
    if field.wireIndex == some 0 then owner
    else s!"{owner}#{field.projection.getString!}"
  | none => owner

/-- Ordinary registered families reuse the same native-field address rule. -/
opaque recordActionAddress (reference : ComputationRef) (path : Array FieldLayout) : String :=
  nativeRecordActionAddress (computationAddress reference) path

/-- Project the checked native field without reducing or replacing its parent. -/
private def project (parent : Expr) (field : FieldLayout) : MetaM Expr := do
  let some information := (← getEnv).getProjectionFnInfo? field.projection
    | throwError "a prepared record field lost its native projection declaration"
  return .proj (← getConstInfoCtor information.ctorName).induct information.i parent

/-- Follow the original source-ordered field path, retaining its exact parent. -/
private def parentAt (source : SourceLayout) (parent : Expr) (path : Array FieldLayout) :
    MetaM (SourceLayout × Expr × FieldLayout) := do
  let mut layout := source
  let mut parent := parent
  for requested in path, index in [:path.size] do
    let some field := layout.fields[requested.sourceIndex]?
      | throwError "a record action has a field outside its original source record"
    unless field.projection == requested.projection && field.address == requested.address do
      throwError "a record action changed its original source field path"
    if index + 1 == path.size then return (layout, parent, field)
    parent ← project parent field
    layout ← field.toLayout
  throwError "a record action requires its original selected field"

private def retainedInput (context : OpenContext) (selection : Option Name)
    (field : FieldLayout) (owner source : Expr) : MetaM RecordActionInput := do
  check source
  let selected ← selection.mapM fun construction => do
    let selected ← selectedFieldAt construction field.projection owner source
    let some field := selected.field
      | throwError "the ordered record input lost its complete native field selection"
    field.mapM context.close
  return ⟨field.sourceIndex, field.projection, ← context.close source, selected⟩

/-- Native dependencies select the actual earlier fields themselves, retaining a whole
callable when required. A type dependency does not authorize applying another function
to the current field's arguments. -/
private def nativeInputs (context : OpenContext) (layout : SourceLayout)
    (parent : Expr) (field : FieldLayout) : MetaM (Array RecordActionInput) := do
  let mut inputs := #[]
  for index in field.precedingDependencies do
    unless index < field.sourceIndex do
      throwError "a native field dependency is not an earlier source slot"
    let some preceding := layout.fields[index]?
      | throwError "a native field dependency is outside its original source record"
    if preceding.wireIndex.isNone then continue
    inputs := inputs.push (← retainedInput context none preceding parent (← project parent preceding))
  return inputs

/-- Prepare sparse native dependencies for an exact selected record field. The complete
source layout and actual parent stay fixed; no implementation availability is consulted. -/
opaque SourceLayout.actionInputs (source : SourceLayout) (context : OpenContext)
    (parent : Expr) (path : Array FieldLayout) : MetaM (Array RecordActionInput) := do
  let original ← source.source.inContext context
  context.withOriginalSources #[original, parent] fun native => do
    unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
      throwError "the record action changed its original native parent"
  let (layout, parent, field) ← parentAt source parent path
  nativeInputs context layout parent field

/-- The released lift packet consumes ordered earlier action results in addition to its
native type dependencies. Keep the original action-prefix positions and selection identity.
Source: cas-leaf-contracts api/wire-examples.md, prescribed lifts and separate factor. -/
private def orderedInputs (context : OpenContext) (selection : Option Name)
    (layout : SourceLayout) (parent : Expr) (count : Nat) (arguments : Array Expr) :
    MetaM (Array RecordActionInput) := do
  unless count ≤ layout.fields.size do
    throwError "a published record invocation exceeds its original field interface"
  let mut inputs := #[]
  for field in layout.fields.extract 0 count do
    if field.wireIndex.isNone then continue
    let projection ← project parent field
    let arity ← forallTelescope (← inferType projection) fun parameters _ => pure parameters.size
    unless arity ≤ arguments.size do
      throwError "a published record input lost its complete original action prefix"
    let value := mkAppN projection (arguments.extract 0 arity)
    inputs := inputs.push (← retainedInput context selection field parent value)
  return inputs

/-- Prepare the common record dispatch interface. The parent is the exact retained family
result; parameters and arguments are its complete original native source slots. Only checked
source terms are formed here. Runtime evaluates the resulting list after unique selection. -/
opaque RecordAction.prepare (boundary : ProgramBoundary) (universes : List Level)
    (context : OpenContext) (source : SourceLayout) (parent : Expr)
    (path : Array FieldLayout) (parameters arguments : Array Expr)
    (selection : Option Name) : MetaM RecordAction := do
  unless universes.length == boundary.universeParams.length do
    throwError "the record action changed its original universe telescope"
  let declared := mkAppN (← boundary.familyIn universes context) parameters
  context.withOriginalSources #[declared, ← source.source.inContext context] fun native => do
    unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
      throwError "the record action changed its original applied source family"
  if let some reference := boundary.reference then
    let id := computationAddress reference
    if path.isEmpty then return ⟨.computation reference, id, id, #[], #[]⟩
    return ⟨.computation reference, recordActionAddress reference path, id,
      ← source.actionInputs context parent path, #[]⟩
  if let .limitUniversal family _ := boundary then
    let presentation := mkAppN
      (family.presentation.presentationFamily.instantiateLevelParams
        family.universeParams universes) parameters
    let original ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close presentation)
      (selections := source.selections)
    let some universal := original.fields.find? (·.projection == family.projection)
      | throwError "the universal action lost its original presentation field"
    let predecessors ← nativeInputs context original presentation universal
    let inputs ← if path.isEmpty then pure #[]
      else source.actionInputs context parent path
    return ⟨.limit family.presentation.entry.id,
      nativeRecordActionAddress family.operation path, family.operation, inputs, predecessors⟩
  if let .creation family := boundary then
    unless path.isEmpty do
      throwError "a creation field must use its completed original native result"
    return ⟨.lift family.family.entry.id, family.operation, family.operation, #[], #[]⟩
  let .lift family := boundary
    | throwError "the selected source interface has no ordinary record action"
  let (layout, parent, field) ← parentAt source parent path
  let address := s!"{family.lift.raw}#{field.projection.getString!}"
  let inputs ← match family.port with
    | .computation => orderedInputs context selection layout parent field.sourceIndex arguments
    | .factor => do
      let some selected ← source.selected? context
        | throwError "the selected factor lost its complete original source record"
      let some computation := selected.application.bind (·.owner)
        | throwError "the selected factor lost its actual original computation owner"
      let scope ← source.selections.inContext context
      let some original := scope.findAt? context computation
        | throwError "the factor's computation owner has no retained complete selection"
      let some application := original.application
        | throwError "the factor's original computation lost its selected family"
      let .lift computationFamily := application.family
        | throwError "the factor's original owner is not its selected lift computation"
      unless computationFamily.port == .computation &&
          reprStr computationFamily.entry == reprStr family.entry do
        throwError "the selected factor changed its complete original computation family"
      let computationLayout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close computation)
        (selections := source.selections)
      orderedInputs context selection computationLayout computation
        computationLayout.fields.size arguments
  return ⟨.lift family.lift, address, family.lift.raw, inputs, #[]⟩

end CasCompiler

-- Reuse RecordTests' native layouts to distinguish declared sparse dependencies
-- from an arbitrary prefix, without adding a mathematical catalogue entry.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 8, mkNatLit 8]
  let pairLayout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close pair)
  let some second := pairLayout.fields[1]?
    | throwError "the original pair lost its second source field"
  unless (← pairLayout.actionInputs context pair #[second]).isEmpty do
    throwError "an independent record field acquired an unrelated earlier input"

  let family ← withLocalDeclD `n (mkConst ``Nat) fun n =>
    mkLambdaFVars #[n] (mkApp (mkConst ``Fin) (mkApp2 (mkConst ``Nat.add) n (mkNatLit 1)))
  let point := mkApp (mkConst ``Fin.last) (mkNatLit 5)
  let source ← mkAppOptM ``Sigma.mk #[some (mkConst ``Nat), some family,
    some (mkNatLit 5), some point]
  let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close source)
  let some dependent := layout.fields[1]?
    | throwError "the original dependent pair lost its second source field"
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  SourceSelectionScope.withBinding identities {} context { value := source }
      fun context _ retained => do
    let #[input] ← layout.actionInputs context retained #[dependent]
      | throwError "the dependent field did not retain exactly its declared earlier slot"
    unless input.sourceIndex == 0 && input.projection == ``Sigma.fst do
      throwError "the dependent field changed its original source slot"
    let term ← input.source.inContext context
    let some projection ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? term
      | throwError "the prepared input lost its original native projection"
    unless projection.parent == retained && projection.declaration == ``Sigma.fst do
      throwError "a prepared dependency replaced its selected original record parent"

  let proofFamily ← withLocalDeclD `h (mkConst ``True) fun h =>
    mkLambdaFVars #[h] (mkConst ``Nat) (usedOnly := false)
  let proofFirst ← mkAppOptM ``PSigma.mk #[some (mkConst ``True), some proofFamily,
    some (mkConst ``True.intro), some (mkNatLit 8)]
  let proofLayout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close proofFirst)
  let some data := proofLayout.fields[1]?
    | throwError "proof erasure changed a native source field position"
  unless data.sourceIndex == 1 && data.wireIndex == some 0 &&
      (← proofLayout.actionInputs context proofFirst #[data]).isEmpty do
    throwError "a formal proof became a computational preceding input"

  let changed ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 9, mkNatLit 8]
  let rejected ← try
      discard <| pairLayout.actionInputs context changed #[second]
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do
    throwError "record dependency preparation admitted another native parent"

  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 2, mkNatLit 3]
  let nested ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[pair, pair]
  let source ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close nested)
  let roles ← RoleTelescope.ofRequest identities program occurrence context none source #[]
  for left in #[``Prod.fst, ``Prod.snd] do
    for right in #[``Prod.fst, ``Prod.snd] do
      unless roles.results.any (fun role =>
          role.layout.kind == .data && role.layout.address == #[left, right]) do
        throwError "a finite nested record lost a scalar field at {left}.{right}"

/-- A callable ends a stored-record path. Demanding its result starts a new interface.
This retains the lazy recursive interface required by constitutional C8. -/
structure CallableRecursiveLayoutFixture where
  next : Unit → CallableRecursiveLayoutFixture

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) IdentitySupply.new
  let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (identities.fresh .program)
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (identities.fresh .occurrence)
  withLocalDeclD `selected (mkConst ``CallableRecursiveLayoutFixture) fun selected => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[{
      id := ⟨"callable-recursive-layout", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := selected }]
    let source ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close selected)
    let some field := source.fields[0]? | throwError "the callable record lost its field"
    let callable ← field.toLayout
    unless callable.kind == .function do throwError "the recursive field lost its callable role"
    let result ← callable.applyIn context #[← context.close (mkConst ``Unit.unit)]
    let roles ← RoleTelescope.ofRequest identities program occurrence context none result #[]
    unless roles.results.any (fun role => role.layout.kind == .function) do
      throwError "the demanded recursive result lost its lazy callable continuation"
