namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

/-- Publish native results from one complete scoped source derivation. -/
private def resolveTerms (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (read : SourceReadM (Array Expr)) : TermElabM (Array SourceTerm) :=
  session.elaborateJudgementsScoped reference do
    return (← read).map fun value => ⟨value, none⟩

/-- Retain the selected declaration inside every original native lambda, closing all
selection fields over the same formal telescope before the source family is published. -/
private partial def retainResolvedFamily (reference : SelectedSourceReference)
    (value : Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  match value with
  | .lam name type body binderInfo =>
    SourceReadM.withLambda name type binderInfo fun parameter =>
      retainResolvedFamily reference (body.instantiate1 parameter)
  | _ => SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt reference value value)

/-- An exact symbolic source category and its retained native bundle. -/
structure SourceCategory where
  private mk ::
  expression : CategoryExpr
  value : SourceTerm

/-- Form the registered category family at actual arguments and explicit rigid universes.
Reuse: whole-declaration intake, native application and the actual category structure. -/
opaque SourceSession.namedCategory (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax) (name : String)
    (universes : List Level) (arguments : Array SourceTerm) : TermElabM SourceCategory := do
  let entry ← selectCategory (← semanticState) name
  let constant ← session.constant reference entry.declaration universes
  let value ← session.elaborateScoped reference do
    let arguments ← arguments.mapM fun argument => do
      return Arg.expr (← session.readTerm argument)
    let value ← elabAppArgs (← session.readTerm constant) #[] arguments none false false
    discard <| categoryIdentity value
    discard <| SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt (.category entry) value value)
    return value
  return ⟨entry.expression, value⟩

/-- Form an actual registered unary category constructor at the retained category bundle.
Reuse: the same semantics interface checked by source validateConstructor. -/
opaque SourceSession.unaryCategory (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (id : ConstructorId) (argument : SourceCategory) : TermElabM SourceCategory := do
  let some entry := (← semanticState).constructor? id
    | throwError "the source category constructor is absent"
  unless entry.signature == #[.category] do
    throwError "the selected source constructor does not take one category argument"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.semantics
  let value ← session.elaborateScoped reference do
    let category ← session.readTerm argument.value
    let value ← applyConstructorInterface entry.semantics #[category] #[category]
    discard <| categoryIdentity value
    discard <| SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt (.constructor entry) value value)
    return value
  return ⟨.construct id #[.category argument.expression], value⟩

/-- Retain the exact category already formed by registered object intake. -/
opaque SourceObject.sourceCategory (object : SourceObject) : SourceCategory :=
  ⟨object.categoryEntry.expression, object.category⟩

/-- One explicitly selected source derivation and its actual native functor. -/
structure SourceRoute where
  private mk ::
  route : Route
  source : SourceCategory
  target : SourceCategory
  functor : SourceTerm

/-- Interpret the selected route in the complete native context, preserving both bundle fields.
Reuse: the independent routeFunctor/functorCategoryBundles/applyConstructorInterface APIs.
This operation selects no representative from a family of mathematical readings. -/
opaque SourceRoutes.prepareFunctor (routes : SourceRoutes) (session : SourceSession)
    (reference : Syntax) (trace : RouteGrammar.Word) (source : SourceCategory) :
    TermElabM SourceRoute := do
  unless routes.source.syntacticEq source.expression do
    throwError "the native source category differs from the exact symbolic route source"
  let route ← routes.reconstruct trace
  let #[functor, target] ← resolveTerms session reference do
      let category ← session.readTerm source.value
      let selected : NativeRouteFunctor ← nativeEdgePathFunctorWith (m := SourceReadM)
        routes.state route.refs category
        (fun selected expected => SourceReadM.select selected expected)
      return #[selected.functor, selected.target]
    | throwError "native route formation returned an invalid number of expressions"
  return ⟨route, source, ⟨route.target, target⟩, functor⟩

/-- Exact source provenance for an explicitly registered functor or checked structural route. -/
inductive SourceFunctorDerivation where
  | registered (entry : FunctorEntry) (parameters : Array SourceTerm)
  | structural (route : SourceRoute)
  | identity (category : SourceCategory)
  | composition (first second : SourceFunctorDerivation)
  | constructed (constructor : ConstructorEntry) (functor : SourceFunctorDerivation)

/-- A whole native functor with both complete category bundles and original source references. -/
structure SourceFunctor where
  private mk ::
  derivation : SourceFunctorDerivation
  source : SourceCategory
  target : SourceCategory
  functor : SourceTerm

/-- Retain the actual functor already formed by checked source-route interpretation. -/
opaque SourceRoute.asFunctor (route : SourceRoute) : SourceFunctor :=
  ⟨.structural route, route.source, route.target, route.functor⟩

/-- Form an explicitly registered functor at its actual native parameters and source bundle.
Reuse: FunctorEntry, native elabAppArgs and the source registeredFunctorInstance interface.
Explicit selection admits nonstructural functors without changing structural inheritance. -/
opaque SourceSession.namedFunctor (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (id : FunctorId) (parameters : Array SourceTerm) (source : SourceCategory) :
    TermElabM SourceFunctor := do
  let #[entry] := (← semanticState).functors.filter (·.id == id)
    | throwError "explicit source functor selection requires one registered functor"
  let #[functor, target] ← session.elaborateJudgementsScoped reference do
      let arguments ← parameters.mapM fun parameter => do
        return Arg.expr (← session.readTerm parameter)
      let selected ← viewExpressions (.inl entry)
        (some (source.expression, ← session.readTerm source.value)) fun constant =>
          elabAppArgs constant #[] arguments none false false
      return #[⟨selected.functor, none⟩, ⟨selected.targetBundle, none⟩]
    | throwError "registered functor formation returned an invalid expression family"
  return ⟨.registered entry parameters, source, ⟨entry.target, target⟩, functor⟩

/-- Form the identity at the exact retained category structure.
Reuse: native Functor.id with both the actual carrier and category dictionary. -/
opaque SourceSession.identityFunctor (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (category : SourceCategory) : TermElabM SourceFunctor := do
  let functor ← session.elaborateScoped reference do
    categoryIdentity (← session.readTerm category.value)
  return ⟨.identity category, category, category, functor⟩

/-- Compose the actual retained native functors at their complete intermediate category.
Reuse: Semantic.mkFunctorComp, including its carrier/dictionary/universe checks. -/
opaque SourceSession.composeFunctors (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (first second : SourceFunctor) : TermElabM SourceFunctor := do
  unless first.target.expression.syntacticEq second.source.expression do
    throwError "source functor composition has different complete symbolic middle categories"
  let functor ← session.elaborateScoped reference do
    unless ← isDefEq (← session.readTerm first.target.value)
        (← session.readTerm second.source.value) do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "source functor composition has different complete native middle categories"
    mkFunctorComp (← session.readTerm first.functor)
      (← session.readTerm second.functor)
  return ⟨.composition first.derivation second.derivation, first.source, second.target, functor⟩

/-- Apply a registered unary constructor's original functor action to the retained source value.
Reuse: ConstructorEntry.functorialAction and the complete applyConstructorInterface contract. -/
opaque SourceSession.constructFunctor (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (id : ConstructorId) (functor : SourceFunctor) : TermElabM SourceFunctor := do
  let some constructor := (← semanticState).constructor? id
    | throwError "the source functor constructor is absent"
  unless constructor.signature == #[.category] do
    throwError "the source constructor does not expose a unary category functor interface"
  let some action := constructor.functorialAction
    | throwError "the source constructor has no declared functor action"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration constructor.semantics
  discard <| checkedDeclaration action
  let source ← session.unaryCategory reference id functor.source
  let target ← session.unaryCategory reference id functor.target
  let value ← session.elaborateScoped reference do
    let categories := #[← session.readTerm functor.source.value,
      ← session.readTerm functor.target.value]
    let value ← applyConstructorInterface action categories
      #[← session.readTerm functor.functor]
    let (domain, codomain) ← functorCategoryBundles value
    unless ← isDefEq domain (← session.readTerm source.value) <&&>
        isDefEq codomain (← session.readTerm target.value) do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "the constructor functor has different complete native category endpoints"
    SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
      (.constructorInterface constructor .functorialAction) value value)
  return ⟨.constructed constructor functor.derivation, source, target, value⟩

/-- An actual functor image retains the original native functor and source object. -/
structure SourceFunctorImage where
  private mk ::
  functor : SourceFunctor
  object : SourceTerm
  value : SourceTerm

/-- Apply the retained functor to the actual checked source object in the complete context.
Reuse: Functor.toPrefunctor/Prefunctor.obj and stable-ID context transport. -/
opaque SourceSession.functorImage (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (functor : SourceFunctor) (object : SourceTerm) : TermElabM SourceFunctorImage := do
  let value ← session.elaborateScoped reference do
    let native ← session.readTerm functor.functor
    let object ← session.readTerm object
    functorObject native object (← session.readTerm functor.target.value)
  return ⟨functor, object,
    ← value.inCategory functor.target.expression functor.target.value⟩

/-- A whole category declaration, before any of its formal parameters are selected. -/
structure SourceCategoryFamily where
  private mk ::
  expression : CategoryExpr
  family : SourceTerm

/-- Retain the unapplied source declaration at explicit rigid universes. -/
opaque SourceSession.categoryFamily (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax) (name : String)
    (universes : List Level) : TermElabM SourceCategoryFamily := do
  let entry ← selectCategory (← semanticState) name
  let constant ← session.constant reference entry.declaration universes
  let family ← session.elaborateScoped reference do
    let value ← session.readTerm constant
    discard <| SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt (.category entry) value value)
    return value
  return ⟨entry.expression, family⟩

/-- Apply unary semantics under the whole native parameter telescope. -/
opaque SourceSession.unaryCategoryFamily (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (id : ConstructorId) (argument : SourceCategoryFamily) : TermElabM SourceCategoryFamily := do
  let some entry := (← semanticState).constructor? id
    | throwError "the source category constructor is absent"
  unless entry.signature == #[.category] do
    throwError "the selected source constructor does not take one category argument"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.semantics
  let family ← session.elaborateScoped reference do
    let function ← session.readTerm argument.family
    let family ← liftM (m := MetaM) <|
      forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType function) fun parameters _ => do
        let category := mkAppN function parameters
        let value ← applyConstructorInterface entry.semantics #[category] #[category]
        discard <| categoryIdentity value
        mkLambdaFVars parameters value
    discard <| retainResolvedFamily (.constructor entry) family
    return family
  return ⟨.construct id #[.category argument.expression], family⟩

/-- Exact source binding and route, with the entire generic morphism family. -/
structure SourceOperationFamily where
  private mk ::
  private state : SemanticState
  source : SourceCategoryFamily
  route : Route
  binding : OperationEntry
  term : SourceTerm

private def operationTerm (state : SemanticState) (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (source : SourceCategoryFamily) (route : Route) (binding : OperationEntry) :
    TermElabM SourceTerm :=
  session.elaborateScoped reference do
    let family ← nativeOperationFamily state source.expression
      (← session.readTerm source.family) route binding
    retainResolvedFamily (.operation binding) family

/-- Form every binding at an explicitly selected first-hit target before choosing objects/operands.
Reuse: validateOperation's native object/numeral telescope boundary and native abstraction.
Category parameters and remaining declaration parameters are rigid, never chosen by providers. -/
opaque SourceRoutes.operationFamilies (routes : SourceRoutes) (session : SourceSession)
    (reference : Syntax) (trace : RouteGrammar.Word) (source : SourceCategoryFamily) :
    TermElabM (Array SourceOperationFamily) := do
  let .operation _ := routes.query
    | throwError "whole operation preparation requires an operation-name query"
  unless routes.source.syntacticEq source.expression do
    throwError "the whole category family differs from the exact symbolic route source"
  let route ← routes.reconstruct trace
  let bindings := routes.targets.filterMap fun
    | .operation category binding =>
      if category.expression.syntacticEq route.target then some binding else none
    | _ => none
  if bindings.isEmpty then throwError "the selected source target lost its operation binding"
  bindings.mapM fun binding => do
    let term ← operationTerm routes.state session reference source route binding
    return ⟨routes.state, source, route, binding, term⟩

/-- A declared operation restriction, retaining its first-hit binding and full general family. -/
structure SourceOperationRefinement where
  private mk ::
  original : SourceOperationFamily
  base : OperationEntry
  route : Route
  term : SourceTerm
  proposition : SourceTerm
  proof : SourceTerm

/-- Lift the actual registered restriction equality to the whole rigid operation family.
Reuse: OperationRefinement, validateOperation's full declaration-argument interface and funext.
The original first-hit reading is retained; the general family is reached by its declared route. -/
opaque SourceSession.operationRefinement (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (family : SourceOperationFamily) : TermElabM SourceOperationRefinement := do
  let some refinement := family.binding.refines
    | throwError "the source operation has no registered restriction equality"
  let state := family.state
  let #[base] := state.operations.filter (·.id == refinement.base)
    | throwError "the source restriction requires one registered general operation"
  let #[owner] := state.categories.filter (·.id == family.binding.category)
    | throwError "the source restriction has no unique original owner category"
  let #[baseOwner] := state.categories.filter (·.id == base.category)
    | throwError "the source restriction has no unique general owner category"
  unless family.route.target.syntacticEq owner.expression do
    throwError "the source restriction has a different complete original owner"
  let some steps := state.routeEdges? owner.expression baseOwner.expression refinement.route
    | throwError "the source restriction lost its actual structural route"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration refinement.identification
  let route : Route := {
    source := family.route.source
    target := baseOwner.expression
    steps := family.route.steps ++ steps }
  let term ← operationTerm state session reference family.source route base
  let #[proposition, proof] ← resolveTerms session reference do
      let left ← session.readTerm family.term
      let right ← session.readTerm term
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType left) (← inferType right) do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
          throwError "the source restriction has a different complete operation family type"
      let proposition ← mkEq left right
      let proof ← SourceReadM.prove proposition (sources := #[left, right]) fun proposition sources => do
        let letIds := (← getLCtx).foldl (fun ids declaration =>
          if declaration.isLet then ids.push declaration.fvarId else ids) #[]
        let left ← zetaDeltaFVars sources[0]! letIds
        let right ← zetaDeltaFVars sources[1]! letIds
        let proof ← lambdaTelescope left fun parameters body => do
          unless body.getAppFn.constName? == some family.binding.declaration do
            throwError "the retained operation family lost its original source declaration"
          let constant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels refinement.identification
          let (arguments, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType constant)
          let originalArguments := body.getAppArgs
          unless arguments.size == originalArguments.size do
            throwError "the source restriction equality has different complete declaration parameters"
          for argument in arguments, original in originalArguments do
            unless ← isDefEq (← inferType argument) (← inferType original) <&&>
                isDefEq argument original do
              throwError "the source restriction equality changes a rigid declaration parameter"
          let mut proof ← instantiateMVars (mkAppN constant arguments)
          let expected ← mkEq body (mkAppN right parameters).headBeta
          unless ← isDefEq (← inferType proof) expected do
            throwError "the source restriction equality has a different complete morphism equation"
          for parameter in parameters.reverse do
            proof ← mkAppM ``funext #[← mkLambdaFVars #[parameter] proof]
          return proof
        unless ← isDefEq (← inferType proof) proposition do
          throwError "the restriction evidence has a different complete operation family equation"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint proof proposition)
        return proof
      return #[proposition, proof]
    | throwError "source operation restriction returned an invalid evidence family"
  return ⟨family, base, route, term, proposition, proof⟩

/-- A checked equality of entire native operation families with both original derivations. -/
structure SourceOperationAgreement where
  private mk ::
  left : SourceOperationFamily
  right : SourceOperationFamily
  proposition : SourceTerm
  proof : SourceTerm

/-- Discharge whole-family agreement by native conversion and checked equality introduction.
Reuse: the source operation-agreement contract, Lean.mkEq/mkEqRefl and Meta.checkWithKernel.
An unsuccessful conversion supplies no evidence about other permitted comparisons. -/
opaque SourceSession.operationConversion (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (left right : SourceOperationFamily) : TermElabM (Option SourceOperationAgreement) := do
  unless left.source.expression.syntacticEq right.source.expression do
    throwError "operation comparison requires the same complete symbolic source"
  let evidence ← resolveTerms session reference do
    let leftCategory ← session.readTerm left.source.family
    let rightCategory ← session.readTerm right.source.family
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType leftCategory) (← inferType rightCategory) <&&>
        isDefEq leftCategory rightCategory do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "operation comparison requires the same complete native category family"
    let left ← session.readTerm left.term
    let right ← session.readTerm right.term
    let scope ← get
    let agrees ← liftM (m := MetaM) <|
      scope.context.withOriginalSources #[left, right] fun sources => do
        isDefEq (← inferType sources[0]!) (← inferType sources[1]!) <&&>
          isDefEq sources[0]! sources[1]!
    unless agrees do return #[]
    let proposition ← mkEq left right
    let proof ← SourceReadM.prove proposition (sources := #[left]) fun proposition sources => do
      let proof ← mkEqRefl sources[0]!
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType proof) proposition do
        throwError "conversion evidence has a different complete family equation"
      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint proof proposition)
      return proof
    return #[proposition, proof]
  match evidence with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[proposition, proof] => return some ⟨left, right, proposition, proof⟩
  | _ => throwError "operation conversion returned an invalid evidence shape"

/-- All-pairs evidence for the complete finite raw operation family.
The retained original derivations have no selected representative. -/
structure SourceFiniteOperationAgreement where
  private mk ::
  routes : SourceRoutes
  source : SourceCategoryFamily
  families : Array SourceOperationFamily
  agreements : Array (Array SourceOperationAgreement)

/-- Check conversion on every ordered pair of complete finite first-hit operation families.
Reuse: exact finite trace extraction and the source-authorized whole-family conversion rule.
None supplies no semantic judgment: infinite families and unresolved comparisons need evidence. -/
opaque SourceRoutes.finiteOperationConversion (routes : SourceRoutes) (session : SourceSession)
    (reference : Syntax) (source : SourceCategoryFamily) :
    TermElabM (Option SourceFiniteOperationAgreement) := do
  let .operation _ := routes.query
    | throwError "finite operation comparison requires an operation-name query"
  unless routes.source.syntacticEq source.expression do
    throwError "finite operation comparison has a different complete symbolic source"
  Core.checkSystem "finite operation trace extraction"
  let words := routes.language.grammar.finiteWords
  Core.checkSystem "finite operation trace saturation"
  let some words := words | return none
  let mut families : Array SourceOperationFamily := #[]
  for word in words do
    families := families ++ (← routes.operationFamilies session reference word source)
  if families.isEmpty then return none
  let mut agreements : Array (Array SourceOperationAgreement) := #[]
  for left in families do
    let mut row := #[]
    for right in families do
      Core.checkSystem "finite whole operation comparison"
      let some agreement ← session.operationConversion reference left right | return none
      row := row.push agreement
    agreements := agreements.push row
  return some ⟨routes, source, families, agreements⟩

inductive WhiskerSide where
  | left | right
  deriving BEq

/-- Actual source arguments of a registered constructor identity or composition comparison. -/
inductive ConstructorCoherence where
  | identity (category : SourceCategory)
  | composition (first second : SourceFunctor)

/-- Source-owned atoms and licensed composition/inversion in their original order. -/
inductive SourceCellDerivation where
  | registered (entry : CellEntry) (parameters : Array SourceTerm) (inverse : Bool)
  | vertical (first second : SourceCellDerivation)
  | horizontal (first second : SourceCellDerivation)
  | whisker (side : WhiskerSide) (functor : SourceFunctor) (cell : SourceCellDerivation)
  | constructed (constructor : ConstructorEntry) (cell : SourceCellDerivation)
  | coherence (constructor : ConstructorEntry) (input : ConstructorCoherence)
  | inverse (original : SourceCellDerivation)

/-- A whole directed transformation, before selecting any source object for its component. -/
structure SourceCell where
  private mk ::
  derivation : SourceCellDerivation
  source : SourceCategory
  target : SourceCategory
  transformation : SourceTerm
  left : SourceTerm
  right : SourceTerm
  isomorphism : Option SourceTerm

/-- Form the whole directed transformation of a source-owned cell in the complete context.
Reuse: CellEntry, SemanticState.cellEndpoints and Iso.hom/inv.
The source row and full native functor/category structures fix the endpoints and direction. -/
opaque SourceSession.cell (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (id : NaturalTransformationId) (parameters : Array SourceTerm) (source : SourceCategory)
    (inverse : Bool := false) : TermElabM SourceCell := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[entry] := state.cells.filter (·.id == id)
    | throwError "a source cell component requires one registered cell"
  unless source.expression.syntacticEq entry.source do
    throwError "the cell has a different complete symbolic source category"
  let terms ← resolveTerms session reference do
    let category ← session.readTerm source.value
    let arguments ← parameters.mapM fun parameter => do
      return Arg.expr (← session.readTerm parameter)
    let constant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
    let application ← elabAppArgs constant #[] arguments none false false
    let cell ← nativeSourceCell entry application inverse
    unless ← isDefEq cell.sourceBundle category do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "the source cell has a different complete native source category"
    let selected ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt (.cell entry)
      cell.application cell.application)
    let transformation ← if entry.invertible then
        mkAppM (if inverse then ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv else ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom) #[selected]
      else pure selected
    let isomorphism ← if entry.invertible then do
        let directed ← if inverse then mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.symm #[selected]
          else pure selected
        pure (some directed)
      else pure none
    let cell := { cell with transformation, isomorphism }
    let transformation ← SourceReadM.select {
      value := transformation, observation := some (.cell entry), cellFamily := some cell }
    let terms := #[transformation, cell.left.functor, cell.right.functor, cell.targetBundle]
    return terms ++ cell.isomorphism.toArray
  match terms with
  | #[transformation, left, right, target] =>
    return ⟨.registered entry parameters inverse, source, ⟨entry.target, target⟩,
      transformation, left, right, none⟩
  | #[transformation, left, right, target, isomorphism] =>
    return ⟨.registered entry parameters inverse, source, ⟨entry.target, target⟩,
      transformation, left, right, some isomorphism⟩
  | _ => throwError "source cell formation returned an invalid expression family"

/-- Compose whole native transformations at the same complete intermediate functor.
Reuse: Mathlib's CategoryStruct.comp on natural transformations and Iso.trans on isomorphisms.
Original source derivations and all data-bearing components remain attached to the program. -/
opaque SourceSession.composeCells (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (first second : SourceCell) : TermElabM SourceCell := do
  unless first.source.expression.syntacticEq second.source.expression &&
      first.target.expression.syntacticEq second.target.expression do
    throwError "cell composition has different complete symbolic categories"
  let terms ← resolveTerms session reference do
    unless ← isDefEq (← session.readTerm first.source.value)
          (← session.readTerm second.source.value) <&&>
        isDefEq (← session.readTerm first.target.value)
          (← session.readTerm second.target.value) do
      throwError "cell composition has different complete native categories"
    unless ← isDefEq (← session.readTerm first.right)
        (← session.readTerm second.left) do
      throwError "cell composition has different complete intermediate functors"
    let left ← session.readTerm first.left
    let right ← session.readTerm second.right
    let transformation ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
      #[← session.readTerm first.transformation,
        ← session.readTerm second.transformation]
    let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans #[left, right]
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType transformation) expected do
      throwError "cell composition has different complete native endpoints"
    match first.isomorphism, second.isomorphism with
    | some firstIso, some secondIso =>
      let isomorphism ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.trans
        #[← session.readTerm firstIso, ← session.readTerm secondIso]
      let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[left, right]
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType isomorphism) expected <&&>
          isDefEq (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[isomorphism]) transformation do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
          throwError "the composite isomorphism does not witness its complete directed transformation"
      return #[transformation, isomorphism]
    | _, _ => return #[transformation]
  match terms with
  | #[transformation] =>
    return ⟨.vertical first.derivation second.derivation, first.source, first.target,
      transformation, first.left, second.right, none⟩
  | #[transformation, isomorphism] =>
    return ⟨.vertical first.derivation second.derivation, first.source, first.target,
      transformation, first.left, second.right, some isomorphism⟩
  | _ => throwError "cell composition returned an invalid expression family"

/-- Compose whole cell actions horizontally through the exact complete intermediate category.
Reuse: native Functor.comp, NatTrans.hcomp and NatIso.hcomp, including their checked laws. -/
opaque SourceSession.horizontalCells (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (first second : SourceCell) : TermElabM SourceCell := do
  unless first.target.expression.syntacticEq second.source.expression do
    throwError "horizontal cell composition has different complete symbolic middle categories"
  let terms ← resolveTerms session reference do
    unless ← isDefEq (← session.readTerm first.target.value)
        (← session.readTerm second.source.value) do
      throwError "horizontal cell composition has different complete native middle categories"
    let left ← mkFunctorComp (← session.readTerm first.left)
      (← session.readTerm second.left)
    let right ← mkFunctorComp (← session.readTerm first.right)
      (← session.readTerm second.right)
    let transformation ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.hcomp
      #[← session.readTerm first.transformation,
        ← session.readTerm second.transformation]
    let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans #[left, right]
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType transformation) expected do
      throwError "horizontal cell composition has different complete native endpoints"
    match first.isomorphism, second.isomorphism with
    | some firstIso, some secondIso =>
      let isomorphism ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatIso.hcomp
        #[← session.readTerm firstIso, ← session.readTerm secondIso]
      let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[left, right]
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType isomorphism) expected <&&>
          isDefEq (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[isomorphism]) transformation do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
          throwError "horizontal isomorphism does not witness its complete directed transformation"
      return #[transformation, left, right, isomorphism]
    | _, _ => return #[transformation, left, right]
  match terms with
  | #[transformation, left, right] =>
    return ⟨.horizontal first.derivation second.derivation, first.source, second.target,
      transformation, left, right, none⟩
  | #[transformation, left, right, isomorphism] =>
    return ⟨.horizontal first.derivation second.derivation, first.source, second.target,
      transformation, left, right, some isomorphism⟩
  | _ => throwError "horizontal cell composition returned an invalid expression family"

/-- Reverse a retained source-authorized invertible transformation in the full current scope.
Reuse: Iso.symm and Iso.hom on the actual retained native isomorphism. -/
opaque SourceSession.inverseCell (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (cell : SourceCell) : TermElabM SourceCell := do
  let some original := cell.isomorphism | throwError "the source transformation has no inverse"
  let #[transformation, isomorphism, left, right] ← resolveTerms session reference do
    let isomorphism ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.symm #[← session.readTerm original]
    let left ← session.readTerm cell.right
    let right ← session.readTerm cell.left
    let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[left, right]
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType isomorphism) expected do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "the inverse isomorphism has different complete native endpoints"
    return #[← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[isomorphism], isomorphism, left, right]
    | throwError "source inverse formation returned an invalid expression family"
  return ⟨.inverse cell.derivation, cell.source, cell.target,
    transformation, left, right, some isomorphism⟩

/-- Whisker the actual source transformation on the selected side by a retained whole functor.
Reuse: Functor.whiskerLeft/Right and isoWhiskerLeft/Right at complete native endpoints. -/
opaque SourceSession.whiskerCell (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (side : WhiskerSide) (functor : SourceFunctor) (cell : SourceCell) : TermElabM SourceCell := do
  let (source, target, firstMiddle, secondMiddle) := match side with
    | .left => (functor.source, cell.target, functor.target, cell.source)
    | .right => (cell.source, functor.target, cell.target, functor.source)
  unless firstMiddle.expression.syntacticEq secondMiddle.expression do
    throwError "whiskering has different complete symbolic middle categories"
  let terms ← resolveTerms session reference do
    unless ← isDefEq (← session.readTerm firstMiddle.value)
        (← session.readTerm secondMiddle.value) do
      throwError "whiskering has different complete native middle categories"
    let functor ← session.readTerm functor.functor
    let compose (part : Expr) := match side with
      | .left => mkFunctorComp functor part
      | .right => mkFunctorComp part functor
    let arguments (part : Expr) := match side with
      | .left => #[functor, part]
      | .right => #[part, functor]
    let left ← compose (← session.readTerm cell.left)
    let right ← compose (← session.readTerm cell.right)
    let operation := match side with
      | .left => ``CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerLeft
      | .right => ``CategoryTheory.Functor.whiskerRight
    let transformation ← mkAppM operation
      (arguments (← session.readTerm cell.transformation))
    let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans #[left, right]
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType transformation) expected do
      throwError "whiskering has different complete native functor endpoints"
    match cell.isomorphism with
    | none => return #[transformation, left, right]
    | some original =>
      let operation := match side with
        | .left => ``CategoryTheory.Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        | .right => ``CategoryTheory.Functor.isoWhiskerRight
      let isomorphism ← mkAppM operation (arguments (← session.readTerm original))
      let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[left, right]
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType isomorphism) expected <&&>
          isDefEq (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[isomorphism]) transformation do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
          throwError "the whiskered isomorphism does not witness its complete directed transformation"
      return #[transformation, left, right, isomorphism]
  match terms with
  | #[transformation, left, right] =>
    return ⟨.whisker side functor cell.derivation, source, target,
      transformation, left, right, none⟩
  | #[transformation, left, right, isomorphism] =>
    return ⟨.whisker side functor cell.derivation, source, target,
      transformation, left, right, some isomorphism⟩
  | _ => throwError "whiskering returned an invalid expression family"

private def checkConstructorComparison (source target left right isomorphism : Expr) :
    MetaM Unit := do
  let (leftSource, leftTarget) ← functorCategoryBundles left
  let (rightSource, rightTarget) ← functorCategoryBundles right
  unless ← isDefEq leftSource source <&&> isDefEq leftTarget target <&&>
      isDefEq rightSource source <&&> isDefEq rightTarget target do
    throwError "the constructor action has different complete native categories"
  let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[left, right]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType isomorphism) expected do
    throwError "the constructor comparison has different complete native functor endpoints"

/-- Apply a registered unary constructor's actual comparison action to a native isomorphism.
Reuse: ConstructorEntry.comparisonAction and the independent applyConstructorInterface contract.
Both the mapped functors and the comparison retain the actual complete category parameters. -/
opaque SourceSession.constructCell (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (id : ConstructorId) (cell : SourceCell) : TermElabM SourceCell := do
  let some constructor := (← semanticState).constructor? id
    | throwError "the source comparison constructor is absent"
  unless constructor.signature == #[.category] do
    throwError "the source constructor does not expose a unary category comparison interface"
  let some action := constructor.functorialAction
    | throwError "the source constructor has no declared functor action"
  let some comparison := constructor.comparisonAction
    | throwError "the source constructor has no declared comparison action"
  let some original := cell.isomorphism
    | throwError "the source constructor comparison interface requires a native isomorphism"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration constructor.semantics
  discard <| checkedDeclaration action
  discard <| checkedDeclaration comparison
  let source ← session.unaryCategory reference id cell.source
  let target ← session.unaryCategory reference id cell.target
  let #[transformation, left, right, isomorphism] ← resolveTerms session reference do
    let categories := #[← session.readTerm cell.source.value,
      ← session.readTerm cell.target.value]
    let left ← applyConstructorInterface action categories #[← session.readTerm cell.left]
    let right ← applyConstructorInterface action categories #[← session.readTerm cell.right]
    let isomorphism ← applyConstructorInterface comparison categories
      #[← session.readTerm original]
    let left ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
      (.constructorInterface constructor .functorialAction) left left)
    let right ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
      (.constructorInterface constructor .functorialAction) right right)
    let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[left, right]
    let isomorphism ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
      (.constructorInterface constructor .comparisonAction) isomorphism isomorphism) (some expected)
    checkConstructorComparison (← session.readTerm source.value)
      (← session.readTerm target.value) left right isomorphism
    return #[← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[isomorphism], left, right, isomorphism]
    | throwError "constructor comparison returned an invalid expression family"
  return ⟨.constructed constructor cell.derivation, source, target,
    transformation, left, right, some isomorphism⟩

/-- Retain the registered constructor's actual identity/composition coherence isomorphism.
Reuse: ConstructorEntry.identityComparison/compositionComparison and validateConstructor's
complete category/explicit-input interface, with the native source functors retained intact. -/
opaque SourceSession.constructorCoherence (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (id : ConstructorId) (input : ConstructorCoherence) : TermElabM SourceCell := do
  let some constructor := (← semanticState).constructor? id
    | throwError "the source comparison constructor is absent"
  unless constructor.signature == #[.category] do
    throwError "the source constructor does not expose a unary category comparison interface"
  let some action := constructor.functorialAction
    | throwError "the source constructor has no declared functor action"
  let law ← match input with
    | .identity _ => match constructor.identityComparison with
      | some law => pure law
      | none => throwError "the source constructor has no declared identity comparison"
    | .composition _ _ => match constructor.compositionComparison with
      | some law => pure law
      | none => throwError "the source constructor has no declared composition comparison"
  let (domain, codomain) ← match input with
    | .identity category => pure (category, category)
    | .composition first second => do
      unless first.target.expression.syntacticEq second.source.expression do
        throwError "constructor composition has different complete symbolic middle categories"
      pure (first.source, second.target)
  discard <| checkedDeclaration constructor.semantics
  discard <| checkedDeclaration action
  discard <| checkedDeclaration law
  let source ← session.unaryCategory reference id domain
  let target ← session.unaryCategory reference id codomain
  let #[transformation, left, right, isomorphism] ← resolveTerms session reference do
    let (left, right, isomorphism) ← match input with
      | .identity category => do
        let category ← session.readTerm category.value
        let left ← applyConstructorInterface action #[category, category]
          #[← categoryIdentity category]
        let left ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
          (.constructorInterface constructor .functorialAction) left left)
        let right ← categoryIdentity (← session.readTerm source.value)
        let isomorphism ← applyConstructorInterface law #[category] #[category]
        let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[left, right]
        let isomorphism ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
          (.constructorInterface constructor .identityComparison) isomorphism isomorphism) (some expected)
        pure (left, right, isomorphism)
      | .composition first second => do
        let C ← session.readTerm first.source.value
        let D ← session.readTerm first.target.value
        let E ← session.readTerm second.target.value
        unless ← isDefEq D (← session.readTerm second.source.value) do
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
            throwError "constructor composition has different complete native middle categories"
        let F ← session.readTerm first.functor
        let G ← session.readTerm second.functor
        let left ← applyConstructorInterface action #[C, E] #[← mkFunctorComp F G]
        let left ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
          (.constructorInterface constructor .functorialAction) left left)
        let first ← applyConstructorInterface action #[C, D] #[F]
        let second ← applyConstructorInterface action #[D, E] #[G]
        let first ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
          (.constructorInterface constructor .functorialAction) first first)
        let second ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
          (.constructorInterface constructor .functorialAction) second second)
        let right ← mkFunctorComp first second
        let isomorphism ← applyConstructorInterface law #[C, D, E] #[F, G]
        let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[left, right]
        let isomorphism ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
          (.constructorInterface constructor .compositionComparison) isomorphism isomorphism) (some expected)
        pure (left, right, isomorphism)
    checkConstructorComparison (← session.readTerm source.value)
      (← session.readTerm target.value) left right isomorphism
    return #[← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[isomorphism], left, right, isomorphism]
    | throwError "constructor coherence returned an invalid expression family"
  return ⟨.coherence constructor input, source, target,
    transformation, left, right, some isomorphism⟩

/-- A checked component retains the entire original directed source cell. -/
structure SourceCellComponent where
  private mk ::
  cell : SourceCell
  object : SourceTerm
  value : SourceTerm

/-- Apply the retained whole transformation at the exact checked native source object.
Reuse: NatTrans.app and stable-ID context transport; no declaration is reconstructed. -/
opaque SourceSession.cellComponent (session : SourceSession) (reference : Syntax)
    (cell : SourceCell) (object : SourceTerm) : TermElabM SourceCellComponent := do
  let value ← session.elaborateScoped reference do
    let category ← session.readTerm cell.source.value
    let object ← session.readTerm object
    let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[category]
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType object) carrier do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "the source cell object has a different complete native category"
    let transformation ← session.readTerm cell.transformation
    if let some original := (← SourceReadM.selection? transformation).bind (·.cellFamily) then
      let selected ← original.selectedComponent ⟨object,
        some ⟨.object, cell.source.expression, category, none, none⟩⟩
      selectMorphism selected (fun selected expected => SourceReadM.select selected expected)
        (some original.targetBundle)
    else
      mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[transformation, object]
  return ⟨cell, object, value⟩

end CasCompiler

import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Foundation.FiniteObjects
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.ConstructorRegistration
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.MonoidOperations
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.SourceRoutes
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Foundation.FiniteObjects
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.ConstructorRegistration
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.MonoidOperations

open Lean Elab Command CasCompiler CasCatalogue

run_cmd do
  let state ← liftCoreM semanticState
  let some edge := state.structuralEdges.find? fun edge =>
      match edge.ref with
      | .classifierForget _ => !edge.source.syntacticEq edge.target
      | _ => false
    | throwError "the actual source imports supply no classifier-forget control"
  let routes ← liftCoreM <| SourceRoutes.forOwner edge.source edge.target
  let some index := routes.edges.findIdx? (·.ref == edge.ref)
    | throwError "the source route inventory discarded an actual structural edge"
  unless routes.language.grammar.contains #[index] do
    throwError "the source grammar discarded a registered first-hit route"
  let route ← liftCoreM <| routes.reconstruct #[index]
  unless route.refs == #[edge.ref] && route.source.syntacticEq edge.source &&
      route.target.syntacticEq edge.target do
    throwError "source reconstruction changed an edge identity or complete endpoint"
  let some constructor := state.constructors.find? (·.functorialAction.isSome)
    | throwError "the actual source imports supply no unary structural action control"
  let source := CategoryExpr.construct constructor.id #[.category edge.source]
  let target := CategoryExpr.construct constructor.id #[.category edge.target]
  let derived ← liftCoreM <| SourceRoutes.forOwner source target
  let some index := derived.edges.findIdx? (·.ref == edge.ref)
    | throwError "the derived source inventory discarded its original edge"
  unless derived.language.grammar.contains #[index] do
    throwError "the source grammar discarded an actual constructor-image route"
  let route ← liftCoreM <| derived.reconstruct #[index]
  unless route.refs == #[.constructMap constructor.id edge.ref] &&
      route.source.syntacticEq source && route.target.syntacticEq target do
    throwError "source reconstruction lost its exact constructor action"
  let some binding := state.operations[0]?
    | throwError "the actual source imports supply no operation binding control"
  let some owner := state.categories.find? (·.id == binding.category)
    | throwError "the source operation has no registered owner"
  let bound ← liftCoreM <| SourceRoutes.forOperation owner.expression binding.name
  unless bound.targets.any (fun target => match target with
      | .operation category selected => category.id == owner.id && selected.id == binding.id &&
          selected.declaration == binding.declaration && selected.arity == binding.arity
      | _ => false) do
    throwError "the route target lost its actual source operation binding"
  unless bound.language.grammar.contains #[] && bound.language.grammar.distinctWordCount == 1 do
    throwError "the source operation name did not bind at its first owner"
  let some candidates ← liftCoreM bound.finiteRoutes
    | throwError "the initial operation binding acquired an infinite route family"
  unless candidates.size == 1 && candidates[0]?.map (·.steps.isEmpty) == some true &&
      candidates[0]?.map (·.target.syntacticEq owner.expression) == some true do
    throwError "finite source candidates lost the actual empty first-binding route"

public import CasCompiler.Layout
public import CasRuntime.Identity

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasRuntime

/-- Source positions remain distinct when their terms or actual values coincide. -/
inductive RoleAddress
  | context (binding : BindingId)
  | argument (position : Nat)
  | result (path : Array Name)
  | capture (position : Nat)
  deriving BEq, Hashable, Repr

/-- A retained preparation remains distinct from another build of the same source occurrence. -/
structure RoleScope where
  private mk ::
  program : RuntimeId .program
  occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence
  preparation : RuntimeId .preparation
  deriving BEq, Hashable, Repr

structure RoleId where
  private mk ::
  scope : RoleScope
  address : RoleAddress
  deriving BEq, Hashable, Repr

/-- Checked source term, complete native family and exact source-position dependencies. -/
structure ComputationalRole where
  private mk ::
  id : RoleId
  source : ClosedTerm
  typeFamily : ClosedTerm
  dependencies : Array RoleId

structure ArgumentRole where
  private mk ::
  role : ComputationalRole
  wireIndex : Option Nat

structure CaptureRole where
  private mk ::
  role : ComputationalRole
  layout : SourceLayout

structure ResultRole where
  private mk ::
  role : ComputationalRole
  layout : SourceLayout
  wirePath : Option (Array Nat)

/-- Full semantic context and source roles; only declared inputs are demanded before a call.
Future result fields remain declarations until whole-result admission binds their actual values. -/
structure RoleTelescope where
  private mk ::
  scope : RoleScope
  source : SourceLayout
  context : Array ComputationalRole
  arguments : Array ArgumentRole
  results : Array ResultRole
  captures : Array CaptureRole

private def sourceTypeFamily (source : ClosedTerm) : MetaM ClosedTerm :=
  source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    context.close (← inferType expression)

private def contextRoles (scope : RoleScope) (term : ClosedTerm) : MetaM (Array RoleId) :=
  term.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let dependencies ← localDependencies (bindings.map (·.expression)) expression
    dependencies.mapM fun index => do
      let some binding := bindings[index]?
        | throwError "a computational role dependency is outside its native context"
      return ⟨scope, .context binding.id⟩

private partial def resultRoles (scope : RoleScope) (application : Option ApplicationLayout)
    (source : SourceLayout) (family : ClosedTerm) (dependencies : Array RoleId)
    (wirePath : Option (Array Nat)) : MetaM (Array ResultRole) := do
  let root : ResultRole := ⟨⟨⟨scope, .result source.address⟩, source.source, family, dependencies⟩,
    source, wirePath⟩
  let mut results := #[root]
  if source.kind == .record then
    let record ← RecordLayout.ofSource source
    for prepared in record.fields do
      let mut fieldDependencies ← contextRoles scope prepared.field.typeFamily
      if let some application := application then
        let selected ← application.dependenciesFor prepared.layout
        fieldDependencies := fieldDependencies ++ selected.arguments.map fun index =>
          (⟨scope, .argument index⟩ : RoleId)
      for previous in prepared.field.precedingDependencies do
        let some field := record.fields[previous]?
          | throwError "a result role dependency is outside its source constructor"
        fieldDependencies := fieldDependencies.push ⟨scope, .result field.field.address⟩
      let childPath := wirePath.bind fun path => prepared.field.wireIndex.map path.push
      results := results ++ (← resultRoles scope application prepared.layout
        prepared.field.typeFamily fieldDependencies childPath)
  return results

/-- Derive identities from source binder positions, field paths and capture positions.
Reuse: checked Layout families, ContextTelescope, native dependency closure and worker identities.
Source: lean-cas-dsl#66, scoped computational-role telescope and total demanded-role map. -/
opaque RoleTelescope.ofRequest (identities : IdentitySupply)
    (program : RuntimeId .program) (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence)
    (context : OpenContext) (application : Option ApplicationLayout) (source : SourceLayout)
    (captures : Array SourceLayout) : MetaM RoleTelescope := do
  unless identities.worker == program.worker && program.worker == occurrence.worker do
    throwError "a computational role scope mixed worker identities"
  let scope : RoleScope := ⟨program, occurrence, ← identities.fresh .preparation⟩
  let mut contextRoles : Array ComputationalRole := #[]
  for binding in context.bindings do
    let term ← context.close binding.expression
    let family ← sourceTypeFamily term
    contextRoles := contextRoles.push ⟨⟨scope, .context binding.id⟩, term, family,
      ← CasCompiler.contextRoles scope family⟩
  let mut arguments : Array ArgumentRole := #[]
  if let some application := application then
    for argument in application.arguments, index in [:application.arguments.size] do
      unless argument.sourceIndex == index do
        throwError "an application role lost its original source binder position"
      let dependencies := (← CasCompiler.contextRoles scope argument.typeFamily) ++
        argument.precedingDependencies.map fun previous => (⟨scope, .argument previous⟩ : RoleId)
      arguments := arguments.push ⟨⟨⟨scope, .argument index⟩, argument.source.source,
        argument.typeFamily, dependencies⟩, argument.wireIndex⟩
  let family ← match application with
    | some layout => pure layout.resultTypeFamily
    | none => sourceTypeFamily source.source
  let mut rootDependencies ← CasCompiler.contextRoles scope family
  if let some application := application then
    rootDependencies := rootDependencies ++ application.resultDependencies.map fun index =>
      (⟨scope, .argument index⟩ : RoleId)
  let results ← resultRoles scope application source family rootDependencies (some #[])
  let captures ← captures.mapIdxM fun index source => do
    let family ← sourceTypeFamily source.source
    let role := ComputationalRole.mk ⟨scope, .capture index⟩ source.source family
      (← CasCompiler.contextRoles scope family)
    return CaptureRole.mk role source
  return ⟨scope, source, contextRoles, arguments, results, captures⟩

end CasCompiler

/-- Ground prefix words use exact symbol ordinals supplied by the source adapter.
Algorithm: structural_routes_reference.py at cd3cf75; lean-cas-dsl#66 comment 6693871042.
Reuse: the standard PDA-to-CFG productive-summary construction, AFP Pushdown Systems.
No source stack depth or trace length is bounded by this representation. -/
abbrev Word := Array Nat

structure PrefixRule where

  rhs : Word

private inductive Letter

private structure Production where
  emit : Option Nat
  children : Array Summary
  deriving BEq, Inhabited

structure TraceGrammar where
  private mk ::
  private start : Summary
  private productions : Std.HashMap Summary (Array Production)

private def pushUnique [BEq α] (values : Array α) (value : α) : Array α :=
  if values.contains value then values else values.push value

private structure TargetDFA where
  leading : Array (Array Letter)
  accepting : Array Nat

private def targetDFA (targets : Array Word) : TargetDFA := Id.run do
  let mut leading := #[#[]]
  let mut accepting := #[]
  for target in targets do
    let reversed := ((target.map Letter.source).push .bottom).reverse
    for n in [1:reversed.size + 1] do
      leading := pushUnique leading (reversed.extract 0 n)
    if let some index := leading.findIdx? (· == reversed) then
      accepting := pushUnique accepting index
  return ⟨leading, accepting⟩

private def TargetDFA.step (dfa : TargetDFA) (state : Nat) (letter : Letter) : Nat :=
  if state >= dfa.leading.size then dfa.leading.size
  else (dfa.leading.findIdx? (· == dfa.leading[state]!.push letter)).getD dfa.leading.size

private def TargetDFA.annotate (dfa : TargetDFA) (word : Array Letter) (below : Nat) :
    Array StackSymbol := Id.run do
  let mut result := #[]
  let mut state := below
  for letter in word.reverse do
    result := result.push (match letter with
      | .source symbol => .source symbol state
      | .bottom => .bottom state)
    state := dfa.step state letter
  return result.reverse

private inductive Push
  | none
  | one (first : StackSymbol)
  | two (first second : StackSymbol)
  deriving BEq, Inhabited

private structure Transition where
  source : Nat
  pop : StackSymbol
  target : Nat
  push : Push
  emit : Option Nat
  deriving BEq, Inhabited

private structure Machine where
  nextControl : Nat := 4
  transitions : Array Transition := #[]

private def fresh : StateM Machine Nat := do
  let control := (← get).nextControl
  modify fun machine => { machine with nextControl := control + 1 }
  return control

private def transition (source : Nat) (pop : StackSymbol) (target : Nat) (push : Push)
    (emit : Option Nat) : StateM Machine Unit :=
  modify fun machine => { machine with
    transitions := pushUnique machine.transitions ⟨source, pop, target, push, emit⟩ }

private def pushWord (source : Nat) (pop : StackSymbol) (target : Nat)
    (word : Array StackSymbol) (emit : Option Nat) : StateM Machine Unit := do
  match word with
  | #[] => transition source pop target .none emit
  | #[first] => transition source pop target (.one first) emit
  | #[first, second] => transition source pop target (.two first second) emit
  | _ =>
    let mut control ← fresh
    transition source pop control (.two word[word.size - 2]! word[word.size - 1]!) emit
    for offset in [:word.size - 2] do
      let index := word.size - 3 - offset
      let following ← if index == 0 then pure target else fresh
      transition control word[index + 1]! following (.two word[index]! word[index + 1]!) none
      control := following

private def machine (rules : Array PrefixRule) (initial : Word) (targets : Array Word) :
    Machine := (do
  let dfa := targetDFA targets
  let mut alphabet := #[]
  for word in #[initial] ++ targets ++ rules.flatMap (fun rule => #[rule.lhs, rule.rhs]) do
    for symbol in word do alphabet := pushUnique alphabet symbol
  for index in [:rules.size] do
    let rule := rules[index]!
    let mut matching := #[0]
    for _ in [1:rule.lhs.size] do matching := matching.push (← fresh)
    for position in [:rule.lhs.size] do
      let expected := rule.lhs[position]!
      for summary in [:dfa.leading.size + 1] do
        if position == 0 && dfa.accepting.contains (dfa.step summary (.source expected)) then
          continue
        let top := StackSymbol.source expected summary
        if position + 1 < rule.lhs.size then
          transition matching[position]! top matching[position + 1]! .none none
        else
          pushWord matching[position]! top 0 (dfa.annotate (rule.rhs.map Letter.source) summary)
            (some index)
  for summary in [:dfa.leading.size + 1] do
    transition 1 (.bottom summary) 2 .none none
    for symbol in alphabet do
      let top := StackSymbol.source symbol summary
      transition 1 top 1 .none none
      if dfa.accepting.contains (dfa.step summary (.source symbol)) then
        transition 0 top 1 .none none
  pushWord 3 .start 0 (dfa.annotate ((initial.map Letter.source).push .bottom) 0) none
  : StateM Machine Unit).run {} |>.2

private partial def productiveGrammar (transitions : Array Transition) :
    Summary × Std.HashMap Summary (Array Production) := Id.run do
  let mut finishes : Std.HashMap (Nat × StackSymbol) (Array Nat) := {}
  let mut changed := true
  while changed do
    changed := false
    for rule in transitions do
      let ends := match rule.push with
        | .none => #[rule.target]
        | .one first => finishes.getD (rule.target, first) #[]
        | .two first second =>
          (finishes.getD (rule.target, first) #[]).flatMap fun middle =>
            finishes.getD (middle, second) #[]
      let key := (rule.source, rule.pop)
      let previous := finishes.getD key #[]
      let next := ends.foldl pushUnique previous
      if next.size != previous.size then
        changed := true
        finishes := finishes.insert key next
  let mut productions : Std.HashMap Summary (Array Production) := {}
  for rule in transitions do
    let alternatives : Array (Nat × Array Summary) := match rule.push with
      | .none => #[(rule.target, #[])]
      | .one first => (finishes.getD (rule.target, first) #[]).map fun target =>
          (target, #[⟨rule.target, first, target⟩])
      | .two first second => (finishes.getD (rule.target, first) #[]).flatMap fun middle =>
          (finishes.getD (middle, second) #[]).map fun target =>
            (target, #[⟨rule.target, first, middle⟩, ⟨middle, second, target⟩])
    for (target, children) in alternatives do
      let key : Summary := ⟨rule.source, rule.pop, target⟩
      productions := productions.insert key
        (pushUnique (productions.getD key #[]) ⟨rule.emit, children⟩)
  let start : Summary := ⟨3, .start, 2⟩
  let mut work := #[start]
  let mut cursor := 0
  let mut reachable : Std.HashMap Summary (Array Production) := {}
  while cursor < work.size do
    let key := work[cursor]!
    let alternatives := productions.getD key #[]
    reachable := reachable.insert key alternatives
    for alternative in alternatives do
      for child in alternative.children do work := pushUnique work child
    cursor := cursor + 1
  return (start, reachable)

private partial def shortestTrace (grammar : TraceGrammar) : Option Word := Id.run do
  let mut best : Std.HashMap Summary Word := {}
  let mut changed := true
  while changed do
    changed := false
    for (lhs, alternatives) in grammar.productions do
      for alternative in alternatives do
        if alternative.children.any (fun child => !best.contains child) then continue
        let word := alternative.children.foldl (fun result child => result ++ best.getD child #[])
          (alternative.emit.toArray)
        let improves : Bool := match best[lhs]? with
          | none => true
          | some old => word.size < old.size ||
              (word.size == old.size && compare word.toList old.toList == .lt)
        if improves then
          best := best.insert lhs word
          changed := true
  return best[grammar.start]?

/-- A diagnostic least trace. It confers no mathematical preference among source readings. -/
opaque TraceGrammar.shortest (grammar : TraceGrammar) : Option Word := shortestTrace grammar

private partial def reachable (graph : Std.HashMap Summary (Array Summary))
    (source : Summary) : Array Summary := Id.run do
  let mut work := #[source]
  let mut cursor := 0
  while cursor < work.size do
    for target in graph.getD work[cursor]! #[] do work := pushUnique work target
    cursor := cursor + 1
  return work

private partial def finiteWords (grammar : TraceGrammar) : Option (Array Word) := Id.run do
  let mut productive : Std.HashSet Summary := {}
  let mut nonempty : Std.HashSet Summary := {}
  let mut changed := true
  while changed do
    changed := false
    for (lhs, alternatives) in grammar.productions do
      for alternative in alternatives do
        unless alternative.children.all productive.contains do continue
        unless productive.contains lhs do
          productive := productive.insert lhs
          changed := true
        if (alternative.emit.isSome || alternative.children.any nonempty.contains) &&
            !nonempty.contains lhs then
          nonempty := nonempty.insert lhs
          changed := true
  let mut graph : Std.HashMap Summary (Array Summary) := {}
  let mut growing : Array (Summary × Summary) := #[]
  for (lhs, alternatives) in grammar.productions do
    for alternative in alternatives do
      unless alternative.children.all productive.contains do continue
      for index in [:alternative.children.size] do
        let child := alternative.children[index]!
        graph := graph.insert lhs (pushUnique (graph.getD lhs #[]) child)
        let grows := alternative.emit.isSome ||
          (alternative.children.mapIdx fun sibling other =>
            sibling != index && nonempty.contains other).any id
        if grows then growing := pushUnique growing (lhs, child)
  let live := reachable graph grammar.start
  for (source, target) in growing do
    if live.contains source && (reachable graph target).contains source then return none
  let mut languages : Std.HashMap Summary (Array Word) := {}
  changed := true
  while changed do
    changed := false
    for lhs in live do
      for alternative in grammar.productions.getD lhs #[] do
        unless alternative.children.all productive.contains do continue
        let mut words := #[alternative.emit.toArray]
        for child in alternative.children do
          words := words.flatMap fun leading =>
            (languages.getD child #[]).map (leading ++ ·)
        let previous := languages.getD lhs #[]
        let next := words.foldl pushUnique previous
        if next.size != previous.size then
          languages := languages.insert lhs next
          changed := true
  return some (languages.getD grammar.start #[])

/-- The complete finite raw trace set; none denotes a productive growing cycle.
Reuse: finite_words in the published reference and #66 comment 6693871042 §3.
Silent recursion alone does not establish an infinite trace language. -/
opaque TraceGrammar.finiteWords (grammar : TraceGrammar) : Option (Array Word) :=
  CasCompiler.RouteGrammar.finiteWords grammar

private partial def intersects (grammar : TraceGrammar) (states : Nat)
    (accept : Nat → Bool) (step : Nat → Nat → Nat) : Bool := Id.run do
  let mut relations : Std.HashMap Summary (Array (Nat × Nat)) := {}
  let mut changed := true
  while changed do
    changed := false
    for (lhs, alternatives) in grammar.productions do
      for alternative in alternatives do
        let mut edges := (Array.range states).map fun state =>
          (state, alternative.emit.map (step state) |>.getD state)
        for child in alternative.children do
          edges := edges.flatMap fun (source, middle) =>
            (relations.getD child #[]).filterMap fun (left, target) =>
              if middle == left then some (source, target) else none
        let previous := relations.getD lhs #[]
        let next := edges.foldl pushUnique previous
        if next.size != previous.size then
          relations := relations.insert lhs next
          changed := true
  return (relations.getD grammar.start #[]).any fun (source, target) => source == 0 && accept target

private def singletonStep (word : Word) (position letter : Nat) : Nat :=
  if position < word.size && word[position]? == some letter then position + 1 else word.size + 1

/-- Exact membership via grammar intersection with the singleton-word automaton. -/
opaque TraceGrammar.contains (grammar : TraceGrammar) (word : Word) : Bool :=
  intersects grammar (word.size + 2) (· == word.size) (singletonStep word)

/-- Saturated raw trace-word count, not a count of mathematical meanings or grammar parses. -/
opaque TraceGrammar.distinctWordCount (grammar : TraceGrammar) : Nat :=
  match grammar.shortest with
  | none => 0
  | some word =>
    if intersects grammar (word.size + 2) (· != word.size) (singletonStep word) then 2 else 1

structure Occurrence where
  rule : Nat
  source : Word
  target : Word
  outerContext : Word
  deriving Inhabited

structure RouteLanguage where
  private mk ::
  rules : Array PrefixRule
  initial : Word
  targets : Array Word
  grammar : TraceGrammar

/-- Recover each formal source-rule occurrence and its exact constructor suffix. -/
def RouteLanguage.reconstruct (language : RouteLanguage) (trace : Word) :
    Except String (Array Occurrence) := do
  let mut current := language.initial
  let mut occurrences := #[]
  for index in trace do
    if language.targets.contains current then throw "route continues beyond its first binding"
    let some rule := language.rules[index]? | throw "route references an absent source rule"
    unless current.extract 0 rule.lhs.size == rule.lhs do
      throw "source route has a noncomposable prefix"
    let outerContext := current.extract rule.lhs.size current.size
    let target := rule.rhs ++ outerContext
    occurrences := occurrences.push ⟨index, current, target, outerContext⟩
    current := target
  unless language.targets.contains current do throw "source route does not reach a binding"
  return occurrences

/-- Exact finite grammar of all finite first-hit routes for a finite ground-prefix system.
The ordinal of each input rule remains its distinct trace identity. -/
opaque compile (rules : Array PrefixRule) (initial : Word) (targets : Array Word) :
    Except String RouteLanguage := do
  if initial.isEmpty || targets.any (·.isEmpty) ||
      rules.any (fun rule => rule.lhs.isEmpty || rule.rhs.isEmpty) then
    throw "source category words and ground-rule endpoints must be nonempty"
  let (start, productions) := productiveGrammar (machine rules initial targets).transitions
  return ⟨rules, initial, targets, ⟨start, productions⟩⟩

end CasCompiler.RouteGrammar

import CasCompiler.RouteGrammar
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.RouteGrammar

open CasCompiler.RouteGrammar

private def verify : Except String Unit := do
  let rules := #[
    { lhs := #[0], rhs := #[0, 2] : PrefixRule },
    { lhs := #[0], rhs := #[1] },
    { lhs := #[1, 2], rhs := #[1] }]
  let language ← compile rules #[0] #[#[1]]
  unless language.grammar.shortest == some #[1] && language.grammar.distinctWordCount == 2 do
    throw "the complete growing route language lost its witness or alternative traces"
  for n in [:18] do
    let trace := Array.replicate n 0 ++ #[1] ++ Array.replicate n 2
    unless language.grammar.contains trace do throw "a balanced route is absent"
    let occurrences ← language.reconstruct trace
    unless occurrences[n]?.map (·.outerContext) == some (Array.replicate n 2) do
      throw "a route lost its actual constructor occurrence"
    if n > 0 && language.grammar.contains trace.pop then
      throw "an unbalanced trace was admitted"
  let shadowed ← compile rules #[0] #[#[1], #[0, 2]]
  unless shadowed.grammar.contains #[0] && shadowed.grammar.contains #[1] &&
      !shadowed.grammar.contains #[0, 1, 2] do
    throw "first-binding targets did not stop subsequent source transitions"
  let absent ← compile #[rules[0]!] #[0] #[#[1]]
  unless absent.grammar.shortest.isNone && absent.grammar.distinctWordCount == 0 do
    throw "ungrounded growth was confused with a reachable target"
  let deep ← compile #[{ lhs := #[0, 2], rhs := #[0] }]
    (#[0] ++ Array.replicate 80 2) #[#[0]]
  unless deep.grammar.shortest == some (Array.replicate 80 0) &&
      deep.grammar.distinctWordCount == 1 do
    throw "source routes were truncated at a guessed depth"
  let parallel ← compile #[{ lhs := #[0], rhs := #[1] }, { lhs := #[0], rhs := #[1] }]
    #[0] #[#[1]]
  unless parallel.grammar.contains #[0] && parallel.grammar.contains #[1] &&
      parallel.grammar.distinctWordCount == 2 do
    throw "distinct edge occurrences were merged by their endpoints"
  let initial ← compile #[{ lhs := #[0], rhs := #[0] }] #[0] #[#[0]]
  unless initial.grammar.shortest == some #[] && initial.grammar.distinctWordCount == 1 &&
      !initial.grammar.contains #[0] do
    throw "an initial target did not absorb the empty route"
  let noTargets ← compile rules #[0] #[]
  unless noTargets.grammar.shortest.isNone do throw "an empty target set acquired a route"

run_cmd do
  if let .error message := verify then throwError "{message}"

private def verifyFiniteWords : Except String Unit := do
  let diamond ← compile #[
    { lhs := #[0], rhs := #[1] }, { lhs := #[0], rhs := #[2] },
    { lhs := #[1], rhs := #[3] }, { lhs := #[2], rhs := #[3] }] #[0] #[#[3]]
  let some words := diamond.grammar.finiteWords | throw "a finite route family became infinite"
  unless words.size == 2 && words.contains #[0, 2] && words.contains #[1, 3] do
    throw "finite extraction did not retain the complete diamond"
  for word in words do discard <| diamond.reconstruct word
  let looping ← compile #[{ lhs := #[0], rhs := #[0] }, { lhs := #[0], rhs := #[1] }]
    #[0] #[#[1]]
  unless looping.grammar.finiteWords.isNone do throw "a growing route cycle became finite"
  let dead ← compile #[{ lhs := #[0], rhs := #[0] }] #[0] #[#[1]]
  unless dead.grammar.finiteWords == some #[] do
    throw "an unproductive cycle became an infinite nonempty language"
  let initial ← compile #[{ lhs := #[0], rhs := #[0] }] #[0] #[#[0]]
  unless initial.grammar.finiteWords == some #[#[]] do
    throw "finite extraction lost the empty first-hit route"
  let parallel ← compile #[{ lhs := #[0], rhs := #[1] }, { lhs := #[0], rhs := #[1] }]
    #[0] #[#[1]]
  let some words := parallel.grammar.finiteWords | throw "parallel finite routes became infinite"
  unless words.size == 2 && words.contains #[0] && words.contains #[1] do
    throw "finite extraction collapsed distinct source edges"

run_cmd do
  if let .error message := verifyFiniteWords then throwError "{message}"
