  refs : Array CasCatalogue.EdgeRef
  target : CasCatalogue.CategoryExpr
  identifications : Array Name
  actions : Array term
  comparisons : Array term

/-- The registered limit or colimit that a source construction selected: its row, and its cone or
cocone at the source diagram. A later use (`K.leg(j)`) takes them from here, not from the apex. -/
structure SourceLimitSelection where
  row : String
  declaration : Name
  cone : ClosedTerm
  colimit : Bool
  category : CasCatalogue.CategoryExpr
  bundle : ClosedTerm
  presentation : ClosedTerm
  diagram : ClosedTerm
  interface : LimitInterface ClosedTerm
  /-- One formation identity shared by the apex, complete cone and all later legs. -/
  construction : Name
  /-- The original interface under the complete formal M telescope. For a creation lift
  this belongs to the retained target presentation, not the distinct source cone. -/
  ownerFamily : Option ClosedTerm := none
  /-- Exact data-bearing creation, separate from the original target presentation. -/
  creation : Option (LimitCreationInterface ClosedTerm) := none
  /-- Original source-input telescope, distinct from the target presentation owner family. -/
  creationFamily : Option ClosedTerm := none
  /-- Original full diagram-argument indices of that telescope, including proof slots. -/
  creationInputs : Array Nat := #[]

structure NativeSourceLimitSelection (term : Type := Expr) where
  row : String
  declaration : Name
  cone : term
  colimit : Bool
  category : CasCatalogue.CategoryExpr
  bundle : term
  presentation : term
  diagram : term
  interface : LimitInterface term
  construction : Name
  ownerFamily : Option term := none
  creation : Option (LimitCreationInterface term) := none
  creationFamily : Option term := none
  creationInputs : Array Nat := #[]

/-- The selected symbolic category and its complete native bundle in the original context. -/
structure SourceCategoryBinding where
  private mk ::
  expression : CasCatalogue.CategoryExpr
  bundle : ClosedTerm
  role : SourceCategoryRole
  carrier : Option SourceCarrierSelection := none
  limit : Option SourceLimitSelection := none

/-- A native value's selected category, including whether it is an object or an arrow. -/
structure NativeSourceCategory (term : Type := Expr) where
  role : SourceCategoryRole
  expression : CasCatalogue.CategoryExpr
  bundle : term
  carrier : Option (NativeSourceCarrierSelection term) := none
  limit : Option (NativeSourceLimitSelection term) := none

/-- The actual object and checked whole carrier family that supply an element type. -/
structure NativeSourceElementOwner (term : Type := Expr) where
  category : NativeSourceCategory term
  value : term
  evidence : term

/-- The exact selected object and carrier expression carried by a source type. -/
structure NativeSourceTypeOrigin (term : Type := Expr) where
  category : NativeSourceCategory term
  object : term
  type : term

/-- The already selected native generalized point whose value the reader retained.
Its original source object supplies the point domain; the value's carrier does not. -/
structure NativeSourcePointOrigin (term : Type := Expr) where
  private mk ::
  point : term
  domain : term
  target : term

structure NativeRouteFunctor (term : Type := Expr) where
  functor : term
  target : term
  actions : Array term

/-- The complete native meaning of an explicitly selected registered comparison.
The actual edge actions are retained for constructor coherence; their composites alone
cannot supply the expansion comparisons required by the released component interface. -/
structure NativeSourceCell (term : Type := Expr) where
  entry : CellEntry
  application : term
  inverse : Bool
  constructors : Array ConstructorId := #[]
  source : CategoryExpr
  sourceBundle : term
  target : CategoryExpr
  targetBundle : term
  left : NativeRouteFunctor term
  right : NativeRouteFunctor term
  transformation : term
  isomorphism : Option term
  references : Array SelectedSourceReference := #[]

/-- The exact component retained at formation, together with its whole directed cell and
original receiver. Native source closure transports every field in the same telescope. -/
structure NativeSourceCellComponent (term : Type := Expr) where
  private mk ::
  cell : NativeSourceCell term
  receiver : term
  value : term

/-- The original selected reindexing, its actual base map and receiver, and their one
native cartesian arrow. Neither endpoint is reconstructed by a separate object action. -/
structure NativeSourceCartesian (term : Type := Expr) where
  entry : FunctorEntry
  application : term
  realization : term
  baseMap : term
  receiver : term
  totalBundle : term
  arrow : term

/-- The published computations of a selected subobject lift. -/
inductive LiftPort
  /-- `LiftEntry.computation`, a `MonoLiftComputation`: the fields `obj`, `hom`, `forward` and
  `backward`. -/
  | computation
  /-- `MonoLift.factorComputation` at the lift's evidence: the field `factor`. -/
  | factor
  deriving BEq, Repr

/-- A published computation of a selected lift, as a closed family of the parameters of the lift's
evidence declaration. Its fields are the leaf contract's ports `<lift id>#<field>`
(api/wire-examples.md, "Prescribed subobject lifts" and "Separate universal factor"). -/
structure LiftFamily where
  private mk ::
  lift : LiftId
  port : LiftPort
  family : Expr
  familyType : Expr
  universeParams : List Name
  entry : LiftEntry

/-- A registered isomorphism family and the native carrier-function paths of its two maps.
The paths are checked on an abstract isomorphism at the full rigid declaration telescope;
no actual endpoint, point or runtime payload chooses the path. -/
structure PresentationFamily where
  private mk ::
  entry : PresentationComparisonEntry
  source : ObjectEntry
  target : ObjectEntry
  category : NamedCategoryEntry
  family : Expr
  familyType : Expr
  universeParams : List Name
  forwardPath : Array Name
  inversePath : Array Name

/-- The object action of one explicitly selected complete native edge. Its body is the
same functorObject application used by ordinary source views; the retained edge only fixes
the public operation that a provider may implement. -/
structure SourceActionFamily where
  private mk ::
  edge : EdgeRef
  declaration : Name
  universeParams : List Name
  parameterCount : Nat
  category : CategoryExpr
  family : Expr
  familyType : Expr
  references : Array SelectedSourceReference


/-- Actual return data for a whole inherited method. The declarations and their
complete native applications are fixed before any receiver is supplied. -/
structure RoutedMethodReturn where
  route : Route
  rows : Array LiftEntry
  actions : Array Expr
  actionFamilies : Array SourceActionFamily
  agreement : Option Expr
  evidences : Array Expr
  category : CategoryExpr
  categoryFamily : Expr
  resultFamily : Expr

/-- A whole inherited method before its receiver is transported. The native actions and final
functor are closed over the same complete category telescope as the callable result family.
Source: SourceMethod's whole-family comparison and tasks.md T061/T026 boundary rule. -/
structure RoutedMethodFamily where
  private mk ::
  entry : MethodEntry
  route : Route
  functor : FunctorEntry
  categoryFamily : Expr
  functorFamily : Expr
  family : Expr
  actions : Array Expr
  actionFamilies : Array SourceActionFamily
  /-- Original complete constructor rows at each source-route boundary. -/
  receiverViews : Array (Option ConstructorEntry)
  universeParams : List Name
  parameterCount : Nat
  returns : Option RoutedMethodReturn := none

/-- The accepted property proposition over a complete rigid source category family.
Its native result is Prop. Computational observations of that proposition are not proofs. -/
structure PropertyFamily where
  private mk ::
  entry : PropertyEntry
  classifier : ClassifierEntry
  route : Route
  categoryFamily : Expr
  family : Expr
  actions : Array Expr
  actionFamilies : Array SourceActionFamily
  /-- Original complete constructor rows at each source-route boundary. -/
  receiverViews : Array (Option ConstructorEntry)
  universeParams : List Name
  parameterCount : Nat

/-- The two released owners of the common named point interface. Object application is an
existing field of its exact selected object row, not a new ComputationRef or registry row. -/
inductive PointFamilyOwner
  | morphism (entry : MorphismEntry)
  | application (entry : ObjectEntry)

/-- A released callable and the checked carrier-function path of its complete native family.
The actual arrow, its parameters and its applied point remain independent inputs. -/
structure PointFamily where
  private mk ::
  owner : PointFamilyOwner
  declaration : Name
  category : NamedCategoryEntry
  family : Expr
  familyType : Expr
  universeParams : List Name
  path : Array Name

/-- Explicit source inputs of one named provider-requested point action. This provenance is
local to the application; it is not a property inferred from a later point value. -/
structure NativePointRequest (term : Type := Expr) where
  private mk ::
  arrow : term
  domain : term
  source : term
  target : term
  point : term

/-- Original owners of the released categorical point dialect. This is a source selection,
not a registry of additional mathematics or a provider-dependent interpretation. -/
inductive CategoricalPointOwner
  | named (owner : PointFamilyOwner)
  | component (entry : CellEntry) (constructors : Array ConstructorId) (inverse : Bool)
  | cartesian (entry : FunctorEntry)
  | binder (entry : BinderEntry)
  | action (edge : EdgeRef)

/-- A whole native postcomposition family, under its original rigid parameters. The final
two arguments are an arbitrary object of the actual category and a map from that object to
the selected arrow's source. Constructed categories keep their own complete native bundle. -/
structure CategoricalPointFamily where
  private mk ::
  owner : CategoricalPointOwner
  declaration : Name
  universeParams : List Name
  declarationParameterCount : Nat
  parameterCount : Nat
  category : CategoryExpr
  categoryFamily : Expr
  arrowFamily : Expr
  family : Expr
  familyType : Expr
  whole : Bool := false
  invocation : Bool := true
  references : Array SelectedSourceReference := #[]
  componentTemplate : Option (NativeSourceCellComponent Expr) := none
  cartesianTemplate : Option (NativeSourceCartesian Expr) := none

/-- Invocation-local original descriptors retained at the typed generalized map. Their
runtime bindings refer to the original supplied values; they never choose a source family. -/
structure CategoricalPointRequest (term : Type := Expr) where
  arrow : term
  domain : term
  source : term
  target : term
  point : term

/-- The complete computational cone family of one independently selected universal
presentation. Its formal universal mediator is not a computational output of the cone port. -/
structure LimitFamily where
  private mk ::
  entry : LimitEntry
  category : NamedCategoryEntry
  universeParams : List Name
  parameterCount : Nat
  presentationFamily : Expr
  diagramFamily : Expr
  family : Expr
  familyType : Expr

/-- The original native universal-property record of one accepted limit presentation.
The raw cone port remains a separate family; no cone parameter is added to the
mathematical declaration. Actual completed cones are retained by runtime captures. -/
structure LimitUniversalFamily where
  private mk ::
  presentation : LimitFamily
  projection : Name
  family : Expr
  familyType : Expr

/-- The fixed native creation family of one accepted lift. The original evidence parameters
are followed by the actual source diagram, mapped cone and its data-bearing IsLimit interface.
The result is Mathlib's existing LiftsToLimit; no new mathematical computation is defined. -/
structure CreationFamily where
  private mk ::
  entry : LiftEntry
  universeParams : List Name
  parameterCount : Nat
  evidenceFamily : Expr
  evidenceType : Expr
  family : Expr
  familyType : Expr

/-- The construction explicitly retained by source formation, together with this exact
receiver occurrence. The native interface is supplied by that construction's producer;
neither an equal apex nor a row/diagram search can create this selection. -/
structure NativeLimitSelection (term : Type := Expr) where
  private mk ::
  source : NativeSourceLimitSelection term
  receiver : term

/-- The selected owner at its original full formal telescope. Every term field is a
native function of these exact ordered formals; no owner is decoded from a value expression. -/
structure SelectedLimitOwner (term : Type) where
  selection : NativeLimitSelection term
  formalBindings : Array BindingId

/-- One original cone component. Its index is the actual native diagram object selected by
the source reader, including a Discrete wrapper or dependent Fin evidence when present. -/
structure NativeLimitLegSelection (term : Type := Expr) where
  private mk ::
  construction : NativeLimitSelection term
  index : term
  value : term

/-- The accepted whole family and every full original reference in declaration order. -/
structure SourceProgram where
  private mk ::
  source : CheckedComputationDerivation
  targetReference : SelectedSourceReference
  prerequisiteReferences : Array SelectedSourceReference

/-- The checked native family retains the complete original independently selected row. -/
structure SourceFamily where
  private mk ::
  source : CheckedComputationPrerequisite
  universeParams : List Name
  selectedReference : SelectedSourceReference
  pointFamily : Option PointFamily

/-- Rigid accepted families before request-specific layouts and owner substitution. -/
inductive SelectedApplicationFamily
  | registered (family : SourceFamily)
  | target (program : SourceProgram)
  | prerequisite (program : SourceProgram) (index : Fin program.source.prerequisites.size)
  | lift (family : LiftFamily)
  | presentation (family : PresentationFamily)
  | routedMethod (family : RoutedMethodFamily)
  | property (family : PropertyFamily)
  | application (family : PointFamily)
  | point (family : CategoricalPointFamily)
  | objectAction (family : SourceActionFamily)
  | limit (family : LimitFamily)
  | limitUniversal (family : LimitUniversalFamily)
  | creation (family : CreationFamily) (target : LimitFamily)

/-- The selected whole native family and its complete original ordered application. -/
structure SelectedSourceApplication (term : Type) where
  family : SelectedApplicationFamily
  universes : List Level
  parameters : Array term
  arguments : Array term := #[]
  owner : Option term := none
  ownerSelection : Option (SelectedLimitOwner term) := none

/-- The independently admitted native point family and its complete source argument table. -/
structure SelectedSourceAdmission (term : Type) where
  entry : ObjectEntry
  family : term
  arguments : Array term
  element : Nat

/-- A point request retains its accepted owner and every original operand separately. -/
inductive SelectedSourcePointRequest (term : Type)
  | named (family : PointFamily) (request : NativePointRequest term)
  | categorical (family : CategoricalPointFamily) (request : CategoricalPointRequest term)

/-- A field is selected at its original complete owner and construction identity. -/
structure SelectedSourceField (term : Type) where
  selection : Name
  projection : Name
  owner : term
  deferredCone : Bool := false

inductive SelectedEndpointSide
  | source
  | target
  deriving BEq

/-- The actual arrow and endpoint selected by source formation. -/
structure SelectedSourceEndpoint (term : Type) where
  arrow : term
  side : SelectedEndpointSide
  value : term

/-- Typed data beside one native source binder. The native value supplies mathematical
typing and execution data; its expression never supplies a missing selection. -/
structure SourceSelection (term : Type) where
  value : term
  formalBindings : Array BindingId := #[]
  carrierRoutes : Array (Array EdgeRef) := #[]
  preferredRoute : Option (Array EdgeRef) := none
  operationRefinements : Array (CategoryExpr × Array (Array EdgeRef)) := #[]
  /-- Every original row and route retained after their whole-family agreement. -/
  alternatives : Array (SelectedSourceReference × Array EdgeRef) := #[]
  reference : Option SelectedSourceReference := none
  /-- A source-visible derived label; its nested selections own all computational authority. -/
  observation : Option SelectedSourceReference := none
  originalApplication : Option term := none
  application : Option (SelectedSourceApplication term) := none
  /-- The complete accepted creation owners of a formal apex, before any demand. -/
  creationOwner : Option (CreationFamily × LimitFamily) := none
  admission : Option (SelectedSourceAdmission term) := none
  presentationEndpoints : Option (term × term) := none
  routedInputs : Option (Array (Array term)) := none
  legOrdinal : Option Nat := none
  /-- The original whole-record construction token, retained across explicit aliases. -/
  recordSelection : Option Name := none
  /-- The exact bound computation shared by the original whole-record field selections. -/
  recordOwner : Option term := none
  category : Option (NativeSourceCategory term) := none
  typeOrigin : Option (NativeSourceTypeOrigin term) := none
  elementOwner : Option (NativeSourceElementOwner term) := none
  pointOrigin : Option (NativeSourcePointOrigin term) := none
  pointRequest : Option (SelectedSourcePointRequest term) := none
  isoOrigin : Option term := none
  field : Option (SelectedSourceField term) := none
  endpoint : Option (SelectedSourceEndpoint term) := none
  /-- The complete original cone family retained before native parameters are substituted. -/
  limitFamily : Option LimitFamily := none
  limit : Option (NativeLimitSelection term) := none
  leg : Option (NativeLimitLegSelection term) := none
  cellFamily : Option (NativeSourceCell term) := none
  cell : Option (NativeSourceCellComponent term) := none
  cartesian : Option (NativeSourceCartesian term) := none
  powerObject : Option (NativePowerObject term) := none

/-- Selections share the stable native source-binding identities; terms are never keys. -/
abbrev SourceSelectionScope (term : Type) :=
  Std.HashMap BindingId (SourceSelection term)

/-- Transport every native datum; the selected registry row and route stay fixed. -/
def NativePowerObject.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativePowerObject α) : m (NativePowerObject β) := do
  return ⟨value.row, value.object, value.category, ← f value.base⟩

def NativeSourceCarrierSelection.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeSourceCarrierSelection α) : m (NativeSourceCarrierSelection β) := do
  return ⟨value.refs, value.target, value.identifications,
    ← value.actions.mapM f, ← value.comparisons.mapM f⟩

def NativeSourceLimitSelection.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeSourceLimitSelection α) : m (NativeSourceLimitSelection β) := do
  return ⟨value.row, value.declaration, ← f value.cone, value.colimit, value.category,
    ← f value.bundle, ← f value.presentation, ← f value.diagram, ← value.interface.mapM f,
    value.construction, ← value.ownerFamily.mapM f,
    ← value.creation.mapM (fun creation => creation.mapM f),
    ← value.creationFamily.mapM f, value.creationInputs⟩

def NativeSourceCategory.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeSourceCategory α) : m (NativeSourceCategory β) := do
  return ⟨value.role, value.expression, ← f value.bundle,
    ← value.carrier.mapM (fun carrier => carrier.mapM f),
    ← value.limit.mapM (fun limit => limit.mapM f)⟩

def NativeSourceElementOwner.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeSourceElementOwner α) : m (NativeSourceElementOwner β) := do
  return ⟨← value.category.mapM f, ← f value.value, ← f value.evidence⟩

def NativeSourceTypeOrigin.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeSourceTypeOrigin α) : m (NativeSourceTypeOrigin β) := do
  return ⟨← value.category.mapM f, ← f value.object, ← f value.type⟩

opaque NativeSourcePointOrigin.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeSourcePointOrigin α) : m (NativeSourcePointOrigin β) := do
  return ⟨← f value.point, ← f value.domain, ← f value.target⟩

def NativeRouteFunctor.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeRouteFunctor α) : m (NativeRouteFunctor β) := do
  return ⟨← f value.functor, ← f value.target, ← value.actions.mapM f⟩

def NativeSourceCell.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeSourceCell α) : m (NativeSourceCell β) := do
  return {
    entry := value.entry, application := ← f value.application, inverse := value.inverse
    constructors := value.constructors, source := value.source
    sourceBundle := ← f value.sourceBundle, target := value.target
    targetBundle := ← f value.targetBundle, left := ← value.left.mapM f
    right := ← value.right.mapM f, transformation := ← f value.transformation
    isomorphism := ← value.isomorphism.mapM f, references := value.references }

opaque NativeSourceCellComponent.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeSourceCellComponent α) : m (NativeSourceCellComponent β) := do
  return ⟨← value.cell.mapM f, ← f value.receiver, ← f value.value⟩

def NativeSourceCartesian.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeSourceCartesian α) : m (NativeSourceCartesian β) := do
  return ⟨value.entry, ← f value.application, ← f value.realization, ← f value.baseMap,
    ← f value.receiver, ← f value.totalBundle, ← f value.arrow⟩

opaque NativePointRequest.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativePointRequest α) : m (NativePointRequest β) := do
  return ⟨← f value.arrow, ← f value.domain, ← f value.source, ← f value.target, ← f value.point⟩

def CategoricalPointRequest.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : CategoricalPointRequest α) : m (CategoricalPointRequest β) := do
  return ⟨← f value.arrow, ← f value.domain, ← f value.source, ← f value.target, ← f value.point⟩

opaque NativeLimitSelection.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeLimitSelection α) : m (NativeLimitSelection β) := do
  return ⟨← value.source.mapM f, ← f value.receiver⟩

def SelectedLimitOwner.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (owner : SelectedLimitOwner α) : m (SelectedLimitOwner β) := do
  return ⟨← owner.selection.mapM f, owner.formalBindings⟩

/-- Substitute every original owner field at the same explicit formal positions. -/
def SelectedLimitOwner.specialize (owner : SelectedLimitOwner Expr)
    (arguments : Array Expr) : MetaM NativeLimitSelection := do
  unless owner.formalBindings.size == arguments.size do
    throwError "the selected owner lost its complete original formal argument table"
  owner.selection.mapM fun value => do
    let applied := mkAppN value arguments
    check applied
    return applied.headBeta

opaque NativeLimitLegSelection.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : NativeLimitLegSelection α) : m (NativeLimitLegSelection β) := do
  return ⟨← value.construction.mapM f, ← f value.index, ← f value.value⟩

def SelectedSourceApplication.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : SelectedSourceApplication α) : m (SelectedSourceApplication β) := do
  return ⟨value.family, value.universes, ← value.parameters.mapM f,
    ← value.arguments.mapM f, ← value.owner.mapM f,
    ← value.ownerSelection.mapM (fun owner => owner.mapM f)⟩

def SelectedSourceAdmission.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : SelectedSourceAdmission α) : m (SelectedSourceAdmission β) := do
  return ⟨value.entry, ← f value.family, ← value.arguments.mapM f, value.element⟩

def SelectedSourcePointRequest.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : SelectedSourcePointRequest α) : m (SelectedSourcePointRequest β) := do
  match value with
  | .named family request => return .named family (← request.mapM f)
  | .categorical family request => return .categorical family (← request.mapM f)

def SelectedSourceField.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : SelectedSourceField α) : m (SelectedSourceField β) := do
  return ⟨value.selection, value.projection, ← f value.owner, value.deferredCone⟩

def SelectedSourceEndpoint.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : SelectedSourceEndpoint α) : m (SelectedSourceEndpoint β) := do
  return ⟨← f value.arrow, value.side, ← f value.value⟩

/-- Close, reopen or substitute all actual terms without changing a selected owner. -/
@[noinline, nospecialize] def SourceSelection.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (value : SourceSelection α) : m (SourceSelection β) := do
  return {
    value := ← f value.value, formalBindings := value.formalBindings
    carrierRoutes := value.carrierRoutes, preferredRoute := value.preferredRoute
    operationRefinements := value.operationRefinements
    alternatives := value.alternatives
    reference := value.reference
    observation := value.observation
    originalApplication := ← value.originalApplication.mapM f
    application := ← value.application.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    creationOwner := value.creationOwner
    admission := ← value.admission.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    presentationEndpoints := ← value.presentationEndpoints.mapM fun (left, right) => do
      return (← f left, ← f right)
    routedInputs := ← value.routedInputs.mapM fun inputs => inputs.mapM (·.mapM f)
    legOrdinal := value.legOrdinal
    recordSelection := value.recordSelection
    recordOwner := ← value.recordOwner.mapM f
    category := ← value.category.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    typeOrigin := ← value.typeOrigin.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    elementOwner := ← value.elementOwner.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    pointOrigin := ← value.pointOrigin.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    pointRequest := ← value.pointRequest.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    isoOrigin := ← value.isoOrigin.mapM f
    field := ← value.field.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    endpoint := ← value.endpoint.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    limitFamily := value.limitFamily
    limit := ← value.limit.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    leg := ← value.leg.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    cellFamily := ← value.cellFamily.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    cell := ← value.cell.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    cartesian := ← value.cartesian.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f)
    powerObject := ← value.powerObject.mapM (fun item => item.mapM f) }

@[noinline, nospecialize] def SourceSelectionScope.mapM [Monad m] (f : α → m β)
    (scope : SourceSelectionScope α) : m (SourceSelectionScope β) := do
  scope.toList.foldlM (fun result (binding, selection) => do
    return result.insert binding (← selection.mapM f)) {}

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.SelectionData

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

private def sameArray (equal : α → α → Bool) (left right : Array α) : Bool :=
  left.size == right.size && (left.zip right).all (fun (a, b) => equal a b)

private def sameOption (equal : α → α → Bool) : Option α → Option α → Bool
  | none, none => true
  | some left, some right => equal left right
  | _, _ => false

/-- Registry records contain closed declared syntax and have complete derived representations.
This comparison validates an already identical binding ID; it never searches for an owner. -/
private def sameStatic [Repr α] (left right : α) : Bool :=
  reprStr left == reprStr right

private def sameRoute (left right : Route) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.source right.source && sameStatic left.target right.target &&
    sameArray (fun (a b : StructuralEdge) =>
      sameStatic a.source b.source && sameStatic a.target b.target &&
        reprStr a.expression == reprStr b.expression && sameStatic a.ref b.ref)
      left.steps right.steps

/-- Compare the complete originally selected route, including each ordered native edge. -/
def _root_.CasCatalogue.Route.exactlyMatches (left right : Route) : Bool :=
  sameRoute left right

private def sameNamed : SourceNamedEntry → SourceNamedEntry → Bool
  | .registered left leftCategory, .registered right rightCategory =>
      sameStatic left right && sameStatic leftCategory rightCategory
  | .construction left, .construction right => sameStatic left right
  | _, _ => false

private def sameReference : SelectedSourceReference → SelectedSourceReference → Bool
  | .named left, .named right => sameNamed left right
  | .category left, .category right => sameStatic left right
  | .operation left, .operation right => sameStatic left right
  | .method left leftFunctor, .method right rightFunctor =>
    sameStatic left right && sameStatic leftFunctor rightFunctor
  | .functor left, .functor right => sameStatic left right
  | .classifier left, .classifier right => sameStatic left right
  | .constructor left, .constructor right => sameStatic left right
  | .cell left, .cell right => sameStatic left right
  | .binder left, .binder right => sameStatic left right
  | .lift left, .lift right => sameStatic left right
  | .presentation left, .presentation right => sameStatic left right
  | .literal left, .literal right => sameStatic left right
  | .numeral left, .numeral right => sameStatic left right
  | .subset left, .subset right => sameStatic left right
  | .graph left, .graph right => sameStatic left right
  | .generator left, .generator right => sameStatic left right
  | .components left, .components right => sameStatic left right
  | .limit left, .limit right => sameStatic left right
  | .classifierForget left, .classifierForget right => sameStatic left right
  | .constructorInterface left leftField, .constructorInterface right rightField =>
      sameStatic left right && leftField == rightField
  | .refinement left leftRefinement, .refinement right rightRefinement =>
      sameStatic left right && sameStatic leftRefinement rightRefinement
  | _, _ => false

/-- Compare every field of the two already supplied accepted registry references. -/
def SelectedSourceReference.exactlyMatches (left right : SelectedSourceReference) : Bool :=
  sameReference left right

private def samePrerequisite (left right : CheckedComputationPrerequisite) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.reference right.reference &&
    left.declaration == right.declaration &&
    left.family.equal right.family &&
    left.familyType.equal right.familyType

private def sameProgram (left right : SourceProgram) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.source.entry right.source.entry &&
    left.source.universeParams == right.source.universeParams &&
    left.source.targetDeclaration == right.source.targetDeclaration &&
    left.source.target.equal right.source.target &&
    left.source.familyType.equal right.source.familyType &&
    sameArray samePrerequisite left.source.prerequisites right.source.prerequisites &&
    left.source.template.equal right.source.template &&
    left.source.plan.equal right.source.plan &&
    left.source.correctness.equal right.source.correctness &&
    sameReference left.targetReference right.targetReference &&
    sameArray sameReference left.prerequisiteReferences right.prerequisiteReferences

private def samePointOwner : PointFamilyOwner → PointFamilyOwner → Bool
  | .morphism left, .morphism right => sameStatic left right
  | .application left, .application right => sameStatic left right
  | _, _ => false

private def samePointFamily (left right : PointFamily) : Bool :=
  samePointOwner left.owner right.owner &&
    left.declaration == right.declaration &&
    sameStatic left.category right.category &&
    left.family.equal right.family &&
    left.familyType.equal right.familyType &&
    left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
    left.path == right.path

private def sameFamily (left right : SourceFamily) : Bool :=
  samePrerequisite left.source right.source &&
    left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
    sameReference left.selectedReference right.selectedReference &&
    sameOption samePointFamily left.pointFamily right.pointFamily

private def sameLift (left right : LiftFamily) : Bool :=
  left.lift == right.lift &&
    sameStatic left.entry right.entry &&
    left.port == right.port &&
    left.family.equal right.family &&
    left.familyType.equal right.familyType &&
    left.universeParams == right.universeParams

private def samePresentation (left right : PresentationFamily) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.entry right.entry &&
    sameStatic left.source right.source &&
    sameStatic left.target right.target &&
    sameStatic left.category right.category &&
    left.family.equal right.family &&
    left.familyType.equal right.familyType &&
    left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
    left.forwardPath == right.forwardPath &&
    left.inversePath == right.inversePath

private def sameActionFamily (left right : SourceActionFamily) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.edge right.edge &&
    left.declaration == right.declaration &&
    left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
    left.parameterCount == right.parameterCount &&
    sameStatic left.category right.category &&
    left.family.equal right.family &&
    left.familyType.equal right.familyType &&
    sameArray sameReference left.references right.references


private def sameMethodReturn (left right : RoutedMethodReturn) : Bool :=
  sameRoute left.route right.route &&
    sameArray sameStatic left.rows right.rows &&
    sameArray Expr.equal left.actions right.actions &&
    sameArray sameActionFamily left.actionFamilies right.actionFamilies &&
    sameOption Expr.equal left.agreement right.agreement &&
    sameArray Expr.equal left.evidences right.evidences &&
    sameStatic left.category right.category &&
    left.categoryFamily.equal right.categoryFamily &&
    left.resultFamily.equal right.resultFamily

private def sameMethod (left right : RoutedMethodFamily) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.entry right.entry &&
    sameRoute left.route right.route &&
    sameStatic left.functor right.functor &&
    left.categoryFamily.equal right.categoryFamily &&
    left.functorFamily.equal right.functorFamily &&
    left.family.equal right.family &&
    sameArray Expr.equal left.actions right.actions &&
    sameArray sameActionFamily left.actionFamilies right.actionFamilies &&
    sameArray (sameOption sameStatic) left.receiverViews right.receiverViews &&
    left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
    left.parameterCount == right.parameterCount &&
    sameOption sameMethodReturn left.returns right.returns

private def sameProperty (left right : PropertyFamily) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.entry right.entry &&
    sameStatic left.classifier right.classifier &&
    sameRoute left.route right.route &&
    left.categoryFamily.equal right.categoryFamily &&
    left.family.equal right.family &&
    sameArray Expr.equal left.actions right.actions &&
    sameArray sameActionFamily left.actionFamilies right.actionFamilies &&
    sameArray (sameOption sameStatic) left.receiverViews right.receiverViews &&
    left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
    left.parameterCount == right.parameterCount

private def sameCategoricalOwner : CategoricalPointOwner → CategoricalPointOwner → Bool
  | .named left, .named right => samePointOwner left right
  | .component left leftConstructors leftInverse, .component right rightConstructors rightInverse =>
      sameStatic left right && leftConstructors == rightConstructors && leftInverse == rightInverse
  | .cartesian left, .cartesian right => sameStatic left right
  | .binder left, .binder right => sameStatic left right
  | .action left, .action right => sameStatic left right
  | _, _ => false

private def sameRouteFunctor (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeRouteFunctor α) : Bool :=
  termEqual left.functor right.functor &&
    termEqual left.target right.target &&
    sameArray termEqual left.actions right.actions

private def sameCell (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeSourceCell α) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.entry right.entry &&
    termEqual left.application right.application &&
    left.inverse == right.inverse &&
    left.constructors == right.constructors &&
    sameStatic left.source right.source &&
    termEqual left.sourceBundle right.sourceBundle &&
    sameStatic left.target right.target &&
    termEqual left.targetBundle right.targetBundle &&
    sameRouteFunctor termEqual left.left right.left &&
    sameRouteFunctor termEqual left.right right.right &&
    termEqual left.transformation right.transformation &&
    sameOption termEqual left.isomorphism right.isomorphism &&
    sameArray sameReference left.references right.references

private def sameComponent (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeSourceCellComponent α) : Bool :=
  sameCell termEqual left.cell right.cell &&
    termEqual left.receiver right.receiver &&
    termEqual left.value right.value

private def sameCartesian (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeSourceCartesian α) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.entry right.entry &&
    termEqual left.application right.application &&
    termEqual left.realization right.realization &&
    termEqual left.baseMap right.baseMap &&
    termEqual left.receiver right.receiver &&
    termEqual left.totalBundle right.totalBundle &&
    termEqual left.arrow right.arrow

private def sameCategoricalFamily (left right : CategoricalPointFamily) : Bool :=
  sameCategoricalOwner left.owner right.owner &&
    left.declaration == right.declaration &&
    left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
    left.declarationParameterCount == right.declarationParameterCount &&
    left.parameterCount == right.parameterCount &&
    sameStatic left.category right.category &&
    left.categoryFamily.equal right.categoryFamily &&
    left.arrowFamily.equal right.arrowFamily &&
    left.family.equal right.family &&
    left.familyType.equal right.familyType &&
    left.whole == right.whole &&
    left.invocation == right.invocation &&
    sameArray sameReference left.references right.references &&
    sameOption (sameComponent Expr.equal) left.componentTemplate right.componentTemplate &&
    sameOption (sameCartesian Expr.equal) left.cartesianTemplate right.cartesianTemplate

private def sameLimitFamily (left right : LimitFamily) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.entry right.entry &&
    sameStatic left.category right.category &&
    left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
    left.parameterCount == right.parameterCount &&
    left.presentationFamily.equal right.presentationFamily &&
    left.diagramFamily.equal right.diagramFamily &&
    left.family.equal right.family &&
    left.familyType.equal right.familyType

private def sameUniversalFamily (left right : LimitUniversalFamily) : Bool :=
  sameLimitFamily left.presentation right.presentation &&
    left.projection == right.projection &&
    left.family.equal right.family &&
    left.familyType.equal right.familyType

private def sameCreationFamily (left right : CreationFamily) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.entry right.entry &&
    left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
    left.parameterCount == right.parameterCount &&
    left.evidenceFamily.equal right.evidenceFamily &&
    left.evidenceType.equal right.evidenceType &&
    left.family.equal right.family &&
    left.familyType.equal right.familyType

private def sameApplicationFamily : SelectedApplicationFamily → SelectedApplicationFamily → Bool
  | .registered left, .registered right => sameFamily left right
  | .target left, .target right => sameProgram left right
  | .prerequisite left leftIndex, .prerequisite right rightIndex =>
      sameProgram left right && leftIndex.val == rightIndex.val
  | .lift left, .lift right => sameLift left right
  | .presentation left, .presentation right => samePresentation left right
  | .routedMethod left, .routedMethod right => sameMethod left right
  | .property left, .property right => sameProperty left right
  | .application left, .application right => samePointFamily left right
  | .point left, .point right => sameCategoricalFamily left right
  | .objectAction left, .objectAction right => sameActionFamily left right
  | .limit left, .limit right => sameLimitFamily left right
  | .limitUniversal left, .limitUniversal right => sameUniversalFamily left right
  | .creation left leftTarget, .creation right rightTarget =>
      sameCreationFamily left right && sameLimitFamily leftTarget rightTarget
  | _, _ => false

private def sameCarrier (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeSourceCarrierSelection α) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.refs right.refs &&
    sameStatic left.target right.target &&
    left.identifications == right.identifications &&
    sameArray termEqual left.actions right.actions &&
    sameArray termEqual left.comparisons right.comparisons

private def sameInterface (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : LimitInterface α) : Bool :=
  termEqual left.presentation right.presentation &&
    termEqual left.diagram right.diagram &&
    sameOption termEqual left.standardization right.standardization &&
    sameOption termEqual left.dataConstructor right.dataConstructor

private def sameCreation (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : LimitCreationInterface α) : Bool :=
  left.lift == right.lift &&
    left.declaration == right.declaration &&
    sameStatic left.edge right.edge &&
    sameArray termEqual left.terms right.terms

private def sameSourceLimit (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeSourceLimitSelection α) : Bool :=
  left.row == right.row &&
    left.declaration == right.declaration &&
    termEqual left.cone right.cone &&
    left.colimit == right.colimit &&
    sameStatic left.category right.category &&
    termEqual left.bundle right.bundle &&
    termEqual left.presentation right.presentation &&
    termEqual left.diagram right.diagram &&
    sameInterface termEqual left.interface right.interface &&
    left.construction == right.construction &&
    sameOption termEqual left.ownerFamily right.ownerFamily &&
    sameOption (sameCreation termEqual) left.creation right.creation &&
    sameOption termEqual left.creationFamily right.creationFamily &&
    left.creationInputs == right.creationInputs

private def sameCategory (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeSourceCategory α) : Bool :=
  left.role == right.role &&
    sameStatic left.expression right.expression &&
    termEqual left.bundle right.bundle &&
    sameOption (sameCarrier termEqual) left.carrier right.carrier &&
    sameOption (sameSourceLimit termEqual) left.limit right.limit

private def sameElementOwner (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeSourceElementOwner α) : Bool :=
  sameCategory termEqual left.category right.category &&
    termEqual left.value right.value &&
    termEqual left.evidence right.evidence

private def sameTypeOrigin (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeSourceTypeOrigin α) : Bool :=
  sameCategory termEqual left.category right.category &&
    termEqual left.object right.object &&
    termEqual left.type right.type

private def samePointOrigin (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeSourcePointOrigin α) : Bool :=
  termEqual left.point right.point &&
    termEqual left.domain right.domain &&
    termEqual left.target right.target

private def samePowerObject (termEqual : α → α → Bool)
    (left right : NativePowerObject α) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.row right.row &&
    sameStatic left.object right.object &&
    sameStatic left.category right.category &&
    termEqual left.base right.base

private def sameNamedRequest (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativePointRequest α) : Bool :=
  termEqual left.arrow right.arrow &&
    termEqual left.domain right.domain &&
    termEqual left.source right.source &&
    termEqual left.target right.target &&
    termEqual left.point right.point

private def sameCategoricalRequest (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : CategoricalPointRequest α) : Bool :=
  termEqual left.arrow right.arrow &&
    termEqual left.domain right.domain &&
    termEqual left.source right.source &&
    termEqual left.target right.target &&
    termEqual left.point right.point

private def sameLimit (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeLimitSelection α) : Bool :=
  sameSourceLimit termEqual left.source right.source &&
    termEqual left.receiver right.receiver

private def sameLeg (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : NativeLimitLegSelection α) : Bool :=
  sameLimit termEqual left.construction right.construction &&
    termEqual left.index right.index &&
    termEqual left.value right.value

private def sameSelectedLimitOwner (termEqual : α → α → Bool)
    (left right : SelectedLimitOwner α) : Bool :=
  sameLimit termEqual left.selection right.selection &&
    left.formalBindings == right.formalBindings

private def sameApplication (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : SelectedSourceApplication α) : Bool :=
  sameApplicationFamily left.family right.family &&
    left.universes == right.universes &&
    sameArray termEqual left.parameters right.parameters &&
    sameArray termEqual left.arguments right.arguments &&
    sameOption termEqual left.owner right.owner &&
    sameOption (sameSelectedLimitOwner termEqual) left.ownerSelection right.ownerSelection

private def sameAdmission (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : SelectedSourceAdmission α) : Bool :=
  sameStatic left.entry right.entry &&
    termEqual left.family right.family &&
    sameArray termEqual left.arguments right.arguments &&
    left.element == right.element

private def samePointRequest (termEqual : α → α → Bool) :
    SelectedSourcePointRequest α → SelectedSourcePointRequest α → Bool
  | .named leftFamily left, .named rightFamily right =>
      samePointFamily leftFamily rightFamily && sameNamedRequest termEqual left right
  | .categorical leftFamily left, .categorical rightFamily right =>
      sameCategoricalFamily leftFamily rightFamily && sameCategoricalRequest termEqual left right
  | _, _ => false

private def sameField (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : SelectedSourceField α) : Bool :=
  left.selection == right.selection &&
    left.projection == right.projection &&
    termEqual left.owner right.owner &&
    left.deferredCone == right.deferredCone

private def sameEndpoint (termEqual : α → α → Bool) (left right : SelectedSourceEndpoint α) : Bool :=
  termEqual left.arrow right.arrow &&
    left.side == right.side &&
    termEqual left.value right.value

/-- Compare the complete already-selected rigid family, including its checked native data. -/
def SelectedApplicationFamily.exactlyMatches (left right : SelectedApplicationFamily) : Bool :=
  sameApplicationFamily left right

/-- Compare a point request's selected owner and every original operand. -/
def SelectedSourcePointRequest.exactlyMatches (termEqual : α → α → Bool)
    (left right : SelectedSourcePointRequest α) : Bool :=
  samePointRequest termEqual left right

/-- Compare all retained data at the same native binding identity. Native fields are
compared by the supplied exact representation equality, never by definitional equality. -/
def SourceSelection.exactlyMatches (termEqual : α → α → Bool)
    (left right : SourceSelection α) : Bool :=
  termEqual left.value right.value &&
    left.formalBindings == right.formalBindings &&
    sameStatic left.carrierRoutes right.carrierRoutes &&
    sameOption sameStatic left.preferredRoute right.preferredRoute &&
    sameStatic left.operationRefinements right.operationRefinements &&
    sameArray (fun (reference, route) (otherReference, otherRoute) =>
      sameReference reference otherReference && sameStatic route otherRoute)
      left.alternatives right.alternatives &&
    sameOption sameReference left.reference right.reference &&
    sameOption sameReference left.observation right.observation &&
    sameOption termEqual left.originalApplication right.originalApplication &&
    sameOption (sameApplication termEqual) left.application right.application &&
    sameOption (fun (family, target) (otherFamily, otherTarget) =>
      sameCreationFamily family otherFamily && sameLimitFamily target otherTarget)
      left.creationOwner right.creationOwner &&
    sameOption (sameAdmission termEqual) left.admission right.admission &&
    sameOption (fun (a, b) (c, d) => termEqual a c && termEqual b d)
      left.presentationEndpoints right.presentationEndpoints &&
    sameOption (sameArray (sameArray termEqual)) left.routedInputs right.routedInputs &&
    left.legOrdinal == right.legOrdinal &&
    left.recordSelection == right.recordSelection &&
    sameOption termEqual left.recordOwner right.recordOwner &&
    sameOption (sameCategory termEqual) left.category right.category &&
    sameOption (sameTypeOrigin termEqual) left.typeOrigin right.typeOrigin &&
    sameOption (sameElementOwner termEqual) left.elementOwner right.elementOwner &&
    sameOption (samePointOrigin termEqual) left.pointOrigin right.pointOrigin &&
    sameOption (samePointRequest termEqual) left.pointRequest right.pointRequest &&
    sameOption termEqual left.isoOrigin right.isoOrigin &&
    sameOption (sameField termEqual) left.field right.field &&
    sameOption (sameEndpoint termEqual) left.endpoint right.endpoint &&
    sameOption sameLimitFamily left.limitFamily right.limitFamily &&
    sameOption (sameLimit termEqual) left.limit right.limit &&
    sameOption (sameLeg termEqual) left.leg right.leg &&
    sameOption (sameCell termEqual) left.cellFamily right.cellFamily &&
    sameOption (sameComponent termEqual) left.cell right.cell &&
    sameOption (sameCartesian termEqual) left.cartesian right.cartesian &&
    sameOption (samePowerObject termEqual) left.powerObject right.powerObject

/-- Equality of complete selection tables, indexed only by stable native binding IDs. -/
def SourceSelectionScope.exactlyMatches (termEqual : α → α → Bool)
    (left right : SourceSelectionScope α) : Bool :=
  left.size == right.size && left.toList.all fun (binding, selection) =>
    match right[binding]? with
    | some other => selection.exactlyMatches termEqual other
    | none => false

end CasCompiler

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta

/-- Transport the complete typed selection data through the same captured native context. -/
def SourceSelectionScope.close (scope : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (context : OpenContext) :
    MetaM (SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm) :=
  SourceSelectionScope.mapM context.close scope

def SourceSelectionScope.inContext (scope : SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm) (context : OpenContext) :
    MetaM (SourceSelectionScope Expr) :=
  SourceSelectionScope.mapM (fun term => term.inContext context) scope

/-- Combine independently retained scopes in one complete native context. A duplicate
binding ID must carry the entire identical selection; neither scope overrides any field. -/
def SourceSelectionScope.merge (current incoming : SourceSelectionScope Expr) :
    MetaM (SourceSelectionScope Expr) := do
  let mut result := current
  for (binding, selection) in incoming.toList do
    if let some original := result[binding]? then
      unless original.exactlyMatches Expr.equal selection do
        throwError "one source binding has incompatible retained selections"
    else
      result := result.insert binding selection
  return result

/-- Only the exact native binder selects its retained typed record. -/
def SourceSelectionScope.findAt? (scope : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (context : OpenContext)
    (source : Expr) : Option (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let .fvar localId := source | none
  let binding ← context.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == localId)
  scope[binding.id]?

/-- Carry one complete selected record to an explicitly introduced native alias. The alias
retains the prior binder as its native source; no expression equality chooses either identity. -/
def SourceSelectionScope.alias (scope : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (context : OpenContext)
    (original sourceVariable : Expr) : MetaM (SourceSelectionScope Expr) := do
  let some selection := scope.findAt? context original | return scope
  let .fvar originalId := original
    | throwError "a selected source alias lost its original native binder"
  let .fvar variableId := sourceVariable
    | throwError "a selected source alias requires its explicitly introduced native binder"
  if originalId == variableId then return scope
  let some binding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == variableId)
    | throwError "the selected source alias is outside its complete context"
  scope.merge (({} : SourceSelectionScope Expr).insert binding.id
    { selection with value := original })

/-- A selected intermediate is an opaque native binder. Its mathematical source is retained
only for checking; all subsequent selection consumers use this same stable binding identity. -/
def SourceSelectionScope.withBinding [Monad m] [MonadLiftT MetaM m] [MonadControlT MetaM m]
    (identities : CasRuntime.IdentitySupply) (scope : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
    (context : OpenContext) (selection : SourceSelection Expr)
    (action : OpenContext → SourceSelectionScope Expr → Expr → m α)
    (declaredType : Option Expr := none) : m α := do
  let instances ← liftM (m := MetaM) getLocalInstances
  let allocated ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| identities.fresh .sourceBinding
  let id : BindingId := ⟨allocated.worker, allocated.serial⟩
  let type ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| match declaredType with
    | some type => pure type
    | none => inferType selection.value
  context.withLocalBinding id .selectedStructure `selectedSource type
    (fun context binding =>
      mapMetaM (fun action => do withLCtx (← getLCtx) instances action) do
        let context ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| ContextTelescope.capture context.bindings
        action context (scope.insert id selection) binding.expression)
    (originalSource := some selection.value)

/-- Lambda-lift every contextual datum over the same complete original formal telescope. -/
def SourceSelection.abstract (selection : SourceSelection Expr)
    (formals : Array LocalBinding) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  unless selection.formalBindings.isEmpty do
    throwError "a source selection has already abstracted its original formals"
  if formals.isEmpty then return selection
  let result ← selection.mapM fun term =>
    mkLambdaFVars (formals.map (·.expression)) term (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
  let mut formalBindings := #[]
  for formal in formals do
    unless (← getFVarLocalDecl formal.expression).isLet do
      formalBindings := formalBindings.push formal.id
  return { result with formalBindings }

/-- Instantiate the complete original telescope in every selected operand at once. -/
def SourceSelection.specialize (selection : SourceSelection Expr)
    (arguments : Array Expr) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  unless selection.formalBindings.size == arguments.size do
    throwError "a source selection lost its complete original formal argument table"
  if arguments.isEmpty then return selection
  let result ← selection.mapM fun term => do
    let applied := mkAppN term arguments
    check applied
    return applied.headBeta
  return { result with formalBindings := #[] }

end CasCompiler

/- The bars of an element are its registered absolute value: `|z|` for `z` in ℂ is the morphism
of sets `abs : ℂ → ℝ` (`mor.sets.complex_abs`), as in tests/acceptance/numbers.cas; the bars of
an object remain its cardinality. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "source-abs.cas" "let z := 2 + 2i in ℂ\n"
  let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  for item in file.items do
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
      | throwError "the complex statement did not parse"
    let .definition next _ ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
      | throwError "the complex number did not extend its source context"
    session := next
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term "|z|"
    | throwError "the absolute value did not parse"
  let value ← session.read ⟨source⟩
  checkSelected value fun expression => do
    checkOriginal #[expression] fun native => do
      let value ← instantiateMVars native[0]!
      unless (value.find? (·.isConstOf ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NumberSystems.abs)).isSome do
        throwError "`|z|` is not the registered absolute value: {value}"

private def nativeTerm (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do

  return ⟨parsed⟩

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do

      let scope ← get
      let bindings ← authoredBindings
      let expected ← expected.source.inContext scope.context
      checkOriginal #[expression, expected, bindings[4]!.expression, bindings[5]!.expression,
          bindings[6]!.expression, bindings[7]!.expression] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "a source action changed its actual ring, module or declared action"
        unless native[0]!.containsFVar native[2]!.fvarId! &&
            native[0]!.containsFVar native[3]!.fvarId! &&
            !native[0]!.containsFVar native[4]!.fvarId! &&
            !native[0]!.containsFVar native[5]!.fvarId! do

        checkWithKernel
