run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `R (← nativeTerm "RingCat.{0}")
  let ring ← session.term (← nativeTerm "R")
  let rings ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Rings" [.zero] #[]
  let ring ← ring.inCategory rings.expression rings.value
  let session ← session.defineTerm `S ring
  let moduleObject ← session.read (← sourceTerm "RegularModule(S)")
  let session ← session.defineTerm `M moduleObject
  let session ← session.assume `v (← nativeTerm "M")
  let expected ← session.term (← nativeTerm
    "TypeCat.Fun.toFun (TypeCat.Hom.hom (CasCatalogue.Modules.Operations.scalarAction S M)) (TypeCat.Fun.toFun (TypeCat.Hom.hom (CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.ringNumeral S 2)) default, v)")
  for source in #["2 • v", "2 * v", "2 v"] do
    let term ← session.read (← sourceTerm source)
    checkSelected term fun expression => do
      let scope ← get
      let expected ← expected.source.inContext scope.context
      checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun native => do
        unless native[0]!.containsConst (· == ``CasCatalogue.Modules.Operations.scalarAction) &&
            (← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]!) do
          throwError "source action {source} changed its generic scalar or module role"
        checkWithKernel
          (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!) (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))

  -- The same original regular-module value admits two explicitly named operations:
  -- its inherited monoid product and its selected scalar action. Juxtaposition must
  -- retain both readings as an ambiguity; declaration order cannot choose one.
  for (source, operation) in #[
      ("v · v", "op.monoids.mul"), ("v • v", "op.modules.scalar_action")] do
    let term ← session.read (← sourceTerm source)
    let #[entry] := (← semanticState).operations.filter (·.id.raw == operation)
      | throwError "the explicit operation control lost its independent original row"
    checkSelected term fun expression => do
      let count ← visitNativeData (fun actual => do
        let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? actual | return false
        return selected.reference.any (·.exactlyMatches (.operation entry))) expression
      unless count > 0 do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
          throwError "the explicit operation control changed its original selected family"
      checkOriginal #[expression] fun native => check native[0]!

  let failure : Option Exception ← withoutModifyingState do
    try
      discard <| session.read (← sourceTerm "v v")
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "juxtaposition selected one of two admitted original operations"
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity failure do throw failure

module

public import CasCompiler.SourceRing
public import CasCompiler.SourceTypeOrigin
public import CasCompiler.SourceProof
public import CasCatalogue.Evaluation
public import CasContract.Failure

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

/-- The explicit arguments of an application, in order. -/
def sourceExplicitArguments (expression : Expr) : MetaM (Array Expr) := do
  let arguments := expression.getAppArgs
  let info ← getFunInfoNArgs expression.getAppFn arguments.size
  return (arguments.zip (info.paramInfo.map (·.isExplicit))).filterMap fun (argument, explicit) =>
    if explicit then some argument else none

/-- The unique registered object family application that is the native type `type` by reducible
unification (`polynomials ℤ` for `Polynomial ℤ`), or `type` itself when there is none or several. -/
def sourceRegisteredForm (type : Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  if (← SourceReadM.selection? type).isSome then return type
  let mut found : Array (ObjectEntry × Expr) := #[]
  for entry in (← semanticState).objects do
    discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
    let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
    let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
    let object := mkAppN family parameters
    let applicable ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState do
      unless ← withReducible (isDefEq object type) do return false
      return !(← instantiateMVars object).hasMVar
    if applicable then
      discard <| liftM (m := MetaM) <| withReducible (isDefEq object type)
      let object ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars object
      found := found.push (entry, object)
  match found with
  | #[(entry, object)] =>
    let #[category] := (← semanticState).categories.filter (·.id == entry.category)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source domain lost its original registered category"
    SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt (.named (.registered (.inl entry) category)) object object)
  | _ => return type

/-- An explicitly retained object selects its own admission. Only an unselected native
template can enter the original reducible-family lookup; another selected structure
cannot be recovered or substituted from its carrier. -/
def sourceAdmissionDomain? (type : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option ObjectEntry) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let (_, declared) ← registeredSourceDomain type
  if !declared.isEmpty then
    let #[entry] := declared
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity
          "several registered objects declare this admission domain"
    return if entry.admission.isSome then some entry else none
  if (← SourceReadM.selection? type).isSome then return none
  let mut found := #[]
  for entry in state.objects do
    unless entry.admission.isSome do continue
    discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
    let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
    let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
    let applicable ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState <| withReducible <|
      isDefEq (mkAppN family parameters) type
    if applicable then found := found.push entry
  match found with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[entry] => return some entry
  | _ =>
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
      throwSemanticAmbiguity "several admitted subobjects have this carrier"

/-- Establish the hypothesis `obligation` of an admission by the domain's registered evidence and
nothing else, at the closed value it is about. The result is the term the procedure built.
Source: ObjectEntry.evidence (LC-18) and `Evaluation.runProcedure`, the one procedure runner. -/
private def establish (entry : ObjectEntry) (obligation : Expr) : TermElabM Expr := do
  let some evidence := entry.evidence
    | throwStratum .invalid m!"{entry.name} registers no evidence for its admission"
  let closed ← zetaReduce (← instantiateMVars obligation)
  if closed.hasFVar || closed.hasMVar then
    throwStratum .invalid
      m!"the hypothesis {closed} of {entry.name} is about a value that is not closed"
  -- The procedure is stated of the value's mathematics, not the reader's categorical plumbing.
  let presented ← Evaluation.evidencePresentation (← semanticState) closed
  let goal ← mkFreshExprMVar presented .syntheticOpaque
  match ← Evaluation.runProcedure evidence goal.mvarId! with
  | .error message =>
    throwStratum .invalid m!"{closed} is not established by the evidence of {entry.name}: {message}"
  | .ok remaining =>
    unless remaining.isEmpty do
      throwStratum .invalid m!"the evidence of {entry.name} leaves {closed} unestablished"
    let term ← instantiateMVars goal
    if term.hasMVar || term.hasSorry then
      throwStratum .invalid m!"the evidence of {entry.name} built no closed term for {closed}"
    return term

/-- The element `v` of the subobject `D` (the object whose carrier is `target`), by its registered
admission `∀ params (x : B) (h : P x), 1 ⟶ D params`: `x` is read in `B` by `read`, each
hypothesis is established by the domain's evidence, and the admitted point is read at its point.
The element is the first explicit binder that the admission's target does not depend on; the
explicit binders after it are its hypotheses. Source: ObjectEntry.admission and the original
reader's `admit`. A value that is not established to lie in `D` is not an element of it. -/
def sourceAdmissionApplicable (entry : ObjectEntry) (target : Expr)
    (read : Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr)) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) := do
  let some admission := entry.admission
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid m!"{entry.name} registers no admission"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration admission
  let previous ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
  let constant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels admission
  let (arguments, infos, type) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType constant)
  let type ← whnfR type
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the admission of {entry.name} is not a point map"
  let explicit := (List.range arguments.size).toArray.filter (infos[·]!.isExplicit)
  let some element := explicit.find? fun index =>
      (type.findMVar? (· == arguments[index]!.mvarId!)).isNone
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the admission of {entry.name} takes no value"
  let mut retainedArguments : Array (Option Expr) := Array.replicate arguments.size none
  let (original, references) ← registeredSourceDomain target
  if !references.isEmpty then
    let #[selected] := references
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid m!"the admission of {entry.name} has ambiguous selected objects"
    unless reprStr selected == reprStr entry do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid m!"the admission of {entry.name} has another selected object"
  if !references.isEmpty || original.getAppFn.isConstOf entry.declaration then
    -- The actual native factor of a registered map can state this same admitted family
    -- without surface metadata. Its complete authored argument spine is equally retained.
    -- Registry.Semantic.validateObject checks this exact target head before conversion.
    let some retained ← alignSourceArguments? entry.declaration arguments type.getAppArgs[3]!
        original
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid m!"the admission of {entry.name} has different original target parameters"
    retainedArguments := retained
  unless ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withReducible (isDefEq type.getAppArgs[3]! original) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid m!"the admission of {entry.name} does not land in the selected domain"
  -- Infer the datum binder at the actual declared prefix, including implicit arguments.
  -- Native unification may erase identity wrappers, so restore only parameters supplied by
  -- the original target alignment before their selected category is needed by the reader.
  let parameterPrefix ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| ((arguments.take element).mapIdx fun index argument =>
    retainedArguments[index]!.getD argument).mapM instantiateMVars
  let .forallE _ dataType _ _ ← whnfR (← inferType (mkAppN constant parameterPrefix))
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the admission of {entry.name} lost its declared datum binder"
  let dataType ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars dataType
  -- Finish typed elaboration before evidence inspects the complete actual data.
  -- Native dependent constructors can leave pending synthetic coercion terms.
  let current ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
  let owned := current.decls.foldl (fun result identity _ =>
    if previous.decls.contains identity then result else result.push identity) #[]
  let datum ← withSynthesizeApplicableScoped <| read dataType
  let read ← match datum with
    | .ok value => liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars value
    | .error message => return .error message
  -- The evidence is stated of a closed value's plumbing-free normal form, which is
  -- definitionally it; the admitted element remains the value as read, so that its registered
  -- operations reach the kernel (constitution C22).
  extendSourceApplicationScope owned
  unless ← isDefEq arguments[element]! read do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid m!"the value is not in the set that {entry.name} is included in"
  for argument in arguments, info in infos do
    if info.isInstImplicit && (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars argument).isMVar then
      let some instanceValue ← synthInstance? (← inferType argument)
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the admission of {entry.name} lacks its declared instance"
      discard <| isDefEq argument instanceValue
  for index in explicit.filter (element < ·) do
    let obligation ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType arguments[index]!)
    let proof ← SourceReadM.prove obligation fun original _ => establish entry original
    extendSourceApplicationScope owned
    unless ← isDefEq arguments[index]! proof do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid m!"the evidence of {entry.name} does not apply"
  let constant ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars constant
  let mut arguments ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| (arguments.set! element read).mapM instantiateMVars
  -- Native unification checks the parameter, while the actual source application retains
  -- its original expression, including its original source binding and supplied evidence.
  for original in retainedArguments, index in [:retainedArguments.size] do
    if let some original := original then
      arguments := arguments.set! index (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars original)
  let admitted := mkAppN constant arguments
  if admitted.hasMVar || admitted.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid m!"the parameters or evidence of {entry.name} are not determined"
  -- Keep the complete admission telescope before specializing the point value. Native input
  -- routing can then select the original element and data-bearing evidence independently;
  -- inspecting those routes never substitutes or evaluates the actual evidence.
  let family ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <| forallTelescope (← inferType constant) fun parameters _ => do
    let value ← sourcePointValueSelection (mkAppN constant parameters) none
    mkLambdaFVars parameters value.value (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
  let value := mkAppN family arguments
  let scope ← get
  let agrees ← scope.context.withOriginalSources #[← inferType value, target] fun original =>
    isDefEq original[0]! original[1]!
  unless agrees do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid m!"the admitted point is not in the selected domain of {entry.name}"
  let selected ← retainSourcePoint admitted {
    value
    admission := some ⟨entry, family, arguments, element⟩ }
  return .ok (← SourceReadM.select selected (some target))

/-- Required admission keeps its original public callback and diagnostics. Only a datum
reader's explicit applicability result can reject a candidate; selected target, admission,
instance and evidence failures in the owner above remain exceptions. -/
def sourceAdmission (entry : ObjectEntry) (target : Expr) (read : Expr → SourceReadM Expr) :
    SourceReadM Expr := do
  let admitted ← sourceAdmissionApplicable entry target fun type => do
    return .ok (← read type)
  match admitted with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid message

/-- A binding operator `token` (`∫_{a}^{b} e dt`, `lim_{t → a} e`, `∑_{t ∈ A} e`) through its
registered rows (Registry.Entry.BinderEntry). The notation's arguments are the operation's last
explicit parameters, each a point `1 ⟶ X` (read as an element of `X`) or an object; the bound
variable ranges over the row's domain at the same parameters; the map `t ↦ e` is admitted into
the operation's source object with that object's evidence; the operation is applied to it.
`readArgument` reads an argument at a type, `readBody` the body with the bound variable. Every
parameter must be fixed by the arguments and the body; one row must read the statement. -/
def sourceBinder (token : String)
    (arguments : Array (Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr)))
    (bound : Name) (readBody : Expr → SourceReadM Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let rows := state.binders.filter (·.token == token)
  let attempt : BinderEntry → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) := fun row => do
    discard <| checkedDeclaration row.operation
    discard <| checkedDeclaration row.domain
    let previous ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
    let operation ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels row.operation
    let (parameters, infos, arrow) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType operation)
    let explicit := (parameters.zip infos).filter (·.2.isExplicit) |>.map (·.1)
    let current ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
    let owned := current.decls.foldl (fun result identity _ =>
      if previous.decls.contains identity then result else result.push identity) #[]
    unless arguments.size ≤ explicit.size do
      return .error m!"the binder takes fewer arguments"
    let rec visitArguments (remaining : List Expr) (index : Nat) :
        SourceReadM (Except MessageData Unit) := do
      match remaining with
      | [] => return .ok ()
      | parameter :: remaining => do
        let some read := arguments[index]?
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the binder lost its original argument position"
        let type ← whnfR (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType parameter))
        let value : Except MessageData Expr ← if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then do
            let expected ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars type.getAppArgs[3]!
            let datum ← read expected
            let element ← match datum with
              | .ok value => pure value
              | .error message => return .error message
            unless ← isDefEq (← inferType element) expected do
              return .error m!"the binder argument has another type"
            let constant ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLocalDeclD `point type.getAppArgs[2]! fun point =>
              mkLambdaFVars #[point] element
            pure (.ok (← elabAppArgs (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``TypeCat.ofHom)
              #[] #[Arg.expr constant] (some type) false false))
          else read type
        let value ← match value with
          | .ok value => pure value
          | .error message => return .error message
        unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) type do
          return .error m!"the binder argument has another type"
        extendSourceApplicationScope owned
        unless ← isDefEq parameter value do
          return .error m!"the binder argument has another type"
        visitArguments remaining (index + 1)
    match ← visitArguments
        (explicit.extract (explicit.size - arguments.size) explicit.size).toList 0 with
    | .ok () => pure ()
    | .error message => return .error message
    let domainConstant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels row.domain
    -- The bound variable lies in the registered form of the domain (`ℝ` for `∫_{a}^{b}`).
    let domain ← sourceRegisteredForm (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN domainConstant parameters))
    let arrow ← whnfR arrow
    unless arrow.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the binder operation is not a map"
    let some entry ← sourceAdmissionDomain? (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars arrow.getAppArgs[2]!)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the binder operation does not act on an admitted object of maps"
    let admitted ← sourceAdmissionApplicable entry (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars arrow.getAppArgs[2]!) fun base => do
      let function ← SourceReadM.withLambda bound domain .default readBody
      let scope ← get
      let agrees ← scope.context.withOriginalSources #[← inferType function, base] fun original =>
        isDefEq original[0]! original[1]!
      unless agrees do
        return .error m!"the binder body is not a map of the operation's source"
      return .ok (← SourceReadM.select { value := function } (some base))
    let point ← match admitted with
      | .ok value => pure value
      | .error message => return .error message
    let applied ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN operation parameters)
    if applied.hasMVar || applied.hasLevelMVar then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource m!"the binder {token} has parameters its arguments do not determine"
    let selected ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt (.binder row) applied applied)
    let function ← sourceSetFunction selected
    return .ok (← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr point] none false false)
  let require : BinderEntry → SourceReadM Expr := fun row => do
    match ← attempt row with
    | .ok value => pure value
    | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid message
  if let #[row] := rows then return ← require row
  match ← SourceReadM.chooseApplicable (rows.map attempt)
      m!"no registered binder {token} reads these arguments and body"
      m!"several registered binders {token} read this statement" with
  | .ok value => return value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .invalid message

/-- The registered object whose family, at parameters that reducible unification determines, is
the native type `type`, with that application. -/
private def registeredObjectAt? (type : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option (ObjectEntry × Expr)) := do
  let (original, entries) ← registeredSourceDomain type
  if (← SourceReadM.selection? type).isSome then
    match entries with
    | #[entry] => return if entry.refines.isNone then some (entry, original) else none
    | _ => return none
  let mut found := #[]
  for entry in (← semanticState).objects do
    if entry.refines.isSome then continue
    discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
    let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
    let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
    let object := mkAppN family parameters
    let applicable ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState do
      unless ← withReducible (isDefEq object type) do return false
      return !(← instantiateMVars object).hasMVar
    if applicable then
      discard <| liftM (m := MetaM) <| withReducible (isDefEq object type)
      found := found.push (entry, ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars object)
  match found with
  | #[unique] => return some unique
  | _ => return none

/-- A registered map out of the set `source`: a declaration whose arrow, at parameters that
reducible unification with `source` determines, leaves `source`. -/
private def mapFrom? (declaration : Name) (source : Expr) : MetaM (Option (Expr × Expr)) := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
  let constant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels declaration
  let (parameters, _, arrow) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType constant)
  let arrow ← whnfR arrow
  unless arrow.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do return none
  let applicable ← withoutModifyingState do
    unless ← withReducible (isDefEq arrow.getAppArgs[2]! source) do return false
    return !(← instantiateMVars (mkAppN constant parameters)).hasMVar
  unless applicable do return none
  discard <| withReducible (isDefEq arrow.getAppArgs[2]! source)
  return some (← instantiateMVars (mkAppN constant parameters),
    ← instantiateMVars arrow.getAppArgs[3]!)

/-- A registered map into the set `target`, at the parameters that reducible unification of its
target with `target` determines, with its source set. -/
private def mapInto? (declaration : Name) (target : Expr) : MetaM (Option (Expr × Expr)) := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
  let constant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels declaration
  let (parameters, _, arrow) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType constant)
  let arrow ← whnfR arrow
  unless arrow.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do return none
  let applicable ← withoutModifyingState do
    unless ← withReducible (isDefEq arrow.getAppArgs[3]! target) do return false
    return !(← instantiateMVars (mkAppN constant parameters)).hasMVar
  unless applicable do return none
  discard <| withReducible (isDefEq arrow.getAppArgs[3]! target)
  return some (← instantiateMVars (mkAppN constant parameters),
    ← instantiateMVars arrow.getAppArgs[2]!)

/-- Every chain of registered inclusions out of the set `current`, as the maps along it with the
set it ends in. A visited object is not entered again, so each chain is a simple path. -/
private partial def inclusionChains (state : SemanticState) (current : Expr)
    (visited : List String) : SourceReadM (Array (Array Expr × Expr)) := do
  let mut found := #[(#[], current)]
  let some (entry, original) ← registeredObjectAt? (← sourceRegisteredForm current) | return found
  if visited.contains entry.id.raw then return found
  for inclusion in state.inclusions do
    unless inclusion.sub == entry.id do continue
    let some (arrow, next) ← mapFrom? inclusion.declaration original | continue
    for (maps, last) in ← inclusionChains state next (entry.id.raw :: visited) do
      found := found.push (#[arrow] ++ maps, last)
  return found

/-- The element `value` of a named set read in the named set `target`, through the registered
inclusions (`ℕ ⊆ ℤ`) and the target's registered constants (`R ↪ R[x]`): `none` when no chain
of these maps leads there. Several chains are a competing reading. Source: InclusionEntry,
ObjectEntry.constants and the original reader's rule for elements of related sets. -/
def sourceCoercion? (value target : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let source ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType value)
  let some _ ← registeredObjectAt? (← sourceRegisteredForm source) | return none
  let some (goal, originalTarget) ← registeredObjectAt? (← sourceRegisteredForm target) | return none
  let chains ← inclusionChains state source []
  let mut readings := #[]
  for (maps, last) in chains do
    if maps.isEmpty then continue
    if ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState (isDefEq last originalTarget) then readings := readings.push maps
  if let some constants := goal.constants then
    if let some (arrow, coefficients) ← mapInto? constants originalTarget then
      for (maps, last) in chains do
        if ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState (isDefEq last coefficients) then
          readings := readings.push (maps.push arrow)
  match readings with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[maps] =>
    let mut result := value
    for arrow in maps do
      let type ← whnfR (← inferType arrow)
      unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected inclusion lost its original native map"
      let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? result).getD { value := result }
      result ← SourceReadM.select { selected with value := result } (some type.getAppArgs[2]!)
      let function ← sourceSetFunction arrow
      result ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr result] none false false
    return some (← SourceReadM.select { value := result } (some target))
  | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "several registered maps read this element in the expected set"

/-- The set in which operands of the given sets meet: the one into which every other operand's
set maps through registered maps (`sourceCoercion?`), so that `n² · tⁿ` is read in ℤ[[t]];
otherwise the first set. -/
def sourceCommonDomain (types : Array Expr) : SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  let mut distinct : Array Expr := #[]
  for type in types do
    unless ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| distinct.anyM fun other =>
        withoutModifyingState (isDefEq other type) do
      distinct := distinct.push type
  if distinct.size ≤ 1 then return distinct[0]?
  let mut common := #[]
  for candidate in distinct do
    let reaches ← distinct.allM fun other => do
      if ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState (isDefEq other candidate) then return true
      SourceReadM.inspect <| SourceReadM.withBinder `operand other none .default
        (fun _ result => pure result) fun operand => do
          return (← sourceCoercion? operand candidate).isSome
    if reaches then common := common.push candidate
  match common with
  | #[candidate] => return some candidate
  | _ => return distinct[0]?

/-- A numeral in a set with no numeral of its own (`2` in `ℕ ∪ {-∞}`): the image, under the
unique registered inclusion into that set whose source reads the numeral, of the numeral there.
`readAt` returns `none` only for explicit absence of a numeral at that type. Errors in a
chosen reading remain errors. Source: InclusionEntry and the original reader's numerals
of related sets. -/
def sourceIncludedNumeral (target : Expr) (readAt : Expr → SourceReadM (Option Expr)) :
    SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  let originalTarget := target
  let target ← sourceRegisteredForm target
  let (nativeTarget, _) ← registeredSourceDomain target
  let mut readings := #[]
  for inclusion in (← semanticState).inclusions do
    let some (arrow, source) ← mapInto? inclusion.declaration nativeTarget | continue
    let applicable ← SourceReadM.inspect do return (← readAt source).isSome
    if applicable then readings := readings.push (arrow, source)
  match readings with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[(arrow, source)] =>
    let function ← sourceSetFunction arrow
    let some numeral ← readAt source
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected inclusion lost its admitted source numeral"
    let value ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr numeral] none false false
    return some (← SourceReadM.select { value } (some originalTarget))
  | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "several registered inclusions read this numeral"

end CasCompiler

import CasCompiler.Surface

namespace CasCompiler.SourceArgumentIdentityTests

open Lean Meta

-- Native target positions determine formal slots, including reordered parameters. Equal
-- definitions do not make their independently supplied input occurrences interchangeable.
-- These controls perform source matching only; no provider or mathematical value is run.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let typeSort := mkSort (.succ .zero)
  let product := mkConst ``Prod [.zero, .zero]
  withLetDecl `First typeSort (mkConst ``Nat) fun first => do
    withLetDecl `Second typeSort (mkConst ``Nat) fun second => do
      unless ← isDefEq first second do
        throwError "the distinct-source control lost its convertible native definitions"
      let formal ← mkFreshExprMVar typeSort
      let rejected ← alignSourceArguments? ``Prod #[formal]
        (mkApp2 product formal formal) (mkApp2 product first second)
      unless rejected.isNone && (← instantiateMVars formal).isMVar do
        throwError "repeated formal accepted different equal source inputs or leaked its failed match"

      let left ← mkFreshExprMVar typeSort
      let right ← mkFreshExprMVar typeSort
      let some retained ← alignSourceArguments? ``Prod #[left, right]
          (mkApp2 product right left) (mkApp2 product first second)
        | throwError "native target positions did not specialize reordered formals"
      unless retained == #[some second, some first] do
        throwError "native target matching replaced the original reordered source arguments"

    let formal ← mkFreshExprMVar typeSort
    let some retained ← alignSourceArguments? ``Prod #[formal]
        (mkApp2 product formal formal) (mkApp2 product first first)
      | throwError "one repeated original source input was rejected"
    unless retained == #[some first] do
      throwError "the repeated original input lost its actual source expression"

    withLetDecl `Alias typeSort first fun aliasType => do
      let formal ← mkFreshExprMVar typeSort
      let some retained ← alignSourceArguments? ``Prod #[formal]
          (mkApp2 product formal formal) (mkApp2 product aliasType first)
        | throwError "an explicit native alias lost its original input witness"
      unless retained == #[some aliasType] do
        throwError "the alias control replaced its original supplied expression"

    -- Runtime occurrences remain distinct opaque binders even when their explicit
    -- original sources are equal. Mathematical source interpretation cannot choose one.
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[{
      id := ⟨"source-arguments", 0⟩, role := .definition, expression := first }]
    context.withLocalBinding ⟨"source-arguments", 1⟩ .result `firstRuntime typeSort
        (fun context firstRuntime => do
      context.withLocalBinding ⟨"source-arguments", 2⟩ .result `secondRuntime typeSort
          (fun context secondRuntime => do
        context.withOriginalSources #[firstRuntime.expression, secondRuntime.expression]
            fun originals => do
          unless ← isDefEq originals[0]! originals[1]! do
            throwError "the runtime source control lost its equal original definitions"
        let formal ← mkFreshExprMVar typeSort
        let rejected ← alignSourceArguments? ``Prod #[formal]
          (mkApp2 product formal formal)
          (mkApp2 product firstRuntime.expression secondRuntime.expression)
        unless rejected.isNone && (← instantiateMVars formal).isMVar do
          throwError "repeated formal erased distinct retained runtime binders"
      ) (originalSource := some first)
    ) (originalSource := some first)

-- A projected alias keeps the exact original parent and native field path. Equal sibling
-- fields do not establish that path; only the actual supplied projection does.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let natural := mkConst ``Nat
  let pair := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Prod [.zero, .zero]) natural natural
  let pairValue ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 7]
  withLetDecl `pair pair pairValue fun input => do
    let selected := mkProj ``Prod 0 input
    withLetDecl `selected natural selected fun selectedAlias => do
      let formal ← mkFreshExprMVar natural
      let equality := mkConst ``Eq [.succ .zero]
      let some retained ← alignSourceArguments? ``Eq #[formal]
          (mkApp3 equality natural formal formal)
          (mkApp3 equality natural selectedAlias selected)
        | throwError "an exact native projection alias lost its original parent/path"
      unless retained == #[some selectedAlias] do
        throwError "native projection alignment changed its supplied alias expression"
      let other := mkProj ``Prod 1 input
      unless ← isDefEq selected other do
        throwError "the sibling-field control lost its convertible native fields"
      let formal ← mkFreshExprMVar natural
      let rejected ← alignSourceArguments? ``Eq #[formal]
        (mkApp3 equality natural formal formal) (mkApp3 equality natural selected other)
      unless rejected.isNone && (← instantiateMVars formal).isMVar do
        throwError "repeated formal accepted another native input field"

-- The complete native constructor telescope includes dependent arguments and proof-only
-- positions. Actual data is retained, while repeated proofs use native proof irrelevance.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let natural := mkConst ``Nat
  let family ← withLocalDeclD `n natural fun n =>
    mkLambdaFVars #[n] (mkApp (mkConst ``Fin) (mkApp (mkConst ``Nat.succ) n))
  withLocalDeclD `n natural fun n => do
    withLocalDeclD `point (mkApp family n) fun point => do
      let formalNumber ← mkFreshExprMVar natural
      let formalPoint ← mkFreshExprMVar (mkApp family formalNumber)
      let declared ← mkAppOptM ``Sigma.mk
        #[some natural, some family, some formalNumber, some formalPoint]
      let original ← mkAppOptM ``Sigma.mk
        #[some natural, some family, some n, some point]
      let some retained ← alignSourceArguments? ``Sigma.mk #[formalNumber, formalPoint]
          declared original
        | throwError "complete native dependent parameters did not specialize"
      unless retained == #[some n, some point] do
        throwError "native specialization changed an original dependent argument"
  withLocalDeclD `h (mkConst ``True) fun first => do
    withLocalDeclD `k (mkConst ``True) fun second => do
      let formal ← mkFreshExprMVar (mkConst ``True)
      let constructor := mkConst ``And.intro
      let declared := mkApp4 constructor (mkConst ``True) (mkConst ``True) formal formal
      let original := mkApp4 constructor (mkConst ``True) (mkConst ``True) first second
      unless (← alignSourceArguments? ``And.intro #[formal] declared original).isSome do
        throwError "native proof-only repetition was treated as a computational source choice"

end CasCompiler.SourceArgumentIdentityTests

  let cases : Array (String × String × Option String) := #[

    ("ℙ", "ℙ", none), ("C^∞", "C^∞", none), ("«C^∞»", "C^∞", none),

    let (entry, selected) ← selectObject name qualification
    let term ← session.read ⟨stx⟩
    checkSelected term fun value => do
      let some selection ← SourceReadM.selection? value
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a registered source object lost its selected reference"
      let some reference := selection.reference
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a registered source object lost its complete registry row"
      unless reference.exactlyMatches (.named (.registered (.inl entry) selected)) do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a registered source object changed its exact selected reference"
      let some application := selection.originalApplication
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "an atomic source lost its complete original application"
      unless application.getAppFn.constName? == some entry.declaration do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "an atomic source changed its independently registered declaration"

      | throwError "an atomic source lost its selected category bundle"

    checkSelected term fun _ => do
      let scope ← get
      let bundle ← category.bundle.inContext scope.context
      checkOriginal #[bundle] fun native => do

      let some (originalEntry, originalCategory) ←

      unless (SelectedSourceReference.named (.registered (.inl originalEntry) originalCategory)).exactlyMatches
          (.named (.registered (.inl entry) selected)) && value == original.expression do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a native source alias changed its selected object or binding"

module

public import CasCompiler.SourceRoutes
public import CasCompiler.SourceTypeOrigin
public import CasCompiler.Surface
public import CasContract.Registration
public import CasContract.Failure

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

/-- The declared preferred routes (constitution C6) of the admitted registrations that the current
statement is read with; the kernel session sets them before reading. -/
initialize preferredRoutesExtension : EnvExtension (Array PreferredRoute) ←
  registerEnvExtension (pure #[])

/-- Read the statements that follow with the declared preferred routes `routes`. -/
def setPreferredRoutes (routes : Array PreferredRoute) : CoreM Unit :=
  modifyEnv (preferredRoutesExtension.setState · routes)

/-- Of the surviving routes `routes` from the category `receiver` for the surface name `name`, the
one that the admitted registrations declare preferred. None when no preference applies; two
different applicable preferences are not ranked (contract api/manifest.md). -/
def preferredRoute? (state : SemanticState) (receiver : CategoryExpr) (name : String)
    (routes : Array Route) : MetaM (Option Route) := do
  let applicable := (preferredRoutesExtension.getState (← getEnv)).filter fun preference =>
    preference.name == name && state.categories.any fun entry =>
      entry.id.raw == preference.receiver && entry.expression.syntacticEq receiver
  let declared := applicable.foldl (fun found preference =>
    if found.contains preference.route then found else found.push preference.route) #[]
  match declared with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[labels] =>
    let some route := routes.find? (·.refs.map (·.label) == labels)
      | throwStratum .invalid
          m!"the declared preferred route {labels} of {name} is not a surviving route"
    return some route
  | _ => throwSemanticAmbiguity m!"several declared preferred routes of {name} apply: {declared}"

private structure CarrierCategoryFamily where
  value : Expr
  universes : List Name

-- Reuse the named-category and unary-constructor families in the semantic registry.
-- All source parameters and universes stay rigid while comparing complete functors.
private partial def carrierCategoryFamily (state : SemanticState) (source : CategoryExpr) :
    MetaM CarrierCategoryFamily := do
  let value ← nativeCategoryFamily state source fun _ => do
    return .param (← mkFreshUserName `carrierUniverse)
  let levels : CollectLevelParams.State := {}
  return ⟨value, (levels.collect value).params.toList⟩

private def carrierRoutes (source : CategoryExpr) : MetaM (Array Route) := do
  let sets := CategoryExpr.atom CategoryId.sets
  let routes ← SourceRoutes.forOwner source sets
  let some candidates ← routes.finiteRoutes
    | throwUnsupportedSource "the carrier route family requires its supplied uniform comparison"
  if candidates.isEmpty then
    throwError "the selected category has no structural carrier route in the source inventory"
  return candidates

-- Eq.refl is checked on full functor families before any object, category parameter,
-- or universe is specialized. A natural isomorphism is not used as functor equality.
-- Reuse: SourceSession.operationConversion's native conversion rule and congrFun.
def sourceRouteAgreements (state : SemanticState) (source : NativeSourceCategory)
    (routes : Array Route) : MetaM (Array Expr) := do
  if routes.size == 1 then return #[]
  let family ← carrierCategoryFamily state source.expression
  let functions ← routes.mapM fun route => do
    let value ← forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType family.value) fun parameters _ => do
      let selected ← nativeRouteFunctor state route (mkAppN family.value parameters)
      mkLambdaFVars parameters (← instantiateMVars selected.functor)
    if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then
      throwError "the whole carrier functor has undetermined source parameters"
    return value
  let first := functions[0]!
  let proofs ← (functions.drop 1).mapM fun other => do
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType first) (← inferType other) <&&> isDefEq first other do
      throwSemanticAmbiguity
        "structural carrier families require their supplied selection or equality"
    let proposition ← mkEq first other
    let proof ← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl first) proposition
    checkWithKernel proof
    return proof
  -- Instantiate a proof already checked at the complete rigid family. These fresh
  -- arguments are constrained by the actual full category bundle, including str.
  let levels ← family.universes.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  let actual := family.value.instantiateLevelParams family.universes levels
  let (arguments, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType actual)
  unless ← expandSourceStructures arguments do
    throwError "the selected carrier has inconsistent native parameter structures"
  unless ← isDefEq (mkAppN actual arguments) source.bundle do
    throwError "the selected carrier has a different complete native category family"
  let levels ← levels.mapM instantiateLevelMVars
  let arguments ← arguments.mapM instantiateMVars
  proofs.mapM fun proof => do
    let mut proof := proof.instantiateLevelParams family.universes levels
    for argument in arguments do
      proof ← mkAppM ``congrFun #[proof, argument]
    instantiateMVars proof

-- Apply the already selected native functor at the judgement's unchanged role.
private def carrierAction (role : SourceCategoryRole) (functor value target : Expr) :
    MetaM Expr :=
  match role with
  | .object => functorObject functor value target
  | .morphism => mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map #[functor, value]

/-- Consume a supplied carrier prefix, or the complete structural carrier family.
Only checked uniform native equality identifies implicit alternatives. Actual functor
actions, original objects or arrows, route references and equality evidence remain in the term.
Source: ObjectRefinement, structuralEdges and the native family-conversion rule. -/
opaque sourceCarrierSelection (source : NativeSourceJudgement) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let some category := source.category
    | do
      discard <| getLevel source.value
      return { value := source.value, category := source.category }
  if category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) then
    if category.role == .object then discard <| getLevel source.value
    return { value := source.value, category := source.category }
  let state ← semanticState
  let mut value := source.value
  let mut bundle := category.bundle
  let mut start := category.expression
  let mut selectedEdges := #[]
  if let some selected := category.carrier then
    for declaration in selected.identifications do discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
    unless (state.routeEdges? start selected.target selected.refs).isSome &&
        selected.refs.size == selected.actions.size do
      throwError "the selected carrier prefix has incomplete source boundaries or applications"
    for ref in selected.refs, action in selected.actions do
      checkEdgeDeclarations state ref
      unless ← isDefEq (← state.edgeFunctor ref) action do
        throwError "the selected carrier application differs from its declared edge"
      let (domain, target) ← functorCategoryBundles action
      unless ← isDefEq domain bundle do
        throwError "the selected carrier application has a different complete source category"
      value ← carrierAction category.role action value target
      bundle := target
    selectedEdges := selected.refs
    start := selected.target
  let routes ← carrierRoutes start
  let proofs ← sourceRouteAgreements state ⟨category.role, start, bundle, none, none⟩ routes
  let some route := routes[0]?
    | throwError "carrier formation requires its source route"
  if !route.steps.isEmpty then
    let selected ← nativeRouteFunctor state route bundle
    value ← carrierAction category.role selected.functor value selected.target
    bundle := selected.target
  for proof in proofs.reverse do
    let body := value
    value ← withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `carrierAgreement) (← inferType proof) proof
      fun binding => mkLetFVars #[binding] body
        (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
  let selection := category.carrier.map fun selected =>
    { selected with refs := #[], target := .atom CategoryId.sets, actions := #[] }
  return {
    value
    category := some ⟨category.role, .atom CategoryId.sets, bundle, selection, none⟩
    typeOrigin := if category.role == .object then some ⟨category, source.value, value⟩ else none
    carrierRoutes := routes.map fun route => selectedEdges ++ route.refs }

/-- Bind the carrier selected by the same complete native owner and checked route family. -/
opaque sourceCarrier (source : NativeSourceJudgement) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  if source.category.isNone || source.category.any (fun category =>
      category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets)) then
    if source.category.isNone || source.category.any (·.role == .object) then
      discard <| getLevel source.value
    return source
  let selected ← sourceCarrierSelection source
  let value ← SourceReadM.select selected
  return ⟨value, selected.category⟩

/-- The registered category whose objects are the native type `type` (`MonCat` for `Monoids`).
Several categories with that object type are ambiguous. -/
def sourceObjectCategory? (type : Expr) : TermElabM (Option NamedCategoryEntry) := do
  let mut found := #[]
  for entry in (← semanticState).categories do
    discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
    let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
    let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
    let objects ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[mkAppN family parameters]
    if ← withoutModifyingState (isDefEq objects type) then found := found.push entry
  match found with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[entry] => return some entry
  | _ => throwSemanticAmbiguity "several registered categories have these objects"

/-- An object of one selected category read where an object of `target` is expected: its image
along the structural route from its category to `target`, with the whole-family agreement of
competing routes (a ring of matrices as the monoid whose units are formed). The route functor
and its actual object action remain in the term. Source: SourceRoutes, structural edges and
the native family-conversion rule, as for `sourceCarrier`. -/
opaque sourceStructuralView (source : NativeSourceJudgement) (target : CategoryExpr)
    (name : Option String) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let some category := source.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a structural view requires its selected category"
  unless category.role == .object do liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a structural view acts on an object"
  if category.expression.syntacticEq target then return source
  let state ← semanticState
  let routes ← SourceRoutes.forOwner category.expression target
  let some routes ← routes.finiteRoutes
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "the structural view requires its supplied uniform comparison"
  let some route := routes[0]?
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected category has no structural route to the expected category"
  -- Competing routes for a name are resolved by a declared preferred route, recorded with the
  -- reading, or else by their whole-family agreement (constitution C6).
  let preferred ← if routes.size > 1 then
      match name with
      | some name => preferredRoute? state category.expression name routes
      | none => pure none
    else pure none
  let (route, proofs) ← match preferred with
    | some route => pure (route, #[])
    | none => pure (route, ← sourceRouteAgreements state category routes)
  let selected ← nativeRouteFunctor state route category.bundle
  let mut value ← functorObject selected.functor source.value selected.target
  for proof in proofs.reverse do
    let body := value
    value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `viewAgreement) (← inferType proof) proof
      fun binding => mkLetFVars #[binding] body
        (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
  let carrier : NativeSourceCarrierSelection := {
    refs := route.refs, target
    identifications := category.carrier.map (·.identifications) |>.getD #[]
    actions := selected.actions
    comparisons := category.carrier.map (·.comparisons) |>.getD #[] }
  let selection : SourceSelection Expr := {
    value
    category := some ⟨.object, target, selected.target, none, none⟩
    typeOrigin := if target.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) then
      some ⟨{ category with carrier := some carrier }, source.value, value⟩ else none
    carrierRoutes := #[route.refs]
    preferredRoute := preferred.map (·.refs) }
  return ⟨← SourceReadM.select selection, selection.category⟩

/-- Put source values in the category explicitly selected by a set-valued operand.
Reuse: sourceCarrier's whole functor checks and retained native actions. Two structured
operands keep their selected category; an explicit set operand supplies the carrier context. -/
def sourceCommonCategory (left right : NativeSourceJudgement) :
    SourceReadM (NativeSourceJudgement × NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let some first := left.category | return (left, right)
  let some second := right.category | return (left, right)
  unless first.role == second.role do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source values have different object and morphism roles"
  let sets := CategoryExpr.atom CategoryId.sets
  let (left, right) ←
    if first.expression.syntacticEq sets && !second.expression.syntacticEq sets then
      pure (left, ← sourceCarrier right)
    else if second.expression.syntacticEq sets && !first.expression.syntacticEq sets then
      pure (← sourceCarrier left, right)
    else pure (left, right)
  let some first := left.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source carrier comparison lost its first selected category"
  let some second := right.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source carrier comparison lost its second selected category"
  unless first.expression.syntacticEq second.expression &&
      (← isDefEq first.bundle second.bundle) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source values have different complete selected categories"
  return (left, right)

/-- Apply the selected carrier to an arbitrary object in its complete category family.
Reuse: nativeRouteFunctor and sourceCarrier. Typed provenance stays with source types;
family comparisons use the actual carrier expression after removing that annotation. -/
def sourceCarrierFamilyObject (source : NativeSourceCategory) (bundle object : Expr) :
    TermElabM Expr := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let selection ← source.carrier.mapM fun selection => do
    let some steps := state.routeEdges? source.expression selection.target selection.refs
      | throwError "the source carrier family lost its selected prefix"
    let route : Route := { source := source.expression, target := selection.target, steps }
    let native ← nativeRouteFunctor state route bundle
    return { selection with actions := native.actions }
  let carrier ← sourceCarrierSelection ⟨object, some ⟨.object, source.expression, bundle, selection, none⟩⟩
  return carrier.value

/-- Apply the selected complete carrier functor to an arrow before taking its function.
Ordinary native functions retain their original expression and context. -/
def sourceFunction (source : NativeSourceJudgement) : MetaM Expr := do
  if source.category.any (·.role == .morphism) then
    let carrier ← sourceCarrierSelection source
    sourceSetFunction carrier.value
  else pure source.value

private partial def elementTypeBody (type : Expr) : Expr :=
  match type with
  | .mdata _ body => elementTypeBody body
  | .letE _ _ value body _ => elementTypeBody (body.instantiate1 value)
  | _ => type

-- Vary only the final object argument. All other data remain fixed.
private def elementTypeOrigin (type : Expr) : Option (Expr × (Expr → Expr)) :=
  match elementTypeBody type with
  | .app function object => some (object, mkApp function)
  | .proj name index object => some (object, Expr.proj name index)
  | _ => none

/-- Recover an element owner from its principal source object, with a checked family
comparison. Reuse: registeredDomain, objectCarrierSelection and sourceCarrier. -/
def sourceElementOwners
    (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (expected : Expr) (hints : Array Expr) : SourceReadM (Array NativeSourceElementOwner) := do
  let mut selected : Array NativeSourceElementOwner := #[]
  for hint in hints do
    let origin ← sourceTypeOrigin? hint
    let candidate := match origin with
      | some origin => some (origin.object, fun object =>
          origin.type.replace fun part => if part == origin.object then some object else none)
      | none => elementTypeOrigin hint
    let some (value, typeAt) := candidate | continue
    let retained ← if origin.isSome then pure none else sourceObjectOrigin? value
    let value := retained.map (·.2) |>.getD value
    let category ← match origin, retained with
      | some origin, _ => pure (some origin.category)
      | none, some (category, _) => pure (some category)
      | none, none => if let .fvar id := value then categoryOf id else pure none
    let category ← match category with
      | some category => pure (some category)
      | none => pure ((← SourceReadM.selection? value).bind (·.category))
    let some category := category | continue
    unless category.role == .object &&
        !category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) do continue
    if selected.any (·.value == value) then continue
    let carrier ← sourceCarrierSelection ⟨value, some category⟩
    unless ← withoutModifyingState <| isDefEq carrier.value expected do continue
    let proof ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <| withLocalDeclD `elementOwner (← inferType value) fun object => do
      let carrier ← sourceCarrierSelection ⟨object, some category⟩
      let original ← mkLambdaFVars #[object] (typeAt object)
      let canonical ← mkLambdaFVars #[object] carrier.value
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType original) (← inferType canonical) <&&>
          isDefEq original canonical do
        throwUnsupportedSource "element provenance requires its whole carrier-family comparison"
      let proof ← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl original) (← mkEq original canonical)
      checkWithKernel proof
      return proof
    selected := selected.push ⟨category, value, proof⟩
  return selected

end CasCompiler

      checkContext session value "the original image pairing shortened its complete preceding context"
      SourceTest.checkSelected value fun expression => do
        let context := (← get).context
        let expected ← expectedImage.source.inContext context
        SourceTest.checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun values => do
          unless ← isDefEq values[0]! values[1]! do
            liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original image pairing changed its selected native map action"
          checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl values[0]!) (← mkEq values[0]! values[1]!))
      originalImage := true
      session := next
      break
  unless originalImage do liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original image-pairing declaration was not inspected"
  let .ok native := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term
      "TypeCat.ofHom (fun (t : scalarModule) => CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.DegeneratePlaneLifts.kernelInclusion.hom t)"
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native inclusion control did not parse"
  let expectedInclusion ← session.term ⟨native⟩
  let mut originalInclusion := false
  for item in file.items do
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item | continue
    if let `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident($_:cas_term) := $_:cas_term) := statement then
      unless name.getId == `i0 do continue
      let .definition _ value ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original inclusion did not form its source function"
      checkContext session value "the original inclusion shortened its complete preceding context"
      SourceTest.checkSelected value fun expression => do
        let context := (← get).context
        let expected ← expectedInclusion.source.inContext context
        SourceTest.checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun values => do
          unless ← isDefEq values[0]! values[1]! do
            liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original inclusion differs from its actual declared native map"
          checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl values[0]!) (← mkEq values[0]! values[1]!))
      originalInclusion := true
      break
  unless originalInclusion do liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original inclusion declaration was not inspected"


run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let order ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "ReverseFinOrder(3) in LinearOrders")
  let some selection := order.category.bind (·.carrier)
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a selected object lost its independently declared carrier prefix"
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `X order
  let domain ← session.read (← sourceTerm "X → X")
  SourceTest.checkSelected domain fun expression => do
    let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
    let expression ← SourceTest.selectedValue expression
    for carrier in expression.getAppArgs do
      unless (← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun value =>
          pure (value.equal bindings[0]!.expression)) carrier false) > 0 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a selected carrier was replaced by its named comparison target"
      let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? carrier
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a selected carrier discarded its actual route"
      let some origin := selected.typeOrigin
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a selected carrier discarded its exact native owner"
      let scope ← get
      unless ← SourceTest.originatesAt scope.context scope.selections origin.object
          bindings[0]!.expression false do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a selected carrier discarded its exact native owner"
      unless selected.carrierRoutes == #[selection.refs] do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a selected carrier was replaced by another structural route"
  let some edge := selection.refs[0]?
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the selected carrier prefix control has no actual edge"
  let .functor id := edge
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the selected carrier prefix control requires its registered functor"
  let image ← session.read (← sourceTerm s!"view X along «{id.raw}»()")
  let some remainder := image.category.bind (·.carrier)
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "an explicit view discarded its selected carrier continuation"
  unless remainder.refs.isEmpty && remainder.target.syntacticEq selection.target &&
      remainder.identifications == selection.identifications do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "an explicit view changed its supplied carrier continuation or comparison"
  let session ← session.defineTerm `Y image
  let retainedTerm ← session.read (← sourceTerm "Y")
  let some retained := retainedTerm.category.bind (·.carrier)
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a native alias lost its selected carrier continuation"
  unless retained.refs == remainder.refs &&
      retained.identifications == remainder.identifications do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a native alias changed its actual selected carrier data"

/-- Open only the selected declaration's source aliases until its accepted canonical
reindexing interface is visible. Delta and beta substitution retain the original argument
positions. No recursor, matcher or mathematical operation is evaluated. -/
private partial def reindexApplication (expression : Expr)
    (seen : Std.HashSet Name := {}) : MetaM Expr := do
  let expression := expression.consumeMData.headBeta
  if expression.getAppFn.isConstOf ``CategoryFamilyRealization.reindexFunctor ||
      expression.getAppFn.isConstOf ``CategoryFamilyRealization.reindex then
    return expression
  if let .letE _ _ value body _ := expression then
    return ← reindexApplication (body.instantiate1 value) seen
  let .const name _ := expression.getAppFn
    | throwUnsupportedSource "the selected reindexing has no native canonical source application"
  if seen.contains name then
    throwUnsupportedSource "the selected reindexing requires computation to expose its source"
  let .defnInfo _ ← getConstInfo name
    | throwUnsupportedSource "the selected reindexing is not a native declaration alias"
  let some body ← withOptions (fun options => options.setBool `smartUnfolding false) <|
      unfoldDefinition? expression.getAppFn
    | throwUnsupportedSource "the selected reindexing has no available source definition"
  reindexApplication (body.betaRev expression.getAppRevArgs (preserveMData := true))
    (seen.insert name)

private def reindexInputs (application : Expr) : MetaM (Expr × Expr) := do
  let canonical ← reindexApplication application
  let info ← getFunInfoNArgs canonical.getAppFn canonical.getAppNumArgs
  let mut explicit := #[]
  for argument in canonical.getAppArgs, index in [:canonical.getAppNumArgs] do
    if (info.paramInfo[index]?.map (·.isExplicit)).getD false then
      explicit := explicit.push argument
  let #[realization, baseMap] := explicit
    | throwError "the canonical reindexing changed its native realization and base-map slots"
  return (realization, baseMap)

private def cartesianValue (realization receiver baseMap : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let transport ← mkAppM ``CategoryFamilyRealization.transport #[realization]
  mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Pseudofunctor.CoGrothendieck.cartesianLift
    #[none, none, some transport, none, none, some receiver, some baseMap]

/-- Consume an accepted reindex declaration and its actual receiver through the canonical
family fibration. The registered declaration selects the family; its exact source spine
supplies the base map. Conversion checks validate those fixed choices and select nothing. -/
def sourceCartesian (entry : FunctorEntry) (application receiver : Expr) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[original] := state.functors.filter (·.id == entry.id)
    | throwError "the cartesian source requires its unique registered reindexing"
  let .familyReindex family := original.expression.registrationKind
    | throwError "the cartesian source requires a registered family-reindex action"
  unless original.declaration == entry.declaration &&
      original.source.syntacticEq entry.source && original.target.syntacticEq entry.target do
    throwError "the cartesian source changed its accepted reindexing"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
  let application ← instantiateMVars application
  unless application.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf entry.declaration do
    throwError "the cartesian source lost its original declaration application"
  let functor ← sourceFunctorValue application
  let (source, _) ← functorCategoryBundles functor
  let domain ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[source]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType receiver) domain do
    throwError "the cartesian receiver is outside its complete selected source fibre"
  let (realization, baseMap) ← reindexInputs application
  let #[familyEntry] := state.categoryFamilies.filter (·.id == family)
    | throwError "the cartesian source lost its accepted family"
  let registered ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels familyEntry.realization
  unless ← isDefEq realization registered do
    throwError "the cartesian source changed its complete registered family realization"
  let arrow ← cartesianValue realization receiver baseMap
  let totalBundle ← mkAppM ``CategoryFamilyRealization.totalCat #[realization]
  return {
    value := arrow
    category := some ⟨.morphism, .familyTotal family, totalBundle, none, none⟩
    observation := some (.functor entry)
    originalApplication := some application
    cartesian := some ⟨entry, application, realization, baseMap, receiver, totalBundle, arrow⟩ }

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do

  checkSelected same fun value => do
    let scope ← get
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    unless bindings.size == 1 &&
        (← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections value bindings[0]!.expression false) do
      throwError "source qualification replaced the retained object by its definition"
  let aliased ← first.defineTerm `Y same
  let plain ← readSource aliased "Fin(3)"
  let shadowed ← aliased.defineTerm `X plain
  let retained ← readSource shadowed "Y in FiniteSets"
  checkSelected retained fun value => do
    let scope ← get
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    unless bindings.size == 3 &&
        (← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections value bindings[1]!.expression false) do
      throwError "a shadowed source definition changed its earlier selected category"
  let plain ← readSource shadowed "X in Sets"

    let scope ← get

    pure none

    | throwError "qualification changed a retained category without a supplied source action"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do

private def rejectedQualification (session : SourceSession) (text errorPrefix : String) :
    TermElabM Unit := do
  let failure : Option Exception ← withoutModifyingState do
    try
      discard <| readSource session text
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "the explicit qualification incorrectly admitted {text}"
  unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith errorPrefix do throw failure

-- The original B0 product is refined as its already selected Sets object. Its retained
-- presentation remains the original Sets cone, including when every factor has a named
-- finite refinement of its own. Later aliases still expose that same cone's defining legs.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  for text in #["Fin(2) × ℤ/3", "Fin(2) × Fin(3)"] do
    let original ← readSource empty text
    let qualified ← readSource empty s!"({text}) in FiniteSets"
    let some originalCategory := original.category
      | throwError "the original product lost its selected category"
    let some originalLimit := originalCategory.limit
      | throwError "the original product lost its selected cone"
    let some refinedCategory := qualified.category
      | throwError "the explicitly refined product lost its selected category"
    let some refinedLimit := refinedCategory.limit
      | throwError "the explicit refinement discarded the original product cone"
    unless originalCategory.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CasCatalogue.CategoryId.sets) &&
        refinedCategory.expression.syntacticEq
          (.classifierTotal CasCatalogue.ClassifierId.setsFinite) &&
        originalLimit.row == refinedLimit.row &&
        originalLimit.declaration == refinedLimit.declaration &&
        originalLimit.colimit == refinedLimit.colimit do
      throwError "the explicit refinement selected a different universal presentation"
    discard <| empty.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      discard <| empty.readTerm original
      let value ← empty.readTerm qualified
      let scope ← get
      checkOriginal #[← originalLimit.cone.inContext scope.context,
          ← refinedLimit.cone.inContext scope.context] fun native => do
        unless native[0]!.equal native[1]! do
          throwError "the whole product qualification changed its actual original cone"
      return value
    let bound ← empty.defineTerm `P original
    let some originalEntry := bound.context.entries.back?
      | throwError "the product did not retain its source binding"
    let refined ← readSource bound "P in FiniteSets"
    checkSelected refined fun expression => do
      let scope ← get
      let some base := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == originalEntry.id)
        | throwError "the product's original source binding is absent"
      let count ← visitNativeData (fun constructor => do
        unless constructor.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.mk 5 do
          return false
        unless ← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections constructor.getAppArgs[3]! base.expression false do
          throwError "the property constructor replaced its actual original product"
        return true) expression false
      unless count == 1 do
        throwError "the refined product lost its original native property constructor"
    let bound ← bound.defineTerm `K refined
    let bound ← bound.defineTerm `KAgain (← readSource bound "K")
    let retained ← readSource bound "KAgain in FiniteSets"
    checkSelected retained fun value => do
      let scope ← get
      let bindings ← authoredBindings
      let some actual := bindings.back?
        | throwError "the property qualification lost its authored alias"
      unless ← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections value actual.expression false do
        throwError "repeating a property qualification replaced its retained alias"
    let originalLeg ← readSource bound "P.leg(0)"
    let refinedLeg ← readSource bound "KAgain.leg(0)"
    unless originalLeg.category.any (fun category => category.role == .morphism &&
        category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CasCatalogue.CategoryId.sets)) &&
        refinedLeg.category.any (fun category => category.role == .morphism &&
          category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CasCatalogue.CategoryId.sets)) do
      throwError "a refined product's original leg acquired the refinement category"
    discard <| bound.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      let value ← bound.readTerm refinedLeg
      let expected ← bound.readTerm originalLeg
      checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "the aliased refined product replaced its original defining leg"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
          (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
      return value
  let .ok question := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term
    "|(Fin(2) × ℤ/3) in FiniteSets| = 6"
    | throwError "the original finite-product question did not parse"
  discard <| empty.readQuestion ⟨question⟩
  -- Existing directly qualified source rows remain their actual authored declarations.
  let named ← readSource empty "Fin(3) in FiniteSets"
  checkSelected named fun value => do
    let scope ← get
    let some (row, _) ← sourceObjectSelection? scope.context scope.selections value
      | throwError "generic refinement displaced the explicitly selected finite-set row"
    unless row.declaration == ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.FiniteObjects.finiteFin do
      throwError "generic refinement displaced the explicitly named finite-set row"
  let counted ← readSource empty "ℕ in CountableSets"
  unless counted.category.any (·.expression.syntacticEq
      (.classifierTotal CasCatalogue.ClassifierId.setsCountable)) do
    throwError "the declared countability classifier did not admit its original set"
  let rings ← empty.defineTerm `R (← readSource empty "ZMod(3) in Rings")
  rejectedQualification rings "R in FiniteSets"
    "the explicit refinement has a different selected base category"
  -- Nat already has Encodable data in Lean; this syntax still cannot choose that data.
  rejectedQualification empty "ℕ in EnumeratedSets"
    "explicit refinement requires a proof-only property classifier"

-- A supplied proof instance may refine an arbitrary actual set. Equal-looking lexical
-- aliases retain their own occurrences as the constructor's data, and mere fibre
-- inhabitation cannot authorize a chosen enumeration.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let source ← empty.assume `rawX (← nativeSource "Type")
  let sets ← source.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Sets" [.zero] #[]
  let actual ← source.term (← nativeSource "rawX")
  let actual ← actual.inCategory sets.expression sets.value
  let source ← source.defineTerm `X actual
  rejectedQualification source "X in FiniteSets"
    "not a valid call: the explicit property is not established for the original object"
  let finite ← source.assume `finiteX (← nativeSource "Finite X") .instImplicit
  let same ← readSource finite "X"
  let finite ← finite.defineTerm `XAgain same
  let some first := finite.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `X)
    | throwError "the original abstract set binding is absent"
  let some second := finite.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `XAgain)
    | throwError "the abstract set alias is absent"
  for (name, selected, other) in #[("X", first.id, second.id), ("XAgain", second.id, first.id)] do
    let refined ← readSource finite s!"{name} in FiniteSets"
    checkSelected refined fun expression => do
      let scope ← get
      let some selected := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == selected)
        | throwError "the actual abstract set is outside the original context"
      let some other := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == other)
        | throwError "the other abstract set alias is outside the original context"
      let count ← visitNativeData (fun constructor => do
        unless constructor.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.mk 5 do
          return false
        let data := constructor.getAppArgs[3]!
        unless (← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections data selected.expression false) &&
            !(← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections data other.expression false) do
          throwError "proof-only refinement replaced its exact original source occurrence"
        return true) expression false
      unless count == 1 do
        throwError "the abstract refinement is not the native property constructor"
  let countable ← source.assume `countableX (← nativeSource "Countable X") .instImplicit
  discard <| readSource countable "X in CountableSets"
  let existence ← countable.assume `enumerationExists (← nativeSource
    "CasCatalogue.Classifier.Holds LeanCategories.Foundation.enumeratedSets X")
  rejectedQualification existence "X in EnumeratedSets"
    "explicit refinement requires a proof-only property classifier"
