private def checkNativeCell (source target left right transformation : Expr) : MetaM Unit := do
  let (leftSource, leftTarget) ← functorCategoryBundles left
  let (rightSource, rightTarget) ← functorCategoryBundles right
  unless ← isDefEq leftSource source <&&> isDefEq rightSource source <&&>
      isDefEq leftTarget target <&&> isDefEq rightTarget target do
    throwError "the selected cell has different complete native categories"
  let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans #[left, right]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType transformation) expected do
    throwError "the selected cell has different complete native functor endpoints"

/-- Check the already applied declaration against its exact registered routes. Selection
comes from the row supplied by the reader; neither the receiver's carrier nor a provider
chooses a cell. The receiver later fixes any ordinary application metavariables. -/
def nativeSourceCell (entry : CellEntry) (application : Expr) (inverse : Bool := false) :
    MetaM NativeSourceCell := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[original] := state.cells.filter (·.id == entry.id)
    | throwError "a source cell requires its unique registered declaration"
  unless original.declaration == entry.declaration && original.invertible == entry.invertible &&
      original.source.syntacticEq entry.source && original.target.syntacticEq entry.target &&
      original.left == entry.left && original.right == entry.right do
    throwError "the selected cell changed its accepted registration"
  if inverse && !entry.invertible then
    throwStratum .invalid "the source cell has no registered inverse"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
  let application ← instantiateMVars application
  unless application.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf entry.declaration do
    throwError "the selected cell lost its original declaration application"
  let transformation ← if entry.invertible then
      mkAppM (if inverse then ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv else ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom) #[application]
    else pure application
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType transformation)
  let declaredLeft ← if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
      pure type.getAppArgs[2]!
    else if type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans 6 then
      pure type.getAppArgs[4]!
    else throwError "the applied cell has no complete native transformation interface"
  let (source, target) ← functorCategoryBundles declaredLeft
  let left ← nativeEdgePathFunctor state entry.left source
  let right ← nativeEdgePathFunctor state entry.right source
  let (left, right) := if inverse then (right, left) else (left, right)
  checkNativeCell source target left.functor right.functor transformation
  let isomorphism ← if entry.invertible then do
      let directed ← if inverse then mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.symm #[application]
        else pure application
      pure (some directed)
    else pure none
  let mut references : Array SelectedSourceReference := #[.cell entry]
  for edge in entry.left ++ entry.right do
    references := references ++ (← sourceActionReferences state edge)
  return {
    entry := entry
    references := references
    application := application
    inverse := inverse
    source := entry.source
    sourceBundle := source
    target := entry.target
    targetBundle := target
    left := left
    right := right
    transformation := transformation
    isomorphism := isomorphism }

private def selectedConstructorApplication (entry : ConstructorEntry) (field : Name)
    (categories arguments : Array Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration field
  let value ← applyConstructorInterface field categories arguments
  return value

private def checkNativeIso (left right value : Expr) : MetaM Unit := do
  let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso #[left, right]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) expected do
    throwError "the selected constructor comparison changed its complete native endpoints"

/-- Expand a constructor's action on this exact route with its accepted identity and
composition comparisons. The result is the composite of the individually mapped actions,
with an actual isomorphism from the action on the original complete composite. -/
private def mapCellRoute (entry : ConstructorEntry) (source : Expr)
    (route : NativeRouteFunctor) : MetaM (NativeRouteFunctor × Expr) := do
  let some action := entry.functorialAction
    | throwStratum .invalid "the selected constructor has no declared functor action"
  let some identity := entry.identityComparison
    | throwStratum .invalid "the selected constructor has no declared identity comparison"
  let some composition := entry.compositionComparison
    | throwStratum .invalid "the selected constructor has no declared composition comparison"
  let mappedSource ← selectedConstructorApplication entry entry.semantics #[source] #[source]
  let mappedTarget ← selectedConstructorApplication entry entry.semantics
    #[route.target] #[route.target]
  let whole ← selectedConstructorApplication entry action #[source, route.target] #[route.functor]
  if route.actions.isEmpty then
    let result ← categoryIdentity mappedSource
    let comparison ← selectedConstructorApplication entry identity #[source] #[source]
    checkNativeIso whole result comparison
    return (⟨result, mappedTarget, #[]⟩, comparison)
  let first := route.actions[0]!
  let (firstSource, firstTarget) ← functorCategoryBundles first
  unless ← isDefEq firstSource source do
    throwError "the selected cell route lost its original starting category"
  let mapped ← selectedConstructorApplication entry action #[source, firstTarget] #[first]
  let mut original := first
  let mut originalTarget := firstTarget
  let mut expanded := mapped
  let mut actions := #[mapped]
  let mut comparison ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.refl #[mapped]
  for next in route.actions.extract 1 route.actions.size do
    let (nextSource, nextTarget) ← functorCategoryBundles next
    unless ← isDefEq nextSource originalTarget do
      throwError "the selected cell route lost an original intermediate category"
    let mappedNext ← selectedConstructorApplication entry action
      #[originalTarget, nextTarget] #[next]
    let step ← selectedConstructorApplication entry composition
      #[source, originalTarget, nextTarget] #[original, next]
    let carried ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.isoWhiskerRight #[comparison, mappedNext]
    comparison ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.trans #[step, carried]
    original ← mkFunctorComp original next
    originalTarget := nextTarget
    expanded ← mkFunctorComp expanded mappedNext
    actions := actions.push mappedNext
  checkNativeIso whole expanded comparison
  return (⟨expanded, mappedTarget, actions⟩, comparison)

/-- Apply one accepted unary constructor to an invertible cell, retaining both route
expansion comparisons. This is precisely the constructor-induced component contract. -/
def NativeSourceCell.construct (cell : NativeSourceCell) (id : ConstructorId) :
    MetaM NativeSourceCell := do
  let some entry := (← semanticState).constructor? id
    | throwStratum .invalid "the source comparison constructor is absent"
  unless entry.signature == #[.category] do
    throwStratum .invalid "the source comparison constructor does not have a unary category interface"
  let some action := entry.comparisonAction
    | throwStratum .invalid "the source comparison constructor has no declared comparison action"
  let some original := cell.isomorphism
    | throwStratum .invalid "the source constructor comparison requires an invertible cell"
  let source ← selectedConstructorApplication entry entry.semantics
    #[cell.sourceBundle] #[cell.sourceBundle]
  let target ← selectedConstructorApplication entry entry.semantics
    #[cell.targetBundle] #[cell.targetBundle]
  let (left, leftExpansion) ← mapCellRoute entry cell.sourceBundle cell.left
  let (right, rightExpansion) ← mapCellRoute entry cell.sourceBundle cell.right
  let mapped ← selectedConstructorApplication entry action
    #[cell.sourceBundle, cell.targetBundle] #[original]
  let reverseLeft ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.symm #[leftExpansion]
  let comparison ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.trans #[reverseLeft, mapped]
  let comparison ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.trans #[comparison, rightExpansion]
  checkNativeIso left.functor right.functor comparison
  let transformation ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[comparison]
  checkNativeCell source target left.functor right.functor transformation
  return { cell with
    constructors := #[id] ++ cell.constructors
    references := #[.constructor entry, .constructorInterface entry .functorialAction,
      .constructorInterface entry .comparisonAction,
      .constructorInterface entry .identityComparison,
      .constructorInterface entry .compositionComparison] ++ cell.references
    source := .construct id #[.category cell.source]
    sourceBundle := source
    target := .construct id #[.category cell.target]
    targetBundle := target
    left := left
    right := right
    transformation := transformation
    isomorphism := some comparison }

/-- Form the component at the independently read receiver. A constructor path, when supplied,
is outermost first and is applied inside out to the whole retained comparison. -/
def NativeSourceCell.component (cell : NativeSourceCell) (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  if let some category := receiver.category then
    unless category.role == .object && category.expression.syntacticEq cell.source do
      throwStratum .invalid "the source cell receiver has a different selected category"
    unless ← isDefEq category.bundle cell.sourceBundle do
      throwStratum .invalid "the source cell receiver has different complete native category parameters"
  let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[cell.sourceBundle]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType receiver.value) carrier do
    throwStratum .invalid "the source cell receiver is outside its complete declared domain"
  let component ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[cell.transformation, receiver.value]
  check component
  return {
    value := component
    reference := some (.cell cell.entry)
    originalApplication := some cell.application
    cell := some ⟨cell, receiver.value, component⟩
    category := some ⟨.morphism, cell.target, ← instantiateMVars cell.targetBundle, none, none⟩ }

/-- Retrieve only the complete cell record attached to the exact selected binder and its
original formal application. Native definitions and equal component values supply no record. -/
def sourceCellComponent? (context : OpenContext) (scope : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
    (value : Expr) : MetaM (Option NativeSourceCellComponent) := do
  let some selected := scope.findAt? context value.getAppFn | return none
  unless selected.formalBindings.size == value.getAppNumArgs do return none
  return (← selected.specialize value.getAppArgs).cell

end CasCompiler

public meta import Lean.Elab.Command

meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.PortComparison

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue

private def readCellSource (session : SourceSession) (text : String) : TermElabM SourceTerm := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the original cell component syntax did not parse"
  session.read ⟨parsed⟩

private def nativeCellType (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | throwError "the original cell receiver type did not parse"
  return ⟨parsed⟩

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `X (← nativeCellType "Type")
  for (id, inverse) in #[(NaturalTransformationId.listUnit, false),
      (NaturalTransformationId.listJoin, false), (NaturalTransformationId.listReverse, false),
      (NaturalTransformationId.listReverse, true)] do
    let spelling := if inverse then "inverse_component" else "component"
    let component ← readCellSource session s!"{spelling}(«{id.raw}»(), X, [])"
    let some selected := component.category
      | throwError "a public cell component lost its actual target category"
    unless selected.role == .morphism && selected.expression.syntacticEq Foundation.Sets do
      throwError "a public cell component changed its declared morphism role or target"
    discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      let value ← session.readTerm component
      let scope ← get
      let bindings := scope.context.bindings
      let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value
        | throwError "a public cell component lost its retained source selection"
      let some retained := selected.cell
        | throwError "a public cell component lost its complete original interface"
      unless retained.cell.entry.id == id &&
          retained.cell.inverse == inverse && retained.cell.constructors.isEmpty do
        throwError "a public cell component lost its exact row, direction or constructor path"
      let #[entry] := (← semanticState).cells.filter (·.id == id)
        | throwError "the independent list cell was not retained"
      let declaration := Lean.mkConst entry.declaration [.zero]
      let transformation ← if entry.invertible then
          mkAppM (if inverse then ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv else ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom) #[declaration]
        else pure declaration
      let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[transformation, bindings[0]!.expression]
      let agrees ← scope.context.withOriginalSources #[value, expected] fun values =>
        isDefEq values[0]! values[1]!
      unless agrees && retained.value.containsFVar bindings[0]!.expression.fvarId! do
        throwError "a public cell component replaced its actual declared action or receiver"
      unless retained.cell.entry.id == entry.id && retained.cell.inverse == inverse &&
          retained.receiver == bindings[0]!.expression && retained.cell.constructors.isEmpty do
        throwError "a public cell component changed its actual retained source inputs"
      let some original ← sourceApplication? entry.declaration selected
        | throwError "a public cell component lost the actual declaration application"
      unless original.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf entry.declaration do
        throwError "a public cell component substituted another declaration"
      checkWithKernel value
      return value
  let failed ← try
    discard <| readCellSource session "inverse_component(«cell.sets.list.unit»(), X, [])"
    pure false
  catch error =>
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? error == some .invalid do throw error
    pure true
  unless failed do throwError "a public noninvertible cell acquired an inverse"
  let failed ← try
    discard <| readCellSource session "component(«missing.cell»(), X, [])"
    pure false
  catch error =>
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? error == some .invalid do throw error
    pure true
  unless failed do throwError "an unregistered source cell acquired a meaning"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `f (← nativeCellType "CategoryTheory.Arrow (Type)")
  for inverse in #[false, true] do
    let spelling := if inverse then "inverse_component" else "component"
    let component ← readCellSource session
      s!"{spelling}(«cell.sets.list.reverse»(), f, [«ctor.arrow»])"
    let some category := component.category
      | throwError "a constructed component lost its selected target category"
    unless category.expression.syntacticEq
        (.construct ConstructorId.arrow #[.category Foundation.Sets]) do
      throwError "a constructed component changed its original target constructor"
    discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      let value ← session.readTerm component
      let scope ← get
      let bindings := scope.context.bindings
      let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value
        | throwError "a constructed component lost its exact original constructor path"
      let some retained := selected.cell
        | throwError "a constructed component lost its complete original interface"
      unless retained.value.containsFVar bindings[0]!.expression.fvarId! do
        throwError "a constructed component replaced its original arrow receiver"
      unless retained.cell.constructors == #[ConstructorId.arrow] &&
          retained.cell.inverse == inverse do
        throwError "a constructed component changed its path or orientation"
      unless retained.cell.constructors == #[ConstructorId.arrow] &&
          retained.receiver == bindings[0]!.expression && retained.cell.isomorphism.isSome do
        throwError "a constructed component replaced its actual constructor, receiver or comparison"
      checkWithKernel value
      return value
  let failed ← try
    discard <| readCellSource session "component(«cell.sets.list.join»(), f, [«ctor.arrow»])"
    pure false
  catch error =>
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? error == some .invalid do throw error
    pure true
  unless failed do throwError "an isomorphism-only constructor acquired a noninvertible action"

-- The registered ring diamond has nonempty composite routes of different lengths.
-- Mapping it must retain both complete route-expansion comparisons, including all
-- declared constructor composition actions, without identifying the source routes.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let #[entry] := (← semanticState).cells.filter (·.id.raw == "cmp.rings.carrier")
    | throwError "the original independent ring comparison is absent"
  let constant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
  let original ← nativeSourceCell entry constant
  let constructed ← original.construct ConstructorId.arrow
  unless constructed.left.actions.size == entry.left.size &&
      constructed.right.actions.size == entry.right.size &&
      constructed.left.actions.size != constructed.right.actions.size do
    throwError "the constructor collapsed two independently declared comparison routes"
  let some constructor := (← semanticState).constructor? ConstructorId.arrow
    | throwError "the original arrow constructor is absent"
  let some composition := constructor.compositionComparison
    | throwError "the original arrow constructor lost its composition comparison"
  unless constructed.transformation.getUsedConstants.contains composition do
    throwError "the constructed ring component omitted its declared route expansions"
  let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[constructed.sourceBundle]
  withLocalDeclD `f carrier fun receiver => do
    let component ← constructed.component ⟨receiver, none⟩
    unless component.value.containsFVar receiver.fvarId! do
      throwError "the constructed ring component replaced its actual receiver"
    check component.value

public import CasCompiler.Elaborate
public import CasCompiler.SourceCarrier
public import CasCompiler.SourceTypeOrigin
public import CasCompiler.SourceProof

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

private structure ConstrainedPointSchema where
  constructor : Expr
  dataIndex : Nat
  proofCount : Nat

/-- Inspect the actual selected native constructor, without inventing an admission row.
Source: casInProof and the constrained-point schema in CasContract.Port. Parameters stay
fixed by the complete target; only the declared fields are available for construction. -/
private def constrainedPointSchema (target : Expr) : MetaM ConstrainedPointSchema := do
  let target ← instantiateMVars target
  if target.hasMVar || target.hasLevelMVar || (← isProp target) then
    throwError "a constrained point requires a fixed native data type"
  let type ← whnf target
  let .const name levels := type.getAppFn
    | throwError "a constrained point requires its actual native structure"
  let .inductInfo info ← checkedDeclaration name
    | throwError "a constrained point requires its actual native structure"
  unless isStructure (← getEnv) name && !info.isRec && info.numIndices == 0 do
    throwError (MessageData.tagged `CasCompiler.sourceConstrainedPoint.structureShape
      "a constrained point requires a nonrecursive structure with no indices")
  let [constructor] := info.ctors
    | throwError "a constrained point requires exactly one native constructor"
  let .ctorInfo declaration ← checkedDeclaration constructor
    | throwError "the constrained structure lost its actual constructor"
  unless type.getAppNumArgs == declaration.numParams do
    throwError "the constrained structure has incomplete native parameters"
  let constructor := mkAppN (mkConst constructor levels) type.getAppArgs
  forallTelescope (← inferType constructor) fun fields result => do
    unless fields.size == declaration.numFields && (← isDefEq result target) do
      throwError "the constrained constructor has a different complete target"
    let mut dataFields : Array Nat := #[]
    for field in fields, index in [:fields.size] do
      unless ← isProp (← inferType field) do dataFields := dataFields.push index
    let #[dataIndex] := dataFields
      | throwError (MessageData.tagged `CasCompiler.sourceConstrainedPoint.dataFieldCount
          "a constrained point requires exactly one data field and only proof fields otherwise")
    return ⟨constructor, dataIndex, fields.size - 1⟩

private def constructConstrainedPoint (schema : ConstrainedPointSchema) (target : Expr)
    (proofs : Array Term) (readData : Expr → SourceReadM Expr)
    (readProof : Term → Expr → SourceReadM Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let previous ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
  let (arguments, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType schema.constructor)
  let some original := arguments[schema.dataIndex]?
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the constrained constructor lost its original data field"
  let current ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
  let owned := current.decls.foldl (fun result identity _ =>
    if previous.decls.contains identity then result else result.push identity) #[]
  let result ← withSynthesizeApplicableScoped do
    return .ok (← readData (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType original)))
  let actual ← match result with
    | .ok actual => pure actual
    | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message
  extendSourceApplicationScope owned
  unless ← isDefEq original actual do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the original data do not have the constrained constructor's declared field type"
  let mut proofIndex := 0
  for argument in arguments, index in [:arguments.size] do
    if index == schema.dataIndex then continue
    let obligation ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType argument)
    unless ← isProp obligation do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the constrained constructor acquired an additional data field"
    let some evidence := proofs[proofIndex]?
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the constrained point is missing an explicit source proof"
    let proof ← readProof evidence obligation
    extendSourceApplicationScope owned
    unless ← isDefEq argument proof do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the supplied source proof has a different constructor obligation"
    proofIndex := proofIndex + 1
  let value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN schema.constructor arguments)
  if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the constrained point has undetermined native parameters or proofs"
  SourceReadM.select { value } (some target)

/-- Build the existing native constrained constructor at the supplied original data.
For a generalized point, each proof is checked over the whole original domain before it
is applied pointwise. No membership procedure, representative, or backend reply is used. -/
def sourceConstrainedPointApplicable (target : Expr) (proofs : Array Term)
    (readData : Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr))
    (readMap : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let nativeTarget ← match (← SourceReadM.selection? target).bind (·.typeOrigin) with
    | some original => pure original.type
    | none => pure (← registeredSourceDomain target).1
  let schema ← constrainedPointSchema nativeTarget
  unless proofs.size == schema.proofCount do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError (MessageData.tagged `CasCompiler.sourceConstrainedPoint.proofCount
      m!"the constrained point requires exactly {schema.proofCount} explicit source proofs")
  -- Test only the data's declared type here. A wrong proof must never choose another reading.
  let direct ← SourceReadM.inspect do
    let (arguments, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType schema.constructor)
    let some original := arguments[schema.dataIndex]?
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the constrained constructor lost its original data field"
    let actual ← withSynthesizeApplicableScoped <| readData (← inferType original)
    match actual with
    | .error _ => return false
    | .ok actual => isDefEq (← inferType actual) (← inferType original)
  if direct then
    let requiredData : Expr → SourceReadM Expr := fun expected => do
      match ← readData expected with
      | .ok value => pure value
      | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message
    let value ← constructConstrainedPoint schema target proofs requiredData fun evidence obligation =>
      SourceReadM.prove obligation (fun expected _ => sourceFormalProof evidence expected)
    return ⟨value, none⟩
  let result ← withSynthesizeApplicableScoped do return .ok (← readMap)
  let original ← match result with
    | .ok original => pure original
    | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message
  let function ← sourceFunction original
  let .forallE _ domain _ binderInfo ← whnfR (← inferType function)
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "constrained data require a value or a map into the actual data-field type"
  let mapped ← SourceReadM.withLambda (← mkFreshUserName `point) domain binderInfo fun point => do
    let readData := fun expected => do
      let value := mkApp function point
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) expected do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the original map has a different constrained data-field target"
      pure value
    let readProof := fun evidence obligation => do
      let proposition ← mkForallFVars #[point] obligation
      let scope ← get
      let some pointIndex := scope.context.bindings.findIdx? (·.expression == point)
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the constrained proof lost its original point binder"
      -- The explicit proof is uniform over the whole domain. Its elaborator cannot use
      -- the fresh point as a local witness, even inside the mathematical checking view.
      let proof ← SourceReadM.prove proposition fun expected _ => do
        let context ← getLCtx
        let locals := context.foldl (fun result declaration => result.push declaration) #[]
        let some selected := locals[pointIndex]?
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the constrained proof changed its original native telescope"
        withLCtx (context.erase selected.fvarId)
            ((← getLocalInstances).filter (·.fvar != mkFVar selected.fvarId)) <|
          sourceFormalProof evidence expected
      pure (mkApp proof point)
    constructConstrainedPoint schema target proofs readData readProof
  let mappedArrow ← elabAppArgs (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``TypeCat.ofHom)
    #[] #[Arg.expr mapped] none false false
  sourceSetJudgement .morphism mappedArrow

/-- Required data readers preserve their ordinary API. The public source adapter uses the
explicit applicability callback above; exceptions in either form never select a map reading. -/
def sourceConstrainedPoint (target : Expr) (proofs : Array Term)
    (readData : Expr → SourceReadM Expr) (readMap : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement :=
  sourceConstrainedPointApplicable target proofs
    (fun expected => do return .ok (← readData expected)) readMap

end CasCompiler

public import CasCompiler.Surface
public import CasCompiler.SourcePresentation

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

/-- Apply a directly selected construction at its complete native source boundary.
Reuse: ConstructionEntry/validateConstruction, native dependent telescopes, the registered
Core constructor, and Mathlib Functor.obj/map. No inherited route chooses a construction.
Category arguments come from the full selected bundle; other explicit parameters are read
once at their declared types. A core action on a map requires the actual core morphism. -/
opaque sourceConstruction (entry : ConstructionEntry) (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement)
    (parameters : Array (Expr → SourceReadM Expr)) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let some selected := receiver.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a category-sensitive construction requires its selected source category"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
  let previous ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
  let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
  let (arguments, binders, result) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration)
  let owned := (← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx).decls.foldl (fun result identity _ =>
    if previous.decls.contains identity then result else result.push identity) #[]
  let result ← whnfR result
  unless result.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Functor 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source construction requires its complete native functor family"
  let core := (← whnfR result.getAppArgs[0]!).isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.Core
  let iso ← if selected.role == .morphism then sourceIsoOrigin? receiver.value else pure none
  let alreadyCore := (← whnfR (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α
    #[selected.bundle])).isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.Core
  let wrapCore := core && (selected.role == .object || (!alreadyCore && iso.isSome))
  let state ← semanticState
  let bundle ← if wrapCore then do
      let #[constructor] := state.constructors.filter
        (·.semantics == `CasCatalogue.Constructors.core)
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the construction requires its registered core constructor"
      discard <| checkedDeclaration constructor.semantics
      applyConstructorInterface constructor.semantics #[selected.bundle] #[selected.bundle]
    else pure selected.bundle
  extendSourceApplicationScope owned
  unless ← expandSourceStructures arguments do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the construction has inconsistent native category parameters"
  let function := mkAppN declaration arguments
  let (domain, _) ← functorCategoryBundles function
  unless ← isDefEq domain bundle do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the construction has a different complete selected source category"
  let mut index := 0
  let mut actual := arguments
  for argument in arguments, binder in binders, position in [:arguments.size] do
    unless binder.isExplicit do continue
    let type ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType argument)
    if type.isConstOf ``LeanCategories.ObjCat || type.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Cat then
      continue
    let some parameter := parameters[index]?
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source construction requires its actual declaration parameter"
    let value ← parameter type
    extendSourceApplicationScope owned
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) type <&&> isDefEq argument value do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the construction parameter differs from its complete source boundary"
    actual := actual.set! position value
    index := index + 1
  unless index == parameters.size do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source construction has arguments beyond its declared parameters"
  -- The template checks the full boundary; the retained application uses the actual
  -- supplied arguments, as Lean's dependent application does after hole elaboration.
  let function ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN declaration actual)
  if function.hasMVar || function.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source construction has undetermined native declaration parameters"
  let function ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt (.named (.construction entry)) function function)
  let (_, target) ← functorCategoryBundles function
  let value : SourceSelection Expr ← match selected.role with
    | .object => do
      let input ← if core then mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Core.mk #[receiver.value]
        else pure receiver.value
      pure { value := ← functorObject function input target }
    | .morphism => do
      let input ← if wrapCore then do
          let some iso := iso | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the core action lost its selected inverse data"
          sourceIsoCoreHom iso selected.bundle
        else pure receiver.value
      let action ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map #[function]
      let value ← elabAppArgs action #[] #[Arg.expr input] none false false
      if let some iso ← sourceMorphismIso? input then
        retainSourceIso (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.mapIso #[function, iso])
          { value } (some (← get).context)
      else pure { value }
  let category : NativeSourceCategory := ⟨selected.role, entry.target, target, none, none⟩
  let selected := { value with
    observation := some (.named (.construction entry))
    category := some category }
  return ⟨← SourceReadM.select selected, some category⟩

end CasCompiler

module

import CasCompiler.Read
import CasCompiler.SourceTestSupport
import CasCompiler.Resolve
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Foundation.FiniteObjects
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.Automorphisms
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.Read
meta import CasCompiler.SourceTestSupport
meta import CasCompiler.Resolve
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Foundation.FiniteObjects
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.Automorphisms

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue
open CasCompiler.SourceTest

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the construction source did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `n (← `(Nat))
  let object ← session.read (← sourceTerm "Fin(n)")
  let session ← session.defineTerm `X object
  let session ← session.assume `unused (← `(Nat))
  let some category := object.category
    | throwError "the actual finite family has no selected source category"
  for (name, declaration) in #[
      ("Aut", ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Automorphisms.automorphismsConstruction),
      ("End", ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Automorphisms.endomorphismsConstruction)] do
    for text in #[s!"{name}(X)", s!"view X along {name}()"] do
      let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm text)
      let some selected := result.category
        | throwError "the construction lost its complete target category"
      unless selected.role == .object do
        throwError "the construction result changed its native object role"
      checkSelected result fun value => do
        let scope ← get
        let bindings ← authoredBindings
        let context := scope.context
        let bundle ← category.bundle.inContext context
        let functor ← mkAppM declaration #[bundle]
        let input ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Core.mk #[bindings[1]!.expression]
        let (_, target) ← functorCategoryBundles functor
        let expected ← functorObject functor input target
        unless bindings.size == 3 do
          throwError "the construction changed its original authored context"
        checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
          unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
            throwError "the construction changed its actual source category or receiver"
          checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
            (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))

private def nativeTerm (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | throwError "the native construction input did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

private def expectRefusal (message : String) (action : TermElabM SourceTerm) : TermElabM Unit := do
  let refused ← try
    discard action
    pure false
  catch error =>
    if ((← error.toMessageData.toString).splitOn message).length > 1 then pure true
    else throw error
  unless refused do throwError "the source accepted an incompatible construction input"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `G (← nativeTerm "GrpCat.{0}")
  let category ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Groups" [.zero] #[]
  let object ← session.term (← nativeTerm "G")
  let object ← object.inCategory category.expression category.value
  let session ← session.defineTerm `X object
  let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm "Aut(X)")
  checkSelected result fun value => do
    let scope ← get
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    let bundle ← category.value.source.inContext scope.context
    let functor ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Automorphisms.automorphismsConstruction #[bundle]
    let input ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Core.mk #[bindings[1]!.expression]
    let (_, target) ← functorCategoryBundles functor
    let expected ← functorObject functor input target
    checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        throwError "Aut used a carrier category instead of the original group category"
  let session ← session.defineTerm `answer result
  let session ← session.assume `X (← `(Type))
  let retained ← session.read (← sourceTerm "answer")
  checkSelected retained fun value => do
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    unless value == bindings[2]!.expression do
      throwError "the constructed object was replayed after receiver shadowing"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `X (← `(Type))
  let session ← session.assume `Y (← `(Type))
  let session ← session.assume `iso (← nativeTerm "X ≅ Y")
  let sets ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Sets" [.zero] #[]
  let core ← session.unaryCategory Syntax.missing ConstructorId.core sets
  let arrow ← session.term (← nativeTerm
    "CategoryTheory.CoreHom.mk (X := CategoryTheory.Core.mk X) (Y := CategoryTheory.Core.mk Y) iso")
  let arrow ← arrow.inCategory core.expression core.value .morphism
  let session ← session.defineTerm `e arrow
  let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm "map e along Aut()")
  unless result.category.any (·.role == .morphism) do
    throwError "the construction map changed its morphism role"
  checkSelected result fun value => do
    let scope ← get
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    let bundle ← sets.value.source.inContext scope.context
    let functor ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Automorphisms.automorphismsConstruction #[bundle]
    let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map #[functor, bindings[3]!.expression]
    checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        throwError "the construction map changed its retained complete core morphism"
  let session ← session.assume `f (← nativeTerm "X ⟶ Y")
  let arrow ← session.term (← nativeTerm "f")
  let arrow ← arrow.inCategory sets.expression sets.value .morphism
  let session ← session.defineTerm `plain arrow
  expectRefusal "different complete selected source category"
    (session.read (← sourceTerm "map plain along Aut()"))

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let sets ← empty.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Sets" [.zero] #[]
  let functor ← empty.term (← nativeTerm
    "CasCatalogue.Foundation.CatalogueRegistration.setsIdentity.{0}.toFunctor")
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `U functor
  let session ← session.assume `P (← nativeTerm
    "CasCatalogue.Algebra.Automorphisms.Registration.pointedSetsCategory.{0}")
  let category ← session.constant Syntax.missing
    ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Automorphisms.Registration.pointedSetsCategory [.zero]
  let object ← session.term (← nativeTerm "P")
  let object ← object.inCategory CasCatalogue.Algebra.Automorphisms.Registration.PointedSets category
  let session ← session.defineTerm `point object
  let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm "Stab(U, point)")
  checkSelected result fun value => do
    let scope ← get
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    let bundle ← sets.value.source.inContext scope.context
    let functor ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Automorphisms.stabilizersConstruction
      #[bundle, bindings[0]!.expression]
    let input ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Core.mk #[bindings[2]!.expression]
    let (_, target) ← functorCategoryBundles functor
    let expected ← functorObject functor input target
    checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        throwError "the parameterized construction changed its actual functor or pointed object"
    let #[applied] ← declaredApplications scope.context scope.selections
        ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Automorphisms.stabilizersConstruction value
      | throwError "the construction lost its one complete original functor application"
    unless applied.isAppOfArity ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Automorphisms.stabilizersConstruction 2 &&
        (← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections applied.getAppArgs[1]!
          bindings[0]!.expression) do
      throwError "the construction did not retain its exact supplied functor argument"
  expectRefusal "requires its actual declaration parameter"
    (session.read (← sourceTerm "Stab(point)"))

module

import CasCompiler.Read
import CasCompiler.CreationFamily
import CasCompiler.PreparedCreationFamily
import CasCompiler.SourceLimit
import CasCompiler.CategoricalPointFamily
import LeanCategories.Catalogue
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.Read
meta import CasCompiler.CreationFamily
meta import CasCompiler.PreparedCreationFamily
meta import CasCompiler.SourceLimit
meta import CasCompiler.CategoricalPointFamily
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue

private def creationSourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the original creation source did not parse"
  return ⟨parsed⟩

/-- The original SourceNamedLimitTests finite-set pullback inputs, unchanged. -/
private def creationSourceSession : TermElabM SourceSession := do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let f ← empty.read (← creationSourceTerm
    "{0 ↦ 0, 1 ↦ 1, 2 ↦ 1} : (Fin(3) in FiniteSets) → (Fin(2) in FiniteSets)")
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `f' f
  let g ← session.read (← creationSourceTerm
    "{0 ↦ 1, 1 ↦ 0} : (Fin(2) in FiniteSets) → (Fin(2) in FiniteSets)")
  session.defineTerm `g' g

private def creationField (source : SourceLayout) (projection : Name) : MetaM SourceLayout := do
  let some field := source.fields.find? (·.projection == projection)
    | throwError "the complete creation interface lost native field {projection}"
  field.toLayout

/-- Import every completed source operand through the ordinary lexical selection gate. -/
private def withCreationTerms (session : SourceSession) (terms : Array SourceTerm)
    (action : OpenContext → SourceSelectionScope Expr → Array Expr → TermElabM α) :
    TermElabM α := do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  session.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let initial : SourceReadScope := {
      identities := identities, context,
      selections := ← session.selections.inContext context }
    let read : SourceReadM (Array Expr) := terms.mapM session.readTerm
    read.runK initial fun values scope => action scope.context scope.selections values

/-- Inspect the complete action selected by this binder or its explicit endpoint provenance. -/
private def creationApplication (context : OpenContext) (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
    (value : Expr) : MetaM (SelectedSourceApplication Expr) := do
  let rec visit (fuel : Nat) (value : Expr) : MetaM (SelectedSourceApplication Expr) := do
    match fuel with
    | 0 => throwError "the creation action has cyclic endpoint provenance"
    | fuel + 1 =>
      let some template := selections.findAt? context value.getAppFn
        | throwError "the creation lost an exact selected action binder"
      let selected ← template.specialize value.getAppArgs
      if let some application := selected.application then return application
      if let some endpoint := selected.endpoint then return ← visit fuel endpoint.value
      throwError "the creation lost its complete original action family"
  visit (context.bindings.size + 1) value

/- Read the complete existing native data family, including data-bearing subsingletons.
No new mathematical definition or target answer is introduced by this source-layout control. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[entry] := state.lifts.filter (·.id == LiftId.finiteSetsPullbacks)
    | throwError "the original finite-set creation lift is absent or ambiguous"
  let family ← CreationFamily.forLift entry
  unless family.evidenceFamily.getAppFn.isConstOf entry.evidence &&
      !family.family.hasMVar && !family.family.hasLevelMVar do
    throwError "creation preparation changed its complete rigid evidence family"
  lambdaTelescope family.family fun parameters result => do
    unless parameters.size == family.parameterCount + 3 do
      throwError "the creation family lost an original evidence/diagram/cone/universal slot"
    let cone := parameters[family.parameterCount + 1]!
    let universal := parameters[family.parameterCount + 2]!
    let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[cone]
    unless (← isDefEq (← inferType universal) expected) && !(← isProp expected) do
      throwError "the original target universal data was erased or retargeted"
    let nativeType ← whnfR (← inferType result)
    unless nativeType.isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit do
      throwError "creation preparation discarded the complete LiftsToLimit result"
    let declarations := (← getLCtx).foldl (fun values declaration => values.push declaration) #[]
    let bindings := declarations.mapIdx fun index declaration =>
      { id := ⟨"creation-family-layout", index⟩, role := .parameter,
        expression := mkFVar declaration.fvarId : LocalBinding }
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close result)
    let liftable ← creationField layout ``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit.toLiftableCone
    let cone ← creationField liftable ``CategoryTheory.LiftableCone.liftedCone
    let comparison ← creationField liftable ``CategoryTheory.LiftableCone.validLift
    let hom ← creationField comparison ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom
    let inv ← creationField comparison ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv
    let universal ← creationField layout ``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit.makesLimit
    let mediator ← creationField universal ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.lift
    unless cone.kind == .record && comparison.kind == .record &&
        hom.kind != .proof && inv.kind != .proof && mediator.kind == .function do
      throwError "the complete creation interface erased a cone, comparison or mediator"
    let some law := universal.fields.find? (·.projection == ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.fac)
      | throwError "the creation mediator lost its original native law"
    unless law.kind == .proof && law.wireIndex.isNone do
      throwError "the creation interface changed its proof/data boundary"
  let template ← family.standardizedTemplate
  lambdaTelescope template fun parameters result => do
    unless parameters.size == family.parameterCount + 5 &&
        (← whnfR (← inferType result)).isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit do
      throwError "the published creation template erased its complete comparison/data context"
    let comparison := parameters[family.parameterCount + 2]!
    let cone := parameters[family.parameterCount + 3]!
    let universal := parameters[family.parameterCount + 4]!
    unless (← whnfR (← inferType comparison)).isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.Iso &&
        (← isDefEq (← inferType universal)
          (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[cone])) do
      throwError "the published creation template changed its selected comparison or c/t relation"

/- Source formation retains the exact selected lift, target presentation, comparison and full
request. The request consumes raw target c/t; standardization stays inside its fixed source. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let session ← creationSourceSession
  let result ← session.read (← creationSourceTerm "pullback(f', g')")
  let some selected := result.category.bind (·.limit)
    | throwError "the original created pullback lost its selected construction"
  let some creation := selected.creation
    | throwError "the created pullback did not retain its complete creation interface"
  unless creation.lift == LiftId.finiteSetsPullbacks &&
      creation.declaration == ``CasCatalogue.Limits.Lifts.finiteSetsCreatePullbacks &&
      creation.edge == .classifierForget ClassifierId.setsFinite &&
      selected.row == "lim.sets.pullback" && !selected.colimit do
    throwError "the created pullback changed its accepted lift/target pair"
  withCreationTerms session #[result] fun context _ values => do
    let native ← creation.mapM (·.inContext context)
    let presentation ← selected.interface.presentation.inContext context
    let targetCone ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.cone #[presentation]
    let targetUniversal ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.isLimit #[presentation]
    unless native.targetCone.equal targetCone && native.targetUniversal.equal targetUniversal do
      throwError "creation replaced one original target projection"
    let request ← instantiateMVars native.requestFamily
    lambdaTelescope request fun actual body => do
      let #[cone, universal] := actual
        | throwError "the selected creation request changed its two original data inputs"
      let coneType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone
        #[← selected.interface.diagram.inContext context]
      let universalType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[cone]
      unless (← isDefEq (← inferType cone) coneType) &&
          (← isDefEq (← inferType universal) universalType) &&
          body.containsFVar cone.fvarId! && body.containsFVar universal.fvarId! do
        throwError "creation requested computed standardized inputs instead of original target data"
      unless body.containsConst (· == ``CategoryTheory.liftsToLimitOfCreates) &&
          body.containsConst (· == ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.postcomposeInvEquiv) do
        throwError "the fixed request discarded its accepted creation or diagram transport"
      check body
    let actual := mkAppN request #[targetCone, targetUniversal]
    unless actual.equal native.result do
      throwError "creation result no longer belongs to its exact prepared request"
    context.withOriginalSources #[values[0]!] fun sources => do
      let letIds := (← getLCtx).foldl (fun ids declaration =>
        if declaration.isLet then ids.push declaration.fvarId else ids) #[]
      let source ← zetaDeltaFVars sources[0]! letIds
      unless source.containsConst (· == ``CategoryTheory.liftLimit) &&
          source.containsConst (· == ``CasCatalogue.Limits.Registration.setsPullback) do
        throwError "creation changed the original source presentation"
  let retained ← session.defineTerm `Created result
  let sourceAlias ← retained.read (← creationSourceTerm "Created")
  let leg ← retained.read (← creationSourceTerm "Created.leg(0)")
  let secondLeg ← retained.read (← creationSourceTerm "Created.leg(1)")
  let thirdLeg ← retained.read (← creationSourceTerm "Created.leg(2)")
  let some aliasSelection := sourceAlias.category.bind (·.limit)
    | throwError "the source alias dropped the original selected construction"
  let some aliasCreation := aliasSelection.creation
    | throwError "the source alias dropped the complete creation interface"
  unless aliasSelection.construction == selected.construction &&
      aliasCreation.lift == creation.lift && aliasCreation.edge == creation.edge &&
      aliasSelection.creationInputs == selected.creationInputs &&
      aliasSelection.creationFamily.isSome do
    throwError "the source alias changed the original creation selection"
  withCreationTerms retained #[sourceAlias, leg, secondLeg, thirdLeg] fun context selections _ => do
    let original ← creation.mapM (·.inContext context)
    let reopened ← aliasCreation.mapM (·.inContext context)
    unless (original.terms.zip reopened.terms).all (fun (left, right) => left.equal right) do
      throwError "closing and reopening changed an original creation field"
    let source ← leg.source.inContext context
    let some decoded ← NativeLimitLegSelection.ofExpr? context selections source
      | throwError "the alias leg lost its original typed construction envelope"
    let some decodedCreation := decoded.construction.source.creation
      | throwError "the typed owner envelope omitted the selected creation"
    unless (decodedCreation.terms.zip original.terms).all
        (fun (left, right) => left.equal right) do
      throwError "the typed construction envelope changed its complete creation field table"
    let shape := Lean.mkConst ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair
    let expected := #[
      ← mkAppOptM ``Option.none #[some shape],
      ← mkAppOptM ``Option.some #[some shape, some (Lean.mkConst ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair.left)],
      ← mkAppOptM ``Option.some #[some shape, some (Lean.mkConst ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair.right)]]
    for leg in #[leg, secondLeg, thirdLeg], index in expected do
      let some selected ← NativeLimitLegSelection.ofExpr? context selections (← leg.source.inContext context)
        | throwError "a created leg lost its original typed native index"
      unless selected.index.equal index &&
          selected.construction.source.construction == decoded.construction.source.construction do
        throwError "the created leg changed its native constructor-order index or original owner"
  let outside ← try
      discard <| retained.read (← creationSourceTerm "Created.leg(3)")
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  let some outside := outside
    | throwError "the original created cone admitted an ordinal outside its native shape"
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? outside == some .invalid do throw outside

/- The prepared contextual marker retains actual separately supplied c/t expressions while
leaving every original selected interface field intact. A universal record for another actual
cone fails its native dependent input check before any provider is selected. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let session ← creationSourceSession
  let result ← session.read (← creationSourceTerm "pullback(f', g')")
  withCreationTerms session #[result] fun original selections values => do
    let owner := values[0]!
    let some sourceSelection := selections.findAt? original owner
      | throwError "the selected creation lost its complete typed source record"
    let some selected := sourceSelection.limit
      | throwError "the selected creation lost its original native interface"
    let some (creationFamily, targetFamily) := sourceSelection.creationOwner
      | throwError "the selected creation lost its complete accepted family pair"
    let some prepared ← PreparedCreationFamily.ofSelection original owner selected
      creationFamily targetFamily selections
      | throwError "the selected creation did not prepare a complete contextual request"
    unless prepared.operation == LiftId.finiteSetsPullbacks.raw &&
        prepared.input == "lift.finite_sets.pullbacks#input" &&
        prepared.inputs.evidence.arguments.isEmpty &&
        prepared.inputs.diagramTag == "cospan" && prepared.inputs.diagramPorts.size == 2 do
      throwError "the prepared creation changed an original public/native input position"
    let explicit := (prepared.inputs.evidence.arguments ++
      prepared.inputs.standardization.arguments ++ prepared.inputs.target.arguments).filter
      (fun argument => argument.wireIndex.isSome && argument.binderInfo.isExplicit)
    unless prepared.captureSources.size > explicit.size do
      throwError "the creation capture plan erased its actual implicit computational parameters"
    let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
    let originalInputs ← prepared.sourceArguments.mapM (·.inContext original)
    let reading : SourceReadM (Array Expr) :=
      originalInputs.mapM fun value => SourceReadM.select { value }
    reading.runK { identities := identities, context := original, selections }
        fun markedInputs scope =>
      prepared.rebindSource identities scope.context scope.selections markedInputs
          fun original selections rebound => do
        let reboundSelection ← rebound.selection original
        for marked in markedInputs, index in prepared.sourcePositions do
          let some actual := reboundSelection.source.diagram.getAppArgs[index]?
            | throwError "the source owner lost an original full diagram argument"
          unless actual.equal marked do
            throwError "the source owner reconstructed or merged an original positional input"
        let some reboundCreation := reboundSelection.source.creation
          | throwError "positional source binding lost the selected creation"
        let presentation := reboundSelection.source.interface.presentation
        let information ← getFunInfoNArgs presentation.getAppFn presentation.getAppNumArgs
        let mut targetInputs := #[]
        for input in presentation.getAppArgs, index in [:presentation.getAppNumArgs] do
          if (information.paramInfo[index]?.map (·.isExplicit)).getD false && !(← isProof input) then
            targetInputs := targetInputs.push input
        unless targetInputs.size == rebound.inputs.diagramPorts.size do
          throwError "the target presentation changed its original mapped source-port order"
        let maps ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.action reboundCreation.edge)
        let objects ← SourceActionFamily.forEdge reboundCreation.edge
        let family ← if (← maps.carrierFamily?).isSome then maps.asReference else maps.asWhole
        for targetInput in targetInputs, sourcePort in rebound.inputs.diagramPorts do
          let sourceInput ← sourcePort.source.source.inContext original
          let hom ← inferType targetInput
          unless hom.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
            throwError "the target map lost its complete native Hom schema"
          let targetMap := if targetInput.isAppOfArity ``id 2 then
            targetInput.getAppArgs[1]! else targetInput
          let application ← creationApplication original selections targetMap
          let .point retainedFamily := application.family
            | throwError "the target map lost its selected generic action family"
          unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.point retainedFamily).exactlyMatches (.point family) do
            throwError "the target map changed its complete original action owner"
          let levels := application.universes
          let parameters := application.parameters
          let #[source, target, input] := parameters.extract maps.declarationParameterCount parameters.size
            | throwError "the target map lost its original endpoint/arrow input positions"
          unless input.equal sourceInput do
            throwError "the target map recomputed or replaced its exact original source input"
          let sourceType ← instantiateMVars (← inferType sourceInput)
          let sourceType ← if sourceType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure sourceType
            else whnfR sourceType
          let endpoints ← if sourceType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
              pure (sourceType.getAppArgs.extract 2 4)
            else if sourceType.isAppOfArity ``TypeCat.Hom 2 then pure sourceType.getAppArgs
            else throwError "the original test arrow lost its stated native endpoint slots"
          unless endpoints == #[source, target] do
            dbg_trace "[creation.endpoint] original positions={reprStr prepared.sourcePositions}; source arguments={reprStr markedInputs}"
            dbg_trace "[creation.endpoint] actual source input={reprStr sourceInput}; original native type={reprStr sourceType}"
            dbg_trace "[creation.endpoint] stated endpoints={reprStr endpoints}; selected action endpoints={reprStr #[source, target]}"
            dbg_trace "[creation.endpoint] retained target application={reprStr targetInput}"
            throwError "the target map replaced an original stated source endpoint"
          let (native, _) ← maps.arrowAt levels parameters
          unless native.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map 8 &&
              native.getAppArgs[7]!.equal sourceInput do
            throwError "the selected target family changed its original native map"
          let nativeType ← inferType native
          unless nativeType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 &&
              hom.getAppFn == nativeType.getAppFn &&
              hom.getAppArgs.extract 0 2 == nativeType.getAppArgs.extract 0 2 do
            throwError "the target endpoint hint changed its original universe or category dictionary"
          for image in hom.getAppArgs.extract 2 4, receiver in #[source, target] do
            let application ← creationApplication original selections image
            let .objectAction retainedFamily := application.family
              | throwError "an implicit target object lost its selected object action"
            unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.objectAction retainedFamily).exactlyMatches
                (.objectAction objects) do
              throwError "an implicit target object changed its original action"
            unless application.universes == levels &&
                application.parameters == parameters.extract 0 maps.declarationParameterCount &&
                application.arguments == #[receiver] do
              throwError "an implicit target object lost an original declaration argument or receiver"
        let firstType ← inferType targetInputs[0]!
        let secondType ← inferType targetInputs[1]!
        unless presentation.getAppNumArgs == 5 &&
            presentation.getAppArgs[0]!.equal firstType.getAppArgs[2]! &&
            presentation.getAppArgs[1]!.equal secondType.getAppArgs[2]! &&
            presentation.getAppArgs[2]!.equal firstType.getAppArgs[3]! &&
            presentation.getAppArgs[2]!.equal secondType.getAppArgs[3]! do
          throwError "the target presentation lost the action markers at its original implicit object slots"
        unless reboundCreation.requestFamily.containsConst
            (· == ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.postcomposeInvEquiv) do
          throwError "the same source inputs no longer determine the fixed creation request"
        let coneType ← inferType (← prepared.interface.targetCone.inContext original)
        withLocalDeclD `actualTargetCone coneType fun cone => do
          let universalType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[cone]
          withLocalDeclD `actualTargetUniversal universalType fun universal => do
            withLocalDeclD `otherTargetCone coneType fun other => do
              let otherType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[other]
              withLocalDeclD `otherTargetUniversal otherType fun otherUniversal => do
                let actualBindings := #[cone, universal, other, otherUniversal].mapIdx fun index value =>
                  (⟨⟨"creation-actual-input", index⟩, .parameter, value⟩ : LocalBinding)
                let context ← ContextTelescope.capture (original.bindings ++ actualBindings)
                let decoded ← prepared.withArguments context cone universal
                let selectedRequest ← prepared.selectedArguments context
                  (← prepared.owner.inContext context) cone universal
                let some application := selectedRequest.application
                  | throwError "the fixed creation request lost its complete selected application"
                unless selectedRequest.value.equal
                    (mkAppN (← decoded.familyIn context) #[cone, universal]) &&
                    application.arguments == #[cone, universal] do
                  throwError "the temporary creation inputs changed before their complete scope was closed"
                let #[retainedCone, retainedUniversal] ← decoded.arguments.mapM (·.inContext context)
                  | throwError "the fixed creation request changed its exact input arity"
                unless retainedCone.equal cone && retainedUniversal.equal universal do
                  throwError "the fixed creation marker regenerated an actual c/t input"
                let before ← prepared.interface.mapM (·.inContext context)
                let after ← decoded.interface.mapM (·.inContext context)
                unless (before.terms.zip after.terms).all
                    (fun (left, right) => left.equal right) do
                  throwError "actual input retention changed the immutable original creation interface"
                let wrong ← try
                    discard <| prepared.withArguments context cone otherUniversal
                    pure false
                  catch _ => pure true
                unless wrong do
                  throwError "creation accepted universal data for another original cone"
                let replaced ← try
                    let originalSelection ← prepared.selection context
                    let changed ← NativeLimitSelection.ofSource
                      { originalSelection.source with construction := `differentConstruction }
                      originalSelection.receiver
                    discard <| PreparedCreationFamily.ofSelection context
                      (← prepared.owner.inContext context) changed prepared.family prepared.target selections
                    pure false
                  catch _ => pure true
                unless replaced do
                  throwError "the fixed creation marker accepted a different construction occurrence"

/- Candidate order cannot choose among two applicable accepted native interfaces. The test
duplicates only publication metadata for the same existing mathematics; no new math is added. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let session ← creationSourceSession
  let first ← session.read (← creationSourceTerm "f'")
  let second ← session.read (← creationSourceTerm "g'")
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[lift] := state.lifts.filter (·.id == LiftId.finiteSetsPullbacks)
    | throwError "the original creation lift is absent or ambiguous"
  let #[row] := state.limits.filter (·.id.raw == "lim.sets.pullback")
    | throwError "the original target presentation is absent or ambiguous"
  let otherLift := { lift with id := ⟨"test.creation.same_native_lift"⟩ }
  let otherRow := { row with id := ⟨"test.creation.same_native_presentation"⟩ }
  withCreationTerms session #[first, second] fun context selections values => do
    let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
    let initial : SourceReadScope := { identities, context, selections }
    let firstValue := values[0]!
    let secondValue := values[1]!
    let .fvar firstId := firstValue.consumeMData
      | throwError "the first original map lost its source binding"
    let .fvar secondId := secondValue.consumeMData
      | throwError "the second original map lost its source binding"
    let some selected ← session.openCategory context firstId
      | throwError "the first original map lost its complete source category"
    let some secondSelected ← session.openCategory context secondId
      | throwError "the second original map lost its complete source category"
    let maps : Array NativeSourceJudgement := #[
      ⟨firstValue, some selected⟩, ⟨secondValue, some secondSelected⟩]
    for inventory in #[
        { state with lifts := #[lift, otherLift] },
        { state with lifts := #[otherLift, lift] },
        { state with limits := #[row, otherRow] },
        { state with limits := #[otherRow, row] }] do
      let failure ← try
          (sourceCreatedLimit? inventory "pullback" selected maps).runK initial
            (fun _ _ => pure ())
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure
        | throwError "creation silently selected the first applicable lift/presentation pair"
      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity failure do throw failure
    (sourceCreatedLimit? { state with lifts := #[] } "pullback" selected maps).runK initial
        fun absent _ => do
      unless absent.isNone do
        throwError "creation inferred an unregistered source lift"

initialize registerTraceClass `cas.division

/-- `a / b`: a registered morphism named `/` (`mor.sets.divide : M × Mˣ → M`) at the object `M` of
its parameter category that the operands' registered owner is, viewed along its structural route.
Competing routes are resolved by a declared preferred route for `/`, else by their whole-family
agreement, else the reading is ambiguous (sourceStructuralView; constitution C6). The divisor is
admitted into the second factor with that subobject's own evidence (sourceAdmission).
`owners` are the registered objects whose carrier is the operands' set; `read` reads an operand in
that set. Several applicable rows or owners are ambiguous; none is an unsupported source. -/
def sourceDivision (owners : Array NativeSourceOperationDomain) (left right : TSyntax `cas_term)
    (read : TSyntax `cas_term → SourceReadM Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let mut candidates := #[]
  for row in state.morphisms do
    unless row.name == "/" do continue
    let (_, _, parameters) ← morphismAtSource row
    let mut objects := #[]
    for (parameter, info) in parameters do
      unless info.isExplicit do continue
      if let some category ← sourceObjectCategory? (← inferType parameter) then
        objects := objects.push category
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| do trace[cas.division] "{row.id.raw}: object parameters {objects.map (·.id.raw)}; owners {owners.map (·.value)}"
    let #[category] := objects | continue
    for owner in owners do
      let routes ← SourceRoutes.forOwner owner.category.expression category.expression
      let some routes ← routes.finiteRoutes
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "the division's monoid view requires its uniform comparison"
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| do trace[cas.division] "{owner.value} has {routes.size} routes to {category.id.raw}"
      unless routes.isEmpty do candidates := candidates.push (row, category, owner)
  let (row, category, owner) ← match candidates with
    | #[candidate] => pure candidate
    | #[] => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "no registered division `/` applies to the operands' object"
    | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "several registered divisions `/` apply to the operands' object"
  let monoid ← sourceStructuralView ⟨owner.value, some owner.category⟩ category.expression
    (some "/")
  let (morphism, _, parameters) ← morphismAtSource row
  let some objectIndex := parameters.findIdx? fun (_, info) => info.isExplicit
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered division lost its object parameter"
  let (parameter, _) := parameters[objectIndex]!
  -- The monoid is stated at the parameter's own type (`MonCat`), not at the bundled category of
  -- the view, so that the factor `Mˣ` is spelled as its admission declares it.
  let monoidAtParameter ← mkExpectedTypeHint monoid.value (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType parameter))
  unless ← isDefEq parameter monoidAtParameter do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered division does not take the operands' monoid"
  unless ← synthesizeDeclared parameters do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered division lacks a declared instance at the operands' monoid"
  -- Native unification checks this argument but may normalize its view. The actual
  -- declaration keeps the original routed object in its complete formal position.
  let arguments ← liftM (m := MetaM) <|
    parameters.mapM fun (parameter, _) => instantiateMVars parameter
  let morphism := mkAppN (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars morphism.getAppFn)
    (arguments.set! objectIndex monoidAtParameter)
  if morphism.hasMVar || morphism.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered division is not determined by the operands' monoid"
  let #[originalCategory] := state.categories.filter (·.id == row.category)
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered division lost its original complete category row"
  let selected ← SourceReadM.select
    (← sourceReferenceAt (.named (.registered (.inr row) originalCategory)) morphism morphism)
  let function ← sourceSetFunction selected
  let hole ← mkFreshExprMVar none
  discard <| elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr hole] none false false
  let pair ← whnfR (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType hole))
  unless pair.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered division does not take a pair"
  let operand := fun (source : TSyntax `cas_term) (type : Expr) => do
    let value ← read source
    let value ← match owner.comparison with
      | none => pure value
      | some comparison => do
        let inverse ← sourceSetFunction (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv #[comparison])
        elabAppArgs inverse #[] #[Arg.expr value] (some type) false false
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) type do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwErrorAt source "the operand is not in the monoid the division acts on"
    return value
  let dividend ← operand left pair.getAppArgs[0]!
  -- The divisor's factor is a registered subobject at the monoid (`Mˣ`): the admitted object
  -- whose declaration is its head.
  let units := pair.getAppArgs[1]!
  let #[entry] := state.objects.filter fun entry =>
      entry.admission.isSome && units.getAppFn.constName? == some entry.declaration
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the divisor's factor {units} of the registered division is not one admitted subobject"
  let divisor ← sourceAdmission entry units fun base => operand right base
  let tuple ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[dividend, divisor]
  let value ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr tuple] none false false
  let mut value ← match owner.comparison with
    | none => pure value
    | some comparison => do
      let forward ← sourceSetFunction (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[comparison])
      elabAppArgs forward #[] #[Arg.expr value] none false false
  for evidence in owner.originEvidence.reverse do
    let body := value
    value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `divisionOwnerAgreement)
      (← inferType evidence) evidence fun binding =>
        mkLetFVars #[binding] body (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
  return value

/-- Read `text` after `let Q := ℚ in CommutativeRings`. -/
private def readInRationals (text : String) : TermElabM SourceTerm := do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "source-division.cas" "let Q := ℚ in CommutativeRings\n"
  let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  for item in file.items do
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
      | throwError "the ring statement did not parse"
    let .definition next _ ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
      | throwError "the ring did not extend its source context"
    session := next
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the quotient did not parse"
  session.read ⟨source⟩

/- `a / b` is the registered division `/ : M × Mˣ → M` (mor.sets.divide) at the monoid `M` of the
operands' object, with `b` admitted into `Mˣ` by the domain's own evidence
(tests/acceptance/fractions.cas; RX-LIFT's row `[3/2, -1]`). A commutative ring is a monoid along
several structural routes that agree by no registered comparison, so without a declared
preferred route the reading is ambiguous (constitution C6). -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let failure ← try
        discard <| readInRationals "3/2 in Q"
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
    match failure with
    | none => throwError "`3/2` was read with no declared preferred monoid route"
    | some error => unless CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity error do throw error
  finally setEnv environment

/- With a declared preferred route for `/` on commutative rings along the multiplicative monoid,
`3/2` reads as that division. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    setPreferredRoutes #[⟨"/", "cat.commutative_rings",
      #["fun.commutative_rings.ring", "fun.rings.multiplicative_monoid"]⟩]
    let value ← readInRationals "3/2 in Q"
    checkSelected value fun expression => do
      checkOriginal #[expression] fun native => do
        let value ← instantiateMVars native[0]!
        unless (value.find? (·.isConstOf ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Units.divide)).isSome do
          throwError "`3/2` is not the registered division: {value}"
  finally setEnv environment

      unless id.getId.toString.endsWith ".formed_arrow_action" do
        throwError "the original first whole-arrow assertion changed its source position"

            (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))

          | throwError "the original structured arrow entry is absent"

          | throwError "the original structured arrow binding is absent"

          throwError "a whole-arrow comparison changed its principal typed source terms"
