/-- The distinguished point registered on the actual selected source object.
Reuse: registeredSourceDomain follows original source aliases, applyObjectParameters retains the
declaration's complete actual parameters, and sourcePointValue applies its native point map.
No generator is selected by a coincident carrier or an inferred algebraic structure. -/
def sourceObjectGenerator (object : NativeSourceJudgement) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let some category := object.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "an explicit generator requires its selected source object"
  unless category.role == .object do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "an explicit generator requires an object"
  let (declared, entries) ← registeredSourceDomain object.value
  if entries.isEmpty then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "an explicit generator requires a registered source object"
  let #[entry] := entries
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "an explicit generator requires one registered source object"
  unless declared.getAppFn.constName? == some entry.declaration do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the generator's source object lost its original declaration parameters"
  let some generator := entry.generator
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "the selected object has no registered generator"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
  discard <| checkedDeclaration generator
  let point ← applyObjectParameters s!"generator of {entry.id.raw}" generator declared.getAppArgs
  let pointType ← whnfR (← inferType point)
  unless pointType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "the selected generator requires its remaining declared parameters"
  let carrier ← sourceCarrierFamilyObject category category.bundle object.value
  checkRegisteredSourceDomains pointType.getAppArgs[3]! carrier
  unless ← (← get).context.withOriginalSources #[pointType.getAppArgs[3]!, carrier]
      (fun values => isDefEq values[0]! values[1]!) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered generator has a different complete selected carrier"
  let value ← sourcePointValue point (some carrier)
  -- A named set's original binder is already its exact element type. Keeping that binder
  -- lets later operation selection use its declared named refinement. Structured objects
  -- keep the same complete carrier provenance used by the ordinary carrier reader.
  let type ← if category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) then
      pure object.value
    else annotateSourceType category object.value carrier
  let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? value).getD { value }
  let selected ← retainSourceApplication { selected with
    value := value
    reference := some (.generator entry) } point
  SourceReadM.select selected (some type)

end CasCompiler

-- questions. The alias control checks source identity only: equal native carriers cannot
-- replace the actual named object. No comparison action or generator value is evaluated.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do

  try
    let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
    let file ← SourceFile.parse "source-explicit-generators.cas"
      "let X := F9x\nlet Y := F9y\nlet Xalias := X\n\
       let GX := generator(X)\nlet GY := generator(Y)\nlet GA := generator(Xalias)\n"
    let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
    let expected := #[
      (`X, "obj.sets.f9_x", ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.PolynomialPresentations.firstGenerator),
      (`Y, "obj.sets.f9_y", ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.PolynomialPresentations.secondGenerator),

        | throwError "the explicit generator control is not a source definition"

      let some (name, objectId, declaration) := expected[index - 3]?
        | throwError "the generator control acquired an unexpected source statement"
      checkSelected value fun expression => do
        let scope ← get
        let some selected ← scope.context.bindings.findM? fun binding =>
            return (← binding.expression.fvarId!.getUserName) == name
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the explicit generator lost its original source object"
        unless (← inferType expression) == selected.expression do
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the generator replaced its exact source object by another carrier"
        let some selection ← SourceReadM.selection? expression
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the explicit generator lost its selected native binding"
        let some (.generator entry) := selection.reference
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the explicit generator lost its selected catalogue reference"
        let #[originalEntry] := (← semanticState).objects.filter (·.id.raw == objectId)
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the explicit generator lost its independently registered owner"
        unless entry.id.raw == objectId && entry.generator == some declaration &&
            (SelectedSourceReference.generator entry).exactlyMatches (.generator originalEntry) do
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the explicit generator changed its original registered declaration"
        checkOriginal #[expression] fun native => do
          unless native[0]!.containsConst (· == declaration) do
            throwError "the explicit generator changed its original registered declaration"
        let some ordinal := scope.context.bindings.findIdx? (·.id == selected.id)
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the generator's source object is outside its complete telescope"
        unless (← contextDependencies scope.context.bindings (← inferType expression)).contains ordinal do
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the generator dropped its actual source-binding dependency"
  finally setEnv original

      let expression ← session.readTerm value

          originatesAt scope.context scope.selections term bindings[1]!.expression false)

              originatesAt scope.context scope.selections actual bindings[1]!.expression false do

    let scope ← get

    unless ← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections expression bindings[2]!.expression false do

-- A completed registered application cannot be reread after losing its selected row.
-- The native expression and complete original context stay unchanged in this control.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let application ← session.read (← sourceTerm "rev(3, 0)")
  discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing (session.readTerm application)
  let selected := application.selections.toArray.filter fun (_, selection) =>
    match selection.reference with
    | some (.named (.registered (.inr entry) _)) =>
      entry.id.raw == "mor.sets.fin_rev" && selection.originalApplication.isSome
    | _ => false
  unless !selected.isEmpty do
    throwError "the registered application lost its original selected map row"
  for (identity, _) in selected do
    let broken := { application with selections := application.selections.erase identity }
    let failure : Option Exception ← withoutModifyingState do
      try
        discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing (session.readTerm broken)
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
    let some failure := failure
      | throwError "the reader accepted an application without its selected row"
    unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag (· == `CasCompiler.SourceReadM.missingSelection) do
      throw failure

-- Native quotation returns only the caller's original locals after the source continuation
-- exits, including an authored let and an original parameter of a registered object.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let results ← withLocalDeclD `n (mkConst ``Nat) fun n =>
    withLetDecl `m (mkConst ``Nat) n fun m => do
      let originalContext ← getLCtx
      let originalInstances ← getLocalInstances
      let localValue ← withSynthesize <| elabTermEnsuringType
        (← nativeTerm "cas_source% m") (some (mkConst ``Nat))
      checkWithKernel localValue
      unless ← isDefEq localValue m do
        throwError "native source quotation replaced its original ambient local"
      let expected ← withSynthesize <| elabTerm
        (← nativeTerm "CasCatalogue.Foundation.Objects.fin m") none
      let registered ← withSynthesize <| elabTermEnsuringType
        (← nativeTerm "cas_source% (Fin(m) in Sets)") (some (← inferType expected))
      checkWithKernel registered
      unless ← isDefEq registered expected do
        throwError "native source quotation lost its registered object's original parameter"
      let current := (← getLCtx).foldl (fun ids declaration =>
        ids.push declaration.fvarId) #[]
      let currentInstances ← getLocalInstances
      unless current == originalContext.foldl (fun ids declaration =>
          ids.push declaration.fvarId) #[] && currentInstances.size == originalInstances.size do
        throwError "native source quotation changed its caller's complete native scope"
      for first in originalInstances, second in currentInstances do
        unless first.className == second.className && first.fvar.equal second.fvar do
          throwError "native source quotation changed its caller's selected instance order"
      return #[← mkLambdaFVars #[n, m] localValue (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false),
        ← mkLambdaFVars #[n, m] registered (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)]
  for result in results do
    if result.hasFVar || result.hasMVar then
      throwError "native source quotation escaped its completed original telescope"
    checkWithKernel result

      | throwError "the native-instance source control did not parse"

      unless literal.isAppOfArity ``List.toFinset 3 do return false
      let arguments := literal.getAppArgs
      let some outer ← SourceReadM.selection? arguments[0]!
        | throwError "the finite-subset dictionary erased its original base binding"
      unless outer.category.isSome do
        throwError "the finite-subset dictionary erased its original base origin"
      let some (_, polynomial) ← sourceObjectOrigin? arguments[0]!
        | throwError "the finite subset lost its original polynomial object"
      let scope ← get
      let some (row, _) ← sourceObjectSelection? scope.context scope.selections polynomial
        | throwError "the finite subset lost its original selected polynomial row"
      let applications ← declaredApplications scope.context scope.selections row.declaration polynomial
      unless !applications.isEmpty do
        throwError "native inference erased the polynomial's original declaration inputs"
      let mut nested := false
      for application in applications do
        for parameter in application.getAppArgs do
          if (← sourceObjectOrigin? parameter).isSome then nested := true
      unless nested do
        throwError "native inference erased the polynomial's original scalar binding"
      check literal
      if literal.hasMVar || literal.hasLevelMVar then
        throwError "the finite-subset dictionary is unresolved"
      return true) expression
    unless count > 0 do
      throwError "the original finite subset lost its native quotient application"
  let failure : Option Exception ← withoutModifyingState do
    try
      discard <| define session
        "let unsupportedView := view formedSource along «fun.bilin_module.forget»(ℕ, ℕ)"
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "native inference fabricated an unavailable CommRing dictionary"
  let message ← failure.toMessageData.toString
  unless message.startsWith "failed to synthesize" &&
      (message.splitOn "CommRing").length > 1 do throw failure

/- An invariant of objects is a registered family of global elements indexed by objects:
`dimension (A : CommRingCat) : 1 ⟶ ℕ∞ ∪ {-∞}`. Applied to the commutative ring ℚ it reads as that
family at ℚ, not as a map on elements. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  for text in #["dimension(ℚ)"] do
    let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm text)
    checkSelected result fun expression => do
      checkOriginal #[expression] fun native => do
        let value ← instantiateMVars native[0]!
        let some family := value.find?
            (·.isAppOfArity ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.MvPolynomials.dimension 1)
          | throwError "`{text}` did not read as the dimension family: {value}"
        let ring := Expr.const ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedCommutativeRings.rationals []
        unless ← isDefEq family.appArg! ring do
          throwError "`{text}` applied the dimension family to another object: {family.appArg!}"

/- An invariant compared with a numeral (`dimension(ℚ) = 0`): the global element is compared at
its point, where the numeral reads in the set of dimensions through the registered inclusion
ℕ ↪ ℕ∞ ∪ {-∞}. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm "dimension(ℚ) = 0")
  checkSelected result fun expression => do
    checkOriginal #[expression] fun native => do
      let value ← instantiateMVars native[0]!
      unless value.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do throwError "the comparison is not an equation: {value}"
      unless (value.find? (·.isConstOf ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.MvPolynomials.naturalsDimensions)).isSome do
        throwError "the numeral did not enter the dimensions through their inclusion: {value}"

public import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Lift

public import CasCompiler.SelectedField

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open CategoryTheory

universe u₁ u₂ v₁ v₂

/-- Native storage for a selected application of the independent lift interface.
This records its original inputs; all resulting operations are the upstream projections.
Source: MonoLift and the mathematical-input contract, existing lift and universal data. -/
structure SourceLiftApplication {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂}
    [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₂} D] (U : C ⥤ D) where
  selected : CasCatalogue.MonoLift U
  object : C
  domain : D
  inclusion : domain ⟶ U.obj object
  monicity : Mono inclusion

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

-- Reuse registered boundaries and edgesFrom's unary constructor action.
-- An explicitly selected lift keeps the registered action's actual role.
private partial def liftEdgeBoundary (state : SemanticState) (ref : EdgeRef) :
    MetaM (CategoryExpr × CategoryExpr) := do
  match ref with
  | .constructMap id inner =>
    let (source, target) ← liftEdgeBoundary state inner
    return (.construct id #[.category source], .construct id #[.category target])
  | .functor id =>
    let some entry := state.functor? id
      | throwError "the selected lift functor is not registered"
    return (entry.source, entry.target)
  | .classifierForget id =>
    let some entry := state.classifier? id
      | throwError "the selected lift classifier is not registered"
    return (.classifierTotal id, entry.host)

private def liftBoundary (state : SemanticState) (row : LiftEntry) :
    MetaM (CategoryExpr × CategoryExpr) := do
  let .subobjects := row.kind
    | throwUnsupportedSource "selected limit lifting requires its declared diagram"
  let (source, target) ← liftEdgeBoundary state row.edge
  -- validateLift checks the complete edge against the actual functor's mapArrow.
  -- Its declared unary boundaries retain the source and target category expressions.
  let .construct _ #[.category source] := source
    | throwError "the selected lift has no declared arrow source category"
  let .construct _ #[.category target] := target
    | throwError "the selected lift has no declared arrow target category"
  return (source, target)

/-- Apply the supplied original lift inputs at their complete native positions. The shared
application producer owns its holes; dependent aliases keep their exact source selection. -/
private def applyLiftInputs (function : Expr) (arguments : Array Expr)
    (allArguments : Bool := true) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let result ← elabSourceApplicationApplicableScoped function
    (Array.replicate arguments.size Syntax.missing) none (fun index expected => do
      let argument := arguments[index]!
      if ← isDefEq (← inferType argument) expected then return .ok argument
      let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? argument).getD { value := argument }
      return .ok (← SourceReadM.select { selected with value := argument } (some expected)))
    allArguments
  match result with
  | .ok (value, _) => return value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

/-- Check the selected whole family before applying original source arguments.
The original computation is selected once; every member and factor retains that actual owner. -/
def sourceSelectedLift (row : LiftEntry) (receiver input : NativeSourceJudgement)
    (selected monicity : Expr) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let original ← match ← SourceReadM.selection? selected with
    | none => pure selected
    | some retained =>
      let same := SourceSelection.exactlyMatches Expr.equal
        { value := selected, reference := retained.reference }
        (sourceReference (.lift row) selected)
      unless same do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
          throwError "the selected lift changed its independent source declaration"
      let some original := retained.originalApplication
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected lift lost its original evidence"
      pure original
  unless original.consumeMData.getAppFn.constName? == some row.evidence do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
      throwError "the selected lift changed its independent source declaration"
  let selected ← SourceReadM.select
    { (sourceReference (.lift row) selected) with originalApplication := some original }
  let (source, target) ← liftBoundary state row
  let some category := receiver.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a selected lift requires its complete source category"
  unless category.role == .object && category.expression.syntacticEq source do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected lift has a different complete source category"
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType selected)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``MonoLift 5 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected lift declaration has a different native interface"
  let functor := type.getAppArgs[4]!
  let (domain, codomain) ← functorCategoryBundles functor
  unless ← isDefEq domain category.bundle do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected lift has different native category parameters"
  let proofType ← whnfR (← inferType monicity)
  unless proofType.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Mono 5 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected lift requires its explicit monicity evidence"
  let inclusion := proofType.getAppArgs.back!
  let arrow : NativeSourceJudgement :=
    ⟨inclusion, some ⟨.morphism, target, codomain, none, none⟩⟩
  let actual ← if input.category.any (fun selected =>
      selected.role == .morphism && selected.expression.syntacticEq target) then
    pure arrow
  else sourceCarrier arrow
  let same ← (← get).context.withOriginalSources #[actual.value, input.value] fun values => do
    isDefEq (← inferType values[0]!) (← inferType values[1]!) <&&>
      isDefEq values[0]! values[1]!
  unless same do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
      throwError "the supplied monicity evidence has a different original inclusion"
  let inputSelection := (← SourceReadM.selection? input.value).getD { value := input.value }
  let inputValue ← SourceReadM.select { inputSelection with value := input.value }
    (some (← inferType actual.value))
  let agreement ← SourceReadM.prove (← mkEq actual.value inputValue) fun proposition _ => do
    let proposition ← whnfR proposition
    unless proposition.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do
      throwError "the selected lift lost its original inclusion equation"
    mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl proposition.getAppArgs[1]!) proposition
  let domainObject := proofType.getAppArgs[2]!
  let value ← applyLiftInputs (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``SourceLiftApplication.mk)
    #[selected, receiver.value, domainObject, inclusion, monicity] false
  let value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `liftInputAgreement)
      (← inferType agreement) agreement fun binding =>
    mkLetFVars #[binding] value (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
  let selection ← mkFreshUserName `selectedLift
  let computation ← selectRecordActions selection
    (← LiftFamily.atEvidence row .computation original)
    (fun selected expected => SourceReadM.select selected expected)
  let retained := { (sourceReference (.lift row) value) with
    originalApplication := some original
    recordSelection := some selection
    recordOwner := some computation }
  return ⟨← SourceReadM.select retained, none⟩

private def liftSelection (source : SourceSelection Expr) : MetaM Name := do
  let some selection := source.recordSelection
    | throwError "the selected lift lost its source identity"
  unless !selection.isAnonymous do throwError "the selected lift lost its source identity"
  return selection

private def liftReference (value : Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Option (LiftEntry × SourceSelection Expr)) := do
  let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value | return none
  let some (.lift row) := selected.reference | return none
  return some (row, selected)

/-- The original application fields are read at their actual native projection positions.
No definition, equal native value or alternative selected owner supplies these inputs. -/
private def liftInputs (value : Expr) : MetaM (Expr × Expr × Expr × Expr × Expr) := do
  return (← mkProjection value `selected, ← mkProjection value `object,
    ← mkProjection value `domain, ← mkProjection value `inclusion,
    ← mkProjection value `monicity)

/-- Project the original computation selected with this lift application. -/
def sourceLiftMember? (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (name : String) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType receiver.value)
  unless type.isAppOf ``SourceLiftApplication do return none
  let some (row, retained) ← liftReference receiver.value
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the native lift application has no selected source reference"
  let some computation := retained.recordOwner
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected lift lost its original computation owner"
  let (source, target) ← liftBoundary (← semanticState) row
  let (sourceBundle, targetBundle) ← functorCategoryBundles type.getAppArgs.back!
  let (_, object, domainObject, inclusion, monicity) ← liftInputs receiver.value
  let selection ← liftSelection retained
  let declaration ← match name with
    | "obj" => pure ``MonoLiftComputation.obj
    | "hom" => pure ``MonoLiftComputation.hom
    | "forward" => pure ``MonoLiftComputation.forward
    | "backward" => pure ``MonoLiftComputation.backward
    | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected lift has no declared member {name}"
  let function ← mkAppM declaration #[computation]
  let value ← applyLiftInputs function #[object, domainObject, inclusion, monicity]
  let category := if name == "forward" || name == "backward" then target else source
  let bundle := if name == "forward" || name == "backward" then targetBundle else sourceBundle
  let role := if name == "obj" then SourceCategoryRole.object else .morphism
  let category : NativeSourceCategory := ⟨role, category, bundle, none, none⟩
  let selected ← selectedFieldAt selection declaration computation value
  return some ⟨← SourceReadM.select { selected with category := some category }, some category⟩

/-- The universal factor uses the same original computation owner and all supplied
native operands. Its factor family remains an independent accepted callable record. -/
def sourceLiftFactor (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (base source proof : Expr) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType receiver.value)
  unless type.isAppOf ``SourceLiftApplication do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source factor requires a selected lift application"
  let some (row, retained) ← liftReference receiver.value
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the native lift application has no selected source reference"
  let some computation := retained.recordOwner
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected lift lost its original computation owner"
  let some original := retained.originalApplication
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected lift lost its original evidence"
  let (category, _) ← liftBoundary (← semanticState) row
  let (bundle, _) ← functorCategoryBundles type.getAppArgs.back!
  let (_, object, domainObject, inclusion, monicity) ← liftInputs receiver.value
  let factor ← LiftFamily.atEvidence row .factor original
  let some application := factor.application
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected lift lost its accepted factor family"
  let factor := { factor with application := some { application with owner := some computation } }
  let selection ← liftSelection retained
  let factor ← selectRecordActions selection factor
    (fun selected expected => SourceReadM.select selected expected)
  let function ← mkAppM ``MonoLiftFactorComputation.factor #[factor]
  let sourceType ← inferType source
  let sourceType ← if sourceType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure sourceType else whnfR sourceType
  unless sourceType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the factor's source arrow is not a morphism"
  let apex := sourceType.getAppArgs[2]!
  let value ← applyLiftInputs function
    #[object, domainObject, inclusion, monicity, apex, base, source, proof]
  let target ← applyLiftInputs (← mkAppM ``MonoLiftComputation.obj #[computation])
    #[object, domainObject, inclusion, monicity]
  let resultType ← inferType value
  let resultType ← if resultType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure resultType else whnfR resultType
  unless resultType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected factor has no declared morphism endpoints"
  let resultType := mkAppN resultType.getAppFn (resultType.getAppArgs.set! 3 target)
  let selected ← selectedFieldAt selection ``MonoLiftFactorComputation.factor factor value
  let category : NativeSourceCategory := ⟨.morphism, category, bundle, none, none⟩
  return ⟨← SourceReadM.select { selected with category := some category } (some resultType),
    some category⟩

end CasCompiler

/- RX-LIFT's first factor (rx-lift-prescribed-stages.cas): `factor(g0) through first with cone
using proof(…)` reads as the selected lift's upstream factor computation
(`MonoLift.factorComputation`) at the lift's actual object and inclusion, with the base arrow
`g0` and the source arrow `cone`. The file writes `g0` with the matrix `[3/2, -1]`, whose entry
`3/2` is the registered division at the multiplicative monoid of `Q`, selected by a declared
preferred route for `/` on commutative rings (C6). -/
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  setPreferredRoutes #[⟨"/", "cat.commutative_rings",
    #["fun.commutative_rings.ring", "fun.rings.multiplicative_monoid"]⟩]
  let path := "tests/acceptance/proposals/independent-extension-reconstruction-20261024/" ++
    "completion/rx-lift-prescribed-stages.cas"
  let file ← SourceFile.parse path (← liftM (m := IO) (IO.FS.readFile path))
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  for item in file.items do
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item | continue
    let name ← match statement with
      | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident := $_:cas_term) => pure name.getId
      | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident($_:cas_term) := $_:cas_term) => pure name.getId
      | _ => continue
    -- The binding `unscaled` needs source admission with explicit evidence; the factor does not
    -- use it.
    if name == `unscaled then continue
    let .definition next _ ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
      | throwError "the original binding {name} did not extend its source context"
    session := next
    if name == `g0 then break
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term
      ("factor(g0) through first with cone using proof(" ++
        "CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.DegeneratePlaneFactorization.cone_base_factorization)")
    | throwError "the factor source did not parse"
  let factor ← session.read ⟨source⟩
  unless factor.category.any (·.role == .morphism) do
    throwError "the factor did not read as a morphism"
  checkSelected factor fun value => do
    let scope ← get
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    let some entry := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `cone)
      | throwError "the session lost its cone binding"
    let some cone := bindings.find? (·.id == entry.id)
      | throwError "the original cone lost its exact native binding"
    let some retained ← SourceReadM.selection? value
      | throwError "the factor lost its exact original selected binding"
    let some field := retained.field
      | throwError "the factor lost its selected original computation field"
    unless field.projection == ``CasCatalogue.MonoLiftFactorComputation.factor do
      throwError "the factor changed its selected original computation field"
    let count ← visitNativeData (fun applied => do
      unless applied.isAppOf ``CasCatalogue.MonoLiftFactorComputation.factor do return false
      unless ← applied.getAppArgs.anyM fun original =>
          originatesAt scope.context scope.selections original cone.expression do
        throwError "the factor lost its actual source arrow: {applied}"
      return true) value
    unless count == 1 do
      throwError "the factor is not the selected lift's one original factor computation"

-- Reuse the original selected application and accepted MonoLift projection terms.
-- This checks native source translation, without deciding any acceptance question.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let path := "tests/acceptance/proposals/independent-extension-reconstruction-20261024/" ++
    "completion/rx-lift-prescribed-stages.cas"
  let file ← SourceFile.parse path (← liftM (m := IO) (IO.FS.readFile path))
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let mut observed := #[]
  let mut questions := #[]
  for item in file.items do
    if let `(cas_item| test $id:ident $_:str : assert $body:cas_term) := item then
      let text := id.getId.toString (escape := false)
      let native := if text.endsWith ".first_inverse_on_carrier" then
          some "CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp alpha1 beta1 = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id firstCarrier"
        else if text.endsWith ".first_inverse_on_scalar" then
          some "CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp beta1 alpha1 = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id scalarModule"
        else none
      if let some native := native then
        let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term native
          | throwError "the native composed-map proposition did not parse"
        let expected ← session.term ⟨parsed⟩
        let question ← file.withContext (session.readQuestion body)
        discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
          let expression ← session.readTerm question
          let expected ← session.readTerm expected
          checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun native => do
            unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
              throwError "the original inverse equation changed its complete native reading"
            checkWithKernel
              (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!) (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
          return expression
        questions := questions.push text
      continue
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item | continue
    if let `(cas_stmt| assert $_:cas_term) := statement then continue
    let name ← match statement with
      | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident := $_:cas_term) => pure name.getId
      | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident($_:cas_term) := $_:cas_term) => pure name.getId
      | _ => continue
    let formed ← try file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
      catch error => throwError "original binding {name}: {error.toMessageData}"
    let .definition next value := formed
      | throwError "the original selected lift did not extend its source context"
    session.withTerm value fun _ _ _ => pure ()
    let previous ← authoredEntries session.context session.selections
    let current ← authoredEntries value.source.context value.selections
    unless current.map (·.id) == previous.map (·.id) do
      throwError "the selected lift changed its original ordered authored context"
    let expectedName := match name with
      | `X1 => some "CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.DegeneratePlaneLifts.firstObject"
      | `i1 => some "CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.DegeneratePlaneLifts.firstInclusion"
      | `alpha1 => some "CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.DegeneratePlaneLifts.alpha"
      | `beta1 => some "CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.DegeneratePlaneLifts.beta"
      | `unscaledRaw => some "(![(4 : ℚ), (-4 : ℚ)])"
      | _ => none
    if let some expectedName := expectedName then
      let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term expectedName
        | throwError "the owned lift projection did not parse"
      let expected ← session.term ⟨parsed⟩
      discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
        let expression ← session.readTerm value
        let expected ← session.readTerm expected
        checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun native => do
          unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
            throwError "the original lift projection {name} changed its selected native application"
          checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
            (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
        return expression
      observed := observed.push name
    session := next
    if name == `i0 then
      for (input, proof, detail) in #[
          ("i0", "True.intro", "explicit monicity evidence"),
          ("underlyingF",
            "CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.DegeneratePlaneLifts.kernelInclusion_mono",
            "different original inclusion")] do
        let text := "lift(X) along «lift.bilin_module.restrict»(ℚ, ℚ) with " ++
          input ++ " using proof(" ++ proof ++ ")"
        let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
          | throwError "the selected lift evidence control did not parse"
        let rejected ← withoutModifyingState do
          try
            discard <| session.read ⟨parsed⟩
            pure false
          catch error =>
            let message ← error.toMessageData.toString
            unless (message.splitOn detail).length > 1 do throw error
            pure true
        unless rejected do
          throwError "a selected lift accepted evidence for a different source input"
    if name == `unscaledRaw then break
  unless observed == #[`X1, `i1, `alpha1, `beta1, `unscaledRaw] && questions.size == 2 do
    throwError "the original lift context did not supply its projections, equations and raw point"
