namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

-- Match the complete native diagram, including its category structure, before
-- projecting any field. Reuse: LimitEntry and the native LimitCone/ColimitCocone family.
private def limitPresentation (row : LimitEntry) (diagram : Expr) :
    TermElabM (Option Expr) := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration row.declaration
  let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels row.declaration
  let (parameters, _, result) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration)
  let result ← whnfR result
  let constructor := if row.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone
    else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone
  unless result.isAppOf constructor do
    throwError "the registered universal presentation has a different native result family"
  let expected ← mkAppM constructor #[diagram]
  unless ← isDefEq result expected do return none
  let presentation ← instantiateMVars (mkAppN declaration parameters)
  if presentation.hasMVar || presentation.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the registered universal presentation requires its complete declaration parameters"
  return some presentation

/-- Prepare the original owner under every formal M parameter before substituting actual
source arguments. Equal actual terms therefore retain their different declaration positions.
The returned template is also the authority for later whole-cone demand. -/
private def preparedSourceLimit (row : LimitEntry) (family : LimitFamily) (presentation : Expr)
    (construction : Name) : SourceReadM (NativeLimitInterface × Expr) := do
  unless (SelectedSourceReference.limit row).exactlyMatches (.limit family.entry) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected limit changed its complete original row"
  let .const declaration levels := presentation.consumeMData.getAppFn
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected limit lost its complete native declaration application"
  unless declaration == row.declaration &&
      presentation.getAppNumArgs == family.parameterCount do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected limit changed its complete formal parameter telescope"
  let scope ← get
  let owner ← family.prepareOwner scope.identities levels construction
  let selection ← family.ownerAt owner presentation.getAppArgs
  unless selection.source.construction == construction &&
      selection.source.interface.presentation.consumeMData.equal presentation.consumeMData do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected limit changed its original positional application"
  return (selection.source.interface, ← owner.bind family)

/-- Form the declared binary presentation at the original complete source objects.
Reuse: Limits.pair, LimitEntry and the accepted native cone/cocone projections.
The category bundle fixes the diagram's chosen structure and dependent parameters. -/
opaque sourceBinaryLimit (left right : NativeSourceJudgement) (colimit : Bool) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let left ← if left.category.isSome then pure left else sourceSetJudgement .object left.value
  let right ← if right.category.isSome then pure right else sourceSetJudgement .object right.value
  -- Objects of different selected categories meet in sets: each operand is its carrier, read
  -- through its whole structural carrier route (`Fin(2) × ℤ/3`).
  let (left, right) ← match left.category, right.category with
    | some source, some target =>
      if source.expression.syntacticEq target.expression then pure (left, right)
      else pure (← sourceCarrier left, ← sourceCarrier right)
    | _, _ => pure (left, right)
  let some source := left.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source binary construction requires its selected category"
  let some target := right.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source binary construction requires its selected category"
  unless source.role == .object && target.role == .object do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source binary construction requires objects"
  unless source.expression.syntacticEq target.expression &&
      (← isDefEq source.bundle target.bundle) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source binary construction has different complete selected categories"
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.expression.syntacticEq source.expression)
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "source binary construction requires its declared complete category"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration category.declaration
  let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[source.bundle]
  let categoryInstance ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.str #[source.bundle]
  let diagram ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.pair
    #[some carrier, some categoryInstance, some left.value, some right.value]
  let shape := if colimit then "coproduct" else "product"
  let mut candidates := #[]
  for row in state.limits do
    unless row.category == category.id && row.colimit == colimit && row.shape == shape do continue
    let applicable ← withoutModifyingState do
      return (← limitPresentation row diagram).isSome
    if applicable then candidates := candidates.push row
  let #[row] := candidates
    | if candidates.isEmpty then
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource
          "source binary construction has no applicable declared universal presentation"
      else
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity
          "source binary construction requires its selected universal presentation"
  let some presentation ← limitPresentation row diagram
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected universal presentation changed its complete diagram"
  let construction ← mkFreshUserName `selectedLimit
  let family ← LimitFamily.forId row.id
  let (interface, ownerFamily) ← preparedSourceLimit row family presentation construction
  let cone ← mkAppM (if colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone.cocone
    else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.cone) #[presentation]
  let apex ← mkAppM (if colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.pt
    else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt) #[cone]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType apex) carrier do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the universal presentation changed its complete selected category"
  -- The apex is the registered limit's named object at its diagram, as for a limit named by
  -- its shape: the lowerer sends it as that row's descriptor, not the presentation record.
  let reference ← sourceReferenceAt (.limit row) presentation apex
  let value ← SourceReadM.select { reference with limitFamily := some family }
  return ← retainLimitConstruction ⟨value,
    some ⟨.object, source.expression, source.bundle, none,
      some ⟨row.id.raw, row.declaration, cone, colimit, source.expression, source.bundle,
        presentation, diagram, interface, construction, some ownerFamily, none, none, #[]⟩⟩⟩

/-- Typed inputs of one applicable accepted creation/presentation pair. This is source
preparation only; the actual target completion and universal data remain runtime inputs. -/
private structure PreparedCreationSource where
  family : CreationFamily
  evidence : Expr
  functor : Expr
  diagram : Expr
  targetBundle : Expr
  targetPresentation : Expr
  targetFamily : LimitFamily

/-- Retain the selected action's complete declaration and the original arrow slots before
forming the target presentation. Its implicit object parameters use that same action's object
family; the native Hom keeps its original universe, carrier and Quiver dictionary. -/
private def creationTargetMap (edge : EdgeRef) (functor arrow : Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let native ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map #[functor, arrow]
  unless native.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map 8 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the created target map lost its native action telescope"
  let stated ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType arrow)
  let stated ← if stated.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure stated else whnfR stated
  let inputs := if stated.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
      (native.getAppArgs.set! 5 stated.getAppArgs[2]!).set! 6 stated.getAppArgs[3]!
    else if stated.isAppOfArity ``TypeCat.Hom 2 then
      (native.getAppArgs.set! 5 stated.getAppArgs[0]!).set! 6 stated.getAppArgs[1]!
    else native.getAppArgs
  let inputs := inputs.set! 7 arrow
  let native := mkAppN native.getAppFn inputs
  check native
  let objects ← SourceActionFamily.forEdge edge
  let application ← routedActionApplication objects functor
  let .const declaration levels := application.consumeMData.getAppFn
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the created target map lost its original action declaration"
  let maps ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.action edge)
  unless declaration == objects.declaration && declaration == maps.declaration do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the created target map changed its original action owner"
  let declarationInputs := application.getAppArgs
  let parameters := declarationInputs ++ inputs.extract 5 8
  let (selected, bundle) ← maps.arrowAt levels parameters
  unless ← isDefEq selected native do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the created target map changed its original native action"
  let source ← SourceReadM.select (← objects.selected levels declarationInputs inputs[5]!)
  let target ← SourceReadM.select (← objects.selected levels declarationInputs inputs[6]!)
  let originalType ← inferType native
  let originalType ← if originalType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure originalType
    else whnfR originalType
  unless originalType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the created target map lost its complete native Hom interface"
  let expected := mkAppN originalType.getAppFn
    ((originalType.getAppArgs.set! 2 source).set! 3 target)
  let (domain, _) ← categoricalPointEndpoints selected
  let identity ← categoricalPointIdentity bundle domain
  let family ← if (← maps.carrierFamily?).isSome then maps.asReference else maps.asWhole
  let value ← family.selected levels parameters domain { value := identity }
  SourceReadM.select value (some expected)

private def prepareCreatedLimitCandidate (state : SemanticState)
    (selected : NativeSourceCategory) (lift : LiftEntry) (target : NamedCategoryEntry)
    (row : LimitEntry) (maps : Array NativeSourceJudgement) :
    SourceReadM (Option PreparedCreationSource) := do
  let some steps := state.routeEdges? selected.expression target.expression #[lift.edge]
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected creation lift is not a route of its own original step"
  let some diagram ← CreationFamily.diagramAt? row selected.bundle (maps.map (·.value))
    | return none
  let routed ← nativeRouteFunctor state
    { source := selected.expression, target := target.expression, steps } selected.bundle
  let family ← CreationFamily.forLift lift
  let some evidence ← family.evidenceAt? routed.functor diagram | return none
  let mapped ← maps.mapM fun map =>
    creationTargetMap lift.edge routed.functor map.value
  let some targetPresentation ←
      CreationFamily.presentationAt? row routed.target mapped | return none
  let mappedDiagram ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.comp #[diagram, routed.functor]
  -- Validate the same original comparison before treating this pair as applicable.
  -- The final selection retains its original whole owner family instead of this probe.
  discard <| prepareLimitInterface row targetPresentation (some mappedDiagram)
  return some ⟨family, evidence, routed.functor, diagram, routed.target, targetPresentation,
    ← LimitFamily.forId row.id⟩

/-- Prepare the fixed selected creation under its source constructor's original formal inputs.
The same retained target owner family supplies its original constructor universes and schema;
only its declared parameter positions are substituted. -/
private def creationSourceOwner (prepared : PreparedCreationSource)
    (selected : NativeSourceCategory) (row : LimitEntry) (targetOwner : Expr)
    (targetTemplate : SelectedLimitOwner Expr) (construction : Name) (diagram : Expr) :
    SourceReadM NativeLimitSelection := do
  let (_, sourceArguments) ← LimitFamily.diagramPorts diagram
  let mapped ← sourceArguments.mapM fun argument =>
    creationTargetMap prepared.family.entry.edge prepared.functor argument
  let some targetPresentation ←
      CreationFamily.presentationAt? row prepared.targetBundle mapped
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected creation lost its original target family at the formal source inputs"
  let target ← prepared.targetFamily.ownerAt targetTemplate targetPresentation.getAppArgs
  unless target.source.construction == construction && target.source.row == row.id.raw &&
      target.source.interface.presentation.equal targetPresentation do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the created source changed its exact target owner application"
  let mappedDiagram ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.comp #[diagram, prepared.functor]
  let interface ← NativeLimitInterface.withRequestedDiagram target.source.interface row mappedDiagram
  let creation ← prepared.family.interfaceAt prepared.evidence prepared.functor diagram interface
  let presentation ← NativeLimitCreationInterface.presentation creation
  let cone ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.cone #[presentation]
  let apex ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt #[cone]
  NativeLimitSelection.ofSource {
    row := row.id.raw, declaration := row.declaration, cone, colimit := false
    category := selected.expression, bundle := selected.bundle, presentation, diagram, interface
    construction, ownerFamily := some targetOwner, creation := some creation } apex

/-- Construct the selected source owner under its exact original native diagram telescope.
Every action selection remains in the same scope, lambda-lifted over these formal identities. -/
private partial def creationSourceTemplate (prepared : PreparedCreationSource)
    (selected : NativeSourceCategory) (row : LimitEntry) (targetOwner : Expr)
    (targetTemplate : SelectedLimitOwner Expr) (construction : Name) (template : Expr) :
    SourceReadM (SelectedLimitOwner Expr) := do
  match template with
  | .lam name domain body binderInfo =>
    SourceReadM.withBinder name domain none binderInfo
      (fun binding owner => do
        let owner ← owner.mapM fun field =>
          mkLambdaFVars #[binding.expression] field (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
        return { owner with formalBindings := #[binding.id] ++ owner.formalBindings })
      (fun parameter =>
        creationSourceTemplate prepared selected row targetOwner targetTemplate construction
          (body.instantiate1 parameter))
  | .letE name type value body _ =>
    SourceReadM.withBinder name type (some value) .default
      (fun binding owner => owner.mapM fun field =>
        mkLetFVars #[binding.expression] field (usedLetOnly := false)
          (generalizeNondepLet := false))
      (fun parameter =>
        creationSourceTemplate prepared selected row targetOwner targetTemplate construction
          (body.instantiate1 parameter))
  | diagram =>
    return ⟨← creationSourceOwner prepared selected row targetOwner targetTemplate
      construction diagram, #[]⟩

/-- Resolve every applicable accepted creation/presentation pair, independently of provider
availability and storage order. The diagram constructor comes from the declared standardization.
Only an actual absence or failed native applicability is skipped; required-data errors propagate.

The explicit state is the ordinary accepted source inventory (as in nativeRouteFunctor).
It also permits the original multiplicity controls to exercise both inventory orders without
declaring new mathematical examples or changing the formal operation. -/
opaque sourceCreatedLimit? (state : SemanticState) (shape : String)
    (selected : NativeSourceCategory) (maps : Array NativeSourceJudgement) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let mut candidates : Array (LiftEntry × NamedCategoryEntry × LimitEntry) := #[]
  for lift in state.lifts do
    unless lift.kind == .createsLimits shape do continue
    let #[edge] := state.structuralEdges.filter (·.ref == lift.edge)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected creation lift lost its unique original structural edge"
    unless edge.source.syntacticEq selected.expression do continue
    for target in state.categories do
      unless target.expression.syntacticEq edge.target do continue
      for row in state.limits do
        unless !row.colimit && row.category == target.id && row.shape == shape do continue
        let applicable ← SourceReadM.inspect do
          return (← prepareCreatedLimitCandidate state selected lift target row maps).isSome
        if applicable then candidates := candidates.push (lift, target, row)
  let #[(lift, target, row)] := candidates
    | if candidates.isEmpty then return none
      else
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity
          m!"the created {shape} has several applicable accepted lift/presentation pairs"
  let some prepared ← prepareCreatedLimitCandidate state selected lift target row maps
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected creation changed its complete native applicability"
  let construction ← mkFreshUserName `selectedLimit
  let (_, ownerFamily) ←
    preparedSourceLimit row prepared.targetFamily prepared.targetPresentation construction
  let (sourceTelescope, positions) ← CreationFamily.sourceTelescope prepared.diagram
  let scope ← get
  let targetTemplate ← SelectedLimitOwner.ofBinding scope.context scope.selections ownerFamily
  let creationTemplate ← creationSourceTemplate prepared selected row ownerFamily
    targetTemplate construction sourceTelescope
  let creationFamily ← creationTemplate.bind prepared.targetFamily
    (some (prepared.family, prepared.targetFamily))
  let arguments ← positions.mapM fun index => do
    let some argument := prepared.diagram.getAppArgs[index]?
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the created source lost an original constructor input position"
    pure argument
  let retained ← creationTemplate.specialize arguments
  let source := { retained.source with
    ownerFamily := some ownerFamily
    creationFamily := some creationFamily
    creationInputs := positions }
  let reference ← sourceReferenceAt (.limit row) prepared.targetPresentation retained.receiver
  let value ← SourceReadM.select { reference with
    limitFamily := some prepared.targetFamily
    creationOwner := some (prepared.family, prepared.targetFamily) }
  return some (← retainLimitConstruction {
    value
    category := some {
      role := .object, expression := selected.expression, bundle := selected.bundle,
      limit := some source } })

/-- A registered limit or colimit named by its shape and applied to the maps of its diagram
(`pullback(f, g)`, `cokernel(m)`): the apex of the declared cone or cocone at those maps, in the
category of the maps. Reuse: LimitEntry and the native LimitCone/ColimitCocone family. A row
whose declaration does not accept the maps is not a candidate; several accepting rows are a
semantic ambiguity. -/
opaque sourceNamedLimit (shape : String) (maps : Array NativeSourceJudgement) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let rows := state.limits.filter (·.shape == shape)
  if rows.isEmpty then return none
  let some selected := maps[0]?.bind (·.category)
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the universal construction {shape} requires maps of a selected category"
  unless maps.all (·.category.any (·.role == .morphism)) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the universal construction {shape} is applied to the maps of its diagram"
  let references := Array.replicate maps.size (← liftM (m := TermElabM) getRef)
  let present (row : LimitEntry) : TermElabM (Option Expr) := do
    discard <| checkedDeclaration row.declaration
    let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels row.declaration
    let explicitCount ← withoutModifyingState do
      let (_, binders, result) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration)
      let constructor := if row.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone
        else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone
      unless (← whnfR result).isAppOf constructor do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered universal presentation has a different native result family"
      return (binders.filter (·.isExplicit)).size
    unless maps.size == explicitCount do return none
    let applied ← elabSourceApplicationApplicable declaration references none fun index _ => do
      let some map := maps[index]?
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the universal presentation lost an original map"
      return .ok map.value
    let .ok (value, _) := applied | return none
    let value ← instantiateMVars value
    if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the presentation of {shape} has undetermined parameters"
    return some value
  let mut candidates := #[]
  for row in rows do
    -- Applicability is the declaration's own typing at the actual maps.
    let accepts ← withoutModifyingState do
      return (← present row).isSome
    if accepts then candidates := candidates.push row
  if candidates.isEmpty then
    if let some created ← sourceCreatedLimit? state shape selected maps then return some created
  let #[row] := candidates
    | if candidates.isEmpty then
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource m!"no registered {shape} accepts these maps"
      else liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity s!"several registered presentations of {shape} accept these maps"
  let some presentation ← present row
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected universal presentation no longer accepts its original maps"
  let construction ← mkFreshUserName `selectedLimit
  let family ← LimitFamily.forId row.id
  let (interface, ownerFamily) ← preparedSourceLimit row family presentation construction
  let cone ← mkAppM (if row.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone.cocone
    else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.cone) #[presentation]
  let apex ← mkAppM (if row.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.pt
    else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt) #[cone]
  let reference ← sourceReferenceAt (.limit row) presentation apex
  let value ← SourceReadM.select { reference with limitFamily := some family }
  return some (← retainLimitConstruction ⟨value,
    some ⟨.object, selected.expression, selected.bundle, none,
      some ⟨row.id.raw, row.declaration, cone, row.colimit,
        selected.expression, selected.bundle, presentation, interface.diagram, interface,
        construction, some ownerFamily, none, none, #[]⟩⟩⟩)

/-- Read finite native constructor syntax at the original index type. Type synonyms are
transparent to this schema check; constructor fields must themselves have finite, independent
native constructor schemas. No runtime data, proof inhabitant or diagram port is consulted. -/
private partial def constructionCases (indexType : Expr) : TermElabM (Array Expr) := do
  let nativeType ← instantiateMVars (← withTransparency .all <| whnf indexType)
  if nativeType.hasMVar || nativeType.hasLevelMVar then
    throwStratum .invalid m!"the construction index type is not determined"
  let .const name levels := nativeType.getAppFn
    | throwStratum .invalid m!"the construction index {indexType} is not a finite native enumeration"
  let .inductInfo info ← getConstInfo name
    | throwStratum .invalid m!"the construction index {indexType} has no native constructor schema"
  unless !info.isRec && info.numIndices == 0 &&
      nativeType.getAppNumArgs == info.numParams do
    throwStratum .invalid m!"an ordinal cannot select a recursive or indexed constructor of {indexType}"
  let mut alternatives := #[]
  for constructor in info.ctors do
    let .ctorInfo constructorInfo ← getConstInfo constructor | unreachable!
    let head := mkAppN (mkConst constructor levels) nativeType.getAppArgs
    let values ← forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType head) fun fields result => do
      unless fields.size == constructorInfo.numFields && (← isDefEq result nativeType) do
        throwStratum .invalid m!"the construction index lost its original constructor telescope"
      let mut values := #[head]
      for field in fields, index in [:fields.size] do
        let domain ← inferType field
        if (← isProp domain) ||
            (fields.extract 0 index).any (fun prior => domain.containsFVar prior.fvarId!) then
          throwStratum .invalid m!"an ordinal cannot supply proof or dependent constructor fields of {indexType}"
        let choices ← constructionCases domain
        let mut next := #[]
        for value in values do
          for choice in choices do
            next := next.push (mkApp value choice)
        values := next
      return values
    for value in values do
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) indexType do
        throwStratum .invalid m!"the index constructor does not inhabit {indexType}"
      check value
    alternatives := alternatives ++ values
  return alternatives

/-- The object of a diagram's index type that the ordinal `ordinal` names: the number itself in
`ℕ`, `⟨ordinal, _⟩` in `Fin n` when it is below `n`, else the `ordinal`-th constructor of a closed
enumeration. A native Discrete index wraps that same underlying selection by Discrete.mk.
Any other index, or an ordinal outside it, is invalid.
Reference: the original reader's `constructionIndex` (CasCatalogue/Language.lean). -/
private partial def constructionIndex (indexType : Expr) (ordinal : Nat) : TermElabM Expr := do
  let indexType ← instantiateMVars (← whnfR indexType)
  if indexType.hasMVar || indexType.hasLevelMVar then
    throwStratum .invalid m!"the construction index type is not determined"
  if indexType.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Discrete 1 then
    let selected ← constructionIndex indexType.appArg! ordinal
    let index ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Discrete.mk
      #[some indexType.appArg!, some selected]
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType index) indexType do
      throwStratum .invalid m!"the index constructor does not inhabit {indexType}"
    return index
  if indexType.isConstOf ``Nat then return mkNatLit ordinal
  if indexType.isAppOfArity ``Fin 1 then
    let bound := indexType.appArg!
    let below ← mkAppM ``LT.lt #[mkNatLit ordinal, bound]
    let proof ← try mkDecideProof below
      catch _ => throwStratum .invalid m!"the construction index {ordinal} is outside {indexType}"
    return mkApp3 (mkConst ``Fin.mk) bound (mkNatLit ordinal) proof
  let alternatives ← constructionCases indexType
  let some index := alternatives[ordinal]?
    | throwStratum .invalid m!"the construction index {ordinal} is outside {indexType}"
  return index

/-- `K.leg(j)`: the defining leg of the registered limit or colimit `K` at the object of its shape
that the ordinal `j` names (constitution C7: a universal construction supplies its defining maps).
The row and the cone or cocone are the selection that the formation of `K` retained in its
judgement (constitution C23); a receiver with no such selection is not a limit. The leg is the
cone's `π` or the cocone's `ι` at that object, marked with the limit's row and the ordinal, so
that it is sent as the limit's named leg and not unfolded (C22). Reference: the original reader's
`constructionLeg` (CasCatalogue/Language.lean). -/
def sourceLimitLeg? (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (ordinal : Nat) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let some category := receiver.category | return none
  let some selection := category.limit | return none
  let some retained ← SourceReadM.selection? receiver.value
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected construction lost its original typed reference"
  let some presentation ← sourceApplication? selection.declaration retained
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected construction lost its original registered application"
  let some (.limit row) := retained.reference
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected construction changed its original registered row"
  let cone := selection.cone
  let colimit := selection.colimit
  let leg ← mkAppM (if colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.ι
    else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.π) #[cone]
  let component ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[leg]
  let .forallE _ indexType _ _ ← whnf (← inferType component)
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the defining leg has no shape index"
  let index ← constructionIndex indexType ordinal
  let native := mkApp component index
  check native
  let homType ← inferType native
  let homType ← if homType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure homType else whnfR homType
  unless homType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the defining leg lost its complete native morphism type"
  let endpoints := homType.getAppArgs.set! (if colimit then 3 else 2) receiver.value
  let expected := mkAppN homType.getAppFn endpoints
  let hom ← retainLimitLeg category receiver.value index native (some expected)
  let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? hom
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the defining leg lost its original typed component"
  let reference ← sourceReferenceAt (.limit row) presentation hom
  let hom ← selectMorphism { selected with
      value := hom
      reference := reference.reference
      originalApplication := reference.originalApplication
      legOrdinal := some ordinal }
    (fun value expected => SourceReadM.select value expected) (some selection.bundle)
  return some ⟨hom, some ⟨.morphism, selection.category, selection.bundle, none, none⟩⟩

end CasCompiler

module

import CasCompiler.Read
import CasCompiler.Parse
import CasCompiler.SourceTestSupport
import LeanCategories.Catalogue
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.Read
meta import CasCompiler.Parse
meta import CasCompiler.SourceTestSupport
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler
open CasCompiler.SourceTest

/-- Read `text` after `let C := cokernel(to_dual(1))` (tests/acceptance/lattices.cas). -/
private def readAtCokernel (text : String) : TermElabM SourceTerm := do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "source-leg.cas" "let C := cokernel(to_dual(1))\n"
  let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  for item in file.items do
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
      | throwError "the cokernel statement did not parse"
    let .definition next _ ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
      | throwError "the cokernel did not extend its source context"
    session := next
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the leg did not parse"
  session.read ⟨source⟩

/- A universal construction supplies its defining maps (constitution C7): `C.leg(j)` is the leg of
the registered cocone at the object of its shape that the ordinal `j` names, the `j`-th constructor
of the shape's enumeration (the original reader's `constructionLeg`). The cokernel's shape is
`WalkingParallelPair`; its leg at `one` is the quotient map. An ordinal outside the shape is
invalid. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let leg ← readAtCokernel "C.leg(1)"
  unless leg.category.any (·.role == .morphism) do
    throwError "`C.leg(1)` did not read as a morphism"
  checkSelected leg fun value => do
    let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value
      | throwError "the cokernel leg lost its original typed selection"
    let some retained := selected.leg
      | throwError "the cokernel leg lost its original cone component"
    unless retained.value.containsConst (· == ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.ι) &&
        retained.index.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingParallelPair.one do
      throwError "`C.leg(1)` is not the cocone's leg at `one`: {value}"
  let failure ← try
      discard <| readAtCokernel "C.leg(2)"
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  match failure with
  | none => throwError "an ordinal outside the cokernel's shape was admitted"
  | some error =>
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? error == some .invalid do throw error

/- The formation of a limit retains its selection (constitution C23): the binding of `C` carries
the row of the registered cokernel and its cocone. `C.leg(j)` is read from that selection, not from
the apex. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "source-leg.cas" "let C := cokernel(to_dual(1))\n"
  let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  for item in file.items do
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
      | throwError "the cokernel statement did not parse"
    let .definition next _ ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
      | throwError "the cokernel did not extend its source context"
    session := next
  let some entry := session.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the cokernel added no declaration"
  let some category := session.categoryFor entry.id
    | throwError "the cokernel has no selected category"
  let some limit := category.limit
    | throwError "the binding of the cokernel did not retain its limit selection"
  unless limit.colimit do throwError "the retained selection is not a colimit"
  let state ← CasCatalogue.semanticState
  unless state.limits.any (fun row => row.id.raw == limit.row && row.colimit) do
    throwError "the retained selection names no registered colimit row: {limit.row}"

-- A binary product's published diagram is indexed by Discrete WalkingPair. The
-- ordinal chooses its existing left/right constructor, wrapped by the actual Discrete
-- constructor; the defining map still comes from the original retained cone.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term "Fin(2) × Fin(3)"
    | throwError "the original product source did not parse"
  let product ← empty.read ⟨source⟩
  let some category := product.category
    | throwError "the original product lost its selected category"
  let some selection := category.limit
    | throwError "the original product lost its selected cone"
  checkSelected product fun value => do
    let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value
      | throwError "product formation lost its shared original construction anchor"
    let some retained := selected.limit
      | throwError "product formation lost its shared original construction anchor"
    unless retained.source.construction == selection.construction &&
        !selection.construction.isAnonymous do
      throwError "product formation changed its original construction identity"
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `P product
  for (ordinal, constructor) in #[
      (0, ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair.left),
      (1, ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair.right)] do
    let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term s!"P.leg({ordinal})"
      | throwError "the product leg source did not parse"
    let leg ← session.read ⟨source⟩
    unless leg.category.any (fun actual => actual.role == .morphism &&
        actual.expression.syntacticEq category.expression) do
      throwError "the product leg changed its original source category"
    checkSelected leg fun value => do
      let scope ← get
      let cone ← selection.cone.inContext scope.context
      let projection ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.π #[cone]
      let component ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[projection]
      let index ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Discrete.mk #[Lean.mkConst constructor]
      let expected := mkApp component index
      let some retained ← NativeLimitLegSelection.ofExpr? scope.context scope.selections value
        | throwError "the product leg lost its typed original receiver/index demand"
      unless retained.construction.source.construction == selection.construction &&
          retained.construction.source.cone.equal cone && retained.index.equal index do
        throwError "the product leg changed its construction, original cone or native index"
      unless retained.value.containsConst (· == ``CategoryTheory.Discrete.mk) &&
          retained.value.containsConst (· == constructor) do
        throwError "the product leg changed its original actual diagram index"
      checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "the product leg changed the original cone component"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
          (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term "P.leg(2)"
    | throwError "the invalid product leg source did not parse"
  let failure ← try
      discard <| session.read ⟨source⟩
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "the product admitted an ordinal outside its actual two-object shape"
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .invalid do throw failure

-- Equal definitions are distinct diagram inputs. In particular a module-valued
-- product's second leg must retain Y even though the first candidate X is convertible.
-- The Sets case checks the same retained cone interface without selecting another shape.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let readAt := fun (session : SourceSession) (text : String) => do
    let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
      | throwError "the retained-endpoint source did not parse"
    session.read ⟨source⟩
  for objectSource in #["RegularModule(ℤ)", "Fin(3)"] do
    let object ← readAt empty objectSource
    let session ← empty.defineTerm `X object
    let session ← session.defineTerm `Y object
    let product ← readAt session "X × Y"
    let some category := product.category
      | throwError "the equal-input product lost its selected category"
    let some selection := category.limit
      | throwError "the equal-input product lost its retained cone"
    let session ← session.defineTerm `P product
    let some first := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `X)
      | throwError "the first original diagram input is absent"
    let some second := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `Y)
      | throwError "the second original diagram input is absent"
    for (ordinal, constructor, selected) in #[
        (0, ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair.left, first.id),
        (1, ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair.right, second.id)] do
      let leg ← readAt session s!"P.leg({ordinal})"
      discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
        let value ← session.readTerm leg
        let scope ← get
        let context := scope.context
        let some first := context.bindings.find? (·.id == first.id)
          | throwError "the first diagram input is outside its original context"
        let some second := context.bindings.find? (·.id == second.id)
          | throwError "the second diagram input is outside its original context"
        let some chosen := context.bindings.find? (·.id == selected)
          | throwError "the selected diagram input is outside its original context"
        unless first.expression != second.expression do
          throwError "the endpoint control merged distinct source bindings"
        checkOriginal #[first.expression, second.expression] fun native => do
          unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
            throwError "the endpoint control lost its equal-valued source bindings"
        let cone ← selection.cone.inContext context
        for original in #[first.expression, second.expression] do
          unless (← visitNativeData (fun term =>
              originatesAt context scope.selections term original false) cone false) > 0 do
            throwError "product formation discarded one of its exact original diagram inputs"
        let projection ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.π #[cone]
        let component ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[projection]
        let index ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Discrete.mk #[Lean.mkConst constructor]
        let expected := mkApp component index
        let some (_, originalTarget) ← SourceReader.mapEnds expected
          | throwError "the original cone component lost its native endpoints"
        let some (_, actualTarget) ← SourceReader.mapEnds value
          | throwError "the retained product leg lost its native endpoints"
        -- This fixture reduces only the declared diagram projection; all actual
        -- context bindings remain opaque, so equal definitions cannot hide a swap.
        let preserveInputs := fun term =>
          withConfig (fun config => { config with zetaDelta := false }) <|
            withTransparency .all (whnf term)
        let originalTarget ← preserveInputs originalTarget
        let actualTarget := (selectedEndpoint? context scope.selections actualTarget).getD actualTarget
        let actualTarget ← preserveInputs actualTarget
        unless ← originatesAt context scope.selections originalTarget chosen.expression false do
          throwError "the native product diagram changed its stated ordinal input"
        unless ← originatesAt context scope.selections actualTarget chosen.expression false do
          throwError "the product leg replaced its actual diagram endpoint by an equal-valued input"
        checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
          unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
            throwError "the product leg changed its exact retained cone component"
          checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
            (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
        return value

-- A named cokernel's leg and its actual map action retain the selected apex binding.
-- C and Cagain have equal native definitions but are distinct original source inputs.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let readAt := fun (session : SourceSession) (text : String) => do
    let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
      | throwError "the named-apex source did not parse"
    session.read ⟨source⟩
  let object ← readAt empty "cokernel(to_dual(1))"
  let some selection := object.category.bind (·.limit)
    | throwError "the named cokernel lost its retained cocone"
  let independent ← readAt empty "cokernel(to_dual(1))"
  let some independentSelection := independent.category.bind (·.limit)
    | throwError "the independent equal cokernel lost its original selection"
  unless selection.construction != independentSelection.construction do
    throwError "independent equal constructions shared a formation identity"
  unless selection.colimit do
    throwError "the named cokernel control changed its construction direction"
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `C object
  let session ← session.defineTerm `Cagain object
  for name in #[`C, `Cagain] do
    let leg ← readAt session s!"{name}.leg(1)"
    let mapped ← readAt session
      s!"map {name}.leg(1) along «fun.bil_wform.base_change»(ℤ, ℚ)"
    discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      let value ← session.readTerm leg
      let mapped ← session.readTerm mapped
      let scope ← get
      let context := scope.context
      let some original := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == name)
        | throwError "the named apex has no original source binding"
      let some other := session.context.entries.find? (fun entry =>
          entry.userName == (if name == `C then `Cagain else `C))
        | throwError "the equal apex has no independent source binding"
      let some receiver := context.bindings.find? (·.id == original.id)
        | throwError "the named apex is outside its original source context"
      let some otherReceiver := context.bindings.find? (·.id == other.id)
        | throwError "the equal apex is outside its original source context"
      unless receiver.expression != otherReceiver.expression do
        throwError "the control merged its distinct apex bindings"
      checkOriginal #[receiver.expression, otherReceiver.expression] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "the control did not retain equal-valued apex definitions"
      let some retained ← NativeLimitLegSelection.ofExpr? context scope.selections value
        | throwError "the named leg lost its original receiver/index demand"
      unless retained.construction.source.construction == selection.construction &&
          retained.construction.receiver.equal receiver.expression &&
          !retained.construction.receiver.equal otherReceiver.expression &&
          retained.index.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingParallelPair.one do
        throwError "the named leg replaced its receiver, shared construction or typed index"
      let some legData ← SourceReadM.selection? value
        | throwError "the named leg lost its original typed source selection"
      let some (.limit row) := legData.reference
        | throwError "the named leg lost its complete original limit row"
      unless row.id.raw == selection.row && row.declaration == selection.declaration &&
          legData.legOrdinal == some 1 do
        throwError "the named leg changed its original row, declaration or ordinal"
      let some (actualSource, actualTarget) ← SourceReader.mapEnds value
        | throwError "the named leg has no complete native endpoints"
      let actualTarget := (selectedEndpoint? context scope.selections actualTarget).getD actualTarget
      unless ← originatesAt context scope.selections actualTarget receiver.expression false do
        throwError "the named leg replaced its original apex with an equal-valued construction"
      let cone ← selection.cone.inContext context
      let projection ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.ι #[cone]
      let component ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[projection]
      let originalLeg := mkApp component (Lean.mkConst ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingParallelPair.one)
      let some (originalSource, _) ← SourceReader.mapEnds originalLeg
        | throwError "the original native component lost its endpoints"
      let actualSource := (selectedEndpoint? context scope.selections actualSource).getD actualSource
      unless actualSource.equal originalSource do
        throwError "apex retention changed the original diagram endpoint"
      check value
      checkOriginal #[value, originalLeg] fun native => do
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
          (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
      let some mapData ← SourceReadM.selection? mapped
        | throwError "the actual base-change map lost its selected source"
      let some application := mapData.application
        | throwError "the actual base-change map lost its complete native application"
      let .point family := application.family
        | throwError "the actual base-change map changed its selected point family"
      let .action (.functor id) := family.owner
        | throwError "the actual base-change map changed its original action owner"
      let image := mapData.value
      unless id.raw == "fun.bil_wform.base_change" &&
          image.getAppFn.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map do
        throwError "the actual base-change map changed its selected native action"
      let arguments := image.getAppArgs
      let some target := arguments[arguments.size - 2]?
        | throwError "the actual base-change map lost its target input"
      let target := (selectedEndpoint? context scope.selections target).getD target
      unless ← originatesAt context scope.selections target receiver.expression false do
        throwError "the actual map action discarded the selected original apex input"
      let some actualLeg := arguments.back?
        | throwError "the actual base-change map lost its original leg input"
      let some actualSelection ← NativeLimitLegSelection.ofExpr? context scope.selections actualLeg
        | throwError "the actual map argument lost its complete original leg selection"
      unless actualSelection.construction.source.construction == selection.construction &&
          actualSelection.construction.receiver.equal receiver.expression do
        throwError "the actual map argument replaced its original construction receiver"
      let some source := arguments[arguments.size - 3]?
        | throwError "the actual map action lost its source input"
      let some endpointData ← SourceReadM.selection? source
        | throwError "the actual map source lost its exact selected endpoint"
      let some endpoint := endpointData.endpoint
        | throwError "the actual map source is not its selected leg endpoint"
      unless endpoint.side == .source &&
          (← originatesAt context scope.selections actualLeg endpoint.arrow false) do
        throwError "the selected endpoint refers to a different leg occurrence"
      let some (legSource, legTarget) ← SourceReader.mapEnds actualLeg
        | throwError "the actual map action lost its leg's complete native endpoints"
      let legSource := (selectedEndpoint? context scope.selections legSource).getD legSource
      let legTarget := (selectedEndpoint? context scope.selections legTarget).getD legTarget
      unless legSource.equal originalSource &&
          (← originatesAt context scope.selections legTarget receiver.expression false) do
        throwError "the actual map action changed an original leg endpoint"
      check mapped
      checkOriginal #[actualLeg, originalLeg] fun native => do
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
          (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
      return mapped

private def nativeTerm (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | throwError "the native limit parameter did not parse"
  return ⟨parsed⟩

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the source limit did not parse"
  return ⟨parsed⟩

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `X (← nativeTerm "Type")
  let session ← session.assume `Y (← nativeTerm "Type")
  for (text, declaration, colimit) in #[
      ("X × Y", ``CasCatalogue.Limits.Registration.setsProduct, false),
      ("X ⊔ Y", ``CasCatalogue.Limits.Registration.setsCoproduct, true)] do
    let object ← session.read (← sourceTerm text)
    let some category := object.category
      | throwError "the source limit lost its selected category"
    unless category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) do
      throwError "the source limit changed its complete selected category"
    checkSelected object fun value => do
      let scope ← get
      let bindings := scope.context.bindings
      let presentation ← mkAppM declaration #[bindings[0]!.expression, bindings[1]!.expression]
      let cone ← mkAppM (if colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone.cocone
        else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.cone) #[presentation]
      let expected ← mkAppM (if colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.pt
        else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt) #[cone]
      let some retained ← SourceReadM.selection? value
        | throwError "the source limit lost its exact selected native binder"
      let some original := retained.originalApplication
        | throwError "the source limit lost its original positional application"
      unless original.getAppFn.isConstOf declaration do
        throwError "the source limit replaced its declared presentation"
      for input in #[bindings[0]!.expression, bindings[1]!.expression] do
        unless ← original.getAppArgs.anyM fun actual =>
            originatesAt scope.context scope.selections actual input false do
          throwError "the source limit replaced an original input object"
      checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "the source limit changed its declared apex"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
          (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))

    let selected ← session.defineTerm `K object
    let selected ← selected.defineTerm `KAgain object
    for name in #[`K, `KAgain] do
      let leg ← selected.read (← sourceTerm s!"{name}.leg(0)")
      checkSelected leg fun value => do
        let scope ← get
        let some authored := selected.context.entries.find? (·.userName == name)
          | throwError "the selected defining leg lost its original authored receiver"
        let some receiver := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == authored.id)
          | throwError "the selected defining leg lost its original native receiver"
        let type ← inferType value
        let type ← if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure type else whnfR type
        unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
          throwError "the selected defining leg lost its native endpoints"
        let apex := type.getAppArgs[if colimit then 3 else 2]!
        let apex := (selectedEndpoint? scope.context scope.selections apex).getD apex
        unless ← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections apex receiver.expression false do
          throwError "the defining leg replaced its selected construction occurrence"

/- A native cone declaration can accept all supplied maps and still require declaration
data that those maps do not determine. The helper control below preserves that distinction
without adding a downstream registry row. The public named pullback remains an independent
consumer control of the actual registered presentation. -/
open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits

def nativeTrialUnresolvedPullback {_extra : Type}
    {X Y Z : LeanCategories.Foundation.Mathlib.Sets.{0}} (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    LimitCone (cospan f g) :=
  CasCatalogue.Limits.Registration.setsPullback f g

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `X (← nativeTerm "Type")
  let original ← session.read (← sourceTerm "pullback(id(X), id(X))")
  let some category := original.category
    | throwError "the named pullback lost its original selected category"
  let some limit := category.limit
    | throwError "the named pullback lost its original cone"
  unless limit.row == "lim.sets.pullback" &&
      limit.declaration == ``CasCatalogue.Limits.Registration.setsPullback &&
      !limit.colimit && limit.category.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) do
    throwError "the named pullback changed its complete selected presentation"
  checkSelected original fun apex => do
    let scope ← get
    let cone ← limit.cone.inContext scope.context
    unless cone.containsConst (· == ``CasCatalogue.Limits.Registration.setsPullback) &&
        (← visitNativeData (fun term => originatesAt scope.context scope.selections term
          scope.context.bindings[0]!.expression false) cone false) > 0 do
      throwError "the named pullback replaced its original source objects or declaration"
    let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt #[cone]
    checkOriginal #[apex, expected] fun native => do
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        throwError "the named pullback lost its selected cone's apex"
      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
        (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
  let identity ← session.read (← sourceTerm "id(X)")
  discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let originalMap ← session.readTerm identity
    let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``nativeTrialUnresolvedPullback
    let arguments := #[originalMap, originalMap]
    let result ← elabSourceApplicationApplicable declaration
      (Array.replicate arguments.size Syntax.missing) none fun index _ => do
        let some argument := arguments[index]?
          | throwError "the native limit control lost an original supplied map"
        return .ok argument
    let .ok (presentation, actual) := result
      | throwError "the native limit control confused undetermined data with a domain mismatch"
    let presentation ← instantiateMVars presentation
    unless actual == arguments && presentation.hasMVar &&
        presentation.getAppFn.isConstOf ``nativeTrialUnresolvedPullback do
      throwError "the native limit helper changed or silently completed the original application"
    return originalMap

private def limitOwnerTerms (limit : NativeSourceLimitSelection) : Array Expr :=
  #[limit.cone, limit.bundle, limit.presentation, limit.diagram,
    limit.interface.presentation, limit.interface.diagram] ++
    limit.interface.standardization.toArray ++ limit.interface.dataConstructor.toArray ++
    limit.ownerFamily.toArray

private def limitOwnerSyntax (original retained : NativeSourceLimitSelection) : Bool :=
  retained.row == original.row && retained.declaration == original.declaration &&
    retained.construction == original.construction &&
    retained.colimit == original.colimit && retained.category.syntacticEq original.category &&
    retained.interface.standardization.isSome == original.interface.standardization.isSome &&
    retained.interface.dataConstructor.isSome == original.interface.dataConstructor.isSome &&
    retained.ownerFamily.isSome == original.ownerFamily.isSome

private def ownerNativeTerms (category : NativeSourceCategory) : Array Expr :=
  #[category.bundle] ++
    category.carrier.toArray.flatMap (fun carrier => carrier.actions ++ carrier.comparisons) ++
    category.limit.toArray.flatMap limitOwnerTerms

/-- Freeze the completed reader judgement before encoding, as SourceSession's ordinary
instantiate-and-close boundary does. Exact comparisons below do not solve metavariables. -/
private def freezeLimitOwner (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) : MetaM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let resolve := fun value => do
    let value ← instantiateMVars value
    if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then
      throwError "the original owner control has unresolved native parameters"
    return value
  let value ← resolve judgement.value
  let category ← judgement.category.mapM fun selected => selected.mapM resolve
  return ⟨value, category⟩

private def checkLimitOwner (expected actual : NativeSourceCategory) : MetaM Unit := do
  unless ({ value := actual.bundle, category := some actual } : SourceSelection Expr).exactlyMatches
      Expr.equal { value := expected.bundle, category := some expected } do
    throwError "the typed owner changed a complete original category or construction field"
  unless actual.role == expected.role &&
      actual.expression.syntacticEq expected.expression && actual.bundle.equal expected.bundle do
    throwError "the typed owner envelope changed the complete selected category"
  let some original := expected.limit
    | throwError "the original source construction lost its selected limit"
  let some retained := actual.limit
    | throwError "the typed owner envelope discarded the selected construction"
  unless limitOwnerSyntax original retained &&
      (limitOwnerTerms retained).size == (limitOwnerTerms original).size &&
      ((limitOwnerTerms retained).zip (limitOwnerTerms original)).all
        (fun (left, right) => left.equal right) do
    throwError "the typed owner envelope replaced part of the original construction"
  match expected.carrier, actual.carrier with
  | none, none => pure ()
  | some original, some retained =>
    unless toJson retained.refs == toJson original.refs &&
        retained.target.syntacticEq original.target &&
        retained.identifications == original.identifications &&
        retained.actions.size == original.actions.size &&
        retained.comparisons.size == original.comparisons.size &&
        (retained.actions.zip original.actions).all (fun (left, right) => left.equal right) &&
        (retained.comparisons.zip original.comparisons).all (fun (left, right) => left.equal right) do
      throwError "construction retention changed an original carrier selection"
  | _, _ => throwError "construction retention added or discarded a carrier selection"

/- A construction passed as a native object or carrier parameter retains its actual cone,
category, row and original source bindings. Native closure transport uses the same fields;
it must not reconstruct a construction from its definitionally equal apex. -/
private def checkLimitEnvelope (session : SourceSession) (text : String) : TermElabM Unit := do
  let source ← sourceTerm text
  let #[retained] ← session.elaborateJudgementsScoped source do
    let original ← readExpression (fun _ => pure none) source none
    let original ← freezeLimitOwner original
    let some category := original.category
      | throwError "the original construction has no selected category"
    let some limit := category.limit
      | throwError "the original construction has no selected cone"
    unless limit.interface.standardization.isSome && limit.interface.dataConstructor.isSome do
      throwError "the independent binary limit row lost its declared computational interface"
    let some ownerFamily := limit.ownerFamily
      | throwError "the original construction lost its full formal owner family"
    let scope ← get
    let owner ← SelectedLimitOwner.ofBinding scope.context scope.selections ownerFamily
    forallTelescope (← inferType owner.selection.receiver) fun formals _ => do
      let formal ← owner.specialize formals
      let parameters := formal.source.interface.presentation.getAppArgs
      unless formal.source.construction == limit.construction &&
          formal.source.ownerFamily.isNone && formals.size == parameters.size &&
          (formals.zip parameters).all (fun (formal, actual) => formal.equal actual) do
        throwError "the owner family replaced or merged complete formal M argument positions"
    let applied ← owner.specialize limit.interface.presentation.getAppArgs
    unless applied.source.construction == limit.construction &&
        applied.source.interface.presentation.equal limit.interface.presentation &&
        applied.source.interface.dataConstructor == limit.interface.dataConstructor do
      throwError "source formation re-prepared its original interface after actual substitution"
    let encoded ← annotateSourceObject category original.value
    let some (decoded, object) ← sourceObjectOrigin? encoded
      | throwError "the selected construction lost its object annotation"
    checkLimitOwner category decoded
    let scope ← get
    unless object.equal encoded &&
        (← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections object original.value) do
      throwError "the owner binding replaced the original construction occurrence"
    discard <| SourceReadM.withLet `sameSpelling (← inferType encoded) encoded fun boundOwner => do
      let some (decoded, object) ← sourceObjectOrigin? boundOwner
        | throwError "an explicitly bound native alias lost the selected construction's owner"
      checkLimitOwner category decoded
      let scope ← get
      unless object.equal boundOwner &&
          (← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections object original.value) do
        throwError "a native alias reconstructed the selected source object"
      return boundOwner
    let carrier ← freezeLimitOwner (← sourceCarrier original)
    let encodedType ← annotateSourceType category original.value carrier.value
    let some decoded ← sourceTypeOrigin? encodedType
      | throwError "the construction's carrier lost its original selected owner"
    checkLimitOwner category decoded.category
    unless decoded.object.equal original.value && decoded.type.equal carrier.value do
      throwError "the typed carrier changed its original object or carrier"
    let scope ← get
    let closed ← scope.context.close encodedType
    let originalObject ← scope.context.close original.value
    let originalCategory ← category.mapM scope.context.close
    let selections ← scope.selections.close scope.context
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| closed.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
      let reopened ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let selections ← selections.inContext reopened
      let assertions : SourceReadM Unit := do
        let some decoded ← sourceTypeOrigin? expression
          | throwError "native context reopening discarded the original selected construction"
        let some reopenedLimit := decoded.category.limit
          | throwError "native context reopening discarded the selected cone"
        checkLimitOwner (← originalCategory.mapM (fun term => term.inContext reopened))
          decoded.category
        unless decoded.object.equal (← originalObject.inContext reopened) &&
            limitOwnerSyntax limit reopenedLimit do
          throwError "native context transport substituted another construction occurrence"
      assertions.runK { identities := scope.identities, context := reopened, selections }
        fun _ _ => pure ()
    return #[original]
    | throwError "the construction owner control changed its statement arity"
  session.withTerm retained fun _ _ _ => pure ()
  let originalEntries ← authoredEntries session.context session.selections
  let actualEntries ← authoredEntries retained.source.context retained.selections
  unless actualEntries.map (·.id) == originalEntries.map (·.id) do
    throwError "construction retention changed its original authored source scope"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let type ← empty.elaborate Syntax.missing fun _ =>
    pure (mkSort (.succ (.param `limitOwnerUniverse)))
  let session ← empty.assumeTerm `X type
  let session ← session.assumeTerm `Y type
  for source in #["X × Y", "X ⊔ Y"] do
    withCurrHeartbeats <| checkLimitEnvelope session source
  let rings ← empty.assume `R (← nativeTerm "RingCat.{0}")
  withCurrHeartbeats <| checkLimitEnvelope rings "RegularModule(R) × RegularModule(R)"

private def requireMalformedOwner (expression : Expr) (category : NativeSourceCategory)
    (typeOwner : Bool) : SourceReadM Unit := do
  let scope ← get
  let some binding := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.expression.equal expression)
    | throwError "the malformed owner control lost its exact binding"
  let some original ← SourceReadM.selection? expression
    | throwError "the malformed owner control lost its original complete typed record"
  let (owner, body, changed) ← if typeOwner then do
      let some origin := original.typeOrigin
        | throwError "the malformed type owner control lost its complete original fields"
      pure (origin.object, origin.type, { original with
        typeOrigin := some { origin with category } })
    else pure (expression, expression, { original with category := some category })
  checkWithKernel body
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    if typeOwner then discard <| annotateSourceType category owner body
    else discard <| annotateSourceObject category owner
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "an inconsistent complete typed owner was accepted at a fresh binder"
  unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
      "a source owner changed its original selected construction" do throw failure
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    discard <| SourceSelectionScope.merge scope.selections
      (({} : SourceSelectionScope Expr).insert binding.id changed)
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "one original source binding accepted a different complete owner record"
  unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
      "one source binding has incompatible retained selections" do throw failure

-- A real module-product structural view adds nonempty carrier actions to the original
-- selected limit. The actions are checked against the independent route declarations;
-- the original limit and the carrier comparisons remain separate typed fields.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `R (← nativeTerm "RingCat.{0}")
  let source ← sourceTerm "RegularModule(R) × RegularModule(R)"
  let #[retained] ← session.elaborateJudgementsScoped source do
    let original ← readExpression (fun _ => pure none) source none
    let original ← freezeLimitOwner original
    let some category := original.category
      | throwError "the structural-view control lost its original selected category"
    let some limit := category.limit
      | throwError "the structural-view control lost its original selected construction"
    let sets := CategoryExpr.atom CategoryId.sets
    let viewed ← freezeLimitOwner (← sourceStructuralView original sets none)
    let some origin ← sourceTypeOrigin? viewed.value
      | throwError "the actual structural view discarded its selected owner"
    let some carrier := origin.category.carrier
      | throwError "the actual structural view retained no carrier selection"
    unless !carrier.actions.isEmpty && !carrier.refs.isEmpty do
      throwError "the structural-view control did not exercise nonempty carrier data"
    let state ← semanticState
    let query ← SourceRoutes.forOwner category.expression sets
    let some routes ← query.finiteRoutes
      | throwError "the actual module carrier route has no finite independent presentation"
    let #[route] := routes.filter (·.refs == carrier.refs)
      | throwError "the structural view did not retain one actual registered route"
    let independent ← nativeRouteFunctor state route category.bundle
    unless carrier.target.syntacticEq sets &&
        carrier.identifications == (category.carrier.map (·.identifications)).getD #[] &&
        carrier.actions.size == independent.actions.size &&
        carrier.comparisons.size == ((category.carrier.map (·.comparisons)).getD #[]).size do
      throwError "the structural view changed its independently selected carrier data"
    for actual in carrier.actions, expected in independent.actions do
      checkOriginal #[actual, expected] fun native => do
        unless ← withoutModifyingState <| isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "the structural view changed an original complete native route action"
    for actual in carrier.comparisons,
        expected in (category.carrier.map (·.comparisons)).getD #[] do
      unless actual.equal expected do
        throwError "construction fields were mistaken for original carrier comparisons"
    let combined := { category with carrier := some carrier }
    checkLimitOwner combined origin.category
    unless origin.object.equal original.value do
      throwError "the structural view replaced its actual original source occurrence"

    let encodedObject ← annotateSourceObject combined original.value
    let some (decoded, _) ← sourceObjectOrigin? encodedObject
      | throwError "the combined carrier/construction owner was not decoded"
    checkLimitOwner combined decoded
    let scope ← get
    let originalCategory ← combined.mapM scope.context.close
    let originalObject ← scope.context.close original.value
    let closed ← scope.context.close viewed.value
    let selections ← scope.selections.close scope.context
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| closed.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
      let reopened ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let selections ← selections.inContext reopened
      let assertions : SourceReadM Unit := do
        let some decoded ← sourceTypeOrigin? expression
          | throwError "reopening lost a combined carrier/construction owner"
        let some reopenedLimit := decoded.category.limit
          | throwError "reopening lost the structural view's original limit"
        let some reopenedCarrier := decoded.category.carrier
          | throwError "reopening lost the structural view's original carrier"
        checkLimitOwner (← originalCategory.mapM (fun term => term.inContext reopened))
          decoded.category
        unless limitOwnerSyntax limit reopenedLimit && reopenedCarrier.refs == carrier.refs &&
            reopenedCarrier.identifications == carrier.identifications &&
            reopenedCarrier.target.syntacticEq carrier.target &&
            reopenedCarrier.actions.size == carrier.actions.size &&
            reopenedCarrier.comparisons.size == carrier.comparisons.size &&
            decoded.object.equal (← originalObject.inContext reopened) do
          throwError "reopening changed complete carrier/construction source data"
      assertions.runK { identities := scope.identities, context := reopened, selections }
        fun _ _ => pure ()

    requireMalformedOwner encodedObject
      { combined with limit := some { limit with declaration := .anonymous } } false
    requireMalformedOwner viewed.value
      { combined with limit := some { limit with colimit := !limit.colimit } } true
    requireMalformedOwner viewed.value
      { combined with limit := some { limit with
        interface := { limit.interface with dataConstructor := none } } } true
    return #[original]
    | throwError "the structural-view control changed its source statement arity"
  session.withTerm retained fun _ _ _ => pure ()
  let originalEntries ← authoredEntries session.context session.selections
  let actualEntries ← authoredEntries retained.source.context retained.selections
  unless actualEntries.map (·.id) == originalEntries.map (·.id) do
    throwError "the structural view changed the original authored source scope"

-- An ordinary owner retains its complete original native data without acquiring a limit.
-- The typed binding holds the original value directly; no native wrapper supplies metadata.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  discard <| empty.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let original ← readExpression (fun _ => pure none) (← sourceTerm "Fin(3)") none
    let original ← freezeLimitOwner original
    let some category := original.category
      | throwError "the ordinary owner control lost its actual selected category"
    unless category.limit.isNone do
      throwError "the ordinary owner control unexpectedly selected a universal presentation"
    let encoded ← annotateSourceObject category original.value
    let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? encoded
      | throwError "the ordinary owner lost its exact original typed binding"
    unless encoded.isFVar && selected.value.equal original.value && selected.limit.isNone do
      throwError "an owner without a limit changed its original native body or gained a limit"
    let some (decoded, object) ← sourceObjectOrigin? encoded
      | throwError "the ordinary owner no longer retains its complete category"
    unless ({ value := category.bundle, category := some category } : SourceSelection Expr).exactlyMatches
        Expr.equal { value := decoded.bundle, category := some decoded } &&
        object.equal encoded && decoded.limit.isNone &&
        (ownerNativeTerms decoded).size == (ownerNativeTerms category).size &&
        ((ownerNativeTerms decoded).zip (ownerNativeTerms category)).all
          (fun (left, right) => left.equal right) do
      throwError "ordinary owner retention changed complete original data"
    return encoded

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the source did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

/- A matrix of Mat₂(ℚ) acting on a vector of ℚ² (tests/acceptance/linear_algebra.cas,
`matrices.application` and `matrices.product`): the registered application `(M, v) ↦ M v` of
Mat is reached with no argument object, its parameters fixed by the matrix, and `M(v)` and
`M*v` read. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let matrices ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "Mat₂(ℚ)")
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `M (← empty.read (← sourceTerm "[1, 2; 3, 4]") (some matrices.source) matrices.selections)
  let vectors ← session.read (← sourceTerm "ℚ²")
  let session ← session.defineTerm `v (← session.read (← sourceTerm "(1, 2)") (some vectors.source) vectors.selections)
  for text in #["M(v)", "M*v"] do
    let product ← session.read (← sourceTerm text)
    checkSelected product fun expression => do
      checkOriginal #[expression] fun native => do
        let value ← instantiateMVars native[0]!
        if value.hasMVar then throwError "`{text}` left a parameter undetermined: {value}"
        unless (value.find? (·.isConstOf ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.LinearAlgebra.apply)).isSome do
          throwError "`{text}` is not the registered application of Mat: {value}"

  -- The original public juxtaposition spelling reaches the same independently
  -- registered matrix application; a rejected scalar-action input cannot hide it.
  let product ← session.read (← sourceTerm "M v")
  checkSelected product fun expression => do
    checkOriginal #[expression] fun native => do
      let value ← instantiateMVars native[0]!
      unless !value.hasMVar &&
          (value.find? (·.isConstOf ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.LinearAlgebra.apply)).isSome do
        throwError "matrix juxtaposition lost its actual registered application"
      check value
