-- Reuse Language.bindSelectedReceiver's native structure telescope. All fields remain
-- metavariables until the complete receiver type determines them; no instance is chosen.
private def bindReceiver (row : MorphismEntry) (receiver : Expr) (slot : Nat) :
    MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration row.declaration
  let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels row.declaration
  let (parameters, binders, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration)
  let some parameter := parameters[slot]? | return none
  unless binders[slot]!.isExplicit do return none
  withConfig (fun config => { config with zetaDelta := false }) do
    unless ← expandSourceStructures (parameters.take slot) do return none
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType parameter) (← inferType receiver) <&&>
        isDefEq parameter receiver do return none
    return some (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN declaration parameters))

/-- Prepare every family indexed by the actual receiver, retaining each complete
native/source snapshot until the final member competition chooses its result. -/
opaque sourceMemberFamilyChoices (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (name : String)
    (qualification : Option String := none) :
    SourceReadM (Array (SourceMemberChoice (MorphismEntry × Nat))) := do
  let some selected := receiver.category | return #[]
  let state ← semanticState
  let qualified ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <| qualification.mapM (selectCategory state)
  let mut candidates : Array (MorphismEntry × Nat) := #[]
  for row in state.morphisms do
    unless row.name == name && qualified.all (·.id == row.category) do continue
    discard <| checkedDeclaration row.declaration
    let info ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| getConstInfo row.declaration
    let binders ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState do
      let (_, binders, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing info.type
      return binders
    for slot in [:binders.size] do
      unless binders[slot]!.isExplicit do continue
      candidates := candidates.push (row, slot)
  return (← SourceMemberChoice.collectApplicable <| candidates.map fun (row, slot) => do
    let some original ← bindReceiver row receiver.value slot | return .ok none
    let original ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars original
    if original.hasMVar || original.hasLevelMVar then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwUnsupportedSource "the selected member requires its complete declaration parameters"
    let parameters ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| original.getAppArgs.mapM fun parameter => do
      let parameter ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars parameter
      let some constructor ← isConstructorApp? parameter | return parameter
      unless isStructure (← liftM (m := MetaM) getEnv) constructor.induct do return parameter
      let fields ← parameter.getAppArgs.mapM fun field =>
        withConfig (fun config => { config with zetaDelta := false }) <| withReducible (whnf field)
      let parameter ← Sym.foldProjs (mkAppN parameter.getAppFn fields)
      etaStructReduce parameter (fun _ => true)
    let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == row.category)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the member family requires one complete result category"
    let (bundle, value) ← registeredExpressions (.inr row) category fun function _ => do
      unless ← isDefEq function original.getAppFn do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the member family changed its whole source declaration"
      return mkAppN function parameters
    let original ← SourceReadM.select { value := original } (some (← inferType value))
    let proof ← SourceReadM.prove (← mkEq original value) fun proposition _ => do
      let proposition ← whnfR proposition
      unless proposition.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do
        throwError "the member family lost its original parameter agreement"
      mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl proposition.getAppArgs[1]!) proposition
    let body ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `memberParameterAgreement) (← inferType proof) proof
      fun binding => mkLetFVars #[binding] value
        (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
    let body ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `memberReceiverCategory)
      (← inferType selected.bundle) selected.bundle fun binding => mkLetFVars #[binding] body
        (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
    let retained := (← SourceReadM.selection? value).getD { value }
    let category : NativeSourceCategory := ⟨.morphism, category.expression, bundle, none, none⟩
    let value ← SourceReadM.select { retained with value := body, category := some category }
    return .ok (some (← SourceMemberChoice.capture ⟨receiver, none⟩
      (row, slot) ⟨value, some category⟩))).1

opaque sourceMemberFamily (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (name : String)
    (qualification : Option String := none) : SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let choices ← sourceMemberFamilyChoices receiver name qualification
  if choices.isEmpty then return none
  let paths := choices.map (·.path)
  let preferred ← sourceMemberPreference name (paths.filterMap (·.receiver.category)) paths
  let surviving := match preferred with
    | none => choices
    | some selected => selected.filterMap fun (selection : Nat × Route) => choices[selection.1]?
  let #[chosen] := surviving
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
      throwSemanticAmbiguity "several declared member parameters accept this selected receiver"
  chosen.withScope do
    return some (← retainMemberPreference chosen.judgement (preferred.bind fun selected =>
      selected[0]?.map fun (selection : Nat × Route) => selection.2))

/-- A registered morphism named `name` at fresh declaration parameters, with its source set. -/
def morphismAtSource (row : MorphismEntry) :
    TermElabM (Expr × Expr × Array (Expr × BinderInfo)) := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration row.declaration
  let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels row.declaration
  let (parameters, infos, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration)
  let morphism := mkAppN declaration parameters
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType morphism)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    throwError "the registered morphism {row.id.raw} is not a native map"
  return (morphism, type.getAppArgs[2]!, parameters.zip infos)

/-- Synthesize the declared instances of a morphism once its source fixed the parameters. -/
def synthesizeDeclared (parameters : Array (Expr × BinderInfo)) : TermElabM Bool := do
  for (parameter, info) in parameters do
    if info.isInstImplicit && (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars parameter).isMVar then
      let some instanceValue ← synthInstance? (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType parameter))
        | return false
      unless ← isDefEq parameter instanceValue do return false
  return true

private structure MemberSourceObject where
  entry : Option ObjectEntry
  value : Expr
  category : NativeSourceCategory

/-- Inspect only the original registered domain and its explicit object parameters.
Owner envelopes are consumed through their checked codec; their proof, comparison and
carrier fields are never searched for another possible source object. -/
private partial def memberSourceObjects (value : Expr) : SourceReadM (Array MemberSourceObject) := do
  let retained ← match ← sourceTypeOrigin? value with
    | some origin => pure (some (origin.category, origin.object))
    | none => sourceObjectOrigin? value
  let original := retained.map (·.2) |>.getD value
  let (declared, entries) ← registeredSourceDomain original
  let entry ← match entries with
    | #[] => pure none
    | #[entry] => pure (some entry)
    | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "the member parameter requires its selected source object"
  if retained.isNone && entry.isNone then return #[]
  let category ← match retained with
    | some (category, _) => pure category
    | none => do
      let some entry := entry
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the member parameter lost its already selected source row"
      let #[category] := (← semanticState).categories.filter (·.id == entry.category)
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the member parameter requires its complete registered category"
      discard <| checkedDeclaration category.declaration
      let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels category.declaration
      let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
      let bundle := mkAppN family parameters
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType original)
          (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]) do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the member parameter changed its complete registered category"
      let bundle ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars bundle
      discard <| SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt (.category category) bundle bundle)
      pure ⟨.object, category.expression, bundle,
        ← objectCarrierSelection entry bundle original, none⟩
  let mut found : Array MemberSourceObject := #[⟨entry, original, category⟩]
  -- A selected structured owner supplies only its own structure. In particular its
  -- underlying named carrier cannot be promoted to another registered structure.
  unless category.role == .object && category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) do
    return found
  if entry.isNone then return found
  let info ← getFunInfoNArgs declared.getAppFn declared.getAppNumArgs
  for argument in declared.getAppArgs, parameter in info.paramInfo do
    if parameter.isExplicit && !(← isProof argument) then
      found := found ++ (← memberSourceObjects argument)
  return found

/-- Specialize an authored refinement at the original named base's complete arguments.
The comparison keeps that actual base occurrence and complete category in its native type. -/
private def memberRefinement? (base : MemberSourceObject) (entry : ObjectEntry)
    (expected : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  let some original := base.entry | return none
  let some refinement := entry.refines | return none
  unless refinement.base == original.id &&
      base.category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) do return none
  discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
  discard <| checkedDeclaration refinement.identification
  let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
  let (parameters, _, result) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration)
  unless ← isDefEq result expected do return none
  let comparison ← applyObjectParameters entry.id.raw refinement.identification parameters
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the member refinement requires its complete registered comparison"
  let some supplied ← alignSourceArguments? original.declaration parameters type.getAppArgs[3]!
      (← registeredSourceDomain base.value).1 | return none
  let arguments ← (parameters.zip supplied).mapM fun (parameter, supplied) => do
    match supplied with
    | some actual =>
      unless ← isDefEq parameter actual do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the member refinement changed an original source parameter"
      pure actual
    | none => liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars parameter
  let #[category] := (← semanticState).categories.filter (·.id == entry.category)
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the member refinement requires its complete registered category"
  let (bundle, object) ← registeredExpressions (.inl entry) category fun function _ =>
    pure (mkAppN function arguments)
  let some carrier ← objectCarrierSelection entry bundle object
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the member refinement lost its registered carrier comparison"
  let #[comparison] := carrier.comparisons
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the member refinement changed its original comparison family"
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the member refinement lost its native comparison type"
  let targetType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[base.category.bundle]
  let targetStructure ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.str #[base.category.bundle]
  let target ← annotateSourceObject base.category base.value
  let expected ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Iso
    #[some targetType, some targetStructure, some type.getAppArgs[2]!, some target]
  unless ← (← get).context.withOriginalSources #[type, expected]
      (fun values => isDefEq values[0]! values[1]!) do return none
  let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? comparison).getD { value := comparison }
  let comparison ← SourceReadM.select { selected with value := comparison } (some expected)
  let carrier := { carrier with comparisons := #[comparison] }
  return some (← annotateSourceObject
    ⟨.object, category.expression, bundle, some carrier, none⟩ object)

/-- Select a registered map from its original declared domain and explicit supplied
parameter owners. Complete native application identity only removes duplicate derivations
of that same declaration application; it never identifies a runtime operand. -/
def sourceMorphismFrom? (name : String) (type : Expr)
    (selected : Option MorphismEntry := none) : SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  let rows ← match selected with
    | some row => do
      unless row.name == name do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected morphism has another source name"
      pure #[row]
    | none => pure ((← semanticState).morphisms.filter (·.name == name))
  let (originalType, _) ← registeredSourceDomain type
  let mut found : Array (MorphismEntry × Expr × Expr) := #[]
  for row in rows do
    let (morphism, source, parameters) ← morphismAtSource row
    let applicable ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <| withoutModifyingState do
      unless ← withReducible (isDefEq source originalType) do return false
      unless ← synthesizeDeclared parameters do return false
      let morphism ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars morphism
      return !morphism.hasMVar && !morphism.hasLevelMVar
    unless applicable do continue
    discard <| liftM (m := MetaM) <| withReducible (isDefEq source originalType)
    discard <| synthesizeDeclared parameters
    let morphism ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars morphism
    found := found.push (row, morphism, ← inferType morphism)
  if found.isEmpty then
    let state ← semanticState
    let objects ← memberSourceObjects type
    for row in rows do
      let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == row.category)
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected member requires its complete category"
      let declaration ← checkedDeclaration row.declaration
      let count ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| forallTelescopeReducing declaration.type fun parameters _ => pure parameters.size
      for object in objects do
        let refinements := state.objects.filter fun entry =>
          object.entry.any fun base => entry.refines.any (·.base == base.id)
        let choices : Array (Option ObjectEntry) := #[none] ++ refinements.map some
        for choice in choices do
          for slot in [:count] do
            let prepare : SourceReadM (Option (Expr × Expr)) := do
              let previous ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
              let (morphism, source, parameters) ← morphismAtSource row
              let owned := (← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx).decls.foldl (fun result identity _ =>
                if previous.decls.contains identity then result else result.push identity) #[]
              let some (parameter, info) := parameters[slot]? | return none
              unless info.isExplicit do return none
              let expected ← inferType parameter
              let value ← match choice with
                | some refinement => memberRefinement? object refinement expected
                | none => do
                  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType object.value) expected do return none
                  let retained ← SourceReadM.selection? object.value
                  let same := retained.any fun source =>
                    SourceSelection.exactlyMatches Expr.equal source
                      { source with category := some object.category }
                  if same then pure (some object.value)
                  else pure (some (← annotateSourceObject object.category object.value))
              let some value := value | return none
              extendSourceApplicationScope owned
              unless ← isDefEq parameter value do return none
              unless ← isDefEq source originalType do return none
              unless ← synthesizeDeclared parameters do return none
              let morphism ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars morphism
              let morphism := mkAppN morphism.getAppFn
                (morphism.getAppArgs.set! slot (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars value))
              if morphism.hasMVar || morphism.hasLevelMVar then return none
              let arrow ← inferType morphism
              let arrow ← if arrow.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure arrow else whnfR arrow
              unless arrow.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
                liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected member lost its native map type"
              let target := arrow.getAppArgs[3]!
              let target ← if ← isDefEq target originalType then pure type else pure target
              let args := arrow.getAppArgs
              let expected := mkAppN arrow.getAppFn #[args[0]!, args[1]!, type, target]
              return some (morphism, expected)
            unless ← SourceReadM.inspect (return (← prepare).isSome) do continue
            let some (morphism, expected) ← prepare | continue
            let duplicate := found.any fun (original, value, target) =>
              SourceSelection.exactlyMatches Expr.equal
                (sourceReference (.named (.registered (.inr original) category)) value)
                (sourceReference (.named (.registered (.inr row) category)) morphism) &&
                target.equal expected
            unless duplicate do found := found.push (row, morphism, expected)
  match found with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[(row, morphism, expected)] =>
    let #[category] := (← semanticState).categories.filter (·.id == row.category)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected member requires its complete category"
    let (_, value) ← registeredExpressions (.inr row) category (fun _ _ => pure morphism)
    let some retained ← SourceReadM.selection? value
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected member lost its original source row"
    return some (← SourceReadM.select { retained with value := value } (some expected))
  | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
    throwSemanticAmbiguity s!"several registered morphisms {name} leave this set"

/-- Original element-member candidates retain their own reading and completion scopes.
A selected categorical receiver cannot enter this branch. -/
def sourceElementMemberChoices (name : String) (receiver : Option NativeSourceJudgement)
    (read : Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr))
    (arguments : Option (Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr))) :
    SourceReadM (Array (SourceMemberChoice MorphismEntry) × Array MessageData) := do
  if receiver.any (fun receiver => receiver.category.isSome) then return (#[], #[])
  let state ← semanticState
  SourceMemberChoice.collectApplicable <|
    (state.morphisms.filter (·.name == name)).map fun row => do
      let previous ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
      let (morphism, whole, parameters) ← morphismAtSource row
      let owned := (← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx).decls.foldl (fun result identity _ =>
        if previous.decls.contains identity then result else result.push identity) #[]
      let source ← match arguments with
        | none => pure (some whole)
        | some _ => do
          let pair ← whnfR whole
          if pair.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 then pure (some pair.getAppArgs[0]!) else pure none
      let some source := source | return .ok none
      let elementResult : Except MessageData (Option Expr) ← match receiver with
        | some receiver => do
          let (type, _) ← registeredSourceDomain (← inferType receiver.value)
          unless ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withReducible (isDefEq source type) do return .ok none
          unless ← synthesizeDeclared parameters do return .ok none
          if (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars morphism).hasMVar then return .ok none
          pure (.ok (some receiver.value))
        | none => do
          unless ← synthesizeDeclared parameters do return .ok none
          let source ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars source
          if source.hasMVar || source.hasLevelMVar then return .ok none
          match ← read source with
          | .ok element => pure (.ok (some element))
          | .error message => return .error message
      let element ← match elementResult with
        | .ok (some element) => pure element
        | .ok none => return .ok none
        | .error message => return .error message
      extendSourceApplicationScope owned
      let morphism ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars morphism
      let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == row.category)
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the element member lost its complete registered category"
      let (_, selected) ← registeredExpressions (.inr row) category (fun _ _ => pure morphism)
      let function ← sourceSetFunction selected
      let argumentResult : Except MessageData Expr ← match arguments with
        | none => pure (.ok element)
        | some read => do
          let pair ← whnfR (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars whole)
          match ← read pair.getAppArgs[1]! with
          | .ok value => pure (.ok (← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[element, value]))
          | .error message => pure (.error message)
      let argument ← match argumentResult with
        | .ok value => pure value
        | .error message => return .error message
      let applied ← elabSourceApplicationApplicableScoped function #[Syntax.missing] none
        fun _ expected => do
          if ← isDefEq (← inferType argument) expected then return .ok argument
          let retained := (← SourceReadM.selection? argument).getD { value := argument }
          return .ok (← SourceReadM.select { retained with value := argument } (some expected))
      let value ← match applied with
        | .ok (value, _) => pure value
        | .error message => return .error message
      return .ok (some (← SourceMemberChoice.capture
        ⟨receiver.getD ⟨element, none⟩, none⟩ row ⟨value, none⟩))

def sourceElementMember? (name : String) (receiver : Option NativeSourceJudgement)
    (read : Expr → SourceReadM Expr) (arguments : Option (Expr → SourceReadM Expr)) :
    SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  let (found, mismatches) ← sourceElementMemberChoices name receiver
    (fun type => do return .ok (← read type))
    (arguments.map fun read type => do return .ok (← read type))
  match found with
  | #[] =>
    if let some message := mismatches[0]? then liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message
    return none
  | #[chosen] => chosen.withScope (pure (some chosen.judgement.value))
  | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
    throwSemanticAmbiguity s!"several registered morphisms {name} accept this element"

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.SourceCarrier

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

/-- The actual receiver of a member candidate and its structural transport, if any.
A direct projection or parameter use has no structural transport; when its receiver has a
selected category, that direct use is the empty route at that complete category. -/
structure SourceMemberPath where
  receiver : NativeSourceJudgement
  inherited : Option Route := none

def SourceMemberPath.route? (path : SourceMemberPath) : TermElabM (Option Route) := do
  let some selected := path.receiver.category
    | if path.inherited.isSome then
        throwError "an inherited member lost its complete selected source category"
      else return none
  if let some route := path.inherited then
    unless route.source.syntacticEq selected.expression do
      throwError "an inherited member changed its actual source category"
    return some route
  return some ⟨selected.expression, selected.expression, #[]⟩

/-- A produced reading and the exact native elaboration state which formed it. The evidence
belongs to the producer; neither a printed result nor a recovered carrier selects a route. -/
structure SourceMemberChoice (Evidence : Type) where
  path : SourceMemberPath
  evidence : Evidence
  judgement : NativeSourceJudgement
  nativeState : Lean.Elab.Term.SavedState
  sourceScope : SourceReadScope
  localContext : LocalContext
  localInstances : LocalInstances

/-- Freeze a candidate only in its producing continuation, with the complete native
local context and typed source scope that give every expression its meaning. -/
def SourceMemberChoice.capture (path : SourceMemberPath) (evidence : Evidence)
    (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) : SourceReadM (SourceMemberChoice Evidence) := do
  return {
    path, evidence, judgement
    nativeState := ← liftM (m := TermElabM) saveState
    sourceScope := ← get
    localContext := ← liftM (m := MetaM) getLCtx
    localInstances := ← liftM (m := MetaM) getLocalInstances }

/-- Prepare independent candidate snapshots in the original source and native state.
Only typed mismatches are collected; original exceptions retain their classification. -/
def SourceMemberChoice.collectApplicable
    (readings : Array (SourceReadM (Except MessageData (Option (SourceMemberChoice Evidence))))) :
    SourceReadM (Array (SourceMemberChoice Evidence) × Array MessageData) :=
  fun _ initial finish => do
    let original ← saveState
    let context ← getLCtx
    let instances ← getLocalInstances
    let result ← try
      let mut choices : Array (SourceMemberChoice Evidence) := #[]
      let mut mismatches : Array MessageData := #[]
      for reading in readings do
        original.restore
        let result : Except MessageData (Option (SourceMemberChoice Evidence)) ←
            withLCtx context instances <| reading.runK initial fun result _ => do
              match result with
              | .ok value => return .ok value
              | .error message => return .error (← addMessageContext message)
        match result with
        | .ok (some choice) => choices := choices.push choice
        | .ok none => pure ()
        | .error message => mismatches := mismatches.push message
      pure (choices, mismatches)
    finally
      original.restore
    finish result initial

/-- Resume the exact saved native telescope. All completion and the caller's continuation
remain inside that scope; a selected expression is never interpreted in another candidate. -/
def SourceMemberChoice.withScope (choice : SourceMemberChoice Evidence)
    (action : SourceReadM α) : SourceReadM α :=
  fun _ _ finish => do
    let previous ← saveState
    let completed ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef false
    try
      choice.nativeState.restore
      withLCtx choice.localContext choice.localInstances <|
        action.runK choice.sourceScope fun value scope => do
          completed.set true
          finish value scope
    catch error =>
      unless ← completed.get do previous.restore
      throw error

private structure MemberResultSelection where
  type : Expr
  category : Option NativeSourceCategory
  declarations : NativeDeclarations

-- Freeze only in the state which actually completed this reading. No candidate's assigned
-- metavariables or local native declarations may be interpreted in another candidate state.
private def memberResultSelection (context : OpenContext)
    (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) : MetaM MemberResultSelection := do
  let terms ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (#[] : Array Expr)
  let close := fun original => do
    let value ← instantiateMVars original
    if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar || value.hasLooseBVars then
      throwError "a competing member result has undetermined complete selection data"
    let value ← context.withOriginalSources #[value] fun expressions => do
      let formals := (← getLCtx).foldl
        (fun result declaration => result.push (mkFVar declaration.fvarId)) #[]
      mkLambdaFVars formals expressions[0]! (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
    terms.modify (·.push value)
    return value
  let type ← close (← inferType judgement.value)
  let category ← judgement.category.mapM fun category => category.mapM close
  return ⟨type, category, ← NativeDeclarations.capture (← terms.get)⟩

private def memberExprAgrees (left right : Expr) : MetaM Bool :=
  withoutModifyingState do
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType left) (← inferType right) do return false
    isDefEq left right

private def memberExprArrayAgrees (left right : Array Expr) : MetaM Bool := do
  unless left.size == right.size do return false
  for left in left, right in right do
    unless ← memberExprAgrees left right do return false
  return true

private def memberCategoryAgrees (left right : Option NativeSourceCategory) : MetaM Bool := do
  let leftRecord : SourceSelection Expr := { value := mkSort .zero, category := left }
  let rightRecord : SourceSelection Expr := { value := mkSort .zero, category := right }
  unless SourceSelection.exactlyMatches (fun _ _ => true) leftRecord rightRecord do
    return false
  let terms ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (#[] : Array Expr)
  let collect := fun value => do
    terms.modify (·.push value)
    return value
  discard <| left.mapM fun category => category.mapM collect
  let first ← terms.get
  terms.set #[]
  discard <| right.mapM fun category => category.mapM collect
  memberExprArrayAgrees first (← terms.get)

/-- Whole-family agreement does not erase a later result's selected structure. Compare the
complete completed selection in addition to that independent family proof. Only full native
bundles, unapplied carrier actions and the actual universal presentation are compared here;
an equality of values at one receiver is never consulted. The chosen state stays unchanged. -/
def checkSourceMemberSelections (choices : Array (SourceMemberChoice Evidence)) :
    TermElabM Unit := do
  if choices.size ≤ 1 then return
  let original ← saveState
  try
    let selections ← choices.mapM fun choice => do
      choice.nativeState.restore
      withLCtx choice.localContext choice.localInstances <|
        memberResultSelection choice.sourceScope.context choice.judgement
    original.restore
    let some first := selections[0]?
      | throwError "member comparison lost its first completed selection"
    for other in selections.drop 1 do
      -- Candidate-local auxiliary names may coincide after rollback. Different checked
      -- payloads cannot become equal by restoring one over the other's environment.
      for declaration in other.declarations.constants do
        if let some current := ((← getEnv).setExporting false).find? declaration.name then
          unless nativeConstantExactlyMatches declaration current do
            throwSemanticAmbiguity "member result selections have different native declarations"
      other.declarations.ensure
      unless (← memberExprAgrees first.type other.type) &&
          (← memberCategoryAgrees first.category other.category) do
        throwSemanticAmbiguity "member families have different complete result selections"
  finally
    original.restore

/-- Apply the existing C6 preference check to all actually surviving member kinds together.
The considered categories include candidates rejected by their own native expected check,
so a declared preference cannot silently disappear when its route fails that check. The
returned indices refer to the original typed candidates; no reading is reconstructed. -/
def sourceMemberPreference (name : String) (considered : Array NativeSourceCategory)
    (surviving : Array SourceMemberPath) : TermElabM (Option (Array (Nat × Route))) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let sources := considered.foldl (fun found category =>
    if found.any (·.syntacticEq category.expression) then found
    else found.push category.expression) (#[] : Array CategoryExpr)
  let routes ← surviving.mapM SourceMemberPath.route?
  let mut selected : Array (Nat × Route) := #[]
  let mut preferred := false
  for source in sources do
    let candidates := routes.filterMap id |>.filter (·.source.syntacticEq source)
    let some route ← preferredRoute? state source name candidates | continue
    preferred := true
    for index in [:routes.size] do
      let some actual := routes[index]! | continue
      if actual.source.syntacticEq source && actual.refs == route.refs then
        selected := selected.push (index, actual)
  return if preferred then some selected else none

/-- Retain the admitted route as typed observation of the already chosen reading.
The actual receiver and independent family evidence retain their original selected owners. -/
def retainMemberPreference (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) (route : Option Route) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let some route := route | return judgement
  let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? judgement.value).getD { value := judgement.value }
  let value ← SourceReadM.select { selected with
    value := judgement.value
    category := judgement.category
    preferredRoute := some route.refs }
  return { judgement with value }

end CasCompiler

module

import CasCompiler.Read
import CasCompiler.SourceTestSupport
import CasCompiler.ReadMember
import CasCompiler.ReadDispatch
import CasCompiler.SourcePropertyQualification
import LeanCategories.Catalogue
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.Read
meta import CasCompiler.SourceTestSupport
meta import CasCompiler.ReadMember
meta import CasCompiler.ReadDispatch
meta import CasCompiler.SourcePropertyQualification
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue

namespace CasCompiler.SourceMemberCompetitionTests

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← liftM (m := CoreM) getEnv) `cas_term text
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the member competition control did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

private def readMember (context : ReadContext) (receiver : TSyntax `cas_term)
    (name : String) (arguments : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  match ← SourceReader.memberCompleting context (checkReadJudgementApplicable context)
      receiver name arguments with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError message

private def memberContext (source : TSyntax `cas_term) (reads : IO.Ref Nat)
    (project : NativeSourceJudgement → String → Array (TSyntax `cas_term) →
      SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement)) : ReadContext := {
  categoryOf := fun _ => pure none
  source
  expected := none
  qualification := none
  expectedCategory := none
  project
  read := fun categoryOf source expected qualification expectedCategory => do
    liftM (m := IO) <| reads.modify (· + 1)
    readExpressionApplicable categoryOf source expected qualification expectedCategory
}

-- This controls the actual reader's projection callback; it adds no mathematical registry
-- row. The property is the independently registered Fin(3).is_finite() reading. Both kinds
-- must compete, even when the earlier projection callback returns a well-typed value.
-- Original public method/property/image/projection tests remain separate and unchanged.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  discard <| session.elaborateJudgementsScoped Syntax.missing do
    let source ← sourceTerm "Fin(3).is_finite()"
    let receiver ← sourceTerm "Fin(3)"
    let reads ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
    let projects ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
    let declarations ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (#[] : Array Name)
    let context := memberContext source reads fun _ name arguments => do
      unless name == "is_finite" && arguments.isEmpty do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the competing projection lost its original member call"
      liftM (m := IO) <| projects.modify (· + 1)
      let name ← mkAuxDeclName `competingMemberProjection
      addDecl (.defnDecl {
        name
        levelParams := []
        type := mkConst ``Nat
        value := mkNatLit 0
        hints := .abbrev
        safety := .safe })
      liftM (m := IO) <| declarations.modify (·.push name)
      return some ⟨mkConst name, none⟩
    let failure : Option Exception ← try
      discard <| readMember context receiver "is_finite" #[]
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
    let some failure := failure
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a projection displaced a simultaneously applicable property"
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity failure do throw failure
    unless (← liftM (m := IO) reads.get) == 1 && (← liftM (m := IO) projects.get) == 1 do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "member competition reread its receiver or replayed a selected projection"
    for name in ← liftM (m := IO) declarations.get do
      if ((← liftM (m := CoreM) getEnv).setExporting false).contains name then
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "an ambiguous member retained a speculative native declaration"

    -- Discovery receives the actual selected native receiver and the same
    -- competing candidates, rather than running the source reader a second time.
    let selectedReceiver ← readExpression (fun _ => pure none) receiver none
    liftM (m := IO) <| reads.set 0
    liftM (m := IO) <| projects.set 0
    liftM (m := IO) <| declarations.set #[]
    discard <| SourceReadM.inspect do
      let candidates ← SourceReader.memberChoicesAtReceiver context selectedReceiver "is_finite" #[] none
      unless candidates.choices.size == 2 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the formed-receiver entrance lost a competing native reading"
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| SourceReader.completeMemberChoices context (checkReadJudgementApplicable context)
          "is_finite" #[] candidates.considered candidates.choices candidates.mismatches
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "discovery selected an ambiguous member"
      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity failure do throw failure
      unless (← liftM (m := IO) reads.get) == 0 && (← liftM (m := IO) projects.get) == 1 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "discovery reread the receiver or replayed a candidate"
      return true

    -- The final expected-type check is applied to each result. Its explicit mismatch can
    -- decline the Nat-valued projection, while the original property remains a proposition.
    liftM (m := IO) <| reads.set 0
    liftM (m := IO) <| projects.set 0
    liftM (m := IO) <| declarations.set #[]
    let result ← readMember { context with expected := some (mkSort .zero) }
      receiver "is_finite" #[]
    let #[classifier] := (← semanticState).classifiers.filter (·.id == ClassifierId.setsFinite)
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original finiteness classifier is absent or ambiguous"
    let finite ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Objects.fin #[mkNatLit 3]
    let expected ← elabAppArgs (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``CasCatalogue.Classifier.Holds)
      #[] #[Arg.expr (← classifierInstance classifier), Arg.expr finite] none false false
    SourceTest.checkOriginal #[result.value, expected] fun native => do
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the surviving member changed its independently declared property"
    checkWithKernel result.value
    unless (← liftM (m := IO) reads.get) == 1 && (← liftM (m := IO) projects.get) == 1 do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "member result checking reread source or replayed a candidate"
    for name in ← liftM (m := IO) declarations.get do
      if ((← liftM (m := CoreM) getEnv).setExporting false).contains name then
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a native-domain mismatch retained a rejected projection declaration"
    pure #[]

-- A unique kind retains the exact checked native state from its one callback invocation.
-- The ordinary native alias makes a replay or a discarded selected environment observable.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  discard <| session.elaborateJudgementsScoped Syntax.missing do
    let source ← sourceTerm "Fin(3).retained_native_projection()"
    let receiver ← sourceTerm "Fin(3)"
    let reads ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
    let projects ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
    let introduced ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (none : Option Name)
    let context := memberContext source reads fun _ name arguments => do
      unless name == "retained_native_projection" && arguments.isEmpty do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the retained projection changed its original member call"
      liftM (m := IO) <| projects.modify (· + 1)
      let name ← mkAuxDeclName `retainedMemberProjection
      addDecl (.defnDecl {
        name
        levelParams := []
        type := mkConst ``Nat
        value := mkNatLit 7
        hints := .abbrev
        safety := .safe })
      liftM (m := IO) <| introduced.set (some name)
      return some ⟨mkConst name, none⟩
    let result ← readMember context receiver "retained_native_projection" #[]
    let some name ← liftM (m := IO) introduced.get
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the selected projection callback was not executed"
    unless (← liftM (m := IO) reads.get) == 1 && (← liftM (m := IO) projects.get) == 1 && result.value == Lean.mkConst name do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "member selection replaced or replayed the original checked native result"
    unless ((← liftM (m := CoreM) getEnv).setExporting false).contains name do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "member selection discarded its original checked native environment"
    checkWithKernel result.value
    pure #[]

-- An exception is not absence. A property that would otherwise apply cannot rescue a
-- failed projection callback, and the failed callback's native declaration is rolled back.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  discard <| session.elaborateJudgementsScoped Syntax.missing do
    let source ← sourceTerm "Fin(3).is_finite()"
    let receiver ← sourceTerm "Fin(3)"
    let reads ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
    let introduced ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (none : Option Name)
    let originalFailure ← liftM (m := IO) <|
      registerInternalExceptionId `CasCompiler.tests.originalMemberStateFailure
    let context := memberContext source reads fun _ _ _ => do
      let name ← mkAuxDeclName `failedMemberProjection
      addDecl (.defnDecl {
        name
        levelParams := []
        type := mkConst ``Nat
        value := mkNatLit 1
        hints := .abbrev
        safety := .safe })
      liftM (m := IO) <| introduced.set (some name)
      throw (Exception.internal originalFailure)
    let failure : Option Exception ← try
      discard <| readMember context receiver "is_finite" #[]
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
    let some (.internal actual _) := failure
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a failed member callback lost its original native exception"
    unless actual == originalFailure do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a failed member callback was relabelled or retried"
    let some name ← liftM (m := IO) introduced.get
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the failed member control never reached its actual callback"
    if ((← liftM (m := CoreM) getEnv).setExporting false).contains name then
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a failed member callback retained its speculative native declaration"
    pure #[]

private def preference? (value : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option (Array EdgeRef)) := do
  return (← SourceReadM.selection? value).bind (·.preferredRoute)

-- The completion continuation belongs to the already matched rule. Even an internal
-- exception with the dispatcher's private mismatch identifier cannot reopen syntax search
-- after that boundary. No result from the fallback may replace the failed interpretation.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  discard <| session.elaborateJudgementsScoped Syntax.missing do
    let source ← sourceTerm "Fin(3)"
    let reads ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
    let fallbackCalls ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
    let context := memberContext source reads fun _ _ _ => pure none
    let failing : ReadCompletingRule := fun context complete => do
      let value ← context.readExpression context.categoryOf context.source none
      discard <| complete value
      throwReadRuleMismatch
    let fallback : ReadCompletingRule := fun _ complete => do
      liftM (m := IO) <| fallbackCalls.modify (· + 1)
      complete ⟨mkNatLit 0, none⟩
    let failure : Option Exception ← try
      discard <| readWithCompletingRules #[failing, fallback] context
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
    let some (.internal id _) := failure
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a completed rule's original internal exception was relabelled or swallowed"
    unless id == readRuleMismatch && (← liftM (m := IO) fallbackCalls.get) == 0 do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a completed rule's failure reopened source interpretation"
    let unmatched : ReadCompletingRule := fun _ _ => throwReadRuleMismatch
    let .ok _ ← readWithCompletingRules #[unmatched, fallback] context
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "ordinary unmatched syntax stopped trying its next rule"
    unless (← liftM (m := IO) fallbackCalls.get) == 1 do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the unmatched syntax control did not reach its ordinary next rule"
    pure #[]

private def selectedMethod? (value : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option MethodEntry) := do
  let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value | return none
  let some application := selected.application | return none
  let .routedMethod family := application.family | return none
  return some family.entry

-- A preference is checked after all actual kinds and their native result domains survive.
-- The method and its nonempty structural route come from the independent registry. The
-- callback controls the existing projection entrance and supplies no registry row or law.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let previous := preferredRoutesExtension.getState (← liftM (m := CoreM) getEnv)
  try
    let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
    let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
    discard <| session.elaborateJudgementsScoped Syntax.missing do
      setPreferredRoutes #[]
      let source ← sourceTerm "(ℚ in Rings).cardinality()"
      let receiver ← sourceTerm "ℚ in Rings"
      let state ← semanticState
      let rings ← selectCategory state "Rings"
      let query ← SourceRoutes.forMethod rings.expression "cardinality"
      let some routes ← query.finiteRoutes
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the actual cardinality control requires its finite registered routes"
      let distinct := routes.foldl (fun found route =>
        if found.any (·.refs == route.refs) then found else found.push route) (#[] : Array Route)
      let some chosen := distinct.find? (! ·.refs.isEmpty)
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original ring cardinality has no inherited route"
      let #[method] := state.methods.filter fun entry =>
        entry.name == "cardinality" && entry.owner.syntacticEq chosen.target
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the actual cardinality route does not have one method binding"
      let labels := chosen.refs.map (·.label)
      let reads ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
      let calls ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
      let introduced ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (none : Option Name)
      let context := memberContext source reads fun _ name arguments => do
        unless name == "cardinality" && arguments.isEmpty do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the competing projection changed its actual source call"
        liftM (m := IO) <| calls.modify (· + 1)
        let name ← mkAuxDeclName `preferredMemberProjection
        addDecl (.defnDecl {
          name
          levelParams := []
          type := mkConst ``Nat
          value := mkNatLit 9
          hints := .abbrev
          safety := .safe })
        liftM (m := IO) <| introduced.set (some name)
        return some ⟨mkConst name, none⟩

      setPreferredRoutes #[{ receiver := rings.id.raw, name := "cardinality", route := labels }]
      let result ← readMember context receiver "cardinality" #[]
      unless (← selectedMethod? result.value).any (fun original => reprStr original == reprStr method) &&
          (← preference? result.value) == some chosen.refs do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a direct projection displaced the actually preferred inherited method"
      checkWithKernel result.value
      unless (← liftM (m := IO) reads.get) == 1 && (← liftM (m := IO) calls.get) == 1 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "preferred member selection replayed its receiver or a candidate"
      let some rejected ← liftM (m := IO) introduced.get
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the competing projection was not considered"
      if ((← liftM (m := CoreM) getEnv).setExporting false).contains rejected then
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the preferred method retained a rejected projection declaration"

      -- The direct projection has the actual empty path at its already selected receiver.
      -- It competes with the inherited methods even though they use a different kind.
      liftM (m := IO) <| reads.set 0
      liftM (m := IO) <| calls.set 0
      liftM (m := IO) <| introduced.set none
      setPreferredRoutes #[{ receiver := rings.id.raw, name := "cardinality", route := #[] }]
      let direct ← readMember context receiver "cardinality" #[]
      let some retained ← liftM (m := IO) introduced.get
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the direct preferred member was not formed"
      let scope ← get
      unless (← SourceTest.originatesAt scope.context scope.selections direct.value (Lean.mkConst retained)) &&
          (← preference? direct.value) == some #[] &&
          (← liftM (m := IO) reads.get) == 1 && (← liftM (m := IO) calls.get) == 1 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "member selection did not retain its original direct native result"
      checkWithKernel direct.value

      -- The inherited method's result is not a Nat. A preference for its rejected route is
      -- invalid; the Nat-valued projection cannot rescue or relabel that declared choice.
      setPreferredRoutes #[{ receiver := rings.id.raw, name := "cardinality", route := labels }]
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| readMember { context with expected := some (mkConst ``Nat) }
          receiver "cardinality" #[]
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a non-surviving preferred member route was silently replaced"
      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .invalid do throw failure

      -- A preference selects a route, never a member kind. On Sets the real property and
      -- the controlled direct projection have the same empty route and remain ambiguous.
      let sets ← selectCategory state "Sets"
      setPreferredRoutes #[{ receiver := sets.id.raw, name := "is_finite", route := #[] }]
      let propertySource ← sourceTerm "Fin(3).is_finite()"
      let propertyReceiver ← sourceTerm "Fin(3)"
      let propertyContext := memberContext propertySource reads fun _ _ _ =>
        pure (some ⟨mkNatLit 0, none⟩)
      let conflict : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| readMember propertyContext propertyReceiver "is_finite" #[]
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some conflict := conflict
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a preferred empty route invented agreement between member kinds"
      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity conflict do throw conflict
      pure #[]
  finally
    setPreferredRoutes previous

-- Qualification is the same once-per-candidate completion as expected native typing.
-- The real property has no selected object category and declines only that own mismatch;
-- the actual finite object returned by the projection is refined by its existing proof.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  discard <| session.elaborateJudgementsScoped Syntax.missing do
    let source ← sourceTerm "Fin(3).is_finite()"
    let receiver ← sourceTerm "Fin(3)"
    let #[required] := (← semanticState).categories.filter fun entry =>
      entry.expression.syntacticEq (.classifierTotal ClassifierId.setsFinite)
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the qualification control lost its independent finite-object category"
    let reads ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
    let completed ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
    let original ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (none : Option NativeSourceJudgement)
    let context := memberContext source reads (fun receiver _ _ => do
        liftM (m := IO) <| original.set (some receiver)
        return some receiver)
    let context := { context with qualification := some required.name }
    let result ← SourceReader.memberCompleting context (fun value => do
        liftM (m := IO) <| completed.modify (· + 1)
        checkReadJudgementApplicable context value) receiver "is_finite" #[]
    let .ok result := result
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a qualifier's explicit category mismatch displaced an applicable member"
    unless (← liftM (m := IO) completed.get) == 2 && (← liftM (m := IO) reads.get) == 1 do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "member qualification replayed its receiver or completed a candidate twice"
    let some selected := result.category
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the qualified member lost its complete selected category"
    let some carrier := selected.carrier
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the qualified member lost its checked property inclusion"
    let some original ← liftM (m := IO) original.get
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the qualification control lost its original source receiver"
    let some originalCategory := original.category
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original finite object lost its source category"
    let some forget := carrier.actions[0]?
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the qualified member lost its actual forgetful action"
    unless selected.expression.syntacticEq required.expression &&
        carrier.refs[0]? == some (.classifierForget ClassifierId.setsFinite) do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "member qualification changed the original selected classifier"
    let mapped ← functorObject forget result.value originalCategory.bundle
    SourceTest.checkOriginal #[mapped, original.value] fun native => do
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "member qualification changed the original object"
    checkWithKernel result.value

    -- A failed chosen proof remains an actual error. No competing property can turn an
    -- arbitrary infinite object into a finite one or treat that proof failure as absence.
    let source ← sourceTerm "ℕ.is_finite()"
    let receiver ← sourceTerm "ℕ"
    let context := memberContext source reads (fun receiver _ _ => pure (some receiver))
    let context := { context with qualification := some required.name }
    let failure : Option Exception ← try
      discard <| readMember context receiver "is_finite" #[]
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
    let some failure := failure
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "member qualification accepted an unestablished original property"
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .invalid do throw failure
    pure #[]

-- Two actual source constructions can share the complete Sets bundle while retaining
-- different chosen diagrams. Whole-family coalescing must not discard that selected data.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  discard <| session.elaborateJudgementsScoped Syntax.missing do
    let first ← readExpression (fun _ => pure none) (← sourceTerm "Fin(2) × Fin(3)") none
    let firstChoice ← SourceMemberChoice.capture ⟨first, none⟩ () first
    checkSourceMemberSelections #[firstChoice, firstChoice]
    let second ← readExpression (fun _ => pure none) (← sourceTerm "Fin(3) × Fin(2)") none
    let secondChoice ← SourceMemberChoice.capture ⟨second, none⟩ () second
    let some left := first.category
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the first independent construction lost its category"
    let some right := second.category
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the second independent construction lost its category"
    unless left.expression.syntacticEq right.expression &&
        (← isDefEq left.bundle right.bundle) do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the selected-diagram control did not share the same complete category"
    let failure : Option Exception ← try
      checkSourceMemberSelections #[firstChoice, secondChoice]
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
    let some failure := failure
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "member agreement compared only the carrier and discarded a selected diagram"
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity failure do throw failure
    pure #[]

end CasCompiler.SourceMemberCompetitionTests

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue CasCompiler.SourceTest

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the original member-origin source did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

-- The original public span retains the named scalar it was formed over, including after
-- that name is shadowed. Its otherwise implicit field is supplied by the independently
-- registered refinement, with the complete comparison retained on the actual parameter.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let source ← empty.defineTerm `Scalar (← empty.read (← sourceTerm "ℚ"))
  let some scalar := source.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the original scalar lost its source binding"
  let selectedScalar ← source.read (← sourceTerm "Scalar")
  let some scalarCategory := selectedScalar.category
    | throwError "the original scalar lost its complete selected category"
  let space ← source.read (← sourceTerm "Scalar³")
  let source ← source.defineTerm `u
    (← source.read (← sourceTerm "(1, 0, 1)") (some space.source) space.selections)
  let source ← source.defineTerm `Scalar (← source.read (← sourceTerm "ℤ"))
  let some shadow := source.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the scalar shadow lost its distinct source binding"
  let span ← source.read (← sourceTerm "span({u})")
  let #[field] := (← semanticState).objects.filter (·.id.raw == "obj.fields.rationals")
    | throwError "the independent rational-field registration is absent or ambiguous"
  let some refinement := field.refines
    | throwError "the independent rational field lost its registered base comparison"
  checkSelected span fun value => do
    let scope ← get
    let some original := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == scalar.id)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
          throwError "the selected span lost its original scalar occurrence"
    let some later := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == shadow.id)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
          throwError "the selected span lost its distinct shadow control"
    unless original.expression != later.expression do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "the scalar shadow reused the original source identity"
    let applications ← declaredApplications scope.context scope.selections
      ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.LinearAlgebra.span value
    if applications.isEmpty then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "the public span lost its original registered morphism"
    let mut found := false
    for applied in applications do
      for parameter in applied.getAppArgs do
        if let some (category, _) ← sourceObjectOrigin? parameter then
          if let some carrier := category.carrier then
            for comparison in carrier.comparisons do
              let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? comparison | continue
              unless selected.reference.any
                  (·.exactlyMatches (.refinement field refinement)) do continue
              let some application := selected.originalApplication
                | liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
                    throwError "the member refinement lost its exact selected owner and declaration"
              unless application.getAppFn.isConstOf refinement.identification do
                liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
                  throwError "the member refinement lost its exact selected owner and declaration"
              let type ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
              unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
                liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
                  throwError "the member refinement lost its complete native comparison type"
              let some (baseCategory, base) ← sourceObjectOrigin? type.getAppArgs[3]!
                | liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
                    throwError "the member comparison lost its original base's selected data"
              unless (← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections base original.expression false) &&
                  !(← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections base later.expression false) do
                liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
                  throwError "the member refinement changed its actual named base after shadowing"
              unless baseCategory.expression.syntacticEq scalarCategory.expression &&
                  baseCategory.bundle == (← scalarCategory.bundle.inContext scope.context) do
                liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
                  throwError "the member comparison changed the original base occurrence or category"
              checkOriginal #[comparison] fun native => checkWithKernel native[0]!
              found := true
    unless found do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "the span's selected field lost its original registered refinement comparison"
    checkOriginal #[value] fun native => checkWithKernel native[0]!

-- An explicitly selected ring keeps that structure. Its rational carrier does not license
-- substituting the independently registered field when the member requires a field.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let ring ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "ℚ in Rings")
  let some category := ring.category
    | throwError "the structured scalar control lost its selected category"
  let declared ← selectCategory (← semanticState) "Rings"
  unless category.expression.syntacticEq declared.expression do
    throwError "the structured scalar control did not select the registered ring"
  let source ← empty.defineTerm `Scalar ring
  let space ← source.read (← sourceTerm "Scalar³")
  let source ← source.defineTerm `u
    (← source.read (← sourceTerm "(1, 0, 1)") (some space.source) space.selections)
  let subset ← source.read (← sourceTerm "{u}")
  checkSelected subset fun value => do
    checkOriginal #[value] fun native => checkWithKernel native[0]!
    if (← sourceMorphismFrom? "span" (← inferType value)).isSome then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "a selected ring was replaced by a field from its equal carrier"

-- A named rational object in an ignored native argument does not supply a field for a
-- separate bare carrier. This is the exact false-positive shape of the former subterm probe.
-- The native type is unchanged and no alternate interpretation or registry row is supplied.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let named ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "ℚ")
  checkSelected named fun value => do
    let bare ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
      elabTermAndSynthesize (← `(Set (Fin 2 → ℚ))) none
    let hidden ← mkAppM ``Function.const #[← inferType value, bare, value]
    checkOriginal #[bare, hidden] fun native => do
      checkWithKernel native[1]!
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        throwError "the ignored source-object control changed its native type"
    if (← sourceMorphismFrom? "span" hidden).isSome then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwError "an unrelated type subterm supplied an unselected member structure"

end CasCompiler.SourceMemberOriginTests

    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the source member did not parse"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do

    (← nativeTerm "LeanCategories.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.BilinModuleCat R W")

    let family ← mkAppM declaration

      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)

  let parenthesized ← session.read (← sourceTerm "(A).pairing(x, y)")

      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
        (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))

  let session ← session.defineTerm `result result

    let scope ← get

        value bindings[8]!.expression false do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "member application was reconstructed after its receiver name was shadowed"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do

  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `R (← nativeTerm "CommRingCat.{0}")
  let session ← session.assume `W (← nativeTerm "ModuleCat.{0} R")
  let session ← session.assume `X
    (← nativeTerm "LeanCategories.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.BilinModuleCat R W")
  let session ← session.assume `Y
    (← nativeTerm "LeanCategories.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.BilinModuleCat R W")
  let ringType ← session.term (← nativeTerm "(R : Type)")
  let valueType ← session.term (← nativeTerm "(W : Type)")
  let category ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Bil" [.zero] #[ringType, valueType]
  let first ← session.term (← nativeTerm "X")
  let first ← first.inCategory category.expression category.value
  let session ← session.defineTerm `A first
  let second ← session.term (← nativeTerm "Y")
  let second ← second.inCategory category.expression category.value
  let session ← session.defineTerm `B second
  let session ← session.assume `f (← nativeTerm "A ⟶ B")
  let arrow ← session.term (← nativeTerm "f")
  let arrow ← arrow.inCategory category.expression category.value .morphism
  let session ← session.defineTerm `g arrow
  let session ← session.assume `x (← nativeTerm "A.carrier")
  let expected ← session.term (← nativeTerm
    "LeanCategories.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.BilinModuleCat.underlyingMap g x")
  for source in #["g(x)", "(g)(x)"] do
    let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm source)
    SourceTest.checkSelected result fun value => do
      let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
      let expected ← expected.source.inContext (← get).context
      unless (← SourceTest.visitNativeData
          (fun expression => pure (expression.equal bindings[7]!.expression)) value false) > 0 &&
          (← SourceTest.visitNativeData
            (fun expression => pure (expression.equal bindings[8]!.expression)) value false) > 0 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a selected source arrow changed its arbitrary native function or operand"
      SourceTest.checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a selected source arrow changed its arbitrary native function or operand"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
          (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))

private def methodReceiver (state : SemanticState) (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) :
    TermElabM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let some category := receiver.category | return none
  if category.role == .object then return some receiver
  let #[constructor] := state.constructors.filter (·.semantics == `CasCatalogue.Constructors.arrow)
    | throwError "a source morphism method requires its registered arrow constructor"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration constructor.semantics
  let bundle ← applyConstructorInterface constructor.semantics #[category.bundle] #[category.bundle]
  let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]
  let function ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk
  let value ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr receiver.value] (some expected) false false
  return some ⟨value, some ⟨.object,
    .construct constructor.id #[.category category.expression], bundle, none, none⟩⟩

/-- The original routed native family and its exact specialization. -/
structure SourceMethodEvidence where
  family : RoutedMethodFamily
  levels : List Level
  parameters : Array Expr

/-- Prepare every original method in an independent complete native and selected scope. -/
opaque sourceMethodChoices (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (name : String) :
    SourceReadM (Array (SourceMemberChoice SourceMethodEvidence)) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  unless state.methods.any (·.name == name) do return #[]
  let some receiver ← methodReceiver state receiver | return #[]
  let some selected := receiver.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source method lost its selected category"
  let families ← RoutedMethodFamily.atSource selected.expression name
  let (choices, _) ← SourceMemberChoice.collectApplicable <| families.map fun chosen => do
    let universes := chosen.universeParams
    let levels ← universes.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
    let category := chosen.categoryFamily.instantiateLevelParams universes levels
    let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType category)
    unless ← isDefEq (mkAppN category parameters) selected.bundle do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source method has different complete category parameters"
    let parameters ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| parameters.mapM instantiateMVars
    let levels ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| levels.mapM instantiateLevelMVars
    let callable := mkAppN (chosen.family.instantiateLevelParams universes levels) parameters
    if callable.hasMVar || callable.hasLevelMVar then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the specialized source method has undetermined parameters"
    let (value, target) ← chosen.applyAt levels parameters receiver.value
      (fun selected expected => SourceReadM.select selected expected)
    let retained := (← SourceReadM.selection? value).getD { value }
    let category : NativeSourceCategory := ⟨.object, chosen.resultCategory, target, none, none⟩
    let value ← SourceReadM.select { retained with
      value := value
      category := some category
      alternatives := families.map fun family =>
        (.method family.entry family.functor, family.route.refs) }
    return .ok (some (← SourceMemberChoice.capture ⟨receiver, some chosen.route⟩
      ⟨chosen, levels, parameters⟩ ⟨value, some category⟩))
  return choices

/-- Compare complete routed families before retaining their checked specialized proofs.
The completed source result and its actual selected owner are never replayed. -/
def retainSourceMethodAgreements (choices : Array (SourceMemberChoice SourceMethodEvidence))
    (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let some first := choices[0]?
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source method lost its first-hit binding"
  let some selected := first.path.receiver.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source method lost its selected category"
  let proofs ← first.evidence.family.agreementsWith (choices.map (·.evidence.family))
    (selected.carrier.toArray.flatMap (·.comparisons))
  let mut value := judgement.value
  for proof in proofs.reverse do
    let mut proof := proof.instantiateLevelParams
      first.evidence.family.universeParams first.evidence.levels
    for parameter in first.evidence.parameters do proof ← mkAppM ``congrFun #[proof, parameter]
    checkWithKernel proof
    value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `methodFamilyAgreement) (← inferType proof) proof
      fun binding => mkLetFVars #[binding] value
        (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
  let retained := (← SourceReadM.selection? judgement.value).getD { value := judgement.value }
  value ← SourceReadM.select { retained with value, category := judgement.category }
  return { judgement with value }

/-- Ordinary notation uses the same independent candidates and C6 route preference. -/
opaque sourceMethod (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (name : String) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let choices ← sourceMethodChoices receiver name
  if choices.isEmpty then return none
  let paths := choices.map (·.path)
  let preferred ← sourceMemberPreference name (paths.filterMap (·.receiver.category)) paths
  let surviving := match preferred with
    | none => choices
    | some selected => selected.filterMap fun (selection : Nat × Route) => choices[selection.1]?
  let some first := surviving[0]?
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source method lost its first-hit binding"
  first.withScope do
    let value ← retainSourceMethodAgreements surviving first.judgement
    checkSourceMemberSelections surviving
    return some (← retainMemberPreference value (preferred.bind fun selected =>
      selected[0]?.map fun (selection : Nat × Route) => selection.2))

/-- The actual classifier family of a property candidate. -/
structure SourcePropertyEvidence where
  family : PropertyFamily

/-- Prepare every original property row and route before the caller's final type check. -/
opaque sourcePropertyChoices (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (name : String) :
    SourceReadM (Array (SourceMemberChoice SourcePropertyEvidence)) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let some selected := receiver.category | return #[]
  unless selected.role == .object do return #[]
  let rows := state.properties.filter fun row =>
    row.name == name && row.receiver.all (·.syntacticEq selected.expression)
  let mut families : Array PropertyFamily := #[]
  for row in rows do
    let some classifier := state.classifier? row.classifier
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the property lost its accepted classifier"
    let query ← SourceRoutes.forOwner selected.expression classifier.host
    let some routes ← query.finiteRoutes
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwUnsupportedSource "the property route family requires its supplied uniform comparison"
    if routes.isEmpty then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the property is not reachable from the receiver's category"
    for route in routes do
      families := families.push (← PropertyFamily.forSelection selected.expression row.id route.refs)
  let (choices, _) ← SourceMemberChoice.collectApplicable <| families.map fun family => do
    let value ← SourceReadM.select (← family.atReceiver selected receiver.value)
    return .ok (some (← SourceMemberChoice.capture ⟨receiver, some family.route⟩
      ⟨family⟩ ⟨value, none⟩))
  return choices

/-- Different property rows remain ambiguous; one row retains whole-route agreement. -/
def retainSourcePropertyAgreements (name : String)
    (choices : Array (SourceMemberChoice SourcePropertyEvidence))
    (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let some first := choices[0]?
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source property lost its selected route"
  unless choices.all (·.evidence.family.entry.id == first.evidence.family.entry.id) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity s!"several properties named {name} accept this receiver"
  let some selected := first.path.receiver.category
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source property lost its selected category"
  let agreements ← sourceRouteAgreements (← semanticState) selected
    (choices.map (·.evidence.family.route))
  let mut value := judgement.value
  for proof in agreements.reverse do
    value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `propertyRouteAgreement) (← inferType proof) proof
      fun binding => mkLetFVars #[binding] value
        (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
  let retained := (← SourceReadM.selection? judgement.value).getD { value := judgement.value }
  value ← SourceReadM.select { retained with value, category := judgement.category }
  return { judgement with value }

opaque sourceProperty (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (name : String) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let choices ← sourcePropertyChoices receiver name
  if choices.isEmpty then return none
  let paths := choices.map (·.path)
  let preferred ← sourceMemberPreference name (paths.filterMap (·.receiver.category)) paths
  let surviving := match preferred with
    | none => choices
    | some selected => selected.filterMap fun (selection : Nat × Route) => choices[selection.1]?
  let some first := surviving[0]?
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source property lost its selected route"
  first.withScope do
    let value ← retainSourcePropertyAgreements name surviving first.judgement
    checkSourceMemberSelections surviving
    return some (← retainMemberPreference value (preferred.bind fun selected =>
      selected[0]?.map fun (selection : Nat × Route) => selection.2))

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
