namespace CasCompiler.SourceMethodPreferenceTests

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue CasCompiler.SourceTest

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the preferred member source did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

private def failedReading (read : TermElabM α) : TermElabM Exception :=
  withoutModifyingState do
    let result ← try
      discard <| read
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
    let some error := result | throwError "the invalid member preference was accepted"
    return error

-- Select an actual nonfirst route already present in the independent registry. No new
-- method, mathematical equality, or backend response is supplied by this control.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let previous := preferredRoutesExtension.getState (← getEnv)
  try
    setPreferredRoutes #[]
    let state ← semanticState
    let rings ← selectCategory state "Rings"
    let query ← SourceRoutes.forMethod rings.expression "cardinality"
    let some routes ← query.finiteRoutes
      | throwError "the actual ring methods require a finite registered route control"
    let distinct := routes.foldl (fun found route =>
      if found.any (·.refs == route.refs) then found else found.push route) (#[] : Array Route)
    let some first := distinct[0]?
      | throwError "the original ring cardinality has no registered route"
    let some chosen := distinct[1]?
      | throwError "the preference control requires two actual distinct ring-method routes"
    let #[method] := state.methods.filter (fun method =>
      method.name == "cardinality" && method.owner.syntacticEq chosen.target)
      | throwError "the selected actual route does not have one cardinality binding"
    let labels := chosen.refs.map (·.label)
    unless !labels.isEmpty do
      throwError "the selected ring-to-cardinality route lost its actual edges"
    let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
    let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
    let session ← empty.defineTerm `R (← empty.read (← sourceTerm "ℚ in Rings"))
    let some original := session.context.entries.back?
      | throwError "the preferred method lost its original receiver binding"
    setPreferredRoutes #[{ receiver := rings.id.raw, name := "cardinality", route := labels }]
    let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm "R.cardinality()")
    checkSelected result fun value => do
      let scope ← get
      let some receiver := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == original.id)
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the preferred method lost the actual source occurrence"
      let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the preferred method lost its exact selected source"
      let some application := selected.application
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the preferred method lost its complete original application"
      let .routedMethod family := application.family
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the preferred method changed its selected family"
      let #[actual] := application.arguments
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the preferred method lost its original receiver position"
      unless selected.preferredRoute == some chosen.refs &&
          family.entry.id == method.id && family.route.refs == chosen.refs &&
          (← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections actual receiver.expression) do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the method did not retain its admitted route and original receiver"
      checkOriginal #[value] fun native => checkWithKernel native[0]!

    -- The deferred boundary consumes the same selected route. It must not require an
    -- agreement with the routes discarded by the source's admitted preference.
    let families ← RoutedMethodFamily.atSource rings.expression "cardinality"
    let #[selected] := families.filter (fun family =>
      family.entry.id == method.id && family.route.refs == chosen.refs)
      | throwError "the actual preferred method lost its complete native family"
    discard <| selected.agreements #[]
    let some discarded := families.find? (·.route.refs == first.refs)
      | throwError "the actual alternate route disappeared before the native boundary control"
    let rejected ← failedReading <| discarded.agreements #[]
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? rejected == some .invalid do throw rejected

    -- Two different surviving preferences are not ordered by declaration or provider.
    setPreferredRoutes #[
      { receiver := rings.id.raw, name := "cardinality", route := first.refs.map (·.label) },
      { receiver := rings.id.raw, name := "cardinality", route := labels }]
    let conflict ← failedReading <| session.read (← sourceTerm "R.cardinality()")
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity conflict do throw conflict

    -- A property also consumes its admitted preference, including the identity route.
    let sets ← selectCategory state "Sets"
    setPreferredRoutes #[{ receiver := sets.id.raw, name := "is_finite", route := #[] }]
    let property ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "Fin(3).is_finite()")
    checkSelected property fun value => do
      let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the preferred property lost its exact selected source"
      unless selected.preferredRoute == some #[] do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the property discarded its explicitly selected identity route"
      unless ← isProp value do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the preferred property lost its original proposition"
      checkOriginal #[value] fun native => checkWithKernel native[0]!

    -- This is an actual ring route, but it does not survive from the property's Sets owner.
    setPreferredRoutes #[{ receiver := sets.id.raw, name := "is_finite", route := labels }]
    let absent ← failedReading <| empty.read (← sourceTerm "Fin(3).is_finite()")
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? absent == some .invalid do throw absent
  finally
    setPreferredRoutes previous

end CasCompiler.SourceMethodPreferenceTests

    unless (← authoredEntries result.source.context result.selections).size == 2 do
      throwError "inherited method formation lost its original parameter or object binding"
    discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      let value ← session.readTerm result
      let expected ← session.readTerm expected
      checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "inherited method formation changed its actual classifier forgetful action"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
          (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
      return value

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let object ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "Fin(3)")
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `X object
  let session ← session.assume `unused (← nativeTerm "Nat")
  for expression in #["|X| = 3", "|X| = (3)", "3 = |X|"] do
    let question ← session.readQuestion (← sourceTerm expression)
    unless (← authoredEntries question.source.context question.selections).size == 2 do
      throwError "literal formation lost the original mathematical context"
    checkSelected question fun value => do
      let type ← inferType value
      unless type.isSort && type.sortLevel! == .zero do
        throwError "literal comparison did not form a proposition"
      let literal ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Cardinality.CardinalLiteral.denote
        #[← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Cardinality.CardinalLiteral.finite #[mkNatLit 3]]
      checkOriginal #[value, literal] fun native => do
        let value := native[0]!
        unless value.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do
          throwError "literal comparison changed the source equality"
        let right := value.getAppArgs[if expression == "3 = |X|" then 1 else 2]!
        unless ← isDefEq right native[1]! do
          throwError "the literal did not retain its registered denotation"
      unless (← authoredBindings).size == 2 do
        throwError "literal comparison lost its unused binding"
  let question ← session.readQuestion (← sourceTerm "|X| = ℵ₀")
  checkSelected question fun value => do
    let literal ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Cardinality.CardinalLiteral.denote
      #[mkConst ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Cardinality.CardinalLiteral.aleph0]
    checkOriginal #[value, literal] fun native => do
      unless native[0]!.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do
        throwError "the named literal comparison changed the source equality"
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]!.getAppArgs[2]! native[1]! do
        throwError "the named literal lost its independently registered denotation"

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the limit source did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

/- A registered limit named by its shape and applied to the maps of its diagram reads as the
apex of the declared cone at those maps: `pullback(rev(3), rev(3))` is the apex of
`setsPullback (rev 3) (rev 3)`, an object of sets (LimitEntry `lim.sets.pullback`). -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm "pullback(rev(3), rev(3))")
  unless result.category.any (·.role == .object) do
    throwError "the pullback did not read as an object"
  checkSelected result fun value => do
    let some retained ← SourceReadM.selection? value
      | throwError "the pullback lost its exact selected source"
    let some presentation := retained.originalApplication
      | throwError "the pullback lost its original complete presentation"
    unless presentation.isAppOf ``CasCatalogue.Limits.Registration.setsPullback do
      throwError "the pullback is not the declared presentation: {value}"
    let rev ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Morphisms.finRev #[mkNatLit 3]
    checkOriginal #[presentation.appFn!.appArg!, presentation.appArg!, rev] fun native => do
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[2]! <&&> isDefEq native[1]! native[2]! do
        throwError "the pullback lost its diagram maps: {presentation}"

/- A limit in a category that only creates it is the registered limit of the image diagram,
returned along the registered creation lift: `pullback(f', g')` of finite sets is the lifted apex
of the pullback of sets (`lift.finite_sets.pullbacks`, tests/acceptance/sets.cas). -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let f ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "{0 ↦ 0, 1 ↦ 1, 2 ↦ 1} : (Fin(3) in FiniteSets) → (Fin(2) in FiniteSets)")
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `f' f
  let g ← session.read (← sourceTerm "{0 ↦ 1, 1 ↦ 0} : (Fin(2) in FiniteSets) → (Fin(2) in FiniteSets)")
  let session ← session.defineTerm `g' g
  let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm "pullback(f', g')")
  unless result.category.any (·.role == .object) do
    throwError "the created pullback did not read as an object"
  checkSelected result fun value => do
    let some retained ← SourceReadM.selection? value
      | throwError "the created pullback lost its exact original selection"
    let some construction := retained.limit
      | throwError "the created pullback lost its complete original owner"
    unless construction.source.creation.isSome && construction.source.creationFamily.isSome do
      throwError "the created pullback lost its actual selected creation interface"
    checkOriginal #[value] fun native => do
      unless (native[0]!.find? (·.isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.liftLimit)).isSome &&
          (native[0]!.find? (·.isAppOf ``CasCatalogue.Limits.Registration.setsPullback)).isSome do
        throwError "the pullback is not the lifted registered pullback of sets: {value}"

module

public import CasCompiler.OperationFamily
public import CasCompiler.FamilyConversion
public import CasCompiler.SourcePointOrigin
import CasCompiler.SourceCarrier

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

private structure RoutedNumeral where
  owner : NativeSourceElementOwner
  route : Route
  categoryFamily : Expr
  family : NativeOwnedFamily
  evidence : Array Expr := #[]
  alternatives : Array (SelectedSourceReference × Array EdgeRef) := #[]
  terminal : Option Expr := none

private inductive NumeralContext where
  | direct
  | carrier (owner : NativeSourceElementOwner) (comparison : Expr)
      (refinement : Option ObjectEntry)
  | selected (routed : RoutedNumeral)
  | refinement (entry : ObjectEntry)

-- The point must land in the complete selected carrier family before specialization.
-- Reuse sourceCarrier's explicit prefix and whole-functor agreement rules.
private def numeralCarrierAgreement (routed : RoutedNumeral) : TermElabM Expr := do
  let count ← forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType routed.categoryFamily) fun parameters _ =>
    pure parameters.size
  lambdaTelescope routed.family.value fun parameters body => do
    let category := mkAppN routed.categoryFamily (parameters.take count)
    let object := parameters[routed.family.objectIndex]!
    let carrier ← sourceCarrierFamilyObject routed.owner.category category object
    let type ← whnfR (← inferType body)
    unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
      throwError "the whole numeral family lost its point-map boundary"
    let target ← mkLambdaFVars parameters type.getAppArgs[3]!
    let expected ← mkLambdaFVars parameters carrier
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType target) (← inferType expected) <&&> isDefEq target expected do
      throwError "the numeral has a different complete selected carrier family"
    let proof ← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl target) (← mkEq target expected)
    checkWithKernel proof
    return proof

-- Source rule: CasCatalogue.Language.decideObligation, using native checked decisions.
private def numeralProof (proposition : Expr) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  if proposition.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 then
    let arguments := proposition.getAppArgs
    if ← withoutModifyingState <| isDefEq arguments[1]! arguments[2]! then
      return some (← mkEqRefl arguments[1]!)
  let decision ← mkDecide proposition
  unless (← withAtLeastTransparency .default <| whnf decision).isConstOf ``Bool.true do
    return none
  return some (← mkDecideProof proposition)

-- Resolve only proof and instance fields, in declaration order. All mathematical data
-- parameters must already come from the actual domain, literal or selected structure.
private def completePointParameters (arguments : Array Expr) (binders : Array BinderInfo)
    (proofs : Array Term) (start : Nat) : TermElabM (Option Nat) := do
  let mut proofIndex := start
  for argument in arguments, binder in binders do
    unless (← instantiateMVars argument).hasMVar do continue
    let type ← instantiateMVars (← inferType argument)
    if binder.isInstImplicit then
      unless ← isDefEq argument (← synthInstance type) do return none
    else if ← isProp type then
      let proof ← if proofs.isEmpty then do
          let some proof ← numeralProof type | return none
          pure proof
        else do
          let some evidence := proofs[proofIndex]?
            | throwError "the source numeral requires explicit evidence for its domain obligation"
          proofIndex := proofIndex + 1
          elabTermEnsuringType evidence (some type)
      unless ← isDefEq argument proof do return none
    else throwSemanticAmbiguity "the source numeral requires an actual declaration parameter"
  return some proofIndex

-- This is the ordinary named-base reading used below and through an explicitly supplied
-- carrier comparison. It does not select a stronger structure for the original owner.
private def numeralRefinementParameters (entry : ObjectEntry) (expected : Expr)
    (proofs : Array Term) : SourceReadM (Option (SourceSelection Expr × Expr × Nat)) := do
  let some refinement := entry.refines
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source numeral refinement has no declared comparison"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
  discard <| checkedDeclaration refinement.identification
  let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
  let (parameters, binders, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration)
  let comparison ← applyObjectParameters entry.id.raw refinement.identification parameters
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source numeral refinement requires its complete native isomorphism"
  unless ← isDefEq type.getAppArgs[3]! expected do return none
  let some proofIndex ← completePointParameters parameters binders proofs 0
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source numeral's declared domain obligation is not established"
  let #[category] := (← semanticState).categories.filter (·.id == entry.category)
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source numeral refinement lost its original category row"
  let object ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN declaration parameters)
  let object ← sourceReferenceAt (.named (.registered (.inl entry) category)) object object
  let comparison ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars comparison
  let comparison ← SourceReadM.select
    (← sourceReferenceAt (.refinement entry refinement) comparison comparison)
  return some (object, comparison, proofIndex)

/-- Reapply the same complete declaration positions after selecting its structural object.
Dependent proofs and dictionaries keep their original supplied values at the stated types. -/
private def numeralApplication (function : Expr) (arguments : Array Expr) :
    SourceReadM Expr := do
  let mut result := function
  for original in arguments do
    let .forallE _ type _ _ ← whnfR (← inferType result)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the numeral lost its complete declaration telescope"
    let argument ← if ← isDefEq (← inferType original) type then pure original else do
      let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? original).getD { value := original }
      SourceReadM.select { selected with value := original } (some type)
    result := mkApp result argument
    check result
  return result

/-- Form only the source's actual point map, with its actual refinement comparison.
Reuse: NumeralEntry's last natural parameter and explicit proof obligations;
ObjectRefinement's checked shared telescope and directed identification. -/
private def numeralCandidate (row : NumeralEntry) (context : NumeralContext)
    (number : Nat) (expected : Expr) (proofs : Array Term) : SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  let (object, comparison, proofIndex) ← match context with
    | .direct => pure (none, none, 0)
    | .carrier _ comparison refinement => do
      let comparison ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.symm #[comparison]
      let type ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
      unless ← isDefEq type.getAppArgs[3]! expected do return none
      match refinement with
      | none => pure (none, some comparison, 0)
      | some entry => do
        let some (object, baseComparison, proofIndex) ←
            numeralRefinementParameters entry type.getAppArgs[2]! proofs | return none
        let comparison ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.trans #[baseComparison, comparison]
        pure (some object, some comparison, proofIndex)
    | .selected routed => do
      let selected ← nativeRouteFunctor (← semanticState) routed.route routed.owner.category.bundle
      let value ← functorObject selected.functor routed.owner.value selected.target
      pure (some ({ value } : SourceSelection Expr), none, 0)
    | .refinement entry => do
      let some (object, comparison, proofIndex) ←
          numeralRefinementParameters entry expected proofs | return none
      pure (some object, some comparison, proofIndex)
  let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels row.declaration
  let (arguments, binders, type) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a registered numeral requires its complete native point signature"
  let explicit := (List.range arguments.size).toArray.filter (binders[·]!.isExplicit)
  let some literal ← explicit.reverse.findM? fun index =>
      return (← inferType arguments[index]!).isConstOf ``Nat
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a registered numeral has no declared natural parameter"
  if let some object := object then
    let some first := explicit[0]?
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a registered numeral has no declared structural object parameter"
    unless ← isDefEq arguments[first]! object.value do return none
  unless ← isDefEq arguments[literal]! (mkNatLit number) do return none
  let target := type.getAppArgs[3]!
  let destination ← match comparison with
    | none => pure expected
    | some comparison => do
      let type ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
      pure type.getAppArgs[2]!
  if row.over.isNone then
    let source ← sourceDomain destination
    let target ← sourceDomain target
    unless source.getAppFn.constName?.isSome &&
        source.getAppFn.constName? == target.getAppFn.constName? do return none
  unless ← isDefEq target destination do return none
  for index in explicit.filter (· > literal) do
    let proposition ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType arguments[index]!)
    unless ← isProp proposition do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a registered numeral's trailing obligations must be propositions"
  let some proofIndex ← completePointParameters arguments binders proofs proofIndex
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source numeral's declared domain obligation is not established"
  unless proofIndex == proofs.size do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source numeral has evidence beyond its declared domain obligations"
  let point ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN declaration arguments)
  if point.hasMVar || point.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered source numeral is not determined at its complete boundary"
  let mut actual ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| arguments.mapM instantiateMVars
  if let some object := object then
    let some first := explicit[0]?
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected numeral lost its original structural argument position"
    let object ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| object.mapM instantiateMVars
    let object ← SourceReadM.select object
    actual := actual.set! first object
  let point ← numeralApplication (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars declaration) actual
  let application := point
  let point ← match comparison with
    | none => do
      let type ← inferType point
      let type ← if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure type else whnfR type
      unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected numeral lost its complete point type"
      let stated := mkAppN type.getAppFn (type.getAppArgs.set! 3 expected)
      SourceReadM.select { value := point } (some stated)
    | some comparison => do
      let comparison ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars comparison
      let type ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
      let pointType ← inferType point
      let pointType ← if pointType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure pointType
        else whnfR pointType
      unless pointType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the transported numeral lost its original point domain"
      let stated := mkAppN type.getAppFn
        (type.getAppArgs.set! 2 pointType.getAppArgs[3]! |>.set! 3 expected)
      let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? comparison).getD { value := comparison }
      let comparison ← SourceReadM.select { selected with value := comparison } (some stated)
      let type ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
      let hom ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[comparison]
      let categoryStructure ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct
        #[some type.getAppArgs[0]!, some type.getAppArgs[1]!]
      let pointType ← inferType point
      let pointType ← if pointType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure pointType
        else whnfR pointType
      unless pointType.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the transported numeral lost its original point domain"
      -- Keep the original consuming carrier in the native composite's target. Conversion
      -- validates the supplied isomorphism; it never replaces that source parameter.
      mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
        #[some type.getAppArgs[0]!, some categoryStructure,
          some pointType.getAppArgs[2]!, some pointType.getAppArgs[3]!, some expected,
          some point, some hom]
  let type ← inferType point
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the admitted numeral is not a native point map"
  let source := type.getAppArgs[2]!
  let terminalPoint ← mkAppOptM ``default #[some source, none]
  let function ← sourceSetFunction point
  let value ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr terminalPoint] (some expected) false false
  let selected ← retainSourcePoint point (← sourceReferenceAt (.numeral row) application value)
  let value ← match context with
    | .carrier owner _ _ =>
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `numeralCarrierAgreement)
        (← inferType owner.evidence) owner.evidence fun binding =>
          mkLetFVars #[binding] value (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
    | .selected routed => do
      let mut value := value
      for evidence in (routed.evidence.push routed.owner.evidence).reverse do
        let body := value
        value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `numeralOwnerAgreement)
          (← inferType evidence) evidence fun binding =>
            mkLetFVars #[binding] body (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
      pure value
    | _ => pure value
  let selected := { selected with
    value
    elementOwner := match context with
      | .carrier owner _ _ => some owner
      | .selected routed => some routed.owner
      | _ => none
    alternatives := match context with
      | .selected routed => routed.alternatives
      | _ => #[] }
  return some (← SourceReadM.select selected (some expected))

-- A nullary row's arity does not itself prove that its complete native source is
-- terminal. Retain the existing Unique dictionary at the rigid family, before an
-- actual object or category parameter is substituted.
private def nullaryPointTerminal (family : Expr) : TermElabM Expr := do
  let value ← lambdaTelescope family fun parameters body => do
    let type ← whnfR (← inferType body)
    unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
      throwError "the nullary point family lost its complete native map"
    let source ← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[2]!
    let some unique ← synthInstance? (← mkAppM ``Unique #[source])
      | throwUnsupportedSource "the nullary operation requires its complete terminal-source witness"
    mkLambdaFVars parameters unique (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
  if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the nullary terminal family has undetermined native parameters"
  checkWithKernel value
  return value

-- Apply the native default field of this already checked Unique dictionary.
-- No unrelated Inhabited or OfNat instance can replace its selected point.
private def uniquePoint (unique : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let inhabited ← mkProjection unique `toInhabited
  mkProjection inhabited `default

-- Specialize only the already checked nullary family, against the complete
-- selected category and its exact original object. The terminal dictionary is
-- specialized with the same arguments, rather than inferred again from a value.
private def nullaryNumeralCandidate (routed : RoutedNumeral) (expected : Expr)
    (proofs : Array Term) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  unless proofs.isEmpty do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the nullary source operation has no numeral obligations"
  let some terminal := routed.terminal
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the nullary source operation lost its terminal family"
  let mut collected : CollectLevelParams.State := {}
  collected := collected.collect routed.categoryFamily
  collected := collected.collect routed.family.value
  collected := collected.collect terminal
  let universes := collected.params.toList
  let levels ← universes.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  let categoryFamily := routed.categoryFamily.instantiateLevelParams universes levels
  let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType categoryFamily)
  unless ← isDefEq (mkAppN categoryFamily parameters) routed.owner.category.bundle do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the nullary operation has a different complete selected category"
  let family := routed.family.value.instantiateLevelParams universes levels
  let function := mkAppN family parameters
  let (arguments, binders, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType function)
  let objectIndex := routed.family.objectIndex - parameters.size
  let some object := arguments[objectIndex]?
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the nullary operation lost its selected object parameter"
  unless ← isDefEq object routed.owner.value do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the nullary operation changed its actual selected object"
  let some _ ← completePointParameters arguments binders #[] 0
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the nullary operation has unestablished native obligations"
  let actual ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| (parameters ++ arguments).mapM instantiateMVars
  let point ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN family actual)
  let terminal ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars
    (mkAppN (terminal.instantiateLevelParams universes levels) actual)
  if point.hasMVar || point.hasLevelMVar || terminal.hasMVar || terminal.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the nullary operation requires its complete original parameters"
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType point)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the nullary operation lost its complete native point"
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType terminal)
      (← mkAppM ``Unique #[← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[2]!]) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the nullary operation changed its complete terminal source"
  unless ← isDefEq type.getAppArgs[3]! expected do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the nullary operation has a different complete selected carrier"
  let argument ← uniquePoint terminal
  let function ← sourceSetFunction point
  let value ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr argument] (some expected) false false
  let selected ← retainSourcePoint point { value }
  let mut value := value
  for evidence in (routed.evidence.push routed.owner.evidence).reverse do
    let body := value
    value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `numeralOwnerAgreement)
      (← inferType evidence) evidence fun binding =>
        mkLetFVars #[binding] body (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
  SourceReadM.select { selected with
    value
    elementOwner := some routed.owner
    alternatives := routed.alternatives } (some expected)

-- T034's existing numeric syntax resolves registered numerals before an inherited
-- nullary operation (Language at 92916e1, lines 8015-8017 and 8143-8154). Enter
-- this lookup only when no numeral reading applies; semantic failures are not
-- absence. The exact token selects first-hit operations, whose complete native
-- families must agree before any actual source object is supplied.
private def sourceNullaryNumeral (state : SemanticState)
    (ownerFamilies : Array (NativeSourceElementOwner × Expr))
    (number : Nat) (expected : Expr) (proofs : Array Term) : SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  let mut candidates : Array (OperationEntry × RoutedNumeral) := #[]
  let mut hasBinding := false
  for (selected, categoryFamily) in ownerFamilies do
    let paths ← SourceRoutes.forOperation selected.category.expression (toString number)
    let some routes ← paths.finiteRoutes
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "nullary numeral inheritance requires its supplied uniform comparison"
    for route in routes do
      for row in state.operationBindings route.target (toString number) do
        hasBinding := true
        unless row.arity == 0 && row.numerals == 0 do continue
        let family ← nativeOwnedFamily state selected.category.expression categoryFamily route
          row.declaration (fun infos => if infos.isEmpty then none else some (infos.size - 1))
          (some (.operation row))
        candidates := candidates.push
          (row, ⟨selected, route, categoryFamily, family,
            #[], #[(.operation row, route.refs)], none⟩)
  for (_, routed) in candidates do
    discard <| levelMVarToParam (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars routed.family.value)
  candidates ← candidates.mapM fun (row, routed) => do
    let value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars routed.family.value
    if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the complete nullary point family has undetermined parameters"
    let routed := { routed with
      categoryFamily := ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars routed.categoryFamily
      family := { routed.family with value } }
    let proof ← numeralCarrierAgreement routed
    let terminal ← nullaryPointTerminal value
    return (row, { routed with evidence := #[proof], terminal := some terminal })
  let some (row, first) := candidates[0]?
    | if hasBinding then
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the first source numeral operation has a different nullary signature"
      else
        return none
  let mut evidence := first.evidence
  let mut alternatives := #[]
  for (_, other) in candidates do
    unless first.owner.value == other.owner.value &&
        first.owner.category.expression.syntacticEq other.owner.category.expression &&
        (← isDefEq first.owner.category.bundle other.owner.category.bundle) do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "the source numeral requires its selected original structure"
    let comparisons := first.owner.category.carrier.toArray.flatMap (·.comparisons) ++
      other.owner.category.carrier.toArray.flatMap (·.comparisons)
    let some proof ← sourceFamilyConversion first.family.value other.family.value comparisons
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity
          s!"inherited point families require their supplied whole agreement: {repr (first.alternatives.map fun (reference, route) => (reference.declaration, route))} and {repr (other.alternatives.map fun (reference, route) => (reference.declaration, route))}"
    evidence := evidence ++ other.evidence.push proof
    alternatives := alternatives ++ other.alternatives
  let value ← nullaryNumeralCandidate { first with evidence, alternatives } expected proofs
  let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? value).getD { value }
  return some (← SourceReadM.select { selected with value, observation := some (.operation row) })

/-- First-binding lookup for numerals (constitution C6): an inherited numeral route is a reading
only when no numeral row binds at a category before its target. This is the rule that
`SemanticState.isFirstOperationBindingRoute` states for operation names; a farther binding
cannot replace one already found on the same path. -/
private def firstNumeralBinding (state : SemanticState) (route : Route) : Bool :=
  route.steps.all fun edge => !state.categories.any fun entry =>
    entry.expression.syntacticEq edge.source && state.numerals.any (·.over == some entry.id)

/-- Read a numeral from its independent point declarations, not a host OfNat instance.
Nat parameters use the kernel's natural literal. Point domains retain their original source
object identity; refinements require the actual registered object and directed comparison.
Only the absence of an applicable numeral and a numeric operation binding returns `none`.
Failures of a selected family, native boundary or required evidence remain errors.
Source: Registry.Entry.NumeralEntry and ObjectRefinement, LC-15; #66 source intake contract. -/
opaque sourceNumeral? (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (number : Nat) (expected : Expr) (proofs : Array Term := #[]) : SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  if expected.headBeta.isConstOf ``Nat then
    unless proofs.isEmpty do liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a natural parameter literal has no domain obligations"
    return some (mkNatLit number)
  let state ← semanticState
  let (domain, bases) ← registeredSourceDomain expected
  let originalType ← SourceReadM.selection? expected
  let nativeExpected := if bases.isEmpty then
      (originalType.bind (·.typeOrigin)).map (·.type) |>.getD expected
    else domain
  let finish := fun (value : Expr) => do
    let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? value).getD { value }
    SourceReadM.select { selected with value } (some expected)
  let owners ← if bases.isEmpty then sourceElementOwners categoryOf expected #[expected]
    else pure #[]
  let ownerFamilies ← owners.mapM fun owner => do
    let family ← nativeCategoryFamily state owner.category.expression fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
    return (owner, family)
  -- A supplied comparison fixes its base before any numeral is interpreted there.
  -- A named refinement requires that exact registered codomain; direct point readings
  -- retain their existing declaration-head check. The context cannot recurse back
  -- to the original owner or replace it with a convertible structure.
  let mut carrierBases : Array (NativeSourceElementOwner × Expr × Array ObjectEntry) := #[]
  for owner in owners do
    for comparison in owner.category.carrier.toArray.flatMap (·.comparisons) do
      let type ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
      unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do continue
      unless ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState <|
          isDefEq type.getAppArgs[2]! expected do continue
      let (_, namedBases) ← registeredSourceDomain type.getAppArgs[3]!
      carrierBases := carrierBases.push (owner, comparison, namedBases)
  let mut candidates : Array (NumeralEntry × NumeralContext) := #[]
  let mut carrierRefinements : Array (NumeralEntry × NumeralContext) := #[]
  for row in state.numerals do
    discard <| checkedDeclaration row.declaration
    match row.over with
    | none =>
      candidates := candidates.push (row, .direct)
      for (owner, comparison, _) in carrierBases do
        candidates := candidates.push (row, .carrier owner comparison none)
    | some owner =>
      let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == owner)
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source numeral requires one registered structural category"
      for (selected, categoryFamily) in ownerFamilies do
        let paths ← SourceRoutes.forOwner selected.category.expression category.expression
        let some routes ← paths.finiteRoutes
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "numeral inheritance requires its supplied uniform comparison"
        for route in routes do
          unless firstNumeralBinding state route do continue
          let family ← nativeOwnedFamily state selected.category.expression categoryFamily route
            row.declaration (fun infos => infos.findIdx? (·.isExplicit)) (some (.numeral row))
          candidates := candidates.push
            (row, .selected ⟨selected, route, categoryFamily, family,
              #[], #[(.numeral row, route.refs)], none⟩)
      for entry in state.objects.filter (·.category == owner) do
        if let some refinement := entry.refines then
          if bases.any (·.id == refinement.base) then
            candidates := candidates.push (row, .refinement entry)
          for (selected, comparison, namedBases) in carrierBases do
            if namedBases.any (·.id == refinement.base) then
              carrierRefinements := carrierRefinements.push
                (row, .carrier selected comparison (some entry))
  let hasSelectedStructure := candidates.any fun (_, context) =>
    match context with
    | .selected _ => true
    | _ => false
  if bases.isEmpty && !hasSelectedStructure then
    let defaults ← sourceLiteralDomains domain
    for base in defaults do
      for row in state.numerals do
        if let some owner := row.over then
          for entry in state.objects.filter (·.category == owner) do
            if entry.refines.any (·.base == base.id) then
              candidates := candidates.push (row, .refinement entry)
  -- Freeze every whole-family universe before checking carriers or point agreement.
  for (_, context) in candidates do
    if let .selected routed := context then
      discard <| levelMVarToParam (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars routed.family.value)
  candidates ← candidates.mapM fun (row, context) => do
    let .selected routed := context | return (row, context)
    let value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars routed.family.value
    if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the complete inherited numeral family has undetermined parameters"
    let routed := { routed with
      categoryFamily := ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars routed.categoryFamily
      family := { routed.family with value } }
    let proof ← numeralCarrierAgreement routed
    return (row, .selected { routed with evidence := #[proof] })
  let mut admitted := #[]
  for (row, context) in candidates do
    let applicable ← SourceReadM.inspect do
      return (← numeralCandidate row context number nativeExpected proofs).isSome
    if applicable then
      admitted := admitted.push (row, context)
  -- T034's selected and derived structure readings return before ordinary named-base
  -- reading (Language at 92916e1, 8083-8138 and 8143-8146). A supplied base comparison
  -- supplies this later reading only on actual absence; ambiguity and proof failures
  -- above are not absence, and no sampled numeral identifies different families.
  if admitted.isEmpty then
    for (row, context) in carrierRefinements do
      let applicable ← SourceReadM.inspect do
        return (← numeralCandidate row context number nativeExpected proofs).isSome
      if applicable then admitted := admitted.push (row, context)
  let some (row, context) := admitted[0]?
    | do
      let some value ← sourceNullaryNumeral state ownerFamilies number nativeExpected proofs
        | return none
      return some (← finish value)
  let context ← if admitted.size == 1 then pure context else do
    let .selected first := context
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "several declared source point numerals apply in this domain"
    let mut evidence := first.evidence
    let mut alternatives := #[]
    for (_, other) in admitted do
      let .selected other := other
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "several declared source point numerals apply in this domain"
      unless first.owner.value == other.owner.value &&
          first.owner.category.expression.syntacticEq other.owner.category.expression &&
          (← isDefEq first.owner.category.bundle other.owner.category.bundle) do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "the source numeral requires its selected original structure"
      let comparisons := first.owner.category.carrier.toArray.flatMap (·.comparisons) ++
        other.owner.category.carrier.toArray.flatMap (·.comparisons)
      let some proof ← sourceFamilyConversion first.family.value other.family.value comparisons
        | do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity
          s!"inherited point families require their supplied whole agreement: {repr (first.alternatives.map fun (reference, route) => (reference.declaration, route))} and {repr (other.alternatives.map fun (reference, route) => (reference.declaration, route))}"
      evidence := evidence ++ other.evidence.push proof
      alternatives := alternatives ++ other.alternatives
    pure (.selected { first with evidence, alternatives })
  let some value ← numeralCandidate row context number nativeExpected proofs
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected source numeral changed its admitted boundary"
  return some (← finish value)

/-- An ordinary numeral reading requires a declared source point. The optional producer
reports only actual absence; its original family, domain and proof failures propagate. -/
opaque sourceNumeral (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (number : Nat) (expected : Expr) (proofs : Array Term := #[]) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let some value ← sourceNumeral? categoryOf number expected proofs
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError (MessageData.tagged `CasCompiler.sourceNumeral.noAdmittedPoint
      "no declared source point numeral was admitted in the supplied domain")
  return value

-- Reuse Registry.Entry.LiteralEntry: category identity selects the complete literal
-- boundary before elaborating either existing literal syntax form at its native type.
private def sourceObjectLiteral (selected : NativeSourceCategory) (expected : Expr)
    (readLiteral : Name → Expr → TermElabM Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  unless selected.role == .object do return none
  let .atom category := selected.expression | return none
  let rows := (← semanticState).literals.filter (·.category == category)
  if rows.isEmpty then return none
  let #[row] := rows
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "the selected category requires its literal form"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration row.type
  discard <| checkedDeclaration row.denotation
  let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[selected.bundle]
  unless ← isDefEq expected carrier do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the object literal has a different complete selected category"
  let literalType ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels row.type
  let literal ← readLiteral row.type literalType
  let value ← mkAppM row.denotation #[literal]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) carrier do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered literal denotation has a different selected category"
  let value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars value
  if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered object literal has undetermined parameters"
  let value ← SourceReadM.select { (← sourceReferenceAt (.literal row) value value) with
    category := some selected } (some expected)
  return some ⟨value, some selected⟩

/-- OfNat acts only on the registered literal type; the denotation supplies the object.
Reuse: LiteralEntry and Lean's typed numeral elaborator, not a carrier OfNat instance. -/
def sourceObjectNumeral (number : Nat) (selected : NativeSourceCategory)
    (expected : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  sourceObjectLiteral selected expected fun _ literalType => do
    let source : Term := ⟨Syntax.mkNumLit (toString number)⟩
    elabTermEnsuringType source (some literalType)

/-- Named literals use the actual declaration in their registered type's namespace.
Reuse: the public literalExpr namespace rule and LiteralEntry; source is never replayed. -/
def sourceObjectNamedLiteral (name : Name) (selected : NativeSourceCategory)
    (expected : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) :=
  sourceObjectLiteral selected expected fun typeName literalType => do
    let declaration := typeName ++ name
    discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
    elabTermEnsuringType (mkIdent declaration) (some literalType)

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.Surface
public import CasCompiler.FamilyConversion

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue

/-- Name an authored native object alias only after comparing its entire family under rigid
universes. The unchanged original arguments are applied after that check. A retained object
reference is never selected or replaced by native carrier equality. -/
def sourceNamedObjectAlias (category : CategoryId) (source : SourceSelection Expr) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  -- This operation names only an unselected declaration at its whole rigid family.
  -- Every already retained structure and source occurrence keeps its complete selection.
  if source.value.isFVar || !source.formalBindings.isEmpty ||
      source.reference.isSome || source.observation.isSome || source.originalApplication.isSome ||
      source.application.isSome || source.admission.isSome || source.category.isSome ||
      source.typeOrigin.isSome || source.elementOwner.isSome || source.pointOrigin.isSome ||
      source.pointRequest.isSome || source.isoOrigin.isSome || source.field.isSome ||
      source.endpoint.isSome || source.limit.isSome || source.leg.isSome || source.cell.isSome ||
      source.cartesian.isSome || source.presentationEndpoints.isSome || source.routedInputs.isSome ||
      source.legOrdinal.isSome || !source.carrierRoutes.isEmpty || source.preferredRoute.isSome ||
      source.creationOwner.isSome then return source
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[categoryEntry] := state.categories.filter (·.id == category)
    | throwSemanticAmbiguity "the native object alias requires one complete registered category"
  let body := source.value
  let .const declaration levels := body.getAppFn | return source
  let original ← checkedDeclaration declaration
  let direct := state.objects.filter fun row =>
    row.category == category && row.declaration == declaration
  if let #[row] := direct then
    return { source with reference := some (.named (.registered (.inl row) categoryEntry)) }
  unless direct.isEmpty do
    throwSemanticAmbiguity "the native object declaration has several registered source names"
  let names ← original.levelParams.mapM fun _ => mkFreshUserName `objectAliasUniverse
  let rigid := mkConst declaration (names.map Level.param)
  let mut aliases : Array (ObjectEntry × Expr) := #[]
  for row in state.objects do
    unless row.category == category do continue
    let candidate ← withoutModifyingState do
      let info ← checkedDeclaration row.declaration
      let universes ← info.levelParams.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
      let aliasTerm := mkConst row.declaration universes
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType rigid) (← inferType aliasTerm) do return none
      let aliasTerm ← instantiateMVars aliasTerm
      if aliasTerm.hasMVar || aliasTerm.hasLevelMVar then return none
      let some _ ← sourceFamilyConversion rigid aliasTerm #[] | return none
      return some aliasTerm
    if let some aliasTerm := candidate then aliases := aliases.push (row, aliasTerm)
  match aliases with
  | #[] => return source
  | #[(row, aliasTerm)] =>
    unless names.length == levels.length do
      throwError "the native object alias lost its complete universe parameters"
    let named := mkAppN (aliasTerm.instantiateLevelParams names levels) body.getAppArgs
    unless ← isDefEq named source.value do
      throwError "the registered object alias changed its original native arguments"
    return { source with
      value := named
      reference := some (.named (.registered (.inl row) categoryEntry)) }
  | _ => throwSemanticAmbiguity "the native object family has several authored registered aliases"

end CasCompiler

module

public import CasCompiler.OperationFamily
public import CasCompiler.FamilyConversion
import CasCompiler.SourceCarrier
public import CasCompiler.SourceProof

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

/-- A selected element domain, or its exact registered refinement and supplied comparison.
The shared resolver owns construction; consumers retain its actual native parameters. -/
structure NativeSourceOperationDomain where
  private mk ::
  category : NativeSourceCategory
  value : Expr
  comparison : Option Expr
  originEvidence : Array Expr

private def refinementDomainCandidate (state : SemanticState) (entry : ObjectEntry) (domain : Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceOperationDomain) := do
  let some refinement := entry.refines | return none
  discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
  discard <| checkedDeclaration refinement.identification
  let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
  let (arguments, infos, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration)
  let comparison ← applyObjectParameters entry.id.raw refinement.identification arguments
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source operation refinement requires its actual isomorphism"
  let some base := state.objects.find? (·.id == refinement.base)
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source refinement lost its declared base object"
  let (original, _) ← registeredSourceDomain domain
  let declared := type.getAppArgs[3]!.headBeta.consumeMData
  let mut retainedArguments : Array (Option Expr) := Array.replicate arguments.size none
  if original.getAppFn.isConstOf base.declaration then
    let some retained ← alignSourceArguments? base.declaration arguments declared original
      | return none
    retainedArguments := retained
  -- Exact named arguments are fixed before an abbreviation can expose a non-injective
  -- carrier. Unmarked native forms retain their existing conversion check.
  let determined ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| if arguments.isEmpty then isDefEq type.getAppArgs[3]! original
    else withReducible <| isDefEq type.getAppArgs[3]! original
  unless determined do return none
  for argument in arguments, info in infos do
    if info.isInstImplicit && (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars argument).isMVar then
      let some instanceValue ← synthInstance? (← inferType argument) | return none
      unless ← isDefEq argument instanceValue do return none
  let mut arguments ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| arguments.mapM instantiateMVars
  for original in retainedArguments, index in [:retainedArguments.size] do
    if let some original := original then
      arguments := arguments.set! index (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars original)
  if arguments.any (fun argument => argument.hasMVar || argument.hasLevelMVar) then return none
  -- applyObjectParameters uses this complete telescope. Reuse its original constant head
  -- and the same retained source arguments for both the object and its comparison.
  let comparison := mkAppN (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars comparison.getAppFn) arguments
  let comparison ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
    (.refinement entry refinement) comparison comparison)
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType comparison)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the specialized source refinement lost its actual isomorphism"
  -- Registered identities are compared at the determined parameters, not at fresh ones.
  checkRegisteredSourceDomains domain (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars type.getAppArgs[3]!)
  let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == entry.category)
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source refinement requires one complete category"
  let (bundle, value) ← registeredExpressions (.inl entry) category fun function _ => do
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType function) (← inferType declaration) do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source refinement changed its complete declaration parameters"
    return mkAppN function arguments
  let selection ← objectCarrierSelection entry bundle value
  return some ⟨⟨.object, category.expression, bundle, selection, none⟩, value,
    some (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars comparison), #[]⟩

private def refinementDomain (state : SemanticState) (entry : ObjectEntry) (domain : Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceOperationDomain) := do
  -- A failed candidate must not constrain a later candidate's source parameters. Probe the
  -- complete native preparation, then keep successful expressions in the live Meta state.
  let accepts ← SourceReadM.inspect do
    return (← refinementDomainCandidate state entry domain).isSome
  unless accepts do return none
  refinementDomainCandidate state entry domain

private def scopedOperationDomains
    (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (expected : Expr) (hints : Array Expr) : SourceReadM (Array NativeSourceOperationDomain) := do
  return (← sourceElementOwners categoryOf expected hints).map fun owner =>
    ⟨owner.category, owner.value, none, #[owner.evidence]⟩

/-- Selected source objects precede default literal selectors. Every matching original
structure is retained; native carrier coincidence does not identify their dictionaries.
Reuse this boundary for operations and registered division alike. -/
opaque sourceOperationDomains
    (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory)) (expected : Expr)
    (contextual : Option Expr) (hints : Array Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Array NativeSourceOperationDomain) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let (domain, entries) ← registeredSourceDomain expected
  if entries.isEmpty then
    let hints := contextual.toArray ++ hints
    let selected ← scopedOperationDomains categoryOf expected hints
    if !selected.isEmpty then return selected
  let bases := entries
  let bases ← if bases.isEmpty then sourceLiteralDomains domain else pure bases
  let mut domains := #[]
  for entry in state.objects do
    unless entry.refines.any (fun refinement => bases.any (·.id == refinement.base)) do continue
    if let some candidate ← refinementDomain state entry expected then
      domains := domains.push candidate
  return domains

private def operationRoutes (source : CategoryExpr) (name : String) :
    TermElabM (Array Route) := do
  let routes ← SourceRoutes.forOperation source name
  let some candidates ← routes.finiteRoutes
    | throwUnsupportedSource "the operation route family requires its supplied uniform comparison"
  return candidates

private structure OperationRoot where
  domain : NativeSourceOperationDomain
  domains : Array NativeSourceOperationDomain
  routes : Array Route
  images : Array (Array Route)

-- A common supplied refinement gives one generic comparison context. Selection uses
-- symbolic structural incidence only; operation values and operands are not inspected.
private def operationRoot (domains : Array NativeSourceOperationDomain) (name : String) :
    TermElabM OperationRoot := do
  let mut active := #[]
  for domain in domains do
    let routes ← operationRoutes domain.category.expression name
    if !routes.isEmpty then active := active.push (domain, routes)
  if active.isEmpty then throwError "the source domain has no binding for operation {name}"
  let mut roots := #[]
  for (domain, routes) in active do
    let mut images := #[]
    for (target, _) in active do
      let family ← SourceRoutes.forOwner domain.category.expression target.category.expression
      let some candidates ← family.finiteRoutes
        | throwUnsupportedSource "the source refinement cone requires its uniform comparison"
      images := images.push candidates
    if images.all (! ·.isEmpty) then roots := roots.push (domain, routes, images)
  let #[(domain, routes, images)] := roots
    | throwSemanticAmbiguity "the source operation requires its selected common refinement"
  return ⟨domain, active.map (·.1), routes, images⟩

private structure NativeOperationFamily where
  route : Route
  binding : OperationEntry
  value : Expr

/-- A native operation whose whole source families have been checked before specialization. -/
structure NativeSourceOperation where
  value : Expr
  arity : Nat
  comparison : Option Expr
  inputDomains : Array Bool
  outputDomain : Bool
  inputTransports : Array Bool
  outputTransport : Bool

private partial def operationInputs (type : Expr) (arity : Nat) : MetaM (Array Expr) := do
  if arity == 1 then return #[type]
  unless arity > 1 do throwError "a source element operation requires its operand domain"
  let pair ← whnf type
  unless pair.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 do
    throwUnsupportedSource "the source operation requires its declared product mediation"
  return #[pair.getAppArgs[0]!] ++ (← operationInputs pair.getAppArgs[1]! (arity - 1))

/-- Form every element-juxtaposition role from selected owners and whole input families.
Reuse: Language.juxtapose's common-object rule, first-hit operation routes and
nativeOperationFamily. A pending numeral has no selected object; heterogeneous action
roles are compared before any actual scalar or module is substituted. -/
def sourceJuxtapositionNames
    (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory))
    (left : Option NativeSourceJudgement) (right : NativeSourceJudgement) :
    SourceReadM (Array String) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let rightType ← inferType right.value
  let rightDomains ← sourceOperationDomains categoryOf rightType none #[rightType]
  let leftDomains ← match left with
    | none => pure #[]
    | some left => do
      let type ← inferType left.value
      sourceOperationDomains categoryOf type none #[type]
  let mut names : Array String := #[]
  if !leftDomains.isEmpty && !rightDomains.isEmpty then
    let domains := leftDomains ++ rightDomains
    for root in domains do
      if (← operationRoutes root.category.expression "·").isEmpty then continue
      let mut common := true
      for target in domains do
        let family ← SourceRoutes.forOwner root.category.expression target.category.expression
        let some routes ← family.finiteRoutes
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "juxtaposition requires its uniform source comparison"
        if routes.isEmpty then common := false
      if common && !names.contains "·" then names := names.push "·"
  let mut heterogeneous := #[]
  for domain in rightDomains do
    let routes ← operationRoutes domain.category.expression "•"
    if routes.isEmpty then continue
    let categoryFamily ← nativeCategoryFamily state domain.category.expression
      fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
    for route in routes do
      for binding in state.operationBindings route.target "•" do
        unless binding.arity == 2 && binding.numerals == 0 do
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the first juxtaposition action has a different declared signature"
        let value ← nativeOperationFamily state domain.category.expression categoryFamily route binding
        discard <| levelMVarToParam (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars value)
        let value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars value
        if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the whole juxtaposition action has undetermined parameters"
        let same ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <| lambdaTelescope value fun parameters body => do
          let arrow ← whnfR (← inferType body)
          unless arrow.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
            throwError "the juxtaposition action lost its native morphism boundary"
          let inputs ← operationInputs arrow.getAppArgs[2]! 2
          let first ← mkLambdaFVars parameters inputs[0]!
          let second ← mkLambdaFVars parameters inputs[1]!
          withoutModifyingState <| isDefEq (← inferType first) (← inferType second) <&&>
            isDefEq first second
        heterogeneous := heterogeneous.push (!same)
  if heterogeneous.isEmpty || heterogeneous.all (! ·) then
    for domain in rightDomains do
      unless (← operationRoutes domain.category.expression "·").isEmpty do
        if !names.contains "·" then names := names.push "·"
  else
    unless heterogeneous.all id do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "juxtaposition requires its selected whole action family"
    names := names.push "•"
  return names

-- Classify transport roles at the entire rigid source family. A scalar argument and
-- an object argument remain distinct even if their carriers coincide after substitution.
private def operationTransportRoles (root : OperationRoot)
    (categoryFamily : Expr) (family : NativeOperationFamily) :
    TermElabM (Array Bool × Bool × Array Expr) := do
  let parameterCount ← forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType categoryFamily) fun parameters _ =>
    pure parameters.size
  lambdaTelescope family.value fun parameters body => do
    let category := mkAppN categoryFamily (parameters.take parameterCount)
    let objectIndex := parameters.size - 1 - family.binding.numerals
    let carrier ← sourceCarrierFamilyObject root.domain.category category parameters[objectIndex]!
    let arrow ← whnfR (← inferType body)
    unless arrow.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
      throwError "the whole source operation lost its typed morphism"
    let inputs ← operationInputs arrow.getAppArgs[2]! family.binding.arity
    let carrierFamily ← mkLambdaFVars parameters carrier
    let mut flags := #[]
    let mut evidence := #[]
    for type in inputs.push arrow.getAppArgs[3]! do
      let typeFamily ← mkLambdaFVars parameters type
      let agrees ← withoutModifyingState do
        isDefEq (← inferType typeFamily) (← inferType carrierFamily) <&&>
          isDefEq typeFamily carrierFamily
      flags := flags.push agrees
      if agrees then
        let proof ← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl typeFamily)
          (← mkEq typeFamily carrierFamily)
        checkWithKernel proof
        evidence := evidence.push proof
    let some output := flags[family.binding.arity]?
      | throwError "the whole operation lost its actual result transport role"
    return (flags.take family.binding.arity, output, evidence)

private def retainOperationEvidence (value : Expr) (proofs : Array Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let mut value := value
  for proof in proofs.reverse do
    let body := value
    value ← withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `operationAgreement) (← inferType proof) proof
      fun binding => mkLetFVars #[binding] body
        (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
  return value

private structure RefinedConstantParameter where
  value : Expr
  category : NativeSourceCategory
  comparison : Expr
  evidence : Array Expr

-- A refinement already selects its carrier route. Consume only a prefix of that route;
-- an unrelated outgoing functor does not acquire authority from the named base.
private def refinedConstantParameter? (state : SemanticState) (entry : ObjectEntry)
    (domain : Expr) (target : CategoryExpr) :
    SourceReadM (Option RefinedConstantParameter) := do
  let some refined ← refinementDomain state entry domain | return none
  let some carrier := refined.category.carrier
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the named parameter refinement lost its declared carrier"
  let some comparison := refined.comparison
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the named parameter refinement lost its base identification"
  let mut routes : Array Route := #[]
  for count in [:carrier.refs.size + 1] do
    if let some steps := state.routeEdges? refined.category.expression target
        (carrier.refs.take count) then
      routes := routes.push { source := refined.category.expression, target, steps }
  let some route := routes[0]? | return none
  let evidence ← sourceRouteAgreements state refined.category routes
  let selected ← nativeRouteFunctor state route refined.category.bundle
  let value ← functorObject selected.functor refined.value selected.target
  let remaining := { carrier with
    refs := carrier.refs.drop route.refs.size
    actions := carrier.actions.drop route.refs.size }
  return some ⟨← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars value,
    ⟨.object, target, ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars selected.target, some remaining, none⟩,
    comparison, evidence⟩

/-- Check complete selected mathematical data without using conversion to choose its
occurrence. The original terms and checked agreement remain explicit source inputs. -/
private def operationAgreement (left right : Expr) (evidence : Array Expr)
    (failure : MessageData) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let agrees ← (← get).context.withOriginalSources (#[left, right] ++ evidence) fun values =>
    return (← sourceFamilyConversion values[0]! values[1]!
      (values.extract 2 values.size)).isSome
  unless agrees do liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity failure
  let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? right).getD { value := right }
  let right ← SourceReadM.select { selected with value := right } (some (← inferType left))
  SourceReadM.prove (← mkEq left right) (fun proposition sources => do
    let proposition ← whnfR proposition
    unless proposition.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do
      throwError "the source operation lost its complete agreement proposition"
    let some proof ← sourceFamilyConversion proposition.getAppArgs[1]!
        proposition.getAppArgs[2]! sources
      | throwSemanticAmbiguity failure
    return proof) evidence

/-- Read a bare named constant at a parameter category reached by its declared refinement
carrier. The base row and its complete argument spine are checked by refinementDomain;
parameterized source families remain on their ordinary expected-type reading path.
Every applicable complete structure and base identification must agree, with all witnesses
retained. This does not reinterpret an existing binding or explicitly selected category. -/
opaque sourceNamedConstantParameter? (domain : Expr) (target : CategoryExpr) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let (original, bases) ← registeredSourceDomain domain
  let #[base] := bases
    | if bases.isEmpty then return none
      else liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "the named parameter requires its exact registered base"
  unless original.getAppArgs.isEmpty do return none
  if (← whnfR (← checkedDeclaration base.declaration).type).isForall then return none
  let mut candidates : Array RefinedConstantParameter := #[]
  for entry in state.objects do
    unless entry.refines.any (·.base == base.id) do continue
    if let some candidate ← refinedConstantParameter? state entry domain target then
      candidates := candidates.push candidate
  let some first := candidates[0]? | return none
  let forward ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[first.comparison]
  let mut evidence := #[]
  for candidate in candidates do
    let categoryAgreement ← operationAgreement first.category.bundle candidate.category.bundle #[]
      "the named parameter refinements have different complete categories"
    let objectAgreement ← operationAgreement first.value candidate.value #[]
      "the named parameter refinements require their complete structural comparison"
    let otherForward ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[candidate.comparison]
    let comparisonAgreement ← operationAgreement forward otherForward #[]
      "the named parameter refinements require coherent base identifications"
    evidence := evidence ++ candidate.evidence ++
      #[candidate.comparison, categoryAgreement, objectAgreement, comparisonAgreement]
  let value ← retainOperationEvidence first.value evidence
  let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? first.value).getD { value := first.value }
  return some ⟨← SourceReadM.select { selected with value, category := some first.category },
    some first.category⟩

/-- Prepare first-hit source bindings and their complete rigid morphism families.
Reuse: SourceRoutes, nativeOperationFamily, native conversion, ObjectRefinement and
congruFun. The supplied refinement cone is checked at complete structured objects after
universal operation agreement; all original source data remain in the resulting term. -/
opaque sourceOperation
    (categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory)) (name : String)
    (domain : Expr) (contextual : Option Expr) (hints : Array Expr) (arity : Nat)
    (numerals : Array (Expr → SourceReadM Expr)) :
    SourceReadM NativeSourceOperation := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let domains ← sourceOperationDomains categoryOf domain contextual hints
  if domains.isEmpty then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "the source operation requires its interpreted element domain"
  let root ← operationRoot domains name
  -- These level variables are constrained only by the unapplied source declarations.
  -- Lean's level generalizer freezes every remaining variable before comparison.
  let categoryFamily ← nativeCategoryFamily state root.domain.category.expression
    fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  let mut families : Array NativeOperationFamily := #[]
  for route in root.routes do
    for binding in state.operationBindings route.target name do
      unless binding.arity == arity && binding.numerals == numerals.size do continue
      let value ← nativeOperationFamily state root.domain.category.expression categoryFamily
        route binding
      families := families.push ⟨route, binding, value⟩
  if families.isEmpty then liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the first source binding has a different operation arity"
  for family in families do discard <| levelMVarToParam (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars family.value)
  let categoryFamily ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars categoryFamily
  families := ← families.mapM fun family => do
    let value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars family.value
    if value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the complete source operation family has undetermined parameters"
    return { family with value }
  let some first := families[0]?
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "operation preparation requires its complete first binding"
  let mut proofs := #[]
  let agreementEvidence := root.domains.flatMap fun domain =>
    domain.originEvidence ++ domain.category.carrier.toArray.flatMap (·.comparisons)
  for other in families do
    let some proof ← sourceFamilyConversion first.value other.value agreementEvidence
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "the whole operation families require their supplied agreement"
    proofs := proofs.push proof
  let (inputDomains, outputDomain, roleProofs) ←
    operationTransportRoles root categoryFamily first
  let inputTransports := inputDomains.map (· && root.domain.comparison.isSome)
  let outputTransport := outputDomain && root.domain.comparison.isSome
  proofs := proofs ++ roleProofs
  -- Specialize already checked universal evidence at the exact category parameters.
  let mut levelParameters : CollectLevelParams.State := {}
  levelParameters := levelParameters.collect categoryFamily
  for family in families do levelParameters := levelParameters.collect family.value
  let universes := levelParameters.params.toList
  let levels ← universes.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  let actualCategoryFamily := categoryFamily.instantiateLevelParams universes levels
  let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType actualCategoryFamily)
  let supplied := root.domain.category.bundle.consumeMData
  let declared := mkAppN actualCategoryFamily.consumeMData parameters
  let mut originals : Array (Option Expr) := Array.replicate parameters.size none
  if let some declaration := declared.getAppFn.constName? then
    if supplied.getAppFn.isConstOf declaration then
      let some aligned ← alignSourceArguments? declaration parameters declared supplied
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source operation lost its exact category arguments"
      originals := aligned
  unless ← isDefEq (mkAppN actualCategoryFamily parameters) root.domain.category.bundle do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source operation has a different complete selected category"
  let mut parameters ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| parameters.mapM instantiateMVars
  for original in originals, index in [:originals.size] do
    if let some original := original then
      parameters := parameters.set! index (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars original)
  let value := first.value.instantiateLevelParams universes levels
  let value := mkAppN value parameters
  let previous ← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx
  let (arguments, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType value)
  unless arguments.size > first.binding.numerals do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source operation lost its original object argument"
  let objectIndex := arguments.size - 1 - first.binding.numerals
  unless ← isDefEq arguments[objectIndex]! root.domain.value do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source operation changed its actual selected object"
  -- Keep the source expressions supplied at these exact positions, not Lean's
  -- potentially reduced assignments to the metavariables used to check them.
  let mut actualArguments := arguments.set! objectIndex root.domain.value
  let owned := (← liftM (m := MetaM) getMCtx).decls.foldl (fun result identity _ =>
    if previous.decls.contains identity then result else result.push identity) #[]
  for numeral in numerals, index in [:numerals.size] do
    let position := objectIndex + 1 + index
    let argument := arguments[position]!
    let value ← numeral (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType argument))
    extendSourceApplicationScope owned
    unless ← isDefEq argument value do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source operation numeral has a different complete parameter type"
    actualArguments := actualArguments.set! position value
  let arguments ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| actualArguments.mapM instantiateMVars
  let allArguments ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| (parameters ++ arguments).mapM instantiateMVars
  let mut evidence := #[]
  for proof in proofs do
    let mut proof := proof.instantiateLevelParams universes levels
    for argument in allArguments do proof ← mkAppM ``congrFun #[proof, argument]
    evidence := evidence.push (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars proof)
  -- The actual objects of the supplied cone are compared with every original
  -- refinement. These are structured-object equations, not operation agreement.
  for routes in root.images, target in root.domains do
    evidence := evidence ++ (← sourceRouteAgreements state root.domain.category routes)
    for route in routes do
      let native ← nativeRouteFunctor state route root.domain.category.bundle
      let image ← functorObject native.functor root.domain.value native.target
      let categoryProof ← operationAgreement native.target target.category.bundle #[]
        "the supplied source refinements require their complete category comparison"
      let proof ← operationAgreement image target.value #[]
        "the supplied source refinements require their structured comparison"
      evidence := evidence ++ #[categoryProof, proof]
      if let some original := root.domain.comparison then
        let some other := target.comparison
