          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source refinement cone lost its comparison datum"
        let some originalCarrier := root.domain.category.carrier
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source refinement cone lost its source carrier"
        let some targetCarrier := target.category.carrier
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source refinement cone lost its target carrier"
        let some originalSteps := state.routeEdges? root.domain.category.expression
            originalCarrier.target originalCarrier.refs
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source refinement cone has an invalid carrier route"
        let some composedSteps := state.routeEdges? root.domain.category.expression
            originalCarrier.target (route.refs ++ targetCarrier.refs)
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source refinement cone has an invalid composed carrier route"
        let originalRoute : Route := {
          source := root.domain.category.expression
          target := originalCarrier.target
          steps := originalSteps }
        let composedRoute : Route := {
          source := root.domain.category.expression
          target := originalCarrier.target
          steps := composedSteps }
        evidence := evidence ++ (← sourceRouteAgreements state root.domain.category
          #[originalRoute, composedRoute])
        let forward ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[original]
        let otherForward ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[other]
        let proof ← operationAgreement forward otherForward #[]
          "the supplied presentation maps require their coherent comparison"
        evidence := evidence.push proof
  for candidate in root.domains do
    evidence := evidence ++ candidate.originEvidence
    if let some comparison := candidate.comparison then evidence := evidence.push comparison
  let original := (mkAppN value arguments).headBeta
  let operation ← retainOperationEvidence original evidence
  let selected ← sourceReferenceAt (.operation first.binding) original operation
  let cone := (root.domains.zip root.images).map fun (domain, routes) =>
    (domain.category.expression, routes.map Route.refs)
  let operation ← SourceReadM.select { selected with
    alternatives := families.map fun family => (.operation family.binding, family.route.refs)
    operationRefinements := cone }
  return ⟨operation, arity, root.domain.comparison, inputDomains, outputDomain,
    inputTransports, outputTransport⟩

end CasCompiler

module

import CasCompiler.Read
import CasCompiler.Resolve
import CasCompiler.SourceTestSupport
import LeanCategories.Catalogue
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCompiler.Read
meta import CasCompiler.Resolve
meta import CasCompiler.SourceTestSupport
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue

private def nativeTerm (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native operation parameter did not parse"
  return ⟨stx⟩

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the source operation did not parse"
  return ⟨stx⟩

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `a (← nativeTerm "Rat")
  let session ← session.assume `b (← nativeTerm "Rat")
  let type ← session.term (← nativeTerm "Rat")
  for (source, declaration) in #[
      ("a + b", ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.add),
      ("a · b", ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.mul),
      ("a * b", ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.mul),
      ("-a", ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.neg),
      ("a ^ 2", ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.pow)] do
    let term ← session.read (← sourceTerm source) (some type.source) type.selections
    SourceTest.checkSelected term fun expression => do
      let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
      let scope ← get
      let applications ← SourceTest.declaredApplications scope.context scope.selections
        declaration expression
      let occurs := fun original =>
        SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun value => pure (value.equal original)) expression false
      unless !applications.isEmpty && (← occurs bindings[0]!.expression) > 0 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a source scalar operation changed its declared operation or first operand"
      if source == "a + b" || source == "a · b" || source == "a * b" then
        unless (← occurs bindings[1]!.expression) > 0 do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a binary source operation lost its second original operand"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let parameters ← empty.assume `R (← nativeTerm "RingCat.{0}")
  let rings ← parameters.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Rings" [.zero] #[]
  let ring ← parameters.term (← nativeTerm "R")
  let selected ← ring.inCategory rings.expression rings.value
  let session ← parameters.defineTerm `S selected
  let session ← session.assume `x (← nativeTerm "S")
  let session ← session.assume `y (← nativeTerm "S")
  let session ← session.assume `customAddition (← nativeTerm "Add S") .instImplicit
  let session ← session.assume `customMapCall (← nativeTerm
    "CoeFun (TypeCat.Hom (S × S) S) (fun _ => (S × S) → S)") .instImplicit
  let term ← session.read (← sourceTerm "x + y")
  SourceTest.checkSelected term fun expression => do
    let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
    let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[bindings[2]!.expression, bindings[3]!.expression]
    let addition ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.add #[bindings[1]!.expression]
    let function ← mkAppM ``TypeCat.Hom.hom #[addition]
    let function ← mkAppM ``TypeCat.Fun.toFun #[function]
    let expected := mkApp function pair
    SourceTest.checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun values => do
      unless ← isDefEq values[0]! values[1]! do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "source addition differs from its complete selected native map"
      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl values[0]!)
        (← mkEq values[0]! values[1]!))
    let scope ← get
    let applications ← SourceTest.declaredApplications scope.context scope.selections
      ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.add expression
    let occurs := fun original =>
      SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun value => pure (value.equal original)) expression false
    unless !applications.isEmpty && (← occurs bindings[1]!.expression) > 0 &&
        (← occurs bindings[2]!.expression) > 0 && (← occurs bindings[3]!.expression) > 0 &&
        (← occurs bindings[4]!.expression) == 0 && (← occurs bindings[5]!.expression) == 0 do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a source operation changed its selected ring, operands or dictionary"
  let session ← session.defineTerm `sum term
  let session ← session.assume `S (← nativeTerm "RingCat.{0}")
  let retained ← session.read (← sourceTerm "sum")
  SourceTest.checkSelected retained fun expression => do
    let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
    unless expression == bindings[6]!.expression do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a source operation was reconstructed after its structure name was shadowed"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let parameters ← empty.assume `A (← nativeTerm "Type")
  let parameters ← parameters.assume `first (← nativeTerm "Ring A")
  let parameters ← parameters.assume `second (← nativeTerm "Ring A")
  let rings ← parameters.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Rings" [.zero] #[]
  let first ← parameters.term (← nativeTerm "@RingCat.of A first")
  let first ← first.inCategory rings.expression rings.value
  let parameters ← parameters.defineTerm `R first
  let second ← parameters.term (← nativeTerm "@RingCat.of A second")
  let second ← second.inCategory rings.expression rings.value
  let session ← parameters.defineTerm `S second
  let session ← session.assume `x (← nativeTerm "R")
  let session ← session.assume `y (← nativeTerm "S")
  let type ← session.term (← nativeTerm "(R : Type)")
  for expected in #[none, some type.source] do
    for source in #["x + y", "x * y"] do
      let rejected ← withoutModifyingState do
        try
          discard <| session.read (← sourceTerm source) expected type.selections
          pure false
        catch error => return CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity error
      unless rejected do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "equal carriers selected one of two independently supplied ring structures"

-- A nullary numeral keeps the exact category parameter and original object even
-- when independently bound inputs have equal definitions. No host OfNat supplies it.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `R (← nativeTerm "RingCat.{0}")
  let session ← session.define `RFirst (← nativeTerm "R")
  let session ← session.define `RSecond (← nativeTerm "R")
  let firstRing ← session.term (← nativeTerm "RFirst")
  let secondRing ← session.term (← nativeTerm "RSecond")
  let first ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Modules" [.zero, .zero] #[firstRing]
  let second ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Modules" [.zero, .zero] #[secondRing]
  let session ← session.assume `raw (← nativeTerm "ModuleCat.{0} RFirst")
  let raw ← session.term (← nativeTerm "raw")
  let firstModule ← raw.inCategory first.expression first.value
  let secondModule ← raw.inCategory second.expression second.value
  let session ← session.defineTerm `MFirst firstModule
  let session ← session.defineTerm `MSecond secondModule
  let session ← session.assume `unrelatedZero
    (← nativeTerm "OfNat (raw : Type) 0") .instImplicit
  for (name, scalar, otherName, otherScalar) in #[
      ("MFirst", `RFirst, `MSecond, `RSecond),
      ("MSecond", `RSecond, `MFirst, `RFirst)] do
    let point ← session.read (← sourceTerm s!"0 in {name}")
    SourceTest.checkSelected point fun expression => do
      let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
      let some chosen ← bindings.findM? fun binding => do
          return (← binding.expression.fvarId!.getUserName) == Name.mkSimple name
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the nullary control lost its chosen module"
      let findNamed := fun name => bindings.findM? fun binding => do
        return (← binding.expression.fvarId!.getUserName) == name
      let some scalar ← findNamed scalar
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the nullary control lost its chosen scalar"
      let some other ← findNamed otherName
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the nullary control lost the distinct equal module"
      let some otherScalar ← findNamed otherScalar
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the nullary control lost the distinct equal scalar"
      let some unrelated ← findNamed `unrelatedZero
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the nullary control lost its unrelated host instance"
      let some original := (← SourceReadM.selection? expression).bind (·.pointOrigin)
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the nullary numeral discarded its actual native point"
      let application := original.point.headBeta.consumeMData
      unless application.getAppFn.isConstOf ``CasCatalogue.Modules.Operations.zero &&
          application.getAppArgs.size == 2 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the nullary numeral replaced its published operation family"
      let actualObject ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withConfig (fun config => { config with zetaDelta := false }) <|
        withTransparency .all <| whnf application.getAppArgs[1]!
      let scope ← get
      let occurs := fun source original =>
        SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun value => pure (value.equal original)) source false
      unless (← SourceTest.originatesAt scope.context scope.selections
          application.getAppArgs[0]! scalar.expression false) &&
          (← SourceTest.originatesAt scope.context scope.selections actualObject chosen.expression false) &&
          (← occurs original.point other.expression) == 0 &&
          (← occurs original.point otherScalar.expression) == 0 &&
          (← occurs expression unrelated.expression) == 0 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the nullary numeral replaced an exact selected input or dictionary"
      let expectedPoint ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Modules.Operations.zero
        #[scalar.expression, chosen.expression]
      SourceTest.checkOriginal #[expression, expectedPoint, original.domain, original.target] fun values => do
        let type ← whnfR (← inferType values[1]!)
        unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 &&
            (← isDefEq values[2]! type.getAppArgs[2]!) &&
            (← isDefEq values[3]! type.getAppArgs[3]!) do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the nullary numeral changed its complete native point domain"
        let defaultPoint ← mkAppOptM ``default #[some type.getAppArgs[2]!, none]
        let expected := mkApp (← sourceSetFunction values[1]!) defaultPoint
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl values[0]!) (← mkEq values[0]! expected))
  let rawType ← session.term (← nativeTerm "(raw : Type)")
  for (text, expected) in #[
      ("0", some rawType.source), ("2 in MFirst", none), ("2 in MSecond", none)] do

-- A native projection retains only its own constructor component's original point.
-- The two equal native arrows remain distinct source occurrences.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let point ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "7 in ℕ")
  let originalPoint ← empty.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let expression ← empty.readTerm point
    let some original := (← SourceReadM.selection? expression).bind (·.pointOrigin)
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the projected-point control lost its original numeral map"
    return original.point
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `firstPoint originalPoint
  let firstId := session.context.entries.back!.id
  let session ← session.defineTerm `secondPoint originalPoint
  let secondId := session.context.entries.back!.id
  discard <| session.elaborateJudgementsScoped Syntax.missing do
    let expression ← session.readTerm point
    let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? expression
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the projected-point control lost its selected numeral"
    let some original := selected.pointOrigin
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the projected-point control lost its original numeral map"
    let scope ← get
    let some firstBinding := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == firstId)
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the projected-point control lost its first original point"
    let some secondBinding := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == secondId)
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the projected-point control lost its second original point"
    let firstPoint := firstBinding.expression
    let secondPoint := secondBinding.expression
    unless firstPoint != secondPoint && (← isDefEq firstPoint secondPoint) do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the projected-point control needs distinct equal native arrows"
    let first ← SourceReadM.select (← retainSourcePoint firstPoint { selected with value := expression })
    let second ← SourceReadM.select (← retainSourcePoint secondPoint { selected with value := expression })
    let pair ← retainSourceConstructor (← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[first, second])
    let firstKernel := mkProj ``Prod 0 pair
    let secondKernel := mkProj ``Prod 1 pair
    let firstFunction ← mkAppM ``Prod.fst #[pair]
    let secondFunction ← mkAppM ``Prod.snd #[pair]
    for (projection, expectedPoint, otherPoint) in #[
        (firstKernel, firstPoint, secondPoint),
        (secondKernel, secondPoint, firstPoint),
        (firstFunction, firstPoint, secondPoint),
        (secondFunction, secondPoint, firstPoint)] do
      let some projected ← retainSourceProjection? projection
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the selected native constructor field lost its point origin"
      let some retained := (← SourceReadM.selection? projected.value).bind (·.pointOrigin)
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the selected native constructor field lost its point origin"
      unless retained.point == expectedPoint && retained.point != otherPoint do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native projection selected another point or changed its endpoints"
      SourceTest.checkOriginal #[retained.domain, original.domain, retained.target, original.target]
        fun values => do
          unless (← isDefEq values[0]! values[1]!) && (← isDefEq values[2]! values[3]!) do
            liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native projection selected another point or changed its endpoints"
      check projected.value
    -- The unrelated component is the same native number, with no point authority.
    let mixed ← retainSourceConstructor (← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[first, mkNatLit 7])
    let unrelated := mkProj ``Prod 1 mixed
    if (← retainSourceProjection? unrelated).isSome then
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a native projection borrowed its sibling's point origin"
    SourceReadM.withBinder `opaquePair (← inferType pair) none .default
      (fun _ result => pure result) fun opaquePair => do
        if (← retainSourceProjection? (mkProj ``Prod 0 opaquePair)).isSome then
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "point provenance was inferred without an actual source constructor"
    return #[]

-- The polynomial question's algebra-to-ring operation is formed over a rigid selected
-- algebra category. Its actual routed object argument retains that category selection,
-- the two declared functors and the original object at their native positions. Inference
-- of convertible category projections must not replace that source selection.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let state ← semanticState
  let source := CasCatalogue.Algebra.Algebras.AlgebrasExpr
  let target := CategoryExpr.atom CategoryId.rings
  let refs : Array EdgeRef := #[.functor FunctorId.algebrasForget,
    .functor FunctorId.commutativeRingsRings]
  let some steps := state.routeEdges? source target refs
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original polynomial operation lost its declared route"
  let route : Route := { source, target, steps }
  let registered ← selectCategory state "Algebras"
  let info ← getConstInfo registered.declaration
  let category ← empty.categoryFamily Syntax.missing "Algebras"
    (info.levelParams.map fun _ => Level.zero)
  unless category.expression.syntacticEq source do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the polynomial operation changed its complete selected category"
  let #[operation] := (state.operationBindings target "+").filter (·.id == "op.rings.add")
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the polynomial operation lost its exact source declaration"
  SourceTest.checkSelected category.family fun family => do
    let scope ← get
    let selectedCategories := scope.selections.toArray.filterMap fun (_, selected) =>
      match selected.reference with
      | some (.category _) => some selected
      | _ => none
    let #[selectedCategory] := selectedCategories
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the polynomial operation has a bare inferred algebra category"
    unless selectedCategory.value.equal family &&
        SourceSelection.exactlyMatches Expr.equal selectedCategory
          { selectedCategory with reference := some (.category registered) } &&
        registered.id.raw == "cat.algebras" &&
        registered.declaration == ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Algebras.algebrasCategory do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the polynomial operation has a bare inferred algebra category"
    let native ← nativeOwnedFamily state source family route
      ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.add (fun infos => some (infos.size - 1))
      (some (.operation operation))
    unless SourceSelection.exactlyMatches Expr.equal
        { value := native.value, reference := native.reference }
        { value := native.value, reference := some (.operation operation) } do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the polynomial operation lost its exact source declaration"
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| lambdaTelescope native.value fun parameters application => do
      unless application.getAppFn.isConstOf ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.add do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the polynomial operation changed its selected addition"
      let some image := application.getAppArgs.back?
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the polynomial operation lost its original routed object"
      unless image.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Functor.obj 6 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the polynomial operation does not retain its actual native object projection"
      let arguments := image.getAppArgs
      unless arguments.back! == parameters[native.objectIndex]! do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the polynomial operation replaced its rigid original object"
      let category := mkApp family parameters[0]!
      let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[category]
      unless arguments[0]! == carrier do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the polynomial operation lost its selected algebra category parameter"
      let composite := arguments[4]!
      unless composite.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Functor.comp 8 &&
          composite.getAppArgs[0]! == carrier do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the polynomial operation changed the selected composition source"
      let prefunctor ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.toPrefunctor #[composite]
      let original ← mkAppM ``Prefunctor.obj #[prefunctor, parameters[native.objectIndex]!]
      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl image) (← mkEq image original))

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

private inductive SourcePattern where
  | name (identifier : Ident)
  | tuple (source : Syntax) (components : Array SourcePattern)

private partial def sourcePattern (source : TSyntax `cas_term) : TermElabM SourcePattern :=
  match source with
  | `(cas_term| $name:ident) => return .name name
  | `(cas_term| ($first:cas_term, $rest:cas_term,*)) => do
    return .tuple source.raw (← (#[first] ++ rest.getElems).mapM sourcePattern)
  | `(cas_term| ($inner:cas_term)) => sourcePattern inner
  | _ => throwErrorAt source "a source binding pattern must contain names or tuple patterns"

private partial def patternNames (pattern : SourcePattern) : Array Ident :=
  match pattern with
  | .name name => #[name]
  | .tuple _ components => components.flatMap patternNames

-- Native pair projections apply only after exact registered-component lookup.
-- Reuse: Lean's Prod/Sigma/PSigma projections and the declared ObjectComponents maps.
private def componentValues (source : Syntax) (value : Expr) (count : Nat) :
    SourceReadM (Array Expr) := SourceReadM.withRef source do
  if let some values ← sourceComponentValues value count then return values
  let type ← whnf (← inferType value)
  if let .forallE _ index _ _ := type then
    let index ← whnf index
    if index.isAppOfArity ``Fin 1 then
      -- Native finite functions retain their actual argument, index type and order.
      -- Reference: Mathlib.Data.Fin.VecNotation's native Fin-indexed vector semantics.
      return (← sourceFiniteIndices index.getAppArgs[0]! count).map (mkApp value)
  let (first, second) ←
    if type.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 then pure (``Prod.fst, ``Prod.snd)
    else if type.isAppOfArity ``Sigma 2 then pure (``Sigma.fst, ``Sigma.snd)
    else if type.isAppOfArity ``PSigma 2 then pure (``PSigma.fst, ``PSigma.snd)
    else
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource
        m!"source pattern binding is not implemented for domain {← inferType value}"
  unless count == 2 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a native pair pattern must have its declared pair of components"
  return #[← mkAppM first #[value], ← mkAppM second #[value]]

-- Each pattern name is a native let at its actual projection. Close those lets in
-- order, including unused components, before closing the enclosing function binder.
-- Reuse: Lean.Meta.withLetDecl/mkLetFVars and metavariable-aware native abstraction.
private partial def bindPattern (pattern : SourcePattern) (value : Expr)
    (body : SourceReadM Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  match pattern with
  | .name name =>
    SourceReadM.withLet name.getId (← inferType value) value fun _ => body
  | .tuple source components =>
    let values ← componentValues source value components.size
    (components.zip values).foldr
      (fun (pattern, value) body => bindPattern pattern value body) body

/-- Form a native lambda at its independently specified domain, with recursive source patterns.
Source: casPatternLambda and ObjectComponents. Native local declarations preserve lexical
shadowing, selected instance binders and captures; no source expression is replayed. -/
opaque sourcePatternLambda (source : TSyntax `cas_term) (domain : Expr) (info : BinderInfo)
    (body : Expr → SourceReadM Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let pattern ← sourcePattern source
  let mut names := #[]
  for name in patternNames pattern do
    if names.contains name.getId then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwErrorAt name "a source tuple pattern repeats a bound name"
    names := names.push name.getId
  match pattern with
  | .name name =>
    SourceReadM.withLambda name.getId domain info body
  | .tuple _ _ =>
    SourceReadM.withLambda (← mkFreshUserName `argument) domain info fun parameter =>
      bindPattern pattern parameter (body parameter)

end CasCompiler

  let type ← session.term (← nativeTerm "((i : Fin 3) → X i) → X 1")
  let expected ← session.term (← nativeTerm "fun (v : (i : Fin 3) → X i) => v 1")
  let term ← session.read (← sourceTerm "(a, b, c) ↦ b") (some type.source) type.selections
  discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let expression ← session.readTerm term
    let expected ← session.readTerm expected
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    checkOriginal #[expression, expected, bindings[0]!.expression] fun native => do
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        throwError "a finite function pattern changed its actual indexed component"
      unless native[0]!.containsFVar native[2]!.fvarId! do
        throwError "a finite function pattern lost its original dependent value family"
    return expression
  let rejected ← try
    discard <| session.read (← sourceTerm "(a, b) ↦ b") (some type.source) type.selections
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do
    throwError "a finite function pattern accepted a different native index arity"

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue

/-- Validate the complete supplied generalized point without recovering it from a value. -/
opaque NativeSourcePointOrigin.ofPoint (point value : Expr) :
    MetaM NativeSourcePointOrigin := do
  let point ← instantiateMVars point
  let type ← inferType point
  let type ← if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then pure type else whnfR type
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    throwError "a retained source point requires its complete native map"
  let domain ← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[2]!
  let target ← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[3]!
  discard <| getLevel domain
  discard <| getLevel target
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) target do
    throwError "the retained source point has a different native value target"
  if point.hasMVar || point.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the retained source point has undetermined native parameters"
  return ⟨point, domain, target⟩

/-- Keep the complete original point beside the unchanged native source value. -/
def retainSourcePoint (point : Expr) (source : SourceSelection Expr) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  return { source with pointOrigin := some (← NativeSourcePointOrigin.ofPoint point source.value) }

private def globalPointDomain : Elab.Term.TermElabM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let (entry, category) ← selectObject "Fin" (some "Sets")
  discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
  let domain ← mkAppM entry.declaration #[mkNatLit 1]
  let categoryFamily ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels category.declaration
  let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType categoryFamily)
  let bundle := mkAppN categoryFamily parameters
  let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType domain) carrier do
    throwError "the global point domain is outside its original registered category"
  let bundle ← instantiateMVars bundle
  if bundle.hasMVar || bundle.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the global point domain lost its complete registered category"
  return {
    value := domain
    reference := some (.named (.registered (.inl entry) category))
    originalApplication := some domain
    category := some ⟨.object, category.expression, bundle, none, none⟩ }

private def globalPointAt (domain : Expr) (source : SourceSelection Expr) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let point ← withLocalDeclD `globalPoint domain fun input => do
    let function ← mkLambdaFVars #[input] source.value
      (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
    mkAppM ``TypeCat.ofHom #[function]
  retainSourcePoint point source

/-- Ordinary elements author the registered Fin(1) domain once, through the same typed
selection producer as every other source. Existing generalized points keep their domain. -/
def retainGlobalSourcePoint [Monad m] [MonadLiftT Elab.Term.TermElabM m]
    (select : SourceSelection Expr → m Expr) (source : SourceSelection Expr) :
    m (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  if source.pointOrigin.isSome then return source
  let selected ← liftM (m := Elab.Term.TermElabM) globalPointDomain
  let domain ← select selected
  liftM (m := Elab.Term.TermElabM) <| globalPointAt domain source

/-- Pair the original point maps under their common authored domain. Two ordinary
elements share the one explicit global domain created by this source operation. -/
def sourcePairPoint [Monad m] [MonadLiftT Elab.Term.TermElabM m]
    (select : SourceSelection Expr → m Expr) (first second : SourceSelection Expr) :
    m (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let sources : SourceSelection Expr × SourceSelection Expr ←
    if first.pointOrigin.isNone && second.pointOrigin.isNone then do
      let selected ← liftM (m := Elab.Term.TermElabM) globalPointDomain
      let domain ← select selected
      let left ← liftM (m := Elab.Term.TermElabM) <| globalPointAt domain first
      let right ← liftM (m := Elab.Term.TermElabM) <| globalPointAt domain second
      pure (left, right)
    else do
      let left ← retainGlobalSourcePoint select first
      let right ← retainGlobalSourcePoint select second
      pure (left, right)
  let (firstSource, secondSource) := sources
  liftM (m := Elab.Term.TermElabM) do
    let some left := firstSource.pointOrigin
      | throwError "the first application operand lost its original source point"
    let some right := secondSource.pointOrigin
      | throwError "the second application operand lost its original source point"
    checkRegisteredDomains left.domain right.domain
    unless left.domain.equal right.domain do
      throwError "application operands require the same original generalized-point domain"
    let value ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[first.value, second.value]
    let point ← withLocalDeclD `applicationPoint left.domain fun input => do
      let first ← sourceSetFunction left.point
      let second ← sourceSetFunction right.point
      let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkApp first input, mkApp second input]
      let function ← mkLambdaFVars #[input] pair (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
      mkAppM ``TypeCat.ofHom #[function]
    retainSourcePoint point { value }

end CasCompiler

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

/-- Retain the actual selected Iso beside its forward map in the typed source record.
The complete supplied Iso, including its native category dictionary, remains unchanged. -/
def retainSourceIso (iso : Expr) (source : SourceSelection Expr)
    (context : Option OpenContext := none) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let verify := fun (values : Array Expr) => do
    let iso := values[0]!
    let value := values[1]!
    let type ← whnfR (← inferType iso)
    unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
      throwError "source invertibility requires its actual native isomorphism"
    let hom ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[iso]
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) (← inferType hom) <&&> isDefEq value hom do
      throwError "the source isomorphism has a different original map"
  match context with
  | none => verify #[iso, source.value]
  | some context => context.withOriginalSources #[iso, source.value] verify
  return { source with isoOrigin := some iso }

/-- Read the Iso supplied by the exact source binder. When the displayed forward arrow
is an opaque alias, keep that actual arrow and transport the original two checked laws. -/
def sourceIsoOrigin? (value : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value | return none
  let some iso := selected.isoOrigin | return none
  let hom ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[iso]
  if ← isDefEq hom value then return some iso
  let arguments := #[value, ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv #[iso],
    ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom_inv_id #[iso],
    ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv_hom_id #[iso]]
  let rebuilt ← elabSourceApplicationApplicableScoped
    (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``CategoryTheory.Iso.mk)
    (Array.replicate arguments.size Syntax.missing) none fun index expected => do
      let original := arguments[index]!
      if index < 2 then
        if ← isDefEq (← inferType original) expected then return .ok original
        let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? original).getD { value := original }
        return .ok (← SourceReadM.select { selected with value := original } (some expected))
      return .ok (← SourceReadM.prove expected
        (fun _ sources => pure sources[0]!) #[original])
  match rebuilt with
  | .ok (iso, _) => return some iso
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

/-- A genuine core morphism already contains its inverse data at its original endpoints. -/
def sourceMorphismIso? (value : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  if let some iso ← sourceIsoOrigin? value then return some iso
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType value)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.CoreHom 4 do return none
  let iso ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.CoreHom.iso #[value]
  return some (← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Core.isoMk
    #[some type.getAppArgs[0]!, some type.getAppArgs[1]!,
      some type.getAppArgs[2]!, some type.getAppArgs[3]!, some iso])

/-- Use the actual inverse-bearing source data in a core action, preserving its dictionary.
Reuse: Mathlib Core.mk/CoreHom.mk; no IsIso instance or inverse is inferred. -/
def sourceIsoCoreHom (iso bundle : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType iso)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
    throwError "the core action requires its actual source isomorphism"
  let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]
  let structureValue ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.str #[bundle]
  unless ← isDefEq type.getAppArgs[0]! carrier <&&>
      isDefEq type.getAppArgs[1]! structureValue do
    throwError "the source isomorphism has a different complete selected category"
  let x ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Core.mk #[type.getAppArgs[2]!]
  let y ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Core.mk #[type.getAppArgs[3]!]
  mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CoreHom.mk
    #[some carrier, some structureValue, some x, some y, some iso]

/-- Apply the selected whole comparison at the supplied native arguments and bind its
actual Iso before deriving a directed map. Complete endpoint and category rows stay typed. -/
opaque sourcePresentation (name : String) (inverse : Bool)
    (application : Expr → SourceReadM Expr) : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[entry] := state.presentations.filter (·.name == name)
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
      throwError "the selected source presentation requires one registered comparison"
  let family ← PresentationFamily.forEntry entry
  let iso ← application (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration)
  let iso ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars iso
  if iso.hasMVar || iso.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected presentation has undetermined native parameters"
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType iso)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
      throwError "the selected presentation is not its declared native isomorphism"
  let actual ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Cat.of
    #[some type.getAppArgs[0]!, some type.getAppArgs[1]!]
  let category := family.category
  let categoryFamily ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels category.declaration
  let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType categoryFamily)
  unless ← expandSourceStructures parameters do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
      throwError "the presentation category has inconsistent native parameters"
  let bundle := mkAppN categoryFamily parameters
  unless ← isDefEq bundle actual do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
      throwError "the presentation has a different complete registered category"
  let bundle ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars bundle
  discard <| SourceReadM.select (sourceReference (.category category) bundle)
  let (source, target) ← family.endpoints iso
  let source ← SourceReadM.select (← retainSourceApplication source source.value)
  let target ← SourceReadM.select (← retainSourceApplication target target.value)
  let selected ← family.withEndpoints iso source target (some (← get).context)
  let iso ← SourceReadM.select selected
  let iso ← if inverse then mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.symm #[iso] else pure iso
  let hom ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom #[iso]
  let category : NativeSourceCategory := ⟨.morphism, category.expression, bundle, none, none⟩
  let selected ← retainSourceIso iso {
    (sourceDerivedReference (.presentation entry) hom) with category := some category }
  let value ← selectMorphism selected
    (fun selected expected => SourceReadM.select selected expected) (some bundle)
  return ⟨value, some category⟩

end CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the presentation source did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `n (← `(Nat))
  let some n := session.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the original dependent presentation parameter was not retained"
  let q ← session.read (← sourceTerm "CyclicQuotient(n) in Groups")
  let session ← session.defineTerm `Q q
  let r ← session.read (← sourceTerm "ZMod(n) in Groups")
  let session ← session.defineTerm `R r
  let session ← session.assume `unused (← `(Nat))
  for (text, projection) in #[
      ("presentation(cyclic_quotient_residue(n))", ``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom),
      ("inverse_presentation(cyclic_quotient_residue(n))", ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv)] do
    let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm text)
    unless result.category.any (·.role == .morphism) do
      throwError "the presentation changed its ordinary morphism role"
    let authored ← SourceTest.authoredEntries result.source.context result.selections
    unless authored.size == 4 && authored[0]?.map (·.id) == some n.id do
      throwError "the selected presentation changed its complete authored context"
    SourceTest.checkSelected result fun value => do
      let some parameter := (← get).context.bindings.find? (·.id == n.id)
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the selected presentation lost its original parameter binding"
      SourceTest.checkOriginal #[value, parameter.expression] fun native => do
        let iso ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.CyclicQuotients.residueComparison #[native[1]!]
        let expected ← mkAppM projection #[iso]
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! expected do
          throwError "the selected presentation changed its full dependent parameters"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!) (← mkEq native[0]! expected))
  let arrow ← session.read (← sourceTerm "presentation(cyclic_quotient_residue(n))")
  let session ← session.defineTerm `e arrow
  let some e := session.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the original presentation map was not retained"
  let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm "map e along Aut()")
  SourceTest.checkSelected result fun value => do
    let scope ← get
    let some parameter := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == n.id)
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the mapped presentation lost its original parameter"
    let some originalMap := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == e.id)
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the mapped presentation lost its original source map"
    SourceTest.checkOriginal #[value, parameter.expression] fun native => do
      let iso ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.CyclicQuotients.residueComparison #[native[1]!]
      let type ← whnfR (← inferType iso)
      let x ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Core.mk #[type.getAppArgs[2]!]
      let y ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Core.mk #[type.getAppArgs[3]!]
      let core ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.CoreHom.mk
        #[some type.getAppArgs[0]!, some type.getAppArgs[1]!, some x, some y, some iso]
      let bundle ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Cat.of
        #[some type.getAppArgs[0]!, some type.getAppArgs[1]!]
      let functor ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Automorphisms.automorphismsConstruction #[bundle]
      let expected ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map #[functor, core]
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! expected do
        throwError "Aut lost the selected presentation's actual inverse data"
    let occurrences ← SourceTest.visitNativeData
      (fun source => pure (source.equal originalMap.expression)) value false
    unless occurrences > 0 do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the presentation action discarded its actual source map reference"

-- These four questions are unchanged from the original public B0 consumer. This control
-- checks source formation and the retained named family only; no proof procedure runs and
-- no comparison, generator image or arithmetic answer is supplied by this test.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let identities ← CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
    let file ← SourceFile.parse "source-original-f9-comparisons.cas"
      "let X := F9x\nlet Y := F9y\n\
       assert (map generator(X) along F9translation) = generator(Y) + 2\n\
       assert (map generator(Y) back along F9translation) = generator(X) - 2\n\
       assert (map F9x_constants(2) along F9translation) = F9y_constants(2)\n\
       assert (map F9y_constants(2) back along F9translation) = F9x_constants(2)\n"
    let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
    let mut questions := 0
    for item in file.items do
      let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
        | throwError "an original F9 statement changed its parsed category"
      match ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement) with
      | .definition next _ => session := next
      | .question term =>
        questions := questions + 1
        SourceTest.checkSelected term fun expression => do
          let occurrences ← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun source => do
            let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? source | return false
            let some application := selected.application | return false
            let .presentation family := application.family | return false
            let some original := selected.originalApplication
              | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original F9 comparison lost its complete native application"
            unless family.entry.id.raw == "cmp.f9.translation" &&
                family.entry.declaration ==
                  ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.PolynomialPresentations.quadraticComparison &&
                original.getAppFn.isConstOf family.entry.declaration do
              liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "an original F9 comparison changed its named Iso or operation address"
            return true) expression
          unless occurrences > 0 do
            liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "an original F9 comparison lost its published native boundary"
      | _ => throwError "an original F9 assertion was replaced by a settled source result"
    unless questions == 4 do throwError "the original F9 comparison control omitted a question"
  finally setEnv original

-- Both directions come from the original Iso under the complete rigid parameter family.
-- A proper prefix or extension of its checked carrier path is not a point action.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let state ← semanticState
  for address in #["cmp.f9.translation", "cmp.polynomial_quotient.translation"] do
    let some row := state.presentations.find? (·.id.raw == address)
      | throwError "the independently registered presentation control is missing"
    let family ← PresentationFamily.forEntry row
    unless family.family.isConstOf row.declaration &&
        !family.family.hasMVar && !family.family.hasFVar &&
        family.direction? family.forwardPath == some false &&
        family.direction? family.inversePath == some true do
      throwError "the presentation changed its original rigid family or native directions"
    for path in #[family.forwardPath, family.inversePath] do
      unless !path.isEmpty &&
          (family.direction? (path.extract 0 (path.size - 1))).isNone &&
          (family.direction? (path.push `not_a_presentation_field)).isNone do
        throwError "an unrelated native field path became a presentation point action"

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

/-- Check actual native evidence in the explicit mathematical source interpretation, then
retain its full positional proof function. No rebuilt local escapes that interpretation. -/
opaque SourceReadM.prove (proposition : Expr)
    (prepare : Expr → Array Expr → TermElabM Expr)
    (sources : Array Expr := #[]) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let original ← get
  let formals ← original.context.bindings.filterM fun binding => do
    return binding.originalSource.isNone && (← binding.expression.fvarId!.getDecl).value?.isNone
  let function ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <| controlAt MetaM fun run =>
    original.context.withOriginalSources (#[proposition] ++ sources) fun expressions =>
      run do
        let expected := expressions[0]!
        unless ← isProp expected do
          throwError "source proof checking requires a proposition"
        let proof ← instantiateMVars (← prepare expected (expressions.extract 1 expressions.size))
        unless ← isDefEq (← inferType proof) expected do
          throwError (← mkTypeMismatchError none proof (← inferType proof) expected)
        checkWithKernel proof
        let locals := (← getLCtx).foldl
          (fun result declaration => result.push (mkFVar declaration.fvarId)) #[]
        unless locals.size == original.context.bindings.size do
          throwError "source proof preparation changed the original native telescope"
        let function ← mkLambdaFVars locals proof (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
        checkWithKernel function
        return function
  let mut proof := function
  for formal in formals do
    let .forallE _ type _ _ ← whnfR (← inferType proof)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source proof closure lost an original formal position"
    let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? formal.expression).getD {
      value := formal.expression }
    let value ← SourceReadM.select { selected with value := formal.expression } (some type)
    proof := mkApp proof value
  checkWithKernel proof
  SourceReadM.select { value := proof } (some proposition)

/-- Check an explicitly supplied source proof at an independently prepared proposition.
Reuse: native expected-type elaboration and stable-ID context transport. The source hypothesis
and proof remain formal; this operation accepts no computational response as evidence. -/
opaque SourceSession.proof (session : SourceSession) (stx : TSyntax `cas_term)
    (obligation : ClosedTerm) (selections : SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm := {}) :
    TermElabM SourceTerm := withRef stx do
  let `(cas_term| proof($evidence:term)) := stx
    | throwError "source evidence requires an explicit proof term"
  session.elaborateScoped evidence do
    let proposition ← session.readClosed evidence obligation selections
    SourceReadM.prove proposition (fun expected _ => sourceFormalProof evidence expected)

end CasCompiler

private def classifierAsValue (value : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType value)
  if type.isAppOf ``LeanCategories.PropertyClassifier ||
      type.isAppOf ``LeanCategories.StructureClassifier then
    return ← mkProjection value `toClassifier
  unless type.isAppOf ``LeanCategories.Classifier do
    throwError "the explicit refinement requires its complete native classifier"
  return value

-- Validate the whole registered classifier, including its actual forgetful functor,
-- before specializing any category parameter. A full-subcategory carrier alone is
-- insufficient: a different functor from it is not the property inclusion.
private def propertyClassifierAt (entry : ClassifierEntry) (host : Expr) :
    MetaM (Expr × Expr) := do
  let info ← checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
  let universes ← info.levelParams.mapM fun _ => mkFreshUserName `propertyUniverse
  let family := Lean.mkConst entry.declaration (universes.map Level.param)
  let agreement ← forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType family) fun parameters _ => do
    let classifier ← classifierAsValue (mkAppN family parameters)
    let type ← whnfR (← inferType classifier)
    let completeHost := type.getAppArgs[0]!
    let total ← mkAppM ``LeanCategories.Classifier.total #[classifier]
    let objects ← withTransparency .all <| whnf (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[total])
    unless objects.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory 3 do
      throwUnsupportedSource
        "explicit refinement requires a proof-only property classifier; chosen data are required"
    let property := objects.getAppArgs[2]!
    let inclusion ← mkAppOptM ``LeanCategories.Classifier.ofProperty
      #[some completeHost, some property]
    let inclusion ← instantiateMVars inclusion
    let some proof ← withTransparency .all <| sourceFamilyConversion classifier inclusion #[]
      | throwUnsupportedSource
          "the explicit classifier is not the complete native property inclusion"
    mkLambdaFVars parameters proof (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
  let levels ← universes.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
  let family := family.instantiateLevelParams universes levels
  let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
  unless ← expandSourceStructures parameters do
    throwError "the explicit classifier has inconsistent complete parameters"
  let classifier ← classifierAsValue (mkAppN family parameters)
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType classifier)
  unless ← isDefEq type.getAppArgs[0]! host do
    throwError "the explicit classifier has a different complete selected host"
  let classifier ← instantiateMVars classifier
  let agreement ← instantiateMVars
    (mkAppN (agreement.instantiateLevelParams universes levels) parameters)
  if classifier.hasMVar || classifier.hasLevelMVar ||
      agreement.hasMVar || agreement.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the explicit classifier requires its complete source parameters"
  checkWithKernel agreement
  return (classifier, agreement)

/-- Refine the actual selected object through the explicitly named property classifier.
Reuse: Classifier.holds_ofProperty, the native FullSubcategory constructor, and checked native
family conversion. Only an existing proof-class instance is discharged; an inhabited fibre
never supplies a chosen structure. The original object and universal presentation survive. -/
def sourcePropertyQualificationApplicable (source : NativeSourceJudgement)
    (required : NamedCategoryEntry) :
    TermElabM (Except MessageData NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let some selected := source.category
    | return .error m!"the retained source value has no selected category"
  if selected.expression.syntacticEq required.expression then return .ok source
  let .classifierTotal id := required.expression
    | return .error m!"the retained source value has a different selected category"
  let state ← semanticState
  let some entry := state.classifier? id
    | throwError "the explicitly selected classifier is absent"
  unless selected.role == .object && selected.expression.syntacticEq entry.host do
    return .error m!"the explicit refinement has a different selected base category"
  let (classifier, agreement) ← propertyClassifierAt entry selected.bundle
  let total ← instantiateMVars (← mkAppM ``LeanCategories.Classifier.total #[classifier])
  discard <| checkedDeclaration required.declaration
  let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels required.declaration
  let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
  let bundle := mkAppN family parameters
  unless ← isDefEq bundle total do
    throwError "the requested category is not the complete selected classifier total"
  let bundle ← instantiateMVars bundle
  if bundle.hasMVar || bundle.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the requested property category has undetermined source parameters"
  let objects ← withTransparency .all <| whnf (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[total])
  unless objects.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory 3 do
    throwError "the checked property classifier changed its native constructor"
  let property := objects.getAppArgs[2]!
  let obligation ← instantiateMVars (mkApp property source.value)
  unless (← isProp obligation) && (← isClass? obligation).isSome do
    throwUnsupportedSource "the explicit property requires its independently supplied proof"
  -- Instance search uses instance transparency. Native definitional normalization
  -- here affects only this proof obligation; the constructor below keeps source.value.
  -- The resulting existing class proof is checked against the original obligation.
  let normalized ← withTransparency .all <|
    reduce obligation (explicitOnly := false) (skipTypes := false) (skipProofs := true)
  let some evidence ← synthInstance? normalized
    | throwStratum .invalid m!"the explicit property is not established for the original object"
  let evidence ← instantiateMVars evidence
  if evidence.hasMVar || evidence.hasLevelMVar || evidence.hasSorry then
    throwError "the explicit property has no complete checked proof"
  checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint evidence obligation)
  let value ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.mk
    ((objects.getAppArgs.map some) ++ #[some source.value, some evidence])
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]) do
    throwError "the property constructor has a different complete selected target"
  let forget ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Cat.Hom.toFunctor
    #[← mkAppM ``LeanCategories.Classifier.forget #[classifier]]
  let original ← functorObject forget value selected.bundle
  unless ← isDefEq original source.value do
    throwError "the property inclusion changed the original source object"
  -- The retained cone belongs to the old category even after its apex is refined.
  -- This checks the supplied relation; it never recovers a selection from an apex.
  if let some limit := selected.limit then
    unless limit.category.syntacticEq selected.expression &&
        (← isDefEq limit.bundle selected.bundle) do
      throwError "the retained universal presentation has a different selected category"
    let apex ← mkAppM (if limit.colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.pt
      else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt) #[limit.cone]
    unless ← isDefEq apex source.value do
      throwError "the retained universal presentation has a different original apex"
  let equivalence ← mkAppOptM ``CasCatalogue.Classifier.holds_ofProperty
    #[some selected.bundle, some property, some source.value]
  let holds ← mkAppM ``Iff.mpr #[equivalence, evidence]
  let proposition ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Classifier.Holds #[classifier, source.value]
  let holds ← mkExpectedTypeHint holds proposition
  checkWithKernel holds
  let mut value := value
  for proof in #[agreement, holds] do
    value ← withLetDecl (← mkFreshUserName `propertyEvidence) (← inferType proof) proof
      fun binding => mkLetFVars #[binding] value
        (usedLetOnly := false) (generalizeNondepLet := false)
  let carrier : NativeSourceCarrierSelection := match selected.carrier with
    | none => ⟨#[.classifierForget id], selected.expression, #[], #[forget], #[]⟩
    | some original =>
      ⟨#[.classifierForget id] ++ original.refs, original.target, original.identifications,
        #[forget] ++ original.actions, original.comparisons⟩
  return .ok ⟨value, some ⟨.object, required.expression, bundle, some carrier, selected.limit⟩⟩

/-- Ordinary qualification requires its own category match. Classifier formation, proof
search, universe, retained-presentation and native errors remain the original exceptions. -/
def sourcePropertyQualification (source : NativeSourceJudgement)
    (required : NamedCategoryEntry) : TermElabM NativeSourceJudgement := do
  match ← sourcePropertyQualificationApplicable source required with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => throwError message

end CasCompiler

    | throwError "the property source did not parse"

/- A registered property of an object reads as the proposition that its classifier's fibre over
the object is inhabited (CC-PROP): `Fin(3).is_finite()` is `Classifier.Holds` of the finiteness
classifier at `Fin(3)`. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  for (text, object) in #[("Fin(3).is_finite()", ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Objects.fin #[mkNatLit 3]),
      ("ℤ.is_finite()", Expr.const ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Objects.integers [])] do
    let result ← session.read (← sourceTerm text)
    let #[classifier] := (← semanticState).classifiers.filter (·.id == ClassifierId.setsFinite)
      | throwError "the finiteness classifier is not uniquely registered"
    checkSelected result fun value => do
      let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the property lost its original selected source"
      let some application := selected.application
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the property lost its original complete application"
      let .property family := application.family
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the property changed its original family"
      unless (SelectedSourceReference.classifier family.classifier).exactlyMatches
          (.classifier classifier) do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the property reading has a different classifier"
      let expectedClassifier ← classifierInstance classifier
      checkOriginal #[value, object, expectedClassifier] fun native => do
        let value ← zetaReduce native[0]!
        unless (← whnf (← inferType value)).isProp do
          throwError "the property did not read as a proposition"
        let holds := value.consumeMData
        unless holds.isAppOfArity ``CasCatalogue.Classifier.Holds 3 do
          throwError "the property reading is not a classifier proposition: {value}"
        unless ← isDefEq holds.appFn!.appArg! native[2]! do
          throwError "the property reading has a different classifier: {value}"
        unless ← isDefEq holds.appArg! native[1]! do
          throwError "`{text}` is not the property at its receiver: {value}"

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue

/-- The declaration belongs to the complete selected row, including its exact interface field. -/
def SelectedSourceReference.declaration : SelectedSourceReference → Option Name
  | .named (.registered (.inl entry) _) => some entry.declaration
  | .named (.registered (.inr entry) _) => some entry.declaration
  | .named (.construction entry) => some entry.declaration
  | .category entry => some entry.declaration
  | .operation entry => some entry.declaration
  | .method _ nativeFunctor => some nativeFunctor.declaration
  | .functor entry => some entry.declaration
  | .classifier entry | .classifierForget entry => some entry.declaration
  | .constructor entry => some entry.semantics
  | .cell entry => some entry.declaration
  | .binder entry => some entry.operation
  | .lift entry => some entry.evidence
  | .presentation entry => some entry.declaration
  | .literal entry => some entry.denotation
  | .numeral entry => some entry.declaration
  | .subset entry => some entry.denotation
  | .graph entry => some entry.denotation
  | .generator entry => entry.generator
  | .components entry => entry.components.map (·.projection)
  | .limit entry => some entry.declaration
  | .constructorInterface entry field =>
    match field with
    | .functorialAction => entry.functorialAction
    | .comparisonAction => entry.comparisonAction
    | .identityComparison => entry.identityComparison
    | .compositionComparison => entry.compositionComparison
  | .refinement _ nativeRefinement => some nativeRefinement.identification

/-- A computation address comes from its selected row, never from the native term. -/
def SelectedSourceReference.computation? : SelectedSourceReference → Option ComputationRef
  | .named (.registered (.inr entry) _) => some (.morphism entry.id)
  | .named (.construction entry) => some (.construction entry.id)
  | .operation entry => some (.operation entry.id)
  | .method entry _ => some (.method entry.id)
  | .functor entry => some (.functor entry.id)
  | _ => none

/-- Resolve an explicitly accepted computation address once at source-family formation.
The native term does not participate in choosing its original complete row. -/
def SelectedSourceReference.forComputation (reference : ComputationRef) :
    MetaM SelectedSourceReference := do
  let state ← semanticState
  match reference with
  | .operation id =>
    let #[entry] := state.operations.filter (·.id == id)
      | throwError "the accepted operation address has no unique original row"
    return .operation entry
  | .method id =>
    let #[entry] := state.methods.filter (·.id == id)
      | throwError "the accepted method address has no unique original row"
    let #[nativeFunctor] := state.functors.filter (·.id == entry.functor)
      | throwError "the accepted method lost its unique original functor row"
    return .method entry nativeFunctor
  | .functor id =>
    let #[entry] := state.functors.filter (·.id == id)
      | throwError "the accepted functor address has no unique original row"
    return .functor entry
  | .construction id =>
    let #[entry] := state.constructions.filter (·.id == id)
      | throwError "the accepted construction address has no unique original row"
    return .named (.construction entry)
  | .morphism id =>
    let #[entry] := state.morphisms.filter (·.id == id)
      | throwError "the accepted morphism address has no unique original row"
    let #[categoryRow] := state.categories.filter (·.id == entry.category)
      | throwError "the accepted morphism lost its original complete category row"
    return .named (.registered (.inr entry) categoryRow)

/-- Public descriptors name their selected original declaration and complete row. -/
def SelectedSourceReference.descriptor? : SelectedSourceReference → Option (Name × String)
  | .named (.registered (.inl entry) _) => some (entry.declaration, entry.id.raw)
  | .category entry => some (entry.declaration, entry.id.raw)
  | .classifier entry => some (entry.declaration, entry.id.raw)
  | .constructor entry => some (entry.semantics, entry.id.raw)
  | .cell entry => some (entry.declaration, entry.id.raw)
  | .presentation entry => some (entry.declaration, entry.id.raw)
  | .literal entry => some (entry.denotation, entry.id.raw)
  | .graph entry => some (entry.denotation, entry.id.raw)
  | _ => none

/-- These rows publish a named element at its retained original application. -/
def SelectedSourceReference.element? : SelectedSourceReference → Option (Name × String)
  | .numeral entry => some (entry.declaration, entry.id.raw)
  | .subset entry => some (entry.denotation, entry.id.raw)
  | .limit entry => some (entry.declaration, entry.id.raw)
  | .generator entry => entry.generator.map (fun declaration => (declaration, entry.id.raw ++ "#generator"))
  | _ => none

def SelectedSourceReference.nativeInterface? : SelectedSourceReference → Option Name
  | .constructorInterface entry field => (SelectedSourceReference.constructorInterface entry field).declaration
  | .refinement _ nativeRefinement => some nativeRefinement.identification
  | _ => none

/-- Retain the full selected row beside its original native mathematical value. -/
def sourceReference (reference : SelectedSourceReference) (value : Expr) : SourceSelection Expr :=
  { value, reference := some reference }

/-- An observation label carries no computational authority for its native subterms. -/
def sourceDerivedReference (reference : SelectedSourceReference) (value : Expr) :
    SourceSelection Expr :=
  { value, observation := some reference }

/-- The producer explicitly supplies the original application at formation. -/
def retainSourceApplication (selection : SourceSelection Expr) (application : Expr) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let some reference := selection.reference
    | throwError "the source application has no original selected row"
  let some declaration := reference.declaration
    | throwError "the selected row has no declared native application"
  let application ← instantiateMVars application
  unless application.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf declaration do
    throwError "the source application changed its selected original declaration"
  return { selection with originalApplication := some application }

/-- Read only the application retained explicitly in this exact selected record. -/
def sourceApplication? (declaration : Name) (selection : SourceSelection Expr) :
    MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  let some application := selection.originalApplication | return none
  unless selection.reference.bind (·.declaration) == some declaration &&
      application.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf declaration do
    throwError "the retained source application changed its selected original declaration"
  return some application

def sourceReferenceAt (reference : SelectedSourceReference) (application value : Expr) :
    MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) :=
  retainSourceApplication (sourceReference reference value) application

/-- An object reference follows only its exact binding and explicit endpoint provenance.
Native definitions and convertible carriers do not supply a missing selected row. -/
def sourceObjectSelection? (context : OpenContext) (scope : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
    (value : Expr) : MetaM (Option (ObjectEntry × NamedCategoryEntry)) := do
  let rec visit (fuel : Nat) (value : Expr) :
      MetaM (Option (ObjectEntry × NamedCategoryEntry)) := do
    match fuel with
    | 0 => throwError "the selected object reference has cyclic binding provenance"
    | fuel + 1 =>
      let some template := scope.findAt? context value.getAppFn | return none
      unless template.formalBindings.size == value.getAppNumArgs do return none
      let selected ← template.specialize value.getAppArgs
      match selected.reference with
      | some (.named (.registered (.inl entry) category)) => return some (entry, category)
      | _ =>
        if let some endpoint := selected.endpoint then return ← visit fuel endpoint.value
        return none
  visit (context.bindings.size + 1) value

/-- Project the public address from the complete original selected object record. -/
def sourceObjectReference? (context : OpenContext) (scope : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
    (value : Expr) : MetaM (Option (ObjectId × Name)) := do
  return (← sourceObjectSelection? context scope value).map fun (entry, _) =>
    (entry.id, entry.declaration)

end CasCompiler

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the original relation source did not parse"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  for name in #["FinOrder", "ReverseFinOrder"] do
    let object ← empty.read (← sourceTerm s!"{name}(5)")
    let session ← empty.defineTerm `X object
    let session ← session.assume `unused (← `(Nat))
    for (text, declaration) in #[
        ("0 ≤ 1 in X", ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.PowerSets.le),
        ("0 < 1 in X", ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.PowerSets.lt)] do
      let question ← session.readQuestion (← sourceTerm text)
      discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
        let value ← session.readTerm question
        let object ← session.readTerm object
        unless (← authoredBindings).size == 2 do
          throwError "the source relation changed its complete preceding context"
        let scope ← get
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| controlAt MetaM fun run =>
          scope.context.withOriginalSources #[value, object] fun native => run do
            let operation ← mkAppM declaration #[native[1]!]

            let pair : Term ← `((0, 1))

            checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do

  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `L (← `(LinOrd.{0}))
  let category ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "LinearOrders" [.zero] #[]
  let object ← session.term (← nativeTerm "L")
  let object ← object.inCategory category.expression category.value
  let session ← session.defineTerm `A object
  let session ← session.assume `x (← nativeTerm "CasCatalogue.Foundation.PowerSets.orderCarrier A")
  let session ← session.assume `y (← nativeTerm "CasCatalogue.Foundation.PowerSets.orderCarrier A")
  let session ← session.assume `unused (← `(Nat))
  let expected ← session.term (← nativeTerm "CasCatalogue.Foundation.PowerSets.le A (x, y)")
  for (text, truth) in #[
      ("x ≤ y", none), ("(x ≤ y) = false", some ``False),
      ("(x ≤ y) = true", some ``True)] do
    let question ← session.readQuestion (← sourceTerm text)
    discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      let value ← session.readTerm question
      let expected ← session.readTerm expected
      unless (← authoredBindings).size == 5 do
        throwError "the relation or truth constant changed its complete preceding context"
      checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
        let expected ← match truth with
          | none => pure native[1]!
          | some declaration => mkEq native[1]! (mkConst declaration)
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! expected do
          throwError "the relation or truth constant changed its arbitrary selected order"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
          (← mkEq native[0]! expected))
      return value
  let session ← session.assume `false (← `(Prop))
  let question ← session.readQuestion (← sourceTerm "(x ≤ y) = false")
  discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let value ← session.readTerm question

      let expected ← mkEq native[1]! native[2]!

        throwError "a logical spelling displaced its exact lexical binding"
    return value

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do

  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let expected ← session.term (← nativeTerm

    checkOriginal #[value, expected] fun native => do
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        throwError "the relation's truth-value result replaced its declared integral literal domain"
      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
        (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
    return value
