namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

/-- The value of a global element `1 ⟶ X` at the terminal source's point, as source numerals
read their registered point declarations. -/
def sourcePointValueSelection (element : Expr) (expected : Option Expr) :
    TermElabM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let type ← whnfR (← inferType element)
  unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    throwError "a registered distinguished element is not a native point map"
  -- A selected map states its ends as projections of its own arrow (`selectMorphism`). The point
  -- and the set of the value are read at the declared ends that those projections retain.
  let point ← mkAppOptM ``default #[some (← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[2]!), none]
  let function ← sourceSetFunction element
  let value ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr point] expected false false
  let value ← if expected.isSome then pure value
    else mkExpectedTypeHint value (← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[3]!)
  retainSourcePoint element { value }

/-- The reader binds the complete point record before any later source use. -/
def sourcePointValue (element : Expr) (expected : Option Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  SourceReadM.select (← sourcePointValueSelection element expected)

/-- The registered generator `∀ params, 1 ⟶ obj params` of the object whose carrier is `type`,
at its point: the variable `x` of `R[x]`. The parameters are those that reducible unification
of the declared family with `type` determines (as for operation refinements).
Source: Registry.Entry.ObjectEntry.generator. Several applicable objects are ambiguous. -/
def sourceGeneratorAt? (type : Expr) (index : Option Nat) : SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let (nativeType, selected) ← registeredSourceDomain type
  if selected.isEmpty && (← SourceReadM.selection? type).isSome then return none
  let entries := if selected.isEmpty then state.objects else selected
  let mut found := #[]
  for entry in entries do
    let some generator := entry.generator | continue
    discard <| checkedDeclaration generator
    let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels generator
    let (parameters, infos, result) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
    -- An indexed family of generators (`xᵢ`) is selected by its index; a single generator by
    -- a bare variable.
    let explicit := (parameters.zip infos).filter (·.2.isExplicit)
    let indexed ← match explicit.back? with
      | some (last, _) => pure ((← whnfR (← inferType last)).isAppOf ``Fin)
      | none => pure false
    unless indexed == index.isSome do continue
    let result ← whnfR result
    unless result.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do continue
    let applicable ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState do
      unless ← withReducible (isDefEq result.getAppArgs[3]! nativeType) do return false
      for argument in parameters, info in infos do
        if info.isInstImplicit && (← instantiateMVars argument).isMVar then
          let some instanceValue ← synthInstance? (← inferType argument) | return false
          unless ← isDefEq argument instanceValue do return false
      -- The index of an indexed generator is the variable's own position, assigned below.
      let determined := if indexed then parameters.pop else parameters
      let arguments ← determined.mapM instantiateMVars
      return !arguments.any (fun argument => argument.hasMVar || argument.hasLevelMVar)
    unless applicable do continue
    discard <| liftM (m := MetaM) <| withReducible (isDefEq result.getAppArgs[3]! nativeType)
    for argument in parameters, info in infos do
      if info.isInstImplicit && (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars argument).isMVar then
        let some instanceValue ← synthInstance? (← inferType argument)
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered generator lost its instance"
        discard <| isDefEq argument instanceValue
    if let some index := index then
      let some (slot, _) := explicit.back? | continue
      let bound ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← whnfR (← inferType slot)).appArg!
      let proposition ← mkAppM ``LT.lt #[mkNatLit index, bound]
      let some proof ← CasCatalogue.Decide.decisionProof proposition
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the ring has no variable of index {index}"
      discard <| isDefEq slot (← mkAppM ``Fin.mk #[mkNatLit index, proof])
    let element ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN family parameters)
    found := found.push (entry, element)
  match found with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[(entry, element)] =>
    let selected ← sourcePointValueSelection element none
    let selected ← retainSourceApplication { selected with reference := some (.generator entry) }
      element
    return some (← SourceReadM.select selected (some type))
  | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "several registered objects have a generator at this carrier"

/-- `x_3` as `("x_", 3)`. -/
def sourceIndexed? (name : Name) : Option (String × Nat) :=
  let chars := name.toString.toList
  let digits := (chars.reverse.takeWhile Char.isDigit).reverse
  if digits.isEmpty || digits.length == chars.length then none
  else some (String.ofList (chars.take (chars.length - digits.length)),
    (String.ofList digits).toNat!)

/-- The variables `x, y` or `x_0, x_1, ..., x_9` of `R[…]`, in order: `...` runs through the
indices between its neighbours, which share their prefix (public language contract). -/
def sourceRingVariableNames (stx : Syntax) : Except String (Array Name) := do
  let items := #[stx[2]] ++ stx[4].getSepArgs.map (·[0])
  let mut names : Array Name := #[]
  let mut index := 0
  while index < items.size do
    let item := items[index]!
    if item.isIdent then
      names := names.push item.getId
    else
      let (some before, some after) := (names.back?, items[index + 1]?)
        | throw "`...` stands between variables"
      let (some (stem, first), some (stem', last)) :=
          (sourceIndexed? before, sourceIndexed? after.getId)
        | throw "`...` stands between indexed variables `x_i, ..., x_k`"
      unless stem == stem' && first < last do
        throw "`...` runs up between variables of one prefix"
      for middle in [first + 1:last] do names := names.push (.mkSimple s!"{stem}{middle}")
    index := index + 1
  return names

/-- The variables that the rings `R[v]`, `R[v₀, …]` and series `R[[v]]` written in `stx` name,
with the ring syntax and, in several variables, the variable's index.
Source: the public language contract, "`R[x]`: the polynomials over `R` in `x`". -/
partial def sourceRingVariables (stx : Syntax) : Array (Name × Syntax × Option Nat) :=
  let own : Array (Name × Syntax × Option Nat) :=
    if stx.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casRing then #[(stx[2].getId, stx, none)]
    else if stx.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casSeries then #[(stx[3].getId, stx, none)]
    else if stx.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casMvRing then
      match sourceRingVariableNames stx with
      | .ok names => names.mapIdx fun index name => (name, stx, some index)
      | .error _ => #[]
    else #[]
  stx.getArgs.foldl (fun found argument => found ++ sourceRingVariables argument) own

/-- The variable `v` whose differential the identifier `dv` names. -/
def sourceDifferentialOf? (name : Name) : Option Name :=
  match name with
  | .str .anonymous text =>
    if text.startsWith "d" && text.length > 1 then some (.mkSimple (text.drop 1).toString) else none
  | _ => none

/-- Whether `name` occurs as an identifier of `stx` outside the variable slot of a ring, or as
its differential `dv`. -/
partial def sourceUses (name : Name) (stx : Syntax) : Bool :=
  if stx.isIdent then stx.getId == name || sourceDifferentialOf? stx.getId == some name
  else if stx.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casRing ||
      stx.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casSeries ||
      stx.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casMvRing then sourceUses name stx[0]
  else stx.getArgs.any (sourceUses name)

/-- Whether a binder of `stx` binds `name`: a map `name ↦ e`, a comprehension, an image, a
big operator, a limit or a definite integral. -/
partial def sourceBinds (name : Name) (stx : Syntax) : Bool :=
  let binder :=
    if stx.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casBig then stx[2].getId == name
    else if stx.isOfKind ``CasCatalogue.Language.casLimit then stx[1].getId == name
    else match stx.getArgs.toList with
      | [identifier, arrow, _] => identifier.isIdent && identifier.getId == name &&
          arrow.isAtom && arrow.getAtomVal.trim == "↦"
      | [left, first, second, third, fourth, _, right] =>
        let atom := fun (node : Syntax) (value : String) =>
          node.isAtom && node.getAtomVal.trim == value
        atom left "{" && atom right "}" &&
          ((first.isIdent && first.getId == name && atom second "∈") ||
            (atom second "|" && third.isIdent && third.getId == name && atom fourth "∈"))
      | _ => false
  binder || stx.getArgs.any (sourceBinds name)

/-- The registered objects of the object type `type` of a parameter (`A : Under R`), at the
declaration parameters that unification determines, for which `fits` holds once the parameter
is that object. -/
private def registeredObjectsAt (type : Expr) (fits : Expr → TermElabM Bool) :
    TermElabM (Array Expr) := do
  let mut found := #[]
  for entry in (← semanticState).objects do
    discard <| checkedDeclaration entry.declaration
    let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels entry.declaration
    let (parameters, _, objectType) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
    let object := mkAppN family parameters
    let applicable ← withoutModifyingState do
      unless ← isDefEq objectType type do return false
      unless ← fits object do return false
      return !(← instantiateMVars object).hasMVar
    if applicable then
      discard <| isDefEq objectType type
      discard <| fits object
      found := found.push (← instantiateMVars object)
  return found

/-- `p(a)` for an element `p` of an object with a registered application
`∀ params A, obj params × A ⟶ B` (a polynomial's evaluation `R[x] × A → A` at an `R`-algebra
`A`). An argument in the coefficient ring `R` itself is evaluated in `Under.mk (𝟙 R)`, the
algebra that lean-categories states is own-ring evaluation (`Polynomials.evaluation_own`); any
other argument in the unique registered `R`-algebra whose carrier is its set.
Source: ObjectEntry.application. `read` reads the argument, at the coefficient set when given. -/
private def objectApplication? (value : Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Option (ObjectEntry × Name)) := do
  let (_, owners) ← registeredSourceDomain (← inferType value)
  let applications := owners.filterMap fun entry =>
    entry.application.map fun application => (entry, application)
  let some found := applications[0]? | return none
  unless applications.size == 1 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "several registered applications act on this element"
  return some found

/-- An element's registered application that takes no argument object (`(M, v) ↦ M v` on
`Mat n K × Kⁿ`): the element fixes every parameter of the application, and with them the set
its argument is read in. `read` reads the argument at that set. -/
def sourceDirectApplicationApplicable? (value : Expr)
    (read : Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr)) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData (Option Expr)) := do
  let some (entry, application) ← objectApplication? value | return .ok none
  discard <| checkedDeclaration application
  let (type, _) ← registeredSourceDomain (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType value))
  let selectedValue := (← SourceReadM.selection? value).getD { value }
  let value ← SourceReadM.select { selectedValue with value } (some type)
  let constant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels application
  let (parameters, _, arrow) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType constant)
  let arrow ← whnfR arrow
  unless arrow.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the application of {entry.name} is not a native map"
  let pair ← whnfR arrow.getAppArgs[2]!
  unless pair.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the application of {entry.name} does not act on a pair"
  unless ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withReducible (isDefEq pair.getAppArgs[0]! type) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the application of {entry.name} does not act on this element"
  let some last := parameters.back? | return .ok none
  if (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType last)).isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.Under then return .ok none
  let argumentSet ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars pair.getAppArgs[1]!
  if argumentSet.hasMVar then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource m!"the application of {entry.name} acts at an unread argument object"
  let argument ← match ← read argumentSet with
    | .ok value => pure value
    | .error message => return .error message
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType argument) argumentSet do
    return .error m!"the application argument has another declared native type"
  let applied ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN constant parameters)
  if applied.hasMVar || applied.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the application of {entry.name} is not determined"
  let family ← PointFamily.forApplication entry
  let arrow ← SourceReadM.select (← family.selected applied.getAppFn.constLevels!
    applied.getAppArgs applied)
  let function ← sourceSetFunction arrow
  let first := (← SourceReadM.selection? value).getD { value }
  let second := (← SourceReadM.selection? argument).getD { value := argument }
  let pair ← SourceReadM.select (← sourcePairPoint (fun selected => SourceReadM.select selected)
    { first with value } { second with value := argument })
  return .ok (some (← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr pair]
    none false false))

/-- Required element application preserves its callback and selected application. -/
def sourceDirectApplication? (value : Expr) (read : Expr → SourceReadM Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  match ← sourceDirectApplicationApplicable? value (fun type => do return .ok (← read type)) with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

def sourceObjectApplication? (value : Expr) (numeral : Bool)
    (read : Option Expr → SourceReadM Expr) : SourceReadM (Option Expr) := do
  if let some applied ← sourceDirectApplication? value fun set => read (some set) then
    return some applied
  let (type, _) ← registeredSourceDomain (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType value))
  let selectedValue := (← SourceReadM.selection? value).getD { value }
  let value ← SourceReadM.select { selectedValue with value } (some type)
  let some (entry, application) ← objectApplication? value | return none
  discard <| checkedDeclaration application
  let constant ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels application
  let (parameters, _, arrow) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType constant)
  let arrow ← whnfR arrow
  unless arrow.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the application of {entry.name} is not a native map"
  let pair ← whnfR arrow.getAppArgs[2]!
  unless pair.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the application of {entry.name} does not act on a pair"
  unless ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withReducible (isDefEq pair.getAppArgs[0]! type) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the application of {entry.name} does not act on this element"
  let some algebra := parameters.back?
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the application of {entry.name} has no argument object"
  let algebraType ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType algebra)
  unless algebraType.isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.Under do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource m!"the application of {entry.name} acts at an unread argument object"
  let ring := algebraType.appArg!
  let own ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Under.mk #[← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id #[ring]]
  -- The set the application reads its argument in, once the argument object is `object`.
  let argumentSet : Expr → MetaM (Option Expr) := fun object => do
    unless ← isDefEq algebra object do return none
    return some (← instantiateMVars pair.getAppArgs[1]!)
  let ownCarrier ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState do
    let some carrier ← argumentSet own | throwError "the own-ring algebra does not fit"
    return carrier
  -- A numeral is an element of the coefficient set, the source of the object's registered
  -- constants `R ↪ R[x]` (ObjectEntry.constants). It is read by the numeral rules at that set's
  -- native type, where the declared literal selectors (ℤ, ℚ) recognize it.
  let coefficients ← match entry.constants with
    | none => pure ownCarrier
    | some constants => do
      discard <| checkedDeclaration constants
      let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels constants
      let (_, _, inclusion) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
      let inclusion ← whnfR inclusion
      unless inclusion.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 &&
          (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withReducible (isDefEq inclusion.getAppArgs[3]! type)) do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the constants of {entry.name} do not land in this element's set"
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars inclusion.getAppArgs[2]!
  let argument ← if numeral then read (some (← whnf coefficients)) else read none
  let originalArgumentType ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType argument)
  let (argumentType, _) ← registeredSourceDomain originalArgumentType
  let selectedArgument := (← SourceReadM.selection? argument).getD { value := argument }
  let argument ← SourceReadM.select { selectedArgument with value := argument } (some argumentType)
  let candidates ← if ← isDefEq argumentType ownCarrier then pure #[own]
    else registeredObjectsAt algebraType fun object => do
      let some carrier ← argumentSet object | return false
      isDefEq carrier argumentType
  let selected ← match candidates with
    | #[object] => pure object
    | #[] => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource m!"no registered coefficient algebra acts on this argument"
    | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "several registered algebras act on the argument's set"
  unless ← isDefEq algebra selected do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected argument object does not fit the application of {entry.name}"
  let applied ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (mkAppN constant parameters)
  if applied.hasMVar || applied.hasLevelMVar then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the application of {entry.name} is not determined"
  let family ← PointFamily.forApplication entry
  let arrow ← SourceReadM.select (← family.selected applied.getAppFn.constLevels!
    applied.getAppArgs applied)
  let function ← sourceSetFunction arrow
  let first := (← SourceReadM.selection? value).getD { value }
  let second := (← SourceReadM.selection? argument).getD { value := argument }
  let pair ← SourceReadM.select (← sourcePairPoint (fun selected => SourceReadM.select selected)
    { first with value } { second with value := argument })
  let result ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr pair]
    none false false
  -- The value lies in the argument's own set, as the reader formed it.
  return some (← SourceReadM.select { value := result } (some originalArgumentType))

end CasCompiler

/- `R[x]` reads the polynomial object, and its variable `x` is the registered generator: as a
free variable of a term that writes the ring, and as the bound variable of `x ↦ e in R[x]`. -/

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "source-rings.cas"
    "let p(x) := x² - 2x + 1 in ℤ[x]\nassert x ∈ ℤ[x]\nlet q := x · x in ℚ[x]\n\
     assert p(1) = 0\nassert q(√2) = 2\n"
  let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let mut formed := #[]
  for item in file.items do
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
      | throwError "the ring statement control changed its parsed category"
    let statement ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
    if let .definition next _ := statement then session := next
    formed := formed.push statement
  let generator := ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Polynomials.generator
  let evaluation := ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Polynomials.evaluation
  for index in [3, 4] do
    let some (SourceStatement.question term) := formed[index]?
      | throwError "a polynomial evaluation is not a question"
    checkSelected term fun expression =>
      checkOriginal #[expression] fun original => do
        unless original[0]!.containsConst (· == evaluation) do
          throwError "a polynomial value was not applied by its registered evaluation"
  for statement in formed.extract 0 3 do
    let term ← match statement with
      | .assumption _ | .proved .. | .inspection _ | .contextBlock _ =>
        throwError "this original source control contains no scoped declaration or explicit proof"
      | .definition _ value | .question value | .implemented value => pure value
      | .settled values =>
        let #[value] := values
          | throwError "an individual ring typing judgement did not retain exactly one term"
        pure value
    checkSelected term fun expression =>
      checkOriginal #[expression] fun original => do
        unless original[0]!.containsConst (· == generator) do
          throwError "a ring variable was not read as the registered generator"
  unless formed[1]? matches some (SourceStatement.settled _) do
    throwError "membership of the ring's variable was not settled by its reading"
  let free ← SourceFile.parse "source-free-variable.cas" "let r := x · x\n"
  let rejected ← try
    let some (item : TSyntax `cas_item) := free.items[0]?
      | throwError "the free-variable control is absent"
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item | throwError "the control did not parse"
    discard <| free.withContext ((← SourceSession.empty identities).readStatement statement)
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do throwError "a variable with no written ring was read"

/- An element of a named set read in a larger one goes through the registered maps between them:
inclusions (`ℕ ⊆ ℤ`) and the target's constants (`ℚ ↪ ℚ[x]`). -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "source-coercions.cas" "let n := 3 in ℕ\nlet m := n in ℤ\nlet p := n in ℚ[x]\n"
  let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let mut values := #[]
  for item in file.items do
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
      | throwError "the coercion control changed its parsed category"
    let .definition next value ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
      | throwError "a coercion control is not a definition"
    session := next
    values := values.push value
  let uses := fun (index : Nat) (declaration : Name) (failure : String) => do
    let some value := values[index]? | throwError "a coercion control was not read"
    checkSelected value fun expression =>
      checkOriginal #[expression] fun original => do
        unless original[0]!.containsConst (· == declaration) do throwError failure
  uses 1 ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NumberSystems.naturalsIntegers
    "a natural was not read in ℤ through the registered inclusion"
  uses 2 ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Polynomials.coefficients
    "a natural was not read in ℚ[x] through the registered constants"

-- Read the complete unchanged B0 unit assertion through its original source positions.
-- This checks source formation only; the full public consumer still owes its computation.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let path := "tests/acceptance/b0-required-positives.cas.proposed"
  let file ← SourceFile.parse path (← IO.FS.readFile path)
  let mut found := false
  for item in file.items do
    let `(cas_item| test $id:ident $_:str : $statement:cas_stmt) := item
      | continue
    unless id.getId.toString == "units.rationals.three_inverse" do continue
    if found then throwError "the original unit assertion is repeated"
    let .question proposition ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
      | throwError "the complete original unit assertion did not remain a question"
    checkSelected proposition fun expression =>
      checkOriginal #[expression] fun original => do
        unless original[0]!.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do
          throwError "the original unit equality was not retained"
    found := true
  unless found do throwError "the complete original unit assertion is absent"

-- Equal native monoids retain their separately selected source occurrences and complete
-- carrier comparisons when they become parameters of the declared units admission.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let read := fun (session : SourceSession) (text : String) => do
    let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
      | throwError "the units parameter control did not parse"
    session.read ⟨parsed⟩
  let first ← read empty "view (ℚ in Rings) along «fun.rings.multiplicative_monoid»()"
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `MFirst first
  let second ← read session "view (ℚ in Rings) along «fun.rings.multiplicative_monoid»()"
  let session ← session.defineTerm `MSecond second
  for (name, otherName, text) in #[
      (`MFirst, `MSecond, "3 in MFirstˣ"),
      (`MSecond, `MFirst, "3 in MSecondˣ")] do
    let selected ← read session name.toString
    let some selectedCategory := selected.category
      | throwError "the units parameter lost its selected category"
    let some selectedCarrier := selectedCategory.carrier
      | throwError "the units parameter lost its declared base comparison"
    let admitted ← read session text
    checkSelected admitted fun expression => do
      let scope ← get
      let context := scope.context
      let selections := scope.selections
      let findNamed := fun name => context.bindings.findM? fun binding =>
        return (← binding.expression.fvarId!.getUserName) == name
      let some original ← findNamed name
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units parameter lost its original binding"
      let some other ← findNamed otherName
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units parameter lost its distinct equal binding"
      unless original.expression != other.expression do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units parameter control does not have distinct equal native objects"
      checkOriginal #[original.expression, other.expression] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "the units parameter control does not have distinct equal native objects"
      let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? expression
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units value lost its original selected binding"
      let some admission := selected.admission
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units value lost its original registered admission"
      let count ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| forallTelescope (← inferType admission.family)
        fun parameters _ => pure parameters.size
      unless admission.entry.id.raw == "obj.sets.units" &&
          admission.entry.admission == some ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Units.admit &&
          admission.element == 1 && admission.arguments.size == count do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units admission changed its complete native argument positions"
      let parameter := admission.arguments[0]!
      let some parameterSelection ← SourceReadM.selection? parameter
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units admission lost its original selected parameter"
      let some category := parameterSelection.category
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units admission lost its complete selected category"
      unless parameterSelection.value == original.expression &&
          parameterSelection.value != other.expression do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units admission replaced its original parameter by an equal object"
      unless category.role == .object &&
          category.expression.syntacticEq selectedCategory.expression &&
          category.bundle == (← selectedCategory.bundle.inContext context) do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units admission changed its complete selected category"
      let some carrier := category.carrier
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units admission discarded its selected carrier"
      unless carrier.refs == selectedCarrier.refs &&
          carrier.target.syntacticEq selectedCarrier.target &&
          carrier.identifications == selectedCarrier.identifications &&
          carrier.actions == (← selectedCarrier.actions.mapM (·.inContext context)) &&
          carrier.comparisons == (← selectedCarrier.comparisons.mapM (·.inContext context)) do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units admission changed its actual carrier or base comparison"
      let datum := admission.arguments[admission.element]!
      let some datumSelection ← SourceReadM.selection? datum
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units datum lost its original selected point"
      let some point := datumSelection.pointOrigin
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units datum lost its transported source point"
      unless (point.target.find? (· == parameter)).isSome do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the numeral point replaced its original selected carrier target"
      let comparisons ← carrier.comparisons.filterM fun comparison =>
        return (← whnfR (← inferType comparison)).isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Iso 4
      let #[comparison] := comparisons
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units control lost its exact supplied carrier comparison"
      checkOriginal #[point.point, comparison] fun native => do
        unless native[0]!.containsConst
            (· == ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.ringNumeral) do
          throwError "the named rational base lost its declared numeral point"
        unless (native[0]!.find? fun term =>
            term.getAppFn.isConstOf ``CategoryTheory.Iso.symm &&
              term.getAppArgs.back? == some native[1]!).isSome do
          throwError "the numeral point did not use the supplied inverse carrier comparison"
      -- Only the complete record at the original parameter identity authenticates its owner.
      let .fvar parameterId := parameter
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units parameter lost its exact source binder"
      let some parameterBinding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == parameterId)
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the units parameter lost its original source identity"
      let forged := { parameterSelection with value := other.expression }
      let failure : Option Exception ← liftM (m := TermElabM) do
        try
          discard <| selections.merge
            (({} : SourceSelectionScope Expr).insert parameterBinding.id forged)
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "object provenance accepted a different equal source occurrence"
      unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString) ==
          "one source binding has incompatible retained selections" do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throw failure
  -- Division in each original units set uses its declared group refinement. The
  -- native registered quotient must retain that set's original Monoid parameter.
  for (name, otherName) in #[ (`MFirst, `MSecond), (`MSecond, `MFirst) ] do
    let equation ← read session s!"(3 in {name.toString}ˣ)⁻¹ = 1/3"
    checkSelected equation fun root => do
      let scope ← get
      let context := scope.context
      let selections := scope.selections
      let some original ← context.bindings.findM? fun binding =>
          return (← binding.expression.fvarId!.getUserName) == name
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the quotient lost its original Monoid binding"
      let some other ← context.bindings.findM? fun binding =>
          return (← binding.expression.fvarId!.getUserName) == otherName
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the quotient lost its distinct equal Monoid binding"
      let inspected ← visitNativeData (fun expression => do
        unless expression.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do return false
        let result := expression.getAppArgs[2]!
        let #[division] ← declaredApplications context selections
            ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Units.divide result
          | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the quotient lost its independently declared division"
        unless division.isAppOfArity ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Units.divide 1 do
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the quotient changed its complete division parameter"
        let parameter := division.getAppArgs[0]!
        let hasOriginal ← visitNativeData (fun actual => pure (actual == original.expression)) parameter
        let hasOther ← visitNativeData (fun actual => pure (actual == other.expression)) parameter
        unless hasOriginal > 0 && hasOther == 0 do
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "division replaced its original Monoid by an equal binding"
        let groups ← visitNativeData (fun group => do
          unless group.isAppOfArity ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Units.groupUnits 1 do return false
          let groupParameter := group.getAppArgs[0]!
          unless (← originatesAt context selections groupParameter original.expression) &&
              !(← originatesAt context selections groupParameter other.expression) do
            liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the quotient group changed its actual original Monoid argument"
          let comparisons ← visitNativeData (fun comparison => do
            unless comparison.isAppOfArity ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Units.unitsIdentification 1 do
              return false
            unless comparison.getAppArgs[0]! == groupParameter do
              liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "division changed the original parameter of its carrier comparison"
            return true) result
          unless comparisons > 0 do
            liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "division lost its supplied group-carrier comparison"
          -- The inverse result's native domain has no surface object selector.
          let nativeTarget ← inferType expression.getAppArgs[1]!
          let originalTarget ← sourceDomain nativeTarget
          unless originalTarget.isAppOfArity ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Units.units 1 do
            liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the inverse result lost its authored native units domain"
          unless originalTarget.getAppArgs[0]! == groupParameter do
            liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the native units domain changed its actual admission parameter"
          unless (← sourceObjectReference? context selections nativeTarget).isNone do
            liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the native units control retained a surface object reference"
          let some selectedAdmission ← sourceAdmissionDomain? nativeTarget
            | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the exact native units domain did not select its declared admission"
          unless selectedAdmission.id.raw == "obj.sets.units" &&
              selectedAdmission.declaration == ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Units.units &&
              selectedAdmission.admission == some ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Units.admit do
            liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the native units domain selected another admission row"
          return true) parameter
        unless groups > 0 do
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "division lost the declared group of the original units set"
        return true) root
      unless inspected == 1 do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the original units division did not remain an equality"
  -- The same native Monoid without its supplied base comparison cannot acquire
  -- a numeral from the convertible rational carrier or a stronger structural owner.
  let some firstCategory := first.category
    | throwError "the missing-comparison control lost its selected category"
  let some firstCarrier := firstCategory.carrier
    | throwError "the missing-comparison control lost its original carrier route"
  let categoryTerm ← empty.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    discard <| empty.readTerm first
    firstCategory.bundle.inContext (← get).context
  let withoutComparison ← first.inCategory firstCategory.expression categoryTerm
    firstCategory.role
    (some { firstCarrier with comparisons := #[], identifications := #[] })
    firstCategory.limit
  let unpresented ← session.defineTerm `MWithoutComparison withoutComparison
  let failure : Option Exception ← withoutModifyingState do
    try
      discard <| read unpresented "3 in MWithoutComparisonˣ"
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "a Monoid numeral was inferred without its supplied base comparison"
  unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString) ==
      "no declared source point numeral was admitted in the supplied domain" do throw failure
  let failure : Option Exception ← withoutModifyingState do
    try
      discard <| read session "0 in MFirstˣ"
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "units admission accepted zero without its prescribed evidence"
  let message ← failure.toMessageData.toString
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .invalid &&
      (message.splitOn "not established by the evidence of").length > 1 do
    throw failure

private def numeralAbsenceFailure (action : TermElabM α) : TermElabM Exception := do
  let failure : Option Exception ← withoutModifyingState do
    try
      discard action
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "a rejected numeral reading was reported as absence or success"
  return failure

-- Absence belongs to the actual point producer. Its ordinary consumer still rejects
-- that absence, and explicit evidence errors retain their original diagnostic.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let initial : SourceReadScope := { identities, context, selections := {} }
  let noCategory : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory) := fun _ => pure none
  let originalLiteral : SourceReadM Unit := do
    unless (← sourceNumeral? noCategory 4 (mkConst ``Nat)) == some (mkNatLit 4) do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the optional numeral producer changed the native natural literal"
  originalLiteral.runK initial fun _ _ => pure ()
  let evidence : Term ← `(term| rfl)
  let rejected ← numeralAbsenceFailure <|
    (sourceNumeral? noCategory 4 (mkConst ``Nat) #[evidence]).runK initial fun _ _ => pure ()
  unless (← rejected.toMessageData.toString) ==
      "a natural parameter literal has no domain obligations" do throw rejected

  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let native : String → TermElabM Term := fun text => do
    let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
      | throwError "the native numeral absence control did not parse"
    return ⟨parsed⟩
  let session ← empty.assume `M (← native "MonCat.{0}")
  let object ← session.term (← native "M")
  let #[category] := (← semanticState).categories.filter (·.id == CategoryId.monoids)
    | throwError "the numeral absence control lost its independently registered Monoid category"
  let bundle ← session.constant Syntax.missing category.declaration [.zero]
  let object ← object.inCategory category.expression bundle
  let session ← session.defineTerm `S object
  let type ← session.term (← native "(S : Type)")
  session.withTerm type fun context selections target => do
    let some selectedEntry := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `S)
      | throwError "the numeral absence control lost its original selected Monoid"
    let some selectedBinding := context.bindings.find? (·.id == selectedEntry.id)
      | throwError "the numeral absence control lost its exact selected Monoid binder"
    let some selected := session.categoryFor selectedBinding.id
      | throwError "the numeral absence control lost its actual category selection"
    unless selected.carrier.isNone && selected.limit.isNone do
      throwError "the absence control acquired a supplied carrier comparison or limit"
    let bundle ← selected.bundle.inContext context
    let categoryOf : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory) := fun id =>
      pure (if id == selectedBinding.expression.fvarId! then
        some (⟨selected.role, selected.expression, bundle, none, none⟩ : NativeSourceCategory)
      else none)
    let scope : SourceReadScope := { identities, context, selections }
    let absent : SourceReadM Unit := do
      unless (← sourceNumeral? categoryOf 4 target).isNone do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the selected Monoid acquired an undeclared numeral"
    absent.runK scope fun _ _ => pure ()
    let failure ← numeralAbsenceFailure <|
      (sourceNumeral categoryOf 4 target).runK scope fun _ _ => pure ()
    unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString) ==
        "no declared source point numeral was admitted in the supplied domain" do throw failure
  let source : TSyntax `cas_term ← `(cas_term| 4)
  let failure ← numeralAbsenceFailure <|
    session.read source (some type.source) type.selections
  unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString) ==
      "no declared source point numeral was admitted in the supplied domain" do throw failure

-- The original coercion control establishes the registered natural-to-integer inclusion.
-- A genuine rejection by its numeral producer must cross the inclusion probe unchanged;
-- it cannot select another inclusion or turn into a missing numeral.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let initial : SourceReadScope := { identities, context, selections := {} }
  let noCategory : FVarId → TermElabM (Option NativeSourceCategory) := fun _ => pure none
  let evidence : Term ← `(term| rfl)
  let observed : IO.Ref (Option Exception) ← IO.mkRef none
  let included := sourceIncludedNumeral (mkConst ``Int) fun source =>
    SourceReadM.tryCatch (sourceNumeral? noCategory 4 source #[evidence]) fun error => do
      observed.set (some error)
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throw error
  let failure ← numeralAbsenceFailure <|
    included.runK initial fun _ _ => pure ()
  let some original ← observed.get
    | throwError "the inclusion error control did not reach an original numeral producer"
  unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString) == (← original.toMessageData.toString) &&
      CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? original do
    throwError "inclusion search replaced a rejected chosen numeral interpretation"

module

public import CasCompiler.RouteGrammar
public import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Registry.Semantic

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

private inductive SourceSymbol
  | atom (expression : CategoryExpr)
  | constructor (id : ConstructorId)

private def SourceSymbol.same : SourceSymbol → SourceSymbol → Bool
  | .atom left, .atom right => left.syntacticEq right
  | .constructor left, .constructor right => left == right
  | _, _ => false

private def symbol (value : SourceSymbol) : StateM (Array SourceSymbol) Nat := do
  let symbols ← get
  if let some index := symbols.findIdx? (·.same value) then return index
  set (symbols.push value)
  return symbols.size

/-- Exact source decomposition follows the same active unary-context test as edgesFrom.
Residual atoms retain their entire parameter syntax and selected symbolic structure. -/
private partial def encode (constructors : Array ConstructorId) (category : CategoryExpr) :
    StateM (Array SourceSymbol) RouteGrammar.Word := do
  match category with
  | .construct id args =>
    match args with
    | #[.category inner] =>
      if constructors.contains id then
        let leading ← encode constructors inner
        return leading.push (← symbol (.constructor id))
      else return #[← symbol (.atom category)]
    | _ => return #[← symbol (.atom category)]
  | _ => return #[← symbol (.atom category)]

inductive RouteQuery
  | owner (category : CategoryExpr)
  | operation (name : String)
  | method (name : String)

inductive RouteTarget
  | owner (category : CategoryExpr)
  | operation (category : NamedCategoryEntry) (binding : OperationEntry)
  | method (binding : MethodEntry)

def RouteTarget.category : RouteTarget → CategoryExpr
  | .owner category => category
  | .operation category _ => category.expression
  | .method binding => binding.owner

/-- Symbolic route family over the exact frozen registry inventory.
Native dependent operation formation and comparison evidence are separate consumers. -/
structure SourceRoutes where
  private mk ::
  state : SemanticState
  source : CategoryExpr
  query : RouteQuery
  targets : Array RouteTarget
  private symbols : Array SourceSymbol
  edges : Array StructuralEdge
  language : RouteGrammar.RouteLanguage

private def sourceRoutes (state : SemanticState) (source : CategoryExpr)
    (query : RouteQuery) : CoreM SourceRoutes := do
  Core.checkSystem "source route construction"
  let targets := match query with
    | .owner category => #[RouteTarget.owner category]
    | .operation name => state.categories.flatMap fun category =>
      (state.operationBindings category.expression name).map (RouteTarget.operation category)
    | .method name => (state.methods.filter (·.name == name)).map RouteTarget.method
  let constructors := (state.constructors.filter (·.functorialAction.isSome)).map (·.id)
  let edges := state.structuralEdges
  let build : StateM (Array SourceSymbol)
      (RouteGrammar.Word × Array RouteGrammar.Word × Array RouteGrammar.PrefixRule) := do
    let initial ← encode constructors source
    let targets ← targets.mapM (fun target => encode constructors target.category)
    let rules ← edges.mapM fun edge => do
      let lhs ← encode constructors edge.source
      let rhs ← encode constructors edge.target
      return ({ lhs, rhs } : RouteGrammar.PrefixRule)
    return (initial, targets, rules)
  let ((initial, encodedTargets, rules), symbols) := build.run #[]
  let .ok language := RouteGrammar.compile rules initial encodedTargets
    | throwError "the source registry produced an invalid ground-prefix route system"
  Core.checkSystem "source route saturation"
  return ⟨state, source, query, targets, symbols, edges, language⟩

/-- Project one independently supplied owner target from the current accepted source inventory.
Reuse: structuralEdges/edgesFrom and the source correspondence in #66 comment 6693871042. -/
opaque SourceRoutes.forOwner (source owner : CategoryExpr) : CoreM SourceRoutes := do
  sourceRoutes (← semanticState) source (.owner owner)

/-- Bind the surface operation name before any arity filtering, exactly as the source does. -/
opaque SourceRoutes.forOperation (source : CategoryExpr) (name : String) : CoreM SourceRoutes := do
  sourceRoutes (← semanticState) source (.operation name)

/-- Stop at every first actual owner of this method name, before applying a receiver.
Reuse: the same accepted structural inventory and first-hit ground-prefix grammar. -/
opaque SourceRoutes.forMethod (source : CategoryExpr) (name : String) : CoreM SourceRoutes := do
  sourceRoutes (← semanticState) source (.method name)

/-- Reconstruct a selected symbolic derivation and validate it against the frozen source.
Actual edge references and constructor actions remain attached to each source occurrence. -/
opaque SourceRoutes.reconstruct (routes : SourceRoutes) (trace : RouteGrammar.Word) :
    CoreM Route := do
  let .ok occurrences := routes.language.reconstruct trace
    | throwError "the selected trace is not a first-hit source derivation"
  let mut current := routes.source
  let mut refs := #[]
  for occurrence in occurrences do
    Core.checkSystem "source route reconstruction"
    let some base := routes.edges[occurrence.rule]?
      | throwError "the selected trace lost its original structural edge"
    let mut edge := base
    for ordinal in occurrence.outerContext do
      let some (.constructor id) := routes.symbols[ordinal]?
        | throwError "the source constructor suffix contains a residual atom"
      edge := {
        source := .construct id #[.category edge.source]
        target := .construct id #[.category edge.target]
        expression := .constructMap id edge.expression
        ref := .constructMap id edge.ref }
    unless current.syntacticEq edge.source do
      throwError "the reconstructed source route has incompatible complete endpoints"
    refs := refs.push edge.ref
    current := edge.target
  unless routes.targets.any (·.category.syntacticEq current) do
    throwError "the reconstructed source route lost its exact binding target"
  let some steps := routes.state.routeEdges? routes.source current refs
    | throwError "the reconstructed route does not belong to the retained source inventory"
  let route : Route := { source := routes.source, target := current, steps }
  if let .operation name := routes.query then
    unless routes.state.isFirstOperationBindingRoute name route do
      throwError "the reconstructed route does not reach its first actual operation binding"
  Core.checkSystem "source route validation"
  return route

/-- Reconstruct every finite raw candidate family; none denotes an infinite trace language.
Each returned route retains and validates its actual source edges and constructor actions. -/
opaque SourceRoutes.finiteRoutes (routes : SourceRoutes) : CoreM (Option (Array Route)) := do
  Core.checkSystem "finite source route extraction"
  let words := routes.language.grammar.finiteWords
  Core.checkSystem "finite source route saturation"
  let result ← match words with
    | none => pure none
    | some words => return some (← words.mapM routes.reconstruct)
  Core.checkSystem "finite source route publication"
  return result

end CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Language

private def readScopedStatement (session : SourceSession) (text : String) :
    TermElabM SourceStatement := do
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "scoped-declarations.cas" text
  let #[item] := file.items
    | throwError "the scoped declaration control changed its public statement count"
  let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
    | throwError "the scoped declaration control changed its public syntax"
  file.withContext <| session.readStatement statement

-- Public abstract forms introduce actual locals. The uniform numeral keeps that
-- original ring, and explicit proof uses the actual local hypothesis.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let environment ← getEnv
  let .assumption rings ← readScopedStatement empty "let R ∈ CommutativeRings"
    | throwError "the abstract category declaration did not introduce a local assumption"
  let #[ring] ← authoredEntries rings.context rings.selections
    | throwError "the abstract declaration changed the original source telescope"
  let category ← selectCategory (← semanticState) "CommutativeRings"
  let some selected := rings.categoryFor ring.id
    | throwError "the abstract ring lost its selected category"
  unless ring.role == .parameter && ring.value.isNone && selected.role == .object &&
      selected.expression.syntacticEq category.expression do
    throwError "the abstract declaration acquired a concrete value or changed its category"
  let .assumption elements ← readScopedStatement rings "let x ∈ R"
    | throwError "the dependent abstract element did not remain a local parameter"
  let some element := elements.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the dependent abstract element has no retained source binding"
  unless element.role == .parameter && element.value.isNone do
    throwError "the hypothetical element acquired an invented definition"
  let .definition uniform one ← readScopedStatement elements "let one := 1 in R"
    | throwError "the abstract ring did not expose its declared uniform numeral"
  checkSelected one fun expression => do
    let scope ← get
    let some actualRing := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == ring.id)
      | throwError "the uniform numeral lost its original abstract ring"
    let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? expression
      | throwError "the uniform numeral lost its exact selected native binder"
    let some (.numeral row) := selected.reference
      | throwError "the uniform numeral lost its complete original numeral row"
    let some application := selected.originalApplication
      | throwError "the uniform numeral lost its complete original application"
    unless row.id.raw == "num.rings" && application.getAppFn.isConstOf row.declaration &&
        (← application.getAppArgs.anyM fun argument =>
          originatesAt scope.context scope.selections argument actualRing.expression false) do
      throwError "the uniform numeral replaced its abstract input or selected family"
    check expression
  let .assumption assumptions ← readScopedStatement uniform "assume h : x = one"
    | throwError "the public hypothesis did not extend the actual local scope"
  let some hypothesis := assumptions.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the public hypothesis has no retained source binding"
  unless hypothesis.role == .hypothesis && hypothesis.value.isNone do
    throwError "a local hypothesis became a proved definition"
  let .proved proposition evidence ← readScopedStatement assumptions
      "assert x = one using (proof(h))"
    | throwError "the explicit proof did not retain its original proposition and evidence"
  discard <| assumptions.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let expression ← assumptions.readTerm evidence
    let proposition ← assumptions.readTerm proposition
    let scope ← get
    let some actualHypothesis := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == hypothesis.id)
      | throwError "the source proof lost its actual local hypothesis"
    let some actualRing := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == ring.id)
      | throwError "the source proof lost its original abstract ring"
    let some actualElement := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == element.id)
      | throwError "the source proof lost its original abstract element"
    unless ← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections expression actualHypothesis.expression false do
      throwError "the explicit proof replaced its original source hypothesis"
    let dependent ← visitNativeData (fun term =>
      originatesAt scope.context scope.selections term actualRing.expression false)
      (← inferType actualElement.expression) false
    unless dependent > 0 do
      throwError "the dependent element replaced its original source ring"
    checkOriginal #[expression, proposition] fun native => do
      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint native[0]! native[1]!)
    return expression
  let conclusion ← assumptions.conclusion #[proposition] (some evidence)
  unless conclusion.context.context.exactlyMatches assumptions.context &&
      conclusion.proof.isSome && conclusion.inspectAssumptions != "No local assumptions." do
    throwError "the proved statement lost its original local assumptions"
  let .inspection observed ← readScopedStatement assumptions "inspect assumptions"
    | throwError "explicit assumption inspection did not return a frozen context"
  unless observed.context.exactlyMatches assumptions.context &&
      observed.assumptionsText == conclusion.inspectAssumptions do
    throwError "explicit inspection changed the actual retained assumptions"
  for name in #[`R, `x, `one, `h] do
    unless (← getEnv).contains name == environment.contains name do
      throwError "a public local declaration introduced a global declaration"
  let bad ← SourceFile.parse "wrong-scoped-proof.cas"
    "assert x = one using (proof(True.intro))"
  let #[item] := bad.items | throwError "the wrong-proof control did not parse one statement"
  let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
    | throwError "the wrong-proof control changed its syntax"
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    discard <| bad.withContext <| assumptions.readStatement statement
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure | throwError "a different proposition justified a scoped assertion"
  unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag (· == `CasCompiler.sourceFormalProof.typeMismatch) do
    throw failure

-- A parameterized category keeps the exact original abstract scalar in its complete
-- selected bundle; creating its object does not supply either parameter as runtime data.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let .assumption scalars ← readScopedStatement empty "let S ∈ Rings"
    | throwError "the parameterized-category control lost its abstract scalar"
  let #[scalar] ← authoredEntries scalars.context scalars.selections
    | throwError "the scalar declaration changed its original telescope"
  let some scalarCategory := scalars.categoryFor scalar.id
    | throwError "the scalar lost its originally selected category"
  let .assumption modules ← readScopedStatement scalars "let M ∈ Modules(S)"
    | throwError "the parameterized abstract category did not introduce a local object"
  let some moduleEntry := modules.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the abstract module lost its original binding"
  let some selected := modules.categoryFor moduleEntry.id
    | throwError "the abstract module lost its complete selected category"
  let expectedCategory ← selectCategory (← semanticState) "Modules"
  unless moduleEntry.role == .parameter && moduleEntry.value.isNone &&
      selected.role == .object && selected.expression.syntacticEq expectedCategory.expression do
    throwError "the module became a concrete object or changed its category family"
  discard <| modules.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let scope ← get
    let context := scope.context
    let some original := context.bindings.find? (·.id == scalar.id)
      | throwError "the complete module category lost its original scalar binding"
    let some object := context.bindings.find? (·.id == moduleEntry.id)
      | throwError "the complete module category lost its original object binding"
    let bundle ← selected.bundle.inContext context
    let expected ← sourceReferenceAt (.category expectedCategory) bundle bundle
    unless scope.selections.toList.any (fun (_, retained) =>
        retained.exactlyMatches Expr.equal expected) do
      throwError "the abstract module changed its complete original category row"
    unless bundle.getAppFn.isConstOf expectedCategory.declaration &&
        bundle.getAppArgs.size == 1 do
      throwError "the abstract module changed the complete declared category application"
    let some (actualCategory, actualScalar) ← sourceObjectOrigin? bundle.getAppArgs[0]!
      | throwError "the parameterized category discarded its explicit source parameter"
    unless (← originatesAt context scope.selections actualScalar original.expression) &&
        actualCategory.role == .object &&
        actualCategory.expression.syntacticEq scalarCategory.expression &&
        actualCategory.bundle.equal (← scalarCategory.bundle.inContext context) do
      throwError "the parameterized category replaced its original scalar or selected category"
    let expectedType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]
    checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint object.expression expectedType)
    return bundle

-- The Unicode defined form retains concrete knowledge. Membership still defines a
-- proposition when its ordinary domain shadows a registered category name.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let .definition concrete value ← readScopedStatement empty
      "let Q := ℚ ∈ CommutativeRings"
    | throwError "the Unicode concrete declaration did not remain a definition"
  let some entry := concrete.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the concrete declaration lost its original source binding"
  let some category := concrete.categoryFor entry.id
    | throwError "the concrete declaration lost its selected category"
  let expectedCategory ← selectCategory (← semanticState) "CommutativeRings"
  unless entry.role == .definition && entry.value.isSome &&
      category.expression.syntacticEq expectedCategory.expression do
    throwError "the concrete declaration became a hypothetical object"
  let .definition _ expected ← readScopedStatement empty
      "let expected := ℚ in CommutativeRings"
    | throwError "the established concrete qualification did not read"
  discard <| empty.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let expression ← empty.readTerm value
    let expected ← empty.readTerm expected
    checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun native => do
      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
        (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
    return expression
  -- Transparent parentheses retain the complete original body span and the same
  -- declared rational ring, including when the category itself is parenthesized.
  for text in #["(ℚ ∈ CommutativeRings)", "((ℚ ∈ (CommutativeRings)))"] do
    let file ← SourceFile.parse "parenthesized-category.cas"
      s!"-- original qualification\nlet Q := {text}\n"
    let #[item] := file.items
      | throwError "the parenthesized qualification changed its statement count"
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
      | throwError "the parenthesized qualification changed its public statement"
    let `(cas_stmt| let $_:ident := $body:cas_term) := statement
      | throwError "the parenthesized qualification lost its original body"
    let .definition bounded actual ← file.withContext <| empty.readStatement statement
      | throwError "the parenthesized Unicode qualification did not remain a definition"
    let some bound := bounded.context.entries.back?
      | throwError "the parenthesized declaration lost its original binding"
    let some selected := bounded.categoryFor bound.id
      | throwError "the parenthesized declaration lost its selected category"
    unless bound.role == .definition && bound.value == some actual.source.expression &&
        selected.role == .object &&
        selected.expression.syntacticEq expectedCategory.expression do
      throwError "parentheses changed the concrete value or its selected category"
    unless actual.span.fileName == "parenthesized-category.cas" &&
        actual.span.start.isSome && actual.span.stop.isSome &&
        actual.span.start == body.raw.getPos? && actual.span.stop == body.raw.getTailPos? do
      throwError "category qualification discarded the original outer parentheses span"
    discard <| empty.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      let expression ← empty.readTerm actual
      let original ← empty.readTerm value
      let expected ← empty.readTerm expected
      let scope ← get
      let some (actualRow, actualCategory) ←
          sourceObjectSelection? scope.context scope.selections expression
        | throwError "parentheses lost the rational ring's complete selected row"
      let some (originalRow, originalCategory) ←
          sourceObjectSelection? scope.context scope.selections original
        | throwError "the original rational ring lost its complete selected row"
      unless (sourceReference (.named (.registered (.inl actualRow) actualCategory)) expression).exactlyMatches
          Expr.equal (sourceReference (.named (.registered (.inl originalRow) originalCategory)) expression) &&
          actualRow.declaration == ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedCommutativeRings.rationals do
        throwError "parentheses replaced the actual rational ring or its complete category"
      checkOriginal #[expression, original, expected,
          ← selected.bundle.inContext scope.context, ← category.bundle.inContext scope.context] fun native => do
        unless (← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]!) &&
            native[0]!.containsConst (· == ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedCommutativeRings.rationals) &&
            (← isDefEq native[3]! native[4]!) do
          throwError "parentheses changed the original native rational ring or category"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
          (← mkEq native[0]! native[2]!))
      return expression
  let .definition subsets _ ← readScopedStatement concrete
      "let CommutativeRings := {1, 2} in 𝒫(ℤ)"
    | throwError "the membership domain did not define its original subset"
  let .definition membership proposition ← readScopedStatement subsets
      "let member := 1 ∈ CommutativeRings"
    | throwError "ordinary membership was reinterpreted as category qualification"
  proposition.source.withOpen fun _ expression => do
    unless ← isProp expression do
      throwError "a membership proposition became a category-qualified value"
  let some member := membership.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the membership proposition lost its definition"
  unless member.role == .definition && member.value.isSome do
    throwError "the membership proposition was promoted to a hypothesis"
  let some subset := subsets.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the shadowing membership domain lost its original binding"
  for text in #["(1 ∈ CommutativeRings)", "((1 ∈ (CommutativeRings)))"] do
    let file ← SourceFile.parse "parenthesized-membership.cas" s!"let member := {text}\n"
    let #[item] := file.items
      | throwError "the parenthesized membership changed its statement count"
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
      | throwError "the parenthesized membership changed its public statement"
    let `(cas_stmt| let $_:ident := $body:cas_term) := statement
      | throwError "the parenthesized membership lost its original body"
    let .definition _ actual ← file.withContext <| subsets.readStatement statement
      | throwError "parentheses reinterpreted ordinary membership as category qualification"
    unless actual.span.fileName == "parenthesized-membership.cas" &&
        actual.span.start.isSome && actual.span.stop.isSome &&
        actual.span.start == body.raw.getPos? && actual.span.stop == body.raw.getTailPos? do
      throwError "ordinary membership discarded the original outer parentheses span"
    discard <| subsets.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      let expression ← subsets.readTerm actual
      let proposition ← subsets.readTerm proposition
      let scope ← get
      let some originalSubset := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == subset.id)
        | throwError "parenthesized membership lost its actual shadowing domain"
      let usesSubset ← visitNativeData (fun term =>
        originatesAt scope.context scope.selections term originalSubset.expression false) expression false
      unless (← isProp expression) && usesSubset > 0 do
        throwError "parentheses changed membership in the original same-name local subset"
      checkOriginal #[expression, proposition] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "parentheses changed the original native membership proposition"
      return expression

-- A block keeps typed children and original labels without extending its parent
-- source scope. Its retained local conclusion remains conditional after that boundary.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let .definition outer _ ← readScopedStatement empty "let outside := Fin(3)"
    | throwError "the outer source control did not define its original object"
  let .contextBlock children ← readScopedStatement outer
      "context do\n  let X ∈ Sets\n  let x in X\n  assume h : x = x\n  \
       test scoped.local \"local hypothesis\": assert x = x using (proof(h))\nend"
    | throwError "the public context block did not retain its typed children"
  unless children.size == 4 do throwError "the block lost an original child statement"
  let hypothesisItem? : Option (TSyntax `cas_item × SourceStatement) := children[2]?
  let some (_, innerStatement) := hypothesisItem?
    | throwError "the block lost its actual local hypothesis scope"
  let .assumption inner := innerStatement
    | throwError "the block lost its actual local hypothesis scope"
  let questionItem? : Option (TSyntax `cas_item × SourceStatement) := children[3]?
  let some (question, proofStatement) := questionItem?
    | throwError "the block lost its actual conditional conclusion"
  let .proved proposition evidence := proofStatement
    | throwError "the block lost its actual conditional conclusion"
  let `(cas_item| test $identity:ident $label:str : $_:cas_stmt) := question
    | throwError "the block discarded the original question label"
  unless identity.getId == `scoped.local && label.getString == "local hypothesis" do
    throwError "the block changed its original question identity"
  let conclusion ← inner.conclusion #[proposition] (some evidence)
  let outerEntries ← authoredEntries outer.context outer.selections
  let innerEntries ← authoredEntries conclusion.context.context inner.selections
  unless outerEntries.size == 1 && innerEntries.size == 4 &&
      (innerEntries[3]?).map (·.role) == some .hypothesis do
    throwError "scope exit discarded local assumptions or leaked a local binding"
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "outside-scope.cas" "let escaped := x"
  let #[item] := file.items | throwError "the scope-exit control did not parse"
  let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
    | throwError "the scope-exit control changed its source syntax"
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    discard <| file.withContext <| outer.readStatement statement
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure | throwError "a local element escaped its source scope"
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.isUnknownSourceName failure "x" do throw failure

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the source did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

/- A set literal with no declared power object (the argument of `span({u₁, u₂})`,
tests/acceptance/linear_algebra.cas) is a subset of the set in which its elements meet: here the
vectors of ℚ³, in that set's registered power object. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let space ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "ℚ³")
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `u₁ (← empty.read (← sourceTerm "(1, 0, 1)") (some space.source) space.selections)
  let session ← session.defineTerm `u₂ (← session.read (← sourceTerm "(0, 1, 1)") (some space.source) space.selections)
  let literal ← session.read (← sourceTerm "{u₁, u₂}")
  checkSelected literal fun value => do
    checkOriginal #[value] fun native => do
      let vectors ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.LinearAlgebra.vectors
        #[Expr.const ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.rationals [], mkNatLit 3]
      let power ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.PowerSets.powerSet #[vectors]
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType native[0]!) power do
        throwError "the literal is not a subset of ℚ³: {← inferType native[0]!}"
