@[expose] public section

namespace CasCompiler.SourceSnapshot

open Lean CasTools CasCatalogue ContextSnapshot

-- Registry rows reuse InterfaceDocument's codecs, derived from the actual independent
-- records. A rigid family's native expressions are complete closed functions; their
-- nested graphs retain every binder and universe without reopening or interpreting them.
local instance : ToJson Name := ⟨NativeExpression.nameJson⟩
local instance : ToJson BindingId := ⟨bindingJson⟩
local instance : ToJson Expr := ⟨fun expression => NativeExpression.encode #[expression]⟩
-- A prerequisite ordinal retains the bound supplied by its original whole program.
-- The finite type's proof is determined by that checked value and bound.
local instance {bound : Nat} : ToJson (Fin bound) :=
  ⟨fun index => Json.mkObj [("value", toJson index.val), ("bound", toJson bound)]⟩

deriving instance ToJson for Sum

deriving instance ToJson for StructuralEdge, Route
deriving instance ToJson for ComputationRef, ComputationDerivationId, ComputationDerivationEntry
deriving instance ToJson for CheckedComputationPrerequisite, CheckedComputationDerivation
deriving instance ToJson for SourceNamedEntry, SelectedConstructorInterface, SelectedSourceReference
deriving instance ToJson for SourceCategoryRole, NativePowerObject
deriving instance ToJson for LimitInterface, LimitCreationInterface
deriving instance ToJson for NativeSourceCarrierSelection, NativeSourceLimitSelection
deriving instance ToJson for NativeSourceCategory, NativeSourceElementOwner, NativeSourceTypeOrigin
deriving instance ToJson for NativeSourcePointOrigin, NativeRouteFunctor, NativeSourceCell
deriving instance ToJson for NativeSourceCellComponent, NativeSourceCartesian
deriving instance ToJson for LiftPort, LiftFamily, PresentationFamily
deriving instance ToJson for SourceActionFamily
deriving instance ToJson for RoutedMethodReturn, RoutedMethodFamily, PropertyFamily
deriving instance ToJson for PointFamilyOwner, PointFamily, NativePointRequest
deriving instance ToJson for CategoricalPointOwner, CategoricalPointFamily, CategoricalPointRequest
deriving instance ToJson for LimitFamily, LimitUniversalFamily, CreationFamily
deriving instance ToJson for NativeLimitSelection, SelectedLimitOwner, NativeLimitLegSelection
deriving instance ToJson for SourceProgram, SourceFamily
deriving instance ToJson for SelectedApplicationFamily, SelectedSourceApplication
deriving instance ToJson for SelectedSourceAdmission, SelectedSourcePointRequest, SelectedSourceField
deriving instance ToJson for SelectedEndpointSide, SelectedSourceEndpoint, SourceSelection

/-- Every native payload is encoded in its retained complete telescope. The derived record
codec also retains all original registry rows, whole rigid families, formal slots and routes;
it cannot silently omit a field when the typed selection owner grows. -/
def selectionJson (selection : SourceSelection ClosedTerm) :
    StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return toJson (← selection.mapM closedTermJson)

/-- Stable binding identities order the complete source side table. No expression, type,
carrier or available implementation is consulted to reconstruct a selection. -/
def selectionsJson (selections : SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm) :
    StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let entries := selections.toArray.qsort fun left right =>
    if left.1.session == right.1.session then left.1.serial < right.1.serial
    else left.1.session < right.1.session
  let rows ← entries.mapM fun (binding, selection) => do
    return Json.mkObj [("binding", bindingJson binding),
      ("selection", ← selectionJson selection)]
  return Json.arr rows

/-- Original source positions; no reconstructed or pretty-printed source is substituted. -/
def spanJson (span : SourceSpan) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("file", toJson span.fileName),
    ("startByte", toJson (span.start.map (·.byteIdx))),
    ("stopByte", toJson (span.stop.map (·.byteIdx)))]

def ringVariablesJson (rings : Array SourceRingVariable) :
    StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let rows ← rings.mapM fun ring => do
    let carrier ← closedTermJson ring.carrier
    return Json.mkObj [("name", toJson (ring.name.toString (escape := false))),
      ("nativeName", NativeExpression.nameJson ring.name),
      ("carrier", carrier), ("index", toJson ring.index),
      ("selections", ← selectionsJson ring.selections)]
  return toJson rows

def carrierJson (carrier : SourceCarrierSelection) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let actions ← carrier.actions.mapM closedTermJson
  let comparisons ← carrier.comparisons.mapM closedTermJson
  return Json.mkObj [("refs", toJson (reprStr carrier.refs)),
    ("target", toJson (reprStr carrier.target)),
    ("identifications", Json.arr (carrier.identifications.map NativeExpression.nameJson)),
    ("actions", toJson actions), ("comparisons", toJson comparisons)]

/-- The accepted interface is retained as supplied, including its dependent constructor and
optional standardization. It is not reconstructed from the selected apex or cone. -/
def limitInterfaceJson (interface : LimitInterface ClosedTerm) :
    StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let presentation ← closedTermJson interface.presentation
  let diagram ← closedTermJson interface.diagram
  let standardization ← interface.standardization.mapM closedTermJson
  let dataConstructor ← interface.dataConstructor.mapM closedTermJson
  return Json.mkObj [("presentation", presentation), ("diagram", diagram),
    ("standardization", toJson standardization), ("dataConstructor", toJson dataConstructor)]

/-- Exact native creation inputs and full fixed result family, in the original source context. -/
def creationJson (creation : LimitCreationInterface ClosedTerm) :
    StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [
    ("lift", toJson creation.lift.raw),
    ("declaration", NativeExpression.nameJson creation.declaration),
    ("edge", toJson creation.edge),
    ("evidence", ← closedTermJson creation.evidence),
    ("createsLimit", ← closedTermJson creation.createsLimit),
    ("functor", ← closedTermJson creation.functor),
    ("diagram", ← closedTermJson creation.diagram),
    ("targetCone", ← closedTermJson creation.targetCone),
    ("targetUniversal", ← closedTermJson creation.targetUniversal),
    ("standardization", ← closedTermJson creation.standardization),
    ("standardizedCone", ← closedTermJson creation.standardizedCone),
    ("standardizedUniversal", ← closedTermJson creation.standardizedUniversal),
    ("requestFamily", ← closedTermJson creation.requestFamily),
    ("result", ← closedTermJson creation.result)]

/-- Source and target presentations stay distinct for a created limit. All fields are the
already checked retained data; serializing them neither elaborates nor executes mathematics. -/
def limitJson (limit : SourceLimitSelection) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let cone ← closedTermJson limit.cone
  let presentation ← closedTermJson limit.presentation
  let diagram ← closedTermJson limit.diagram
  let interface ← limitInterfaceJson limit.interface
  let ownerFamily ← limit.ownerFamily.mapM closedTermJson
  let creation ← limit.creation.mapM creationJson
  let creationFamily ← limit.creationFamily.mapM closedTermJson
  return Json.mkObj [("row", toJson limit.row),
    ("construction", NativeExpression.nameJson limit.construction),
    ("declaration", NativeExpression.nameJson limit.declaration),
    ("displayDeclaration", toJson (limit.declaration.toString (escape := false))),
    ("nativeDeclaration", NativeExpression.nameJson limit.declaration),
    ("colimit", toJson limit.colimit), ("cone", cone),
    ("presentation", presentation), ("diagram", diagram), ("interface", interface),
    ("ownerFamily", toJson ownerFamily), ("creation", toJson creation),
    ("creationFamily", toJson creationFamily), ("creationInputs", toJson limit.creationInputs),
    ("category", toJson (reprStr limit.category)), ("bundle", ← closedTermJson limit.bundle)]

def categoryJson (category : SourceCategoryBinding) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let bundle ← closedTermJson category.bundle
  let carrier ← category.carrier.mapM carrierJson
  let limit ← category.limit.mapM limitJson
  let fields := [("role", toJson <| match category.role with
      | .object => "object" | .morphism => "morphism"),
    ("expression", toJson (reprStr category.expression)),
    ("bundle", bundle), ("carrier", toJson carrier)]
  return Json.mkObj (fields ++ limit.toList.map ("limit", ·))

def bindingSpan (session : SourceContextObservation) (id : BindingId) : Option Json := do
  let index ← session.context.entries.findIdx? (·.id == id)
  spanJson <$> session.spans[index]?

/-- Prepare an inert exact source document at the existing source handoff.
Categories and declaration spans are aligned with the retained context by stable identity.
This pure encoder does not reopen terms, infer types, print expressions, select providers or
read a mutable environment. Callers retain its result for later observation. -/
def snapshot (session : SourceContextObservation) (term : SourceTerm)
    (definedBinding : Option ContextEntry := none) : Json := Id.run do
  let build : StateM NativeExpression.Builder (List (String × Json) × Array Nat) := do
    let native ← closedTermJson term.source
    let context ← contextJson term.source.context
    let expression ← NativeExpression.Builder.add term.source.expression
    let type ← NativeExpression.Builder.add term.source.type
    let categories ← term.source.context.entries.mapM fun entry =>
      (session.categoryFor entry.id).mapM categoryJson
    let rings ← term.source.context.entries.mapM fun entry => do
      let rings ← ringVariablesJson (session.ringsFor entry.id)
      return Json.mkObj [("id", bindingJson entry.id), ("variables", rings)]
    let resultBinding ← definedBinding.mapM fun entry => do
      let category ← (session.categoryFor entry.id).mapM categoryJson
      let rings ← ringVariablesJson (session.ringsFor entry.id)
      return Json.mkObj [("id", bindingJson entry.id),
        ("name", toJson (entry.userName.toString (escape := false))),
        ("nativeName", NativeExpression.nameJson entry.userName),
        ("span", toJson (bindingSpan session entry.id)),
        ("category", toJson category), ("ringVariables", rings)]
    let category ← term.category.mapM categoryJson
    let selections ← selectionsJson term.selections
    let sessionSelections ← selectionsJson session.selections
    pure ([("native", native), ("context", context),
      ("instances", instancesJson term.source.context),
      ("categories", toJson categories), ("category", toJson category),
      ("ringVariables", toJson rings),
      ("selections", selections), ("sessionSelections", sessionSelections),
      ("resultBinding", toJson resultBinding),
      ("file", toJson term.span.fileName),
      ("startByte", toJson (term.span.start.map (·.byteIdx))),
      ("stopByte", toJson (term.span.stop.map (·.byteIdx))),
      ("bindingSpans", toJson <| term.source.context.entries.map fun entry => Json.mkObj [
        ("id", bindingJson entry.id), ("span", toJson (bindingSpan session entry.id))])],
      #[expression, type])
  let ((fields, roots), builder) := build.run {}
  return Json.mkObj (fields ++ [("nativeExpressions", builder.finish roots)])

end CasCompiler.SourceSnapshot

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the source did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

/- `span` names a registered morphism of sets and a registered object of module subobjects.
Of the two, only the morphism accepts a finite set of vectors of ℚ³ (the object needs a module
whose carrier the argument does not determine), so `span({u₁, u₂})` reads as that morphism
(tests/acceptance/linear_algebra.cas). -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let space ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "ℚ³")
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `u₁ (← empty.read (← sourceTerm "(1, 0, 1)") (some space.source) space.selections)
  let session ← session.defineTerm `u₂ (← session.read (← sourceTerm "(0, 1, 1)") (some space.source) space.selections)
  let span ← session.read (← sourceTerm "span({u₁, u₂})")
  SourceTest.checkSelected span fun value => do
    unless (← SourceTest.visitNativeData
        (fun expression => pure (expression.isConstOf ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.LinearAlgebra.span))
        value) > 0 do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the span is not the registered span of sets: {value}"

/- The span is a subset of the same set of vectors of ℚ³, so a tuple of numerals is read in it
as its elements are: `(1, 1, 2) ∈ span({u₁, u₂})` (tests/acceptance/linear_algebra.cas). -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let space ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "ℚ³")
  let session ← empty.defineTerm `u₁ (← empty.read (← sourceTerm "(1, 0, 1)") (some space.source) space.selections)
  let session ← session.defineTerm `u₂ (← session.read (← sourceTerm "(0, 1, 1)") (some space.source) space.selections)
  discard <| session.read (← sourceTerm "(1, 1, 2) ∈ span({u₁, u₂})")

/- The native application helper distinguishes equal-arity declarations by their complete
argument types. These are ordinary native declarations, not downstream catalogue rows.
The public source-reader controls above still exercise the independently owned span. -/
open CategoryTheory

def nativeTrialObject (n : Nat) (_ : Nat) : Type := Fin n

def nativeTrialMap (_ _ : Fin 2) : Fin 2 ⟶ Fin 2 :=
  TypeCat.ofHom fun value => value

private def nativeTrialSession : TermElabM SourceSession := do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assumeTerm `n (← empty.read (← sourceTerm "ℕ"))
  session.assumeTerm `i (← session.read (← sourceTerm "Fin(2)"))

private def nativeTrialFailure (read : TermElabM α) : TermElabM Exception := withoutModifyingState do
  let result ← try
      discard <| read
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  let some error := result | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the negative native applicability control succeeded"
  return error

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let session ← nativeTrialSession
  session.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let authored ← SourceTest.authoredEntries session.context session.selections
    let actual ← authored.mapM fun entry => do
      let some binding := bindings.find? (·.id == entry.id)
        | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native applicability control lost an original source position"
      return binding.expression
    context.withOriginalSources actual fun native => do
      let natural := native[0]!
      let finite := native[1]!
      for (declaration, arguments, applicable) in
          #[(``nativeTrialObject, #[natural, natural], true),
            (``nativeTrialMap, #[finite, finite], true),
            (``nativeTrialObject, #[finite, finite], false),
            (``nativeTrialMap, #[natural, natural], false)] do
        let result ← withoutModifyingState do
          elabSourceApplicationApplicable (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels declaration)
            (Array.replicate arguments.size Syntax.missing) none fun index _ => do
              let some value := arguments[index]?
                | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native applicability control lost an actual argument"
              return .ok value
        match result with
        | .ok (value, retained) =>
          unless applicable && retained == arguments &&
              value.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf declaration do
            liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native applicability helper changed or accepted incompatible arguments"
        | .error _ =>
          if applicable then liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native applicability helper rejected its actual domain"

/- Controlled dispatcher coverage: both independently registered span rows receive complete
native operands through the ReadContext callback, and each distinct operand choice is checked first.
This is not a public-source ambiguity fixture: genuine public ambiguity remains covered by
SourceDivisionTests and SourceViewTests without changing their original inputs. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let field ← elabTermAndSynthesize (← `(CasCatalogue.Algebra.Fields.rationals)) none
  let ring ← elabTermAndSynthesize (← `(CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.ringRationals)) none
  let moduleObject ← elabTermAndSynthesize (← `(ModuleCat.of ℚ (Fin 2 → ℚ))) none
  let subset ← elabTermAndSynthesize (← `((∅ : Set (Fin 2 → ℚ)))) none
  let operands := #[#[field, ring], #[mkNatLit 2, moduleObject], #[subset]]
  let source ← sourceTerm "span(0, 1, 2)"
  let `(cas_term| $name:ident($arguments:cas_term,*)) := source
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the controlled span lost its original application syntax"
  let reads ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (#[] : Array Nat)
  let contextFor : Array (Array Expr) → ReadContext := fun operands =>
    ⟨(fun _ => pure none), source, none, none, none,
      readProjection, fun _ argument expected _ _ => do
        let some expected := expected
          | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the controlled span operand lost its declared parameter type"
        let `(cas_term| $index:num) := argument
          | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the controlled span lost an operand position"
        liftM (m := IO) <| reads.modify (·.push index.getNat)
        let some choices := operands[index.getNat]?
          | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the controlled span requested an absent operand"
        let matching ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| choices.filterM fun value => do
          withoutModifyingState <| isDefEq (← inferType value) expected
        if matching.isEmpty then
          return .error m!"the supplied operand has another native type"
        let #[value] := matching
          | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the controlled span requires one supplied operand at its native type"
        unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) expected do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the controlled span changed its original native parameter"
        return .ok ⟨value, none⟩⟩
  let context := contextFor operands
  let candidates ← selectNamed "span" none none
  unless candidates.size == 2 do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the controlled span requires its two independently registered source kinds"
  for candidate in candidates do
    let .registered entry _ := candidate
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the controlled span acquired a different registered kind"
    let (declaration, selectedOperands) : Name × Array (Array Expr) := match entry with
      | .inl entry => (entry.declaration, #[#[ring], #[moduleObject], #[subset]])
      | .inr entry => (entry.declaration, #[#[field], #[mkNatLit 2], #[subset]])
    withoutModifyingState do
      reads.set #[]
      discard <| empty.elaborateJudgementsScoped source do
        let judgement ← SourceReader.registered (contextFor selectedOperands)
          name arguments.getElems
        let value ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars judgement.value
        let scope ← get
        let applications ← SourceTest.declaredApplications scope.context scope.selections
          declaration value
        unless !applications.isEmpty &&
            applications.all (fun application => !application.hasMVar && !application.hasLevelMVar) &&
            !value.hasMVar && !value.hasLevelMVar do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a controlled span candidate did not retain its actual native declaration"
        check value
        -- Only the accepted row reaches its final original operand. Retaining its
        -- native state must not elaborate that successful source occurrence again.
        unless ((← liftM (m := IO) reads.get).filter (· == 2)).size == 1 do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the selected named reading replayed its original source operand"
        return #[judgement]
  let ambiguous ← nativeTrialFailure <| empty.elaborateJudgementsScoped source do
    return #[← SourceReader.registered context name arguments.getElems]
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity ambiguous do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "two applicable native candidates were not retained as an ambiguity"
  let mismatchContext : ReadContext := { context with
    read := fun _ _ _ _ _ => pure (.error m!"controlled native parameter mismatch") }
  let inapplicable ← nativeTrialFailure <| empty.elaborateJudgementsScoped source do
    return #[← SourceReader.registered mismatchContext name arguments.getElems]
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? inapplicable == some .invalid &&
      !CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity inapplicable do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "zero applicable native candidates did not preserve invalid source"

/- Recursive operand failures belong to the matched source expression, not to candidate
applicability. This includes the original unknown-name stratum and internal exceptions. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let session ← nativeTrialSession
  for source in #["span(unregistered_native_trial_operand)",
      "span(span(unregistered_native_trial_operand))"] do
    let missing ← nativeTrialFailure <| session.read (← sourceTerm source)
    unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? missing == some .invalid &&
        CasCatalogue.Exception.isUnknownSourceName missing "unregistered_native_trial_operand" do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the named trial replaced its operand's original unknown-name failure"
  let original ← nativeTrialFailure <| session.read
    (← sourceTerm "id(Fin(2), Fin(3))")
  let nested ← nativeTrialFailure <| session.read
    (← sourceTerm "span(id(Fin(2), Fin(3)))")
  unless (← original.toMessageData.toString) == (← nested.toMessageData.toString) do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native trial replaced a matched operand's original construction failure"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let nativeTrialInternal ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    registerInternalExceptionId `CasCompiler.tests.nativeTrialInternal
  let source ← sourceTerm "span(Fin(2))"
  let `(cas_term| $name:ident($arguments:cas_term,*)) := source
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native trial control lost its source application"
  let context : ReadContext := ⟨(fun _ => pure none), source, none, none, none,
    readProjection, fun _ _ _ _ _ => throw (Exception.internal nativeTrialInternal)⟩
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let internal ← nativeTrialFailure <| empty.elaborateJudgementsScoped source do
    return #[← SourceReader.registered context name arguments.getElems]
  match internal with
  | .internal id _ =>
    unless id == nativeTrialInternal do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native trial changed the original internal exception"
  | _ => liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native trial swallowed a matched operand's internal exception"

-- Check the public constructor at its whole rigid category, before any receiver or
-- category parameters are supplied. Its native FullSubcategory contains the actual
-- monomorphism Arrow; no carrier shape selects a mathematical interface.
private def checkSubobjectConstructor (entry : ConstructorEntry) : MetaM Unit := do
  unless entry.signature == #[.category] do
    throwError "the selected subobject constructor changed its complete signature"
  let info ← checkedDeclaration entry.semantics
  let universes ← info.levelParams.mapM fun _ => mkFreshUserName `subobjectUniverse
  let family := Lean.mkConst entry.semantics (universes.map Level.param)
  let agreement ← forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType family) fun parameters _ => do
    let #[category] := parameters
      | throwError "the selected subobject constructor has additional native parameters"
    let expected ← applyConstructorInterface ``CasCatalogue.Constructors.subobjects
      #[category] #[category]
    let some proof ← withTransparency .all <|
        sourceFamilyConversion (mkAppN family parameters) expected #[]
      | throwError "the selected subobject constructor is not its complete native family"
    mkLambdaFVars parameters proof (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
  checkWithKernel agreement

/-- The domain and inclusion of the actual selected Subobjects object.
Reuse: Constructors.subobjects, FullSubcategory.obj and the native Arrow fields.
The whole accepted constructor is checked before specializing the selected complete bundle;
both projections remain rooted in this receiver, including after source aliasing. -/
def sourceSubobjectMember? (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) (name : String) :
    TermElabM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  unless name == "obj" || name == "hom" do return none
  let some selected := receiver.category | return none
  unless selected.role == .object do return none
  let .construct id #[.category base] := selected.expression | return none
  let state ← semanticState
  let some constructor := state.constructor? id
    | throwError "the selected subobject constructor is absent"
  unless constructor.semantics == ``CasCatalogue.Constructors.subobjects do return none
  checkSubobjectConstructor constructor
  -- Specialize the selected base category's complete family against the supplied
  -- constructed bundle. Do not expand native structure parameters or any bound input.
  let family ← nativeCategoryFamily state base (fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar)
  let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
  let bundle := mkAppN family parameters
  let expected ← applyConstructorInterface constructor.semantics #[bundle] #[bundle]
  unless ← isDefEq expected selected.bundle do
    throwError "the selected subobject has different complete native category parameters"
  let bundle ← instantiateMVars bundle
  if bundle.hasMVar || bundle.hasLevelMVar then
    throwError "the selected subobject requires its complete original category parameters"
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType receiver.value)
      (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[selected.bundle]) do
    throwError "the selected subobject value does not inhabit its complete native category"
  -- mkProjection preserves the parent expression. The existing projection lowering
  -- therefore consumes the actual retained K, not another evaluation of its definition.
  let arrow ← mkProjection receiver.value `obj
  let value ← mkProjection arrow (if name == "obj" then `left else `hom)
  check value
  let role := if name == "obj" then SourceCategoryRole.object else .morphism
  return some ⟨value, some ⟨role, base, bundle, none, none⟩⟩

end CasCompiler

private def kernelSource (session : SourceSession) (text : String) : TermElabM SourceTerm := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the ordinary subobject source did not parse"
  session.read ⟨stx⟩

private def kernelNative (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | throwError "the ordinary subobject native parameter did not parse"
  return ⟨stx⟩

private def expectKernelFailure (action : TermElabM Unit) (errorPrefix : String) :
    TermElabM Unit := do
  let failure : Option Exception ← withoutModifyingState do
    try
      action
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure | throwError "the ordinary subobject control was admitted"
  unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith errorPrefix do throw failure

-- Check the actual source occurrence and native field path, not just definitional equality
-- of a newly evaluated kernel with the expected mathematical object.
private def checkKernelProjection (term : SourceTerm) (root : BindingId)
    (field : Name) (base : ClosedTerm) : TermElabM Unit := do
  let some category := term.category
    | throwError "the ordinary subobject projection lost its selected category"
  let role := if field == ``CategoryTheory.Comma.left then SourceCategoryRole.object else .morphism
  unless category.role == role && category.expression.syntacticEq Modules.Modules do
    throwError "the ordinary subobject projection changed its original base category or role"
  checkSelected term fun expression => do
    let scope ← get
    let value ← selectedValue expression
    let source ← ClosedTerm.close scope.context value
    let some selected ← source.inputProjectionAt #[] (scope.context.bindings.map (·.id))
      | throwError "the ordinary subobject projection is not rooted in a retained input"
    let .context selectedRoot := selected.target
      | throwError "the ordinary subobject projection selected an argument instead of its binding"
    unless selectedRoot == root &&
        selected.path == #[``CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.obj, field] do
      throwError "the ordinary subobject projection selected a different occurrence or native field"
    let some original := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == root)
      | throwError "the ordinary subobject projection lost its retained source binding"
    let arrow ← mkProjection original.expression `obj
    let expected ← mkProjection arrow (if field == ``CategoryTheory.Comma.left then `left else `hom)
    checkOriginal #[value, expected, ← category.bundle.inContext scope.context,
        ← base.inContext scope.context] fun native => do
      unless (← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]!) && (← isDefEq native[2]! native[3]!) do
        throwError "the ordinary subobject projection changed its complete native source"
      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
        (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))

-- The unchanged kernel prefix of each existing file is read through its complete
-- projection and zero-composite questions. This focused frontend check stops at
-- restricted; the complete original RX08 files remain separate required consumers.
private def checkOrdinaryKernel (path : String) : TermElabM Unit := do
  let file ← SourceFile.parse path (← liftM (m := IO) (IO.FS.readFile path))
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let mut questions : Array String := #[]
  let mut projections : Array Name := #[]
  for item in file.items do
    if let `(cas_item| test $id:ident $_:str : assert $body:cas_term) := item then
      let question ← try file.withContext (session.readQuestion body)
        catch error => throwError "original kernel question {id.getId}: {error.toMessageData}"
      unless (question.source.context.entries.take session.context.entries.size).map (·.id) ==
          session.context.entries.map (·.id) do
        throwError "the original kernel question lost its complete source context"
      checkSelected question fun expression => do
        checkOriginal #[expression] fun native => do
          unless ← isProp native[0]! do throwError "the original kernel question is not a proposition"
          check native[0]!
      questions := questions.push (id.getId.toString (escape := false))
      continue
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item | continue
    let name ← match statement with
      | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident := $_:cas_term) => pure name.getId
      | `(cas_stmt| let $name:ident($_:cas_term) := $_:cas_term) => pure name.getId
      | _ => continue
    if name == `restricted then break
    let checked ← try file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
      catch error => throwError "original kernel binding {name}: {error.toMessageData}"
    let .definition next value := checked
      | throwError "an original kernel definition changed its statement kind"
    if name == `K then
      let some original := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `projection)
        | throwError "the original module map is absent"
      let some category := value.category
        | throwError "the ordinary kernel lost its selected result category"
      unless category.expression.syntacticEq Modules.Bilinear.Valued.Kernels.SubobjectsModules do
        throwError "the ordinary kernel acquired a different source result family"
      checkSelected value fun expression => do
        let scope ← get
        let some projection := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == original.id)
          | throwError "the ordinary kernel lost its original module map"
        unless (← visitNativeData (fun term =>
            originatesAt scope.context scope.selections term projection.expression false)
            expression false) > 0 do
          throwError "the ordinary kernel replaced its actual input"
        checkOriginal #[expression, projection.expression] fun native => do
          let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels
            ``CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.Kernels.kernelDeclaration
          let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration)
          unless ← expandSourceStructures parameters do
            throwError "the published kernel functor has inconsistent native parameters"
          let family := mkAppN declaration parameters
          let (domain, target) ← functorCategoryBundles family
          let arrow ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk #[native[1]!]
          unless ← isDefEq (← inferType arrow) (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[domain]) do
            throwError "the published kernel functor has a different complete native input"
          let family ← instantiateMVars family
          if family.hasMVar || family.hasLevelMVar then
            throwError "the published kernel functor lost an actual native parameter"
          let expected ← functorObject family arrow (← instantiateMVars target)
          unless ← isDefEq native[0]! expected do
            throwError "the ordinary kernel replaced its published functor"
          checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
            (← mkEq native[0]! expected))
    if name == `kernelObject || name == `kernelInclusion then
      let some original := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `K)
        | throwError "the original kernel result is absent"
      let some projection := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `projection)
        | throwError "the original module map is absent"
      let some base := session.categoryFor projection.id
        | throwError "the original module map lost its selected category"
      checkKernelProjection value original.id
        (if name == `kernelObject then ``CategoryTheory.Comma.left else ``CategoryTheory.Comma.hom)
        base.bundle
      projections := projections.push name
    session := next
  unless projections == #[`kernelObject, `kernelInclusion] && questions.size == 3 &&
      questions[0]!.endsWith ".full_projection" &&
      questions[1]!.endsWith ".kernel_dimension" &&
      questions[2]!.endsWith ".kernel_zero_composite" do
    throwError "the original kernel consumer lost a projection or complete source question"
  let some projection := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `projection)
    | throwError "the original module map is absent after its continuation"
  let some base := session.categoryFor projection.id
    | throwError "the original module category is absent after its continuation"
  session ← session.defineTerm `KAgain (← kernelSource session "K")
  let some selectedAlias := session.context.entries.back?
    | throwError "the original kernel alias did not bind"
  for (name, field) in #[
      ("obj", ``CategoryTheory.Comma.left), ("hom", ``CategoryTheory.Comma.hom)] do
    checkKernelProjection (← kernelSource session s!"KAgain.{name}()") selectedAlias.id field base.bundle

-- Equal definitions do not identify the selected category parameters. The same raw
-- subobject can be explicitly typed in either convertible complete category; each
-- projection must preserve the category that its source actually selected.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `R (← kernelNative "RingCat.{0}")
  let session ← session.define `RFirst (← kernelNative "R")
  let session ← session.define `RSecond (← kernelNative "R")
  let firstRing ← session.term (← kernelNative "RFirst")
  let secondRing ← session.term (← kernelNative "RSecond")
  let first ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Modules" [.zero, .zero] #[firstRing]
  let second ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Modules" [.zero, .zero] #[secondRing]
  let firstSubobjects ← session.unaryCategory Syntax.missing ConstructorId.subobjects first
  let secondSubobjects ← session.unaryCategory Syntax.missing ConstructorId.subobjects second
  let type ← session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[← session.readTerm firstSubobjects.value]
  let session ← session.assumeTerm `raw type
  let raw ← session.term (← kernelNative "raw")
  let firstValue ← raw.inCategory firstSubobjects.expression firstSubobjects.value
  let secondValue ← raw.inCategory secondSubobjects.expression secondSubobjects.value
  let session ← session.defineTerm `KFirst firstValue
  let session ← session.defineTerm `KSecond secondValue
  for (name, ring, other, base) in #[
      ("KFirst", `RFirst, `RSecond, first.value.source),
      ("KSecond", `RSecond, `RFirst, second.value.source)] do
    let some original := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == Name.mkSimple name)
      | throwError "the typed subobject did not retain its original source binding"
    let some chosen := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == ring)
      | throwError "the typed subobject lost its chosen category parameter"
    let some unrelated := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == other)
      | throwError "the category control lost its distinct equal definition"
    for (member, field) in #[
        ("obj", ``CategoryTheory.Comma.left), ("hom", ``CategoryTheory.Comma.hom)] do
      let projected ← kernelSource session s!"{name}.{member}()"
      checkKernelProjection projected original.id field base
      let some category := projected.category
        | throwError "the projection lost its actual complete category"
      checkSelected projected fun _ => do
        let scope ← get
        let some chosen := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == chosen.id)
          | throwError "the actual category parameter is outside the original context"
        let some unrelated := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == unrelated.id)
          | throwError "the distinct category parameter is outside the original context"
        let bundle ← category.bundle.inContext scope.context
        unless (← visitNativeData (fun term =>
            originatesAt scope.context scope.selections term chosen.expression false) bundle false) > 0 &&
            (← visitNativeData (fun term =>
            originatesAt scope.context scope.selections term unrelated.expression false) bundle false) == 0 do
          throwError "the projection replaced its actual selected category parameter"
  expectKernelFailure (discard <| kernelSource session "raw.obj()")
    "no declared member family accepts this complete selected receiver"
  expectKernelFailure (discard <| kernelSource session "raw.hom()")
    "no declared member family accepts this complete selected receiver"
  expectKernelFailure (discard <| kernelSource session "KFirst.obj(0)")
    "a selected subobject projection takes no additional source arguments"

-- The empty-return case is not an inherited-return bypass. A real nonidentity route
-- still requires actual lifting data, and a forged empty route is not first-hit source data.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let state ← semanticState
  let some method := state.methods.find? (·.id.raw == "meth.kernel")
    | throwError "the published kernel method is absent"
  let query ← SourceRoutes.forMethod Modules.Bilinear.Valued.Kernels.ArrowsBilin "kernel"
  let some routes ← query.finiteRoutes
    | throwError "the original formed-arrow route lost its finite selected comparison"
  let some route := routes.find? (fun route =>
      !route.refs.isEmpty && route.target.syntacticEq method.owner)
    | throwError "the formed-arrow control no longer has its declared inherited route"
  expectKernelFailure (do
      let _ ← RoutedMethodFamily.forRoute route method
      pure ())
    "source method lifting requires its actual selected return data"
  expectKernelFailure
    (do
      let _ ← RoutedMethodFamily.forRoute { route with steps := #[] } method
      pure ())
    "the selected method route is not a complete first-hit source route"
  -- Keeping the refs and outer endpoints cannot replace an original intermediate edge.
  let some first := route.steps[0]?
    | throwError "the original inherited route lost its first structural edge"
  unless !(first.source.syntacticEq first.target) do
    throwError "the original inherited-route control lost its distinct first endpoints"
  let changed : StructuralEdge := {
    source := first.source
    target := first.source
    expression := .identity first.source
    ref := first.ref }
  let forged := { route with steps := route.steps.set! 0 changed }
  unless forged.refs == route.refs && forged.source.syntacticEq route.source &&
      forged.target.syntacticEq route.target do
    throwError "the intermediate-edge control changed the route's original outer interface"
  let failure : Option Exception ← withoutModifyingState do
    try
      discard <| RoutedMethodFamily.forRoute forged method
      return none
    catch failure => return some failure
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "the source method accepted a substituted intermediate structural edge"
  unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag (· == `CasCompiler.RoutedMethodFamily.invalidRoute) do
    throw failure

/-- The registered power object whose object at some base is the native type `type`.
Source: Registry.Entry.PowerObjectEntry; `𝒫(X)` is the object family of the row at `X`.
Two power objects with the same native type remain distinct, so several matches are ambiguous. -/
def sourcePowerObject? (type : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option NativePowerObject) := do
  let selected ← SourceReadM.selection? type
  let (native, objects) ← registeredSourceDomain type
  if selected.isSome && objects.isEmpty then return none
  let state ← semanticState
  let mut found := #[]
  for row in state.powerObjects do
    let #[object] := state.objects.filter (·.id == row.object)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered power object {row.id.raw} has no unique original object family"
    let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == object.category)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered power object {row.id.raw} has no complete original category"
    unless objects.isEmpty || objects.any (fun original => reprStr original == reprStr object) do
      continue
    discard <| checkedDeclaration object.declaration
    let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels object.declaration
    let base ← mkFreshExprMVar none
    let applicable ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <| withoutModifyingState do
      let object ← elabAppArgs family #[] #[Arg.expr base] none false false
      isDefEq object native
    unless applicable do continue
    let candidate ← elabAppArgs family #[] #[Arg.expr base] none false false
    discard <| isDefEq candidate native
    let base ← if objects.isEmpty then liftM (m := MetaM) (instantiateMVars base) else do
      let application := native.consumeMData.headBeta
      unless application.getAppFn.isConstOf object.declaration do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the power object lost its original declared application"
      let information ← getFunInfoNArgs application.getAppFn application.getAppNumArgs
      let originals := (application.getAppArgs.zip information.paramInfo).filterMap
        fun (argument, parameter) => if parameter.isExplicit then some argument else none
      let #[original] := originals
        | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the power object changed its original base position"
      unless ← isDefEq base original do
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the power object changed its original native base"
      pure original
    if base.hasMVar || base.hasLevelMVar then
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered power object is not determined by its native type"
    found := found.push ⟨row, object, category, base⟩
  match found with
  | #[] => return none
  | #[selected] => return some selected
  | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "the native type is the object of several registered power objects"

/-- The registered power object at the base `base`: the rows whose object family accepts it. -/
def sourcePowerObjectAt (base : Expr) : SourceReadM NativePowerObject := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let mut found := #[]
  for row in state.powerObjects do
    let #[object] := state.objects.filter (·.id == row.object)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered power object {row.id.raw} has no unique original object family"
    let #[category] := state.categories.filter (·.id == object.category)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered power object {row.id.raw} has no complete original category"
    discard <| checkedDeclaration object.declaration
    let family ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels object.declaration
    let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType family)
    let some parameter := parameters[0]?
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the registered power object {row.id.raw} has no base parameter"
    if ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withoutModifyingState
        (isDefEq (← inferType parameter) (← inferType base)) then
      found := found.push (⟨row, object, category, base⟩ : NativePowerObject)
  match found with
  | #[selected] => return selected
  | #[] => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "no registered power object accepts this base object"
  | _ => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "several registered power objects accept this base object"

/-- Apply a declaration of the power object at its base, then at the remaining arguments. -/
private def atBase (power : NativePowerObject) (declaration : Name) (arguments : Array Expr) :
    SourceReadM Expr := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
  let function ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels declaration
  let actual := #[power.base] ++ arguments
  let references := Array.replicate actual.size (← liftM (m := TermElabM) getRef)
  let (result, _) ← elabSourceApplicationScoped function references none fun index expected => do
    let some value := actual[index]?
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the power-object application lost an original argument"
    let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? value).getD { value }
    SourceReadM.select { selected with value } (some expected)
  return result

/-- The value of a global element `1 ⟶ Y` at the power object's registered point.
Source: PowerObjectEntry.point, the declaration consumers use to extract a value from a global
element. -/
def sourceGlobalValue (power : NativePowerObject) (element : Expr) (expected : Option Expr) :
    SourceReadM Expr := do
  discard <| checkedDeclaration power.row.point
  let point ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels power.row.point
  let function ← sourceSetFunction element
  let value ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr point] none false false
  let selected ← retainSourcePoint element { value, powerObject := some power }
  SourceReadM.select selected expected

/-- The subset `{a₁, …, aₙ} ⊆ X`, through the registered subset-literal form of the power object.
The literal is the Finset of the elements, formed by the quotient map `List.toFinset` that the
literal form's normal form names; its denotation is the registered global element of `𝒫(X)`.
Source: Registry.Entry.SubsetLiteralEntry and lit.sets.finite_subsets. -/
def sourceSubsetLiteral (power : NativePowerObject) (elements : Array Expr) (expected : Expr) :
    SourceReadM Expr := do
  let rows := (← semanticState).subsetLiterals.filter (·.powerObject == power.row.id)
  let #[row] := rows
    | if rows.isEmpty then
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource "the selected power object has no registered subset-literal form"
      else liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwSemanticAmbiguity "the selected power object has several subset-literal forms"
  unless row.type == ``Finset do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwUnsupportedSource m!"the subset-literal form {row.id.raw} has an unread literal type"
  let list ← mkListLit power.base elements.toList
  let equalityType ← mkAppM ``DecidableEq #[power.base]
  let equality ← match ← trySourceInstance equalityType with
    | .some instanceValue => pure instanceValue
    | .none | .undef => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwFailedToSynthesize equalityType
  let literal ← mkAppOptM ``List.toFinset #[some power.base, some equality, some list]
  let element ← atBase power row.denotation #[literal]
  let value ← sourceGlobalValue power element (some expected)
  let some original ← SourceReadM.selection? value
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the subset literal lost its complete original power-object point"
  let selected ← sourceReferenceAt (.subset row) element value
  SourceReadM.select { original with
    value
    reference := selected.reference
    originalApplication := selected.originalApplication }

/-- A subset `A ⊆ X` used as an object is the set of its members, through the registered extent
of its power object. The global element of `𝒫(X)` at the point is the constant map with value
`A`, since the point's source is the terminal object.
Source: PowerObjectEntry.extent; the original reader's rule that a subset names its extent. -/
def sourceExtent? (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) : SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  if judgement.category.isSome then return none
  let selected ← SourceReadM.selection? judgement.value
  let power ← match selected with
    | some selected =>
      match selected.powerObject, selected.pointOrigin with
      | some original, some _ => pure (some original)
      | _, _ => sourcePowerObject? (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType judgement.value))
    | none => sourcePowerObject? (← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType judgement.value))
  let some power := power | return none
  discard <| checkedDeclaration power.row.extent
  let extent ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels power.row.extent
  let element ← mkFreshExprMVar none
  discard <| elabAppArgs extent #[] #[Arg.expr power.base, Arg.expr element] none false false
  let elementType ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType element)
  let constant ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLocalDeclD `point (← mkFreshTypeMVar) fun point => do
    mkLambdaFVars #[point] judgement.value
  let global ← elabAppArgs (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``TypeCat.ofHom) #[]
    #[Arg.expr constant] (some elementType) false false
  let object ← elabAppArgs extent #[] #[Arg.expr power.base, Arg.expr global] none false false
  let judgement ← sourceSetJudgement .object object
  let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? judgement.value).getD { value := judgement.value }
  let value ← SourceReadM.select { selected with
    value := judgement.value
    powerObject := some power }
  return some { judgement with value }

/-- `x ∈ A` for a subset `A` of `X`: the registered membership `X × 𝒫 X → Ω` at the pair. -/
def sourceMembership (power : NativePowerObject) (element container : Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let member ← atBase power power.row.member #[]
  let function ← sourceSetFunction member
  let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[element, container]
  let value ← elabAppArgs function #[] #[Arg.expr pair] none false false
  SourceReadM.select { value, powerObject := some power }

/-- `{t ∈ X | P}`: the subset that the predicate `t ↦ P : X → Ω` classifies, through the
registered transpose. `predicate` is the native function into the truth values. -/
def sourceComprehension (power : NativePowerObject) (predicate : Expr) (expected : Option Expr) :
    SourceReadM Expr := do
  let transpose ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels power.row.transpose
  discard <| checkedDeclaration power.row.transpose
  let classifier ← mkFreshExprMVar none
  discard <| elabAppArgs transpose #[] #[Arg.expr power.base, Arg.expr classifier] none false false
  let classifierType ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType classifier)
  let classifierValue ← elabAppArgs (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``TypeCat.ofHom) #[]
    #[Arg.expr predicate] (some classifierType) false false
  let element ← atBase power power.row.transpose #[classifierValue]
  sourceGlobalValue power element expected

/-- `f(X)` for a map `f : X → Y` applied to its whole domain: the image of `f` in `𝒫(Y)`, through
the registered image of the power object of `Y`. `target` is the power object at `Y`. -/
def sourceImageOf (target : NativePowerObject) (domain arrow : Expr) (expected : Option Expr) :
    SourceReadM Expr := do
  let image ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels target.row.image
  discard <| checkedDeclaration target.row.image
  let element ← elabAppArgs image #[] #[Arg.expr domain, Arg.expr target.base, Arg.expr arrow]
    none false false
  sourceGlobalValue target element expected

/-- `{e | t ∈ X}`: the image of the whole map `t ↦ e : X → Y` in `𝒫(Y)`, through the registered
image of the power object of `Y`. `target` is the power object at `Y`. -/
def sourceImage (target : NativePowerObject) (domain function : Expr) (expected : Option Expr) :
    SourceReadM Expr := do
  let image ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels target.row.image
  discard <| checkedDeclaration target.row.image
  let arrow ← mkFreshExprMVar none
  discard <| elabAppArgs image #[] #[Arg.expr domain, Arg.expr target.base, Arg.expr arrow]
    none false false
  let arrowType ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| instantiateMVars (← inferType arrow)
  let arrowValue ← elabAppArgs (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels ``TypeCat.ofHom) #[]
    #[Arg.expr function] (some arrowType) false false
  sourceImageOf target domain arrowValue expected

end CasCompiler

/- Power-object forms read through the registered power object of `Sets`: the subset-literal
denotation, membership, transpose, image and extent; typing questions settle at reading. -/

private def statements (session : SourceSession) (text : String) :
    TermElabM (Array SourceStatement × SourceSession) := do
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "source-subsets.cas" text
  let mut session := session
  let mut formed := #[]
  for item in file.items do
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
      | throwError "the source statement control changed its parsed category"
    let statement ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
    if let .definition next _ := statement then session := next
    formed := formed.push statement
  return (formed, session)

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let (formed, _) ← statements empty
    "let A := {1, 2, 3} in 𝒫(ℤ)\nlet B := {3, 4} in 2^ℤ\n\
     assert 2 ∈ A\nassert 4 ∉ A\nassert A ∪ B = {1, 2, 3, 4}\nassert A ⊆ A ∪ B\n\
     let S := {n ∈ ℤ | n² ≤ 4}\nlet E := {2n | n ∈ ℕ}\n\
     assert S in 𝒫(ℤ)\nassert -3 ∈ ℤ\nassert |A| = 3\n"
  let literal := ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.FiniteSubsetLiterals.literal
  let powerSets : Name := `CasCatalogue.Foundation.PowerSets
  let expectations : Array (Nat × Array Name) := #[
    (0, #[literal]), (1, #[literal]),
    (2, #[powerSets ++ `member]),
    (3, #[``Not, powerSets ++ `member]),
    (4, #[powerSets ++ `union, literal]),
    (5, #[powerSets ++ `subset, powerSets ++ `union]),
    (6, #[powerSets ++ `transpose, ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.PowerSets.le]),
    (7, #[powerSets ++ `image]),
    (10, #[powerSets ++ `extent])]
  for (index, declarations) in expectations do
    let some statement := formed[index]? | throwError "a subset statement was not formed"
    let term ← match statement with
      | .assumption _ | .proved .. | .inspection _ | .contextBlock _ =>
        throwError "this original source control contains no scoped declaration or explicit proof"
      | .definition _ value | .question value | .implemented value => pure value
      | .settled values =>
        let #[value] := values
          | throwError "an individual subset typing judgement did not retain exactly one term"
        pure value
    checkSelected term fun value => do
      checkOriginal #[value] fun native => do
        let expression ← instantiateMVars native[0]!
        unless declarations.all (fun declaration => expression.containsConst (· == declaration)) do
          throwError "subset statement {index} lost its registered power-object declaration"
  for index in [2, 3, 4, 5, 10] do
    unless formed[index]? matches some (SourceStatement.question _) do
      throwError "subset statement {index} is not a proposition"
  for index in [8, 9] do
    unless formed[index]? matches some (SourceStatement.settled _) do
      throwError "typing statement {index} was not settled by its reading"
  for source in #["let C := {1, 2}", "let D := {x ∈ ℤ | x}"] do
    let rejected ← try
      discard <| statements empty source
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless rejected do throwError "an untyped subset form was admitted: {source}"

import CasCompiler.Read
import CasCompiler.SourceTestSupport

meta import CasCompiler.Read
meta import CasCompiler.SourceTestSupport

meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Foundation.Objects
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Foundation.FiniteObjects
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Modules.CatalogueRegistration

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue

private def nativeTerm (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native source parameter did not parse"
  return ⟨stx⟩

private def definition (file : SourceFile) (index : Nat) :
    TermElabM (Ident × TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let some item := file.items[index]? | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the source definition is absent"
  let `(cas_item| let $name:ident := $value:cas_term) := item
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the source item is not a definition"
  return (name, value)

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let parameters ← empty.assume `n (← nativeTerm "Nat")
  let session ← parameters.assume `h (← nativeTerm "n = n")
  let state ← semanticState
  let some rings := state.categories.find? (·.name == "Rings")
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the scalar source category is absent"
  let ringType ← session.elaborate Syntax.missing fun _ => do
    let info ← checkedDeclaration rings.declaration
    mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α
      #[Lean.mkConst rings.declaration (info.levelParams.map Level.param)]
  let mut session ← session.assumeTerm `R ringType
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "public-source.cas"
    "let X := Fin(n)\nlet X := Fin(3)\nlet Y := X\n\
     let Z := (Fin(n) in FiniteSets)\nlet M := RegularModule(R)\n"
  for index in [:file.items.size] do
    let (name, stx) ← definition file index
    let term ← file.withContext <| session.read stx
    unless term.span.fileName == "public-source.cas" && term.span.start == stx.raw.getPos? do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "public source reading lost its complete scope or actual source span"
    SourceTest.checkSelected term fun expression => do
      let scope ← get
      let original ← ContextTelescope.capture
        (scope.context.bindings.take session.context.entries.size)
      let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
      unless original.telescope.exactlyMatches session.context && bindings.size == 3 + index do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "public source reading lost its complete scope or actual source span"
      if index == 0 then
        unless (← SourceTest.visitNativeData
            (fun value => pure (value.equal bindings[0]!.expression)) expression false) > 0 do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "public source reading discarded an actual native parameter"
      if index == 2 then
        unless ← SourceTest.originatesAt scope.context scope.selections
            expression bindings[4]!.expression false do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "public source reading replayed or rebound a shadowed source definition"
      if index == 3 then
        let some refined := state.objects.find? fun entry =>
            entry.name == "Fin" && entry.refines.isSome
          | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the source refinement is absent"
        let some owner := state.categories.find? (·.id == refined.category)
          | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original refined declaration lost its registered category"
        let selected ← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun value => do
          let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value | return false
          return selected.reference.any
            (·.exactlyMatches (.named (.registered (.inl refined) owner)))) expression
        let applications ← SourceTest.declaredApplications scope.context scope.selections
          refined.declaration expression
        unless selected > 0 && !applications.isEmpty do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "public source qualification lost its exact refined declaration"
      if index == 4 then
        unless (← SourceTest.visitNativeData
            (fun value => pure (value.equal bindings[2]!.expression)) expression false) > 0 do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "public source reading discarded its selected scalar object"
    session ← session.defineTerm name.getId term
  for source in #["Fin(h)", "Fin(unregistered_parameter)", "Fin(n) in Rings", "3"] do
    let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term source
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the source rejection control did not parse"
    let rejected ← try
      discard <| session.read ⟨stx⟩
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless rejected do liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "public source reading accepted an untyped source argument"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let dimensions ← empty.assume `n (← nativeTerm "Nat")
  let elements ← dimensions.assume `i (← nativeTerm "Fin n")
  let functions ← elements.define `f (← nativeTerm "fun (m : Nat) (j : Fin m) => j")
  let session ← functions.define `e (← nativeTerm "Equiv.refl (Fin n)")
  for source in #["f(n, i)", "(f)(n, i)", "e(i)", "(e)(i)"] do
    let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term source
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the callable source control did not parse"
    let term ← session.read ⟨stx⟩
    SourceTest.checkSelected term fun expression => do
      let scope ← get
      let original ← ContextTelescope.capture
        (scope.context.bindings.take session.context.entries.size)
      let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
      unless original.telescope.exactlyMatches session.context && bindings.size == 4 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "public callable application lost its complete source context"
      let function := if source.startsWith "e" || source.startsWith "(e" then
        bindings[3]!.expression else bindings[2]!.expression
      unless (← SourceTest.visitNativeData
          (fun value => pure (value.equal function)) expression false) > 0 &&
          (← SourceTest.visitNativeData
            (fun value => pure (value.equal bindings[1]!.expression)) expression false) > 0 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "public application replaced its actual callable or argument"
  let shadowed ← session.define `Fin (← nativeTerm "fun (m : Nat) => m")
  let .ok qualified := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term "Fin(n) in FiniteSets"
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the qualified source shadowing control did not parse"
  let rejected ← try
    discard <| shadowed.read ⟨qualified⟩
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "source qualification bypassed a retained lexical binding"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let parameters ← empty.assume `n (← nativeTerm "Nat")
  let parameters ← parameters.assume `m (← nativeTerm "Nat")
  let initial ← parameters.assume `h (← nativeTerm "n = n")
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "source-statements.cas"
    "let X := Fin(n)\nlet X := Fin(3)\nlet i : X := rev(3,2)\n\
     assert n = m and m = n\nassert i = i\n"
  let mut session := initial
  for item in file.items do
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := item
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the source statement control changed its parsed category"
    match ← file.withContext (session.readStatement statement) with
    | .definition next value =>
      let before ← SourceTest.authoredEntries session.context session.selections
      let after ← SourceTest.authoredEntries next.context next.selections
      unless next.context.entries.size == value.source.context.entries.size + 1 &&
          after.size == before.size + 1 && value.span.fileName == "source-statements.cas" do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "source statement formation lost its declaration or original location"
      next.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
        let original ← ContextTelescope.capture
          (bindings.take value.source.context.entries.size)
        unless original.telescope.exactlyMatches value.source.context do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "source statement formation changed its complete retained source scope"
      session := next
    | .assumption _ | .proved .. | .inspection _ | .contextBlock _ =>
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "these original source statements contain no scoped declaration or explicit proof"
    | .implemented _ => liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "these source statements contain no implementation request"
    | .settled _ => liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "these source statements contain no typing question"
    | .question proposition =>
      let authored ← SourceTest.authoredEntries session.context session.selections
      unless authored.size == 6 do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a source question changed or shortened its complete preceding scope"
      SourceTest.checkSelected proposition fun expression => do
        let scope ← get
        let original ← ContextTelescope.capture
          (scope.context.bindings.take session.context.entries.size)
        let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
        unless original.telescope.exactlyMatches session.context && bindings.size == 6 do
          liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a source question changed or shortened its complete preceding scope"
        unless ← isProp expression do liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a source question is not a proposition"
        let native ← SourceTest.selectedValue expression
        if native.isAppOfArity ``And 2 then
          for equality in native.getAppArgs, positions in #[(0, 1), (1, 0)] do
            let equality ← SourceTest.selectedValue equality
            unless equality.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 &&
                (← SourceTest.originatesAt scope.context scope.selections
                  equality.getAppArgs[1]! bindings[positions.1]!.expression false) &&
                (← SourceTest.originatesAt scope.context scope.selections
                  equality.getAppArgs[2]! bindings[positions.2]!.expression false) do
              liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "question formation changed the actual formal parameters or conjunction"
          let expected ← mkAppM ``And
            #[← mkEq bindings[0]!.expression bindings[1]!.expression,
              ← mkEq bindings[1]!.expression bindings[0]!.expression]
          SourceTest.checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun values => do
            unless values[0]!.equal values[1]! do
              liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "question formation changed the actual formal parameters or conjunction"
        else
          unless native.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 &&
              (← SourceTest.originatesAt scope.context scope.selections
                native.getAppArgs[1]! bindings[5]!.expression false) &&
              (← SourceTest.originatesAt scope.context scope.selections
                native.getAppArgs[2]! bindings[5]!.expression false) do
            liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "question formation replaced the retained source definition"
          let expected ← mkEq bindings[5]!.expression bindings[5]!.expression
          SourceTest.checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun values => do
            unless values[0]!.equal values[1]! do
              liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "question formation replaced the retained source definition"
  for text in #["assert n", "assert n = X", "let bad : X := rev(4,2)"] do
    let source ← SourceFile.parse "rejected-statement.cas" text
    let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := source.items[0]!
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the rejected statement did not parse"
    let rejected ← try
      discard <| source.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless rejected do liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "source statements accepted an ill-typed definition or question"

  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let points ← empty.assume `i (← nativeTerm "CasCatalogue.Foundation.Objects.fin 3")
  let session ← points.assume `j (← nativeTerm "CasCatalogue.Foundation.Objects.integersMod 3")
  let source ← SourceFile.parse "point-domain-equality.cas" "assert i = j"
  let `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) := source.items[0]!
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the point domain comparison did not parse"
  let rejected ← try
    discard <| source.withContext (session.readStatement statement)
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "source equality identified distinct point domains by their native representations"

namespace CasCompiler.SourceTest

open Lean Meta Elab Term

/-- Run assertions inside the original completed term's complete native/typed scope.
The callback returns no local expression, so test inspection cannot escape its telescope. -/
def checkSelected (term : SourceTerm) (assertions : Expr → SourceReadM Unit) :
    TermElabM Unit := do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  term.source.ensureDeclarations
  term.source.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let expression ← term.source.inContext context
    let selections ← term.selections.inContext context
    (assertions expression).runK { identities, context, selections } fun _ _ => pure ()

/-- Interpret original sources only for mathematical assertions. Exact original operands
are checked separately in the typed scope; this view supplies no compiler selection. -/
def checkOriginal (expressions : Array Expr) (assertions : Array Expr → MetaM Unit) :
    SourceReadM Unit := do
  let scope ← get
  scope.context.withOriginalSources expressions fun expressions => do
    let letIds := (← getLCtx).foldl (fun ids declaration =>
      if declaration.isLet then ids.push declaration.fvarId else ids) #[]
    assertions (← expressions.mapM fun expression => zetaDeltaFVars expression letIds)

/-- Verify a specified original binder through explicit typed aliases or authored native
lets. Equal native values and originalSource checking correspondences are never consulted. -/
partial def originatesAt (context : OpenContext) (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
    (source expected : Expr) (throughAuthoredLets : Bool := true) : MetaM Bool := do
  if source.equal expected then return true
  let beta := source.headBeta
  if !beta.equal source then
    return ← originatesAt context selections beta expected throughAuthoredLets
  if let .letE _ _ value body _ := source then
    return ← originatesAt context selections (body.instantiate1 value) expected throughAuthoredLets
  if !throughAuthoredLets && source.getAppFn.isFVar then
    let some binding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression.equal source.getAppFn)
      | return false
    if binding.role != .selectedStructure then return false
  if let some selected := selections.findAt? context source.getAppFn then
    unless selected.formalBindings.size == source.getAppNumArgs do return false
    let selected ← selected.specialize source.getAppArgs
    if selected.value.equal source then return false
    return ← originatesAt context selections selected.value expected throughAuthoredLets
  if let .fvar localId := source then
    if let some value := (← localId.getDecl).value? then
      return ← originatesAt context selections value expected throughAuthoredLets
  if let .mdata _ body := source then
    return ← originatesAt context selections body expected throughAuthoredLets
  return false

/-- Inspect only explicitly selected applications reachable along a result's native data
and typed value aliases. A matching original record supplies its own complete application;
there is no registry lookup, expression-head search, or selection from an equal carrier. -/
partial def declaredApplications (context : OpenContext) (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
    (declaration : Name) (source : Expr) : MetaM (Array Expr) := do
  if let some selected := selections.findAt? context source.getAppFn then
    if selected.formalBindings.size == source.getAppNumArgs then
      let selected ← selected.specialize source.getAppArgs
      let owns := selected.reference.bind (·.declaration) == some declaration ||
        (selected.application.any fun application => match application.family with
          | .objectAction family => family.declaration == declaration
          | .point family => family.declaration == declaration
          | _ => false)
      if owns then
        let some original := selected.originalApplication
          | throwError "the selected test application lost its original complete native table"
        return #[original]
      if selected.value.equal source then return #[]
      return ← declaredApplications context selections declaration selected.value
  match source with
  | .fvar localId =>
    match (← localId.getDecl).value? with
    | some value => declaredApplications context selections declaration value
    | none => pure #[]
  | .app function argument =>
    return (← declaredApplications context selections declaration function) ++
      (← declaredApplications context selections declaration argument)
  | .letE _ _ value body _ =>
    declaredApplications context selections declaration (body.instantiate1 value)
  | .proj _ _ parent | .mdata _ parent =>
    declaredApplications context selections declaration parent
  | _ => pure #[]

/-- Visit actual native data through explicit typed value aliases. The assertion callback
can inspect an ordinary native constructor without unfolding any registered declaration. -/
partial def visitNativeData (assertion : Expr → SourceReadM Bool) (source : Expr)
    (throughAuthoredLets : Bool := true) :
    SourceReadM Nat := do
  if ← assertion source then return 1
  let followSelection ← if !throughAuthoredLets && source.getAppFn.isFVar then do
    let scope ← get
    let some binding := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.expression.equal source.getAppFn)
      | pure false
    pure (binding.role == .selectedStructure)
  else pure true
  if followSelection then
    if let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? source then
      if selected.value.equal source then return 0
      return ← visitNativeData assertion selected.value throughAuthoredLets
  match source with
  | .fvar localId =>
    if !throughAuthoredLets then pure 0
    else match (← localId.getDecl).value? with
      | some value => visitNativeData assertion value throughAuthoredLets
      | none => pure 0
  | .app function argument =>
    let first ← visitNativeData assertion function throughAuthoredLets
    let second ← visitNativeData assertion argument throughAuthoredLets
    return first + second
  | .letE _ _ value body _ =>
    visitNativeData assertion (body.instantiate1 value) throughAuthoredLets
  | .proj _ _ parent | .mdata _ parent =>
    visitNativeData assertion parent throughAuthoredLets
  | .lam name type body binderInfo | .forallE name type body binderInfo => do
    let inType ← visitNativeData assertion type throughAuthoredLets
    let inBody ← SourceReadM.withBinder name type none binderInfo
      (fun _ count => pure count) fun parameter =>
        visitNativeData assertion (body.instantiate1 parameter) throughAuthoredLets
    return inType + inBody
  | _ => pure 0

/-- The added typed source locals cannot stand in for authored assumptions or definitions. -/
def authoredEntries {term : Type} (context : ContextTelescope) (selections : SourceSelectionScope term) :
    MetaM (Array ContextEntry) := do
  let mut authored := #[]
  for entry in context.entries do
    if entry.role == .selectedStructure then
      unless entry.originalSource.isSome && entry.value.isNone && selections.contains entry.id do
        throwError "a selected test local changed its original source-binding contract"
    else
      unless entry.originalSource.isNone do
        throwError "an authored test local acquired a selected-source checking correspondence"
      authored := authored.push entry
  return authored

/-- Name the original authored positions inside the unchanged complete test scope. -/
def authoredBindings : SourceReadM (Array LocalBinding) := do
  let scope ← get
  let entries ← authoredEntries scope.context.telescope scope.selections
  entries.mapM fun entry => do
    let some binding := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == entry.id)
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "an authored test binding is outside its complete original context"
    return binding

/-- Inspect the native value behind only exact typed selection aliases. This preserves
top-level shape assertions without searching subterms or unfolding authored native lets. -/
partial def selectedValue (source : Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? source | return source
  if selected.value.equal source then return source
  selectedValue selected.value

end CasCompiler.SourceTest

public import CasCompiler.Surface
