namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term

-- As in ReadExpression's native application, infer the complete dependent argument
-- types first, then retain each actual source expression in the final application.
-- Reuse: Lean.Elab.App.elabAppArgs and native constructor declarations.
private def constructTuple (declaration : Name) (expected : Expr)
    (arguments : Array (Expr → ExceptT MessageData SourceReadM Expr)) :
    ExceptT MessageData SourceReadM Expr := do
  let result ← liftM <| elabSourceApplicationApplicableScoped
    (← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels declaration)
    (Array.replicate arguments.size Syntax.missing) (some expected)
    (fun index type => (arguments[index]! type).run)
  match result with
  | .ok (value, _) =>
    liftM <| retainSourceConstructor (← mkExpectedTypeHint value expected)
  | .error message => throwThe MessageData message

-- Nondependent finite data use Mathlib's native vector notation constructors.
-- Dependent or Sort-polymorphic families retain Fin.cases/Fin.elim0. Every component
-- receives its actual declared type before its original source is read.
private partial def finiteTuple (components : Array (Expr → ExceptT MessageData SourceReadM Expr))
    (expected : Expr) : ExceptT MessageData SourceReadM Expr := do
  let .forallE name domain codomain info ← whnf expected
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source finite tuple requires its declared indexed domain"
  let index ← whnf domain
  unless index.isAppOfArity ``Fin 1 do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source finite tuple requires its declared finite index"
  unless ← isDefEq index.getAppArgs[0]! (mkNatLit components.size) do
    throwThe MessageData m!"the source tuple has a different declared finite arity"
  let homogeneous ← if codomain.hasLooseBVars then pure false
    else pure ((← getLevel codomain).dec.isSome)
  if components.isEmpty then
    if homogeneous then return ← constructTuple ``Matrix.vecEmpty expected #[]
    return ← liftM <| SourceReadM.withLambda name domain info fun argument =>
      mkAppOptM ``Fin.elim0 #[some (codomain.instantiate1 argument), some argument]
  let some first := components[0]?
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a nonempty source finite tuple requires its first component"
  let constructor := if homogeneous then ``Matrix.vecCons else ``Fin.cases
  constructTuple constructor expected #[first,
    fun type => finiteTuple (components.drop 1) type]

/-- Construct finite rows at the complete supplied native matrix domain.
Reuse: the same native finite tuple constructors as sourceTuple. Row and column arities
come from the actual function type; original cells are read once in order. -/
def sourceMatrix (rows : Array (Array (TSyntax `cas_term))) (expected : Expr)
    (readComponent : TSyntax `cas_term → Expr → SourceReadM Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  if let some first := rows[0]? then
    unless rows.all (·.size == first.size) do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source matrix rows have different finite arities"
  let result ← (finiteTuple (rows.map fun row type =>
    finiteTuple (row.map fun component type => liftM (readComponent component type)) type) expected).run
  match result with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

/-- Construct a tuple at its actual declared native domain.
Reuse: Prod/Sigma/PSigma, native Matrix.vecCons/vecEmpty for homogeneous finite data,
and Fin.cases/Fin.elim0 for dependent families. Original components are read once at their
actual dependent types; the complete declared domain is never replaced. -/
private partial def sourceTupleCore (components : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) (expected : Expr)
    (readComponent : TSyntax `cas_term → Expr → ExceptT MessageData SourceReadM Expr) :
    ExceptT MessageData SourceReadM Expr := do
  let type ← whnf expected
  if let .forallE _ domain _ _ := type then
    let index ← whnf domain
    if index.isAppOfArity ``Fin 1 then
      return ← finiteTuple (components.map fun component type =>
        readComponent component type) expected
  let constructor ←
    if type.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 then pure ``Prod.mk
    else if type.isAppOfArity ``Sigma 2 then pure ``Sigma.mk
    else if type.isAppOfArity ``PSigma 2 then pure ``PSigma.mk
    else
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| CasCatalogue.throwUnsupportedSource
        "source tuple construction is not implemented for this declared domain"
  unless components.size >= 2 do
    throwThe MessageData m!"a source pair requires both native components"
  let some first := components[0]?
    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "a source pair requires its first component"
  let tail := components.drop 1
  constructTuple constructor expected #[
    fun type => readComponent first type,
    fun type => do
      if let #[last] := tail then readComponent last type
      else sourceTupleCore tail type readComponent]

/-- The existing tuple construction with explicit component applicability. Only a component's
own result or a false native component/arity comparison returns an error. Exceptions from
its reader, declaration inference or the selected constructor remain native exceptions. -/
def sourceTupleApplicable (components : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) (expected : Expr)
    (readComponent : TSyntax `cas_term → Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr)) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) :=
  (sourceTupleCore components expected fun component type =>
    ExceptT.mk (readComponent component type)).run

/-- Required tuple reading retains the original public callback and diagnostics. -/
def sourceTuple (components : Array (TSyntax `cas_term)) (expected : Expr)
    (readComponent : TSyntax `cas_term → Expr → SourceReadM Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let result ← sourceTupleApplicable components expected fun component type => do
    return .ok (← readComponent component type)
  match result with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

end CasCompiler

private def nativeTerm (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the source tuple did not parse"
  return ⟨stx⟩

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `A (← nativeTerm "Type")
  let session ← session.assume `B (← nativeTerm "Type")
  let session ← session.assume `a (← nativeTerm "A")
  let session ← session.assume `b (← nativeTerm "B")
  let type ← session.term (← nativeTerm "A × B")
  let term ← session.read (← sourceTerm "(a, b)") (some type.source) type.selections
  let expected ← session.term (← nativeTerm "(a, b)")
  discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let expression ← session.readTerm term
    let expected ← session.readTerm expected
    let scope ← get
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    for binding in bindings.extract 2 4 do
      unless (← visitNativeData (fun term =>
          originatesAt scope.context scope.selections term binding.expression false)
          expression false) > 0 do
        throwError "a source pair replaced its original component bindings"
    checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun native => do
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        throwError "a source pair changed its actual native constructor arguments"
    return expression
  let session ← session.defineTerm `pair term
  let session ← session.assume `a (← nativeTerm "B")
  let retained ← session.read (← sourceTerm "pair")
  checkSelected retained fun expression => do
    let scope ← get
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    unless ← originatesAt scope.context scope.selections expression bindings[4]!.expression false do
      throwError "a source pair was rebuilt after a component name was shadowed"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `n (← nativeTerm "Nat")
  let session ← session.assume `i (← nativeTerm "Fin n")
  for pair in #["Sigma", "PSigma"] do
    let type ← session.term (← nativeTerm s!"{pair} (fun n : Nat => Fin n)")
    let expected ← session.term (← nativeTerm s!"{pair}.mk n i")
    let term ← session.read (← sourceTerm "(n, i)") (some type.source) type.selections
    discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      let expression ← session.readTerm term
      let expected ← session.readTerm expected
      checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "a source dependent pair changed its constructor or dependent component"
      return expression

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `X (← nativeTerm "Fin 2 → Type")
  let session ← session.assume `a (← nativeTerm "X 0")
  let session ← session.assume `b (← nativeTerm "X 1")
  let type ← session.term (← nativeTerm "(i : Fin 2) → X i")
  let term ← session.read (← sourceTerm "(a, b)") (some type.source) type.selections
  unless (← authoredEntries term.source.context term.selections).map (·.id) ==
      (← authoredEntries session.context session.selections).map (·.id) do
    throwError "a finite tuple shortened its complete dependent context"
  checkSelected term fun expression => do
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    checkOriginal #[expression, bindings[1]!.expression, bindings[2]!.expression] fun native => do
      let expression := native[0]!
      let indices ← sourceFiniteIndices (mkNatLit 2) 2
      for index in indices, binding in native.extract 1 3 do
        unless ← isDefEq (mkApp expression index) binding do
          throwError "a finite dependent tuple changed its actual indexed component"
        unless expression.containsFVar binding.fvarId! do
          throwError "a finite dependent tuple discarded an original component binding"
  let rejected ← try
    discard <| session.read (← sourceTerm "(a, b, a)") (some type.source) type.selections
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do
    throwError "a finite tuple accepted a different declared native arity"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `X (← nativeTerm "Type")
  let session ← session.assume `a (← nativeTerm "X")
  let session ← session.assume `b (← nativeTerm "X")
  let type ← session.read (← sourceTerm "Vec(X, 3)")
  let term ← session.read (← sourceTerm "(b, a, b)") (some type.source) type.selections
  let expected ← session.term (← nativeTerm "![b, a, b]")
  discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let expression ← session.readTerm term
    let expected ← session.readTerm expected
    checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun native => do
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        throwError "a source vector tuple changed its original ordered components"
    return expression

-- A matrix literal is checked at the actual declared finite row and column domains.
-- Its native data are ordered finite functions; this control supplies arbitrary cells.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← empty.assume `R (← nativeTerm "CommRingCat.{0}")
  let rings ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "CommutativeRings" [.zero] #[]
  let ring ← session.term (← nativeTerm "R")
  let ring ← ring.inCategory rings.expression rings.value
  let session ← session.defineTerm `S ring
  let session ← session.assume `a (← nativeTerm "(S : Type)")
  let session ← session.assume `b (← nativeTerm "(S : Type)")
  for (source, native) in #[
      ("Mat₂(S)", "CasCatalogue.Algebra.LinearAlgebra.matrices 2 S"),
      ("Mat₂(S) in Rings", "CasCatalogue.Algebra.LinearAlgebra.matrixRing 2 S")] do
    let value ← session.read (← sourceTerm source)
    let expected ← session.term (← nativeTerm native)
    discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      let expression ← session.readTerm value
      let expected ← session.readTerm expected
      let scope ← get
      let bindings ← authoredBindings
      unless (← visitNativeData (fun term =>
          originatesAt scope.context scope.selections term bindings[1]!.expression false)
          expression false) > 0 do
        throwError "a subscripted family discarded its actual coefficient binding"
      checkOriginal #[expression, expected] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "a subscripted family changed its selected declaration or coefficient object"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
          (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
      return expression
  for (domain, source, native) in #[
      ("RectangularMatrices(1, 2, S)", "[a, b]", "![![a, b]]"),
      ("RectangularMatrices(2, 2, S)", "[a, b; b, a]", "![![a, b], ![b, a]]"),
      ("RectangularMatrices(3, 2, S)", "[a, b; b, a; a, a]",
        "![![a, b], ![b, a], ![a, a]]"),
      ("Mat₂(S)", "[a, b; b, a]", "![![a, b], ![b, a]]")] do
    let type ← session.read (← sourceTerm domain)
    let value ← session.read (← sourceTerm source) (some type.source) type.selections
    let expected ← session.term (← nativeTerm native)
    discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
      let expression ← session.readTerm value
      let expected ← session.readTerm expected
      let scope ← get
      let bindings ← authoredBindings
      unless (← visitNativeData (fun term =>
          originatesAt scope.context scope.selections term bindings[1]!.expression false)
          (← inferType expression) false) > 0 do
        throwError "a source matrix discarded its selected coefficient object"
      checkOriginal #[expression, expected, bindings[2]!.expression, bindings[3]!.expression] fun native => do
        unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
          throwError "a source finite matrix changed its declared dimensions or ordered cells"
        unless native[0]!.containsFVar native[2]!.fvarId! &&
            native[0]!.containsFVar native[3]!.fvarId! do
          throwError "a source matrix discarded its original cell bindings"
        checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
          (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
      return expression
  let type ← session.read (← sourceTerm "RectangularMatrices(2, 2, S)")
  for source in #["[a, b]", "[a; b]", "[a, b; b]"] do
    let rejected ← withoutModifyingState do
      try
        discard <| session.read (← sourceTerm source) (some type.source) type.selections
        pure false
      catch error =>
        let detail ← error.toMessageData.toString
        unless (detail.splitOn "finite arit").length > 1 do throw error
        pure true
    unless rejected do throwError "a finite matrix accepted a different declared shape"
  let session ← session.assume `ambientZero (← nativeTerm "OfNat (S : Type) 0") .instImplicit
  let session ← session.assume `ambientOne (← nativeTerm "OfNat (S : Type) 1") .instImplicit
  let type ← session.read (← sourceTerm "RectangularMatrices(1, 2, S)")
  let value ← session.read (← sourceTerm "[1, 0]") (some type.source) type.selections
  let expected ← session.term (← nativeTerm
    "![![TypeCat.Fun.toFun (TypeCat.Hom.hom (CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.ringNumeral (CasCatalogue.Algebra.Algebras.commutativeRingsRings.toFunctor.obj S) 1)) default, TypeCat.Fun.toFun (TypeCat.Hom.hom (CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.ringNumeral (CasCatalogue.Algebra.Algebras.commutativeRingsRings.toFunctor.obj S) 0)) default]]")
  discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let expression ← session.readTerm value
    let expected ← session.readTerm expected
    let bindings ← authoredBindings
    checkOriginal #[expression, expected, bindings[4]!.expression, bindings[5]!.expression] fun native => do
      unless (← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]!) &&
          !native[0]!.containsFVar native[2]!.fvarId! &&
          !native[0]!.containsFVar native[3]!.fvarId! do
        throwError "matrix cells changed their selected coefficient or declared point maps"
      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint (← mkEqRefl native[0]!)
        (← mkEq native[0]! native[1]!))
    return expression

-- Native source syntax is data. Derive its codec from the independently owned types.
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for CategoryId, ClassifierId, CategoryFamilyId
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for ParameterId, ParameterOperationId, FunctorId, ConstructorId
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for ParameterExpr
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for EdgeRef

-- Reference: Lean.Elab.Deriving.FromToJson at Lean 4.33.0, tagged constructor encoding.
-- Its generator uses auxFunNames[0] for every mutual member; traverse the actual source
-- category/argument pair explicitly while keeping the same native data constructors.
mutual
partial def categoryJson : CategoryExpr → Json
  | .atom id => Json.mkObj [("atom", toJson id)]
  | .construct id args => Json.mkObj [("construct", toJson (id, args.map argumentJson))]
  | .familyApp id args => Json.mkObj [("familyApp", toJson (id, args))]
  | .familyTotal id => Json.mkObj [("familyTotal", toJson id)]
  | .classifierTotal id => Json.mkObj [("classifierTotal", toJson id)]
  | .refine base id => Json.mkObj [("refine", toJson (categoryJson base, id))]
  | .opaque id => Json.mkObj [("opaque", toJson id)]

partial def argumentJson : ConstructorArg → Json
  | .category category => Json.mkObj [("category", categoryJson category)]
  | .object id => Json.mkObj [("object", toJson id)]
  | .functor id => Json.mkObj [("functor", toJson id)]
end

mutual
partial def categoryFromJson (document : Json) : Except String CategoryExpr := do
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "atom" then return .atom (← fromJson? value)
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "construct" then
    let (id, args) ← (fromJson? value : Except String (ConstructorId × Array Json))
    return .construct id (← args.mapM argumentFromJson)
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "familyApp" then
    let (id, args) ← (fromJson? value : Except String (CategoryFamilyId × Array ParameterExpr))
    return .familyApp id args
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "familyTotal" then
    return .familyTotal (← fromJson? value)
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "classifierTotal" then
    return .classifierTotal (← fromJson? value)
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "refine" then
    let (base, id) ← (fromJson? value : Except String (Json × ClassifierId))
    return .refine (← categoryFromJson base) id
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "opaque" then return .opaque (← fromJson? value)
  .error "invalid source category constructor"

partial def argumentFromJson (document : Json) : Except String ConstructorArg := do
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "category" then
    return .category (← categoryFromJson value)
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "object" then return .object (← fromJson? value)
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "functor" then return .functor (← fromJson? value)
  .error "invalid source constructor argument"
end

instance : ToJson CategoryExpr := ⟨categoryJson⟩
instance : FromJson CategoryExpr := ⟨categoryFromJson⟩

private def checkSourceConstruction (category : NativeSourceCategory) (object : Expr) :
    SourceReadM Unit := do
  let original ← SourceReadM.selection? object
  let construction := original.bind fun selected => selected.limit.map (·.source)
  let categorized := original.bind fun selected => selected.category.bind (·.limit)
  let same := fun (left right : Option NativeSourceLimitSelection) =>
    SourceSelection.exactlyMatches Expr.equal
      ({ value := object, category := some { category with limit := left } } : SourceSelection Expr)
      ({ value := object, category := some { category with limit := right } } : SourceSelection Expr)
  if construction.isSome && categorized.isSome && !same construction categorized then
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError (MessageData.tagged
      `CasCompiler.sourceOwner.constructionMismatch
      m!"a source owner changed its original selected construction")
  unless same category.limit (construction <|> categorized) do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError (MessageData.tagged
      `CasCompiler.sourceOwner.constructionMismatch
      m!"a source owner changed its original selected construction")

/-- Retain an authored native structure constructor and every original field occurrence.
Only the supplied constructor syntax gives its positions; no native definition is unfolded. -/
opaque retainSourceConstructor (value : Expr) : SourceReadM Expr := do
  let native := value.consumeMData
  let .const declaration _ := native.getAppFn | return value
  let environment ← liftM (m := CoreM) getEnv
  let some (.ctorInfo constructor) := environment.find? declaration | return value
  unless (getStructureInfo? environment constructor.induct).isSome do return value
  unless native.getAppNumArgs == constructor.numParams + constructor.numFields do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the native source constructor lost an original field position"
  check value
  let selection ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| mkFreshUserName `sourceNativeRecord
  SourceReadM.select { value, recordSelection := some selection }

/-- A projection transports only its own authored constructor field's complete selection.
The exact owner binding, declared projection, and original field ordinal are authoritative. -/
opaque retainSourceProjection? (value : Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceJudgement) := do
  let some projection ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? value | return none
  let some owner ← SourceReadM.selection? projection.parent | return none
  let some selection := owner.recordSelection | return none
  if owner.application.isSome then return none
  let constructor ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| getConstInfoCtor projection.info.ctorName
  let native := owner.value.consumeMData
  unless native.getAppFn.constName? == some constructor.name &&
      native.getAppNumArgs == constructor.numParams + constructor.numFields &&
      projection.info.i < constructor.numFields do return none
  let component := native.getAppArgs[constructor.numParams + projection.info.i]!
  let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? component | return none
  let field ← selectedFieldAt selection projection.declaration projection.parent value
  let result ← SourceReadM.select { selected with value, field := field.field }
  return some ⟨result, selected.category⟩

/-- Retain the actual complete selected object and its carrier in typed source data. -/
opaque annotateSourceType (category : NativeSourceCategory) (object type : Expr) :
    SourceReadM Expr := do
  unless category.role == .object do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source provenance requires an object"
  checkSourceConstruction category object
  SourceReadM.select { value := type, typeOrigin := some ⟨category, object, type⟩ }

/-- A native object parameter keeps the same complete selected record at its exact binder. -/
opaque annotateSourceObject (category : NativeSourceCategory) (object : Expr) :
    SourceReadM Expr := do
  unless category.role == .object do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "source provenance requires an object"
  checkSourceConstruction category object
  let selected := (← SourceReadM.selection? object).getD { value := object }
  SourceReadM.select { selected with value := object, category := some category }

/-- Only the exact selected binder supplies an object owner; native aliases and equal
carriers cannot recover a missing selection. Authored aliases copy their record on entry. -/
opaque sourceObjectOrigin? (value : Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Option (NativeSourceCategory × Expr)) := do
  let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value | return none
  let some category := selected.category | return none
  if category.role == .object then return some (category, value)
  return none

/-- Read the complete type owner stored by the source producer at this exact binding. -/
opaque sourceTypeOrigin? (type : Expr) : SourceReadM (Option NativeSourceTypeOrigin) := do
  return (← SourceReadM.selection? type).bind (·.typeOrigin)

/-- Native instance search retains its original selected local dictionaries. Source readers
supply any typed original-source correspondence explicitly at their scoped application boundary;
the native lookup performs no selection recovery from expression annotations or carrier types. -/
opaque trySourceInstance (type : Expr) : MetaM (LOption Expr) := do
  let type ← instantiateMVars type
  let result ← trySynthInstance type
  let result ← match result with
    | .none => do
      let arguments ← type.getAppArgs.mapM fun argument =>
        withTransparency .all <| Meta.reduce argument (explicitOnly := false)
          (skipTypes := false) (skipProofs := true)
      trySynthInstance (mkAppN type.getAppFn arguments)
    | result => pure result
  if let .some instanceValue := result then
    unless ← withTransparency .all <| isDefEq (← inferType instanceValue) type do
      throwError "the native instance has a different complete source goal"
  return result

/-- Isolate the synthetic goals created by an applicability read and solve them only when
that read returned actual data. Reuse Lean 4.33's `withSynthesizeImp` queue isolation and
`finally` restoration. A returned native mismatch has no data to synthesize; exceptions
from the reader or from synthesis propagate unchanged. -/
def withSynthesizeApplicable {α : Type} (read : TermElabM (Except MessageData α)) :
    TermElabM (Except MessageData α) := do
  let pendingMVarsSaved := (← get).pendingMVars
  modify fun state => { state with pendingMVars := [] }
  try
    let result : Except MessageData α ← read
    match result with
    | .error message => return .error message
    | .ok value =>
      synthesizeSyntheticMVars (postpone := .no)
      return .ok value
  finally
    modify fun state => { state with pendingMVars := state.pendingMVars ++ pendingMVarsSaved }

/-- Synthesize only the scoped operand's pending goals before its continuation runs.
The caller's queue is restored at that boundary; later continuation failures are not
reclassified as operand failures or used to discard later pending goals. -/
def withSynthesizeApplicableScoped {α : Type}
    (read : StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Except MessageData α)) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Except MessageData α) :=
  fun _ scope finish => do
    let pendingMVarsSaved := (← get).pendingMVars
    modify fun state => { state with pendingMVars := [] }
    let completed ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef false
    let restorePending := do
      modify fun state =>
        { state with pendingMVars := state.pendingMVars ++ pendingMVarsSaved }
    try
      read.runK scope fun result scope => do
        if result matches .ok _ then
          synthesizeSyntheticMVars (postpone := .no)
        restorePending
        completed.set true
        finish result scope
    catch error =>
      unless ← completed.get do restorePending
      throw error

/-- Extend only this application's unassigned native holes into the operand continuation.
Every original declaration and selected instance remains an exact prefix. Callback locals
are fully typed before they become legal dependencies of these producer-owned goals. -/
opaque extendSourceApplicationScope (owned : Array MVarId) : TermElabM Unit := do
  let current ← getLCtx
  let currentDeclarations := current.foldl (fun result declaration => result.push declaration) #[]
  let currentInstances ← getLocalInstances
  for slot in owned do
    if ← slot.isAssignedOrDelayedAssigned then continue
    let declaration ← slot.getDecl
    let original := declaration.lctx.foldl (fun result native => result.push native) #[]
    unless original.size ≤ currentDeclarations.size do
      throwError "the native application lost an original metavariable scope"
    for previous in original, actual in currentDeclarations.extract 0 original.size do
      unless previous.fvarId == actual.fvarId && previous.index == actual.index &&
          previous.userName == actual.userName && previous.binderInfo == actual.binderInfo &&
          previous.kind == actual.kind && previous.isNondep == actual.isNondep &&
          previous.type.equal actual.type && previous.value? true == actual.value? true do
        throwError "the native application changed an original metavariable declaration"
    unless declaration.localInstances.size ≤ currentInstances.size do
      throwError "the native application lost an original selected local instance"
    for previous in declaration.localInstances,
        actual in currentInstances.extract 0 declaration.localInstances.size do
      unless previous.className == actual.className && previous.fvar == actual.fvar do
        throwError "the native application changed its selected local instance order"
    if original.size == currentDeclarations.size then continue
    for native in currentDeclarations.extract original.size currentDeclarations.size do
      let type ← instantiateMVars native.type
      if type.hasMVar || type.hasLevelMVar then
        throwError "a scoped source operand has an unresolved native declaration type"
      check type
      discard <| getLevel type
      if let some value := native.value? true then
        check value
        unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) type do
          throwError "a scoped source operand changed an authored native definition"
    slot.modifyDecl fun declaration =>
      { declaration with lctx := current, localInstances := currentInstances }

/-- Elaborate one application in the complete scopes supplied by its original operands.
Only holes and goals allocated by this producer may acquire those later native locals.
A failed reader unwinds its continuation and restores elaboration state before returning
the mismatch. Exceptions propagate unchanged. The result uses every original argument. -/
private opaque nativeSourceApplicationApplicable (function : Expr) (references : Array Syntax)
    (expected : Option Expr)
    (readArgument : Nat → Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Except MessageData Expr))
    (allArguments : Bool := false) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Except MessageData (Expr × Array Expr)) :=
  fun δ initial finish => do
    let saved ← Term.saveState
    try
      let previous ← getMCtx
      let holes ← references.mapM fun _ => mkFreshExprMVar none
      let prepared ← elabAppArgs function #[] (holes.map Arg.expr) expected allArguments false
      let owned := (← getMCtx).decls.foldl (fun result identity _ =>
        if previous.decls.contains identity then result else result.push identity) #[]
      for hole in holes do
        unless (prepared.find? (· == hole)).isSome do
          throwError "the native application lost an original explicit argument"
      let instanceSlots ← (← getMVars prepared).filterM fun slot => do
        let some declaration ← getSyntheticMVarDecl? slot | return false
        return declaration.kind matches .typeClass _
      let complete (actual : Array Expr) (state : σ) : TermElabM (Except MessageData δ) := do
        for slot in instanceSlots do
          let solved ← slot.withContext do
            let type ← instantiateMVars (← slot.getType)
            match ← trySourceInstance type with
            | .some instanceValue =>
              if ← slot.isAssigned then
                let previous ← instantiateMVars (mkMVar slot)
                unless ← isDefEq previous instanceValue do
                  if (← containsPendingMVar previous <||> containsPendingMVar instanceValue) then
                    return false
                  throwError "the native application changed its original instance slot"
              else
                unless ← isDefEq (mkMVar slot) instanceValue do
                  throwError "the native application could not retain its original instance slot"
              return true
            | .undef => return false
            | .none => do
              discard <| throwFailedToSynthesize type
              return false
          if solved then
            modify fun state => { state with syntheticMVars := state.syntheticMVars.erase slot }
        let result := prepared.replace fun expression =>
          (holes.findIdx? (· == expression)).bind fun index => actual[index]?
        check result
        let checked ← instantiateMVars result
        unless checked.hasMVar || checked.hasLevelMVar do checkWithKernel checked
        return .ok (← finish (.ok (result, actual)) state)
      let rec visit (remaining : List Syntax) (actual : Array Expr) (state : σ) :
          TermElabM (Except MessageData δ) := do
        let reference :: rest := remaining | return ← complete actual state
        let index := actual.size
        let hole := holes[index]!
        withRef reference do
          let type ← instantiateMVars (← inferType hole)
          (readArgument index type).runK state fun value state => do
            let value ← match value with
              | .ok value => pure value
              | .error message => return .error message
            extendSourceApplicationScope owned
            unless ← isDefEq (← inferType value) type do
              return .error m!"the source argument does not match its dependent native type"
            unless ← isDefEq hole value do
              return .error m!"the source argument does not match its dependent native type"
            visit rest (actual.push value) state
      match ← visit references.toList #[] initial with
      | .ok result => return result
      | .error message =>
        saved.restore (restoreInfo := true)
        finish (.error message) initial
    catch error =>
      saved.restore (restoreInfo := true)
      throw error

/-- Ordinary syntax uses the shared native application producer with Lean's implicit
argument convention. Complete published interfaces use the same producer with every
computational native position exposed, preserving the same original argument holes. -/
opaque elabSourceApplicationApplicableScoped (function : Expr) (references : Array Syntax)
    (expected : Option Expr)
    (readArgument : Nat → Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Except MessageData Expr))
    (allArguments : Bool := false) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Except MessageData (Expr × Array Expr)) :=
  nativeSourceApplicationApplicable function references expected readArgument allArguments

/-- Ordinary readers use the same original holes without a scoped runtime state. -/
opaque elabSourceApplicationApplicable (function : Expr) (references : Array Syntax)
    (expected : Option Expr)
    (readArgument : Nat → Expr → TermElabM (Except MessageData Expr)) :
    TermElabM (Except MessageData (Expr × Array Expr)) :=
  (elabSourceApplicationApplicableScoped function references expected
    (fun index type => liftM (readArgument index type))).run' ()

/-- Required applications keep operand continuations through the full native check. -/
opaque elabSourceApplicationScoped (function : Expr) (references : Array Syntax)
    (expected : Option Expr) (readArgument : Nat → Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM (Expr × Array Expr) := do
  let applied ← elabSourceApplicationApplicableScoped function references expected
    fun index type => do return .ok (← readArgument index type)
  match applied with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message

/-- Ordinary native application requires every explicit applicability check to succeed.
Only the application's own argument-reader result or native type comparison can
return a mismatch. Exceptions from readers, inference and chosen instance slots propagate. -/
opaque elabSourceApplication (function : Expr) (references : Array Syntax)
    (expected : Option Expr) (readArgument : Nat → Expr → TermElabM Expr) :
    TermElabM (Expr × Array Expr) := do
  let applied ← elabSourceApplicationApplicable function references expected
    fun index type => do return .ok (← readArgument index type)
  match applied with
  | .ok value => pure value
  | .error message => throwError message

/-- A formal premise of a published application can use only a proof already in the
original native context. This boundary never asks a provider for a proof and never runs
an unregistered proof search. A missing premise is missing implementation of that call,
not malformed computational data. -/
private def sourceContextProof (domain : Expr) : TermElabM Expr := do
  let domain ← instantiateMVars domain
  if domain.hasMVar || domain.hasLevelMVar then
    throwStratum .noImplementation m!"the published premise has undetermined original source parameters {domain}"
  for declaration in ← getLCtx do
    unless ← isProp declaration.type do continue
    if ← isDefEq declaration.type domain then
      let value := mkFVar declaration.fvarId
      checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint value domain)
      return value
  throwStratum .noImplementation m!"the published application requires its original formal premise {domain}"

/-- Apply the explicit data parameters of a complete named family. Native implicit
slots are solved by the ordinary source elaborator; explicit proof slots have no external
data position and use only an original source hypothesis. The same argument-hole producer
retains every actual expression rather than returning metavariable assignments as sources. -/
opaque applySourceDataArgumentsScoped (function : Expr) (count : Nat) (expected : Option Expr)
    (readArgument : Nat → Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := do
  let (_, binders, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType function)
  let references := Array.replicate (binders.filter (·.isExplicit)).size Syntax.missing
  let next ← IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
  let applied ← nativeSourceApplicationApplicable function references expected fun _ domain => do
    if ← isProp domain then return .ok (← sourceContextProof domain)
    let index ← liftM (m := IO) next.get
    unless index < count do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
        throwStratum .malformed "the named source input is missing an explicit data parameter"
    let actual ← readArgument index domain
    liftM (m := IO) <| next.set (index + 1)
    return .ok actual
  let (value, _) ← match applied with
    | .ok value => pure value
    | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError message
  let supplied ← liftM (m := IO) next.get
  unless supplied == count do
    liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
      throwStratum .malformed "the named source input has extra data parameters"
  return value

/-- Apply complete computational positions of an already selected source function.
This is the same native application producer as ordinary syntax. The caller supplies
one reader per wire position; proof positions are supplied by the original source scope
and have no wire slot. Every retained operand is substituted at its exact original hole.
Native implicit positions are explicit in this complete-interface entrance. -/
opaque applySourceArgumentsScoped (function : Expr) (references : Array Syntax)
    (readArgument : Nat → Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr) :
    StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr := do
  let applyAt := fun (term : Expr) (reference : Syntax)
      (read : Expr → StateCpsT σ TermElabM Expr) => do
    let applied ← nativeSourceApplicationApplicable term #[reference] none
      (fun _ domain => do return .ok (← read domain)) true
    match applied with
    | .ok (result, _) => pure result
    | .error message => liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwStratum .malformed message
  let applyOne := fun (term value : Expr) =>
    applyAt term Syntax.missing (fun _ => pure value)
  let insertPremises := fun initial => do
    let mut term := initial
    repeat
      let type ← whnfR (← inferType term)
      let .forallE _ domain _ _ := type | break
      unless ← isProp domain do break
      term ← applyOne term (← sourceContextProof domain)
    return term
  let mut term := function
  for reference in references, index in [:references.size] do
    term ← insertPremises term
    term ← applyAt term reference (fun domain => readArgument index domain)
  insertPremises term

/-- Ordinary callers use the same scoped producer without adding a runtime state. -/
opaque applySourceDataArguments (function : Expr) (count : Nat) (expected : Option Expr)
    (readArgument : Nat → Expr → TermElabM Expr) : TermElabM Expr :=
  (applySourceDataArgumentsScoped function count expected
    (fun index type => liftM (readArgument index type))).run' ()

/-- Complete ordinary applications retain the shared positional producer. -/
opaque applySourceArguments (function : Expr) (references : Array Syntax)
    (readArgument : Nat → Expr → TermElabM Expr) : TermElabM Expr :=
  (applySourceArgumentsScoped function references
    (fun index type => liftM (readArgument index type))).run' ()

end

private def readSource (session : SourceSession) (text : String) : TermElabM SourceTerm := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the explicit source view did not parse"
  session.read ⟨stx⟩

private def nativeSource (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the native view parameter did not parse"
  return ⟨stx⟩

private def reference (term : SourceTerm) (expected : SelectedSourceReference) :
    TermElabM Unit :=
  SourceTest.checkSelected term fun value => do
    let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? value
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the source view lost its selected reference"
    let references := selected.reference.toArray ++ selected.observation.toArray ++
      (selected.application.toArray.flatMap fun application => match application.family with
        | .objectAction family => family.references
        | .point family => family.references
        | _ => #[])
    unless references.any (fun actual =>
        SourceSelection.exactlyMatches Expr.equal

        return selected.admission.any (·.entry.id.raw == admission)) expression

/- A supplied whole map is a generalized point at its original source. The selected later
map composes with that actual arrow, while a map-valued native parameter remains a value. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let domains ← empty.assume `A (← nativeSource "Type")
  let domains ← domains.assume `B (← nativeSource "Type")
  let domains ← domains.assume `C (← nativeSource "Type")
  let functions ← domains.assume `rawF (← nativeSource "A → B")
  let functions ← functions.assume `rawG (← nativeSource "B → C")
  -- Public lambda formation supplies each selected Sets morphism; native assumptions
  -- alone intentionally carry no source category in SourceSession.assume.
  let first ← readSource functions "(x ↦ rawF(x)) in (A → B)"
  let arrows ← functions.defineTerm `f first
  let second ← readSource arrows "(x ↦ rawG(x)) in (B → C)"
  let arrows ← arrows.defineTerm `g second
  let supplied ← readSource arrows "f"
  let arrows ← arrows.defineTerm `fAgain supplied
  for text in #["f", "g", "fAgain"] do
    let selected ← readSource arrows text
    unless selected.category.any (·.role == .morphism) do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the public source fixture did not select its native map category"
  let retained := fun (session : SourceSession) (bindings : Array LocalBinding)
      (name : Name) => (do
    let some entry := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == name)
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the generalized application fixture lost its named source entry"
    let some binding := bindings.find? (·.id == entry.id)
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the generalized application fixture lost its exact source binding"
    pure binding.expression : MetaM Expr)
  for (text, native, used, unused) in #[
      ("g(f)", "CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f g", `f, `fAgain),
      ("g(fAgain)", "CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp fAgain g", `fAgain, `f)] do
    let composed ← readSource arrows text
    let expected ← arrows.term (← nativeSource native)
    let some category := composed.category
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "generalized application lost its morphism category"
    unless category.role == .morphism &&
        category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "generalized application changed its complete source role"
    SourceTest.checkSelected composed fun value => do
      let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
      let expected ← expected.source.inContext (← get).context
      let original ← retained arrows bindings used
      let other ← retained arrows bindings unused
      let later ← retained arrows bindings `g
      unless (← (← get).context.withOriginalSources #[value, expected] fun originals => isDefEq originals[0]! originals[1]!) && ((← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun expression => pure (expression == mkFVar original.fvarId!)) value false) > 0) &&
          ((← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun expression => pure (expression == mkFVar later.fvarId!)) value false) > 0) && !((← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun expression => pure (expression == mkFVar other.fvarId!)) value false) > 0) do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "generalized application substituted an equal native arrow binding"
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    discard <| readSource arrows "f(g)"
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "generalized application ignored the actual intermediate native object"
  unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
      "Application type mismatch: The " do
    throw failure
  let nested ← arrows.assume `rawH (← nativeSource "B → B")
  let middle ← readSource nested "(x ↦ rawH(x)) in (B → B)"
  let nested ← nested.defineTerm `h middle
  let composed ← readSource nested "g(h(f))"
  let expected ← nested.term (← nativeSource
    "CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f h) g")
  SourceTest.checkSelected composed fun value => do
    let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
    let expected ← expected.source.inContext (← get).context
    unless ← (← get).context.withOriginalSources #[value, expected] (fun originals => isDefEq originals[0]! originals[1]!) do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "nested generalized application changed its complete native composite"
    for name in #[`f, `g, `h] do
      unless ((← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun expression => do pure (expression.equal (← retained nested bindings name))) value false) > 0) do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "nested generalized application lost an original complete map"
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    discard <| readSource nested "g(h(g))"
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "nested generalized application changed its actual intermediate object"
  unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
      "Application type mismatch: The " do
    throw failure
  let consumers ← arrows.assume `rawConsumeMap
    (← nativeSource "TypeCat.Hom A B → C")
  let consumers ← consumers.assume `rawConsumeFunction
    (← nativeSource "(A → B) → C")
  let consumers ← consumers.define `nativeFunctions (← nativeSource "A → B")
  let mapConsumer ← readSource consumers "(m ↦ rawConsumeMap(m)) in ((A → B) → C)"
  let consumers ← consumers.defineTerm `consumeMap mapConsumer
  let functionConsumer ← readSource consumers
    "(m ↦ rawConsumeFunction(m)) in (nativeFunctions → C)"
  let consumers ← consumers.defineTerm `consumeFunction functionConsumer
  for (text, native) in #[
      ("consumeMap(f)", "consumeMap.hom.toFun f"),
      ("consumeFunction(f)", "consumeFunction.hom.toFun f.hom.toFun")] do
    let applied ← readSource consumers text
    let expected ← consumers.term (← nativeSource native)
    SourceTest.checkSelected applied fun value => do
      let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
      let expected ← expected.source.inContext (← get).context
      unless (← (← get).context.withOriginalSources #[value, expected] fun originals => isDefEq originals[0]! originals[1]!) &&
          ((← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun expression => do pure (expression.equal (← retained consumers bindings `f))) value false) > 0) do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a map-valued native parameter was changed into generalized composition"

private def originalReaderFailure {α : Type} (action : TermElabM α) :
    TermElabM Exception := do
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    discard <| withCurrHeartbeats <| withoutModifyingState action
    pure none
  catch failure => pure (some failure)
  let some failure := failure | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the negative reader control unexpectedly succeeded"
  pure failure

/- A reader failure is not evidence that the same datum is a map. Proof failure is checked
only after choosing the direct datum and cannot invoke the generalized reader either. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let originalDataFailure ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    registerInternalExceptionId `CasCompiler.tests.originalConstrainedDataFailure
  let target := mkApp (mkConst ``Fin) (mkNatLit 3)
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let mapCalls ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
  let unexpectedMap : SourceReadM NativeSourceJudgement := do
    liftM (m := IO) <| mapCalls.modify (· + 1)
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the failed direct datum was retried as a map"
  let validProof ← nativeSource "by decide"
  let failedData : Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) := fun _ =>
    throw (Exception.internal originalDataFailure)
  let failure ← originalReaderFailure <| empty.elaborateJudgementsScoped Syntax.missing do
    return #[← sourceConstrainedPointApplicable target #[validProof] failedData unexpectedMap]
  match failure with
  | .internal id _ =>
    unless id == originalDataFailure do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the constrained datum changed its original internal exception"
  | _ => liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the constrained datum replaced its reader's original internal exception"
  unless (← mapCalls.get) == 0 do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the failed constrained datum invoked another interpretation"
  let wrongProof ← nativeSource "True.intro"
  discard <| originalReaderFailure <| empty.elaborateJudgementsScoped Syntax.missing do
    return #[← sourceConstrainedPointApplicable target #[wrongProof]
      (fun _ => pure (.ok (mkNatLit 0))) unexpectedMap]
  unless (← mapCalls.get) == 0 do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a failed constrained proof invoked another interpretation"

private def nativeBinderArgument (value expected : Expr) :
    SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) := do
  unless ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| isDefEq (← inferType value) expected do
    return .error "the test argument has another native type"
  return .ok value

/- In the same actual overloaded family, failed argument/body reads and selected admission
evidence are errors. Only an explicit own-type mismatch can remove a candidate. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let originalDataFailure ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    registerInternalExceptionId `CasCompiler.tests.originalBinderDataFailure
  unless ((← semanticState).binders.filter (·.token == "∑")).size > 1 do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the binder failure control requires the original overloaded family"
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let missing ← originalReaderFailure <|
    readSource empty "∑_{n ∈ ℕ} unregistered_binder_body"
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? missing == some .invalid &&
      CasCatalogue.Exception.isUnknownSourceName missing "unregistered_binder_body" do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the binder replaced its body's original unknown-name failure"
  let index := nativeBinderArgument (mkConst ``Nat)
  let failedBody : Expr → SourceReadM Expr := fun _ =>
    throw (Exception.internal originalDataFailure)
  let bodyFailure ← originalReaderFailure <| empty.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing <| sourceBinder "∑" #[index] `n failedBody
  match bodyFailure with
  | .internal id _ =>
    unless id == originalDataFailure do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the binder changed its original body exception"
  | _ => liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the binder swallowed its original body exception"
  let failedArgument : Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) := fun _ =>
    throw (Exception.internal originalDataFailure)
  let argumentFailure ← originalReaderFailure <| empty.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing <|
    sourceBinder "∑" #[failedArgument] `n failedBody
  match argumentFailure with
  | .internal id _ =>
    unless id == originalDataFailure do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the binder changed its original argument exception"
  | _ => liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the binder swallowed its original argument exception"
  let mismatch : Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) := fun _ =>
    pure (.error "the supplied argument has another native type")
  let absent ← originalReaderFailure <| empty.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing <| sourceBinder "∑" #[mismatch] `n failedBody
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? absent == some .invalid &&
      !CasCatalogue.Exception.isSemanticAmbiguity absent do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "zero applicable binder rows were reported as ambiguity"
  let family ← elabTermAndSynthesize (← nativeSource "fun _ : Nat => (1 : Real)") none
  let bodies ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
  let admissionFailure ← originalReaderFailure <| empty.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing <| sourceBinder "∑" #[index] `n fun n => do
    liftM (m := IO) <| bodies.modify (· + 1)
    pure (mkApp family n)
  unless (← bodies.get) == 1 &&
      CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? admissionFailure == some .invalid do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a selected binder admission failure retried another body interpretation"

/- Overload selection keeps the original checked body occurrence and its native state.
The declarations below are checked aliases of the identity function, not new binder rows;
their distinct names expose a replay even though every candidate has the same value. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let rows := (← semanticState).binders.filter (·.token == "∑")
  unless rows.size > 1 do liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the binder retention control requires the actual overloads"
  let some selectedIndex := rows.findIdx? (·.id.raw == "bind.sets.real_series")
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the binder retention control lost the original real-series row"
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let parameters ← empty.assume `n (← nativeSource "Nat")
  let hypotheses ← parameters.assume `h (← nativeSource "n = n")
  let session ← hypotheses.define `g
    (← nativeSource "fun n : Nat => ((1 : Real) / 2) ^ n")
  let identity ← elabTermAndSynthesize (← nativeSource "fun x : Real => x") none
  let identityType ← inferType identity
  let argumentReads ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
  let declarations ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (#[] : Array (Nat × Name))
  let index : Expr → SourceReadM (Except MessageData Expr) := fun expected => do
    liftM (m := IO) <| argumentReads.modify (· + 1)
    nativeBinderArgument (mkConst ``Nat) expected
  let retained ← withCurrHeartbeats <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let bindings ← SourceTest.authoredBindings
    let #[outer, _, family] := bindings
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the binder retention control changed its original source scope"
    let value ← sourceBinder "∑" #[index] `n fun parameter => do
      unless parameter.isFVar && parameter.fvarId! != outer.expression.fvarId! do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the bound variable replaced an earlier same-named source parameter"
      let ordinal ← liftM (m := IO) argumentReads.get
      let name ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <| mkAuxDeclName (.num `binderBodyOccurrence ordinal)
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| addDecl (.defnDecl {
        name := name
        levelParams := []
        type := identityType
        value := identity
        hints := .abbrev
        safety := .safe })
      -- Match the native reducibility status of an elaborated abbrev, not
      -- just its kernel reduction hint. The independent evidence procedure
      -- deliberately uses reducible transparency.
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| setReducibilityStatus name .reducible
      liftM (m := IO) <| declarations.modify (·.push (ordinal, name))
      pure (mkApp (mkConst name) (mkApp family.expression parameter))
    unless (← liftM (m := IO) argumentReads.get) == rows.size do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "binder selection replayed an original argument or bound body"
    let created ← liftM (m := IO) declarations.get
    let some (_, selectedName) := created.find? (·.1 == selectedIndex + 1)
      | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the original selected binder body was not retained"
    unless ((← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun expression => pure (expression.isConstOf selectedName)) value) > 0) &&
        ((← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun expression => pure (expression == mkFVar family.expression.fvarId!)) value false) > 0) &&
        !((← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun expression => pure (expression == mkFVar outer.expression.fvarId!)) value false) > 0) do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "binder selection replaced its checked body or captured source occurrence"
    let environment := (← liftM (m := MetaM) getEnv).setExporting false
    for (ordinal, name) in created do
      unless environment.contains name == (ordinal == selectedIndex + 1) do
        liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "binder selection lost the selected native state or kept a rejected state"
    check value
    return value
  SourceTest.checkSelected retained fun value => do
    let scope ← get
    let original ← ContextTelescope.capture
      (scope.context.bindings.take session.context.entries.size)
    unless original.telescope.exactlyMatches session.context do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "binder selection shortened its complete context or changed stable binding identities"
    let before ← SourceTest.authoredEntries session.context session.selections
    let after ← SourceTest.authoredEntries retained.source.context retained.selections
    unless before.map (·.id) == after.map (·.id) do
      liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "binder selection changed its complete original authored telescope"
    checkWithKernel value

/- Native exceptions restore a speculative row's state and retain the original exception.
The public source failure controls above continue to check the same error classifications. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let originalFailure ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    registerInternalExceptionId `CasCompiler.tests.originalBinderStateFailure
  let introduced ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef (none : Option Name)
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) CasRuntime.IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    discard <| withCurrHeartbeats <| empty.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing <| sourceBinder "∑"
      #[nativeBinderArgument (mkConst ``Nat)] `n fun _ => do
        let name ← liftM (m := TermElabM) <| mkAuxDeclName `failedBinderBody
        liftM (m := TermElabM) <| addDecl (.defnDecl {
          name := name
          levelParams := []
          type := Lean.mkConst ``Nat
          value := mkNatLit 1
          hints := .abbrev
          safety := .safe })
        liftM (m := IO) <| introduced.set (some name)
        throw (Exception.internal originalFailure)
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some (.internal actual _) := failure
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a binder state failure lost its original native exception"
  unless actual == originalFailure do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a binder state failure was replaced by another exception"
  let some name ← introduced.get
    | liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "the binder state control never reached its original body"
  unless !((← getEnv).setExporting false).contains name do
    liftM (m := MetaM) <| throwError "a failed binder row left its speculative native declaration behind"

module

public import CasCompiler.Layout
public import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.Shapes.ZeroMorphisms

public section

namespace CasCompiler

open Lean Meta

/-- A structural map written in the original native Hom interface. It retains the actual
category/dictionary and ordered operands; the wire descriptor supplies no executable code. -/
structure NativeStructuralMap where
  private mk ::
  value : Expr
  tag : String
  source : Expr
  target : Expr
  operands : Array Expr
  dictionary : Expr

private def originalHom? (value : Expr) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  let type ← inferType value
  if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then return some type
  let type ← whnfR type
  return if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then some type else none

/-- Inspect only an explicitly selected class parent, then return its exact field without
reducing that field. This is the same native constructor boundary used by Lower.field. -/
private def originalClassField? (context : OpenContext) (inputs : Array BindingId)
    (value : Expr) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  let some projection ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? value | return none
  unless projection.info.fromClass do return none
  let parent ← context.inputProjectionSource projection.parent inputs
  unless parent.getAppFn.isConstOf projection.info.ctorName do return none
  let some selected ← projectCore? parent projection.info.i | return none
  return some (selected.betaRev
    (value.getAppArgs.extract (projection.info.numParams + 1) value.getAppNumArgs).reverse
    (preserveMData := true))

private def numeralField? (context : OpenContext) (inputs : Array BindingId)
    (value : Expr) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  unless value.isAppOfArity ``OfNat.ofNat 3 do return some value
  let some index := value.getAppArgs[1]!.rawNatLit? | return none
  unless index == 0 || index == 1 do return none
  originalClassField? context inputs value

/-- The original Hom supplies the exact Category parent. Instance inference is only for its
zero structure; the supplied map must be the unchanged native field of that structure.
In particular, a group's literal 1 is accepted only when it is that actual zero-map field. -/
private def originalZero? (context : OpenContext) (inputs : Array BindingId)
    (value type : Expr) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  let some value ← numeralField? context inputs value | return none
  unless value.isAppOfArity ``Zero.zero 2 || value.isAppOfArity ``One.one 2 do return none
  if value.isAppOfArity ``Zero.zero 2 then
    let instanceValue := value.getAppArgs[1]!
    if instanceValue.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.zero 5 then
      return some instanceValue
  let quiver := type.getAppArgs[1]!.consumeMData
  let structureValue ← if quiver.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.toQuiver 2 then
      pure (some quiver.getAppArgs[1]!)
    else if let .proj owner 0 parent := quiver then
      pure (if owner == ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct then some parent else none)
    else pure none
  let some structureValue := structureValue | return none
  let structureValue := structureValue.consumeMData
  let category ← if structureValue.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.Category.toCategoryStruct 2 then
      pure (some structureValue.getAppArgs[1]!)
    else if let .proj owner 0 parent := structureValue then
      pure (if owner == ``CategoryTheory.Category then some parent else none)
    else pure none
  let some category := category | return none
  let fields := type.getAppArgs
  let classType ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms
    #[some fields[0]!, some category]
  let some zeros := (← trySynthInstance classType).toOption | return none
  let zeroInstance ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms.zero
    #[some fields[0]!, some category, some zeros, some fields[2]!, some fields[3]!]
  let canonical ← mkAppOptM ``Zero.zero #[some type, some zeroInstance]
  let some original ← originalClassField? context inputs canonical | return none
  let some original ← numeralField? context inputs original | return none
  unless original.equal value do return none
  return some zeroInstance

/-- Recognize native identity, composition and the exact original categorical-zero field.
No declaration is unfolded to discover a map, and no map body, matcher or recursor executes.
Only an OfNat/class parent can expose its constructor before the unchanged field is read. -/
opaque NativeStructuralMap.ofExpr? (context : OpenContext) (value : Expr)
    (inputs : Array BindingId := #[]) : MetaM (Option NativeStructuralMap) := do
  let .const _ _ := value.getAppFn | return none
  if value.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id 3 then
    check value
    let args := value.getAppArgs
    return some ⟨value, "identity", args[2]!, args[2]!, #[args[2]!, args[2]!], args[1]!⟩
  if value.isAppOfArity ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp 7 then
    check value
    let args := value.getAppArgs
    return some ⟨value, "compose", args[2]!, args[4]!, #[args[5]!, args[6]!], args[1]!⟩
  unless value.isAppOfArity ``Zero.zero 2 || value.isAppOfArity ``One.one 2 ||
      value.isAppOfArity ``OfNat.ofNat 3 do return none
  let some type ← originalHom? value | return none
  let some dictionary ← originalZero? context inputs value type | return none
  check value
  return some ⟨value, "zero", type.getAppArgs[2]!, type.getAppArgs[3]!,
    #[type.getAppArgs[2]!, type.getAppArgs[3]!], dictionary⟩

end CasCompiler

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCatalogue

-- Both fixed native diagram maps are checked under their entire original rigid telescope.
-- In groups the original syntax is the trivial homomorphism 1, not a guessed scalar zero.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let state ← semanticState
  for id in #["lim.groups.kernel", "colim.bil_w_form.cokernel"] do
    let #[entry] := state.limits.filter (·.id.raw == id)
      | throwError "the structural-map control lost its original declared limit"
    let declaration ← getConstInfo entry.declaration
    for levels in #[declaration.levelParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero),
        declaration.levelParams.map Level.param] do
      let presentation := Lean.mkConst declaration.name levels
      forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType presentation) fun parameters result => do
        let bindings := parameters.mapIdx fun index expression =>
          ({ id := ⟨"fixed-native-diagram", index⟩, role := .parameter, expression } : LocalBinding)
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let result ← whnfR result
        let diagram := result.getAppArgs.back!
        unless diagram.isAppOf ``CategoryTheory.Limits.parallelPair do
          throwError "the structural-map control changed its original native diagram"
        let original := diagram.getAppArgs.back!
        let some selected ← NativeStructuralMap.ofExpr? context original
          | throwError "the original fixed diagram map {id} has no unchanged structural descriptor"
        unless selected.tag == "zero" && selected.value.equal original do
          throwError "structural framing replaced the original fixed native map"
        let type ← inferType original
        unless type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 &&
            selected.source.equal type.getAppArgs[2]! &&
            selected.target.equal type.getAppArgs[3]! do
          throwError "structural framing lost its original complete native endpoints"
        checkWithKernel (← mkLambdaFVars parameters selected.value
          (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false))

-- Ordinary arithmetic literals and unregistered function computations do not acquire a map.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  for source in #["(0 : Nat)", "(1 : Nat)", "Nat.add 0 0"] do
    let stx ← ofExcept <| Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term source
    let value ← elabTermAndSynthesize stx none
    if (← NativeStructuralMap.ofExpr? context value).isSome then
      throwError "native scalar computation acquired a categorical structural map"

end CasCompiler.StructuralMapTests
