        let evidence := element + 1
        let some evidenceSource := arguments[evidence]?
          | throwError "the complete admission lost its supplied evidence slot"
        unless arguments.size == evidence + 1 do
          throwError "the accepted units admission changed its complete source telescope"
        let family ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close admission.family)
          (selections := admitted.selections)
        let (result, application) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource family context
          (← arguments.mapM context.close)
        let some evidenceArgument := application.arguments[evidence]?
          | throwError "the admission layout lost its supplied evidence argument"
        unless application.arguments.size == arguments.size &&
            evidenceArgument.wireIndex.isSome do
          throwError "the admission erased a data-bearing evidence argument"
        for (path, slot, selected) in #[
            (#[``Units.val], element, #[]),
            (#[``Units.inv], evidence, #[``Invertible.invOf])] do
          let some (.projection route) ← application.inputProjectionThrough #[] path
            | throwError "the admitted field lost its complete native input route"
          match route.target with
          | .argument index =>
            unless index == slot do
              throwError "the admitted field selected another formal argument"
          | .context _ => throwError "the admitted field replaced a formal input by context"
          unless route.path == selected do
            throwError "the admitted field changed its native evidence projection"
        unless (result.fields.filter (·.wireIndex.isSome)).size == 2 do
          throwError "the accepted units admission lost a computational result field"

        let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        let evidenceRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close evidenceSource)
          (selections := admitted.selections)
        let mut evidenceFields : Array ValueBinding := #[]
        for declared in evidenceRole.fields do
          if declared.wireIndex.isSome then
            evidenceFields := evidenceFields.push
              (← retainedCode kernel producer context (← declared.source.inContext context)
                (selections := selections))
        unless evidenceFields.size == 1 &&
            evidenceRole.fields.any (fun declared =>
              declared.projection == ``Invertible.invOf && declared.wireIndex == some 0) do
          throwError "the accepted evidence lost its native computational field"
        let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
        let evidenceEnvironment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context {}
          (← producer.view) (selections := selections)
        let evidenceValue ← producer.stage
          (← evidenceEnvironment.origin program (← kernel.ledger.allocate) evidenceRole)
          (.product evidenceFields)
        let mut values : Array ValueBinding := #[]
        for argument in arguments, index in [:arguments.size] do
          -- The accepted admission's three arguments are all computational. Their code
          -- stays unforced, including the selected monoid and the original element.
          if ← isProof argument then
            throwError "the accepted units control changed its formal proof positions"
          values := values.push (← if index == evidence then pure evidenceValue
            else retainedCode kernel producer context argument (selections := selections))
        withApplicationInputs owners.identities context {} admission.family arguments
            (values.map some) fun context bound retained => do
            let retainedEvidence := retained[evidence]!
            let parentSource ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[retainedEvidence, mkNatLit 0]
            let evidenceParent ← retainedCode kernel producer context parentSource #[evidenceValue] bound
              (selections := selections)
            let .ok _ ← producer.commit
              | throwError "the admission inputs could not publish their original references"

            let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
            try
              let value ← runAdmission kernel consumer context bound selections admission retained
              let graph ← consumer.view
              let some node := graph.find value.value
                | throwError "the admitted result is outside its graph"
              let some fields := node.payload.data.storedFields?
                | throwError "the complete admission returned no native record fields"
              unless fields.size == 2 do
                throwError "the complete admission changed its mandatory native field arity"
              let some originalValue := values[element]?
                | throwError "the admission control lost its retained original element"
              let some originalInverse := evidenceFields[0]?
                | throwError "the admission control lost its retained original evidence field"
              let selectedValue ← field graph value ``Units.val
              let selectedInverse ← field graph value ``Units.inv
              unless selectedValue.value == originalValue.value &&
                  originalValue.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf selectedValue.associationIds.toList &&
                  selectedInverse.value == originalInverse.value &&
                  originalInverse.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf selectedInverse.associationIds.toList do
                throwError "the admitted record changed its original element or supplied inverse field"
              let .ok (some baseline) :=
                  graph.projectionBasis selectedInverse evidenceValue #[``Invertible.invOf]
                | throwError "the admitted inverse lost its exact evidence-field access"
              unless baseline.value == originalInverse.value &&
                  baseline.associationIds == originalInverse.associationIds do
                throwError "the admitted inverse acquired another evidence baseline"
              unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                throwError "the complete native admission dispatched a mathematical operation"
              let .ok _ ← consumer.commit
                | throwError "the complete admission could not publish its native result"
            finally discard <| consumer.abort

            -- Used projected evidence is an ordinary access to its actual lazy parent. It must
            -- return the original h before selecting h.invOf, never a self-referential h thunk.
            let projected ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
            try
              withBoundValue owners.identities context bound parentSource evidenceParent fun context bound parent => do
                let marked := retained.set! evidence (mkProj ``Prod 0 parent)
                let value ← runAdmission kernel projected context bound selections admission marked
                let graph ← projected.view
                let .ok (some actualEvidence) := graph.projected? evidenceParent #[``Prod.fst]
                  | throwError "used projected admission evidence did not demand its actual parent"
                unless actualEvidence.value == evidenceValue.value do
                  throwError "used projected admission evidence fabricated a replacement h"
                let selectedInverse ← field graph value ``Units.inv
                let some originalInverse := evidenceFields[0]?
                  | throwError "the projected evidence control lost its original inverse field"
                let .ok (some baseline) := graph.projectionBasis selectedInverse evidenceParent
                    #[``Prod.fst, ``Invertible.invOf]
                  | throwError "used admission evidence lost its complete original parent/path"
                unless baseline.value == originalInverse.value &&
                    selectedInverse.value == originalInverse.value do
                  throwError "used admission evidence replaced its original selected field"
                unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                  throwError "native projected admission evidence dispatched a mathematical operation"
                let .ok _ ← projected.commit
                  | throwError "the projected admission evidence could not publish"
            finally discard <| projected.abort

            -- A same-typed descriptor supplies the whole h but no h.invOf field. Its schema
            -- must not authorize a complete unit record, even though the native source has one.
            let absent ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
            try
              let .ok payload := ValuePayload.descriptor .null #[]
                | throwError "the absent-field evidence control has an invalid descriptor"
              let graph ← absent.view
              let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context bound graph
                (selections := selections)
              let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close retained[evidence]!)
                (selections := ← selections.close context)
              let missing ← absent.stage
                (← environment.origin program (← kernel.ledger.allocate) role) payload
              SourceSelectionScope.withBinding owners.identities selections context
                  { value := evidenceSource } fun context selections emptySource => do
                withBoundValue owners.identities context bound emptySource missing
                    (fun context bound retainedMissing => do
                      let marked := retained.set! evidence retainedMissing
                      let failure : Option Exception ← try
                          discard <| runAdmission kernel absent context bound selections admission marked
                          pure none
                        catch error => pure (some error)
                      let some failure := failure
                        | throwError "the admission fabricated its absent computational evidence field"
                      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .noImplementation do
                        throw failure
                      unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                        throwError "absent admission data triggered an unrelated mathematical dispatch"
                    ) (declaredType := some (← inferType retained[evidence]!))
            finally discard <| absent.abort

            -- The same absence behind a genuine lazy parent must still fail after its ordinary
            -- projection. A closure of the projected h expression is not an actual h reference.
            let absentParent ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
            try
              let .ok payload := ValuePayload.descriptor .null #[]
                | throwError "the projected absent-field control has an invalid descriptor"
              let graph ← absentParent.view
              let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context bound graph
                (selections := selections)
              let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close retained[evidence]!)
                (selections := ← selections.close context)
              let missing ← absentParent.stage
                (← environment.origin program (← kernel.ledger.allocate) role) payload
              SourceSelectionScope.withBinding owners.identities selections context
                  { value := evidenceSource } fun context selections emptySource => do
                withBoundValue owners.identities context bound emptySource missing
                    (fun context bound retainedMissing => do
                      let parentSource ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[retainedMissing, mkNatLit 0]
                      let parentValue ← retainedCode kernel absentParent context parentSource #[missing] bound
                        (selections := selections)
                      withBoundValue owners.identities context bound parentSource parentValue fun context bound parent => do
                        let marked := retained.set! evidence (mkProj ``Prod 0 parent)
                        let failure : Option Exception ← try
                          discard <| runAdmission kernel absentParent context bound selections admission marked
                          pure none
                        catch error => pure (some error)
                        let some failure := failure
                          | throwError "used projected evidence fabricated its absent native field"
                        unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .noImplementation do
                          throw failure
                        unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                          throwError "missing projected admission data dispatched an unrelated operation"
                    ) (declaredType := some (← inferType retained[evidence]!))
            finally discard <| absentParent.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- Selecting a data field may still require a formal parameter solely through that input's
-- native type. This checks the transitive prefix without instantiating any mathematical datum.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let function ← elabTermAndSynthesize (← `(fun (n : Nat) (p : Fin n) => p.val)) none
  forallTelescope (← inferType function) fun locals _ => do
    let bindings := locals.mapIdx fun index expression =>
      ({ id := ⟨"admission-input-type-prefix", index⟩, role := .parameter, expression } : LocalBinding)
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let (_, application) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource
      (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close function)) context
      (← locals.mapM fun argument => context.close argument)
    let some required ← application.inputResultArguments (bindings.map (·.id))
      | throwError "the native dependent field lost its complete source coverage"
    unless required == #[0, 1] do
      throwError "source coverage erased the selected input's transitive type parameter"

-- These native identity/record terms test only the fixed-input execution gate. The omitted
-- second argument is an unresolved projection of a real lazy parent; it remains a declared
-- computational slot and acquires no fabricated value. An incomplete result must reject the
-- same missing slot before either its lazy resolver or its ordinary executor is called.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      let pairSource ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 11]
      let pair ← retainedCode kernel producer context pairSource
      let first ← retainedCode kernel producer context (mkNatLit 7)
      let identitySource ← elabTermAndSynthesize
        (← `(fun (x : Nat) (_h : Nat) => x)) none
      let incompleteSource ← elabTermAndSynthesize
        (← `(fun (p : Nat × Nat) (_h : Nat) => (p.1, Nat.succ p.2))) none
      let identity ← retainedCode kernel producer context identitySource
      let incomplete ← retainedCode kernel producer context incompleteSource
      let .ok _ ← producer.commit
        | throwError "the missing-input controls could not publish their native sources"
      withBoundValue owners.identities context {} pairSource pair fun context bound parent => do
        let absentSource ← context.close (mkProj ``Prod 0 parent)

        let completed ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let graph ← completed.view
          let parameters ← bound.toArray.mapM fun (id, value) =>
            IO.ofExcept <| (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph id value).mapError IO.userError
          let .ok firstArgument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 first
            | throwError "the identity control lost its supplied first argument"
          let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program
            (← kernel.ledger.allocate) context identity
            #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7), absentSource] #[firstArgument] parameters (some graph)
          let some missingRole := request.roles.arguments[1]?
            | throwError "the unused computational argument disappeared from the telescope"
          unless missingRole.wireIndex == some 1 do
            throwError "unused data were relabeled as a formal proof"
          let failure : Option Exception ← try
            discard <| request.admitInputs graph
            pure none
          catch error => pure (some error)
          let some failure := failure
            | throwError "ordinary input admission accepted an absent computational argument"
          unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag
              (· == `CasRuntime.InputRoleMap.missingArgument) do throw failure
          let resolverCalls ← IO.mkRef 0
          let executorCalls ← IO.mkRef 0
          let response ← Execute.run
            (fun _ _ => do
              executorCalls.modify (· + 1)
              throwError "the complete identity reached its ordinary executor")
            (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) request) completed
            (some (fun _ => do
              resolverCalls.modify (· + 1)
              throwError "the complete identity forced unused projected evidence"))
          unless response.root.value == first.value &&
              first.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf response.root.associationIds.toList &&
              (← resolverCalls.get) == 0 && (← executorCalls.get) == 0 do
            throwError "source-fixed identity changed its input or demanded unused evidence"
          let graph ← completed.view
          let .ok none := graph.projected? pair #[``Prod.fst]
            | throwError "unused projected evidence acquired an actual field value"
          let some application := request.origin.application
            | throwError "the completed identity lost its complete formal application"
          unless application.arguments.size == 2 && (application.arguments[1]?.bind id).isNone do
            throwError "the completed identity manufactured its unused computational argument"
          let .ok published ← completed.commit
            | throwError "the sealed identity completion could not publish"
          let some receipt := published.receipt request.occurrence
            | throwError "the sealed identity completion lost its receipt"
          unless !(receipt.association.inputs.lookup published.graph missingRole.role.id).isOk &&
              !(receipt.association.inputs.arguments published.graph).isOk do
            throwError "the fixed completion exposed omitted data as an ordinary complete input map"
        finally discard <| completed.abort

        let refused ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let graph ← refused.view
          let parameters ← bound.toArray.mapM fun (id, value) =>
            IO.ofExcept <| (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph id value).mapError IO.userError
          let .ok pairArgument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 pair
            | throwError "the incomplete control lost its supplied record"
          let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program
            (← kernel.ledger.allocate) context incomplete
            #[← context.close pairSource, absentSource] #[pairArgument] parameters (some graph)
          unless (← request.inputResultPlan graph).isNone do
            throwError "an unknown result field acquired complete input coverage"
          let resolverCalls ← IO.mkRef 0
          let executorCalls ← IO.mkRef 0
          let failure : Option Exception ← try
            discard <| Execute.run
              (fun _ _ => do
                executorCalls.modify (· + 1)
                throwError "incomplete inputs reached an ordinary executor")
              (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) request) refused
              (some (fun _ => do
                resolverCalls.modify (· + 1)
                throwError "incomplete inputs forced a partial input-result route"))
            pure none
          catch error => pure (some error)
          let some failure := failure
            | throwError "an incomplete result bypassed total input admission before effects"
          unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag
              (· == `CasRuntime.InputRoleMap.missingArgument) do throw failure
          unless (← resolverCalls.get) == 0 && (← executorCalls.get) == 0 do
            throwError "an incomplete result bypassed total input admission before effects"
          unless ((← SessionSnapshot.current).receipt request.occurrence).isNone do
            throwError "the incomplete result published a completion"
        finally discard <| refused.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- With the original monoid fixed explicitly, the postfix reader retains the released group
-- inverse declaration. This reads no answer. The unchanged unqualified equality is exercised
-- separately by tests/acceptance/b0-required-positives.cas.proposed.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let source ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
    let inverse ← readTerm source
      "(((3 in (ℚ in Rings)) in (view (ℚ in Rings) along «fun.rings.multiplicative_monoid»())ˣ))⁻¹"
    inverse.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      context.withOriginalSources #[expression] fun originals => do
        let letIds := (← getLCtx).foldl (fun ids declaration =>
          if declaration.isLet then ids.push declaration.fvarId else ids) #[]
        let expression ← zetaDeltaFVars originals[0]! letIds
        unless (expression.find? (·.isConstOf ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.Units.groupInverse)).isSome do
          throwError "the selected inverse lost its accepted operation declaration"
  finally setEnv original

end CasRuntime.AdmissionInputTests

module

public import CasRuntime.Session
public import CasCompiler.Parse
public import CasCatalogue.TestSuite
import LeanCategories.Catalogue
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCatalogue.TestSuite
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue

namespace CasRuntime.ApplicationLogTests

open Lean Meta Elab Command Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

-- T127 exercises the original acceptance file through its public runner. The peer
-- receives only its existing Fin cardinality registration. Every mathematical outcome
-- stays in the report; the checks below assert the integrity of the execution log.
/-- Run the unchanged original file and check its complete trace against the public report.
Additional controls inspect the same executed session and log; they do not replay statements. -/
public meta def runOriginalFile (peer : Bool)
    (observe : KernelSession → SourceFile → Array CasCatalogue.Language.TestResult →
      Array Json → Json → CommandElabM Unit := fun _ _ _ _ _ => pure ()) :
    CommandElabM Unit := do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let root ← IO.currentDir
    let input : System.FilePath := "tests/acceptance/sets.cas"
    let contents ← IO.FS.readFile input
    let sourceSha256 ← sha256Hex contents
    let original ← liftCoreM <| SourceFile.parse input.toString contents
    let contract ← packageDir contractPackage
    let python := (← IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
    let logDirectory : System.FilePath :=
      (← IO.getEnv "CAS_APPLICATION_LOG_DIR").getD "timing/application"
    let nonce := (← IO.FS.readFile "/proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid").trimAscii.toString
    let evidence := logDirectory / "original-acceptance" / nonce
    IO.FS.createDirAll evidence
    let registration := Json.mkObj [
      ("operation", "meth.cardinality"), ("input", "obj.sets.fin"), ("backend", "peer")]
    let backends := if peer then
        #[Json.mkObj [("name", "peer"), ("command", python.toString),
          ("args", toJson #[(root / "scripts/probes/kernel_session_peer.py").toString])]]
      else #[]
    let registrations := if peer then #[registration] else #[]
    let manifest := Json.mkObj [
      ("backends", .arr backends), ("registrations", .arr registrations)]
    let manifestPath := evidence / "leaves.json"
    IO.FS.writeFile manifestPath manifest.compress
    let initial ← liftTermElabM <| KernelSession.start (some manifestPath)
      (computationOnly := true)
    try
      unless initial.kernel.rejected.isEmpty do
        throwError "the original-file control lost its one legitimate peer registration"
      let (rows, completed) ← CasCatalogue.Language.runFile initial input
      -- Save the complete unmodified public report before checking its trace. Passing
      -- this log control never changes a gap or a failure into mathematical acceptance.
      IO.FS.writeFile (evidence / "results.json") <| (Json.mkObj [
        ("file", toJson input.toString), ("sourceSha256", toJson sourceSha256),
        ("manifest", manifest), ("peer", toJson peer),
        ("applicationLog", toJson initial.kernel.log.path.toString),
        ("results", toJson rows)]).pretty
      unless (← IO.FS.readFile input) == contents do
        throwError "the original acceptance file changed during its public execution"
      let mut events : Array Json := #[]
      for line in (← IO.FS.readFile initial.kernel.log.path).splitOn "\n" do
        if line.isEmpty then continue
        events := events.push (← IO.ofExcept <| (Json.parse line).mapError IO.userError)
      let dataOf (event : Json) : Json := (event.getObjVal? "data").toOption.getD .null
      let isEvent (name : String) (event : Json) : Bool :=
        (event.getObjValAs? String "event").toOption == some name
      let hasParent (sequence : Nat) (event : Json) : Bool :=
        ((event.getObjValAs? (Array Nat) "parents").toOption.getD #[]).contains sequence
      for event in events, sequence in [:events.size] do
        unless (event.getObjValAs? Nat "sequence").toOption == some sequence &&
            (event.getObjValAs? String "session").toOption == some initial.kernel.log.session do
          throwError "the original file log changed its event order or session"
        let .ok parents := event.getObjValAs? (Array Nat) "parents"
          | throwError "the original file log lost its causal event parents"
        unless parents.all (· < sequence) do
          throwError "the original file log references a missing or later event"
      let #[started] := (events.filter (isEvent "file.started")).map dataOf
        | throwError "the original file lost its one parsed-file event"
      let #[finished] := (events.filter (isEvent "file.finished")).map dataOf
        | throwError "the original file lost its complete file outcome"
      for fileEvent in #[started, finished] do
        unless (fileEvent.getObjValAs? String "file").toOption == some input.toString &&
            (fileEvent.getObjValAs? String "sourceSha256").toOption == some sourceSha256 do
          throwError "the file log replaced its original path or exact source"
      unless (started.getObjValAs? Nat "statements").toOption == some original.items.size &&
          (finished.getObjValAs? Nat "executed").toOption == some original.items.size do
        throwError "the public runner omitted an original acceptance-file item"
      let computations := events.filter (isEvent "computation.started")
      let timings := events.filter (isEvent "computation.timing")
      unless computations.size == original.items.size && timings.size == original.items.size do
        throwError "the public file lost an original computation or timing record"
      let originalIds := original.items.filterMap fun item =>
        match item with
        | `(cas_item| test $id:ident $_:str : $_:cas_stmt) => some id.getId.toString
        | _ => none
      unless (rows.filter (!·.id.startsWith "(statement)")).map (·.id) == originalIds do
        throwError "the public report changed the complete original assertion inventory"
      for item in original.items, ordinal in [:original.items.size] do
        let (id, statement) : String × TSyntax `cas_stmt := match item with
          | `(cas_item| test $id:ident $_:str : $statement:cas_stmt) =>
            (id.getId.toString, statement)
          | `(cas_item| $statement:cas_stmt) =>
            (s!"(statement) {item.raw.reprint.getD ""}", statement)
          | _ => (s!"(statement) {item.raw.reprint.getD ""}", ⟨item.raw⟩)
        let some computation := computations[ordinal]?
          | throwError "the original statement lost its entered computation"
        let .ok computationSequence := computation.getObjValAs? Nat "sequence"
          | throwError "the original computation lost its log identity"
        let data := dataOf computation
        unless (data.getObjValAs? String "id").toOption == some id &&
            (data.getObjValAs? Nat "ordinal").toOption == some ordinal &&
            (data.getObjValAs? String "source").toOption ==
              some (statement.raw.reprint.getD "") &&
            (data.getObjValAs? String "sourceSha256").toOption == some sourceSha256 &&
            (data.getObjVal? "position").toOption ==
              some (SourceSnapshot.spanJson ⟨input.toString,
                statement.raw.getPos?, statement.raw.getTailPos?⟩) do
          throwError "the entered computation changed its original statement or position"
        let descendants := events.filter (hasParent computationSequence)
        let #[statementStarted] := descendants.filter (isEvent "statement.started")
          | throwError "an original file item lost its public statement entrance"
        let .ok statementSequence := statementStarted.getObjValAs? Nat "sequence"
          | throwError "the original statement lost its causal identity"
        unless ((dataOf statementStarted).getObjVal? "source").toOption ==
            (data.getObjVal? "source").toOption &&
            ((dataOf statementStarted).getObjVal? "position").toOption ==
              (data.getObjVal? "position").toOption do
          throwError "the public statement replaced its parsed source or position"
        let entered := descendants.filter (hasParent statementSequence)
        let #[timing] := (descendants.filter (isEvent "computation.timing")).map dataOf
          | throwError "an original statement lost its own complete timing"
        let .ok result := timing.getObjVal? "result"
          | throwError "an original statement timing lost its actual root result"
        unless (result.getObjValAs? String "id").toOption == some id &&
            (timing.getObjValAs? Nat "ordinal").toOption == some ordinal &&
            (timing.getObjValAs? Nat "executionMilliseconds").isOk &&
            (timing.getObjValAs? Nat "cumulativeSetupMilliseconds").isOk do
          throwError "the original statement timing changed its identity or measured work"
        let terminal := entered.filter fun event =>
          isEvent "statement.finished" event || isEvent "statement.interrupted" event
        let #[terminal] := terminal
          | throwError "an entered original statement lost its one terminal event"
        if isEvent "statement.finished" terminal then
          for field in #["kind", "stratum", "detail", "fails", "attempted", "published"] do
            unless ((dataOf terminal).getObjVal? field).toOption ==
                (result.getObjVal? field).toOption do
              throwError "the log changed the original root outcome field {field}"
          if ((dataOf terminal).getObjValAs? Bool "attempted").toOption == some true then
            unless entered.any (isEvent "statement.read") do
              throwError "an executed original statement lost its selected reading"
        else
          unless (result.getObjValAs? String "kind").toOption == some "internal" do
            throwError "an interrupted statement was relabeled as another outcome"
        for reading in entered.filter (isEvent "statement.read") do
          let .ok scope := (dataOf reading).getObjVal? "scope"
            | throwError "the original selected reading lost its source scope"
          unless (scope.getObjVal? "context").isOk &&
              (scope.getObjVal? "selections").isOk &&
              (scope.getObjVal? "nativeExpressions").isOk do
            throwError "the original selected reading lost its complete typed interpretation"
      for row in rows do
        let matching := timings.filter fun event =>
          ((dataOf event).getObjValAs? String "id").toOption == some row.id
        let #[timing] := matching
          | throwError "an original report row lost its one measured computation"
        unless ((dataOf timing).getObjVal? "result").toOption == some (toJson row) do
          throwError "the diagnostic report changed an original public result"
      let required := #[
        ("sets.implemented.card_fin", if peer then "holds" else "gap"),
        ("sets.apply.rev", "gap")]
      for (id, kind) in required do
        let #[row] := rows.filter (·.id == id)
          | throwError "the original file lost a required public log control"
        unless row.kind == kind && row.attempted && !row.question.isEmpty &&
            !row.conclusions.isEmpty do
          throwError "the required original statement did not reach its typed execution boundary: {id}: {toJson row}"
        let #[computation] := computations.filter fun event =>
            ((dataOf event).getObjValAs? String "id").toOption == some id
          | throwError "the required original statement lost its computation"
        let .ok sequence := computation.getObjValAs? Nat "sequence"
          | throwError "the required computation lost its causal identity"
        let entered := events.filter (hasParent sequence)
        let #[terminal] := entered.filter (isEvent "statement.finished")
          | throwError "the required original statement lost its completed public outcome"
        unless (entered.filter (isEvent "statement.interrupted")).isEmpty do
          throwError "a required original execution was interrupted"
        if peer && id == "sets.implemented.card_fin" then
          unless row.published && row.dispatches == #[registration] do
            throwError "the original cardinality statement lost its actual peer dispatch"
          let #[dispatch] := entered.filter (isEvent "dispatch")
            | throwError "the original cardinality statement lost its one actual dispatch event"
          let .ok selected := (dataOf dispatch).getObjVal? "selected"
            | throwError "the actual dispatch lost its selected registration"
          for (field, expected) in #[
              ("operation", "meth.cardinality"), ("input", "obj.sets.fin"), ("backend", "peer")] do
            unless (selected.getObjValAs? String field).toOption == some expected do
              throwError "the actual dispatch changed its original registration field {field}"
          let .ok request := (dataOf dispatch).getObjVal? "request"
            | throwError "the actual dispatch lost its prepared request"
          let .ok native := request.getObjVal? "native"
            | throwError "the actual dispatch lost its complete native request"
          unless ((dataOf dispatch).getObjVal? "operands").isOk do
            throwError "the actual dispatch lost its original operands"
          unless entered.any (fun event => isEvent "request.prepared" event &&
              ((dataOf event).getObjVal? "native").toOption == some native) do
            throwError "the dispatch lost its original prepared request event"
          let .ok occurrence := (dataOf dispatch).getObjVal? "occurrence"
            | throwError "the actual dispatch lost its original occurrence"
          for phase in #["reply.admission.started", "reply.admitted"] do
            unless entered.any (fun event => isEvent phase event &&
                ((dataOf event).getObjVal? "occurrence").toOption == some occurrence) do
              throwError "the actual peer reply lost its admission phase {phase}"
        else
          unless !row.published && row.dispatches.isEmpty &&
              ((dataOf terminal).getObjValAs? String "stratum").toOption ==
                some "noImplementation" do
            throwError "the original missing implementation lost its classified terminal outcome"
          let #[missing] := entered.filter (isEvent "realization.missing")
            | throwError "the original missing implementation lost its exact realization request"
          let .ok forms := (dataOf missing).getObjValAs? (Array String) "forms"
            | throwError "the missing implementation lost its complete original input forms"
          let (operation, inputForm) := if id == "sets.implemented.card_fin" then
              ("meth.cardinality", "obj.sets.fin")
            else ("mor.sets.fin_rev", "mor.sets.fin_rev")
          unless ((dataOf missing).getObjValAs? String "operation").toOption ==
              some operation && forms[0]? == some inputForm do
            throwError "the missing implementation changed its original operation or input address"
          unless (entered.filter (isEvent "dispatch")).isEmpty &&
              entered.any (isEvent "request.prepared") do
            throwError "the unregistered original request dispatched or lost its preparation"
      observe completed original rows events manifest
    finally initial.close
  finally setEnv environment

run_cmd runOriginalFile true

end CasRuntime.ApplicationLogTests

module

import CasRuntime.PreparedRequest
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.PreparedRequest

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasRuntime

-- Native source families determine which actual arguments a produced field needs.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let indexRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkNatLit 7))
  let type ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
    (← `((n : Nat) → Nat × Fin (n + 1))) (some (mkSort (.succ .zero)))
  let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let owner ← liftM (m := IO) <| owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
  let codeOwner ← liftM (m := IO) <| owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
  try
    let token ← liftM (m := IO) do
      owner.child.stdin.putStr "actual argument index\n"
      owner.child.stdin.flush
      return (← owner.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
    let codeToken ← liftM (m := IO) do
      codeOwner.child.stdin.putStr "actual callable code\n"
      codeOwner.child.stdin.flush
      return (← codeOwner.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
    let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
    let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
    withLocalDeclD `f type fun f => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[{
        id := ⟨"application-origin", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := f }]
      let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close f)
      let (older, callable) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[none] } (.ownedExport codeOwner codeToken #[])
      let (graph, index) ← liftM (m := IO) <| older.stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence, role := indexRole, parameters := #[] } (.ownedExport owner token #[])
      let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 index
        | throwError "the actual source index is outside its graph"
      let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable
        #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7)] #[argument] #[]
      -- The native result program retains the original formal slot, not the supplied numeral.
      let expectedFamily ← context.close
        (mkLambda `n .default (mkConst ``Nat) (mkApp f (.bvar 0)))
      let observedApplication :=
        (request.observation.native.getObjValD "request").getObjValD "application"
      let observedFamily := observedApplication.getObjValD "resultTermFamily"
      let .ok expressionIndex := observedFamily.getObjValAs? Nat "expression"
        | throwError "the native application observation lost its original result term family"
      let .ok typeIndex := observedFamily.getObjValAs? Nat "type"
        | throwError "the native result term family lost its complete dependent type"
      let .ok nodes := CasTools.NativeExpression.decodeNodes
          (request.observation.native.getObjValD "nativeExpressions")
        | throwError "the result term family is outside its exact native expression graph"
      unless nodes[expressionIndex]? == some expectedFamily.expression &&
          nodes[typeIndex]? == some expectedFamily.type do
        throwError "the application observation substituted an actual result for its original family"
      let .ok familyContext := observedFamily.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "context"
        | throwError "the original result family lost its source binding table"
      unless familyContext.size == 1 && familyContext[0]!.getObjValD "id" ==
          Json.mkObj [("session", toJson "application-origin"), ("serial", toJson (0 : Nat))] do
        throwError "the original result family changed its captured callable binding"
      let expectedReadable ← expectedFamily.withOpen fun _ expression =>
        return (← ppExpr expression).pretty
      let readableFamily := (request.observation.readable.getObjValD "application").getObjValD
        "resultTermFamily"
      unless readableFamily.getObjValD "expression" == toJson expectedReadable do
        throwError "the readable application observation changed its original result term family"
      let some record := request.record | throwError "the source result record is absent"
      let some first := record.fields[0]? | throwError "the independent source field is absent"
      let some second := record.fields[1]? | throwError "the dependent source field is absent"
      let finite ← RecordLayout.ofSource second.layout
      let some valueField := finite.fields[0]? | throwError "the nested source data field is absent"
      let independent ← request.originFor first.layout
      let dependent ← request.originFor second.layout
      let nested ← request.originFor valueField.layout
      let unrelated ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 1))
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| request.originFor unrelated
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure | throwError "result provenance accepted an unrelated source role"
      unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
          "the source role is not its prepared application result projection" do throw failure
      let some whole := request.origin.application
        | throwError "the prepared result lost its actual application provenance"
      let some left := independent.application
        | throwError "the independent result lost its application table"
      let some right := dependent.application
        | throwError "the dependent result lost its application table"
      let some inner := nested.application
        | throwError "the nested result lost its application table"
      unless whole.arguments.size == 1 &&
          (whole.arguments[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some index.value &&
          whole.callable.map (·.value) == some callable.value &&
          whole.dependencies == #[0] && right.dependencies == #[0] &&
          left.dependencies.isEmpty && inner.dependencies.isEmpty do
        throwError "result provenance changed an actual argument or a field's native dependencies"
      let hidden ← liftM (m := IO) do
        try
          discard <| older.stage owners.identities dependent (.portable "0".toUTF8)
          pure false
        catch error => pure (error.toString.endsWith "the value reference is outside the visible graph")
      unless hidden do throwError "application provenance recovered an index absent from its graph"
      let (graph, leftValue) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        graph.stage owners.identities independent (.portable "0".toUTF8)
      let (graph, innerValue) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        graph.stage owners.identities nested (.portable "0".toUTF8)
      let (graph, rightValue) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        graph.stage owners.identities dependent (.product #[innerValue])
      let (graph, result) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        graph.stage owners.identities request.origin (.product #[leftValue, rightValue])
      let some node := graph.find leftValue.value | throwError "the independent result is absent"
      unless node.references.map (·.value) == #[callable.value, index.value] && node.owners.isEmpty do
        throwError "an independent field lost argument visibility or acquired an unrelated owner"
      unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (graph.isAvailable owners result) do
        throwError "a result with a live argument index is unavailable"
      liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close codeOwner.generation
      unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (graph.isAvailable owners result) do
        throwError "completed portable data retained the supplying callable's unrelated owner"
      liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close owner.generation
      for value in #[rightValue, result] do
        if ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (graph.isAvailable owners value) then
          throwError "a dependent result survived loss of its actual argument index owner"
      for value in #[leftValue, innerValue] do
        unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (graph.isAvailable owners value) do
          throwError "a field independent of the argument index lost its usable value"
  finally
    liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close owner.generation
    liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close codeOwner.generation

-- Lazy access retains the original application's context across a later source telescope.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkNatLit 7))
  let zero ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkNatLit 0))
  let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let contextOwner ← liftM (m := IO) <| owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
  let indexOwner ← liftM (m := IO) <| owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
  let accessOwner ← liftM (m := IO) <| owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
  let extraOwner ← liftM (m := IO) <| owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
  try
    let token (connection : Connection) (text : String) : IO String := do
      connection.child.stdin.putStr (text ++ "\n")
      connection.child.stdin.flush
      return (← connection.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
    let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
    let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
    let (graph, contextValue) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
      (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] }
        (.ownedExport contextOwner (← liftM (m := IO) <| token contextOwner "context index") #[])
    let (graph, index) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] }
      (.ownedExport indexOwner (← liftM (m := IO) <| token indexOwner "argument index") #[])
    let (graph, extra) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] }
      (.ownedExport extraOwner (← liftM (m := IO) <| token extraOwner "unused later binding") #[])
    let (graph, number) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role := zero, parameters := #[] } (.portable "0".toUTF8)
    withLocalDeclD `n (mkConst ``Nat) fun n => do
      let nBinding : LocalBinding := { id := ⟨"lazy-origin", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := n }
      let nContext ← ContextTelescope.capture #[nBinding]
      let functionType ← withLocalDeclD `k (mkConst ``Nat) fun k => do
        let bound := mkApp2 (mkConst ``Nat.add) (mkApp2 (mkConst ``Nat.add) n k) (mkNatLit 1)
        mkForallFVars #[k] (← mkAppM ``Prod #[mkConst ``Nat, mkApp (mkConst ``Fin) bound])
      let closedFunctionType ← nContext.close functionType
      withLocalDeclD `f functionType fun f => do
        let fBinding : LocalBinding := { id := ⟨"lazy-origin", 1⟩, role := .parameter, expression := f }
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[nBinding, fBinding]
        let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close f)
        let (graph, callable) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
          { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[some contextValue, none] } (.closure program #[])
        let .ok parameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph nBinding.id contextValue
          | throwError "the original context value is outside its graph"
        let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 index
          | throwError "the original argument value is outside its graph"
        let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable
          #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7)] #[argument] #[parameter]
        let (graph, parent) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities request.origin
          (.ownedExport accessOwner (← liftM (m := IO) <| token accessOwner "lazy record") #[])
        let parentType ← inferType (← request.source.source.inContext context)
        let closedParentType ← context.close parentType
        withLCtx {} #[] do
          withLocalDeclD `n (mkConst ``Nat) fun shadow => do
            let extraBinding : LocalBinding := {
              id := ⟨"lazy-current", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := shadow }
            withLocalDeclD `n (mkConst ``Nat) fun currentN => do
              let currentNBinding := { nBinding with expression := currentN }
              let prefixContext ← ContextTelescope.capture #[extraBinding, currentNBinding]
              let functionType ← closedFunctionType.inContext prefixContext
              withLocalDeclD `f functionType fun currentF => do
                let currentFBinding := { fBinding with expression := currentF }
                let prefixContext ← ContextTelescope.capture #[extraBinding, currentNBinding, currentFBinding]
                let parentType ← closedParentType.inContext prefixContext
                withLocalDeclD `r parentType fun r => do
                  let resultBinding : LocalBinding := {
                    id := ⟨"lazy-current", 1⟩, role := .result, expression := r }
                  let current ← ContextTelescope.capture
                    #[extraBinding, currentNBinding, currentFBinding, resultBinding]
                  let .ok extraParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph extraBinding.id extra
                    | throwError "the later unrelated context value is absent"
                  let .ok resultParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph resultBinding.id parent
                    | throwError "the lazy result is absent"
                  let parameters := #[extraParameter, parameter, resultParameter]
                  let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker current parameters
                  let .ok (some retained) := environment.lookup resultBinding.id
                    | throwError "the later source binding lost the actual lazy result"
                  let fieldOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
                  let projection ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program fieldOccurrence current graph retained 1 parameters
                  let origin ← projection.originFor projection.source
                  let some application := origin.application
                    | throwError "the projected result lost its originating application"
                  let some access := origin.access
                    | throwError "the projected result lost its actual access operand"
                  unless origin.parameters.size == 4 && application.parameters.size == 2 &&
                      application.path == #[``Prod.snd] &&
                      application.contextDependencies == #[0] && application.dependencies == #[0] &&
                      (application.parameters[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some contextValue.value &&
                      (application.arguments[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some index.value &&
                      access.value == parent.value && (← access.role.source.inContext current) == r do
                    throwError "projection changed its source planes, path or actual later-bound operand"
                  let document := projection.observation.native.getObjValD "request"
                  let .ok observedContext :=
                      (document.getObjValD "environment").getObjValAs? (Array Json) "context"
                    | throwError "projection observation lost its complete current source context"
                  let expectedIds := #[
                    Json.mkObj [("session", toJson "lazy-current"), ("serial", toJson (0 : Nat))],
                    Json.mkObj [("session", toJson "lazy-origin"), ("serial", toJson (0 : Nat))],
                    Json.mkObj [("session", toJson "lazy-origin"), ("serial", toJson (1 : Nat))],
                    Json.mkObj [("session", toJson "lazy-current"), ("serial", toJson (1 : Nat))]]
                  let .ok readable :=
                      projection.observation.readable.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "context"
                    | throwError "projection observation lost its prepared readable context"
                  unless observedContext.map (·.getObjValD "id") == expectedIds &&
                      readable.map (·.getObjValD "id") == expectedIds &&
                      observedContext[0]?.map (·.getObjValD "name") == some (toJson "n") &&
                      observedContext[1]?.map (·.getObjValD "name") == some (toJson "n") do
                    throwError "observation merged shadowed names or omitted unused bindings"
                  let checkSourceAddress (prepared : PreparedRequest) (path : Array Name) :
                      MetaM Unit := do
                    let requestDocument := prepared.observation.native.getObjValD "request"
                    let nativeSource := requestDocument.getObjValD "source"
                    let nativeAddress := nativeSource.getObjValD "inputProjection"
                    let sourceText := prepared.observation.readable.getObjValD "source"
                    let readableAddress := sourceText.getObjValD "inputProjection"
                    let target := Json.mkObj [("context", expectedIds[3]!)]
                    let nativePath := Json.arr (path.map CasTools.NativeExpression.nameJson)
                    unless nativeAddress.getObjValD "target" == target &&
                        nativeAddress.getObjValD "path" == nativePath &&
                        readableAddress.getObjValD "target" == target &&
                        readableAddress.getObjValD "path" == nativePath &&
                        readableAddress.getObjValD "displayPath" ==
                          toJson (path.map (·.toString (escape := false))) do
                      throwError "projection observation changed its exact source binding or native path"
                  checkSourceAddress projection #[``Prod.snd]
                  let observedOrigin := document.getObjValD "origin"
                  let observedApplication := observedOrigin.getObjValD "application"
                  let observedAccess := (observedOrigin.getObjValD "access").getObjValD "reference"
                  unless (observedOrigin.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "parameters").toOption.map
                        (·.size) == some 4 &&
                      (observedApplication.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "parameters").toOption.map
                        (·.size) == some 2 &&
                      observedApplication.getObjValD "path" ==
                        Json.arr #[CasTools.NativeExpression.nameJson ``Prod.snd] &&
                      observedAccess.getObjValD "value" == Json.mkObj [
                        ("worker", toJson parent.value.worker),
                        ("serial", toJson parent.value.serial)] do
                    throwError "observation lost its final application or access origin"
                  let (projected, point) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
                    graph.stage owners.identities origin (.product #[number])
                  let .ok dependencies := projected.requiredOwners #[point]
                    | throwError "the projected result is outside its graph"
                  unless dependencies.contains contextOwner.generation &&
                      dependencies.contains indexOwner.generation &&
                      !dependencies.contains accessOwner.generation &&
                      !dependencies.contains extraOwner.generation do
                    throwError "lazy projection lost its original application context or argument dependencies"
                  let nestedOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
                  let nested ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program nestedOccurrence current
                    projected point 0 parameters
                  let innerOrigin ← nested.originFor nested.source
                  let some inner := innerOrigin.application
                    | throwError "the nested field lost its originating application"
                  unless inner.path == #[``Prod.snd, ``Fin.val] &&
                      inner.dependencies.isEmpty && inner.contextDependencies.isEmpty &&
                      innerOrigin.access.map (·.value) == some point.value do
                    throwError "nested projection changed its original path or independent role"
                  checkSourceAddress nested #[``Prod.snd, ``Fin.val]
                  let hidden ← liftM (m := IO) do
                    try
                      discard <| graph.stage owners.identities innerOrigin (.portable "0".toUTF8)
                      pure false
                    catch error =>
                      pure (error.toString.endsWith "the value reference is outside the visible graph")
                  unless hidden do
                    throwError "projection provenance recovered an access operand outside its snapshot"
                  let (projected, numeric) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
                    projected.stage owners.identities innerOrigin (.portable "0".toUTF8)
                  discard <| nested.environment.checkResult projected nested.source numeric
                  liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close accessOwner.generation
                  liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close extraOwner.generation
                  unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (projected.isAvailable owners point) do
                    throwError "a delivered dependent field retained its accessor or unrelated owner"
                  liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close contextOwner.generation
                  if ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (projected.isAvailable owners point) then
                    throwError "a projected dependent field survived its original context owner"
                  unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (projected.isAvailable owners numeric) do
                    throwError "the delivered numeric field acquired an unrelated source owner"
  finally
    liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close contextOwner.generation
    liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close indexOwner.generation
    liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close accessOwner.generation
    liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close extraOwner.generation

module

public import CasRuntime.PreparedRequest
public import CasRuntime.Transaction
public import CasRuntime.FixedInput

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler

private def fixedResultAt (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (source : SourceLayout) (value : ValueBinding) (fixed : Array FixedResult) (complete : Bool) :
    MetaM (Option FixedResult) := do
  let path ← request.source.projectionPathTo source
  if let some retained := fixed.find? (fun entry => entry.path.toList.isPrefixOf path.toList) then
    let suffix := path.extract retained.path.size path.size
    let selected := { retained.input with parent := retained.value, path := suffix }
    return some ⟨path, { retained.input with path := retained.input.path ++ suffix },
      ← selected.storedValue graph⟩
  if complete then return none
  let some input ← request.fixedInputFor graph source | return none
  let selected ← match ← input.storedValue? graph with
    | some selected => pure selected
    | none =>
      match ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.projectionBasis value input.parent input.path).mapError IO.userError with
      | some selected => pure selected
      | none => input.storedValue graph
  return some ⟨path, input, selected⟩

/-- Resolve the materialized portion of an existing result before opening a reply draft.
Lazy record descendants remain demands. The resolver is used only for lazy source-selected
inputs, with a fresh graph after each demand; stored inputs keep their original bindings. -/
partial def PreparedRequest.resolveFixedResults (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (source : SourceLayout) (value : ValueBinding)
    (resolve : Option (FixedInput → MetaM ValueBinding) := none) :
    MetaM (Array FixedResult) := do
  let select := fun (input : FixedInput) => do
    input.resolveValue (liftM (m := IO) transaction.view) resolve
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let input ← request.fixedInputFor graph source
  if let some input := input then
    let selected ← match ← input.storedValue? (← transaction.view) with
      | some selected => pure selected
      | none =>
        let graph ← transaction.view
        match ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.projectionBasis value input.parent input.path).mapError IO.userError with
        | some selected => pure selected
        | none => select input
    -- Existing replies must preserve the exact input before later fields are checked.
    -- Reuse the same baseline guard as association, without staging or changing a path.
    unless value.value == selected.value &&
        selected.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf value.associationIds.toList do
      CasCatalogue.throwStratum .malformed "the reply changed a fixed source input"
    return #[⟨← request.source.projectionPathTo source, input, selected⟩]
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let some node := graph.find value.value
    | throwError "the reused result is outside its isolated graph"
  let stored := node.payload.data.storedFields?.isSome
  if source.kind != .record || !stored then return #[]
  let mut fixed := #[]
  for prepared in (← RecordLayout.ofSource source).fields do
    if let some index := prepared.field.wireIndex then
      let graph ← transaction.view
      let actual ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.project value index).mapError IO.userError
      fixed := fixed ++ (← request.resolveFixedResults transaction prepared.layout actual resolve)
  return fixed

/-- Associate the descendants of one already fully checked candidate. Recursive validation
has checked every stored field before this private routine adds any consuming association. -/
private partial def associateCheckedResult (request : PreparedRequest) (supply : IdentitySupply)
    (source : SourceLayout) (draft : CellDraft) (candidate : CandidateResponse source)
    (fixed : Array FixedResult) (complete : Bool) :
    MetaM (CellDraft × ValueBinding) := do
  let retained ← fixedResultAt request draft.view source candidate.root fixed complete
  let mut draft := draft
  if let some retained := retained then
    unless candidate.root.value == retained.value.value &&
        retained.value.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf candidate.root.associationIds.toList do
      CasCatalogue.throwStratum .malformed "the reply changed a fixed source input"
    let input := retained.input
    if !input.path.isEmpty && (← IO.ofExcept <|
        (draft.view.projectedAccess? input.parent input.path).mapError IO.userError).isNone then
      -- Publish the original native input access before an output field can become the
      -- first full-path view. The saved baseline never acquires output associations.
      let currentDraft := draft
      draft ← input.source.withOpen fun bindings _ => do
        unless input.parameters.size == bindings.size do
          throwError "a fixed input lost its original complete source context"
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let mut parameters := #[]
        for (binding, value) in bindings.zip input.parameters do
          if let some value := value then
            let .ok parameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue currentDraft.view binding.id value
              | throwError "a fixed input parameter is outside its original graph"
            parameters := parameters.push parameter
        let sourceParameters := parameters
        let publishSource := fun (projection : PreparedRequest) (sourceDraft : CellDraft)
            (baseline : ValueBinding) => do
          let projection := projection.withSourceSnapshot request.observation.sourceSnapshot
          let .project parent field := projection.action
            | throwError "a fixed input lost its prepared native projection"
          let checked ← projection.environment.checkProjectionResult sourceDraft.view
            projection.source baseline parent field
          let (nextDraft, access) ← associateCheckedResult projection supply
            projection.source sourceDraft checked #[] true
          discard <| projection.admitResult nextDraft.view access
          return (nextDraft, access)
        let prepareField := fun (sourceDraft : CellDraft) (parent : ValueBinding)
            (projection : Name) => do
          let some index := parent.nativeRole.fields.findIdx? (·.projection == projection)
            | throwError "a fixed input lost its original native field position"
          PreparedRequest.forProjection supply request.program (← supply.fresh .occurrence)
            context sourceDraft.view parent index sourceParameters
        let frontier ← IO.ofExcept <|
          (currentDraft.view.projectionFrontier input.parent input.path).mapError IO.userError
        let some (parent, remaining) := frontier
          | throwError "a fixed input has no available native field interface"
        if !remaining.isEmpty then
          unless remaining.size == 1 do
            throwError "a fixed input has no independently available intermediate parent"
          let some _ ← IO.ofExcept <|
              (currentDraft.view.projectionBasis retained.value input.parent input.path).mapError IO.userError
            | throwError "a fixed input lost its exact original pending projection"
        let mut sourceDraft := currentDraft
        if input.path.size > 1 && !remaining.isEmpty then
          let sourcePrefix := input.path.extract 0 (input.path.size - 1)
          let projection ← PreparedRequest.forStoredProjection supply request.program
            (← supply.fresh .occurrence) context sourceDraft.view input.parent sourcePrefix sourceParameters
          let (nextDraft, parentAccess) ← publishSource projection sourceDraft parent
          sourceDraft := nextDraft
          let some last := input.path.back?
            | throwError "a fixed input lost its original final field"
          let projection ← prepareField sourceDraft parentAccess last
          let (nextDraft, _) ← publishSource projection sourceDraft retained.value
          sourceDraft := nextDraft
        let projection ← if input.path.size == 1 then do
            let some field := input.path[0]?
              | throwError "a fixed input lost its original native field"
            prepareField sourceDraft input.parent field
          else
            PreparedRequest.forStoredProjection supply request.program
              (← supply.fresh .occurrence) context sourceDraft.view input.parent input.path sourceParameters
        let (completedDraft, _) ← publishSource projection sourceDraft retained.value
        return completedDraft
  if request.origin.application.isNone && request.origin.access.isNone && retained.isNone then
    return (← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.retain candidate.root, candidate.root)
  let some node := draft.view.find candidate.root.value
    | throwError "the reused result is outside its isolated graph"
  let stored := node.payload.data.storedFields?.isSome
  let mut selected := #[]
  if source.kind == .record && stored then
    let layout ← RecordLayout.ofSource source
    let mut record ← RecordPrefix.prepare supply request.program request.occurrence layout
      draft.view request.environment.bound
    for prepared in layout.fields do
      if let some index := prepared.field.wireIndex then
        let actual ← IO.ofExcept <|
          (draft.view.project candidate.root index).mapError IO.userError
        let candidate ← IO.ofExcept <|
          (CandidateResponse.ofValue prepared.layout draft.view actual).mapError IO.userError
        let (nextDraft, binding) ← associateCheckedResult request supply prepared.layout draft
          candidate fixed complete
        let (nextDraft, nextRecord, binding) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
          nextDraft.bindField record binding
        draft := nextDraft
        record := nextRecord
        selected := selected.push binding
    discard <| IO.ofExcept <| record.finish.mapError IO.userError
  let origin ← request.originFor source (some draft.view)
  let mut value := candidate.root
  if let some retained := retained then
    if !retained.input.path.isEmpty then
      let original ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (draft.view.applicationOrigin retained.input.parent).mapError IO.userError
      let mut application := original
      for projection in retained.input.path do
        application ← application.mapM (·.forProjection projection)
      let inputOrigin : ValueOrigin := { origin with
        application := application
        access := some retained.input.parent
        accessPath := retained.input.path }
      let (next, selectedValue) ← draft.bindProjection inputOrigin value selected
      draft := next
      value := selectedValue
  if origin.access.isSome then
    draft.bindProjection origin value selected
  else if origin.application.isSome then
    liftM (m := IO) <| draft.bindApplication origin value selected
  else
    return (← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.retain value, value)

/-- Reuse exact nodes under the new application's native roles and actual dependencies.
The actual projection request supplies its one pending edge only during complete candidate
validation. Stored descendants are then associated in this isolated reply; ordinary result
admission rechecks their published paths before installation.
Reuse: originFor, RecordPrefix and immutable CellDraft association extensions. -/
def PreparedRequest.associateResult (request : PreparedRequest) (supply : IdentitySupply)
    (source : SourceLayout) (draft : CellDraft) (value : ValueBinding)
    (fixed : Array FixedResult := #[]) (complete : Bool := false) :
    MetaM (CellDraft × ValueBinding) := do
  let candidate ← match request.action with
    | .project operand field =>
      if source.address == request.source.address then
        request.environment.checkProjectionResult draft.view source value operand field
      else request.environment.checkResult draft.view source value
    | .primitive (.limitUniversal _ _) _ => do
      let fieldPrefix ← request.resultFieldPrefix draft.view value
      request.environment.checkResult draft.view source value fieldPrefix
    | .apply .. | .primitive .. => request.environment.checkResult draft.view source value
  associateCheckedResult request supply source draft candidate fixed complete

/-- Carry the authenticated source access into an assembled input result while its sealed
selection and the graph's projection cache retain the original baseline. A stored source
path without an earlier access is admitted through the ordinary original projection. -/
private def selectedInputView (request : PreparedRequest) (supply : IdentitySupply)
    (selected : FixedResult) (draft : CellDraft) : MetaM (CellDraft × ValueBinding) := do
  let input := selected.input
  if input.path.isEmpty then return (draft, selected.value)
  let existing ← IO.ofExcept <|
    (draft.view.projectedAccess? input.parent input.path).mapError IO.userError
  let (draft, access) ← match existing with
    | some access => pure (draft, access)
    | none => input.source.withOpen fun bindings _ => do
      unless input.parameters.size == bindings.size do
        throwError "a fixed input lost its original complete source context"
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let mut parameters := #[]
      for (binding, value) in bindings.zip input.parameters do
        if let some value := value then
          let parameter ← IO.ofExcept <|
            (RuntimeParameter.ofValue draft.view binding.id value).mapError IO.userError
          parameters := parameters.push parameter
      let projection ← PreparedRequest.forStoredProjection supply request.program
        (← supply.fresh .occurrence) context draft.view input.parent input.path parameters
      let projection := projection.withSourceSnapshot request.observation.sourceSnapshot
      let (draft, access) ← projection.associateResult supply projection.source draft
        selected.value #[] (complete := true)
      discard <| projection.admitResult draft.view access
      return (draft, access)
  let some baseline ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (draft.view.projectionBasis access input.parent input.path).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "an assembled input lost its exact original source access"
  unless baseline.value == selected.value.value &&
      baseline.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf selected.value.associationIds.toList &&
      selected.value.value == access.value &&
      selected.value.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf access.associationIds.toList do
    throwError "an assembled input access changed its original selected occurrence"
  return (draft, access)

private partial def assembleInputResult (request : PreparedRequest) (source : SourceLayout)
    (supply : IdentitySupply) (fixed : Array FixedResult) (draft : CellDraft) :
    MetaM (CellDraft × ValueBinding) := do
  let path ← request.source.projectionPathTo source
  if let some selected := fixed.find? (·.path == path) then
    return ← selectedInputView request supply selected draft
  unless source.kind == .record do
    throwError "the complete input result lost a prepared computational field"
  let layout ← RecordLayout.ofSource source
  let mut draft := draft
  let mut fields := #[]
  for prepared in layout.fields do
    if prepared.field.wireIndex.isNone then continue
    let (nextDraft, value) ← assembleInputResult request prepared.layout supply fixed draft
    draft := nextDraft
    fields := fields.push value
  -- The original views are checked against the complete actual result prefix first.
  -- associateCheckedResult alone adds the result's new consuming field associations.
  liftM (m := IO) <| draft.stage (← request.originFor source (some draft.view)) (.product fields)

/-- Assemble the complete source-selected result after all selected lazy inputs have settled.
Validate its stored fields together with their actual native prefixes before adding consuming
associations. The isolated draft remains unpublished until the complete result is admitted.
Reuse: RecordPrefix, whole-result associateResult and the sealed input-result admission check. -/
def ResolvedInputResult.assemble (resolved : ResolvedInputResult request)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) : MetaM (CellDraft × InputResultCompletion request) := do
  let traced := (request.source.source.expression.find? (·.isConstOf `CasCatalogue.Modules.CatalogueRegistration.modulesFibreInclusionDeclaration)).isSome
  let draft ← transaction.draft
  if traced then CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[inclusion.stage] assembly {repr request.occurrence}: before raw tree"
  let (draft, value) ← assembleInputResult request request.source transaction.owners.identities
    resolved.selections draft
  if traced then CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[inclusion.stage] assembly {repr request.occurrence}: before whole association"
  let (draft, value) ← request.associateResult transaction.owners.identities
    request.source draft value resolved.selections (complete := true)
  if traced then CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[inclusion.stage] assembly {repr request.occurrence}: before result admission"
  let response ← request.admitResult draft.view value
  if traced then CasTools.Diagnostics.message m!"[inclusion.stage] assembly {repr request.occurrence}: result admitted"
  let completed ← IO.ofExcept <| (resolved.admit draft.view response).mapError IO.userError
  return (draft, completed)

end CasRuntime

module

public import CasRuntime.Connection
public import CasContract.Registration
public import CasContract.Failure
public import Lean.Meta

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- Negotiated backend processes for one loaded manifest. -/
structure BackendConnections where
  private mk ::
  private owners : OwnerRegistry
  private root : System.FilePath
  private programs : Array BackendProgram
  private timeoutMs : UInt32
  private active : IO.Ref (Std.HashMap String FramedConnection)

def BackendConnections.new (owners : OwnerRegistry) (root : System.FilePath)
    (programs : Array BackendProgram) (timeoutMs : UInt32) : IO BackendConnections :=
  return ⟨owners, root, programs, timeoutMs, ← IO.mkRef {}⟩

opaque BackendConnections.close (connections : BackendConnections) : IO Unit := do
  for (_, wire) in (← connections.active.get).toList do wire.close
  connections.active.set {}

/-- Start and negotiate a declared backend at its first use. A closed process is not restarted. -/
def BackendConnections.get (connections : BackendConnections) (backend : String) :
    MetaM FramedConnection := do
  if let some wire := (← connections.active.get)[backend]? then return wire
  let some program := connections.programs.find? (·.name == backend)
    | do
      let error := PortError.unavailable backend "not declared in the manifest"
      throwStratum error.stratum error.render
  let portPython ← IO.FS.realPath ((← packageDir contractPackage) / "python")
  let path := match ← IO.getEnv "PYTHONPATH" with
    | some inherited => s!"{portPython}:{inherited}"
    | none => portPython.toString
  let started ← FramedConnection.start connections.owners backend {
    cmd := program.command, args := program.args, cwd := some connections.root
    env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some path)] } connections.timeoutMs
  match started with
  | .error error => throwStratum error.stratum error.render
  | .ok wire =>
    connections.active.modify (·.insert backend wire)
    return wire

/-- Resolve the original supplying generation of a retained export. -/
def BackendConnections.ofOwner (connections : BackendConnections) (owner : ConnectionGeneration) :
    MetaM FramedConnection := do
  for (_, wire) in (← connections.active.get).toList do
    if wire.connection.generation == owner then return wire
  throwStratum .unavailable "stale_owner"

end CasRuntime
