namespace CasRuntime.BindingIdentityTests

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Language

private def statement (session : SourceSession) (text : String) :
    TermElabM SourceStatement := do
  let file ← SourceFile.parse "binding-identities.cas" text
  let #[item] := file.items
    | throwError "the binder control changed its original statement count"
  let `(cas_item| $source:cas_stmt) := item
    | throwError "the binder control changed its public statement syntax"
  file.withContext <| session.readStatement source

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the binder control's original source term did not parse"
  return ⟨parsed⟩

private def nativeTerm (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | throwError "the binder control's native function type did not parse"
  return ⟨parsed⟩

-- The original public declarations have the same displayed name, but independent
-- native identities. Reopening and shadowing preserve the first source occurrence.
-- Native aliases retain actual captured values, not a value found by its display name.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
  discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
  let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
  let firstOwner ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
  let secondOwner ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
  try
    let empty ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
    let .assumption firstSource ← statement empty "let x ∈ ℤ"
      | throwError "the original abstract element did not remain a native parameter"
    let some firstEntry := firstSource.context.entries.back?
      | throwError "the first source parameter lost its native identity"
    let firstTerm ← firstSource.read (← sourceTerm "x")
    let .definition aliasSource _ ← statement firstSource "let saved := x"
      | throwError "the original source alias did not retain a native definition"
    let some aliasEntry := aliasSource.context.entries.back?
      | throwError "the source alias lost its original native binding"
    let .assumption shadowSource ← statement aliasSource "let x ∈ ℤ"
      | throwError "the shadowing element did not remain a native parameter"
    let some secondEntry := shadowSource.context.entries.back?
      | throwError "the shadowing source parameter lost its native identity"
    let shadowTerm ← shadowSource.read (← sourceTerm "x")
    let aliasTerm ← shadowSource.read (← sourceTerm "saved")
    unless firstEntry.id != secondEntry.id && firstEntry.userName == `x &&
        secondEntry.userName == `x && aliasEntry.userName == `saved do
      throwError "source shadowing changed display names or reused an earlier binding identity"

    let lower := fun (term : SourceTerm) => term.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      kernel.run producer context {} expression
        (selections := ← term.selections.inContext context)
    let firstSymbol ← lower firstTerm
    let secondSymbol ← lower shadowTerm
    let aliasSymbol ← lower aliasTerm
    let reopenedSymbol ← shadowTerm.source.withOpen fun bindings _ => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let earlier ← firstTerm.source.inContext context
      let some retained := bindings.find? (·.id == firstEntry.id)
        | throwError "context reopening lost the original shadowed binder"
      unless earlier == retained.expression do
        throwError "context transport changed the earlier binder to its same-named successor"
      kernel.run producer context {} earlier
        (selections := ← shadowTerm.selections.inContext context)
    let symbolId := fun (value : ValueBinding) => do
      let .ok (some packet) := (← producer.view).packet? value
        | throwError "the formal parameter did not retain its portable symbol descriptor"
      let .ok constructor := packet.getObjValAs? String "ctor"
        | throwError "the original symbol descriptor lost its constructor"
      let .ok arguments := packet.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "args"
        | throwError "the original symbol descriptor lost its argument array"
      let #[.str identity] := arguments
        | throwError "the original symbol descriptor changed its one-string wire grammar"
      unless constructor == "variable" do
        throwError "the original formal parameter changed its wire constructor"
      return identity
    let firstIdentity ← symbolId firstSymbol
    let secondIdentity ← symbolId secondSymbol
    unless firstIdentity == s!"{firstEntry.id.session}:{firstEntry.id.serial}" &&
        secondIdentity == s!"{secondEntry.id.session}:{secondEntry.id.serial}" &&
        firstIdentity != secondIdentity &&
        (← symbolId reopenedSymbol) == firstIdentity &&
        (← symbolId aliasSymbol) == firstIdentity do
      throwError "formal wire identity changed under shadowing, native aliasing or reopening"

    -- Both tokens are opaque actual parameter values from distinct live owners.
    -- They supply no arithmetic result or mathematical assertion.
    let firstToken ← liftM (m := IO) do
      firstOwner.child.stdin.putStr "first captured parameter\n"
      firstOwner.child.stdin.flush
      return (← firstOwner.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
    let secondToken ← liftM (m := IO) do
      secondOwner.child.stdin.putStr "second shadowed parameter\n"
      secondOwner.child.stdin.flush
      return (← secondOwner.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
    let stage := fun (term : SourceTerm) (payload : ValuePayload) =>
      term.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let selections ← term.selections.inContext context
        let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker context #[]
          (selections := selections)
        let origin ← environment.origin (← owners.identities.fresh .program)
          (← kernel.ledger.allocate) (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close expression)
            (selections := ← selections.close context))
        producer.stage origin payload
    let firstValue ← stage firstTerm (.ownedExport firstOwner firstToken #[])
    let secondValue ← stage shadowTerm (.ownedExport secondOwner secondToken #[])
    let bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding :=
      ({} : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding).insert firstEntry.id firstValue
        |>.insert secondEntry.id secondValue
    unless (bound[aliasEntry.id]?).isNone do
      throwError "the native-alias control accidentally supplied its own runtime binding"

    let type ← shadowSource.term (← nativeTerm "Int → Int")
    let function ← shadowSource.read (← sourceTerm "t ↦ saved") (some type.source)
      type.selections
    let callable ← function.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      kernel.run producer context bound expression
        (selections := ← function.selections.inContext context)
    let graph ← producer.view
    let .ok code := graph.callable callable
      | throwError "the source lambda lost its actual callable"
    let some node := graph.find code.value
      | throwError "the source lambda lost its retained native code"
    let .closure program captures := node.payload.data
      | throwError "the source lambda was replaced by another computational interface"
    let #[capture] := captures
      | throwError "a native alias lost or enlarged its exact earlier capture"
    unless capture.value == firstValue.value &&
        capture.associationIds == firstValue.associationIds &&
        capture.value != secondValue.value do
      throwError "the native alias captured the shadowing value instead of its original occurrence"
    let some (.term retainedSource _) := (← kernel.codes.get)[program]?
      | throwError "the source lambda lost its original closed term"
    unless retainedSource.context.exactlyMatches function.source.context &&
        retainedSource.expression.equal function.source.expression do
      throwError "closure capture changed the complete original source or native telescope"
    let .ok dependencies := graph.requiredOwners #[callable]
      | throwError "the original closure capture is outside its active graph"
    unless dependencies == #[firstOwner.generation] do
      throwError "the closure did not retain exactly the owner of its original alias capture"

    let functions ← shadowSource.defineTerm `f function
    let some functionEntry := functions.context.entries.back?
      | throwError "the source function lost its original definition binding"
    let applied ← functions.read (← sourceTerm "f(saved)")
    let consuming := bound.insert functionEntry.id callable
    let .ok _ ← producer.commit
      | throwError "the source closure and its actual input values did not publish"
    owners.close secondOwner.generation
    let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
    try
      let result ← applied.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        kernel.run consumer context consuming expression
          (selections := ← applied.selections.inContext context)
      unless result.value == firstValue.value &&
          firstValue.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf result.associationIds.toList do
        throwError "the actual source application replaced its original captured value"
      unless ← (← consumer.view).isAvailable owners callable do
        throwError "an unused shadowing owner invalidated the original closure"
      let .ok _ ← consumer.commit
        | throwError "the source application could not publish its original captured result"
    finally discard <| consumer.abort
    owners.close firstOwner.generation
    let unavailable ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
    try
      unless !(← (← unavailable.view).isAvailable owners callable) do
        throwError "the closed original capture remained available after its owner retired"
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| applied.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
          let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
          kernel.run unavailable context consuming expression
            (selections := ← applied.selections.inContext context)
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure
        | throwError "an actual application consumed its retired captured owner"
      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .unavailable do throw failure
    finally discard <| unavailable.abort
    unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
      throwError "native binder identity or capture preservation dispatched an external operation"
  finally
    discard <| producer.abort
    owners.close firstOwner.generation
    owners.close secondOwner.generation
    kernel.close
    setEnv original

-- An opaque runtime binder promises an actual captured reference. Its native expression
-- stays type-correct if the bound entry is lost, so source closure alone cannot check it.
-- Preserve the ordinary complete capture; reject its absence before code or graph admission.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
  discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
  let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let source := mkNatLit 7
    let actual ← kernel.run transaction context {} source
    withBoundValue owners.identities context {} source actual fun context bound retainedSource => do
      let callable ← withLocalDeclD `unused (mkConst ``Unit) fun argument =>
        mkLambdaFVars #[argument] retainedSource
      checkWithKernel callable
      let retained ← kernel.run transaction context bound callable
      let graph ← transaction.view
      let some node := graph.find retained.value
        | throwError "the ordinary bound closure was not retained"
      let .closure _ captures := node.payload.data
        | throwError "the bound native function lost its callable code"
      unless captures.map (·.value) == #[actual.value] do
        throwError "the bound native function lost its exact actual capture"
      let codeCount := (← kernel.codes.get).size
      let emptyEnvironment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context {} graph
      let missingReference : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| emptyEnvironment.hasRetainedSource context retainedSource
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some missingReference := missingReference
        | throwError "a missing actual occurrence was treated as a source-only parameter"
      unless (← missingReference.toMessageData.toString).endsWith
          "the source lost a retained runtime binding" do throw missingReference
      -- Removing the actual bound entry changes no native mathematical type or term.
      checkWithKernel callable
      let failed : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| kernel.run transaction context {} callable
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failed := failed
        | throwError "a closure silently discarded its missing actual runtime capture"
      unless (← failed.toMessageData.toString).endsWith
          "the source lost a retained runtime binding" do throw failed
      unless graph.sameRevision (← transaction.view) &&
          (← kernel.codes.get).size == codeCount && (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "a lost capture published closure code, graph data or an external demand"
  finally
    discard <| transaction.abort
    kernel.close
    setEnv original

-- Two equal defining expressions supply different original occurrences. Projection,
-- native let substitution and a later callable demand must preserve their chosen position.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
  discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
  let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let seven := mkNatLit 7
    let first ← kernel.run producer context {} seven
    let second ← kernel.run producer context {} seven
    unless first.value != second.value do
      throwError "equal-source control did not produce distinct runtime occurrences"
    withBoundValue owners.identities context {} seven first fun context bound firstSource => do
      withBoundValue owners.identities context bound seven second fun context bound secondSource => do
        unless firstSource.isFVar && secondSource.isFVar && firstSource != secondSource do
          throwError "equal defining expressions lost their distinct native runtime binders"
        let pairSource ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[firstSource, secondSource]
        let pair ← kernel.run producer context bound pairSource
        withBoundValue owners.identities context bound pairSource pair fun context bound pairSource => do
          let projected ← kernel.run producer context bound (mkProj ``Prod 0 pairSource)
          unless projected.value == first.value && projected.value != second.value do
            throwError "projection substituted the equal-valued sibling occurrence"
          let substituted ← withLetDecl `samePair (← inferType pairSource) pairSource fun aliasValue =>
            mkLetFVars #[aliasValue] (mkProj ``Prod 0 aliasValue) (usedLetOnly := false)
          let substituted ← kernel.run producer context bound substituted
          unless substituted.value == first.value && substituted.value != second.value do
            throwError "native substitution changed the selected original field occurrence"
          let callableSource ← withLocalDeclD `unused (mkConst ``Nat) fun unused =>
            mkLambdaFVars #[unused] (mkProj ``Prod 1 pairSource)
          let callable ← kernel.run producer context bound callableSource
          withBoundValue owners.identities context bound callableSource callable
              fun context bound callableSource => do
            let application ← context.close (mkApp callableSource firstSource)
            let .ok _ ← producer.commit
              | throwError "the equal-source producer did not publish its complete captured context"
            let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
            try
              let result ← application.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
                kernel.run consumer (← ContextTelescope.capture bindings) bound expression
              unless result.value == second.value && result.value != first.value do
                throwError "a later call replaced its captured field with an equal input"
              let .ok _ ← consumer.commit
                | throwError "the later call did not preserve its original captured result"
            finally discard <| consumer.abort
    unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
      throwError "runtime occurrence preservation dispatched an external mathematical operation"
  finally
    discard <| producer.abort
    kernel.close
    setEnv original

-- Losing a selected row is not a new symbolic assumption. The original public reader
-- supplies the complete positive; each negative removes only that exact binder's typed row.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
  discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
  let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
  try
    let empty ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
    let selected ← empty.read (← sourceTerm "ℤ")
    selected.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let selections ← selected.selections.inContext context
      let some sourceBinding := bindings.find? (·.expression == expression)
        | throwError "the public object lost its explicit typed source binder"
      unless sourceBinding.role == .selectedStructure && selections.contains sourceBinding.id do
        throwError "the public object lost its complete selected source role"
      discard <| kernel.run transaction context {} expression (selections := selections)
      let graph ← transaction.view
      let codeCount := (← kernel.codes.get).size
      let broken := selections.erase sourceBinding.id
      let expectMissing := fun (action : MetaM Unit) => do
        let failed : Option Exception ← try
          action
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
        let some failed := failed
          | throwError "a missing typed selection became a source-only native value"
        unless (← failed.toMessageData.toString).endsWith
            "the source lost its retained typed selection" do throw failed
      expectMissing do
        discard <| boundSourceReferences (some graph) context {} expression broken
      expectMissing do
        let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context {} graph
          (selections := broken)
        discard <| environment.hasRetainedSource context expression
      expectMissing do
        let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context {} graph
          (selections := broken)
        discard <| environment.endpointValue? context graph expression
      expectMissing do
        discard <| kernel.run transaction context {} expression (selections := broken)
      unless graph.sameRevision (← transaction.view) &&
          (← kernel.codes.get).size == codeCount && (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "a lost typed selection published graph data, code or an external demand"
  finally
    discard <| transaction.abort
    kernel.close
    setEnv original


-- The public session commits every actual occurrence and later use. Native definitions
-- supply only generic source functions, as in UnpublishedOperationTests; no runtime
-- binding is seeded. The equal literals must remain distinct through original fields,
-- native substitution and a later call which receives the other equal occurrence.
public meta opaque observePublicOccurrences (path : System.FilePath)
    (definition : String := "nativeSeven")
    (expectedDispatches : Array (String × String × String) := #[])
    (nativeType : String := "Nat") : TermElabM Unit := do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let initial ← KernelSession.start (some path) (computationOnly := true)
    try
      unless initial.kernel.rejected.isEmpty do
        throwError "the public occurrence control lost an admitted peer registration"
      let mut source := initial.source
      for (name, body) in #[
          (`nativeSeven, "(7 : Nat)"),
          (`nativePair, s!"fun (left right : {nativeType}) => (left, right)"),
          (`nativeFirst, s!"fun (pair : {nativeType} × {nativeType}) => pair.1"),
          (`nativeSubstituted, s!"fun (pair : {nativeType} × {nativeType}) => let samePair := pair; samePair.1"),
          (`nativePick, s!"fun (pair : {nativeType} × {nativeType}) (_ : {nativeType}) => pair.2")] do
        source ← source.define name (← nativeTerm body)
      let mut session := { initial with source }
      let runStatement := fun (session : KernelSession) (text : String) => do
        let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text
          | throwError "the public occurrence statement did not parse: {text}"
        withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨parsed⟩
      let mut retained : Array (BindingId × ValueBinding) := #[]
      for (name, text) in #[
          (`first, s!"let first := {definition}"),
          (`second, s!"let second := {definition}"),
          (`pair, "let pair := nativePair(first, second)"),
          (`projected, "let projected := nativeFirst(pair)"),
          (`alias, "let alias := pair"),
          (`substituted, "let substituted := nativeSubstituted(alias)"),
          (`pick, "let pick := nativePick(pair)"),
          (`later, "let later := pick(first)")] do
        let run ← runStatement session text
        unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" && run.attempted && run.published do
          throwError "the public occurrence statement did not commit: {text}: {run.outcome.detail}"
        session := run.session
        let some entry := (← SourceTest.authoredEntries
            session.source.context session.source.selections).back?
          | throwError "the public occurrence statement lost its authored declaration"
        unless entry.userName == name do
          throwError "the public occurrence statement changed its original result binding"
        let some value := session.value? entry.id
          | throwError "the public occurrence statement lost its actual computed reference"
        retained := retained.push (entry.id, value)
      let #[first, second, pair, projected, aliasValue, substituted, pick, later] := retained
        | throwError "the public occurrence control changed its original statement count"
      unless first.1 != second.1 && first.2.value != second.2.value do
        throwError "equal public definitions shared one source or runtime occurrence"
      unless retainsReference first.2 projected.2 && retainsReference first.2 substituted.2 &&
          projected.2.value != second.2.value && substituted.2.value != second.2.value &&
          retainsReference pair.2 aliasValue.2 &&
          retainsReference second.2 later.2 && later.2.value != first.2.value do
        throwError "a public projection, substitution or later call changed its chosen occurrence"
      let published ← SessionSnapshot.current
      for (_, value) in retained do
        unless (published.graph.find value.value).isSome do
          throwError "a public occurrence did not survive its publication boundary"
      let .ok (some firstPacket) := published.graph.packet? first.2
        | throwError "the first public literal lost its admitted descriptor"
      let .ok (some secondPacket) := published.graph.packet? second.2
        | throwError "the second public literal lost its admitted descriptor"
      unless firstPacket == secondPacket do
        throwError "the distinct-occurrence control no longer has equal actual literals"
      let .ok _ := published.graph.callable pick.2
        | throwError "the public delayed projection lost its retained callable"
      let implemented ← runStatement session "assert implemented later"
      unless implemented.outcome.kind == "holds" && implemented.published do
        throwError "the committed original field could not be demanded by a later public statement"
      session := implemented.session
      unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).map
          (fun registration => (registration.operation, registration.input, registration.backend)) ==
            expectedDispatches do
        throwError "public occurrence preservation changed its actual registered dispatches"

      -- Corrupt exactly one retained source selection at a time. Even an already bound
      -- object must fail in the reader, before a runtime cell or dispatch is entered.
      let objectRun ← runStatement session "let R := ℤ"
      unless objectRun.outcome.kind == "holds" && objectRun.published do
        throwError "the ordinary public selected object did not commit: {objectRun.outcome.detail}"
      session := objectRun.session
      let selected := session.source.context.entries.filter (·.role == .selectedStructure)
      unless !selected.isEmpty do
        throwError "the ordinary public object did not retain a typed selection binder"
      let .ok reuse := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt "let reused := R"
        | throwError "the ordinary public object reuse did not parse"
      for entry in selected do
        unless session.source.selections.contains entry.id do
          throwError "the original public source was already missing a selected row"
        let brokenSource := { session.source with
          selections := session.source.selections.erase entry.id }
        let broken := { session with source := brokenSource }
        let before ← SessionSnapshot.current
        let codeCount := (← session.kernel.codes.get).size
        let dispatchCount := (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).size
        let failure : Option Exception ← try
          discard <| broken.source.readStatement ⟨reuse⟩
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
        let some failure := failure
          | throwError "the reader accepted a public source with a missing selected row"
        unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag (· == `CasCompiler.SourceReadM.missingSelection) do
          throw failure
        let failed ← withoutErrToSorry <| broken.run ⟨reuse⟩
        let .internal message := failed.outcome
          | throwError "the public boundary changed the missing-selection reader failure"
        unless message.endsWith "the source lost its retained typed selection" &&
            !failed.attempted && !failed.published &&
            failed.session.source.context.exactlyMatches session.source.context &&
            !failed.session.source.selections.contains entry.id &&
            failed.session.source.selections.size + 1 == session.source.selections.size do
          throwError "a missing public source selection entered execution or changed its original scope"
        unless before.graph.sameRevision (← SessionSnapshot.current).graph &&
            (← session.kernel.codes.get).size == codeCount &&
            (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).size == dispatchCount do
          throwError "a reader-rejected selected source changed graph, code or dispatch state"
    finally initial.close
  finally setEnv original

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let root ← IO.currentDir
  IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
  let path := root / ".tmp/kernel-binding-identity-empty-leaves.json"
  IO.FS.writeFile path
    (Json.mkObj [("backends", .arr #[]), ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
  observePublicOccurrences path

end CasRuntime.BindingIdentityTests

public import CasContract.Port
public import CasCatalogue.GraphData
public import CasRuntime.Owner

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- Data used only for finite framing. Portable references use their actual packets;
nonportable values retain original node/association identity. Transport slots stay unchanged. -/
inductive CallableDatum where
  | literal (value : Json)
  | reference (value : RuntimeId .value) (associations : Array (RuntimeId .association))
  | exported (owner : ConnectionGeneration) (token : String)
      (captures : Array (RuntimeId .value × Array (RuntimeId .association)))
  | array (values : Array CallableDatum)
  | object (values : Array (String × CallableDatum))
  deriving BEq

/-- Complete public callable data, with its released representation framing already checked.
This evidence supplies no executable code and asserts no correctness of the returned map. -/
structure CallablePacket where
  private mk ::
  value : Json

/-- Admit the released finite graph alternatives at complete actual computational endpoints.
An explicit finiteGraph inventory is data supplied by the producer; when the independently
retained domain also has an inventory, both must describe the same complete computational set.
Graph order is immaterial. This gate never supplies a missing computation or executes a graph. -/
opaque CallablePacket.finiteWith (value : Json)
    (domain target : Option (Array CallableDatum))
    (view : Json → Array InputPathStep → Except String CallableDatum) :
    Except String CallablePacket := do
  let mut graph := value
  let mut graphPath := #[]
  let mut actualDomain := domain
  if (value.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "finiteGraph" then
    checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] value
    let #[inventory, body] ← (← value.getObjVal? "args").getArr?
      | throw "finiteGraph requires its actual domain inventory and complete graph"
    let inventory ← (← inventory.getArr?).mapIdxM fun index point =>
      view point #[.field "args", .index 0, .index index]
    CasCatalogue.GraphData.validateInventory inventory
    if let some domain := domain then
      CasCatalogue.GraphData.validateInventory domain
      unless domain.size == inventory.size && inventory.all domain.contains do
        throw "the finite graph changed its selected actual domain inventory"
    actualDomain := some inventory
    graph := body
    graphPath := #[.field "args", .index 1]
  let some domain := actualDomain
    | throw "a finite graph requires its complete actual domain inventory"
  let pairs ← (← CasCatalogue.GraphData.pairs graph).mapIdxM fun index (input, output) => do
    return (← view input (graphPath ++ #[.index index, .index 0]),
      ← view output (graphPath ++ #[.index index, .index 1]))
  CasCatalogue.GraphData.validateEndpoints domain target pairs
  return ⟨value⟩

/-- Literal-only specialization of the same gate. Scoped replies use finiteWith. -/
def CallablePacket.finite (value : Json) (domain target : Option (Array Json)) :
    Except String CallablePacket :=
  CallablePacket.finiteWith value (domain.map (·.map CallableDatum.literal))
    (target.map (·.map CallableDatum.literal)) fun value _ => pure (.literal value)

/-- Frame a released symbolic callable without interpreting its mathematical operands.
The prepared native source validator must separately check the actual scoped operands,
selected declarations and complete endpoints before this packet is stored at a callable role.
Named descriptors retain their public row and full ordered arguments; this gate does not
invent a closed catalogue of declarations or compare the answer with the requested term. -/
opaque CallablePacket.symbolic (value : Json) : Except String CallablePacket := do
  checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] value
  let tag ← value.getObjValAs? String "ctor"
  let args ← (← value.getObjVal? "args").getArr?
  if tag.isEmpty then throw "a symbolic callable requires its complete public descriptor"
  if #["scopeRef", "inputRef", "resultRef", "opaqueData", "deferredData", "valueData",
      "typedMap", "finiteGraph"].contains tag then
    throw "the callable representation must use its own released admission boundary"
  if #["identity", "zero", "compose", "map"].contains tag then
    unless args.size == 2 do
      throw "a symbolic map requires both complete ordered operands"
  else if tag == "cellComponent" then
    discard <| CellComponent.decode value
  else if tag == "constructedCellComponent" then
    discard <| ConstructedCellComponent.decode value
  else if tag == "cartesianMap" then
    discard <| CartesianMap.decode value
  else if tag == "presentation" then
    let #[name, parameters, inverse] := args
      | throw "a presentation map requires its id, parameters and direction"
    if (← name.getStr?).isEmpty then throw "a presentation map has no declared id"
    discard parameters.getArr?
    discard inverse.getBool?
  else if tag == "constructionLeg" then
    let #[name, _, _, _] := args
      | throw "a construction leg requires its id, original diagram, complete result and typed index"
    if (← name.getStr?).isEmpty then throw "a construction leg has no declared limit id"
  return ⟨value⟩

/-- Frame only the existing retained-reference or export alternatives. The live reply
parser must still authenticate their exact scope position, owner and capture table. -/
opaque CallablePacket.retained (value : Json) : Except String CallablePacket := do
  checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] value
  if (← ScopedReference.parse? value).isSome then return ⟨value⟩
  let .opaque _ ← ComputationalValue.decode value
    | throw "a retained callable requires its original scoped reference or native export"
  return ⟨value⟩

/-- Preserve an original inline envelope around its already framed complete callable.
This checks packet containment only; it introduces no scope or native value authority. -/
opaque CallablePacket.inline (packet : CallablePacket) (value : Json) :
    Except String CallablePacket := do
  checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] value
  let .inline data ← ComputationalValue.decode value
    | throw "the callable wrapper is not its original inline envelope"
  unless data == packet.value do
    throw "the inline wrapper changed its complete admitted callable"
  return ⟨value⟩
/-- Retain the complete original typedMap around already framed callable data. -/
opaque CallablePacket.withMap (packet : CallablePacket) (value : Json) :
    Except String CallablePacket := do
  checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] value
  let map ← TypedMap.decode value
  unless map.callable == packet.value do
    throw "the callable wrapper changed its complete admitted field"
  return ⟨value⟩

/-- Read only an inventory explicitly retained in public object data. Its descriptor remains
part of that same object packet; callers authenticate the actual endpoint before using this.
Other descriptors supply no inventory here, even when a formal carrier is known to be finite. -/
partial def callableEndpointInventory (value : Json) : Except String (Option (Array Json)) := do
  match (value.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption with
  | some "valueData" =>
    checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] value
    let #[data] ← (← value.getObjVal? "args").getArr?
      | throw "valueData requires its complete actual object data"
    callableEndpointInventory data
  | some "finiteData" =>
    checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] value
    let #[_, inventory] ← (← value.getObjVal? "args").getArr?
      | throw "finiteData requires its complete object descriptor and actual inventory"
    let inventory ← inventory.getArr?
    CasCatalogue.GraphData.validateInventory inventory
    return some inventory
  | _ => return none

end CasRuntime

import CasRuntime.CallablePacket
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.CallablePacket

open Lean CasRuntime

-- Complete released callable framing is checked independently of mathematical correctness.
-- No callable is applied, and no native function is reconstructed from a graph.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let domain := #[toJson (0 : Nat), toJson (1 : Nat)]
  let target := #[toJson (3 : Nat), toJson (4 : Nat)]
  let graph := Json.arr #[Json.arr #[domain[1]!, target[0]!],
    Json.arr #[domain[0]!, target[1]!]]
  let explicit := Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "finiteGraph"),
    ("args", Json.arr #[Json.arr domain.reverse, graph])]
  for packet in #[graph, explicit] do
    let .ok admitted := CallablePacket.finite packet (some domain) (some target)
      | throwError "complete original-domain callable data were rejected"
    unless admitted.value == packet do
      throwError "callable admission rewrote the original graph or inventory order"
  let .ok admitted := CallablePacket.finite explicit none none
    | throwError "an explicit complete actual inventory was discarded"
  unless admitted.value == explicit do
    throwError "explicit callable framing replaced the supplied map"
  let incomplete := Json.arr #[Json.arr #[domain[0]!, target[0]!]]
  let repeated := Json.arr #[Json.arr #[domain[0]!, target[0]!],
    Json.arr #[domain[0]!, target[1]!]]
  let foreign := Json.arr #[Json.arr #[domain[0]!, target[0]!],
    Json.arr #[toJson (2 : Nat), target[1]!]]
  let outOfRange := Json.arr #[Json.arr #[domain[0]!, target[0]!],
    Json.arr #[domain[1]!, toJson (5 : Nat)]]
  let wrongInventory := Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "finiteGraph"),
    ("args", Json.arr #[Json.arr #[domain[0]!], incomplete])]
  let duplicateInventory := Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "finiteGraph"),
    ("args", Json.arr #[Json.arr #[domain[0]!, domain[0]!], repeated])]
  for packet in #[incomplete, repeated, foreign, outOfRange, wrongInventory,
      duplicateInventory, Json.arr #[Json.arr #[domain[0]!]], toJson (7 : Nat)] do
    if (CallablePacket.finite packet (some domain) (some target)).isOk then
      throwError "an incomplete or malformed callable acquired a function interface"
  if (CallablePacket.finite graph none none).isOk then
    throwError "an unframed graph invented its complete computational domain"
  let object := Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "finiteData"),
    ("args", Json.arr #[Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "retainedEndpoint"),
      ("args", Json.arr #[])], Json.arr domain])]
  unless callableEndpointInventory object == .ok (some domain) do
    throwError "an original finiteData inventory was not retained"
  let duplicateObject := Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "finiteData"),
    ("args", Json.arr #[toJson "actual endpoint", Json.arr #[domain[0]!, domain[0]!]])]
  if (callableEndpointInventory duplicateObject).isOk then
    throwError "a repeated object inventory was admitted"

  let node := fun (tag : String) (args : Array Json) =>
    Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson tag), ("args", .arr args)]
  let endpoint := node "retainedEndpoint" #[]
  let retained := (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode
  let symbolic := #[
    node "identity" #[endpoint, endpoint],
    node "zero" #[endpoint, endpoint],
    node "compose" #[retained, retained],
    node "map" #[node "functor.actual" #[], retained],
    node "morphism.actual" #[retained],
    node "cellComponent" #["cell.actual", .arr #[retained], retained, toJson false],
    node "constructedCellComponent" #[.arr #["constructor.actual"],
      node "cellComponent" #["cell.actual", .arr #[], retained, toJson true]],
    node "cartesianMap" #["functor.reindex", .arr #[retained], retained],
    node "presentation" #["comparison.actual", .arr #[retained], toJson false],
    node "constructionLeg" #["limit.actual", retained, retained, toJson (0 : Nat)]]
  for packet in symbolic do
    let .ok admitted := CallablePacket.symbolic packet
      | throwError "a complete symbolic callable lost its released framing"
    unless admitted.value == packet do
      throwError "symbolic framing rewrote the supplied descriptor or original references"
  for packet in #[
      node "identity" #[endpoint],
      node "compose" #[retained, retained, retained],
      node "cartesianMap" #["", .arr #[], retained],
      node "presentation" #["comparison.actual", retained, toJson false],
      node "constructionLeg" #["limit.actual", retained, retained],
      retained, node "opaqueData" #["not-an-admitted-export"]] do
    if (CallablePacket.symbolic packet).isOk then
      throwError "malformed symbolic framing acquired a callable packet"
  let owned := node "opaqueData" #["original-token"]
  for value in #[retained, (ScopedReference.input #[.index 2]).encode,
      (ScopedReference.result 0).encode, owned] do
    let .ok framed := CallablePacket.retained value
      | throwError "released retained callable framing was rejected"
    let complete := node "typedMap" #[endpoint, endpoint, value]
    let .ok mapped := framed.withMap complete
      | throwError "complete typedMap lost its original retained callable field"
    unless mapped.value == complete do
      throwError "retained callable framing rewrote the complete original map"
    let wrapped := node "valueData" #[complete]
    let .ok framed := mapped.inline wrapped
      | throwError "an original complete inline wrapper was discarded"
    unless framed.value == wrapped do
      throwError "inline framing rewrote the original complete packet"
  for value in #[node "scopeRef" #[toJson (-1 : Int)], node "resultRef" #[],
      node "opaqueData" #[""], node "identity" #[endpoint, endpoint],
      node "valueData" #[owned]] do
    if (CallablePacket.retained value).isOk then
      throwError "malformed retained framing acquired a callable packet"

public import CasRuntime.CallablePacket
public import CasRuntime.Reply

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean CasCatalogue.Backend

private def collapseArray (values : Array CallableDatum) : CallableDatum :=
  let literals := values.filterMap fun value => match value with
    | .literal value => some value
    | _ => none
  if literals.size == values.size then .literal (.arr literals) else .array values

private def collapseObject (values : Array (String × CallableDatum)) : CallableDatum :=
  let literals := values.filterMap fun (name, value) => match value with
    | .literal value => some (name, value)
    | _ => none
  if literals.size == values.size then .literal (Json.mkObj literals.toList) else .object values

mutual
  /-- Resolve only exact already selected references while reading comparison data. -/
  private partial def bindingDatum (graph : ValueGraph) (binding : ValueBinding)
      (seen : Std.HashSet (RuntimeId .value)) : Except String CallableDatum := do
    if seen.contains binding.value then throw "the callable comparison data have a cycle"
    discard <| graph.requiredOwners #[binding]
    let some node := graph.find binding.value
      | throw "a callable comparison reference is outside its visible graph"
    let seen := seen.insert binding.value
    match node.payload.data with
    | .portable bytes =>
      let some text := String.fromUTF8? bytes
        | throw "a portable callable point is not UTF-8 packet data"
      let value ← Json.parse text
      checkLiteral value
      return .literal value
    | .closure .. | .ownedToken .. =>
      return .reference binding.value binding.associationIds
    | .product fields =>
      let mut values := #[]
      for index in [:fields.size] do
        values := values.push (← bindingDatum graph (← graph.project binding index) seen)
      return match values with
        | #[only] => only
        | _ => collapseArray values
    | .container value =>
      let mut slots := #[]
      for slot in value.slots do
        let selected ← match slot.fieldIndex with
          | none => pure slot.binding
          | some index => graph.project binding index
        slots := slots.push (slot.path, selected)
      packetDatum graph value.template #[]
        (fun path => (slots.find? (·.1 == path)).map (·.2))
        (fun path => (value.exports.find? (·.path == path)).map fun owned =>
          .exported owned.owner owned.token
            (owned.captures.map fun captured => (captured.value, captured.associationIds))) seen

  private partial def packetDatum (graph : ValueGraph) (value : Json)
      (path : Array InputPathStep) (referenceAt : Array InputPathStep → Option ValueBinding)
      (exportAt : Array InputPathStep → Option CallableDatum)
      (seen : Std.HashSet (RuntimeId .value)) : Except String CallableDatum := do
    if let some reference := referenceAt path then
      return ← bindingDatum graph reference seen
    if let some exported := exportAt path then return exported
    match value with
    | .arr values =>
      return collapseArray (← values.mapIdxM fun index value =>
        packetDatum graph value (path.push (.index index)) referenceAt exportAt seen)
    | .obj values =>
      return collapseObject (← values.toList.toArray.mapM fun (name, value) => do
        return (name, ← packetDatum graph value (path.push (.field name)) referenceAt exportAt seen))
    | _ => return .literal value
end

/-- Read actual endpoint/point data from its original binding; never choose a source by data. -/
opaque ValueGraph.callableDatum (graph : ValueGraph) (binding : ValueBinding) :
    Except String CallableDatum := bindingDatum graph binding {}

/-- Resolve only the parser's checked current-scope references for finite-data comparison.
The original wire packet and every reference slot remain separate and unchanged. -/
opaque ImmediateReply.callableDatum (reply : ImmediateReply) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (value : Json) (path : Array InputPathStep) : Except String CallableDatum := do
  unless (← reply.fragmentAt path) == value do
    throw "callable framing changed its exact original reply fragment"
  packetDatum graph value path
    (fun path => (reply.references.find? (·.path == path)).map (·.binding))
    (fun path => do
      let value ← (reply.fragmentAt path).toOption
      let .opaque token ← (ComputationalValue.decode value).toOption | none
      let declaration ← reply.exports.find? (·.token == token)
      return .exported declaration.owner token
        (declaration.captures.map fun captured => (captured.value, captured.associationIds))) {}

private def datumField (value : CallableDatum) (name : String) : Except String CallableDatum := do
  match value with
  | .literal value => return .literal (← value.getObjVal? name)
  | .object values =>
    let some (_, value) := values.find? (·.1 == name)
      | throw "a callable descriptor omitted a required field"
    return value
  | _ => throw "a callable descriptor requires complete object data"

private def datumArray (value : CallableDatum) : Except String (Array CallableDatum) := do
  match value with
  | .literal value => return (← value.getArr?).map CallableDatum.literal
  | .array values => return values
  | _ => throw "a callable inventory requires an array of actual points"

/-- Inventories come only from actual finiteData packets, including their original references. -/
partial def CallableDatum.endpointInventory (value : CallableDatum) :
    Except String (Option (Array CallableDatum)) := do
  let .ok (.literal (.str tag)) := datumField value "ctor" | return none
  if tag == "valueData" then
    let #[data] ← datumArray (← datumField value "args")
      | throw "valueData requires its complete actual object data"
    return ← data.endpointInventory
  if tag != "finiteData" then return none
  let #[_, inventory] ← datumArray (← datumField value "args")
    | throw "finiteData requires its complete object descriptor and actual inventory"
  let inventory ← datumArray inventory
  CasCatalogue.GraphData.validateInventory inventory
  return some inventory

end CasRuntime

import CasRuntime.CallableView
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.CallableView

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasRuntime CasCatalogue.Backend

-- The real scope parser supplies every input/result reference. Literal inventories and
-- reference-held portable points have one computational framing, while opaque points
-- keep their exact original identities. The cat process supplies no mathematical answer.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 0))
  liftM (m := IO) do
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← OccurrenceLedger.new owners
    let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
    let produced ← ledger.allocate
    let origin := { program, occurrence := produced, role, parameters := #[] : ValueOrigin }
    let (graph, zero) ← (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities origin
      (.portable "0".toUTF8)
    let (graph, one) ← graph.stage owners.identities origin (.portable "1".toUTF8)
    let (graph, three) ← graph.stage owners.identities origin (.portable "3".toUTF8)
    let (graph, four) ← graph.stage owners.identities origin (.portable "4".toUTF8)
    let owner ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      owner.child.stdin.putStr "original-point\n"
      owner.child.stdin.flush
      let token := (← owner.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
      let (graph, opaquePoint) ← graph.stage owners.identities origin
        (.ownedExport owner token #[])
      let (graph, otherOpaquePoint) ← graph.stage owners.identities origin
        (.ownedExport owner (token ++ "-other") #[])
      let occurrence ← ledger.allocate
      let transaction ← owners.identities.fresh .transaction
      let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "callable-framing", profileDigest := "callable-framing"
        registration := { operation := "callable-framing", input := "callable-framing",
          backend := "cat" } }
      let values := #[zero, zero, one, three, four, opaquePoint, opaquePoint, otherOpaquePoint]
      let .ok reservation ← ledger.reserve occurrence transaction selected owner graph values
        | throw <| IO.userError "the callable framing scope could not reserve"
      let inputPath := #[InputPathStep.field "original", .index 0]
      let scope ← RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph values
        #[{ path := inputPath, binding := zero }] #[one]
      let frame := fun value => Json.mkObj [("request_id", toJson (73 : Nat)),
        ("status", toJson "ok"), ("value", value), ("exports", Json.arr #[])]
      let domain := some (#[toJson (0 : Nat), toJson (1 : Nat)].map CallableDatum.literal)
      let target := some (#[toJson (3 : Nat), toJson (4 : Nat)].map CallableDatum.literal)
      let referenceGraph := Json.arr #[
        Json.arr #[(ScopedReference.input inputPath).encode, (ScopedReference.scope 3).encode],
        Json.arr #[(ScopedReference.result 0).encode, (ScopedReference.scope 4).encode]]
      let mixedGraph := Json.arr #[
        Json.arr #[(ScopedReference.scope 1).encode, toJson (3 : Nat)],
        Json.arr #[toJson (1 : Nat), (ScopedReference.scope 4).encode]]
      for packet in #[referenceGraph, mixedGraph] do
        let reply ← ImmediateReply.parseControl scope reservation graph scope.wireId 73 (frame packet)
        let original := reply.references.map fun reference =>
          (reference.path, reference.binding.value, reference.binding.associationIds)
        let .ok admitted := CallablePacket.finiteWith packet domain target
            (fun value path => reply.callableDatum graph value path)
          | throw <| IO.userError "original reference points did not match their literal inventory"
        unless admitted.value == packet && original == reply.references.map (fun reference =>
            (reference.path, reference.binding.value, reference.binding.associationIds)) do
          throw <| IO.userError "graph framing changed original packet references"
      let duplicate := Json.arr #[
        Json.arr #[(ScopedReference.scope 0).encode, toJson (3 : Nat)],
        Json.arr #[(ScopedReference.scope 1).encode, toJson (4 : Nat)]]
      let reply ← ImmediateReply.parseControl scope reservation graph scope.wireId 73 (frame duplicate)
      if (CallablePacket.finiteWith duplicate domain target
          (fun value path => reply.callableDatum graph value path)).isOk then
        throw <| IO.userError "different wire aliases concealed a repeated actual graph key"
      for key in #[6, 7] do
        let packet := Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "finiteGraph"),
          ("args", Json.arr #[Json.arr #[(ScopedReference.scope 5).encode],
            Json.arr #[Json.arr #[(ScopedReference.scope key).encode, toJson (3 : Nat)]]])]
        let reply ← ImmediateReply.parseControl scope reservation graph scope.wireId 73 (frame packet)
        let admitted := CallablePacket.finiteWith packet none target
          (fun value path => reply.callableDatum graph value path)
        unless admitted.isOk == (key == 6) do
          throw <| IO.userError "opaque graph keys lost their exact original reference identity"
      scope.retire
      discard <| ledger.retire reservation
    finally owners.close owner.generation

private def withPeer (family : CategoricalPointFamily) (configuration : List (String × Json))
    (action : Kernel → TermElabM Unit) (available : Bool := true) : TermElabM Unit := do

  let log := root / ".tmp/categorical-point-native-observations.jsonl"
