    ("log", toJson log.toString) :: configuration)
  let manifest := Json.mkObj [
    ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "categorical-packet-peer"),
      ("command", toJson (contract / ".venv/bin/python").toString),
      ("args", .arr #[toJson (root / "scripts/probes/categorical_point_peer.py").toString,
        toJson config.compress])]]),
    ("registrations", .arr (if available then #[Json.mkObj [
      ("operation", toJson family.operation), ("input", toJson family.owner.input),
      ("backend", "categorical-packet-peer")]] else #[]))]
  IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
  let path := root / ".tmp/categorical-point-native-consumer.json"
  IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let kernel ← Kernel.load owners (some path) none 5000
  discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
  try
    unless kernel.rejected.isEmpty do
      throwError "the original categorical operation lost its native registration"
    action kernel
  finally kernel.close

private def stageOriginal (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
    (source : Expr) (payload : ValuePayload)
    (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr := {}) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let program ← kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .program
  let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound program.worker context bound
    (← transaction.view) (selections := selections)
  let selectionBinding := match source with
    | .fvar localId =>
      (context.bindings.find? fun binding =>
        binding.expression.fvarId! == localId && selections.contains binding.id).map (·.id)
    | _ => none
  let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close source)
    (← selections.close context) selectionBinding
  transaction.stage (← environment.origin program (← kernel.ledger.allocate) role) payload

-- The original List(Fin 0) object carries the independently supplied inventory [[]].
-- The peer returns that complete graph once and requires the actual unchanged
-- typedMap on later application. It never computes the list operation.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let originalEnvironment ← getEnv
  try
    let #[entry] := (← semanticState).cells.filter (·.id == NaturalTransformationId.listReverse)
      | throwError "the original list-reversal cell is absent"
    let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner (.component entry #[] false)
    withPeer family [("mode", "inline"), ("point", .arr #[])] fun kernel => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        let receiverSelection ← sourceNamedObjectAlias CategoryId.sets
          { value := mkApp (mkConst ``Fin) (mkNatLit 0) }
        SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities {} context receiverSelection
          fun context selections receiverSource => do
            let receiverPacket := Json.mkObj [("ctor", "finiteData"),
              ("args", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("ctor", "obj.sets.fin"), ("args", .arr #[toJson (0 : Nat)])],
                .arr #[]])]
            let receiver ← stageOriginal kernel transaction context {} receiverSource
              (.portable receiverPacket.compress.toUTF8) selections
            withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context {} receiverSource receiver
              fun context bound selectedReceiver => do
                let levels := family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero)
                let parameters := #[selectedReceiver]
                let (arrowSource, bundle) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
                let (source, target) ← categoricalPointEndpoints arrowSource
                unless ← isDefEq source target do
                  throwError "the original list reversal changed its native endpoints"
                let endpointPacket := Json.mkObj [("ctor", "finiteData"),
                  ("args", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("ctor", "fun.sets.list"), ("args", .arr #[]),
                    ("receiver", receiverPacket)], .arr #[.arr #[]]])]
                let endpoint ← stageOriginal kernel transaction context bound source
                  (.portable endpointPacket.compress.toUTF8) selections
                withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound source endpoint
                  fun context bound selectedEndpoint => do
                    let reference ← family.arrowSelection levels parameters
                    selections.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities context reference
                      fun context selections referenceSource => do
                        let arrow ← kernel.run transaction context bound referenceSource
                          (selections := selections)
                        unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                          throwError "forming the native component invoked a provider"
                        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound referenceSource arrow
                          fun context bound selectedArrow => do
                            let identitySource ← categoricalPointIdentity bundle selectedEndpoint
                            let identityPayload ← IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.descriptor
                              (Json.mkObj [("ctor", "identity"), ("args", .arr #[.null, .null])]) #[
                                { path := #[.field "args", .index 0], binding := endpoint, fieldIndex := none },
                                { path := #[.field "args", .index 1], binding := endpoint, fieldIndex := none }]).mapError IO.userError
                            let identity ← stageOriginal kernel transaction context bound identitySource
                              identityPayload selections
                            withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound identitySource identity
                              fun context bound selectedIdentity => do
                                let whole ← family.asWhole
                                let callable := whole.family.instantiateLevelParams whole.universeParams levels
                                withApplicationInputs kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound callable
                                  (parameters ++ #[selectedEndpoint, selectedIdentity])
                                  #[some receiver, some endpoint, some identity]
                                  fun context bound inputs => do
                                    let parameters := inputs.extract 0 whole.parameterCount
                                    let domain := inputs[whole.parameterCount]!
                                    let point := inputs[whole.parameterCount + 1]!
                                    let originalPoint ← whole.withRequest levels parameters selectedArrow domain
                                      selectedEndpoint selectedEndpoint point (some context)
                                    let request ← whole.selected levels parameters domain originalPoint
                                      (context := some context)
                                    selections.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities context request
                                      fun context selections requested => do
                                        let result ← kernel.run transaction context bound requested
                                          (selections := selections)
                                        let graph ← transaction.view
                                        let some resultNode := graph.find result.value
                                          | throwError "the complete returned component lost its original result node"
                                        let .container complete := resultNode.payload.data
                                          | throwError "the complete typedMap result was reduced to its callable body"
                                        unless complete.originalPacket.isSome do
                                          throwError "the result lost its immutable original reply packet"
                                        let .ok owners := graph.requiredOwners #[result]
                                          | throwError "the complete returned component lost its owner closure"
                                        unless owners.isEmpty do
                                          throwError "the wholly inline component acquired a supplier owner"
                                        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound requested result
                                          fun context bound selectedResult => do
                                            let value ← mkAppOptM ``List.nil #[some receiverSource]
                                            let build : SourceReadM Expr := do
                                              let point ← retainGlobalSourcePoint
                                                (fun selected => SourceReadM.select selected) { value }
                                              SourceReadM.select point
                                            build.runK ⟨kernel.ledger.owners.identities, context, selections⟩
                                              fun pointSource scope => do
                                                let context := scope.context
                                                let selections := scope.selections
                                                let point ← kernel.run transaction context bound pointSource
                                                  (selections := selections)
                                                withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound pointSource point
                                                  fun context bound retainedPoint => do
                                                    let function ← family.function levels parameters selectedResult
                                                    let output ← kernel.run transaction context bound (mkApp function retainedPoint)
                                                      (selections := selections)
                                                    unless output.value == point.value &&
                                                        point.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf output.associationIds.toList do
                                                      throwError "the actual returned callable did not retain its original supplied point"
                                                    let dispatches ← kernel.dispatches.get
                                                    unless dispatches.size == 2 && dispatches.all (·.operation == family.operation) &&
                                                        dispatches[0]! == dispatches[1]! do
                                                      throwError "the returned component changed its original selected registration"
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
  finally setEnv originalEnvironment


-- Complete record results exercise the same seven-field invocation at every native
-- owner. Cartesian base projection must return the captured original base map.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let originalEnvironment ← getEnv
  try
    let state ← semanticState
    let #[component] := state.cells.filter (·.id == NaturalTransformationId.listReverse)
      | throwError "the original list-reversal cell is absent"
    let #[cartesian] := state.functors.filter (·.id == FunctorId.modulesReindex)
      | throwError "the original module reindexing is absent"
    let mut selected : Array CategoricalPointOwner := #[
      .component component #[] false, .component component #[] true,
      .component component #[ConstructorId.arrow] false, .cartesian cartesian,
      .action (.functor FunctorId.setsList),
      .action (.classifierForget ClassifierId.setsFinite),
      .action (.constructMap ConstructorId.arrow (.functor FunctorId.setsList))]
    for id in #["bind.sets.finite_sum", "bind.sets.finite_product"] do
      let #[entry] := state.binders.filter (·.id.raw == id)
        | throwError "an original finite binder is absent"
      selected := selected.push (.binder entry)
    for declaration in #[
        ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.PolynomialPresentations.firstConstants,
        ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.PolynomialPresentations.secondConstants] do
      let #[entry] := state.morphisms.filter (·.declaration == declaration)
        | throwError "an original F9 constant map is absent"
      selected := selected.push (.named (.morphism entry))
    let #[application] := state.objects.filter (·.id.raw == "obj.sets.polynomials")
      | throwError "the original polynomial application is absent"
    selected := selected.push (.named (.application application))
    for (owner, available) in selected.flatMap (fun owner => #[(owner, false), (owner, true)]) do
      let family ← CategoricalPointFamily.forOwner owner
      let isCartesian := match owner with | .cartesian _ => true | _ => false
      let configuration := [("mode", toJson "opaque")] ++
        (if isCartesian then [("capture", Json.arr
          #[toJson "args", toJson (1 : Nat), toJson (0 : Nat), toJson (0 : Nat)])] else [])
      withPeer family configuration (available := available) fun kernel => do
        let sourceOwner ← kernel.ledger.owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
        try
          let levels := family.universeParams.map Level.param
          let type ← inferType
            (family.arrowFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels)
          forallTelescopeReducing type fun parameters _ => do
            let bindings ← parameters.mapIdxM fun index expression => do
              let declaration ← getFVarLocalDecl expression
              let role := if declaration.binderInfo.isInstImplicit then
                BindingRole.instance else BindingRole.parameter
              return ({ id := ⟨"original-categorical-parameters", index⟩, role, expression } : LocalBinding)
            let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
            let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
            try
              let program ← kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .program
              let mut runtimeParameters : Array RuntimeParameter := #[]
              let mut bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding := {}
              let mut parameterValues : Array (Option ValueBinding) := #[]
              for binding in bindings do
                if ← isProof binding.expression then
                  parameterValues := parameterValues.push none
                  continue
                let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture kernel.ledger.owners.identities.worker
                  context runtimeParameters (some (← transaction.view))
                let source ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close binding.expression)
                let value ← transaction.stage
                  (← environment.origin program (← kernel.ledger.allocate) source)
                  (.ownedExport sourceOwner s!"native-parameter-{binding.id.serial}"
                    (parameterValues.filterMap id))
                let .ok parameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue (← transaction.view) binding.id value
                  | throwError "an original categorical parameter lost its runtime identity"
                runtimeParameters := runtimeParameters.push parameter
                parameterValues := parameterValues.push (some value)
                bound := bound.insert binding.id value
              let (nativeArrow, bundle) ← family.arrowAt levels parameters
              let (source, _) ← categoricalPointEndpoints nativeArrow
              let identity ← categoricalPointIdentity bundle source
              let referenceFamily ← family.asReference
              let reference ← referenceFamily.selected levels parameters source { value := identity }
              SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities {} context reference
                fun context selections delayedSource => do
                  let delayed ← kernel.run transaction context bound delayedSource
                    (selections := selections)
                  unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                    throwError "forming a complete native arrow invoked a provider"
                  let graph ← transaction.view
                  let some delayedNode := graph.find delayed.value
                    | throwError "the native arrow formation lost its retained result"
                  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType (← delayedNode.origin.role.source.inContext context))
                      (← inferType nativeArrow) do
                    throwError "native formation changed its complete original Hom interface"
                  if !available then return
                  let request ← family.selected levels parameters source { value := identity }
                    (whole := true)
                  selections.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities context request
                    fun context selections requested => do
                      let result ← kernel.run transaction context bound requested
                        (selections := selections)
                      let graph ← transaction.view
                      let some resultNode := graph.find result.value
                        | throwError "the complete categorical request has no actual result"
                      let .container packet := resultNode.payload.data
                        | throwError "the native whole Hom result lost its complete typedMap wrapper"
                      unless packet.originalPacket.isSome do
                        throwError "the native map lost its complete original reply packet"
                      let .ok required := graph.requiredOwners #[result]
                        | throwError "the complete record lost its actual owner closure"
                      let .ok inputOwners := graph.requiredOwners (parameterValues.filterMap id)
                        | throwError "the original categorical inputs lost their owners"
                      unless inputOwners.all required.contains && required.size > inputOwners.size do
                        throwError "the original inputs or returned native export lost their actual owners"
                      let dispatches ← kernel.dispatches.get
                      unless dispatches.size == 1 && dispatches[0]!.operation == family.operation do
                        throwError "the native categorical request dispatched another owner or operation"
                      if isCartesian then
                        let #[baseIndex] ← family.explicitParameters
                          | throwError "the original cartesian declaration changed its base-map port"
                        let some originalBase := parameterValues[baseIndex]?.bind id
                          | throwError "the original cartesian base map lost its binding"
                        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound requested result
                          fun context bound retained => do
                            let base ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Pseudofunctor.CoGrothendieck.Hom.base #[retained]
                            let actualBase ← kernel.run transaction context bound base (selections := selections)
                            unless actualBase.value == originalBase.value &&
                                originalBase.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf actualBase.associationIds.toList do
                              throwError "the actual cartesian result replaced its original base map"
                            let observed ← IO.FS.readFile ((← IO.currentDir) /
                              ".tmp/categorical-point-native-observations.jsonl")
                            let events ← (observed.splitOn "\n").filter (· != "") |>.toArray.mapM fun line => do
                              IO.ofExcept <| (Json.parse line).mapError IO.userError
                            unless events.any (fun event =>
                                ((event.getObjValAs? String "prepared_role").toOption.getD "").startsWith "project:") do
                              throwError "the cartesian native continuation did not inspect its actual returned export"
            finally discard <| transaction.abort
        finally kernel.ledger.owners.close sourceOwner.generation
  finally setEnv originalEnvironment

end CasRuntime.CategoricalPointInvocationTests

module

public import CasRuntime.Value
public import CasCompiler.CategoricalPointFamily
public import CasCompiler.RoutedMethodFamily

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- The released parameter grouping and arrow descriptor of one actual native family.
The slots refer to original admitted inputs; packet arrays are never fabricated Lean values. -/
structure CategoricalPointPacket where
  parameters : ValueContainer
  arrow : ValuePayload

private def packetContainer (template : Json) (slots : Array ContainerSlot) :
    MetaM ValueContainer := do
  let payload ← IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.descriptor template slots).mapError IO.userError
  let .container packet := payload.data
    | throwError "the point descriptor lost its checked packet layout"
  return packet

private def parameterSlot (path : Array InputPathStep) (binding : ValueBinding) : ContainerSlot :=
  { path, binding, fieldIndex := none }

private def actionParameterPath : EdgeRef → Array InputPathStep
  | .functor _ => #[.field "args"]
  | .classifierForget _ => #[.field "args", .index 1]
  | .constructMap _ inner => #[.field "args", .index 1] ++ actionParameterPath inner

/-- Read only the original native parameter table and use the released encoders for framing.
This is a descriptor view; it adds no source action, result field or alternate operation. -/
def CategoricalPointPacket.prepare (family : CategoricalPointFamily)
    (actual : Array (Option ValueBinding)) : MetaM CategoricalPointPacket := do
  unless actual.size == family.parameterCount do
    throwError "the point packet lost its original complete parameter table"
  let value := fun index => do
    let some original := actual[index]?.bind id
      | throwError "the point packet is missing an original computational parameter"
    return original
  let indices ← family.explicitParameters
  let parameters ← indices.mapM value
  let holes := Array.replicate parameters.size Json.null
  let parameterSlots := fun (pathStart : Array InputPathStep) => parameters.mapIdx fun index binding =>
    parameterSlot (pathStart.push (.index index)) binding
  let (parameterTemplate, parameterSlots, arrowTemplate, arrowSlots) ← match family.owner with
    | .named owner =>
      pure (.arr holes, parameterSlots #[],
        Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson owner.operation), ("args", .arr holes)],
        parameterSlots #[.field "args"])
    | .component entry constructors inverse => do
      let receiver ← value family.declarationParameterCount
      let parametersTemplate := Json.arr #[.arr holes, .null, toJson inverse]
      let slots := parameterSlots #[.index 0] ++ #[parameterSlot #[.index 1] receiver]
      let descriptor : ConstructedCellComponent := {
        constructors := constructors.map (·.raw)
        component := { cell := entry.id.raw, parameters := holes, receiver := .null, inverse } }
      let pathStart := if constructors.isEmpty then #[] else #[.field "args", .index 1]
      let arrowSlots := parameterSlots (pathStart ++ #[.field "args", .index 1]) ++
        #[parameterSlot (pathStart ++ #[.field "args", .index 2]) receiver]
      pure (parametersTemplate, slots, descriptor.encode, arrowSlots)
    | .cartesian entry => do
      let receiver ← value family.declarationParameterCount
      let slots := parameterSlots #[.index 0] ++ #[parameterSlot #[.index 1] receiver]
      let arrow : CartesianMap := { reindex := entry.id.raw, parameters := holes, receiver := .null }
      pure (.arr #[.arr holes, .null], slots, arrow.encode,
        parameterSlots #[.field "args", .index 1] ++
          #[parameterSlot #[.field "args", .index 2] receiver])
    | .binder entry =>
      pure (.arr holes, parameterSlots #[],
        Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson entry.id.raw), ("args", .arr holes)],
        parameterSlots #[.field "args"])
    | .action edge => do
      let source ← value family.declarationParameterCount
      let target ← value (family.declarationParameterCount + 1)
      let arrow ← value (family.declarationParameterCount + 2)
      let action := routedActionDescriptor edge holes
      let path := actionParameterPath edge
      let (template, invocationSlots) := match edge with
        | .functor _ => (Json.arr holes, parameterSlots #[])
        | _ => (Json.arr #[action], parameterSlots (#[InputPathStep.index 0] ++ path))
      let mapped := Json.mkObj [("ctor", "map"), ("args", .arr #[action,
        TypedMap.encode { source := .null, target := .null, callable := .null }])]
      let slots := parameterSlots (#[InputPathStep.field "args", .index 0] ++ path) ++ #[
        parameterSlot #[.field "args", .index 1, .field "args", .index 0] source,
        parameterSlot #[.field "args", .index 1, .field "args", .index 1] target,
        parameterSlot #[.field "args", .index 1, .field "args", .index 2] arrow]
      pure (template, invocationSlots, mapped, slots)
  return {
    parameters := ← packetContainer parameterTemplate parameterSlots
    arrow := ← IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.descriptor arrowTemplate arrowSlots).mapError IO.userError }

/-- The same complete native action inputs in the released object-action envelope. -/
def CategoricalPointPacket.action (family : SourceActionFamily)
    (actual : Array (Option ValueBinding)) : MetaM ValueContainer := do
  unless actual.size == family.parameterCount + 1 do
    throwError "the object action lost its complete original native input table"
  let parameters ← (← family.explicitParameters).mapM fun index => do
    let some value := actual[index]?.bind id
      | throwError "the object action lost an original explicit declaration parameter"
    pure value
  let some receiver := actual[family.parameterCount]?.bind id
    | throwError "the object action lost its actual original receiver"
  let holes := Array.replicate parameters.size Json.null
  let action := routedActionDescriptor family.edge holes
  let (packets, pathStart) : Array Json × Array InputPathStep := match family.edge with
    | .functor _ => (holes, #[.field "args"])
    | _ => (#[action], #[InputPathStep.field "args", .index 0] ++ actionParameterPath family.edge)
  let slots := parameters.mapIdx (fun index binding =>
      parameterSlot (pathStart.push (.index index)) binding) ++
    #[parameterSlot #[.field "receiver"] receiver]
  let packet : ConstructionInvocation := {
    construction := family.operation, parameters := packets, receiver := .null }
  packetContainer packet.encode slots

end CasRuntime

public import CasRuntime.ExecutionContext

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- The complete open source scope and its one runtime occurrence table. -/
private structure ChildSourceState where
  context : OpenContext
  bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding
  selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr

/-- Collect only explicit released wire addresses. Different addresses remain distinct even
when their actual values coincide; native expressions never participate in this lookup. -/
private partial def childReferences (packet : Json) : Except String (Array ScopedReference) := do
  if let some reference ← ScopedReference.parse? packet then return #[reference]
  let children : Array Json := match packet with
    | .arr values => values
    | .obj fields => fields.toList.toArray.map (fun (entry : String × Json) => entry.2)
    | _ => #[]
  let mut references := #[]
  for child in children do
    for reference in ← childReferences child do
      unless references.contains reference do references := references.push reference
  return references

/-- Read this request's exact typed binder, with visibility checked in the current graph.
Neither native source equality nor a matching type can supply another runtime occurrence. -/
private def boundSourceValue (transaction : CellTransaction) (state : ChildSourceState)
    (source : Expr) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let .fvar localId := source.consumeMData
    | throwError "the prepared source operand lost its actual bound variable"
  let some binding := state.context.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == localId)
    | throwError "the prepared source operand is outside its complete typed context"
  let some value := state.bound[binding.id]?
    | throwError "the prepared source operand names an unavailable bound identity"
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| ((← transaction.view).requiredOwners #[value]).mapError IO.userError
  return value

/-- Adapt the released service frame to the common compiler source entrance, then run the
ordinary lowerer and executor. Explicit references are bound before native argument reading;
new computations extend that same typed context through the complete compiler continuation. -/
partial def Kernel.child (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (reservation : DispatchReservation) (scope : RequestScope)
    (call : Json) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let malformed : {α : Type} → MessageData → MetaM α := fun reason =>
    throwStratum .malformed m!"deferred call {call.compress}: {reason}"
  let retained : Json → MetaM (Option ValueBinding) := fun packet => do
    match ScopedReference.parse? packet with
    | .error reason => malformed reason
    | .ok none => return none
    | .ok (some reference) =>
      let #[binding] ← scope.resolveMany reservation (← transaction.view) scope.wireId #[reference]
        | throwError "internal: one scoped reference resolved to several values"
      return some binding
  let references ← match childReferences call with
    | .ok references => pure references
    | .error reason => malformed reason
  let finish := fun (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
      (sources : Array (ScopedReference × Expr)) => do
    let readRetained := fun (_state : ChildSourceState) packet => do
      match ScopedReference.parse? packet with
      | .error reason => malformed reason
      | .ok none => pure none
      | .ok (some reference) =>
        let some (_, source) := sources.find? (·.1 == reference)
          | throwError "the child source lost an explicit original wire reference"
        pure (some source)
    let environment := fun (state : ChildSourceState) => do
      RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound request.environment.worker state.context state.bound
        (← transaction.view) (some request.environment) state.selections
    let stateIn := fun (state : ChildSourceState) context bound => do
      let current ← environment { state with context, bound }
      return ({ context, bound, selections := ← current.selections.inContext context } :
        ChildSourceState)
    let readAction : Json → StateCpsT ChildSourceState Elab.Term.TermElabM
        (Option (ValueBinding × Expr)) := fun packet _ state continuation =>
      controlAt MetaM fun run => do
        let some value ← retained packet
          | run (continuation none state)
        withNativeInterface kernel.ledger.owners.identities (← transaction.view)
            state.context state.bound state.selections value
            fun context bound selections nativeSource => do
          let next ← stateIn { state with selections } context bound
          run (continuation (some (value, nativeSource)) next)
    let source : PublishedSourceContext ChildSourceState := {
      scope := (·.context)
      selections := (·.selections)
      identities := fun _ => kernel.ledger.owners.identities
      select := fun selection declaredType _ state continuation =>
        controlAt MetaM fun run => do
          SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities
            state.selections state.context selection
            (fun context selections sourceVariable =>
              run (continuation sourceVariable { state with context, selections }))
            (declaredType := declaredType)
      retained := readRetained
      actionSource := fun packet => do return (← readAction packet).map (·.2)
      literal := ScalarLiteral.readAt
      bind := fun term _ state continuation =>
        controlAt MetaM fun run => do
          let value ← evaluateSource transaction request.program state.context state.bound state.selections term
          withBindingContext (← transaction.view) state.context state.bound value fun context bound =>
            withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound term value
              fun context bound sourceVariable => do
                let next ← stateIn state context bound
                let selections ← next.selections.alias context
                  (← value.selectedSource context) sourceVariable
                run (continuation sourceVariable { next with selections })
      bindAt := fun term declaredType _ state continuation =>
        controlAt MetaM fun run => do
          let value ← evaluateSource transaction request.program state.context state.bound state.selections term
          withBindingContext (← transaction.view) state.context state.bound value fun context bound =>
            withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound term value
              (fun context bound sourceVariable => do
                let next ← stateIn state context bound
                let selections ← next.selections.alias context
                  (← value.selectedSource context) sourceVariable
                run (continuation sourceVariable { next with selections }))
              (declaredType := some declaredType)
      withLocal := fun _ _ _ _ _ =>
        throwError "a child source request cannot invent a symbolic interface"
      rebind := fun original selected _ state continuation =>
        controlAt MetaM fun run => do
          let value ← boundSourceValue transaction state selected
          withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities state.context state.bound original value
            fun context bound sourceVariable => do
                let next ← stateIn state context bound
                let selections ← next.selections.alias context
                  (← value.selectedSource context) sourceVariable
                run (continuation sourceVariable { next with selections })
      methodParameters := fun family parameters receiver _ state continuation =>
        controlAt MetaM fun run => do
          let receiver ← boundSourceValue transaction state receiver
          let environment ← environment state
          let continuing ← IO.mkRef false
          try
            environment.methodParameters state.context state.bound transaction kernel.ledger.allocate
              family parameters receiver
              (fun context bound selections expression => do
                let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge state.selections selections
                let current ← stateIn { state with selections } context bound
                evaluateSource transaction request.program context bound current.selections expression)
              (fun context bound selections parameters => do
                continuing.set true
                let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge state.selections selections
                let next ← stateIn { state with selections } context bound
                run (continuation parameters next))
              request.observation.sourceSnapshot
          catch error =>
            if ← continuing.get then throw error
            malformed m!"the original receiver's category inputs disagree: {error.toMessageData}"
      checkInput := fun state expected selected => do
        let value ← boundSourceValue transaction state selected
        try
          (← environment state).checkDeclaredInput state.context (← transaction.view) expected value
        catch error => malformed m!"a complete action parameter disagrees: {error.toMessageData}"
      admitMethod := fun state family receiver input => do
        unless ← CasRuntime.RoutedMethodFamily.admitsSourceForm
            state.context state.selections family receiver input do
          malformed "the input form is not the original receiver's source boundary"
      admitProperty := fun state family receiver input => do
        let some boundary := (← routedSourceBoundaries
            state.context state.selections family.route receiver)[0]?
          | malformed "the property lost its original source boundary"
        unless boundary.forms.contains input do
          malformed "the input form is not the original receiver's source boundary"
      admitPoint := fun state family selected => do
        let value ← boundSourceValue transaction state selected
        match family.owner with
        | .morphism row =>
          discard <| InputDescriptorView.requireMorphism (← transaction.view)
            (← kernel.codes.get) value row.id
        | .application row =>
          discard <| InputDescriptorView.requireApplication (← transaction.view)
            (← kernel.codes.get) value row.id
      admitCategorical := fun state family parameters selected => do
        let value ← boundSourceValue transaction state selected
        let graph ← transaction.view
        let view ← InputDescriptorView.requireCategorical graph (← kernel.codes.get) value family
        let some original := view.family
          | malformed "the categorical arrow lost its original source preparation"
        let values := original.origin.application.map (·.arguments) |>.getD #[]
        unless parameters.size == values.size do
          malformed "the categorical arrow changed its complete original parameter telescope"
        let environment ← environment state
        for expected in parameters, supplied in values do
          match supplied with
          | some actual => environment.checkDeclaredInput state.context graph expected actual
          | none =>
            unless ← isProof expected do
              malformed "the categorical arrow lost an original computational parameter"
      constructionCone := fun packet _ state continuation =>
        controlAt MetaM fun run => do
          kernel.retainedConstructionCone transaction (← transaction.view) state.context state.bound retained packet
            fun context bound selected => do
              let next ← stateIn state context bound
              run (continuation selected next)
      creationOwner := fun packet _ state continuation =>
        controlAt MetaM fun run => do
          kernel.retainedCreationOwner (← transaction.view) state.context state.bound retained packet
            fun context bound selected => do
              let next ← stateIn state context bound
              run (continuation selected next)
      projection := fun packet position => do
        let some (value, source) ← readAction packet
          | liftM (m := MetaM) <| malformed "the acted value must be a scoped reference"
        let some field := value.nativeRole.fields.find? (·.wireIndex == some position)
          | liftM (m := MetaM) <| malformed "the field is outside the prepared record interface"
        return (source, field.projection) }
    let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge (← request.selections.inContext context)
      (← request.environment.selections.inContext context)
    let initial ← stateIn { context, bound, selections } context bound
    Elab.Term.TermElabM.run' do
      Elab.Term.withSynthesize do
        (PublishedSource.prepare source call).runK initial fun term state =>
          evaluateSource transaction request.program state.context state.bound state.selections term
  withSourceScope request fun context bound => do
    let rec prepare (remaining : List ScopedReference) (context : OpenContext)
        (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding) (sources : Array (ScopedReference × Expr)) :
        MetaM ValueBinding := do
      match remaining with
      | [] => finish context bound sources
      | reference :: remaining =>
        let #[value] ← scope.resolveMany reservation (← transaction.view) scope.wireId #[reference]
          | throwError "internal: one scoped reference resolved to several values"
        withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound value fun context bound => do
          withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound
              (← value.selectedSource context) value fun context bound source =>
            prepare remaining context bound (sources.push (reference, source))
    prepare references.toList context bound #[]

end CasRuntime

/-- Operational code of a kernel closure. The value node retains the actual captures.
Source: data model §5, ComputationalClosure, lean-cas-dsl#66 comment 6664275536. -/
inductive ClosureCode
  /-- A checked source term. A field or application demand lowers that eliminator on it. -/
  | term (source : ClosedTerm) (selections : SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm := {})
  /-- A formal selected leg keeps its native continuation and, for a direct construction,
  its unchanged released named packet. Formation does not demand a whole cone. A created
  source leg has no target-row packet and retains only its scoped native continuation. -/
  | formalLeg (source : ClosedTerm) (packet : Option ValueContainer)
      (selections : SourceSelectionScope ClosedTerm := {})
  /-- A published family at its prepared parameters, with the fields already selected.
  Its realization is selected when an action reaches actual arguments
  (execution contract v2 §5.2, lean-cas-dsl#69 comment 6664277464). -/
  | family (request : PreparedRequest) (path : Array FieldLayout)
  /-- A formal created object retains its complete source preparation and actual original
  inputs. Its native field demand completes the fixed creation against this exact owner. -/
  | creationOwner (source : PreparedCreationFamily)
  /-- An actual returned map with its originally selected provider and native carrier path. -/
  | retainedPoint (request : PreparedRequest) (registration : Registration)
      (parameters : ValueContainer) (source target : ValueBinding) (packet : ValueContainer)
      (path : NativePointPath request.source)
  /-- Components of an actual completed cone retain its whole original data packet. -/
  | constructionLeg (request : PreparedRequest) (registration : Registration)
      (diagram packet : ValueContainer) (ports : Array (Option ValueBinding))
      (path : Array Name) (retained : Array ValueBinding)

/-- Authenticate a supplied family from the actual callable's retained code. The code table
fixes the original preparation, native field path and captures; equality of native types or
source expressions cannot select another family. -/
opaque PreparedRequest.requireFamily (request family : PreparedRequest)
    (path : Array FieldLayout) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (codes : Std.HashMap (RuntimeId .program) ClosureCode) : MetaM Unit := do
  let .apply callable _ _ := request.action
    | throwError "a prepared family invocation requires its actual callable"
  let code ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.callable callable).mapError IO.userError
  let some node := graph.find code.value
    | throwError "the family callable is outside its visible graph"
  let .closure program captures := node.payload.data
    | throwError "the family callable has no retained native code"
  let some (.family original selected) := codes[program]?
    | throwError "the family callable lost its original prepared family"
  family.requirePreparation original.roles.scope
  unless path.map (·.projection) == selected.map (·.projection) do
    throwError "the family invocation changed its actual callable's native field path"
  unless captures.size == family.scope.size &&
      (captures.zip family.scope).all (fun (left, right) =>
        left.value == right.value && left.associationIds == right.associationIds) do
    throwError "the family invocation changed its actual callable's complete captures"

end CasRuntime

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| packageDir contractPackage
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let .ok wire ← liftM (m := IO) <| FramedConnection.start owners "failure-peer" {
        cmd := (contract / ".venv/bin/python").toString
        args := #[(root / "scripts/probes/protocol_v2_peer.py").toString]
        env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some (contract / "python").toString)] } 5000
      | throwError "the producer failure peer did not negotiate"
    try
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
      let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
      let producing ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
      let input ← liftM (m := IO) <| producer.stage
        { program, occurrence := producing, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      let function ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkConst ``Nat.succ))
      let callable ← liftM (m := IO) <| producer.stage
        { program, occurrence := producing, role := function, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
      let .ok before ← producer.commit | throwError "the failure control inputs could not commit"
      let failedCell ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let failedOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue before.graph 0 input
        | throwError "the failure control input is absent"
      let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program failedOccurrence
        context callable #[scalar.source] #[actual] #[]
      let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "failure-manifest", profileDigest := "failure-profile"
        registration := {
          operation := "missing-waiter-operation", input := "failure#input", backend := wire.backend } }
      let observer : IO.Ref (Option CompletionWaiter) ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.mkRef none
      let missing : PFunctor.Handler.Stateful MetaM CellTransaction OperationalSignature :=
        fun (demand : PreparedRequest) (active : CellTransaction) => do
          let some role := demand.roles.results[0]?
            | throwError "the failed producer lost its result role"
          let .ok waiter ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| active.watch demand.occurrence role.role.id
            | throwError "the failed producer's observer could not attach"
          liftM (m := BaseIO) <| observer.set (some waiter)
          let .ok reserved ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
            active.reserve demand.occurrence selected wire.connection #[input]
            | throwError "the unsupported invocation could not reserve"
          let graph ← liftM (m := IO) active.view
          let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger reserved graph #[input] #[] #[]
          match ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger active reserved scope (toJson (7 : Nat)) 5000 with
          | .error error => CasCatalogue.throwStratum (m := MetaM) error.stratum error.render
          | .ok _ => throwError "the SDK accepted an unimplemented diagnostic operation"
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| Execute.run missing (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) request) failedCell
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure | throwError "the unsupported producer returned a value"
      unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag (· == CasCatalogue.Stratum.noImplementation.tag) do throw failure
      let some failedWaiter ← liftM (m := IO) observer.get
        | throwError "the failed producer lost its observer"
      match ← liftM (m := IO) failedWaiter.wait with
      | .error (.producerError (some tag) message) =>
        unless tag == CasCatalogue.Stratum.noImplementation.tag &&
            message.endsWith "the backend has no implementation of missing-waiter-operation" do
          throwError "the waiter lost its producer's failure stratum or diagnostic"
      | .error _ => throwError "a producer failure was reported to its waiter as cancellation"
      | .ok _ => throwError "a failed producer supplied a mathematical result"
      unless (← SessionSnapshot.current).id == before.id do
        throwError "a failed producer changed the committed Environment"
      let unreserved ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let unreservedOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let unreservedRequest ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program unreservedOccurrence
        context callable #[scalar.source] #[actual] #[]
      let .ok .producer ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| unreserved.claim unreservedRequest.roles.scope
        | throwError "the unreserved producer could not claim"
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) unreserved.abort
      let retry ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
          retry.reserve unreservedOccurrence selected wire.connection #[input] with
      | .error (.reservation .consumed) => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "an aborted unreserved claim regained a dispatch right"
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) retry.abort
    finally liftM (m := IO) wire.close
  finally setEnv original

private def checkNativeObservation (retained : CommittedReceipt) (nativeRequest : PreparedRequest)
    (nativeObservation : Json) : MetaM Unit := do
  unless retained.association.request.observation.toJson == nativeObservation do
    throwError "completion publication or owner loss changed the prepared observation"
  let .ok nativeRoots := CasTools.NativeExpression.decode
      (retained.association.request.observation.native.getObjValD "nativeExpressions")
    | throwError "the committed observation lost its exact native source graph"
  unless nativeRoots ==
      #[nativeRequest.source.source.expression, nativeRequest.source.source.type] do
    throwError "the inert receipt no longer describes the original native request"
  let readableSource := retained.association.request.observation.readable.getObjValD "source"
  let .ok readable := readableSource.getObjValAs? String "expression"
    | throwError "the committed observation lost its prepared readable source"
  unless !readable.isEmpty && retained.association.request.observation.sourceSnapshot.isNone do
    throwError "native receipt observation is empty or invents a frontend source snapshot"

private def perform (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (program : RuntimeId .program)
    (selected : DispatchIdentity) (transaction : CellTransaction) (peer : FramedConnection) :
    MetaM CompletionAssociation := do
  let owners := ledger.owners
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
  let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
  let value ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
    { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let identity ← mkAppOptM ``id #[some (mkConst ``Nat)]
  let function ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close identity)
  let callable ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
    { program, occurrence, role := function, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
  let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
  let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 value
    | throwError "the completion input is absent"
  let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable
    #[scalar.source] #[actual] #[] (some graph)
  discard <| request.admitInputs graph
  let .ok reservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
    transaction.reserve occurrence selected peer.connection #[value]
    | throwError "the completion invocation could not reserve"
  let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[value] #[] #[]
  let some role := request.roles.results[0]?
    | throwError "the pending request has no result role"
  match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.reuse occurrence role.role.id with
  | .ok (.pending pending) =>
    unless pending.occurrence == reservation.occurrence && pending.connection == reservation.connection do
      throwError "pending reuse changed its exact invocation locator"
  | _ => throwError "pending reuse lost the actual reserved invocation"
  let .ok reply ← liftM (m := IO) <| peer.invokeBefore ledger transaction reservation scope
    (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode 5000
    | throwError "the completion invocation did not return"
  let .ok completion ← reply.stageCompletion request transaction scope peer.connection
    | throwError "the admitted reply did not stage its completion"
  let duplicate : Option Exception ← try
    discard <| reply.stageCompletion request transaction scope peer.connection
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some duplicate := duplicate
    | throwError "a completed reply retained its old request authority"
  unless (← duplicate.toMessageData.toString).endsWith "the request scope has retired" do throw duplicate
  return completion

-- Actual SDK frames enter admission, same-cell reuse and whole-cell publication.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM <| liftM (m := MetaM) do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| packageDir contractPackage
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    let initial ← SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let prefixEnvironment ← getEnv
    let .ok wire ← liftM (m := IO) <| FramedConnection.start owners "completion-peer" {
        cmd := (contract / ".venv/bin/python").toString
        args := #[(root / "scripts/probes/protocol_v2_peer.py").toString]
        env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some (contract / "python").toString)] } 5000
      | throwError "the completion peer did not negotiate"
    let .ok otherWire ← liftM (m := IO) <| FramedConnection.start owners "completion-peer" {
        cmd := (contract / ".venv/bin/python").toString
        args := #[(root / "scripts/probes/protocol_v2_peer.py").toString]
        env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some (contract / "python").toString)] } 5000
      | liftM (m := IO) wire.close; throwError "the second completion peer did not negotiate"
    try
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
      let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
      let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "completion-manifest", profileDigest := "completion-profile"
        registration := { operation := "echo", input := "completion#input", backend := wire.backend } }
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let first ← perform ledger program selected transaction wire
      let second ← perform ledger program selected transaction otherWire
      let third ← perform ledger program selected transaction wire
      let nativeOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let function ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkConst ``Nat.succ))
      let argument ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
        { program, occurrence := nativeOccurrence, role := function, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
      let constant := mkLambda `ignored .default
        (← inferType (mkConst ``Nat.succ)) (mkConst ``Nat.succ)
      let constantRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close constant)
      let callable ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
        { program, occurrence := nativeOccurrence, role := constantRole, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 argument
        | throwError "the native completion argument is absent"
      let nativeRequest ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program nativeOccurrence context callable
        #[function.source] #[actual] #[] (some graph)
      let nativeObservation := nativeRequest.observation.toJson
      discard <| nativeRequest.admitInputs graph
      let .ok nativeReservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.reserve nativeOccurrence
        { selected with registration := { selected.registration with operation := "stored" } }
        wire.connection #[argument]
        | throwError "the native completion could not reserve"
      let nativeScope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger nativeReservation graph #[argument] #[] #[]
      let .ok nativeReply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction nativeReservation
        nativeScope (.str "owned completion") 5000
        | throwError "the native completion did not return"
      let .ok native ← nativeReply.stageCompletion nativeRequest transaction nativeScope wire.connection
        | throwError "the native completion did not admit"
      let some firstRole := first.request.roles.results[0]?
        | throwError "the completed result has no root role"
      let .apply oldCallable oldArguments supplied := first.request.action
        | throwError "the completion control lost its prepared application"
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let #[some value] := supplied
        | throwError "the identity completion lost its prescribed argument"
      let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 value
        | throwError "the original completion input is outside its graph"
      let rebuilt ← first.request.environment.withContext context {} fun context bound => do
        let mut parameters := #[]
        for binding in context.bindings do
          if let some value := bound[binding.id]? then
            parameters := parameters.push (← IO.ofExcept <|
              (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id value).mapError IO.userError)
        PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program first.request.occurrence context
          oldCallable oldArguments #[actual] parameters (some graph)
      let some rebuiltRole := rebuilt.roles.results[0]?
        | throwError "the rebuilt request has no root role"
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.reuse first.request.occurrence rebuiltRole.role.id with
      | .error .referenceOutsideGraph => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "a rebuilt request recovered a different preparation's completion"
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.reuse first.request.occurrence firstRole.role.id with
      | .ok (.ready binding) =>
        unless binding.value == first.response.root.value do
          throwError "same-cell reuse replaced its completed value"
      | _ => throwError "same-cell reuse did not find its staged completion"
      if (← SessionSnapshot.current).receipt first.request.occurrence |>.isSome then
        throwError "an uncommitted completion entered an Environment query"
      transaction.emit (.str "completed output")
      let .ok published ← transaction.commit
        | throwError "admitted SDK completions could not commit"
      let some receipt := published.receipt first.request.occurrence
        | throwError "whole-cell commit omitted its receipt"
      let some other := published.receipt second.request.occurrence
        | throwError "whole-cell commit omitted a joint completion"
      let some repeated := published.receipt third.request.occurrence
        | throwError "whole-cell commit omitted a repeated connection's completion"
      let some batch := published.outputBatches.back?
        | throwError "whole-cell commit omitted its output batch"
      unless receipt.snapshot == published.id && receipt.commit == batch.commit &&
          receipt.outputBatch == batch.id && other.outputBatch == batch.id && repeated.outputBatch == batch.id &&
          receipt.association.response.root.value == first.response.root.value do
        throwError "receipt promotion changed its actual result or publication identities"
      let .ok (some reused) ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        published.reuse owners first.request.occurrence firstRole.role.id
        | throwError "the visible committed receipt could not supply its result"
      unless reused.value == first.response.root.value do
        throwError "committed reuse replaced its actual value"
      let committedEnvironment ← getEnv
      setEnv prefixEnvironment
      unless (← SessionSnapshot.current).id == initial.id &&
          ((← SessionSnapshot.current).receipt first.request.occurrence).isNone do
        throwError "restoring an old snapshot recovered a newer receipt"
      let restored ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| restored.reuse first.request.occurrence firstRole.role.id with
      | .ok .unavailable => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "a consumed ledger entry supplied an invisible completion"
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
          restored.reserve first.request.occurrence selected wire.connection #[] with
      | .error (.reservation .consumed) => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "snapshot restoration granted another dispatch"
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) restored.abort
      setEnv committedEnvironment
      let aborted ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let tentative ← perform ledger program selected aborted wire
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) aborted.abort
      if (← SessionSnapshot.current).receipt tentative.request.occurrence |>.isSome then
        throwError "abort published a staged completion"
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| ledger.pendingFor tentative.request.occurrence aborted.id with
      | none => pure ()
      | some _ => throwError "a settled completion remained pending in the ledger"
      let raced ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let racingCompletion ← perform ledger program selected raced otherWire
      let beforeRace ← SessionSnapshot.current
      let cancellation ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.asTask (prio := .dedicated) do
        return ← raced.abort
      let publishedRace ← raced.commit
      let cancelled ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.ofExcept (← IO.wait cancellation)
      match publishedRace with
      | .ok snapshot =>
        unless !cancelled && (snapshot.receipt racingCompletion.request.occurrence).isSome &&
            snapshot.outputBatches.size == beforeRace.outputBatches.size + 1 do
          throwError "commit/cancel published a partial completion"
      | .error .settled =>
        unless cancelled && (← SessionSnapshot.current).id == beforeRace.id &&
            ((← SessionSnapshot.current).receipt racingCompletion.request.occurrence).isNone do
          throwError "cancel/commit exposed an aborted completion"
      | .error _ => throwError "commit/cancel reached an unrelated failure"
      liftM (m := IO) wire.close
      let some nativeRole := native.request.roles.results[0]?
        | throwError "the native receipt lost its root role"
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| published.reuse owners nativeOccurrence nativeRole.role.id with
      | .error .staleOwner => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "an owned receipt remained reusable after its actual owner died"
      let some retained := published.receipt nativeOccurrence
        | throwError "owner loss hid inert receipt metadata"
      checkNativeObservation retained nativeRequest nativeObservation
      let .ok (some portable) ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        published.reuse owners first.request.occurrence firstRole.role.id
        | throwError "an independent portable completion acquired its former provider's owner"
      unless portable.value == first.response.root.value do
        throwError "provider loss reconstructed the committed portable result"
    finally
      liftM (m := IO) otherWire.close
      liftM (m := IO) wire.close
  finally setEnv original

import CasRuntime.Execute
