public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Execute
meta import CasRuntime.Materialize
meta import CasRuntime.Transport

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasRuntime CasCatalogue.Backend

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| packageDir contractPackage
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let prefixEnvironment ← getEnv
    let .ok wire ← liftM (m := IO) <| FramedConnection.start owners "waiter-peer" {
        cmd := (contract / ".venv/bin/python").toString
        args := #[(root / "scripts/probes/protocol_v2_peer.py").toString]
        env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some (contract / "python").toString)] } 5000
      | throwError "the completion waiter peer did not negotiate"
    try
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
      let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
      let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
      let input ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
        { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      let identity ← mkAppOptM ``id #[some (mkConst ``Nat)]
      let function ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close identity)
      let callable ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
        { program, occurrence, role := function, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 input
        | throwError "the waiter input is absent"
      let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable
        #[scalar.source] #[actual] #[]
      let some role := request.roles.results[0]?
        | throwError "the waiter request has no result role"
      let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "waiter-manifest", profileDigest := "waiter-profile"
        registration := { operation := "echo", input := "waiter#input", backend := wire.backend } }
      let .ok .producer ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.claim request.roles.scope
        | throwError "the first demand did not claim its producer"
      let .ok .waiter ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.claim request.roles.scope
        | throwError "a repeated fresh demand started another producer"
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.reuse occurrence role.role.id with
      | .ok .running => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "a claimed producer was invisible before wire reservation"
      let .ok attached ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.watch occurrence role.role.id
        | throwError "the first waiter could not attach"
      let .ok detached ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.watch occurrence role.role.id
        | throwError "the second waiter could not attach"
      let .ok reservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.reserve occurrence selected wire.connection #[input]
        | throwError "the waiter invocation could not reserve"
      liftM (m := BaseIO) detached.detach
      match ← liftM (m := IO) detached.wait with
      | .error .detached => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "a detached waiter remained attached"
      unless (← liftM (m := BaseIO) transaction.activeGraph).isSome &&
          (← liftM (m := BaseIO) (ledger.pendingFor occurrence transaction.id)).isSome do
        throwError "detaching one waiter cancelled its producer"
      let waiting ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.asTask (prio := .dedicated) attached.wait
      let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[input] #[] #[]
      let .ok reply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction reservation scope
        (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode 5000
        | throwError "the waiter producer did not return"
      let .ok completion ← reply.stageCompletion request transaction scope wire.connection
        | throwError "the waiter producer did not stage its complete reply"
      let .ok joined ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.ofExcept (← IO.wait waiting)
        | throwError "the attached waiter did not receive its completed result"
      unless joined.value == completion.response.root.value do
        throwError "a waiter received a replacement result"
      let noDispatch : PFunctor.Handler.Stateful MetaM CellTransaction OperationalSignature :=
        fun _ _ => throwError "a completed occurrence reached external execution"
      let reused ← Execute.run noDispatch
        (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) request) transaction
      unless reused.root.value == joined.value do
        throwError "the execution handler replaced a staged completion"
      let .ok published ← transaction.commit
        | throwError "the joined result could not commit"
      let committedEnvironment ← getEnv
      let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let committed ← Execute.run noDispatch
        (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) request) consumer
      unless committed.root.value == joined.value do
        throwError "the execution handler replaced a committed receipt"
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) consumer.abort
      let cancelledCell ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let cancelledOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let cancelledRequest ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program cancelledOccurrence
        context callable #[scalar.source] #[actual] #[]
      let some cancelledRole := cancelledRequest.roles.results[0]?
        | throwError "the cancelled waiter has no result role"
      let .ok _ ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        cancelledCell.reserve cancelledOccurrence selected wire.connection #[input]
        | throwError "the cancelled producer could not reserve"
      let .ok cancelledWaiter ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        cancelledCell.watch cancelledOccurrence cancelledRole.role.id
        | throwError "the cancelled producer's waiter could not attach"
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) cancelledCell.abort
      match ← liftM (m := IO) cancelledWaiter.wait with
      | .error .settled => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "an aborted producer supplied a completion through its waiter"
      setEnv prefixEnvironment
      let restored ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| Execute.run noDispatch
          (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) request) restored
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure
        | throwError "an old snapshot recovered a consumed completion"
      unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).endsWith "unavailable: reserved_without_receipt" do
        throw failure
      setEnv committedEnvironment
      unless (published.receipt occurrence).isSome do
        throwError "snapshot restoration changed the immutable committed receipt"
    finally liftM (m := IO) wire.close
  finally setEnv original

module

public import CasRuntime.Owner
public import CasRuntime.Deadline
public import CasContract.Port
public import Std.Sync.Semaphore

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean CasCatalogue.Backend

private inductive LeaseStatus
  | allocated | sent | draining | received | discardQueued | discarding | discarded
  | discardFailed (reason : String)
  | committed | abandoned

private structure RequestResource where
  status : LeaseStatus
  cleanup : Option (Task (Except IO.Error Unit)) := none

private structure FramedState where
  nextRequest : Nat := 0
  active : Option Nat := none
  closed : Bool := false
  requests : Std.HashMap Nat RequestResource := {}

/-- One actually negotiated process, one native frame permit and resource-only request status. -/
structure FramedConnection where
  private mk ::
  connection : Connection
  backend : String
  ready : ReadyV2
  private owners : OwnerRegistry
  private permit : Std.Semaphore
  private state : Std.Mutex FramedState

/-- Cleanup authority for one request; this stores no value graph or completed reply. -/
structure RequestLease where
  private mk ::
  requestId : Nat
  transaction : RuntimeId .transaction
  occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence
  private wire : FramedConnection

def RequestLease.owner (lease : RequestLease) : ConnectionGeneration :=
  lease.wire.connection.generation

opaque FramedConnection.close (wire : FramedConnection) : IO Unit := do
  wire.state.atomically do modify fun state => { state with closed := true }
  wire.owners.close wire.connection.generation

/-- Race negotiation against the caller's explicit deadline, without a computational write.
Reuse: CasContract.negotiateV2 and the native task/event-loop deadline helper. -/
opaque FramedConnection.start (owners : OwnerRegistry) (backend : String)
    (arguments : IO.Process.SpawnArgs) (timeoutMs : UInt32) :
    IO (Except PortError FramedConnection) := do
  if timeoutMs == 0 then return .error (.unavailable backend "incompatible_protocol: deadline")
  let connection ← try owners.spawn arguments
    catch error => return .error (.unavailable backend s!"startup: {error}")
  let negotiation ← IO.asTask (prio := .dedicated) <|
    negotiateV2 backend connection.child.stdin connection.child.stdout
  let result ← awaitBefore negotiation timeoutMs
  match result with
  | some (.ok (.ok ready)) =>
    unless ← owners.isLive connection.generation do
      return .error (.unavailable backend "incompatible_protocol: connection_lost")
    return .ok ⟨connection, backend, ready, owners, ← Std.Semaphore.new 1, ← Std.Mutex.new {}⟩
  | none =>
    owners.close connection.generation
    return .error (.unavailable backend "incompatible_protocol: deadline")
  | some (.error error) =>
    owners.close connection.generation
    return .error (.unavailable backend s!"incompatible_protocol: {error}")
  | some (.ok (.error error)) =>
      owners.close connection.generation
      return .error error

/-- The semaphore covers complete frames and request-local cleanup, never a short state mutex. -/
opaque FramedConnection.acquire (wire : FramedConnection) : IO Unit := do
  let acquired ← wire.permit.acquire
  let some () ← IO.wait acquired.result?
    | throw <| IO.userError "the connection permit was dropped"

opaque FramedConnection.release (wire : FramedConnection) : BaseIO Unit := do
  wire.state.atomically do modify fun state => { state with active := none }
  wire.permit.release

def FramedConnection.isBusy (wire : FramedConnection) : BaseIO Bool := do
  return (← wire.permit.availablePermits) == 0

opaque FramedConnection.hasOutstanding (wire : FramedConnection) : BaseIO Bool :=
  wire.state.atomically do
    if (← get).closed then return false
    return (← get).requests.any fun _ resource => match resource.status with
      | .sent | .draining => true
      | _ => false

opaque FramedConnection.isDraining (wire : FramedConnection) : BaseIO Bool :=
  wire.state.atomically do
    if (← get).closed then return false
    return (← get).requests.any fun _ resource => match resource.status with
      | .draining | .discardQueued | .discarding => true
      | _ => false

/-- Allocate under the held frame permit. IDs remain consumed even if dispatch later fails. -/
opaque FramedConnection.beginRequest (wire : FramedConnection)
    (transaction : RuntimeId .transaction) (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence) :
    IO (Except PortError RequestLease) :=
  wire.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    if state.closed then return .error (.unavailable wire.backend "stale_owner")
    unless state.active.isNone &&
        transaction.worker == wire.connection.generation.worker &&
        occurrence.worker == wire.connection.generation.worker do
      throw <| IO.userError "the connection cannot allocate this request"
    let id := state.nextRequest
    set { state with
      nextRequest := id + 1, active := some id,
      requests := state.requests.insert id { status := .allocated } }
    return .ok ⟨id, transaction, occurrence, wire⟩

opaque RequestLease.markSent (lease : RequestLease) : BaseIO Bool :=
  lease.wire.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let some resource := state.requests[lease.requestId]? | return false
    let .allocated := resource.status | return false
    set { state with requests := state.requests.insert lease.requestId { resource with status := .sent } }
    return true

opaque RequestLease.abandon (lease : RequestLease) : BaseIO Unit :=
  lease.wire.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let some resource := state.requests[lease.requestId]? | return
    let .allocated := resource.status | return
    set { state with requests := state.requests.insert lease.requestId { status := .abandoned } }

/-- Decide whether the completed frame still belongs to an active request or must be drained. -/
opaque RequestLease.readCompleted (lease : RequestLease) : BaseIO Bool :=
  lease.wire.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let some resource := state.requests[lease.requestId]? | return false
    match resource.status with
    | .sent =>
      set { state with requests := state.requests.insert lease.requestId { resource with status := .received } }
      return true
    | .draining =>
      set { state with requests := state.requests.insert lease.requestId { resource with status := .discarding } }
      return false
    | _ => return false

private def discardAck (id : Nat) (json : Json) : Except String Unit := do
  checkServiceFields #["request_id", "status", "disposed"] json
  unless (← json.getObjValAs? Nat "request_id") == id &&
      (← json.getObjValAs? String "status") == "ok" &&
      (← json.getObjValAs? Bool "disposed") do
    throw "the cleanup acknowledgement does not match its request"

/-- The caller holds the frame permit. A cleanup has its own fresh transport ID.
Reference: execution contract v2 section 7; reuse the existing framed byte transport. -/
private def discardOnPermit (lease : RequestLease) : IO Unit := do
  let wire := lease.wire
  let cleanupId ← wire.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let id := state.nextRequest
    set { state with nextRequest := id + 1 }
    return id
  let outcome ← try
    writeFrame wire.connection.child.stdin <| Json.mkObj [
      ("protocol", toJson (2 : Nat)), ("request_id", toJson cleanupId),
      ("op", .str "$cas.discard"), ("discard_request_id", toJson lease.requestId)]
    match ← readFrame wire.connection.child.stdout with
    | .ok frame => pure (discardAck cleanupId frame)
    | .error error =>
      wire.close
      pure (.error error.render)
  catch error =>
    wire.close
    pure (.error error.toString)
  wire.state.atomically do
    modify fun state => { state with requests := state.requests.insert lease.requestId {
      status := match outcome with | .ok () => .discarded | .error reason => .discardFailed reason } }

/-- Finish cleanup while retaining the original outstanding frame's permit. -/
opaque RequestLease.discardAfterDrain (lease : RequestLease) : IO Unit :=
  discardOnPermit lease

/-- Abort keeps sent readers running. Received replies instead schedule resource-only cleanup.
Only request identity, actual channels and lease status enter the cleanup task.
Lean IO tasks continue after their caller detaches; no mathematical payload is retained here. -/
opaque RequestLease.cancel (lease : RequestLease) : BaseIO Unit :=
  lease.wire.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let some resource := state.requests[lease.requestId]? | return
    if state.closed then
      set { state with requests := state.requests.insert lease.requestId {
        status := .discardFailed "connection_lost" } }
      return
    match resource.status with
    | .sent =>
      set { state with requests := state.requests.insert lease.requestId { resource with status := .draining } }
    | .received =>
      let task ← IO.asTask (prio := .dedicated) do
        lease.wire.acquire
        try discardOnPermit lease
        finally lease.wire.release
      set { state with requests := state.requests.insert lease.requestId {
        status := .discardQueued, cleanup := some task } }
    | .allocated =>
      set { state with requests := state.requests.insert lease.requestId { status := .abandoned } }
    | _ => pure ()

/-- Only this request's live frame or pending disposal authorizes force.
The check and wire revocation are atomic, so a later request cannot enter the
connection between the check and the actual owner revocation. -/
private def RequestLease.needsDrain (lease : RequestLease) (state : FramedState) : Bool :=
  if state.closed then false else
    match state.requests[lease.requestId]? with
    | some resource => (resource.status matches .sent | .draining | .discardQueued | .discarding)
    | none => false

opaque RequestLease.draining (lease : RequestLease) : BaseIO Bool :=
  lease.wire.state.atomically do
    return lease.needsDrain (← get)

opaque RequestLease.force (lease : RequestLease) : IO (Option ConnectionGeneration) := do
  let closing ← lease.wire.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    unless lease.needsDrain state do return false
    set { state with closed := true }
    return true
  unless closing do return none
  if ← lease.wire.owners.revoke lease.owner then
    return some lease.owner
  return none

opaque RequestLease.canCommit (lease : RequestLease) : BaseIO Bool :=
  lease.wire.state.atomically do
    let some resource := (← get).requests[lease.requestId]? | return false
    return resource.status matches .received

private partial def commitLeaseGroups [Monad m] [MonadLiftT BaseIO m]
    [MonadLiftT (ST IO.RealWorld) m] [MonadFinally m]
    (leases : Array RequestLease) (action : m α) : m (Option α) := do
  let some first := leases[0]? | return some (← action)
  let group := leases.filter (·.owner == first.owner)
  let remaining := leases.filter (·.owner != first.owner)
  first.wire.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    unless group.all (fun lease => match state.requests[lease.requestId]? with
        | some resource => (resource.status matches .received)
        | none => false) do return none
    let result ← commitLeaseGroups remaining action
    if result.isSome then
      let mut state := state
      for lease in group do
        state := { state with requests := state.requests.insert lease.requestId { status := .committed } }
      set state
    return result

/-- Promote every received request lease with one publication decision, or promote none.
Group a connection once and lock connections in generation order to prevent lock cycles.
Reuse: Lean Std.Mutex.atomically and the existing request-resource states. No engine I/O runs here.
Lock-order reference: Oracle Multithreaded Programming Guide, Using Locking Hierarchies,
https://docs.oracle.com/cd/E19455-01/806-5257/sync-ex-3/index.html . -/
opaque RequestLease.commitAll [Monad m] [MonadLiftT BaseIO m]
    [MonadLiftT (ST IO.RealWorld) m] [MonadFinally m]
    (transaction : RuntimeId .transaction) (leases : Array RequestLease) (action : m α) :
    m (Option α) := do
  unless leases.all (fun lease => lease.transaction == transaction &&
      lease.owner.worker == transaction.worker) do return none
  commitLeaseGroups (leases.qsort fun left right => left.owner.serial < right.owner.serial) action

opaque FramedConnection.cleanupFailures (wire : FramedConnection) : BaseIO (Array (Nat × String)) :=
  wire.state.atomically do
    return (← get).requests.fold (init := #[]) fun found id resource =>
      match resource.status with
      | .discardFailed reason => found.push (id, reason)
      | _ => found

end CasRuntime

import CasRuntime.Session

namespace CasRuntime.ConstrainedPointTests

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue

private def nativeSyntax (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | throwError "the native constrained-point control did not parse"
  return ⟨stx⟩

private def readSource (session : SourceSession) (text : String) : TermElabM SourceTerm := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the constrained-point source control did not parse"
  session.read ⟨stx⟩

private def rejected (session : SourceSession) (text : String) (tag : Name) : TermElabM Unit := do
  let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the constrained-point source control did not parse"
  let failure : Option Exception ← withoutModifyingState do
    try
      discard <| session.read ⟨stx⟩
      pure none
    catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "the constrained-point source was incorrectly admitted: {text}"
  unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag (· == tag) do throw failure

-- The same native Hom endpoint inspection as SourceReader.mapEnds, in the MetaM context
-- of ClosedTerm.withOpen. This fixture adds no source interpretation or chosen endpoint.
private def mapEndpoints (arrow : Expr) : MetaM (Option (Expr × Expr)) := do
  let type ← whnfR (← instantiateMVars (← inferType arrow))
  if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then
    return some (← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[2]!,
      ← declaredEndpoint type.getAppArgs[3]!)
  if type.isAppOfArity ``TypeCat.Hom 2 then
    return some (type.getAppArgs[0]!, type.getAppArgs[1]!)
  return none

-- Native Subtype is the independently declared constructor. Its one computational field
-- is the actual opaque input, even though no numeric value is supplied or observed.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let owner ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let empty ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
      let dataSource ← empty.assume `datum (← nativeSyntax "Nat")
      let some datumEntry := dataSource.context.entries.back?
        | throwError "the constrained input lost its original source declaration"
      let source ← dataSource.define `target (← nativeSyntax "{ n : Nat // n = datum }")
      let admitted ← readSource source "datum in target using (proof(rfl))"
      for (text, tag) in #[
          ("datum in target using (proof(True.intro))", `CasCompiler.sourceFormalProof.typeMismatch),
          ("datum in target using (proof(rfl), proof(rfl))", `CasCompiler.sourceConstrainedPoint.proofCount),
          ("datum in target using (rfl)", `CasCompiler.SourceReader.explicitProof),
          ("datum in target", `CasCompiler.SourceReader.declaredParameterType)] do
        rejected source text tag
      let twoFields ← source.define `target (← nativeSyntax "Nat × Nat")
      rejected twoFields "datum in target using (proof(True.intro))"
        `CasCompiler.sourceConstrainedPoint.dataFieldCount
      let recursiveSource ← source.define `target (← nativeSyntax "List Nat")
      rejected recursiveSource "datum in target using (proof(True.intro))"
        `CasCompiler.sourceConstrainedPoint.structureShape
      SourceTest.checkSelected admitted fun expression => do
        let scope ← get
        let some datum := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == datumEntry.id)
          | throwError "the constrained input lost its original source binding"
        let originalData ← SourceTest.visitNativeData
          (fun term => pure (term.equal datum.expression)) expression (throughAuthoredLets := false)
        let constructors ← SourceTest.visitNativeData
          (fun term => pure (term.isConstOf ``Subtype.mk)) expression (throughAuthoredLets := false)
        unless originalData > 0 && constructors > 0 do
          throwError "constrained formation replaced its original data or native constructor"
      admitted.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let selections ← admitted.selections.inContext context
        let some datum := bindings.find? (·.id == datumEntry.id)
          | throwError "the constrained input lost its original source binding"
        let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm admitted.source (selections := admitted.selections)
        unless layout.kind == .record &&
            (layout.fields.filter (·.wireIndex.isSome)).size == 1 &&
            (layout.fields.filter (·.kind == .proof)).size == 1 do
          throwError "constrained formation erased data or invented a computational proof field"
        let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
        let input ← producer.stage
          { program, occurrence := ← kernel.ledger.allocate,
            role := ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close datum.expression)
              (selections := admitted.selections),
            parameters := Array.replicate bindings.size none }
          (.ownedExport owner "original constrained input" #[])
        let .ok _ ← producer.commit
          | throwError "the original constrained input could not publish"
        let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let supplied : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding := {}
          let value ← kernel.run consumer context (supplied.insert datum.id input) expression
            (selections := selections)
          let graph ← consumer.view
          let some node := graph.find value.value
            | throwError "the constrained value is outside its actual graph"
          let some fields := node.payload.data.storedFields?
            | throwError "the native constrained value lost its stored data field"
          unless fields.size == 1 do
            throwError "the native constrained value invented an additional field"
          let .ok actual := graph.project value 0
            | throwError "the constrained value lost its declared computational field"
          unless actual.value == input.value &&
              input.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf actual.associationIds.toList do
            throwError "the constrained value replaced the actual original data"
          let some originalNode := graph.find actual.value
            | throwError "the original constrained data are outside the visible graph"
          let .ownedToken generation token _ := originalNode.payload.data
            | throwError "the constrained value decoded or replaced opaque data"
          unless generation == owner.generation && token == "original constrained input" &&
              (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "constrained formation changed ownership or dispatched a provider"
        finally discard <| consumer.abort
    finally
      owners.close owner.generation
      kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- The prerequisite declarations and membership proof are unchanged RX08 source. This is
-- formal reading only: no kernel coordinate, inclusion, or pairing answer is supplied.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let identities ← liftM (m := IO) IdentitySupply.new
    let mut session ← SourceSession.empty identities
    for text in #[
        "let Q := ℚ in CommutativeRings",
        "let Qring := view Q along «fun.commutative_rings.ring»()",
        "let scalarModule := RegularModule(Qring)",
        "let formedSource := RationalDiagonal23()",
        "let sourceModule := view formedSource along «fun.bilin_module.forget»(ℚ, ℚ)",
        "let row := [1, 0] in RectangularMatrices(1, 2, Q)",
        "let projection := row_linear_map(2, Q, row)",
        "let restricted := RestrictToModuleKernel(Q, scalarModule, formedSource, scalarModule, projection)",
        "let formedInclusion := ordinary_kernel_inclusion(Q, scalarModule, formedSource, scalarModule, projection)",
        "let restrictionCarrier := view restricted along «fun.bilin_module.forget»(ℚ, ℚ)",
        "let coordinateData(t) := (0, t) in (ℚ in Sets) → (Vec(Q, 2) in Sets)"] do
      let .ok stx := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text
        | throwError "an original RX08 declaration did not parse"
      let checked ← try session.readStatement ⟨stx⟩
        catch failure => throwError
          "the original RX08 declaration did not read: {text}; {failure.toMessageData}"
      let .definition next _ := checked
        | throwError "an original RX08 declaration changed statement kind"
      session := next
    let text := "coordinateData in restrictionCarrier using (proof(by intro t; exact (CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.ModuleKernelRestriction.RationalProjection.mem_kernel ![0, t]).2 rfl))"
    let admitted ← readSource session text
    let nativeType ← session.term (← nativeSyntax "Type")
    let .ok carrierSyntax := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term "restrictionCarrier"
      | throwError "the original constrained target did not parse"
    let expectedTarget ← session.read ⟨carrierSyntax⟩ (some nativeType.source)
      (expectedSelections := nativeType.selections)
    let some category := admitted.category
      | throwError "the generalized constrained point lost its source-map category"
    unless category.role == .morphism &&
        category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) do
      throwError "the generalized constrained point acquired another categorical role"
    let some coordinateEntry := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `coordinateData)
      | throwError "RX08 lost its original coordinate declaration"
    SourceTest.checkSelected admitted fun expression => do
      let scope ← get
      let some coordinateData := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == coordinateEntry.id)
        | throwError "RX08 lost its original coordinate map"
      let originalData ← SourceTest.visitNativeData
        (fun term => pure (term.equal coordinateData.expression)) expression
        (throughAuthoredLets := false)
      let constructors ← SourceTest.visitNativeData
        (fun term => pure (term.isConstOf ``Subtype.mk)) expression (throughAuthoredLets := false)
      let proofs ← SourceTest.visitNativeData (fun term => pure (term.isConstOf
        ``CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.ModuleKernelRestriction.RationalProjection.mem_kernel))
        expression (throughAuthoredLets := false)
      unless originalData > 0 && constructors > 0 && proofs > 0 do
        throwError "RX08 changed its original map, full domain, selected target or supplied proof"
      let target ← session.readTerm expectedTarget
      SourceTest.checkOriginal #[coordinateData.expression, expression, target] fun terms => do
        let some (originalDomain, _) ← mapEndpoints terms[0]!
          | throwError "the original coordinate data lost its complete map domain"
        let some (actualDomain, actualTarget) ← mapEndpoints terms[1]!
          | throwError "the constrained coordinate data are not a complete generalized point"
        unless (← isDefEq actualDomain originalDomain) && (← isDefEq actualTarget terms[2]!) do
          throwError "RX08 changed its original map, full domain, selected target or supplied proof"
    -- A proof at one sample cannot replace the original universally quantified evidence.
    rejected session "coordinateData in restrictionCarrier using (proof((CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.ModuleKernelRestriction.RationalProjection.mem_kernel ![0, (0 : ℚ)]).2 rfl))"
      `CasCompiler.sourceFormalProof.typeMismatch
    let withPoint ← session.defineTerm `kappa admitted
    let composite ← try readSource withPoint "formedInclusion(kappa)"
      catch failure => throwError
        "the original whole coordinate application did not read: {failure.toMessageData}"
    let some category := composite.category
      | throwError "the original whole coordinate inclusion lost its morphism role"
    unless category.role == .morphism &&
        category.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) do
      throwError "the original whole coordinate inclusion changed its carrier category"
    let some inclusionEntry := withPoint.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `formedInclusion)
      | throwError "the original formed inclusion binding is absent"
    let some pointEntry := withPoint.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `kappa)
      | throwError "the original admitted coordinate binding is absent"
    SourceTest.checkSelected composite fun expression => do
      let scope ← get
      let some inclusion := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == inclusionEntry.id)
        | throwError "the original formed inclusion is outside the source context"
      let some point := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == pointEntry.id)
        | throwError "the original coordinate map is outside the source context"
      let originalInclusion ← SourceTest.visitNativeData
        (fun term => pure (term.equal inclusion.expression)) expression (throughAuthoredLets := false)
      let originalPoint ← SourceTest.visitNativeData
        (fun term => pure (term.equal point.expression)) expression (throughAuthoredLets := false)
      unless originalInclusion > 0 && originalPoint > 0 do
        throwError "the whole coordinate inclusion replaced its actual source maps"
      SourceTest.checkOriginal #[expression, inclusion.expression, point.expression] fun terms => do
        -- Fixed.forget uses this independently declared underlyingMap. Its full implicit
        -- parameters, including the chosen Module instance, come from the actual arrow
        -- before any projection is applied; no instance is synthesized at ↑Q ↑scalarModule.
        let expected ← try
            let declaration ← mkConstWithFreshMVarLevels
              ``LeanCategories.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.BilinModuleCat.underlyingMap
            let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType declaration)
            let some arrow := parameters.back?
              | throwError "the native underlying map has no morphism parameter"
            unless ← isDefEq arrow terms[1]! do
              throwError "the native underlying map changed the actual inclusion type"
            let linear ← instantiateMVars (mkAppN declaration parameters)
            if linear.hasMVar || linear.hasLevelMVar then
              throwError "the native inclusion did not determine its complete parameters"
            let additive ← mkProjection linear `toAddHom
            let function ← mkProjection additive `toFun
            let carrierMap ← mkAppM ``TypeCat.ofHom #[function]
            mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp #[terms[2]!, carrierMap]
          catch failure => throwError
            "the native coordinate inclusion composite did not elaborate: {failure.toMessageData}"
        unless ← isDefEq terms[0]! expected do
          throwError "the whole coordinate inclusion replaced its actual source maps"
    let .ok question := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term
      "formedInclusion(kappa) = coordinateData"
      | throwError "the original whole coordinate assertion did not parse"
    discard <| withPoint.readQuestion ⟨question⟩
  finally setEnv original

-- Literal data use the same independently fixed native record constructor. The numeral
-- reader must leave a non-categorical proof annotation to constrained-point formation.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let identities ← liftM (m := IO) IdentitySupply.new
    let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
    let source ← empty.define `numericTarget (← nativeSyntax "{ n : Nat // n = 3 }")
    let admitted ← readSource source "3 in numericTarget using (proof(rfl))"
    SourceTest.checkSelected admitted fun expression => do
      let constructors ← SourceTest.visitNativeData
        (fun term => pure (term.isConstOf ``Subtype.mk)) expression (throughAuthoredLets := false)
      unless constructors > 0 do
        throwError "the constrained literal lost its native record constructor"
    rejected source "3 in numericTarget using (proof(True.intro))"
      `CasCompiler.sourceFormalProof.typeMismatch
    rejected source "3 in numericTarget using (proof(rfl), proof(rfl))"
      `CasCompiler.sourceConstrainedPoint.proofCount
  finally setEnv original

end CasRuntime.ConstrainedPointTests

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

private def sameConstructionOccurrence (original actual : ValueBinding) : Bool :=
  original.value == actual.value &&
    original.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf actual.associationIds.toList

/-- Only an actual recorded native projection can extend an original argument position.
No source expression, packet or native endpoint selects another value. -/
private partial def constructionParameterPath? (graph : ValueGraph)
    (original actual : ValueBinding) : MetaM (Option (Array Name)) := do
  if original.value == actual.value && original.associationIds == actual.associationIds then
    return some #[]
  let some (_, parent, path) ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (graph.projectionSelection actual).mapError IO.userError | return none
  let some earlier ← constructionParameterPath? graph original parent | return none
  return some (earlier ++ path)

/-- Follow this cone's actual native access back to its producing completion. A creation
owns its lifted source Cone at the declared LiftsToLimit path; its target Cone is distinct. -/
private partial def constructionCompletion (transaction : CellTransaction) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (cone current : ValueBinding) (path : Array Name := #[]) :
    MetaM CompletionAssociation := do
  let some node := graph.find current.value
    | throwError "the construction leg lost its original visible cone"
  if let some completion ← transaction.completionFor? node.origin.occurrence then
    if sameConstructionOccurrence completion.response.root current then
      match completion.request.action with
      | .primitive (.limit ..) _ =>
        unless path.isEmpty do
          throwError "the raw construction leg changed its original complete cone root"
        return completion
      | .primitive (.creation _) _ =>
        unless path == #[``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit.toLiftableCone,
            ``CategoryTheory.LiftableCone.liftedCone] do
          throwError "the created construction leg changed its exact lifted source cone path"
        let some _ ← IO.ofExcept <|
            (graph.projectionBasis cone current path).mapError IO.userError
          | throwError "the created source cone lost its actual complete-result parent"
        return completion
      | _ => pure ()
  let some (_, parent, previous) ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (graph.projectionSelection current).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "the construction leg lost its original producing completion"
  constructionCompletion transaction graph cone parent (previous ++ path)

/-- A read-only view of the actual completion's original source argument table. The native
view retains every original proof and computational argument position. -/
private structure RetainedConstructionSource where
  request : PreparedRequest
  owner : Expr
  ownerFamily : SelectedLimitOwner Expr
  parameters : Array Expr
  values : Array (Option ValueBinding)
  selection : NativeLimitSelection

private def retainedConstructionSource (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
    (cone : ValueBinding)
    (action : OpenContext → Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding → RetainedConstructionSource →
      MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  unless ← graph.isAvailable kernel.ledger.owners cone do transactionFailure .staleOwner
  let completion ← constructionCompletion transaction graph cone cone
  unless ← graph.isAvailable kernel.ledger.owners completion.response.root do
    transactionFailure .staleOwner
  let request := completion.request
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs graph
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
  let some node := graph.find cone.value
    | throwError "the construction leg lost its original visible native fields"
  match node.payload.data with
  | .container complete =>
    unless complete.originalPacket.isSome && complete.fields.isSome do
      throwError "the construction leg cannot use an incomplete native cone"
  | .ownedToken .. =>
    unless request.action matches .primitive (.creation _) _ do
      throwError "the raw construction leg requires its complete native data ports"
  | _ => throwError "the construction leg lost its complete returned native cone"
  request.environment.withContext context bound fun context bound => do
    match request.action with
    | .primitive (.limit family owner) _ =>
      let ownerFamily ← owner.mapM (·.inContext context)
      let owner ← family.ownerFamily ownerFamily
      let source := request.application.map (·.arguments.map (·.source.source)) |>.getD #[]
      let values := request.origin.application.map (·.arguments) |>.getD #[]
      unless source.size == family.parameterCount && values.size == source.size do
        throwError "the construction leg lost its complete original parameter table"
      let parameters ← source.mapM (·.inContext context)
      let selection ← family.ownerAt ownerFamily parameters
      return ← action context bound { request, owner, ownerFamily, parameters, values, selection }
    | .primitive (.creation prepared) _ =>
      let owner ← prepared.owner.inContext context
      let ownerFamily ← prepared.sourceOwner.mapM (·.inContext context)
      let parameters ← prepared.sourceArguments.mapM (·.inContext context)
      let selection ← prepared.selection context
      let environment ← request.environment.withGraph (some graph)
      let mut values : Array (Option ValueBinding) := #[]
      for parameter in parameters do
        let selected ← if ← isProof parameter then pure none
          else environment.endpointValue? context graph parameter
        if let some value := selected then
          environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph parameter value
        values := values.push selected
      return ← action context bound { request, owner, ownerFamily, parameters, values, selection }
    | _ => throwError "the construction leg has no original raw or created source preparation"

/-- The exact whole raw-construction input shared by creation preparation and descriptor
admission. The original request retains every native argument position; this read does not
promote a created source Cone, another equal record, or an apex to a raw target completion. -/
opaque Kernel.retainedRawConstructionCone (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
    (cone : ValueBinding)
    (action : OpenContext → Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding →
      (PreparedRequest × Expr × NativeLimitSelection × Expr) → MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  retainedConstructionSource kernel transaction graph context bound cone fun context bound original => do
    unless original.request.action matches .primitive (.limit ..) _ do
      throwError "the creation target is not its original complete raw construction"
    withBindingContext graph context bound cone fun context bound => do
      withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound
          (← cone.role.source.inContext context) cone fun context bound coneSource =>
        action context bound (original.request, original.owner, original.selection, coneSource)

/-- Resolve only an explicit complete-cone reference to its original producing completion,
selected owner and already admitted source. The common compiler entrance owns diagram/index
reading and native leg formation. No equal packet, apex, endpoint or expression selects a
completion, and this adapter emits no mathematical application. -/
opaque Kernel.retainedConstructionCone (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
    (retained : Json → MetaM (Option ValueBinding)) (packet : Json)
    (action : OpenContext → Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding →
      Option (Expr × NativeLimitSelection × Expr) → MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  let some cone ← retained packet | return ← action context bound none
  retainedConstructionSource kernel transaction graph context bound cone fun context bound original => do
    let finish (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
        (selected : NativeLimitSelection) : MetaM α :=
      withBindingContext graph context bound cone fun context bound => do
        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound
            (← cone.role.source.inContext context) cone fun context bound coneSource =>
          action context bound (some (original.owner, selected, coneSource))
    match original.request.action with
    | .primitive (.limit family _) _ =>
      original.request.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound family.parameterCount
        fun context bound parameters _ => do
          finish context bound (← family.ownerAt original.ownerFamily parameters)
    | .primitive (.creation _) _ => finish context bound original.selection
    | _ => throwError "the construction leg changed its original source preparation"

/-- Abstract an index occurrence only when its explicit retained reference selects an
original parameter and the original source syntax verifies that exact positional substitution.
Unrelated locals stay unchanged; no matcher or function body is evaluated. -/
private partial def abstractConstructionIndex (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (context : OpenContext) (graph : ValueGraph) (original : RetainedConstructionSource)
    (formals : Array Expr) (expression : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  if let some selected ← environment.endpointValue? context graph expression then
    let mut positions : Array Nat := #[]
    for value in original.values, index in [:original.values.size] do
      let some value := value | continue
      unless value.value == selected.value && value.associationIds == selected.associationIds do
        continue
      let some parameter := original.parameters[index]?
        | throwError "the construction index lost an original source position"
      if parameter.equal expression then positions := positions.push index
    if let #[position] := positions then
      let some formal := formals[position]?
        | throwError "the construction index lost an original formal position"
      return formal
    -- Repeated identical source slots supply no unique positional substitution. Keep the
    -- actual original index occurrence in scope; the native checker must validate it there.
    unless positions.isEmpty do return expression
  let recur := abstractConstructionIndex environment context graph original formals
  match expression with
  | .mdata data body => return .mdata data (← recur body)
  | .app function argument => return .app (← recur function) (← recur argument)
  | .lam name type body info => return .lam name (← recur type) (← recur body) info
  | .forallE name type body info => return .forallE name (← recur type) (← recur body) info
  | .letE name type value body nonDependent =>
    return .letE name (← recur type) (← recur value) (← recur body) nonDependent
  | .proj owner index body => return .proj owner index (← recur body)
  | expression => return expression

/-- Validate an explicitly supplied original endpoint against this exact construction leg.
Every matching declaration position comes from the original actual binding table. The native
checker only validates those positions in the rigid owner telescope; it chooses no value. -/
opaque Kernel.checkConstructionEndpoint (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext) (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (leg : NativeConstructionLeg) (target : Bool) (candidate : Expr) : MetaM Bool := do
  if target == leg.selection.source.colimit then return false
  let some supplied ← environment.endpointValue? context graph candidate | return false
  let some cone ← environment.endpointValue? context graph leg.cone
    | throwError "the construction endpoint lost its exact retained native cone"
  retainedConstructionSource kernel transaction graph context environment.bound cone
      fun context _ original => do
    unless leg.owner.equal original.owner &&
        leg.selection.source.construction == original.selection.source.construction &&
        leg.selection.source.row == original.selection.source.row &&
        leg.selection.source.declaration == original.selection.source.declaration &&
        leg.selection.source.colimit == original.selection.source.colimit do
      throwError "the construction endpoint changed its original complete source owner"
    let mut positions : Array (Nat × Array Name) := #[]
    for value in original.values, index in [:original.values.size] do
      let some value := value | continue
      if let some path ← constructionParameterPath? graph value supplied then
        positions := positions.push (index, path)
    let some (position, path) := positions[0]? | return false
    let indexFamily ← withConstructionParameters original.ownerFamily
        original.selection.source.construction original.parameters.size fun formals _ => do
      let index ← abstractConstructionIndex environment context graph original formals leg.index
      mkLambdaFVars formals index (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
    checkConstructionLegEndpointAt original.ownerFamily original.selection original.parameters
      indexFamily leg.index target position path (positions.extract 1 positions.size)
    return true

/-- Read the creation selection only from an explicit retained value's immutable original
source role. The actual binding is named in the same complete scope; payloads and equal native types do not
supply or replace a construction owner. -/
opaque Kernel.retainedCreationOwner (kernel : Kernel) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
    (retained : Json → MetaM (Option ValueBinding)) (packet : Json)
    (action : OpenContext → Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding →
      Option (NativeLimitSelection × Expr) → MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  let some value ← retained packet | return ← action context bound none
  unless ← graph.isAvailable kernel.ledger.owners value do
    transactionFailure .staleOwner
  let some node := graph.find value.value
    | throwError "the creation request lost its original visible owner"
  withBindingContext graph context bound value fun context bound => do
    let source ← value.selectedSource context
    let some original ← value.role.selected? context | return ← action context bound none
    let some selected := original.limit | return ← action context bound none
    unless selected.source.creation.isSome do return ← action context bound none
    withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound source value fun context bound owner =>
      action context bound (some (selected, owner))

end CasRuntime
