open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasRuntime CasCatalogue

private def constructorPortNative (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | throwError "the original native constructor parameter did not parse"
  return ⟨parsed⟩

private def constructorPortSource (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the original public construction did not parse"
  return ⟨parsed⟩

-- Actual accepted product and pullback constructors preserve native/proof slot order.
-- Equal endpoint packets at distinct original bindings never identify those endpoints.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← OccurrenceLedger.new owners
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let supplier ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let source ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
      let source ← source.assume `X (← constructorPortNative "Type")
      let source ← source.assume `Y (← constructorPortNative "Type")
      for (text, proofExpected) in #[
          ("X × Y", false), ("pullback(id(X), id(X))", true)] do
        let construction ← source.read (← constructorPortSource text)
        let some category := construction.category
          | throwError "the public construction lost its original category"
        let some selected := category.limit
          | throwError "the public construction lost its accepted native constructor"
        let fresh : MetaM BindingId := do
          let id ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| owners.identities.fresh .sourceBinding
          return ⟨id.worker, id.serial⟩
        let plan ← ConstructorPorts.prepare selected.interface fresh
        unless plan.context.entries.size == plan.originalContext.entries.size + plan.ports.size do
          throwError "constructor preparation dropped part of its complete native telescope"
        let mut wire := 0
        let mut seen : Std.HashSet BindingId := {}
        for port in plan.ports, index in [:plan.ports.size] do
          unless port.argument.sourceIndex == index && !seen.contains port.binding do
            throwError "constructor ports merged original bindings or reordered native positions"
          seen := seen.insert port.binding
          if let some actual := port.argument.wireIndex then
            unless actual == wire do throwError "constructor wire order replaced native source order"
            wire := wire + 1
          port.argument.typeFamily.withOpen fun _ family => do
            lambdaTelescope family fun previous _ => do
              unless previous.size == index do
                throwError "a constructor port erased an earlier native or proof binder"
        unless plan.ports.any (·.argument.wireIndex.isNone) == proofExpected do
          throwError "the original proof-port control lost its native telescope"
        let some apex ← plan.projectionAt #[``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt]
          | throwError "the accepted constructor lost its source-authored apex route"
        let .argument apexIndex := apex.target
          | throwError "the accepted constructor replaced its apex data port"
        let some originalApexPort := plan.ports[apexIndex]?
          | throwError "the accepted constructor lost its original apex position"
        unless apex.path.isEmpty && originalApexPort.argument.wireIndex == some 0 do
          throwError "the accepted constructor changed its original apex supplier"
        if (← plan.projectionAt #[``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.π,
            ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app]).isSome then
          throwError "a matcher-defined cone leg was guessed from a data-port ordinal"

        construction.source.withOpen fun bindings _ => do
          let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
          let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
          let occurrence ← ledger.allocate
          let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
          try
            let packet := Lean.Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "finiteData"),
              ("args", .arr #[toJson "equal original endpoint data", .arr #[toJson (0 : Nat)]])]
            let mut parameters := #[]
            let mut endpoints : Array ValueBinding := #[]
            for binding in bindings do
              let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close binding.expression)
              let value ← transaction.stage
                { program, occurrence, role, parameters := Array.replicate bindings.size none }
                (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
              let parameter ← IO.ofExcept <|
                (RuntimeParameter.ofValue (← transaction.view) binding.id value).mapError IO.userError
              parameters := parameters.push parameter
              endpoints := endpoints.push value
            let #[firstEndpoint, secondEndpoint] := endpoints
              | throwError "the original endpoint fixture lost a declared binding"
            unless firstEndpoint.value != secondEndpoint.value &&
                bindings[0]!.id != bindings[1]!.id do
              throwError "equal-data endpoint controls lost their distinct original occurrences"
            let cone ← selected.cone.inContext context
            let function ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close
              (mkLambda `ignored .default (mkConst ``Nat) cone))
            let actualContext := endpoints.map some
            let callable ← transaction.stage
              { program, occurrence, role := function, parameters := actualContext }
              (.closure program endpoints)
            let dummyRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 0))
            let dummy ← transaction.stage
              { program, occurrence, role := dummyRole, parameters := actualContext }
              (.portable "0".toUTF8)
            let graph ← transaction.view
            let actual ← IO.ofExcept <| (RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 dummy).mapError IO.userError
            let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence
              context callable #[dummyRole.source] #[actual] parameters (some graph)
            let initial ← ConstructorPortPrefix.prepare request graph plan
            let apexOrigin ← initial.origin request graph
            let apex ← transaction.stage apexOrigin (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
            let otherApex ← transaction.stage apexOrigin (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
            let graph ← transaction.view
            let mut nativePrefix ← initial.bind graph apex
            let otherPrefix ← initial.bind graph otherApex
            let mut first := true
            let mut last : Option ValueBinding := none
            while nativePrefix.current?.isSome do
              let some port := nativePrefix.current? | throwError "the original constructor cursor disappeared"
              let (domain, target) ← port.argument.source.source.withOpen fun locals value => do
                let (domain, target) ← categoricalPointEndpoints value
                let originalValue (endpoint : Expr) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
                  let .fvar id := endpoint.consumeMData
                    | throwError "the constructor endpoint control changed its original native binder"
                  let some originalBinding := locals.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == id)
                    | throwError "the constructor endpoint lost its original BindingId"
                  let some actual ← IO.ofExcept <|
                      (nativePrefix.environment.lookup originalBinding.id).mapError IO.userError
                    | throwError "the constructor endpoint has no earlier actual supplier"
                  return actual
                return (← originalValue domain, ← originalValue target)
              let codec ← nativePrefix.mapCodec (← transaction.view) domain target
              unless codec.source.value == apex.value && codec.target.value == target.value do
                throwError "the map port replaced its original constructor/request endpoint"
              let wrong := if target.value == firstEndpoint.value then secondEndpoint else firstEndpoint
              let rejected ← try
                  discard <| nativePrefix.mapCodec (← transaction.view) domain wrong
                  pure false
                catch _ => pure true
              unless rejected do
                throwError "equal endpoint bytes replaced a different original request binding"
              supplier.child.stdin.putStr s!"constructor-port-{port.argument.sourceIndex}\n"
              supplier.child.stdin.flush
              let token := (← supplier.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
              let origin ← nativePrefix.origin request (← transaction.view)
              let nativeMap ← transaction.stage origin (.ownedExport supplier token #[domain, target])
              let graph ← transaction.view
              if first then
                let rejected ← try
                    discard <| otherPrefix.bind graph nativeMap
                    pure false
                  catch _ => pure true
                unless rejected do
                  throwError "a map captured another equal-data constructor predecessor"
                first := false
              nativePrefix ← nativePrefix.bind graph nativeMap
              last := some nativeMap
            let values ← IO.ofExcept <| nativePrefix.finish.mapError IO.userError
            unless values.size == plan.ports.size && (values.filterMap id).size == wire do
              throwError "the completed constructor lost its full native/proof port table"
            for port in plan.ports, value in values do
              if port.argument.wireIndex.isNone && value.isSome then
                throwError "a formal constructor proof acquired a computational payload"
            -- The complete original table rejects a different equal-data apex before
            -- any native result association is created.
            let wrongValues := values.set! apexIndex (some otherApex)
            let wrongTableRejected ← try
                discard <| ConstructorPortPrefix.ofValues request (← transaction.view)
                  plan wrongValues
                pure false
              catch _ => pure true
            unless wrongTableRejected do
              throwError "a completed constructor accepted another actual predecessor"
            let missingRejected ← try
                discard <| ConstructorPortPrefix.ofValues request (← transaction.view)
                  plan (values.extract 0 (values.size - 1))
                pure false
              catch _ => pure true
            unless missingRejected do
              throwError "constructor transport accepted an incomplete native telescope"

            -- Consume the port through the original outer Cone interface, rather than
            -- admitting the port only inside the extra formal constructor scope.
            let admitted ← ConstructorPortPrefix.ofValues request (← transaction.view) plan values
            let before ← transaction.view
            let some originalNode := before.find apex.value
              | throwError "the original apex disappeared before outer-cone assembly"
            let some declaredPoint := request.source.fields.find?
                (·.projection == ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt)
              | throwError "the original cone lost its declared apex position"
            let bareRejected ← try
                discard <| request.environment.checkResult before
                  (← declaredPoint.toLayout) apex
                pure false
              catch _ => pure true
            unless bareRejected do
              throwError "an untransported port escaped its original full native telescope"
            let draft ← transaction.draft
            let (draft, nativeApex) ← admitted.transportProjection request
              #[``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt] draft
            unless nativeApex.value == apex.value &&
                apex.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf nativeApex.associationIds.toList do
              throwError "native cone transport replaced its original apex node or baseline"
            let some unchanged := draft.view.find apex.value
              | throwError "native cone transport dropped its original apex node"
            unless unchanged.origin.role.source.context.exactlyMatches
                originalNode.origin.role.source.context &&
                unchanged.origin.role.source.expression.equal
                  originalNode.origin.role.source.expression &&
                unchanged.origin.parameters.size == plan.context.entries.size do
              throwError "native cone transport rewrote or truncated the immutable producing scope"

            let coneLayout ← RecordLayout.ofSource request.source
            let #[pointField, transformationField] :=
                coneLayout.fields.filter (·.field.wireIndex.isSome)
              | throwError "the actual native cone changed its complete data interface"
            unless pointField.field.projection == ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt do
              throwError "the native cone changed its source-prescribed apex field"
            let transformation ← RecordLayout.ofSource transformationField.layout
            let #[componentField] := transformation.fields.filter (·.field.wireIndex.isSome)
              | throwError "the native cone changed its component interface"
            let (draft, component) ← draft.stage
              (← request.originFor componentField.layout (some draft.view))
              (.closure program (values.filterMap id))
            let transPrefix ← RecordPrefix.prepare owners.identities program request.occurrence
              transformation draft.view request.environment.bound
            let (draft, transPrefix, _) ← draft.bindField transPrefix component
            let payload ← IO.ofExcept <| transPrefix.finish.mapError IO.userError
            let (draft, transformationValue) ← draft.stage
              (← request.originFor transformationField.layout (some draft.view)) payload
            let conePrefix ← RecordPrefix.prepare owners.identities program request.occurrence
              coneLayout draft.view request.environment.bound
            let (draft, conePrefix, nativeApex) ← draft.bindField conePrefix nativeApex
            let (draft, conePrefix, _) ← draft.bindField conePrefix transformationValue
            let payload ← IO.ofExcept <| conePrefix.finish.mapError IO.userError
            let (draft, coneValue) ← draft.stage
              (← request.originFor request.source (some draft.view)) payload
            let whole ← request.admitResult draft.view coneValue
            unless whole.root.value == coneValue.value do
              throwError "whole-cone admission replaced the returned result occurrence"
            let apexOwners ← IO.ofExcept <|
              (draft.view.requiredOwners #[nativeApex]).mapError IO.userError
            let coneOwners ← IO.ofExcept <|
              (draft.view.requiredOwners #[whole.root]).mapError IO.userError
            unless !apexOwners.contains supplier.generation &&
                coneOwners.contains supplier.generation do
              throwError "portable apex ownership was widened to the cone's retained legs"

            let projection ← PreparedRequest.forStoredProjection owners.identities program
              (← ledger.allocate) context draft.view whole.root
              #[``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt] parameters
            let (draft, access) ← projection.associateResult owners.identities projection.source
              draft nativeApex #[] (complete := true)
            discard <| projection.admitResult draft.view access
            withBindingContext draft.view context request.environment.bound whole.root fun context bound => do
              let originalCone ← request.source.source.inContext context
              withBoundValue owners.identities context bound originalCone whole.root fun context bound selectedCone => do
                let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context bound draft.view
                let actualSource ← context.close (← mkProjection selectedCone `pt)
                let actual ← IO.ofExcept <|
                  (RuntimeArgument.ofValue draft.view 0 access).mapError IO.userError
                let consumed ← environment.checkArgument actualSource actual
                unless consumed.value == apex.value &&
                    access.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf consumed.associationIds.toList do
                  throwError "the later native consumer lost the exact projected apex occurrence"
                let wrongConsumerRejected ← try
                    let wrong ← IO.ofExcept <|
                      (RuntimeArgument.ofValue draft.view 0 otherApex).mapError IO.userError
                    discard <| environment.checkArgument actualSource wrong
                    pure false
                  catch _ => pure true
                unless wrongConsumerRejected do
                  throwError "a later cone consumer accepted another equal-data apex"
            if proofExpected then
              owners.close supplier.generation
              unless ← draft.view.isAvailable owners nativeApex do
                throwError "an unrelated leg owner invalidated the portable apex"
              if ← draft.view.isAvailable owners whole.root then
                throwError "owner death left the complete owned-leg cone available"
            let some lastValue := last | throwError "the original construction had no retained map port"
            let rejected ← try
                discard <| nativePrefix.bind (← transaction.view) lastValue
                pure false
              catch _ => pure true
            unless rejected do throwError "a completed constructor accepted an extra data port"
          finally discard <| transaction.abort
    finally owners.close supplier.generation
  finally setEnv original

module

public import CasCompiler.ConstructorPorts
public import CasRuntime.PreparedRequest
public import CasRuntime.ResultCodec

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler

/-- The original constructor's actual data ports, admitted in native dependency order.
Proof slots stay present and empty. The current port has no runtime association until its
complete packet has passed that port's own native interface and dependency checks. -/
structure ConstructorPortPrefix (scope : RoleScope) where
  private mk ::
  plan : ConstructorPorts
  environment : RuntimeEnvironment
  private parameters : Array RuntimeParameter
  values : Array (Option ValueBinding)
  nextIndex : Nat

private def ConstructorPortPrefix.skipProofs (nativePrefix : ConstructorPortPrefix scope) :
    ConstructorPortPrefix scope := Id.run do
  let mut nextIndex := nativePrefix.nextIndex
  while nextIndex < nativePrefix.plan.ports.size do
    let some port := nativePrefix.plan.ports[nextIndex]? | break
    if port.argument.wireIndex.isSome then break
    nextIndex := nextIndex + 1
  return { nativePrefix with nextIndex }

/-- Open the already accepted formal constructor scope over the exact request inputs.
No native object/arrow is reconstructed from the answer packet. -/
opaque ConstructorPortPrefix.prepare (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (plan : ConstructorPorts) :
    MetaM (ConstructorPortPrefix request.roles.scope) := do
  unless plan.originalContext.exactlyMatches request.environment.context do
    throwError "the constructor ports changed their original prepared request context"
  unless request.environment.values.size == plan.originalContext.entries.size do
    throwError "the constructor ports lost the complete original context value table"
  let mut parameters := #[]
  for entry in plan.originalContext.entries, value in request.environment.values do
    if let some value := value then
      parameters := parameters.push (← IO.ofExcept <|
        (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph entry.id value).mapError IO.userError)
  let environment ← plan.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    RuntimeEnvironment.capture request.program.worker context parameters
      (some graph) (selections := ← request.environment.selections.inContext context)
  return (⟨plan, environment, parameters, Array.replicate plan.ports.size none, 0⟩ :
    ConstructorPortPrefix request.roles.scope).skipProofs

def ConstructorPortPrefix.current? (nativePrefix : ConstructorPortPrefix scope) :
    Option ConstructorPort :=
  nativePrefix.plan.ports[nativePrefix.nextIndex]?

/-- The current native port is an original constructor binder, with only earlier actual
ports supplying its dependent type. It is not a fabricated projection from a reply shape. -/
opaque ConstructorPortPrefix.origin (nativePrefix : ConstructorPortPrefix scope)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph) : MetaM ValueOrigin := do
  request.requirePreparation scope
  let some port := nativePrefix.current?
    | throwError "the complete constructor has no remaining computational data port"
  let environment ← nativePrefix.environment.withGraph (some graph)
  environment.origin request.program request.occurrence port.argument.source

/-- Admit the actual stored port before assigning its original formal BindingId. All later
ports read this exact node/view through the ordinary complete runtime context machinery. -/
opaque ConstructorPortPrefix.bind (nativePrefix : ConstructorPortPrefix scope)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (value : ValueBinding) : MetaM (ConstructorPortPrefix scope) := do
  let some port := nativePrefix.current?
    | throwError "a constructor reply supplied an extra computational data port"
  unless port.argument.sourceIndex == nativePrefix.nextIndex && port.argument.wireIndex.isSome do
    throwError "the constructor reply changed its original native port order"
  let candidate ← nativePrefix.environment.checkResult graph port.argument.source value
  let parameter ← IO.ofExcept <|
    (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph port.binding candidate.root).mapError IO.userError
  let parameters := nativePrefix.parameters.push parameter
  let environment ← nativePrefix.plan.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    RuntimeEnvironment.capture nativePrefix.environment.worker context parameters
      (some graph) (selections := ← nativePrefix.environment.selections.inContext context)
  return ({ nativePrefix with
    environment := environment
    parameters := parameters
    values := nativePrefix.values.set! nativePrefix.nextIndex (some candidate.root),
    nextIndex := nativePrefix.nextIndex + 1 }).skipProofs

/-- Finish only the complete original native telescope. Proof entries remain explicit empty
positions; callers project to the public non-Prop port order only after this check. -/
opaque ConstructorPortPrefix.finish (nativePrefix : ConstructorPortPrefix scope) :
    Except String (Array (Option ValueBinding)) := do
  let nativePrefix := nativePrefix.skipProofs
  unless nativePrefix.nextIndex == nativePrefix.plan.ports.size do
    throw "the constructor reply omitted a required dependent data port"
  for port in nativePrefix.plan.ports, value in nativePrefix.values do
    unless port.argument.wireIndex.isSome == value.isSome do
      throw "the constructor reply changed its original computational/proof port table"
  return nativePrefix.values

/-- A map port uses this port's exact original Hom binder and the already admitted
constructor prefix. Its endpoints are actual earlier ports or original request suppliers. -/
opaque ConstructorPortPrefix.mapCodec (nativePrefix : ConstructorPortPrefix scope)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (source target : ValueBinding)
    (operands : Array (ValueBinding × ValueBinding × ValueBinding) := #[])
    (checkSymbolic : Option PreparedSymbolicCheck := none) : MetaM PreparedMapResult := do
  let some port := nativePrefix.current?
    | throwError "the complete constructor has no remaining native map port"
  PreparedMapResult.forSource nativePrefix.environment port.argument.source graph source target
    none none none operands checkSymbolic

/-- Select only the original supplier named by the accepted constructor's native projection
route. This returns its retained parent and remaining native path; it performs no field
evaluation, association or endpoint equality search. Port admission remains with the prefix. -/
opaque _root_.CasCompiler.ConstructorPorts.projectionSupplier? (plan : ConstructorPorts)
    (environment : RuntimeEnvironment) (values : Array (Option ValueBinding))
    (path : Array Name) : MetaM (Option (ValueBinding × Array Name)) := do
  unless values.size == plan.ports.size do
    throwError "constructor projection requires the complete original native port table"
  let some selected ← plan.projectionAt path | return none
  let value ← match selected.target with
    | .argument index =>
      let some original := values[index]?
        | throwError "a constructor projection selected an undeclared native port"
      pure original
    | .context id =>
      IO.ofExcept <| (environment.lookup id).mapError IO.userError
  let some value := value
    | throwError "a constructor projection has no actual original supplier"
  return some (value, selected.path)

/-- Reopen only the exact complete table already materialized at this request's original
native port positions. Proof slots remain empty, and each computational view is admitted
again through the same dependency-ordered prefix without allocating graph nodes. -/
opaque ConstructorPortPrefix.ofValues (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (plan : ConstructorPorts) (values : Array (Option ValueBinding)) :
    MetaM (ConstructorPortPrefix request.roles.scope) := do
  unless values.size == plan.ports.size do
    throwError "constructor transport requires its complete native/proof port table"
  let mut nativePrefix ← ConstructorPortPrefix.prepare request graph plan
  for port in plan.ports, value in values do
    match port.argument.wireIndex, value with
    | none, none => pure ()
    | some _, some value =>
      unless nativePrefix.nextIndex == port.argument.sourceIndex do
        throwError "constructor transport changed its original dependent port order"
      unless value.role.address == port.argument.source.address &&
          value.role.source.context.exactlyMatches port.argument.source.source.context &&
          value.role.source.expression.equal port.argument.source.source.expression &&
          value.role.source.type.equal port.argument.source.source.type do
        throwError "constructor transport changed an original admitted port view"
      nativePrefix ← nativePrefix.bind graph value
    | _, _ => throwError "constructor transport changed a native computational/proof slot"
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| nativePrefix.finish.mapError IO.userError
  return nativePrefix

/-- Present the accepted constructor's exact selected port as its native result field.
Both producing and consuming interfaces are checked; the immutable origin remains in its
complete original telescope, and no returned data is converted into a mathematical term. -/
opaque ConstructorPortPrefix.transportProjection (nativePrefix : ConstructorPortPrefix scope)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (path : Array Name) (draft : CellDraft) :
    MetaM (CellDraft × ValueBinding) := do
  request.requirePreparation scope
  let values ← IO.ofExcept <| nativePrefix.finish.mapError IO.userError
  let transport ← nativePrefix.plan.projectionTransport request.source path
  let some (parent, remaining) ← nativePrefix.plan.projectionSupplier?
      nativePrefix.environment values path
    | throwError "the accepted constructor lost its original result-field supplier"
  let some (selected, #[]) ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (draft.view.projectionFrontier parent remaining).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "constructor transport requires the original stored field selection"
  let original ← nativePrefix.environment.checkResult draft.view transport.source selected
  unless original.root.value == selected.value &&
      original.root.associationIds == selected.associationIds do
    throwError "constructor transport changed its original selected port baseline"
  let (draft, value) ← draft.bindTelescopeTransport transport nativePrefix.environment.values
    original.root
  let candidate ← request.environment.checkResult draft.view transport.target value
  return (draft, candidate.root)
end CasRuntime

import CasRuntime.Scope
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Scope

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasRuntime CasCatalogue.Backend

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let scalarRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
  let functionRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkConst ``Nat.succ))
  let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkConst ``Nat.succ]
  let recordRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close pair)
  let some firstField := recordRole.fields[0]? | throwError "the first source field is missing"
  let aliasRole ← firstField.toLayout
  liftM (m := IO) do
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← OccurrenceLedger.new owners
    let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
    let produced ← ledger.allocate
    let child ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      child.child.stdin.putStr "retained container token\n"
      child.child.stdin.flush
      let token := (← child.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
      let (base, scalar) ← (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := scalarRole, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      let (base, callable) ← base.stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := functionRole, parameters := #[] } (.ownedExport child token #[])
      let firstPath : Array InputPathStep := #[.field "args", .index 0]
      let secondPath : Array InputPathStep := #[.field "args", .index 1, .field "wrapped"]
      let template := Json.mkObj [
        ("ctor", .str "retainedPacket"),
        ("args", .arr #[.null, Json.mkObj [("wrapped", .null)]]),
        ("description", .str "retained literal data")]
      let slots : Array ContainerSlot := #[
        { path := secondPath, binding := callable, fieldIndex := some 1 },
        { path := firstPath, binding := scalar, fieldIndex := some 0 }]
      let payload ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (ValuePayload.container template slots #[scalar, callable] none).mapError IO.userError
      let (graph, record) ← base.stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := recordRole, parameters := #[] } payload
      let .ok recordCandidate := CandidateResponse.ofValue recordRole graph record
        | throw <| IO.userError "the retained container lost its complete record shape"
      unless recordCandidate.root.value == record.value do
        throw <| IO.userError "candidate shape checking replaced its actual root"
      let .ok first := graph.project record 0
        | throw <| IO.userError "the retained first field is missing"
      let .ok second := graph.project record 1
        | throw <| IO.userError "the retained second field is missing"
      unless first.value == scalar.value && second.value == callable.value do
        throw <| IO.userError "container projection used packet traversal order instead of field slots"
      let invocation ← ledger.allocate
      let transaction ← owners.identities.fresh .transaction
      let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "resource-test-manifest"
        registration := { operation := "resource-test", input := "resource-test", backend := "cat" }
        profileDigest := "resource-test-profile" }
      let .ok reservation ← ledger.reserve invocation transaction selected child graph #[record]
        | throw <| IO.userError "the container request could not reserve"
      let scope ← RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[scalar, callable] #[] #[]
      let some node := graph.find record.value
        | throw <| IO.userError "the retained container root is missing"
      let .container stored := node.payload.data
        | throw <| IO.userError "container storage changed its operational form"
      let replacements := #[(ScopedReference.scope 1).encode, (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode]
      let packet ← IO.ofExcept <| (stored.fill replacements).mapError IO.userError
      let expected := Json.mkObj [
        ("ctor", .str "retainedPacket"),
        ("args", .arr #[replacements[1]!, Json.mkObj [("wrapped", replacements[0]!)]]),
        ("description", .str "retained literal data")]
      unless packet == expected && stored.slots.size == 2 do
        throw <| IO.userError "container substitution lost literal structure or exact reference positions"
      let aliased ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.rebind scalar aliasRole).mapError IO.userError
      let aliases ← IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.container
        (.arr #[(ScopedReference.scope 0).encode, (ScopedReference.scope 1).encode])
        #[{ path := #[.index 0], binding := scalar, fieldIndex := some 0 },
          { path := #[.index 1], binding := aliased, fieldIndex := some 1 }]
        #[scalar, aliased] none).mapError IO.userError
      let .container aliasContainer := aliases.data
        | throw <| IO.userError "the aliased container lost its packet form"
      unless aliasContainer.template == .arr #[.null, .null] &&
          (aliasContainer.slots.map (·.binding.value)) == #[scalar.value, scalar.value] &&
          (aliasContainer.slots.map (·.binding.role.address)) == #[scalarRole.address, aliasRole.address] do
        throw <| IO.userError "container retention merged aliases, changed their roles or retained ambient authority"
      let some scalarSlot := slots[1]?
        | throw <| IO.userError "the scalar reference slot is missing"
      let incompletePayload ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (ValuePayload.container template #[scalarSlot] #[scalar] none).mapError IO.userError
      let (incompleteGraph, incomplete) ← graph.stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := recordRole, parameters := #[] } incompletePayload
      match CandidateResponse.ofValue recordRole incompleteGraph incomplete with
      | .error _ => pure ()
      | .ok _ => throw <| IO.userError "an incomplete container filled a complete record interface"
      let resolved ← scope.resolveMany reservation graph scope.wireId #[.scope 1, .scope 0]
      unless (resolved.map (·.value)) == (stored.slots.map (·.binding.value)) do
        throw <| IO.userError "rendered container slots changed their retained values"
      let callablePayload ← IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.container
        (Json.mkObj [("description", .str "retained callable interface")])
        #[] #[] (some callable)).mapError IO.userError
      let (wrappedGraph, wrapped) ← graph.stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := functionRole, parameters := #[] } callablePayload
      let .ok candidate := CandidateResponse.ofValue functionRole wrappedGraph wrapped
        | throw <| IO.userError "a stored callable container lost its accepted action"
      let leaf ← IO.ofExcept <| (wrappedGraph.callable candidate.root).mapError IO.userError
      unless leaf.value == callable.value && candidate.root.value == wrapped.value do
        throw <| IO.userError "callable access replaced the stored arrow or actual callable node"
      let (invalidGraph, dataFunction) ← graph.stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := functionRole, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      let invalidCallable ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (ValuePayload.container .null #[] #[] (some dataFunction)).mapError IO.userError
      let (invalidGraph, invalidFunction) ← invalidGraph.stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := functionRole, parameters := #[] } invalidCallable
      match CandidateResponse.ofValue functionRole invalidGraph invalidFunction with
      | .error _ => pure ()
      | .ok _ => throw <| IO.userError "a data slot became a retained callable"
      let some nativeSlot := slots[0]?
        | throw <| IO.userError "the native reference slot is missing"
      let malformed := #[
        ValuePayload.container template #[nativeSlot, nativeSlot] #[scalar, callable] none,
        ValuePayload.container template
          #[{ path := #[], binding := scalar, fieldIndex := some 0 }, nativeSlot] #[scalar, callable] none,
        ValuePayload.container template
          #[{ path := #[.field "missing"], binding := scalar, fieldIndex := none }] #[scalar] none,
        ValuePayload.container template slots #[scalar] none,
        ValuePayload.container template #[{ scalarSlot with fieldIndex := some 1 }] #[scalar, callable] none,
        ValuePayload.container template #[{ scalarSlot with fieldIndex := some 2 }] #[scalar, callable] none,
        ValuePayload.container template slots #[] (some scalar),
        ValuePayload.container (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode #[] #[] none,
        ValuePayload.container (ComputationalValue.encode (.opaque token)) #[] #[] none]
      for invalid in malformed do
        match invalid with
        | .error _ => pure ()
        | .ok _ => throw <| IO.userError "an invalid container reference layout was retained"
      match stored.fill #[replacements[0]!] with
      | .error _ => pure ()
      | .ok _ => throw <| IO.userError "container substitution changed its required arity"
      let other ← OwnerRegistry.new
      let otherProgram ← other.identities.fresh .program
      let otherOccurrence ← other.identities.fresh .occurrence
      let (_, foreign) ← (ValueGraph.empty other.identities).stage other.identities
        { program := otherProgram, occurrence := otherOccurrence, role := scalarRole, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      let foreignPayload ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (ValuePayload.container .null #[] #[foreign] none).mapError IO.userError
      let rejectedForeign ← try
        discard <| graph.stage owners.identities
          { program, occurrence := produced, role := scalarRole, parameters := #[] } foreignPayload
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
      unless rejectedForeign do
        throw <| IO.userError "a non-wire field recovered a value outside the current graph"
      scope.retire
      discard <| ledger.retire reservation
      owners.close child.generation
      unless ← wrappedGraph.isAvailable owners first do
        throw <| IO.userError "a portable container field died with another field's owner"
      if ← wrappedGraph.isAvailable owners second then
        throw <| IO.userError "a native container field survived its actual owner"
      if ← wrappedGraph.isAvailable owners wrapped then
        throw <| IO.userError "a callable container lost its transitive owner dependency"
    finally owners.close child.generation

-- Start from an ordinary source operation. Every fault belongs to the original complete
-- control frame, so no first child, resume, result or receipt may escape its rejection.
-- The framing peer supplies no mathematical result and is not a mathematical oracle.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| packageDir contractPackage
  let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
  let peer := root / "scripts/probes/kernel_control_admission_peer.py"
  let python := (← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
  for mode in #["duplicate_capture", "bad_export_capture", "bad_later_call",
      "bad_later_graph", "bad_template_scope", "undeclared_opaque"] do
    let environment ← getEnv
    try
      let traffic := root / ".tmp" / s!"control-admission-{mode}.jsonl"
      let manifestPath := root / ".tmp" / s!"control-admission-{mode}.json"
      let registration := fun (operation : String) => Json.mkObj [
        ("operation", toJson operation), ("input", toJson s!"{operation}#input"),
        ("backend", "control-admission-peer")]
      let manifest := Json.mkObj [
        ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "control-admission-peer"),
          ("command", toJson python.toString), ("args", .arr #[toJson peer.toString,
            toJson mode, toJson traffic.toString])]]),
        ("registrations", .arr (#["op.rings.mul", "op.rings.add"].map registration))]
      liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
      liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile traffic ""
      liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile manifestPath manifest.compress
      let session ← KernelSession.start (some manifestPath)
      try
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt
            "let d := 17 · 2 in ℤ" with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the control-admission statement did not parse: {error}"
        let before ← SessionSnapshot.current
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "malformed" do
          throwError "{mode}: the complete control was {run.outcome.kind}: {run.outcome.detail}"
        let after ← SessionSnapshot.current
        unless before.id == after.id && before.graph.sameRevision after.graph &&
            before.outputBatches.size == after.outputBatches.size do
          throwError "a malformed whole control published a result or output batch"
        let dispatched := (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).map (·.operation)
        unless dispatched == #["op.rings.mul"] do
          throwError "a child was dispatched before whole-control admission: {dispatched}"
        let lines := (← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.readFile traffic).splitOn "\n"
        let mut operations : Array String := #[]
        for line in lines do
          if line.isEmpty then continue
          let .ok frame := Json.parse line
            | throwError "the independent traffic log contains a malformed frame"
          let .ok operation := frame.getObjValAs? String "op"
            | throwError "the independent traffic log omitted its operation"
          if operation != "$cas.discard" then operations := operations.push operation
        unless operations == #["op.rings.mul"] do
          throwError "a malformed control sent a child or resume frame: {operations}"
      finally liftM (m := IO) session.close
    finally setEnv environment

-- Distinct original addresses may carry the same node and must remain distinct captures.
-- A nonempty valid export table is accepted; nothing is materialized by control admission.
run_cmd liftTermElabM <| liftM (m := MetaM) do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← packageDir contractPackage
    let root ← IO.currentDir
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← OccurrenceLedger.new owners
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let traffic := root / ".tmp" / "control-admission-valid.jsonl"
    IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    IO.FS.writeFile traffic ""
    let .ok wire ← FramedConnection.start owners "control-admission-peer" {
        cmd := ((← IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python").toString
        args := #[(root / "scripts/probes/kernel_control_admission_peer.py").toString,
          "valid", traffic.toString]
        env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some (contract / "python").toString)] } 5000
      | throwError "the valid control peer did not negotiate"
    try
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      try
        let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
        let occurrence ← ledger.allocate
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
        let source ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 7]
        let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close source)
        let original ← transaction.stage
          { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
        let graph ← transaction.view
        let identity : DispatchIdentity := {
          manifestDigest := "control-admission", profileDigest := "control-admission"
          registration := { operation := "op.rings.mul", input := "op.rings.mul#input",
            backend := "control-admission-peer" } }
        let .ok reservation ← transaction.reserve occurrence identity wire.connection #[original]
          | throwError "the valid control could not reserve"
        let positions : Array InputPosition := #[
          { path := #[.field "first"], binding := original },
          { path := #[.field "second"], binding := original }]
        let scope ← RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[] positions #[]
        let .ok (.suspended _ _ captures calls exports) ← wire.invokeControlBefore ledger
            transaction reservation scope (Json.mkObj [("first", .null), ("second", .null)]) 5000
          | throwError "the valid original captures or nonempty export table were rejected"
        unless captures == #[(ScopedReference.input #[.field "first"]).encode,
            (ScopedReference.input #[.field "second"]).encode] && calls.size == 1 do
          throwError "the control changed its ordered original capture addresses"
        let declared ← ReplyExport.parseControl scope reservation graph scope.wireId exports
        let #[exported] := declared
          | throwError "the valid control lost its original export"
        unless exported.owner == wire.connection.generation && exported.captures.size == 2 &&
            exported.captures.all (fun value => value.value == original.value &&
              value.associationIds == original.associationIds) do
          throwError "export capture admission merged or replaced original reference roles"
        unless graph.sameRevision (← transaction.view) &&
            ((← SessionSnapshot.current).receipt occurrence).isNone do
          throwError "control admission staged or published a joint result"
        scope.retire
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
    finally wire.close
  finally setEnv environment

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- One complete fixed creation request retains the actual target cone, its universal
data and the original source owner, followed by every declared computational capture. -/
structure PreparedCreationInvocation where
  private mk ::
  preparation : RoleScope
  family : PreparedCreationFamily
  parameters : ValueContainer
  forms : Array String
  dependencies : Array ValueBinding
  views : Array InputDescriptorView
  private inputs : InputRoleMap

/-- Preserve a fixed native source capture without evaluating its definition. Direct
retained inputs keep their original binding. Compound source data keep the complete
original native application table, so later source admission sees those same positions.
The existing term closure supplies only its ordinary delayed native interface. -/
private partial def retainCreationCapture (kernel : Kernel) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (context : OpenContext) (source : ClosedTerm) :
    MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let expression ← source.inContext context
  if ← isProof expression then
    throwError "a creation capture cannot replace an original formal proof with runtime data"
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let environment ← request.environment.withGraph (some graph)
  if let some retained ← environment.endpointValue? context graph expression then
    environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph expression retained
    return retained
  let native := expression.consumeMData
  let mut arguments : Array (Option ValueBinding) := #[]
  let application ← if native.getAppNumArgs == 0 then pure none else do
    let originals ← native.getAppArgs.mapM fun argument => context.close argument
    let head ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close native.getAppFn)
      (selections := request.environment.selections)
    let (_, layout) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource head context originals
    unless layout.arguments.size == originals.size do
      throwError "a passive creation capture lost its complete native application telescope"
    for argument in layout.arguments do
      if argument.wireIndex.isSome then
        arguments := arguments.push (some (← retainCreationCapture kernel request transaction
          context argument.source.source))
      else
        arguments := arguments.push none
    let origin ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (ApplicationOrigin.ofArguments layout environment.values arguments none).mapError IO.userError
    pure (some origin)
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let environment ← environment.withGraph (some graph)
  let mut captures ← boundContextReferences (some graph) context environment.bound expression
    (← environment.selections.inContext context)
  let positions ← computationalDependencies (context.bindings.map (·.expression)) expression
  for position in positions do
    let some binding := context.bindings[position]?
      | throwError "a passive creation capture lost an original source-context position"
    let value ← IO.ofExcept <| (environment.lookup binding.id).mapError IO.userError
    if let some value := value then captures := captures.push value
  captures := captures ++ arguments.filterMap id
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners captures).mapError IO.userError
  let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm source (selections := request.environment.selections)
  let program ← kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .program
  let occurrence ← kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .occurrence
  let origin ← environment.origin request.program occurrence role
  let origin := { origin with application }
  kernel.codes.modify (·.insert program (.term source environment.selections))
  let value ← transaction.stage origin (.closure program captures)
  environment.checkDeclaredInput context (← transaction.view) expression value
  return value

/-- The supplied universal record must retain this actual cone at its original native
predecessor slot. The check is independent of the record's portable/owned/callable payload. -/
private def requireCreationUniversal (family : PreparedCreationFamily) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (cone universal : ValueBinding) : MetaM Unit := do
  let some node := graph.find universal.value
    | throwError "the creation request lost its actual universal data"
  let some nativePrefix := node.origin.fieldPrefix
    | throwError "the creation universal data lost its original actual-cone predecessor"
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <|
    (nativePrefix.requireOrigin node.origin.program node.origin.occurrence node.origin.role).mapError
      IO.userError
  let #[frame] := nativePrefix.frames.filter
      (·.field.projection == ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.isLimit)
    | throwError "the creation universal data changed its original limit-presentation field"
  let #[field] := frame.association.layout.fields.filter
      (·.field.projection == family.target.coneProjection)
    | throwError "the creation universal data lost its native preceding cone slot"
  let some preceding := frame.preceding[field.field.sourceIndex]?.bind id
    | throwError "the creation universal data has no actual original cone predecessor"
  unless preceding.value == cone.value &&
      cone.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf preceding.associationIds.toList do
    throwError "the creation universal data belongs to another actual cone occurrence"
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners #[cone, universal, preceding]).mapError IO.userError

/-- The explicit target cone must come from the selected original raw construction.
Every original target parameter position is checked against its own retained supplier. -/
private def requireCreationTarget (kernel : Kernel) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (context : OpenContext) (family : PreparedCreationFamily)
    (cone universal : ValueBinding) : MetaM Unit := do
  let graph ← transaction.view
  kernel.retainedRawConstructionCone transaction graph context request.environment.bound cone
      fun context _ (original, _, selected, _) => do
    let .primitive (.limit target _) universes := original.action
      | throwError "the creation target lost its original raw-cone request"
    unless target.entry.id == family.target.entry.id &&
        universes == family.targetUniverses &&
        selected.source.row == family.target.entry.id.raw &&
        selected.source.construction == family.construction do
      throwError "the creation request changed its original target construction"
    family.target.requireInterface selected.source
    let supplied := original.origin.application.map (·.arguments) |>.getD #[]
    let native := original.application.map (·.arguments) |>.getD #[]
    let expected := family.inputs.target.arguments
    unless supplied.size == expected.size && native.size == expected.size do
      throwError "the creation target changed its complete original parameter table"
    for argument in expected, position in [:expected.size] do
      let some actual := supplied[position]?
        | throwError "the creation target lost an original declaration position"
      let some source := native[position]?
        | throwError "the creation target lost its original native argument schema"
      unless argument.sourceIndex == position && source.sourceIndex == position &&
          argument.wireIndex.isSome == actual.isSome &&
          source.wireIndex.isSome == actual.isSome do
        throwError "the creation target changed an original proof or computational position"
      if let some actual := actual then
        request.environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph
          (← argument.source.source.inContext context) actual
      else
        unless ← isDefEq (← inferType (← argument.source.source.inContext context))
            (← inferType (← source.source.source.inContext context)) do
          throwError "the creation target changed an original formal hypothesis"
    requireCreationUniversal family graph cone universal

/-- Prepare the root creation operation with unchanged c/t and the exact retained owner.
Only the source diagram's original declared ports are evaluated here. Fixed native captures
are retained as source data, including implicit categories, dictionaries and mapped diagrams. -/
opaque PreparedCreationInvocation.prepare (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (transaction : CellTransaction) :
    MetaM PreparedCreationInvocation := do
  let .primitive (.creation family) _ := request.action
    | throwError "a creation invocation requires its original fixed source boundary"
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs (← transaction.view)
  let #[cone, universal] ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (inputs.arguments (← transaction.view)).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "the creation invocation changed its original two native data inputs"
  withSourceScope request fun context bound => do
    let graph ← transaction.view
    let ownerSource ← family.owner.inContext context
    let environment ← request.environment.withGraph (some graph)
    let some owner ← environment.endpointValue? context graph ownerSource
      | throwError "the creation invocation lost its explicit original source-owner binding"
    environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph ownerSource owner
    let some node := graph.find owner.value
      | throwError "the creation owner is outside the current value graph"
    let some original ← owner.role.selected? context
      | throwError "the creation owner lost its complete original selected record"
    let some selected := original.limit
      | throwError "the creation owner lost its original native construction"
    let some (originalFamily, originalTarget) := original.creationOwner
      | throwError "the creation owner lost its complete original accepted families"
    unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.creation originalFamily originalTarget).exactlyMatches
        (.creation family.family family.target) do
      throwError "the creation owner changed its complete original accepted families"
    let some creation := selected.source.creation
      | throwError "the original source owner has no accepted creation interface"
    unless selected.source.construction == family.construction &&
        selected.source.row == family.target.entry.id.raw &&
        creation.lift == family.family.entry.id do
      throwError "the creation invocation changed its original source owner or lift"
    requireCreationTarget kernel request transaction context family cone universal
    let mut diagramValues := #[]
    for argument in family.inputs.diagramPorts, index in [:family.inputs.diagramPorts.size] do
      let source ← argument.source.source.inContext context
      let value ← evaluateSource transaction request.program context bound
        (← request.environment.selections.inContext context) source
      let graph ← transaction.view
      let actual ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph index value).mapError IO.userError
      let value ← request.environment.checkArgument argument.source.source actual
      request.environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph source value
      diagramValues := diagramValues.push value
    let mut captures := #[]
    for source in family.captureSources do
      captures := captures.push (← retainCreationCapture kernel request transaction context source)
    let diagram := Json.mkObj [
      ("ctor", toJson family.inputs.diagramTag),
      ("args", .arr (Array.replicate diagramValues.size .null))]
    let template := Json.arr (#[.null, .null, .null, diagram] ++
      Array.replicate captures.size .null)
    let slots : Array ContainerSlot :=
      #[{ path := #[.index 0], binding := cone, fieldIndex := none },
        { path := #[.index 1], binding := universal, fieldIndex := none },
        { path := #[.index 2], binding := owner, fieldIndex := none }] ++
      diagramValues.mapIdx (fun index binding =>
        { path := #[.index 3, .field "args", .index index], binding, fieldIndex := none }) ++
      captures.mapIdx (fun index binding =>
        { path := #[.index (4 + index)], binding, fieldIndex := none })
    let payload ← IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.descriptor template slots).mapError IO.userError
    let .container parameters := payload.data
      | throwError "the creation invocation lost its complete parameter packet"
    let graph ← transaction.view
    discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
    let roots := slots.map (·.binding)
    let views ← InputDescriptorView.collect graph (← kernel.codes.get) roots
    return ⟨request.roles.scope, family, parameters, #[family.input],
      request.scope ++ roots ++ views.flatMap (·.dependencies), views, inputs⟩

/-- Reuse the original sealed inputs and recheck all actual capture owners in the current graph. -/
opaque PreparedCreationInvocation.requireInputs (invocation : PreparedCreationInvocation)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph) : MetaM Unit := do
  request.requirePreparation invocation.preparation
  request.requirePreparation invocation.inputs.telescope.scope
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (invocation.inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners invocation.dependencies).mapError IO.userError

/-- Encode the whole fixed parameter vector in one scope, preserving every original root path. -/
def PreparedCreationInvocation.encode (invocation : PreparedCreationInvocation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (receiver : ConnectionGeneration) :
    Except String (EncodedInputs × Array Json) := do
  let roots := invocation.parameters.slots.map fun slot =>
    ({ path := #[.field "parameters"] ++ slot.path, binding := slot.binding } : InputPosition)
  let encoded ← graph.encodeInputs receiver roots invocation.views
  let parameters ← (← invocation.parameters.fill encoded.values).getArr?
  return (encoded, parameters)

end CasRuntime
