private def originalTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the original creation consumer did not parse"
  return ⟨parsed⟩

private def originalSession (identities : IdentitySupply) : TermElabM SourceSession := do
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let f ← empty.read (← originalTerm
    "{0 ↦ 0, 1 ↦ 1, 2 ↦ 1} : (Fin(3) in FiniteSets) → (Fin(2) in FiniteSets)")
  let source ← empty.defineTerm `f' f
  let g ← source.read (← originalTerm
    "{0 ↦ 1, 1 ↦ 0} : (Fin(2) in FiniteSets) → (Fin(2) in FiniteSets)")
  source.defineTerm `g' g

private def retains (actual original : ValueBinding) : Bool :=
  actual.value == original.value &&
    original.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf actual.associationIds.toList

private def originalInputs (transaction : CellTransaction) (result : ValueBinding) :
    MetaM (ValueBinding × ValueBinding) := do
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let some node := graph.find result.value
    | throwError "the complete creation has no original producing node"
  let some completion ← transaction.completionFor? node.origin.occurrence
    | throwError "the complete creation lost its actual prepared invocation"
  let .primitive (.creation _) _ := completion.request.action
    | throwError "the stored result was not produced by the complete creation family"
  let some application := completion.request.origin.application
    | throwError "the creation lost its complete native input table"
  let #[some cone, some universal] := application.arguments
    | throwError "the creation changed its original c/t data positions"
  let some universalNode := graph.find universal.value
    | throwError "the original universal input is outside the visible graph"
  let some nativePrefix := universalNode.origin.fieldPrefix
    | throwError "the original universal input lost its preceding cone"
  let #[frame] := nativePrefix.frames.filter
      (·.field.projection == ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.isLimit)
    | throwError "the universal input lost its original presentation field"
  let some preceding := frame.preceding[0]?.bind id
    | throwError "the original universal input has no actual cone predecessor"
  unless retains preceding cone do
    throwError "the creation received a universal record for another actual cone"
  return (cone, universal)

private def requireProjection (transaction : CellTransaction) (value parent : ValueBinding)
    (path : Array Name) : MetaM Unit := do
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let some _ ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.projectionBasis value parent path).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "a creation field lost its original complete-result parent"

/-- Invoke a supplied native map on a formal point at its exact original domain.
The point is a source assumption; no native mathematical element is reconstructed from bytes. -/
private def applyNative (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
    (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (source : Expr) (cone universal : ValueBinding) (label : String) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let function ← if (← whnf (← inferType source)).isForall then pure source else do
    let some function ← coerceToFunction? source
      | throwError "the returned native map has no original callable interface"
    pure function
  let callable ← kernel.run transaction context bound function (selections := selections)
  withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound callable fun context bound =>
    withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound function callable fun context bound selected => do
      let .forallE _ domain _ _ ← whnf (← inferType function)
        | throwError "the returned map lost its exact native point domain"
      withLocalDeclD `originalCreationPoint domain fun point => do
        let pointId : BindingId := ⟨"creation-point:" ++ label, 0⟩
        let current ← ContextTelescope.capture
          (context.bindings.push ⟨pointId, .parameter, point⟩)
        let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← current.close point)
          (selections := ← selections.close current)
        let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound kernel.ledger.owners.worker
          current bound (← transaction.view) (selections := selections)
        let program ← kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .program
        let value ← transaction.stage (← environment.origin program (← kernel.ledger.allocate) role)
          (.portable (toJson (0 : Nat)).compress.toUTF8)
        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities current bound point value fun current bound pointSource => do
          let result ← kernel.run transaction current bound (mkApp selected pointSource)
            (selections := selections)
          let graph ← transaction.view
          let some node := graph.find result.value
            | throwError "the actual native application produced no stored result"
          let .ownedToken _ _ captures := node.payload.data
            | throwError "the native continuation did not return its actual owned data"
          unless captures.any (fun actual => retains actual value) &&
              captures.any (fun actual => retains actual cone) &&
              captures.any (fun actual => retains actual universal) do
            throwError "the native continuation changed its original point or c/t captures"
          return result

private def withOriginalPeer (action : Kernel → TermElabM Unit) : TermElabM Unit := do
  let contract ← IO.FS.realPath (← packageDir contractPackage)
  let leaves : System.FilePath :=
    (← IO.getEnv "CAS_LEAVES").getD ".lake/packages/cas_leaves"
  let leaves ← IO.FS.realPath (if leaves.extension == some "json" then
    leaves.parent.getD "." else leaves)
  let root ← IO.currentDir
  IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
  let log := root / ".tmp/creation-invocation-observations.jsonl"
  IO.FS.writeFile log ""
  let configuration := Json.mkObj [("log", toJson log.toString)]
  let peer := Json.mkObj [("name", "creation-invocation-peer"),
    ("command", toJson (contract / ".venv/bin/python").toString),
    ("args", .arr #[toJson (root / "scripts/probes/creation_invocation_peer.py").toString,
      toJson configuration.compress])]
  -- The original set-limit implementation supplies c. This test defines no pullback algorithm.
  let raw := Json.mkObj [("name", "original-set-limits"), ("command", "python3"),
    ("args", .arr #[toJson (leaves / "backends/sage_set_limits.py").toString])]
  let manifest := Json.mkObj [
    ("backends", .arr #[raw, peer]),
    ("registrations", .arr #[
      Json.mkObj [("operation", "lim.sets.pullback"), ("input", "cat.sets"),
        ("backend", "original-set-limits")],
      Json.mkObj [("operation", "lift.finite_sets.pullbacks"),
        ("input", "lift.finite_sets.pullbacks#input"), ("backend", "creation-invocation-peer")]])]
  let path := root / ".tmp/creation-invocation-manifest.json"
  IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let kernel ← Kernel.load owners (some path) none 10000
  try
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    unless kernel.rejected.isEmpty do
      throwError "the original finite-pullback creation lost its declared native registration"
    action kernel
  finally kernel.close

/- The original finite-pullback source is used unchanged. The target raw cone comes from the
existing set-limit provider. The peer supplies complete native interfaces, then handles the
actual retained native projections and applications; it supplies no new mathematical definition
or answer table. A source cone is never synthesized from compact createdCone data. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let originalEnvironment ← getEnv
  try
    withOriginalPeer fun kernel => do
      let source ← originalSession kernel.ledger.owners.identities
      let original ← source.read (← originalTerm "pullback(f', g')")
      original.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let selections ← original.selections.inContext context
        let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let owner ← kernel.run transaction context {} expression (selections := selections)
          unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "forming the original created object dispatched a target computation"
          let graph ← transaction.view
          let some ownerNode := graph.find owner.value
            | throwError "the created source owner has no retained original node"
          let .closure program _ := ownerNode.payload.data
            | throwError "the created source was not retained as its complete native owner"
          let some (.creationOwner prepared) := (← kernel.codes.get)[program]?
            | throwError "the created source lost its exact source-input telescope"
          withBindingContext graph context {} owner fun context bound => do
            let ownerSource ← prepared.owner.inContext context
            withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound ownerSource owner fun context bound actualOwner => do
              let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections
                (← prepared.selections.inContext context)
              prepared.completionSource kernel.ledger.owners.identities context selections actualOwner
                  fun context selections completionSource => do
                checkWithKernel completionSource
                let mut originals : Array (ValueBinding × ValueBinding) := #[]
                let mut results : Array ValueBinding := #[]
                let mut continuations : Array ValueBinding := #[]
                for mode in #["inline", "owned"] do
                  let complete ← kernel.run transaction context bound completionSource (selections := selections)
                  let (cone, universal) ← originalInputs transaction complete
                  originals := originals.push (cone, universal)
                  results := results.push complete
                  let graph ← transaction.view
                  let some completeNode := graph.find complete.value
                    | throwError "the complete native creation result disappeared"
                  if mode == "inline" then
                    let .container data := completeNode.payload.data
                      | throwError "the inline creation did not retain its complete native record"
                    unless data.originalPacket.isSome && data.fields.map (·.size) == some 2 do
                      throwError "the inline creation lost a native data field or original packet"
                  else
                    let .ownedToken _ _ _ := completeNode.payload.data
                      | throwError "the owned creation did not retain its actual native export"
                  let generated ← withBindingContext graph context bound complete fun context bound =>
                    withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound completionSource complete
                        fun context bound selected => do
                      let liftableSource ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit.toLiftableCone #[selected]
                      let coneSource ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.LiftableCone.liftedCone #[liftableSource]
                      let sourceCone ← kernel.run transaction context bound coneSource (selections := selections)
                      let sourceConeAgain ← kernel.run transaction context bound coneSource (selections := selections)
                      unless sourceCone.value == sourceConeAgain.value do
                        throwError "repeating a native source-cone projection recomputed its actual value"
                      requireProjection transaction sourceCone complete
                        #[``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit.toLiftableCone, ``CategoryTheory.LiftableCone.liftedCone]
                      requireProjection transaction sourceConeAgain complete
                        #[``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit.toLiftableCone, ``CategoryTheory.LiftableCone.liftedCone]
                      let comparisonSource ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.LiftableCone.validLift #[liftableSource]
                      let comparison ← kernel.run transaction context bound comparisonSource (selections := selections)
                      requireProjection transaction comparison complete
                        #[``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit.toLiftableCone, ``CategoryTheory.LiftableCone.validLift]
                      let comparisonResults ← withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound comparison fun context bound =>
                        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound comparisonSource comparison
                            fun context bound actualComparison => do
                          #[``CategoryTheory.Iso.hom, ``CategoryTheory.Iso.inv].mapM fun direction => do
                            let arrow ← mkAppM direction #[actualComparison]
                            let nativeMap ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ConeMorphism.hom #[arrow]
                            applyNative kernel transaction context bound selections nativeMap cone universal
                              (mode ++ ":" ++ direction.toString)
                      let universalSource ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit.makesLimit #[selected]
                      let sourceUniversal ← kernel.run transaction context bound universalSource (selections := selections)
                      requireProjection transaction sourceUniversal complete
                        #[``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit.makesLimit]
                      let mediator ← withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound sourceUniversal fun context bound =>
                        withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound sourceCone fun context bound =>
                          withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound universalSource sourceUniversal
                              fun context bound actualUniversal =>
                            withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound coneSource sourceCone
                                fun context bound actualCone => do
                              let mediatorSource ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit.lift
                                #[actualUniversal, actualCone]
                              applyNative kernel transaction context bound selections mediatorSource cone universal
                                (mode ++ ":makesLimit")
                      return comparisonResults.push mediator
                  continuations := continuations ++ generated
                let #[(firstCone, firstUniversal), (secondCone, _)] := originals
                  | throwError "the original creation controls lost one complete c/t invocation"
                unless firstCone.value != secondCone.value do
                  throwError "equal source requests merged two actual target cone occurrences"
                let targetOwner ← prepared.targetOwner.mapM (·.inContext context)
                let parameters ← (prepared.inputs.target.arguments.mapM (fun argument =>
                  argument.source.source.inContext context) : MetaM (Array Expr))
                let rawSelection ← prepared.target.selectedAtOwner targetOwner
                  prepared.targetUniverses parameters
                let repeated ← SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities
                    selections context rawSelection fun context selections firstRawSource =>
                  SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities
                      selections context rawSelection fun context selections secondRawSource =>
                    withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound firstCone fun context bound =>
                      withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound secondCone fun context bound =>
                        withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound firstUniversal fun context bound =>
                          withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound firstRawSource firstCone
                              fun context bound firstSource =>
                            withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound secondRawSource secondCone
                                fun context bound secondSource => do
                              let universalFamily ← LimitUniversalFamily.forId prepared.target.entry.id
                              let universalSelection ← universalFamily.selectedAtOwner targetOwner
                                prepared.targetUniverses parameters
                                (fun _ _ => throwError "the original explicit cone cannot be replaced")
                                (some firstSource)
                              let universalType ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit #[firstSource]
                              SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities
                                  selections context universalSelection
                                  (fun context selections universalSource =>
                                    withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound universalSource
                                        firstUniversal fun context bound wrongUniversal => do
                                      -- Keep the original positive boundary before changing only
                                      -- c to the other actual occurrence of this same native cone.
                                      let matching ← prepared.selectedArguments context actualOwner firstSource wrongUniversal
                                      let beforeMatching := (← kernel.dispatches.get).size
                                      SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities
                                          selections context matching fun context selections matchingSource => do
                                        let repeated ← kernel.run transaction context bound matchingSource
                                          (selections := selections)
                                        let (repeatedCone, repeatedUniversal) ← originalInputs transaction repeated
                                        unless retains repeatedCone firstCone && retains repeatedUniversal firstUniversal &&
                                            (← kernel.dispatches.get).size == beforeMatching + 1 do
                                          throwError "the explicit matching c/t boundary changed or recomputed an original input"
                                        let before := (← kernel.dispatches.get).size
                                        let rejected ← try
                                            let mismatch ← prepared.selectedArguments context actualOwner secondSource wrongUniversal
                                            SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities
                                                selections context mismatch fun context selections mismatchSource => do
                                              discard <| kernel.run transaction context bound mismatchSource
                                                (selections := selections)
                                              pure false
                                          catch _ => pure true
                                        unless rejected && (← kernel.dispatches.get).size == before do
                                          throwError "creation accepted t from another equal-source c or dispatched before rejection"
                                        return repeated)
                                  (declaredType := some universalType)
                results := results.push repeated
                let malformed : Option Exception ← try
                    discard <| kernel.run transaction context bound completionSource (selections := selections)
                    pure none
                  catch error => pure (some error)
                let some malformed := malformed
                  | throwError "the whole creation admitted a result missing makesLimit"
                unless ((← malformed.toMessageData.toString).splitOn "data-field arity").length > 1 do
                  throw malformed
                let dispatches ← kernel.dispatches.get
                unless (dispatches.filter (·.operation == "lift.finite_sets.pullbacks")).size == 4 do
                  throwError "a native field replayed or skipped the original complete creation request"
                if dispatches.any (fun entry =>
                    entry.operation.startsWith "lift.finite_sets.pullbacks#") then
                  throwError "a creation field acquired an undeclared independent operation"
                let observed ← IO.FS.readFile
                  ((← IO.currentDir) / ".tmp/creation-invocation-observations.jsonl")
                for required in #["creation:inline", "creation:owned", "Iso.hom", "Iso.inv", "IsLimit.lift"] do
                  unless (observed.splitOn required).length > 1 do
                    throwError "the original creation continuation did not actually reach {required}"
                let graph ← transaction.view
                let .ok owners := graph.requiredOwners continuations
                  | throwError "the created native continuations lost their actual owners"
                unless !owners.isEmpty do
                  throwError "owned creation data became portable"
                for owner in owners do kernel.ledger.owners.close owner
                for result in results do
                  if ← graph.isAvailable kernel.ledger.owners result then
                    throwError "a complete created result survived its actual native export owner"
                unless ← graph.isAvailable kernel.ledger.owners firstCone do
                  throwError "closing the creation owner invalidated its independently portable target cone"
        finally discard <| transaction.abort
  finally setEnv originalEnvironment

end CasRuntime.CreationInvocationTests

module

public import Std.Async.Timer

public section

namespace CasRuntime

/-- Wait for an existing task under a native event-loop timer, then release the timer.
The task itself continues on expiry. Its owner decides cancellation and resource cleanup.
Reference: Lean v4.33.0 Std/Async/Timer.lean (Sleep) and Init/System/IO.lean (waitAny). -/
def awaitBefore (task : Task α) (timeoutMs : UInt32) : IO (Option α) := do
  if timeoutMs == 0 then return none
  let sleeper ← (Std.Async.Sleep.mk (.ofNat timeoutMs.toNat)).block
  let deadline ← sleeper.wait.toIO
  let completed : Task (Except IO.Error (Option α)) := task.map fun value => .ok (some value)
  try
    IO.ofExcept (← IO.waitAny [completed,
      Task.map (x := deadline) (fun result => result.map fun _ => none)])
  finally sleeper.stop

end CasRuntime

module

public import CasRuntime.Environment
public import CasCompiler.Surface

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

private partial def containsRetained (environment : RuntimeEnvironment) (context : OpenContext)
    (source : Expr) : MetaM Bool := do
  if ← environment.hasRetainedSource context source then return true
  match source with
  | .mdata _ body => containsRetained environment context body
  | .app function argument =>
    return (← containsRetained environment context function) ||
      (← containsRetained environment context argument)
  | .lam _ type body _ | .forallE _ type body _ =>
    return (← containsRetained environment context type) ||
      (← containsRetained environment context body)
  | .letE _ type value body _ =>
    return (← containsRetained environment context type) ||
      (← containsRetained environment context value) ||
      (← containsRetained environment context body)
  | .proj _ _ parent => containsRetained environment context parent
  | _ => return false

/-- Select only an already published access for the exact original native path. Prefer the
whole source-selected path before following independently published single steps: choosing an
intermediate access cannot authorize a continuation under a different consuming parent chain.
Descriptor schemas and raw stored baselines do not manufacture an access witness. -/
private def declaredProjection? (graph : ValueGraph) (parent : ValueBinding)
    (path : Array Name) : MetaM (Option ValueBinding) := do
  if path.isEmpty then return some parent
  if let some retained ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (graph.projectedAccess? parent path).mapError IO.userError then return some retained
  let mut selected := parent
  for projection in path do
    let some field := selected.nativeRole.fields.find? (·.projection == projection)
      | throwError "a declared parameter selected a field outside its actual source"
    unless field.wireIndex.isSome do return none
    let some retained ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (graph.projectedAccess? selected #[projection]).mapError IO.userError | return none
    selected := retained
  return some selected

/-- Read an original producing parameter or its already published native projection.
Only the producer's exact source table selects a reference; no equal value is found
and no missing native field is forced. This covers non-wire implicit declaration positions. -/
private partial def producingReference? (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext)
    (origin : ValueOrigin) (source : Expr)
    (path : Array Name := #[]) : MetaM (Option ValueBinding) := do
  if let .mdata _ body := source then
    return ← producingReference? graph context origin body path
  if source.isFVar then
    let some binding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression == source)
      | throwError "a declared parameter is outside its source context"
    let some index := origin.role.source.context.entries.findIdx? (·.id == binding.id)
      | return none
    let some value := origin.parameters[index]?.bind id | return none
    return ← declaredProjection? graph value path
  if let some selected ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? source then
    producingReference? graph context origin selected.parent (#[selected.declaration] ++ path)
  else return none

private structure DeclaredSlot where
  source : Expr
  value : ValueBinding

private structure DescriptorDeclaration where
  declaration : Name
  source : Expr
  path : Array Name
  address : String

/-- The exact typed limit record supplies its accepted row and complete original producer.
Native checking validates that record's claimed apex; it never selects another construction,
registered row or actual input from equal source expressions. -/
private def selectedLimitDeclaration? (context : OpenContext)
    (selected : SourceSelection Expr) : MetaM (Option DescriptorDeclaration) := do
  let some (.limit row) := selected.reference | return none
  if selected.leg.isSome || selected.legOrdinal.isSome then return none
  let some construction := selected.limit
    | throwError "the selected limit result lost its complete original construction"
  let original := construction.source
  unless original.row == row.id.raw && original.declaration == row.declaration &&
      original.colimit == row.colimit && !original.construction.isAnonymous do
    throwError "the selected limit result changed its original construction"
  discard <| checkedDeclaration row.declaration
  let some producer ← sourceApplication? row.declaration selected
    | throwError "the selected limit result lost its retained producer application"
  unless original.presentation.consumeMData.equal producer.consumeMData do
    throwError "the selected limit result changed its original producer application"
  let path := if row.colimit then
      #[``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone.cocone, ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.pt]
    else #[``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.cone, ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt]
  let some cone ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? original.cone
    | throwError "the selected limit result lost its native cone projection"
  unless cone.declaration == path[0]! &&
      cone.parent.consumeMData.equal producer.consumeMData do
    throwError "the selected limit result changed its native cone projection"
  let apex ← mkAppM path[1]! #[original.cone]
  context.withOriginalSources #[construction.receiver, selected.value, apex] fun values => do
    unless ← isDefEq values[0]! values[2]! <&&> isDefEq values[1]! values[2]! do
      throwError "the selected limit result changed its original native apex"
  let producer := producer.consumeMData
  let arity ← forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType producer.getAppFn)
    fun parameters _ => pure parameters.size
  unless producer.getAppNumArgs == arity do
    throwError "the selected limit result lost its complete producer telescope"
  return some ⟨row.declaration, producer, path, row.id.raw⟩

private def descriptorDeclaration? (context : OpenContext) (origin : ValueOrigin)
    (packet : ValueContainer) : MetaM (Option DescriptorDeclaration) := do
  if let some selected ← origin.role.selected? context then
    if let some limit ← selectedLimitDeclaration? context selected then
      unless packet.fields.isNone && packet.callable.isNone do return none
      unless (packet.template.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some limit.address do
        throwStratum .malformed "a selected result descriptor changed its original source address"
      return some limit
    let some (.named (.registered (.inl row) category)) := selected.reference | return none
    unless row.category == category.id do
      throwError "the selected object descriptor changed its complete original category"
    let original := (selected.originalApplication.getD selected.value).consumeMData
    unless original.getAppFn.isConstOf row.declaration do
      throwError "the selected object descriptor lost its original declared application"
    unless (packet.template.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some row.id.raw do
      return none
    return some ⟨row.declaration, original, #[], row.id.raw⟩
  let source ← origin.role.source.inContext context
  let original ← sourceDomain source
  -- Ordinary native binary products retain their own source constructor and original
  -- argument positions. This case supplies no missing selected category or source row.
  unless original.getAppFn.isConstOf ``Prod &&
      (packet.template.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "objectProduct" &&
      original.getAppNumArgs == 2 && packet.fields.isNone && packet.callable.isNone do
    return none
  return some ⟨``Prod, original, #[], "objectProduct"⟩

/-- Actual explicit descriptor slots are indexed by the declared native argument positions.
The object's schema supplies no field data: these are the already stored descriptor inputs. -/
private def descriptorSlots? (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext)
    (origin : ValueOrigin) (payload : ValueData)
    (declaration : Name) (arity : Nat) : MetaM (Option (Array (Option DeclaredSlot))) := do
  let .container packet := payload | return none
  let some selected ← descriptorDeclaration? context origin packet | return none
  let original := selected.source
  unless selected.declaration == declaration && original.getAppNumArgs == arity do return none
  let arguments := original.getAppArgs
  let information ← getFunInfoNArgs original.getAppFn arguments.size
  let mut slots := Array.replicate arity none
  let mut wire := 0
  for source in arguments, index in [:arguments.size] do
    if ← isProof source then continue
    if (information.paramInfo[index]?.map (·.isExplicit)).getD true then
      let path := #[.field "args", .index wire]
      let #[slot] := packet.slots.filter (·.path == path)
        | throwStratum .malformed "a declared descriptor is missing an exact original parameter slot"
      unless slot.fieldIndex.isNone do
        throwStratum .malformed "a declaration parameter cannot be supplied by a fabricated native field"
      slots := slots.set! index (some ⟨source, slot.binding⟩)
      wire := wire + 1
    else if let some value ← producingReference? graph context origin source then
      slots := slots.set! index (some ⟨source, value⟩)
  let .ok fields := (packet.template.getObjVal? "args").bind (·.getArr?)
    | throwStratum .malformed "a declared descriptor lost its complete parameter packet"
  unless fields.size == wire && packet.slots.size == wire do
    throwStratum .malformed "a declared descriptor changed its complete parameter arity"
  return some slots

/-- A genuine native application may retain the same declared inputs without a descriptor.
Only the original producer and exact formal argument positions are used. Native projections
read already published fields; an unrecorded field never supplies a reconstructed slot. -/
private def applicationSlots? (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext) (origin : ValueOrigin)
    (declaration : Name) (arity : Nat) : MetaM (Option (Array (Option DeclaredSlot))) := do
  let some application := origin.application | return none
  unless application.path.isEmpty do return none
  let family ← application.layout.resultTermFamily.inContext context
  lambdaBoundedTelescope family application.arguments.size fun parameters body => do
    let body := body.headBeta.consumeMData
    unless body.getAppFn.isConstOf declaration && body.getAppNumArgs == arity do return none
    let mut computational := #[]
    for parameter in parameters, position in [:parameters.size] do
      unless ← isProof parameter do computational := computational.push (position, parameter)
    let mut slots := Array.replicate arity none
    for argument in body.getAppArgs, index in [:arity] do
      if ← isProof argument then continue
      let some (selected, path) ← sourceInputProjection? argument (computational.map (·.2))
        | continue
      let some (position, _) := computational[selected]?
        | throwError "a declared application lost its original native argument position"
      let some value := application.arguments[position]?.bind id | continue
      let some parameter := application.layout.arguments[position]?
        | throwError "a declared application lost its original native argument position"
      let some retained ← declaredProjection? graph value path | continue
      let mut source ← parameter.source.source.inContext context
      for projection in path do
        let some info := (← getEnv).getProjectionFnInfo? projection
          | throwError "a declared application lost its native projection metadata"
        source := .proj (← getConstInfoCtor info.ctorName).induct info.i source
      slots := slots.set! index (some ⟨source, retained⟩)
    return some slots

/-- Check complete declared input data against independently retained original source inputs.
An outer input reference is checked by the ordinary argument boundary. Nested references must
be witnessed by exact stored descriptor slots or original native application arguments, with
the same node and association checks recursively. Native equality cannot select these inputs. -/
partial def RuntimeEnvironment.checkDeclaredInput (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (context : OpenContext) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (expected : Expr) (value : ValueBinding) : MetaM Unit := do
  let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 value
    | throwStratum .malformed "a declared input is outside its visible graph"
  let direct ← environment.hasRetainedSource context expected
  let nested ← containsRetained environment context expected
  if direct || !nested then
    discard <| environment.checkArgument (← context.close expected) argument
    return
  -- A constructed family is authenticated by the exact producer slots below. Its native
  -- type may mention newly opaque argument binders, so source-expression conversion is
  -- neither needed nor sufficient to select the original runtime parameters.
  let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close expected)
    (← (← environment.selections.inContext context).close context)
  discard <| environment.checkResult graph layout value
  -- Native instance wrappers can conceal the same original field path. Re-admit that
  -- source-only path before accepting its retained occurrence; equality is insufficient.
  let retainedSource ← (← context.close expected).inputProjectionSource
  if ← environment.hasRetainedSource context (← retainedSource.inContext context) then
    discard <| environment.checkArgument retainedSource argument
    return
  let expected ← sourceDomain expected
  let .const declaration _ := expected.getAppFn
    | throwStratum .malformed "a declared input has no exact native family for its retained parameters"
  let some node := graph.find value.value
    | throwError "the declared input lost its original producing node"
  let slots ← descriptorSlots? graph context node.origin node.payload.data declaration
    expected.getAppNumArgs
  let slots ← match slots with
    | some slots => pure (some slots)
    | none => applicationSlots? graph context node.origin declaration expected.getAppNumArgs
  let some slots := slots
    | throwStratum .malformed "the declared input has no original parameter reference slots"
  for source in expected.getAppArgs, index in [:expected.getAppNumArgs] do
    if ← isProof source then continue
    let required ← containsRetained environment context source
    match slots[index]?.bind id with
    | none =>
      if required then
        throwStratum .malformed "the declared input is missing an original retained parameter"
    | some slot =>
      let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph index slot.value
        | throwStratum .malformed "a declared parameter is outside its visible graph"
      discard <| environment.checkArgument (← context.close slot.source) argument
      environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph source slot.value

/-- One original producing declaration argument at its exact native position. The source and
binding come from the same admitted descriptor/application slot; consumers cannot construct a
new correspondence from two equal specialized source expressions. -/
structure DeclaredInputSlot where
  private mk ::
  declaration : Name
  index : Nat
  source : ClosedTerm
  value : ValueBinding

/-- Read an original declared argument by a position already established on the full abstract
source telescope. This reuses the same producer and complete-arity gates as declared-input
checking. It cannot search for an equal value, force a missing field, or reconstruct a slot. -/
opaque RuntimeEnvironment.declaredInputAt? (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (context : OpenContext) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (declaration : Name) (index : Nat) (value : ValueBinding) :
    MetaM (Option DeclaredInputSlot) := do
  -- This is an actual already selected producer input. Its authenticated native projection
  -- may carry the original dependent prefix; ordinary candidate result admission is separate.
  discard <| environment.checkOperand graph value.role value
  let info ← checkedDeclaration declaration
  let arity ← forallTelescopeReducing info.type fun parameters _ => pure parameters.size
  if index >= arity then return none
  let some node := graph.find value.value
    | throwError "the declared input lost its original producing node"
  let slots ← descriptorSlots? graph context node.origin node.payload.data declaration arity
  let slots ← match slots with
    | some slots => pure (some slots)
    | none => applicationSlots? graph context node.origin declaration arity
  let some slots := slots | return none
  let some slot := slots[index]?.bind id | return none
  environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph slot.source slot.value
  return some ⟨declaration, index, ← context.close slot.source, slot.value⟩

/-- A selected descriptor result whose whole native family has one explicit computational
input. The source, projection path and original argument position are read together from
the actual producer; consumers cannot construct an unrelated source correspondence. -/
structure DeclaredResultSource where
  private mk ::
  declaration : Name
  source : ClosedTerm
  path : Array Name
  position : Nat

/-- Recover only an already selected descriptor's exact native projection and input position.
The following declaredInputAt? lookup must still supply its actual retained input node.
No category is inferred from the descriptor's result type or its printable packet. -/
opaque RuntimeEnvironment.declaredResultSource? (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (context : OpenContext) (graph : ValueGraph) (value : ValueBinding) :
    MetaM (Option DeclaredResultSource) := do
  discard <| environment.checkOperand graph value.role value
  let some node := graph.find value.value
    | throwError "the selected result is outside its original graph"
  let .container packet := node.payload.data | return none
  let some selected ← descriptorDeclaration? context node.origin packet | return none
  if selected.path.isEmpty then return none
  let arguments := selected.source.getAppArgs
  let information ← getFunInfoNArgs selected.source.getAppFn arguments.size
  let mut explicit := #[]
  for argument in arguments, index in [:arguments.size] do
    if (information.paramInfo[index]?.map (·.isExplicit)).getD true &&
        !(← isProof argument) then explicit := explicit.push index
  let #[position] := explicit | return none
  return some ⟨selected.declaration, ← context.close selected.source, selected.path, position⟩

end CasRuntime

/-- Input addresses of this exact invocation: the complete-request form, and the exact form and
category of each argument that is a registered named object. -/
def inputForms (action : RecordAction) (context : OpenContext)
    (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (arguments : Array ClosedTerm) : MetaM (Array String) := do
  -- Named morphisms publish their own raw complete-declaration request address.
  let own := match action.owner with
    | .computation (.morphism _) => action.familyAddress
    | _ => s!"{action.familyAddress}#input"
  let mut forms := #[own]
  for argument in arguments do
    if let some (entry, _) ← sourceObjectSelection? context selections
        (← argument.inContext context) then
      forms := forms ++ #[entry.id.raw, entry.category.raw]
  return forms

/-- Retain a published family, or one more selected field of it, as a delayed demand. -/
def Kernel.delay (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (family : PreparedRequest) (path : Array FieldLayout)
    (captures : Array ValueBinding) : MetaM (PreparedResponse request) := do
  let program ← kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .program
  kernel.codes.modify (·.insert program (.family family path))
  let value ← if family.action matches .primitive (.limitUniversal _ _) _ then do
      if path.isEmpty && request.occurrence == family.occurrence then
        kernel.stageUniversal request transaction program captures
      else
        transaction.stage (← request.originFor request.source) (.closure program captures)
    else
      transaction.stage (← request.originFor request.source) (.closure program captures)
  kernelCompletion request transaction value
    (some (kernel.resolveFixedInput evaluateSource transaction request.program))

/-- Evaluate a checked source term for a claimed demand and complete that demand. -/
private def evaluateRequest (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (build : OpenContext → Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding → MetaM ValueBinding) : MetaM (PreparedResponse request) := do
  let value ← withSourceScope request build
  kernelCompletion request transaction value
    (some (kernel.resolveFixedInput evaluateSource transaction request.program))

/-- A native record action closed over the exact environment that owns its typed operands. -/
private structure ScopedRecordAction where
  action : RecordAction
  environment : RuntimeEnvironment

/-- Prepare record invocation inputs from the exact retained family result. Only the
source compiler determines their native slots and applications. The original completion
is selected by occurrence and preparation identity, never by expression or type. -/
private def Kernel.prepareRecordAction (kernel : Kernel) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (family : PreparedRequest) (boundary : ProgramBoundary)
    (universes : List Level) (path : Array FieldLayout) (arguments : Array ClosedTerm) :
    MetaM ScopedRecordAction := do
  withSourceScope request fun context bound => do
    let count := family.application.map (·.arguments.size) |>.getD 0
    family.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound count
        fun context bound parameters _ => do
      request.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound arguments.size
          fun context bound actual _ => do
        let finish := fun context bound parent => do
          let action ← RecordAction.prepare boundary universes context family.source parent path
            parameters actual family.selection
          let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge
            (← family.environment.selections.inContext context)
            (← family.source.selections.inContext context)
          let selections ← selections.merge (← request.source.selections.inContext context)
          let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound request.environment.worker
            context bound (← transaction.view) (some request.environment) selections
          return (⟨action, environment⟩ : ScopedRecordAction)
        let parent ← family.source.source.inContext context
        if path.isEmpty then return ← finish context bound parent
        let some completion ← transaction.completionFor? family.occurrence
          | throwError "the delayed record lost its original completed family"
        family.requirePreparation completion.request.roles.scope
        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound parent
          completion.response.root finish

/-- Materialize only the source-prepared invocation slots, after realization selection.
The same path handles ordinary records and released record packets. -/
private def Kernel.recordInputs (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation)
    (request family : PreparedRequest) (transaction : CellTransaction) (prepared : ScopedRecordAction) :
    MetaM (Array (Nat × ValueBinding)) := do
  let action := prepared.action
  let predecessors ← if action.predecessors.isEmpty then pure #[]
    else kernel.universalPredecessors family transaction action.predecessors
  let inputs ← prepared.environment.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    action.inputs.mapM fun input => do
      let source ← input.source.inContext context
      let evaluate := fun context selections source =>
        prepared.environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program
          context prepared.environment.bound source selections
      let selections ← prepared.environment.selections.inContext context
      let value ← match input.selectedField with
        | none => evaluate context selections source
        | some field => do
          let field ← field.mapM (fun term => term.inContext context)
          selections.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities context
            { value := source, field := some field } evaluate
      return (input.sourceIndex, value)
  return predecessors ++ inputs

/-- Dispatch a delayed family demand whose action has reached its actual arguments.
The selected registration receives the family parameters and the action arguments.
A selected derivation is the checked plan at those same parameters, fields and arguments. -/
partial def Kernel.reach (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (family : PreparedRequest) (path : Array FieldLayout)
    (parameters : Array ValueBinding) (arguments : Array ClosedTerm) :
    MetaM (PreparedResponse request) := do
  let .primitive boundary universes := family.action
    | throwError "internal: a delayed family demand lost its published boundary"
  if let .limit selected _ := boundary then
    unless path.isEmpty && request.occurrence == family.occurrence do
      throwError "a raw construction changed its original complete request boundary"
    let invocation ← PreparedLimitInvocation.prepare kernel evaluateSource request transaction
    let registration ← selectLift kernel.profile kernel.manifest (.limit selected.entry.id)
      selected.operation invocation.forms
    return ← kernel.invokeLimit evaluateSource request transaction registration invocation
  if let .creation selected := boundary then
    unless path.isEmpty && request.occurrence == family.occurrence do
      throwError "a creation changed its original complete fixed request boundary"
    let invocation ← PreparedCreationInvocation.prepare kernel evaluateSource request transaction
    let registration ← selectLift kernel.profile kernel.manifest (.lift selected.family.entry.id)
      selected.operation invocation.forms
    return ← kernel.invokeCreation evaluateSource request transaction registration invocation
  if let .point selected := boundary then
    let invocation ← if selected.invocation then do
        unless path.isEmpty && request.occurrence == family.occurrence do
          throwError "a complete categorical request changed its original whole boundary"
        PreparedPointInvocation.prepare kernel request transaction
      else do
        let some invocation ← PreparedPointInvocation.prepare? kernel evaluateSource
            request family path transaction
          | throwStratum .noImplementation "the categorical field has no original scalar point interface"
        pure invocation
    let realization ← match selected.owner with
      | .named (.morphism entry) => do
        kernel.profile.select kernel.manifest
          (.morphism entry.id) invocation.operation invocation.forms
      | .action (.functor id) => do
        kernel.profile.select kernel.manifest
          (.functor id) invocation.operation invocation.forms
      | owner => do
        let target := match owner with
          | .named (.application entry) => ProfileTarget.application entry.id
          | .component entry _ _ => .component entry.id
          | .cartesian entry => .cartesian entry.id
          | .binder entry => .binder entry.id
          | .action edge => .edge ("action:" ++ (edgeImageDescriptor edge).compress)
          | .named (.morphism entry) => .computation (.morphism entry.id)
        Realization.registration <$>
          selectLift kernel.profile kernel.manifest target invocation.operation invocation.forms
    match realization with
    | .registration registration =>
      return ← kernel.invokePoint evaluateSource request transaction registration invocation
    | .derivation checked =>
      return ← evaluateRequest kernel evaluateSource request transaction fun context bound => do
        let count := selected.parameterCount + (if selected.invocation then 2 else 0)
        family.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound count
            fun context bound supplied _ => do
          let actual := supplied.extract 0 selected.parameterCount
          let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge
            (← request.environment.selections.inContext context)
            (← family.environment.selections.inContext context)
          checked.instantiate universes kernel.ledger.owners.identities context selections
              fun context selections plan => do
            let replacement := plan.betaRev
              (actual.extract 0 selected.declarationParameterCount).reverse
            let mut arrow ← selected.realizedArrow universes actual replacement
            if selected.invocation then
              let some domain := supplied[selected.parameterCount]?
                | throwError "the categorical derivation lost its original domain position"
              let some point := supplied[selected.parameterCount + 1]?
                | throwError "the categorical derivation lost its original point position"
              return ← request.environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program
                context bound (← selected.resultAt universes actual arrow domain point) selections
            for field in path do arrow ← projectTerm arrow field
            request.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound arguments.size
                fun context bound applied _ =>
              request.environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program
                context bound (arrow.betaRev applied.reverse) selections
  if let .objectAction selected := boundary then
    unless path.isEmpty && request.occurrence == family.occurrence do
      throwError "an object action changed its original complete request boundary"
    let invocation ← PreparedObjectAction.prepare kernel request (← transaction.view)
    let realization ← match selected.edge with
      | .functor id => do
        kernel.profile.select kernel.manifest (.functor id)
          invocation.operation invocation.forms
      | _ => do
        Realization.registration <$>
          selectLift kernel.profile kernel.manifest (.edge selected.operation)
            invocation.operation invocation.forms
    match realization with
    | .registration registration =>
      return ← kernel.invokeObjectAction evaluateSource request transaction registration invocation
    | .derivation checked =>
      return ← evaluateRequest kernel evaluateSource request transaction fun context bound => do
        family.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound (selected.parameterCount + 1)
            fun context bound actual _ => do
          let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge
            (← request.environment.selections.inContext context)
            (← family.environment.selections.inContext context)
          checked.instantiate universes kernel.ledger.owners.identities context selections
              fun context selections plan => do
            let parameters := actual.extract 0 selected.parameterCount
            let replacement := plan.betaRev parameters.reverse
            request.environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program context bound
              (← selected.realized universes parameters actual[selected.parameterCount]! replacement)
              selections
  if let .property _ := boundary then
    unless path.isEmpty && parameters.isEmpty && request.occurrence == family.occurrence do
      throwError "a property observation lost its complete original primitive request"
    let route ← PreparedPropertyRoute.prepare kernel (← transaction.view) request
    let selected ← route.select kernel.profile kernel.manifest
    let invocation ← selected.materialize kernel evaluateSource request transaction
    return ← kernel.invokeProperty evaluateSource request transaction invocation
  if let .routedMethod _ := boundary then
    let route ← PreparedMethodRoute.prepare kernel (← transaction.view)
      request family path parameters
    let selection ← route.select kernel.profile kernel.manifest
    let selected ← selection.materialize kernel evaluateSource request transaction
    return ← match selection.realization with
      | .registration _ => do
        let invocation ← selected.invocation kernel evaluateSource request transaction
        kernel.invokeMethod evaluateSource request transaction invocation
      | .derivation _ =>
        selected.derivation kernel evaluateSource request transaction
  let selectedPath : Array Name := match boundary with
    | .limitUniversal selected _ =>
      selected.path ++ path.map (fun (field : FieldLayout) => field.projection)
    | _ => path.map (fun (field : FieldLayout) => field.projection)
  let role := "/".intercalate (selectedPath.map Name.toString).toList
  if let .presentation selected := boundary then
    let invocation ← PreparedPresentationInvocation.prepare request family path (← transaction.view)
      (← kernel.codes.get)
    let registration ← selectLift kernel.profile kernel.manifest (.presentation selected.entry.id)
      invocation.operation invocation.forms
    return ← kernel.invokePresentation evaluateSource request transaction registration invocation
  if let .application selected := boundary then
    let .application entry := selected.owner
      | throwError "the delayed object application changed its exact owner kind"
    let some invocation ← PreparedPointInvocation.prepare? kernel evaluateSource request family path transaction
      | throwError "the object application lost its complete original point interface"
    let registration ← selectLift kernel.profile kernel.manifest (.application entry.id)
      invocation.operation invocation.forms
    return ← kernel.invokePoint evaluateSource request transaction registration invocation
  let prepared ← kernel.prepareRecordAction request transaction family boundary universes path arguments
  let action := prepared.action
  let point ← PreparedPointInvocation.prepare? kernel evaluateSource request family path transaction
  let address := point.map (·.operation) |>.getD action.address
  let forms ← match point with
    | some point => pure point.forms
    | none => withSourceScope request fun context _ => do
      return (← inputForms action context
        (← request.environment.selections.inContext context) arguments)
  let realization : Realization ← match action.owner with
    | .computation reference => kernel.profile.select kernel.manifest reference address forms
    | .lift id =>
      pure (.registration (← selectLift kernel.profile kernel.manifest (.lift id) address forms))
    | .limit id =>
      pure (.registration (← selectLift kernel.profile kernel.manifest (.limit id) address forms))
  match realization with
  | .registration registration =>
    match point with
    | some point => kernel.invokePoint evaluateSource request transaction registration point
    | none => do
      let inputs ← kernel.recordInputs evaluateSource request family transaction prepared
      let parameters := match boundary with
        | .limitUniversal _ _ =>
          (family.origin.application.map (·.arguments.filterMap id)).getD #[]
        | _ => parameters
      kernel.invokeRegistration evaluateSource request transaction registration role parameters inputs
  | .derivation checked =>
    evaluateRequest kernel evaluateSource request transaction fun context bound => do
      checked.instantiate universes kernel.ledger.owners.identities context
          (← request.environment.selections.inContext context) fun context selections plan => do
        let count := family.application.map (·.arguments.size) |>.getD 0
        family.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound count
            fun context bound parameters _ => do
          let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections
            (← family.environment.selections.inContext context)
          let mut term := plan.betaRev parameters.reverse
          for field in path do term ← projectTerm term field
          request.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound arguments.size
              fun context bound actual _ =>
            request.environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program
              context bound (term.betaRev actual.reverse) selections

/-- A concrete field demand completes this exact formal construction once. The original
producer's owner envelope supplies its whole native request; the actual operand remains
the receiver-scoped key. An equal descriptor or source expression cannot select a cone. -/
private def Kernel.limitProjection? (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (transaction : CellTransaction) (operand : ValueBinding)
    (field : FieldLayout) (creation : Option PreparedCreationFamily := none) :
    MetaM (Option ValueBinding) := do
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let some node := graph.find operand.value
    | throwError "the construction receiver is outside its original graph"
  withSourceScope request fun context bound => do
    withBindingContext graph context bound operand fun context bound => do
      let some originalSelection ← operand.role.selected? context | return none
      let some selected := originalSelection.limit | return none
      let family : LimitFamily ← match originalSelection.application.map
          (fun (application : SelectedSourceApplication Expr) => application.family) with
        | some (.limit family) => pure family
        | some (.limitUniversal family) => pure family.presentation
        | some (.creation _ target) => pure target
        | _ =>
          match originalSelection.creationOwner with
          | some (_, target) => pure target
          | none =>
            let some family := originalSelection.limitFamily
              | throwError "the construction lost its complete original selected limit family"
            pure family
      if let some retained := originalSelection.limitFamily then
        unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.limit family).exactlyMatches (.limit retained) do
          throwError "the construction changed its complete original selected limit family"
      if let some (.limit entry) := originalSelection.reference.orElse
          (fun _ => originalSelection.observation) then
        unless (SelectedSourceReference.limit family.entry).exactlyMatches (.limit entry) do
          throwError "the construction changed its complete original selected limit row"
      unless family.entry.id.raw == selected.source.row do
        throwError "the construction changed its original selected presentation"
      let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge
        (← request.environment.selections.inContext context)
        (← operand.role.selections.inContext context)
      let original ← operand.selectedSource context
      let cached ← match ← transaction.selectedAt selected.source.construction
          family.coneProjection operand with
        | .ok value => pure value
        | .error failure => transactionFailure failure
      let finish := fun (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
          (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (cone : ValueBinding) => do
        withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound cone fun context bound => do
          withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound
              (← cone.selectedSource context) cone fun context bound coneSource => do
            let apexSource ← mkAppM family.apexProjection #[coneSource]
            let apex ← request.environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program
              context bound apexSource selections
            withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound apexSource apex
                fun context bound actual => do
              return some (← request.environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program
                context bound (← projectTerm actual field) selections)
      if let some value := cached then return ← finish context bound selections value
      let complete := fun (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
          (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (whole : Expr) => do
        let value ← request.environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program
          context bound whole selections
        let graph ← transaction.view
        let some completed := graph.find value.value
          | throwError "the completed construction has no actual result node"
        match completed.payload.data with
        | .container packet =>
          unless packet.originalPacket.isSome && packet.fields.isSome do
            throwError "the construction cannot publish an incomplete native cone"
        | .ownedToken .. =>
          unless creation.isSome do
            throwError "the raw construction requires its whole original native data ports"
        | _ => throwError "the completed construction lost its whole original native cone"
        match ← transaction.bindSelectedAt selected.source.construction family.coneProjection operand value with
        | .ok () => finish context bound selections value
        | .error failure => transactionFailure failure
      match creation with
      | some prepared =>
        unless prepared.construction == selected.source.construction &&
            prepared.target.entry.id.raw == selected.source.row do
          throwError "the created object changed its original source preparation"
        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound original operand
            fun context bound owner =>
          prepared.coneSource kernel.ledger.owners.identities context selections owner
            fun context selections whole => complete context bound selections whole
      | none =>
        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound original operand
            fun context bound owner =>
          limitConeSource kernel.ledger.owners.identities context selections owner originalSelection
            fun context selections whole => do
              let some whole := whole
                | throwError "the original construction lost its whole native request"
              complete context bound selections whole

/-- The kernel-owned concrete executor of prepared demands (T013).
A published family whose value is a callable or a record is retained as a delayed demand.
A field of retained code extends that demand or lowers the source field. An application
dispatches the delayed family on its selected realization, evaluates retained source code at
the actual arguments, or invokes the native export on its original connection. -/
partial def Kernel.execute (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) : MetaM (PreparedResponse request) := do
  let graph ← transaction.view
  match request.action with
  | .primitive boundary _ =>
    let immediate := match boundary with
      | .point family => family.invocation
      | .objectAction _ | .limit _ _ | .creation _ => true
      | _ => false
    if immediate then
      let arguments := request.application.map (·.arguments.map (·.source.source)) |>.getD #[]
      return ← kernel.reach evaluateSource request transaction request #[] #[] arguments
    if request.source.kind == .function || request.source.kind == .record then
      return ← kernel.delay evaluateSource request transaction request #[] request.scope
    let arguments : Array ClosedTerm := match request.application with
      | none => #[]
      | some application => application.arguments.map (·.source.source)
    kernel.reach evaluateSource request transaction request #[] #[] arguments
  | .project operand field =>
    let some node := graph.find operand.value
      | throwError "internal: the projected value is outside the active graph"
    match node.payload.data with
    | .closure program captures =>
      match (← kernel.codes.get)[program]? with
      | some (.family family path) =>
        if request.source.kind == .function || request.source.kind == .record then
          kernel.delay evaluateSource request transaction family (path.push field) captures
        else
          kernel.reach evaluateSource request transaction family (path.push field) captures #[]
      | some (.term source retainedSelections) | some (.formalLeg source _ retainedSelections) =>
        evaluateRequest kernel evaluateSource request transaction fun context bound => do
          withBindingContext graph context bound operand fun context bound => do
            let selections ← retainedSelections.inContext context
            request.environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program context bound
              (← projectTerm (← source.inContext context) field) selections
      | some (.creationOwner source) => do
        let some value ← kernel.limitProjection? evaluateSource request transaction
            operand field (some source)
          | throwError "the created object lost its original native construction"
        kernelCompletion request transaction value
          (some (kernel.resolveFixedInput evaluateSource transaction request.program))
      | some (.retainedPoint ..) =>
        throwError "the retained scalar carrier cannot supply another record field"
      | some (.constructionLeg ..) =>
        throwError "a native cone component function cannot supply another record field"
      | none => throwError "internal: a retained closure has no code"
    | .ownedToken .. =>
      kernel.invokeExport evaluateSource request transaction operand s!"project:{field.projection}"
    | .container container =>
      if container.fields.isSome then
        throwError "internal: a stored field reached the executor"
      if let some value ← kernel.limitProjection? evaluateSource request transaction operand field then
        return ← kernelCompletion request transaction value
          (some (kernel.resolveFixedInput evaluateSource transaction request.program))
      throwStratum .noImplementation
        m!"the retained descriptor supplies no native data for {field.projection}"
    | _ => throwError "internal: a stored field reached the executor"
  | .apply callable arguments _ =>
    let code ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.callable callable).mapError IO.userError
    let some node := graph.find code.value
      | throwError "internal: the applied value is outside the active graph"
    match node.payload.data with
    | .closure program captures =>
      match (← kernel.codes.get)[program]? with
      | some (.family family path) =>
        kernel.reach evaluateSource request transaction family path captures arguments
      | some (.creationOwner _) =>
        throwError "a created object requires its declared native field before application"
      | some (.retainedPoint original registration parameters source target packet path) => do
        let invocation ← PreparedPointInvocation.retained kernel evaluateSource request transaction
          original registration parameters source target packet path captures
        kernel.invokePoint evaluateSource request transaction registration invocation
      | some (.constructionLeg original registration diagram packet ports path retained) =>
        kernel.constructionLeg request transaction original registration diagram packet ports
          path retained captures
      | some (.term source retainedSelections) | some (.formalLeg source _ retainedSelections) =>
        evaluateRequest kernel evaluateSource request transaction fun context bound => do
          withBindingContext graph context bound callable fun context bound => do
            request.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound arguments.size
                fun context bound actual _ => do
              request.environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program context bound
                (mkAppN (← source.inContext context) actual).headBeta
                (← retainedSelections.inContext context)
      | none => throwError "internal: a retained closure has no code"
    | .ownedToken .. => kernel.invokeExport evaluateSource request transaction callable "apply"
    | .container container =>
      if container.callableData then
        throwStratum .noImplementation
          "the retained callable data have no accepted native application continuation"
      throwError "internal: the applied container has no retained callable interface"
    | _ => throwError "internal: the applied value has no code or native export"

end CasRuntime

-- The independently checked ring-multiplication plan must reach one of its exact
-- published prerequisites. The existing protocol peer implements neither operation:
-- it supplies no mathematical answer and must return its ordinary unsupported outcome.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← packageDir contractPackage
    let root ← IO.currentDir
    let python := (← IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
    let operations := #[FunctorId.ringsMultiplicative.raw, "op.monoids.mul"]
    let manifest := Json.mkObj [
      ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "prerequisite-peer"),
        ("command", toJson python.toString),
        ("args", .arr #[toJson (root / "scripts/probes/protocol_v2_peer.py").toString])]]),
      ("registrations", .arr (operations.map fun operation => Json.mkObj [
        ("operation", toJson operation), ("input", toJson s!"{operation}#input"),
        ("backend", "prerequisite-peer")]))]
    let profile := Json.mkObj [("format", "cas-realization-profile/1"),
      ("id", "selected-source-prerequisites"), ("default", "all"),
      ("rules", .arr #[Json.mkObj [
        ("target", Json.mkObj [("kind", "operation"), ("id", "op.rings.mul")]),
        ("primitive_registrations", Json.mkObj [("mode", "only"), ("entries", .arr #[])]),
        ("derivations", Json.mkObj [("mode", "only"),
          ("ids", .arr #["derive.rings.mul.monoid"])])]])]
    IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let path := root / ".tmp/checked-derivation-prerequisites.json"
    IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
    let session ← KernelSession.start (some path) (computationOnly := true)
      (profile := some profile)
    try
      unless session.kernel.rejected.isEmpty do
        throwError "the checked derivation lost its published prerequisite registrations"
      let .ok statement := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt
          "let product := 17 · 2 in ℤ"
        | throwError "the original multiplication statement did not parse"
      let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
      let dispatched := (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).map (·.operation)
      unless !dispatched.isEmpty && dispatched.all operations.contains do
        throwError "the source program did not reach its exact prerequisite: {dispatched}; \
          {run.outcome.detail}"
      unless run.outcome.stratum? == some "noImplementation" do
        throwError "the absent prerequisite changed failure stratum: {run.outcome.kind}; \
          {run.outcome.detail}"
      let some result := run.session.source.context.entries.back?
        | throwError "the source program lost its original result declaration"
      unless (run.session.value? result.id).isNone do
        throwError "the kernel computed a result for the unsupported prerequisite"
    finally session.close
  finally setEnv environment

module

public import CasRuntime.Scope
public import CasRuntime.PreparedRequest
public import CasRuntime.Closure
public import CasRuntime.CategoricalPointPacket

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- Original packet data and fresh scope/input authorities for the actual receiving process. -/
structure EncodedInputs where
  values : Array Json
  slots : Array ValueBinding
  inputs : Array InputPosition

/-- A checked released descriptor for an original visible input. The ordinary value node and
its complete association chain remain the scope authority; this view creates no replacement
value or stored field. Only the declared source-specific producers below can create it. -/
structure InputDescriptorView where
  private mk ::
  binding : ValueBinding
  packet : ValueContainer
  family : Option PreparedRequest
  parameters : Array ValueBinding
  dependencies : Array ValueBinding

def InputDescriptorView.slots (descriptorView : InputDescriptorView) : Array ContainerSlot :=
  descriptorView.packet.slots

private def exactInput (left right : ValueBinding) : Bool :=
  left.value == right.value && left.associationIds == right.associationIds

/-- The exact root of a delayed registered named callable has its released declaration packet.
The code must name that family at the empty native path, and its complete original input table
is admitted before any view is produced. A formal direct leg exposes only the exact named
packet retained by its source producer. Other opaque arrows and projected code stay scoped. -/
opaque InputDescriptorView.namedPoint? (graph : ValueGraph)
    (codes : Std.HashMap (RuntimeId .program) ClosureCode) (binding : ValueBinding) :
    MetaM (Option InputDescriptorView) := do
  let .ok _ := graph.requiredOwners #[binding]
    | throwError "the named arrow is outside its visible graph"
  let some node := graph.find binding.value
    | throwError "the named arrow has no visible original node"
  let .closure program captures := node.payload.data | return none
  if let some (.formalLeg _ (some packet) _) := codes[program]? then
    unless packet.fields.isNone && packet.callable.isNone && packet.originalPacket.isNone do
      throwError "the formal leg changed its original inert named packet"
    let parameters := packet.slots.map (·.binding)
    for parameter in parameters do
      unless captures.any (exactInput parameter) do
        throwError "the formal leg lost an original named descriptor operand"
    discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners parameters).mapError IO.userError
    return some ⟨binding, packet, none, parameters, captures.push binding⟩
  let some (.family request path) := codes[program]? | return none
  unless path.isEmpty do return none
  let .primitive boundary _ := request.action | return none
  if let .point family := boundary then
    unless !family.invocation && captures.size == request.scope.size &&
        (captures.zip request.scope).all (fun (left, right) => exactInput left right) do
      throwError "the categorical arrow changed its original delayed family or complete captures"
    let complete ← request.source.source.withOpen fun _ source => do
      return (← whnfR (← inferType source)).isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4
    unless complete do return none
    discard <| request.admitInputs graph
    let values := request.origin.application.map (·.arguments) |>.getD #[]
    let prepared ← CategoricalPointPacket.prepare family values
    let .container packet := prepared.arrow.data
      | throwError "the categorical arrow lost its checked complete declaration packet"
    let parameters := prepared.parameters.slots.map (·.binding)
    return some ⟨binding, packet, some request, parameters,
      (request.scope ++ parameters ++ packet.slots.map (·.binding)).push binding⟩
  let selected : Option (Name × String) ← match boundary with
    | .registered family => do
      let .morphism morphismId := family.source.reference | pure none
      let some row := (← semanticState).morphisms.find? (·.id == morphismId)
        | throwError "the delayed named arrow lost its released declaration"
      unless family.source.declaration == row.declaration &&
          family.source.family.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf row.declaration do
        throwError "the delayed named arrow changed its checked family"
      pure (some (row.declaration, row.id.raw))
    | .application family => do
      let .application entry := family.owner
        | throwError "the object application lost its original owner kind"
