        -- Preserve all original fields and replace only the equal-valued ambient occurrence.
        let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.installDraft draft
          | throwError "the valid fixed result could not enter the active graph"
        let installed ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
        let wholeProduced ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
        let arrowFields ← ((← RecordLayout.ofSource arrow.role).fields.filterMap
          (·.field.wireIndex)).mapM fun index =>
            IO.ofExcept <| (installed.project arrow index).mapError IO.userError
        let environment ← request.environment.withGraph (some installed)
        let arrowOrigin ← environment.origin program wholeProduced arrow.role
        let wholeArrow ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
          arrowOrigin
          (.product (arrowFields.set! 1 right))
        let resultFields ← ((← RecordLayout.ofSource request.source).fields.filterMap
          (·.field.wireIndex)).mapM fun index =>
            IO.ofExcept <| (installed.project response.root index).mapError IO.userError
        let assembled ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
        let environment ← request.environment.withGraph (some assembled)
        let resultOrigin ← environment.origin program wholeProduced request.source
        let wholeCandidate ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
          resultOrigin
          (.product (resultFields.set! 0 wholeArrow))
        let wholeOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
        let wholeGraph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
        let wholeRequest ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program wholeOccurrence
          context callable #[← context.close receiver] #[argument] #[] (some wholeGraph)
        let .ok wholeReservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.reserve wholeOccurrence
          selected connection (wholeRequest.scope.push wholeCandidate)
          | throwError "the whole-record fixed-input control could not reserve its reply"
        let wholeScope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger wholeReservation
          wholeGraph #[wholeCandidate] #[] #[]
        let wholeFrame := Json.mkObj [
          ("request_id", toJson (3 : Nat)), ("status", .str "ok"),
          ("value", (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode), ("exports", .arr #[])]
        let wholeReply ← liftM (m := IO) <| ImmediateReply.parseControl wholeScope
          wholeReservation wholeGraph wholeScope.wireId 3 wholeFrame
        let wholeFailure : Option Exception ← try
          discard <| wholeReply.materialize wholeRequest transaction wholeScope connection
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
        let some wholeFailure := wholeFailure
          | throwError "a whole-record reference bypassed its fixed source input"
        unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? wholeFailure == some .malformed do throw wholeFailure
        unless (← wholeFailure.toMessageData.toString).endsWith
            "the reply changed a fixed source input" do throw wholeFailure
      finally discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) transaction.abort
    finally liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close connection.generation
  finally setEnv original

-- These native lambdas specify only which retained input occurrence is selected.
-- Equal source terms and payloads deliberately have different actual nodes. No callable
-- fixture is executed, and no mathematical answer or provider implementation is supplied.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkNatLit 7))

  let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let (graph, left) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let (graph, right) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  unless left.value != right.value do
    throwError "the route control merged equal-valued input occurrences"
  let stage (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext)
      (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (term : Expr) (payload : ValuePayload) :
      MetaM (ValueGraph × ValueBinding) := do
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close term)
    let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
    liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role, parameters } payload
  let prepare (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext) (callable : ValueBinding)
      (arguments : Array Expr) (values : Array (Option ValueBinding))
      (parameters : Array RuntimeParameter) : MetaM PreparedRequest := do
    unless arguments.size == values.size do
      throwError "the route control omitted a formal argument slot"
    let mut actual : Array RuntimeArgument := #[]
    for value in values, index in [:values.size] do
      if let some value := value then
        let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph index value
          | throwError "the route control argument is outside its actual graph"
        actual := actual.push argument
    let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
    let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context
      callable (← arguments.mapM context.close) actual parameters (some graph)
    discard <| request.admitInputs graph
    return request
  let checkFixed (label : String) (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph)
      (expected : ValueBinding) : MetaM Unit := do
    let some fixed ← request.fixedInputFor graph request.source
      | throwError m!"{label}: the fixed input route is absent"
    unless fixed.parent.value == expected.value && fixed.path.isEmpty do
      throwError m!"{label}: the route selected a different actual input"
    let some stored ← fixed.storedValue? graph
      | throwError m!"{label}: an existing fixed input was treated as a lazy demand"
    let required ← fixed.storedValue graph
    unless stored.value == expected.value && required.value == expected.value do
      throwError m!"{label}: stored traversal changed the selected input occurrence"
  withLocalDeclD `n (mkConst ``Nat) fun original => do
    let originalBinding : LocalBinding := {
      id := ⟨"fixed-input-route", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := original }
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[originalBinding]
    let .ok originalParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph originalBinding.id left
      | throwError "the original route context value is absent"
    let parameters := #[originalParameter]
    let values := #[some left]

    -- The first application captures left; the later actual argument is distinct right.
    let constant ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (x _y : Nat) => x)) none
    let (graph, constant) ← stage graph context values constant (.closure program #[])
    let first ← prepare graph context constant #[mkNatLit 7] #[some left] parameters
    let (graph, residual) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities first.origin
      (.closure program #[])
    let some originalApplication := first.origin.application
      | throwError "the first partial application lost its original source table"

    let supplied : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding := {}
    withBindingContext graph context (supplied.insert originalBinding.id left) residual
        fun context bound => do
      let values := context.telescope.entries.map fun entry => bound[entry.id]?
      let parameters ← (context.bindings.filterMap fun binding =>
        (bound[binding.id]?).map fun value => (binding.id, value)).mapM fun (id, value) =>
          IO.ofExcept <| (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph id value).mapError IO.userError
      -- A genuine polymorphic id call supplies both formal arguments. Forward its actual
      -- partial-callable node into the new association; the earlier origin must survive.
      let partialTerm ← residual.role.source.inContext context
      let callableType ← inferType partialTerm
      let (graph, typeValue) ← stage graph context values callableType (.portable "null".toUTF8)
      let identityLevel ← getLevel callableType
      let (graph, identity) ← stage graph context values (mkConst ``id [identityLevel])
        (.closure program #[])
      let forwarded ← prepare graph context identity #[callableType, partialTerm]
        #[some typeValue, some residual] parameters
      checkFixed "identity forwarding" forwarded graph residual
      let (graph, wrapped) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        graph.bindApplication owners.identities forwarded.origin residual #[]
      unless wrapped.value == residual.value &&
          wrapped.applications.size == residual.applications.size + 1 do
        throwError "identity forwarding replaced the node or lost its new consuming association"
      unless wrapped.role.kind == .data && wrapped.nativeRole.kind == .function &&
          wrapped.admittedInterface?.isSome &&
          wrapped.nativeInterface.exactlyMatches residual &&
          wrapped.role.source.context.exactlyMatches forwarded.source.source.context do
        throwError "identity forwarding lost its consuming role or complete admitted callable"
      let .ok relabeled := residual.withRole forwarded.source #[]
          (some forwarded.environment.values)
        | throwError "the role-only interface control lost its complete original source table"
      unless relabeled.admittedInterface?.isNone && relabeled.nativeRole.kind == .data do
        throwError "an unchecked consuming role manufactured a native callable interface"
      let .ok unchanged := wrapped.withRole wrapped.role #[] wrapped.sourceParameters?
        | throwError "an unchanged native interface view lost its complete source table"
      unless unchanged.admittedInterface?.isSome &&
          unchanged.nativeInterface.exactlyMatches wrapped.nativeInterface do
        throwError "an unchanged native interface view lost its admitted relation"
      let .ok unrelated := wrapped.withRole wrapped.role #[right] wrapped.sourceParameters?
        | throwError "the changed dependency control lost its complete source table"
      unless unrelated.admittedInterface?.isNone do
        throwError "an unchecked dependency addition retained an exact native interface view"
      let (otherGraph, otherResidual) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
        first.origin (.closure program #[])
      let wrongForwarded ← liftM (m := IO) <| try
          discard <| otherGraph.bindApplication owners.identities forwarded.origin otherResidual #[]
          pure true
        catch error =>
          if error.toString == "the application result changed its exact admitted interface input" then
            pure false
          else throw error
      if wrongForwarded then
        throwError "the admitted callable interface accepted another equal-source occurrence"
      -- Both the original and a later application contain proof-only formal positions.
      -- The final result still selects original argument 1, across all three applications.
      let threeStage ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
        (← `(fun (_h : True) (x : Nat) (_k : True) (_y _z : Nat) => x)) none
      let (graph, threeStage) ← stage graph context values threeStage (.closure program #[])
      let proofFirst ← prepare graph context threeStage #[mkConst ``True.intro, mkNatLit 7]
        #[none, some left] parameters
      let (graph, proofPartial) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities proofFirst.origin
        (.closure program #[])
      let proofSecond ← prepare graph context proofPartial #[mkConst ``True.intro, mkNatLit 7]
        #[none, some right] parameters
      let (graph, proofResidual) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities proofSecond.origin
        (.closure program #[])
      for request in #[proofFirst, proofSecond] do
        let some application := request.origin.application
          | throwError "a proof-bearing route stage lost its original argument table"
        unless application.arguments.size == 2 &&
            (application.arguments[0]?.bind id).isNone &&
            application.layout.arguments.map (·.wireIndex) == #[none, some 0] do
          throwError "proof erasure displaced a route's original formal positions"

      -- A selected native record field keeps the original producer's callable path.
      let paired ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
        (← `(fun (x : Nat) => ((fun (_y : Nat) => x), (0 : Nat)))) none
      let (graph, paired) ← stage graph context values paired (.closure program #[])
      let pairRequest ← prepare graph context paired #[mkNatLit 7] #[some left] parameters
      let some record := pairRequest.record
        | throwError "the native callable pair has no prepared record"
      let #[functionField, scalarField] := record.fields
        | throwError "the native callable pair changed its source fields"
      let functionOrigin ← pairRequest.originFor functionField.layout
      let scalarOrigin ← pairRequest.originFor scalarField.layout
      let (graph, functionValue) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
        functionOrigin (.closure program #[])
      let (graph, scalarValue) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
        scalarOrigin (.portable "0".toUTF8)
      let (graph, pairValue) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities pairRequest.origin
        (.product #[functionValue, scalarValue])
      -- Opaque polymorphic result typing must retain the whole original native record,
      -- including its callable field, without replacing the consuming role or input scope.
      withBindingContext graph context bound pairValue fun recordContext recordBound => do
        let recordValues := recordContext.telescope.entries.map fun entry => recordBound[entry.id]?
        let recordParameters ← (recordContext.bindings.filterMap fun binding =>
          (recordBound[binding.id]?).map fun value => (binding.id, value)).mapM fun (id, value) =>
            IO.ofExcept <| (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph id value).mapError IO.userError
        let pairTerm ← pairValue.role.source.inContext recordContext
        let pairType ← inferType pairTerm
        let (recordGraph, pairTypeValue) ← stage graph recordContext recordValues pairType
          (.portable "null".toUTF8)
        let (recordGraph, recordIdentity) ← stage recordGraph recordContext recordValues
          (mkConst ``id [← getLevel pairType]) (.closure program #[])
        let recordForward ← prepare recordGraph recordContext recordIdentity #[pairType, pairTerm]
          #[some pairTypeValue, some pairValue] recordParameters
        checkFixed "identity record forwarding" recordForward recordGraph pairValue
        let (recordGraph, wrappedRecord) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
          recordGraph.bindApplication owners.identities recordForward.origin pairValue #[]
        unless wrappedRecord.role.kind == .data && wrappedRecord.nativeRole.kind == .record &&
            wrappedRecord.nativeInterface.exactlyMatches pairValue &&
            wrappedRecord.role.source.context.exactlyMatches recordForward.source.source.context &&
            wrappedRecord.applications.size == pairValue.applications.size + 1 do
          throwError "identity forwarding erased the native record or its full consuming view"
        let projectedOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
        let fieldRequest ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program projectedOccurrence
          recordContext recordGraph wrappedRecord 0 recordParameters
        let .ok originalField := recordGraph.project wrappedRecord 0
          | throwError "the forwarded native record lost its exact stored callable field"
        unless retainsReference functionValue originalField do
          throwError "the forwarded native record selected another actual field"
        let (recordGraph, forwardedField) ← recordGraph.bindProjection owners.identities
          fieldRequest.origin originalField #[]
        let later ← prepare recordGraph recordContext forwardedField #[mkNatLit 7]
          #[some right] recordParameters
        checkFixed "identity record field continuation" later recordGraph left
      -- Later source bindings extend the context, including a shadowing name. The original
      -- symbolic application must remain in its captured context, not a merged table.
      withLocalDeclD `n (mkConst ``Nat) fun shadow => do
        let shadowBinding : LocalBinding := {
          id := ⟨"fixed-input-route", 1⟩, role := .parameter, expression := shadow }
        let current ← ContextTelescope.capture (context.bindings.push shadowBinding)
        let .ok shadowParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph shadowBinding.id right
          | throwError "the later route context value is absent"
        let currentParameters := parameters.push shadowParameter
        let direct ← prepare graph current residual #[mkNatLit 7] #[some right] currentParameters
        checkFixed "two partial applications" direct graph left
        let wrappedRequest ← try
            prepare graph current wrapped #[mkNatLit 7] #[some right] currentParameters
          catch failure => throwError
            "identity-wrapped partial callable preparation: {failure.toMessageData}"
        checkFixed "identity-wrapped partial callable" wrappedRequest graph left
        let finalRequest ← prepare graph current proofResidual #[mkNatLit 7] #[some right]
          currentParameters
        checkFixed "three stages with proof slots" finalRequest graph left
        let projectionOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
        let projection ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program projectionOccurrence
          current graph pairValue 0 currentParameters
        let .ok stored := graph.project pairValue 0
          | throwError "the native callable pair lost its stored function"
        let (graph, projected) ←
          graph.bindProjection owners.identities projection.origin stored #[]
        let .ok (some projectedOrigin) := graph.applicationOrigin projected
          | throwError "the native projected callable lost its application origin"
        unless projectedOrigin.path == #[``Prod.fst] do
          throwError "the native projected callable lost its exact source path"
        let projectedRequest ← prepare graph current projected #[mkNatLit 7] #[some right]
          currentParameters
        checkFixed "native projected partial callable" projectedRequest graph left
        let some currentApplication := direct.origin.application
          | throwError "the final application lost its current source table"
        let originalContext := originalApplication.layout.result.source.context.entries
        let currentContext := currentApplication.layout.result.source.context.entries
        let originalAuthored := originalContext.filter (·.role == .parameter)
        let currentAuthored := currentContext.filter (·.role == .parameter)
        let originalInputs := originalContext.filter (·.role == .result)
        let currentInputs := currentContext.filter (·.role == .result)
        unless originalApplication.parameters.size == originalContext.size &&
            currentApplication.parameters.size == currentContext.size &&
            originalAuthored.map (·.id) == #[originalBinding.id] &&
            currentAuthored.map (·.id) == #[originalBinding.id, shadowBinding.id] &&
            originalInputs.size == 1 && currentInputs.size == 2 &&
            originalContext.size == originalAuthored.size + originalInputs.size &&
            currentContext.size == currentAuthored.size + currentInputs.size &&
            (originalInputs ++ currentInputs).all
              (fun entry => entry.value.isNone && entry.originalSource.isSome) &&
            originalApplication.arguments.size == 1 && currentApplication.arguments.size == 1 &&
            (originalApplication.arguments[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some left.value &&
            (currentApplication.arguments[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some right.value do
          throwError "fixed-route composition changed an original context or argument plane"
        for original in originalContext do
          let some before := originalContext.findIdx? (·.id == original.id)
            | throwError "the original route lost its native parameter position"
          let some after := currentContext.findIdx? (·.id == original.id)
            | throwError "the later route dropped an original source binding"
          let some previous := originalApplication.parameters[before]?.bind id
            | throwError "the original route lost an actual parameter"
          let some retained := currentApplication.parameters[after]?.bind id
            | throwError "the later route lost an imported actual parameter"
          unless retainsReference previous retained && previous.value == left.value do
            throwError "the later route replaced an original equal-valued occurrence"
        for added in currentContext.filter
            (fun entry => !(originalContext.any (·.id == entry.id))) do
          let some index := currentContext.findIdx? (·.id == added.id)
            | throwError "the later route lost its own original binder"
          let some actual := currentApplication.parameters[index]?.bind id
            | throwError "the later route omitted its own actual parameter"
          unless retainsReference right actual do
            throwError "the later route reused the earlier equal-valued occurrence"
        for application in #[originalApplication, currentApplication] do
          application.layout.result.source.withOpen fun bindings _ => do
            let opened ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
            let #[argument] := application.layout.arguments
              | throwError "the route changed its complete original formal argument table"
            let input ← argument.source.source.inContext opened
            let some binding := bindings.find? (·.expression.equal input)
              | throwError "the route's actual input lost its opaque source binder"
            let some originalSource := binding.originalSource
              | throwError "the route's actual input lost its native source"
            unless binding.role == .result && originalSource.equal (mkNatLit 7) &&
                (← inferType input).equal (mkConst ``Nat) do
              throwError "the route's original formal argument changed its typed source"

-- A native local definition has a source body even before it has any application origin.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkNatLit 7))
  let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let (graph, left) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let (graph, right) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let source ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize (← `(fun (x _y : Nat) => x)) none
  withLetDecl `pick (← inferType source) source fun pick => do
    let binding : LocalBinding := {
      id := ⟨"fixed-input-let", 0⟩, role := .definition, expression := pick }
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[binding]
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close pick)
    let (graph, callable) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[none] } (.closure program #[])
    let .ok none := graph.applicationOrigin callable
      | throwError "the native let control already has an application origin"
    let .ok parameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id callable
      | throwError "the native let callable is outside its graph"
    let .ok firstArgument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 left
      | throwError "the native let's first actual argument is absent"
    let firstOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
    let first ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program firstOccurrence context
      callable #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7)] #[firstArgument] #[parameter] (some graph)
    discard <| first.admitInputs graph
    let (graph, residual) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities first.origin
      (.closure program #[])
    let .ok secondArgument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 right
      | throwError "the native let's second actual argument is absent"
    let secondOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
    let second ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program secondOccurrence context
      residual #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7)] #[secondArgument] #[parameter] (some graph)
    discard <| second.admitInputs graph
    let some fixed ← second.fixedInputFor graph second.source
      | throwError "the native let-bound callable lost its fixed input route"
    let selected ← fixed.storedValue graph
    unless fixed.parent.value == left.value && fixed.path.isEmpty &&
        selected.value == left.value && selected.value != right.value do
      throwError "the native let-bound callable selected a different equal-valued input"

-- Two actual stored projections retain the baseline at their composed native path.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
  let innerTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 7]
  let outerTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[innerTerm, mkNatLit 7]
  let innerRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close innerTerm)
  let outerRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close outerTerm)
  let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let (graph, other) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let (graph, selected) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let (graph, inner) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence, role := innerRole, parameters := #[] } (.product #[other, selected])
  let (graph, original) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence, role := outerRole, parameters := #[] } (.product #[inner, other])
  let firstOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let first ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program firstOccurrence
    context graph original 0 #[]
  let .ok firstStored := graph.project original 0
    | throwError "the nested projection control lost its stored inner pair"
  let (graph, firstView) ←
    graph.bindProjection owners.identities first.origin firstStored #[other, selected]
  let secondOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let second ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program secondOccurrence
    context graph firstView 1 #[]
  let .ok secondStored := graph.project firstView 1
    | throwError "the nested projection control lost its selected scalar"
  let (graph, secondView) ←
    graph.bindProjection owners.identities second.origin secondStored #[]
  let .ok (some basis) := graph.projectionBasis secondView original #[``Prod.fst, ``Prod.snd]
    | throwError "nested stored projections lost their original composed-path baseline"
  unless basis.value == selected.value && basis.associationIds == selected.associationIds &&
      basis.value != other.value do
    throwError "the composed projection baseline replaced its original selected scalar"
  let .ok none := graph.projectionBasis secondView original #[``Prod.fst, ``Prod.fst]
    | throwError "the composed projection baseline accepted a different native path"

-- A captured source variable belongs to the callable's original parameter plane. A later
-- same-named binding and an equal-valued formal argument cannot replace that occurrence.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkNatLit 7))
  let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let (graph, left) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let (graph, right) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  unless left.value != right.value do
    throwError "the captured input control merged equal-valued occurrences"
  let checkCaptured (label : String) (original : LocalBinding) : MetaM Unit := do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[original]
    let source ← withLocalDeclD `_y (mkConst ``Nat) fun ignored =>
      mkLambdaFVars #[ignored] original.expression
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close source)
    let (graph, callable) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[some left] } (.closure program #[left])
    let .ok none := graph.applicationOrigin callable
      | throwError m!"{label}: the captured callable already has an application history"
    let .ok originalParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph original.id left
      | throwError m!"{label}: the original captured parameter is absent"
    withLocalDeclD `x (mkConst ``Nat) fun shadow => do
      withLocalDeclD `f (← inferType source) fun retained => do
        let shadowBinding : LocalBinding := {
          id := ⟨original.id.session, 1⟩, role := .parameter, expression := shadow }
        let callableBinding : LocalBinding := {
          id := ⟨original.id.session, 2⟩, role := .parameter, expression := retained }
        let current ← ContextTelescope.capture #[original, shadowBinding, callableBinding]
        let .ok shadowParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph shadowBinding.id right
          | throwError m!"{label}: the shadowing parameter is absent"
        let .ok callableParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph callableBinding.id callable
          | throwError m!"{label}: the retained callable parameter is absent"
        let parameters := #[originalParameter, shadowParameter, callableParameter]
        let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture program.worker current parameters (some graph)
        let .ok (some supplied) := environment.lookup callableBinding.id
          | throwError m!"{label}: the callable lost its current source binding"
        let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 right
          | throwError m!"{label}: the later formal argument is absent"
        let callOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
        let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program callOccurrence
          current supplied #[← current.close (mkNatLit 7)] #[argument] parameters (some graph)
        discard <| request.admitInputs graph
        let some fixed ← request.fixedInputFor graph request.source
            (some fun _ => throwError m!"{label}: route discovery invoked a resolver")
          | throwError m!"{label}: the original captured input route is absent"
        let selected ← fixed.storedValue graph
        unless fixed.parent.value == left.value && fixed.path.isEmpty &&
            selected.value == left.value && selected.value != right.value &&
            selected.associationIds == left.associationIds do
          throwError m!"{label}: a later equal-valued occurrence replaced the captured input"
        unless fixed.source.context.entries.map (·.id) == #[original.id] &&
            fixed.parameters.map (fun value => value.map (·.value)) == #[some left.value] do
          throwError m!"{label}: the selected source escaped its original parameter plane"
        fixed.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
          let #[binding] := bindings
            | throwError m!"{label}: the captured source acquired later context entries"
          unless binding.id == original.id && expression == binding.expression do
            throwError m!"{label}: the retained source variable was unfolded or replaced"
  withLocalDeclD `x (mkConst ``Nat) fun original =>
    checkCaptured "captured parameter" {
      id := ⟨"fixed-input-captured", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := original }
  withLetDecl `x (mkConst ``Nat) (mkNatLit 7) fun original =>
    checkCaptured "retained let value" {
      id := ⟨"fixed-input-retained-let", 0⟩, role := .definition, expression := original }

-- A lazy record contains no stored callable field to project. Route discovery follows its
-- exact original source or application history without demanding that field from a resolver.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkNatLit 7))
  let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
  let (graph, left) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let (graph, right) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  unless left.value != right.value do
    throwError "the lazy callable control merged equal-valued occurrences"
  let stage (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext)
      (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (term : Expr) :
      MetaM (ValueGraph × ValueBinding) := do
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close term)
    let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)
    liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role, parameters } (.closure program (parameters.filterMap id))
  let prepare (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext) (callable : ValueBinding)
      (arguments : Array Expr) (values : Array ValueBinding)
      (parameters : Array RuntimeParameter) : MetaM PreparedRequest := do
    unless arguments.size == values.size do
      throwError "the lazy callable control omitted an actual argument"
    let mut actual : Array RuntimeArgument := #[]
    for value in values, index in [:values.size] do
      let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph index value
        | throwError "the lazy callable control argument is outside its graph"

    let originalBinding : LocalBinding := {

              let .ok callableParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph callableBinding.id callable

  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .occurrence)

  let stage (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext)

    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close term)

  let prepare (graph : ValueGraph) (context : OpenContext) (callable : ValueBinding)

        selected.value == expected.value && selected.associationIds == expected.associationIds do

  let identityTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize (← `(fun (x : Nat) => x)) none

  let keep ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize (← `(fun (_unknown keep : Nat) => keep)) none
  let (graph, keep) ← stage graph empty #[] keep
  let invoke ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
    (← `(fun (p : (Nat → Nat) × Nat) (y : Nat) => p.1 y)) none
  let (graph, invoke) ← stage graph empty #[] invoke
  let pairTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[identityTerm, mkNatLit 0]

  let .error _ := graph.project pair 0

  let compose ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
    (← `(fun (f g : Nat → Nat) (x : Nat) => f (g x))) none

    (← `(fun (f : Nat → Nat → Nat) (g : Nat → Nat) (x keep : Nat) => f (g x) keep)) none
  let (graph, ignore) ← stage graph empty #[] ignore
  let wrap ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize

  let (graph, wrap) ← stage graph empty #[] wrap
  let pairIdentity ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
    (← `(fun (p : Nat × Nat) => p)) none
  let (graph, pairIdentity) ← stage graph empty #[] pairIdentity
  let projectCall ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize

  let (graph, right) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
    { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)

    let (graph, callable) ← liftM (m := IO) <| graph.stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[some left] } (.closure program #[left])
    let .ok originalParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph originalBinding.id left
      | throwError "the native callable's original captured parameter is absent"
    withLocalDeclD `x (mkConst ``Nat) fun shadow => do
      let shadowBinding : LocalBinding := {
        id := ⟨"fixed-input-native-frame", 1⟩, role := .parameter, expression := shadow }
      let current ← ContextTelescope.capture #[originalBinding, shadowBinding]
      let .ok shadowParameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph shadowBinding.id right
        | throwError "the native callable's later shadowing parameter is absent"
      let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 right
        | throwError "the native callable's later formal argument is absent"

        | throwError "the native callable lost its original captured input route"
      let selected ← fixed.storedValue graph

          selected.value == left.value && selected.associationIds == left.associationIds do

          fixed.parameters.map (fun value => value.map (·.value)) == #[some left.value] do
        throwError "the native callable selected through the later consuming source frame"

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- Read only the exact JSON position retained by a typed container slot.
Reuse: Lean.Json getters and ValueContainer.fill's InputPathStep grammar. -/
private def fixedValuePosition (value : Json) (path : List InputPathStep) : Except String Json := do
  match path with
  | [] => return value
  | .field name :: rest => fixedValuePosition (← value.getObjVal? name) rest
  | .index index :: rest =>
    let values ← value.getArr?
    let some entry := values[index]? | throw "a fixed input slot is outside the reply array"
    fixedValuePosition entry rest

/-- Check a reply fragment against an already selected fixed source input.
References preserve its node and original association prefix; literal data are compared only
after that input is selected. Products and containers follow their retained field views.
Reuse: ImmediateReply's parsed authorities, ValueGraph.project, ValueContainer.fill and the
released computational envelope. This comparison never searches for an input by its data. -/
partial def ImmediateReply.retainsValue (reply : ImmediateReply) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (connection : Connection) (value : Json) (path : Array InputPathStep)
    (expected : ValueBinding) : Except String Bool := do
  unless connection.generation.worker == graph.worker do
    throw "the fixed input comparison belongs to a different worker"
  discard <| graph.requiredOwners #[expected]
  if let some reference := reply.references.find? (·.path == path) then
    discard <| graph.requiredOwners #[reference.binding]
    return reference.binding.value == expected.value &&
      expected.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf reference.binding.associationIds.toList
  let some node := graph.find expected.value
    | throw "the fixed source input is outside the visible graph"
  let tag := (value.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption
  if tag == some "valueData" || tag == some "opaqueData" then
    match ← ComputationalValue.decode value with
    | .inline data =>
      return ← reply.retainsValue graph connection data
        (path ++ #[.field "args", .index 0]) expected
    | .opaque token =>
      let some declaration := reply.exports.find? (·.token == token)
        | throw "the parsed reply lost its native export declaration"
      unless declaration.owner == connection.generation do
        throw "the fixed input export belongs to a different supplying connection"
      let .ownedToken owner retainedToken captures := node.payload.data | return false
      discard <| graph.requiredOwners (captures ++ declaration.captures)
      unless owner == declaration.owner && retainedToken == token &&
          captures.size == declaration.captures.size do return false
      for retained in captures, actual in declaration.captures do
        unless retained.value == actual.value &&
            retained.associationIds == actual.associationIds do return false
      return true
  match node.payload.data with
  | .portable bytes =>
    let some text := String.fromUTF8? bytes
      | throw "the fixed portable input is not UTF-8 packet data"
    let packet ← Json.parse text
    checkLiteral packet
    return packet == value
  | .closure .. | .ownedToken .. => return false
  | .product fields =>
    unless expected.nativeRole.kind == .record &&
        (expected.nativeRole.fields.filter (·.wireIndex.isSome)).size == fields.size do
      throw "the fixed product does not match its complete source data-field interface"
    let values ← if fields.size == 1 then pure #[value] else value.getArr?
    unless values.size == fields.size do
      throw "the fixed reply record has a different complete data-field arity"
    for index in [:fields.size] do
      let field ← graph.project expected index
      let fieldPath := if fields.size == 1 then path else path.push (.index index)
      unless ← reply.retainsValue graph connection values[index]! fieldPath field do
        return false
    return true
  | .container container =>
    if (expected.nativeRole.kind == .function || container.callable.isSome) &&
        !container.callableData then return false
    if container.packetExports.any (·.owner != connection.generation) then return false
    let mut fragments := #[]
    for slot in container.slots do
      let field ← match slot.fieldIndex with
        | none => pure slot.binding
        | some index => graph.project expected index
      let fragment ← fixedValuePosition value slot.path.toList
      unless ← reply.retainsValue graph connection fragment (path ++ slot.path) field do
        return false
      fragments := fragments.push fragment
    for owned in container.exports do
      let fragment ← fixedValuePosition value owned.path.toList
      let .opaque token ← ComputationalValue.decode fragment | return false
      unless token == owned.token do return false
      let some declaration := reply.exports.find? (·.token == token)
        | throw "the parsed reply lost its retained packet export declaration"
      unless declaration.owner == owned.owner &&
          declaration.captures.size == owned.captures.size do return false
      discard <| graph.requiredOwners (owned.captures ++ declaration.captures)
      for retained in owned.captures, actual in declaration.captures do
        unless retained.value == actual.value &&
            retained.associationIds == actual.associationIds do return false
    return (← container.fillForOwner connection.generation fragments) == value

end CasRuntime

open Lean CasRuntime

private def check (graph : RealizationGraph size) (node : Fin size)
    (count : RealizationCount) (choice : Option Nat) : Except String Unit := do
  let some result := graph.grounded | throw "the finite grounding analysis did not return a result"
  unless result.counts[node] == count do
    throw "finite grounded realization multiplicity differs from the required count"
  unless (← result.uniqueAlternative node) == choice do
    throw "the unique realization lost its original alternative identity"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftIO <| IO.ofExcept do
  check (⟨#v[#[]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 1) 0 .zero none
  check (⟨#v[#[#[]]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 1) 0 .one (some 0)
  check (⟨#v[#[#[], #[]]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 1) 0 .many none
  -- Finite trees cannot be grounded by a cycle without a primitive leaf.
  check (⟨#v[#[#[0]]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 1) 0 .zero none
  -- Wrapped and unwrapped grounded realizations remain distinct.
  check (⟨#v[#[#[], #[0]]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 1) 0 .many none
  -- An ungrounded alternative does not invalidate a direct realization.
  check (⟨#v[#[#[], #[1]], #[#[1]]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 2) 0 .one (some 0)
  check (⟨#v[#[#[1]], #[#[0]]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 2) 0 .zero none
  -- Each ordered prerequisite occurrence participates in the product.
  check (⟨#v[#[#[1, 2]], #[#[]], #[]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 3) 0 .zero none
  check (⟨#v[#[#[1, 1]], #[#[]]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 2) 0 .one (some 0)
  check (⟨#v[#[#[1, 1]], #[#[], #[]]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 2) 0 .many none
  -- A unique parent cannot select one of an ambiguous child's alternatives.
  check (⟨#v[#[#[1]], #[#[], #[]]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 2) 0 .many none
  -- Source order changes an ordinal, never eligibility or multiplicity.
  check (⟨#v[#[#[1], #[]], #[#[1]]]⟩ : RealizationGraph 2) 0 .one (some 1)
  let graph : RealizationGraph 4 := ⟨#v[#[#[1]], #[#[2]], #[#[3]], #[#[]]]⟩
  let some result := graph.grounded | throw "the finite grounding analysis did not return a result"
  for node in [0:4] do
    if bound : node < 4 then
      let current : Fin 4 := ⟨node, bound⟩
      unless result.counts[current] == RealizationCount.one &&
          (← result.uniqueAlternative current) == some 0 do
        throw "the unique graph lost a reached child or its actual alternative"
  -- Structural finiteness supplies the closure size; no guessed depth bounds it.
  let deep : RealizationGraph 257 := ⟨Vector.ofFn fun node =>
    if bound : node.val + 1 < 257 then #[#[⟨node.val + 1, bound⟩]] else #[#[]]⟩
  check deep 0 .one (some 0)

public import Lean

@[expose] public section

namespace CasRuntime

/-- Saturated multiplicity of distinct finite grounded realization trees. -/
inductive RealizationCount
  | zero | one | many
  deriving BEq, DecidableEq, Inhabited, Repr

/-- Distinct alternatives add, even when their denotations or dependency lists coincide.
Reference: Goodman, Semiring Parsing (1999), https://aclanthology.org/J99-4004/;
the specific saturated equation is execution contract v2 §5.1, issue 69 comment 6664277464. -/
def RealizationCount.add : RealizationCount → RealizationCount → RealizationCount
  | .zero, count | count, .zero => count
  | _, _ => .many

/-- Every ordered prerequisite occurrence must have a grounded realization. -/
def RealizationCount.multiply : RealizationCount → RealizationCount → RealizationCount
  | .zero, _ | _, .zero => .zero
  | .one, count | count, .one => count
  | .many, .many => .many

/-- A structurally finite AND/OR graph with fixed child demands.
Each row is an OR node; its alternatives contain ordered AND prerequisite occurrences.
An empty alternative is grounded. Its row/alternative ordinal retains its distinct identity.
Finite indices exclude missing child nodes. Source lowering must separately establish that
this graph includes the complete actual demand closure; this type does not assert that claim. -/
structure RealizationGraph (size : Nat) where
  alternatives : Vector (Array (Array (Fin size))) size

/-- Product of prerequisite counts in their original occurrence order. -/
def RealizationGraph.alternativeCount (counts : Vector RealizationCount size)
    (children : Array (Fin size)) : RealizationCount :=
  children.foldl (fun count child => count.multiply counts[child]) .one

/-- One simultaneous generation of the exact saturated grounding equations.
Recompute from the preceding generation; accumulating an old count would count a tree twice. -/
def RealizationGraph.step (graph : RealizationGraph size) (counts : Vector RealizationCount size) :
    Vector RealizationCount size :=
  Vector.ofFn fun node => graph.alternatives[node].foldl
    (fun count children => count.add (RealizationGraph.alternativeCount counts children)) .zero

/-- Simultaneous zero-seeded approximation at a fixed finite tree height. -/
def RealizationGraph.atHeight (graph : RealizationGraph size) : Nat → Vector RealizationCount size
  | 0 => Vector.replicate size .zero
  | height + 1 => graph.step (graph.atHeight height)

/-- Stable counts for the supplied finite graph, retaining its original adjacency and ordinals.
No provider call, selected execution binding or mathematical judgment is created here. -/
structure GroundedRealizations (graph : RealizationGraph size) where
  height : Nat
  counts : Vector RealizationCount size
  generated : counts = graph.atHeight height
  fixed : graph.step counts = counts

/-- Iterate until the equations stabilize, retaining checked generation and fixed-point proofs.
Reuse: Lean's equation-preserving monadic partial_fixpoint construction,
https://lean-lang.org/doc/reference/latest/Definitions/Recursive-Definitions/.
There is no depth or search bound. Nontermination is not a zero count. Source-demand closure,
universal termination and the realization-tree interpretation remain separate obligations. -/
def RealizationGraph.stabilize (graph : RealizationGraph size) (height : Nat)
    (counts : Vector RealizationCount size) (generated : counts = graph.atHeight height) :
    Option (GroundedRealizations graph) :=
  if fixed : graph.step counts = counts then
    some ⟨height, counts, generated, fixed⟩
  else graph.stabilize (height + 1) (graph.step counts) (congrArg graph.step generated)
partial_fixpoint

/-- Least grounding iteration from zero, as specified by execution contract v2 §5.1. -/
def RealizationGraph.grounded (graph : RealizationGraph size) : Option (GroundedRealizations graph) :=
  graph.stabilize 0 (Vector.replicate size .zero) rfl

/-- Retain the original unique alternative ordinal; zero and many counts remain in counts.
This is graph analysis only. A caller cannot infer noImplementation from an incomplete
source closure, or authorize dispatch from an ordinal without the exact prepared bindings. -/
def GroundedRealizations.uniqueAlternative {size : Nat} {graph : RealizationGraph size}
    (result : GroundedRealizations graph)
    (node : Fin size) : Except String (Option Nat) := do
  unless result.counts[node] == .one do return none
  let choices := (graph.alternatives[node].mapIdx fun index children =>
    (index, RealizationGraph.alternativeCount result.counts children)).filterMap fun (index, count) =>
      if count == .one then some index else none
  match choices with
  | #[index] => return some index
  | _ => throw "internal: a unique grounded count has no unique original alternative"

end CasRuntime

namespace CasRuntime

inductive IdentityKind
  | connection | program | occurrence | value | transaction | snapshot | commit | outputBatch | scope
  | association | sourceBinding | draft | revision | preparation

/-- Identity kinds share a serial supply but remain distinct Lean types. -/
structure RuntimeId (kind : IdentityKind) where
  private mk ::
  worker : String
  serial : Nat
  deriving BEq, Hashable, Repr

/-- The worker retains this supply outside immutable semantic snapshots. -/
structure IdentitySupply where
  private mk ::
  worker : String
  private nextSerial : Std.Mutex Nat

/-- Linux supplies a fresh worker nonce.
Reference: Linux Documentation/admin-guide/sysctl/kernel.rst, `random`. -/
opaque IdentitySupply.new : IO IdentitySupply := do
  let worker := (← IO.FS.readFile "/proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid").trimAscii.toString
  if worker.isEmpty then throw <| IO.userError "the kernel supplied an empty worker identifier"
  return ⟨worker, ← Std.Mutex.new 0⟩

/-- Allocate before normalization or dispatch. Only the native atomic section advances the counter.
Reference: Lean v4.33.0 Std/Sync/Mutex.lean, `Mutex.atomically`. -/
opaque IdentitySupply.fresh (supply : IdentitySupply) (kind : IdentityKind) :
    BaseIO (RuntimeId kind) :=
  supply.nextSerial.atomically do
    let serial ← get
    set (serial + 1)
    return ⟨supply.worker, serial⟩

end CasRuntime

import CasRuntime.Owner
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Owner

open CasRuntime

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftIO do
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let first ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
  try
    let value ← owners.identities.fresh .value
    let occurrence ← owners.identities.fresh .occurrence
    unless first.generation.worker == value.worker && value.worker == occurrence.worker do
      throw <| IO.userError "worker resources have different worker identities"
    unless first.generation.serial < value.serial && value.serial < occurrence.serial do
      throw <| IO.userError "worker identities are not monotone across resource kinds"
    let tasks ← (Array.range 32).mapM fun _ =>
      IO.asTask (owners.identities.fresh .value)
    let values ← tasks.mapM fun task => IO.ofExcept task.get
    let mut seen : Std.HashSet Nat := {}
    for identity in values do
      if seen.contains identity.serial then
        throw <| IO.userError "concurrent allocations reused a worker identity"
      unless identity.worker == occurrence.worker && identity.serial > occurrence.serial do
        throw <| IO.userError "concurrent allocation changed worker or reused an earlier identity"
      seen := seen.insert identity.serial
    let other ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let unrelated ← other.identities.fresh .value
    if unrelated.worker == value.worker then
      throw <| IO.userError "separate workers share an identity supply"
  finally owners.close first.generation

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler

private inductive InputResultTree where
  | input (path : Array Name) (selected : FixedInput)
  | record (layout : RecordLayout) (children : Array InputResultTree)

/-- Complete source coverage of this exact prepared result, before resolving any lazy input.
The native record tree retains every computational field, including subsingleton data.
Reuse: fixedInputFor, RecordLayout and the original prepared result addresses. -/
structure InputResultPlan (request : PreparedRequest) where
  private mk ::
  private tree : InputResultTree
  private inputs : InputRoleMap

private partial def prepareInputResult (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (source : SourceLayout) : MetaM (Option InputResultTree) := do
  if let some input ← request.fixedInputFor graph source then
    return some (.input (← request.source.projectionPathTo source) input)
  if source.kind != .record then return none
  let layout ← RecordLayout.ofSource source
  let mut children := #[]
  for field in layout.fields do
    if field.field.wireIndex.isNone then continue
    let some child ← prepareInputResult request graph field.layout | return none
    children := children.push child
  return some (.record layout children)

/-- Establish all input routes without executing a field, selecting a provider or staging data.
A fixed whole root takes precedence over reconstructing its individual fields. -/
opaque PreparedRequest.inputResultPlan (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph) :
    MetaM (Option (InputResultPlan request)) := do
  let some tree ← prepareInputResult request graph request.source | return none
  let inputs ← request.admitInputResultInputs graph
  return some ⟨tree, inputs⟩

private partial def InputResultTree.inputs (tree : InputResultTree) :
    Array (Array Name × FixedInput) :=
  match tree with
  | .input path selected => #[(path, selected)]
  | .record _ children => children.flatMap (·.inputs)

/-- Sealed original selections, validated against input-side access history before output
association can add any wrappers. The public reader cannot replace a selected baseline. -/
structure ResolvedInputResult (request : PreparedRequest) where
  private mk ::
  private plan : InputResultPlan request
  private selected : Array FixedResult

def ResolvedInputResult.selections (resolved : ResolvedInputResult request) : Array FixedResult :=
  resolved.selected

/-- Resolve only an already complete plan. A lazy resolver returns its enriched input access;
the graph derives its original baseline at the exact planned parent and native path.
Reuse: storedValue?, projectionBasis and immutable graph visibility. -/
opaque InputResultPlan.resolve (plan : InputResultPlan request) (graphView : MetaM ValueGraph)
    (resolve : Option (FixedInput → MetaM ValueBinding) := none) :
    MetaM (ResolvedInputResult request) := do
  let mut selected := #[]
  for (path, input) in plan.tree.inputs do
    let value ← input.resolveValue graphView resolve
    selected := selected.push ⟨path, input, value⟩
  return ⟨plan, selected⟩

private partial def InputResultTree.check (tree : InputResultTree) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (selected : Array FixedResult) (value : ValueBinding) : Except String Unit := do
  discard <| graph.requiredOwners #[value]
  match tree with
  | .input path _ =>
    let some original := selected.find? (·.path == path)
      | throw "the complete input result lost a validated selection"
    unless value.value == original.value.value &&
        original.value.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf value.associationIds.toList do
      throw "the input result changed its original selected occurrence"
  | .record layout children =>
    let some node := graph.find value.value
      | throw "the assembled input result is outside its graph"
    let some stored := node.payload.data.storedFields?
      | throw "the assembled input result has no complete stored record"
    let count := stored.size
    let fields := layout.fields.filterMap (·.field.wireIndex)
    unless count == fields.size && children.size == fields.size do
      throw "the assembled input result changed its complete native field arity"
    for child in children, index in fields do
      child.check graph selected (← graph.project value index)

/-- This particular admitted response contains every original input selected by the complete
plan. It authorizes the selected-output owner gate, not arbitrary source-typed responses. -/
structure InputResultCompletion (request : PreparedRequest) where
  private mk ::
  response : PreparedResponse request
  private inputMap : InputRoleMap

def InputResultCompletion.inputs (completed : InputResultCompletion request) : InputRoleMap :=
  completed.inputMap

/-- Check the sealed tree against the assembled response without rediscovering source routes.
Selected roots may remain lazy; reconstructed records must expose all stored data fields. -/
opaque ResolvedInputResult.admit (resolved : ResolvedInputResult request) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (response : PreparedResponse request) : Except String (InputResultCompletion request) := do
  resolved.plan.tree.check graph resolved.selected response.root
  return ⟨response, resolved.plan.inputs⟩

end CasRuntime

module

import CasRuntime.Kernel
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.FiniteGroups
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Kernel
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.FiniteGroups

namespace CasRuntime.InputResultTests

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- Keep each fixture's actual supplied references under the production typed scope. -/
private def withRetainedValues (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
    (values : Array ValueBinding)
    (action : OpenContext → Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding →
      SourceSelectionScope Expr → Array Expr → MetaM α) :
    MetaM α := do
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let rec visit (remaining : List ValueBinding) (context : OpenContext)
      (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding) (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
      (sources : Array Expr) : MetaM α := do
    match remaining with
    | [] => action context bound selections sources
    | value :: rest =>
      withBindingContext graph context bound value fun context bound => do
        let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections (← value.role.selections.inContext context)
        let source ← value.selectedSource context
        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound source value fun context bound source =>
          visit rest context bound selections (sources.push source)
  visit values.toList context bound {} #[]

private def prepare (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (program : RuntimeId .program) (context : OpenContext) (callable : ValueBinding)
    (arguments : Array Expr) (values : Array ValueBinding)
    (parameters : Array RuntimeParameter := #[]) : MetaM PreparedRequest := do
  unless arguments.size == values.size do
    throwError "the input-result control omitted an actual argument"
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let mut actual := #[]
  for value in values, index in [:values.size] do
    let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph index value
      | throwError "the input-result argument is outside its actual graph"
    actual := actual.push argument
  PreparedRequest.forApplication kernel.ledger.owners.identities program
    (← kernel.ledger.allocate) context callable (← arguments.mapM context.close) actual parameters
    (some graph)

private def demand (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (request : PreparedRequest) : MetaM (PreparedResponse request) :=
  Execute.run kernel.executor
    (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) request) transaction

-- A successful shortcut must complete the actual occurrence, survive ordinary publication,
-- and reuse the same retained result through the production executor in a later cell.
private def checkCompletion (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (first : ValueBinding)
    (expectedOwners : Array ConnectionGeneration := #[]) : MetaM SessionSnapshot := do
  let .ok requiredOwners := (← transaction.view).requiredOwners #[first]
    | throwError "the input-result completion is outside its actual graph"
  unless requiredOwners == expectedOwners do
    throwError "the input result retained an unused owner or dropped a selected owner"
  let some role := request.roles.results[0]?
    | throwError "the input-result request lost its root role"
  match ← transaction.reuse request.occurrence role.role.id with
  | .ok (.ready value) =>
    unless value.value == first.value && value.associationIds == first.associationIds do
      throwError "same-cell input-result reuse changed the completed reference"
  | _ => throwError "the source-fixed result did not complete its claimed occurrence"
  let repeated ← demand kernel transaction request
  unless repeated.root.value == first.value &&
      repeated.root.associationIds == first.associationIds do
    throwError "repeated input-result execution reconstructed its result"
  if ← kernel.ledger.isFresh request.occurrence then
    throwError "the completed input-result occurrence retained a dispatch right"
  unless (← kernel.ledger.pendingFor request.occurrence transaction.id).isNone do
    throwError "the input-result shortcut left a pending provider invocation"
  unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
    throwError "a wholly source-fixed result dispatched a registration"
  unless ((← SessionSnapshot.current).receipt request.occurrence).isNone do
    throwError "the input-result receipt became visible before commit"
  let .ok published ← transaction.commit
    | throwError "the source-fixed result could not commit independently of unused owners"
  let some receipt := published.receipt request.occurrence
    | throwError "input-result commit omitted its ordinary receipt"
  let .kernel := receipt.association.producer
    | throwError "the source-fixed result acquired a provider completion"
  let some batch := published.outputBatches.back?
    | throwError "input-result commit omitted its output batch"
  unless receipt.association.request.roles.scope == request.roles.scope &&
      receipt.association.response.root.value == first.value &&
      receipt.association.response.root.associationIds == first.associationIds &&
      receipt.snapshot == published.id && receipt.commit == batch.commit &&
      receipt.outputBatch == batch.id do
    throwError "input-result publication changed its request, result, or receipt identities"
  let .ok (some retained) ← published.reuse kernel.ledger.owners request.occurrence role.role.id
    | throwError "the committed input-result receipt could not supply its selected result"
  unless retained.value == first.value && retained.associationIds == first.associationIds do
    throwError "committed input-result reuse changed the selected association"
  let next ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
  try
    let reused ← demand kernel next request
    unless reused.root.value == first.value &&
        reused.root.associationIds == first.associationIds do
      throwError "later-cell execution reconstructed a committed input result"
    unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
      throwError "input-result receipt reuse dispatched a registration"
  finally discard <| next.abort
  return published

-- Native source terms specify only selections and record assembly. The target payloads are
-- unpublished native exports, so evaluating an ordinary retained lambda cannot satisfy these
-- controls. Equal portable data have distinct nodes and distinct record positions.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
    let pairTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 7]
    let pairRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close pairTerm)
    let aliasTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p _other : Nat × Nat) => p)) none
    let secondTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p : Nat × Nat) => p.2)) none
    let firstTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p : Nat × Nat) => p.1)) none
    let duplicateTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p : Nat × Nat) => (p.1, p.1))) none
    let reverseTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p : Nat × Nat) => (p.2, p.1))) none
    let functionPairTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkConst ``Nat.succ]
    let functionPairRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close functionPairTerm)
    let functionTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p : Nat × (Nat → Nat)) => p.2)) none
    let incompleteTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p : Nat × Nat) => (p.1, Nat.succ p.2))) none
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let live ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    let unrelated ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      let produced ← kernel.ledger.allocate
      let stage (role : SourceLayout) (payload : ValuePayload) := producer.stage
        { program, occurrence := produced, role, parameters := #[] } payload
      let left ← stage scalar (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      let right ← stage scalar (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      let input ← stage pairRole (.product #[left, right])
      let equalInput ← stage pairRole (.product #[right, left])
      unless left.value != right.value && input.value != equalInput.value do
        throwError "the input-result control merged equal-valued occurrences"
      let wholeCallable ← stage (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close aliasTerm))
        (.ownedExport unrelated "unpublished whole alias" #[])
      let second ← stage (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close secondTerm))
        (.ownedExport live "unpublished second field" #[])
      let first ← stage (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close firstTerm))
        (.ownedExport unrelated "unpublished first field" #[])
      let duplicate ← stage (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close duplicateTerm))
        (.ownedExport unrelated "unpublished duplicated first field" #[])
      let reverse ← stage (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close reverseTerm))
        (.ownedExport unrelated "unpublished reversed pair" #[])
      let selectedFunction ← stage
        (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkConst ``Nat.succ)))
        (.ownedExport live "unpublished selected callable" #[])
      let functionInput ← stage functionPairRole (.product #[left, selectedFunction])
      let selectFunction ← stage (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close functionTerm))
        (.ownedExport unrelated "unpublished callable projection" #[])
      let incompleteCallable ← stage (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close incompleteTerm))
        (.ownedExport live "unpublished partially input-fixed callable" #[])
      let lazyPair ← stage pairRole (.ownedExport live "unpublished lazy input pair" #[])
      let required ← stage scalar (.ownedExport unrelated "required selected input" #[])
      let requiredInput ← stage pairRole (.product #[left, required])
      let .ok _ ← producer.commit
        | throwError "the input-result fixture could not publish its original inputs"
      owners.close unrelated.generation
      if ← owners.isLive unrelated.generation then
        throwError "the input-result control did not close its unrelated owner"

      -- A previously produced native field can retain its exact lazy parent directly,
      -- before any projection index is published. Reuse that occurrence without a resolver.
      do
        let directCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let directRequest ← prepare kernel directCell program context first
            #[pairTerm] #[lazyPair]
          let directProjection ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program
            (← kernel.ledger.allocate) context (← directCell.view) lazyPair 0 #[]
          let directValue ← directCell.stage directProjection.origin (.portable "7".toUTF8)
          let otherParent ← directCell.stage
            { program, occurrence := ← kernel.ledger.allocate, role := pairRole, parameters := #[] }
            (.ownedExport live "another direct-origin input pair" #[])
          let otherProjection ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program
            (← kernel.ledger.allocate) context (← directCell.view) otherParent 0 #[]
          let otherValue ← directCell.stage otherProjection.origin (.portable "7".toUTF8)
          let before ← directCell.view
          unless lazyPair.value != otherParent.value && directValue.value != otherValue.value do
            throwError "the direct-origin control merged distinct equal-valued inputs"
          for parent in #[lazyPair, otherParent] do
            let .ok none := before.projected? parent #[``Prod.fst]
              | throwError "the direct-origin control already has a published field baseline"
            let .ok none := before.projectedAccess? parent #[``Prod.fst]
              | throwError "the direct-origin control already has a published access"
          let fixed ← directRequest.resolveFixedResults directCell directRequest.source directValue
          let #[selected] := fixed
            | throwError "the direct-origin result lost its one source-selected input"
          unless selected.path.isEmpty && selected.input.parent.value == lazyPair.value &&
              selected.input.parent.associationIds == lazyPair.associationIds &&
              selected.input.path == #[``Prod.fst] &&
              selected.value.value == directValue.value &&
              selected.value.associationIds == directValue.associationIds do
            throwError "direct-origin resolution changed its exact parent, path or baseline"
          let .ok none := before.projectionBasis otherValue lazyPair #[``Prod.fst]
            | throwError "a direct origin borrowed an equal-valued field from another parent"
          -- Leave fixed discovery enabled here; the preflight above supplied no resolver.
          let (draft, result) ← directRequest.associateResult owners.identities
            directRequest.source (← directCell.draft) directValue
          discard <| directRequest.admitResult draft.view result
          let .ok (some sourceAccess) := draft.view.projectedAccess? lazyPair #[``Prod.fst]
            | throwError "direct-origin admission did not publish its original native access"
          let .ok (some (nativeSource, parent, path)) :=
              draft.view.projectionSelection sourceAccess
            | throwError "the direct-origin access lost its immutable source selection"
          unless parent.value == lazyPair.value &&
              parent.associationIds == lazyPair.associationIds && path == #[``Prod.fst] &&
              (← nativeSource.source.inContext context) ==
                (← directProjection.source.source.inContext context) do
            throwError "direct-origin publication changed its original parent or native source"
          let .ok (some baseline) := draft.view.projected? lazyPair #[``Prod.fst]
            | throwError "direct-origin publication lost its selected baseline"
          unless result.value == directValue.value && sourceAccess.value == directValue.value &&
              baseline.value == directValue.value &&
              baseline.associationIds == directValue.associationIds &&
              directValue.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf result.associationIds.toList do
            throwError "direct-origin association replaced or enriched its original baseline"
          let failure : Option Exception ← try
              discard <| directRequest.associateResult owners.identities directRequest.source
                (← directCell.draft) otherValue fixed (complete := true)
              pure none
            catch error => pure (some error)
          let some failure := failure
            | throwError "direct-origin admission accepted an equal field from another parent"
          unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .malformed &&
              (← failure.toMessageData.toString).endsWith
                "the reply changed a fixed source input" do throw failure
          unless (← directCell.view).sameRevision before && (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "direct-origin admission published its isolated draft or invoked a provider"
        finally discard <| directCell.abort

      let wholeCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let whole ← prepare kernel wholeCell program context wholeCallable
        #[pairTerm, pairTerm] #[input, equalInput]
      let wholeResult ← demand kernel wholeCell whole
      unless wholeResult.root.value == input.value && wholeResult.root.value != equalInput.value do
        throwError "whole input aliasing selected an equal but different actual record"
      let wholeGraph ← wholeCell.view
      let .ok wholeLeft := wholeGraph.project wholeResult.root 0
        | throwError "whole input aliasing lost its first stored field"
      let .ok wholeRight := wholeGraph.project wholeResult.root 1
        | throwError "whole input aliasing lost its second stored field"
      unless wholeLeft.value == left.value && wholeRight.value == right.value do
        throwError "whole input aliasing replaced its retained field occurrences"
      discard <| checkCompletion kernel wholeCell whole wholeResult.root

      let fieldCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let field ← prepare kernel fieldCell program context second #[pairTerm] #[input]
      let fieldResult ← demand kernel fieldCell field
      unless fieldResult.root.value == right.value && fieldResult.root.value != left.value do
        throwError "the fixed second field selected the equal first-field occurrence"
      discard <| checkCompletion kernel fieldCell field fieldResult.root

      -- The actual input record itself is unavailable because its second field is owned
      -- by the closed process. Selecting only its portable first field must still succeed.
      let firstCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let firstRequest ← prepare kernel firstCell program context first #[pairTerm] #[requiredInput]
      if ← (← firstCell.view).isAvailable owners requiredInput then
        throwError "the dead-sibling input-result control unexpectedly has an available whole input"
      let firstResult ← demand kernel firstCell firstRequest
      unless firstResult.root.value == left.value do
        throwError "a dead input sibling changed the selected portable first field"
      discard <| checkCompletion kernel firstCell firstRequest firstResult.root

      let duplicateCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let duplicateRequest ← prepare kernel duplicateCell program context duplicate
        #[pairTerm] #[requiredInput]
      let duplicateResult ← demand kernel duplicateCell duplicateRequest
      let duplicateGraph ← duplicateCell.view
      let some duplicateNode := duplicateGraph.find duplicateResult.root.value
        | throwError "the duplicated input record is outside its actual graph"
      let .product duplicateFields := duplicateNode.payload.data
        | throwError "duplicating the portable first field left a lazy provider demand"
      unless duplicateFields.size == 2 do
        throwError "duplicating the portable first field omitted a computational result field"
      for index in [0:2] do
        let .ok actual := duplicateGraph.project duplicateResult.root index
          | throwError "the duplicated input result lost a stored field"
        unless actual.value == left.value do
          throwError "the duplicated result substituted the dead sibling's equal native value"
      discard <| checkCompletion kernel duplicateCell duplicateRequest duplicateResult.root

      -- Returning a selected callable preserves its lazy interface and its own live owner;
      -- neither the enclosing native export nor the selected callable may be invoked.
      let functionCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let functionRequest ← prepare kernel functionCell program context selectFunction
        #[functionPairTerm] #[functionInput]
      let functionResult ← demand kernel functionCell functionRequest
      unless functionResult.root.value == selectedFunction.value do
        throwError "the input-result shortcut replaced or evaluated its selected callable"
      discard <| checkCompletion kernel functionCell functionRequest functionResult.root
        #[live.generation]

      let reverseCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let reversed ← prepare kernel reverseCell program context reverse #[pairTerm] #[input]
      let reverseResult ← demand kernel reverseCell reversed
      let reverseGraph ← reverseCell.view
      unless reverseResult.root.value != input.value && reverseResult.root.value != equalInput.value do
        throwError "record reconstruction reused an unrelated equal-valued input root"
