      let some reverseNode := reverseGraph.find reverseResult.root.value
        | throwError "the reconstructed input record is outside its actual graph"
      let .product fields := reverseNode.payload.data
        | throwError "the wholly input-projected pair was left as a lazy provider demand"
      unless fields.size == 2 do
        throwError "the wholly input-projected pair omitted a computational field"
      let .ok reverseLeft := reverseGraph.project reverseResult.root 0
        | throwError "the reconstructed input pair lost its first field"
      let .ok reverseRight := reverseGraph.project reverseResult.root 1
        | throwError "the reconstructed input pair lost its second field"
      unless reverseLeft.value == right.value && reverseRight.value == left.value do
        throwError "input-result reconstruction changed the declared field order"
      let published ← checkCompletion kernel reverseCell reversed reverseResult.root

      -- The selected result's own owner remains required; the shortcut must not turn a
      -- genuine unavailable selected field into an owner-free native-typed replacement.
      let failed ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let selected ← prepare kernel failed program context second #[pairTerm] #[requiredInput]
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| demand kernel failed selected
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure
        | throwError "an input-result shortcut returned a field whose required owner is dead"
      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .unavailable &&
          (← failure.toMessageData.toString).endsWith "stale_owner" do throw failure
      unless (← failed.activeGraph).isNone &&
          (← kernel.ledger.pendingFor selected.occurrence failed.id).isNone &&
          ((← SessionSnapshot.current).receipt selected.occurrence).isNone &&
          (← SessionSnapshot.current).id == published.id &&
          (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "a failed selected-owner check retained or published an input-result demand"

      let failedWhole ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let wholeRequired ← prepare kernel failedWhole program context wholeCallable
        #[pairTerm, pairTerm] #[requiredInput, input]
      let wholeFailure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| demand kernel failedWhole wholeRequired
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some wholeFailure := wholeFailure
        | throwError "whole input aliasing dropped the selected record's dead field owner"
      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? wholeFailure == some .unavailable &&
          (← wholeFailure.toMessageData.toString).endsWith "stale_owner" do throw wholeFailure
      unless (← failedWhole.activeGraph).isNone &&
          ((← SessionSnapshot.current).receipt wholeRequired.occurrence).isNone &&
          (← SessionSnapshot.current).id == published.id do
        throwError "a failed whole-record owner check published an input-result alias"

      -- The first result field is input-fixed and the second is not. Keep this request on
      -- the production execution path: a partial prefix cannot become a completed record.
      let incompleteCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let incompleteRequest ← prepare kernel incompleteCell program context incompleteCallable
        #[pairTerm] #[lazyPair]
      let resolutionCalls ← IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
      let rejectedResolution : FixedInput → MetaM ValueBinding := fun _ => do
        resolutionCalls.modify (· + 1)
        throwError "incomplete result coverage forced a lazy input"
      let incompleteFailure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| Execute.run kernel.executor
          (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) incompleteRequest) incompleteCell
          (some rejectedResolution)
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some incompleteFailure := incompleteFailure
        | throwError "a known input-result prefix was admitted as a complete reconstructed record"
      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? incompleteFailure == some .unavailable &&
          (← incompleteFailure.toMessageData.toString).endsWith "stale_owner" do
        throw incompleteFailure
      unless (← incompleteCell.activeGraph).isNone &&
          (← resolutionCalls.get) == 0 &&
          (← SessionSnapshot.current).id == published.id &&
          ((← SessionSnapshot.current).receipt incompleteRequest.occurrence).isNone &&
          (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "an incomplete input-result prefix entered the committed result graph"
    finally
      owners.close unrelated.generation
      owners.close live.generation
      kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- The earlier application owns its original argument and context tables. A later source
-- scope adds a shadowing binder and a different equal-valued actual argument; it cannot
-- replace the earlier selected actual when the residual callable is finally applied.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkNatLit 7))
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let owner ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      let produced ← kernel.ledger.allocate
      let left ← producer.stage
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := scalar, parameters := #[] }
        (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      let right ← producer.stage
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := scalar, parameters := #[] }
        (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      withLocalDeclD `n (mkConst ``Nat) fun originalParameter => do
        let oldBinding : LocalBinding := {
          id := ⟨"input-result-context", 0⟩, role := .parameter,
          expression := originalParameter }
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[oldBinding]
        let .ok oldActual := RuntimeParameter.ofValue (← producer.view) oldBinding.id left
          | throwError "the original input-result context binding is outside its graph"
        let source ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
          (← `(fun (x _y : Nat) => x)) none
        let callableRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close source)
        let callable ← producer.stage
          { program, occurrence := produced, role := callableRole, parameters := #[some left] }
          (.ownedExport owner "unpublished original partial application" #[])
        let first ← prepare kernel producer program context callable #[mkNatLit 7] #[left]
          #[oldActual]
        let residual ← producer.stage first.origin
          (.ownedExport owner "unpublished residual callable" #[])
        let some earlier := first.origin.application
          | throwError "the partial input-result fixture lost its producing application"
        let .ok _ ← producer.commit
          | throwError "the captured input-result fixture could not publish"
        owners.close owner.generation
        withLocalDeclD `n (mkConst ``Nat) fun shadowParameter => do
          let newBinding : LocalBinding := {
            id := ⟨"input-result-context", 1⟩, role := .parameter,
            expression := shadowParameter }
          let current ← ContextTelescope.capture #[oldBinding, newBinding]
          let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
          let .ok newActual := RuntimeParameter.ofValue (← consumer.view) newBinding.id right
            | throwError "the shadowing input-result context binding is outside its graph"
          let request ← prepare kernel consumer program current residual #[mkNatLit 7] #[right]
            #[oldActual, newActual]
          let response ← demand kernel consumer request
          unless response.root.value == left.value && response.root.value != right.value do
            throwError "partial input-result execution selected a later equal-valued actual"
          let some later := request.origin.application
            | throwError "the final input-result demand lost its actual argument table"
          let earlierContext := earlier.layout.result.source.context.entries
          let laterContext := later.layout.result.source.context.entries
          let earlierAuthored := earlierContext.filter (·.role == .parameter)
          let laterAuthored := laterContext.filter (·.role == .parameter)
          let earlierInputs := earlierContext.filter (·.role == .result)
          let laterInputs := laterContext.filter (·.role == .result)
          unless earlier.parameters.size == earlierContext.size &&
              later.parameters.size == laterContext.size &&
              earlierAuthored.map (·.id) == #[oldBinding.id] &&
              laterAuthored.map (·.id) == #[oldBinding.id, newBinding.id] &&
              earlierInputs.size == 1 && laterInputs.size == 2 &&
              earlierContext.size == earlierAuthored.size + earlierInputs.size &&
              laterContext.size == laterAuthored.size + laterInputs.size &&
              (earlierInputs ++ laterInputs).all
                (fun entry => entry.value.isNone && entry.originalSource.isSome) &&
              (earlier.arguments[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some left.value &&
              (later.arguments[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some right.value do
            throwError "input-result execution merged original and later source argument planes"
          for original in earlierContext do
            let some firstIndex := earlierContext.findIdx? (·.id == original.id)
              | throwError "the earlier input-result plane lost an original context position"
            let some nextIndex := laterContext.findIdx? (·.id == original.id)
              | throwError "the later input-result plane dropped an original binding identity"
            let some first := earlier.parameters[firstIndex]?.bind id
              | throwError "the earlier input-result plane lost an actual source value"
            let some next := later.parameters[nextIndex]?.bind id
              | throwError "the later input-result plane lost an imported actual source value"
            unless retainsReference first next && first.value == left.value do
              throwError "the later source plane replaced an original equal-valued occurrence"
          let added := laterContext.filter fun entry =>
            !(earlierContext.any (·.id == entry.id))
          for original in added do
            let some index := laterContext.findIdx? (·.id == original.id)
              | throwError "the later input-result plane lost its own original binding"
            let some actual := later.parameters[index]?.bind id
              | throwError "the later input-result plane omitted its original actual value"
            unless retainsReference right actual do
              throwError "the later source plane reused the earlier equal-valued occurrence"
          discard <| checkCompletion kernel consumer request response.root
    finally
      owners.close owner.generation
      kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- The independent registered group-kernel declaration fixes the inclusion's ambient to
-- the input arrow's source. Its other fields still require a provider. These opaque native
-- interfaces supply no computed group-theoretic answer; only the existing source selection
-- and the absence of a whole-result realization are under test.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let sign ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(CasCatalogue.Algebra.FiniteGroups.sign 3)) none
    let signArrow ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk #[sign]
    let object ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Arrow.left #[signArrow]
    let identity ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id #[object]
    let receiver ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Arrow.mk #[identity]
    let receiverRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close receiver)
    let receiverRecord ← RecordLayout.ofSource receiverRole
    let #[leftField, rightField, homField] :=
        receiverRecord.fields.filter (·.field.wireIndex.isSome)
      | throwError "the group-kernel input changed its native computational fields"
    unless ← isDefEq (← leftField.layout.source.inContext context)
        (← rightField.layout.source.inContext context) do
      throwError "the group-kernel control requires equal native endpoint terms"
    let family ← SourceFamily.forReference (.functor ⟨"fun.arrows_groups.kernel"⟩)
    let declaration := family.source.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams
      (family.universeParams.map fun _ => Level.zero)
    let callableSource ← mkProjection declaration `obj
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let owner ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      let produced ← kernel.ledger.allocate
      let left ← producer.stage
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := leftField.layout, parameters := #[] }
        (.closure program #[])
      let right ← producer.stage
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := rightField.layout, parameters := #[] }
        (.closure program #[])
      let hom ← producer.stage
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := homField.layout, parameters := #[] }
        (.closure program #[])
      let input ← producer.stage
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := receiverRole, parameters := #[] }
        (.product #[left, right, hom])
      let lazyInput ← producer.stage
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := receiverRole, parameters := #[] }
        (.ownedExport owner "unpublished lazy group arrow" #[])
      -- Obtain the actual delayed published family through the production lowerer.
      let callable ← kernel.run producer context {} callableSource
      let application ← prepare kernel producer program context callable #[receiver] #[input]
      let resultRecord ← RecordLayout.ofSource application.source
      let some underlying := resultRecord.fields.find? (·.field.wireIndex == some 0)
        | throwError "the group-kernel result lost its native underlying arrow"
      let arrowRecord ← RecordLayout.ofSource underlying.layout
      let some ambient := arrowRecord.fields.find? (·.field.wireIndex == some 1)
        | throwError "the group-kernel inclusion lost its native ambient field"
      let resultArrow ← producer.stage (← application.originFor underlying.layout)
        (.ownedExport owner "unpublished kernel inclusion arrow" #[])
      let .ok _ ← producer.commit
        | throwError "the registered group-kernel input interfaces could not publish"

      let projectedCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let projection ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program
        (← kernel.ledger.allocate) context (← projectedCell.view) resultArrow
        ambient.field.sourceIndex #[]
      let selected ← demand kernel projectedCell projection
      unless selected.root.value == left.value && selected.root.value != right.value do
        throwError "the registered fixed ambient selected a different equal-valued input endpoint"
      unless selected.root.projectionAccesses.any (fun (parent, path) =>
          parent.value == input.value && path == #[leftField.field.projection]) &&
          selected.root.projectionAccesses.any (fun (parent, path) =>
            parent.value == resultArrow.value && path == #[ambient.field.projection]) do
        throwError "the fixed ambient lost its original input or current output access"
      let published ← checkCompletion kernel projectedCell projection selected.root

      -- A lazy input would require its unpublished owner's projection interface if forced.
      -- The whole kernel result is not input-fixed: coverage discovery must leave that input
      -- untouched and reach the ordinary missing-realization failure for the target family.
      let incomplete ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
        withRetainedValues kernel incomplete context {} #[callable, lazyInput] fun context bound selections sources =>
          discard <| kernel.run incomplete context bound (mkApp sources[0]! sources[1]!) (selections := selections)
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure
        | throwError "a partially input-fixed group-kernel result bypassed its required provider"
      unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .noImplementation do throw failure
      if ((← failure.toMessageData.toString).splitOn "fun.arrows_groups.kernel").length == 1 then
        throw failure
      unless (← incomplete.activeGraph).isNone &&
          (← SessionSnapshot.current).id == published.id &&
          (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "incomplete input-result coverage published or dispatched a partial result"
    finally
      owners.close owner.generation
      kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- Native id preserves its complete input; Prod.fst selects a declared native field. A descriptor
-- carries the whole Prod value but no stored field identities. These controls use only those
-- native structural rules: the ordinary result below is produced by Kernel.run on Prod.mk,
-- not supplied by a mathematical backend or recovered from the descriptor's packet.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let pairTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 11]
    let pairRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close pairTerm)
    let identityTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p : Nat × Nat) => p)) none
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      let produced ← kernel.ledger.allocate
      let .ok payload := ValuePayload.descriptor
          (.arr #[toJson (7 : Nat), toJson (11 : Nat)]) #[]
        | throwError "the native descriptor control has an invalid packet"
      let input ← producer.stage
        { program, occurrence := produced, role := pairRole, parameters := #[] } payload
      let identity ← kernel.run producer context {} identityTerm
      let producerGraph ← producer.view
      let some inputNode := producerGraph.find input.value
        | throwError "the descriptor control lost its original input"
      unless inputNode.payload.data.storedFields?.isNone do
        throwError "the descriptor control already has stored native field data"
      let .error _ := producerGraph.project input 0
        | throwError "the descriptor control fabricated a native field reference"
      let .ok _ ← producer.commit
        | throwError "the descriptor control could not publish its original input"

      let executionCalls ← IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
      let resolutionCalls ← IO.mkRef (0 : Nat)
      let executor : PFunctor.Handler.Stateful MetaM CellTransaction OperationalSignature :=
        fun request transaction => do
          executionCalls.modify (· + 1)
          kernel.executor request transaction
      let rejectResolution : FixedInput → MetaM ValueBinding := fun _ => do
        resolutionCalls.modify (· + 1)
        throwError "descriptor input routing invoked a fabricated lazy field resolver"
      let wholeCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let whole ← prepare kernel wholeCell program context identity #[pairTerm] #[input]
      let wholeResult ← Execute.run executor
        (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) whole) wholeCell
        (some rejectResolution)
      unless wholeResult.root.value == input.value && (← executionCalls.get) == 0 &&
          (← resolutionCalls.get) == 0 do
        throwError "whole descriptor identity changed its node or executed a demand"
      let wholeGraph ← wholeCell.view
      let some wholeNode := wholeGraph.find wholeResult.root.value
        | throwError "whole descriptor identity lost its retained node"
      unless wholeNode.payload.data.storedFields?.isNone do
        throwError "whole descriptor identity fabricated a stored native record"
      discard <| checkCompletion kernel wholeCell whole wholeResult.root

      -- The identity's retained application supplies a real fixed-source path to the same
      -- descriptor. Its absent field table must prevent that path from becoming coverage.
      let fieldCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let fieldGraph ← fieldCell.view
      let field ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program
        (← kernel.ledger.allocate) context fieldGraph wholeResult.root 0 #[]
      unless field.origin.application.isSome do
        throwError "the descriptor projection control lost its source application provenance"
      let .none ← field.fixedInputFor fieldGraph field.source
          (some fun _ => do
            resolutionCalls.modify (· + 1)
            throwError "descriptor field discovery invoked a lazy resolver")
        | throwError "the descriptor's native schema fabricated a fixed input field"
      let .none ← field.inputResultPlan fieldGraph
        | throwError "the descriptor's absent field table supplied complete result coverage"
      let computed : IO.Ref (Option ValueBinding) ← IO.mkRef none
      let fieldExecutor : PFunctor.Handler.Stateful MetaM CellTransaction OperationalSignature :=
        fun request transaction => do
          executionCalls.modify (· + 1)
          let .project operand selected := request.action
            | throwError "the descriptor field control reached a different action"
          unless operand.value == input.value && selected.projection == ``Prod.fst do
            throwError "the descriptor field demand changed its exact operand or projection"
          let value ← kernel.run transaction context {} (mkProj ``Prod 0 pairTerm)
          computed.set (some value)
          let response ← kernelCompletion request transaction value (some rejectResolution)
          return (response, transaction)
      let fieldResult ← Execute.run fieldExecutor
        (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) field) fieldCell
        (some rejectResolution)
      let some computed ← computed.get
        | throwError "the descriptor field was not produced by the ordinary executor"
      unless (← executionCalls.get) == 1 && (← resolutionCalls.get) == 0 &&
          fieldResult.root.value == computed.value && fieldResult.root.value != input.value do
        throwError "descriptor field admission fabricated an input identity or bypassed execution"
      discard <| checkCompletion kernel fieldCell field fieldResult.root
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- One lazy runtime record has one first field, even when two result positions select it.
-- The stored source is only a native Prod constructor. Both projections run through the
-- production native evaluator and its ordinary fixed-input resolver; no provider or fixture
-- executor supplies a field value. The two output roles may differ, but their node must not.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let pairTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 11]
    let pairSource ← context.close pairTerm
    let pairRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm pairSource
    let duplicateTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p : Nat × Nat) => (p.1, p.1))) none
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let code ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      kernel.codes.modify (·.insert code (.term pairSource))
      let produced ← kernel.ledger.allocate
      let input ← producer.stage
        { program := code, occurrence := produced, role := pairRole, parameters := #[] }
        (.closure code #[])
      let duplicate ← kernel.run producer context {} duplicateTerm
      let producerGraph ← producer.view
      let some inputNode := producerGraph.find input.value
        | throwError "the lazy duplicate control lost its original record"
      unless inputNode.payload.data.storedFields?.isNone do
        throwError "the lazy duplicate control already has stored field identities"
      let .error _ := producerGraph.project input 0
        | throwError "the lazy duplicate control already exposes its first field"
      let .ok _ ← producer.commit
        | throwError "the lazy duplicate control could not publish its original record"

      let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        -- Kernel.run installs the production fixed-input resolver for one application
        -- to the same retained record.
        let result ← withRetainedValues kernel consumer context {} #[duplicate, input]
            fun context bound selections sources =>
          kernel.run consumer context bound (mkApp sources[0]! sources[1]!) (selections := selections)
        let graph ← consumer.view
        let .ok first := graph.project result 0
          | throwError "the lazy duplicate result lost its first field"
        let .ok second := graph.project result 1
          | throwError "the lazy duplicate result lost its second field"
        for field in #[first, second] do
          unless field.projectionAccesses.any (fun (parent, path) =>
              parent.value == input.value && parent.associationIds == input.associationIds &&
                path == #[``Prod.fst]) do
            throwError "the lazy duplicate result did not select the same original record field"
        unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
          throwError "the native lazy duplicate control dispatched a provider"
        unless first.value == second.value do
          throwError "one lazy input field was realized as two different nodes"
      finally discard <| consumer.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- A deeper selection may occur before its shared prefix. Retain the intermediate field,
-- while equal source terms at another parent or native path remain distinct selections.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let pairTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 11]
    let inputTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[pairTerm, pairTerm]
    let inputSource ← context.close inputTerm
    let inputRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm inputSource
    let selectTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p q : (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat)) =>
        (p.1.1, (p.1, (p.2, q.1))))) none
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let code ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      kernel.codes.modify (·.insert code (.term inputSource))
      let produced ← kernel.ledger.allocate
      let stage := producer.stage
        { program := code, occurrence := produced, role := inputRole, parameters := #[] }
        (.closure code #[])
      let input ← stage
      let other ← stage
      unless input.value != other.value do
        throwError "the lazy overlap control merged its original parent nodes"
      let selected ← kernel.run producer context {} selectTerm
      let graph ← producer.view
      for parent in #[input, other] do
        let .error _ := graph.project parent 0
          | throwError "the lazy overlap control already has stored field identities"
      let .ok _ ← producer.commit
        | throwError "the lazy overlap control could not publish its original records"

      let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        let result ← withRetainedValues kernel consumer context {} #[selected, input, other]
            fun context bound selections sources =>
          kernel.run consumer context bound (mkAppN sources[0]! #[sources[1]!, sources[2]!]) (selections := selections)
        let graph ← consumer.view
        let project := fun parent index => IO.ofExcept <|
          (graph.project parent index).mapError IO.userError
        let deep ← project result 0
        let rest ← project result 1
        let first ← project rest 0
        let rest ← project rest 1
        let second ← project rest 0
        let otherFirst ← project rest 1
        let fromFirst ← project first 0
        unless deep.value == fromFirst.value do
          throwError "a deeper lazy input selection recreated its shared prefix field"
        unless first.value != second.value && first.value != otherFirst.value &&
            second.value != otherFirst.value do
          throwError "lazy input reuse merged distinct parent or native path identities"
        for (field, parent, path) in #[
            (deep, input, #[``Prod.fst, ``Prod.fst]),
            (first, input, #[``Prod.fst]),
            (second, input, #[``Prod.snd]),
            (otherFirst, other, #[``Prod.fst])] do
          unless field.projectionAccesses.any (fun (actual, selectedPath) =>
              actual.value == parent.value && actual.associationIds == parent.associationIds &&
                selectedPath == path) do
            throwError "lazy input reuse changed an original selected parent or native path"
        unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
          throwError "the native lazy overlap control dispatched a provider"
      finally discard <| consumer.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- A lazy native prefix may expose a symbolic descriptor. Discovering its unavailable field
-- preserves the ordinary projection failure, without replaying the prefix or inventing data.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let pairTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 11]
    let pairRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close pairTerm)
    let selectTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p : (Nat × Nat) × Nat) => p.1.1)) none
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let code ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      let produced ← kernel.ledger.allocate
      let .ok descriptorPayload := ValuePayload.descriptor .null #[]
        | throwError "the lazy descriptor control could not prepare its symbolic value"
      let descriptor ← producer.stage
        { program := code, occurrence := produced, role := pairRole, parameters := #[] }
        descriptorPayload
      withRetainedValues kernel producer context {} #[descriptor] fun context bound selections sources => do
        let retained := sources[0]!
        let inputTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[retained, mkNatLit 13]
        let inputSource ← context.close inputTerm
        kernel.codes.modify (·.insert code (.term inputSource))
        let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context bound (← producer.view)
          (selections := selections)
        let input ← producer.stage
          (← environment.origin code produced (← SourceLayout.ofTerm inputSource))
          (.closure code #[descriptor])
        let selected ← kernel.run producer context bound selectTerm (selections := selections)
        let graph ← producer.view
        for parent in #[descriptor, input] do
          let .error _ := graph.project parent 0
            | throwError "the lazy descriptor control already has stored native fields"
        let .ok _ ← producer.commit
          | throwError "the lazy descriptor control could not publish its original values"

        let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let failure : Option Exception ← try
            withRetainedValues kernel consumer context bound #[selected, input] fun context bound selections sources =>
              discard <| kernel.run consumer context bound (mkApp sources[0]! sources[1]!) (selections := selections)
            pure none
          catch error => pure (some error)
          let some failure := failure
            | throwError "a lazy descriptor prefix fabricated its absent native field"
          unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .noImplementation do
            throw failure
          unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "the native lazy descriptor control dispatched a provider"
        finally discard <| consumer.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- Fresh projection requests reuse the published field of one exact lazy parent. Equal
-- fields at another path or parent are independent, and an older snapshot sees no new data.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let pairTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 7]
    let pairSource ← context.close pairTerm
    let pairRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm pairSource
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let code ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      kernel.codes.modify (·.insert code (.term pairSource))
      let produced ← kernel.ledger.allocate
      let stage := producer.stage
        { program := code, occurrence := produced, role := pairRole, parameters := #[] }
        (.closure code #[])
      let input ← stage
      let other ← stage
      unless input.value != other.value do
        throwError "the published lazy projection control merged its original parents"
      let .ok _ ← producer.commit
        | throwError "the published lazy projection control could not publish its parents"
      let project (transaction : CellTransaction) (parent : ValueBinding) (index : Nat) :
          MetaM ValueBinding := do
        withRetainedValues kernel transaction context {} #[parent] fun context bound selections sources =>
          kernel.run transaction context bound (.proj ``Prod index sources[0]!) (selections := selections)
      -- These cells begin at the same snapshot. Only the first one's graph is published.
      let stale ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let firstCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        let before ← stale.view
        let first ← project firstCell input 0
        let again ← project firstCell input 0
        let sibling ← project firstCell input 1
        let otherFirst ← project firstCell other 0
        unless (before.find first.value).isNone &&
            !(before.requiredOwners #[first]).isOk do
          throwError "a tentative lazy projection escaped into an older visible graph"
        let .ok published ← firstCell.commit
          | throwError "the published lazy projection control could not commit its first reads"
        let laterCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let later ← project laterCell input 0
          let .ok latest ← laterCell.commit
            | throwError "the published lazy projection control could not commit its later read"
          unless latest.id != published.id do
            throwError "the published lazy projection control did not enter a new snapshot"
          for (value, parent, path) in #[
              (first, input, #[``Prod.fst]),
              (again, input, #[``Prod.fst]),
              (later, input, #[``Prod.fst]),
              (sibling, input, #[``Prod.snd]),
              (otherFirst, other, #[``Prod.fst])] do
            unless value.projectionAccesses.any (fun (actual, selectedPath) =>
                actual.value == parent.value && actual.associationIds == parent.associationIds &&
                  selectedPath == path) do
              throwError "a fresh projection request changed its original parent or field path"
          unless first.value != sibling.value && first.value != otherFirst.value &&
              sibling.value != otherFirst.value do
            throwError "published projection reuse merged distinct parent or native path identities"
          let staleValue ← project stale input 0
          let staleGraph ← stale.view
          unless staleValue.value != first.value && (staleGraph.find first.value).isNone &&
              (latest.graph.find staleValue.value).isNone do
            throwError "published projection reuse crossed an immutable snapshot boundary"
          let .error .staleSnapshot ← stale.commit
            | throwError "an older lazy projection cell published over a newer snapshot"
          unless (← SessionSnapshot.current).id == latest.id do
            throwError "an older lazy projection cell changed the current snapshot"
          unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "the native published projection control dispatched a provider"
          unless first.value == again.value && first.value == later.value do
            throwError "one lazy input field changed node across fresh requests or committed cells"
        finally discard <| laterCell.abort
      finally
        discard <| firstCell.abort
        discard <| stale.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- An actual lazy inner record is first accessed through its enriched projection view.
-- Later plan preparation reaches that same record through the exact original input baseline.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let pairTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 11]
    let pairSource ← context.close pairTerm
    let pairRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm pairSource
    let selectTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(fun (p : (Nat × Nat) × Nat) => (p.1.1, p.1))) none
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let innerCode ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      kernel.codes.modify (·.insert innerCode (.term pairSource))
      let inner ← producer.stage
        { program := innerCode, occurrence := ← kernel.ledger.allocate,
          role := pairRole, parameters := #[] }
        (.closure innerCode #[])
      withRetainedValues kernel producer context {} #[inner] fun context bound selections sources => do
        let retainedInner := sources[0]!
        let outerTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[retainedInner, mkNatLit 13]
        let outerSource ← context.close outerTerm
        let outerCode ← owners.identities.fresh .program
        kernel.codes.modify (·.insert outerCode (.term outerSource))
        let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context bound (← producer.view)
          (selections := selections)
        let outer ← producer.stage
          (← environment.origin outerCode (← kernel.ledger.allocate)
            (← SourceLayout.ofTerm outerSource))
          (.closure outerCode #[inner])
        let selected ← kernel.run producer context bound selectTerm (selections := selections)
        let graph ← producer.view
        for parent in #[outer, inner] do
          let .error _ := graph.project parent 0
            | throwError "the lazy intermediate control already has stored field identities"
        let .ok _ ← producer.commit
          | throwError "the lazy intermediate control could not publish its original records"

        -- A real first projection supplies the intermediate parent; its final field is an
        -- already produced direct reply. Association must publish the full original path.
        do
          let pendingCell ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
          try
            let initialSnapshot ← SessionSnapshot.current
            withRetainedValues kernel pendingCell context bound #[outer] fun context bound selections sources => do
              let retainedOuter := sources[0]!
              let prefixAccess ← kernel.run pendingCell context bound (mkProj ``Prod 0 retainedOuter) (selections := selections)
              let beforeFinal ← pendingCell.view
              let .ok (some originalPrefix) := beforeFinal.projected? outer #[``Prod.fst]
                | throwError "the pending-final control lost its ordinary first projection"
              unless prefixAccess.value == inner.value && originalPrefix.value == inner.value &&
                  originalPrefix.associationIds == inner.associationIds do
                throwError "the pending-final control replaced its original intermediate parent"
              let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
              let finalProjection ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program
                (← kernel.ledger.allocate) context beforeFinal prefixAccess 0 #[]
              let finalValue ← pendingCell.stage finalProjection.origin (.portable "7".toUTF8)
              let before ← pendingCell.view
              let inputPath := #[``Prod.fst, ``Prod.fst]
              let .ok (some (frontier, remaining)) := before.projectionFrontier outer inputPath
                | throwError "the pending-final control lost its actual native frontier"
              unless frontier.value == originalPrefix.value &&
                  frontier.associationIds == originalPrefix.associationIds &&
                  remaining == #[``Prod.fst] do
                throwError "the pending-final control did not retain exactly one unavailable field"
              let .ok (some directBaseline) := before.projectionBasis finalValue outer inputPath
                | throwError "the direct final reply lost its original composed parent and path"
              unless directBaseline.value == finalValue.value &&
                  directBaseline.associationIds == finalValue.associationIds do
                throwError "the direct final reply changed its original baseline"
              let .ok none := before.projected? prefixAccess #[``Prod.fst]
                | throwError "the pending-final field was already indexed"
              let .ok none := before.projectedAccess? outer inputPath
                | throwError "the pending-final control already has a full-path source access"
              let parameters ← context.bindings.filterMapM fun binding => do
                let some value := bound[binding.id]? | return none
                return some (← IO.ofExcept <|
                  (RuntimeParameter.ofValue before binding.id value).mapError IO.userError)
              let request ← prepare kernel pendingCell program context selected #[outerTerm] #[outer] parameters
              let outputRecord ← RecordLayout.ofSource request.source
              let some outputField := outputRecord.fields.find? (·.field.wireIndex == some 0)
                | throwError "the source-fixed result lost its first native field"
              let fixed ← request.resolveFixedResults pendingCell outputField.layout finalValue
              let #[selection] := fixed
                | throwError "the pending-final result lost its single fixed source selection"
              unless selection.path == #[``Prod.fst] &&
                  selection.input.parent.value == outer.value &&
                  selection.input.parent.associationIds == outer.associationIds &&
                  selection.input.path == inputPath &&
                  selection.value.value == finalValue.value &&
                  selection.value.associationIds == finalValue.associationIds do
                throwError "pending-final resolution changed its original input or result position"
              let (draft, result) ← request.associateResult owners.identities outputField.layout
                (← pendingCell.draft) finalValue fixed (complete := true)
              discard <| request.environment.checkResult draft.view outputField.layout result
              let .ok (some sourceAccess) := draft.view.projectedAccess? outer inputPath
                | throwError "pending-final association omitted its complete original source access"
              let .ok (some (selectedSource, selectedParent, selectedPath)) :=
                  draft.view.projectionSelection sourceAccess
                | throwError "the composed source access lost its immutable native selection"
              unless selectedParent.value == outer.value &&
                  selectedParent.associationIds == outer.associationIds &&
                  selectedPath == inputPath do
                throwError "the composed source access changed its original parent or native path"
              let mut nativeSource := selectedParent.role
              for projection in inputPath do
                let some field := nativeSource.fields.find? (·.projection == projection)
                  | throwError "the composed source access lost its original field layout"
                nativeSource ← field.toLayout
              unless (← selectedSource.source.inContext context) ==
                  (← nativeSource.source.inContext context) do
                throwError "the composed source access acquired an output-derived source role"
              let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue draft.view 0 sourceAccess
                | throwError "the pending-final source access is outside its isolated graph"
              discard <| request.environment.checkArgument
                (← context.close (mkProj ``Prod 0 (mkProj ``Prod 0 retainedOuter))) actual
              for (parent, path, expected) in #[
                  (outer, #[``Prod.fst], originalPrefix),
                  (prefixAccess, #[``Prod.fst], finalValue),
                  (outer, inputPath, finalValue)] do
                let .ok (some baseline) := draft.view.projected? parent path
                  | throwError "pending-final association lost an original projection baseline"
                unless baseline.value == expected.value &&
                    baseline.associationIds == expected.associationIds do
                  throwError "pending-final association enriched or replaced an original baseline"
              unless result.value == finalValue.value && sourceAccess.value == finalValue.value &&
                  finalValue.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf result.associationIds.toList do
                throwError "pending-final association replaced its actual returned field"
              let some innerNode := draft.view.find inner.value
                | throwError "pending-final association lost its actual intermediate node"
              unless innerNode.payload.data.storedFields?.isNone &&
                  (← pendingCell.view).sameRevision before &&
                  (← SessionSnapshot.current).id == initialSnapshot.id &&
                  (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                throwError "pending-final association forced, installed or published its isolated work"
          finally discard <| pendingCell.abort

        let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let accessedInner ← withRetainedValues kernel consumer context bound #[outer]
              fun context bound selections sources =>
            kernel.run consumer context bound (mkProj ``Prod 0 sources[0]!) (selections := selections)
          unless accessedInner.value == inner.value &&
              accessedInner.associationIds != inner.associationIds &&
              accessedInner.projectionAccesses.any (fun (parent, path) =>
                parent.value == outer.value && parent.associationIds == outer.associationIds &&
                  path == #[``Prod.fst]) do
            throwError "the lazy intermediate control did not retain its enriched parent view"
          let first ← withRetainedValues kernel consumer context bound #[accessedInner]
              fun context bound selections sources =>
            kernel.run consumer context bound (mkProj ``Prod 0 sources[0]!) (selections := selections)
          unless first.projectionAccesses.any (fun (parent, path) =>
              parent.value == accessedInner.value &&
                parent.associationIds == accessedInner.associationIds &&
                path == #[``Prod.fst]) do
            throwError "the lazy intermediate field lost its actual first access parent"

          let parameters ← context.bindings.filterMapM fun binding => do
            let some value := bound[binding.id]? | return none
            return some (← IO.ofExcept <|
              (RuntimeParameter.ofValue (← consumer.view) binding.id value).mapError IO.userError)
          let request ← prepare kernel consumer (← owners.identities.fresh .program) context
            selected #[outerTerm] #[outer] parameters
          let some plan ← request.inputResultPlan (← consumer.view)
            | throwError "the retained lazy intermediate did not supply complete result coverage"
          -- No resolver is supplied: both selections must already be visible graph relations.
          let resolved ← plan.resolve (liftM (m := IO) consumer.view)
          let some planned := resolved.selections.find? (·.path == #[``Prod.fst])
            | throwError "the lazy intermediate plan lost its deeper selected field"
          unless planned.value.value == first.value && planned.input.parent.value == outer.value &&
              planned.input.parent.associationIds == outer.associationIds &&
              planned.input.path == #[``Prod.fst, ``Prod.fst] do
            throwError "plan preparation changed the retained lazy intermediate field or source path"
          let beforeAssembly ← consumer.view
          let .ok none := beforeAssembly.projectedAccess? outer #[``Prod.fst, ``Prod.fst]
            | throwError "the composed input already has a full-path access before assembly"
          let result ← withRetainedValues kernel consumer context bound #[selected, outer]
              fun context bound selections sources =>
            kernel.run consumer context bound (mkApp sources[0]! sources[1]!) (selections := selections)
          let graph ← consumer.view
          let .ok deep := graph.project result 0
            | throwError "the lazy intermediate result lost its deeper field"
          let .ok retained := graph.project result 1
            | throwError "the lazy intermediate result lost its original inner record"
          unless deep.value == first.value && retained.value == inner.value do
            throwError "the input result recreated an already retained lazy intermediate selection"
          for (value, path) in #[
              (deep, #[``Prod.fst, ``Prod.fst]), (retained, #[``Prod.fst])] do
            unless value.projectionAccesses.any (fun (parent, selectedPath) =>
                parent.value == outer.value && parent.associationIds == outer.associationIds &&
                  selectedPath == path) do
              throwError "the lazy intermediate result lost its complete original access path"
          -- The first full-path view must belong to the selected input source, independently
          -- of the output record. The baseline and the raw lazy parents remain unchanged.
          for selection in resolved.selections do
            let input := selection.input
            let .ok (some sourceAccess) := graph.projectedAccess? input.parent input.path
              | throwError "input-result assembly omitted its original native source access"
            let .ok (some (selectedSource, selectedParent, selectedPath)) :=
                graph.projectionSelection sourceAccess
              | throwError "the input access lost its immutable native selection"
            unless selectedParent.value == input.parent.value &&
                selectedParent.associationIds == input.parent.associationIds &&
                selectedPath == input.path do
              throwError "the input access changed its original parent or complete path"
            withRetainedValues kernel consumer context bound #[input.parent] fun context bound selections sources => do
              request.environment.withContext context bound fun context bound => do
                let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context bound graph
                  (selections := selections)
                let mut nativeSource := selectedParent.role
                let mut specified := sources[0]!
                for projection in input.path do
                  let some field := nativeSource.fields.find? (·.projection == projection)
                    | throwError "the original input lost its native field layout"
                  specified ← projectTerm specified field
                  nativeSource ← field.toLayout
                unless (← selectedSource.source.inContext context) ==
                    (← nativeSource.source.inContext context) do
                  throwError "the first input access borrowed its output record's source role"
                discard <| environment.checkOperand graph nativeSource sourceAccess
                let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 sourceAccess
                  | throwError "the original input access is outside its admitted graph"
                discard <| environment.checkArgument (← context.close specified) actual
            let .ok (some (beforeBaseline, #[])) :=
                beforeAssembly.projectionFrontier input.parent input.path
              | throwError "the no-resolver input lost its previously available native path"
            let .ok (some baseline) := graph.projected? input.parent input.path
              | throwError "source-access publication lost its original cached baseline"
            let some afterBaseline ← input.storedValue? graph
              | throwError "source-access publication changed its original stored frontier"
            for actual in #[beforeBaseline, baseline, afterBaseline] do
              unless actual.value == selection.value.value &&
                  actual.associationIds == selection.value.associationIds do
                throwError "source-access publication enriched or replaced an original input baseline"
          for parent in #[outer, inner] do
            let some node := graph.find parent.value
              | throwError "source-access publication lost an original lazy parent"
            unless node.payload.data.storedFields?.isNone do
              throwError "source-access publication evaluated an original lazy parent"
          unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "the native lazy intermediate control dispatched a provider"
        finally discard <| consumer.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

end CasRuntime.InputResultTests

module

public import CasRuntime.Value
public import CasCatalogue.InterpretationFailure

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler

/-- An exact source-selected input and native field path, before any reply is admitted. -/
structure FixedInput where
  parent : ValueBinding
  path : Array Name
  source : ClosedTerm
  parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)

/-- The original selected input at one native result address.
Resolution precedes reply staging, including any demands needed for lazy input fields. -/
structure FixedResult where
  path : Array Name
  input : FixedInput
  value : ValueBinding

private def selectedInputLayout (source : SourceLayout) (path : Array Name) :
    MetaM SourceLayout := do
  let mut source := source
  for projection in path do
    let some field := source.fields.find? (·.projection == projection)
      | throwError "a fixed input route is outside its actual native record interface"
    unless field.wireIndex.isSome do
      throwError "a fixed computational input route selected a proof field"
    source ← field.toLayout
  return source

private def FixedInput.checkPath (input : FixedInput) : MetaM Unit :=
  discard <| selectedInputLayout input.parent.nativeRole input.path

/-- Follow actual stored fields and retain the exact remaining selection at a lazy frontier.
A descriptor without field data supplies no route through its schema. This reads only the
graph; genuine native closures and tokens are not invoked to discover source coverage. -/
private def FixedInput.storedFrontier (input : FixedInput) (graph : ValueGraph) :
    MetaM (Option (ValueBinding × Array Name)) := do
  input.checkPath
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners #[input.parent]).mapError IO.userError
  let mut value := input.parent
  for projection in input.path, offset in [:input.path.size] do
    let some field := value.nativeRole.fields.find? (·.projection == projection)
      | throwError "a fixed input route lost its actual native field"
    let some index := field.wireIndex
      | throwError "a fixed computational input route selected a proof field"
    let some node := graph.find value.value
      | throwError "the fixed input is outside the visible graph"
    if node.payload.data.storedFields?.isNone then
      if let some retained ← IO.ofExcept <|
          (graph.projected? value #[projection]).mapError IO.userError then
        value := retained
        continue
    match node.payload.data with
    | .closure .. | .ownedToken .. =>
      return some (value, input.path.extract offset input.path.size)
    | .container container =>
      if container.fields.isNone then return none
      value ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.project value index).mapError IO.userError
    | .product .. =>
      value ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.project value index).mapError IO.userError
    | .portable .. => throwError "the fixed input has no native record access interface"
  return some (value, #[])

/-- Resolve an already stored input by its native field ordinals, never by value equality.
Lazy record fields are resolved through ordinary prepared demands by the caller. -/
opaque FixedInput.storedValue? (input : FixedInput) (graph : ValueGraph) :
    MetaM (Option ValueBinding) := do
  let some (value, remaining) ← input.storedFrontier graph | return none
  return if remaining.isEmpty then some value else none

opaque FixedInput.storedValue (input : FixedInput) (graph : ValueGraph) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let some value ← input.storedValue? graph
    | throwError "the fixed input requires its prepared lazy projection demand"
  return value

/-- Resolve a selected input only after source coverage is established. Existing fields retain
their original bindings. A lazy resolver supplies the enriched access; its exact recorded parent
and path authorize the baseline value, including a captured value with no earlier access history.
Reuse: storedValue?, the refreshed transaction view and ValueGraph.projectionBasis. -/
opaque FixedInput.resolveValue (input : FixedInput) (graphView : MetaM ValueGraph)
    (resolve : Option (FixedInput → MetaM ValueBinding) := none) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let graph ← graphView
  let some (value, remaining) ← input.storedFrontier graph
    | CasCatalogue.throwStratum .noImplementation
        m!"the retained descriptor supplies no native data for input path {input.path}"
  if remaining.isEmpty then return value
  let some resolve := resolve | return ← input.storedValue graph
  let access ← resolve input
  let graph ← graphView
  let some value ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (graph.projectionBasis access input.parent input.path).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "a resolved fixed input did not retain its exact source access"
  return value

/-- Actual formal slots and suspended native arguments retain separate source frames.
An unknown source expression is not a missing original runtime argument. -/
private inductive InputArgument where
  | actual (value : Option ValueBinding) (source : ClosedTerm)
      (context : ContextTelescope) (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding))
  | expression (source : InputExpression) (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding))
      (arguments : Array InputArgument)

private def inputArguments (layout : ApplicationLayout)
    (parameters values : Array (Option ValueBinding)) : MetaM (Array InputArgument) := do
  unless parameters.size == layout.result.source.context.entries.size &&
      values.size == layout.arguments.size do
    throwError "fixed input routing requires its original complete source tables"
  let mut actual : Array InputArgument := #[]
  for value in values, argument in layout.arguments do
    actual := actual.push (.actual value argument.source.source
      layout.result.source.context parameters)
  return actual

private structure InputRuntimeStep where
  selection : Array Name
  arguments : Array InputArgument

/-- Only supplied original context slots are selectable. Formal argument ordinals retain their
own plane, including proof positions, independently of these stable source binding identities. -/
private def contextInputIds (context : ContextTelescope)
    (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)) : MetaM (Array BindingId) := do
  unless parameters.size == context.entries.size do
    throwError "fixed input routing requires its original complete context table"
  let mut selected := #[]
  for entry in context.entries, parameter in parameters do
    if parameter.isSome then selected := selected.push entry.id
  return selected

private def inputSelection (context : ContextTelescope)
    (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (arguments : Array InputArgument)
    (route : InputProjection) : MetaM InputArgument := do
  match route.target with
    | .argument index => do
      let some argument := arguments[index]?
        | throwError "a fixed source route is outside its original argument table"
      return argument
    | .context binding => do
      unless parameters.size == context.entries.size do
        throwError "a fixed context route lost its original complete parameter table"
      let some index := context.entries.findIdx? (·.id == binding)
        | throwError "a fixed context route is outside its original source telescope"
      let source ← context.withOpen fun bindings => do
        let some selected := bindings.find? (·.id == binding)
          | throwError "a fixed context route lost its exact reopened source binding"
        let opened ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        opened.close selected.expression
      return .actual parameters[index]! source context parameters

private def actualFixedInput (graph : ValueGraph) (value : Option ValueBinding)
    (source : ClosedTerm) (context : ContextTelescope)
    (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (path : Array Name) : MetaM FixedInput := do
  let some parent := value
    | throwError (MessageData.tagged `CasRuntime.FixedInput.missingInput
        "a fixed result requires its actual source input")
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners #[parent]).mapError IO.userError
  let source ← context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    context.close (← source.inContext context)
  let input : FixedInput := ⟨parent, path, source, parameters⟩
  input.checkPath
  return input

/-- Capture symbolic arguments without forcing them. Their exact formal prefix and original
context parameters remain different planes, including unused and proof-only formal slots. -/
private def remainingInputApplications (context : ContextTelescope)
    (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (arguments : Array InputArgument)
    (remaining : Array CasCompiler.InputApplicationStep) : MetaM (Array InputRuntimeStep) := do
  let mut steps : Array InputRuntimeStep := #[]
  for step in remaining do
    let mut actual : Array InputArgument := #[]
    for argument in step.arguments do
      match argument with
      | .slot index =>
        let some argument := arguments[index]?
          | throwError "a composed input route lost an exact remaining argument slot"
        actual := actual.push argument
      | .expression source =>
        unless source.argumentCount ≤ arguments.size do
          throwError "a suspended input expression lost its original formal prefix"
        unless source.context.entries.map (·.id) == context.entries.map (·.id) &&
            parameters.size == context.entries.size do
          throwError "a suspended input expression lost its original context parameter plane"
        actual := actual.push (.expression source parameters
          (arguments.extract 0 source.argumentCount))
    steps := steps.push ⟨step.selection, actual⟩
  return steps

mutual

/-- Interpret only the selected argument. A suspended callable is traced together with its
pending applications; it need not first produce a separate stored callable node. -/
private partial def fixedFromArgument (graph : ValueGraph) (argument : InputArgument)
    (selection : Array Name) (steps : Array InputRuntimeStep) : MetaM (Option FixedInput) := do
  match argument with
  | .actual value source context parameters =>
    let input ← actualFixedInput graph value source context parameters selection
    let some (value, selection) ← input.storedFrontier graph | return none
    if steps.isEmpty then return some input
    fixedFromCallable graph value selection steps #[]
  | .expression source parameters arguments =>
    match steps[0]? with
    | none => fixedFromExpression graph source parameters arguments #[] selection
    | some next =>
      fixedFromExpression graph source parameters arguments
        (steps.set! 0 { next with selection := selection ++ next.selection }) #[]

/-- Compiler continuations contain the complete remaining operation suffix, including final
field selections. No previously consumed result path is applied again after a source call. -/
private partial def fixedFromResult (graph : ValueGraph) (context : ContextTelescope)
    (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (arguments : Array InputArgument)
    (result : InputProjectionResult) : MetaM (Option FixedInput) := do
  match result with
  | .projection route =>
    fixedFromArgument graph (← inputSelection context parameters arguments route) route.path #[]
  | .callable route remaining =>
    fixedFromArgument graph (← inputSelection context parameters arguments route) route.path
      (← remainingInputApplications context parameters arguments remaining)

/-- A selected native expression can expose an exact input or remain computationally unknown.
Only actual original slots require stored values; an unrouteable expression yields no coverage. -/
private partial def fixedFromExpression (graph : ValueGraph) (source : InputExpression)
    (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (actual : Array InputArgument)
    (steps : Array InputRuntimeStep) (path : Array Name) : MetaM (Option FixedInput) := do
  unless actual.size == source.argumentCount do
    throwError "a suspended input expression changed its exact formal prefix"
  let context := source.context
  let contextInputs ← contextInputIds context parameters
  let arguments := actual ++ steps.flatMap (·.arguments)
  let some traced ← source.inputProjectionThrough
      (steps.map fun step => (step.selection, step.arguments.size)) path contextInputs
    | return none
  fixedFromResult graph context parameters arguments traced

/-- Compose only the selected callable's own retained source history.
A projected callable resumes at its recorded parent/path before source inspection; a newer
application retains its own continuation. Input routes preserve those exact binding aliases. -/
private partial def fixedFromCallable (graph : ValueGraph) (value : ValueBinding)
    (selection : Array Name) (steps : Array InputRuntimeStep) (path : Array Name) :
    MetaM (Option FixedInput) := do
  let some next := steps[0]?
    | throwError "a composed callable route has no remaining application"
  if let some native := value.admittedInterface? then
    return ← fixedFromCallable graph native selection steps path
  let projected ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.projectionOrigin value).mapError IO.userError
  if let some (parent, accessPath) := projected then
    return ← fixedFromCallable graph parent (accessPath ++ selection) steps path
  let original ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.applicationOrigin value).mapError IO.userError
  if let some original := original then
    let steps := steps.set! 0 {
      next with selection := original.path ++ selection ++ next.selection }
    return ← fixedFromApplication graph original.layout original.parameters
      (← inputArguments original.layout original.parameters original.arguments) original.callable
      steps path
  let some node := graph.find value.value
    | throwError "the selected callable is outside its original graph"
  node.origin.role.source.withOpen fun bindings _ => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let source ← selectedInputLayout node.origin.role selection
    let (_, layout) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource source context #[]
    fixedFromApplication graph layout node.origin.parameters #[] none steps path

private partial def fixedFromApplication (graph : ValueGraph) (layout : ApplicationLayout)
    (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (actual : Array InputArgument)
    (callable : Option ValueBinding) (steps : Array InputRuntimeStep) (path : Array Name) :
    MetaM (Option FixedInput) := do
  -- The callable's lexical frame precedes the consuming request's transported role.
  -- Keep its supplied application as one complete step, including every proof slot.
  if let some callable := callable then
    return ← fixedFromCallable graph callable #[]
      (#[{ selection := #[], arguments := actual }] ++ steps) path
  let context := layout.result.source.context
  let contextInputs ← contextInputIds context parameters
  let arguments := actual ++ steps.flatMap (·.arguments)
  let some traced ← layout.inputProjectionThrough
      (steps.map fun step => (step.selection, step.arguments.size)) path contextInputs
    | return none
  fixedFromResult graph context parameters arguments traced

end

/-- Trace the exact prepared application to its original input before a request wrapper exists.
Reuse: the complete fixed-input interpreter and original argument/context tables above.
No lazy input is executed and no runtime payload or earlier role chooses the source. -/
opaque ApplicationOrigin.fixedInputAt (origin : ApplicationOrigin) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (path : Array Name := #[]) : MetaM (Option FixedInput) := do
  fixedFromApplication graph origin.layout origin.parameters
    (← inputArguments origin.layout origin.parameters origin.arguments)
    origin.callable #[] (origin.path ++ path)

end CasRuntime

module

public import CasRuntime.Session
public import CasCompiler.SourceSnapshot
public import CasCompiler.SourceMethod
public import CasCompiler.OperationFamily
public import CasCompiler.SourceMember
public import CasCompiler.ReadMember
public import CasCompiler.ReadProjection
public import CasCompiler.ReadDispatch

public section

namespace CasRuntime.Inspect

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasTools

/-- A declaration observation is prepared from the actual retained source binding,
not from the carrier or the name of a resulting Lean expression. Its data are
inert and may be shared by all committed observations of one source scope. -/
structure BindingObservation where
  binding : BindingId
  name : String
  type : String
  details : Json
  members : Array String

private def contextDocument (source : SourceContextObservation) : Json := Id.run do
  let build : StateM NativeExpression.Builder (List (String × Json) × Array Nat) := do
    let context ← ContextSnapshot.contextJson source.context
    let categories ← source.context.entries.mapM fun entry =>
      (source.categoryFor entry.id).mapM SourceSnapshot.categoryJson
    let ringVariables ← source.context.entries.mapM fun entry =>
      SourceSnapshot.ringVariablesJson (source.ringsFor entry.id)
    let declarations ← source.context.nativeDeclarations.constants.mapM
      (NativeExpression.constantInfoJson NativeExpression.Builder.add)
    let roots ← source.context.entries.mapM fun entry =>
      NativeExpression.Builder.add entry.type
    return ([
      ("context", context), ("instances", ContextSnapshot.instancesJson source.context),
      ("categories", toJson categories), ("ringVariables", toJson ringVariables),
      ("selections", ← SourceSnapshot.selectionsJson source.selections),
      ("declarations", toJson declarations),
      ("descriptions", toJson source.descriptions),
      ("spans", toJson (source.spans.map SourceSnapshot.spanJson))], roots)
  let ((fields, roots), builder) := build.run {}
  return Json.mkObj (fields ++ [("nativeExpressions", builder.finish roots)])

/-- Exact registration information, not an inferred name for a backend routine.
The executable configuration is retained separately from any actual routine
observations returned during negotiation-authorized execution. -/
private def registrationDocument (kernel : Kernel) (identity : DispatchIdentity) : Json :=
  let registration := identity.registration
  let backend := kernel.manifest.backends.find? (·.name == registration.backend)
  Json.mkObj [
    ("operation", toJson registration.operation), ("input", toJson registration.input),
    ("backend", toJson registration.backend),
    ("manifestSha256", toJson identity.manifestDigest),
    ("profileSha256", toJson identity.profileDigest),
    ("command", toJson (backend.map (·.command))),
    ("arguments", toJson (backend.map (·.args)))]

private def ownerDocument (owner : ConnectionGeneration) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("worker", toJson owner.worker), ("serial", toJson owner.serial)]

private def producerDocument (kernel : Kernel) (producer : CompletionProducer) : Json :=
  match producer with
  | .kernel => Json.mkObj [("kind", "kernel")]
  | .invocation dispatch scope requestId =>
    let target := match dispatch.selected with
      | .primitive identity => registrationDocument kernel identity
      | .native value _ => Json.mkObj [("nativeValue", Observation.identityJson value)]
    Json.mkObj [
      ("kind", "invocation"), ("target", target),
      ("connection", ownerDocument dispatch.connection),
      ("scope", Observation.identityJson scope), ("requestId", toJson requestId),
      ("occurrence", Observation.identityJson dispatch.occurrence),
      ("transaction", Observation.identityJson dispatch.transaction)]

private def completionDocument (kernel : Kernel) (association : CompletionAssociation) : Json :=
  let observation := association.request.observation
  Json.mkObj [
    ("producer", producerDocument kernel association.producer),
    ("routines", toJson (association.routines.map fun frame => Json.mkObj [
      ("connection", ownerDocument frame.connection),
      ("scope", Observation.identityJson frame.scope),
      ("requestId", toJson frame.requestId),
      ("occurrence", Observation.identityJson frame.occurrence),
      ("observations", toJson frame.observations)])),
    ("native", observation.native), ("readable", observation.readable),
    ("selection", toJson observation.selection),
    ("sourceSnapshot", toJson observation.sourceSnapshot),
    ("result", Observation.identityJson association.response.root.value)]

/-- The graph's actual source role and exact supplying occurrence are observed
without forcing a field, reconstructing a closure, or asking any provider.
Availability at preparation is explicitly distinct from the immutable
mathematical data and exact owner dependency identities. -/
private def retainedValue (session : KernelSession) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (binding : ValueBinding) : IO Json := do
  let some node := graph.find binding.value
    | throw (IO.userError "the retained source binding has no actual value node")
  let owners ← IO.ofExcept ((graph.requiredOwners #[binding]).mapError IO.userError)
  let available ← session.kernel.ledger.owners.allAlive owners
  let completion ← transaction.completionFor? node.origin.occurrence
  let occurrences := (#[node.origin.occurrence] ++
    binding.applications.map (·.association.occurrence) ++
    binding.instantiations.map (·.association.occurrence)).toList.eraseDups.toArray
  let completions ← occurrences.filterMapM fun occurrence => do
    return (← transaction.completionFor? occurrence).map (completionDocument session.kernel)
  -- Inspect only the stored packet representation, never an exported token or
  -- a delayed program. The original native role is retained separately.
  let packet ← IO.ofExcept ((graph.packet? binding).mapError IO.userError)
  let (native, expressions) := (Observation.valueJson binding).run {}
  return Json.mkObj [
    ("reference", Observation.identityJson binding.value),
    ("occurrence", Observation.identityJson node.origin.occurrence),
    ("program", Observation.identityJson node.origin.program),
    ("associations", toJson (binding.associationIds.map Observation.identityJson)),
    ("owners", toJson (owners.map ownerDocument)),
    ("availableAtPreparation", toJson available),
    ("hasPacket", toJson packet.isSome), ("packet", toJson packet),
    ("native", Json.mkObj [("binding", native), ("nativeExpressions", expressions.finish #[])]),
    ("completion", toJson (completion.map (completionDocument session.kernel))),
    ("completions", toJson completions)]

/-- List the frozen registration forms permitted for an independently selected
source family. This is an inventory of forms, not a claim that an arbitrary
future operand matches a form or that a provider is currently live. -/
private def permittedForms (kernel : Kernel) (state : SemanticState)
    (target : ProfileTarget) : MetaM (Array Json) := do
  let selected ← kernel.manifest.registrations.filterM fun row => do
    if !kernel.profile.allowsRegistration target row then return false
    target.containsAddress state row.operation
  return selected.map fun row =>
    Json.mkObj [("operation", toJson row.operation), ("input", toJson row.input),
      ("backend", toJson row.backend)]

/-- Close an already chosen category interface, including its dependent carrier and
limit data, in the exact original native scope. None of these expressions is evaluated. -/
private def closeSelection (context : OpenContext) (category : NativeSourceCategory) :
    MetaM (StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json) := do
  let bundle ← context.close category.bundle
  let carrier ← category.carrier.mapM fun carrier => do
    let actions ← carrier.actions.mapM context.close
    let comparisons ← carrier.comparisons.mapM context.close
    return (⟨carrier.refs, carrier.target, carrier.identifications, actions, comparisons⟩ :
      SourceCarrierSelection)
  let limit ← category.limit.mapM fun limit => do
    let cone ← context.close limit.cone
    let bundle ← context.close limit.bundle
    let presentation ← context.close limit.presentation
    let diagram ← context.close limit.diagram
    let interface ← limit.interface.mapM context.close
    return (⟨limit.row, limit.declaration, cone, limit.colimit, limit.category, bundle,
      presentation, diagram, interface, limit.construction,
      ← limit.ownerFamily.mapM context.close,
      ← limit.creation.mapM (·.mapM context.close),
