      ← limit.creationFamily.mapM context.close, limit.creationInputs⟩ : SourceLimitSelection)
  return do
    let bundle ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson bundle
    let carrier ← carrier.mapM SourceSnapshot.carrierJson
    let limit ← limit.mapM SourceSnapshot.limitJson
    return Json.mkObj [
      ("role", toJson <| match category.role with
        | .object => "object" | .morphism => "morphism"),
      ("expression", toJson (reprStr category.expression)),
      ("bundle", bundle), ("carrier", toJson carrier), ("limit", toJson limit)]

/-- Freeze an actual checked judgement, retaining both its complete native type
and its selected mathematical interface, in the same expression graph. -/
private def judgementDocument (scope : SourceReadScope)
    (judgement : NativeSourceJudgement) : TermElabM Json := do
  let context := scope.context
  let term ← context.close judgement.value
  let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.close scope.selections context
  let selection ← judgement.category.mapM (fun selected => liftM (closeSelection context selected))
  let build : StateM NativeExpression.Builder (List (String × Json) × Array Nat) := do
    let native ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson term
    let category ← selection.mapM id
    let selections ← SourceSnapshot.selectionsJson selections
    let expression ← NativeExpression.Builder.add term.expression
    let type ← NativeExpression.Builder.add term.type
    return ([("native", native), ("category", toJson category),
      ("selections", selections)], #[expression, type])
  let ((fields, roots), builder) := build.run {}
  return Json.mkObj (fields ++ [
    ("type", toJson (← ppExpr (← inferType judgement.value)).pretty),
    ("nativeExpressions", builder.finish roots)])

/-- Freeze an actual typed operation family before its additional operands are supplied.
The independent source row fixes the registration address; it does not select a provider. -/
private def candidateDocument (kernel : Kernel) (state : SemanticState)
    (scope : SourceReadScope) (kind name id : String) (target : ProfileTarget)
    (reference : Option SelectedSourceReference) (route : Option Route) (expression : Expr) : TermElabM Json := do
  let document ← judgementDocument scope ⟨expression, none⟩
  return document
    |>.setObjVal! "kind" (toJson kind)
    |>.setObjVal! "name" (toJson name)
    |>.setObjVal! "id" (toJson id)
    |>.setObjVal! "route" (toJson (route.map fun route => reprStr route.refs))
    |>.setObjVal! "nativeRoute" (toJson route)
    |>.setObjVal! "reference" (toJson reference)
    |>.setObjVal! "status" (toJson "typed_candidate")
    |>.setObjVal! "permittedRegistrationForms" (toJson (← permittedForms kernel state target))

private def memberCandidateDocument (kernel : Kernel) (state : SemanticState)
    (scope : SourceReadScope) (name : String) (choice : SourceMemberChoice SourceReader.MemberEvidence) :
    TermElabM Json := do
  let (kind, id, target) : String × Option String × Option ProfileTarget :=
    match choice.evidence with
    | .projection => ("projection", none, none)
    | .image => ("image", none, none)
    | .method choice =>
      let entry := choice.evidence.family.entry
      ("method", some entry.id.raw, some (.computation (.method entry.id)))
    | .family row _ => ("morphism", some row.id.raw, some (.computation (.morphism row.id)))
    | .property choice =>
      let entry := choice.evidence.family.entry
      ("property", some entry.id.raw, some (.property entry.id))
    | .element row => ("element", some row.id.raw, some (.computation (.morphism row.id)))
  let document ← judgementDocument scope choice.judgement
  let route ← choice.path.route?
  return document
    |>.setObjVal! "kind" (toJson kind)
    |>.setObjVal! "name" (toJson name)
    |>.setObjVal! "id" (toJson id)
    |>.setObjVal! "route" (toJson (route.map fun route => reprStr route.refs))
    |>.setObjVal! "nativeRoute" (toJson route)
    |>.setObjVal! "status" (toJson "typed_candidate")
    |>.setObjVal! "permittedRegistrationForms"
      (toJson ((← target.mapM (fun target => liftM (permittedForms kernel state target))) |>.getD #[]))

/-- Prepare the same zero-additional-argument member that source syntax would select.
The retained receiver is passed directly, never reparsed or reread. An ambiguous
member retains its original typed alternatives but contributes no completion name. -/
private def observeMember (kernel : Kernel) (state : SemanticState)
    (initial : SourceReadScope) (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement)
    (name : String) : TermElabM (Option (Json × Bool)) := do
  let saved ← saveState
  let reader : ReadContext := {
    categoryOf := fun _ => pure none
    source := ⟨← getRef⟩
    expected := none
    qualification := none
    expectedCategory := none
    project := readProjection
    read := fun _ _ _ _ _ =>
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "observation cannot read additional source"
  }
  try
    (SourceReader.memberChoicesAtReceiver reader receiver name #[] none).runK initial
        fun candidates scope => do
      let baseline ← saveState
      let alternatives ← candidates.choices.mapM fun choice => do
        baseline.restore
        (choice.withScope do
          let selected ← get
          liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
            memberCandidateDocument kernel state selected name choice).runK scope
              fun document _ => pure document
      baseline.restore
      if alternatives.isEmpty && candidates.mismatches.isEmpty then
        discard <| sourceMemberPreference name candidates.considered #[]
        return none
      let result : Except Outcome Json ← try
          (SourceReader.completeMemberChoices reader (checkReadJudgementApplicable reader)
              name #[] candidates.considered candidates.choices candidates.mismatches).runK scope
            fun result completed => do
              match result with
              | .ok judgement =>
                pure (.ok (← judgementDocument completed judgement))
              | .error message =>
                pure (.error (.invalid (← message.toString)))
        catch error =>
          pure (.error (← Outcome.ofException error))
      let base := Json.mkObj [("kind", "member"), ("name", toJson name),
        ("alternatives", toJson alternatives)]
      match result with
      | .ok selected =>
        return some (base.setObjVal! "status" (toJson "applicable")
          |>.setObjVal! "selected" selected, true)
      | .error failure =>
        return some (base.setObjVal! "status" (toJson "unresolved")
          |>.setObjVal! "outcome" (toJson failure.kind)
          |>.setObjVal! "stratum" (toJson failure.stratum?)
          |>.setObjVal! "diagnostic" (toJson failure.detail), false)
  finally
    saved.restore

/-- Specialize only the rigid source-object slot of the whole independently
registered operation. All other arguments and dependent binder types remain
native lambda data; no numeral, operand or selected structure is fabricated. -/
private partial def specializeObject (family : Expr) (index : Nat)
    (object : Expr) : MetaM Expr := do
  let .lam name type body info := family
    | throwError "the discovered operation lost its original object slot"
  if index == 0 then
    unless ← isDefEq (← inferType object) type do
      throwError "the discovered operation has a different complete source object type"
    return body.instantiate1 object
  withLocalDecl name info type fun argument => do
    mkLambdaFVars #[argument] (← specializeObject (body.instantiate1 argument) (index - 1) object)

private def observeOperation (kernel : Kernel) (state : SemanticState)
    (scope : SourceReadScope) (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement)
    (name : String) : TermElabM (Array Json) := do
  let some category := receiver.category | return #[]
  unless category.role == .object do return #[]
  let query ← SourceRoutes.forOperation category.expression name
  let some routes ← query.finiteRoutes
    | throwUnsupportedSource "operation discovery requires the uniform source route comparison"
  let original ← saveState
  try
    let mut result := #[]
    for route in routes do
      for row in state.operationBindings route.target name do
        original.restore
        let family ← nativeOwnedFamily state category.expression category.bundle route
          row.declaration
          (fun binders => if binders.size > row.numerals then
            some (binders.size - 1 - row.numerals) else none)
          (some (.operation row))
        let expression ← specializeObject family.value family.objectIndex receiver.value
        discard <| levelMVarToParam (← instantiateMVars expression)
        let expression ← instantiateMVars expression
        let candidate ← candidateDocument kernel state scope "operation" name row.id.raw
          (.computation (.operation row.id)) family.reference (some route) expression
        result := result.push (candidate.setObjVal! "arity" (toJson row.arity))
    return result
  finally
    original.restore

/-- Enumerate actual member competition and independently typed operation families.
Projection spellings come from the source reader; they are advertised only when
that reader selects an actual typed value. An operation still requiring an operand
is a typed family, not a promise of applicability to an invented argument. -/
private def discover (kernel : Kernel) (scope : SourceReadScope)
    (receiver : NativeSourceJudgement) : TermElabM (Array Json × Array String) := do
  let state ← semanticState
  let mut rows := #[]
  let mut names := #[]
  let saved ← saveState
  try
    let members := state.methods.map (·.name) ++ state.properties.map (·.name) ++
      state.morphisms.map (·.name) ++ #["obj", "hom", "forward", "backward", "image"]
    for name in members.toList.eraseDups do
      saved.restore
      Core.checkSystem "source member discovery"
      try
        if let some (document, applicable) ← observeMember kernel state scope receiver name then
          rows := rows.push document
          if applicable then names := names.push name
      catch error =>
        let failure ← Outcome.ofException error
        rows := rows.push (Json.mkObj [
          ("kind", "member"), ("name", toJson name), ("status", "unresolved"),
          ("outcome", toJson failure.kind), ("stratum", toJson failure.stratum?),
          ("diagnostic", toJson failure.detail)])
    if receiver.category.any (·.role == .object) then
      for name in (state.operations.map (·.name)).toList.eraseDups do
        saved.restore
        Core.checkSystem "source operation discovery"
        try
          rows := rows ++ (← observeOperation kernel state scope receiver name)
        catch error =>
          let failure ← Outcome.ofException error
          rows := rows.push (Json.mkObj [
            ("kind", "operation"), ("name", toJson name), ("status", "unresolved"),
            ("outcome", toJson failure.kind), ("stratum", toJson failure.stratum?),
            ("diagnostic", toJson failure.detail)])
    return (rows, names)
  finally
    saved.restore

/-- Display only the actual new source bindings and their retained values.
The native type determines whether a packet has a scalar display convention;
an arbitrary two-slot record is never interpreted as a rational. -/
def newBindings (before after : KernelSession) (transaction : CellTransaction) :
    TermElabM (Array Json) := do
  let previous := before.source.observation.context.entries
  let frozen := after.source.observation
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let document := contextDocument frozen
  frozen.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let mut result := #[]
    for entry in frozen.context.entries, index in [:frozen.context.entries.size] do
      if entry.role == .selectedStructure || entry.role == .result then continue
      if previous.any (·.id == entry.id) then continue
      let some binding := bindings[index]?
        | throwError "the display scope lost its retained declaration"
      unless binding.id == entry.id do
        throwError "the display scope changed its retained declaration identity"
      let type ← inferType binding.expression
      let shown := frozen.descriptions[index]?.getD ""
      let shown ← if shown.isEmpty then pure (← ppExpr type).pretty else pure shown
      let nativeType ← whnf (← zetaReduce type)
      let scalar := if nativeType.isConstOf ``Rat then "rational"
        else if nativeType.isConstOf ``Nat then "natural"
        else if nativeType.isConstOf ``Int then "integer"
        else "native"
      let runtime ← (after.value? entry.id).mapM fun value =>
        liftM (m := IO) (retainedValue after transaction graph value)
      result := result.push (Json.mkObj [
        ("binding", ContextSnapshot.bindingJson entry.id), ("index", toJson index),
        ("name", toJson entry.userName.toString), ("type", toJson shown),
        ("scalarConvention", toJson scalar), ("runtime", toJson runtime),
        ("source", document)])
    return result

/-- Prepare all declarations from the actual candidate source/graph before
publication. Query code receives only these immutable JSON records; it never
reopens the source scope or reads a transaction. -/
def prepare (session : KernelSession) (transaction : CellTransaction) :
    TermElabM (Array BindingObservation) := do
  let frozen := session.source.observation
  let document := contextDocument frozen
  let graph ← transaction.view
  frozen.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let scope : SourceReadScope := {
      identities := session.kernel.ledger.owners.identities
      context
      selections := ← frozen.selections.inContext context }
    let mut result := #[]
    for entry in frozen.context.entries, index in [:frozen.context.entries.size] do
      if entry.role == .selectedStructure || entry.role == .result then continue
      let some binding := bindings[index]?
        | throwError "the inspection scope lost its retained declaration"
      unless binding.id == entry.id do
        throwError "the inspection scope changed its retained declaration identity"
      let type ← inferType binding.expression
      let shown := frozen.descriptions[index]?.getD ""
      let shown ← if shown.isEmpty then pure (← ppExpr type).pretty else pure shown
      let runtime ← (session.value? entry.id).mapM fun value =>
        liftM (m := IO) (retainedValue session transaction graph value)
      let category ← session.source.openCategory context binding.expression.fvarId!
      let (candidates, members) ← discover session.kernel scope ⟨binding.expression, category⟩
      let details := Json.mkObj [
        ("binding", ContextSnapshot.bindingJson entry.id), ("index", toJson index),
        ("source", document), ("runtime", toJson runtime),
        ("candidates", toJson candidates)]
      result := result.push ⟨entry.id, entry.userName.toString, shown, details, members⟩
    return result

end CasRuntime.Inspect

-- Use the public source statement entrance, with an explicitly empty provider
-- manifest. A registered property remains mathematically applicable even
-- when there is no provider for its computation.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let env ← getEnv
  try
    let root ← IO.currentDir
    IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let manifest := root / ".tmp" / "inspect-empty-leaves.json"
    IO.FS.writeFile manifest (Json.mkObj
      [("backends", .arr #[]), ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
    let initial ← KernelSession.start (some manifest)
    try
      let .ok statement := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt "let S := Fin(3)"
        | throwError "the finite object observation did not parse"
      let run ← initial.run ⟨statement⟩
      unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" do
        throwError "the original finite object did not bind: {run.outcome.detail}"
      let session := run.session
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin session.kernel.ledger
      try
        let before ← session.kernel.dispatches.get
        let #[observed] ← Inspect.prepare session transaction
          | throwError "discovery did not observe exactly the retained source binding"
        unless observed.name == "S" && observed.members.contains "is_finite" do
          throwError "the selected finite object's applicable property was not discovered"
        let source := observed.details.getObjValD "source"
        let .ok sourceContext := source.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "context"
          | throwError "inspection omitted the complete original source telescope"
        let .ok sourceSelections := source.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "selections"
          | throwError "inspection omitted the complete typed source selection table"
        unless sourceContext.map (·.getObjValD "id") ==
              session.source.context.entries.map
                (fun entry => ContextSnapshot.bindingJson entry.id) &&
            sourceSelections.size == session.source.selections.size &&
            !sourceSelections.isEmpty do
          throwError "inspection dropped original source bindings or selections"
        for (id, _) in session.source.selections.toArray do
          unless (sourceSelections.filter fun row =>
              row.getObjValD "binding" == ContextSnapshot.bindingJson id).size == 1 do
            throwError "inspection changed an exact source selection identity"
        let .ok candidates := observed.details.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "candidates"
          | throwError "the observation has no source candidate inventory"
        let some property := candidates.find? fun row =>
            (row.getObjValAs? String "kind").toOption == some "member" &&
            (row.getObjValAs? String "name").toOption == some "is_finite"
          | throwError "the original finiteness classifier was not retained"
        unless (property.getObjValAs? String "status").toOption == some "applicable" do
          throwError "the original classifier did not survive ordinary member competition: {property}"
        let .ok #[alternative] := property.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "alternatives"
          | throwError "the classifier lost its unique original candidate"
        unless (alternative.getObjValAs? String "kind").toOption == some "property" &&
            (alternative.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "permittedRegistrationForms").toOption == some #[] do
          throwError "mathematical applicability was identified with provider availability"
        let .ok selected := property.getObjVal? "selected"
          | throwError "discovery did not retain the actual checked selection"
        unless (selected.getObjVal? "native").isOk &&
            (selected.getObjVal? "nativeExpressions").isOk do
          throwError "the selected property lost its original native term"
        let .ok selectedScopes := selected.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "selections"
          | throwError "the completed property lost its original typed source scope"
        let .ok propertyId := alternative.getObjValAs? String "id"
          | throwError "the property candidate lost its original registry identity"
        let some propertyRow := (← semanticState).properties.find? (·.id.raw == propertyId)
          | throwError "the property observation does not name its original registry row"
        unless selectedScopes.any (fun row =>
            let application := (row.getObjValD "selection").getObjValD "application"
            let selectedFamily := (application.getObjValD "family").getObjValD "property"
            (selectedFamily.getObjValD "family").getObjValD "entry" == toJson propertyRow) do
          throwError "the completed property discarded its complete original registry row"
        unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).size == before.size do
          throwError "mathematical discovery dispatched a computation"
      finally
        discard <| transaction.abort
    finally initial.close
  finally setEnv env

-- An operation that still needs its exponent is observed as its complete native
-- family. Discovery must neither invent an exponent nor demand a computation.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let env ← getEnv
  try
    let root ← IO.currentDir
    IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let manifest := root / ".tmp" / "inspect-operation-empty-leaves.json"
    IO.FS.writeFile manifest (Json.mkObj
      [("backends", .arr #[]), ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
    let initial ← KernelSession.start (some manifest)
    try
      let .ok statement := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt "let R := ℤ"
        | throwError "the original ring object observation did not parse"
      let run ← initial.run ⟨statement⟩
      unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" do
        throwError "the original ring object did not bind: {run.outcome.detail}"
      let session := run.session
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin session.kernel.ledger
      try
        let before ← session.kernel.dispatches.get
        let #[observed] ← Inspect.prepare session transaction
          | throwError "operation discovery lost the retained ring binding"
        let .ok candidates := observed.details.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "candidates"
          | throwError "the ring observation has no source candidate inventory"
        let some power := candidates.find? fun row =>
            (row.getObjValAs? String "kind").toOption == some "operation" &&
            (row.getObjValAs? String "id").toOption == some "op.rings.pow"
          | throwError "the selected ring lost its independently declared power family"
        unless (power.getObjValAs? String "status").toOption == some "typed_candidate" &&
            (power.getObjValAs? Nat "arity").toOption == some 1 &&
            (power.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "permittedRegistrationForms").toOption == some #[] do
          throwError "the power family's dependent interface or availability changed"
        let some powerRow := (← semanticState).operations.find? (·.id.raw == "op.rings.pow")
          | throwError "the power observation lost its independent source row"
        unless power.getObjValD "reference" ==
            toJson (some (.operation powerRow : SelectedSourceReference)) &&
            (power.getObjVal? "nativeRoute").isOk &&
            (power.getObjVal? "selections").isOk do
          throwError "the power family lost its complete original row, route or source scope"
        let .ok native := power.getObjVal? "nativeExpressions"
          | throwError "the discovered power family lost its complete native expression graph"
        let .ok #[expression, type] := NativeExpression.decode native
          | throwError "the discovered power family lost its exact expression and type"
        unless expression.containsConst (· == ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.pow) &&
            type.containsConst (· == ``Nat) && !expression.hasMVar && !type.hasMVar do
          throwError "the power family lost its declared operation or remaining exponent"
        unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).size == before.size do
          throwError "operation discovery dispatched a computation"
      finally
        discard <| transaction.abort
    finally initial.close
  finally setEnv env

end CasRuntime.InspectTests

/-- Send one prepared invocation on its reserved connection, then admit and stage the whole
reply with its completion. A deferred group runs first, with the provider permit released.
Reuse: FramedConnection.invokeControlBefore and stageCompletion. -/
partial def Kernel.invoke (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (wire : FramedConnection) (reservation : DispatchReservation)
    (encoded : EncodedInputs) (arguments : Json)
    (codec : Option (PreparedResultCodec request.roles.scope) := none) :
    MetaM (PreparedResponse request) := do
  let codec ← match codec with
    | some codec => pure codec
    | none => PreparedResultCodec.forNative request (preparedSymbolicCheck kernel request transaction)
  let codec := some codec
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let issued ← RequestScope.issue kernel.ledger reservation graph encoded.slots encoded.inputs #[]
  let selected := match reservation.selected with
    | .primitive identity => Json.mkObj [
      ("kind", toJson "registration"), ("operation", toJson identity.registration.operation),
      ("input", toJson identity.registration.input), ("backend", toJson identity.registration.backend),
      ("manifestDigest", toJson identity.manifestDigest), ("profileDigest", toJson identity.profileDigest)]
    | .native value _ => Json.mkObj [
      ("kind", toJson "native"), ("value", Observation.identityJson value)]
  CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "dispatch" <| Json.mkObj [
    ("occurrence", Observation.identityJson request.occurrence),
    ("transaction", Observation.identityJson transaction.id),
    ("scope", Observation.identityJson issued.id),
    ("connection", Json.mkObj [("worker", toJson reservation.connection.worker),
      ("serial", toJson reservation.connection.serial)]),
    ("selected", selected), ("operands", arguments),
    ("request", request.observation.toJson)]
  let control ← match ← wire.invokeControlBefore kernel.ledger transaction reservation issued
      arguments kernel.timeoutMs with
    | .ok control => pure control
    | .error error => portFailure error
  let (scope, reply) ← kernel.settle evaluateSource request transaction wire reservation issued
    (fun results => do
      RequestScope.issue kernel.ledger reservation (← transaction.view) encoded.slots
        encoded.inputs results)
    control
  CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "reply.admission.started" <| Json.mkObj [
    ("occurrence", Observation.identityJson request.occurrence),
    ("scope", Observation.identityJson reply.scopeId), ("requestId", toJson reply.requestId),
    ("reply", reply.value)]
  try
    match ← reply.stageCompletion request transaction scope wire.connection
        (some (kernel.resolveFixedInput evaluateSource transaction request.program)) codec with
    | .error failure => transactionFailure failure
    | .ok association =>
      let admitted ← request.admitResult (← transaction.view) association.response.root
      CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "reply.admitted" <| Json.mkObj [
        ("occurrence", Observation.identityJson request.occurrence),
        ("value", Observation.valueIdentityJson admitted.root)]
      return admitted
  catch error =>
    CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "reply.rejected" <| Json.mkObj [
      ("occurrence", Observation.identityJson request.occurrence),
      ("detail", toJson (← error.toMessageData.toString))]
    throw error

/-- Dispatch a published operation on its selected registration.
`parameters` are the retained family parameters and `bindings` the earlier outputs the selected
field depends on; the request supplies the action arguments. -/
partial def Kernel.invokeRegistration (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (registration : Registration) (role : String)
    (parameters : Array ValueBinding) (bindings : Array (Nat × ValueBinding)) :
    MetaM (PreparedResponse request) := do
  let wire ← kernel.connections.get registration.backend
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs graph
  let arguments ← IO.ofExcept <| (inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
  let roots : Array InputPosition :=
    parameters.mapIdx (fun index binding =>
      { path := #[.field "parameters", .index index], binding }) ++
    bindings.mapIdx (fun index binding =>
      { path := #[.field "bindings", .index index, .field "value"], binding := binding.2 }) ++
    arguments.mapIdx (fun index binding =>
      { path := #[.field "arguments", .index index], binding })
  let encoded ← IO.ofExcept <|
    (graph.encodeInputs wire.connection.generation roots).mapError IO.userError
  let identity : DispatchIdentity := {
    manifestDigest := kernel.manifestDigest, registration, profileDigest := kernel.profile.sha256 }
  let reservation ← match ← transaction.reserve request.occurrence identity wire.connection
      (parameters ++ bindings.map (·.2) ++ arguments) with
    | .ok reservation => pure reservation
    | .error failure => transactionFailure failure
  kernel.dispatches.modify (·.push registration)
  let leading := parameters.size + bindings.size
  kernel.invoke evaluateSource request transaction wire reservation encoded <|
    dependentContext role (encoded.values.extract 0 parameters.size)
      (bindings.zipWith (fun binding packet => (binding.1, packet))
        (encoded.values.extract parameters.size leading))
      (encoded.values.extract leading encoded.values.size) (argumentLayouts request) request.source

/-- Invoke one original raw construction through the ordinary scoped reply lifecycle. Its
accepted constructor codec admits every data port before exposing any native cone field. -/
partial def Kernel.invokeLimit (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (transaction : CellTransaction) (registration : Registration)
    (invocation : PreparedLimitInvocation) : MetaM (PreparedResponse request) := do
  request.requirePreparation invocation.preparation
  unless registration.operation == invocation.family.operation &&
      invocation.forms.contains registration.input do
    throwError "the construction changed its original operation or diagram category"
  let codec ← invocation.resultCodec kernel request transaction registration
  let wire ← kernel.connections.get registration.backend
  let graph ← transaction.view
  invocation.requireInputs request graph
  let (encoded, packet) ← IO.ofExcept <|
    (invocation.encode graph wire.connection.generation).mapError IO.userError
  let identity : DispatchIdentity := {
    manifestDigest := kernel.manifestDigest, registration, profileDigest := kernel.profile.sha256 }
  let reservation ← match ← transaction.reserve request.occurrence identity wire.connection
      invocation.dependencies with
    | .ok reservation => pure reservation
    | .error failure => transactionFailure failure
  kernel.dispatches.modify (·.push registration)
  kernel.invoke evaluateSource request transaction wire reservation encoded packet (some codec)

/-- Invoke a retained native export on its original supplying connection.
Source: execution contract v2 §4.1. No registration is searched for a selected callable. -/
partial def Kernel.invokeExport (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (callable : ValueBinding) (role : String) :
    MetaM (PreparedResponse request) := do
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let code ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.callable callable).mapError IO.userError
  let some node := graph.find code.value
    | throwError "internal: the native callable is outside the active graph"
  let .ownedToken owner _ _ := node.payload.data
    | throwError "internal: the retained callable has no native export"
  let wire ← kernel.connections.ofOwner owner
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs graph
  let arguments ← IO.ofExcept <| (inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
  let roots : Array InputPosition := arguments.mapIdx fun index binding =>
    { path := #[.field "arguments", .index index], binding }
  let encoded ← IO.ofExcept <|
    (graph.encodeExportInputs wire.connection.generation callable roots).mapError IO.userError
  let reservation ← match ← transaction.reserveExport request.occurrence callable wire.connection
      arguments with
    | .ok reservation => pure reservation
    | .error failure => transactionFailure failure
  kernel.invoke evaluateSource request transaction wire reservation encoded <|
    dependentContext role #[] #[] encoded.values (argumentLayouts request) request.source

/-- Follow one invocation's control to its immediate reply. A deferred group is executed. A
suspension's calls run through the production lowerer and executor in the suspending scope,
then the same occurrence is resumed on its supplying connection with the declared captures
and the child results; the resumed control is followed in turn. `issue` forms a scope over the
positions of the scope that issued `control`, with a completed prefix of child results.
Source: execution contract v2 §6; python-sdk.md "Generator suspension". -/
partial def Kernel.settle (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (wire : FramedConnection) (reservation : DispatchReservation)
    (scope : RequestScope) (issue : Array ValueBinding → IO RequestScope)
    (control : InvocationReply) : MetaM (RequestScope × ImmediateReply) := do
  match control with
  | .immediate reply => return (scope, reply)
  | .deferred requestId calls template exports =>
    scope.retire
    kernel.deferred evaluateSource request transaction reservation issue requestId calls template exports
  | .suspended _ continuation captures calls _ =>
    let malformed : {α : Type} → String → MetaM α := fun reason =>
      throwStratum .malformed m!"suspension: {reason}"
    let graph ← transaction.view
    let mut references := #[]
    for capture in captures do
      match ScopedReference.parse? capture with
      | .ok (some reference) => references := references.push reference
      | .ok none => malformed "a declared capture must be a scoped reference"
      | .error reason => malformed reason
    let captured ← scope.capture reservation graph scope.wireId references
    scope.retire
    let mut results : Array ValueBinding := #[]
    for call in calls do
      let child ← issue results
      let value ← try kernel.child evaluateSource request transaction reservation child call
        finally child.retire
      results := results.push value
    let slots := captured ++ results
    let resumed ← RequestScope.issueResume kernel.ledger reservation (← transaction.view) slots #[]
    let next ← match ← wire.resumeControlBefore kernel.ledger transaction reservation resumed
        continuation captured.size results.size kernel.timeoutMs with
      | .ok next => pure next
      | .error error => portFailure error
    kernel.settle evaluateSource request transaction wire reservation resumed
      (fun prior => do
        RequestScope.issueResume kernel.ledger reservation (← transaction.view) slots prior)
      next

/-- Execute an ordered deferred group and form its final immediate control.
Source: execution contract v2 §6. Each child has a fresh scope over the original inputs and
the completed prefix of results. The final template is read in a scope over all results and
is then admitted at the parent's prepared role, like an immediate reply. -/
partial def Kernel.deferred (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (reservation : DispatchReservation)
    (issue : Array ValueBinding → IO RequestScope)
    (requestId : Nat) (calls : Array Json) (template exports : Json) :
    MetaM (RequestScope × ImmediateReply) := do
  let mut results : Array ValueBinding := #[]
  for call in calls do
    let scope ← issue results
    let value ← try kernel.child evaluateSource request transaction reservation scope call
      finally scope.retire
    results := results.push value
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let scope ← issue results
  let frame := Json.mkObj [("request_id", toJson requestId), ("status", "ok"),
    ("value", template), ("exports", exports)]
  let reply ← try
      liftM (m := IO) <| ImmediateReply.parseControl scope reservation graph scope.wireId
        requestId frame
    catch error => throwStratum .malformed m!"deferred result: {← error.toMessageData.toString}"
  return (scope, reply)

end

end CasRuntime

private partial def Kernel.evaluateSource (kernel : Kernel) (sourceSnapshot : Option Json)
    (validatedEnvironment : Option RuntimeEnvironment := none) :
    SourceEvaluation :=
  fun transaction program context bound selections expression =>
    lowerTerm {
      ledger := kernel.ledger, transaction, codes := kernel.codes
      sourceSnapshot
      limitLeg := fun demand => do
        let graph ← transaction.view
        unless ← graph.isAvailable kernel.ledger.owners demand.cone do
          transactionFailure .staleOwner
        let selected := demand.selection.construction
        let apex := if selected.source.colimit then
          ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.pt else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt
        if demand.apexSource.isSome then
          let some _ ← IO.ofExcept <|
              (graph.projectionBasis demand.receiver demand.cone #[apex]).mapError IO.userError
            | throwError "the selected leg changed its actual receiver/cone projection"
        else
          let field := if selected.source.colimit then
            ``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone.cocone else
            ``CategoryTheory.Limits.LimitCone.cone
          let retained ← match ← transaction.selectedAt selected.source.construction field
              demand.receiver with
            | .ok value => pure value
            | .error failure => transactionFailure failure
          let some retained := retained
            | throwError "the selected leg lost its exact receiver-scoped completed cone"
          unless retained.value == demand.cone.value &&
              retained.associationIds == demand.cone.associationIds do
            throwError "the selected leg changed its original completed cone occurrence"
        let component ← demand.component.inContext demand.context
        kernel.evaluateSource sourceSnapshot (some demand.contextEnvironment)
          transaction program demand.context demand.bound demand.selections component
      run := fun computation => Execute.run kernel.executor computation transaction
        (some (kernel.resolveFixedInput
          (kernel.evaluateSource sourceSnapshot validatedEnvironment) transaction program)) }
      program context bound expression validatedEnvironment selections

/-- Compose prepared demand execution with checked-source lowering for subsequent calls. -/
partial def Kernel.executor (kernel : Kernel) :
    PFunctor.Handler.Stateful MetaM CellTransaction OperationalSignature :=
  fun request transaction => do
    let parents := match ← CasTools.Diagnostics.current? with
      | some active => if active.log.session == kernel.log.session then active.parents else #[]
      | none => #[]
    let entry ← kernel.log.write parents "request.execute" request.observation.toJson
    CasTools.Diagnostics.withScope { log := kernel.log, parents := parents.push entry } do
      return (← kernel.execute
        (kernel.evaluateSource request.observation.sourceSnapshot (some request.environment))
        request transaction, transaction)

end

/-- Lower and execute a checked term in the active cell with its actual source bindings. -/
opaque Kernel.run (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction) (context : OpenContext)
    (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding) (expression : Expr)
    (sourceSnapshot : Option Json := none) (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr := {}) :
    MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let parents := match ← CasTools.Diagnostics.current? with
    | some active => if active.log.session == kernel.log.session then active.parents else #[]
    | none => #[]
  CasTools.Diagnostics.withScope { log := kernel.log, parents } do
    let program ← kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .program
    CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "lower.started" <| Json.mkObj [
      ("program", Observation.identityJson program),
      ("transaction", Observation.identityJson transaction.id),
      ("bindings", Observation.boundJson context.telescope bound),
      ("source", sourceSnapshot.getD .null)]
    try
      let value ← kernel.evaluateSource sourceSnapshot none transaction program context bound
        selections expression
      CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "lower.completed" <| Json.mkObj [
        ("program", Observation.identityJson program),
        ("value", Observation.valueIdentityJson value)]
      return value
    catch error =>
      CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "lower.failed" <| Json.mkObj [
        ("program", Observation.identityJson program),
        ("detail", toJson (← error.toMessageData.toString))]
      throw error

end CasRuntime

/-- The worker's computational kernel: the frozen manifest and realization profile, the live
negotiated connections and the code of retained closures.
Source: execution contract v2 §1 and §2, lean-cas-dsl#69 comment 6664277464. -/
structure Kernel where
  private mk ::
  ledger : OccurrenceLedger
  manifest : Manifest
  manifestDigest : String
  profile : RealizationProfile
  timeoutMs : UInt32
  /-- Registrations of the manifest that name no published operation or declared backend. -/
  rejected : Array String
  connections : BackendConnections
  codes : IO.Ref (Std.HashMap (RuntimeId .program) ClosureCode)
  /-- The registrations actually dispatched, in order. An observation, not evidence. -/
  dispatches : IO.Ref (Array Registration)
  /-- Inert session diagnostics, separate from source and runtime authority. -/
  log : CasTools.ApplicationLog

/-- Read and freeze the manifest and profile before any invocation. No process starts here.
Without a manifest no leaf is installed. A registration is admitted when its operation is the
address of a published family and its backend is declared. Rejections are reported, and a
rejected registration is never selected. -/
opaque Kernel.load (owners : OwnerRegistry) (manifest : Option System.FilePath)
    (profile : Option Json) (timeoutMs : UInt32) : MetaM Kernel := do
  let (root, text) ← match manifest with
    | some path => pure (path.parent.getD ".", ← IO.FS.readFile path)
    | none => pure (".", "{}")
  let parsed ← IO.ofExcept <| (Json.parse text >>= Manifest.parse).mapError IO.userError
  let (installed, rejected) ← admitManifest parsed
  let digest ← sha256Hex text
  let selectedProfile ← RealizationProfile.prepare installed profile
  let log ← CasTools.ApplicationLog.new owners.identities.worker <| Json.mkObj [
    ("manifest", toJson (manifest.map (·.toString))), ("manifestDigest", toJson digest),
    ("profileDigest", toJson selectedProfile.sha256), ("rejected", toJson rejected)]
  return ⟨← OccurrenceLedger.new owners, installed, digest,
    selectedProfile, timeoutMs, rejected,
    ← BackendConnections.new owners root installed.backends timeoutMs,
    ← IO.mkRef {}, ← IO.mkRef #[], log⟩

/-- Branch preparation copies the retained code table. A committed
parent is never mutated by a child cell; occurrence/connection authority and
dispatch observations remain shared resource state. -/
def Kernel.fork (kernel : Kernel) : BaseIO Kernel := do
  return { kernel with codes := ← IO.mkRef (← kernel.codes.get) }

/-- Close every started process and invalidate its generation. -/
opaque Kernel.close (kernel : Kernel) : IO Unit := do
  try kernel.connections.close
  finally
    discard <| kernel.log.write #[] "session.resourcesClosed" (Json.mkObj [])

end CasRuntime

/-- The actual complete diagram of one original raw cone request. The accepted constructor
owns the native/proof port telescope; no packet shape or equal source expression selects it. -/
structure PreparedLimitInvocation where
  private mk ::
  preparation : RoleScope
  family : LimitFamily
  owner : SelectedLimitOwner ClosedTerm
  plan : ConstructorPorts
  bundle : ClosedTerm
  diagram : ValueContainer
  forms : Array String
  dependencies : Array ValueBinding
  views : Array InputDescriptorView
  private inputs : InputRoleMap

/-- Retain the original declaration arguments by position before exposing its accepted
diagram. The existing owner family supplies the same construction and constructor universes. -/
opaque PreparedLimitInvocation.prepare (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (transaction : CellTransaction) :
    MetaM PreparedLimitInvocation := do
  let .primitive (.limit family owner) _ := request.action
    | throwError "a raw construction requires its original complete limit boundary"
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs (← transaction.view)
  withSourceScope request fun context bound => do
    request.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound family.parameterCount
        fun context bound parameters originals => do
      let selected ← family.ownerAt (← owner.mapM (·.inContext context)) parameters
      family.requireInterface selected.source
      let interface ← selected.source.interface.mapM context.close
      let fresh : MetaM BindingId := do
        let identity ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .sourceBinding
        return ⟨identity.worker, identity.serial⟩
      let plan ← ConstructorPorts.prepare interface fresh
        (selections := request.environment.selections)
      let (tag, arguments) ← LimitFamily.diagramPorts selected.source.interface.diagram
      let mut values := #[]
      for argument in arguments, index in [:arguments.size] do
        let value ← evaluateSource transaction request.program context bound
          (← request.environment.selections.inContext context) argument
        let graph ← transaction.view
        let actual ← IO.ofExcept <|
          (RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph index value).mapError IO.userError
        let value ← request.environment.checkArgument (← context.close argument) actual
        request.environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph argument value
        values := values.push value
      let payload ← IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.descriptor
        (Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson tag), ("args", .arr (Array.replicate values.size .null))])
        (values.mapIdx fun index binding =>
          { path := #[.field "args", .index index], binding, fieldIndex := none })).mapError IO.userError
      let .container diagram := payload.data
        | throwError "the original diagram lost its complete native descriptor"
      let graph ← transaction.view
      discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
      let roots := originals.filterMap id ++ values
      let views ← InputDescriptorView.collect graph (← kernel.codes.get) roots
      return ⟨request.roles.scope, family, owner, plan, ← context.close selected.source.bundle,
        diagram, #[family.entry.category.raw],
        request.scope ++ roots ++ views.flatMap (·.dependencies), views, inputs⟩

/-- Recheck only the original admitted input map and current graph ownership. -/
opaque PreparedLimitInvocation.requireInputs (invocation : PreparedLimitInvocation)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph) : MetaM Unit := do
  request.requirePreparation invocation.preparation
  request.requirePreparation invocation.inputs.telescope.scope
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (invocation.inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners invocation.dependencies).mapError IO.userError

/-- Encode the declared diagram constructor, preserving every original argument position. -/
def PreparedLimitInvocation.encode (invocation : PreparedLimitInvocation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (receiver : ConnectionGeneration) :
    Except String (EncodedInputs × Json) := do
  let roots := invocation.diagram.slots.map fun slot =>
    ({ path := slot.path, binding := slot.binding } : InputPosition)
  let encoded ← graph.encodeInputs receiver roots invocation.views
  return (encoded, ← invocation.diagram.fill encoded.values)

private def constructionCaptures (invocation : PreparedLimitInvocation)
    (packet : ValueContainer) (ports : Array (Option ValueBinding)) : Array ValueBinding :=
  invocation.dependencies ++ packet.slots.map (·.binding) ++ ports.filterMap id

/-- Assemble only the native Cone/Cocone data fields. Its component function retains the
whole returned packet; accepted matcher-defined legs remain a released constructionLeg
descriptor until a declared mathematical consumer receives them. -/
private def assembleConstruction (invocation : PreparedLimitInvocation) (kernel : Kernel)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (registration : Registration) : PreparedConstructionTransport :=
    fun source packet constructorPath ports draft => do
  request.requirePreparation invocation.preparation
  unless source.address == request.source.address && source.kind == .record do
    throwError "the construction transport changed its original whole native result"
  let family := invocation.family
  let admitted ← ConstructorPortPrefix.ofValues request draft.view invocation.plan ports

  let (draft, apex) ← admitted.transportProjection request #[family.apexProjection] draft
  let layout ← RecordLayout.ofSource source
  let #[apexField, transformationField] := layout.fields.filter (·.field.wireIndex.isSome)
    | throwError "the complete native cone changed its computational field schema"
  unless apexField.field.projection == family.apexProjection &&
      transformationField.field.projection == family.legProjection do
    throwError "the complete native cone changed its original apex/transformation order"
  let transformation ← RecordLayout.ofSource transformationField.layout
  let #[appField] := transformation.fields.filter (·.field.wireIndex.isSome)
    | throwError "the native cone transformation changed its complete data interface"
  unless appField.field.projection == ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app &&
      appField.layout.kind == .function do
    throwError "the cone transformation lost its original component function"
  let nativePrefix ← RecordPrefix.prepare kernel.ledger.owners.identities request.program
    request.occurrence layout draft.view request.environment.bound
  let (draft, nativePrefix, apex) ← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.bindField nativePrefix apex
  let transformationPrefix ← nativePrefix.currentField
  let transPrefix ← RecordPrefix.prepare kernel.ledger.owners.identities request.program
    request.occurrence transformation draft.view request.environment.bound
  let appPrefix ← (← transPrefix.currentField).join
    (← transformationPrefix.descend ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app)
  let path := #[family.legProjection, ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app]
  let captures := constructionCaptures invocation packet ports
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (draft.view.requiredOwners captures).mapError IO.userError
  let program ← kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .program
  kernel.codes.modify (·.insert program
    (.constructionLeg request registration invocation.diagram packet ports path captures))
  let (draft, code) ← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.stage
    (← appPrefix.attachOrigin (← request.originFor appField.layout (some draft.view)) draft.view)
    (.closure program captures)
  let wrapped ← IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.retainedCallable packet code).mapError IO.userError
  let (draft, app) ← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.stage
    (← appPrefix.attachOrigin (← request.originFor appField.layout (some draft.view)) draft.view)
    wrapped
  discard <| appPrefix.checkResult request.environment draft.view app
  let (draft, transPrefix, _) ← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.bindField transPrefix app
  let transPayload ← IO.ofExcept <| transPrefix.finish.mapError IO.userError
  let (draft, nativeTransformation) ← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.stage
    (← transformationPrefix.attachOrigin
      (← request.originFor transformationField.layout (some draft.view)) draft.view) transPayload
  discard <| transformationPrefix.checkResult request.environment draft.view nativeTransformation
  let (draft, nativePrefix, nativeTransformation) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
    draft.bindField nativePrefix nativeTransformation
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| nativePrefix.finish.mapError IO.userError
  let mut slots : Array ContainerSlot := #[]
  for port in invocation.plan.ports, value in ports do
    if let some index := port.argument.wireIndex then
      let some value := value
        | throwError "the complete construction lost an admitted original data port"
      slots := slots.push {
        path := constructorPath ++ #[.field "args", .index index],
        binding := value, fieldIndex := none }
    else if value.isSome then
      throwError "the construction supplied computational data at an original proof position"
  let payload ← IO.ofExcept <|
    (ValuePayload.completeContainer packet slots #[apex, nativeTransformation]).mapError IO.userError
  liftM (m := IO) <| draft.stage (← request.originFor source (some draft.view)) payload

/-- Seal the accepted constructor and whole native output before the supplying connection
is invoked. Port decoding and whole-result admission share this exact preparation. -/
opaque PreparedLimitInvocation.resultCodec (invocation : PreparedLimitInvocation)
    (kernel : Kernel) (request : PreparedRequest) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (registration : Registration) : MetaM (PreparedResultCodec request.roles.scope) := do
  request.requirePreparation invocation.preparation
  PreparedResultCodec.forConstruction request invocation.plan invocation.family.category.expression
    invocation.bundle invocation.family.entry.colimit
    (assembleConstruction invocation kernel request registration)
    (some (preparedSymbolicCheck kernel request transaction))

/-- Continue the actual stored cone component. The original completion fixes the provider,
packet and path. The result retains its native typed index and whole original packet, never
an ordinal guessed from a constructor field or a fabricated call under the raw limit ID. -/
opaque Kernel.constructionLeg (kernel : Kernel) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (original : PreparedRequest) (registration : Registration)
    (diagram packet : ValueContainer) (ports : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (path : Array Name)
    (retained captures : Array ValueBinding) : MetaM (PreparedResponse request) := do
  let .primitive (.limit family _) _ := original.action
    | throwError "the stored cone component lost its original complete construction"
  let .apply callable _ _ := request.action
    | throwError "a stored cone component requires its actual native index"
  unless path == #[family.legProjection, ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app] do
    throwError "the stored cone component changed its native field path"
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs graph
  let #[index] ← IO.ofExcept <| (inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "the cone component changed its complete original index telescope"
  unless captures.size == retained.size &&
      (captures.zip retained).all (fun (actual, expected) =>
        actual.value == expected.value && actual.associationIds == expected.associationIds) do
    throwError "the cone component changed its original captures"
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <|
    (graph.requiredOwners (captures ++ ports.filterMap id ++ #[callable, index])).mapError IO.userError
  let some completion ← transaction.completionFor? original.occurrence
    | throwError "the cone component lost its original producing completion"
  original.requirePreparation completion.request.roles.scope
  let .invocation dispatch _ _ := completion.producer
    | throwError "the cone component lost its original supplying invocation"
  let .primitive selected := dispatch.selected
    | throwError "the cone component changed its original supplying dispatch kind"
  unless selected.registration == registration &&
      selected.manifestDigest == kernel.manifestDigest &&
      selected.profileDigest == kernel.profile.sha256 do
    throwError "the cone component changed its originally selected realization"
  let cone := completion.response.root
  let some node := graph.find cone.value
    | throwError "the cone component lost its complete actual parent"
  let .container actual := node.payload.data
    | throwError "the cone component lost its complete returned data packet"
  unless actual.retainsOriginalPacket packet do
    throwError "the cone component changed its original returned packet"
  let some _ ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (graph.projectionBasis callable cone path).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "the component callable has another cone or original projection ancestry"
  let diagramPrefix := #[InputPathStep.field "args", .index 1]
  let slots := diagram.slots.map (fun slot =>
      { slot with path := diagramPrefix ++ slot.path, fieldIndex := none }) ++
    #[{ path := #[.field "args", .index 2], binding := cone, fieldIndex := none },
      { path := #[.field "args", .index 3], binding := index, fieldIndex := none }]
  let exports := diagram.exports.map (·.prefixed diagramPrefix)
  let symbolic ← IO.ofExcept <| (CallablePacket.symbolic
    (Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "constructionLeg"), ("args", .arr #[
      toJson family.operation, diagram.template, .null, .null])])).mapError IO.userError
  let payload ← IO.ofExcept <|
    (ValuePayload.callablePacket symbolic slots none exports).mapError IO.userError
  let value ← transaction.stage (← request.originFor request.source) payload
  kernelCompletion request transaction value

end CasRuntime

module

public import CasRuntime.Limit
public import CasCompiler.RecordAction

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- Retain the actual completed cone at the original preceding field of its presentation.
The delayed universal family carries only provider code and original values; it does not
evaluate the mathematical IsLimit/IsColimit declaration. -/
opaque Kernel.stageUniversal (kernel : Kernel) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (program : RuntimeId .program)
    (captures : Array ValueBinding) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let .primitive (.limitUniversal family owner) universes := request.action
    | throwError "a universal producer requires its original native family"
  let cone ← request.universalCone
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let some node := graph.find cone.value
    | throwError "the universal family lost its actual completed cone"
  let some completion ← transaction.completionFor? node.origin.occurrence
    | throwError "the universal family lost its cone's original completion"
  let original := completion.request
  let .primitive (.limit presentation originalOwner) originalUniverses := original.action
    | throwError "the universal family requires an original raw-cone completion"
  unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.limit presentation).exactlyMatches (.limit family.presentation) &&
      originalUniverses == universes do
    throwError "the universal family changed its original presentation or universes"
  let selectedConstruction ← withSourceScope request fun context _ => do
    let parameters := request.application.map (·.arguments.map (·.source.source)) |>.getD #[]
    let selected ← family.presentation.ownerAt (← owner.mapM (·.inContext context))
      (← parameters.mapM (·.inContext context))
    pure selected.source.construction
  let originalConstruction ← withSourceScope original fun context _ => do
    let parameters := original.application.map (·.arguments.map (·.source.source)) |>.getD #[]
    let selected ← presentation.ownerAt (← originalOwner.mapM (·.inContext context))
      (← parameters.mapM (·.inContext context))
    pure selected.source.construction
  unless selectedConstruction == originalConstruction do
    throwError "the universal family changed its original retained construction owner"
  unless completion.response.root.value == cone.value &&
      completion.response.root.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf cone.associationIds.toList do
    throwError "the universal family changed its actual completed cone occurrence"
  let declared := request.origin.application.map (·.arguments) |>.getD #[]
  let supplied := original.origin.application.map (·.arguments) |>.getD #[]
  unless declared.size == supplied.size && (declared.zip supplied).all (fun pair =>
      match pair with
      | (none, none) => true
      | (some left, some right) =>
        left.value == right.value && left.associationIds == right.associationIds
      | _ => false) do
    throwError "the universal family changed its cone's original parameter occurrences"
  unless captures.size == request.scope.size &&
      (captures.zip request.scope).all (fun (left, right) =>
        left.value == right.value && left.associationIds == right.associationIds) do
    throwError "the universal family changed its complete original captures"
  let .container complete := node.payload.data
    | throwError "the universal family requires the complete actual cone packet"
  unless complete.originalPacket.isSome && complete.fields.isSome do
    throwError "the universal family cannot capture an incomplete native cone"
  discard <| request.admitInputs graph
  let some parent := request.nativeParent
    | throwError "the universal family lost its complete native presentation layout"
  let #[coneField, universalField] := parent.fields.filter (·.field.wireIndex.isSome)
    | throwError "the original presentation changed its complete computational field schema"
  unless coneField.field.projection == family.presentation.coneProjection &&
      universalField.field.projection == family.projection do
    throwError "the original presentation changed its cone/universal field order"
  let draft ← transaction.draft
  let nativePrefixState ← RecordPrefix.prepare kernel.ledger.owners.identities request.program
    request.occurrence parent draft.view request.environment.bound
  let (draft, nativePrefixState, _) ← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.bindField nativePrefixState cone
  let nativePrefix ← nativePrefixState.currentField
  let origin ← nativePrefix.attachOrigin
    (← request.originFor request.source (some draft.view)) draft.view
  let (draft, value) ← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.stage origin (.closure program captures)
  -- This is an isolated staged producer. Ordinary kernel completion authenticates
  -- the same prefix before association and admits the complete returned interface.
  match ← transaction.installDraft draft with
  | .ok () => return value
  | .error failure => transactionFailure failure

/-- Supply exact earlier fields from the immutable original universal producer. The
source action names native slots; neither source equality nor a later consuming association
can choose their values. -/
opaque Kernel.universalPredecessors (kernel : Kernel) (family : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (inputs : Array RecordActionInput) :
    MetaM (Array (Nat × ValueBinding)) := do
  let _ := kernel
  let .primitive (.limitUniversal selected _) _ := family.action
    | throwError "native predecessor inputs require the original universal subfamily"
  let some completion ← transaction.completionFor? family.occurrence
    | throwError "the universal action lost its original completed family"
  family.requirePreparation completion.request.roles.scope
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let some node := graph.find completion.response.root.value
    | throwError "the universal action lost its original producing value"
  let some nativePrefix := node.origin.fieldPrefix
    | throwError "the universal action lost its original native predecessor frame"
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <|
    (nativePrefix.requireOrigin family.program family.occurrence family.source).mapError IO.userError
  let #[frame] := nativePrefix.frames
    | throwError "the universal action changed its original whole-presentation frame"
  unless frame.field.projection == selected.projection do
    throwError "the universal action selected another native presentation field"
  inputs.mapM fun input => do
    let some field := frame.association.layout.fields[input.sourceIndex]?
      | throwError "a universal input is outside its original native predecessor slots"
    unless field.field.projection == input.projection do
      throwError "a universal input changed its original native projection"
    let some value := frame.preceding[input.sourceIndex]?.bind id
      | throwError "a universal input has no actual original predecessor value"
    discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners #[value]).mapError IO.userError
    return (input.sourceIndex, value)

end CasRuntime

public import CasRuntime.Value
public import CasCompiler.Declaration
public import Lean.Meta.Transform

public section

namespace CasRuntime.ScalarLiteral

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue.Backend

inductive Status
  | notScalar | checked
  deriving BEq, Repr

private def constraintProof (condition : Expr) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  let some decisionInstance ← synthInstance? (← mkAppM ``Decidable #[condition]) | return none
  for declaration in (← zetaReduce decisionInstance).getUsedConstants do
    discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
  let decision ← withTransparency .all <| whnf (← mkDecide condition)
  if decision.isConstOf ``Bool.false then
    throwError "a scalar literal violates its declared representation constraint"
  unless decision.isConstOf ``Bool.true do return none
  let proof ← mkDecideProof condition
  for declaration in proof.getUsedConstants do discard <| checkedDeclaration declaration
  checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint proof condition)
  return some proof

/-- Read only closed, data-only scalar representations, discarding the value at the public gate.
Grammar reference: CasContract.Port wire encoding and CasCatalogue.Codec.decodeAt. Reuse Lean's
constructor telescopes, native literal expressions, mkDecideProof and synchronous kernel checks.
Function/type fields have no scalar decoding path; no finite-function or law reconstruction runs. -/
private partial def decode (asked : Expr) (packet : Json) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  let type ← whnf (← zetaReduce asked)
  if type.hasFVar || type.hasMVar || type.hasLevelMVar || type.isSort || type.isForall then
    return none
  if ← isProp type then return none
  if (packet.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "valueData" then
    let .ok () := checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] packet
      | throwError "a scalar literal has unexpected computational envelope fields"
    let .ok (.inline data) := ComputationalValue.decode packet
      | throwError "a scalar literal has an invalid computational envelope"
    return ← decode asked data
  if type.isConstOf ``Nat then
    let .ok value := packet.getNat?
      | throwError "a scalar literal requires a natural JSON number"
    return some (mkNatLit value)
  if type.isConstOf ``Int then
    let .ok value := packet.getInt?
      | throwError "a scalar literal requires an integer JSON number"
    return some (toExpr value)
  if type.isAppOfArity ``List 1 then
    let .ok values := packet.getArr?
      | throwError "a scalar list literal requires a JSON array"
    let element := type.appArg!
    let mut decoded : Array Expr := #[]
    for value in values do
      let some value ← decode element value | return none
      decoded := decoded.push value
    let mut result ← mkAppOptM ``List.nil #[some element]
    for value in decoded.reverse do result ← mkAppM ``List.cons #[value, result]
    return some result
  if type.isAppOfArity ``Quot 2 then
    let #[carrier, relation] := type.getAppArgs | return none
    let some value ← decode carrier packet | return none
    let .const _ levels := type.getAppFn | return none
    return some (mkAppN (mkConst ``Quot.mk levels) #[carrier, relation, value])
  let .const name levels := type.getAppFn | return none
  let some (.inductInfo info) := (← getEnv).find? name | return none
  let parameters := type.getAppArgs.extract 0 info.numParams
  let constructorName ← if info.ctors.length == 1 && info.numIndices == 0 then
      pure info.ctors[0]!
    else do
      let .ok () := checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] packet
        | throwError "a scalar literal has unexpected constructor fields"
      let .ok label := packet.getObjValAs? String "ctor"
        | throwError "a scalar literal requires its declared constructor tag"
      let some constructor := info.ctors.find? (·.getString! == label)
        | throwError "a scalar literal names a constructor outside its declared type"
      pure constructor
  discard <| checkedDeclaration constructorName
  let mut result := mkAppN (mkConst constructorName levels) parameters
  let count ← forallTelescope (← inferType result) fun fields _ => do
    let mut count := 0
    for field in fields do
      unless ← isProp (← inferType field) do count := count + 1
    return count
  let values ← if info.ctors.length == 1 && info.numIndices == 0 && count == 1 then
      pure #[packet]
    else do
      let .ok values := if info.ctors.length == 1 && info.numIndices == 0 then packet.getArr?
          else (packet.getObjVal? "args").bind (·.getArr?)
        | throwError "a scalar literal requires its complete ordered constructor data"
      pure values
  unless values.size == count do
    throwError "a scalar literal has a different declared data-field arity"
  let mut index := 0
  while true do
    let remaining ← whnf (← inferType result)
    let .forallE _ fieldType _ _ := remaining | break
    if ← isProp fieldType then
      let some proof ← constraintProof fieldType | return none
      result := mkApp result proof
    else
      let some packet := values[index]?
        | throwError "a scalar literal has an incomplete constructor prefix"
      let some value ← decode fieldType packet | return none
      result := mkApp result value
      index := index + 1
  unless ← isDefEq (← inferType result) asked do
    throwError "a scalar literal has a different declared native type"
  checkWithKernel (← mkExpectedTypeHint result asked)
  return some result

/-- Open only the supplied source type for representation checking. The packet remains the
sole source of decoded data, and no local from this checking view escapes with the value. -/
private def decodeSource (source : SourceLayout) (packet : Json) : MetaM (Option Expr) :=
  source.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let type ← inferType expression
    let selections ← source.selections.inContext context
    for index in ← selectedContextDependencies context selections type do
      let some binding := bindings[index]?
        | throwError "a scalar type dependency is outside its complete native context"
      if binding.role == .result ||
          (binding.role != .selectedStructure && binding.originalSource.isSome) then return none
    context.withOriginalSources #[type] fun native => do
      let some value ← decode native[0]! packet | return none
      if value.hasFVar || value.hasMVar || value.hasLevelMVar then return none
      return some value

/-- Validate a wholly inline closed scalar at its source type, then discard the checked value.
This establishes representation constraints, not correctness of the requested computation.
Structured/owned/open-dependent values retain their prepared operational admission path. -/
opaque check (source : SourceLayout) (packet : Json) : MetaM Status := do
  let .ok () := CasRuntime.checkLiteral packet | return .notScalar
  let some _ ← decodeSource source packet | return .notScalar
  return .checked

/-- Read a wholly inline closed scalar candidate as a native value of its source type.
The value is computational data for a comparison of candidates. It proves nothing about
the computation that returned it. Reuse: the checked decoder above. -/
opaque read (source : SourceLayout) (packet : Json) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  let .ok () := CasRuntime.checkLiteral packet | return none
  decodeSource source packet

/-- Read an inline candidate at a closed registered literal type, as `read` does at a source
type. The registry's literal form fixes that type; the candidate does not select it. -/
opaque readAt (type : Expr) (packet : Json) : MetaM (Option Expr) := do
  let .ok () := CasRuntime.checkLiteral packet | return none
  decode type packet

end CasRuntime.ScalarLiteral

namespace CasRuntime.PropertyObservation

open Lean CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- The released property observation packet is Option Bool, with no native proof reading.
This exact constructor grammar is shared by response admission and question observation. -/
def decode (packet : Json) : Except String (Option Bool) := do
  checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] packet
  let label ← packet.getObjValAs? String "ctor"
  let fields ← (packet.getObjVal? "args").bind (·.getArr?)
  if label == "none" && fields.isEmpty then return none
  unless label == "some" do throw "a property answer requires an Option Bool constructor"
  let #[answer] := fields
    | throw "a property answer requires exactly one Boolean field"
  checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] answer
  let label ← answer.getObjValAs? String "ctor"
  let fields ← (answer.getObjVal? "args").bind (·.getArr?)
  unless fields.isEmpty do throw "a property Boolean constructor has no fields"
  if label == "true" then return some true
  if label == "false" then return some false
  throw "a property answer requires the declared Boolean constructor"

end CasRuntime.PropertyObservation

private def literalSource (term : Term) : TermElabM SourceLayout := do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (← elabTermAndSynthesize term none))

private def reject (source : SourceLayout) (packet : Json) (expected : String) : MetaM Unit := do
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    discard <| ScalarLiteral.check source packet
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure | throwError "a scalar packet violated its source representation"
  unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith expected do throw failure

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let natural ← literalSource (← `((7 : Nat)))
  let integer ← literalSource (← `((-7 : Int)))
  let rational ← literalSource (← `(((1 : Rat) / 2)))
  let finite ← literalSource (← `((Fin.last 3)))
  let dependent ← literalSource (← `((⟨3, Fin.last 3⟩ : Σ n : Nat, Fin (n + 1))))
  let list ← literalSource (← `(([1, 2] : List Nat)))
  let boolean ← literalSource (← `((true : Bool)))
  let valid : Array (SourceLayout × Json) := #[
    (natural, toJson (0 : Nat)), (integer, toJson (-19 : Int)),
    (rational, .arr #[toJson (-2 : Int), toJson (3 : Nat)]),
    (rational, .arr #[toJson (0 : Int), toJson (1 : Nat)]),
    (finite, toJson (0 : Nat)), (finite, toJson (3 : Nat)),
    (dependent, .arr #[toJson (3 : Nat), toJson (3 : Nat)]),
    (list, .arr #[toJson (3 : Nat), toJson (4 : Nat)]),
    (boolean, Json.mkObj [("ctor", .str "false"), ("args", .arr #[])])]
  for (source, packet) in valid do
    unless (← ScalarLiteral.check source packet) == .checked do
      throwError "the native scalar representation was not checked"
  reject natural (.str "7") "a scalar literal requires a natural JSON number"
  reject integer (.arr #[]) "a scalar literal requires an integer JSON number"
  for packet in #[Json.arr #[toJson (1 : Int), toJson (0 : Nat)],
      .arr #[toJson (2 : Int), toJson (4 : Nat)],
      .arr #[toJson (0 : Int), toJson (2 : Nat)]] do
    reject rational packet "a scalar literal violates its declared representation constraint"
  reject finite (toJson (4 : Nat))
    "a scalar literal violates its declared representation constraint"
  reject dependent (.arr #[toJson (3 : Nat), toJson (4 : Nat)])
    "a scalar literal violates its declared representation constraint"
  reject list (.arr #[.str "3"]) "a scalar literal requires a natural JSON number"
  let function ← literalSource (← `((Nat.succ)))
  let type ← literalSource (← `((Nat)))
  for source in #[function, type] do
    unless (← ScalarLiteral.check source .null) == .notScalar do
      throwError "scalar validation reconstructed a callable or type-valued result"
  let native := CasCatalogue.Backend.ComputationalValue.encode (.opaque "actual-token")
  unless (← ScalarLiteral.check natural native) == .notScalar do
    throwError "scalar validation interpreted a native export as a literal"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let inspect (bound point : Expr) : MetaM SourceLayout := do
    let declaration ← getFVarLocalDecl bound
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[
      { id := ⟨"literal-index", 0⟩,
        role := if declaration.isLet then .definition else .parameter, expression := bound },
      { id := ⟨"literal-index", 1⟩, role := .parameter, expression := point }]
    SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close point)
  withLetDecl `bound (mkConst ``Nat) (mkNatLit 4) fun bound =>
    withLocalDeclD `point (mkApp (mkConst ``Fin) bound) fun point => do
      let source ← inspect bound point
      unless (← ScalarLiteral.check source (toJson (3 : Nat))) == .checked do
        throwError "scalar validation lost the actual native source let definition"
      reject source (toJson (4 : Nat))
        "a scalar literal violates its declared representation constraint"
  withLocalDeclD `bound (mkConst ``Nat) fun bound =>

-- An explicitly retained carrier checks the supplied packet without using the original
-- point as its answer. An unselected rigid carrier still cannot be learned from that packet.

public import CasContract.Registration
public import CasCatalogue.Admission
public import CasCompiler.LiftFamily
public import CasCompiler.PublishedPorts
public import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Registry.Semantic
public import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Registry.Computation
