private def checkStoredProjection (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (program : RuntimeId .program)
    (context : OpenContext) (parent : ValueBinding) (index : Nat) (expected : ValueBinding) :
    MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
  let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
  let projection ← PreparedRequest.forProjection transaction.owners.identities program occurrence
    context graph parent index #[]
  let storedOnly : PFunctor.Handler.Stateful MetaM CellTransaction OperationalSignature :=
    fun _ _ => throwError "a stored field projection invoked external execution"
  let projected ← Execute.run storedOnly
    (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) projection) transaction
  let .ok (some basis) := (← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view).projectionBasis
      projected.root parent projection.origin.accessPath
    | throwError "stateful projection lost its actual parent and native field path"
  unless projected.root.value == expected.value &&
      expected.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf projected.root.associationIds.toList &&
      basis.value == expected.value && basis.associationIds == expected.associationIds do
    throwError "stateful projection changed the reused field or its consuming associations"
  return projected.root

-- The public SDK echoes packets and exports a stored diagnostic callable; it computes no mathematics.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| packageDir contractPackage
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let .ok wire ← liftM (m := IO) <| FramedConnection.start owners "materialization-peer" {
        cmd := (contract / ".venv/bin/python").toString
        args := #[(root / "scripts/probes/protocol_v2_peer.py").toString]
        env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some (contract / "python").toString)] } 5000
      | throwError "the materialization control peer did not negotiate"
    try
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
      let prepare (term : Expr) (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence) :
          MetaM PreparedRequest := do
        let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm
          (← context.close (mkLambda `ignored .default (mkConst ``Nat) term))
        let dummyRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 0))
        let dummy ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
          { program, occurrence, role := dummyRole, parameters := #[] } (.portable "0".toUTF8)
        let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue (← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view) 0 dummy
          | throwError "the materialization fixture argument is absent"
        let callable ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
          { program, occurrence, role := layout, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
        PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable
          #[dummyRole.source] #[actual] #[]
      let nativeOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let nativeRequest ← prepare (mkConst ``Nat.succ) nativeOccurrence
      let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "materialization-manifest", profileDigest := "materialization-profile"
        registration := {
          operation := "stored", input := "materialization#input", backend := wire.backend } }
      let .ok reservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.reserve nativeOccurrence selected wire.connection #[]
        | throwError "the native result control could not reserve"
      let before ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger reservation before #[] #[] #[]
      let .ok reply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction reservation scope
        (.str "retained diagnostic callable") 5000
        | throwError "the native result control did not return"
      let (draft, native) ← reply.materialize nativeRequest transaction scope wire.connection
      let some node := draft.view.find native.root.value
        | throwError "materialization lost the returned native node"
      let .ownedToken owner token captures := node.payload.data
        | throwError "materialization replaced the actual native export"
      unless owner == wire.connection.generation && captures.isEmpty &&
          reply.exports.any (·.token == token) do
        throwError "materialization changed the actual native owner, token or capture table"
      if ((← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view).find native.root.value).isSome then
        throwError "materialization installed a tentative native reply"
      let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.installDraft draft
        | throwError "the complete native draft could not enter the active graph"
      let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkConst ``Nat.succ]
      let request ← prepare pair occurrence
      let scalarRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
      let scalar ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
        { program, occurrence, role := scalarRole, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      let selected := { selected with registration := { selected.registration with operation := "echo" } }
      let .ok reservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.reserve occurrence selected wire.connection #[scalar, native.root]
        | throwError "the joint result control could not reserve"
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[scalar, native.root] #[] #[]
      let packet := Json.arr #[(ScopedReference.scope 0).encode, (ScopedReference.scope 1).encode]
      let .ok reply ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction reservation scope packet 5000
        | throwError "the joint result control did not return"
      let (draft, response) ← reply.materialize request transaction scope wire.connection
      let .ok first := draft.view.project response.root 0
        | throwError "the materialized record lost its first actual field"
      let .ok second := draft.view.project response.root 1
        | throwError "the materialized record lost its actual callable"
      unless first.value == scalar.value && second.value == native.root.value &&
          second.instantiations.size == native.root.instantiations.size + 1 do
        throwError "joint materialization replaced a retained input or its consuming role"
      for declared in request.roles.results do
        let .ok actual := response.roles.lookup draft.view declared.role.id
          | throwError "joint SDK materialization lost a declared result binding"
        let expected ← match declared.wirePath with
          | some #[] => pure response.root
          | some #[0] => pure first
          | some #[1] => pure second
          | _ => throwError "the joint SDK result has an unexpected source field path"
        unless actual.value == expected.value && actual.associationIds == expected.associationIds do
          throwError "joint result-role admission changed an actual field or its association"
      let some selectedRole := request.roles.results.find? (·.wirePath == some #[0])
        | throwError "the joint result has no first field role"
      let .ok selectedField := response.roles.lookup draft.view selectedRole.role.id
        | throwError "the selected returned field has no admitted binding"
      if ((← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view).find response.root.value).isSome then
        throwError "joint materialization exposed an uninstalled result"
      let some node := draft.view.find response.root.value
        | throwError "the materialized literal packet is absent"
      let .container stored := node.payload.data
        | throwError "joint materialization discarded the original packet structure"
      let .ok filled := stored.fill #[.str "scalar-slot", .str "callable-slot"]
        | throwError "the materialized packet lost its exact reference positions"
      unless filled == Json.arr #[.str "scalar-slot", .str "callable-slot"] do
        throwError "materialization changed its original packet layout"
      if ((← SessionSnapshot.current).graph.find response.root.value).isSome then
        throwError "materialization published a tentative reply"
      let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.installDraft draft
        | throwError "the existing joint result could not enter the active graph"
      let reuseWhole (input : ValueBinding) : MetaM Unit := do
        let jointOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
        let jointRequest ← prepare pair jointOccurrence
        let .ok jointReservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.reserve jointOccurrence
          selected wire.connection (jointRequest.scope.push input)
          | throwError "the whole-record reference control could not reserve"
        let jointGraph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
        let argumentPath := #[InputPathStep.field "argument"]
        let .ok originalPacket := jointGraph.encodeInputs wire.connection.generation
            #[{ path := argumentPath, binding := input }]
          | throwError "the existing record could not encode"
        let jointScope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger jointReservation
          jointGraph #[input] #[] #[]
        let .ok jointReply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction
          jointReservation jointScope (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode 5000
          | throwError "the SDK did not return the existing whole record"
        let (jointDraft, joint) ← jointReply.materialize jointRequest transaction
          jointScope wire.connection
        let .ok jointFirst := jointDraft.view.project joint.root 0
          | throwError "the reused record lost its first consuming field view"
        let .ok jointSecond := jointDraft.view.project joint.root 1
          | throwError "the reused record lost its second consuming field view"
        let .ok encoded := jointDraft.view.encodeInputs wire.connection.generation
            #[{ path := argumentPath, binding := joint.root }]
          | throwError "the reused record could not encode for its next consumer"
        unless joint.root.value == input.value && encoded.values == originalPacket.values &&
            encoded.inputs.map (·.binding.associationIds) ==
              #[joint.root.associationIds, jointFirst.associationIds, jointSecond.associationIds] do
          throwError "input encoding changed a reused record or its consuming field associations"
      reuseWhole response.root
      let productOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let product ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
        { request.origin with occurrence := productOccurrence }
        (.product #[first, second])
      reuseWhole product
      let selectedField ← checkStoredProjection ledger transaction program context
        response.root 0 selectedField
      let aliasOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let identity ← mkAppOptM ``id #[some (mkConst ``Nat)]
      let identityRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close identity)
      let identity ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
        { program, occurrence := aliasOccurrence, role := identityRole, parameters := #[] }
        (.closure program #[])
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let .ok actualAlias := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 selectedField
        | throwError "the existing scalar input is outside its graph"
      let aliasRequest ← withBindingContext graph context {} response.root fun context bound => do
        let parent ← request.source.source.inContext context
        withBoundValue owners.identities context bound parent response.root fun context bound parent => do
          let selectedSource ← context.close (← mkAppM ``Prod.fst #[parent])
          let parameters ← bound.toArray.mapM fun (id, value) =>
            IO.ofExcept <| (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph id value).mapError IO.userError
          PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program aliasOccurrence context identity
            #[selectedSource] #[actualAlias] parameters (some graph)
      let .ok aliasReservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.reserve aliasOccurrence selected wire.connection #[selectedField]
        | throwError "the returned-reference control could not reserve"
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let aliasScope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger aliasReservation graph #[selectedField] #[] #[]
      let .ok aliasReply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction
        aliasReservation aliasScope (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode 5000
        | throwError "the returned-reference control did not return"
      let (aliasDraft, aliasValue) ←
        aliasReply.materialize aliasRequest transaction aliasScope wire.connection
      unless aliasValue.root.value == scalar.value && !aliasDraft.view.sameRevision graph do
        throwError "returning a reference changed its node or lost its new application revision"
      let .ok _ ← transaction.completeReply aliasDraft aliasRequest aliasValue aliasScope aliasReply
        | throwError "a complete reference-only reply could not stage its completion"
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.installDraft aliasDraft with
      | .error .staleDraft => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "a reference-only reply draft installed twice"
      let retainAlias : PFunctor.Handler.Stateful MetaM CellTransaction OperationalSignature :=
        fun _ _ => throwError "a completed reference-only reply reached external execution"
      let retained ← Execute.run retainAlias
        (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) aliasRequest) transaction
      aliasRequest.environment.withContext context {} fun context _ => do
        unless retained.root.value == scalar.value &&
            (← retained.root.role.source.inContext context) ==
              (← aliasRequest.source.source.inContext context) do
          throwError "native execution changed the returned reference or its consuming source role"
      let badOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let badRequest ← prepare pair badOccurrence
      let boolRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkConst ``Bool.true))
      let wrong ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
        { program, occurrence := badOccurrence, role := boolRole, parameters := #[] }
        (.portable "true".toUTF8)
      let .ok badReservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.reserve badOccurrence selected wire.connection #[wrong]
        | throwError "the joint rejection control could not reserve"
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let badScope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger badReservation graph #[wrong] #[] #[]
      let .ok badReply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction
        badReservation badScope (.arr #[toJson (7 : Nat), (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode]) 5000
        | throwError "the joint rejection control did not return"
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| badReply.materialize badRequest transaction badScope wire.connection
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let some failure := failure | throwError "joint materialization accepted a mistyped later field"
      unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
          "the runtime value has an incompatible complete source type" do throw failure
      unless (← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view).sameRevision graph do
        throwError "a rejected later field installed an earlier tentative reply prefix"
      let rational ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize (← `(((1 : Rat) / 2))) none
      for packet in #[Json.arr #[toJson (-2 : Int), toJson (3 : Nat)],
          .arr #[toJson (1 : Int), toJson (0 : Nat)],
          .arr #[toJson (2 : Int), toJson (4 : Nat)]] do
        let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
        let request ← prepare rational occurrence
        let .ok reservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
          transaction.reserve occurrence selected wire.connection #[]
          | throwError "the scalar representation control could not reserve"
        let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
        let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
          RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[] #[] #[]
        let .ok reply ← liftM (m := IO) <|
          wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction reservation scope packet 5000
          | throwError "the scalar representation control did not return"
        if packet == Json.arr #[toJson (-2 : Int), toJson (3 : Nat)] then
          let (draft, result) ← reply.materialize request transaction scope wire.connection
          let .ok numerator := draft.view.project result.root 0
            | throwError "the scalar packet lost its actual numerator"
          let some node := draft.view.find numerator.value
            | throwError "the scalar numerator is absent from its draft"
          let .container stored := node.payload.data
            | throwError "the scalar numerator lost its original literal data"
          unless stored.template == toJson (-2 : Int) do
            throwError "scalar validation substituted the source answer for the actual returned data"
        else
          let failure : Option Exception ← try
            discard <| reply.materialize request transaction scope wire.connection
            pure none
          catch error => pure (some error)
          let some failure := failure
            | throwError "immediate materialization accepted a malformed scalar representation"
          unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
              "a scalar literal violates its declared representation constraint" do throw failure
        unless (← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view).sameRevision graph do
          throwError "scalar representation checking installed tentative data"
      let indexOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let indexRequest ← prepare (mkNatLit 7) indexOccurrence
      let stored := { selected with registration := { selected.registration with operation := "stored" } }
      let .ok indexReservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.reserve indexOccurrence stored wire.connection #[]
        | throwError "the actual native index control could not reserve"
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let indexScope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger indexReservation graph #[] #[] #[]
      let .ok indexReply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction
        indexReservation indexScope (.str "native index ownership") 5000
        | throwError "the SDK did not supply the native index control"
      let (indexDraft, indexValue) ←
        indexReply.materialize indexRequest transaction indexScope wire.connection
      let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.installDraft indexDraft
        | throwError "the native index could not enter the active graph"
      let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let functionSource ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
        (← `(fun (n : Nat) => (0 : Fin (n + 1)))) none
      let functionRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close functionSource)
      let function ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
        { program, occurrence, role := functionRole, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 indexValue.root
        | throwError "the native index is outside its current graph"
      let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context function
        #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7)] #[actual] #[]
      let .ok reservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.reserve occurrence selected wire.connection request.scope
        | throwError "the dependent materialization control could not reserve"
      let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[] #[] #[]
      let .ok reply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction reservation scope
        (toJson (0 : Nat)) 5000
        | throwError "the dependent scalar packet did not return"
      let (draft, point) ← reply.materialize request transaction scope wire.connection
      let .ok number := draft.view.project point.root 0
        | throwError "the dependent packet lost its numeric field"
      let some node := draft.view.find point.root.value
        | throwError "the dependent point is absent from its draft"
      let some application := node.origin.application
        | throwError "materialization discarded actual application provenance"
      unless application.dependencies == #[0] &&
          (application.arguments[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some indexValue.root.value do
        throwError "materialization changed the actual argument-index association"
      let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.installDraft draft
        | throwError "the numeric field could not enter the active graph"
      let plain ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
        { program, occurrence, role := request.source, parameters := #[] } (.product #[number])
      let reuseOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let reuseRequest ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program reuseOccurrence context function
        #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7)] #[actual] #[]
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let .ok baselineOwners := graph.requiredOwners #[plain]
        | throwError "the existing point is outside its graph"
      unless baselineOwners.isEmpty do
        throwError "the existing point acquired an unrelated index owner"
      let .ok reuseReservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.reserve reuseOccurrence selected wire.connection (reuseRequest.scope.push plain)
        | throwError "the reused dependent result could not reserve"
      let reuseScope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger reuseReservation graph #[plain] #[] #[]
      let .ok reuseReply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction
        reuseReservation reuseScope (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode 5000
        | throwError "the SDK did not return the existing dependent result"
      let (reusedDraft, reused) ←
        reuseReply.materialize reuseRequest transaction reuseScope wire.connection
      let .ok reuseOwners := reusedDraft.view.requiredOwners #[reused.root]
        | throwError "the reused result is outside its isolated graph"
      unless reused.root.value == plain.value && reuseOwners == #[wire.connection.generation] do
        throwError "a reused result lost its consuming application's actual index dependency"
      if (graph.requiredOwners #[reused.root]).isOk then
        throwError "an older graph recovered the new consuming application association"
      let some association := reused.root.applications.back?
        | throwError "the reused result lost its consuming application table"
      unless association.association.occurrence == reuseOccurrence &&
          association.association.program == program &&
          association.association.dependencies == #[0] &&
          (association.arguments[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some indexValue.root.value &&
          association.callable.map (·.value) == some function.value do
        throwError "a reused result changed its actual consuming application provenance"
      let some originalPoint := reusedDraft.view.find plain.value
        | throwError "the original point is absent from the extended graph"
      unless originalPoint.origin.occurrence == occurrence && originalPoint.origin.application.isNone do
        throwError "consuming application binding rewrote the original producer"
      let .ok reusedNumber := reusedDraft.view.project reused.root 0
        | throwError "the reused result lost its stored numeric projection"
      let .ok numericOwners := reusedDraft.view.requiredOwners #[reusedNumber]
        | throwError "the reused numeric projection is outside the extended graph"
      unless reusedNumber.value == number.value && numericOwners.isEmpty &&
          number.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf reusedNumber.associationIds.toList &&
          reusedNumber.instantiations.size == number.instantiations.size + 1 do
        throwError "a reused field changed its node, earlier roles or independent owner requirements"
      if (graph.requiredOwners #[reusedNumber]).isOk then
        throwError "an older graph recovered a later consuming application field view"
      let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.installDraft reusedDraft
        | throwError "the reused application draft could not install"
      let chainedOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let chainedRequest ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program chainedOccurrence context function
        #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7)] #[actual] #[]
      let chainedGraph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let .ok chainedReservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.reserve chainedOccurrence
        selected wire.connection (chainedRequest.scope.push reused.root)
        | throwError "the successive application could not reserve"
      let chainedScope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger chainedReservation
        chainedGraph #[reused.root] #[] #[]
      let .ok chainedReply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction
        chainedReservation chainedScope (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode 5000
        | throwError "the SDK did not return the successively reused point"
      let (chainedDraft, chained) ← chainedReply.materialize chainedRequest transaction
        chainedScope wire.connection
      unless chained.root.value == plain.value &&
          chained.root.applications.size == reused.root.applications.size + 1 &&
          reused.root.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf chained.root.associationIds.toList do
        throwError "successive reuse discarded an earlier application association"
      let pointType ← inferType (← reuseRequest.source.source.inContext context)
      withLocalDeclD `retainedPoint pointType fun pointName => do
        let binding : LocalBinding := {
          id := ⟨"retained-point", 0⟩, role := .parameter, expression := pointName }
        let pointContext ← ContextTelescope.capture #[binding]
        let .ok parameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue chainedDraft.view binding.id reused.root
          | throwError "the earlier consuming result is absent from the extended graph"
        let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker pointContext #[parameter]
        let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue chainedDraft.view 0 chained.root
          | throwError "the successively reused result is absent from its graph"
        let retained ← environment.checkArgument (← pointContext.close pointName) argument
        unless retained.associationIds == chained.root.associationIds do
          throwError "source argument capture lost successive application associations"
        let .ok originalArgument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue chainedDraft.view 0 plain
          | throwError "the original point is absent from the extended graph"
        let failure : Option Exception ← try
          discard <| environment.checkArgument (← pointContext.close pointName) originalArgument
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
        let some failure := failure
          | throwError "source argument checking erased the retained consuming application identity"
        unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag
            (· == `CasRuntime.RuntimeEnvironment.sourceReferenceMismatch) do throw failure
      liftM (m := IO) wire.close
      if ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (draft.view.isAvailable owners point.root) then
        throwError "a materialized dependent point survived its actual index owner"
      unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (draft.view.isAvailable owners number) do
        throwError "a materialized numeric field retained its unrelated index owner"
      if ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (reusedDraft.view.isAvailable owners reused.root) then
        throwError "a reused dependent result survived its consuming index owner"
      unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (graph.isAvailable owners plain) do
        throwError "a consuming application changed its original result's owner requirements"
      unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (reusedDraft.view.isAvailable owners reusedNumber) do
        throwError "the reused numeric field acquired its parent application's unrelated owner"
      discard <| checkStoredProjection ledger transaction program context reused.root 0 reusedNumber
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) transaction.abort
    finally liftM (m := IO) wire.close
  finally setEnv original

module

import CasRuntime.Kernel
import CasCompiler.Read
import LeanCategories.Catalogue
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Kernel
meta import CasCompiler.Read
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue

namespace CasRuntime.NamedApplicationTests

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the named-application source control did not parse"
  return ⟨parsed⟩

private def nativeTerm (text : String) : TermElabM Term := do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
    | throwError "the named-application native context did not parse"
  return ⟨parsed⟩

private def symbol (id : BindingId) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("ctor", "variable"), ("args", .arr #[toJson s!"{id.session}:{id.serial}"])]

private def descriptor (address : String) (arguments : Array Json) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson address), ("args", .arr arguments)]

private def withNamedSource (term : SourceTerm)
    (action : OpenContext → SourceSelectionScope Expr → Expr → MetaM α) : MetaM α :=
  term.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    action context (← term.selections.inContext context) expression

private def namedSelection (context : OpenContext) (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
    (expression : Expr) : MetaM (SourceSelection Expr) := do
  let some selected := selections.findAt? context expression.getAppFn
    | throwError "the named source lost its exact original typed binding"
  selected.specialize expression.getAppArgs

private def lower (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction) (term : SourceTerm) :
    MetaM ValueBinding :=
  withNamedSource term fun context selections expression =>
    kernel.run transaction context {} expression (selections := selections)

private def packet (transaction : CellTransaction) (value : ValueBinding) : MetaM Json := do
  let .ok (some packet) := (← transaction.view).packet? value
    | throwError "the named application did not retain its descriptor and actual arguments"
  return packet

-- Both the outer diagram and its first object contain the same registered presentation.
-- Its public runtime descriptor must contain the outer pair, including Z. The earlier X,Y
-- application is a proper argument, never a substitute for the outer application.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
  discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
  let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
  try
    let empty ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
    let source ← empty.assume `X (← nativeTerm "Type")
    let source ← source.assume `Y (← nativeTerm "Type")
    let source ← source.assume `Z (← nativeTerm "Type")
    let #[x, y, z] := source.context.entries
      | throwError "the nested presentation lost its three original source parameters"
    for (text, declaration, address) in #[
        ("(X × Y) × Z", ``CasCatalogue.Limits.Registration.setsProduct, "lim.sets.product"),
        ("(X ⊔ Y) ⊔ Z", ``CasCatalogue.Limits.Registration.setsCoproduct, "colim.sets.coproduct")] do
      let object ← source.read (← sourceTerm text)
      let some category := object.category
        | throwError "the nested presentation lost its selected category"
      let some selection := category.limit
        | throwError "the nested presentation lost its selected universal construction"
      unless selection.row == address && selection.declaration == declaration &&
          selection.category.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.sets) do
        throwError "the nested presentation changed its actual registered selection"
      withNamedSource object fun context selections value => do
        let selected ← namedSelection context selections value
        let some application ← sourceApplication? declaration selected
          | throwError "the nested presentation lost its exact original application"
        let some originalZ := context.bindings.find? (·.id == z.id)
          | throwError "the nested presentation lost the original Z"
        unless application.getAppArgs.back? == some originalZ.expression do
          throwError "the outer presentation took its arguments from the nested presentation"
        let some construction := selected.limit
          | throwError "the selected cone lost its exact original presentation"
        unless construction.source.interface.presentation.equal application do
          throwError "the selected apex and cone retained different original applications"
        checkWithKernel value
        -- The complete limit record cannot supply a missing original application.
        -- The fresh binder still denotes the unchanged, checked native apex.
        selections.withBinding owners.identities context
            { selected with originalApplication := none } fun context selections missing => do
          checkWithKernel missing
          let rejected : Option Exception ← try
            discard <| kernel.run transaction context {} missing (selections := selections)
            pure none
          catch error => pure (some error)
          let some rejected := rejected
            | throwError "lowering recovered a lost named application from a nested declaration"
          unless (← rejected.toMessageData.toString) ==
              "the named element lost its explicitly retained original application" do
            throw rejected
      let expected := descriptor address #[descriptor address #[symbol x.id, symbol y.id], symbol z.id]
      unless (← packet transaction (← lower kernel transaction object)) == expected do
        throwError "the nested construction's public descriptor changed its actual outer arguments"

      let source ← source.defineTerm `K object
      let source ← source.assume `X (← nativeTerm "Type")
      let retained ← source.read (← sourceTerm "K")
      unless (← packet transaction (← lower kernel transaction retained)) == expected do
        throwError "a retained construction changed its original application after shadowing"
      let leg ← source.read (← sourceTerm "K.leg(0)")
      withNamedSource leg fun context selections value => do
        let selected ← namedSelection context selections value
        let some application ← sourceApplication? declaration selected
          | throwError "the defining leg lost its original presentation application"
        let some originalZ := context.bindings.find? (·.id == z.id)
          | throwError "the defining leg lost its original final object"
        unless application.getAppArgs.back? == some originalZ.expression do
          throwError "the defining leg selected the nested presentation's arguments"
        checkWithKernel value
    unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
      throwError "retaining a named construction dispatched an external computation"
  finally
    discard <| transaction.abort
    kernel.close
    setEnv environment

-- Every named-element producer supplies the same typed application origin. These are
-- ordinary registered source forms; their descriptors need no provider or fabricated data.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
  discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
  let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
  try
    let source ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
    for (text, address) in #[
        ("3 in ℤ", "num.rings"),
        ("{1, 2} in 𝒫(ℤ)", "lit.sets.finite_subsets"),
        ("x in ℤ[x]", "obj.sets.polynomials#generator"),
        ("generator(ℤ[x])", "obj.sets.polynomials#generator")] do
      let term ← source.read (← sourceTerm text)
      let result ← lower kernel transaction term
      let actual ← packet transaction result
      unless (actual.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some address do
        throwError "`{text}` changed its registered named-element descriptor: {actual}"
    unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
      throwError "a named-element descriptor dispatched an external computation"
  finally
    discard <| transaction.abort
    kernel.close
    setEnv environment

-- The actual public source row is authoritative. A still well-typed native declaration
-- cannot replace a missing address or an address changed to another real registered row.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
  discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
  let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
  try
    let source ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
    let object ← source.read (← sourceTerm "Fin(3)")
    let other ← source.read (← sourceTerm "ℤ")
    let otherEntry ← withNamedSource other fun context selections expression => do
      let selected ← namedSelection context selections expression
      let some (.named (.registered (.inl entry) _)) := selected.reference
        | throwError "the independent address control is not a registered object"
      return entry
    let actual ← lower kernel transaction object
    unless ((← packet transaction actual).getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption ==
        some "obj.sets.fin" do
      throwError "the public finite object did not retain its independently registered address"
    withNamedSource object fun context selections expression => do
      let selected ← namedSelection context selections expression
      let some (.named (.registered (.inl entry) category)) := selected.reference
        | throwError "the actual public object lost its retained source selection"
      unless entry.id.raw == "obj.sets.fin" &&
          entry.declaration != otherEntry.declaration && !otherEntry.id.raw.isEmpty do
        throwError "the two original source objects do not have distinct registered declarations"
      let application := selected.value
      let throughLambda := fun (value : Expr) => do
        let function ← withLocalDeclD `unused (mkConst ``Unit) fun argument =>
          mkLambdaFVars #[argument] value (usedOnly := false)
        pure (mkApp function (mkConst ``Unit.unit))
      let throughIdentity := fun value => mkAppM ``id #[value]
      let selectedReference := SelectedSourceReference.named (.registered (.inl entry) category)
      selections.withBinding owners.identities context
          (sourceReference selectedReference application.getAppFn)
          fun headContext headSelections selectedHead => do
        let atHead := mkAppN selectedHead application.getAppArgs
        checkWithKernel atHead
        let selected ← kernel.run transaction headContext {} atHead (selections := headSelections)
        unless (← packet transaction selected) == (← packet transaction actual) do
          throwError "native application of the selected descriptor changed its original address"
      for (wrapped, message) in #[
          (← throughLambda expression, "native beta reduction changed the original selected descriptor"),
          (← throughIdentity expression, "native delta reduction changed the original selected descriptor")] do
        checkWithKernel wrapped
        let selected ← kernel.run transaction context {} wrapped (selections := selections)
        unless (← packet transaction selected) == (← packet transaction actual) do
          throwError message
      for unselected in #[application, ← throughLambda application,
          ← throughIdentity application] do
        checkWithKernel unselected
        let graph ← transaction.view
        let codeCount := (← kernel.codes.get).size
        let failed : Option Exception ← try
          discard <| kernel.run transaction context {} unselected (selections := selections)
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
        let some failed := failed
          | throwError "an unselected declaration acquired its address from the registry"
        unless (← failed.toMessageData.toString) ==
            s!"the registered source declaration {entry.declaration} lost its selected source address" do
          throw failed
        unless graph.sameRevision (← transaction.view) &&
            (← kernel.codes.get).size == codeCount do
          throwError "an unselected declaration published a replacement value or closure"
      for (broken, message) in #[
          ({ entry with id := ⟨""⟩ },
            "the selected source lost its unique original registered address"),
          ({ entry with id := otherEntry.id },
            "the selected source changed its complete independently registered row"),
          ({ entry with declaration := .anonymous },
            "the selected source changed its complete independently registered row")] do
        let reference := SelectedSourceReference.named (.registered (.inl broken) category)
        selections.withBinding owners.identities context
            { selected with reference := some reference } fun context selections whole =>
          selections.withBinding owners.identities context
              (sourceReference reference application.getAppFn) fun context selections selectedHead => do
            let head := mkAppN selectedHead application.getAppArgs
            for malformed in #[whole, head, ← throughLambda whole, ← throughLambda head,
                ← throughIdentity whole, ← throughIdentity head] do
              checkWithKernel malformed
              let graph ← transaction.view
              let codeCount := (← kernel.codes.get).size
              let failed : Option Exception ← try
                discard <| kernel.run transaction context {} malformed (selections := selections)
                pure none
              catch error => pure (some error)
              let some failed := failed
                | throwError "a lost source selection fell back to an address found in the registry"
              unless (← failed.toMessageData.toString) == message do throw failed
              unless graph.sameRevision (← transaction.view) &&
                  (← kernel.codes.get).size == codeCount do
                throwError "a malformed source selection published a replacement value or closure"
    unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
      throwError "a descriptor-address control dispatched an external computation"
  finally
    discard <| transaction.abort
    kernel.close
    setEnv environment

-- The public source records both the visible derived selection and the active native
-- declaration application. Native functor projection, method composition and lambda
-- specialization cannot turn an outer observation into an instruction to scan subterms.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) IdentitySupply.new
  let source ← SourceSession.empty identities
  for text in #["1 + 2 in ℤ", "0 in ℚ³", "|Fin(3)|",
      "view Fin(3) along «fun.sets.list»()"] do
    let term ← source.read (← sourceTerm text)
    withNamedSource term fun _ selections expression => do
      checkWithKernel expression
      let mut active := false
      for (_, selected) in selections.toList do
        let some reference := selected.reference | continue
        unless reference.computation?.isSome do continue
        active := true
        if let some application := selected.application then
          let .routedMethod family := application.family
            | throwError "`{text}` moved its active reference to an unrelated native family"
          let native := mkAppN
            (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams application.universes)
            (application.parameters ++ application.arguments)
          unless SourceSelection.exactlyMatches Expr.equal
              { value := native, reference := some reference }
              { value := native, reference := some (.method family.entry family.functor) } &&
              selected.originalApplication.any (·.equal native) do
            throwError "`{text}` changed its selected complete method or original application"
        else
          let some declaration := reference.declaration
            | throwError "`{text}` lost its selected native declaration"
          let actual := selected.originalApplication.getD selected.value
          unless actual.consumeMData.getAppFn.isConstOf declaration do
            throwError "`{text}` retained its active computation reference on a derived value"
      unless active do
        throwError "`{text}` lost its actual selected computation application"

end CasRuntime.NamedApplicationTests

-- The same inline named module is formed twice. Each native field's delayed code must
-- retain the exact ring occurrence in its own descriptor slot, before any later consumer
-- opens that code. Equal source expressions do not identify the two parameter occurrences.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let source ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
      let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term "RegularModule(ℤ)"
        | throwError "the inline named-record source did not parse"
      let checked ← source.read ⟨parsed⟩
      checked.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let selections ← checked.selections.inContext context
        let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let mut originals : Array ValueBinding := #[]
          for _ in [:2] do
            let value ← kernel.run transaction context {} expression (selections := selections)
            let graph ← transaction.view
            let some node := graph.find value.value
              | throwError "the named record lost its actual producing node"
            let .container packet := node.payload.data
              | throwError "the named record lost its complete descriptor"
            let #[argument] := packet.slots
              | throwError "the named record lost its original declaration argument"
            unless argument.path == #[.field "args", .index 0] &&
                argument.fieldIndex.isNone do
              throwError "the named record changed its declared argument position"
            let some fields := packet.fields
              | throwError "the named record lost its native stored fields"
            unless fields.size > 1 do
              throwError "the inline module control lost its dependent native record"
            for index in [:fields.size] do
              let field ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.project value index).mapError IO.userError
              let some fieldNode := graph.find field.value
                | throwError "the original native field is outside its producing graph"
              let .closure program _ := fieldNode.payload.data
                | throwError "the named native field lost its delayed original source"
              let some (.term code codeSelections) := (← kernel.codes.get)[program]?
                | throwError "the named native field lost its original source code"
              let retained ← withBindingContext graph context {} field fun context bound => do
                let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge
                  (← field.role.selections.inContext context) (← codeSelections.inContext context)
                boundContextReferences (some graph) context bound (← code.inContext context)
                  selections
              unless retained.any (fun selected =>
                  selected.value == argument.binding.value &&
                    selected.associationIds == argument.binding.associationIds) do
                throwError "the named native field did not retain its exact original argument slot"
              for other in originals do
                if retained.any (fun selected => selected.value == other.value) then
                  throwError "an equal inline source substituted another record's argument"
            if originals.any (fun previous => previous.value == argument.binding.value) then
              throwError "independent inline named records merged their original arguments"
            originals := originals.push argument.binding
          unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "retaining named source code dispatched mathematical computation"
        finally discard <| transaction.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

structure NativeMapRecord where
  domain : Type
  law : True
  target : Type
  arrow : domain → target

-- The whole W has no runtime binding. Only its actual earlier source-order fields
-- authorize the endpoint roles, including the intervening native proof position.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
  let occurrence ← owners.identities.fresh .occurrence
  withLocalDeclD `W (mkConst ``NativeMapRecord) fun w => do
    let identity ← owners.identities.fresh .sourceBinding
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[
      { id := ⟨identity.worker, identity.serial⟩, role := .result, expression := w }]
    let source ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close w)
    let layout ← RecordLayout.ofSource source
    let graph := ValueGraph.empty owners.identities
    let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker context #[] (some graph)
    let checkAt := fun (label : String) (action : MetaM Unit) => do
      try action
      catch failure => throwError "native field prefix {label}: {failure.toMessageData}"
    let packet := Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "finiteData"),
      ("args", .arr #[toJson "same endpoint bytes", .arr #[toJson (0 : Nat)]])]
    let record ← RecordPrefix.prepare owners.identities program occurrence layout graph environment.bound
    let firstPrefix ← record.currentField
    let firstOrigin ← firstPrefix.origin environment program occurrence graph
    let (graph, first) ← graph.stage owners.identities firstOrigin
      (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
    let (graph, other) ← graph.stage owners.identities firstOrigin
      (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
    checkAt "domain" do discard <| firstPrefix.checkResult environment graph first
    let originalFirst := first
    let (graph, record, first) ← record.bind graph first
    let sibling ← RecordPrefix.prepare owners.identities program occurrence layout graph environment.bound
    let (graph, _, siblingFirst) ← sibling.bind graph originalFirst
    unless first.value == siblingFirst.value &&
        first.associationIds != siblingFirst.associationIds &&
        other.value != first.value do
      throwError "native prefix controls lost their original endpoint occurrences"

    let targetPrefix ← record.currentField
    let #[frame] := targetPrefix.frames
      | throwError "the native target prefix lost its original declaration"
    unless frame.field.sourceIndex == 2 && frame.preceding.size == 2 &&
        (frame.preceding[1]?.bind id).isNone do
      throwError "native prefix preparation erased or filled an original proof slot"
    let targetOrigin ← targetPrefix.origin environment program occurrence graph
    let (graph, target) ← graph.stage owners.identities targetOrigin
      (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
    checkAt "target" do discard <| targetPrefix.checkResult environment graph target
    let (graph, record, target) ← record.bind graph target

    let arrowPrefix ← record.currentField
    let prepared ← try
        PreparedMapResult.forSource environment arrowPrefix.native graph
          first target (fieldPrefix := some arrowPrefix)
      catch failure => throwError "native field prefix codec: {failure.toMessageData}"
    unless prepared.source.value == first.value && prepared.target.value == target.value &&
        prepared.source.associationIds == first.associationIds &&
        prepared.target.associationIds == target.associationIds do
      throwError "native map framing replaced an original preceding field"
    for wrong in #[other, siblingFirst, target] do
      let rejected ← try
          discard <| PreparedMapResult.forSource environment arrowPrefix.native graph
            wrong target (fieldPrefix := some arrowPrefix)
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
      unless rejected do
        throwError "native map framing accepted another equal-data endpoint occurrence"

    -- This deliberately raw producer has no prefix evidence; ordinary typed origin
    -- construction requires the original prefix before this whole record exists.
    let rawOrigin : ValueOrigin := {
      program, occurrence, role := arrowPrefix.native, parameters := environment.values }
    let wrongOccurrence ← owners.identities.fresh .occurrence
    let wrongOriginRejected ← try
        discard <| arrowPrefix.attachOrigin { rawOrigin with occurrence := wrongOccurrence } graph
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
    unless wrongOriginRejected do
      throwError "a native prefix stamped a different original result occurrence"
    let (rawGraph, raw) ← graph.stage owners.identities rawOrigin
      (.closure program #[first, target])
    let rawRejected ← try
        discard <| arrowPrefix.checkResult environment rawGraph raw
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
    unless rawRejected do
      throwError "a consuming prefix supplied missing original producer evidence"

    let capturedOrigin ← arrowPrefix.origin environment program occurrence graph
    let (capturedGraph, capturedArrow) ← graph.stage owners.identities capturedOrigin
      (.closure program #[first, target])
    checkAt "typed producer prefix" do
      discard <| arrowPrefix.checkResult environment capturedGraph capturedArrow
    let missingPrefixRejected ← try
        discard <| graph.stage owners.identities { capturedOrigin with fieldPrefix := none }
          (.closure program #[first, target])
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
    unless missingPrefixRejected do
      throwError "a native field producer erased the prefix used for its type capture"

    let origin ← arrowPrefix.attachOrigin rawOrigin graph
    let (graph, arrow) ← graph.stage owners.identities origin (.closure program #[first, target])
    checkAt "callable" do discard <| arrowPrefix.checkResult environment graph arrow
    checkAt "standalone retained operand" do
      let admitted ← environment.checkOperand graph arrowPrefix.native arrow
      unless admitted.root.value == arrow.value &&
          admitted.root.associationIds == arrow.associationIds do
        throwError "native input admission replaced its original standalone field"
    let some producing := graph.find arrow.value
      | throwError "the original native field producer disappeared"
    unless producing.origin.parameters.size == context.bindings.size &&
        producing.origin.parameters.all (·.isNone) &&
        producing.origin.role.source.expression.equal rawOrigin.role.source.expression do
      throwError "native prefix staging fabricated a parent or rewrote its producing source"
    let (graph, record, _) ← record.bind graph arrow
    let payload ← IO.ofExcept <| record.finish.mapError IO.userError
    let (graph, whole) ← graph.stage owners.identities
      (← environment.origin program occurrence source) payload
    let admitted ← try environment.checkResult graph source whole
      catch failure => throwError "native field prefix whole record: {failure.toMessageData}"
    let retained ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.project admitted.root 2).mapError IO.userError
    unless retained.value == arrow.value &&
        arrow.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf retained.associationIds.toList do
      throwError "whole native record admission replaced its original callable field"
    let rootParameter ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph context.bindings[0]!.id admitted.root).mapError IO.userError
    let consumer ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker context #[rootParameter] (some graph)
    let consumed ← try consumer.checkResult graph arrowPrefix.native retained
      catch failure => throwError "native field prefix bound consumer: {failure.toMessageData}"
    unless consumed.root.value == arrow.value &&
        arrow.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf consumed.root.associationIds.toList do
      throwError "a native field consumer replaced its original producing occurrence"
    for wrong in #[other, siblingFirst] do
      let (badGraph, bad) ← graph.stage owners.identities
        (← environment.origin program occurrence source)
        (.product #[wrong, target, arrow])
      let rejected ← try
          discard <| environment.checkResult badGraph source bad
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
      unless rejected do
        throwError "whole native record admission replaced an original producer endpoint"
      let changedParentRejected ← try
          let parameter ← IO.ofExcept <|
            (RuntimeParameter.ofValue badGraph context.bindings[0]!.id bad).mapError IO.userError
          let changed ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker context #[parameter]
            (some badGraph)
          discard <| changed.checkResult badGraph arrowPrefix.native retained
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
      unless changedParentRejected do
        throwError "a native field consumer accepted a different actual parent dependency"

    let (unframedGraph, unframed) ← rawGraph.stage owners.identities
      (← environment.origin program occurrence source) (.product #[first, target, raw])
    let unframedRejected ← try
        discard <| environment.checkResult unframedGraph source unframed
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
    unless unframedRejected do
      throwError "whole native record admission supplied missing original field provenance"

    let checkRawRecord := fun (label : String) (nativeContext : OpenContext)
        (term : Expr) (accepted : Bool) => do
      let source ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← nativeContext.close term)
      let layout ← RecordLayout.ofSource source
      let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker nativeContext #[] (some graph)
      let mut currentGraph := graph
      let mut fields := #[]
      for prepared in layout.fields do
        unless prepared.field.wireIndex.isSome do continue
        let origin : ValueOrigin := {
          program, occurrence, role := prepared.layout, parameters := environment.values }
        let payload : ValuePayload := if prepared.layout.kind == .function then
          .closure program fields else .portable packet.compress.toUTF8
        let (next, field) ← currentGraph.stage owners.identities origin payload
        currentGraph := next
        fields := fields.push field
      let (checkedGraph, whole) ← currentGraph.stage owners.identities
        { program, occurrence, role := source, parameters := environment.values } (.product fields)
      let failure : Option Exception ← try
          discard <| environment.checkResult checkedGraph source whole
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
      if accepted then
        if let some failure := failure then
          throwError "native field prefix {label}: {failure.toMessageData}"
      else unless failure.isSome do
        throwError "native field prefix {label} admitted an unresolved computational parent"
    let closed ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(NativeMapRecord.mk (Fin 2) True.intro (Fin 2) (fun point => point))) none
    checkRawRecord "closed constructor" context closed true
    withLetDecl `closedRecord (mkConst ``NativeMapRecord) closed fun named => do
      let identity ← owners.identities.fresh .sourceBinding
      let nativeContext ← ContextTelescope.capture (context.bindings.push
        { id := ⟨identity.worker, identity.serial⟩, role := .definition, expression := named })
      checkRawRecord "closed definition" nativeContext named true
    withLocalDeclD `h (mkForall `input .default (mkConst ``NativeMapRecord)
        (mkConst ``NativeMapRecord)) fun function => do
      let identity ← owners.identities.fresh .sourceBinding
      let nativeContext ← ContextTelescope.capture (context.bindings.push
        { id := ⟨identity.worker, identity.serial⟩, role := .parameter, expression := function })
      checkRawRecord "open application" nativeContext (mkApp function w) false


structure NativeCallableRecord (domain target : Type) where
  apply : domain → target

structure NativeNestedMapRecord where
  domain : Type
  target : Type
  universal : NativeCallableRecord domain target

-- A standalone dependent record keeps its actual earlier fields when a later request
-- projects its callable. Another equal-source record cannot supply that continuation.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
  let occurrence ← owners.identities.fresh .occurrence
  withLocalDeclD `W (mkConst ``NativeNestedMapRecord) fun w => do
    let identity ← owners.identities.fresh .sourceBinding
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[
      { id := ⟨identity.worker, identity.serial⟩, role := .result, expression := w }]
    let source ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close w)
    let layout ← RecordLayout.ofSource source
    let graph := ValueGraph.empty owners.identities
    let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker context #[] (some graph)
    let packet := (toJson "same native field packet").compress.toUTF8
    let makeRecord := fun (graph : ValueGraph) => do
      let record ← RecordPrefix.prepare owners.identities program occurrence layout graph environment.bound
      let domainPrefix ← record.currentField
      let (graph, domain) ← graph.stage owners.identities
        (← domainPrefix.origin environment program occurrence graph) (.portable packet)
      let (graph, record, domain) ← record.bind graph domain
      let targetPrefix ← record.currentField
      let (graph, target) ← graph.stage owners.identities
        (← targetPrefix.origin environment program occurrence graph) (.portable packet)
      let (graph, record, target) ← record.bind graph target
      let universalPrefix ← record.currentField
      let (graph, universal) ← graph.stage owners.identities
        (← universalPrefix.origin environment program occurrence graph)
        (.closure program #[domain, target])
      let admitted ← universalPrefix.checkResult environment graph universal
      return (graph, admitted.root)
    let (graph, first) ← makeRecord graph
    let (graph, second) ← makeRecord graph
    let prepareCallable := fun (graph : ValueGraph) (parent : ValueBinding) => do
      let request ← try
          PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program
            (← owners.identities.fresh .occurrence) context graph parent 0 #[] (some environment)
        catch failure => throwError
          "standalone dependent record preparation: {failure.toMessageData}"
      let origin ← try request.originFor request.source (some graph)
        catch failure => throwError
          "standalone dependent record producing origin: {failure.toMessageData}"
      let (graph, callable) ← try
          graph.stage owners.identities origin (.closure program #[parent])
        catch failure => throwError
          "standalone dependent record staging: {failure.toMessageData}"
      return (graph, request, callable)
    let (graph, request, callable) ← prepareCallable graph first
    let accepted ← try request.admitResult graph callable
      catch failure => throwError "standalone dependent record projection: {failure.toMessageData}"
    unless accepted.root.value == callable.value do
      throwError "the native projection replaced its original callable occurrence"
    let (graph, _, other) ← prepareCallable graph second
    let some producer := graph.find callable.value
      | throwError "the native projection lost its actual producing node"
    let some captured := producer.origin.sourceDependencies
      | throwError "the native projection lost its checked type capture"
    let some (originalParent, path) := captured.projectedFrom
      | throwError "the native projection lost its original parent and path"
    unless originalParent.value == first.value &&
        originalParent.associationIds == first.associationIds &&
        path == #[``NativeCallableRecord.apply] do
      throwError "the native projection changed its exact original prefix anchor"
    let changedParentRejected ← try
        discard <| graph.stage owners.identities { producer.origin with access := some second }
          (.closure program #[second])
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
    unless changedParentRejected do
      throwError "a projected type capture accepted another equal-source parent"
    let rejected ← try
        discard <| request.admitResult graph other
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
    unless rejected do
      throwError "a native projection accepted another equal-source record's callable"
    let some selectedField := first.role.fields[0]?
      | throwError "the native callable record lost its original field"
    let fieldSource ← selectedField.toLayout
    let projection ← fieldSource.source.inContext context
    SourceSelectionScope.withBinding owners.identities {} context { value := projection }
        fun context selections selected => do
      let some selectedBinding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression.equal selected)
        | throwError "the native projection lost its explicitly selected source binder"
      let selectedRequest ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program
        (← owners.identities.fresh .occurrence) context graph first 0 #[] (some environment)
        selections (some selectedBinding.id)
      let selectedOrigin ← selectedRequest.originFor selectedRequest.source (some graph)
      let some selectedPrefix := selectedOrigin.fieldPrefix
        | throwError "the selected native projection lost its original producing prefix"
      unless selectedRequest.source.selectionBinding == some selectedBinding.id &&
          selectedPrefix.native.selectionBinding == some selectedBinding.id &&
          selectedPrefix.native.selections.contains selectedBinding.id do
        throwError "a native prefix lost its explicitly prepared source selection"
      let (graph, selectedCallable) ← graph.stage owners.identities selectedOrigin
        (.closure program #[first])
      let selectedAccepted ← selectedRequest.admitResult graph selectedCallable
      unless selectedAccepted.root.value == selectedCallable.value do
        throwError "a selected native projection replaced its actual callable occurrence"

end CasRuntime.NativeFieldPrefixTests

namespace CasRuntime

/-- An endpoint supplier is read only from this original native endpoint's context BindingId, or syntactic native projection spine. No expression/type search
selects a computational value, and no source definition or matcher is evaluated here. -/
private partial def nativeEndpointReference? (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (context : OpenContext) (source : Expr) (path : Array Name := #[]) :
    MetaM (Option (ValueBinding × Array Name)) := do
  if let .mdata data body := source then
    return ← nativeEndpointReference? environment context body path
  if let .fvar id := source then
    let some original := context.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == id)
      | throwError "a native endpoint is outside its original complete source context"
    let value ← IO.ofExcept <| (environment.lookup original.id).mapError IO.userError
    if value.isNone && original.role == .selectedStructure &&
        !environment.selections.contains original.id then
      throwError "the source lost its retained typed selection"
    if value.isNone && original.role == .result then
      throwError "the source lost a retained runtime binding"
    return value.map (fun value => (value, path))
  if let some selected ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? source then
    return ← nativeEndpointReference? environment context selected.parent
      (#[selected.declaration] ++ path)
  return none

/-- Read only an explicit original endpoint supplier or an already authenticated native
projection access. A source expression such as a new functor image has no binding here;
its native dependency constraints remain with the caller's transient interface check. -/
opaque RuntimeEnvironment.endpointValue? (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (context : OpenContext) (graph : ValueGraph) (source : Expr) :
    MetaM (Option ValueBinding) := do
  let some (parent, path) ← nativeEndpointReference? environment context source | return none
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners #[parent]).mapError IO.userError
  if path.isEmpty then return some parent
  let some access ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (graph.projectedAccess? parent path).mapError IO.userError | return none
  let some baseline ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (graph.projectionBasis access parent path).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "an original endpoint access lost its exact native parent/path"
  unless baseline.value == access.value &&
      baseline.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf access.associationIds.toList do
    throwError "an original endpoint access changed its retained value occurrence"
  return some access

/-- Reuse an original stored native endpoint path. Publishing its access uses the ordinary
intrinsic projection preparation/association boundary, as fixed-input result assembly does.
The original baseline stays unchanged; lazy fields are not executed during reply admission. -/
private def retainNativeEndpoint (request : PreparedRequest) (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (context : OpenContext) (supply : IdentitySupply) (parent : ValueBinding) (path : Array Name)
    (draft : CellDraft) : MetaM (CellDraft × ValueBinding) := do
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (draft.view.requiredOwners #[parent]).mapError IO.userError
  if path.isEmpty then return (draft, parent)
  if let some access ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (draft.view.projectedAccess? parent path).mapError IO.userError then
    return (draft, access)
  let some (baseline, remaining) ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (draft.view.projectionFrontier parent path).mapError IO.userError
    | throwStratum .noImplementation "the original native endpoint has no stored field interface"
  unless remaining.isEmpty do
    throwStratum .noImplementation "the original native endpoint requires its retained field demand"
  let mut parameters := #[]
  for entry in environment.context.entries, value in environment.values do
    if let some value := value then
      parameters := parameters.push (← IO.ofExcept <|
        (RuntimeParameter.ofValue draft.view entry.id value).mapError IO.userError)
  let projection ← PreparedRequest.forStoredProjection supply request.program
    (← supply.fresh .occurrence) context draft.view parent path parameters (some environment)
    (selections := ← environment.selections.inContext context)
  let projection := projection.withSourceSnapshot request.observation.sourceSnapshot
  let (draft, access) ← projection.associateResult supply projection.source draft
    baseline #[] (complete := true)
  discard <| projection.admitResult draft.view access
  let some retained ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (draft.view.projectionBasis access parent path).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "the native endpoint lost its original stored projection basis"
  unless retained.value == baseline.value &&
      retained.associationIds == baseline.associationIds &&
      access.value == baseline.value &&
      baseline.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf access.associationIds.toList do
    throwError "native endpoint admission changed its original field occurrence"
  return (draft, access)

/-- Retain each independently supplied endpoint of this original native function. A known
domain remains fixed when the target is absent or depends on the argument. Absence means
only that the source grammar supplied no value; missing original bindings, changed parents and failed
native admission remain errors. No finite inventory or source value is reconstructed. -/
opaque nativeFunctionEndpoints? (request : PreparedRequest)
    (environment : RuntimeEnvironment) (native : SourceLayout) (supply : IdentitySupply)
    (draft : CellDraft) (fieldPrefix : Option NativeFieldPrefix := none) :
    MetaM (CellDraft × Option ValueBinding × Option ValueBinding) := do
  unless native.kind == .function do
    throwError "function endpoint preparation requires its original native function role"
  let environment ← environment.withGraph (some draft.view)
  environment.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    native.source.context.withInContext context fun context => do
      let inspect := fun (context : OpenContext) (type : Expr)
          (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding) => do
        let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge (← environment.selections.inContext context)
          (← native.selections.inContext context)
        let current ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound environment.worker context bound draft.view
          (selections := selections)
        let (source, target) ← nativeFunctionEndpointTypes type
        let retain := fun (endpoint : Expr) (draft : CellDraft) => do
          let some (parent, path) ← nativeEndpointReference? current context endpoint
            | return (draft, none)
          let (draft, value) ← retainNativeEndpoint request current context supply parent path draft
          let retained ← match fieldPrefix with
            | some nativePrefix =>
              nativePrefix.checkEndpoint current context draft.view endpoint value
            | none => pure false
          unless retained do
            current.checkDeclaredInput context draft.view endpoint value
          return (draft, some value)
        let (draft, source) ← retain source draft
        let (draft, target) ← match target with
          | some target => retain target draft
          | none => pure (draft, none)
        return (draft, source, target)
      match fieldPrefix with
      | some nativePrefix =>
        discard <| IO.ofExcept <|
          (nativePrefix.requireOrigin request.program request.occurrence native).mapError IO.userError
        nativePrefix.withBoundType context draft.view environment.bound inspect
      | none =>
        let expression ← native.source.inContext context
        inspect context (← inferType expression) environment.bound

/-- The actual suppliers of this independently selected native Hom's endpoint slots.
Constructor ports supply their prefix environment; nested maps supply their own native role.
This is a source-directed read of exact retained positions, never endpoint reconstruction. -/
opaque PreparedMapResult.fromNative (request : PreparedRequest)
    (environment : RuntimeEnvironment) (native : SourceLayout) (supply : IdentitySupply)
    (draft : CellDraft) (checkSymbolic : Option PreparedSymbolicCheck := none)
    (fieldPrefix : Option NativeFieldPrefix := none) :
    MetaM (CellDraft × PreparedMapResult) := do
  let environment ← environment.withGraph (some draft.view)
  environment.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    native.source.context.withInContext context fun context => do
      let inspect := fun (context : OpenContext) (expression : Expr)
          (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding) => do
        let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge (← environment.selections.inContext context)
          (← native.selections.inContext context)
        let current ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound environment.worker context bound draft.view
          (selections := selections)
        let (source, target) ← nativeMapEndpoints expression
        let some (sourceParent, sourcePath) ← nativeEndpointReference? current context source
          | throwStratum .noImplementation "the native map source has no retained original supplier"
        let some (targetParent, targetPath) ← nativeEndpointReference? current context target
          | throwStratum .noImplementation "the native map target has no retained original supplier"
        let (draft, source) ← retainNativeEndpoint request current context supply sourceParent
          sourcePath draft
        let (draft, target) ← retainNativeEndpoint request current context supply targetParent
          targetPath draft
        let prepared ← PreparedMapResult.forSource current native draft.view source target
          none none none #[] checkSymbolic (fieldPrefix := fieldPrefix)
        return (draft, prepared)
      match fieldPrefix with
      | none => inspect context (← native.source.inContext context) environment.bound
      | some nativePrefix =>
        discard <| IO.ofExcept <|
          (nativePrefix.requireOrigin request.program request.occurrence native).mapError IO.userError
        nativePrefix.withBoundType context draft.view environment.bound fun context type bound =>
          withLocalDeclD `nativeMap type fun expression => inspect context expression bound

end CasRuntime
