private def failAt (stratum : Stratum) (action : MetaM Unit) : MetaM Unit := do
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    action
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure | throwError "the negative named-point control was accepted"
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some stratum do throw failure

private def prepare (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction) (context : OpenContext)
    (callable point : ValueBinding) (pointSource : Expr)
    (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding := {})
    (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr := {}) :
    MetaM (PreparedRequest × PreparedPointInvocation) := do
  withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound pointSource point fun context bound pointSource => do
    let graph ← transaction.view
    let .ok code := graph.callable callable
      | throwError "the named point callable is outside its actual graph"
    let some node := graph.find code.value
      | throwError "the named point callable lost its original code"
    let .closure program _ := node.payload.data
      | throwError "the named point callable is not its retained native source"
    let some (.family family path) := (← kernel.codes.get)[program]?
      | throwError "the named point callable was replaced by a source computation"
    let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 point
      | throwError "the named point operand is outside its actual graph"
    let mut parameters := #[]
    for binding in context.bindings do
      if let some value := bound[binding.id]? then
        parameters := parameters.push (← IO.ofExcept <|
          (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id value).mapError IO.userError)
    let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication kernel.ledger.owners.identities program
      (← kernel.ledger.allocate) context callable #[← context.close pointSource] #[argument]
      parameters (some graph) (selections := selections)
    let evaluate : SourceEvaluation := fun cell _ current bound selections source =>
      kernel.run cell current bound source (selections := selections)
    let some invocation ← PreparedPointInvocation.prepare? kernel evaluate request family path transaction
      | throwError "the original named point action did not prepare its published packet"
    return (request, invocation)

-- The native source supplies the original numeral map and all endpoint families. The complete
-- packet and scoped child use the production kernel, without a provider or substitute answer.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let connection ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      for declaration in #[
          ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.PolynomialPresentations.firstConstants,
          ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.PolynomialPresentations.secondConstants] do
        let #[entry] := (← semanticState).morphisms.filter (·.declaration == declaration)
          | throwError "an original F9 constants map is not uniquely registered"
        let family ← PointFamily.forEntry entry
        let readInputs : SourceReadM (Expr × Expr × NativeSourcePointOrigin) := do
          let rawArrow := mkConst declaration
          let arrowSource ← SourceReadM.select (← family.selected rawArrow.constLevels! #[] rawArrow)
          let callableSource ← family.function arrowSource
          let (source, _) ← family.endpoints rawArrow
          let pointSource ← sourceNumeral (fun _ => pure none) 2 source
          let some selected ← SourceReadM.selection? pointSource
            | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source numeral lost its exact selected binder"
          let some pointOrigin := selected.pointOrigin
            | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the source numeral lost its independently supplied point map"
          return (callableSource, pointSource, pointOrigin)
        readInputs.runK { identities := owners.identities, context, selections := {} }
            fun (callableSource, pointSource, pointOrigin) sourceScope => do
          let context := sourceScope.context
          let selections := sourceScope.selections
          let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
          let callable ← kernel.run producer context {} callableSource (selections := selections)
          let point ← kernel.run producer context {} pointSource (selections := selections)
          let .ok _ ← producer.commit
            | throwError "the original named point inputs could not publish"
          let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
          try
            let (request, invocation) ← prepare kernel transaction context callable point pointSource (selections := selections)
            unless invocation.operation == entry.id.raw && invocation.parameters.isEmpty &&
                invocation.argument.value == point.value &&
                invocation.argument.associationIds == point.associationIds do
              throwError "the named point action changed its released identity or original argument"
            do
              unless invocation.preparation == request.roles.scope do
                throwError "the named point lost its original complete request preparation"
              let rejectPreparation (action : MetaM Unit) : MetaM Unit := do
                let failure : Option Exception ← try
                  action
                  pure none
                catch error => pure (some error)
                let some failure := failure
                  | throwError "a named point accepted a different request preparation"
                unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag (· == requestPreparationMismatchTag) do throw failure
              let otherPoint ← kernel.run transaction context {} pointSource (selections := selections)
              unless otherPoint.value != point.value do
                throwError "the named-point scope control merged separate equal operands"
              let graph ← transaction.view
              let rebuild := fun (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence) (value : ValueBinding) =>
                withBoundValue owners.identities context {} pointSource value fun context bound source => do
                  let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 value
                    | throwError "the named-point scope control lost its original operand"
                  let mut parameters := #[]
                  for binding in context.bindings do
                    if let some value := bound[binding.id]? then
                      parameters := parameters.push (← IO.ofExcept <|
                        (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id value).mapError IO.userError)
                  PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities request.program occurrence context
                    callable #[← context.close source] #[argument] parameters (some graph)
                    (selections := selections)
              let otherRequest ← rebuild (← kernel.ledger.allocate) otherPoint
              let rebuilt ← rebuild request.occurrence point
              unless otherRequest.occurrence != request.occurrence &&
                  rebuilt.occurrence == request.occurrence && rebuilt.roles.scope != request.roles.scope do
                throwError "the named-point scope control lost its independent preparations"
              let .ok code := graph.callable callable
                | throwError "the named-point scope control lost its actual callable"
              let some node := graph.find code.value
                | throwError "the named-point scope control lost its retained code"
              let .closure program _ := node.payload.data
                | throwError "the named-point scope control has no family closure"
              let some (.family originalFamily fieldPath) := (← kernel.codes.get)[program]?
                | throwError "the named-point scope control lost its original family"
              let .primitive boundary levels := originalFamily.action
                | throwError "the named-point scope control changed its native family"
              unless originalFamily.application.isNone && originalFamily.scope.isEmpty do
                throwError "the named-point scope control unexpectedly has declaration parameters"
              let otherFamily ← PreparedRequest.forBoundary owners.identities originalFamily.program
                originalFamily.occurrence boundary levels context #[] #[] #[] #[] (selections := selections)
              unless otherFamily.occurrence == originalFamily.occurrence &&
                  otherFamily.roles.scope != originalFamily.roles.scope do
                throwError "the named-point scope control reused its original family preparation"
              let beforeRejection ← transaction.view
              let evaluate : SourceEvaluation := fun cell _ current bound selections expression =>
                kernel.run cell current bound expression (selections := selections)
              rejectPreparation do
                discard <| PreparedPointInvocation.prepare? kernel evaluate request otherFamily
                  fieldPath transaction
              let registration : Registration := {
                operation := entry.id.raw, input := entry.id.raw, backend := "scope-control" }
              for wrong in #[otherRequest, rebuilt] do
                rejectPreparation do
                  discard <| kernel.invokePoint evaluate wrong transaction registration invocation
                unless (← kernel.ledger.pendingFor wrong.occurrence transaction.id).isNone do
                  throwError "a rejected named-point preparation reserved a dispatch"
              unless (← transaction.view).sameRevision beforeRejection &&
                  (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                throwError "a rejected named-point preparation published or dispatched"
            let graph ← transaction.view
            withBindingContext graph context {} invocation.domain fun context _ => do
              context.withOriginalSources #[← invocation.domain.selectedSource context, pointOrigin.domain]
                  fun native => do
                unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
                  throwError "the point packet guessed a domain instead of retaining its native source"
            let .ok (encoded, packet) := invocation.encode graph connection.generation
              | throwError "the complete original named point could not encode"
            let .ok decoded := PointInvocation.decode packet
              | throwError "the named point did not use the public seven-field envelope"
            unless decoded.operation == entry.id.raw && decoded.parameters.isEmpty &&
                (decoded.arrow.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some entry.id.raw &&
                (decoded.source.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "obj.sets.integers_mod" do
              throwError "the point packet changed its released arrow or authored source alias"
            for root in invocation.roots do
              let some retained := encoded.inputs.find? (·.path == root.path)
                | throwError "the point packet lost an original root authority"
              unless retained.binding.value == root.binding.value &&
                  retained.binding.associationIds == root.binding.associationIds do
                throwError "the point packet replaced an input by a descriptor value node"
            let identity : DispatchIdentity := {
              manifestDigest := "native-point-scope-control"
              profileDigest := "no-providers"
              registration := {
                operation := entry.id.raw
                input := entry.id.raw
                backend := "scope-control" } }
            let .ok reservation ← transaction.reserve request.occurrence identity connection
                invocation.dependencies
              | throwError "the original named point scope could not reserve its actual inputs"
            let scope ← RequestScope.issue kernel.ledger reservation graph encoded.slots encoded.inputs #[]
            try
              let arrowReference := ScopedReference.input #[.field "args", .index 2]
              let #[retainedArrow] ← scope.resolveMany reservation graph scope.wireId #[arrowReference]
                | throwError "the named descriptor lost its original arrow scope authority"
              unless retainedArrow.value == invocation.arrow.value &&
                  retainedArrow.associationIds == invocation.arrow.associationIds do
                throwError "an arrow-root reference resolved a new descriptor node"
              let reference := fun index =>
                (ScopedReference.input #[.field "args", .index index]).encode
              let child : PointInvocation := {
                operation := entry.id.raw, parameters := #[], arrow := reference 2,
                domain := reference 3, source := reference 4,
                target := reference 5, argument := reference 6 }
              let observed ← IO.mkRef false
              let evaluate : SourceEvaluation := fun cell _ current bound selections source => do
                let .app _ argument := source.consumeMData
                  | return ← kernel.run cell current bound source (selections := selections)
                let some selected := selections.findAt? current argument.getAppFn
                  | return ← kernel.run cell current bound source (selections := selections)
                let selected ← selected.specialize argument.getAppArgs
                let some (.named original actual) := selected.pointRequest
                  | return ← kernel.run cell current bound source (selections := selections)
                unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.application family).exactlyMatches
                    (.application original) do
                  throwError "the named child changed its original selected point family"
                for term in #[actual.domain, actual.source, actual.target, actual.point],
                    expected in #[invocation.domain, invocation.source, invocation.target, point] do
                  let .fvar localId := term.consumeMData
                    | throwError "the named child replaced a supplied original input"
                  let some binding := current.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == localId)
                    | throwError "the named child has no actual typed input binder"
                  let some value := bound[binding.id]?
                    | throwError "the named child input is outside its retained table"
                  unless value.value == expected.value &&
                      value.associationIds == expected.associationIds do
                    throwError "the named child substituted another equal source input"
                observed.set true
                kernel.run cell current bound source (selections := selections)
              failAt .noImplementation do
                discard <| kernel.child evaluate request transaction reservation scope
                  (Json.mkObj [("op", toJson entry.id.raw), ("args", child.encode)])
              unless ← observed.get do
                throwError "the named child bypassed common typed source lowering"
            finally scope.retire
          finally discard <| transaction.abort
      unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "the named point controls dispatched a mathematical provider"
    finally
      kernel.close
      owners.close connection.generation
  finally setEnv original

-- A complete named-arrow descriptor uses every original declared parameter slot, including
-- repeated aliases. Distinct released families with the same endpoints remain distinct.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let #[groupEntry] := (← semanticState).objects.filter
      (·.declaration == ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.FiniteGroups.symmetric)
      | throwError "the original symmetric-group source has no unique declared row"
    let #[groupCategory] := (← semanticState).categories.filter (·.id == groupEntry.category)
      | throwError "the original symmetric group lost its complete registered category"
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let connection ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        let readGroup : SourceReadM Expr := do
          return (← registeredExpressions (.inl groupEntry) groupCategory
            (fun function _ => pure (mkAppN function #[mkNatLit 3]))).2
        readGroup.runK { identities := owners.identities, context, selections := {} } fun groupSource sourceScope => do
          let context := sourceScope.context
          let selections := sourceScope.selections
          let group ← kernel.run transaction context {} groupSource (selections := selections)
          controlAt MetaM fun run =>
            withBoundValue owners.identities context {} groupSource group fun context bound selected => run do
              let readArrows : SourceReadM (Array Expr) := do
                let mut sources := #[]
                for (declaration, arguments) in #[
                    (``CasCatalogue.Algebra.FiniteGroups.identity, #[selected]),
                    (``CasCatalogue.Algebra.FiniteGroups.trivial, #[selected, selected])] do
                  let #[entry] := (← semanticState).morphisms.filter (·.declaration == declaration)
                    | liftM (m := TermElabM) <|
                        throwError "the original named-arrow source has no unique declared row"
                  let family ← PointFamily.forEntry entry
                  let arrow ← mkAppM declaration arguments
                  sources := sources.push (← SourceReadM.select
                    (← family.selected arrow.getAppFn.constLevels! arrow.getAppArgs arrow))
                return sources
              readArrows.runK { identities := owners.identities, context, selections } fun sources sourceScope => do
                let context := sourceScope.context
                let selections := sourceScope.selections
                let #[identitySource, trivialSource] := sources
                  | throwError "the original named-arrow controls lost their complete source table"
                unless ← isDefEq (← inferType identitySource) (← inferType trivialSource) do
                  throwError "the family-identity control did not retain equal declared endpoints"
                let identity ← kernel.run transaction context bound identitySource
                  (selections := selections)
                let trivial ← kernel.run transaction context bound trivialSource
                  (selections := selections)
                let graph ← transaction.view
                let codes ← kernel.codes.get
                let some first ← InputDescriptorView.namedMorphism? graph codes identity
                  | throwError "the original identity arrow has no checked named descriptor"
                let some second ← InputDescriptorView.namedMorphism? graph codes trivial
                  | throwError "the original trivial arrow has no checked named descriptor"
                let some firstFamily := first.family
                  | throwError "the identity arrow lost its original family"
                let some secondFamily := second.family
                  | throwError "the trivial arrow lost its original family"
                unless firstFamily.reference != secondFamily.reference &&
                    first.binding.value == identity.value && second.binding.value == trivial.value &&
                    second.parameters.size == 2 do
                  throwError "equal endpoints merged distinct named-arrow sources"
                let some (.morphism firstId) := firstFamily.reference
                  | throwError "the identity arrow lost its released morphism address"
                failAt .malformed do
                  discard <| InputDescriptorView.requireMorphism graph codes trivial firstId
                for value in second.parameters do
                  unless value.value == group.value && value.associationIds == group.associationIds do
                    throwError "the named arrow reconstructed an equal parameter instead of its original input"
                let views ← InputDescriptorView.collect graph codes #[trivial]
                let root : InputPosition := { path := #[.field "arrow"], binding := trivial }
                let .ok encoded := graph.encodeInputs connection.generation #[root] views
                  | throwError "the parameterized named arrow could not encode"
                for index in [:2] do
                  let path := #[.field "arrow", .field "args", .index index]
                  let some retained := encoded.inputs.find? (·.path == path)
                    | throwError "the named arrow lost a complete parameter root"
                  unless retained.binding.value == group.value &&
                      retained.binding.associationIds == group.associationIds do
                    throwError "a named arrow parameter root changed its original binding"
                unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                  throwError "the named arrow codec control invoked a mathematical provider"
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
    finally
      kernel.close
      owners.close connection.generation
  finally setEnv original

-- A named arrow's parameter is an actual chosen endpoint, even when another object has the
-- same declared family and scalar data. Reuse the original numeral map and original arrow;
-- changing only the supplied endpoint must fail before any provider can observe the request.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let #[entry] := (← semanticState).morphisms.filter (·.declaration ==
        ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.FiniteGroups.identity)
      | throwError "the existing group identity family is not uniquely registered"
    let #[groupEntry] := (← semanticState).objects.filter
      (·.declaration == ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.FiniteGroups.cyclic)
      | throwError "the original cyclic-group source has no unique declared row"
    let #[groupCategory] := (← semanticState).categories.filter (·.id == groupEntry.category)
      | throwError "the original cyclic group lost its complete registered category"
    let family ← PointFamily.forEntry entry
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        let parameter ← kernel.run transaction context {} (mkNatLit 2)
        controlAt MetaM fun run =>
          withBoundValue owners.identities context {} (mkNatLit 2) parameter fun context bound selectedParameter => run do
            let readGroups : SourceReadM (Expr × Expr) := do
              let (_, first) ← registeredExpressions (.inl groupEntry) groupCategory
                (fun function _ => pure (mkAppN function #[selectedParameter]))
              let (_, other) ← registeredExpressions (.inl groupEntry) groupCategory
                (fun function _ => pure (mkAppN function #[selectedParameter]))
              return (first, other)
            readGroups.runK { identities := owners.identities, context, selections := {} } fun (firstSource, otherSource) sourceScope => do
              let context := sourceScope.context
              let selections := sourceScope.selections
              let first ← kernel.run transaction context bound firstSource (selections := selections)
              let other ← kernel.run transaction context bound otherSource (selections := selections)
              unless first.value != other.value do
                throwError "the endpoint control did not retain two distinct supplied objects"
              controlAt MetaM fun run =>
                withBoundValue owners.identities context bound firstSource first fun context bound firstSource => run do
                  controlAt MetaM fun run =>
                    withBoundValue owners.identities context bound otherSource other fun context bound otherSource => run do
                      let nativeArrow ← mkAppM entry.declaration #[firstSource]
                      let selectedArrow ← family.selected nativeArrow.getAppFn.constLevels!
                        nativeArrow.getAppArgs nativeArrow
                      selections.withBinding owners.identities context selectedArrow fun context selections arrowSource => do
                        let arrow ← kernel.run transaction context bound arrowSource
                          (selections := selections)
                        controlAt MetaM fun run =>
                          withBoundValue owners.identities context bound arrowSource arrow fun context bound arrowSource => run do
                            let callable ← kernel.run transaction context bound
                              (← family.function arrowSource) (selections := selections)
                            let carrier ← mkAppM ``CasCatalogue.Foundation.Objects.integersMod #[selectedParameter]
                            let readPoint : SourceReadM (Expr × SourceSelection Expr) := do
                              let pointSource ← sourceNumeral (fun _ => pure none) 0 carrier
                              let some selection ← SourceReadM.selection? pointSource
                                | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the endpoint control lost its original point binder"
                              return (pointSource, { selection with value := pointSource })
                            readPoint.runK { identities := owners.identities, context, selections }
                                fun (pointSource, pointSelection) sourceScope => do
                              let context := sourceScope.context
                              let selections := sourceScope.selections
                              let some origin := pointSelection.pointOrigin
                                | throwError "the endpoint control lost its original numeral point map"
                              let point ← kernel.run transaction context bound pointSource
                                (selections := selections)
                              let exact ← family.withRequest arrowSource origin.domain firstSource firstSource
                                pointSelection (context := some context)
                              selections.withBinding owners.identities context exact fun context selections exact => do
                                let (_, invocation) ← prepare kernel transaction context callable point exact bound
                                  (selections := selections)
                                unless invocation.source.value == first.value && invocation.target.value == first.value &&
                                    invocation.source.associationIds == first.associationIds &&
                                    invocation.target.associationIds == first.associationIds do
                                  throwError "the named point packet changed its original chosen endpoint"
                                let changed ← family.withRequest arrowSource origin.domain otherSource firstSource
                                  pointSelection (context := some context)
                                selections.withBinding owners.identities context changed fun context selections changed => do
                                  let failure : Option Exception ← try
                                    discard <| prepare kernel transaction context callable point changed bound
                                      (selections := selections)
                                    pure none
                                  catch error => pure (some error)
                                  let some failure := failure
                                    | throwError "the named point action accepted a different equal endpoint node"
                                  unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag
                                      (· == `CasRuntime.RuntimeEnvironment.sourceReferenceMismatch) do
                                    throw failure
                                  unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                                    throwError "the original endpoint control dispatched a mathematical provider"
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- Framing remains the public parser's exact seven fields; it supplies no point interpretation.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let packet : PointInvocation := {
    operation := "mor.groups.identity"
    parameters := #[]
    arrow := .null
    domain := .null
    source := .null
    target := .null
    argument := .null
  }
  let .ok fields := (packet.encode.getObjVal? "args").bind (·.getArr?)
    | throwError "the public point encoder lost its ordered input packet"

        (Json.mkObj [("ctor", "apply"), ("args", .arr fields)])).isOk then

-- The public zero source lowers to its exact published operation demand. The
-- opaque original inputs carry no fields or answer; the observer returns no result.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let nativeTerm : String → TermElabM Term := fun text => do
    let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `term text
      | throwError "the native nullary input did not parse"
    return ⟨source⟩
  let sourceTerm : String → TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := fun text => do
    let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
      | throwError "the public nullary source did not parse"
    return ⟨source⟩
  let originalEnvironment ← getEnv
  try
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let connection ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let empty ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
      let session ← empty.assume `R (← nativeTerm "RingCat.{0}")
      let ring ← session.term (← nativeTerm "R")
      let category ← session.namedCategory Syntax.missing "Modules" [.zero, .zero] #[ring]
      let session ← session.assume `raw (← nativeTerm "ModuleCat.{0} R")
      let raw ← session.term (← nativeTerm "raw")
      let session ← session.defineTerm `M
        (← raw.inCategory category.expression category.value)
      let point ← session.read (← sourceTerm "0 in M")
      point.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let selections ← point.selections.inContext context
        let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
        let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let some ringEntry := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `R)
            | throwError "the nullary input lost its original ring declaration"
          let some moduleEntry := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `M)
            | throwError "the nullary input lost its original module declaration"
          let some ringSource := bindings.find? (·.id == ringEntry.id)
            | throwError "the nullary input lost its original ring binding"
          let some moduleSource := bindings.find? (·.id == moduleEntry.id)
            | throwError "the nullary input lost its original module binding"
          let ringRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close ringSource.expression)
          let ringRole := { ringRole with
            selections := point.selections
            selectionBinding := if selections.contains ringSource.id then some ringSource.id else none }
          let moduleRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close moduleSource.expression)
          let moduleRole := { moduleRole with
            selections := point.selections
            selectionBinding := if selections.contains moduleSource.id then some moduleSource.id else none }
          let ring ← transaction.stage
            { program, occurrence := ← kernel.ledger.allocate,
              role := ringRole,
              parameters := Array.replicate bindings.size none }
            (.ownedExport connection "original nullary scalar" #[])
          let .ok parameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue
              (← transaction.view) ringSource.id ring
            | throwError "the nullary runtime scalar is outside its original graph"
          let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.identities.worker
            context #[parameter] (selections := selections)
          let moduleValue ← transaction.stage
            (← environment.origin program (← kernel.ledger.allocate)
              moduleRole)
            (.ownedExport connection "original nullary module" #[ring])
          let observed ← IO.mkRef false
          let observe : PFunctor.Handler.Stateful MetaM CellTransaction
              OperationalSignature := fun request _ => do
            unless request.reference == some (.operation ⟨"op.modules.zero"⟩) do
              throwError "the public nullary value emitted another demand before its operation"
            let some application := request.origin.application
              | throwError "the nullary operation demand lost its native argument telescope"
            let #[some actualRing, some actualModule] := application.arguments
              | throwError "the nullary operation changed its complete original argument slots"
            unless actualRing.value == ring.value &&
                actualRing.associationIds == ring.associationIds do
              throwError "the nullary operation changed its original scalar reference"
            unless actualModule.value == moduleValue.value &&
                moduleValue.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf actualModule.associationIds.toList do
              throwError "the nullary operation changed its original module reference"
            -- The empty source route applies its declared identity functor to M. Accept
            -- only that one consuming application over the complete original references.
            let some identityCall := actualModule.applications.back?
              | throwError "the nullary module lost its declared identity application"
            unless actualModule.associationIds ==
                moduleValue.associationIds.push identityCall.association.id &&
                identityCall.association.path.isEmpty && identityCall.access.isNone &&
                identityCall.callable.isSome do
              throwError "the nullary module acquired another consuming association"
            let #[some originalModule] := identityCall.arguments
              | throwError "the nullary identity application changed its original input slots"
            unless originalModule.value == moduleValue.value &&
                originalModule.associationIds == moduleValue.associationIds do
              throwError "the nullary identity application replaced its original module"
            let #[originalArgument] := identityCall.association.layout.arguments
              | throwError "the nullary identity family changed its declared argument telescope"
            let sourceArgument ← originalArgument.source.source.inContext context
            unless sourceArgument.consumeMData == moduleSource.expression do
              throwError "the nullary identity application changed its original source binding"
            let some scalarPosition :=
                identityCall.association.layout.result.source.context.entries.findIdx?
                  (·.id == ringSource.id)
              | throwError "the nullary identity application lost its original scalar context"
            let some originalRing := identityCall.applicationParameters[scalarPosition]?.bind id
              | throwError "the nullary identity application lost its actual scalar parameter"
            unless originalRing.value == ring.value &&
                originalRing.associationIds == ring.associationIds do
              throwError "the nullary identity application replaced its original scalar"
            let some selected ← identityCall.association.layout.inputProjectionAt #[]
              | throwError "the nullary identity family lost its original input selection"
            let .argument 0 := selected.target
              | throwError "the nullary identity family selected another source input"
            unless selected.path.isEmpty do
              throwError "the nullary identity family selected a module field"
            let bundle ← category.value.source.inContext context
            let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[bundle]
            let structureValue ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.str #[bundle]
            let identityFunctor ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.id
              #[some carrier, some structureValue]
            let identityAction ← mkProjection identityFunctor `obj
            let family ← identityCall.association.layout.resultTermFamily.inContext context
            unless (← isDefEq (← inferType family) (← inferType identityAction)) &&
                (← isDefEq family identityAction) do
              throwError "the nullary module association changed its whole native identity family"
            observed.set true
            throwError "observed the original nullary operation demand"
          let bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding :=
            ({} : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
              |>.insert ringSource.id ring |>.insert moduleSource.id moduleValue
          let failure : Option Exception ← try
              discard <| lowerTerm {
                ledger := kernel.ledger, transaction, codes := kernel.codes
                run := fun computation => Execute.run observe computation transaction }
                program context bound expression (selections := selections)
              pure none
            catch error => pure (some error)
          let some failure := failure
            | throwError "the reader computed a nullary operation without its published demand"
          unless (← observed.get) && (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
              "observed the original nullary operation demand" do throw failure
          unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "the nullary source control dispatched a mathematical provider"
        finally discard <| transaction.abort
    finally
      owners.close connection.generation
      kernel.close
  finally setEnv originalEnvironment

end CasRuntime.NativePointInvocationTests

open Lean Meta Elab Command Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue

private abbrev BindingKey := RuntimeId .value × Array (RuntimeId .association)

private def bindingKey (binding : ValueBinding) : BindingKey :=
  (binding.value, binding.associationIds)

private def sameContext (left right : ContextTelescope) : Bool :=
  left.entries.size == right.entries.size &&
    (left.entries.zip right.entries).all (fun (left, right) =>
      left.id == right.id && left.role == right.role && left.userName == right.userName &&
        left.binderInfo == right.binderInfo && left.kind == right.kind &&
        left.type == right.type && left.value == right.value &&
        left.originalSource == right.originalSource && left.nondep == right.nondep) &&
    left.instances.size == right.instances.size &&
    (left.instances.zip right.instances).all (fun (left, right) =>
      left.className == right.className && left.binding == right.binding)

private def sameSource (left right : ClosedTerm) : Bool :=
  left.expression == right.expression && left.type == right.type &&
    left.universeParams == right.universeParams && sameContext left.context right.context

private structure ProjectionFrame where
  field : Name
  source : ClosedTerm
  origin : ClosedTerm
  parameters : Array (Option BindingKey)
  captures : Array BindingKey
  operand : BindingKey
  occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence

-- A repeated source computation is detected without equating independently retained values.
-- Fresh operand/occurrence IDs are printed as evidence; they do not hide the repeated code.
private def sameProjection (left right : ProjectionFrame) : Bool :=
  left.field == right.field && sameSource left.source right.source &&
    sameSource left.origin right.origin && left.parameters == right.parameters &&
    left.captures == right.captures

private def projectionFrame? (kernel : Kernel) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) : MetaM (Option ProjectionFrame) := do
  let .project operand field := request.action | return none
  let some node := (← transaction.view).find operand.value | return none
  let .closure program captures := node.payload.data | return none
  let some (.term source _) := (← kernel.codes.get)[program]? | return none
  return some {
    field := field.projection
    source
    origin := node.origin.role.source
    parameters := node.origin.parameters.map (·.map bindingKey)
    captures := captures.map bindingKey
    operand := bindingKey operand
    occurrence := request.occurrence }

-- Describe the actual projection spine without expanding implicit mathematical parameters.
-- SourceProjection supplies the same native declaration and parent used by the lowerer.
-- Typed source locals stay visible; inert native metadata contributes no runtime authority.
private partial def describeSpine (expression : Expr) : MetaM (Array String) := do
  if let .mdata _ body := expression then return ← describeSpine body
  if let some projection ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? expression then
    return #[s!"projection {projection.declaration}"] ++ (← describeSpine projection.parent)
  if expression.isApp then
    return #[s!"application ({expression.getAppNumArgs} arguments)"] ++
      (← describeSpine expression.getAppFn)
  return #[match expression with
    | .const name _ => s!"constant {name}"
    | .proj owner index _ => s!"native projection {owner}[{index}]"
    | .fvar id => s!"local {repr id}"
    | .bvar index => s!"bound variable {index}"
    | .mvar id => s!"metavariable {repr id}"
    | .lam name .. => s!"lambda {name}"
    | .forallE name .. => s!"forall {name}"
    | .letE name .. => s!"let {name}"
    | .sort level => s!"sort {repr level}"
    | .lit .. => "literal"
    | .app .. | .mdata .. => "unreachable outer expression"]

private def describeProjection (frame : ProjectionFrame) : MetaM MessageData := do
  let source ← frame.source.withOpen fun _ expression => ppExpr expression
  let sourceSpine ← describeSpine frame.source.expression
  let typeSpine ← describeSpine frame.source.type
  let origin ← if sameSource frame.source frame.origin then
      pure m!"same exact closed source, type and context"
    else do
      let shown ← frame.origin.withOpen fun _ expression => ppExpr expression
      let spine ← describeSpine frame.origin.expression
      let type ← describeSpine frame.origin.type
      pure m!"{shown}\norigin spine: {repr spine}\norigin type head: {repr type}\n\
        origin context: {repr (frame.origin.context.entries.map (·.id))}"
  return m!"field: {frame.field}\noperand: {repr frame.operand}\n\
    occurrence: {repr frame.occurrence}\nsource: {source}\n\
    source spine: {repr sourceSpine}\nsource type head: {repr typeSpine}\n\
    source context: {repr (frame.source.context.entries.map (·.id))}\n\
    origin: {origin}\nparameters: {repr frame.parameters}\ncaptures: {repr frame.captures}"

private structure ProjectionGuard where
  active : IO.Ref (Array ProjectionFrame)
  demands : IO.Ref Nat

mutual

-- This is the same public composition used by Kernel.evaluateSource. The injected evaluator
-- is passed into Kernel.execute itself, so recursive source demands cannot escape the guard.
private partial def evaluateBounded (kernel : Kernel) (guard : ProjectionGuard) : SourceEvaluation :=
  fun transaction program context bound selections expression =>
    lowerTerm {
      ledger := kernel.ledger, transaction, codes := kernel.codes
      run := fun computation => Execute.run (executeBounded kernel guard) computation transaction
        (some (kernel.resolveFixedInput (evaluateBounded kernel guard) transaction program)) }
      program context bound expression (selections := selections)

private partial def executeBounded (kernel : Kernel) (guard : ProjectionGuard) :
    PFunctor.Handler.Stateful MetaM CellTransaction OperationalSignature :=
  fun request transaction => do
    let count ← guard.demands.get
    guard.demands.set (count + 1)
    let active ← guard.active.get
    let frame ← projectionFrame? kernel request transaction
    if let some frame := frame then
      if let some prior := active.find? (sameProjection · frame) then
        throwError "a native projection re-entered its active source computation\n\
          earlier:\n{← describeProjection prior}\nrepeated:\n{← describeProjection frame}"
      guard.active.set (active.push frame)
    try
      -- This cap belongs only to the diagnostic harness, never to the kernel. It catches a
      -- cycle whose generated source changes, instead of allowing an unbounded test process.
      if count ≥ 256 then
        let detail ← match frame with
          | some frame => describeProjection frame
          | none => pure m!"the current demand is not a native term projection"
        throwError "the native projection diagnostic exceeded 256 demands\n{detail}"
      return (← kernel.execute (evaluateBounded kernel guard) request transaction, transaction)
    finally guard.active.set active

end

-- Exactly Session.underBindings: it exposes the proposition read beneath leading source lets.
private partial def underBindings : Expr → Expr
  | .letE _ _ value body _ => underBindings (body.instantiate1 value)
  | .mdata _ body => underBindings body
  | expression => expression

private def expectMissing (text operation : String) (action : MetaM ValueBinding) : MetaM Unit := do
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    discard <| action
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure
    | throwError "`{text}` unexpectedly computed without a leaf"
  unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag (· == Stratum.noImplementation.tag) do
    throwError "`{text}` failed before its original published boundary:\n{failure.toMessageData}"
  let detail ← failure.toMessageData.toString
  unless (detail.splitOn operation).length > 1 do
    throwError "`{text}` did not reach {operation}: {detail}"

-- These are unchanged statements and missing-operation expectations from the first block of
-- SessionComputationTests. The harness reads their actual left sides; it supplies no answers.
private def checkQuestion (source : SourceSession) (kernel : Kernel) (text operation : String)
    (evaluate : CellTransaction → OpenContext → SourceSelectionScope Expr → Expr →
      MetaM ValueBinding) : TermElabM Unit :=
  withCurrHeartbeats <|
  withTheReader Core.Context (fun context =>
    { context with maxHeartbeats := statementHeartbeats * 1000 }) do
    let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
      | .ok statement => pure statement
      | .error error => throwError "the original projection question did not parse: {error}"
    let .question proposition ← source.readStatement ⟨statement⟩
      | throwError "the original projection question did not read as a question"
    let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
    try
      proposition.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let selections ← proposition.selections.inContext context
        let asked := underBindings expression
        let some (_, left, _) := asked.eq?
          | throwError "the original projection question did not read as an equality"
        expectMissing text operation (evaluate transaction context selections left)
    finally discard <| transaction.abort

-- A selected limit apex retains the exact original map slot. Category recovery composes
-- the two whole native declarations; the generic pt accessor and an unselected equal source
-- are insufficient. This checks source/provenance only, without executing a mathematical leaf.
private def checkSelectedLimitProducer (source : SourceSession) (kernel : Kernel) :
    TermElabM Unit := do
  let .ok parsedSource := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term "cokernel(to_dual(1))"
    | throwError "the original cokernel producer source did not parse"
  let selected ← source.read ⟨parsedSource⟩
  let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
  try
    selected.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let selections ← selected.selections.inContext context
      let value ← kernel.run transaction context {} expression (selections := selections)
      let identities := transaction.owners.identities
      let graph ← transaction.view
      withBindingContext graph context {} value fun context bound => do
        let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections
          (← value.role.selections.inContext context)
        let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound identities.worker context bound graph
          (selections := selections)
        let some produced ← environment.declaredResultSource? context graph value
          | throwError "the selected limit lost its original declaration projection"
        let expectedPath := #[``CategoryTheory.Limits.ColimitCocone.cocone,
          ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.pt]
        unless produced.declaration == ``CasCatalogue.Limits.Registration.bilWFormCokernel &&
            produced.path == expectedPath && produced.position == 4 do
          throwError "the selected limit changed its complete native producer or actual input position"
        let some input ← environment.declaredInputAt? context graph
            produced.declaration produced.position value
          | throwError "the selected limit lost its original retained map slot"
        let some node := graph.find value.value
          | throwError "the selected limit descriptor is outside its actual graph"
        let .container packet := node.payload.data
          | throwError "the selected limit lost its original descriptor"
        let #[slot] := packet.slots
          | throwError "the selected limit changed its sole actual packet input"
        unless slot.path == #[.field "args", .index 0] && slot.fieldIndex.isNone &&
            slot.binding.value == input.value.value &&
            slot.binding.associationIds == input.value.associationIds do
          throwError "the selected limit reconstructed its original producer input"
        let some category := selected.category
          | throwError "the selected limit lost its original category"
        let families ← RoutedMethodFamily.atSource category.expression "cardinality"
        let some family := families[0]?
          | throwError "the selected limit lost its original cardinality method family"
        let direct ← family.receiverParameterRoutes ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone.pt
        unless direct.all (fun route => match route with | .unavailable => true | _ => false) do
          throwError "a generic apex accessor fabricated a concrete category parameter route"
        let routes ← family.receiverProjectionInputRoutes produced.declaration produced.path
          produced.position ``LeanCategories.Lattices.Integral.rootAToDual
        let #[.fixed scalar, .fixed dictionary] := routes
          | throwError "the whole original producer families did not fix their declared scalar category"
        unless (← isDefEq scalar (Lean.mkConst ``Int)) &&
            (← isDefEq (← inferType dictionary) (← mkAppM ``CommRing #[Lean.mkConst ``Int])) do
          throwError "the whole original producer families changed their fixed scalar category"
        checkWithKernel dictionary

        let some originalSelection ← value.role.selected? context
          | throwError "the original cokernel source lost its selected reference"
        let some (.limit originalRow) := originalSelection.reference
          | throwError "the original cokernel source changed its selected reference kind"
        unless originalRow.declaration == produced.declaration do
          throwError "the selected source changed its original complete limit row"
        let bareRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close originalSelection.value)
        let bareOrigin ← environment.origin node.origin.program (← identities.fresh .occurrence)
          bareRole
        let bare ← transaction.stage bareOrigin node.payload
        if (← environment.declaredResultSource? context (← transaction.view) bare).isSome then
          throwError "an unselected equal apex recovered a declaration from the registry"

        -- An equal source expression at a different actual node cannot replace a bound
        -- original map inside the selected producer's descriptor input slot.
        let some inputNode := graph.find input.value.value
          | throwError "the original producer input is outside its actual graph"
        let otherOccurrence ← identities.fresh .occurrence
        let other ← transaction.stage
          { inputNode.origin with occurrence := otherOccurrence } inputNode.payload
        if other.value == input.value.value then
          throwError "the distinct producer-input control reused its original occurrence"
        let original ← produced.source.inContext context
        let inputSource ← input.source.inContext context
        let allocated ← identities.fresh .sourceBinding
        let retainedId : BindingId := ⟨allocated.worker, allocated.serial⟩
        context.withLocalBinding retainedId .result `originalMap (← inferType inputSource)
            (fun context binding => do
          let bound := bound.insert binding.id input.value
          let retainedProducer := mkAppN original.getAppFn
            (original.getAppArgs.set! produced.position binding.expression)
          let some construction := originalSelection.limit
            | throwError "the original selected producer lost its complete construction"
          let some ownerSource := construction.source.ownerFamily
            | throwError "the selected construction lost its original owner template"
          let owner ← SelectedLimitOwner.ofBinding context selections ownerSource
          let some family := originalSelection.limitFamily
            | throwError "the original selected producer lost its complete limit family"
          let some rebound ← LimitFamily.formalAt family context construction owner
              retainedProducer.getAppArgs
            | throwError "the original selected construction could not retain its exact input binder"
          unless rebound.source.presentation.equal retainedProducer do
            throwError "the selected producer changed its exact retained application"
          let retainedSelection := { originalSelection with
            value := rebound.receiver, limit := some rebound,
            originalApplication := some retainedProducer,
            category := originalSelection.category.map
              (fun category => { category with limit := some rebound.source }) }
          selections.withBinding identities context retainedSelection
              fun context selections retainedApex => do
            let some selectedBinding := context.bindings.find?
                (·.expression == retainedApex)
              | throwError "the selected producer lost its original typed source binder"
            let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound identities.worker context bound
              (← transaction.view) (selections := selections)
            let retainedRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close retainedApex)
              (← selections.close context) (some selectedBinding.id)
            let correctOrigin ← environment.origin node.origin.program
              (← identities.fresh .occurrence) retainedRole
            let correct ← transaction.stage correctOrigin node.payload
            let some correctInput ← environment.declaredInputAt? context (← transaction.view)
                produced.declaration produced.position correct
              | throwError "the correctly retained producer lost its original input"
            unless correctInput.value.value == input.value.value &&
                correctInput.value.associationIds == input.value.associationIds do
              throwError "the correctly retained producer changed its actual original input"

            let payload ← IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.descriptor packet.template
              #[{ slot with binding := other }]).mapError IO.userError
            let changedOrigin ← environment.origin node.origin.program
              (← identities.fresh .occurrence) retainedRole
            let changed ← transaction.stage changedOrigin payload
            let failure : Option Exception ← try
                discard <| environment.declaredInputAt? context (← transaction.view)
                  produced.declaration produced.position changed
                pure none
              catch error => pure (some error)
            let some failure := failure
              | throwError "the selected producer accepted a different equal original input"
            unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag
                (· == `CasRuntime.RuntimeEnvironment.sourceReferenceMismatch) do throw failure

            -- The complete typed construction and its original application must agree
            -- at the exact producer. Native equality cannot repair a different witness.
            unless !original.equal retainedProducer &&
                (← context.withOriginalSources #[original, retainedProducer]
                  fun sources => isDefEq sources[0]! sources[1]!) do
              throwError "the mismatched producer control lost its equal distinct native sources"
            let forgedSelection := { retainedSelection with originalApplication := some original }
            selections.withBinding identities context forgedSelection
                fun context selections forgedSource => do
              let some forgedBinding := context.bindings.find?
                  (·.expression == forgedSource)
                | throwError "the mismatched producer lost its typed source binder"
              let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound identities.worker context bound
                (← transaction.view) (selections := selections)
              let forgedRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close forgedSource)
                (← selections.close context) (some forgedBinding.id)
              let forgedOrigin ← environment.origin node.origin.program
                (← identities.fresh .occurrence) forgedRole
              let forgedValue ← transaction.stage forgedOrigin node.payload
              let failure : Option Exception ← try
                  discard <| environment.declaredResultSource? context
                    (← transaction.view) forgedValue
                  pure none
                catch error => pure (some error)
              let some failure := failure
                | throwError "a definitionally equal but different producer witness was accepted"
              unless ((← failure.toMessageData.toString).splitOn
                  "changed its original producer application").length > 1 do throw failure)
          (originalSource := some inputSource)
  finally discard <| transaction.abort

/-- Lower one native source lambda once, then use it at distinct actual input occurrences.
The producer's static source selection is shared, while its completed selections are not. -/
private def checkRepeatedLimitSource (source : SourceSession) (kernel : Kernel) :
    TermElabM Unit := do
  let function ← source.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing <|
    SourceReadM.withBinder `X (mkSort (Level.succ Level.zero)) none .default
      (fun binding body => mkLambdaFVars #[binding.expression] body) fun input => do
        let object ← sourceSetJudgement .object input
        let product ← sourceBinaryLimit object object false
        return product.value
  let readObject := fun text => do
    let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
      | throwError "the repeated construction's original object source did not parse"
    source.read ⟨parsed⟩
  let first ← readObject "Fin(2)"
  let second ← readObject "Fin(3)"
  let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
  try
    function.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
      let selections ← function.selections.inContext context
      let selection ← lambdaTelescope expression fun _ body => do
        let some selectedConstruction := selections.findAt? context body.getAppFn
          | throwError "the compiled construction lost its original source anchor"
        let some original := (← selectedConstruction.specialize body.getAppArgs).limit
          | throwError "the compiled construction lost its original source anchor"
        return original.source.construction
      let before := (← kernel.dispatches.get).size
      let callable ← kernel.run transaction context {} expression (selections := selections)
      withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context {} callable fun context bound => do
        let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections
          (← callable.role.selections.inContext context)
        let callableSource ← callable.selectedSource context
        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound callableSource callable
            fun context bound retainedCallable => do
          let mut receivers := #[]
          for input in #[first, first, second] do
            let receiver ← input.source.context.withInContext context fun context => do
              let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections
                (← input.selections.inContext context)
              let argument ← input.source.inContext context
              let receiver ← kernel.run transaction context bound
                (mkApp retainedCallable argument) (selections := selections)
              let some _ := (← transaction.view).find receiver.value
                | throwError "the repeated construction lost its actual receiver node"
              withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound receiver fun context _ => do
                let some retained ← receiver.role.selected? context
                  | throwError "the construction execution lost its original source selection"
                let some retained := retained.limit
                  | throwError "the construction execution lost its original source selection"
                unless retained.source.construction == selection do
                  throwError "the one compiled source lambda acquired another producer identity"
              return receiver
            receivers := receivers.push receiver
          let #[firstReceiver, equalReceiver, otherReceiver] := receivers
            | throwError "the repeated construction lost an actual source application"
          unless firstReceiver.value != equalReceiver.value &&
              firstReceiver.value != otherReceiver.value &&
              equalReceiver.value != otherReceiver.value do
            throwError "the compiled construction merged distinct actual applications"
          let field := `occurrenceProbe
          let .ok () ← transaction.bindSelectedAt selection field firstReceiver firstReceiver
            | throwError "the first actual source receiver could not retain its selection"
          for unrelated in #[equalReceiver, otherReceiver] do
            let .ok none ← transaction.selectedAt selection field unrelated
              | throwError "a compiled source selection crossed an actual receiver boundary"
            let .ok () ← transaction.bindSelectedAt selection field unrelated unrelated
              | throwError "another source application could not retain its own occurrence"
          let .ok (some selected) ← transaction.selectedAt selection field firstReceiver
            | throwError "the first actual source occurrence lost its original selection"
          unless bindingKey selected == bindingKey firstReceiver do
            throwError "a later application replaced the first exact receiver selection"
          unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).size == before do
            throwError "forming the original symbolic constructions demanded an implementation"
  finally discard <| transaction.abort

run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let source ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
    let cases := #[
      ("assert |cokernel(to_dual(1))| = 2", "fun.bil_wform.carrier"),
      ("assert |Fin(2) ⊔ Fin(3)| = 5", "meth.cardinality")]
    try
      checkSelectedLimitProducer source kernel
      checkRepeatedLimitSource source kernel
      -- The outer carrier projection must cross the existing native definition of the
      -- unretained classifier total. Reprojecting its field closure is the same computation.
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
      let info ← getConstInfo ``LeanCategories.Algebra.associative
      let classifier := Lean.mkConst info.name (info.levelParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero))
      let total ← mkAppM ``LeanCategories.Classifier.total #[classifier]
      let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[total]
      for bounded in #[true, false] do
        let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let before := (← kernel.dispatches.get).size
          let value ← if bounded then do
              let guard : ProjectionGuard := ⟨← IO.mkRef #[], ← IO.mkRef 0⟩
              let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
              evaluateBounded kernel guard transaction program context {} {} carrier
            else kernel.run transaction context {} carrier
          let some node := (← transaction.view).find value.value
            | throwError "the native classifier carrier is outside its actual graph"
          if let .closure .. := node.payload.data then
            throwError "the native classifier carrier retained unevaluated projection code"
          unless ← isDefEq (← node.origin.role.source.inContext context) carrier do
            throwError "the nested native projection changed its declared carrier"
          unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).size == before do
            throwError "a nested native definition projection dispatched a computation"
        finally discard <| transaction.abort
      for (text, operation) in cases do
        let guard : ProjectionGuard := ⟨← IO.mkRef #[], ← IO.mkRef 0⟩
        checkQuestion source kernel text operation fun transaction context selections expression => do
          let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
          evaluateBounded kernel guard transaction program context {} selections expression
      -- The actual public executor must reach the same boundary after the bounded controls.
      for (text, operation) in cases do
        checkQuestion source kernel text operation fun transaction context selections expression =>
          kernel.run transaction context {} expression (selections := selections)
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv environment

end CasRuntime.NativeProjectionTests

-- Forgetting a functor's laws retains its one actual object action and the map that depends
-- on that action. The two projections of the original formal argument must share that input.
-- This uses only the existing native identity functor and requires no provider or value answer.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let declaration ← getConstInfo ``LeanCategories.Foundation.Mathlib.Sets
    let sets := mkConst declaration.name (declaration.levelParams.map fun _ => Level.zero)
    let carrier ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[sets]
    let category ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.str #[sets]
    let functor ← mkAppOptM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.id #[some carrier, some category]
    let term ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.toPrefunctor #[functor]
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        let bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding := {}
        let value ← kernel.run transaction context bound term
        withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound value fun context bound =>
          withBoundValue owners.identities context bound term value fun context bound retained => do
            let objectAction ← kernel.run transaction context bound (mkProj ``Prefunctor 0 retained)
            let mapAction ← kernel.run transaction context bound (mkProj ``Prefunctor 1 retained)
            let some consumed := mapAction.instantiations.find?
                (·.field.projection == ``CategoryTheory.Functor.map)
              | throwError "the native conversion lost the original functor's dependent map role"
            let some (some originalObject) := consumed.preceding[0]?
              | throwError "the native conversion lost the map's original object action"
            unless originalObject.value == objectAction.value &&
                originalObject.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf objectAction.associationIds.toList do
              throwError "the native conversion rebuilt the original formal object-action occurrence"
            unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
              throwError "a native record conversion dispatched a provider"
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
      -- The same genuine functor source may name a descriptor with no native field data.
      -- Its source definition cannot replace those missing actual input projections.
      let missing ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
        let .ok payload := ValuePayload.descriptor .null #[]
          | throwError "the native conversion descriptor control is malformed"
        let descriptor ← missing.stage
          { program, occurrence := ← kernel.ledger.allocate,
            role := ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close functor), parameters := #[] }
          payload
        withBoundValue owners.identities context {} functor descriptor fun context bound marked => do
          let unavailable ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.toPrefunctor #[marked]
          let failure : Option Exception ← try
            discard <| kernel.run missing context bound unavailable
            pure none
          catch error => pure (some error)
          let some failure := failure
            | throwError "a native conversion fabricated a descriptor's unavailable fields"
          match CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure with
          | some .noImplementation => pure ()
          | _ => throw failure
          -- A local alias must preserve the same unavailable actual field boundary.
          let sourceAlias := Expr.letE `value (← inferType marked) marked (.bvar 0) false
          let unavailableAlias ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.toPrefunctor #[sourceAlias]
          let aliasFailure : Option Exception ← try
            discard <| kernel.run missing context bound unavailableAlias
            pure none
          catch error => pure (some error)
          let some aliasFailure := aliasFailure
            | throwError "a native conversion alias fabricated a descriptor's unavailable fields"
          match CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? aliasFailure with
          | some .noImplementation => pure ()
          | _ => throw aliasFailure
          unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "a missing native conversion field dispatched a provider"
      finally discard <| missing.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- Constant projection syntax and a nondependent native record conversion must retain the
-- same actual fields as Expr.proj. Equal source fields at different positions stay distinct;
-- a descriptor supplies none of them. Runtime class records have the same boundary, while
-- a formal class projection still reads its ordinary native definition.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let pairTerm ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 7]
    let multiplicationType := mkApp (mkConst ``Mul [.zero]) (mkConst ``Nat)
    let multiplication ← synthInstance multiplicationType
    let leftAction := Expr.lam `left (mkConst ``Nat)
      (.lam `right (mkConst ``Nat) (.bvar 1) .default) .default
    let selectedMultiplication ← mkAppOptM ``Mul.mk
      #[some (mkConst ``Nat), some leftAction]
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        let pair ← kernel.run transaction context {} pairTerm
        let graph ← transaction.view
        let .ok first := graph.project pair 0
          | throwError "the native projection control lost its first original field"
        let .ok second := graph.project pair 1
          | throwError "the native projection control lost its second original field"
        unless first.value != second.value do
          throwError "the native projection control merged equal original fields"
        withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context {} pair fun context bound =>
          withBoundValue owners.identities context bound pairTerm pair fun context bound marked => do
            let markedType ← inferType marked
            for aliased in #[false, true] do
              let parent := if aliased then
                  Expr.letE `value markedType marked (.bvar 0) false
                else marked
              for (projection, expected) in #[(``Prod.fst, first), (``Prod.snd, second)] do
                let term ← mkAppM projection #[parent]
                let selected ← kernel.run transaction context bound term
                unless selected.value == expected.value &&
                    expected.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf selected.associationIds.toList do
                  throwError "a constant native projection replaced its original selected field"
              let swapped ← kernel.run transaction context bound (← mkAppM ``Prod.swap #[parent])
              let graph ← transaction.view
              for expected in #[second, first], index in [:2] do
                let .ok selected := graph.project swapped index
                  | throwError "the nondependent native conversion lost a result field"
                unless selected.value == expected.value &&
                    expected.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf selected.associationIds.toList do
                  throwError "a nondependent native conversion replaced an original selected field"
        let formal ← mkAppOptM ``Mul.mul #[some (mkConst ``Nat), some selectedMultiplication]
        let formalValue ← kernel.run transaction context {} formal
        unless formalValue.role.kind == .function do
          throwError "a formal class projection lost its native function field"
        let actual ← kernel.run transaction context {} selectedMultiplication
        withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context {} actual fun context bound =>
          withBoundValue owners.identities context bound selectedMultiplication actual fun context bound marked => do
            let markedType ← inferType marked
            let projected ← kernel.run transaction context bound (mkProj ``Mul 0 marked)
            for aliased in #[false, true] do
              let parent := if aliased then
                  Expr.letE `value markedType marked (.bvar 0) false
                else marked
              let term ← mkAppOptM ``Mul.mul #[some (mkConst ``Nat), some parent]
              let selected ← kernel.run transaction context bound term
              unless selected.value == projected.value do
                throwError "constant projection syntax rebuilt an actual class field"
        let actual ← kernel.run transaction context {} selectedMultiplication
        withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context {} actual fun context bound =>
          withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound first fun context bound =>
            withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound second fun context bound =>
              withBoundValue owners.identities context bound selectedMultiplication actual fun context bound marked =>
                withBoundValue owners.identities context bound (mkNatLit 7) first fun context bound left =>
                  withBoundValue owners.identities context bound (mkNatLit 7) second fun context bound right => do
                    let markedType ← inferType marked
                    for aliased in #[false, true] do
                      let parent := if aliased then
                          Expr.letE `value markedType marked (.bvar 0) false
                        else marked
                      let constant ← mkAppOptM ``Mul.mul
                        #[some (mkConst ``Nat), some parent, some left, some right]
                      let annotated := mkAppN
                        (.mdata (KVMap.empty.setNat `control.inert 1) constant.getAppFn)
                        constant.getAppArgs
                      for term in #[constant, annotated, mkAppN (mkProj ``Mul 0 parent) #[left, right]] do
                        let selected ← kernel.run transaction context bound term
                        unless selected.value == first.value &&
                            first.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf selected.associationIds.toList do
                          throwError "an applied class projection replaced its original argument"
        unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
          throwError "the native projection controls dispatched a provider"
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
      for (source, operation, applied, annotated) in #[
          (pairTerm, ``Prod.fst, false, false), (pairTerm, ``Prod.swap, false, false),
          (multiplication, ``Mul.mul, false, false),
          (selectedMultiplication, ``Mul.mul, true, false),
          (selectedMultiplication, ``Mul.mul, true, true)] do
        for aliased in #[false, true] do
          let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
          try
            let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
            let .ok payload := ValuePayload.descriptor .null #[]
              | throwError "the native projection descriptor control is malformed"
            let descriptor ← transaction.stage
              { program, occurrence := ← kernel.ledger.allocate,
                role := ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close source), parameters := #[] }
              payload
            withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context {} descriptor fun context bound =>
