              withBoundValue owners.identities context bound source descriptor fun context bound marked => do
                let markedType ← inferType marked
                let parent := if aliased then
                    Expr.letE `value markedType marked (.bvar 0) false
                  else marked
                let type ← whnf (← inferType source)
                let mut arguments := type.getAppArgs.push parent
                if applied then arguments := arguments ++ #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 7]
                let term ← mkAppOptM operation (arguments.map some)
                let term := if annotated then
                    mkAppN (.mdata (KVMap.empty.setNat `control.inert 1) term.getAppFn)
                      term.getAppArgs
                  else term
                let failure : Option Exception ← try
                  discard <| kernel.run transaction context bound term
                  pure none
                catch error => pure (some error)
                let some failure := failure
                  | throwError "the native selection {operation} fabricated a descriptor field"
                unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some .noImplementation do
                  throw failure
                unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                  throwError "a missing native projection field dispatched a provider"
          finally discard <| transaction.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- The published total-module additive-group object action selects only the original
-- module's carrier and class fields. Check the symbolic paths before running that same
-- registered action, then compare its actual returned fields with those original inputs.
-- No provider data or expected additive-group value is constructed by this control.
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        let scalarTerm := mkConst ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.NamedRings.ringIntegers
        let scalarValue ← kernel.run transaction context {} scalarTerm
        withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context {} scalarValue fun context bound =>
          withBoundValue owners.identities context bound scalarTerm scalarValue fun context bound scalarSource => do
            let moduleTerm ← mkAppM
              ``CasCatalogue.Modules.CatalogueRegistration.regularModule #[scalarSource]
            let moduleValue ← kernel.run transaction context bound moduleTerm
            withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound moduleValue fun context bound =>
              withBoundValue owners.identities context bound moduleTerm moduleValue fun context bound moduleSource => do
                let inclusionInfo ← getConstInfo
                  ``CasCatalogue.Modules.CatalogueRegistration.modulesFibreInclusionDeclaration
                let inclusion := mkApp
                  (mkConst inclusionInfo.name (inclusionInfo.levelParams.map fun _ => Level.zero))
                  scalarSource
                let inclusionPrefunctor ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.toPrefunctor #[inclusion]
                let totalTerm ← mkAppM ``Prefunctor.obj #[inclusionPrefunctor, moduleSource]
                let totalValue ← kernel.run transaction context bound totalTerm
                withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound totalValue fun context bound =>
                  withBoundValue owners.identities context bound totalTerm totalValue fun context bound totalSource => do
                    let some fibreField := totalValue.role.fields.find?
                        (·.projection == ``CategoryTheory.Pseudofunctor.CoGrothendieck.fiber)
                      | throwError "the native total module lost its original fibre field"
                    let some fibreIndex := fibreField.wireIndex
                      | throwError "the original module fibre became a proof field"
                    let fibreValue ← IO.ofExcept <|
                      ((← transaction.view).project totalValue fibreIndex).mapError IO.userError
                    unless fibreValue.value == moduleValue.value &&
                        moduleValue.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf fibreValue.associationIds.toList do
                      throwError "the native fibre inclusion replaced its actual original module"
                    let actionInfo ← getConstInfo
                      ``CasCatalogue.Modules.CatalogueRegistration.modulesAdditiveGroupDeclaration
                    let action := mkConst actionInfo.name (actionInfo.levelParams.map fun _ => Level.zero)
                    let actionPrefunctor ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Functor.toPrefunctor #[action]
                    let objectAction ← mkAppM ``Prefunctor.obj #[actionPrefunctor]
                    let functionLayout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close objectAction)
                    let (outputLayout, applicationLayout) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource
                      functionLayout context #[← context.close totalSource]
                    let originalPaths : Array (Name × Array Name) := #[
                      (``AddGrpCat.carrier,
                        #[``CategoryTheory.Pseudofunctor.CoGrothendieck.fiber, ``ModuleCat.carrier]),
                      (``AddGrpCat.str,
                        #[``CategoryTheory.Pseudofunctor.CoGrothendieck.fiber,
                          ``ModuleCat.isAddCommGroup, ``AddCommGroup.toAddGroup])]
                    unless outputLayout.kind == .record &&
                        (outputLayout.fields.filter (·.wireIndex.isSome)).size == originalPaths.size do
                      throwError "the published additive-group object action changed its native field interface"
                    for (projection, originalPath) in originalPaths do
                      let some selected ← applicationLayout.inputProjectionAt #[projection]
                        | throwError "the published native object field {projection} has no original input route"
                      let .argument 0 := selected.target
                        | throwError "the native object field {projection} selected a different formal input"
                      unless selected.path == originalPath do
                        throwError "the native object field {projection} changed its original input path: {selected.path}"
                    -- Do not evaluate the expected input projections first: the actual object action must
                    -- discover and preserve them through its ordinary complete input-result plan.
                    let outputTerm := mkApp objectAction totalSource
                    let outputValue ← kernel.run transaction context bound outputTerm
                    withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound outputValue fun context bound =>
                      withBoundValue owners.identities context bound outputTerm outputValue fun context bound outputSource => do
                        for (projection, originalPath) in originalPaths do
                          let some field := outputValue.role.fields.find? (·.projection == projection)
                            | throwError "the native additive-group output lost its selected field"
                          let selectedValue ← kernel.run transaction context bound
                            (← projectTerm outputSource field)
                          let graph ← transaction.view
                          let some originalValue ← IO.ofExcept <|
                              (graph.projected? totalValue originalPath).mapError IO.userError
                            | throwError "the native view did not publish its original input path {originalPath}"
                          let some selectedBasis ← IO.ofExcept <|
                              (graph.projectionBasis selectedValue totalValue originalPath).mapError IO.userError
                            | throwError "the native view lost the selected field's exact original parent and path"
                          unless selectedValue.value == originalValue.value &&
                              originalValue.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf selectedValue.associationIds.toList &&
                              selectedBasis.value == originalValue.value &&
                              selectedBasis.associationIds == originalValue.associationIds do
                            throwError "the native additive-group view replaced an original field occurrence"
                        unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                          throwError "the complete native module view dispatched a provider"
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

end CasRuntime.NativeRecordConversionTests

module

import CasRuntime.Session
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.NamedRings
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.NamedCommutativeRings
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.NumberSystems
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Session
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.NamedRings
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.NamedCommutativeRings
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.NumberSystems

namespace CasRuntime.NotebookStagingTests

open Lean Meta Elab Command Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

private def statement (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_stmt) := do
  match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
  | .ok parsed => pure ⟨parsed⟩
  | .error message => throwError "the original notebook statement did not parse: {message}"

-- A deferred result can share the child's actual node. The consuming
-- application's occurrence is nevertheless a separate committed receipt.
private def checkRoutineReceipts (snapshot : SessionSnapshot)
    (binding : ValueBinding) (expected : Array (String × String)) : TermElabM Unit := do
  let some node := snapshot.graph.find binding.value
    | throwError "routine test lost the retained node"
  let occurrences := (#[node.origin.occurrence] ++
    binding.applications.map (·.association.occurrence) ++
    binding.instantiations.map (·.association.occurrence)).toList.eraseDups
  let mut observed : Array (String × String) := #[]
  for occurrence in occurrences do
    let some receipt := snapshot.receipt occurrence | continue
    match receipt.association.producer with
    | .kernel => unless receipt.association.routines.isEmpty do
        throwError "kernel computation fabricated an engine routine"
    | .invocation dispatch _ requestId =>
      let .primitive identity := dispatch.selected
        | throwError "the arithmetic peer used an unexpected native export"
      let #[frame] := receipt.association.routines
        | throwError "an ordinary peer invocation lost its one actual received frame"
      unless frame.connection == dispatch.connection &&
          frame.occurrence == occurrence && frame.requestId == requestId do
        throwError "routine observation lost its actual request identity"
      let some #[routine] := frame.observations
        | throwError "the negotiated SDK invocation lost its actual entrypoint"
      let .ok role := routine.getObjValAs? String "role"
        | throwError "routine observation lost its role"
      let .ok name := routine.getObjValAs? String "qualified_name"
        | throwError "routine observation lost its callable identity"
      unless role == "entrypoint" do
        throwError "the arithmetic peer's actual entrypoint was replaced"
      observed := observed.push (identity.registration.operation, name)
  unless observed.size == expected.size &&
      expected.all (fun item => observed.contains item) do
    throwError "the committed binding lost an actual routine: {repr observed}"

-- The notebook stages separately parsed statements in one actual transaction.
-- Exercise that exact public runtime entrance in addition to the context-block
-- and actual worker controls. No alternate executor or host arithmetic is used.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let env ← getEnv
  try
    let root ← IO.currentDir
    let contract ← packageDir contractPackage
    let python := (← IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
    let peer := root / "scripts/probes/kernel_session_peer.py"
    let manifest := Json.mkObj [
      ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "peer"), ("command", python.toString),
        ("args", .arr #[toJson peer.toString])]]),
      ("registrations", .arr (#["op.rings.add", "op.rings.mul"].map fun operation =>
        Json.mkObj [("operation", toJson operation), ("input", toJson (s!"{operation}#input")), ("backend", "peer")]))]
    IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let path := root / ".tmp/notebook-staging-leaves.json"
    IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
    let initial ← KernelSession.start (some path)
    try
      let parent ← initial.run (← statement "let outer := 17 + 29 in ℤ")
      unless parent.outcome.kind == "holds" && parent.published do
        throwError "the notebook parent failed: {parent.outcome.detail}"
      let before ← SessionSnapshot.current
      let callsBefore ← initial.kernel.dispatches.get
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin initial.kernel.ledger
      try
        let mut session := parent.session
        for text in #["let localSum := outer + 1 in ℤ",
            "let localProduct := localSum · 2 in ℤ",
            "assert localProduct = 94 in ℤ"] do
          let run ← session.run (← statement text) (some transaction)
          unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" && !run.published do
            throwError "the notebook staging failed at {text}: {run.outcome.kind}: {run.outcome.detail}"
          session := run.session
        unless (← SessionSnapshot.current).outputBatches.size == before.outputBatches.size do
          throwError "a staged statement independently published its cell"
        let calls ← initial.kernel.dispatches.get
        unless (calls.drop callsBefore.size).map (·.operation) ==
            #["op.rings.add", "op.rings.mul", "op.rings.add"] do
          throwError "the notebook replayed or lost an actual deferred arithmetic occurrence"
        let .ok snapshot ← transaction.commit
          | throwError "the staged notebook cell failed to commit"
        unless snapshot.outputBatches.size == before.outputBatches.size + 1 do
          throwError "the staged notebook did not publish exactly one output batch"
        let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
          | throwError "the notebook lost its product binding"
        let some value := session.value? entry.id
          | throwError "the notebook lost its retained product"
        let packet ← IO.ofExcept <| (snapshot.graph.packet? value).mapError IO.userError
        unless packet == some (toJson (94 : Int)) do
          throwError "the committed product changed its actual value"
        checkRoutineReceipts snapshot value
          #[("op.rings.mul", "multiply"), ("op.rings.add", "add")]
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
    finally initial.close
  finally setEnv env

end CasRuntime.NotebookStagingTests

module

import CasRuntime.Kernel
import CasRuntime.Point
import CasRuntime.ManifestAdmission
import CasCompiler.Read
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.LinearAlgebra
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.Polynomials
import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.NamedCommutativeRings
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Kernel
meta import CasRuntime.Point
meta import CasRuntime.ManifestAdmission
meta import CasCompiler.Read
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.LinearAlgebra
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.Polynomials
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Semantics.Algebra.NamedCommutativeRings

namespace CasRuntime.ObjectApplicationTests

open Lean Meta Elab Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

private def sourceTerm (text : String) : TermElabM (TSyntax `cas_term) := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
    | throwError "the original application term did not parse"
  return ⟨source⟩

private def assumeSource (session : SourceSession) (text : String) : TermElabM SourceSession := do
  let .ok source := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text
    | throwError "the application input declaration did not parse"
  let .assumption session ← session.readStatement ⟨source⟩
    | throwError "the application input was not retained as its original assumption"
  return session

private def exactInput (left right : ValueBinding) : Bool :=
  left.value == right.value && left.associationIds == right.associationIds

private def failAt (stratum : Stratum) (action : MetaM Unit) : MetaM Unit := do
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    action
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some failure := failure | throwError "an invalid object application was accepted"
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some stratum do throw failure

private def rejected (action : MetaM Unit) : MetaM Unit := do
  let failed ← try
    action
    pure false
  catch _ => pure true
  unless failed do throwError "an incompatible selected application was accepted"

-- This is the existing named-point preparation boundary, with the original formal inputs.
private def prepare (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction) (context : OpenContext)
    (callable point : ValueBinding) (pointSource : Expr) (parameters : Array RuntimeParameter)
    (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr := {}) :
    MetaM (PreparedRequest × PreparedPointInvocation × PreparedRequest) := do
  let bound := parameters.foldl (fun bound parameter => bound.insert parameter.source parameter.value)
    ({} : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
  withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound pointSource point fun context bound pointSource => do
    let graph ← transaction.view
    let .ok code := graph.callable callable | throwError "the original callable is not visible"
    let some node := graph.find code.value | throwError "the original callable lost its code"
    let .closure program _ := node.payload.data | throwError "the original callable is not native code"
    let some (.family family path) := (← kernel.codes.get)[program]?
      | throwError "the object application lost its retained family"
    let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 point
      | throwError "the original point is not visible"
    let mut parameters := #[]
    for binding in context.bindings do
      if let some value := bound[binding.id]? then
        parameters := parameters.push (← IO.ofExcept <|
          (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id value).mapError IO.userError)
    let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication kernel.ledger.owners.identities program
      (← kernel.ledger.allocate) context callable #[← context.close pointSource] #[argument]
      parameters (some graph) (selections := selections)
    let evaluate : SourceEvaluation := fun cell _ current bound selections source =>
      kernel.run cell current bound source (selections := selections)
    let some invocation ← PreparedPointInvocation.prepare? kernel evaluate request family path transaction
      | throwError "the original object application did not prepare its published packet"
    return (request, invocation, family)

-- These are formal operands of the original matrix/polynomial application forms, not
-- computed answers. The actual reader, lowering, family preparation and wire codec run;
-- no provider is allowed to supply a result for either application.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let connection ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      for (first, second, text, owner, otherOwner) in #[
          ("let M ∈ Mat₂(ℚ)", "let v ∈ ℚ²", "M(v)", "obj.sets.matrices", "obj.sets.polynomials"),
          ("let p ∈ ℤ[x]", "let a ∈ ℤ", "p(a)", "obj.sets.polynomials", "obj.sets.matrices")] do
        let empty ← SourceSession.empty owners.identities
        let session ← assumeSource (← assumeSource empty first) second
        let term ← session.read (← sourceTerm text)
        term.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
          let originalInputs := session.context.entries.filter (·.role == .parameter)
          unless originalInputs.size == 2 && originalInputs[0]!.id != originalInputs[1]!.id do
            throwError "the original operands lost their distinct source bindings"
          let operands ← originalInputs.mapM fun entry => do
            let some binding := bindings.find? (·.id == entry.id)
              | throwError "the reader lost an original operand's actual binding"
            pure binding
          let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
          let selections ← term.selections.inContext context
          -- Read the original native application from its exact selected result binder.
          -- Its actual argument keeps the independent typed point record in this scope.
          let original := ((selections.findAt? context expression).map (·.value)
            |>.getD expression).consumeMData
          let original := if original.isAppOfArity ``id 2 then
              original.getAppArgs[1]!.consumeMData else original
          let .app callableSource pointSource := original
            | throwError "the original reading is not its final native point application"
          let some selectedPoint := selections.findAt? context pointSource
            | throwError "the exact original application argument lost its selected source binder"
          let some pointOrigin := selectedPoint.pointOrigin
            | throwError "the exact original application argument lost its point provenance"
          let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
          let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
          try
            let mut values : Array ValueBinding := #[]
            let mut parameters : Array RuntimeParameter := #[]
            let mut bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding := {}
            for binding in operands do
              let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close binding.expression)
              let role := { role with
                selections := term.selections
                selectionBinding := if selections.contains binding.id then some binding.id else none }
              let value ← transaction.stage
                { program, occurrence := ← kernel.ledger.allocate,
                  role,
                  parameters := Array.replicate bindings.size none }
                (.ownedExport connection s!"formal operand {binding.id.serial}" #[])
              let .ok parameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue (← transaction.view) binding.id value
                | throwError "the original operand lost its source binding authority"
              values := values.push value
              parameters := parameters.push parameter
              bound := bound.insert binding.id value
            let callable ← kernel.run transaction context bound callableSource (selections := selections)
            let point ← kernel.run transaction context bound pointSource (selections := selections)
            let (request, invocation, family) ←
              prepare kernel transaction context callable point pointSource parameters selections
            let .primitive (.application selected) _ := family.action
              | throwError "the object application was replaced by another computation boundary"
            let .application entry := selected.owner
              | throwError "the selected application changed its owner kind"
            unless entry.id.raw == owner && invocation.operation == entry.applicationAddress &&
                invocation.preparation == request.roles.scope && exactInput invocation.argument point do
              throwError "the application packet changed its original owner, request or operand"
            family.environment.withContext context bound fun context bound => do
              let arrow ← family.source.source.inContext context
              let (expectedSource, expectedTarget) ← selected.endpoints arrow
              unless expectedSource.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 do
                throwError "the application lost its whole native product source"
              for actual in #[invocation.domain, invocation.source, invocation.target],
                  expected in #[pointOrigin.domain, expectedSource, expectedTarget] do
                withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound actual fun context _ => do
                  context.withOriginalSources #[← actual.selectedSource context, expected]
                      fun native => do
                    unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
                      throwError "the application changed its complete native domain or endpoint"
            let some originalArguments := family.origin.application
              | throwError "the application lost its original declared parameter table"
            let some application := family.application
              | throwError "the application lost its complete native telescope"
            let declared := application.arguments.filter fun argument =>
              argument.wireIndex.isSome && argument.binderInfo.isExplicit
            unless declared.size == 2 && invocation.parameters.size == declared.size do
              throwError "the application omitted a declared ring, dimension or algebra parameter"
            for slot in declared, value in invocation.parameters do
              let some original := originalArguments.arguments[slot.sourceIndex]?.bind id
                | throwError "the application lost an original selected parameter"
              unless exactInput value original do
                throwError "the application replaced an original parameter by an equal value"
            let graph ← transaction.view
            for expectedValue in values, index in [:values.size] do
              let .ok actual := graph.project invocation.argument index
                | throwError "the application lost an ordered original operand slot"
              unless actual.value == expectedValue.value &&
                  expectedValue.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf actual.associationIds.toList do
                throwError "the product operand changed a source binding or its association chain"
            let codes ← kernel.codes.get
            let some descriptor ← InputDescriptorView.namedApplication? graph codes invocation.arrow
              | throwError "the application arrow lost its original checked descriptor"
            unless exactInput descriptor.binding invocation.arrow &&
                (← InputDescriptorView.namedMorphism? graph codes invocation.arrow).isNone do
              throwError "the object application was reclassified as an unrelated named morphism"
            failAt .malformed do
              discard <| InputDescriptorView.requireApplication graph codes invocation.arrow ⟨otherOwner⟩
            let .ok (encoded, packet) := invocation.encode graph connection.generation
              | throwError "the complete object application could not encode"
            let .ok decoded := PointInvocation.decode packet
              | throwError "the application did not use the public point packet"
            unless decoded.operation == entry.applicationAddress && decoded.parameters.size == 2 &&
                (decoded.arrow.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some entry.applicationAddress &&
                (decoded.source.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "objectProduct" do
              throwError "the application wire packet lost its selected owner or product source"
            for root in invocation.roots do
              let some actual := encoded.inputs.find? (·.path == root.path)
                | throwError "the application omitted an original scope root"
              unless exactInput actual.binding root.binding do
                throwError "the application encoded a replacement for an original scope root"
            let identity : DispatchIdentity := {
              manifestDigest := "object-application-scope-control", profileDigest := "no-providers",
              registration := {
                operation := entry.applicationAddress
                input := entry.applicationAddress
                backend := "scope-control" } }
            let .ok reservation ← transaction.reserve request.occurrence identity connection
                invocation.dependencies
              | throwError "the application could not retain its actual scope inputs"
            let scope ← RequestScope.issue kernel.ledger reservation graph encoded.slots encoded.inputs #[]
            try
              let evaluate : SourceEvaluation := fun cell _ current bound selections source =>
                kernel.run cell current bound source (selections := selections)
              let changed := { decoded with operation := otherOwner ++ "#application" }
              failAt .malformed do
                discard <| kernel.child evaluate request transaction reservation scope
                  (Json.mkObj [("op", toJson entry.applicationAddress), ("args", changed.encode)])
              let reference := fun index =>
                (ScopedReference.input #[.field "args", .index index]).encode
              let child : PointInvocation := {
                operation := entry.applicationAddress
                parameters := invocation.parameters.mapIdx fun index _ =>
                  (ScopedReference.input #[.field "args", .index 1, .index index]).encode
                arrow := reference 2
                domain := reference 3
                source := reference 4
                target := reference 5
                argument := reference 6 }
              let observed ← IO.mkRef false
              let evaluateChild : SourceEvaluation := fun cell _ current bound selections source => do
                let .app _ point := source.consumeMData
                  | return ← kernel.run cell current bound source (selections := selections)
                let some original := selections.findAt? current point.getAppFn
                  | return ← kernel.run cell current bound source (selections := selections)
                let original ← original.specialize point.getAppArgs
                let some (.named family actual) := original.pointRequest
                  | return ← kernel.run cell current bound source (selections := selections)
                unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.application family).exactlyMatches
                    (.application selected) do
                  throwError "the scoped application changed its original selected point family"
                for source in #[actual.domain, actual.source, actual.target, actual.point],
                    expected in #[invocation.domain, invocation.source, invocation.target, invocation.argument] do
                  let .fvar localId := source.consumeMData
                    | throwError "the scoped application replaced an original input"
                  let some binding := current.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == localId)
                    | throwError "the scoped application lost an original input's typed binder"
                  let some value := bound[binding.id]?
                    | throwError "the scoped application lost its retained input authority"
                  unless exactInput value expected do
                    throwError "the scoped application replaced an input by an equal value"
                observed.set true
                kernel.run cell current bound source (selections := selections)
              failAt .noImplementation do
                discard <| kernel.child evaluateChild request transaction reservation scope
                  (Json.mkObj [("op", toJson entry.applicationAddress), ("args", child.encode)])
              unless ← observed.get do
                throwError "the scoped application bypassed the shared typed source boundary"
            finally scope.retire
          finally discard <| transaction.abort
      unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "an application preparation control dispatched a mathematical provider"
    finally
      kernel.close
      owners.close connection.generation
  finally setEnv original

-- A pair of already supplied generalized points keeps its nonterminal domain. A
-- second point with a genuinely different domain is rejected before application.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let identities ← liftM (m := IO) IdentitySupply.new
  let empty ← SourceSession.empty identities
  let session ← assumeSource empty "let input ∈ Fin(2)"
  let (entry, category) ← selectObject "Fin" (some "Sets")
  let some originalEntry := session.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `input)
    | throwError "the original point input was not retained"
  discard <| session.elaborateScoped Syntax.missing do
    let scope ← get
    let some binding := scope.context.bindings.find? (·.id == originalEntry.id)
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the original point input was not retained"
    let input := binding.expression
    let selectedDomain ← mkAppM entry.declaration #[mkNatLit 2]
    let selectedDomain ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
      (.named (.registered (.inl entry) category)) selectedDomain selectedDomain)
    let otherDomain ← mkAppM entry.declaration #[mkNatLit 3]
    let otherDomain ← SourceReadM.select (← sourceReferenceAt
      (.named (.registered (.inl entry) category)) otherDomain otherDomain)
    let domain ← inferType input
    let pointMap ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLocalDeclD `argument domain fun argument => do
      let function ← mkLambdaFVars #[argument] argument (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
      mkAppM ``TypeCat.ofHom #[function]
    let point ← retainSourcePoint pointMap { value := input }
    let some original := point.pointOrigin
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "the supplied point lost its original native domain"
    let scope ← get
    scope.context.withOriginalSources #[original.domain, selectedDomain] fun native => do
      checkRegisteredDomains native[0]! native[1]!
      unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
        throwError "the supplied point does not have its selected Fin(2) domain"
    let pair ← sourcePairPoint (fun source => SourceReadM.select source) point point
    let some retained := pair.pointOrigin
      | liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "pairing erased the supplied generalized point"
    unless retained.domain == original.domain do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "pairing replaced the original nonterminal point domain"
    let applied := mkApp (← sourceSetFunction retained.point) input
    unless ← isDefEq applied (← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[input, input]) do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "pairing changed the original point maps"
    let otherMap ← liftM (m := MetaM) <| withLocalDeclD `other otherDomain fun other => do
      let function ← mkLambdaFVars #[other] input (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
      mkAppM ``TypeCat.ofHom #[function]
    let otherPoint ← retainSourcePoint otherMap { value := input }
    let failed ← try
      discard <| sourcePairPoint (fun source => SourceReadM.select source) point otherPoint
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless failed do
      liftM (m := TermElabM) <| throwError "different supplied point domains were silently identified"
    SourceReadM.select pair

-- These are availability declarations for existing mathematical rows. No backend is
-- started. Two actual eligible registrations must remain ambiguous until the frozen
-- profile selects exactly one; another object's application address cannot substitute.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[matrix] := state.objects.filter (·.id.raw == "obj.sets.matrices")
    | throwError "the existing matrix owner is not unique"
  let #[polynomial] := state.objects.filter (·.id.raw == "obj.sets.polynomials")
    | throwError "the existing polynomial owner is not unique"
  discard <| PointFamily.forApplication matrix
  rejected do discard <| PointFamily.forApplication { matrix with application := polynomial.application }
  let first : Registration := {
    operation := matrix.applicationAddress, input := matrix.applicationAddress, backend := "first" }
  let second := { first with backend := "second" }
  let wrongOwner := { first with input := polynomial.applicationAddress }
  let wrongPort := { first with operation := matrix.id.raw ++ "#application.extra" }
  let (manifest, refused) ← admitManifest {
    backends := #[{ name := "first", command := "/bin/cat" },
      { name := "second", command := "/bin/cat" }],
    registrations := #[first, second, wrongOwner, wrongPort] }
  unless manifest.registrations == #[first, second] && refused.size == 2 do
    throwError "application admission changed its exact owner, complete port or eligible alternatives"
  let all ← RealizationProfile.prepare manifest none
  failAt .ambiguousRealization do
    discard <| selectLift all manifest (.application matrix.id)
      matrix.applicationAddress #[matrix.applicationAddress]
  let registration := Json.mkObj [("operation", toJson first.operation),
    ("input", toJson first.input), ("backend", toJson first.backend)]
  let configuration := fun (owner : String) => Json.mkObj [
    ("format", toJson "cas-realization-profile/1"), ("id", toJson "application-control"),
    ("default", toJson "all"), ("rules", .arr #[Json.mkObj [
      ("target", Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "application"), ("id", toJson owner)]),
      ("primitive_registrations", Json.mkObj [("mode", toJson "only"), ("entries", .arr #[registration])]),
      ("derivations", Json.mkObj [("mode", toJson "all")])]])]
  let frozen ← RealizationProfile.prepare manifest (some (configuration matrix.id.raw))
  unless (← selectLift frozen manifest (.application matrix.id)
      matrix.applicationAddress #[matrix.applicationAddress]) == first &&
      frozen.sha256.length == 64 && frozen.normalized == configuration matrix.id.raw do
    throwError "the frozen profile changed its exact application registration"
  rejected do
    discard <| RealizationProfile.prepare manifest (some (configuration polynomial.id.raw))

end CasRuntime.ObjectApplicationTests

module

public import CasCompiler.Program
public import CasCompiler.Roles
public import CasCompiler.ContextSnapshot
public import CasCompiler.SourceSnapshot
public import CasRuntime.Environment

@[expose] public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasTools

inductive PreparedAction
  | primitive (boundary : ProgramBoundary) (universeArguments : List Level)
  | project (operand : ValueBinding) (field : FieldLayout)
  | apply (callable : ValueBinding) (arguments : Array ClosedTerm)
      (values : Array (Option ValueBinding))

/-- Inert source and request observations, prepared before the request is emitted.
The descriptor owns only immutable JSON and strings, never an elaborator or renderer action. -/
structure ObservationDescriptor where
  private mk ::
  native : Json
  readable : Json
  selection : Option Json
  sourceSnapshot : Option Json

namespace Observation

def identityJson {kind : IdentityKind} (id : RuntimeId kind) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("worker", toJson id.worker), ("serial", toJson id.serial)]

def namesJson (names : Array Name) : Json := Json.arr (names.map NativeExpression.nameJson)

/-- Preserve the original source plane and exact native projection path. -/
def inputProjectionJson (projection : InputProjection) : Json :=
  let target := match projection.target with
    | .argument index => Json.mkObj [("argument", toJson index)]
    | .context binding => Json.mkObj [("context", ContextSnapshot.bindingJson binding)]
  Json.mkObj [("target", target), ("path", namesJson projection.path)]

/-- Display names supplement, rather than replace, the exact native source address. -/
def readableInputProjectionJson (projection : InputProjection) : Json :=
  (inputProjectionJson projection).setObjVal! "displayPath"
    (toJson (projection.path.map (·.toString (escape := false))))

def referenceJson (reference : ComputationRef) : Json :=
  let (kind, id) := match reference with
    | .operation id => ("operation", id.raw)
    | .functor id => ("functor", id.raw)
    | .method id => ("method", id.raw)
    | .construction id => ("construction", id.raw)
    | .morphism id => ("morphism", id.raw)
  Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson kind), ("id", toJson id)]

def prerequisiteJson (source : CheckedComputationPrerequisite) :
    StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [("reference", referenceJson source.reference),
    ("declaration", NativeExpression.nameJson source.declaration),
    ("family", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add source.family)),
    ("familyType", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add source.familyType))]

def programJson (program : SourceProgram) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let source := program.source
  let entry := source.entry
  let prerequisites ← source.prerequisites.mapM prerequisiteJson
  return Json.mkObj [
    ("selected", toJson program),
    ("entry", Json.mkObj [("id", toJson entry.id.raw),
      ("target", referenceJson entry.target),
      ("prerequisites", toJson (entry.prerequisites.map referenceJson)),
      ("plan", NativeExpression.nameJson entry.plan),
      ("correctness", NativeExpression.nameJson entry.correctness)]),
    ("universeParams", namesJson source.universeParams.toArray),
    ("targetDeclaration", NativeExpression.nameJson source.targetDeclaration),
    ("target", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add source.target)),
    ("familyType", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add source.familyType)),
    ("prerequisites", toJson prerequisites),
    ("template", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add source.template)),
    ("plan", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add source.plan)),
    ("correctness", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add source.correctness))]

def boundaryJson (boundary : ProgramBoundary) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  match boundary with
  | .registered family =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "registered"),
      ("source", ← prerequisiteJson family.source),
      ("selected", toJson family),
      ("universeParams", namesJson family.universeParams.toArray)]
  | .target program =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "target"), ("program", ← programJson program)]
  | .prerequisite program index =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "prerequisite"),
      ("program", ← programJson program), ("index", toJson index.val)]
  | .lift family =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "lift"),
      ("selected", toJson family), ("lift", toJson family.lift.raw),
      ("port", toJson family.port.name),
      ("universeParams", namesJson family.universeParams.toArray),
      ("family", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.family)),
      ("familyType", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.familyType))]

  | .presentation family =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "presentation"),
      ("selected", toJson family),
      ("entry", toJson (reprStr family.entry)),
      ("declaration", NativeExpression.nameJson family.entry.declaration),
      ("source", toJson (reprStr family.source)), ("target", toJson (reprStr family.target)),
      ("category", toJson (reprStr family.category)),
      ("universeParams", namesJson family.universeParams.toArray),
      ("family", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.family)),
      ("familyType", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.familyType)),
      ("forwardPath", namesJson family.forwardPath), ("inversePath", namesJson family.inversePath)]
  | .routedMethod family =>
    let returning ← family.returns.mapM fun returned => do
      return Json.mkObj [
        ("route", Json.mkObj [("source", toJson (reprStr returned.route.source)),
          ("target", toJson (reprStr returned.route.target)),
          ("refs", toJson (reprStr returned.route.refs))]),
        ("rows", toJson (returned.rows.map fun row => row.id.raw)),
        ("category", toJson (reprStr returned.category)),
        ("categoryFamily", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add returned.categoryFamily)),
        ("resultFamily", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add returned.resultFamily)),
        ("actions", toJson (← returned.actions.mapM NativeExpression.Builder.add)),
        ("evidences", toJson (← returned.evidences.mapM NativeExpression.Builder.add)),
        ("agreement", toJson (← returned.agreement.mapM NativeExpression.Builder.add))]
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "routedMethod"),
      ("selected", toJson family),
      ("entry", toJson (reprStr family.entry)), ("functor", toJson (reprStr family.functor)),
      ("route", Json.mkObj [("source", toJson (reprStr family.route.source)),
        ("target", toJson (reprStr family.route.target)),
        ("refs", toJson (reprStr family.route.refs))]),
      ("universeParams", namesJson family.universeParams.toArray),
      ("parameterCount", toJson family.parameterCount),
      ("categoryFamily", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.categoryFamily)),
      ("functorFamily", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.functorFamily)),
      ("family", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.family)),
      ("actions", toJson (← family.actions.mapM NativeExpression.Builder.add)),
      ("return", toJson returning)]
  | .property family =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "property"),
      ("selected", toJson family),
      ("entry", toJson (reprStr family.entry)), ("classifier", toJson (reprStr family.classifier)),
      ("route", Json.mkObj [("source", toJson (reprStr family.route.source)),
        ("target", toJson (reprStr family.route.target)),
        ("refs", toJson (reprStr family.route.refs))]),
      ("universeParams", namesJson family.universeParams.toArray),
      ("parameterCount", toJson family.parameterCount),
      ("categoryFamily", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.categoryFamily)),
      ("family", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.family)),
      ("actions", toJson (← family.actions.mapM NativeExpression.Builder.add))]
  | .application family =>
    let owner := match family.owner with
      | .morphism entry => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "morphism"), ("entry", toJson (reprStr entry))]
      | .application entry => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "application"), ("entry", toJson (reprStr entry))]
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "application"),
      ("selected", toJson family), ("owner", owner),
      ("operation", toJson family.operation),
      ("declaration", NativeExpression.nameJson family.declaration),
      ("category", toJson (reprStr family.category)),
      ("universeParams", namesJson family.universeParams.toArray),
      ("family", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.family)),
      ("familyType", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.familyType)),
      ("path", namesJson family.path)]
  | .point family =>
    let owner := match family.owner with
      | .named (.morphism entry) =>
        Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "morphism"), ("entry", toJson (reprStr entry))]
      | .named (.application entry) =>
        Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "application"), ("entry", toJson (reprStr entry))]
      | .component entry constructors inverse =>
        Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "component"), ("entry", toJson (reprStr entry)),
          ("constructors", toJson (constructors.map (·.raw))), ("inverse", toJson inverse)]
      | .cartesian entry =>
        Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "cartesian"), ("entry", toJson (reprStr entry))]
      | .binder entry =>
        Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "binder"), ("entry", toJson (reprStr entry))]
      | .action edge =>
        Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "action"), ("edge", edgeImageDescriptor edge)]
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "point"),
      ("selected", toJson family), ("owner", owner),
      ("operation", toJson family.operation), ("whole", toJson family.whole),
      ("invocation", toJson family.invocation),
      ("declaration", NativeExpression.nameJson family.declaration),
      ("universeParams", namesJson family.universeParams.toArray),
      ("parameterCount", toJson family.parameterCount),
      ("category", toJson (reprStr family.category)),
      ("categoryFamily", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.categoryFamily)),
      ("arrowFamily", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.arrowFamily)),
      ("family", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.family)),
      ("familyType", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.familyType))]
  | .objectAction family =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "objectAction"),
      ("selected", toJson family),
      ("edge", edgeImageDescriptor family.edge), ("operation", toJson family.operation),
      ("declaration", NativeExpression.nameJson family.declaration),
      ("universeParams", namesJson family.universeParams.toArray),
      ("parameterCount", toJson family.parameterCount),
      ("category", toJson (reprStr family.category)),
      ("family", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.family)),
      ("familyType", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.familyType))]
  | .limit family owner =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "limit"),
      ("selected", toJson family), ("entry", toJson (reprStr family.entry)),
      ("declaration", NativeExpression.nameJson family.entry.declaration),
      ("universeParams", namesJson family.universeParams.toArray),
      ("parameterCount", toJson family.parameterCount),
      ("family", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.family)),
      ("owner", toJson (← owner.mapM ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson))]
  | .limitUniversal family owner =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "limitUniversal"),
      ("selected", toJson family),
      ("entry", toJson (reprStr family.presentation.entry)),
      ("operation", toJson family.operation),
      ("projection", NativeExpression.nameJson family.projection),
      ("declaration", NativeExpression.nameJson family.presentation.entry.declaration),
      ("universeParams", namesJson family.universeParams.toArray),
      ("parameterCount", toJson family.parameterCount),
      ("family", toJson (← NativeExpression.Builder.add family.family)),
      ("owner", toJson (← owner.mapM ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson))]
  | .creation family =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "creation"),
      ("selectedFamily", toJson family.family), ("targetFamily", toJson family.target),
      ("selectionData", toJson (← family.selectionData.mapM ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson)),
      ("targetOwner", toJson (← family.targetOwner.mapM ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson)),
      ("sourceOwner", toJson (← family.sourceOwner.mapM ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson)),
      ("selections", ← SourceSnapshot.selectionsJson family.selections),
      ("interface", ← SourceSnapshot.creationJson family.interface),
      ("universeArguments", toJson family.universes),
      ("targetUniverseArguments", toJson family.targetUniverses),
      ("arguments", toJson (← family.arguments.mapM ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson)),
      ("sourceArguments", toJson (← family.sourceArguments.mapM ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson)),
      ("sourcePositions", toJson family.sourcePositions),
      ("lift", toJson family.family.entry.id.raw),
      ("target", toJson family.target.entry.id.raw),
      ("construction", NativeExpression.nameJson family.construction),
      ("requestFamily", ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson family.requestFamily),
      ("owner", ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson family.owner)]

def fieldJson (field : FieldLayout) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [("address", namesJson field.address),
    ("projection", NativeExpression.nameJson field.projection),
    ("sourceIndex", toJson field.sourceIndex), ("wireIndex", toJson field.wireIndex),
    ("precedingDependencies", toJson field.precedingDependencies),
    ("source", ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson field.source),
    ("selections", ← SourceSnapshot.selectionsJson field.selections),
    ("typeFamily", ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson field.typeFamily),
    ("kind", toJson (reprStr field.kind)),
    ("actions", toJson (field.kind.actions.map reprStr))]

def layoutJson (layout : SourceLayout) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let fields ← layout.fields.mapM fieldJson
  return Json.mkObj [("address", namesJson layout.address),
    ("source", ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson layout.source),
    ("selections", ← SourceSnapshot.selectionsJson layout.selections),
    ("selectionBinding", toJson (layout.selectionBinding.map ContextSnapshot.bindingJson)),
    ("kind", toJson (reprStr layout.kind)),
    ("actions", toJson (layout.kind.actions.map reprStr)),
    ("fields", toJson fields), ("contextDependencies", toJson layout.contextDependencies),
    ("inputProjection", toJson (layout.inputProjection.map inputProjectionJson))]

def recordJson (record : RecordLayout) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let fields ← record.fields.mapM fun prepared => do
    return Json.mkObj [("field", ← fieldJson prepared.field),
      ("layout", ← layoutJson prepared.layout)]
  return Json.mkObj [("source", ← layoutJson record.source), ("fields", toJson fields)]

def argumentJson (argument : ArgumentLayout) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [("sourceIndex", toJson argument.sourceIndex),
    ("wireIndex", toJson argument.wireIndex), ("binderInfo", toJson argument.binderInfo),
    ("precedingDependencies", toJson argument.precedingDependencies),
    ("source", ← layoutJson argument.source),
    ("typeFamily", ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson argument.typeFamily)]

def applicationJson (application : ApplicationLayout) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let arguments ← application.arguments.mapM argumentJson
  return Json.mkObj [("arguments", toJson arguments),
    ("resultDependencies", toJson application.resultDependencies),
    ("resultTypeFamily", ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson application.resultTypeFamily),
    ("resultTermFamily", ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson application.resultTermFamily),
    ("result", ← layoutJson application.result),
    ("resultContextDependencies", toJson application.resultContextDependencies)]

def fieldDependencyViewJson (view : FieldDependencyView) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [("path", namesJson view.path),
    ("typeFamily", ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson view.typeFamily),
    ("precedingDependencies", toJson view.precedingDependencies)]

def recordAssociationJson (association : RecordAssociation) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [("id", identityJson association.id),
    ("program", identityJson association.program), ("occurrence", identityJson association.occurrence),
    ("layout", ← recordJson association.layout),
    ("bindings", toJson (association.bindings.map ContextSnapshot.bindingJson))]

/-- Serialize the already prepared constructor telescope and its exact native transport.
The original ports, proof positions and contexts are observed without reconstructing them. -/
def constructorPortsJson (plan : ConstructorPorts) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let ports ← plan.ports.mapM fun port => do
    return Json.mkObj [("binding", ContextSnapshot.bindingJson port.binding),
      ("argument", ← argumentJson port.argument)]
  return Json.mkObj [("interface", ← SourceSnapshot.limitInterfaceJson plan.interface),
    ("originalContext", ← ContextSnapshot.contextJson plan.originalContext),
    ("originalInstances", ContextSnapshot.instancesJson plan.originalContext),
    ("originalDeclarations", toJson (← plan.originalContext.nativeDeclarations.constants.mapM
      (NativeExpression.constantInfoJson NativeExpression.Builder.add))),
    ("context", ← ContextSnapshot.contextJson plan.context),
    ("instances", ContextSnapshot.instancesJson plan.context),
    ("declarations", toJson (← plan.context.nativeDeclarations.constants.mapM
      (NativeExpression.constantInfoJson NativeExpression.Builder.add))),
    ("contextInputs", toJson (plan.contextInputs.map ContextSnapshot.bindingJson)),
    ("ports", toJson ports), ("application", ← applicationJson plan.application)]

def constructorTransportJson (transport : ConstructorProjectionTransport) :
    StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [("plan", ← constructorPortsJson transport.plan),
    ("result", ← layoutJson transport.result), ("path", namesJson transport.path),
    ("selected", inputProjectionJson transport.selected),
    ("binding", ContextSnapshot.bindingJson transport.binding),
    ("source", ← layoutJson transport.source), ("target", ← layoutJson transport.target)]

/-- References name the actual node and ordered association chain. They contain no payload. -/
def valueIdentityJson (value : ValueBinding) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("value", identityJson value.value),
    ("associations", toJson (value.associationIds.map identityJson))]

def boundJson (context : ContextTelescope) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding) : Json :=
  toJson (context.entries.filterMap fun entry => bound[entry.id]?.map fun value =>
    Json.mkObj [("binding", ContextSnapshot.bindingJson entry.id),
      ("reference", valueIdentityJson value)])

partial def valueReferenceJson (value : ValueBinding) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let dependencyRoles ← value.dependencyRoles.mapM layoutJson
  let result := (valueIdentityJson value).setObjVal! "role" (← layoutJson value.role)
  let result := result.setObjVal! "sourceParameters"
    (toJson (value.sourceParameters?.map fun values =>
      values.map fun value => value.map valueIdentityJson))
  let result := result.setObjVal! "sourceDependencies"
    (toJson (value.sourceDependencies.map valueIdentityJson))
  let result := result.setObjVal! "dependencyRoles" (toJson dependencyRoles)
  return result.setObjVal! "admittedInterface"
    (toJson (← value.admittedInterface?.mapM valueReferenceJson))

def actualArgumentJson (argument : RuntimeArgument) (binding : BindingId) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("sourceIndex", toJson argument.index),
    ("reference", valueIdentityJson argument.value),
    ("binding", ContextSnapshot.bindingJson binding)]

def valuesJson (values : Array (Option ValueBinding)) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return toJson (← values.mapM fun value => value.mapM valueReferenceJson)

def telescopeInstantiationJson (view : TelescopeInstantiation) :
    StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [("id", identityJson view.id),
    ("sourceBinding", ContextSnapshot.bindingJson view.sourceBinding),
    ("transport", ← constructorTransportJson view.transport),
    ("source", ← layoutJson view.source), ("selected", ← valueReferenceJson view.selected),
    ("parameters", ← valuesJson view.parameters), ("path", namesJson view.path)]

/-- Original predecessor occurrences remain attached to their complete source-ordered frames. -/
def nativeFieldPrefixJson (nativePrefix : NativeFieldPrefix) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let frames ← nativePrefix.frames.mapM fun frame => do
    return Json.mkObj [("association", ← recordAssociationJson frame.association),
      ("field", ← fieldJson frame.field), ("preceding", ← valuesJson frame.preceding),
      ("dependencyView", toJson (← frame.view.mapM fieldDependencyViewJson))]
  return Json.mkObj [("native", ← layoutJson nativePrefix.native), ("frames", toJson frames)]

def sourceDependencyCaptureJson (capture : SourceDependencyCapture) :
    StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let projected ← capture.projectedFrom.mapM fun (parent, path) => do
    return Json.mkObj [("parent", ← valueReferenceJson parent), ("path", namesJson path)]
  return Json.mkObj [("source", ← layoutJson capture.source),
    ("parameters", ← valuesJson capture.parameters),
    ("references", toJson (← capture.references.mapM valueReferenceJson)),
    ("fieldPrefix", toJson (← capture.fieldPrefix.mapM nativeFieldPrefixJson)),
    ("projectedFrom", toJson projected)]

/-- Preserve the selected field and application associations of this actual reference.
Their ordered operands remain references to the existing graph, not copied returned values. -/
def valueJson (value : ValueBinding) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let fields ← value.instantiations.mapM fun field => do
    let view ← field.view.mapM fieldDependencyViewJson
    return Json.mkObj [("id", identityJson field.id),
      ("association", ← recordAssociationJson field.association),
      ("field", ← fieldJson field.field), ("preceding", ← valuesJson field.preceding),
      ("dependencyView", toJson view)]
  let applications ← value.applications.mapM fun application => do
    let association := application.association
    return Json.mkObj [("association", Json.mkObj [("id", identityJson association.id),
        ("program", identityJson association.program),
        ("occurrence", identityJson association.occurrence),
        ("layout", ← applicationJson association.layout),
        ("path", namesJson association.path), ("dependencies", toJson association.dependencies),
        ("contextDependencies", toJson association.contextDependencies)]),
      ("parameters", ← valuesJson application.parameters),
      ("applicationParameters", ← valuesJson application.applicationParameters),
      ("arguments", ← valuesJson application.arguments),
      ("callable", toJson (← application.callable.mapM valueReferenceJson)),
      ("access", toJson (← application.access.mapM valueReferenceJson))]
  let projections ← value.projectionAccesses.mapM fun (parent, path) => do
    return Json.mkObj [("parent", ← valueReferenceJson parent), ("path", namesJson path)]
  return Json.mkObj [("reference", ← valueReferenceJson value),
    ("fields", toJson fields), ("applications", toJson applications),
    ("projections", toJson projections),
    ("telescopes", toJson (← value.telescopeInstantiations.mapM telescopeInstantiationJson))]

def applicationOriginJson (origin : ApplicationOrigin) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [("layout", ← applicationJson origin.layout),
    ("parameters", ← valuesJson origin.parameters), ("arguments", ← valuesJson origin.arguments),
    ("path", namesJson origin.path), ("dependencies", toJson origin.dependencies),
    ("contextDependencies", toJson origin.contextDependencies),
    ("callable", toJson (← origin.callable.mapM valueJson))]

/-- The explicit admitted input relation keeps both complete native and consuming views,
with the exact original application and selected runtime reference. This observes the sealed
certificate; the JSON does not create or validate one. -/
def admittedInputInterfaceJson (original : AdmittedInputInterface) :
    StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [("program", identityJson original.program),
    ("occurrence", identityJson original.occurrence), ("role", ← layoutJson original.role),
    ("parameters", ← valuesJson original.parameters),
    ("application", ← applicationOriginJson original.application),
    ("selected", ← valueJson original.selected), ("native", ← valueJson original.native)]

def originJson (origin : ValueOrigin) (dependencies : Array ValueBinding) :
    StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [("occurrence", identityJson origin.occurrence),
    ("program", identityJson origin.program), ("role", ← layoutJson origin.role),
    ("parameters", ← valuesJson origin.parameters),
    ("application", toJson (← origin.application.mapM applicationOriginJson)),
    ("access", toJson (← origin.access.mapM valueJson)),
    ("accessPath", namesJson origin.accessPath),
    ("fieldPrefix", toJson (← origin.fieldPrefix.mapM nativeFieldPrefixJson)),
    ("sourceDependencyCapture", toJson (← origin.sourceDependencies.mapM sourceDependencyCaptureJson)),
    ("inputInterface", toJson (← origin.inputInterface.mapM admittedInputInterfaceJson)),
    ("sourceDependencies", toJson (dependencies.map valueIdentityJson))]

def roleScopeJson (scope : RoleScope) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("program", identityJson scope.program),
    ("occurrence", identityJson scope.occurrence), ("preparation", identityJson scope.preparation)]

def roleIdJson (role : RoleId) : Json :=
  let address := match role.address with
    | .context binding => Json.mkObj [("context", ContextSnapshot.bindingJson binding)]
    | .argument position => Json.mkObj [("argument", toJson position)]
    | .result path => Json.mkObj [("result", namesJson path)]
    | .capture position => Json.mkObj [("capture", toJson position)]
  Json.mkObj [("scope", roleScopeJson role.scope), ("address", address)]

def roleJson (role : ComputationalRole) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  return Json.mkObj [("id", roleIdJson role.id),
    ("source", ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson role.source),
    ("typeFamily", ← ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson role.typeFamily),
    ("dependencies", toJson (role.dependencies.map roleIdJson))]

def rolesJson (roles : RoleTelescope) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let context ← roles.context.mapM roleJson
  let arguments ← roles.arguments.mapM fun argument => do
    return Json.mkObj [("role", ← roleJson argument.role),
      ("wireIndex", toJson argument.wireIndex)]
  let results ← roles.results.mapM fun result => do
    return Json.mkObj [("role", ← roleJson result.role), ("layout", ← layoutJson result.layout),
      ("wirePath", toJson result.wirePath)]
  let captures ← roles.captures.mapM fun capture => do
    return Json.mkObj [("role", ← roleJson capture.role), ("layout", ← layoutJson capture.layout)]
  return Json.mkObj [("scope", roleScopeJson roles.scope), ("source", ← layoutJson roles.source),
    ("context", toJson context), ("arguments", toJson arguments),
    ("results", toJson results), ("captures", toJson captures)]

def environmentJson (environment : RuntimeEnvironment) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  let values ← environment.values.mapM fun value => value.mapM valueJson
  return Json.mkObj [("worker", toJson environment.worker),
    ("context", ← ContextSnapshot.contextJson environment.context),
    ("instances", ContextSnapshot.instancesJson environment.context), ("values", toJson values),
    ("bound", boundJson environment.context environment.bound),
    ("selections", ← SourceSnapshot.selectionsJson environment.selections)]

def actionJson (action : PreparedAction) : StateM NativeExpression.Builder Json := do
  match action with
  | .primitive boundary arguments =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "primitive"),
      ("boundary", ← boundaryJson boundary), ("universeArguments", toJson arguments)]
  | .project operand field =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "project"),
      ("operand", ← valueJson operand), ("field", ← fieldJson field)]
  | .apply callable arguments values =>
    return Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "apply"), ("callable", ← valueJson callable),
      ("arguments", toJson (← arguments.mapM ContextSnapshot.closedTermJson)),
      ("values", ← valuesJson values)]

/-- Readability is prepared while the original native contexts may be opened.
Later observation reads only the strings returned here. -/
def readableTerm (term : ClosedTerm) : MetaM Json :=
  term.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let type := term.type.instantiateRev (bindings.map (·.expression))
    return Json.mkObj [("expression", toJson (← ppExpr expression).pretty),
      ("type", toJson (← ppExpr type).pretty)]

/-- Add the retained source address without reopening or rendering the term a second time. -/
def readableLayout (layout : SourceLayout) : MetaM Json := do
  let source ← readableTerm layout.source
  return source.setObjVal! "inputProjection"
    (toJson (layout.inputProjection.map readableInputProjectionJson))
    |>.setObjVal! "selectionBinding"
      (toJson (layout.selectionBinding.map ContextSnapshot.bindingJson))

def readableContext (context : ContextTelescope) : MetaM Json :=
  context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let entries ← bindings.mapM fun binding => do
      let declaration ← getFVarLocalDecl binding.expression
      let value ← (declaration.value? true).mapM fun value => return (← ppExpr value).pretty
      let originalSource ← binding.originalSource.mapM fun source => return (← ppExpr source).pretty
      return Json.mkObj [("id", ContextSnapshot.bindingJson binding.id),
        ("name", toJson (declaration.userName.toString (escape := false))),
        ("type", toJson (← ppExpr declaration.type).pretty), ("value", toJson value),
        ("originalSource", toJson originalSource)]
    return toJson entries

def readableRole (role : ComputationalRole) (layout : Option SourceLayout := none) :
    MetaM Json := do
  let mut source ← readableTerm role.source
  if let some layout := layout then
    source := source.setObjVal! "inputProjection"
      (toJson (layout.inputProjection.map readableInputProjectionJson))
  return Json.mkObj [("id", roleIdJson role.id), ("source", source),
    ("typeFamily", ← readableTerm role.typeFamily)]

def readableApplication (application : ApplicationLayout) : MetaM Json := do
  let arguments ← application.arguments.mapM fun argument => do
    return Json.mkObj [("sourceIndex", toJson argument.sourceIndex),
      ("wireIndex", toJson argument.wireIndex),
      ("source", ← readableLayout argument.source),
      ("typeFamily", ← readableTerm argument.typeFamily)]
  return Json.mkObj [("arguments", toJson arguments),
    ("resultTypeFamily", ← readableTerm application.resultTypeFamily),
    ("resultTermFamily", ← readableTerm application.resultTermFamily),
    ("result", ← readableLayout application.result)]

end Observation

/-- Prepare the reached native request after its complete provenance has been fixed.
Reuse the exact native expression graph and closed-source serializer; no canonical quotient,
source reconstruction, provider call or completed payload copy enters the observation. -/
opaque ObservationDescriptor.prepare
    (program : RuntimeId .program) (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence) (action : PreparedAction)
    (source : SourceLayout) (scope : Array ValueBinding) (outputs : Array SourceLayout)
    (record : Option RecordLayout) (environment : RuntimeEnvironment) (origin : ValueOrigin)
    (application : Option ApplicationLayout) (roles : RoleTelescope)
    (actualArguments : Array RuntimeArgument := #[]) :
    MetaM ObservationDescriptor := do
  let dependencies ← IO.ofExcept <| origin.typeDependencies.mapError IO.userError
  let actualArguments ← actualArguments.mapM fun argument => do
    let some declared := roles.arguments[argument.index]?
      | throwError "an observed actual argument is outside its prepared source telescope"
    let binding ← declared.role.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
      let .fvar localId := expression
        | throwError "the source observation lost its typed argument binder"
      let some binding := bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == localId)
        | throwError "the observed argument is outside its complete source context"
      let some original := environment.bound[binding.id]?
        | throwError "the observed argument lost its actual source binding"
      unless retainsReference original argument.value do
        throwError "the observed argument changed its original source occurrence"
      return binding.id
    return Observation.actualArgumentJson argument binding
  let build : StateM NativeExpression.Builder (Json × Array Nat) := do
    let action ← Observation.actionJson action
    let sourceDocument ← Observation.layoutJson source
    let scope ← scope.mapM Observation.valueJson
    let outputs ← outputs.mapM Observation.layoutJson
    let record ← record.mapM Observation.recordJson
    let environment ← Observation.environmentJson environment
    let origin ← Observation.originJson origin dependencies
    let application ← application.mapM Observation.applicationJson
    let roles ← Observation.rolesJson roles
    let request := Json.mkObj [
      ("program", Observation.identityJson program),
      ("occurrence", Observation.identityJson occurrence),
      ("action", action), ("source", sourceDocument), ("scope", toJson scope),
      ("outputs", toJson outputs), ("record", toJson record), ("environment", environment),
      ("origin", origin), ("application", toJson application), ("roles", roles),
      ("actualArguments", toJson actualArguments)]
    let expression ← NativeExpression.Builder.add source.source.expression
    let type ← NativeExpression.Builder.add source.source.type
    return (request, #[expression, type])
  let ((request, roots), builder) := build.run {}
  let native := Json.mkObj [("request", request), ("nativeExpressions", builder.finish roots)]
  let context ← Observation.readableContext environment.context
  let arguments ← roles.arguments.mapM fun argument => Observation.readableRole argument.role
  let results ← roles.results.mapM fun result =>
    Observation.readableRole result.role (some result.layout)
  let captures ← roles.captures.mapM fun capture =>
    Observation.readableRole capture.role (some capture.layout)
  let sourceText ← Observation.readableLayout source
  let applicationText ← application.mapM Observation.readableApplication
  let readable := Json.mkObj [("source", sourceText),
    ("context", context), ("arguments", toJson arguments),
    ("results", toJson results), ("captures", toJson captures),
    ("application", toJson applicationText),
    ("bound", Observation.boundJson environment.context environment.bound),
    ("sourceDependencies", toJson (dependencies.map Observation.valueIdentityJson))]
  return ⟨native, readable, none, none⟩

/-- Updating a supplied source selection does not reopen or re-render the native descriptor. -/
opaque ObservationDescriptor.withSelection (descriptor : ObservationDescriptor)
    (selection : Option Name) : ObservationDescriptor :=
  { descriptor with selection := selection.map NativeExpression.nameJson }

/-- Attach the source document prepared by the authorized frontend handoff. -/
opaque ObservationDescriptor.withSourceSnapshot (descriptor : ObservationDescriptor)
    (sourceSnapshot : Option Json) : ObservationDescriptor :=
  { descriptor with sourceSnapshot }

def ObservationDescriptor.toJson (descriptor : ObservationDescriptor) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("native", descriptor.native), ("readable", descriptor.readable),
    ("selection", Lean.toJson descriptor.selection),
    ("sourceSnapshot", Lean.toJson descriptor.sourceSnapshot)]

end CasRuntime
