public import CasRuntime.Value
public import CasContract.Registration

public section

namespace CasRuntime

/-- The already selected registration and frozen profile; this record performs no selection. -/
structure DispatchIdentity where
  manifestDigest : String
  registration : CasCatalogue.Registration
  profileDigest : String
  deriving DecidableEq, BEq, Repr

/-- A selected primitive or the exact stored native code node and local token.
Native dispatch retains its existing owner in DispatchReservation.connection. -/
inductive DispatchTarget where
  | primitive (identity : DispatchIdentity)
  | native (value : RuntimeId .value) (token : String)
  deriving BEq, Repr

structure DispatchReservation where
  private mk ::
  occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence
  transaction : RuntimeId .transaction
  selected : DispatchTarget
  connection : ConnectionGeneration
  dependencies : Array ConnectionGeneration

inductive ReservationFailure
  | wrongWorker | unknownOccurrence | consumed | staleOwner | referenceOutsideGraph
  | invalidExport | wrongConnection
  deriving BEq, Repr

private inductive OccurrenceStatus
  | fresh
  | abandoned
  | pending (reservation : DispatchReservation)
  | sent (reservation : DispatchReservation)
  | consumed (reservation : DispatchReservation)

/-- Only resource status and pending locators live here; completed payloads belong to ValueGraph.
Reference: Lean v4.33.0 Std.Sync.Mutex and Std.HashMap. -/
structure OccurrenceLedger where
  private mk ::
  owners : OwnerRegistry
  private state : Std.Mutex (Std.HashMap (RuntimeId .occurrence) OccurrenceStatus)

opaque OccurrenceLedger.new (owners : OwnerRegistry) : BaseIO OccurrenceLedger := do
  return ⟨owners, ← Std.Mutex.new {}⟩

/-- Allocate an invocation before elaboration, normalization or realization selection can merge it. -/
opaque OccurrenceLedger.allocate (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) : BaseIO (RuntimeId .occurrence) := do
  let id ← ledger.owners.identities.fresh .occurrence
  ledger.state.atomically do
    modify fun state => state.insert id .fresh
  return id

/-- Owner retirement and the one-use reservation cannot interleave.
The nested ledger section holds no engine I/O and stores no value or completion payload. -/
private def reserveTarget (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (id : RuntimeId .occurrence)
    (transaction : RuntimeId .transaction) (selected : DispatchTarget) (connection : Connection)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (arguments : Array ValueBinding) :
    BaseIO (Except ReservationFailure DispatchReservation) := do
  unless id.worker == ledger.owners.worker && transaction.worker == ledger.owners.worker &&
      graph.worker == ledger.owners.worker && connection.generation.worker == ledger.owners.worker do
    return .error .wrongWorker
  let .ok dependencies := graph.requiredOwners arguments
    | return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
  let dependencies := if dependencies.contains connection.generation then dependencies
    else dependencies.push connection.generation
  let result ← ledger.owners.atomicallyWhileLive dependencies <| ledger.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    match state[id]? with
    | none => return .error .unknownOccurrence
    | some .fresh =>
      let reservation : DispatchReservation :=
        ⟨id, transaction, selected, connection.generation, dependencies⟩
      set (state.insert id (.pending reservation))
      return .ok reservation
    | some .abandoned | some (.pending _) | some (.sent _) | some (.consumed _) => return .error .consumed
  match result with
  | some reserved => return reserved
  | none => return .error .staleOwner

/-- Reserve the already selected primitive under the shared one-use owner/ledger transition. -/
opaque OccurrenceLedger.reserve (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (id : RuntimeId .occurrence)
    (transaction : RuntimeId .transaction) (selected : DispatchIdentity) (connection : Connection)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (arguments : Array ValueBinding) :
    BaseIO (Except ReservationFailure DispatchReservation) :=
  reserveTarget ledger id transaction (.primitive selected) connection graph arguments

/-- Resolve the actual stored code and reserve only its original supplying connection.
Reuse: ValueGraph.callable and the same atomic reservation as primitive dispatch.
The complete callable reference brings its actual captures and dependent owner closure. -/
opaque OccurrenceLedger.reserveExport (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (id : RuntimeId .occurrence)
    (transaction : RuntimeId .transaction) (callable : ValueBinding) (connection : Connection)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (arguments : Array ValueBinding) :
    BaseIO (Except ReservationFailure DispatchReservation) := do
  let .ok code := graph.callable callable | return .error .invalidExport
  let some node := graph.find code.value | return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
  let .ownedToken owner token _ := node.payload.data | return .error .invalidExport
  if token.isEmpty then return .error .invalidExport
  unless owner == connection.generation do return .error .wrongConnection
  reserveTarget ledger id transaction (.native code.value token) connection graph
    (arguments.push callable)

/-- Inspect coordination state; only the atomic reservation can authorize dispatch. -/
opaque OccurrenceLedger.isFresh (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (id : RuntimeId .occurrence) :
    BaseIO Bool := ledger.state.atomically do
  return (← get)[id]? matches some .fresh

/-- A failed claimed producer cannot acquire a new dispatch right after rollback. -/
opaque OccurrenceLedger.abandon (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (id : RuntimeId .occurrence) :
    BaseIO Unit := ledger.state.atomically do
  let state ← get
  if state[id]? matches some .fresh then set (state.insert id .abandoned)

/-- Return only the locator belonging to this exact active transaction. -/
opaque OccurrenceLedger.pendingFor (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (id : RuntimeId .occurrence)
    (transaction : RuntimeId .transaction) : BaseIO (Option DispatchReservation) :=
  ledger.state.atomically do
    match (← get)[id]? with
    | some (.pending reservation) | some (.sent reservation) =>
      return if reservation.transaction == transaction then some reservation else none
    | _ => return none

/-- Whether this exact reservation's occurrence has been sent and not yet retired: the state in
which the provider may suspend it and the kernel may resume it (execution contract §6).
A resume continues that one dispatch; it is not a second dispatch right. -/
opaque OccurrenceLedger.wasSent (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (reservation : DispatchReservation) :
    BaseIO Bool := ledger.state.atomically do
  match (← get)[reservation.occurrence]? with
  | some (.sent active) =>
    return active.transaction == reservation.transaction &&
      active.connection == reservation.connection && active.selected == reservation.selected
  | _ => return false

/-- Commit this exact reserved invocation to one send, after rechecking actual owners.
The pending locator remains available for scope and reply admission. Engine I/O follows
outside both locks; a later connection loss cannot grant another send.
Reuse: OwnerRegistry.atomicallyWhileLive and the existing one-use ledger transition. -/
opaque OccurrenceLedger.commitSend (ledger : OccurrenceLedger)
    (reservation : DispatchReservation) : BaseIO (Except ReservationFailure Unit) := do
  let result ← ledger.owners.atomicallyWhileLive reservation.dependencies <|
      ledger.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let some status := state[reservation.occurrence]?
      | return .error .unknownOccurrence
    match status with
    | .pending active =>
      unless active.transaction == reservation.transaction &&
          active.connection == reservation.connection && active.selected == reservation.selected do
        return .error .consumed
      set (state.insert reservation.occurrence (.sent active))
      return .ok ()
    | .fresh | .abandoned | .sent _ | .consumed _ => return .error .consumed
  return result.getD (.error .staleOwner)

/-- Retire once. The consumed tombstone remains outside all semantic snapshots. -/
opaque OccurrenceLedger.retire (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (reservation : DispatchReservation) :
    BaseIO Bool :=
  ledger.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let some status := state[reservation.occurrence]? | return false
    let active ← match status with
      | .pending active | .sent active => pure active
      | .fresh | .abandoned | .consumed _ => return false
    unless active.transaction == reservation.transaction &&
        active.connection == reservation.connection && active.selected == reservation.selected do
      return false
    set (state.insert reservation.occurrence (.consumed active))
    return true

end CasRuntime

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
  let callableRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkConst ``Nat.succ))
  liftM (m := IO) do
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← OccurrenceLedger.new owners
    let graph := ValueGraph.empty owners.identities
    let first ← ledger.allocate
    let firstTransaction ← owners.identities.fresh .transaction
    let secondTransaction ← owners.identities.fresh .transaction
    let child ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let choice : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "resource-test-manifest"
        registration := { operation := "resource-test", input := "resource-test", backend := "cat" }
        profileDigest := "resource-test-profile" }
      let tasks ← (Array.range 32).mapM fun index => IO.asTask do
        let transaction := if index % 2 == 0 then firstTransaction else secondTransaction
        ledger.reserve first transaction choice child graph #[]
      let results ← tasks.mapM fun task => IO.ofExcept task.get
      let winners := results.filterMap (·.toOption)
      unless winners.size == 1 do
        throw <| IO.userError "an occurrence reservation did not have exactly one winner"
      let some winner := winners[0]?
        | throw <| IO.userError "the successful reservation is missing"
      unless winner.selected == .primitive choice && winner.connection == child.generation do
        throw <| IO.userError "reservation changed the selected realization or connection"
      unless (← ledger.pendingFor first winner.transaction).isSome do
        throw <| IO.userError "the owning transaction lost its pending occurrence"
      let unrelated ← owners.identities.fresh .transaction
      if (← ledger.pendingFor first unrelated).isSome then
        throw <| IO.userError "another transaction acquired the pending occurrence"
      let senders ← (Array.range 32).mapM fun _ => IO.asTask do
        match ← ledger.commitSend winner with
        | .ok () =>
          child.child.stdin.putStr "one reserved frame\n"
          child.child.stdin.flush
          return true
        | .error .consumed => return false
        | .error _ => throw <| IO.userError "a reserved send failed for an unexpected reason"
      let sent ← senders.mapM fun task => IO.ofExcept task.get
      unless (sent.filter id).size == 1 &&
          (← child.child.stdout.getLine) == "one reserved frame\n" do
        throw <| IO.userError "a reserved occurrence allowed more than one actual sender"
      unless (← ledger.pendingFor first winner.transaction).isSome do
        throw <| IO.userError "sending removed the invocation before reply admission"
      unless ← ledger.retire winner do
        throw <| IO.userError "the pending occurrence did not retire"
      if (← ledger.pendingFor first winner.transaction).isSome then
        throw <| IO.userError "a consumed occurrence remains pending"
      match ← ledger.reserve first unrelated choice child graph #[] with
      | .error .consumed => pure ()
      | _ => throw <| IO.userError "a consumed occurrence acquired another dispatch right"
      let second ← ledger.allocate
      unless second.serial > first.serial do
        throw <| IO.userError "a new invocation reused an occurrence identity"
      let captureOwner ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
      try
        captureOwner.child.stdin.putStr "captured token\n"
        captureOwner.child.stdin.flush
        let token := (← captureOwner.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
        let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
        let (capturedGraph, captured) ← graph.stage owners.identities
          { program, occurrence := second, role, parameters := #[] } (.ownedExport captureOwner token #[])
        let .ok reserved ← ledger.reserve second unrelated choice child capturedGraph #[captured]
          | throw <| IO.userError "the live captured argument could not reserve"
        child.child.stdin.putStr "retained code token\n"
        child.child.stdin.flush
        let codeToken := (← child.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
        let (nativeGraph, native) ← capturedGraph.stage owners.identities
          { program, occurrence := second, role := callableRole, parameters := #[] }
          (.ownedExport child codeToken #[captured])
        let nativeOccurrence ← ledger.allocate
        let .ok nativeReservation ← ledger.reserveExport nativeOccurrence unrelated native child
            nativeGraph #[]
          | throw <| IO.userError "a native export with live captures could not reserve"
        owners.close captureOwner.generation
        match ← ledger.commitSend nativeReservation with
        | .error .staleOwner => pure ()
        | _ => throw <| IO.userError "native send commitment accepted a lost capture owner"
        discard <| ledger.retire nativeReservation
        let deadCaptureOccurrence ← ledger.allocate
        match ← ledger.reserveExport deadCaptureOccurrence unrelated native child nativeGraph #[] with
        | .error .staleOwner => pure ()
        | _ => throw <| IO.userError "native reservation accepted a known-dead capture owner"
        match ← ledger.commitSend reserved with
        | .error .staleOwner => pure ()
        | _ => throw <| IO.userError "send commitment accepted a captured owner lost after reservation"
        discard <| ledger.retire reserved
        match ← ledger.reserve second unrelated choice child capturedGraph #[captured] with
        | .error .staleOwner => pure ()
        | _ => throw <| IO.userError "reservation accepted a known-dead captured owner"
        unless ← owners.isLive child.generation do
          throw <| IO.userError "capture invalidation closed the supplying connection"
      finally owners.close captureOwner.generation
      owners.close child.generation
      let third ← ledger.allocate
      match ← ledger.reserve third unrelated choice child graph #[] with
      | .error .staleOwner => pure ()
      | _ => throw <| IO.userError "reservation accepted a known-dead supplying connection"
    finally owners.close child.generation

public import Std.Sync.Mutex
public import Std.Data.HashMap
public import Init.System.IO
public import CasRuntime.Identity

public section

namespace CasRuntime

structure ConnectionGeneration where
  private mk ::
  worker : String
  serial : Nat
  deriving BEq, Hashable, Repr

abbrev ConnectedChild := IO.Process.Child {
  stdin := .piped, stdout := .piped, stderr := .inherit }

/-- A generation and channels from the same actual process. -/
structure Connection where
  private mk ::
  generation : ConnectionGeneration
  child : ConnectedChild
  exited : Task (Except IO.Error UInt32)

private structure OwnerState where
  live : Std.HashMap Nat ConnectedChild := {}

/-- Live process state belongs to the worker, independently of semantic snapshots. -/
structure OwnerRegistry where
  private mk ::
  identities : IdentitySupply
  private state : Std.Mutex OwnerState

def OwnerRegistry.worker (owners : OwnerRegistry) : String := owners.identities.worker

private def retire (owners : OwnerRegistry) (generation : ConnectionGeneration) : BaseIO Unit :=
  owners.state.atomically do
    modify fun state => { state with live := state.live.erase generation.serial }

/-- Connections and retained runtime values share the worker's monotone identity supply. -/
opaque OwnerRegistry.new : IO OwnerRegistry := do
  return ⟨← IdentitySupply.new, ← Std.Mutex.new {}⟩

/-- Stamp the supplying process before any reply can be admitted.
Uses Lean v4.33.0 `IO.Process` and `Std.Mutex`; process waits run outside the mutex. -/
opaque OwnerRegistry.spawn (owners : OwnerRegistry) (arguments : IO.Process.SpawnArgs) :
    IO Connection := do
  let child : ConnectedChild ← IO.Process.spawn {
    arguments with stdin := .piped, stdout := .piped, stderr := .inherit }
  let identity ← owners.identities.fresh .connection
  let generation : ConnectionGeneration := ⟨identity.worker, identity.serial⟩
  owners.state.atomically do
    modify fun state => { state with live := state.live.insert generation.serial child }
  let exited ← IO.asTask (prio := .dedicated) do
    try child.wait
    finally retire owners generation
  return ⟨generation, child, exited⟩

/-- Read the supervisor's liveness state, without contacting the engine. -/
opaque OwnerRegistry.isLive (owners : OwnerRegistry) (generation : ConnectionGeneration) :
    BaseIO Bool := do
  if generation.worker != owners.worker then return false
  owners.state.atomically do
    return (← get).live.contains generation.serial

/-- Check all owners and run a short ledger transition under the owner-retirement lock.
The action must not wait for engine traffic or reacquire this registry's lock.
Reference: Lean v4.33.0 Std/Sync/Mutex.lean, `Mutex.atomically`. -/
opaque OwnerRegistry.atomicallyWhileLive [Monad m] [MonadLiftT BaseIO m]
    [MonadLiftT (ST IO.RealWorld) m] [MonadFinally m]
    (owners : OwnerRegistry) (generations : Array ConnectionGeneration)
    (action : m α) : m (Option α) :=
  owners.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    unless generations.all (fun generation =>
        generation.worker == owners.worker && state.live.contains generation.serial) do
      return none
    return some (← action)

/-- Owner-free data remain available. Captured owner sets must all remain live. -/
def OwnerRegistry.allAlive (owners : OwnerRegistry) (generations : Array ConnectionGeneration) :
    BaseIO Bool := do
  return (← owners.atomicallyWhileLive generations (pure ())).isSome

/-- Revoke the generation before terminating its process. Repeated cleanup is inert. -/
opaque OwnerRegistry.revoke (owners : OwnerRegistry) (generation : ConnectionGeneration) : IO Bool := do
  if generation.worker != owners.worker then
    throw <| IO.userError "connection cleanup belongs to a different worker"
  let child ← owners.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let child := state.live[generation.serial]?
    set { state with live := state.live.erase generation.serial }
    return child
  if let some child := child then
    try child.kill
    catch error =>
      -- Linux ESRCH means that termination has already completed. Lean's wait task
      -- can reap the child between registry revocation and this signal.
      -- References: Lean v4.33.0 src/runtime/process.cpp, lean_io_process_child_kill;
      -- Linux include/uapi/asm-generic/errno-base.h, ESRCH.
      match error with
      | .noSuchThing _ code _ =>
        if code == 3 then pure () else throw error
      | _ => throw error
  return child.isSome

opaque OwnerRegistry.close (owners : OwnerRegistry) (generation : ConnectionGeneration) : IO Unit := do
  discard <| owners.revoke generation

end CasRuntime

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftIO do
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let first ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
  try
    let second ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      if first.generation == second.generation then
        throw <| IO.userError "separate connections share a generation"
      unless ← owners.allAlive #[first.generation, second.generation] do
        throw <| IO.userError "live child connections are unavailable"
      first.child.stdin.putStr "first\n"
      first.child.stdin.flush
      unless (← first.child.stdout.getLine) == "first\n" do
        throw <| IO.userError "the first generation lost its own channel"
      owners.close first.generation
      if ← owners.isLive first.generation then
        throw <| IO.userError "a closed generation remains available"
      unless ← owners.isLive second.generation do
        throw <| IO.userError "closing one generation invalidated another"
      unless ← owners.allAlive #[] do
        throw <| IO.userError "owner-free data became unavailable"
      second.child.stdin.putStr "second\n"
      second.child.stdin.flush
      unless (← second.child.stdout.getLine) == "second\n" do
        throw <| IO.userError "the surviving generation lost its own channel"
      let third ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
      try
        unless third.generation.serial > second.generation.serial do
          throw <| IO.userError "a new connection reused a generation"
      finally owners.close third.generation
    finally owners.close second.generation
  finally owners.close first.generation

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftIO do
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let child ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/usr/bin/true" }
  discard <| IO.ofExcept child.exited.get
  if ← owners.isLive child.generation then
    throw <| IO.userError "a terminated process retains a live generation"

-- An actual supplying process returns a diagnostic token. Repeated packet positions retain
-- that handle and its exact captures; they do not acquire native point identities.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let scalar ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 0))
  let callable ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkConst ``Nat.succ))
  liftM (m := IO) do
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← OccurrenceLedger.new owners
    let supplier ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    let receiver ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      supplier.child.stdin.putStr "inert-point-handle\n"
      supplier.child.stdin.flush
      let token := (← supplier.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
      let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      let occurrence ← ledger.allocate
      let origin := { program, occurrence, role := scalar, parameters := #[] : ValueOrigin }
      let (graph, first) ← (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities origin
        (.portable "0".toUTF8)
      let (graph, second) ← graph.stage owners.identities origin (.portable "0".toUTF8)
      let (graph, image) ← graph.stage owners.identities origin (.portable "3".toUTF8)
      let values := #[first, second, image]
      let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "packet-ownership", profileDigest := "packet-ownership"
        registration := {
          operation := "packet-ownership", input := "packet-ownership", backend := "cat" } }
      let transaction ← owners.identities.fresh .transaction
      let .ok reservation ← ledger.reserve occurrence transaction selected supplier graph values
        | throw <| IO.userError "the original packet scope could not reserve"
      let scope ← RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph values #[] #[]
      let point := (ComputationalValue.opaque token).encode
      let packet := Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "finiteGraph"),
        ("args", .arr #[.arr #[point],
          .arr #[.arr #[point, (ScopedReference.scope 2).encode]]])]
      let encodedPacket := Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "finiteGraph"),
        ("args", .arr #[.arr #[point], .arr #[.arr #[point, toJson (3 : Nat)]]])]
      let frame := fun capture => Json.mkObj [
        ("request_id", toJson (91 : Nat)), ("status", toJson "ok"), ("value", packet),
        ("exports", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("token", toJson token),
          ("captures", .arr #[(ScopedReference.scope capture).encode])]])]
      let reply ← ImmediateReply.parseControl scope reservation graph scope.wireId 91 (frame 0)
      let .ok admitted := CallablePacket.finiteWith packet none
          (some #[CallableDatum.literal (toJson (3 : Nat))])
          (fun value path => reply.callableDatum graph value path)
        | throw <| IO.userError "the same admitted inert handle lost its finite framing"
      let descriptor ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (reply.packetDescriptor graph supplier #[]).mapError IO.userError
      let #[firstExport, secondExport] := descriptor.exports
        | throw <| IO.userError "inert framing changed the complete original export positions"
      unless
          descriptor.slots.map (·.binding.value) == #[image.value] &&
          firstExport.path != secondExport.path &&
          firstExport.originPath != secondExport.originPath &&
          descriptor.exports.all (fun owned =>
            owned.originScope == reply.scopeId && owned.originPath == owned.path &&
              owned.owner == supplier.generation && owned.token == token &&
              owned.captures.map (·.value) == #[first.value]) do
        throw <| IO.userError "inert framing merged packet positions or changed actual captures"
      let fragment ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (reply.packetDescriptor graph supplier firstExport.path).mapError IO.userError
      let #[fragmentExport] := fragment.exports
        | throw <| IO.userError "an original export fragment changed its complete slot"
      let moved := fragmentExport.prefixed #[.field "nested"]
      unless fragmentExport.path.isEmpty && fragmentExport.originScope == firstExport.originScope &&
          fragmentExport.originPath == firstExport.originPath &&
          moved.path == #[.field "nested"] && moved.originScope == fragmentExport.originScope &&
          moved.originPath == fragmentExport.originPath do
        throw <| IO.userError "packet prefixing changed the original reply export occurrence"
      let (framed, framingBindings, framingExports) ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (ValueContainer.nativeFraming #[descriptor, descriptor, fragment]).mapError IO.userError
      let #[framingFirst, framingSecond] := framingExports
        | throw <| IO.userError "native framing changed the complete original export table"
      unless framed.size == 3 && framingBindings.size == 2 &&
          framingFirst.originPath != framingSecond.originPath do
        throw <| IO.userError "native framing merged equal tokens from distinct original positions"
      let .ok firstGraph := (framed[0]!.getObjVal? "args").bind (·.getArr?)
        | throw <| IO.userError "native framing lost the original complete graph"
      let .ok inventory := firstGraph[0]!.getArr?
        | throw <| IO.userError "native framing lost the original graph inventory"
      unless inventory[0]! == (ScopedReference.scope 2).encode &&
          framed[2]! == (ScopedReference.scope 2).encode do
        throw <| IO.userError "a repeated original export fragment received another native position"
      let conflict ← IO.ofExcept <| (PacketExport.fromConnection receiver
        fragmentExport.originScope fragmentExport.originPath fragmentExport.path
        fragmentExport.token fragmentExport.captures).mapError IO.userError
      let conflictPayload ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (ValuePayload.descriptor fragment.template fragment.slots #[conflict]).mapError IO.userError
      let .container conflictPacket := conflictPayload.data
        | throw <| IO.userError "the conflict control lost its original descriptor"
      if (ValueContainer.nativeFraming #[fragment, conflictPacket]).isOk then
        throw <| IO.userError "one original opaque position accepted another supplying owner"
      let payload ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (ValuePayload.callablePacket admitted descriptor.slots none descriptor.exports
          (some descriptor)).mapError IO.userError
      let (graph, stored) ← graph.stage owners.identities { origin with role := callable } payload
      let some node := graph.find stored.value
        | throw <| IO.userError "the complete inert callable disappeared"
      let .container retained := node.payload.data
        | throw <| IO.userError "inert callable admission replaced its complete packet"
      unless retained.callableData && retained.retainsOriginalPacket descriptor do
        throw <| IO.userError "the completed callable lost its original packet snapshot"
      unless (← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners #[stored]).mapError IO.userError) ==
          #[supplier.generation] &&
          node.references.any (fun value => value.value == first.value) do
        throw <| IO.userError "owner-only packet captures were omitted from graph retention"
      let path := #[InputPathStep.field "actual-map"]
      let ownerInputs ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (graph.encodeInputs supplier.generation #[{ path, binding := stored }]).mapError IO.userError
      unless ownerInputs.values == #[encodedPacket] && ownerInputs.slots.isEmpty do
        throw <| IO.userError "the actual owner lost the complete original callable packet"
      let foreign ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (graph.encodeInputs receiver.generation #[{ path, binding := stored }]).mapError IO.userError
      unless foreign.values == #[(ScopedReference.scope 0).encode] &&
          foreign.slots.map (·.value) == #[stored.value] do
        throw <| IO.userError "a foreign receiver exposed an owned leaf or lost the whole map"
      if (retained.fillForOwner receiver.generation #[toJson (3 : Nat)]).isOk then
        throw <| IO.userError "a foreign owner received an inert token directly"
      let changed ← ImmediateReply.parseControl scope reservation graph scope.wireId 91 (frame 1)
      let changedDescriptor ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (changed.packetDescriptor graph supplier #[]).mapError IO.userError
      if retained.retainsOriginalPacket changedDescriptor then
        throw <| IO.userError "equal captured bytes substituted another original capture"
      let otherOccurrence ← ledger.allocate
      let otherTransaction ← owners.identities.fresh .transaction
      let .ok otherReservation ← ledger.reserve otherOccurrence otherTransaction selected
          supplier graph values
        | throw <| IO.userError "the independent original packet scope could not reserve"
      let otherScope ← RequestScope.issue ledger otherReservation graph values #[] #[]
      let otherReply ← ImmediateReply.parseControl otherScope otherReservation graph
        otherScope.wireId 91 (frame 0)
      let otherDescriptor ← IO.ofExcept <|
        (otherReply.packetDescriptor graph supplier #[]).mapError IO.userError
      if retained.retainsOriginalPacket otherDescriptor then
        throw <| IO.userError "identical export bytes replaced another original reply scope"
      otherScope.retire
      discard <| ledger.retire otherReservation
      if (← IO.ofExcept <|
          (changed.retainsValue graph supplier packet #[] stored).mapError IO.userError) then
        throw <| IO.userError "fixed callable reuse accepted the same token with wrong captures"
      let (graph, dependent) ← graph.stage owners.identities { origin with role := callable }
        (.closure program #[stored])
      scope.retire
      discard <| ledger.retire reservation
      owners.close supplier.generation
      if (← graph.isAvailable owners stored) || (← graph.isAvailable owners dependent) then
        throw <| IO.userError "owner death left an inert callable or dependent continuation live"
    finally
      owners.close supplier.generation
      owners.close receiver.generation

import CasCompiler.Layout

meta import CasCompiler.Layout

open Lean Meta CasCompiler

-- A source function may return a projection before its record argument is supplied.
-- Splitting and reapplying the projection's existing parameter prefix is not progress.
-- The heartbeat bound belongs only to this regression: the old traversal must fail in
-- finite time. Production routing receives no test-specific cutoff.
set_option maxHeartbeats 20000 in
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let check (label : String) (declaration : Name) (partialProjection : Expr) :
      MetaM Unit := do
    let partialProjection := partialProjection.consumeMData
    let some info := (← getEnv).getProjectionFnInfo? declaration
      | throwError m!"{label}: the control is not a registered native projection"
    unless partialProjection.getAppFn.constName? == some declaration &&
        partialProjection.getAppArgs.size == info.numParams do
      throwError m!"{label}: the control must omit exactly its native record argument"
    let .none ← SourceProjection.ofExpr? partialProjection
      | throwError m!"{label}: an unsaturated control was already a record projection"
    let source ← withLocalDeclD `_seed (mkConst ``Nat) fun seed =>
      mkLambdaFVars #[seed] partialProjection (usedOnly := false) (usedLetOnly := false)
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close source)
    let (_, first) ← ApplicationLayout.ofSource role context
      #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7)]
    unless first.arguments.size == 1 && first.result.kind == .function do
      throwError m!"{label}: the first application did not retain its partial callable"

    -- No actual record has been supplied: there is no selected input occurrence.
    -- This call recreated the same partial projection indefinitely before the repair.
    let .none ← first.inputProjectionThrough #[] #[]
      | throwError m!"{label}: an unapplied projection acquired a fixed input route"

    -- A later genuine application supplies the record as formal slot 1. The unused
    -- seed remains slot 0; neither the projection's type parameters nor a reconstructed
    -- callable may replace the selected record or its exact native field path.
    let some (.projection route) ← first.inputProjectionThrough #[(#[], 1)] #[]
      | throwError m!"{label}: a saturated later application lost its fixed input route"
    match route.target with
    | .argument 1 => pure ()
    | _ => throwError m!"{label}: the route did not select the later record argument"
    unless route.path == #[declaration] do
      throwError m!"{label}: the route changed its native projection path"

  -- The actual RX08 recursion repeatedly exposed the bare Subtype.val head after
  -- decomposing its already supplied type and predicate parameters.
  let subtype ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
    (← `(@Subtype.val Nat (fun _ : Nat => True))) none
  check "partial Subtype.val" ``Subtype.val subtype

  -- Keep the fix generic across native record projections, including ordinary products.
  let product ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize (← `(@Prod.fst Nat Nat)) none
  check "partial Prod.fst" ``Prod.fst product

namespace CasRuntime.PendingProjectionTests

open Lean Meta CasCompiler

-- Only existing native Prod and Sigma constructors supply this engineering fixture.
-- A completed projection may name its own freshly produced prefix, but it may not change
-- any previously retained parent, stored field, cached path or dependent field prefix.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let term ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
    (← `(((⟨7, ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ 7⟩⟩ : Sigma (fun n : Nat => Fin (n + 1))), ()))) none
  let source ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close term)
  let innerSource ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkProj ``Prod 0 term))
  let innerLayout ← RecordLayout.ofSource innerSource
  let some firstField := innerLayout.fields[0]?
    | throwError "the native pending-projection control lost its first field"
  let some secondField := innerLayout.fields[1]?
    | throwError "the native pending-projection control lost its dependent field"
  let unitSource ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← empty.close (mkProj ``Prod 1 term))
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let ledger ← OccurrenceLedger.new owners
  discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
  let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
  try
    let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
    let occurrence ← ledger.allocate
    let producing := fun role =>
      ({ program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] } : ValueOrigin)
    let first ← transaction.stage (producing firstField.layout) (.closure program #[])
    let second ← transaction.stage (producing secondField.layout) (.closure program #[])
    let unitValue ← transaction.stage (producing unitSource) (.closure program #[])
    let rawInput ← transaction.stage (producing source) (.closure program #[])
    let wrongInput ← transaction.stage (producing source) (.closure program #[])
    let replacement ← transaction.stage (producing firstField.layout) (.closure program #[])
    let initialDraft ← transaction.draft
    let record ← RecordPrefix.begin owners.identities program occurrence innerLayout
    let (firstDraft, record, _) ← initialDraft.bindField record first
    let (fieldDraft, record, _) ← firstDraft.bindField record second
    let .ok payload := record.finish
      | throwError "the pending-projection source record is incomplete"
    let (recordDraft, result) ← fieldDraft.stage (producing innerSource) payload
    let .ok originalFirst := recordDraft.view.project result 0
      | throwError "the pending-projection source lost its actual first field"
    let .ok originalSecond := recordDraft.view.project result 1
      | throwError "the pending-projection source lost its actual dependent field"
    let (copyDraft, otherResult) ← recordDraft.stage (producing innerSource) payload
    let (mixedDraft, mixedResult) ← copyDraft.stage (producing innerSource)
      (.product #[replacement, originalSecond])
    let (completeDraft, storedInput) ← mixedDraft.stage (producing source)
      (.product #[otherResult, unitValue])
    let .ok () ← transaction.installDraft completeDraft
      | throwError "the native pending-projection fixture could not be retained"
    withLetDecl `x (← inferType term) term fun x => do
      let binding : LocalBinding := {
        id := ⟨"pending-native-projection", 0⟩, role := .definition, expression := x }
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[binding]
      let namedSource ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close x)
      let named := fun (value : ValueBinding) =>
        IO.ofExcept <| (value.withRole namedSource).mapError IO.userError
      let input ← named rawInput
      let wrong ← named wrongInput
      let stored ← named storedInput
      let graph ← transaction.view
      let requestFor (graph : ValueGraph) (operand : ValueBinding)
          (current : Option ValueBinding) : MetaM PreparedRequest := do
        let parameters ← match current with
          | none => pure #[]
          | some current => do
            let parameter ← IO.ofExcept <|
              (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id current).mapError IO.userError
            pure #[parameter]
        PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program (← ledger.allocate)
          context graph operand 0 parameters
      let failureFor (request : PreparedRequest) (draft : CellDraft)
          (candidate : ValueBinding) : MetaM (Option Exception) := do
        try
          let (draft, selected) ← request.associateResult owners.identities request.source
            draft candidate
          discard <| request.admitResult draft.view selected
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
      let requireFailure (failure : Option Exception) (label : String) : MetaM Exception := do
        let some failure := failure
          | throwError "the pending projection accepted {label}"
        pure failure
      let request ← requestFor graph input (some input)
      let ordinaryFailure : Option Exception ← try
        discard <| request.environment.checkResult graph request.source result
        pure none
      catch error => pure (some error)
      let ordinaryFailure ← requireFailure ordinaryFailure "an unpublished generic result"
      unless (← ordinaryFailure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
          "the runtime value has an unresolved consuming dependent reference" do
        throw ordinaryFailure
      let missing ← requestFor graph input none
      let missingFailure ← requireFailure
        (← failureFor missing (← transaction.draft) result) "a missing named parent"
      unless missingValueOf missingFailure binding.id do throw missingFailure
      let wrongRequest ← requestFor graph input (some wrong)
      let wrongFailure ← requireFailure
        (← failureFor wrongRequest (← transaction.draft) result) "a different named parent"
      unless (← wrongFailure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
          "the runtime value has an unresolved consuming dependent reference" do throw wrongFailure
      let mixedFailure ← requireFailure
        (← failureFor request (← transaction.draft) mixedResult) "a changed actual prefix"
      unless (← mixedFailure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
          "the runtime value has a different consuming dependent reference" do throw mixedFailure
      let storedRequest ← requestFor graph stored (some stored)
      let storedFailure ← requireFailure
        (← failureFor storedRequest (← transaction.draft) result) "a changed stored field"
      unless (← storedFailure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
          "the projection changed its retained field reference" do throw storedFailure
      let cacheOrigin ← request.originFor request.source
      let (cachedDraft, _) ← (← transaction.draft).bindProjection cacheOrigin otherResult
        #[originalFirst, originalSecond]
      let cachedRequest ← requestFor cachedDraft.view input (some input)
      let cachedFailure ← requireFailure
        (← failureFor cachedRequest cachedDraft result) "a changed cached field"
      unless (← cachedFailure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
          "the projection changed its retained field reference" do throw cachedFailure
      let nestedLayout ← RecordLayout.ofSource request.source
      let some nestedFirst := nestedLayout.fields[0]?
        | throwError "the pending result lost its native first-field path"
      let nestedOrigin ← request.originFor nestedFirst.layout
      let (nestedDraft, _) ← (← transaction.draft).bindProjection nestedOrigin replacement #[]
      let nestedRequest ← requestFor nestedDraft.view input (some input)
      let nestedFailure ← requireFailure
        (← failureFor nestedRequest nestedDraft result) "a changed cached descendant"
      unless (← nestedFailure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith
          "the runtime value has a different consuming dependent reference" do throw nestedFailure
      let (accepted, projected) ← request.associateResult owners.identities request.source
        (← transaction.draft) result
      discard <| request.admitResult accepted.view projected
      unless projected.value == result.value do
        throwError "pending projection admission replaced the actual result node"
      let .ok (some selected) := accepted.view.projected? input #[``Prod.fst]
        | throwError "pending projection admission lost its exact original input relation"
      unless selected.value == result.value && selected.associationIds == result.associationIds do
        throwError "pending projection admission changed the original result baseline"
      let .ok none := (← transaction.view).projected? input #[``Prod.fst]
        | throwError "pending projection admission escaped its isolated reply draft"
  finally discard <| transaction.abort

end CasRuntime.PendingProjectionTests

@[expose] public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- Install typed source operands while keeping their whole native scope through the result. -/
private def selectPointSource (identities : IdentitySupply) (selection : SourceSelection Expr)
    (declaredType : Option Expr := none) :
    StateCpsT (OpenContext × SourceSelectionScope Expr) MetaM Expr :=
  fun _ state continuation =>
    SourceSelectionScope.withBinding identities state.2 state.1 selection
      (fun context selections value => continuation value (context, selections))
      (declaredType := declaredType)

private def namedPointRequest? (family : PointFamily) (selected : SourceSelection Expr) :
    MetaM (Option NativePointRequest) := do
  match selected.pointRequest with
  | none => return none
  | some (.named original request) =>
    unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.application family).exactlyMatches (.application original) do
      throwError "the point request names a different released callable family"
    return some request
  | some (.categorical ..) =>
    throwError "the named point request changed its original owner kind"

private def categoricalPointRequest? (family : CategoricalPointFamily)
    (selected : SourceSelection Expr) : MetaM (Option CategoricalPointRequest) := do
  match selected.pointRequest with
  | none => return none
  | some (.categorical original request) =>
    unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.point family).exactlyMatches (.point original) do
      throwError "the retained generalized point changed its selected operation"
    return some request
  | some (.named ..) =>
    throwError "the categorical point request changed its original owner kind"

/-- Follow only the actual projection ancestry of this callable, backwards along the checked
native field path. The terminal node must carry the same original prepared family occurrence;
an equal type or endpoint never selects a different arrow. -/
private partial def namedPointRoot? (graph : ValueGraph)
    (codes : Std.HashMap (RuntimeId .program) ClosureCode) (family : PreparedRequest)
    (value : ValueBinding) (path : Array Name) : MetaM (Option InputDescriptorView) := do
  if path.isEmpty then
    let some descriptorView ← InputDescriptorView.namedPoint? graph codes value | return none
    let some original := descriptorView.family | return none
    if original.roles.scope != family.roles.scope then return none
    return some descriptorView
  let some node := graph.find value.value
    | throwError "the named point callable is outside its visible graph"
  let mut accesses := value.projectionAccesses.reverse
  if let some parent := node.origin.access then
    accesses := accesses.push (parent, node.origin.accessPath)
  for (parent, suffix) in accesses do
    if suffix.isEmpty || suffix.size > path.size then continue
    let parentPath := path.extract 0 (path.size - suffix.size)
    unless path.extract parentPath.size path.size == suffix do continue
    let some _ ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.projectionBasis value parent suffix).mapError IO.userError
      | continue
    if let some original ← namedPointRoot? graph codes family parent parentPath then
      return some original
  return none

/-- Complete original inputs of a released named arrow applied to an explicitly retained
generalized point. The arrow descriptor is a checked view of its actual input node. -/
structure PreparedPointInvocation where
  private mk ::
  preparation : RoleScope
  operation : String
  parameters : Array ValueBinding
  arrow : ValueBinding
  domain : ValueBinding
  source : ValueBinding
  target : ValueBinding
  argument : ValueBinding
  forms : Array String
  dependencies : Array ValueBinding
  views : Array InputDescriptorView
  private inputs : InputRoleMap
  parameterPacket : Option ValueContainer
  symbolic : Option ValueContainer

private def categoricalInput (request : PreparedRequest)
    (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (expected selected : Expr) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let .fvar localId := selected.consumeMData
    | throwError "the categorical request lost an original retained input binder"
  let some binding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == localId)
    | throwError "the categorical request names a binder outside its complete source context"
  let some value := bound[binding.id]?
    | throwError "the categorical request names an unavailable bound input"
  let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound request.environment.worker context bound graph
    (some request.environment)
  environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph expected value
  return value

private def categoricalForms (context : OpenContext) (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
    (family : CategoricalPointFamily) (source : Expr) : MetaM (Array String) := do
  let mut forms := #[family.owner.input]
  let admitted : Option CasCatalogue.Operation := match family.owner with
    | .named (.morphism entry) => some (.morphism entry)
    | .named (.application entry) => some (.application entry)
    | _ => none
  if let .named (.application entry) := family.owner then
    forms := forms ++ #[entry.id.raw, entry.category.raw]
  if let some admitted := admitted then
    if let some (entry, _) ← sourceObjectSelection? context selections source then
      let registry : RegistryState := { toSemanticState := ← semanticState }
      let some form := registry.form? entry.id.raw
        | throwError "the categorical point source lost its selected object form"
      if let some reason := registry.rejects admitted form then
        throwError "the categorical point has an incompatible original source form: {reason}"
      forms := forms ++ #[entry.id.raw, entry.category.raw]
  return forms

/-- Prepare only the original complete categorical request produced by the common lowerer.
Every packet position is a bound original value; endpoint actions are never rerun here. -/
opaque PreparedPointInvocation.prepare (kernel : Kernel) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) : MetaM PreparedPointInvocation := do
  let .primitive (.point family) _ := request.action
    | throwError "a complete point packet requires its original categorical boundary"
  unless family.invocation do throwError "an arrow reference is not a whole point demand"
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs graph
  withSourceScope request fun context bound => do
    request.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound family.parameterCount
        fun context bound actual values => do
      let formal := request.application.map (·.arguments.map (·.source.source)) |>.getD #[]
      unless formal.size == family.parameterCount + 2 do
        throwError "the categorical request lost its original domain and generalized point"
      let some domainTerm := formal[family.parameterCount]?
        | throwError "the categorical request lost its original domain input"
      let some pointTerm := formal[family.parameterCount + 1]?
        | throwError "the categorical request lost its original generalized point input"
      let domainSource ← domainTerm.inContext context
      let pointSource ← pointTerm.inContext context
      let some selected ← request.source.selected? context
        | throwError "the categorical request lost its exact selected source binding"
      let some supplied ← categoricalPointRequest? family selected
        | throwError "the categorical request lost its original complete descriptor inputs"
      let selections ← request.selections.inContext context
      let levels := request.universeArguments.getD []
      let (nativeArrow, _) ← family.arrowAt levels actual
      let (nativeSource, nativeTarget) ← categoricalPointEndpoints nativeArrow
      let arrow ← categoricalInput request context bound graph nativeArrow supplied.arrow
      let domain ← categoricalInput request context bound graph domainSource supplied.domain
      let source ← categoricalInput request context bound graph nativeSource supplied.source
      let target ← categoricalInput request context bound graph nativeTarget supplied.target
      let argument ← categoricalInput request context bound graph pointSource supplied.point
      context.withOriginalSources (actual ++
          #[supplied.arrow, supplied.domain, supplied.source, supplied.target, supplied.point])
          fun native => do
        let parameters := native.extract 0 actual.size
        let inputs := native.extract actual.size native.size
        discard <| family.withRequest levels parameters
          inputs[0]! inputs[1]! inputs[2]! inputs[3]! inputs[4]!
      let packet ← CategoricalPointPacket.prepare family values
      let parameters := packet.parameters.slots.map (·.binding)
      let roots := parameters ++ #[arrow, domain, source, target, argument]
      let views ← InputDescriptorView.collect graph (← kernel.codes.get) roots
      let symbolic ← if family.whole then do
          let .container packet := packet.arrow.data
            | throwError "the native arrow descriptor lost its complete original packet"
          pure packet
        else do
          let payload ← IO.ofExcept <| (ValuePayload.descriptor
            (Json.mkObj [("ctor", toJson "compose"), ("args", .arr #[.null, .null])]) #[
              { path := #[.field "args", .index 0], binding := argument, fieldIndex := none },
              { path := #[.field "args", .index 1], binding := arrow, fieldIndex := none }]).mapError IO.userError
          let .container packet := payload.data
            | throwError "the native composite lost its original descriptor operands"
          pure packet
      return ⟨request.roles.scope, family.operation, parameters, arrow, domain, source, target,
        argument, ← categoricalForms context selections family supplied.source,
        request.scope ++ roots ++ views.flatMap (·.dependencies), views, inputs,
        some packet.parameters, some symbolic⟩

private def prepareCategoricalScalar (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation)
    (request familyRequest : PreparedRequest) (family : CategoricalPointFamily)
    (levels : List Level) (path : Array FieldLayout) (transaction : CellTransaction) :
    MetaM (Option PreparedPointInvocation) := do
  unless !family.invocation do return none
  let .apply callable arguments _ := request.action | return none
  unless arguments.size == 1 do return none
  let some carrier ← family.carrierFamily? | return none
  unless path.map (·.projection) == carrier.path do return none
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let familyInputs ← familyRequest.admitInputs graph
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs graph
  let #[argument] ← IO.ofExcept <| (inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "the scalar categorical request lost its original point value"
  let codes ← kernel.codes.get
  request.requireFamily familyRequest path graph codes
  let some arrowView ← namedPointRoot? graph codes familyRequest callable carrier.path
    | throwError "the scalar categorical action lost its original arrow and native field path"
  withSourceScope request fun context bound => do
    withBindingContext graph context bound argument fun context bound => do
      let pointSource ← argument.selectedSource context
      let some pointSelection ← argument.role.selected? context | return none
      let some point := pointSelection.pointOrigin | return none
      let supplied ← categoricalPointRequest? family pointSelection
      familyRequest.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound family.parameterCount
          fun context bound actual values => do
        let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge (← request.environment.selections.inContext context)
          (← familyRequest.environment.selections.inContext context)
        let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections (← argument.role.selections.inContext context)
        let (nativeArrow, bundle) ← family.arrowAt levels actual
        let (nativeSource, nativeTarget) ← categoricalPointEndpoints nativeArrow
        let function ← family.function levels actual nativeArrow
        let .forallE _ expected _ _ ← whnfR (← inferType function)
          | throwError "the original categorical scalar action has no native function interface"
        context.withOriginalSources #[← inferType pointSource, expected] fun native => do
          checkRegisteredDomains native[0]! native[1]!
          unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
            throwError "the original point has another selected categorical source"
        withBindingContext graph context bound arrowView.binding fun context bound => do
          withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound
              (← arrowView.binding.selectedSource context) arrowView.binding fun context bound arrowSource => do
            let some arrowSelection ← arrowView.binding.role.selected? context
              | throwError "the scalar categorical action lost its complete selected arrow"
            let select := fun selection expected =>
              selectPointSource kernel.ledger.owners.identities selection expected
            (selectMorphism { arrowSelection with value := arrowSource } select (some bundle)).runK
                (context, selections) fun selected state => do
              let (context, selections) := state
              let stated ← inferType selected
              unless stated.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 do
                throwError "the original arrow lost its retained native endpoint projections"
              let originalDomain := point.domain
              let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound request.environment.worker
                context bound (← transaction.view) (some request.environment) selections
              let retain := fun (expression expected : Expr) => do
                let value ← environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program
                  context bound expression selections
                environment.checkDeclaredInput context (← transaction.view) expected value
                pure value
              let domain ← retain (supplied.map (·.domain) |>.getD originalDomain) originalDomain
              let source ← retain (supplied.map (·.source) |>.getD stated.getAppArgs[2]!) nativeSource
              let target ← retain (supplied.map (·.target) |>.getD stated.getAppArgs[3]!) nativeTarget
              if let some supplied := supplied then
                context.withOriginalSources (actual ++ #[supplied.arrow, supplied.domain,
                    supplied.source, supplied.target, supplied.point, point.domain]) fun native => do
                  let parameters := native.extract 0 actual.size
                  let fields := native.extract actual.size native.size
                  family.checkScalarRequest levels parameters
                    fields[0]! fields[1]! fields[2]! fields[3]! fields[4]! fields[5]!
                let selected ← retain supplied.arrow nativeArrow
                unless selected.value == arrowView.binding.value &&
                    selected.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf arrowView.binding.associationIds.toList do
                  throwError "the scalar point packet changed its actual selected arrow occurrence"
              let packet ← CategoricalPointPacket.prepare family values
              let parameters := packet.parameters.slots.map (·.binding)
              let graph ← transaction.view
              discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (familyInputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
              discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
              let roots := parameters ++ #[arrowView.binding, domain, source, target, argument]
              let views ← InputDescriptorView.collect graph codes roots #[arrowView]
              return some ⟨request.roles.scope, family.operation, parameters, arrowView.binding,
                domain, source, target, argument, ← categoricalForms context selections family
                  (← source.selectedSource context),
                familyRequest.scope ++ request.scope ++ roots ++ views.flatMap (·.dependencies),
                views, inputs, some packet.parameters, none⟩

/-- Prepare the named-point dialect only at its checked native carrier action and an original
point map retained by the reader. Other native/opaque actions keep their existing path. All
original inputs are admitted before lowering the source-declared descriptor captures. -/
opaque PreparedPointInvocation.prepare? (kernel : Kernel) (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation)
    (request family : PreparedRequest) (path : Array FieldLayout)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) : MetaM (Option PreparedPointInvocation) := do
  let .primitive boundary universes := family.action | return none
  if let .point selected := boundary then
    return ← prepareCategoricalScalar kernel evaluateSource request family selected universes path transaction
  let .apply callable arguments _ := request.action | return none
  unless arguments.size == 1 do return none
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let familyInputs ← family.admitInputs graph
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs graph
  let #[argument] ← IO.ofExcept <| (inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "the named point action lost its complete original operand"
  let retainsPoint ← withSourceScope request fun context bound =>
    withBindingContext graph context bound argument fun context _ => do
      return ((← argument.role.selected? context).bind (·.pointOrigin)).isSome
  unless retainsPoint do return none
  let selected : Option PointFamily ← match boundary with
    | .registered declared => do
      let .morphism morphismId := declared.source.reference | pure none
      let .named (.registered (.inr entry) _) := declared.selectedReference
        | throwError "the named point action lost its complete selected morphism row"
      unless entry.id == morphismId do
        throwError "the named point action changed its released morphism"
      let some selected := declared.pointFamily
        | throwUnsupportedSource "the named morphism has no native input-function path"
      let .morphism original := selected.owner
        | throwError "the named point action changed its released morphism"
      unless SelectedSourceReference.exactlyMatches declared.selectedReference
          (.named (.registered (.inr original) selected.category)) do
        throwError "the named point action changed its released morphism"
      pure (some selected)
    | .application selected => pure (some selected)
    | _ => pure none
  let some selected := selected | return none
  unless path.map (·.projection) == selected.path do return none
  let codes ← kernel.codes.get
  request.requireFamily family path graph codes
  let some arrowView ← namedPointRoot? graph codes family callable selected.path
    | throwError "the named point action lost its exact original arrow and field relation"
  withSourceScope request fun context bound => do
    withBindingContext graph context bound argument fun context bound => do
      let pointSource ← argument.selectedSource context
      let some pointSelection ← argument.role.selected? context | return none
      let some point := pointSelection.pointOrigin | return none
      let supplied ← namedPointRequest? selected pointSelection
      let count := family.application.map (·.arguments.size) |>.getD 0
      family.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound count
          fun context bound actual _ => do
        let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge (← request.environment.selections.inContext context)
          (← family.environment.selections.inContext context)
        let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections (← argument.role.selections.inContext context)
        let head := selected.family.instantiateLevelParams selected.universeParams universes
        let originalArrow := mkAppN head actual
        let select := fun selection => selectPointSource kernel.ledger.owners.identities selection none
        (selected.withEndpoints originalArrow select).runK (context, selections)
            fun (sourceSource, targetSource) state => do
          let (context, selections) := state
          let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound request.environment.worker
            context bound graph (some request.environment) selections
          let domainSource := point.domain
          let function ← selected.function originalArrow
          let .forallE _ expected _ _ ← whnfR (← inferType function)
            | throwError "the named arrow lost its native point-function interface"
          context.withOriginalSources #[← inferType pointSource, expected] fun native => do
            checkRegisteredDomains native[0]! native[1]!
            unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
              throwError "the original point has a different named-arrow source"
          let retain := fun (source expected : Expr) (index : Nat) => do
            let value ← environment.evaluateSource evaluateSource transaction request.program
              context bound source selections
            let graph ← transaction.view
            let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph index value
              | throwError "a named point descriptor is outside its original graph"
            let checked ← environment.checkArgument (← context.close expected) actual
            environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph expected value
            return checked
          if let some supplied := supplied then
            context.withOriginalSources #[supplied.arrow, supplied.domain, supplied.source,
                supplied.target, point.domain] fun native =>
              selected.checkRequest native[0]! native[1]! native[2]! native[3]! native[4]!
            let original ← retain supplied.arrow originalArrow 0
            unless original.value == arrowView.binding.value &&
                original.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf arrowView.binding.associationIds.toList do
              throwError "the named point request changed its actual original arrow occurrence"
            let values := family.origin.application.map (·.arguments) |>.getD #[]
            unless values.size == actual.size do
              throwError "the named point request lost its original parameter value table"
            for source in actual, value in values do
              match value with
              | some value => environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph source value
              | none =>
                unless ← isProof source do
                  throwError "the named point request is missing an original computational parameter"
          let domain ← retain (supplied.map (·.domain) |>.getD domainSource) domainSource 0
          let source ← retain (supplied.map (·.source) |>.getD sourceSource) sourceSource 1
          let target ← retain (supplied.map (·.target) |>.getD targetSource) targetSource 2
          let graph ← transaction.view
          discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (familyInputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
          discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
          let admittedOperation : CasCatalogue.Operation := match selected.owner with
            | .morphism entry => .morphism entry
            | .application entry => .application entry
          let mut forms := match selected.owner with
            | .morphism _ => #[selected.operation]
            | .application entry => #[selected.operation, entry.id.raw, entry.category.raw]
          if let some (object, _) ← sourceObjectSelection? context selections
              (← source.selectedSource context) then
            let registry : RegistryState := { toSemanticState := ← semanticState }
            let some form := registry.form? object.id.raw
              | throwError "the named point source lost its registered object form"
            if let some reason := registry.rejects admittedOperation form then
              throwError "the named point source has an incompatible input form: {reason}"
            forms := forms ++ #[object.id.raw, object.category.raw]
          let roots := arrowView.parameters ++ #[arrowView.binding, domain, source, target, argument]
          let views ← InputDescriptorView.collect graph codes roots #[arrowView]
          return some ⟨request.roles.scope, selected.operation, arrowView.parameters, arrowView.binding,
            domain, source, target, argument, forms, family.scope ++ request.scope ++ roots ++
              views.flatMap (·.dependencies), views, inputs, none, none⟩

/-- Recheck the same sealed input map in the current graph before dispatch. Native roles and
actual immutable bindings were checked at preparation; graph extension requires visibility
and owner checks, not a new source elaboration of the unchanged complete input telescope. -/
opaque PreparedPointInvocation.requireInputs (invocation : PreparedPointInvocation)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph) : MetaM Unit := do
  request.requirePreparation invocation.preparation
  request.requirePreparation invocation.inputs.telescope.scope
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (invocation.inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError

/-- Original roots in the released seven-field PointInvocation packet. Nested named-arrow
parameters are encoded beneath its own args field and retain their exact input authorities. -/
def PreparedPointInvocation.roots (invocation : PreparedPointInvocation) : Array InputPosition :=
  (match invocation.parameterPacket with
    | none => invocation.parameters.mapIdx (fun index binding =>
        { path := #[.field "args", .index 1, .index index], binding })
    | some packet => packet.slots.map fun slot =>
        { path := #[.field "args", .index 1] ++ slot.path, binding := slot.binding }) ++ #[
    { path := #[.field "args", .index 2], binding := invocation.arrow },
    { path := #[.field "args", .index 3], binding := invocation.domain },
    { path := #[.field "args", .index 4], binding := invocation.source },
    { path := #[.field "args", .index 5], binding := invocation.target },
    { path := #[.field "args", .index 6], binding := invocation.argument }]

def PreparedPointInvocation.encode (invocation : PreparedPointInvocation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (receiver : ConnectionGeneration) :
    Except String (EncodedInputs × Json) := do
  let encoded ← graph.encodeInputs receiver invocation.roots invocation.views
  let count := invocation.parameterPacket.map (·.slots.size) |>.getD invocation.parameters.size
  let #[arrow, domain, source, target, argument] := encoded.values.extract count encoded.values.size
    | throw "the named point packet lost a complete original input"
  let parameters ← match invocation.parameterPacket with
    | none => pure (encoded.values.extract 0 count)
    | some packet => (← packet.fill (encoded.values.extract 0 count)).getArr?
  let packet : PointInvocation := {
    operation := invocation.operation
    parameters := parameters
    arrow := arrow
    domain := domain
    source := source
    target := target
    argument := argument
  }
  return (encoded, packet.encode)

/-- Complete original object-action packet at one already prepared source boundary. -/
structure PreparedObjectAction where
  private mk ::
  preparation : RoleScope
  operation : String
  forms : Array String
  packet : ValueContainer
  dependencies : Array ValueBinding
  views : Array InputDescriptorView
  private inputs : InputRoleMap

opaque PreparedObjectAction.prepare (kernel : Kernel) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (graph : ValueGraph) : MetaM PreparedObjectAction := do
  let .primitive (.objectAction family) _ := request.action
    | throwError "an object packet requires its original complete native action"
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs graph
  let values := request.origin.application.map (·.arguments) |>.getD #[]
  let packet ← CategoricalPointPacket.action family values
  let roots := packet.slots.map (·.binding)
  let views ← InputDescriptorView.collect graph (← kernel.codes.get) roots
  let mut forms := #[family.operation ++ "#input"]
  if let .functor _ := family.edge then
    let extra ← withSourceScope request fun context bound => do
      let some receiver := values[family.parameterCount]?.bind id
        | throwError "the object request lost its original receiver"
      withBindingContext graph context bound receiver fun context _ => do
        let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge (← request.environment.selections.inContext context)
          (← receiver.role.selections.inContext context)
        if let some (entry, _) ← sourceObjectSelection? context selections
            (← receiver.selectedSource context) then
          return #[entry.id.raw, entry.category.raw]
        return #[]
    forms := forms ++ extra
  return ⟨request.roles.scope, family.operation, forms, packet,
    request.scope ++ roots ++ views.flatMap (·.dependencies), views, inputs⟩

opaque PreparedObjectAction.requireInputs (invocation : PreparedObjectAction)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph) : MetaM Unit := do
  request.requirePreparation invocation.preparation
  request.requirePreparation invocation.inputs.telescope.scope
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (invocation.inputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError

def PreparedObjectAction.encode (invocation : PreparedObjectAction) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (receiver : ConnectionGeneration) : Except String (EncodedInputs × Json) := do
  let roots := invocation.packet.slots.map fun slot =>
    ({ path := slot.path, binding := slot.binding } : InputPosition)
  let encoded ← graph.encodeInputs receiver roots invocation.views
  return (encoded, ← invocation.packet.fill encoded.values)


private structure PointSourceState where
  context : OpenContext
  bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding
  selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr

/-- Validate a whole symbolic tree against its exact source roles and explicit packet
positions. Cross-node endpoints retain their original native occurrence dependencies after
temporary interface unification; no graph search or fabricated mathematical value is used. -/
opaque preparedSymbolicCheck (kernel : Kernel) (_request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) : PreparedSymbolicCheck := fun graph nodes => do
  let some first := nodes[0]? | return
  let kernel ← kernel.fork
  let base := nodes.foldl (fun selected node =>
    if selected.environment.context.entries.size < node.environment.context.entries.size
      then node else selected) first
  base.environment.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let compatible := fun (left right : ValueBinding) =>
      left.value == right.value &&
        (left.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf right.associationIds.toList ||
          right.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf left.associationIds.toList)
    let bound := base.environment.bound
    let packets := nodes.flatMap fun node => node.inputActions ++ node.action.toArray
    let (descriptors, slots, parameters) ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (ValueContainer.nativeFraming packets).mapError IO.userError
    for exported in packets.flatMap (·.packetExports) do
      unless ← kernel.ledger.owners.isLive exported.owner do transactionFailure .staleOwner
      let owners ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners exported.captures).mapError IO.userError
      unless ← kernel.ledger.owners.allAlive owners do transactionFailure .staleOwner
    let withNative (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
        (value : ValueBinding)
        (action : OpenContext → Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding → Expr → MetaM Unit) :
        MetaM Unit := do
      discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners #[value]).mapError IO.userError
      withBindingContext graph context bound value fun context bound => do
        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound
          (← value.selectedSource context) value action
    let withEndpoint (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
        (endpoint : PreparedSymbolicEndpoint)
        (action : OpenContext → Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding →
          PublishedSource.NativeSymbolicEndpoint → MetaM Unit) : MetaM Unit := do
      match endpoint with
      | .value value => do
        withNative context bound value fun context bound source =>
          action context bound (.value source)
      | .inline position => action context bound (.inline position)
    let asNativeMap : Expr → MetaM Expr := fun expression => do
      let type ← inferType expression
      if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then return expression
      let type ← whnfR type
      if type.isAppOfArity ``Quiver.Hom 4 then return expression
      let .forallE _ _ range _ := type
        | throwError "the symbolic callable has no original native function or Hom interface"
      if range.hasLooseBVars then
        throwError "a dependent callable requires its independently supplied native map interface"
      mkAppM ``TypeCat.ofHom #[expression]
    let finish := fun (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
        (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr)
        (slotSources : Array Expr) (nativeNodes : Array PublishedSource.NativeSymbolicNode) => do
      let environment := fun (state : PointSourceState) =>
        RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound base.environment.worker state.context state.bound graph
          (some base.environment) state.selections
      let stateIn := fun (state : PointSourceState) context bound => do
        let current ← environment { state with context, bound }
        return ({ context, bound, selections := ← current.selections.inContext context } :
          PointSourceState)
      let checkDeclared := fun (state : PointSourceState)
          (expected : Expr) (value : ValueBinding) => do
        let environment ← environment state
        let mut checked := false
        for node in nodes do
          if let some prior := node.fieldPrefix then
            if ← prior.checkEndpoint environment state.context graph expected value then checked := true
        unless checked do environment.checkDeclaredInput state.context graph expected value
      let references := fun (state : PointSourceState)
          expression => do
        let positions ← computationalDependencies (state.context.bindings.map (·.expression)) expression
        let mut values := #[]
        for position in positions do
          let some binding := state.context.bindings[position]?
            | throwError "a symbolic endpoint lost an original context dependency"
          if let some value := state.bound[binding.id]? then values := values.push value
        return values
      let shared := fun (state : PointSourceState)
          (left right : Expr) => do
        checkRegisteredDomains left right
        unless ← isDefEq left right do
          state.context.withOriginalSources #[left, right] fun original => do
            checkRegisteredDomains original[0]! original[1]!
            unless ← isDefEq original[0]! original[1]! do
              throwError "the symbolic maps changed their shared native endpoint"
        let environment ← environment state
        let first ← environment.endpointValue? state.context graph left
        let second ← environment.endpointValue? state.context graph right
        match first, second with
        | some first, some second =>
          unless compatible first second do
            throwError "the symbolic maps share different original endpoint occurrences"
          checkDeclared state left second
          checkDeclared state right first
        | some first, none => checkDeclared state right first
        | none, some second => checkDeclared state left second
        | none, none =>
          let leftInputs ← references state left
          let rightInputs ← references state right
          unless leftInputs.size == rightInputs.size &&
              (leftInputs.zip rightInputs).all (fun (first, second) => compatible first second) do
