              let .primitive (.presentation original) levels := originalFamily.action
                | throwError "the comparison scope control changed its native family"
              unless (originalFamily.application.map (·.arguments.isEmpty)).getD true do
                throwError "the comparison scope control unexpectedly has declaration parameters"
              let (firstEnd, secondEnd) ← originalFamily.presentationEndpoints graph
              let .ok firstArgument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 firstEnd
                | throwError "the comparison scope control lost its original first endpoint"
              let .ok secondArgument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 1 secondEnd
                | throwError "the comparison scope control lost its original second endpoint"
              let otherFamily ← PreparedRequest.forPresentation owners.identities
                originalFamily.program originalFamily.occurrence original levels context #[] #[]
                #[firstEnd.role.source, secondEnd.role.source] #[firstArgument, secondArgument] #[]
                graph (selections := selections)
              unless otherFamily.roles.scope != originalFamily.roles.scope do
                throwError "the comparison scope control reused its original family preparation"
              let beforeRejection ← transaction.view
              rejectPreparation do
                discard <| PreparedPresentationInvocation.prepare request otherFamily fieldPath graph
                  codes
              let evaluate : SourceEvaluation := fun cell _ current bound selections expression =>
                kernel.run cell current bound expression (selections := selections)
              let registration : Registration := {
                operation := row.id.raw, input := row.id.raw, backend := "scope-control" }
              for wrong in #[otherRequest, rebuilt] do
                rejectPreparation do
                  discard <| kernel.invokePresentation evaluate wrong transaction registration invocation
                unless (← kernel.ledger.pendingFor wrong.occurrence transaction.id).isNone do
                  throwError "a rejected presentation preparation reserved a dispatch"
              unless (← transaction.view).sameRevision beforeRejection &&
                  (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                throwError "a rejected presentation preparation published or dispatched"
            let sourceId := if inverse then row.target.raw else row.source.raw
            let targetId := if inverse then row.source.raw else row.target.raw
            unless invocation.forms == #[row.id.raw, sourceId] do
              throwError "the comparison selected a target-endpoint form or lost its own request form"
            let graph ← transaction.view
            let .ok (encoded, packet) := invocation.encode graph connection.generation
              | throwError "the original comparison inputs could not encode"
            let .ok decoded := PresentationInvocation.decode packet
              | throwError "the comparison did not use its published five-field packet"
            unless decoded.inverse == inverse && decoded.parameters.isEmpty &&
                (decoded.source.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some sourceId &&
                (decoded.target.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some targetId do
              throwError "comparison encoding changed its complete oriented endpoints"
            let roots := invocation.roots
            unless roots.map (·.path) == #[
                #[.field "args", .index 2], #[.field "args", .index 3],
                #[.field "args", .index 4]] do
              throwError "comparison references were rooted in a dependentContext packet"
            for root in roots do
              let some actual := encoded.inputs.find? (·.path == root.path)
                | throwError "comparison encoding lost a complete original input position"
              unless actual.binding.value == root.binding.value &&
                  actual.binding.associationIds == root.binding.associationIds do
                throwError "comparison encoding replaced an endpoint or point by equal data"
            let (installed, rejected) ← admitManifest (← manifest #[sourceId, targetId])
            unless rejected.isEmpty && installed.registrations.size == 2 do
              throwError "the original two presentation endpoint registrations were rejected"
            let profileTarget := ProfileTarget.presentation row.id
            let defaultProfile ← RealizationProfile.prepare installed none
            unless (← selectLift defaultProfile installed profileTarget
                invocation.operation invocation.forms).input == sourceId do
              throwError "the opposite endpoint became an eligible comparison input"
            let (overlap, rejected) ← admitManifest (← manifest #[sourceId, row.id.raw])
            unless rejected.isEmpty do throwError "the complete presentation request form was rejected"
            failureAt .ambiguousRealization do
              discard <| selectLift defaultProfile overlap profileTarget invocation.operation invocation.forms
            let (empty, _) ← admitManifest (← manifest #[])
            failureAt .noImplementation do
              discard <| selectLift defaultProfile empty profileTarget invocation.operation invocation.forms

            let freeze := fun (installed : Manifest) (entries : Array Registration) =>
              RealizationProfile.prepare installed (some (Json.mkObj [
                ("format", "cas-realization-profile/1"), ("id", "presentation-control"),
                ("default", "all"), ("rules", .arr #[Json.mkObj [
                  ("target", Json.mkObj [("kind", "presentation"), ("id", toJson row.id.raw)]),
                  ("primitive_registrations", Json.mkObj [("mode", "only"),
                    ("entries", .arr (entries.map fun entry => Json.mkObj [
                      ("operation", toJson entry.operation), ("input", toJson entry.input),
                      ("backend", toJson entry.backend)]))]),
                  ("derivations", Json.mkObj [("mode", "only"), ("ids", .arr #[])])]])]))
            let excluded ← freeze overlap #[]
            failureAt .noImplementation do
              discard <| selectLift excluded overlap profileTarget invocation.operation invocation.forms
            let sourceOnly ← freeze overlap #[overlap.registrations[0]!]
            unless (← selectLift sourceOnly overlap profileTarget
                invocation.operation invocation.forms) == overlap.registrations[0]! do
              throwError "the presentation profile replaced its exact selected source registration"
            let completeOnly ← freeze overlap #[overlap.registrations[1]!]
            unless (← selectLift completeOnly overlap profileTarget
                invocation.operation invocation.forms) == overlap.registrations[1]! do
              throwError "the presentation profile lost its complete original request registration"
            let oppositeOnly ← freeze installed #[installed.registrations[1]!]
            failureAt .noImplementation do
              discard <| selectLift oppositeOnly installed profileTarget
                invocation.operation invocation.forms
            let multiple ← freeze overlap overlap.registrations
            failureAt .ambiguousRealization do
              discard <| selectLift multiple overlap profileTarget invocation.operation invocation.forms
            let permuted ← freeze overlap overlap.registrations.reverse
            unless multiple.normalized == permuted.normalized &&
                multiple.sha256 == permuted.sha256 && multiple.sha256.length == 64 do
              throwError "presentation profile normalization changed exact set identity"
            unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
              throwError "presentation profile selection dispatched an implementation"

            let identity : DispatchIdentity := {
              manifestDigest := "presentation-scope-control", profileDigest := "no-providers",
              registration := {
                operation := row.id.raw
                input := row.id.raw
                backend := "scope-control" } }
            let .ok reservation ← transaction.reserve request.occurrence identity connection
                invocation.dependencies
              | throwError "the named child control could not reserve its original scope"
            let scope ← RequestScope.issue kernel.ledger reservation graph encoded.slots encoded.inputs #[]
            try
              let reference := fun index =>
                (ScopedReference.input #[.field "args", .index index]).encode
              let childPacket : PresentationInvocation := {
                parameters := #[], inverse, source := reference 2,
                target := reference 3, argument := reference 4 }
              let observed ← IO.mkRef false
              let evaluate : SourceEvaluation := fun cell _ current bound selections term => do
                let applied := (selections.findAt? current term).map (·.value) |>.getD term
                let some projection ← (← current.close applied.getAppFn).inputProjectionAt #[]
                  | return ← kernel.run cell current bound term (selections := selections)
                let .context isoId := projection.target
                  | throwError "the named child changed its actual comparison source position"
                let some selected := selections[isoId]?
                  | return ← kernel.run cell current bound term (selections := selections)
                let some application := selected.application
                  | throwError "the named child lost its complete typed comparison application"
                let .presentation selectedFamily := application.family
                  | return ← kernel.run cell current bound term (selections := selections)
                unless reprStr selectedFamily == reprStr family &&
                    family.direction? projection.path == some inverse do
                  throwError "the named child changed its original comparison family or direction"
                let some (actualFirst, actualSecond) := selected.presentationEndpoints
                  | throwError "the named child reconstructed its supplied endpoint values"
                let (actualSource, actualTarget) :=
                  if inverse then (actualSecond, actualFirst) else (actualFirst, actualSecond)
                let inputs := #[actualSource, actualTarget, applied.getAppArgs.back!]
                for actual in inputs, expected in #[invocation.source, invocation.target, point] do
                  let .fvar localId := actual.consumeMData
                    | throwError "the named child lost an actual input reference"
                  let some binding := current.bindings.find? (·.expression.fvarId! == localId)
                    | throwError "the named child replaced a scoped input by source reconstruction"
                  let some retained := bound[binding.id]?
                    | throwError "the named child reference is outside its retained table"
                  unless retained.value == expected.value &&
                      retained.associationIds == expected.associationIds do
                    throwError "the named child selected another equal endpoint or point"
                observed.set true
                kernel.run cell current bound term (selections := selections)
              failureAt .noImplementation do
                discard <| kernel.child evaluate request transaction reservation scope
                  (Json.mkObj [("op", toJson row.id.raw), ("args", childPacket.encode)])
              unless ← observed.get do throwError "the named child bypassed the common source lowerer"
            finally scope.retire
          finally discard <| transaction.abort
        unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
          throwError "the source and protocol controls dispatched a mathematical provider"
      finally
        kernel.close
        owners.close connection.generation
  finally setEnv original

-- The public parser, shared by named child calls, rejects incomplete and nonboolean packets.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let base : PresentationInvocation := {
    parameters := #[], inverse := false, source := .null, target := .null, argument := .null }
  let .ok fields := (base.encode.getObjVal? "args").bind (·.getArr?)
    | throwError "the public presentation encoder lost its ordered packet"
  for malformed in #[fields.pop, fields.push .null, fields.set! 1 (toJson (1 : Nat)),
      fields.set! 1 (.str "false")] do
    if (PresentationInvocation.decode
        (Json.mkObj [("ctor", "presentationApply"), ("args", .arr malformed)])).isOk then
      throwError "the named comparison parser admitted a malformed complete request"

-- Equal native parameter values are distinct supplied occurrences. The original comparison
-- may keep explicit endpoint aliases, but their descriptor slots must retain the comparison's
-- exact original parameter. No comparison result or backend answer is formed here.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let some row := (← semanticState).presentations.find? (·.declaration ==
        ``CasCatalogue.Algebra.CyclicQuotients.residueComparison)
      | throwError "the original parameterized comparison is not registered"
    let family ← PresentationFamily.forEntry row
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        let term := mkNatLit 3
        let first ← kernel.run transaction context {} term
        let other ← kernel.run transaction context {} term
        unless first.value != other.value do
          throwError "the parameter control did not retain distinct original inputs"
        controlAt MetaM fun run =>
          withBoundValue owners.identities context {} term first
            fun context bound firstSource => run do
              controlAt MetaM fun run =>
                withBoundValue owners.identities context bound term other
                  fun context bound otherSource => run do
                    let (head, levels) ← family.instantiate
                    let firstIso := mkApp head firstSource
                    let otherIso := mkApp head otherSource
                    let firstEnds ← family.endpoints firstIso
                    let otherEnds ← family.endpoints otherIso
                    let withEnds (ends : SourceSelection Expr × SourceSelection Expr)
                        (action : MetaM PreparedRequest → MetaM Unit) : MetaM Unit :=
                      SourceSelectionScope.withBinding owners.identities {} context ends.1
                        fun context selections sourceTerm =>
                          SourceSelectionScope.withBinding owners.identities selections context ends.2
                            fun context selections targetTerm => do
                              let source ← kernel.run transaction context bound sourceTerm
                                (selections := selections)
                              let target ← kernel.run transaction context bound targetTerm
                                (selections := selections)
                              withBoundValue owners.identities context bound sourceTerm source fun context bound sourceTerm =>
                                withBoundValue owners.identities context bound targetTerm target fun context bound targetTerm => do
                                  let graph ← transaction.view
                                  let .ok parameter := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 first
                                    | throwError "the original comparison parameter is outside its graph"
                                  let .ok sourceArgument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 source
                                    | throwError "the original comparison source is outside its graph"
                                  let .ok targetArgument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 1 target
                                    | throwError "the original comparison target is outside its graph"
                                  let mut parameters := #[]
                                  for binding in context.bindings do
                                    if let some value := bound[binding.id]? then
                                      parameters := parameters.push (← IO.ofExcept <|
                                        (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id value).mapError IO.userError)
                                  let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
                                  let occurrence ← kernel.ledger.allocate
                                  let universes ← levels.mapM instantiateLevelMVars
                                  let parameterSources := #[← context.close firstSource]
                                  let endpointSources := #[← context.close sourceTerm, ← context.close targetTerm]
                                  action (PreparedRequest.forPresentation owners.identities program
                                    occurrence family universes context parameterSources #[parameter]
                                    endpointSources #[sourceArgument, targetArgument] parameters graph
                                    (selections := selections))

                    withEnds firstEnds fun request => discard request
                    withEnds otherEnds fun request => do
                      let failure : Option Exception ← try
                        discard request
                        pure none
                      catch error => pure (some error)
                      let some failure := failure
                        | throwError "the presentation accepted endpoint descriptors with another equal parameter node"
                      unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag
                          (· == `CasRuntime.RuntimeEnvironment.sourceReferenceMismatch) do throw failure
                    unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                      throwError "the parameter identity control dispatched a comparison"
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

end CasRuntime.PresentationTests

module

import CasRuntime.Kernel
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Kernel

namespace CasRuntime.ProjectionRecordDependencyTests

open Lean Meta CasCompiler

-- The original lazy input contains an ordinary native dependent record. Projecting that
-- record must succeed through its actual retained parent before any later field demand.
-- No provider or mathematical result is supplied, and no payload value is asserted.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let term ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(((⟨7, ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ 7⟩⟩ : Sigma (fun n : Nat => Fin (n + 1))), ()))) none
    let source ← empty.close term
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let producer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      let code ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      kernel.codes.modify (·.insert code (.term source))
      let input ← producer.stage
        { program := code, occurrence := ← kernel.ledger.allocate,
          role := ← SourceLayout.ofTerm source, parameters := #[] }
        (.closure code #[])
      let .error _ := (← producer.view).project input 0
        | throwError "the native dependent-record control already has a stored first field"
      let .ok _ ← producer.commit
        | throwError "the original lazy dependent record could not publish"
      withLocalDeclD `x (← inferType term) fun x => do
        let binding : LocalBinding := {
          id := { session := "native-record-projection", serial := 0 },
          role := .parameter, expression := x }
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[binding]
        let bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding := {}
        let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let result ← kernel.run consumer context (bound.insert binding.id input)
            (mkProj ``Prod 0 x)
          unless result.projectionAccesses.any (fun (parent, path) =>
              parent.value == input.value && parent.associationIds == input.associationIds &&
                path == #[``Prod.fst]) do
            throwError "the native record projection lost its exact original lazy parent"
          unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "the native record projection dispatched a provider"
        finally discard <| consumer.abort
      -- Session retains a definition's exact let role on the same original value node.
      -- Native conversion can still read its definition; reference selection keeps x.
      withLetDecl `x (← inferType term) term fun x => do
        let binding : LocalBinding := {
          id := { session := "native-record-projection-alias", serial := 0 },
          role := .definition, expression := x }
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[binding]
        let .ok selected := input.withRole (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close x))
          #[] (some #[some input])
          | throwError "the native dependent record could not retain its source alias"
        let bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding := {}
        let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let result ← kernel.run consumer context (bound.insert binding.id selected)
            (mkProj ``Prod 0 x)
          unless result.projectionAccesses.any (fun (parent, path) =>
              parent.value == selected.value &&
                parent.associationIds == selected.associationIds && path == #[``Prod.fst]) do
            throwError "the aliased native record projection lost its exact original parent"
          unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "the aliased native record projection dispatched a provider"
        finally discard <| consumer.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

-- Two accesses to a stored nested record retain distinct consuming fields. Publishing
-- the first nested access must not make its new field associations the original stored
-- baseline for the second one. Both still require their exact parent and native path.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 7]
    let outer ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[pair, mkNatLit 7]
    let scalarRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
    let innerRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkProj ``Prod 0 outer))
    let outerRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close outer)
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← OccurrenceLedger.new owners
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    try
      let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
      let occurrence ← ledger.allocate
      let producing := fun role =>
        ({ program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] } : ValueOrigin)
      let scalar ← transaction.stage (producing scalarRole) (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      let inner ← transaction.stage (producing innerRole) (.product #[scalar, scalar])
      let parent ← transaction.stage (producing outerRole) (.product #[inner, scalar])
      let otherParent ← transaction.stage (producing outerRole) (.product #[inner, scalar])
      let publish (parent : ValueBinding) (index : Nat) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
        let graph ← transaction.view
        let .ok stored := graph.project parent index
          | throwError "the repeated projection lost its original stored field"
        let request ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program
          (← ledger.allocate) context graph parent index #[]
        let (draft, selected) ← request.associateResult owners.identities request.source
          (← transaction.draft) stored
        discard <| request.admitResult draft.view selected
        let .ok () ← transaction.installDraft draft
          | throwError "the repeated projection lost its complete admitted draft"
        return selected
      let first ← publish parent 0
      let second ← publish parent 0
      let other ← publish otherParent 0
      unless first.value == inner.value && second.value == inner.value &&
          other.value == inner.value && first.associationIds != second.associationIds &&
          first.associationIds != other.associationIds do
        throwError "the repeated projection control lost its distinct consuming parents"
      let firstField ← publish first 0
      let secondField ← publish second 0
      let otherField ← publish other 0
      let graph ← transaction.view
      for (parent, field) in #[(first, firstField), (second, secondField), (other, otherField)] do
        let .ok (some baseline) := graph.projected? parent #[``Prod.fst]
          | throwError "a repeated nested projection lost its stored baseline"
        unless baseline.value == scalar.value &&
            baseline.associationIds == scalar.associationIds do
          throwError "a nested projection published a consuming view as its stored baseline"
        let .ok (some access) := graph.projectedAccess? parent #[``Prod.fst]
          | throwError "a repeated nested projection lost its exact parent access"
        unless access.value == field.value && access.associationIds == field.associationIds do
          throwError "a repeated nested projection reused another parent's access"
      let check (parent : ValueBinding) (path : Name) (field : ValueBinding)
          (accepted : Bool) : MetaM Unit :=
        withBindingContext graph context {} parent fun context bound => do
          let native ← parent.selectedSource context
          withBoundValue owners.identities context bound native parent fun context bound selected => do
            let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context bound graph
            let specified ← context.close (← mkProjection selected path)
            let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 field
              | throwError "the repeated projection argument is outside its graph"
            let failure : Option Exception ← try
                discard <| environment.checkArgument specified argument
                pure none
              catch error => pure (some error)
            match accepted, failure with
            | true, none => pure ()
            | true, some error =>
              throwError "the exact nested parent access was rejected ({repr parent.associationIds}): {error.toMessageData}"
            | false, none => throwError "a nested projection accepted a different parent or field path"
            | false, some error =>
              unless error.toMessageData.hasTag
                  (· == `CasRuntime.RuntimeEnvironment.sourceReferenceMismatch) do throw error
      check first `fst firstField true
      check second `fst secondField true
      check other `fst otherField true
      check first `fst secondField false
      check first `fst otherField false
      check first `snd firstField false
      -- Retaining the verified inner occurrence cannot authorize a path through a
      -- different original outer occurrence. Both suppliers have explicit typed binders.
      withBindingContext graph context {} first fun context bound => do
        let native ← first.selectedSource context
        withBoundValue owners.identities context bound native first fun context bound inner => do
          withBoundValue owners.identities context bound outer otherParent fun context bound wrongOuter => do
            let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context bound graph
            unless ← environment.hasRetainedSource context inner do
              throwError "the nested projection control lost its verified inner occurrence"
            let wrongInner ← mkProjection wrongOuter `fst
            let specified ← context.close (← mkProjection wrongInner `fst)
            let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 firstField
              | throwError "the retained nested projection is outside its graph"
            let failure : Option Exception ← try
                discard <| environment.checkArgument specified argument
                pure none
              catch error => pure (some error)
            let some failure := failure
              | throwError "a verified inner occurrence bypassed its different original outer parent"
            unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag
                (· == `CasRuntime.RuntimeEnvironment.sourceReferenceMismatch) do throw failure
    finally discard <| transaction.abort
  finally setEnv original

-- The public native lowering path must retain these same stored baselines when the
-- inner record has a dependent field. Every access keeps its exact consuming parent.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let term ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
      (← `(((⟨7, ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ 7⟩⟩ : Sigma (fun n : Nat => Fin (n + 1))), ()))) none
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let kernel ← Kernel.load owners none none 1000
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    try
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
      try
        let outer ← kernel.run transaction context {} term
        let graph ← transaction.view
        let .ok originalInner := graph.project outer 0
          | throwError "the repeated native projection lost its original stored record"
        let .ok originalField := graph.project originalInner 0
          | throwError "the repeated native projection lost its original stored prefix"
        let project (value : ValueBinding) (structureName : Name) (index : Nat) :
            MetaM ValueBinding := do
          let graph ← transaction.view
          withBindingContext graph context {} value fun context bound => do
            let native ← value.selectedSource context
            let selections ← value.role.selections.inContext context
            withBoundValue owners.identities context bound native value fun context bound selected =>
              kernel.run transaction context bound (mkProj structureName index selected)
                (selections := selections)
        let first ← project outer ``Prod 0
        let firstField ← project first ``Sigma 0
        let second ← project outer ``Prod 0
        let secondField ← project second ``Sigma 0
        unless first.value == originalInner.value && second.value == originalInner.value &&
            first.associationIds != second.associationIds do
          throwError "the repeated native projection lost its two distinct consuming views"
        let graph ← transaction.view
        for (parent, selected) in #[(first, firstField), (second, secondField)] do
          let .ok stored := graph.project parent 0
            | throwError "a consuming native projection lost its actual stored field"
          unless selected.value == originalField.value && stored.value == selected.value &&
              stored.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf selected.associationIds.toList do
            throwError "a repeated native projection changed its current parent's original field"
          let .ok (some baseline) := graph.projected? parent #[``Sigma.fst]
            | throwError "the repeated native projection lost its original baseline"
          unless baseline.value == originalField.value &&
              baseline.associationIds == originalField.associationIds do
            throwError "a sibling native projection supplied a consuming view as the original field"
          unless selected.projectionAccesses.any (fun (original, path) =>
              original.value == parent.value &&
                original.associationIds == parent.associationIds && path == #[``Sigma.fst]) do
            throwError "the repeated native projection changed its exact consuming parent"
        unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
          throwError "a stored native projection dispatched a mathematical provider"
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
    finally kernel.close
  finally setEnv original

end CasRuntime.ProjectionRecordDependencyTests

module

public import CasRuntime.RoutedMethod
public import CasCompiler.PropertyFamily

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- One complete property source application before any registration is inspected. The native
proposition, exact category parameters and original receiver keep their prepared authority. -/
structure PreparedPropertyRoute where
  private mk ::
  preparation : RoleScope
  family : PropertyFamily
  actions : Array ClosedTerm
  environment : RuntimeEnvironment
  receiverSource : ClosedTerm
  receiver : ValueBinding
  boundaries : Array RoutedSourceBoundary
  dependencies : Array ValueBinding

opaque PreparedPropertyRoute.prepare (kernel : Kernel) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (request : PreparedRequest) : MetaM PreparedPropertyRoute := do
  let .primitive (.property family) levels := request.action
    | throwError "the property observation lost its accepted native family"
  unless request.source.kind == .typeValue do
    throwError "a property observation requires its native proposition, not a proof"
  discard <| request.admitInputs graph
  let some application := request.application
    | throwError "the property observation lost its complete receiver application"
  let some retained := request.origin.application
    | throwError "the property observation lost its original actual argument table"
  let values := retained.arguments
  unless application.arguments.size == family.parameterCount + 1 &&
      values.size == application.arguments.size do
    throwError "the property observation changed its complete source telescope"
  let some receiver := values[family.parameterCount]?.bind id
    | throwError "the property observation has no actual original receiver"
  let some receiverSlot := application.arguments[family.parameterCount]?
    | throwError "the property observation lost its original receiver position"
  withSourceScope request fun context bound => do
    let selections ← request.environment.selections.inContext context
    let some selectedId := request.selectionBinding
      | throwError "the property request lost its original selected source binding"
    let some originalSelection := selections[selectedId]?
      | throwError "the property request lost its complete original source selection"
    family.checkSelection context selections originalSelection
    request.withArguments kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound (family.parameterCount + 1)
        fun context bound actual _ => do
      let actions ← family.specializeActions levels (actual.extract 0 family.parameterCount)
      let original ← receiver.selectedSource context
      let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge
        (← request.environment.selections.inContext context)
        (← receiver.role.selections.inContext context)
      let boundaries ← routedSourceBoundaries context selections family.route original
      let some receiverSource := actual[family.parameterCount]?
        | throwError "the property observation lost its original receiver position"
      let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound request.environment.worker
        context bound graph (some request.environment) selections
      return ⟨request.roles.scope, family, ← actions.mapM context.close, environment,
        ← context.close receiverSource, receiver, boundaries, request.scope⟩

/-- Registration selection retains its exact original source offset. No property derivation
or synthetic computation address is introduced. -/
structure SelectedPropertyBoundary where
  private mk ::
  route : PreparedPropertyRoute
  boundary : RoutedSourceBoundary
  registration : Registration

def PreparedPropertyRoute.select (route : PreparedPropertyRoute) (profile : RealizationProfile)
    (manifest : Manifest) : MetaM SelectedPropertyBoundary := do
  let (offset, registration) ← selectRegistrationBoundary profile manifest
    (.property route.family.entry.id) route.family.entry.id.raw (route.boundaries.map (·.forms))
  let some boundary := route.boundaries[offset]?
    | throwError "the selected property boundary is outside its original route"
  unless boundary.offset == offset && offset <= route.family.route.refs.size do
    throwError "the selected property boundary changed its original source position"
  return ⟨route, boundary, registration⟩

/-- The released property packet is its actual selected receiver. Complete native parameters
and intermediate dependencies remain owned by the same prepared request and reservation. -/
structure PreparedPropertyInvocation where
  private mk ::
  preparation : RoleScope
  registration : Registration
  property : PropertyId
  offset : Nat
  receiver : ValueBinding
  dependencies : Array ValueBinding
  views : Array InputDescriptorView

def SelectedPropertyBoundary.materialize (selection : SelectedPropertyBoundary) (kernel : Kernel)
    (evaluateSource : SourceEvaluation) (request : PreparedRequest)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) : MetaM PreparedPropertyInvocation := do
  let route := selection.route
  request.requirePreparation route.preparation
  let (receiver, source, dependencies, environment) ← materializeSourcePrefix kernel evaluateSource request
    transaction route.family.route route.family.actionFamilies route.actions route.receiverSource route.receiver
    route.dependencies selection.boundary.offset route.environment
  unless route.family.receiverViews.size == route.family.route.refs.size + 1 do
    throwError "the property lost its complete original category-constructor positions"
  let some receiverView := route.family.receiverViews[selection.boundary.offset]?
    | throwError "the property receiver lost its original selected route position"
  let prepared ← sourceReceiverViews kernel evaluateSource request transaction
    selection.boundary.category receiverView source receiver environment
  let views ← InputDescriptorView.collect (← transaction.view) (← kernel.codes.get)
    #[receiver] prepared
  let dependencies := dependencies ++ views.flatMap (·.dependencies)
  return ⟨route.preparation, selection.registration, route.family.entry.id, selection.boundary.offset, receiver,
    dependencies, views⟩

def PreparedPropertyInvocation.roots (invocation : PreparedPropertyInvocation) :
    Array InputPosition :=
  #[{ path := #[], binding := invocation.receiver }]

/-- Encode only the independently retained receiver, under the raw property request grammar.
The root and every nested scoped reference still refer to their original value bindings. -/
def PreparedPropertyInvocation.encode (invocation : PreparedPropertyInvocation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (connection : ConnectionGeneration) :
    Except String (EncodedInputs × Json) := do
  let encoded ← graph.encodeInputs connection invocation.roots invocation.views
  let #[receiver] := encoded.values
    | throw "the property packet changed its complete receiver arity"
  return (encoded, receiver)

end CasRuntime

module

import CasRuntime.Property
import CasCatalogue.TestSuite
import LeanCategories.Catalogue
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Property
meta import CasCatalogue.TestSuite
meta import LeanCategories.Catalogue

namespace CasRuntime.PropertyTests

open Lean Meta Elab Command Term CasCompiler CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Backend

-- Source, packet and lifecycle controls only. Existing published properties supply every
-- proposition. These tests neither prove abelianness/finiteness nor supply mathematical answers.
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
run_cmd do
  let root ← IO.currentDir
  IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
  let path := root / ".tmp" / "property-empty-leaves.json"
  IO.FS.writeFile path
    (Json.mkObj [("backends", .arr #[]), ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
  CasCatalogue.Language.withSession (some path) true fun initial => do
    let mut session := initial
    for text in #["let C3 := ZMod(3) in Groups", "let C3again := ZMod(3) in Groups",
        "let S3 := Sym(3) in Groups", "let Rfirst := ℤ in Rings", "let Rsecond := ℤ in Rings",
        "let Mfirst := RegularModule(Rfirst)", "let Msecond := RegularModule(Rsecond)"] do
      let result ← CasCatalogue.Language.runStatement session text
      unless result.outcome.kind == "holds" do
        throwError "the original property input failed: {text}: {result.outcome.detail}"
      session := result.session
    liftTermElabM do
      let originalValue (name : Name) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
        let some entry := session.source.context.entries.find? (·.userName == name)
          | throwError "the property control lost original binding {name}"
        let some selected := session.value? entry.id
          | throwError "the property control lost actual value {name}"
        return selected
      let exact := fun (left right : ValueBinding) =>
        left.value == right.value && left.associationIds == right.associationIds
      let failAt (stratum : Stratum) (action : MetaM Unit) : MetaM Unit := do
        let failure : Option Exception ← try
          action
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
        let some failure := failure | throwError "the property negative was accepted"
        unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? failure == some stratum do throw failure
      let failWith (message : String) (action : MetaM Unit) : MetaM Unit := do
        let failure : Option Exception ← try
          action
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
        let some failure := failure | throwError "the property identity negative was accepted"
        unless (← failure.toMessageData.toString).startsWith message do throw failure
      -- The same production Lower/Execute capture pattern as RoutedMethodTests. Only the
      -- final property observation is stopped; every input uses the ordinary interpreter.
      let capture (transaction : CellTransaction) (action : SourceEvaluation → MetaM ValueBinding) :
          MetaM (PreparedRequest × PreparedPropertyRoute) := do
        let captured ← IO.mkRef (none : Option PreparedRequest)
        let evaluate : SourceEvaluation := fun cell program context bound selections expression => do
          let handler : PFunctor.Handler.Stateful MetaM CellTransaction OperationalSignature :=
            fun request current => do
              if let .primitive (.property _) _ := request.action then
                captured.set (some request)
                throwError "captured the original prepared property observation"
              let response ← Execute.run session.kernel.executor
                (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) request) current
                (some (session.kernel.resolveFixedInput
                  (fun cell _ context bound selections expression => session.kernel.run cell context bound expression (selections := selections))
                  current program))
              return (response, current)
          lowerTerm {
            ledger := session.kernel.ledger, transaction := cell,
            codes := session.kernel.codes
            run := fun computation => do
              let (result, _) ← handler.run computation cell
              return result }
            program context bound expression (selections := selections)
        let failure : Option Exception ← try
          discard <| action evaluate
          pure none
        catch error => pure (some error)
        let some request ← captured.get
          | if let some failure := failure then throw failure
            else throwError "the source never reached its complete property observation"
        return (request, ← PreparedPropertyRoute.prepare session.kernel
          (← transaction.view) request)
      let installed (forms : Array String) : MetaM Manifest := do
        let packet := Json.mkObj [
          ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "unused-property-peer"),
            ("command", "/bin/false"), ("args", .arr #[])]]),
          ("registrations", .arr (forms.map fun form => Json.mkObj [
            ("operation", "prop.is_abelian"), ("input", toJson form),
            ("backend", "unused-property-peer")]))]
        let parsed ← IO.ofExcept <| (Manifest.parse packet).mapError IO.userError
        let (admitted, rejected) ← admitManifest parsed
        unless rejected.isEmpty do
          throwError "the published property input forms were rejected: {rejected}"
        return admitted
      let firstGroup ← originalValue `C3
      let otherGroup ← originalValue `C3again
      let firstRing ← originalValue `Rfirst
      let otherRing ← originalValue `Rsecond
      unless firstGroup.value != otherGroup.value && firstRing.value != otherRing.value do
        throwError "the property control merged separately declared equal inputs"
      let connection ← session.kernel.ledger.owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
      try
        let cases : Array (String × String × Option Name × Option String) := #[
          ("C3", "is_abelian", none, some "C3again"),
          ("C3again", "is_abelian", none, some "C3"),
          ("S3", "is_abelian", none, none),
          ("Mfirst", "is_finite", some `Rfirst, some "Msecond"),
          ("Msecond", "is_finite", some `Rsecond, some "Mfirst")]
        for (name, propertyName, scalarName, peerName) in cases do
          let text := s!"{name}.{propertyName}()"
          let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text
            | throwError "the original property expression did not parse"
          let term ← session.source.read ⟨parsed⟩
          let peer ← peerName.mapM fun peerName => do
            let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term
                s!"{peerName}.{propertyName}()"
              | throwError "the equal-source property expression did not parse"
            session.source.read ⟨parsed⟩
          let original ← originalValue (Name.mkSimple name)
          let some originalEntry := session.source.context.entries.find?
              (·.userName == Name.mkSimple name)
            | throwError "the property lost its exact original receiver identity"
          let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin session.kernel.ledger
          try
            let (request, route) ← term.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
              let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
              let selections ← term.selections.inContext context
              let some originalSelection := selections.findAt? context expression
                | throwError "the source property lost its selected binding"
              let some selectedApplication := originalSelection.application
                | throwError "the source property lost its complete typed application"
              let .property family := selectedApplication.family
                | throwError "the source property changed its selected family"
              family.checkSelection context selections originalSelection
              let parameters := selectedApplication.parameters
              let #[receiver] := selectedApplication.arguments
                | throwError "the source property lost its exact receiver position"
              let some selected := bindings.find? (·.id == originalEntry.id)
                | throwError "the source property lost its original receiver binder"
              let some (.classifier classifier) := originalSelection.observation
                | throwError "the property source lost its complete selected classifier"
              unless receiver == selected.expression &&
                  family.entry.id.raw == s!"prop.{propertyName}" &&
                  reprStr classifier == reprStr family.classifier do
                throwError "the property source changed its receiver or accepted classifier"
              if let some scalarName := scalarName then
                let some scalarEntry := session.source.context.entries.find? (·.userName == scalarName)
                  | throwError "the property lost its exact selected scalar identity"
                let some scalar := bindings.find? (·.id == scalarEntry.id)
                  | throwError "the property lost its chosen scalar binder"
                let #[parameter] := parameters
                  | throwError "the property changed its exact category parameter arity"
                let some parameterSelection := selections.findAt? context parameter
                  | throwError "the property lost its selected category parameter binding"
                let some parameterCategory := parameterSelection.category
                  | throwError "the property lost its explicit category parameter origin"
                let some selectedCategory := session.source.categoryFor scalarEntry.id
                  | throwError "the property lost its original scalar category"
                unless parameterSelection.value == scalar.expression && parameterCategory.role == .object &&
                    parameterCategory.expression.syntacticEq (.atom CategoryId.rings) &&
                    parameterCategory.expression.syntacticEq selectedCategory.expression &&
                    parameterCategory.bundle == (← selectedCategory.bundle.inContext context) do
                  throwError "the property source replaced its exact category parameter"
              else unless parameters.isEmpty do
                throwError "the group property invented a category parameter"
              -- The native Holds proposition remains unchanged while an equal peer tries
              -- to replace one original typed application field at the same binding.
              if let some peer := peer then
                peer.source.context.withInContext context fun peerContext => do
                  let peerSelections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections
                    (← peer.selections.inContext peerContext)
                  let peerExpression ← peer.source.inContext peerContext
                  let some peerSelection := peerSelections.findAt? peerContext peerExpression
                    | throwError "the equal-source property lost its selected binding"
                  let some peerApplication := peerSelection.application
                    | throwError "the equal-source property lost its complete application"
                  let .property peerFamily := peerApplication.family
                    | throwError "the equal-source property changed its family kind"
                  unless peerFamily.entry.id == family.entry.id do
                    throwError "the property witness control changed its selected property"
                  let (originalArgument, replacement, changedApplication) ← match scalarName with
                    | none => do
                      let #[peerReceiver] := peerApplication.arguments
                        | throwError "the equal-source property lost its exact receiver"
                      pure (receiver, peerReceiver,
                        { selectedApplication with arguments := #[peerReceiver] })
                    | some _ => do
                      let #[parameter] := peerApplication.parameters
                        | throwError "the equal-source property changed its complete parameter arity"
                      let #[originalParameter] := parameters
                        | throwError "the original property lost its category parameter"
                      pure (originalParameter, parameter,
                        { selectedApplication with parameters := #[parameter] })
                  unless originalArgument != replacement do
                    throwError "the property witness control needs distinct equal source arguments"
                  peerContext.withOriginalSources #[originalArgument, replacement] fun native => do
                    unless ← isDefEq native[0]! native[1]! do
                      throwError "the property witness control needs distinct equal source arguments"
                  check originalSelection.value
                  let .fvar originalId := expression
                    | throwError "the original property lost its selected native binder"
                  let some originalBinding := peerContext.bindings.find?
                      (·.expression.fvarId! == originalId)
                    | throwError "the original property lost its exact source binding"
                  let forged := { originalSelection with application := some changedApplication }
                  failWith "one source binding has incompatible retained selections" do
                    discard <| peerSelections.merge
                      (({} : SourceSelectionScope Expr).insert originalBinding.id forged)
                  let changedNative := mkAppN
                    (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams changedApplication.universes)
                    (changedApplication.parameters ++ changedApplication.arguments)
                  let fresh := { forged with originalApplication := some changedNative }
                  peerSelections.withBinding session.kernel.ledger.owners.identities peerContext fresh
                    fun freshContext freshSelections freshSource => do
                      check freshSource
                      let some retained := freshSelections.findAt? freshContext freshSource
                        | throwError "the forged property control lost its fresh selected binding"
                      failWith "the property source witness changed its original native proposition" do
                        family.checkSelection freshContext freshSelections retained
              let mut bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding := {}
              for binding in bindings do
                if let some actual := session.value? binding.id then
                  bound := bound.insert binding.id actual
              let program ← session.kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .program
              capture transaction fun evaluate =>
                evaluate transaction program context bound selections expression
            let expectedId := s!"prop.{propertyName}"
            unless request.source.kind == .typeValue && request.reference.isNone &&
                route.family.entry.id.raw == expectedId &&
                route.family.entry.classifier == route.family.classifier.id &&
                exact original route.receiver && route.preparation == request.roles.scope do
              throwError "the complete property demand changed its source authority"
            let some application := request.origin.application
              | throwError "the property lost its complete actual input table"
            if let some scalarName := scalarName then
              let scalar ← originalValue scalarName
              let #[some actualScalar, some actualReceiver] := application.arguments
                | throwError "the parameterized property lost its original complete positions"
              unless exact scalar actualScalar && exact original actualReceiver do
                throwError "the property changed an original scalar or receiver occurrence"
            else
              let #[some actualReceiver] := application.arguments
                | throwError "the group property changed its original receiver arity"
              unless exact original actualReceiver do
                throwError "the group property changed its original receiver reference"
            -- Rebuild only for the negative controls, keeping the original expected sources.
            let rebuild (replacement : Option (Nat × ValueBinding)) : MetaM PreparedRequest :=
              withSourceScope request fun context bound => do
                let graph ← transaction.view
                let some layout := request.application
                  | throwError "the property lost its source application layout"
                let mut parameters := #[]
                for binding in context.bindings do
                  if let some actual := bound[binding.id]? then
                    parameters := parameters.push (← IO.ofExcept <|
                      (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id actual).mapError IO.userError)
                let mut actual := #[]
                for selected in application.arguments, index in [:application.arguments.size] do
                  if let some selected := selected then
                    let selected := match replacement with
                      | some (position, changed) => if position == index then changed else selected
                      | none => selected
                    actual := actual.push (← IO.ofExcept <|
                      (RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph index selected).mapError IO.userError)
                let .primitive boundary levels := request.action
                  | throwError "the property control lost its primitive request"
                PreparedRequest.forBoundary session.kernel.ledger.owners.identities request.program
                  request.occurrence boundary levels context
                  (layout.arguments.map (·.source.source)) actual #[] parameters
                  (selections := ← request.environment.selections.inContext context)
                  (selectionBinding := request.selectionBinding)
            if name != "S3" then
              let replacement ← match scalarName with
                | some scalar => originalValue (if scalar == `Rfirst then `Rsecond else `Rfirst)
                | none => originalValue (if name == "C3" then `C3again else `C3)
              let failure : Option Exception ← try
                discard <| rebuild (some (0, replacement))
                pure none
              catch error => pure (some error)
              let some failure := failure
                | throwError "the property identity negative was accepted"
              unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag
                  (· == `CasRuntime.RuntimeEnvironment.sourceReferenceMismatch) do throw failure
            if name == "C3" then
              let some originalBoundary := route.boundaries[0]?
                | throwError "the property has no original source boundary"
              unless originalBoundary.offset == 0 &&
                  originalBoundary.forms.contains "cat.groups" &&
                  originalBoundary.forms.contains "obj.groups.cyclic" &&
                  route.family.classifier.id == ClassifierId.magmasCommutative do
                throwError "the abelian property changed its complete source forms or classifier"
              failAt .noImplementation do
                discard <| route.select session.kernel.profile session.kernel.manifest
              failAt .ambiguousRealization do
                discard <| route.select session.kernel.profile (← installed #["cat.groups", "obj.groups.cyclic"])
              let selection ← route.select session.kernel.profile (← installed #["cat.groups"])
              let overlap ← installed #["cat.groups", "obj.groups.cyclic"]
              let freeze := fun (entries : Array Registration) =>
                RealizationProfile.prepare overlap (some (Json.mkObj [
                  ("format", "cas-realization-profile/1"), ("id", "property-control"),
                  ("default", "all"), ("rules", .arr #[Json.mkObj [
                    ("target", Json.mkObj [("kind", "property"), ("id", toJson expectedId)]),
                    ("primitive_registrations", Json.mkObj [("mode", "only"),
                      ("entries", .arr (entries.map fun entry => Json.mkObj [
                        ("operation", toJson entry.operation), ("input", toJson entry.input),
                        ("backend", toJson entry.backend)]))]),
                    ("derivations", Json.mkObj [("mode", "only"), ("ids", .arr #[])])]])]))
              let excluded ← freeze #[]
              failAt .noImplementation do
                discard <| route.select excluded overlap
              let unique ← freeze #[overlap.registrations[0]!]
              let filtered ← route.select unique overlap
              unless filtered.boundary.offset == selection.boundary.offset &&
                  filtered.registration == selection.registration do
                throwError "the property profile changed the original selected source boundary"
              let namedOnly ← freeze #[overlap.registrations[1]!]
              let named ← route.select namedOnly overlap
              unless named.boundary.offset == originalBoundary.offset &&
                  named.registration == overlap.registrations[1]! do
                throwError "the property profile changed its exact selected named form"
              let multiple ← freeze overlap.registrations
              failAt .ambiguousRealization do
                discard <| route.select multiple overlap
              unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
                throwError "property profile selection dispatched an implementation"
              let evaluate : SourceEvaluation := fun cell _ context bound selections expression =>
                session.kernel.run cell context bound expression (selections := selections)
              let invocation ← selection.materialize session.kernel evaluate request transaction
              unless invocation.offset == 0 && invocation.property.raw == expectedId &&
                  invocation.preparation == request.roles.scope && exact original invocation.receiver do
                throwError "the selected property changed its boundary or original receiver"
              do
                let rebuilt ← rebuild none
                unless rebuilt.occurrence == request.occurrence &&
                    rebuilt.roles.scope != request.roles.scope do
                  throwError "the property control did not make a distinct preparation"
                let rejectPreparation (action : MetaM Unit) : MetaM Unit := do
                  let failure : Option Exception ← try
                    action
                    pure none
                  catch error => pure (some error)
                  let some failure := failure
                    | throwError "a property accepted a different request preparation"
                  unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag (· == requestPreparationMismatchTag) do
                    throw failure
                rejectPreparation do
                  discard <| selection.materialize session.kernel evaluate rebuilt transaction
                rejectPreparation do
                  discard <| session.kernel.invokeProperty evaluate rebuilt transaction invocation
              let graph ← transaction.view
              let .ok (encoded, packet) := invocation.encode graph connection.generation
                | throwError "the original property receiver did not encode"
              unless (packet.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "obj.groups.cyclic" do
                throwError "the property replaced its original raw receiver packet"
              let #[rootInput] := invocation.roots
                | throwError "the property packet changed its root arity"
              let some encodedRoot := encoded.inputs.find? (·.path.isEmpty)
                | throwError "the raw property packet lost its original scope root"
              unless rootInput.path.isEmpty && exact original rootInput.binding &&
                  exact original encodedRoot.binding do
                throwError "property encoding reconstructed the original receiver"
              let identity : DispatchIdentity := {
                manifestDigest := "property-scope-control", profileDigest := "no-provider"
                registration := invocation.registration }
              let .ok reservation ← transaction.reserve request.occurrence identity connection
                  invocation.dependencies
                | throwError "the property could not reserve its original source scope"
              let scope ← RequestScope.issue session.kernel.ledger reservation graph
                encoded.slots encoded.inputs #[]
              try
                let call := Json.mkObj [("op", toJson expectedId), ("input", "cat.groups"),
                  ("args", (ScopedReference.input #[]).encode)]
                let (childRequest, childRoute) ← capture transaction fun evaluate =>
                  session.kernel.child evaluate request transaction reservation scope call
                unless childRequest.occurrence != request.occurrence &&
                    childRoute.family.entry.id == route.family.entry.id &&
                    childRoute.family.classifier.id == route.family.classifier.id &&
                    childRoute.family.route.refs == route.family.route.refs &&
                    exact original childRoute.receiver do
                  throwError "the property child changed its native source selection or actual receiver"
                unless (← sourceFamilyConversion route.family.family childRoute.family.family #[]).isSome do
                  throwError "the child property changed the complete unapplied native family"
                failAt .malformed do
                  discard <| session.kernel.child evaluate request transaction reservation scope
                    (Json.mkObj [("op", toJson expectedId), ("input", "cat.sets"),
                      ("args", (ScopedReference.input #[]).encode)])
                -- Real reply admission, with a protocol-only payload. Rejection must leave
                -- this exact occurrence pending and its isolated delta invisible.
                let malformed := #[Json.bool true,
                  Json.mkObj [("ctor", "some"), ("args", .arr #[.bool true])],
                  Json.mkObj [("ctor", "none"), ("args", .arr #[.null])],
                  Json.mkObj [("ctor", "some"), ("args", .arr #[Json.mkObj
                    [("ctor", "true"), ("args", .arr #[]), ("extra", .null)]])]]
                let some resultRole := request.roles.results[0]?
                  | throwError "the property observation lost its result role"
                for packet in malformed do
                  let before ← transaction.view
                  let reply ← ImmediateReply.parseControl scope reservation before scope.wireId 0
                    (Json.mkObj [("request_id", toJson (0 : Nat)), ("status", "ok"),
                      ("value", packet), ("exports", .arr #[])])
                  failAt .malformed do
                    discard <| reply.stageCompletion request transaction scope connection
                  unless before.sameRevision (← transaction.view) &&
                      ((← SessionSnapshot.current).receipt request.occurrence).isNone do
                    throwError "a malformed property answer published a result"
                  match ← transaction.reuse request.occurrence resultRole.role.id with
                  | .ok (.pending retained) =>
                    unless retained.occurrence == reservation.occurrence &&
                        retained.connection == reservation.connection do
                      throwError "a malformed property answer changed its pending occurrence"
                  | _ => throwError "a malformed property answer became a reusable completion"
              finally scope.retire
          finally discard <| transaction.abort
        unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
          throwError "the property source controls dispatched a mathematical provider"
      finally session.kernel.ledger.owners.close connection.generation

-- Exercise the actual computing question path. The fixed protocol packets are deliberately
-- independent of the group: they test observation/lifecycle classification, never B0 mathematics.
-- The unchanged SessionPredicateTests separately retains ordinary predicate raw-Boolean behavior.
run_cmd do
  let contract ← packageDir contractPackage
  let root ← IO.currentDir
  let python := (← IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
  let peer := root / "scripts/probes/protocol_v2_peer.py"
  let answer := fun (label : String) => Json.mkObj [("ctor", "some"), ("args", .arr #[Json.mkObj
    [("ctor", toJson label), ("args", .arr #[])]])]
  let cases : Array (Json × String) := #[
    (answer "true", "holds"), (answer "false", "wrong"),
    (Json.mkObj [("ctor", "none"), ("args", .arr #[])], "gap"), (.bool true, "malformed")]
  for (packet, expected) in cases, index in [:cases.size] do
    let manifest := Json.mkObj [
      ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "property-observation-peer"),
        ("command", python.toString), ("args", .arr #[toJson peer.toString,
          "--property-observation", toJson packet.compress])]]),
      ("registrations", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("operation", "prop.is_abelian"),
        ("input", "cat.groups"), ("backend", "property-observation-peer")]])]
    IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let path := root / ".tmp" / s!"property-observation-{index}.json"
    IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
    CasCatalogue.Language.withSession (some path) true fun initial => do
      let input ← CasCatalogue.Language.runStatement initial "let C3 := ZMod(3) in Groups"
      unless input.outcome.kind == "holds" do
        throwError "the property observation input failed: {input.outcome.detail}"
      let result ← CasCatalogue.Language.runStatement input.session "assert C3.is_abelian()"
      unless result.outcome.kind == expected do
        throwError "the property packet {packet.compress} was {result.outcome.kind}: {result.outcome.detail}"
      let negatedExpected := if expected == "holds" then "wrong"
        else if expected == "wrong" then "holds" else expected
      let negated ← CasCatalogue.Language.runStatement result.session
        "assert C3.is_abelian() = false"
      unless negated.outcome.kind == negatedExpected do
        throwError "the negated property packet {packet.compress} was {negated.outcome.kind}: {negated.outcome.detail}"
      let dispatched := (← negated.session.kernel.dispatches.get).map (·.operation)
      unless dispatched == #["prop.is_abelian", "prop.is_abelian"] do
        throwError "the computing property questions bypassed their original observation boundaries"

end CasRuntime.PropertyTests

/-- A framing peer exercises negotiation only; it supplies no mathematical result.
Reuse: the public Python cas_port.read_frame/write_frame reference implementation. -/
private def negotiationPeer : String := "
import sys
from cas_port import read_frame, write_frame
mode = sys.argv[1]
ready = {'op': 'ready', 'protocol': 2, 'contract': 'cas-computation/2',
         'features': ['scoped-values/2', 'deferred/2', 'suspend-resume/2', 'export-capture-frames/2'],
         'backend': 'framing peer ℤ', 'backend_version': '0'}
if mode == 'legacy':
    ready['protocol'] = 1
elif mode == 'missing':
    ready['features'].pop()
elif mode == 'authority':
    ready['owner'] = 'claimed'
elif mode == 'extra_feature':
    ready['features'].append('diagnostic-extension/7')
write_frame(ready)
hello = read_frame()
if hello != {'op': 'hello', 'protocol': 2, 'contract': 'cas-computation/2'}:
    raise ValueError('the client sent a non-negotiation message')
ack = dict(hello, status='ok')
if mode == 'bad_ack':
    ack['contract'] = 'cas-computation/1'
elif mode == 'authority_ack':
    ack['proof'] = 'claimed'
write_frame(ack)
"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftIO do
  let contract ← packageDir contractPackage
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  for mode in #["valid", "extra_feature", "legacy", "missing", "authority", "bad_ack", "authority_ack"] do
    let child ← owners.spawn {
      cmd := "/usr/bin/python3", args := #["-c", negotiationPeer, mode]
      env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some (contract / "python").toString)] }
    try
      match ← negotiateV2 "configured-backend" child.child.stdin child.child.stdout with
      | .ok ready =>
        unless mode == "valid" || mode == "extra_feature" do
          throw <| IO.userError "an incompatible peer passed v2 negotiation"
        unless ready.backend == "framing peer ℤ" && ready.backendVersion == "0" do
          throw <| IO.userError "v2 negotiation lost diagnostic announcement data"
      | .error (.unavailable backend reason) =>
        unless backend == "configured-backend" && reason.startsWith "incompatible_protocol" &&
            mode != "valid" && mode != "extra_feature" do
          throw <| IO.userError "v2 negotiation lost its incompatible-protocol outcome"
      | .error error => throw <| IO.userError s!"unexpected negotiation failure: {error.render}"
    finally owners.close child.generation

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftIO do
  let hello := helloV2
  let .ok () := checkHelloV2 hello
    | throw <| IO.userError "the public v2 hello failed its own parser"
  let .ok () := checkHelloV2Ack helloV2Ack
    | throw <| IO.userError "the public v2 acknowledgement failed its own parser"
  for packet in #[
      Json.mkObj [("op", .str "hello"), ("protocol", toJson (1 : Nat)),
        ("contract", .str "cas-computation/2")],
      Json.mkObj [("op", .str "hello"), ("protocol", toJson (2 : Nat)),
        ("contract", .str "cas-computation/2"), ("owner", .str "claimed")]] do
    match checkHelloV2 packet with
    | .error _ => pure ()
    | .ok () => throw <| IO.userError "a malformed hello passed protocol validation"
