private def withConstructionPeer (mode : String) (action : Kernel → TermElabM Unit) :
    TermElabM Unit := do
  let originalEnvironment ← getEnv
  let contract ← IO.FS.realPath (← packageDir contractPackage)
  let root ← IO.currentDir
  IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
  let log := root / ".tmp/raw-construction-observations.jsonl"
  IO.FS.writeFile log ""
  let configuration := Json.mkObj [("mode", toJson mode), ("log", toJson log.toString)]
  let manifest := Json.mkObj [
    ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "raw-construction-peer"),
      ("command", toJson (contract / ".venv/bin/python").toString),
      ("args", .arr #[toJson (root / "scripts/probes/raw_construction_peer.py").toString,
        toJson configuration.compress])]]),
    ("registrations", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("operation", "lim.sets.product"),
      ("input", "cat.sets"), ("backend", "raw-construction-peer")]])]
  let path := root / ".tmp/raw-construction-manifest.json"
  IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let kernel ← Kernel.load owners (some path) none 5000
  try
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    unless kernel.rejected.isEmpty do
      throwError "the original raw limit lost its declared registration"
    action kernel
  finally
    try kernel.close
    finally setEnv originalEnvironment

-- Distinct original Fin(1) occurrences have identical packets. The returned leg to the
-- other occurrence is rejected even though native endpoint types and packet bytes agree.
-- Positive controls retain the whole cone, exact native index, and owner-dependent legs.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let originalEnvironment ← getEnv
  try
    let scenarios := (#["inline", "bare", "owned", "wrapped", "wrapped-owned",
      "swapped", "missing", "opaque"].map fun mode => (mode, false)).push ("inline", true)
    for (mode, sharedEndpoint) in scenarios do
      withConstructionPeer mode fun kernel => do
        let family ← LimitFamily.forId ⟨"lim.sets.product"⟩
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
        let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
        try
          let nativeSelection ← sourceNamedObjectAlias CategoryId.sets
            { value := mkApp (mkConst ``Fin) (mkNatLit 1) }
          let packet := Json.mkObj [("ctor", "finiteData"),
            ("args", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("ctor", "obj.sets.fin"),
              ("args", .arr #[toJson (1 : Nat)])], .arr #[toJson (0 : Nat)]])]
          let program ← kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .program
          let occurrence ← kernel.ledger.allocate
          SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities {} context nativeSelection
              fun context selections leftSource =>
            SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities selections context nativeSelection
                fun context selections rightSource => do
              let some leftBinding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression == leftSource)
                | throwError "the original left endpoint lost its typed source binding"
              let some rightBinding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression == rightSource)
                | throwError "the original right endpoint lost its typed source binding"
              let closedSelections ← selections.close context
              let leftRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close leftSource)
                closedSelections (some leftBinding.id)
              let rightRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close rightSource)
                closedSelections (some rightBinding.id)
              let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound program.worker context {}
                (← transaction.view) (selections := selections)
              let left ← transaction.stage (← environment.origin program occurrence leftRole)
                (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
              let right ← transaction.stage (← environment.origin program occurrence rightRole)
                (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
              unless left.value != right.value do
                throwError "the original equal-data endpoint control merged its two occurrences"
              withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context {} leftSource left
                  fun context bound firstSource =>
                withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound rightSource right
                    fun context bound secondSource => do
                  let parameters := #[firstSource, if sharedEndpoint then firstSource else secondSource]
                  let levels := family.universeParams.map (fun _ => Level.zero)
                  let selected ← family.selected kernel.ledger.owners.identities levels parameters
                  SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities selections context selected
                      fun context selections requested => do
                    checkWithKernel requested
                    let result : Except Exception ValueBinding ← try
                        pure (.ok (← kernel.run transaction context bound requested (selections := selections)))
                      catch error => pure (.error error)
                    let dispatches ← kernel.dispatches.get
                    unless dispatches.size == 1 && dispatches[0]!.operation == family.operation do
                      throwError "the raw cone did not reach its one original declared supplying operation"
                    let observed ← IO.FS.readFile ((← IO.currentDir) / ".tmp/raw-construction-observations.jsonl")
                    unless !observed.isEmpty do
                      throwError "the raw construction control failed before its actual framed reply"
                    if #["swapped", "missing", "opaque"].contains mode then
                      let .error failure := result
                        | throwError "an incomplete or wrong-original-endpoint cone was admitted"
                      let message ← failure.toMessageData.toString
                      unless (message.splitOn (if mode == "swapped" then "endpoint" else "port")).length > 1 do
                        throw failure
                    else
                      let result ← match result with
                        | .ok value => pure value
                        | .error failure => throw failure
                      let graph ← transaction.view
                      let some node := graph.find result.value
                        | throwError "the admitted raw cone has no original graph node"
                      let .container complete := node.payload.data
                        | throwError "the raw construction lost its complete original cone envelope"
                      unless complete.originalPacket.isSome && complete.fields.map (·.size) == some 2 do
                        throwError "the whole raw packet was not attached to its native Cone fields"
                      if mode.startsWith "wrapped" then
                        let some original := complete.originalPacket
                          | throwError "the wrapped cone lost its complete original packet"
                        unless (original.template.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "valueData" do
                          throwError "the complete cone discarded an original inline envelope"
                      withBindingContext graph context bound result fun context bound => do
                        let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections (← result.role.selections.inContext context)
                        withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound
                            (← result.selectedSource context) result fun context bound selected => do
                          let apexSource ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.pt #[selected]
                          let apex ← kernel.run transaction context bound apexSource (selections := selections)
                          let graph ← transaction.view
                          let some _ ← IO.ofExcept <|
                              (graph.projectionBasis apex result #[family.apexProjection]).mapError IO.userError
                            | throwError "the actual apex lost its original whole-cone projection parent"
                          let .ok apexOwners := graph.requiredOwners #[apex]
                            | throwError "the actual apex lost its original ownership information"
                          unless apexOwners.isEmpty do
                            throwError "the inline apex inherited an unrelated native leg owner"
                          let transformation ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone.π #[selected]
                          let component ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app #[transformation]
                          let indexSource ← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Discrete.mk
                            #[mkConst (if sharedEndpoint then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair.right
                              else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.WalkingPair.left)]
                          checkWithKernel indexSource
                          let index ← kernel.run transaction context bound indexSource (selections := selections)
                          withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound index fun context bound =>
                            withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound indexSource index
                                fun context bound retainedIndex => do
                              let leg ← kernel.run transaction context bound (mkApp component retainedIndex) (selections := selections)
                              let graph ← transaction.view
                              let some legNode := graph.find leg.value
                                | throwError "the original cone component has no retained graph node"
                              let .container descriptor := legNode.payload.data
                                | throwError "the original cone component lost its complete symbolic packet"
                              unless descriptor.callableData &&
                                  (descriptor.template.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "constructionLeg" do
                                throwError "the cone component did not retain its passive native map interface"
                              let some originalCone := descriptor.slots.find? (·.path == #[.field "args", .index 2])
                                | throwError "the leg lost its original whole-cone typed slot"
                              let some originalIndex := descriptor.slots.find? (·.path == #[.field "args", .index 3])
                                | throwError "the leg lost its exact typed diagram index"
                              unless originalCone.binding.value == result.value &&
                                  originalCone.binding.associationIds == result.associationIds &&
                                  originalIndex.binding.value == index.value &&
                                  originalIndex.binding.associationIds == index.associationIds do
                                throwError "the cone component replaced an original parent or native index"
                              let some legCompletion ← transaction.completionFor? legNode.origin.occurrence
                                | throwError "the original cone component lost its prepared source request"
                              let symbolic : PreparedSymbolicNode := {
                                source := leg.role
                                environment := legCompletion.request.environment
                                tag := "constructionLeg"
                                operands := #[]
                                action := some descriptor
                                framed := (.value apex, .value left)
                                inputActions := #[] }
                              let validate := preparedSymbolicCheck kernel legCompletion.request transaction
                              validate graph #[symbolic]
                              let wrongEndpoint ← try
                                  validate graph #[{ symbolic with framed := (.value apex, .value right) }]
                                  pure false
                                catch _ => pure true
                              unless wrongEndpoint do
                                throwError "a construction leg accepted another original framed endpoint"
                              let swapped := descriptor.slots.map fun slot =>
                                if slot.path == #[.field "args", .index 1, .field "args", .index 0] then
                                  { slot with binding := right }
                                else if slot.path == #[.field "args", .index 1, .field "args", .index 1] then
                                  { slot with binding := left }
                                else slot
                              let changed ← IO.ofExcept <|
                                (ValuePayload.descriptor descriptor.template swapped descriptor.exports).mapError IO.userError
                              let .container changed := changed.data
                                | throwError "the changed diagram control lost its complete native descriptor"
                              let rejected ← try
                                validate graph #[{ symbolic with action := some changed }]
                                pure false
                              catch _ => pure true
                              unless rejected do
                                throwError "a returned construction leg accepted another equal-data diagram occurrence"
                              unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).size == 1 do
                                throwError "the passive leg invented another call under the raw limit address"
                              if mode == "owned" || mode == "wrapped-owned" then
                                let .ok owners := graph.requiredOwners #[leg]
                                  | throwError "the returned leg lost its packet export owners"
                                unless !owners.isEmpty do
                                  throwError "an owned raw map became portable"
                                for owner in owners do kernel.ledger.owners.close owner
                                unless ← graph.isAvailable kernel.ledger.owners apex do
                                  throwError "closing a leg owner invalidated the independent portable apex"
                                if ← graph.isAvailable kernel.ledger.owners leg then
                                  throwError "a dependent construction leg survived its actual export owner"
                              else
                                let .ok owners := graph.requiredOwners #[leg]
                                  | throwError "the inline cone leg has an invalid owner closure"
                                unless owners.isEmpty do
                                  throwError "an entirely inline cone acquired a supplier owner"
        finally discard <| transaction.abort
  finally setEnv originalEnvironment

-- A direct source leg remains an inert named descriptor for declared consumers. Demanding
-- its stored native component plan completes the original Cone once, without executing a
-- finite graph. Repeated component selection reuses the exact owner and typed index; another
-- owner from the same retained source family receives a distinct completion.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  withConstructionPeer "inline" fun kernel => do
    let family ← LimitFamily.forId ⟨"lim.sets.product"⟩
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin kernel.ledger
    try
      let nativeSelection ← sourceNamedObjectAlias CategoryId.sets
        { value := mkApp (mkConst ``Fin) (mkNatLit 1) }
      let packet := Json.mkObj [("ctor", "finiteData"),
        ("args", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("ctor", "obj.sets.fin"),
          ("args", .arr #[toJson (1 : Nat)])], .arr #[toJson (0 : Nat)]])]
      let program ← kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .program
      let occurrence ← kernel.ledger.allocate
      SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities {} context nativeSelection
          fun context selections leftSource =>
        SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities selections context nativeSelection
            fun context selections rightSource => do
          let some leftBinding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression == leftSource)
            | throwError "the original left endpoint lost its typed source binding"
          let some rightBinding := context.bindings.find? (·.expression == rightSource)
            | throwError "the original right endpoint lost its typed source binding"
          let closedSelections ← selections.close context
          let leftRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close leftSource)
            closedSelections (some leftBinding.id)
          let rightRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close rightSource)
            closedSelections (some rightBinding.id)
          let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound program.worker context {}
            (← transaction.view) (selections := selections)
          let left ← transaction.stage (← environment.origin program occurrence leftRole)
            (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
          let right ← transaction.stage (← environment.origin program occurrence rightRole)
            (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
          withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context {} leftSource left
              fun context bound firstSource =>
            withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound rightSource right
                fun context bound secondSource => do
              let initial : SourceReadScope := { identities := kernel.ledger.owners.identities,
                context, selections }
              (sourceBinaryLimit { value := firstSource, category := none }
                { value := secondSource, category := none } false).runK initial fun original scope => do
                let context := scope.context
                let selections := scope.selections
                let demand : OpenContext → Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding →
                    SourceSelectionScope Expr → NativeSourceJudgement → ValueBinding →
                    TermElabM ValueBinding := fun context bound selections original owner => do
                  let before := (← kernel.dispatches.get).size
                  withBindingContext (← transaction.view) context bound owner fun context bound => do
                    let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections
                      (← owner.role.selections.inContext context)
                    withBoundValue kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound
                        (← owner.selectedSource context) owner fun context bound selectedOwner => do
                      let initial : SourceReadScope := {
                        identities := kernel.ledger.owners.identities, context, selections }
                      (sourceLimitLeg? { original with value := selectedOwner } 0).runK initial
                          fun legSource scope => do
                        let some legSource := legSource
                          | throwError "the original direct construction lost its source-selected leg"
                        let context := scope.context
                        let selections := scope.selections
                        let formal ← kernel.run transaction context bound legSource.value
                          (selections := selections)
                        unless (← kernel.dispatches.get).size == before do
                          throwError "formal leg formation dispatched its deferred construction"
                        let graph ← transaction.view
                        let some node := graph.find formal.value
                          | throwError "the formal leg lost its actual retained node"
                        let .closure code _ := node.payload.data
                          | throwError "the formal leg lost its delayed native continuation"
                        let some (.formalLeg source (some originalPacket) codeSelections) :=
                            (← kernel.codes.get)[code]?
                          | throwError "the formal direct leg lost its original packet and source plan"
                        let some view ← InputDescriptorView.namedPoint? graph (← kernel.codes.get) formal
                          | throwError "the formal leg lost its unchanged declared-consumer packet"
                        unless view.packet.template == originalPacket.template &&
                            (view.packet.template.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption ==
                              some "lim.sets.product#leg" && view.packet.slots.size == 3 do
                          throwError "the formal leg changed its original named descriptor or ordinal slot"
                        withBindingContext graph context bound formal fun context bound => do
                          let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections
                            (← formal.role.selections.inContext context)
                          let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections
                            (← codeSelections.inContext context)
                          let first ← kernel.run transaction context bound
                            (← source.inContext context) (selections := selections)
                          let second ← kernel.run transaction context bound
                            (← source.inContext context) (selections := selections)
                          let graph ← transaction.view
                          let component : ValueBinding → MetaM (ValueBinding × ValueBinding) :=
                              fun value => do
                            let some node := graph.find value.value
                              | throwError "the native component demand lost its actual map data"
                            let .container complete := node.payload.data
                              | throwError "the native component demand did not return its complete map packet"
                            unless complete.callableData &&
                                (complete.template.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption ==
                                  some "constructionLeg" do
                              throwError "the native component demand changed its complete original map data"
                            let some cone := complete.slots.find?
                                (·.path == #[.field "args", .index 2])
                              | throwError "the demanded component lost its original complete Cone"
                            let some index := complete.slots.find?
                                (·.path == #[.field "args", .index 3])
                              | throwError "the demanded component lost its original typed index"
                            return (cone.binding, index.binding)
                          let (firstCone, firstIndex) ← component first
                          let (secondCone, secondIndex) ← component second
                          unless firstCone.value == secondCone.value &&
                              firstCone.associationIds == secondCone.associationIds &&
                              firstIndex.value == secondIndex.value &&
                              firstIndex.associationIds == secondIndex.associationIds do
                            throwError "repeated native leg demand replaced its exact owner completion or typed index"
                          let some selectedConstruction := selections.findAt? context original.value.getAppFn
                            | throwError "the original source lost its exact construction selection"
                          let some selection := (← selectedConstruction.specialize original.value.getAppArgs).limit
                            | throwError "the original source lost its exact construction selection"
                          let .ok (some cached) ← transaction.selectedAt selection.source.construction
                              family.coneProjection owner
                            | throwError "the first native leg demand did not retain its exact owner's complete Cone"
                          unless cached.value == firstCone.value &&
                              cached.associationIds == firstCone.associationIds &&
                              (← kernel.dispatches.get).size == before + 1 do
                            throwError "the exact original owner did not reuse its single completed Cone"
                          return firstCone
                let owner ← kernel.run transaction context bound original.value
                  (selections := selections)
                let firstCone ← demand context bound selections original owner
                let some selectedConstruction := selections.findAt? context original.value.getAppFn
                  | throwError "the original construction lost its retained positional source family"
                let some originalSelection := (← selectedConstruction.specialize original.value.getAppArgs).limit
                  | throwError "the original construction lost its retained positional source family"
                let some ownerSource := originalSelection.source.ownerFamily
                  | throwError "the original construction lost its complete owner template"
                let ownerTemplate ← SelectedLimitOwner.ofBinding context selections ownerSource
                let some retained := selections.findAt? context original.value
                  | throwError "the rebound construction lost its original selection"
                let some family := retained.limitFamily
                  | throwError "the rebound construction lost its complete selected limit family"
                let some rebound ← LimitFamily.formalAt family context originalSelection ownerTemplate
                    #[secondSource, firstSource]
                  | throwError "the original construction lost its retained positional source family"
                let category : NativeSourceCategory := {
                  role := .object, expression := rebound.source.category,
                  bundle := rebound.source.bundle, limit := some rebound.source }
                let changed : SourceSelection Expr := {
                  retained with value := rebound.receiver, limit := some rebound,
                    originalApplication := some rebound.source.presentation, category := some category }
                SourceSelectionScope.withBinding kernel.ledger.owners.identities selections context changed
                    fun context selections rebound => do
                  let changed : NativeSourceJudgement := { value := rebound, category := some category }
                  let anotherOwner ← kernel.run transaction context bound rebound (selections := selections)
                  unless owner.value != anotherOwner.value do
                    throwError "independent equal source receivers merged their original occurrences"
                  let secondCone ← demand context bound selections changed anotherOwner
                  unless firstCone.value != secondCone.value && (← kernel.dispatches.get).size == 2 do
                    throwError "one compiled construction reused another receiver's actual completed Cone"
    finally discard <| transaction.abort

end CasRuntime.RawLimitInvocationTests

module

public import LeanCategories.Catalogue.Registry.Computation
public import CasCompiler.Program
public import CasContract.Registration
public import CasContract.Failure
public import CasRuntime.GroundedRealizations
public import CasTools.Diagnostics
import CasRuntime.ManifestAdmission
import CasContract.Port

@[expose] public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCatalogue CasCompiler

private inductive Selection (α : Type)
  | all
  | only (entries : Array α)

private def Selection.contains [DecidableEq α] : Selection α → α → Bool
  | .all, _ => true
  | .only entries, entry => entries.contains entry

/-- The source-owned family whose computational availability a runtime profile filters.
The additional families keep their existing registry identities and primitive ports; they do
not extend ComputationRef or publish mathematical derivations. -/
inductive ProfileTarget
  | computation (reference : ComputationRef)
  | lift (id : LiftId)
  | presentation (id : NaturalTransformationId)
  | property (id : PropertyId)
  | application (id : ObjectId)
  | limit (id : LimitId)
  | component (id : NaturalTransformationId)
  | cartesian (id : FunctorId)
  | binder (id : BinderId)
  | edge (address : String)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

private structure ProfileRule where
  target : ProfileTarget
  primitives : Selection Registration
  derivations : Selection ComputationDerivationId

/-- Kernel-owned immutable availability sets, fixed before any invocation.
Source: execution contract v2 §5.3, issue 69 comment 6664277464.
The source registry fixes meanings; these sets only filter computational alternatives. -/
structure RealizationProfile where
  private mk ::
  id : String
  normalized : Json
  sha256 : String
  private rules : Array ProfileRule

private def fields (names : Array String) (json : Json) : Except String Unit :=
  CasCatalogue.Backend.checkServiceFields names json |>.mapError ("realization profile: " ++ ·)

private def text (json : Json) (key : String) : Except String String := do
  let value ← json.getObjValAs? String key
  if value.isEmpty then throw s!"realization profile: {key} must be nonempty"
  return value

private def targetJson : ProfileTarget → Json
  | .computation (.operation id) => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "operation"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .computation (.functor id) => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "functor"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .computation (.method id) => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "method"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .computation (.construction id) => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "construction"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .computation (.morphism id) => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "morphism"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .lift id => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "lift"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .presentation id => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "presentation"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .property id => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "property"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .application id => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "application"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .limit id => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "limit"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .component id => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "component"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .cartesian id => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "cartesian"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .binder id => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "binder"), ("id", toJson id.raw)]
  | .edge address => Json.mkObj [("kind", toJson "edge"), ("id", toJson address)]

private def parseTarget (json : Json) : Except String ProfileTarget := do
  fields #["kind", "id"] json
  let id ← text json "id"
  match ← text json "kind" with
  | "operation" => return .computation (.operation ⟨id⟩)
  | "functor" => return .computation (.functor ⟨id⟩)
  | "method" => return .computation (.method ⟨id⟩)
  | "construction" => return .computation (.construction ⟨id⟩)
  | "morphism" => return .computation (.morphism ⟨id⟩)
  | "lift" => return .lift ⟨id⟩
  | "presentation" => return .presentation ⟨id⟩
  | "property" => return .property ⟨id⟩
  | "application" => return .application ⟨id⟩
  | "limit" => return .limit ⟨id⟩
  | "component" => return .component ⟨id⟩
  | "cartesian" => return .cartesian ⟨id⟩
  | "binder" => return .binder ⟨id⟩
  | "edge" => return .edge id
  | _ => throw "realization profile: unknown availability target kind"

/-- A registration's record: its triple, and its declared preferred routes when it has any
(contract api/manifest.md). -/
private def registrationJson (registration : Registration) : Json :=
  let triple := [("operation", toJson registration.operation),
    ("input", toJson registration.input), ("backend", toJson registration.backend)]
  if registration.preferredRoutes.isEmpty then Json.mkObj triple
  else Json.mkObj (triple ++ [("preferredRoutes", .arr (registration.preferredRoutes.map fun route =>
    Json.mkObj [("name", toJson route.name), ("receiver", toJson route.receiver),
      ("route", toJson route.route)]))])

private def parseRegistration (json : Json) : Except String Registration := do
  let preferredRoutes ← match json.getObjVal? "preferredRoutes" with
    | .error _ => do fields #["operation", "input", "backend"] json; pure #[]
    | .ok _ => do
      fields #["operation", "input", "backend", "preferredRoutes"] json
      (← Manifest.arrayField json "preferredRoutes").mapM Manifest.preferredRouteOf
        |>.mapError ("realization profile: " ++ ·)
  let operation ← text json "operation"
  let input ← text json "input"
  let backend ← text json "backend"
  return { operation, input, backend, preferredRoutes }

private def selection [DecidableEq α] (key : String) (parse : Json → Except String α)
    (json : Json) : Except String (Selection α) := do
  match ← text json "mode" with
  | "all" =>
    fields #["mode"] json
    return .all
  | "only" =>
    fields #["mode", key] json
    let values ← (← json.getObjValAs? (Array Json) key).mapM parse
    let mut seen := #[]
    for value in values do
      if seen.contains value then throw "realization profile: duplicate selection entry"
      seen := seen.push value
    return .only values
  | _ => throw "realization profile: selection mode must be all or only"

private def selectionJson (key : String) (encode : α → Json) : Selection α → Json
  | .all => Json.mkObj [("mode", toJson "all")]
  | .only entries => Json.mkObj [("mode", toJson "only"),
      (key, Json.arr ((entries.map encode).qsort fun a b => a.compress < b.compress))]

private def parseRule (json : Json) : Except String ProfileRule := do
  fields #["target", "primitive_registrations", "derivations"] json
  let target ← parseTarget (← json.getObjVal? "target")
  let primitives ← selection "entries" parseRegistration (← json.getObjVal? "primitive_registrations")
  let derivations ← selection "ids" (fun json => do
    let id ← json.getStr?
    if id.isEmpty then throw "realization profile: a derivation ID must be nonempty"
    pure (⟨id⟩ : ComputationDerivationId)) (← json.getObjVal? "derivations")
  return ⟨target, primitives, derivations⟩

private def parseProfile (json : Json) : Except String (String × Array ProfileRule) := do
  fields #["format", "id", "default", "rules"] json
  unless (← text json "format") == "cas-realization-profile/1" do
    throw "realization profile: unsupported format"
  unless (← text json "default") == "all" do
    throw "realization profile: default must be all"
  let id ← text json "id"
  let rules ← (← json.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "rules").mapM parseRule
  let mut seen := #[]
  for rule in rules do
    if seen.contains rule.target then throw "realization profile: duplicate target"
    seen := seen.push rule.target
  return (id, rules.qsort fun a b => (targetJson a.target).compress < (targetJson b.target).compress)

private def normalizedProfile (id : String) (rules : Array ProfileRule) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("format", toJson "cas-realization-profile/1"), ("id", toJson id),
    ("default", toJson "all"), ("rules", Json.arr (rules.map fun rule => Json.mkObj [
      ("target", targetJson rule.target),
      ("primitive_registrations", selectionJson "entries" registrationJson rule.primitives),
      ("derivations", selectionJson "ids" (toJson ∘ ComputationDerivationId.raw) rule.derivations)]))]

/-- SHA-256 of immutable configuration text.
Reuse: GNU Coreutils sha256sum through Lean's IO.Process.output stdin API;
https://www.gnu.org/software/coreutils/manual/html_node/sha2-utilities.html. -/
def sha256Hex (text : String) : IO String := do
  let hashed ← IO.Process.output { cmd := "sha256sum", args := #["-"] } (some text)
  unless hashed.exitCode == 0 do throw <| IO.userError s!"SHA-256 failed: {hashed.stderr}"
  let digest := (hashed.stdout.splitOn " ").head!
  unless digest.length == 64 && digest.toList.all (fun c =>
      c.isDigit || ('a' ≤ c && c ≤ 'f')) do
    throw <| IO.userError "SHA-256 returned an invalid digest"
  return digest

/-- Check the original published address through the same grammar as manifest and child-call
admission. In particular, lift ports retain their exact published field component. -/
opaque ProfileTarget.containsAddress (target : ProfileTarget) (state : SemanticState)
    (address : String) : MetaM Bool := do
  match target with
  | .computation reference => return (← publishedFamily? state address) == some reference
  | .lift id => return (← publishedLift? state address).any (·.1.id == id) ||
      (← publishedCreation? state address).any (·.entry.id == id)
  | .presentation id => return (publishedPresentation? state address).any (·.id == id)
  | .property id => return (publishedProperty? state address).any (·.id == id)
  | .application id => return !applicationAddressConflict state address &&
      (publishedApplication? state address).any (·.id == id)
  | .limit id =>
    if address == id.raw then return state.limits.any (·.id == id)
    return (← publishedLimitUniversal? state address).any (·.presentation.entry.id == id)
  | .component id =>
    return ((PublishedPorts.component? state address).toOption.bind (fun value => value)).any
      (·.1.id == id)
  | .cartesian id =>
    return ((PublishedPorts.cartesian? state address).toOption.bind (fun value => value)).any
      (·.id == id)
  | .binder id => return address == id.raw && state.binders.any (·.id == id)
  | .edge original =>
    let .ok (some (selected, false)) := PublishedPorts.edge? state original | return false
    return ((PublishedPorts.edge? state address).toOption.bind id).any (·.1 == selected)

/-- Validate exact published targets, installed triples and checked target-specific derivations.
Normalize set order once and retain the SHA-256 of that immutable configuration.
Reuse: ComputationRef.declaration, checkedComputationDerivations, the released registration
schema, the strict field checker and sha256Hex. -/
opaque RealizationProfile.prepare (manifest : Manifest) (configuration : Option Json) :
    MetaM RealizationProfile := do
  let (id, rules) ← match configuration with
    | none => pure ("all", #[])
    | some json => IO.ofExcept (parseProfile json)
  let state ← semanticState
  for rule in rules do
    match rule.target with
    | .computation reference => discard <| reference.declaration state
    | .lift id =>
      let some row := state.lifts.find? (·.id == id)
        | throwError "realization profile: unregistered callable lift {id.raw}"
      if let .createsLimits _ := row.kind then
        if (← PublishedPorts.forCreation id).isEmpty then
          throwError "realization profile: unregistered callable creation {id.raw}"
      else
        if row.computation.isNone then
          throwError "realization profile: unregistered callable lift {id.raw}"
        let family ← CasCompiler.LiftFamily.forLift row .computation
        if (← family.projections).isEmpty then
          throwError "realization profile: unregistered callable lift {id.raw}"
    | .presentation id =>
      unless (publishedPresentation? state id.raw).isSome do
        throwError "realization profile: unregistered presentation {id.raw}"
    | .property id =>
      unless (publishedProperty? state id.raw).isSome do
        throwError "realization profile: unregistered property {id.raw}"
    | .application id =>
      unless (publishedApplication? state s!"{id.raw}#application").isSome do
        throwError "realization profile: unregistered object application {id.raw}"
      if applicationAddressConflict state s!"{id.raw}#application" then
        throwError "realization profile: the application address also names another registered row"
    | .limit id =>
      unless state.limits.any (·.id == id) do
        throwError "realization profile: unregistered universal construction {id.raw}"
    | .component id =>
      unless ((PublishedPorts.component? state
          (PublishedPorts.componentAddress id #[])).toOption.bind (fun value => value)).isSome do
        throwError "realization profile: unregistered component {id.raw}"
    | .cartesian id =>
      unless ((PublishedPorts.cartesian? state s!"{id.raw}#cartesian").toOption.bind
          (fun value => value)).isSome do
        throwError "realization profile: unregistered cartesian action {id.raw}"
    | .binder id =>
      unless state.binders.any (·.id == id) do
        throwError "realization profile: unregistered binder {id.raw}"
    | .edge address =>
      let .ok (some (_, false)) := PublishedPorts.edge? state address
        | throwError "realization profile: unregistered canonical action family {address}"
    if let .only entries := rule.primitives then
      for entry in entries do
        unless manifest.registrations.contains entry do
          throwError "realization profile: unknown primitive registration {repr entry}"
        unless ← rule.target.containsAddress state entry.operation do
          throwError "realization profile: wrong-target primitive registration {repr entry}"
    if let .only ids := rule.derivations then
      let checked ← match rule.target with
        | .computation reference => checkedComputationDerivations reference
        | _ => pure #[]
      for id in ids do
        unless checked.any (·.entry.id == id) do
          throwError "realization profile: unknown or wrong-target derivation {id.raw}"
  let normalized := normalizedProfile id rules
  return ⟨id, normalized, ← sha256Hex normalized.compress, rules⟩

/-- Apply the frozen primitive set for this exact source target; unlisted targets allow all. -/
opaque RealizationProfile.allowsRegistration (profile : RealizationProfile)
    (target : ProfileTarget) (registration : Registration) : Bool :=
  match profile.rules.find? (·.target == target) with
  | none => true
  | some rule => rule.primitives.contains registration

/-- Existing computation families retain the same profile selection interface. -/
opaque RealizationProfile.allowsPrimitive (profile : RealizationProfile)
    (target : ComputationRef) (registration : Registration) : Bool :=
  profile.allowsRegistration (.computation target) registration

/-- Apply the frozen derivation set without changing the checked mathematical plan. -/
opaque RealizationProfile.allowsDerivation (profile : RealizationProfile)
    (entry : ComputationDerivationEntry) : Bool :=
  match profile.rules.find? (·.target == .computation entry.target) with
  | none => true
  | some rule => rule.derivations.contains entry.id

def referenceId : ComputationRef → String
  | .operation id => id.raw
  | .functor id => id.raw
  | .method id => id.raw
  | .construction id => id.raw
  | .morphism id => id.raw

/-- Select only among exact registrations at all source boundaries of an interface with no
published derivation family. Repeated occurrences at different boundaries remain distinct. -/
def selectRegistrationBoundary (profile : RealizationProfile) (manifest : Manifest)
    (target : ProfileTarget) (address : String) (boundaries : Array (Array String)) :
    MetaM (Nat × Registration) := do
  if boundaries.isEmpty then throwError "registration selection requires a source boundary"
  let eligible := (boundaries.mapIdx fun index forms =>
    (manifest.registrations.filter fun registration =>
      registration.operation == address && forms.contains registration.input &&
        manifest.backends.any (·.name == registration.backend) &&
        profile.allowsRegistration target registration).map (index, ·)).flatten
  let forms := boundaries.flatten
  match eligible with
  | #[registration] =>
    CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "realization.selected" <| Json.mkObj [
      ("operation", toJson address), ("boundary", toJson registration.1),
      ("input", toJson registration.2.input), ("backend", toJson registration.2.backend)]
    return registration
  | #[] =>
    CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "realization.missing" <| Json.mkObj [
      ("operation", toJson address), ("forms", toJson forms),
      ("kind", toJson "no_implementation")]
    throwStratum .noImplementation m!"{address} on {forms}"
  | _ =>
    CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "realization.ambiguous" <| Json.mkObj [
      ("operation", toJson address), ("forms", toJson forms),
      ("candidates", toJson eligible.size)]
    throwStratum .ambiguousRealization m!"{address} on {forms}"

/-- A lift-port or presentation has one complete input boundary and no derivation family. -/
def selectLift (profile : RealizationProfile) (manifest : Manifest)
    (target : ProfileTarget) (address : String) (forms : Array String) : MetaM Registration := do
  return (← selectRegistrationBoundary profile manifest target address #[forms]).2

inductive Realization
  | registration (selected : Registration)
  | derivation (checked : SourceProgram)

/-- Select the realization of one exact demand by the saturated grounded count.
Source: execution contract v2 §5.1 and §5.2. The root alternatives are the eligible
registrations and the profile's checked derivations. A prerequisite is a delayed demand: an
installed registration or a grounded derivation makes it present, and its own realization is
selected when its actual arguments exist. Zero and many dispatch nothing.
Reuse: RealizationGraph.grounded and GroundedRealizations.uniqueAlternative. -/
private def selectBoundaries (profile : RealizationProfile) (manifest : Manifest)
    (reference : ComputationRef) (address : String) (boundaries : Array (Array String)) :
    MetaM (Nat × Realization) := do
  if boundaries.isEmpty then throwError "realization selection requires a complete source boundary"
  let eligible := (boundaries.mapIdx fun index forms =>
    (manifest.registrations.filter fun registration =>
      registration.operation == address && forms.contains registration.input &&
        manifest.backends.any (·.name == registration.backend) &&
        profile.allowsPrimitive reference registration).map (index, ·)).flatten
  let forms := boundaries.flatten
  let mut nodes : Array ComputationRef := #[reference]
  let mut derivations : Array (Array SourceProgram) := #[]
  let mut next := 0
  while next < nodes.size do
    let some node := nodes[next]? | break
    let checked := (← SourceProgram.forTarget node).filter fun derivation =>
      profile.allowsDerivation derivation.source.entry
    for derivation in checked do
      for prerequisite in derivation.source.prerequisites do
        unless nodes.contains prerequisite.reference do nodes := nodes.push prerequisite.reference
    derivations := derivations.push checked
    next := next + 1
  let size := nodes.size
  let present := fun (node : ComputationRef) =>
    manifest.registrations.any fun registration =>
      (registration.operation == referenceId node ||
        registration.operation.startsWith s!"{referenceId node}#") &&
        profile.allowsPrimitive node registration
  let rows : Array (Array (Array Nat)) := nodes.mapIdx fun index node =>
    let primitive : Array (Array Nat) :=
      if index == 0 then eligible.map fun _ => #[]
      else if present node then #[#[]] else #[]
    primitive ++ (derivations[index]?.getD #[]).map fun derivation =>
      derivation.source.prerequisites.filterMap fun prerequisite =>
        nodes.findIdx? (· == prerequisite.reference)
  let graph : RealizationGraph size := ⟨Vector.ofFn fun node =>
    (rows[node.val]?.getD #[]).map fun children =>
      children.filterMap fun child => if bound : child < size then some ⟨child, bound⟩ else none⟩
  let some grounded := graph.grounded
    | throwError "internal: the realization grounding did not stabilize"
  if root : 0 < size then
    match ← IO.ofExcept <| (grounded.uniqueAlternative ⟨0, root⟩).mapError IO.userError with
    | some alternative =>
      if let some (boundary, registration) := eligible[alternative]? then
        CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "realization.selected" <| Json.mkObj [
          ("operation", toJson address), ("boundary", toJson boundary),
          ("input", toJson registration.input), ("backend", toJson registration.backend)]
        return (boundary, .registration registration)
      let some derivation := (derivations[0]?.getD #[])[alternative - eligible.size]?
        | throwError "internal: the selected realization is outside its alternatives"
      CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "realization.derivation" <| Json.mkObj [
        ("operation", toJson address), ("derivation", toJson derivation.source.entry.id.raw)]
      return (boundaries.size - 1, .derivation derivation)
    | none =>
      if grounded.counts[(⟨0, root⟩ : Fin size)] == .zero then
        CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "realization.missing" <| Json.mkObj [
          ("operation", toJson address), ("forms", toJson forms),
          ("kind", toJson "no_implementation")]
        throwStratum .noImplementation m!"{address} on {forms}"
      CasTools.Diagnostics.emit "realization.ambiguous" <| Json.mkObj [
        ("operation", toJson address), ("forms", toJson forms)]
      throwStratum .ambiguousRealization m!"{address} on {forms}"
  else throwError "internal: the realization graph has no root demand"


/-- One exact native demand uses the same saturated grounded selection as routed methods. -/
opaque RealizationProfile.select (profile : RealizationProfile) (manifest : Manifest)
    (reference : ComputationRef) (address : String) (forms : Array String) : MetaM Realization := do
  return (← selectBoundaries profile manifest reference address #[forms]).2

/-- Count every admitted registration at every exact route boundary before executing a prefix.
Two occurrences of one registration at different boundaries are distinct alternatives; a source
or category-wide row has no priority. A checked derivation belongs to the owner boundary.
Reuse: the same grounded realization graph and frozen profile as ordinary source demands. -/
opaque RealizationProfile.selectMethod (profile : RealizationProfile) (manifest : Manifest)
    (method : MethodId) (boundaries : Array (Array String)) : MetaM (Nat × Realization) :=
  selectBoundaries profile manifest (.method method) method.raw boundaries

end CasRuntime

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do

  rejected manifest (configuration #[rule (target "method" "meth.cardinality")

  rejected manifest (configuration #[rule (target "method" "meth.cardinality") all

  rejected manifest (configuration #[rule (target "operation" "op.rings.mul") all

-- New categorical boundaries use the same frozen exact-registration sets. Their
-- registry owners and canonical addresses cannot be replaced by similar prefixes,
-- another component, or the map port in place of its complete action family.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let path : System.FilePath := (← IO.getEnv "CAS_LEAVES").getD ".lake/packages/cas_leaves"
  let path := if path.extension == some "json" then path else path / manifestFile
  let .ok original ← Manifest.read path | throwError "the original manifest is unreadable"
  let some backend := original.backends[0]? | throwError "the original backend inventory is empty"
  let state ← semanticState
  let some binder := state.binders[0]? | throwError "the accepted binder inventory is empty"
  let some limit := state.limits.find? (·.id.raw == "lim.sets.product")
    | throwError "the original product presentation is absent"
  let cell := NaturalTransformationId.listReverse
  let component := CasCompiler.PublishedPorts.componentAddress cell #[]
  let constructed := CasCompiler.PublishedPorts.componentAddress cell #[ConstructorId.arrow]
  let cartesian := FunctorId.modulesReindex.raw ++ "#cartesian"
  let edge : EdgeRef := .constructMap ConstructorId.arrow
    (.constructMap ConstructorId.arrow (.functor FunctorId.setsList))
  let action := "action:" ++ (CasCatalogue.edgeImageDescriptor edge).compress
  let cases : Array (String × String × ProfileTarget × Array String) := #[
    ("limit", limit.id.raw, .limit limit.id, #[limit.id.raw]),
    ("component", cell.raw, .component cell, #[component, constructed]),
    ("cartesian", FunctorId.modulesReindex.raw, .cartesian FunctorId.modulesReindex,
      #[cartesian]),
    ("binder", binder.id.raw, .binder binder.id, #[binder.id.raw]),
    ("edge", action, .edge action, #[action, action ++ "#map"])]
  for (kind, id, owner, addresses) in cases do
    let entries := addresses.map fun operation =>
      ({ operation, input := operation, backend := backend.name } : Registration)
    let manifest := { original with registrations := entries }
    let selected := rule (target kind id) (only "entries" #[registrationJson entries[0]!])
      (only "ids" #[])
    let profile ← RealizationProfile.prepare manifest (some (configuration #[selected]))
    unless profile.normalized == configuration #[selected] &&
        profile.allowsRegistration owner entries[0]! do
      throwError "a categorical profile changed its exact canonical target or selected registration"
    for entry in entries.extract 1 entries.size do
      unless !profile.allowsRegistration owner entry do
        throwError "an unselected categorical primitive remained available"
    for address in addresses do
      unless ← owner.containsAddress state address do
        throwError "a categorical profile rejected an original published family port"
      if ← owner.containsAddress state (address ++ ".unpublished") then
        throwError "a categorical profile accepted an unpublished address suffix"
    rejected manifest (configuration #[rule (target kind (id ++ ".unregistered")) all all])
    rejected manifest (configuration #[rule (target kind id) all
      (only "ids" #[toJson "derive.rings.mul.monoid"])])
  let direct : Registration := { operation := component, input := component, backend := backend.name }
  for suffix in #["#leg", "#apex", "#map"] do
    if ← (ProfileTarget.limit limit.id).containsAddress state (limit.id.raw ++ suffix) then
      throwError "a raw limit profile invented a published projection or application port"
  let otherComponent :=
    CasCompiler.PublishedPorts.componentAddress NaturalTransformationId.listUnit #[]
  let different : Registration := { direct with operation := otherComponent }
  let manifest := { original with registrations := #[direct, different] }
  rejected manifest (configuration #[rule (target "component" cell.raw)
    (only "entries" #[registrationJson different]) all])
  rejected manifest (configuration #[rule (target "edge" (action ++ "#map")) all all])
  rejected manifest (configuration #[rule (target "edge"
    ("action:" ++ (CasCatalogue.edgeImageDescriptor (.functor FunctorId.setsList)).compress)) all all])


-- Universal records have their exact original presentation owner but a distinct
-- complete input. A creation publishes one whole result under its original lift.
-- Neither path manufactures raw #leg/#apex aliases or creation field registrations.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let path : System.FilePath := (← IO.getEnv "CAS_LEAVES").getD ".lake/packages/cas_leaves"
  let path := if path.extension == some "json" then path else path / manifestFile
  let .ok original ← Manifest.read path | throwError "the original manifest is unreadable"
  let some backend := original.backends[0]? | throwError "the original backend inventory is empty"
  let state ← semanticState
  for identifier in #["lim.sets.product", "colim.sets.coproduct"] do
    let family ← CasCompiler.LimitUniversalFamily.forId ⟨identifier⟩
    let owner := ProfileTarget.limit family.presentation.entry.id
    let universal : Registration := {
      operation := family.operation, input := family.input, backend := backend.name }
    let raw : Registration := {
      operation := identifier, input := identifier, backend := backend.name }
    let manifest := { original with registrations := #[raw, universal] }
    let (admitted, defects) ← admitManifest manifest
    unless defects.isEmpty && admitted.registrations == manifest.registrations do
      throwError "a declared native universal family was rejected at manifest admission"
    let selected := rule (target "limit" identifier)
      (only "entries" #[registrationJson universal]) (only "ids" #[])
    let frozen ← RealizationProfile.prepare manifest (some (configuration #[selected]))
    unless frozen.normalized == configuration #[selected] &&
        frozen.allowsRegistration owner universal &&
        !frozen.allowsRegistration owner raw &&
        (← owner.containsAddress state family.operation) do
      throwError "universal availability failed to retain its original owner or exact selection"
    for input in #[identifier, identifier ++ "#input", family.operation, "cat.sets"] do
      let invalid := { universal with input }
      let (installed, rejectedRows) ← admitManifest { manifest with registrations := #[invalid] }
      unless installed.registrations.isEmpty && rejectedRows.size == 1 do
        throwError "a universal registration accepted a substituted complete input"
    for suffix in #["#leg", "#apex", "#map", "#isLimit#leg", "#isColimit#apex"] do
      let address := identifier ++ suffix
      if ← owner.containsAddress state address then
        throwError "a limit profile invented an unpublished universal or raw projection"
      if ← publishedOperation state address then
        throwError "manifest operation admission invented a raw limit alias"
    let wrongOwner := if identifier == "lim.sets.product" then
      "colim.sets.coproduct" else "lim.sets.product"
    rejected manifest (configuration #[rule (target "limit" wrongOwner)
      (only "entries" #[registrationJson universal]) all])
  let identifier := "lift.finite_sets.pullbacks"
  let owner := ProfileTarget.lift ⟨identifier⟩
  let creation : Registration := {
    operation := identifier, input := identifier ++ "#input", backend := backend.name }
  let manifest := { original with registrations := #[creation] }
  let (admitted, defects) ← admitManifest manifest
  unless defects.isEmpty && admitted.registrations == #[creation] do
    throwError "the existing creates-limits family has no complete public input"
  let selected := rule (target "lift" identifier)
    (only "entries" #[registrationJson creation]) (only "ids" #[])
  let frozen ← RealizationProfile.prepare manifest (some (configuration #[selected]))
  unless frozen.normalized == configuration #[selected] &&
      frozen.allowsRegistration owner creation &&
      (← owner.containsAddress state identifier) do
    throwError "creation availability changed its original registered lift owner"
  let ports ← CasCompiler.PublishedPorts.forCreation ⟨identifier⟩
  unless ports.size == 1 && ports.all (fun port =>
      port.operation == identifier && port.path.isEmpty) do
    throwError "creation publication advertised independently selected partial results"
  for suffix in #["#liftedCone", "#validLift", "#makesLimit", "#leg", "#apex", "#map"] do
    let invalid := { creation with operation := identifier ++ suffix }
    let (installed, rejectedRows) ← admitManifest { manifest with registrations := #[invalid] }
    unless installed.registrations.isEmpty && rejectedRows.size == 1 &&
        !(← owner.containsAddress state invalid.operation) do
      throwError "creation admission accepted an independently registered result field"
  for input in #[identifier, "cat.finite_sets", "lim.sets.pullback#input"] do
    let (installed, rejectedRows) ← admitManifest
      { manifest with registrations := #[{ creation with input }] }
    unless installed.registrations.isEmpty && rejectedRows.size == 1 do
      throwError "creation admission accepted a substituted native input"
  rejected manifest (configuration #[rule (target "limit" "lim.sets.pullback")
    (only "entries" #[registrationJson creation]) all])
  rejected manifest (configuration #[rule (target "lift" identifier) all
    (only "ids" #[toJson "derive.rings.mul.monoid"])])

import CasRuntime.Value
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Value

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasRuntime

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let family ← withLocalDeclD `n (mkConst ``Nat) fun n =>
    mkLambdaFVars #[n] (mkApp (mkConst ``Fin) (mkApp2 (mkConst ``Nat.add) n (mkNatLit 1)))
  let point := mkApp (mkConst ``Fin.last) (mkNatLit 5)
  let source ← mkAppOptM ``Sigma.mk #[some (mkConst ``Nat), some family,
    some (mkNatLit 5), some point]
  let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close source)
  let recordLayout ← RecordLayout.ofSource layout
  let pointLayout ← RecordLayout.ofSource (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close point))
  let scalarLayout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 8))
  let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 8, mkNatLit 8]
  let pairLayout ← RecordLayout.ofSource (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close pair))
  let proofFamily ← withLocalDeclD `h (mkConst ``True) fun h =>
    mkLambdaFVars #[h] (mkConst ``Nat) (usedOnly := false)
  let proofFirst ← mkAppOptM ``PSigma.mk #[some (mkConst ``True), some proofFamily,
    some (mkConst ``True.intro), some (mkNatLit 8)]
  let proofLayout ← RecordLayout.ofSource (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close proofFirst))
  liftM (m := IO) do
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let supply := owners.identities
    let program ← supply.fresh .program
    let occurrence ← supply.fresh .occurrence
    let origin : ValueOrigin := { program, occurrence, role := layout, parameters := #[] }
    let child ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      child.child.stdin.putStr "actual width\n"
      child.child.stdin.flush
      let token := (← child.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
      let empty := ValueGraph.empty supply
      let (graph, number) ← empty.stage supply { origin with role := scalarLayout }
        (.portable "8".toUTF8)
      let finite ← RecordPrefix.begin supply program occurrence pointLayout
      let (registered, finite, numeral) ← finite.bind graph number
      match graph.requiredOwners #[numeral] with
      | .error _ => pure ()
      | .ok _ =>
        throw <| IO.userError "an older graph recovered a later field association over an existing node"
      unless numeral.value == number.value && !registered.sameRevision graph do
        throw <| IO.userError "a field association changed its node or retained the old revision"
      discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (registered.requiredOwners #[numeral]).mapError IO.userError
      let finitePayload ← IO.ofExcept <| finite.finish.mapError IO.userError
      let (withoutWidth, finiteRoot) ← registered.stage supply
        { origin with role := pointLayout.source } finitePayload
      let (graph, width) ← withoutWidth.stage supply { origin with role := scalarLayout }
        (.ownedExport child token #[])
      let record ← RecordPrefix.begin supply program occurrence recordLayout
      match record.finish with
      | .error _ => pure ()
      | .ok _ => throw <| IO.userError "an incomplete dependent record became a complete payload"
      let (graph, record, first) ← record.bind graph width
      let (graph, record, second) ← record.bind graph finiteRoot
      let payload ← IO.ofExcept <| record.finish.mapError IO.userError
      let (graph, root) ← graph.stage supply origin payload
      let selected ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.project root 1).mapError IO.userError
      unless selected.value == finiteRoot.value && first.value == width.value do
        throw <| IO.userError "record binding or projection replaced an actual node"
      let some association := second.instantiations.back?
        | throw <| IO.userError "the dependent field lost its runtime instantiation"
      unless association.field.sourceIndex == 1 &&
          association.field.precedingDependencies == #[0] &&
          association.preceding.size == 1 &&
          (association.preceding[0]?.bind id).map (·.value) == some width.value &&
          association.id.worker == supply.worker do
        throw <| IO.userError "the dependent field uses a reconstructed or incomplete prefix"
      let some erased := numeral.instantiations.back?
        | throw <| IO.userError "the finite record lost its field instantiation"
      unless erased.field.sourceIndex == 0 && erased.preceding.isEmpty do
        throw <| IO.userError "proof erasure changed computational field positions"
      let proofRecord ← RecordPrefix.begin supply program occurrence proofLayout
      let (graph, proofRecord, dataField) ← proofRecord.bind graph number
      discard <| IO.ofExcept <| proofRecord.finish.mapError IO.userError
      let some proofContext := dataField.instantiations.back?
        | throw <| IO.userError "the data field after a proof lost its instantiation"
      unless proofContext.field.sourceIndex == 1 && proofContext.preceding.size == 1 &&
          proofContext.preceding[0]?.map (·.isNone) == some true do
        throw <| IO.userError
          "an erased proof displaced a later data field's formal source position"
      let again ← RecordPrefix.begin supply program occurrence recordLayout
      let (graph, again, _) ← again.bind graph width
      let (graph, again, reused) ← again.bind graph second
      let againPayload ← IO.ofExcept <| again.finish.mapError IO.userError
      let (graph, againRoot) ← graph.stage supply origin againPayload
      let projectedAgain ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.project againRoot 1).mapError IO.userError
      let some reusedAssociation := reused.instantiations.back?
        | throw <| IO.userError "the reused field lost its new consuming association"
      unless reused.value == second.value && projectedAgain.value == second.value &&
          projectedAgain.instantiations.size == reused.instantiations.size &&
          reused.instantiations.size > second.instantiations.size &&
          againRoot.value != root.value &&
          reusedAssociation.id != association.id &&
          reusedAssociation.association.id != association.association.id do
        throw <| IO.userError "reuse merged two record associations or discarded earlier provenance"
      let some original := graph.find second.value
        | throw <| IO.userError "the original producing node is missing"
      unless original.origin.occurrence == occurrence && original.origin.program == program do
        throw <| IO.userError "consuming record roles rewrote producing provenance"
      match withoutWidth.requiredOwners #[second] with
      | .error _ => pure ()
      | .ok _ => throw <| IO.userError "an older graph recovered a field's absent actual prefix"
      let .ok dependencies := graph.requiredOwners #[selected]
        | throw <| IO.userError "the actual dependent prefix is outside the graph"
      unless dependencies == #[child.generation] do
        throw <| IO.userError "a dependent portable field lost its actual prefix owner"
      let fork ← RecordPrefix.begin supply program occurrence recordLayout
      let (graph, left, _) ← fork.bind graph width
      let (graph, _, leftField) ← left.bind graph finiteRoot
      let (graph, right, _) ← fork.bind graph number
      let (graph, _, rightField) ← right.bind graph finiteRoot
      let .ok combined := graph.requiredOwners #[rightField, leftField]
        | throw <| IO.userError "a branched record lost a valid source scope"
      let .ok independent := graph.requiredOwners #[rightField]
        | throw <| IO.userError "the independent branch lost its source scope"
      unless combined == #[child.generation] && independent.isEmpty do
        throw <| IO.userError "role traversal merged aliased nodes in different record branches"
      let mut retained := number
      let mut graph := graph
      for _ in [:64] do
        let chain ← RecordPrefix.begin supply program occurrence pairLayout
        let (nextGraph, chain, _) ← chain.bind graph retained
        let (nextGraph, _, next) ← chain.bind nextGraph retained
        graph := nextGraph
        retained := next
      let .ok captured := graph.requiredOwners #[retained]
        | throw <| IO.userError "shared prefix traversal lost a retained reference"
      unless captured.isEmpty && retained.value == number.value &&
          retained.instantiations.size == 64 do
        throw <| IO.userError "shared prefix traversal changed identity, roles or owner independence"
      owners.close child.generation
      if ← graph.isAvailable owners selected then
        throw <| IO.userError "a dependent field survived loss of a required prefix owner"
      unless ← graph.isAvailable owners numeral do
        throw <| IO.userError "an independent portable field acquired an unrelated owner"
      unless ← graph.isAvailable owners rightField do
        throw <| IO.userError "an independent consuming role acquired another branch's owner"
      let rejected ← try
        discard <| record.bind graph number
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
      unless rejected do throw <| IO.userError "a completed record accepted an extra field"
    finally owners.close child.generation

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean CasCatalogue.Backend

structure ReplyReference where
  path : Array InputPathStep
  binding : ValueBinding

structure ReplyExport where
  token : String
  owner : ConnectionGeneration
  captures : Array ValueBinding

/-- Parsed control authority; prepared-layout and lifecycle admission follow separately. -/
structure ImmediateReply where
  private mk ::
  requestId : Nat
  scopeId : RuntimeId .scope
  value : Json
  exports : Array ReplyExport
  references : Array ReplyReference

private structure ReplyScan where
  references : Array (Array InputPathStep × ScopedReference) := #[]
  tokens : Array (Array InputPathStep × String) := #[]

/-- Walk the existing JSON packet structure, recognizing only reserved reference/envelope tags.
Reference: CasContract.Port.validateResultRefs and ComputationalValue.decode at f0431beb. -/
private partial def scanReply (value : Json) (path : Array InputPathStep) : Except String ReplyScan := do
  if let some reference ← ScopedReference.parse? value then
    return { references := #[(path, reference)] }
  let tag := (value.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption
  if tag == some "deferredData" then
    throw "a deferred control is not an immediate result value"
  if tag == some "opaqueData" || tag == some "valueData" then
    checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] value
    match ← ComputationalValue.decode value with
    | .opaque token => return { tokens := #[(path, token)] }
    | .inline _ => pure ()
  let mut found : ReplyScan := {}
  match value with
  | .arr values =>
    for index in [:values.size] do
      let child ← scanReply values[index]! (path.push (.index index))
      found := ⟨found.references ++ child.references, found.tokens ++ child.tokens⟩
  | .obj fields =>
    for (name, entry) in fields.toList do
      let child ← scanReply entry (path.push (.field name))
      found := ⟨found.references ++ child.references, found.tokens ++ child.tokens⟩
  | _ => pure ()
  return found

/-- Read every export and its exact immutable capture table while its request scope is live.
Immediate, deferred and suspended controls share this original export-admission boundary. -/
opaque ReplyExport.parseControl (scope : RequestScope) (actual : DispatchReservation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (wireId : String) (exportValue : Json) : IO (Array ReplyExport) := do
  let declarations ← IO.ofExcept <| exportValue.getArr?.mapError IO.userError
  let mut tokens : Std.HashSet String := {}
  let mut exports : Array ReplyExport := #[]
  for declaration in declarations do
    IO.ofExcept <| (checkServiceFields #["token", "captures"] declaration).mapError IO.userError
    let token ← IO.ofExcept <| (declaration.getObjValAs? String "token").mapError IO.userError
    if token.isEmpty || tokens.contains token then
      throw <| IO.userError "the reply export table has an empty or repeated token"
    tokens := tokens.insert token
    let captureValue ← IO.ofExcept <| (declaration.getObjVal? "captures").mapError IO.userError
    let captures ← IO.ofExcept <| captureValue.getArr?.mapError IO.userError
    let references ← captures.mapM fun capture => do
      let some reference ← IO.ofExcept <| (ScopedReference.parse? capture).mapError IO.userError
        | throw <| IO.userError "an export capture is not a scoped reference"
      return reference
    let retained ← scope.capture actual graph wireId references
    exports := exports.push { token, owner := actual.connection, captures := retained }
  return exports

/-- Check a whole child/template packet before scheduling a group. Result references remain
relative to its completed prefix; all other references must already denote original input
positions in this exact request. This performs no mathematical operand interpretation. -/
opaque RequestScope.validateReplyTemplate (scope : RequestScope) (actual : DispatchReservation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (wireId : String) (exports : Array ReplyExport)
    (resultBound : Nat) (value : Json) : IO Unit := do
  let found ← IO.ofExcept <| (scanReply value #[]).mapError IO.userError
  for (_, token) in found.tokens do
    unless exports.any (·.token == token) do
      throw <| IO.userError "an opaque control operand has no declaration in this reply"
  let mut original := #[]
  for (_, reference) in found.references do
    match reference with
    | .result index =>
      unless index < resultBound do
        throw <| IO.userError "a result reference is self, forward or outside its program"
    | _ => original := original.push reference
  discard <| scope.resolveMany actual graph wireId original

/-- Validate the complete immediate control record before any graph materialization.
Owner identity comes from the actual invocation; capture/reference authority comes from its scope.
Source: execution contract v2 §4.2 and the retained-capture amendment. -/
opaque ImmediateReply.parseControl (scope : RequestScope) (actual : DispatchReservation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (wireId : String) (expectedRequestId : Nat) (frame : Json) :
    IO ImmediateReply := do
  IO.ofExcept <|
    (checkServiceFields #["request_id", "status", "value", "exports"] frame).mapError IO.userError
  let requestValue ← IO.ofExcept <| (frame.getObjVal? "request_id").mapError IO.userError
  let requestId ← IO.ofExcept <| requestValue.getNat?.mapError IO.userError
  unless requestId == expectedRequestId do
    throw <| IO.userError "the reply request identity does not match its invocation"
  let status ← IO.ofExcept <| (frame.getObjValAs? String "status").mapError IO.userError
  unless status == "ok" do throw <| IO.userError "the control is not an immediate successful reply"
  let value ← IO.ofExcept <| (frame.getObjVal? "value").mapError IO.userError
  let exportValue ← IO.ofExcept <| (frame.getObjVal? "exports").mapError IO.userError
  let exports ← ReplyExport.parseControl scope actual graph wireId exportValue
  let found ← IO.ofExcept <| (scanReply value #[]).mapError IO.userError
  for (_, token) in found.tokens do
    unless exports.any (·.token == token) do
      throw <| IO.userError "an opaque result token has no declaration in this reply"
  let bindings ← scope.resolveMany actual graph wireId (found.references.map (·.2))
  let references := found.references.zipWith (fun position binding =>
    { path := position.1, binding : ReplyReference }) bindings
  return ⟨requestId, scope.id, value, exports, references⟩

/-- Read one structural position of this exact admitted reply. A scoped reference remains
an indivisible authority; its wire fields cannot be reinterpreted as nested result data. -/
def ImmediateReply.fragmentAt (reply : ImmediateReply) (path : Array InputPathStep) :
    Except String Json := do
  for reference in reply.references do
    if reference.path != path && reference.path.toList.isPrefixOf path.toList then
      throw "a reply fragment descends through an original scoped reference"
  let mut value := reply.value
  for step in path do
    match step with
    | .field name => value ← value.getObjVal? name
    | .index index =>
      let values ← value.getArr?
      let some selected := values[index]?
        | throw "the selected reply fragment is outside its original array"
      value := selected
  return value

/-- Retain a complete inert fragment with the parser's exact original reference leaves and
actual export authorities. Export positions are transport ownership only; they do not create
native values, select mathematical endpoints or add an application address. -/
opaque ImmediateReply.packetDescriptor (reply : ImmediateReply) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (connection : Connection) (path : Array InputPathStep) : Except String ValueContainer := do
  unless connection.generation.worker == graph.worker do
    throw "the retained reply packet belongs to a different worker"
  let value ← reply.fragmentAt path
  let slots := reply.references.filterMap fun reference =>
    if path.toList.isPrefixOf reference.path.toList then
      some (⟨reference.path.extract path.size reference.path.size,
        reference.binding, none⟩ : ContainerSlot)
    else none
  discard <| graph.requiredOwners (slots.map (·.binding))
  let found ← scanReply value #[]
  let mut exports := #[]
  for (position, token) in found.tokens do
    let some declaration := reply.exports.find? (·.token == token)
      | throw "the admitted packet lost its original export declaration"
    unless declaration.owner == connection.generation do
      throw "the retained packet export belongs to another supplying connection"
    discard <| graph.requiredOwners declaration.captures
    exports := exports.push (← PacketExport.fromConnection connection reply.scopeId
      (path ++ position) position token
      declaration.captures)
  let payload ← ValuePayload.descriptor value slots exports
  let .container packet := payload.data
    | throw "the retained reply packet lost its original descriptor"
  return packet

end CasRuntime

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do

    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← OccurrenceLedger.new owners

    let produced ← ledger.allocate
    let transaction ← owners.identities.fresh .transaction
    let (graph, input) ← (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence := produced, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable "retained input".toUTF8)
    let child ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }

      child.child.stdin.putStr "returned export token\n"
      child.child.stdin.flush
      let token := (← child.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
