        registration := { operation := "resource-test", input := "resource-test", backend := "cat" }
        profileDigest := "resource-test-profile" }
      let .ok reservation ← ledger.reserve occurrence transaction selected child graph #[input]
        | throw <| IO.userError "the reply control could not reserve"
      let scope ← RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[input, input] #[] #[]
      let reference := (ScopedReference.scope 0).encode
      let capture := (ScopedReference.scope 1).encode
      let exported := CasCatalogue.Backend.ComputationalValue.encode (.opaque token)
      let declaration := Json.mkObj [("token", .str token), ("captures", .arr #[reference, capture])]
      let makeFrame := fun (id : Nat) (value : Json) (exports : Array Json) => Json.mkObj [
        ("request_id", toJson id), ("status", .str "ok"), ("value", value), ("exports", .arr exports)]
      let frame := makeFrame (73 : Nat) (.arr #[reference, exported]) #[declaration]
      let reply ← ImmediateReply.parseControl scope reservation graph scope.wireId 73 frame
      unless reply.requestId == 73 && reply.scopeId == scope.id && reply.references.size == 1 do
        throw <| IO.userError "reply control validation lost its exact scope association"
      let some returned := reply.references[0]? | throw <| IO.userError "the returned reference is missing"
      unless returned.binding.value == input.value && returned.path == #[.index 0] do
        throw <| IO.userError "reply validation changed an actual retained reference"
      let some native := reply.exports[0]? | throw <| IO.userError "the native export declaration is missing"
      unless native.token == token && native.owner == child.generation && native.captures.size == 2 do
        throw <| IO.userError "reply control validation changed exports or capture authority"
      let malformed := #[
        makeFrame 74 (.arr #[reference, exported]) #[declaration],
        makeFrame 73 exported #[],
        makeFrame 73 exported #[declaration, declaration],
        makeFrame 73 exported #[Json.mkObj [("token", .str token)]],
        makeFrame 73 exported #[Json.mkObj [
          ("token", .str token), ("captures", .arr #[reference, reference])]],
        makeFrame 73 exported #[Json.mkObj [
          ("token", .str token), ("captures", .arr #[]), ("owner", .str "claimed")]],
        Json.mkObj [("request_id", toJson (73 : Nat)), ("status", .str "ok"),
          ("value", exported), ("exports", .arr #[declaration]), ("owner", .str "claimed")],
        makeFrame 73 (Json.mkObj [("ctor", .str "valueData"), ("args", .arr #[.null]),
          ("resultType", .str "claimed")]) #[],
        makeFrame 73 (ScopedReference.result 0).encode #[],
        makeFrame 73 exported #[Json.mkObj [("token", .str token), ("captures", .arr #[.null])]]]
      for bad in malformed do
        let rejected ← try
          discard <| ImmediateReply.parseControl scope reservation graph scope.wireId 73 bad
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
        unless rejected do throw <| IO.userError "a malformed reply control was admitted"
      let wrongScope ← try
        discard <| ImmediateReply.parseControl scope reservation graph "another scope" 73
          (makeFrame 73 (.str "portable control") #[])
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
      unless wrongScope do
        throw <| IO.userError "a reference-free reply bypassed scope authority"
      unless (← ledger.pendingFor occurrence transaction).isSome &&
          (graph.find input.value).isSome do
        throw <| IO.userError "control validation changed reservation or retained value state"
      scope.retire
      discard <| ledger.retire reservation
    finally owners.close child.generation

/-- Prepared transport of an admitted complete callable packet at its native output field. -/
abbrev PreparedCallableTransport := ValueGraph → SourceLayout → ValueContainer → MetaM ValuePayload

/-- Native interface positions of supplied symbolic endpoints. An inline position denotes
only its original packet position during validation; it never becomes a runtime value or
formal answer. Repeated composition boundaries share the same already checked position. -/
inductive PreparedSymbolicEndpoint where
  | value (binding : ValueBinding)
  | inline (position : Nat)

/-- An actual selected operand or an inline map's explicitly retained complete endpoints.
Inline data receive no invented native map value. A source validator may use abstract
arrow locals only while checking its original category interface, then discard them. -/
inductive PreparedSymbolicOperand where
  | value (binding : ValueBinding)
  | objectData (endpoint : PreparedSymbolicEndpoint)
  | mapData (source target : PreparedSymbolicEndpoint)

/-- One node of a complete symbolic callable's interface constraints. Inline endpoint
positions share one namespace across the whole tree; actual original bindings stay explicit.
The action route records exactly the enclosing map descriptors, from outermost to innermost. -/
structure PreparedSymbolicNode where
  source : SourceLayout
  environment : RuntimeEnvironment
  tag : String
  operands : Array PreparedSymbolicOperand
  action : Option ValueContainer
  framed : PreparedSymbolicEndpoint × PreparedSymbolicEndpoint
  inputActions : Array ValueContainer
  fieldPrefix : Option NativeFieldPrefix := none

/-- Validate the whole symbolic tree in one transient native interface scope. Constraints
from original named arrows and nested maps must survive their parent abstractions. The
source producer retains its category/action interface; no answer is compared with the
requested mathematical expression, and no temporary mathematical value enters the graph. -/
abbrev PreparedSymbolicCheck := ValueGraph → Array PreparedSymbolicNode → MetaM Unit

/-- An explicitly supplied native map and its independently retained actual endpoints. -/
structure PreparedMapOperand where
  private mk ::
  binding : ValueBinding
  source : ValueBinding
  target : ValueBinding

/-- Actual complete endpoints and original execution transport of a native map result. -/
structure PreparedMapResult where
  private mk ::
  native : SourceLayout
  environment : RuntimeEnvironment
  source : ValueBinding
  target : ValueBinding
  sourceInventory : Option (Array CallableDatum)
  targetInventory : Option (Array CallableDatum)
  callablePath : Option (Array Name)
  makeCallable : Option PreparedCallableTransport
  symbolic : Option ValueContainer
  operands : Array PreparedMapOperand
  checkSymbolic : Option PreparedSymbolicCheck
  fieldPrefix : Option NativeFieldPrefix := none

/-- Attach the complete native cone/cocone to its original packet and admitted constructor
ports. The original constructor path retains every inline envelope. Proof positions stay
explicit empty slots. The callback receives the current isolated draft; it preserves original
port baselines when adding the native record field views. -/
abbrev PreparedConstructionTransport :=
  SourceLayout → ValueContainer → Array CasCatalogue.Backend.InputPathStep →
    Array (Option ValueBinding) → CellDraft →
    MetaM (CellDraft × ValueBinding)

structure PreparedConstructionResult where
  private mk ::
  plan : ConstructorPorts
  category : CasCatalogue.CategoryExpr
  bundle : ClosedTerm
  colimit : Bool
  assemble : PreparedConstructionTransport
  checkSymbolic : Option PreparedSymbolicCheck

inductive PreparedResultKind where
  | native (check : PreparedSymbolicCheck)
  | map (prepared : PreparedMapResult)
  | construction (prepared : PreparedConstructionResult)

/-- A released structured reply interpretation sealed to its original request preparation. -/
structure PreparedResultCodec (scope : RoleScope) where
  private mk ::
  kind : PreparedResultKind

private def endpointInventory (graph : ValueGraph) (value : ValueBinding) :
    MetaM (Option (Array CallableDatum)) := do
  let packet ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.callableDatum value).mapError IO.userError
  IO.ofExcept <| packet.endpointInventory.mapError IO.userError

/-- Seal actual endpoints at this already selected native Hom position. Constructor ports
use their original formal binder and exact preceding runtime context; descendant fields use
their own native source. No root map endpoint is substituted for another native map role.
Reuse: categoricalPointEndpoints and RuntimeEnvironment.checkDeclaredInput. These check
original source slots and occurrence identities without decoding or recomputing endpoints. -/
opaque PreparedMapResult.forSource (environment : RuntimeEnvironment) (native : SourceLayout)
    (graph : ValueGraph)
    (source target : ValueBinding)
    (makeCallable : Option PreparedCallableTransport := none)
    (callablePath : Option (NativePointPath native) := none)
    (symbolic : Option ValueContainer := none)
    (operands : Array (ValueBinding × ValueBinding × ValueBinding) := #[])
    (checkSymbolic : Option PreparedSymbolicCheck := none)
    (fieldPrefix : Option NativeFieldPrefix := none) :
    MetaM PreparedMapResult := do
  if makeCallable.isSome && callablePath.isNone then
    throwError "a map callable transport requires its checked original native carrier path"
  let environment ← environment.withGraph (some graph)
  if let some symbolic := symbolic then
    unless symbolic.fields.isNone && symbolic.callable.isNone do
      throwError "a source-prepared symbolic map requires its original descriptor view"
    discard <| IO.ofExcept <|
      (graph.requiredOwners (symbolic.slots.map (·.binding))).mapError IO.userError
  let inspect := fun (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
      (expression : Expr) => do
    let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound environment.worker context bound graph
      (some environment) (← native.selections.inContext context)
    let checkEndpoint := fun (environment : RuntimeEnvironment) (context : OpenContext)
        (endpoint : Expr) (value : ValueBinding) => do
      let checked ← match fieldPrefix with
        | none => pure false
        | some nativePrefix => nativePrefix.checkEndpoint environment context graph endpoint value
      unless checked do environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph endpoint value
    let (sourceExpression, targetExpression) ← nativeMapEndpoints expression
    checkEndpoint environment context sourceExpression source
    checkEndpoint environment context targetExpression target
    let operands ← operands.mapM fun (binding, source, target) => do
      discard <| environment.checkOperand graph binding.role binding
      withBindingContext graph context bound binding fun context bound => do
        let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound environment.worker context bound graph
          (some environment) (← binding.role.selections.inContext context)
        let original ← binding.selectedSource context
        let (sourceExpression, targetExpression) ← nativeMapEndpoints original
        checkEndpoint environment context sourceExpression source
        checkEndpoint environment context targetExpression target
        return (⟨binding, source, target⟩ : PreparedMapOperand)
    return (operands, environment)
  let (operands, environment) ← environment.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    native.source.context.withInContext context fun context => do
      match fieldPrefix with
      | none => inspect context environment.bound (← native.source.inContext context)
      | some nativePrefix =>
        unless nativePrefix.native.address == native.address &&
            nativePrefix.native.source.context.exactlyMatches native.source.context &&
            nativePrefix.native.source.expression.equal native.source.expression &&
            nativePrefix.native.source.type.equal native.source.type &&
            nativePrefix.native.source.universeParams == native.source.universeParams &&
            nativePrefix.native.source.nativeDeclarations.exactlyMatches native.source.nativeDeclarations &&
            nativePrefix.native.selectionBinding == native.selectionBinding &&
            SourceSelectionScope.exactlyMatches (fun (left right : ClosedTerm) =>
              left.context.exactlyMatches right.context && left.expression.equal right.expression &&
                left.type.equal right.type && left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
                left.nativeDeclarations.exactlyMatches right.nativeDeclarations)
              nativePrefix.native.selections native.selections do
          throwError "the map codec changed its exact native field prefix"
        nativePrefix.withBoundType context graph environment.bound fun context type bound =>
          withLocalDeclD `nativeMap type fun expression => inspect context bound expression
  for actual in operands do
    for retained in operands do
      if actual.binding.value == retained.binding.value &&
          actual.binding.associationIds == retained.binding.associationIds then
        unless actual.source.value == retained.source.value &&
            actual.source.associationIds == retained.source.associationIds &&
            actual.target.value == retained.target.value &&
            actual.target.associationIds == retained.target.associationIds do
          throwError "one original map operand has conflicting retained endpoint slots"
  return ⟨native, environment, source, target, ← endpointInventory graph source,
    ← endpointInventory graph target, callablePath.map (·.path), makeCallable, symbolic,
    operands, checkSymbolic, fieldPrefix⟩

/-- Keep native reply fields on the same source-checked symbolic interface boundary.
Each field still obtains its own original endpoints and preceding-field witnesses. -/
opaque PreparedResultCodec.forNative (request : PreparedRequest)
    (check : PreparedSymbolicCheck) : MetaM (PreparedResultCodec request.roles.scope) :=
  pure ⟨.native check⟩

/-- Seal the root result's codec to the original complete request preparation. -/
opaque PreparedResultCodec.forMap (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (source target : ValueBinding)
    (makeCallable : Option PreparedCallableTransport := none)
    (callablePath : Option (NativePointPath request.source) := none)
    (symbolic : Option ValueContainer := none)
    (operands : Array (ValueBinding × ValueBinding × ValueBinding) := #[])
    (checkSymbolic : Option PreparedSymbolicCheck := none) :
    MetaM (PreparedResultCodec request.roles.scope) := do
  return ⟨.map (← PreparedMapResult.forSource request.environment request.source graph
    source target makeCallable callablePath symbolic operands checkSymbolic)⟩

/-- Seal a complete constructor-port result to the unchanged native cone/cocone request.
The native comparison checks only the selected schema/diagram; actual port suppliers are
subsequently checked by the original constructor context and native dependent interface. -/
opaque PreparedResultCodec.forConstruction (request : PreparedRequest) (plan : ConstructorPorts)
    (category : CasCatalogue.CategoryExpr) (bundle : ClosedTerm)
    (colimit : Bool) (assemble : PreparedConstructionTransport)
    (checkSymbolic : Option PreparedSymbolicCheck := none) :
    MetaM (PreparedResultCodec request.roles.scope) := do
  unless plan.originalContext.exactlyMatches request.environment.context do
    throwError "the construction codec changed its original native request context"
  request.source.source.withOpen fun bindings value => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    discard <| bundle.inContext context
    let diagram ← plan.interface.diagram.inContext context
    let expected ← mkAppM (if colimit then ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone
      else ``CategoryTheory.Limits.Cone) #[diagram]
    unless ← withTransparency .all <| isDefEq (← inferType value) expected do
      throwError "the construction codec changed its original native cone diagram"
  return ⟨.construction ⟨plan, category, bundle, colimit, assemble, checkSymbolic⟩⟩

end CasRuntime

    parameters := #[] : ValueOrigin }
  let source ← transaction.stage origin (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
  let target ← transaction.stage origin (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
  let other ← transaction.stage origin (.portable packet.compress.toUTF8)
  let alias (value : ValueBinding) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
    let argument ← context.close type
    let function ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close
      (mkLambda `endpoint .default (mkSort (.succ .zero)) (.bvar 0)))
    let occurrence ← ledger.allocate
    let callable ← transaction.stage
      { program, occurrence, role := function, parameters := #[] }
      (.closure program #[value])
    let graph ← transaction.view
    let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 value
      | throwError "an original endpoint disappeared"
    let request ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context
      callable #[argument] #[actual] #[] (some graph)
    let (draft, result) ← request.associateResult owners.identities request.source
      (← transaction.draft) value
    discard <| request.admitResult draft.view result
    let .ok () ← transaction.installDraft draft
      | throwError "the original endpoint view could not be retained"
    return result
  let first ← alias source
  let second ← alias source
  unless first.value == second.value && first.associationIds != second.associationIds do
    throwError "the endpoint fixture lost its distinct consuming associations"
  let makeRequest (source target : ValueBinding) : MetaM PreparedRequest := do
    let function := mkLambda `point .default type (.bvar 0)
    let original ← mkAppOptM ``TypeCat.ofHom #[some type, some type, some function]
    check original
    let occurrence ← ledger.allocate
    let scalarRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 0))
    let dummy ← transaction.stage
      { program, occurrence, role := scalarRole, parameters := #[] } (.portable "0".toUTF8)
    let functionRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close function)
    let functionValue ← transaction.stage
      { program, occurrence, role := functionRole, parameters := #[] } (.closure program #[])
    let graph ← transaction.view
    withBindingContext graph context {} source fun context bound =>
      withBindingContext graph context bound target fun context bound =>
        withApplicationInputs owners.identities context bound original.getAppFn original.getAppArgs
            #[some source, some target, some functionValue] fun context bound arguments => do
          let arrow := mkAppN original.getAppFn arguments
          check arrow
          let callableRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close
            (mkLambda `ignored .default (mkConst ``Nat) arrow))
          let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound owners.worker context bound graph
          let callable ← transaction.stage (← environment.origin program occurrence callableRole)
            (.closure program #[source, target, functionValue])
          let graph ← transaction.view
          let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 dummy
            | throwError "the codec fixture lost its original argument"
          PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program occurrence context callable
            #[scalarRole.source] #[actual] #[] (some graph)
  let request ← makeRequest first target
  let graph ← transaction.view
  let codec ← PreparedResultCodec.forMap request graph first target
  let .map prepared := codec.kind | throwError "the map codec changed its original result kind"
  unless prepared.source.value == first.value &&
      prepared.source.associationIds == first.associationIds &&
      prepared.target.value == target.value do
    throwError "the map codec replaced its supplied original endpoint references"
  for (left, right) in #[(second, target), (other, target), (target, first), (first, other)] do
    let rejected ← try
        discard <| PreparedResultCodec.forMap request graph left right
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
    unless rejected do
      throwError "map framing accepted another original endpoint occurrence or association"
  let rejected ← try
      discard <| PreparedResultCodec.forMap request graph first target
        (some fun _ _ _ => pure (.closure program #[]))
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
  unless rejected do
    throwError "a callable transport acquired an unproved native carrier path"
  discard <| transaction.abort

namespace CasRuntime.ResultPrefixDependencyTests

open Lean Meta CasCompiler

def selectedPrefix (width : Nat) : Sigma (fun n : Nat => Fin (n + 1)) :=
  ⟨width, ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ width⟩⟩

-- A complete result's declared second field uses its actual earlier width, even when the
-- result term retains a selected producer boundary. Its original field association remains
-- mandatory: equal data and a sibling association on the same node cannot replace that width.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
  let occurrence ← owners.identities.fresh .occurrence
  let seven := mkNatLit 7
  let point ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
    (← `((⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ 7⟩ : Fin (7 + 1)))) none
  let plain ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
    (← `((⟨7, ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ 7⟩⟩ : Sigma (fun n : Nat => Fin (n + 1))))) none
  let scalarRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close seven)
  let pointRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close point)
  let plainLayout ← RecordLayout.ofSource (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close plain))
  let origin := fun role =>
    ({ program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] } : ValueOrigin)
  let (graph, first) ← (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
    (origin scalarRole) (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let (graph, other) ← graph.stage owners.identities
    (origin scalarRole) (.portable "7".toUTF8)
  let (graph, point) ← graph.stage owners.identities
    (origin pointRole) (.closure program #[])
  let record ← RecordPrefix.begin owners.identities program occurrence plainLayout
  let (graph, record, originalWidth) ← record.bind graph first
  let (graph, _, originalPoint) ← record.bind graph point
  let sibling ← RecordPrefix.begin owners.identities program occurrence plainLayout
  let (graph, _, siblingWidth) ← sibling.bind graph first
  unless originalWidth.value == siblingWidth.value &&
      originalWidth.associationIds != siblingWidth.associationIds &&
      other.value != originalWidth.value do
    throwError "the result-prefix control lost its distinct original suppliers"
  let allocated ← owners.identities.fresh .sourceBinding
  context.withLocalBinding ⟨allocated.worker, allocated.serial⟩ .result `width
      (mkConst ``Nat) (fun context binding => do
        let native := mkConst ``CasRuntime.ResultPrefixDependencyTests.selectedPrefix
        let selectedId ← owners.identities.fresh .sourceBinding
        context.withLocalBinding ⟨selectedId.worker, selectedId.serial⟩ .definition `selectedPrefix
            (← inferType native) (fun context selected => do
            let source ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkApp selected.expression binding.expression))
            let layout ← RecordLayout.ofSource source
            let parameter ← IO.ofExcept <|
              (RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph binding.id originalWidth).mapError IO.userError
            let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.capture owners.worker context #[parameter] (some graph)
            let build (width field : ValueBinding) (associate : Bool) :
                MetaM (ValueGraph × ValueBinding) := do
              if !associate then
                return ← graph.stage owners.identities (← environment.origin program occurrence source)
                  (.product #[width, field])
              let record ← RecordPrefix.prepare owners.identities program occurrence layout graph environment.bound
              let (graph, record, _) ← record.bind graph width
              let (graph, record, _) ← record.bind graph field
              let payload ← IO.ofExcept <| record.finish.mapError IO.userError
              graph.stage owners.identities (← environment.origin program occurrence source) payload
            for associate in #[false, true] do
              let (goodGraph, good) ← build originalWidth originalPoint associate
              let accepted ← environment.checkResult goodGraph source good
              let acceptedPoint ← IO.ofExcept <| (goodGraph.project accepted.root 1).mapError IO.userError
              unless acceptedPoint.value == originalPoint.value &&
                  originalPoint.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf acceptedPoint.associationIds.toList do
                throwError "dependent result admission replaced its original selected field"
              for wrong in #[other, siblingWidth] do
                let (badGraph, bad) ← build wrong originalPoint associate
                let rejected ← try
                  discard <| environment.checkResult badGraph source bad
                  pure false
                catch _ => pure true
                unless rejected do
                  throwError "dependent result admission accepted a different actual prefix supplier"
              -- A new output association cannot supply the missing original field dependency.
              let (badGraph, bad) ← build originalWidth point associate
              let rejected ← try
                discard <| environment.checkResult badGraph source bad
                pure false
              catch _ => pure true
              unless rejected do
                throwError "a consuming output association authorized its own missing original dependency"

        ) (originalSource := some native)

    ) (originalSource := some seven)

end CasRuntime.ResultPrefixDependencyTests

module

public import CasCompiler.InputCoverage
public import CasRuntime.Environment

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler

/-- Input and capture sources name positions, independently of value or expression equality. -/
inductive InputRoleSource
  | argument (position : Nat)
  | capture (position : Nat)
  deriving BEq, Repr

structure InputRoleBinding where
  private mk ::
  role : RoleId
  source : InputRoleSource
  value : ValueBinding

/-- Checked actual bindings under this request's complete source telescope. Ordinary input
admission is total; a sealed whole-input result may leave only source-proven unused arguments
unbound. Wire enumeration still requires every declared computational argument.
The map contains references and source roles, never completed payload storage. -/
structure InputRoleMap where
  private mk ::
  telescope : RoleTelescope
  private bindings : Std.HashMap RoleId InputRoleBinding

private def admitInputRoles (telescope : RoleTelescope) (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (arguments : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (captures : Array ValueBinding)
    (actual : Array RuntimeArgument) (coverage : Option (InputResultSourceCoverage telescope)) :
    MetaM InputRoleMap := do
  unless graph.worker == telescope.scope.program.worker && graph.worker == environment.worker do
    throwError "the computational input map belongs to a different worker"
  unless arguments.size == telescope.arguments.size && captures.size == telescope.captures.size do
    throwError "the computational input map has a different source telescope"
  let mut bindings : Std.HashMap RoleId InputRoleBinding := {}
  for declared in telescope.arguments, index in [:telescope.arguments.size] do
    let some supplied := arguments[index]?
      | throwError "a computational argument is outside its complete source table"
    if declared.wireIndex.isSome then
      if supplied.isNone && coverage.any (fun selected => !selected.arguments.contains index) then
        continue
      let some value := supplied
        | throwError (MessageData.tagged `CasRuntime.InputRoleMap.missingArgument
            "a demanded computational argument role has no actual binding")
      let .ok _ := graph.requiredOwners #[value]
        | throwError "a computational argument is outside the visible graph"
      let argument ← if let some retained := actual.find? (·.index == index) then do
          unless retained.value.value == value.value &&
              retained.value.associationIds == value.associationIds do
            throwError "a computational argument changed its prepared source occurrence"
          pure retained
        else do
          let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph index value
            | throwError "a computational argument is outside the visible graph"
          pure argument
      let value ← environment.checkArgument declared.role.source argument
      bindings := bindings.insert declared.role.id ⟨declared.role.id, .argument index, value⟩
    else
      if supplied.isSome then throwError "a formal proof role has a runtime payload"
  for declared in telescope.captures, index in [:telescope.captures.size] do
    let some value := captures[index]?
      | throwError "a demanded capture role has no actual binding"
    let candidate ← environment.checkOperand graph declared.layout value
    bindings := bindings.insert declared.role.id ⟨declared.role.id, .capture index, candidate.root⟩
  return ⟨telescope, bindings⟩

/-- Admit every declared wire argument and capture in its source position.
Reuse: native RuntimeEnvironment checks and immutable graph visibility. Proof positions stay
in the telescope without a runtime payload. Providers and exports always use this total gate. -/
opaque InputRoleMap.admit (telescope : RoleTelescope) (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (arguments : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (captures : Array ValueBinding)
    (actual : Array RuntimeArgument := #[]) : MetaM InputRoleMap :=
  admitInputRoles telescope environment graph arguments captures actual none

/-- Check all supplied values and every required source slot after complete native coverage
has been sealed for this exact telescope. This cannot authorize an arbitrary partial map;
the only omissions are absent from every output value/type and their dependent formal prefix.
The caller retains this map inside its sealed whole-input result plan/completion. -/
opaque InputRoleMap.admitInputResult (telescope : RoleTelescope)
    (coverage : InputResultSourceCoverage telescope) (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (arguments : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (captures : Array ValueBinding)
    (actual : Array RuntimeArgument := #[]) : MetaM InputRoleMap :=
  admitInputRoles telescope environment graph arguments captures actual (some coverage)

private def InputRoleMap.checkVisibility (map : InputRoleMap) (graph : ValueGraph) :
    Except String Unit := do
  unless graph.worker == map.telescope.scope.program.worker do
    throw "the computational input map belongs to a different worker"
  discard <| graph.requiredOwners (map.bindings.toArray.map (·.2.value))

private def InputRoleMap.requireBinding (map : InputRoleMap) (role : RoleId) :
    Except String InputRoleBinding := do
  unless role.scope == map.telescope.scope do
    throw "the computational role belongs to a different scope"
  let some binding := map.bindings[role]?
    | throw "the computational role has no input binding"
  return binding

/-- Role identity includes its scope. Recheck all input visibility in the caller's snapshot. -/
opaque InputRoleMap.lookup (map : InputRoleMap) (graph : ValueGraph) (role : RoleId) :
    Except String InputRoleBinding := do
  map.checkVisibility graph
  map.requireBinding role

/-- Source-ordered wire values; aliases keep each of their distinct role positions. -/
opaque InputRoleMap.arguments (map : InputRoleMap) (graph : ValueGraph) :
    Except String (Array ValueBinding) := do
  map.checkVisibility graph
  let mut values := #[]
  for argument in map.telescope.arguments do
    if argument.wireIndex.isSome then
      values := values.push (← map.requireBinding argument.role.id).value
  return values

/-- Actual returned references under the producing request's declared source roles.
Lazy exported fields stay unbound until their access demand returns an actual value. -/
structure ResultRoleMap where
  private mk ::
  telescope : RoleTelescope
  root : ValueBinding
  private bindings : Std.HashMap RoleId ValueBinding

def InputRoleMap.references (map : InputRoleMap) : Array ValueBinding :=
  map.bindings.toArray.map (·.2.value)

def ResultRoleMap.references (map : ResultRoleMap) : Array ValueBinding :=
  map.bindings.toArray.map (·.2)

/-- Check the complete stored interface, then bind each declared materialized result position.
A projection request supplies its original operand and field for every admission of that result.
Ordinary results receive no projection authority. The map owns no payloads.
Reuse: native whole-result admission and the exact prepared projection check. -/
opaque ResultRoleMap.admit (telescope : RoleTelescope) (environment : RuntimeEnvironment)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (value : ValueBinding)
    (projectionContext : Option (ValueBinding × FieldLayout) := none)
    (fieldPrefix : Option NativeFieldPrefix := none) : MetaM ResultRoleMap := do
  unless graph.worker == telescope.scope.program.worker do
    throwError "the result role map belongs to a different worker"
  let bindings ← IO.mkRef ({} : Std.HashMap RoleId ValueBinding)
  let sameSource := fun (left right : ClosedTerm) =>
    left.context.exactlyMatches right.context && left.expression.equal right.expression &&
      left.type.equal right.type && left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
      left.nativeDeclarations.exactlyMatches right.nativeDeclarations
  let admitted : Array Nat → ValueBinding → MetaM Unit := fun path actual => do
    for declared in telescope.results do
      unless declared.wirePath == some path do continue
      unless actual.role.address == declared.layout.address &&
          actual.role.kind == declared.layout.kind &&
          sameSource actual.role.source declared.layout.source &&
          actual.role.selectionBinding == declared.layout.selectionBinding &&
          SourceSelectionScope.exactlyMatches sameSource
            actual.role.selections declared.layout.selections do
        throwError "an admitted result changed its original declared source position"
      -- The binding already carries this exact role's admitted dependencies and complete
      -- parameter table. No raw source is reopened after its projection scope has closed.
      bindings.modify (·.insert declared.role.id actual)
  let candidate ← match projectionContext with
    | some (operand, field) =>
      environment.checkProjectionResult graph telescope.source value operand field admitted
    | none => environment.checkResult graph telescope.source value fieldPrefix admitted
  return ⟨telescope, candidate.root, ← bindings.get⟩

/-- Only this occurrence's declared result roles can select actual visible returned references. -/
opaque ResultRoleMap.lookup (map : ResultRoleMap) (graph : ValueGraph) (role : RoleId) :
    Except String ValueBinding := do
  unless graph.worker == map.telescope.scope.program.worker do
    throw "the result role map belongs to a different worker"
  unless role.scope == map.telescope.scope do
    throw "the result role belongs to a different scope"
  discard <| graph.requiredOwners #[map.root]
  let some value := map.bindings[role]?
    | throw "the result role has no materialized binding"
  discard <| graph.requiredOwners #[value]
  return value

end CasRuntime

public import CasRuntime.ExecutionContext
public import CasRuntime.Encode
public import CasRuntime.DeclaredInput
public import CasRuntime.Execute
import all CasRuntime.Value
public import CasCatalogue.Admission
