private def failureAt (stratum : Stratum) (action : MetaM Unit) : MetaM Unit := do
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    action
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some error := failure | throwError "the routed-method negative control was accepted"
  unless CasCatalogue.Exception.stratum? error == some stratum do throw error

private def readTerm (session : KernelSession) (text : String) : TermElabM SourceTerm := do
  let parsed ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_term text with
    | .ok parsed => pure parsed
    | .error message => throwError "the original method term did not parse: {message}"
  session.source.read ⟨parsed⟩

private def define (session : KernelSession) (text : String) : TermElabM KernelSession := do
  let parsed ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
    | .ok parsed => pure parsed
    | .error message => throwError "the original source declaration did not parse: {message}"
  let result ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨parsed⟩
  unless result.outcome.kind == "holds" do
    throwError "`{text}` is {result.outcome.kind}: {result.outcome.detail}"
  return result.session

private def value (session : KernelSession) (name : Name) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
  let some entry := session.source.context.entries.find? (·.userName == name)
    | throwError "the original source binding {name} is absent"
  let some binding := session.value? entry.id
    | throwError "the original source binding {name} has no actual value"
  return binding

/-- Intercept the final real method application before Execute.run owns it. Every setup demand
uses the production executor and resolver. Throwing only outside that interpreter leaves the
cell available for the structural selection/packet checks; no method response is fabricated. -/
private def captureMethod (kernel : Kernel) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (action : SourceEvaluation → MetaM ValueBinding) :
    MetaM (PreparedRequest × PreparedMethodRoute) := do
  let captured ← IO.mkRef (none : Option
    (PreparedRequest × PreparedRequest × Array FieldLayout × Array ValueBinding))
  let evaluate : SourceEvaluation := fun cell program context bound selections expression => do
    let handler : PFunctor.Handler.Stateful MetaM CellTransaction OperationalSignature :=
      fun request current => do
        if let .apply callable _ _ := request.action then
          let graph ← current.view
          if let .ok callable := graph.callable callable then
            if let some node := graph.find callable.value then
              if let .closure code captures := node.payload.data then
                if let some (.family original path) := (← kernel.codes.get)[code]? then
                  if let .primitive (.routedMethod _) _ := original.action then
                    captured.set (some (request, original, path, captures))
                    throwError "captured the original prepared method application"
        let response ← Execute.run kernel.executor
          (PFunctor.FreeM.lift (P := OperationalSignature) request) current
          (some (kernel.resolveFixedInput
            (fun cell _ context bound selections expression => kernel.run cell context bound expression (selections := selections))
            current program))
        return (response, current)
    lowerTerm {
      ledger := kernel.ledger, transaction := cell, codes := kernel.codes
      run := fun computation => do
        let (value, _) ← handler.run computation cell
        return value }
      program context bound expression (selections := selections)
  let failure : Option Exception ← try
    discard <| action evaluate
    pure none
  catch error => pure (some error)
  let some (request, original, path, captures) ← captured.get
    | if let some error := failure then throw error
      else throwError "the source never reached its original prepared method application"
  return (request, ← PreparedMethodRoute.prepare kernel (← transaction.view)
    request original path captures)

/-- Exercise the complete original reader output through production Lower, including exact
receiver-slot recovery. The capture is solely a stop before a mathematical method result. -/
private def prepare (session : KernelSession) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (term : SourceTerm) : MetaM (PreparedRequest × PreparedMethodRoute) :=
  term.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let mut bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding := {}
    for binding in bindings do
      if let some value := session.value? binding.id then bound := bound.insert binding.id value
    let program ← session.kernel.ledger.owners.identities.fresh .program
    let selections ← term.selections.inContext context
    captureMethod session.kernel transaction fun evaluate =>
      evaluate transaction program context bound selections expression

private def manifest (operation : String) (inputs : Array String) : MetaM Manifest := do
  let packet := Json.mkObj [
    ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "unused-method-peer"),
      ("command", "/bin/false"), ("args", .arr #[])]]),
    ("registrations", .arr (inputs.map fun input => Json.mkObj [
      ("operation", toJson operation), ("input", toJson input),
      ("backend", toJson "unused-method-peer")]))]
  IO.ofExcept <| (Manifest.parse packet).mapError IO.userError

private def select (route : PreparedMethodRoute) (inputs : Array String) :
    MetaM SelectedMethodBoundary := do
  let installed ← manifest route.family.entry.id.raw inputs
  let profile ← RealizationProfile.prepare installed none
  route.select profile installed

private def evaluate (kernel : Kernel) : SourceEvaluation :=
  fun transaction _ context bound selections expression => kernel.run transaction context bound expression (selections := selections)

private def sameExactInput (left right : ValueBinding) : Bool :=
  left.value == right.value && left.associationIds == right.associationIds

private def sameInput (original current : ValueBinding) : Bool :=
  original.value == current.value &&
    original.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf current.associationIds.toList

-- Rank's accepted declaration has one universe, while its nominal owner has independent
-- scalar and module universes. The complete source family retains the declaration's diagonal
-- relation at an arbitrary universe; it neither defaults to zero nor widens to other fibres.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let state ← semanticState
  let #[entry] := state.methods.filter (·.id.raw == "meth.rank")
    | throwError "the rank control lost its accepted method declaration"
  let #[family] ← RoutedMethodFamily.atSource entry.owner entry.name
    | throwError "the rank control changed its complete first-hit family"
  unless family.entry.shape == .isoInvariant && family.parameterCount == 1 &&
      family.universeParams.length == 1 do
    throwError "the rank source lost its original shape, parameter or universe family"
  for expression in #[family.categoryFamily, family.functorFamily, family.family] ++ family.actions do
    if expression.hasFVar || expression.hasMVar || expression.hasLevelMVar then
      throwError "the rank source family did not close all original parameters and universes"
  let #[repeated] ← RoutedMethodFamily.atSource entry.owner entry.name
    | throwError "the repeated rank source changed its original family"
  unless (← sourceFamilyConversion family.functorFamily repeated.functorFamily #[]).isSome do
    throwError "independent rank readings changed their complete rigid family"
  let arbitraryLevel := Level.param `rankDeclarationUniverse
  let categoryFamily := family.categoryFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams [arbitraryLevel]
  forallTelescopeReducing (← inferType categoryFamily) fun parameters _ => do
    let #[ring] := parameters
      | throwError "the rank family lost its original ring parameter"
    let expected := mkApp
      (Lean.mkConst ``LeanCategories.Modules.Mathlib.ModulesOf [arbitraryLevel, arbitraryLevel]) ring
    unless ← isDefEq (mkAppN categoryFamily parameters) expected do
      throwError "the rank owner did not retain its declared universe relation"
    let #[action] ← family.specializeActions [arbitraryLevel] parameters
      | throwError "the rank owner acquired a synthetic route action"
    let #[actionFamily] := family.actionFamilies
      | throwError "the rank action lost its complete original family row"
    unless actionFamily.edge == .functor family.functor.id do
      throwError "the rank action changed its exact original edge"
    let #[(_, supplied)] ← routedActionParameters actionFamily action
      | throwError "the rank action lost its original explicit parameter position"
    unless supplied.consumeMData == ring do
      throwError "the rank action reconstructed its whole original ring parameter"
    let (declared, _) ← functorCategoryBundles action
    let core ← applyConstructorInterface ``CasCatalogue.Constructors.core #[expected] #[expected]
    unless ← isDefEq declared core do
      throwError "the rank method lost its complete native Core domain"
    if ← isDefEq declared expected then
      throwError "the rank method identified its Core domain with the ordinary owner"
    let callable := (mkAppN
      (family.family.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams [arbitraryLevel]) parameters).headBeta
    let .forallE _ domain _ _ ← whnf (← inferType callable)
      | throwError "the rank family lost its original receiver boundary"
    unless ← isDefEq domain (← mkAppM ``CategoryTheory.Bundled.α #[expected]) do
      throwError "the rank callable replaced its original receiver by a synthetic Core input"
  let scalarUniverse := Level.param `rankScalarUniverse
  let moduleUniverse := Level.param `rankModuleUniverse
  withLocalDeclD `ring (Lean.mkConst ``RingCat [scalarUniverse]) fun ring => do
    let independent := mkApp
      (Lean.mkConst ``LeanCategories.Modules.Mathlib.ModulesOf [scalarUniverse, moduleUniverse]) ring
    let levels ← family.universeParams.mapM fun _ => mkFreshLevelMVar
    let category := family.categoryFamily.instantiateLevelParams family.universeParams levels
    let (parameters, _, _) ← forallMetaTelescopeReducing (← inferType category)
    if ← withoutModifyingState <| isDefEq (mkAppN category parameters) independent then
      throwError "the rank declaration was widened to independent module and scalar universes"

-- These are source/interface and dispatch controls only. The accepted native methods, routes,
-- object constructors and parameter telescopes supply every mathematical declaration. No leaf
-- computes a cardinality, rank, kernel or a replacement mathematical result in this module.
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let root ← IO.currentDir
    IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let path := root / ".tmp" / "routed-method-empty-leaves.json"
    IO.FS.writeFile path (Json.mkObj [("backends", .arr #[]),
      ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
    let mut session ← KernelSession.start (some path) (computationOnly := true)
    try
      for text in #["let S3 := Sym(3) in Groups", "let S3again := Sym(3) in Groups",
          "let equal_ends := trivial(S3, S3again)"] do
        session ← define session text
      let s3 ← value session `S3
      let second ← value session `S3again
      unless s3.value != second.value do
        throwError "the distinct source group declarations share one fabricated value"
      let term ← readTerm session "|S3|"
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin session.kernel.ledger
      try
        let (request, route) ← prepare session transaction term
        unless route.family.entry.id.raw == "meth.cardinality" &&
            route.boundaries.size > 2 && sameInput s3 route.receiver do
          throwError "the cardinality source lost its original full inherited route"
        let before ← transaction.view
        failureAt .noImplementation do
          discard <| select route #[]
        -- The old generic dependentContext input is not a released method boundary.
        failureAt .noImplementation do
          discard <| select route #[s!"{route.family.entry.id.raw}#input"]
        let some sourceBoundary := route.boundaries[0]?
          | throwError "the source method boundary is absent"
        let some ownerBoundary := route.boundaries.back?
          | throwError "the owner method boundary is absent"
        let some sourceForm := sourceBoundary.forms[0]?
          | throwError "the source method has no complete registered category"
        let some ownerForm := ownerBoundary.forms[0]?
          | throwError "the owner method has no complete registered category"
        failureAt .ambiguousRealization do
          discard <| select route #[sourceForm, ownerForm]
        -- Occurrence counting also rejects one triple admitted at two boundary positions.
        failureAt .ambiguousRealization do
          let installed ← manifest route.family.entry.id.raw #[sourceForm]
          let profile ← RealizationProfile.prepare installed none
          discard <| profile.selectMethod installed route.family.entry.id
            #[#[sourceForm], #[sourceForm]]
        unless (← transaction.view).sameRevision before &&
            (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
          throwError "method realization inspection executed a prefix or dispatched a leaf"

        let some intermediate := route.boundaries[1]?
          | throwError "the original inherited method has no intermediate boundary"
        let some intermediateForm := intermediate.forms[0]?
          | throwError "the intermediate method has no registered category"
        let selection ← select route #[intermediateForm]
        let offset := selection.boundary.offset
        unless offset == 1 do throwError "method selection changed its exact intermediate position"
        let .registration _ := selection.realization
          | throwError "the selected protocol control became a mathematical derivation"
        let calls ← IO.mkRef 0
        let ordinary : SourceEvaluation := fun cell program context bound selections expression => do
          calls.modify (· + 1)
          evaluate session.kernel cell program context bound selections expression
        let selected ← selection.materialize session.kernel ordinary request transaction
        unless (← calls.get) == offset do
          throwError "the method executed more than the uniquely selected prefix"
        let invocation ← selected.invocation session.kernel (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction
        let expected := (route.family.route.refs.extract offset route.family.route.refs.size).push
          (.functor route.family.functor.id)
        unless invocation.offset == offset && invocation.edges == expected &&
            invocation.parameters.size == expected.size &&
            sameExactInput invocation.receiver selected.receiver do
          throwError "the method packet changed its residual suffix or selected receiver"
        do
          unless route.preparation == request.roles.scope &&
              invocation.preparation == request.roles.scope do
            throwError "the method lost its original complete request preparation"
          let rejectPreparation (action : MetaM Unit) : MetaM Unit := do
            let failure : Option Exception ← try
              action
              pure none
            catch error => pure (some error)
            let some failure := failure
              | throwError "a method accepted a different request preparation"
            unless failure.toMessageData.hasTag (· == requestPreparationMismatchTag) do throw failure
          let otherTerm ← readTerm session "|S3again|"
          let (otherRequest, otherRoute) ← prepare session transaction otherTerm
          unless otherRequest.occurrence != request.occurrence &&
              otherRoute.family.entry.id == route.family.entry.id &&
              sameInput second otherRoute.receiver &&
              otherRoute.receiver.value != route.receiver.value do
            throwError "the method scope control lost its separate equal receiver"
          let rebuilt ← withSourceScope request fun context _ => do
            let .apply callable arguments values := request.action
              | throwError "the method scope control lost its original application"
            let graph ← transaction.view
            let mut actual := #[]
            for value in values, index in [:values.size] do
              if let some value := value then
                let .ok argument := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph index value
                  | throwError "the method scope control lost an original argument"
                actual := actual.push argument
            let mut parameters := #[]
            for (entry, value) in request.environment.context.entries.zip request.environment.values do
              if let some value := value then
                let .ok parameter := RuntimeParameter.ofValue graph entry.id value
                  | throwError "the method scope control lost an original capture"
                parameters := parameters.push parameter
            PreparedRequest.forApplication session.kernel.ledger.owners.identities
              request.program request.occurrence context callable arguments actual parameters
              (selections := ← request.environment.selections.inContext context)
              (selectionBinding := request.selectionBinding)
          unless rebuilt.occurrence == request.occurrence &&
              rebuilt.roles.scope != request.roles.scope do
            throwError "the method scope control did not rebuild the same occurrence"
          let graph ← transaction.view
          let .apply otherCallable _ _ := otherRequest.action
            | throwError "the other method lost its original callable"
          let .ok otherCode := graph.callable otherCallable
            | throwError "the other method callable is outside its graph"
          let some otherNode := graph.find otherCode.value
            | throwError "the other method lost its retained code"
          let .closure otherProgram otherCaptures := otherNode.payload.data
            | throwError "the other method is not an original family closure"
          let some (.family otherFamily otherPath) := (← session.kernel.codes.get)[otherProgram]?
            | throwError "the other method lost its original family preparation"
          let beforeRejection ← transaction.view
          let beforeCalls ← calls.get
          rejectPreparation do
            discard <| PreparedMethodRoute.prepare session.kernel graph request otherFamily
              otherPath otherCaptures
          for wrong in #[otherRequest, rebuilt] do
            rejectPreparation do
              discard <| selection.materialize session.kernel ordinary wrong transaction
            rejectPreparation do
              discard <| selected.invocation session.kernel (evaluate session.kernel) wrong transaction
            rejectPreparation do
              discard <| session.kernel.invokeMethod (evaluate session.kernel) wrong transaction invocation
            unless (← session.kernel.ledger.pendingFor wrong.occurrence transaction.id).isNone do
              throwError "a rejected method preparation reserved a dispatch"
          unless (← transaction.view).sameRevision beforeRejection &&
              (← calls.get) == beforeCalls && (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "a rejected method preparation evaluated or published an input"
        let registry : RegistryState := { toSemanticState := ← semanticState }
        let some imageForm := intermediate.forms.find? (fun input =>
            match registry.form? input with
            | some (.functorImage ..) | some (.edgeImage ..) => true
            | _ => false)
          | throwError "the selected intermediate route lost its published image form"
        withSourceScope request fun context bound =>
          selected.environment.withContext context bound fun context _ => do
            let selections ← selected.environment.selections.inContext context
            let source ← selected.receiver.selectedSource context
            let childFamily ← RoutedMethodFamily.forSelection intermediate.category
              route.family.entry.id.raw
              (route.family.route.refs.extract offset route.family.route.refs.size)
            unless ← CasRuntime.RoutedMethodFamily.admitsSourceForm
                context selections childFamily source imageForm do
              throwError "the original native object-action spine rejected its image form {imageForm}: {source}"
            let some original := selections.findAt? context source
              | throwError "the selected method image lost its original source witness"
            let some application := original.application
              | throwError "the selected method image lost its complete source application"
            let .objectAction originalFamily := application.family
              | throwError "the selected method image changed its source witness kind"
            let edge := originalFamily.edge
            unless route.family.route.refs[offset - 1]? == some edge do
              throwError "the selected method image changed its original edge identity"
            if ← CasRuntime.RoutedMethodFamily.admitsSourceForm
                context selections childFamily original.value imageForm then
              throwError "an unselected native image recovered a catalogue address from its declaration"
            let direct ← match edge with
              | .functor id => do
                let #[.functor entry] := originalFamily.references
                  | throwError "the selected image lost its complete original functor row"
                unless entry.id == id do
                  throwError "the selected image changed its exact functor reference"
                pure (some ({ original with reference := some (.functor entry) } : SourceSelection Expr))
              | .classifierForget id => do
                let #[.classifierForget entry] := originalFamily.references
                  | throwError "the selected image lost its complete original classifier row"
                unless entry.id == id do
                  throwError "the selected image changed its exact classifier reference"
                pure (some ({ original with reference := some (.classifierForget entry) } : SourceSelection Expr))
              | .constructMap .. => pure none
            if let some direct := direct then
              selections.withBinding session.kernel.ledger.owners.identities context direct
                fun context selections directSource => do
                  unless ← CasRuntime.RoutedMethodFamily.admitsSourceForm
                      context selections childFamily directSource imageForm do
                    throwError "the original source-reader image reference lost its selected form"
        let connection ← session.kernel.ledger.owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
        try
          let graph ← transaction.view
          let .ok (encoded, packet) := invocation.encode graph connection.generation
            | throwError "the intermediate method packet lost its exact image receiver"
          let .ok decoded := ConstructionInvocation.decodeMethod route.family.entry.id.raw
              route.family.functor.id.raw packet
            | throwError "the intermediate method did not retain its complete residual packet"
          let identity : DispatchIdentity := {
            manifestDigest := "method-image-child-control"
            profileDigest := "no-mathematical-provider"
            registration := {
              operation := route.family.entry.id.raw
              input := imageForm
              backend := "scope-control" } }
          let .ok reservation ← transaction.reserve request.occurrence identity connection
              invocation.dependencies
            | throwError "the intermediate method lost its original scoped receiver"
          let scope ← RequestScope.issue session.kernel.ledger reservation graph
            encoded.slots encoded.inputs #[]
          try
            let packet := { decoded with receiver := inputRef #[.field "receiver"] }
            let call := Json.mkObj [("op", toJson route.family.entry.id.raw),
              ("input", toJson imageForm), ("args", packet.encode)]
            let (_, childRoute) ← captureMethod session.kernel transaction fun evaluate =>
              session.kernel.child evaluate request transaction reservation scope call
            unless childRoute.family.route.refs ==
                route.family.route.refs.extract offset route.family.route.refs.size &&
                sameExactInput childRoute.receiver invocation.receiver do
              throwError "the image-form child lost its original selected edge result"
            let some childSource := childRoute.boundaries[0]?
              | throwError "the image-form child lost its prepared source boundary"
            unless childSource.forms.contains imageForm do
              throwError "the image-form child discarded its admitted intermediate source form"
            let childSelection ← select childRoute #[imageForm]
            unless childSelection.boundary.offset == 0 do
              throwError "the original image form moved after the deferred round trip"
          finally scope.retire
        finally session.kernel.ledger.owners.close connection.generation
        let original ← (← select route #[sourceForm]).materialize session.kernel ordinary request transaction
        unless sameExactInput original.receiver route.receiver && (← calls.get) == offset do
          throwError "a source-composite registration transported or replaced its receiver"
        let owner ← (← select route #[ownerForm]).materialize session.kernel
          (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction
        let ownerInvocation ← owner.invocation session.kernel (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction
        unless ownerInvocation.edges == #[.functor route.family.functor.id] &&
            sameExactInput ownerInvocation.receiver owner.receiver do
          throwError "the owner registration retained a residual action or another receiver"
        unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
          throwError "the native input projections in method preparation dispatched a provider"
      finally discard <| transaction.abort

      -- The actual group-arrow method sends one Arrow view rooted at the original native
      -- parent. Its equal but separately declared endpoints remain distinct scoped values.
      let term ← readTerm session "equal_ends.ker()"
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin session.kernel.ledger
      let connection ← session.kernel.ledger.owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
      try
        let (request, route) ← prepare session transaction term
        unless route.family.entry.id.raw == "meth.group_arrow_kernel" &&
            route.family.route.refs.isEmpty do
          throwError "the original kernel method acquired a different source route"
        let selected ← (← select route #["cat.arrows_groups"]).materialize session.kernel
          (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction
        let invocation ← selected.invocation session.kernel (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction
        let graph ← transaction.view
        let .ok (encoded, packet) := invocation.encode graph connection.generation
          | throwError "the native group arrow could not use its released method packet"
        let .ok decoded := ConstructionInvocation.decodeMethod route.family.entry.id.raw
            route.family.functor.id.raw packet
          | throwError "the method did not use its complete ConstructionInvocation"
        unless decoded.parameters.size == 1 &&
            (decoded.receiver.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "arrow" do
          throwError "the group method lost its final functor or complete Arrow descriptor"
        let roots : Array (Array InputPathStep × ValueBinding) := #[
          (#[.field "receiver", .field "args", .index 0], s3),
          (#[.field "receiver", .field "args", .index 1], second),
          (#[.field "receiver", .field "args", .index 2, .field "args", .index 0], s3),
          (#[.field "receiver", .field "args", .index 2, .field "args", .index 1], second)]
        for (path, original) in roots do
          let some actual := encoded.inputs.find? (·.path == path)
            | throwError "the method packet lost an exact native endpoint/parameter position"
          unless sameInput original actual.binding do
            throwError "method framing replaced an actual endpoint by equal source data"
        let some root := encoded.inputs.find? (·.path == #[.field "receiver"])
          | throwError "the complete Arrow packet lost its actual whole input authority"
        unless sameExactInput root.binding invocation.receiver do
          throwError "the public Arrow view fabricated a replacement input root"
        let identity : DispatchIdentity := {
          manifestDigest := "method-input-scope-control"
          profileDigest := "no-mathematical-provider"
          registration := {
            operation := route.family.entry.id.raw
            input := "cat.arrows_groups"
            backend := "scope-control" } }
        let .ok reservation ← transaction.reserve request.occurrence identity connection
            invocation.dependencies
          | throwError "the method scope lost its original inputs"
        let scope ← RequestScope.issue session.kernel.ledger reservation graph encoded.slots encoded.inputs #[]
        try
          for (path, original) in roots do
            let actual ← scope.resolveMany reservation graph scope.wireId #[.input path]
            let #[actual] := actual | throwError "the original method input path did not resolve"
            unless sameInput original actual do
              throwError "the method scope changed a positioned declaration parameter"
          let childPacket : ConstructionInvocation := { decoded with
            receiver := inputRef #[.field "receiver"] }
          let child := Json.mkObj [("op", toJson route.family.entry.id.raw),
            ("input", toJson "cat.arrows_groups"), ("args", childPacket.encode)]
          let (_, nested) ← captureMethod session.kernel transaction fun evaluate =>
            session.kernel.child evaluate request transaction reservation scope child
          unless nested.family.route.refs == route.family.route.refs &&
              nested.family.entry.id == route.family.entry.id &&
              sameExactInput nested.receiver invocation.receiver do
            throwError "the named method child changed its complete source family or actual receiver"
          failureAt .malformed do
            discard <| session.kernel.child (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction reservation
              scope (Json.mkObj [("op", toJson route.family.entry.id.raw),
                ("input", toJson "cat.arrows_groups"), ("args", Json.mkObj [
                  ("parameters", .arr #[]), ("prepared_role", toJson ""),
                  ("arguments", .arr #[inputRef #[.field "receiver"]])])])
          failureAt .malformed do
            discard <| session.kernel.child (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction reservation
              scope (Json.mkObj [("op", toJson route.family.entry.id.raw),
                ("input", toJson "cat.arrows_groups"),
                ("args", ({ childPacket with parameters := #[] } : ConstructionInvocation).encode)])
        finally scope.retire
      finally
        discard <| transaction.abort
        session.kernel.ledger.owners.close connection.generation

      -- The rank functor's explicit ring parameter is the actual selected RingCat value.
      -- These independent equal source definitions must retain distinct parameter nodes.
      for text in #["let Qfirst := ℚ in CommutativeRings", "let Qsecond := ℚ in CommutativeRings",
          "let Rfirst := view Qfirst along «fun.commutative_rings.ring»()",
          "let Rsecond := view Qsecond along «fun.commutative_rings.ring»()",
          "let Mfirst := RegularModule(Rfirst)", "let Msecond := RegularModule(Rsecond)"] do
        session ← define session text
      let firstRing ← value session `Rfirst
      let secondRing ← value session `Rsecond
      unless firstRing.value != secondRing.value do
        throwError "the independent ring declarations lost their distinct actual nodes"
      for (text, ring, moduleName) in #[
          ("Mfirst.rank()", firstRing, `Mfirst), ("Msecond.rank()", secondRing, `Msecond)] do
        let term ← readTerm session text
        let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin session.kernel.ledger
        try
          let (request, route) ← prepare session transaction term
          unless route.family.entry.id.raw == "meth.rank" && route.family.route.refs.isEmpty do
            throwError "the rank fixture changed its original owner method"
          let selected ← (← select route #["obj.modules.regular"]).materialize session.kernel
            (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction
          let invocation ← selected.invocation session.kernel (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction
          let #[#[parameter]] := invocation.parameters
            | throwError "the complete rank declaration lost its explicit ring parameter"
          unless sameInput ring parameter && sameInput (← value session moduleName) invocation.receiver do
            throwError "rank framing changed an actual parameter or introduced a synthetic Core input"
          if moduleName == `Mfirst then
            let connection ← session.kernel.ledger.owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
            try
              let graph ← transaction.view
              let .ok (encoded, _) := invocation.encode graph connection.generation
                | throwError "the rank invocation lost its complete encoded inputs"
              let identity : DispatchIdentity := {
                manifestDigest := "method-rank-child-control"
                profileDigest := "no-mathematical-provider"
                registration := {
                  operation := route.family.entry.id.raw
                  input := "obj.modules.regular"
                  backend := "scope-control" } }
              let .ok reservation ← transaction.reserve request.occurrence identity connection
                  (invocation.dependencies.push secondRing)
                | throwError "the rank child lost its original input authority"
              let scope ← RequestScope.issue session.kernel.ledger reservation graph
                (encoded.slots.push secondRing) encoded.inputs #[]
              try
                let parameterPath := #[InputPathStep.field "args", .index 0, .field "args", .index 0]
                let packet : ConstructionInvocation := {
                  construction := route.family.entry.id.raw,
                  parameters := #[routedActionDescriptor (.functor route.family.functor.id)
                    #[inputRef parameterPath]], receiver := inputRef #[.field "receiver"] }
                let child := fun packet => Json.mkObj [("op", toJson route.family.entry.id.raw),
                  ("input", toJson "obj.modules.regular"), ("args", packet)]
                let (childRequest, childRoute) ← captureMethod session.kernel transaction fun evaluate =>
                  session.kernel.child evaluate request transaction reservation scope (child packet.encode)
                let chosen ← (← select childRoute #["obj.modules.regular"]).materialize session.kernel
                  (evaluate session.kernel) childRequest transaction
                let nested ← chosen.invocation session.kernel (evaluate session.kernel)
                  childRequest transaction
                let #[#[nestedRing]] := nested.parameters
                  | throwError "the named rank child lost its original ring input"
                unless sameInput ring nestedRing &&
                    sameExactInput nested.receiver invocation.receiver do
                  throwError "the named rank child replaced an actual input by equal source data"
                let changed := { packet with parameters := #[
                  routedActionDescriptor (.functor route.family.functor.id)
                    #[(ScopedReference.scope encoded.slots.size).encode]] }
                failureAt .malformed do
                  discard <| session.kernel.child (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction
                    reservation scope (child changed.encode)
              finally scope.retire
            finally session.kernel.ledger.owners.close connection.generation
        finally discard <| transaction.abort

      -- A category input need not have its own source-session name. The original receiver's
      -- exact descriptor slot is its authority; evaluating the same closed ring again would
      -- create a different occurrence and is not parameter recovery.
      session ← define session
        "let Mclosed := RegularModule(view (ℚ in CommutativeRings) along «fun.commutative_rings.ring»())"
      let moduleValue ← value session `Mclosed
      let term ← readTerm session "Mclosed.rank()"
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin session.kernel.ledger
      try
        let graph ← transaction.view
        let some node := graph.find moduleValue.value
          | throwError "the closed-parameter module is outside its producing graph"
        let .container packet := node.payload.data
          | throwError "the native RegularModule source lost its original descriptor parameters"
        let #[ringSlot] := packet.slots.filter (·.path == #[.field "args", .index 0])
          | throwError "the native RegularModule descriptor lost its original ring slot"
        unless ringSlot.binding.value != firstRing.value do
          throwError "independent equal ring occurrences were merged before method preparation"
        let (request, route) ← prepare session transaction term
        let selected ← (← select route #["obj.modules.regular"]).materialize session.kernel
          (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction
        let invocation ← selected.invocation session.kernel (evaluate session.kernel) request transaction
        let #[#[parameter]] := invocation.parameters
          | throwError "the closed-parameter rank call lost its full declared functor"
        unless sameInput ringSlot.binding parameter && sameInput moduleValue invocation.receiver do
          throwError "the rank call reconstructed its unbound category parameter from a source term"
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
      -- A morphism method keeps its native Arrow wrapper and the hom producer's exact
      -- category inputs. Forgetting commutativity is a complete input-derived record view.
      for text in #[
          "let firstScalar := ℚ in CommutativeRings",
          "let secondScalar := ℚ in CommutativeRings",
          "let firstRow := [1, 0] in RectangularMatrices(1, 2, firstScalar)",
          "let secondRow := [1, 0] in RectangularMatrices(1, 2, secondScalar)",
          "let firstProjection := row_linear_map(2, firstScalar, firstRow)",
          "let secondProjection := row_linear_map(2, secondScalar, secondRow)"] do
        session ← define session text
      let firstScalar ← value session `firstScalar
      let secondScalar ← value session `secondScalar
      unless firstScalar.value != secondScalar.value do
        throwError "the distinct equal scalar declarations lost their actual occurrences"
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin session.kernel.ledger
      try
        let mut prepared := #[]
        for (text, original, projectionName) in #[
            ("firstProjection.ker()", firstScalar, `firstProjection),
            ("secondProjection.ker()", secondScalar, `secondProjection)] do
          let term ← readTerm session text
          dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] before method preparation {text}"
          let (request, route) ← prepare session transaction term
          dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] after method preparation {text}"
          unless route.family.entry.id.raw == "meth.arrow_ker" && route.family.route.refs.isEmpty do
            throwError "the original module-arrow method changed its selected source route"
          -- The existing hom is selected through its actual Arrow before its producer slots
          -- are read. Publication retains the stored node and its complete baseline chain.
          do
            let graph ← transaction.view
            let .ok (some (stored, remaining)) :=
                graph.projectionFrontier route.receiver #[``CategoryTheory.Comma.hom]
              | throwError "the method lost its original stored Arrow hom"
            let .ok (some published) :=
                graph.projected? route.receiver #[``CategoryTheory.Comma.hom]
              | throwError "the method hom lost its prepared original projection"
            unless remaining.isEmpty && sameInput (← value session projectionName) stored &&
                sameExactInput stored published do
              throwError "the method hom projection changed its original input or baseline"
          let parameter ← withSourceScope request fun context bound =>
            route.environment.withContext context bound fun context bound => do
              let some action := route.actions.back?
                | throwError "the module-arrow method lost its final native action"
              let some actionFamily := route.family.actionFamilies.back?
                | throwError "the method lost its original selected action family"
              unless actionFamily.edge == .functor route.family.functor.id do
                throwError "the method changed its original selected action"
              let #[(_, source)] ← routedActionParameters actionFamily
                  (← action.inContext context)
                | throwError "the module-arrow method lost its original ring parameter"
              dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] before category evaluation {text}"
              let value ← session.kernel.run transaction context bound source
                (selections := ← route.environment.selections.inContext context)
              dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] after category evaluation {text}"
              return value
          let graph ← transaction.view
          let some node := graph.find parameter.value
            | throwError "the native ring view is outside its producing graph"
          let some application := node.origin.application
            | throwError "the native ring view lost its certified original application"
          let #[some actual] := application.arguments
            | throwError "the native ring view changed its original scalar input position"
          unless sameInput original actual do
            throwError "the native ring view reconstructed an equal scalar occurrence"
          prepared := prepared.push (request, route, parameter)
        let #[(request, route, original), (_, _, other)] := prepared
          | throwError "the original scalar controls lost a complete method preparation"
        withSourceScope request fun context bound =>
          route.environment.withContext context bound fun context bound => do
            let some action := route.actions.back?
              | throwError "the original method lost its parameter source"
            let some actionFamily := route.family.actionFamilies.back?
              | throwError "the method lost its original selected action family"
            unless actionFamily.edge == .functor route.family.functor.id do
              throwError "the method changed its original selected action"
            let #[(_, source)] ← routedActionParameters actionFamily
                (← action.inContext context)
              | throwError "the original method lost its single native category parameter"
            -- The native Ring instance is the declared projection of this same bound
            -- RingCat source. Mathematical shape checking preserves its original form.
            let graph ← transaction.view
            let environment ← RuntimeEnvironment.captureBound route.environment.worker
              context bound graph (some route.environment)
              (← route.environment.selections.inContext context)
            do
              context.withOriginalSources #[source] fun originals => do
                let nativeSource ← sourceDomain originals[0]!
                unless nativeSource.getAppFn.isConstOf ``RingCat.of do
                  throwError "the native category view lost its original RingCat.of source"
                let #[_, _] := nativeSource.getAppArgs
                  | throwError "the native ring view lost its original structure argument"
              let structureSource ← mkAppM ``RingCat.ring #[source]
              let path := #[``CommRingCat.commRing, ``CommRing.toRing]
              let .ok (some originalStructure) := graph.projectedAccess? firstScalar path
                | throwError "the first scalar lost its published native ring access"
              let .ok (some otherStructure) := graph.projectedAccess? secondScalar path
                | throwError "the second scalar lost its published native ring access"
              dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] before original structure admission"
              environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph structureSource originalStructure
              dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] after original structure admission"
              dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] before wrong structure negative"
              let changedFailure : Option Exception ← try
                environment.checkDeclaredInput context graph structureSource otherStructure
                pure none
              catch error => pure (some error)
              dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] after wrong structure negative rejected={changedFailure.isSome}"
              let some changedFailure := changedFailure
                | throwError "an equal scalar satisfied another scalar's wrapped native field"
              unless changedFailure.toMessageData.hasTag
                  (· == `CasRuntime.RuntimeEnvironment.dependentReferenceMismatch) do
                throw changedFailure
            let evaluate := fun (current : OpenContext)
                (supplied : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
                (selections : SourceSelectionScope Expr) (expression : Expr) => do
              let selections ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections
                (← environment.selections.inContext current)
              session.kernel.run transaction current supplied expression (selections := selections)
            dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] before original parameter admission"
            withBoundValue session.kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound source original
              fun context bound supplied =>
                environment.methodParameters context bound transaction
                  session.kernel.ledger.allocate route.family #[supplied] route.receiver evaluate
                  fun context bound selections parameters => do
                    let #[retained] := parameters
                      | throwError "the retained category parameter changed its original arity"
                    unless sameExactInput original (← evaluate context bound selections retained) do
                      throwError "rechecking a native category view replaced its original occurrence"
            dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] after original parameter admission"
            dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] before wrong parameter negative"
            let failure : Option Exception ← try
              withBoundValue session.kernel.ledger.owners.identities context bound source other
                fun context bound changed =>
                  environment.methodParameters context bound transaction
                    session.kernel.ledger.allocate route.family #[changed] route.receiver evaluate
                    fun _ _ _ _ => pure ()
              pure none
            catch error => pure (some error)
            dbg_trace "[routed.scalar] after wrong parameter negative rejected={failure.isSome}"
            let some failure := failure
              | throwError "a separately produced equal scalar satisfied the original category input"
            let message ← failure.toMessageData.toString
            unless message.endsWith "the input result changed its original selected occurrence" ||
                failure.toMessageData.hasTag (· == `CasRuntime.RuntimeEnvironment.sourceReferenceMismatch) do
              throw failure
      finally discard <| transaction.abort
      unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "the source/packet controls dispatched a mathematical provider"
    finally session.close
  finally setEnv environment

end CasRuntime.RoutedMethodTests

module

import CasRuntime.Transport
import CasRuntime.Encode
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Transport
meta import CasRuntime.Encode

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasRuntime CasCatalogue.Backend

/- The actual public SDK preserves input references through the native transport.
This observes protocol/owner transitions, not a mathematical computation.
Reuse: the pinned SDK project, OwnerRegistry, FramedConnection and RequestScope. -/
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| packageDir contractPackage
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let .ok wire ← liftM (m := IO) <| FramedConnection.start owners "selected-backend" {
        cmd := (contract / ".venv/bin/python").toString
        args := #[(root / "scripts/probes/protocol_v2_peer.py").toString]
        env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some (contract / "python").toString)] } 5000
      | throwError "the public Python SDK did not negotiate through the native connection"
    try
      let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
      let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
      let layout ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
      let binding ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
        { occurrence, program, role := layout, parameters := #[] }
        (ValuePayload.portable "retained traffic data".toUTF8)
      let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "sdk-traffic-manifest", profileDigest := "sdk-traffic-profile"
        registration := {
          operation := "references", input := "traffic#input", backend := "selected-backend" } }
      let .ok reservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
          transaction.reserve occurrence selected wire.connection #[binding]
        | throwError "the public SDK invocation could not reserve"
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[]
        #[{ path := #[.field "item"], binding }] #[]
      let .ok reply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger transaction reservation scope
          (Json.mkObj [("item", .str "retained traffic data")]) 5000
        | throwError "the public SDK did not return the original complete input reference"
      unless reply.references.size == 1 && reply.exports.isEmpty do
        throwError "the SDK replaced an input reference with a new native export"
      let some reference := reply.references[0]?
        | throwError "the SDK input reference was not resolved"
      unless reference.binding.value == binding.value do
        throwError "the SDK input reference changed its actual runtime node"
      let .ok dependencies := graph.requiredOwners #[reference.binding]
        | throwError "the original input node is outside the current graph"
      unless dependencies.isEmpty do
        throwError "the returning SDK acquired ownership of an independent portable input"
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) transaction.abort
      liftM (m := IO) do
        for _ in [:1000] do
          unless ← wire.isDraining do break
          IO.sleep 1
        if ← wire.isDraining then throw <| IO.userError "the SDK cleanup did not settle"
        unless (← wire.cleanupFailures).isEmpty do
          throw <| IO.userError "the native SDK rejected request-local cleanup"
      let later ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let next ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let .ok reserved ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| later.reserve next
          { selected with registration := { selected.registration with operation := "echo" } }
          wire.connection #[]
        | throwError "cleanup revoked the unrelated later SDK invocation"
      let current ← liftM (m := IO) later.view
      let nextScope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger reserved current #[] #[] #[]
      let .ok response ← liftM (m := IO) <|
          wire.invokeBefore ledger later reserved nextScope (.str "after cleanup") 5000
        | throwError "the same supplying SDK connection was unavailable after cleanup"
      unless response.value == .str "after cleanup" && response.requestId > reply.requestId do
        throwError "cleanup changed later traffic or reused its transport identity"
      let storedOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let .ok storedReservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| later.reserve storedOccurrence
          { selected with registration := { selected.registration with operation := "stored" } }
          wire.connection #[]
        | throwError "the native callable producer could not reserve"
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) later.view
      let storedScope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger storedReservation graph #[] #[] #[]
      let .ok produced ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger later storedReservation
          storedScope (.str "actual retained handler") 5000
        | throwError "the actual SDK did not return its stored callable"
      let some exported := produced.exports[0]?
        | throwError "the native callable has no actual SDK export declaration"
      let callableRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkConst ``Nat.succ))
      let callable ← liftM (m := IO) <| later.stage
        { program, occurrence := storedOccurrence, role := callableRole, parameters := #[] }
        (.ownedExport wire.connection exported.token exported.captures)
      let operand ← liftM (m := IO) <| later.stage
        { program, occurrence := storedOccurrence, role := layout, parameters := #[] }
        (.portable "7".toUTF8)
      let .ok wrapper := ValuePayload.container (.str "retained callable wrapper") #[] #[]
        (some callable)
        | throwError "the retained native callable wrapper could not form"
      let retainedCallable ← liftM (m := IO) <| later.stage
        { program, occurrence := storedOccurrence, role := callableRole, parameters := #[] } wrapper
      let nativeOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) later.view
      let .ok actual := RuntimeArgument.ofValue graph 0 operand
        | throwError "the native source argument is outside its graph"
      let nativeRequest ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program nativeOccurrence context retainedCallable
        #[← context.close (mkNatLit 7)] #[actual] #[]
      let nativeInputs ← nativeRequest.admitInputs graph
      let nativeArguments ← IO.ofExcept <| (nativeInputs.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
      let .ok other ← liftM (m := IO) <| FramedConnection.start owners "selected-backend" {
          cmd := (contract / ".venv/bin/python").toString
          args := #[(root / "scripts/probes/protocol_v2_peer.py").toString]
          env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some (contract / "python").toString)] } 5000
        | throwError "the distinct native-owner control did not negotiate"
      try
        match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
            later.reserveExport nativeOccurrence retainedCallable other.connection nativeArguments with
        | .error (.reservation .wrongConnection) => pure ()
        | _ => throwError "a matching backend name redirected a retained native export"
      finally liftM (m := IO) other.close
      let .ok native ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
          later.reserveExport nativeOccurrence retainedCallable wire.connection nativeArguments
        | throwError "the retained native export could not reserve on its actual owner"
      unless native.selected == .native callable.value exported.token &&
          native.connection == exported.owner do
        throwError "native reservation replaced its actual code, token or supplying owner"
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) later.view
      let (admitted, encoded) ← nativeRequest.encodeArguments graph wire.connection.generation
        #[.field "arguments"]
      let some role := nativeRequest.roles.arguments[0]?
        | throwError "the source argument role is absent"
      let .ok bound := admitted.lookup graph role.role.id
        | throwError "the native input role lost its admitted binding"
      unless bound.value.value == operand.value && bound.source == .argument 0 do
        throwError "native argument encoding changed its source role or actual input"
      let nativeScope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger native graph encoded.slots encoded.inputs #[]
      let invocation := Json.mkObj [
        ("kind", .str "dependent"), ("prepared_role", .str "native-transport-control"),
        ("parameters", .arr #[]), ("bindings", .arr #[]),
        ("arguments", .arr encoded.values),
        ("argument_layouts", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("kind", .str "data")]]),
        ("result_layout", Json.mkObj [("kind", .str "data")])]
      let .ok invoked ← liftM (m := IO) <|
          wire.invokeBefore ledger later native nativeScope invocation 5000
        | throwError "native transport did not invoke the actual retained SDK handler"
      unless (invoked.value.getObjValAs? String "stored").toOption ==
          some "actual retained handler" do
        throwError "native invocation selected a different stored handler"
      let .ok encodedContext := invoked.value.getObjValAs? String "context"
        | throwError "the stored native handler did not receive its invocation context"
      unless (Json.parse encodedContext).toOption == some invocation do
        throwError "native transport changed the complete invocation context"
      unless encoded.values == #[toJson (7 : Nat)] &&
          invoked.references.map (·.binding.value) == #[operand.value] do
        throwError "native input encoding changed actual packet data or returned input identity"
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
          later.reserveExport nativeOccurrence retainedCallable wire.connection #[operand] with
      | .error (.reservation .consumed) => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "a native invocation acquired a second dispatch right"
      -- A record projection has no current arguments. Its producing application's
      -- original operand remains provenance, without entering the invocation telescope.
      let recordTerm ← Elab.Term.elabTermAndSynthesize
        (← `(fun (value : Nat) => (value, value))) none
      let recordFunction ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close recordTerm)
      let producer ← liftM (m := IO) <| later.stage
        { program, occurrence := storedOccurrence, role := recordFunction, parameters := #[] }
        (.closure program #[])
      let recordOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let application ← PreparedRequest.forApplication owners.identities program recordOccurrence
        context producer #[layout.source] #[actual] #[]
      unless (argumentLayouts application).size == 1 do
        throwError "the native record control lost its producing argument layout"
      let record ← liftM (m := IO) <| later.stage application.origin
        (.ownedExport wire.connection exported.token exported.captures)
      let projectionOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) later.view
      let projection ← PreparedRequest.forProjection owners.identities program projectionOccurrence
        context graph record 0 #[]
      let some sourceApplication := projection.origin.application
        | throwError "native projection discarded its producing application provenance"
      unless sourceApplication.arguments.map (·.map (·.value)) == #[some operand.value] &&
          sourceApplication.callable.map (·.value) == some producer.value &&
          sourceApplication.path == #[``Prod.fst] &&
          projection.origin.access.map (·.value) == some record.value &&
          projection.origin.accessPath == #[``Prod.fst] do
        throwError "native projection changed its original argument, callable or field access"
      let admitted ← projection.admitInputs graph
      let arguments ← IO.ofExcept <| (admitted.arguments graph).mapError IO.userError
      let roots : Array InputPosition := arguments.mapIdx fun index binding =>
        { path := #[.field "arguments", .index index], binding }
      let .ok encoded := graph.encodeExportInputs wire.connection.generation record roots
        | throwError "the retained native projection could not encode its current inputs"
      let .ok reservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
          later.reserveExport projectionOccurrence record wire.connection arguments
        | throwError "the retained native record projection could not reserve"
      let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph encoded.slots encoded.inputs #[]
      let invocation := dependentContext "native-projection-control" #[] #[] encoded.values
        (argumentLayouts projection) projection.source
      let projected ← match ← liftM (m := IO) <|
          wire.invokeBefore ledger later reservation scope invocation 5000 with
        | .ok reply => pure reply
        | .error failure => throwError "native projection SDK invocation failed: {failure.render}"
      let .ok receivedContext := projected.value.getObjValAs? String "context"
        | throwError "the native projection handler did not receive its invocation context"
      unless (projected.value.getObjValAs? String "stored").toOption ==
          some "actual retained handler" &&
          (Json.parse receivedContext).toOption == some invocation &&
          projected.references.isEmpty && encoded.values.isEmpty &&
          (argumentLayouts projection).isEmpty && projection.application.isNone do
        throwError "native projection mixed its producing arguments with its current invocation"
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) later.abort
    finally liftM (m := IO) wire.close
  finally setEnv environment

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- An exact complete input position already retained by the request encoder. -/
structure InputPosition where
  path : Array InputPathStep
  binding : ValueBinding

private def sameDispatch (left right : DispatchReservation) : Bool :=
  left.occurrence == right.occurrence && left.transaction == right.transaction &&
    left.connection == right.connection && left.selected == right.selected

/-- Active request authority stores references and roles, with no completed payload cache. -/
structure RequestScope where
  private mk ::
  id : RuntimeId .scope
  reservation : DispatchReservation
  slots : Array ValueBinding
  captureCount : Nat
  inputs : Array InputPosition
  priorResults : Array ValueBinding
  private ledger : OccurrenceLedger
  private active : Std.Mutex Bool

def RequestScope.wireId (scope : RequestScope) : String :=
  s!"{scope.id.worker}:{scope.id.serial}"

private def RequestScope.issueWith (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (reservation : DispatchReservation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (captures slots : Array ValueBinding) (inputs : Array InputPosition)
    (priorResults : Array ValueBinding) : IO RequestScope := do
  let slots := captures ++ slots
  let mut paths : Array (Array InputPathStep) := #[]
  for input in inputs do
    if paths.contains input.path then
      throw <| IO.userError "a request input position has duplicate authority"
    paths := paths.push input.path
  let required ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners
    (slots ++ inputs.map (·.binding) ++ priorResults)).mapError IO.userError
  unless required.all reservation.dependencies.contains do
    throw <| IO.userError "the request scope has an owner outside its reservation"
  return ⟨← ledger.owners.identities.fresh .scope, reservation, slots, captures.size, inputs, priorResults,
    ledger, ← Std.Mutex.new true⟩

private def RequestScope.checkPending (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (reservation : DispatchReservation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) : IO Unit := do
  unless graph.worker == ledger.owners.worker do
    throw <| IO.userError "the request scope belongs to a different worker"
  let some pending ← ledger.pendingFor reservation.occurrence reservation.transaction
    | throw <| IO.userError "the request scope has no pending invocation"
  unless sameDispatch pending reservation do
    throw <| IO.userError "the request scope changed its dispatch identity"

/-- Issue fresh authority for an actual pending invocation and exact retained positions.
Reuse: the worker identity supply, occurrence ledger and immutable value-graph visibility checks. -/
opaque RequestScope.issue (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (reservation : DispatchReservation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (slots : Array ValueBinding) (inputs : Array InputPosition)
    (priorResults : Array ValueBinding) : IO RequestScope := do
  RequestScope.checkPending ledger reservation graph
  let captures ← match reservation.selected with
    | .primitive _ => pure #[]
    | .native code token => do
      let some node := graph.find code
        | throw <| IO.userError "the native code is outside the request graph"
      let .ownedToken owner actual captures := node.payload.data
        | throw <| IO.userError "the native code has no stored export"
      unless owner == reservation.connection && actual == token do
        throw <| IO.userError "the native capture table changed its supplying export"
      pure captures
  RequestScope.issueWith ledger reservation graph captures slots inputs priorResults

/-- Issue the scope of a resume request: exactly the captures declared by the suspension,
then the ordered child results, numbered from zero (python-sdk.md, "Generator suspension"), with
the completed prefix of a following group's results. The suspended invocation's own native
export captures are not part of it. -/
opaque RequestScope.issueResume (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) (reservation : DispatchReservation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (slots priorResults : Array ValueBinding) : IO RequestScope := do
  RequestScope.checkPending ledger reservation graph
  RequestScope.issueWith ledger reservation graph #[] slots #[] priorResults

private def RequestScope.lookup (scope : RequestScope) (reference : ScopedReference) :
    Except String ValueBinding := do
  match reference with
  | .scope slot =>
    let some binding := scope.slots[slot]? | throw "the scope slot is outside this request"
    return binding
  | .input path =>
    let some position := scope.inputs.find? (·.path == path)
      | throw "the input reference is not a retained complete typed position"
    return position.binding
  | .result index =>
    let some binding := scope.priorResults[index]?
      | throw "the result reference is self, forward or outside the completed prefix"
    return binding

/-- Resolve only within this live invocation, then verify visibility in the supplied graph.
The scope's metadata cannot recover values absent from that Environment/transaction graph. -/
opaque RequestScope.resolveMany (scope : RequestScope) (actual : DispatchReservation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (wireId : String) (references : Array ScopedReference) :
    IO (Array ValueBinding) :=
  scope.active.atomically do
    unless ← get do throw <| IO.userError "the request scope has retired"
    unless wireId == scope.wireId && sameDispatch actual scope.reservation do
      throw <| IO.userError "the reference belongs to a different request scope"
    let some pending ← scope.ledger.pendingFor actual.occurrence actual.transaction
      | throw <| IO.userError "the scoped invocation has settled"
    unless sameDispatch pending actual do
      throw <| IO.userError "the scoped invocation changed its dispatch identity"
    unless graph.worker == scope.id.worker do
      throw <| IO.userError "the scoped value graph belongs to a different worker"
    let bindings ← references.mapM fun reference =>
      IO.ofExcept <| (scope.lookup reference).mapError IO.userError
    discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners bindings).mapError IO.userError
    return bindings

/-- Capture exact addresses in order. Distinct addresses keep their roles even when values alias. -/
opaque RequestScope.capture (scope : RequestScope) (actual : DispatchReservation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (wireId : String) (references : Array ScopedReference) :
    IO (Array ValueBinding) := do
  let mut seen : Array ScopedReference := #[]
  for reference in references do
    if seen.contains reference then
      throw <| IO.userError "a capture address is repeated"
    seen := seen.push reference
  scope.resolveMany actual graph wireId references

/-- Retire authority independently of semantic snapshots and retained value identity. -/
opaque RequestScope.retire (scope : RequestScope) : BaseIO Unit :=
  scope.active.atomically (set false)

end CasRuntime

public import CasContract.Port

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean CasCatalogue.Backend

inductive ScopedReference
  | scope (slot : Nat)
  | input (path : Array InputPathStep)
  | result (index : Nat)
  deriving BEq, Repr

def ScopedReference.encode : ScopedReference → Json
  | .scope slot => Json.mkObj [("ctor", .str "scopeRef"), ("args", .arr #[toJson slot])]
  | .input path => inputRef path
  | .result index => resultRef index

/-- The existing released reference grammar, independent of live request authority.
Parsing supplies no binding; RequestScope resolves the original position separately. -/
def ScopedReference.parse? (json : Json) : Except String (Option ScopedReference) := do
  if (json.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "scopeRef" then
    checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] json
    let #[slot] ← (← json.getObjVal? "args").getArr?
      | throw "a scope reference requires exactly one slot"
    return some (.scope (← slot.getNat?))
  if let some path ← inputRefPath? json then return some (.input path)
  if let some index ← resultRefIndex? json then return some (.result index)
  return none

end CasRuntime

import CasRuntime.Scope
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Scope

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasRuntime

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
  let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 7]
  let record ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close pair)
  let recordLayout ← RecordLayout.ofSource record
  let some field := record.fields[0]? | throwError "the source field control is missing"
  let fieldRole ← field.toLayout
  liftM (m := IO) do
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← OccurrenceLedger.new owners
    let program ← owners.identities.fresh .program
    let transaction ← owners.identities.fresh .transaction
    let producerOccurrence ← ledger.allocate
    let (graph, original) ← (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities).stage owners.identities
      { program, occurrence := producerOccurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable "scope payload".toUTF8)
    let retained ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.rebind original fieldRole).mapError IO.userError
    let child ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      child.child.stdin.putStr "scope channel\n"
      child.child.stdin.flush
      unless (← child.child.stdout.getLine) == "scope channel\n" do
        throw <| IO.userError "the scope connection lost its actual channel"
      let occurrence ← ledger.allocate
      let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "resource-test-manifest"
        registration := { operation := "resource-test", input := "resource-test", backend := "cat" }
        profileDigest := "resource-test-profile" }
      let .ok reservation ← ledger.reserve occurrence transaction selected child graph #[original]
        | throw <| IO.userError "the request scope could not reserve its invocation"
      let scope ← RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[original, retained]
        #[{ path := #[.field "argument"], binding := retained }] #[original]
      let refs := #[ScopedReference.scope 0, .scope 1, .input #[.field "argument"], .result 0]
      for reference in refs do
        let parsed ← IO.ofExcept <| (ScopedReference.parse? reference.encode).mapError IO.userError
        unless parsed == some reference do
          throw <| IO.userError "a public reference changed through wire encoding"
      let values ← scope.resolveMany reservation graph scope.wireId refs
      unless values.size == 4 && values.all (fun value => value.value == original.value) do
        throw <| IO.userError "scope resolution replaced an actual retained value"
      let some first := values[0]? | throw <| IO.userError "the first scope role is missing"
      let some second := values[1]? | throw <| IO.userError "the second scope role is missing"
      unless first.role.address.isEmpty && second.role.address == #[``Prod.fst] do
        throw <| IO.userError "scope resolution merged aliased consuming roles"
      let captures ← scope.capture reservation graph scope.wireId #[.scope 0, .scope 1]
      unless captures.size == 2 do
        throw <| IO.userError "capture validation merged distinct scope addresses"
      let fields ← RecordPrefix.begin owners.identities program producerOccurrence recordLayout
      let (extended, _, associated) ← fields.bind graph original
      let fieldScope ← RequestScope.issue ledger reservation extended #[associated] #[] #[]
      let visible ← fieldScope.resolveMany reservation extended fieldScope.wireId #[.scope 0]
      unless visible.map (·.value) == #[original.value] do
        throw <| IO.userError "the field scope replaced its original node"
      let outsideAssociation ← try
        discard <| fieldScope.resolveMany reservation graph fieldScope.wireId #[.scope 0]
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
      unless outsideAssociation do
        throw <| IO.userError "scope metadata recovered a field association outside its snapshot"
      fieldScope.retire
      let badRefs := #[ScopedReference.scope 2, .input #[.field "argument", .index 0], .result 1]
      for reference in badRefs do
        let rejected ← try
          discard <| scope.resolveMany reservation graph scope.wireId #[reference]
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
        unless rejected do throw <| IO.userError "scope resolution admitted an unretained position"
      let duplicate ← try
        discard <| scope.capture reservation graph scope.wireId #[.scope 0, .scope 0]
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
      unless duplicate do throw <| IO.userError "capture validation accepted a repeated address"
      let wrongScope ← try
        discard <| scope.resolveMany reservation graph "different scope" #[.scope 0]
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
      unless wrongScope do throw <| IO.userError "a reference escaped its issued scope"
      let outside ← try
        discard <| scope.resolveMany reservation (ValueGraph.empty owners.identities)
          scope.wireId #[.scope 0]
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
      unless outside do throw <| IO.userError "scope metadata recovered an invisible payload"
      let malformed := Json.mkObj [
        ("ctor", .str "scopeRef"), ("args", .arr #[toJson (0 : Nat)]), ("owner", .str "claimed")]
      match ScopedReference.parse? malformed with
      | .error _ => pure ()
      | .ok _ => throw <| IO.userError "a reserved reference accepted an unknown control field"
      scope.retire
      let expired ← try
        discard <| scope.resolveMany reservation graph scope.wireId #[.scope 0]
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
      unless expired do throw <| IO.userError "a retired scope retained reference authority"
      let next ← ledger.allocate
      let .ok nextReservation ← ledger.reserve next transaction selected child graph #[original]
        | throw <| IO.userError "the fresh invocation could not reserve"
      let fresh ← RequestScope.issue ledger nextReservation graph captures #[] #[]
      if fresh.id == scope.id then throw <| IO.userError "a fresh invocation reused its scope identity"
      let mismatch ← try
        discard <| fresh.resolveMany reservation graph fresh.wireId #[.scope 0]
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
      unless mismatch do throw <| IO.userError "a scope accepted another invocation's authority"
      discard <| ledger.retire nextReservation
      let settled ← try
        discard <| fresh.resolveMany nextReservation graph fresh.wireId #[.scope 0]
        pure false
      catch _ => pure true
      unless settled do throw <| IO.userError "a settled invocation retained scope authority"
      discard <| ledger.retire reservation
    finally owners.close child.generation
