/- The original group-kernel continuations in
tests/acceptance/b0-required-positives.cas.proposed require the actual group declared as S3.
All declarations and questions below are unchanged source inputs. With no provider installed,
each question must reach its published group-arrow-kernel operation. No cardinality answer is
computed or supplied by this engineering regression. -/
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let manifest := root / ".tmp" / "session-dependent-reference-empty-leaves.json"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile manifest
      (Json.mkObj [("backends", .arr #[]), ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
    let mut session ← KernelSession.start (some manifest) (computationOnly := true)
    try
      let declarations := #[
        "let S3 := Sym(3) in Groups",
        "let C3 := ZMod(3) in Groups",
        "let sigma := sign(3)",
        "let zero_map := trivial(S3, ZMod(2) in Groups)",
        "let identity_map := id(S3)"]
      let mut failures : Array String := #[]
      let mut originalS3 : Option (BindingId × ValueBinding) := none
      for text in declarations, index in [:declarations.size] do
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the original declaration did not parse: {error}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" do
          throwError "`{text}` is {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail}), not holds"
        session := run.session
        if index == 0 then
          let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
            | throwError "the S3 declaration did not publish its source binding"
          unless entry.userName == `S3 do
            throwError "the first original declaration did not publish S3"
          match session.value? entry.id with
          | none =>
            failures := failures.push
              "the successful S3 declaration discarded its actual runtime reference"
          | some binding => originalS3 := some (entry.id, binding)
        if let some (id, original) := originalS3 then
          match session.value? id with
          | none =>
            failures := failures.push s!"`{text}` discarded the retained S3 reference"
          | some current =>
            unless current.value == original.value &&
                current.associationIds == original.associationIds do
              failures := failures.push s!"`{text}` replaced S3's retained occurrence"
            unless ((← SessionSnapshot.current).graph.find current.value).isSome do
              failures := failures.push s!"`{text}` retained S3 outside the committed graph"
      -- Collect all three outcomes before reporting failures, so a broken trivial-map
      -- continuation cannot prevent the unchanged identity-map continuation from executing.
      for text in #["assert |sigma.ker()| = 3", "assert |zero_map.ker()| = 6",
          "assert |identity_map.ker()| = 1"] do
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the original kernel question did not parse: {error}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "gap" &&
            (run.outcome.detail.splitOn "NoImplementation").length > 1 &&
            (run.outcome.detail.splitOn "meth.group_arrow_kernel").length > 1 do
          failures := failures.push
            s!"`{text}` did not reach the published kernel operation: \
              {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail})"
        session := run.session
        if let some (id, original) := originalS3 then
          match session.value? id with
          | none => failures := failures.push s!"`{text}` discarded the retained S3 reference"
          | some current =>
            unless current.value == original.value &&
                current.associationIds == original.associationIds do
              failures := failures.push s!"`{text}` replaced S3's retained occurrence"
      unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        failures := failures.push "the empty-provider control dispatched a provider operation"
      unless failures.isEmpty do
        let detail := "\n".intercalate failures.toList
        throwError "source-dependent session regressions:\n{detail}"
    finally liftM (m := IO) session.close
  finally setEnv environment

/- A provider's deliberately incorrect scalar reply must remain observable through source
aliases. This uses the existing integer-addition protocol peer with an explicit test-only fault;
it neither supplies an independent mathematical implementation nor changes the peer's default
answers. The ordinary proof-discharge path must not replace observed data by its source term. -/
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| CasCatalogue.Backend.packageDir
      CasCatalogue.Backend.contractPackage
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    let python := (← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
    let peer := root / "scripts/probes/kernel_session_peer.py"
    let manifest := Json.mkObj [
      ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "peer"), ("command", python.toString),
        ("args", .arr #[toJson peer.toString, toJson ("--corrupt-add" : String)])]]),
      ("registrations", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("operation", "op.rings.add"),
        ("input", "op.rings.add#input"), ("backend", "peer")]])]
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let path := root / ".tmp" / "session-dependent-reference-corrupt-leaves.json"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
    let mut session ← KernelSession.start (some path)
    try
      let mut failures : Array String := #[]
      let mut original : Option (BindingId × ValueBinding) := none
      let expected : Array (String × String) := #[
        ("let a := 17 + 29 in ℤ", "holds"),
        ("assert a = 46 in ℤ", "wrong"),
        ("assert (a = 46 in ℤ) using (proof(rfl))", "wrong"),
        ("let copy := a", "holds"),
        ("let copy2 := copy", "holds"),
        ("assert copy2 = 46 in ℤ", "wrong"),
        ("assert (copy2 = 46 in ℤ) using (proof(rfl))", "wrong")]
      for (text, kind) in expected do
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the scalar observation control did not parse: {error}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == kind do
          failures := failures.push
            s!"`{text}` is {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail}), not {kind}"
        session := run.session
        if (text.splitOn "using (proof").length > 1 then
          unless run.published && run.conclusions.any (·.proof.isSome) do
            failures := failures.push
              s!"`{text}` did not retain source evidence through actual candidate observation"
        if text.startsWith "let" then
          let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
            | throwError "the scalar observation control lost its declared source binding"
          match session.value? entry.id with
          | none =>
            failures := failures.push s!"`{text}` discarded the actual scalar reference"
          | some binding =>
            match original with
            | none =>
              unless entry.userName == `a do
                throwError "the scalar observation control lost its original provider result"
              original := some (entry.id, binding)
            | some (_, actual) =>
              unless binding.value == actual.value &&
                  actual.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf binding.associationIds.toList do
                failures := failures.push s!"`{text}` replaced the actual provider result"
            unless ((← SessionSnapshot.current).graph.find binding.value).isSome do
              failures := failures.push s!"`{text}` retained a scalar outside the committed graph"
        if let some (id, actual) := original then
          match session.value? id with
          | none => failures := failures.push s!"`{text}` discarded the original scalar reference"
          | some binding =>
            unless binding.value == actual.value &&
                binding.associationIds == actual.associationIds do
              failures := failures.push s!"`{text}` changed the original scalar reference"
      let dispatched := (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).map (·.operation)
      unless dispatched == #["op.rings.add"] do
        failures := failures.push
          s!"the scalar observation control dispatched {dispatched}, not exactly one addition"
      unless failures.isEmpty do
        let detail := "\n".intercalate failures.toList
        throwError "source-alias observation regressions:\n{detail}"
    finally liftM (m := IO) session.close
  finally setEnv environment

/- Equal native endpoint expressions still name distinct declared runtime occurrences.
The trivial map uses both original source positions. A consuming dependent reference must
select its own binding, rather than every context binding definitionally equal to that field.
The implementation query forces the existing kernel continuation without a cardinality answer. -/
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let manifest := root / ".tmp" / "session-distinct-endpoints-empty-leaves.json"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile manifest
      (Json.mkObj [("backends", .arr #[]), ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
    let mut session ← KernelSession.start (some manifest) (computationOnly := true)
    try
      let declarations : Array (Name × String) := #[
        (`S3, "let S3 := Sym(3) in Groups"),
        (`S3again, "let S3again := Sym(3) in Groups"),
        (`equal_ends, "let equal_ends := trivial(S3, S3again)")]
      let mut endpoints : Array (BindingId × ValueBinding) := #[]
      for (name, text) in declarations do
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the distinct-endpoint declaration did not parse: {error}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" do
          throwError "`{text}` is {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail}), not holds"
        session := run.session
        let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
          | throwError "the distinct-endpoint declaration lost its source binding"
        unless entry.userName == name do
          throwError "the distinct-endpoint declaration published a different name"
        if name != `equal_ends then
          let some binding := session.value? entry.id
            | throwError "the declared endpoint has no actual runtime reference"
          endpoints := endpoints.push (entry.id, binding)
        for (id, original) in endpoints do
          let some current := session.value? id
            | throwError "a later declaration discarded an original endpoint"
          unless current.value == original.value &&
              current.associationIds == original.associationIds do
            throwError "a later declaration replaced an original endpoint occurrence"
      let #[(sourceId, sourceValue), (targetId, targetValue)] := endpoints
        | throwError "the distinct-endpoint control lost one of its two original endpoints"
      if sourceId == targetId || sourceValue.value == targetValue.value then
        throwError "equal source definitions merged their distinct binding or value identities"
      session.source.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
        let some source := bindings.find? (·.id == sourceId)
          | throwError "the source endpoint is outside its original context"
        let some target := bindings.find? (·.id == targetId)
          | throwError "the target endpoint is outside its original context"
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        unless ← context.withOriginalSources #[source.expression, target.expression]
            (fun original => isDefEq original[0]! original[1]!) do
          throwError "the distinct-endpoint control no longer has equal native source definitions"
      let text := "assert implemented |equal_ends.ker()|"
      let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
        | .ok statement => pure statement
        | .error error => throwError "the distinct-endpoint continuation did not parse: {error}"
      let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
      session := run.session
      for (id, original) in endpoints do
        let some current := session.value? id
          | throwError "the kernel continuation discarded an original endpoint"
        unless current.value == original.value &&
            current.associationIds == original.associationIds &&
            ((← SessionSnapshot.current).graph.find current.value).isSome do
          throwError "the kernel continuation replaced or detached an original endpoint"
      unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "the distinct-endpoint empty-provider control dispatched an operation"
      unless run.outcome.kind == "gap" &&
          (run.outcome.detail.splitOn "NoImplementation").length > 1 &&
          (run.outcome.detail.splitOn "meth.group_arrow_kernel").length > 1 do
        throwError "`{text}` did not reach the published kernel operation: \
          {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail})"
    finally liftM (m := IO) session.close
  finally setEnv environment

-- The same original equal-endpoint declarations now reach the public session's actual
-- fixed-result admission. The peer supplies opaque native fields and changes only the
-- scoped ambient reference. Admission claims no computed group-theoretic equation.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  let root ← IO.currentDir
  let contract ← CasCatalogue.Backend.packageDir CasCatalogue.Backend.contractPackage
  let python := (← IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
  let logDirectory : System.FilePath :=
    (← IO.getEnv "CAS_APPLICATION_LOG_DIR").getD "timing/application"
  for mode in #["left", "right"] do
    try
      let nonce := (← IO.FS.readFile "/proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid").trimAscii.toString
      let evidence := logDirectory / "controls" / nonce
      IO.FS.createDirAll evidence
      let traffic := evidence / "peer.jsonl"
      IO.FS.writeFile traffic ""
      let operation := "meth.group_arrow_kernel"
      let manifest := Json.mkObj [
        ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "fixed-group-kernel-peer"),
          ("command", toJson python.toString),
          ("args", toJson #[(root / "scripts/probes/kernel_session_peer.py").toString,
            "--fixed-group-kernel", mode, traffic.toString])]]),
        ("registrations", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("operation", toJson operation),
          ("input", "cat.arrows_groups"), ("backend", "fixed-group-kernel-peer")]])]
      let path := evidence / "leaves.json"
      IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
      let initial ← KernelSession.start (some path) (computationOnly := true)
      try
        unless initial.kernel.rejected.isEmpty do
          throwError "the public fixed-input registration was rejected: {initial.kernel.rejected}"
        let runStatement := fun (session : KernelSession) (text : String) => do
          let .ok statement := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text
            | throwError "the public fixed-input statement did not parse: {text}"
          withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        let mut session := initial
        let mut endpoints : Array (BindingId × ValueBinding) := #[]
        for (name, text) in #[
            (`S3, "let S3 := Sym(3) in Groups"),
            (`S3again, "let S3again := Sym(3) in Groups"),
            (`equal_ends, "let equal_ends := trivial(S3, S3again)")] do
          let run ← runStatement session text
          unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" && run.attempted && run.published do
            throwError "the public fixed-input declaration did not commit: {text}: {run.outcome.detail}"
          session := run.session
          let #[entry] := session.source.context.entries.filter (·.userName == name)
            | throwError "the public fixed-input declaration lost its one original source binding"
          let some value := session.value? entry.id
            | throwError "the public fixed-input declaration lost its actual retained value"
          if name != `equal_ends then endpoints := endpoints.push (entry.id, value)
        let #[(sourceId, sourceValue), (targetId, targetValue)] := endpoints
          | throwError "the public fixed-input control lost an original endpoint"
        unless sourceId != targetId && sourceValue.value != targetValue.value do
          throwError "the public fixed-input control merged equal source occurrences"
        let before ← SessionSnapshot.current
        let .ok (some sourcePacket) := before.graph.packet? sourceValue
          | throwError "the public fixed-input source lost its actual descriptor"
        let .ok (some targetPacket) := before.graph.packet? targetValue
          | throwError "the public fixed-input target lost its actual descriptor"
        unless sourcePacket == targetPacket do
          throwError "the public fixed-input control no longer compares equal endpoint packets"
        let run ← runStatement session "let selected_kernel := equal_ends.ker()"
        let after ← SessionSnapshot.current
        if mode == "left" then
          unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" && run.attempted && run.published do
            throwError "the original fixed source input was rejected: {run.outcome.detail}"
          let #[entry] := run.session.source.context.entries.filter
              (·.userName == `selected_kernel)
            | throwError "the admitted public fixed result lost its original binding"
          let some result := run.session.value? entry.id
            | throwError "the admitted public fixed result lost its actual occurrence"
          let .ok arrow := after.graph.project result 0
            | throwError "the public fixed result lost its complete inclusion arrow"
          let .ok ambient := after.graph.project arrow 1
            | throwError "the public fixed result lost its original ambient field"
          unless retainsReference sourceValue ambient && ambient.value != targetValue.value do
            throwError "the public fixed result substituted the other equal-valued source input"
          let reused ← runStatement run.session "let kept_kernel := selected_kernel"
          unless reused.outcome.kind == "holds" && reused.published do
            throwError "the original admitted fixed result failed at its later public use"
          let #[keptEntry] := reused.session.source.context.entries.filter
              (·.userName == `kept_kernel)
            | throwError "the later public use lost its source binding"
          let some kept := reused.session.value? keptEntry.id
            | throwError "the later public use lost the original fixed result"
          unless retainsReference result kept do
            throwError "the later public use replaced the admitted fixed result"
        else
          let .malformed detail := run.outcome
            | throwError "the wrong equal-valued fixed input changed its failure stratum: {run.outcome.detail}"
          unless detail.endsWith "the reply changed a fixed source input" && run.attempted &&
              !run.published do
            throwError "the wrong equal-valued input did not fail at fixed-result admission: {detail}"
          unless before.id == after.id && before.graph.sameRevision after.graph &&
              before.outputBatches.size == after.outputBatches.size do
            throwError "the rejected equal-valued fixed input published a graph or output"
          unless (run.session.source.context.entries.filter
              (·.userName == `selected_kernel)).isEmpty do
            throwError "the rejected fixed result published its source binding"
        for (id, original) in endpoints do
          let some current := run.session.value? id
            | throwError "fixed-result admission discarded an original endpoint"
          unless current.value == original.value &&
              current.associationIds == original.associationIds do
            throwError "fixed-result admission replaced an original endpoint"
        unless (← initial.kernel.dispatches.get).map (·.operation) == #[operation] do
          throwError "the public fixed-input control changed its actual provider invocation"
        let lines := (← IO.FS.readFile traffic).splitOn "\n" |>.filter (!·.isEmpty)
        let [line] := lines
          | throwError "the public fixed-input control did not reach its one actual peer reply"
        let .ok frame := Json.parse line
          | throwError "the fixed-input peer lost its independent traffic record"
        let expected : Json := .arr #["receiver", "args",
          toJson (if mode == "left" then (0 : Nat) else 1)]
        unless (frame.getObjValAs? String "op").toOption == some operation &&
            (frame.getObjVal? "ambient").toOption == some expected do
          throwError "the peer did not return the selected original input address"
      finally initial.close
    finally setEnv environment

-- The original RX-LIFT cone followed by its public functor action. Its endpoint must refer
-- to that selected arrow occurrence. The peer checks references, not mathematical laws.
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| CasCatalogue.Backend.packageDir
      CasCatalogue.Backend.contractPackage
    let python := (← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
    let log := root / ".tmp" / "kernel-endpoint-peer.log"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile log ""
    let operation := "fun.bilin_module.forget#map"
    let manifest := Json.mkObj [
      ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "peer"), ("command", python.toString),
        ("args", toJson #[ (root / "scripts/probes/kernel_lift_peer.py").toString,
          log.toString, operation])]]),
      ("registrations", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("operation", toJson operation),
        ("input", "fun.bilin_module.forget#input"), ("backend", "peer")]])]
    let path := root / ".tmp" / "kernel-endpoint-leaves.json"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
    let mut session ← KernelSession.start (some path)
    try
      for text in #["let cone := degenerate_plane_cone()",
          "let underlyingCone := map cone along «fun.bilin_module.forget»(ℚ, ℚ)"] do
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" do
          throwError "`{text}` is {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail}), not holds"
        session := run.session
      let some cone := session.source.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `cone)
        | throwError "the selected cone was not declared"
      let some mapped := session.source.context.entries.find? (·.userName == `underlyingCone)
        | throwError "the mapped cone was not declared"
      let some coneValue := session.value? cone.id
        | throwError "the cone has no retained occurrence"
      let some mappedValue := session.value? mapped.id
        | throwError "the mapped cone has no retained occurrence"
      let graph := (← SessionSnapshot.current).graph
      let .ok (some application) := graph.applicationOrigin mappedValue
        | throwError "the mapped cone lost its actual application"
      let #[some domain, some _, some arrow] := application.arguments
        | throwError "the map changed its argument interface"
      unless arrow.value == coneValue.value do
        throwError "the map replaced its selected arrow"
      let some node := graph.find domain.value
        | throwError "the endpoint is outside the retained graph"
      let .container endpoint := node.payload.data
        | throwError "the endpoint lost its selected arrow interface"
      let #[slot] := endpoint.slots
        | throwError "the endpoint does not retain its defining arrow"
      unless slot.binding.value == coneValue.value do
        throwError "the endpoint refers to a different arrow occurrence"
    finally liftM (m := IO) session.close
  finally setEnv environment

import CasRuntime.Session
import LeanCategories.Catalogue

meta import CasRuntime.Session

/- RX-LIFT's first selected lift (tests/acceptance/proposals/independent-extension-reconstruction-
20261024/completion/rx-lift-prescribed-stages.cas) through the public path with no leaf. The lift
is a record of delayed fields: defining it dispatches nothing, and its fields are then projected
from that same retained record. The setup views select actual input fields before registration
selection (T026); the lift's object and map ports still require their missing leaves.
Functional work may use the heartbeats it needs (constitution C21). -/
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let path := root / ".tmp" / "kernel-lift-empty-leaves.json"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile path
      (Json.mkObj [("backends", .arr #[]), ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
    let mut session ← KernelSession.start (some path)
    try
      let statements := #[
          ("let Q := ℚ in CommutativeRings", "holds"),
          ("let Qring := view Q along «fun.commutative_rings.ring»()", "holds"),
          ("let scalarModule := RegularModule(Qring)", "holds"),
          ("let X := DegeneratePlane()", "holds"),
          ("let sourceModule := view X along «fun.bilin_module.forget»(ℚ, ℚ)", "holds"),
          ("let i0(t) := (2*t, -2*t) in scalarModule → sourceModule", "holds"),
          ("let first := lift(X) along «lift.bilin_module.restrict»(ℚ, ℚ) with i0 using proof(CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.DegeneratePlaneLifts.kernelInclusion_mono)", "holds"),
          -- These two fields demand their published lift ports after the input-only setup.
          ("let X1 := first.obj()", "gap"),
          ("let i1 := first.hom()", "gap")]
      let mut originalQ : Option (CasCompiler.BindingId × ValueBinding) := none
      for (text, kind) in statements, index in [:statements.size] do
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == kind do
          throwError "`{text}` is {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail}), not {kind}"
        session := run.session
        if index == 0 then
          let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
            | throwError "the Q declaration did not publish its source binding"
          unless entry.userName == `Q do
            throwError "the first lift declaration did not publish Q"
          let some value := session.value? entry.id
            | throwError "the Q declaration discarded its actual runtime value"
          originalQ := some (entry.id, value)
        if index == 1 then
          -- The registered ring view has exactly these two native input routes. Keep
          -- their actual field identities; no ring operation or provider answer is used.
          let some (qId, q) := originalQ
            | throwError "the ring view lost its original Q input"
          let some currentQ := session.value? qId
            | throwError "the ring view discarded its original Q binding"
          unless currentQ.value == q.value && currentQ.associationIds == q.associationIds do
            throwError "the ring view changed the retained Q occurrence"
          let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
            | throwError "the ring view did not publish its source binding"
          unless entry.userName == `Qring do
            throwError "the ring view published a different source binding"
          let some ring := session.value? entry.id
            | throwError "the wholly input-projected ring view has no actual value"
          let graph := (← SessionSnapshot.current).graph
          let some node := graph.find ring.value
            | throwError "the ring view is outside the committed graph"
          let some fields := node.payload.data.storedFields?
            | throwError "the ring view did not retain its complete native fields"
          unless fields.size == 2 do
            throwError "the ring view changed its complete native field arity"
          let select (parent : ValueBinding) (projection : Name) : MetaM ValueBinding := do
            let some field := parent.role.fields.find? (·.projection == projection)
              | throwError "the ring view lost the native field {projection}"
            let some index := field.wireIndex
              | throwError "the ring view erased a computational field {projection}"
            let .ok value := graph.project parent index
              | throwError "the ring view has no stored field {projection}"
            return value
          let originalCarrier ← select q ``CommRingCat.carrier
          let carrier ← select ring ``RingCat.carrier
          let ringStructure ← select ring ``RingCat.ring
          unless carrier.value == originalCarrier.value &&
              originalCarrier.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf carrier.associationIds.toList do
            throwError "the ring view replaced Q's actual carrier"
          for (field, path) in #[(carrier, #[``CommRingCat.carrier]),
              (ringStructure, #[``CommRingCat.commRing, ``CommRing.toRing])] do
            let .ok (some baseline) := graph.projectionBasis field q path
              | throwError "the ring view lost an exact original Q projection"
            unless field.value == baseline.value &&
                baseline.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf field.associationIds.toList do
              throwError "the ring view changed its source-selected field occurrence"
          unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "a wholly input-projected ring view dispatched a registration"
        if index ≥ 7 then
          let port := if index == 7 then "obj" else "hom"
          unless (run.outcome.detail.splitOn "NoImplementation").length > 1 &&
              (run.outcome.detail.splitOn s!"lift.bilin_module.restrict#{port}").length > 1 do
            throwError "`{text}` did not reach its missing lift port: {run.outcome.detail}"
          unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
            throwError "the missing lift port dispatched a registration"
    finally liftM (m := IO) session.close
  finally setEnv environment

/- The same lift with leaves. A field of a selected lift is the lift's published computation
(LiftEntry.computation), so `first.obj()` is resolved to the leaf registered at the contract's
`<lift>#obj` port (api/wire-examples.md, "Prescribed subobject lifts") and is not reduced in Lean
(constitution C22). The request carries the lift's evidence parameters (ℚ, ℚ). A real
protocol-v2 process answers; its log records each request. -/
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| CasCatalogue.Backend.packageDir
      CasCatalogue.Backend.contractPackage
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    let python := (← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let log := root / ".tmp" / "kernel-lift-peer.log"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile log ""
    let operations : Array String := #["fun.commutative_rings.ring", "fun.bilin_module.forget",
      "fun.bilin_module.forget#map",
      "lift.bilin_module.restrict#obj", "lift.bilin_module.restrict#hom",
      "lift.bilin_module.restrict#forward", "lift.bilin_module.restrict#backward",
      "lift.bilin_module.restrict#factor", "mor.sets.divide", "mor.modules.row_linear_map"]
    -- The divider's leaf declares the multiplicative monoid route for `/` on commutative rings
    -- (C6), so `3/2` in Q reads.
    let preferences := fun (operation : String) => if operation == "mor.sets.divide" then
        #[Json.mkObj [("name", "/"), ("receiver", "cat.commutative_rings"),
          ("route", .arr #["fun.commutative_rings.ring", "fun.rings.multiplicative_monoid"])]]
      else #[]
    let input := fun (operation : String) => s!"{(operation.splitOn "#").head!}#input"
    let manifest := Json.mkObj [
      ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "peer"), ("command", python.toString),
        ("args", .arr (#[toJson (root / "scripts/probes/kernel_lift_peer.py").toString,
          toJson log.toString] ++ operations.map toJson))]]),
      ("registrations", .arr (operations.map fun (operation : String) => Json.mkObj [
        ("operation", toJson operation), ("input", toJson (input operation)),
        ("backend", "peer"), ("preferredRoutes", .arr (preferences operation))]))]
    let path := root / ".tmp" / "kernel-lift-leaves.json"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
    let mut session ← KernelSession.start (some path)
    try
      unless session.kernel.rejected.isEmpty do
        throwError "a lift port registration was rejected: {session.kernel.rejected}"
      for text in #[
          "let Q := ℚ in CommutativeRings",
          "let Qring := view Q along «fun.commutative_rings.ring»()",
          "let scalarModule := RegularModule(Qring)",
          "let X := DegeneratePlane()",
          "let sourceModule := view X along «fun.bilin_module.forget»(ℚ, ℚ)",
          "let i0(t) := (2*t, -2*t) in scalarModule → sourceModule",
          "let first := lift(X) along «lift.bilin_module.restrict»(ℚ, ℚ) with i0 using proof(CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.DegeneratePlaneLifts.kernelInclusion_mono)",
          "let X1 := first.obj()",
          "let i1 := first.hom()",
          "let alpha1 := first.forward()",
          "let beta1 := first.backward()",
          -- Later uses of the returned object and map (T049): each consumer receives the
          -- retained provider value, not a rebuilt term.
          "let firstCarrier := view X1 along «fun.bilin_module.forget»(ℚ, ℚ)",
          "let firstUnderlyingInclusion := map i1 along «fun.bilin_module.forget»(ℚ, ℚ)",
          -- The universal factor through the lift (T044), sent to its port and used later.
          "let cone := degenerate_plane_cone()",
          "let mediatorRow := [3/2, -1] in RectangularMatrices(1, 2, Q)",
          "let g0 := row_linear_map(2, Q, mediatorRow)",
          "let h1 := factor(g0) through first with cone using proof(CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.DegeneratePlaneFactorization.cone_base_factorization)",
          "let underlyingH1 := map h1 along «fun.bilin_module.forget»(ℚ, ℚ)"] do
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" do
          throwError "`{text}` is {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail}), not holds"
        session := run.session
      let dispatched := (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).map (·.operation)
      for port in #["obj", "hom", "forward", "backward", "factor"] do
        unless dispatched.contains s!"lift.bilin_module.restrict#{port}" do
          throwError "the lift's {port} was not dispatched to its port: {dispatched}"
      -- The domain of i1 is the object X1 already returned: it is not staged again (T046, T049;
      -- execution contract: an existing binding retains its occurrence).
      unless (dispatched.filter (· == "lift.bilin_module.restrict#obj")).size == 1 do
        throwError "the lift's object was staged again for a later use: {dispatched}"
      let requests := ((← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.readFile log).splitOn "\n").filter (!·.isEmpty)
      -- The functor's object action on X1 and its map action on i1 receive the values that the
      -- lift's leaf returned: provider data goes back to its owner as its export token
      -- (`opaqueData`). The map's source endpoint is that same X1; its target is the named X.
      let arguments := fun (operation : String) (first : Bool) => do
        let matching := requests.filter (·.startsWith s!"\{\"op\": \"{operation}\"")
        let some line := if first then matching.head? else matching.getLast?
          | throwError "the peer received no request for {operation}: {requests}"
        let .ok request := Json.parse line | throwError "the peer log is malformed: {line}"
        let .ok values := (request.getObjValD "context").getObjValAs? (Array Json) "arguments"
          | throwError "the request has no arguments: {line}"
        pure values
      let returned := fun (argument : Json) =>
        (argument.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "opaqueData"
      let objectAction ← arguments "fun.bilin_module.forget" false
      let mapAction ← arguments "fun.bilin_module.forget#map" true
      let #[carrierOf] := objectAction
        | throwError "the object action has a different arity: {objectAction}"
      let #[source, _, inclusion] := mapAction
        | throwError "the map action has a different arity: {mapAction}"
      unless returned carrierOf && returned inclusion && source == carrierOf do
        throwError "the later uses did not receive the returned X1 and i1: {objectAction} {mapAction}"
      -- The map action on h1 receives the value that the factor's leaf returned.
      let factorAction ← arguments "fun.bilin_module.forget#map" false
      let #[_, _, factor] := factorAction
        | throwError "the factor's map action has a different arity: {factorAction}"
      unless returned factor && factor != inclusion do
        throwError "the map action on h1 did not receive the returned factor: {factorAction}"
      let some line := requests.find? (·.startsWith "{\"op\": \"lift.bilin_module.restrict#obj\"")
        | throwError "the peer received no lift request: {requests}"
      let .ok request := Json.parse line | throwError "the peer log is malformed: {line}"
      let .ok parameters := (request.getObjValD "context").getObjValAs? (Array Json) "parameters"
        | throwError "the lift request has no parameters: {line}"
      -- Every non-proof argument of the evidence `forgetMonoLift (R) [CommRing R] (W)
      -- [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W]`, in order, as for every published family: ℚ at R and W.
      let rationals := Json.mkObj [("args", .arr #[]), ("ctor", "obj.sets.rationals")]
      unless parameters.size == 5 && parameters[0]! == rationals && parameters[2]! == rationals do
        throwError "the lift request does not carry the evidence parameters (ℚ, ℚ): {line}"
      -- Each later lift port receives the earlier outputs, in the order of the contract's ports
      -- (api/wire-examples.md, "Prescribed subobject lifts"): `#hom` the returned X1, `#forward`
      -- X1 and i1, `#backward` X1, i1 and the forward comparison, with their original
      -- computational source-field slots in the complete dependent `bindings` envelope.
      let bindings := fun (port : String) => do
        let some line := requests.find? (·.startsWith s!"\{\"op\": \"lift.bilin_module.restrict#{port}\"")
          | throwError "the peer received no request for #{port}: {requests}"
        let .ok request := Json.parse line | throwError "the peer log is malformed: {line}"
        let .ok values := (request.getObjValD "context").getObjValAs? (Array Json) "bindings"
          | throwError "the #{port} request has no bindings: {line}"
        let mut retained := #[]
        for value in values, index in [:values.size] do
          let .ok () := CasCatalogue.Backend.checkServiceFields #["slot", "value"] value
            | throwError "the #{port} binding lost its exact dependent envelope"
          unless (value.getObjValAs? Nat "slot").toOption == some index do
            throwError "the #{port} binding changed its original source-field slot"
          let .ok data := value.getObjVal? "value"
            | throwError "the #{port} binding lost its original retained value"
          retained := retained.push data
        pure retained
      let hom ← bindings "hom"
      let forward ← bindings "forward"
      let backward ← bindings "backward"
      unless hom == #[carrierOf] && forward == #[carrierOf, inclusion] && backward.size == 3 &&
          backward.extract 0 2 == forward && returned backward[2]! do
        throwError "the lift ports did not receive their earlier outputs: {hom} {forward} {backward}"
    finally liftM (m := IO) session.close

    -- Freeze availability before reading the same original lift source. The object port stays
    -- available: neither a missing nor an ambiguous hom may compute that preceding field.
    let .ok originalBackends := manifest.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "backends"
      | throwError "the original lift manifest lost its backend declarations"
    let .ok originalRegistrations := manifest.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "registrations"
      | throwError "the original lift manifest lost its registrations"
    let some objectRegistration := originalRegistrations.find? fun entry =>
        (entry.getObjValAs? String "operation").toOption == some "lift.bilin_module.restrict#obj"
      | throwError "the original lift object registration is missing"
    let some homRegistration := originalRegistrations.find? fun entry =>
        (entry.getObjValAs? String "operation").toOption == some "lift.bilin_module.restrict#hom"
      | throwError "the original lift hom registration is missing"
    let otherBackend := Json.mkObj [("name", "overlap-peer"), ("command", python.toString),
      ("args", .arr (#[toJson (root / "scripts/probes/kernel_lift_peer.py").toString,
        toJson log.toString] ++ operations.map toJson))]
    let otherHom := Json.mkObj [("operation", "lift.bilin_module.restrict#hom"),
      ("input", toJson (input "lift.bilin_module.restrict#hom")), ("backend", "overlap-peer")]
    let overlap := Json.mkObj [("backends", .arr (originalBackends.push otherBackend)),
      ("registrations", .arr (originalRegistrations.push otherHom))]
    for (name, controlManifest, enabled, expected) in #[
        ("missing", manifest, #[objectRegistration], "NoImplementation"),
        ("multiple", overlap, #[objectRegistration, homRegistration, otherHom],
          "AmbiguousRealization")] do
      let controlPath := root / ".tmp" / s!"kernel-lift-profile-{name}.json"
      liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile controlPath controlManifest.compress
      let configuration := Json.mkObj [
        ("format", "cas-realization-profile/1"), ("id", toJson s!"lift-{name}"),
        ("default", "all"), ("rules", .arr #[Json.mkObj [
          ("target", Json.mkObj [("kind", "lift"), ("id", "lift.bilin_module.restrict")]),
          ("primitive_registrations", Json.mkObj [("mode", "only"), ("entries", .arr enabled)]),
          ("derivations", Json.mkObj [("mode", "all")])]])]
      let before ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.readFile log
      let mut filtered ← KernelSession.start (some controlPath) (profile := some configuration)
      try
        unless filtered.kernel.rejected.isEmpty && filtered.kernel.profile.id == s!"lift-{name}" do
          throwError "the lift control did not freeze its exact startup manifest and profile"
        let objectPort ← selectLift filtered.kernel.profile filtered.kernel.manifest
          (.lift ⟨"lift.bilin_module.restrict"⟩) "lift.bilin_module.restrict#obj"
          #["lift.bilin_module.restrict#input"]
        unless objectPort.operation == "lift.bilin_module.restrict#obj" &&
            objectPort.backend == "peer" do
          throwError "the original preceding lift field was not available"
        for text in #[
            "let Q := ℚ in CommutativeRings",
            "let Qring := view Q along «fun.commutative_rings.ring»()",
            "let scalarModule := RegularModule(Qring)",
            "let X := DegeneratePlane()",
            "let sourceModule := view X along «fun.bilin_module.forget»(ℚ, ℚ)",
            "let i0(t) := (2*t, -2*t) in scalarModule → sourceModule",
            "let first := lift(X) along «lift.bilin_module.restrict»(ℚ, ℚ) with i0 using proof(CasCatalogue.Modules.Bilinear.Valued.DegeneratePlaneLifts.kernelInclusion_mono)"] do
          let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
            | .ok statement => pure statement
            | .error error => throwError "the original lift setup did not parse: {error}"
          let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| filtered.run ⟨statement⟩
          unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" do
            throwError "the original lift setup failed: {text}: {run.outcome.detail}"
          filtered := run.session
        let .ok statement := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt "let i1 := first.hom()"
          | throwError "the original lift hom demand did not parse"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| filtered.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "gap" &&
            (run.outcome.detail.splitOn expected).length > 1 &&
            (run.outcome.detail.splitOn "lift.bilin_module.restrict#hom").length > 1 do
          throwError "the filtered original hom demand changed its failure: {run.outcome.detail}"
        filtered := run.session
        unless (← filtered.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty &&
            (← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.readFile log) == before do
          throwError "the missing or ambiguous lift hom dispatched a preceding field"
      finally liftM (m := IO) filtered.close
  finally setEnv environment

/- A defining leg of a registered limit is that limit's named leg at its maps (constitution C7),
not the apex and not the presentation's definition (C22): the base-change functor's map action on
`C.leg(1)` receives the descriptor `colim.bil_w_form.cokernel#leg` with the limit's map and the
ordinal 1. A real protocol-v2 process answers; its log records each request. -/
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| CasCatalogue.Backend.packageDir
      CasCatalogue.Backend.contractPackage
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    let python := (← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let log := root / ".tmp" / "kernel-leg-peer.log"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile log ""
    let operation := "fun.bil_wform.base_change#map"
    let manifest := Json.mkObj [
      ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "peer"), ("command", python.toString),
        ("args", .arr #[toJson (root / "scripts/probes/kernel_lift_peer.py").toString,
          toJson log.toString, toJson operation])]]),
      ("registrations", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("operation", toJson operation),
        ("input", "fun.bil_wform.base_change#input"), ("backend", "peer")]])]
    let path := root / ".tmp" / "kernel-leg-leaves.json"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
    let mut session ← KernelSession.start (some path)
    let (published, occurrence, observation, logBeforeClose) ← try
      for text in #["let C := cokernel(to_dual(1))",
          "let r := map C.leg(1) along «fun.bil_wform.base_change»(ℤ, ℚ)"] do
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" do
          throwError "`{text}` is {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail}), not holds"
        session := run.session
      let requests := ((← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.readFile log).splitOn "\n").filter (!·.isEmpty)
      let some line := requests.head? | throwError "the base change's map action was not dispatched"
      let .ok request := Json.parse line | throwError "the peer log is malformed: {line}"
      let .ok arguments := (request.getObjValD "context").getObjValAs? (Array Json) "arguments"
        | throwError "the map action has no arguments: {line}"
      let leg := arguments.back?.getD .null
      unless (leg.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "colim.bil_w_form.cokernel#leg" &&
          ((leg.getObjValD "args").getArr?.toOption.bind (·.back?)) == some (toJson (1 : Nat)) do
        throwError "the map action did not receive C's leg 1: {line}"
      let #[selected, result] ← CasCompiler.SourceTest.authoredEntries
          session.source.context session.source.selections
        | throwError "the public cokernel and map definitions lost their two authored bindings"
      let some binding := session.value? result.id
        | throwError "the public map definition lost its actual computed value"
      let published ← SessionSnapshot.current
      let some node := published.graph.find binding.value
        | throwError "the public map result is absent from the committed graph"
      let occurrence := binding.applications.back?.map (·.association.occurrence)
        |>.getD node.origin.occurrence
      let some receipt := published.receipt occurrence
        | throwError "the public map result lost its committed request"
      let some source := receipt.association.request.observation.sourceSnapshot
        | throwError "the public source handoff omitted its original source snapshot"
      let .ok context := source.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "context"
        | throwError "the public source snapshot lost its original context"
      let .ok categories := source.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "categories"
        | throwError "the public source snapshot lost its selected categories"
      unless selected.userName == `C && result.userName == `r &&
          context.map (·.getObjValD "id") ==
            (session.source.context.entries.extract 0 (session.source.context.entries.size - 1)).map
              (fun entry => CasCompiler.ContextSnapshot.bindingJson entry.id) &&
          session.source.context.entries.back?.map (·.id) == some result.id &&
          (source.getObjValD "resultBinding").getObjValD "id" ==
            CasCompiler.ContextSnapshot.bindingJson result.id do
        throwError "the source snapshot changed the original context or result binding"
      let some selection := (session.source.categoryFor selected.id).bind (·.limit)
        | throwError "the public cokernel binding lost its selected presentation"
      let some selectedIndex := context.findIdx? fun entry =>
          entry.getObjValD "id" == CasCompiler.ContextSnapshot.bindingJson selected.id
        | throwError "the source snapshot omitted the original cokernel binding identity"
      let some category := categories[selectedIndex]?
        | throwError "the source snapshot omitted the cokernel's selected category"
      let limit := category.getObjValD "limit"
      unless limit.getObjValD "construction" ==
          CasTools.NativeExpression.nameJson selection.construction do
        throwError "the source snapshot changed the original construction selection"
      let .ok nodes := CasTools.NativeExpression.decodeNodes
          (source.getObjValD "nativeExpressions")
        | throwError "the source snapshot lost its exact native expression graph"
      for (name, original) in #[("cone", selection.cone),
          ("presentation", selection.presentation), ("diagram", selection.diagram)] do
        let retained := limit.getObjValD name
        let .ok expression := retained.getObjValAs? Nat "expression"
          | throwError "the source snapshot lost the selected {name}"
        let .ok type := retained.getObjValAs? Nat "type"
          | throwError "the source snapshot lost the selected {name}'s type"
        unless nodes[expression]? == some original.expression &&
            nodes[type]? == some original.type do
          throwError "the source snapshot changed the actual selected {name}"
      unless (limit.getObjValD "interface").getObjVal? "dataConstructor" |>.isOk do
        throwError "the source snapshot omitted the selected native data interface"
      let .ok typed := source.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "sessionSelections"
        | throwError "the source snapshot omitted its complete typed selection table"
      unless typed.size == session.source.selections.size && !typed.isEmpty do
        throwError "the source snapshot dropped an original typed selection"
      for (id, original) in session.source.selections.toArray do
        let #[retained] := typed.filter fun row =>
            row.getObjValD "binding" == CasCompiler.ContextSnapshot.bindingJson id
          | throwError "the source snapshot lost or repeated an exact selection binding"
        let selected := retained.getObjValD "selection"
        unless selected.getObjValD "formalBindings" ==
              toJson (original.formalBindings.map CasCompiler.ContextSnapshot.bindingJson) &&
            selected.getObjValD "reference" == toJson original.reference do
          throwError "the source snapshot changed the original full row or formal source positions"
        let value := selected.getObjValD "value"
        let .ok expression := value.getObjValAs? Nat "expression"
          | throwError "the typed source selection omitted its original native expression"
        let .ok type := value.getObjValAs? Nat "type"
          | throwError "the typed source selection omitted its complete native type"
        let .ok valueContext := value.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "context"
          | throwError "the typed source selection omitted its complete source telescope"
        unless nodes[expression]? == some original.value.expression &&
            nodes[type]? == some original.value.type &&
            valueContext.map (·.getObjValD "id") ==
              original.value.context.entries.map
                (fun entry => CasCompiler.ContextSnapshot.bindingJson entry.id) do
          throwError "the typed source selection changed its expression, type or original telescope"
        if let some application := original.application then
          let retained := selected.getObjValD "application"
          unless retained.getObjValD "family" == toJson application.family &&
              retained.getObjValD "universes" == toJson application.universes do
            throwError "the source snapshot discarded a complete original family or universe"

      pure (published, occurrence, receipt.association.request.observation.toJson,
        ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.readFile log)
    finally liftM (m := IO) session.close
    let some retained := published.receipt occurrence
      | throwError "provider shutdown hid the public result's inert observation"
    unless retained.association.request.observation.toJson == observation &&
        (← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.readFile log) == logBeforeClose do
      throwError "reading the committed observation changed it or dispatched another request"
  finally setEnv environment


-- Two complete selected limits can have the same native apex. Public definitions,
-- later legs and an authored alias must retain each actual owner separately.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let root ← IO.currentDir
    IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let path := root / ".tmp/kernel-equal-apex-empty-leaves.json"
    IO.FS.writeFile path
      (Json.mkObj [("backends", .arr #[]), ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
    let initial ← KernelSession.start (some path) (computationOnly := true)
    try
      let mut session := initial
      let mut originals : Array (BindingId × ValueBinding) := #[]
      for (name, text) in #[
          (`X, "let X := RegularModule(ℤ)"),
          (`Y, "let Y := RegularModule(ℤ)"),
          (`first, "let first := X × Y"),
          (`second, "let second := X × Y"),
          (`firstLeg, "let firstLeg := first.leg(0)"),
          (`secondLeg, "let secondLeg := second.leg(0)"),
          (`alias, "let alias := first"),
          (`aliasLeg, "let aliasLeg := alias.leg(0)"),
          (`laterLeg, "let laterLeg := first.leg(0)")] do
        let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text
          | throwError "the public equal-apex statement did not parse: {text}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨parsed⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" && run.attempted && run.published do
          throwError "the public equal-apex statement did not commit: {text}: {run.outcome.detail}"
        session := run.session
        let some entry := (← SourceTest.authoredEntries
            session.source.context session.source.selections).back?
          | throwError "the public equal-apex statement lost its authored binding"
        unless entry.userName == name do
          throwError "the public equal-apex statement changed its result binding"
        let some actual := session.value? entry.id
          | throwError "the public equal-apex statement lost its actual result"
        originals := originals.push (entry.id, actual)
      let #[x, y, first, second, firstLeg, secondLeg, aliasValue, aliasLeg, laterLeg] := originals
        | throwError "the public equal-apex control changed its original statement count"
      unless first.1 != second.1 && first.2.value != second.2.value &&
          retainsReference first.2 aliasValue.2 do
        throwError "two public limit definitions or their alias lost their original occurrences"
      let graph := (← SessionSnapshot.current).graph
      let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
      withBindingContext graph empty {} first.2 fun context bound => do
        withBindingContext graph context bound second.2 fun context bound => do
          let some firstSelected ← first.2.role.selected? context
            | throwError "the first public limit lost its complete typed selection"
          let some secondSelected ← second.2.role.selected? context
            | throwError "the second public limit lost its complete typed selection"
          let some firstLimit := firstSelected.limit
            | throwError "the first public limit lost its original cone"
          let some secondLimit := secondSelected.limit
            | throwError "the second public limit lost its original cone"
          let some firstReference := firstSelected.reference
            | throwError "the first public limit lost its original full row"
          let some secondReference := secondSelected.reference
            | throwError "the second public limit lost its original full row"
          unless firstReference.exactlyMatches secondReference &&
              firstLimit.source.construction != secondLimit.source.construction do
            throwError "the equal-apex limits changed their full family or shared one construction"
          unless ← context.withOriginalSources #[firstLimit.receiver, secondLimit.receiver]
              (fun values => isDefEq values[0]! values[1]!) do
            throwError "the two original selected limits no longer have the same native apex"
          for (leg, owner, construction, reference) in #[
              (firstLeg.2, first.2, firstLimit.source.construction, firstReference),
              (secondLeg.2, second.2, secondLimit.source.construction, secondReference),
              (aliasLeg.2, first.2, firstLimit.source.construction, firstReference),
              (laterLeg.2, first.2, firstLimit.source.construction, firstReference)] do
            withBindingContext graph context bound leg fun context bound => do
              let some selected ← leg.role.selected? context
                | throwError "a later public leg lost its complete typed selection"
              let some original := selected.leg
                | throwError "a later public leg lost its original cone component"
              let some retainedReference := selected.reference
                | throwError "a later public leg lost its complete original limit row"
              unless original.construction.source.construction == construction &&
                  reference.exactlyMatches retainedReference do
                throwError "a later public leg crossed an equal-apex construction boundary"
              let some (binding, suffix) ← boundProjection? context bound
                  original.construction.receiver
                | throwError "a later public leg lost its original bound receiver"
              let some receiver := bound[binding]?
                | throwError "a later public leg names an unavailable receiver identity"
              unless suffix.isEmpty && retainsReference owner receiver do
                throwError "a later public leg substituted the other equal-apex receiver"
      unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "forming selected limits or retaining their legs dispatched an implementation"
      -- Preserve the original duplicate-occurrence control above, then distinguish the
      -- ordered source cones themselves. Both modules have the same native definition,
      -- but the public bindings X and Y are independent actual inputs.
      unless x.1 != y.1 && x.2.value != y.2.value do
        throwError "the ordered-cone control lost its distinct original module inputs"
      let some firstSource := session.source.selections[first.1]?
        | throwError "the first public limit lost its original complete reader selection"
      let mut reversedSource : Option (SourceSelection ClosedTerm) := none
      let mut ordered : Array (BindingId × ValueBinding) := #[]
      for (name, text) in #[
          (`reversed, "let reversed := Y × X"),
          (`reversedLeg, "let reversedLeg := reversed.leg(0)"),
          (`reversedOtherLeg, "let reversedOtherLeg := reversed.leg(1)"),
          (`reversedAlias, "let reversedAlias := reversed"),
          (`reversedAliasLeg, "let reversedAliasLeg := reversedAlias.leg(0)")] do
        let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text
          | throwError "the public ordered-cone statement did not parse: {text}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨parsed⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" && run.attempted && run.published do
          throwError "the public ordered-cone statement did not commit: {text}: {run.outcome.detail}"
        session := run.session
        let some entry := (← SourceTest.authoredEntries
            session.source.context session.source.selections).back?
          | throwError "the public ordered-cone statement lost its authored binding"
        unless entry.userName == name do
          throwError "the public ordered-cone statement changed its original result binding"
        let some actual := session.value? entry.id
          | throwError "the public ordered-cone statement lost its actual result"
        ordered := ordered.push (entry.id, actual)
        if name == `reversed then
          let some selected := session.source.selections[entry.id]?
            | throwError "the reversed public limit lost its original complete reader selection"
          reversedSource := some selected
      let #[reversed, reversedLeg, reversedOtherLeg, reversedAlias, reversedAliasLeg] := ordered
        | throwError "the public ordered-cone control changed its original statement count"
      let some originalReversed := reversedSource
        | throwError "the public ordered-cone control lost its original reversed selection"
      unless first.2.value != reversed.2.value && retainsReference reversed.2 reversedAlias.2 do
        throwError "the reversed cone or its alias lost its original actual occurrence"
      session.source.context.withOpen fun bindings => do
        let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
        let selections ← session.source.selections.inContext context
        let firstSource ← firstSource.mapM (fun source => source.inContext context)
        let reversedSource ← originalReversed.mapM (fun source => source.inContext context)
        let some firstLimit := firstSource.limit
          | throwError "the first original reader selection lost its full cone"
        let some reversedLimit := reversedSource.limit
          | throwError "the reversed original reader selection lost its full cone"
        unless ← context.withOriginalSources #[firstLimit.receiver, reversedLimit.receiver]
            (fun values => isDefEq values[0]! values[1]!) do
          throwError "the distinct ordered source cones no longer share their native apex"
        let exchangedOwner ← NativeLimitSelection.ofSource
          { reversedLimit.source with construction := firstLimit.source.construction }
          firstLimit.receiver
        if firstSource.exactlyMatches Expr.equal { firstSource with limit := some exchangedOwner } then
          throwError "the complete source comparison accepted the other ordered construction"
        -- Keep the first construction identity, owner template and receiver. Exchanging
        -- the other cone's entire native presentation/interface must still be detected.
        let exchanged ← NativeLimitSelection.ofSource
          { firstLimit.source with
            cone := reversedLimit.source.cone
            presentation := reversedLimit.source.presentation
            diagram := reversedLimit.source.diagram
            interface := reversedLimit.source.interface }
          firstLimit.receiver
        if firstSource.exactlyMatches Expr.equal { firstSource with limit := some exchanged } then
          throwError "the complete cone comparison ignored exchanged diagram or interface data"
        for (leg, expected) in #[(firstLeg, firstSource), (aliasLeg, firstSource),
            (laterLeg, firstSource), (reversedLeg, reversedSource),
            (reversedOtherLeg, reversedSource), (reversedAliasLeg, reversedSource)] do
          let some selected := selections[leg.1]?
            | throwError "a public ordered leg lost its original complete reader selection"
          let some original := selected.leg
            | throwError "a public ordered leg lost its original full construction"
          let some owner := selections.findAt? context original.construction.receiver
            | throwError "a public ordered leg lost its exact original source owner binding"
          unless expected.exactlyMatches Expr.equal owner do
            throwError "a public ordered leg changed its original complete selected owner"
          let some expectedLimit := expected.limit
            | throwError "an original ordered-cone selection lost its full native interface"
          let actual ← NativeLimitSelection.ofSource original.construction.source expectedLimit.receiver
          let retained := { expected with
            reference := selected.reference
            limitFamily := selected.limitFamily
            limit := some actual }
          unless expected.exactlyMatches Expr.equal retained do
            throwError "a public ordered leg changed its original cone, diagram, interface or family"
      let graph := (← SessionSnapshot.current).graph
      let empty ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
      for (leg, owner) in #[(reversedLeg.2, reversed.2),
          (reversedOtherLeg.2, reversed.2), (reversedAliasLeg.2, reversed.2)] do
        withBindingContext graph empty {} leg fun context bound => do
          let some selected ← leg.role.selected? context
            | throwError "an ordered public leg lost its actual selected source role"
          let some original := selected.leg
            | throwError "an ordered public leg lost its actual original construction"
          let some (binding, suffix) ← boundProjection? context bound original.construction.receiver
            | throwError "an ordered public leg lost its actual source receiver"
          let some receiver := bound[binding]?
            | throwError "an ordered public leg names an unavailable actual receiver"
          unless suffix.isEmpty && retainsReference owner receiver &&
              receiver.value != first.2.value do
            throwError "an ordered public leg substituted the other same-apex construction"
      unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "retaining ordered source cones or their legs dispatched an implementation"
    finally initial.close
  finally setEnv environment
