/- Public statements run from source text through the reader, the lowerer and the kernel
executor to a real protocol-v2 process. The provider supplies integer-ring traffic only; the
catalogue fixes every question. Reuse: the pinned SDK project and KernelSession. -/
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| packageDir contractPackage
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    let python := (← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
    let peer := root / "scripts/probes/kernel_session_peer.py"
    let registration := fun (operation : String) => Json.mkObj [("operation", operation),
      ("input", if operation == "meth.cardinality" then "obj.sets.fin" else s!"{operation}#input"),
      ("backend", "peer")]
    let manifest := Json.mkObj [
      ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "peer"), ("command", python.toString),
        ("args", .arr #[toJson peer.toString])]]),
      ("registrations", .arr (#["op.rings.add", "op.rings.mul", "meth.cardinality"].map
        registration ++ #[Json.mkObj [("operation", "op.unpublished"),
          ("input", "op.unpublished#input"), ("backend", "peer")]]))]
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let path := root / ".tmp" / "kernel-session-leaves.json"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
    let mut session ← KernelSession.start (some path)
    try
      unless session.kernel.rejected.size == 1 do
        throwError "an unpublished operation address was admitted as a registration"
      let expected : Array (String × String) := #[
        ("let a := 17 + 29 in ℤ", "holds"),
        ("assert a = 46 in ℤ", "holds"),
        ("assert a = 47 in ℤ", "wrong"),
        ("let b := a · a in ℤ", "holds"),
        ("assert b = 2116 in ℤ", "holds"),
        ("let d := a · 2 in ℤ", "holds"),
        ("assert d = 92 in ℤ", "holds"),
        ("let c := |Fin(3)|", "holds"),
        ("assert c = 3", "holds"),
        ("assert c = 4", "wrong"),
        ("assert implemented |Fin(2)|", "holds"),
        ("assert 2 + 2 = 4 in ℤ", "holds"),
        -- A numeral of ℤ/5 is the image of 3 under ℤ → ℤ/5; computing it is a leaf's job
        -- (constitution C22), so defining it dispatches nothing and holds.
        ("let x := 3 in ℤ/5", "holds")]
      for (text, kind) in expected do
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == kind do
          throwError "`{text}` is {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail}), not {kind}"
        session := run.session
      -- The retained sum is sent again as data. The deferred addition is a real dispatch.
      let dispatched := (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).map (·.operation)
      unless dispatched == #["op.rings.add", "op.rings.mul", "op.rings.mul", "op.rings.add",
          "meth.cardinality", "meth.cardinality"] do
        throwError "the session dispatched {dispatched}"
    finally liftM (m := IO) session.close
    -- An explicit empty manifest gives the same source its reading without a realization.
    setEnv environment
    let emptyPath := root / ".tmp" / "kernel-session-empty-leaves.json"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile emptyPath
      (Json.mkObj [("backends", .arr #[]), ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
    let bare ← KernelSession.start (some emptyPath)
    try
      let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt "let a := 17 + 29 in ℤ" with
        | .ok statement => pure statement
        | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
      let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| bare.run ⟨statement⟩
      unless run.outcome.kind == "gap" do
        throwError "a statement with no installed leaf is {run.outcome.kind}, not a gap"
      -- The definition keeps its meaning without a leaf (constitution C3): a later statement
      -- reads it, and this closed question is settled in Lean.
      let question ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt "assert a = 46 in ℤ" with
        | .ok statement => pure statement
        | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
      let asked ← withoutErrToSorry <| run.session.run ⟨question⟩
      unless asked.outcome.kind == "holds" do
        throwError "a definition with no installed leaf is lost: {asked.outcome.kind} ({asked.outcome.detail})"
      -- Maps the user wrote are not computed values: a question about them is settled in Lean
      -- from their definitions, not sent to a leaf (tests/acceptance/functions.cas).
      let mut written := asked.session
      for (text, kind) in #[("let h := t ↦ t² + 1 in ℤ → ℤ", "holds"),
          ("let hp(t) := t^2 + 1 in ℤ → ℤ", "holds"), ("assert h = hp", "holds")] do
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
        let step ← withoutErrToSorry <| written.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless step.outcome.kind == kind do
          throwError "`{text}` is {step.outcome.kind} ({step.outcome.detail}), not {kind}"
        written := step.session
    finally liftM (m := IO) bare.close
  finally setEnv environment

/- A failed public definition retains the failure of its one actual invocation. The existing
SDK peer fails only its first addition; retrying an alias would therefore succeed and emit a
second request. Explicitly writing a new addition remains a new independent computation. -/
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| packageDir contractPackage
    let root ← liftM (m := IO) IO.currentDir
    let python := (← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
    liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    for (mode, kind) in #[("unavailable", "unavailable"), ("unsupported", "gap")] do
      setEnv environment
      let log := root / ".tmp" / s!"kernel-session-{mode}.log"
      liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile log ""
      let manifest := Json.mkObj [
        ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "peer"), ("command", python.toString),
          ("args", toJson #[(root / "scripts/probes/kernel_session_peer.py").toString,
            "--fail-first-add", mode, log.toString])]]),
        ("registrations", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("operation", "op.rings.add"),
          ("input", "op.rings.add#input"), ("backend", "peer")]])]
      let path := root / ".tmp" / s!"kernel-session-{mode}.json"
      liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
      let mut session ← KernelSession.start (some path)
      try
        let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt
            "let failedSum := 17 + 29 in ℤ" with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
        let failed ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
        unless failed.outcome.kind == kind do
          throwError "the real {mode} reply became {failed.outcome.kind}: {failed.outcome.detail}"
        session := failed.session
        let some original := session.source.context.entries.back?
          | throwError "a failed computation discarded its checked source definition"
        unless original.userName == `failedSum && original.value.isSome &&
            (session.value? original.id).isNone do
          throwError "the failed definition lost its meaning or published a runtime result"
        let before ← SessionSnapshot.current
        let traffic ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.readFile log
        unless ((traffic.splitOn "\n").filter (!·.isEmpty)).length == 1 do
          throwError "the initial failure did not come from exactly one real provider request"
        for text in #["let failedAlias := failedSum", "let failedDependent := failedAlias",
            "let failedExpression := failedDependent + 1 in ℤ",
            "assert implemented failedDependent", "assert implemented failedExpression",
            "assert implemented failedSum",
            "context do\nassert implemented failedDependent\nend"] do
          let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
            | .ok statement => pure statement
            | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
          let declarations := session.source.context.entries.size
          let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
          unless run.outcome.kind == kind &&
              (run.outcome.detail.splitOn failed.outcome.detail).length > 1 do
            throwError "`{text}` lost the original {mode} outcome: \
              {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail})"
          session := run.session
          if text.startsWith "let" then
            let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
              | throwError "a failed dependent definition was not retained"
            unless session.source.context.entries.size == declarations + 1 &&
                entry.value.isSome && (session.value? entry.id).isNone do
              throwError "a failed dependent definition published a value or lost its meaning"
        -- A question explicitly requesting computation follows that same original failure.
        -- The normal source-only question below retains its separate discharge policy.
        let question ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt
            "assert failedDependent = 46 in ℤ" with
          | .ok statement => pure statement
          | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
        let computedSession := { session with computationOnly := true }
        let computed ← withoutErrToSorry <| computedSession.run ⟨question⟩
        unless computed.outcome.kind == kind &&
            (computed.outcome.detail.splitOn failed.outcome.detail).length > 1 do
          throwError "a computed question lost the original {mode} outcome: \
            {computed.outcome.kind} ({computed.outcome.detail})"
        let unchanged ← SessionSnapshot.current
        unless unchanged.id == before.id && unchanged.graph.sameRevision before.graph &&
            unchanged.outputBatches.size == before.outputBatches.size &&
            (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).map (·.operation) == #["op.rings.add"] &&
            (← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.readFile log) == traffic do
          throwError "a later failed-definition use retried or published a computation"
        -- The failure neither changes the mathematical definition nor poisons a fresh call.
        for text in #["assert failedSum = 46 in ℤ", "let freshSum := 17 + 29 in ℤ",
            "assert freshSum = 46 in ℤ"] do
          let statement ← match Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text with
            | .ok statement => pure statement
            | .error error => throwError "the statement did not parse: {error}"
          let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨statement⟩
          unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" do
            throwError "`{text}` is {run.outcome.kind} ({run.outcome.detail}), not holds"
          session := run.session
        let traffic ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.FS.readFile log
        unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).map (·.operation) ==
            #["op.rings.add", "op.rings.add"] &&
            ((traffic.splitOn "\n").filter (!·.isEmpty)).length == 2 do
          throwError "a fresh addition did not make exactly its own independent invocation"
      finally liftM (m := IO) session.close
  finally setEnv environment


-- The same published operation reaches the same original operands through public source
-- and a provider-requested child. The independent peer forwards released input addresses;
-- immutable committed receipts, not equal returned numbers, establish operand identity.
run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| packageDir contractPackage
    let root ← IO.currentDir
    let python := (← IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
    IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
    let traffic := root / ".tmp/kernel-source-child-parity.jsonl"
    IO.FS.writeFile traffic ""
    let registration := fun (operation : String) => Json.mkObj [
      ("operation", toJson operation), ("input", toJson s!"{operation}#input"),
      ("backend", "peer")]
    let manifest := Json.mkObj [
      ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "peer"), ("command", python.toString),
        ("args", .arr #[toJson (root / "scripts/probes/kernel_session_peer.py").toString,
          "--reference-add", toJson traffic.toString])]]),
      ("registrations", .arr (#["op.rings.add", "op.rings.mul"].map registration))]
    let path := root / ".tmp/kernel-source-child-parity-leaves.json"
    IO.FS.writeFile path manifest.compress
    let initial ← KernelSession.start (some path) (computationOnly := true)
    try
      let mut session := initial
      let mut originals : Array (BindingId × ValueBinding) := #[]
      for (name, text) in #[
          (`R, "let R := ℤ in Rings"),
          (`a, "let a := 17 in R"),
          (`two, "let two := 2 in R"),
          (`direct, "let direct := a + a in R"),
          (`mediated, "let mediated := a · two in R")] do
        let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text
          | throwError "the public provider-parity statement did not parse: {text}"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨parsed⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" && run.attempted && run.published do
          throwError "the public provider-parity statement did not commit: {text}: {run.outcome.detail}"
        session := run.session
        let some entry := (← SourceTest.authoredEntries
            session.source.context session.source.selections).back?
          | throwError "the public provider-parity statement lost its authored result"
        unless entry.userName == name do
          throwError "the public provider-parity statement changed its original result binding"
        let some actual := session.value? entry.id
          | throwError "the public provider-parity statement lost its actual runtime reference"
        originals := originals.push (entry.id, actual)
      let #[ring, operand, _, direct, mediated] := originals
        | throwError "the public provider-parity control changed its original statement count"
      let snapshot ← SessionSnapshot.current
      let codes ← session.kernel.codes.get
      let additionReceipt := fun (value : ValueBinding) => do
        let mut receipts : Array CommittedReceipt := #[]
        for application in value.applications do
          let some receipt := snapshot.receipt application.association.occurrence
            | continue
          let .invocation dispatch _ _ := receipt.association.producer | continue
          let .primitive identity := dispatch.selected | continue
          unless identity.registration.operation == "op.rings.add" do continue
          unless dispatch.occurrence == receipt.association.request.occurrence do
            throwError "the addition receipt changed its original dispatch occurrence"
          if receipts.any (fun prior => prior.association.request.occurrence ==
              receipt.association.request.occurrence) then continue
          receipts := receipts.push receipt
        let #[receipt] := receipts
          | throwError "the public result lost its one actual published addition invocation"
        return receipt
      let originalFamily := fun (receipt : CommittedReceipt) => do
        let .apply callable _ _ := receipt.association.request.action
          | throwError "the published addition lost its original native callable demand"
        let code ← IO.ofExcept <| (snapshot.graph.callable callable).mapError IO.userError
        let some node := snapshot.graph.find code.value
          | throwError "the published addition lost its actual callable node"
        let .closure program _ := node.payload.data
          | throwError "the published addition lost its retained family code"
        let some (.family family path) := codes[program]?
          | throwError "the published addition lost its original prepared family"
        receipt.association.request.requireFamily family path snapshot.graph codes
        return (family, path)
      let directReceipt ← additionReceipt direct.2
      let childReceipt ← additionReceipt mediated.2
      unless directReceipt.association.request.occurrence !=
          childReceipt.association.request.occurrence do
        throwError "the direct operation and provider child shared an invocation occurrence"
      let (directOriginal, directPath) ← originalFamily directReceipt
      let (childOriginal, childPath) ← originalFamily childReceipt
      let .primitive (.registered directFamily) directUniverses := directOriginal.action
        | throwError "the direct addition changed its retained published family"
      let .primitive (.registered childFamily) childUniverses := childOriginal.action
        | throwError "the child addition changed its retained published family"
      unless (SelectedApplicationFamily.registered directFamily).exactlyMatches
          (.registered childFamily) && directUniverses == childUniverses &&
          directPath.map (·.projection) == childPath.map (·.projection) do
        throwError "the provider child changed the original complete addition family"
      let .invocation directDispatch _ _ := directReceipt.association.producer
        | throwError "the direct addition lost its original provider dispatch"
      let .invocation childDispatch _ _ := childReceipt.association.producer
        | throwError "the requested addition lost its original provider dispatch"
      unless directDispatch.selected == childDispatch.selected do
        throwError "the provider child changed the original selected addition registration"
      for (receipt, family) in #[(directReceipt, directOriginal), (childReceipt, childOriginal)] do
        let some original := snapshot.receipt family.occurrence
          | throwError "the published addition lost its original family completion"
        family.requirePreparation original.association.request.roles.scope
        let #[actualRing] ← IO.ofExcept <|
            (original.association.inputs.arguments snapshot.graph).mapError IO.userError
          | throwError "the published addition changed its complete native parameter telescope"
        let #[pair] ← IO.ofExcept <|
            (receipt.association.inputs.arguments snapshot.graph).mapError IO.userError
          | throwError "the published addition changed its complete native operand telescope"
        unless retainsReference ring.2 actualRing do
          throwError "the direct or requested addition replaced its original selected ring"
        for index in #[0, 1] do
          let actual ← IO.ofExcept <| (snapshot.graph.project pair index).mapError IO.userError
          unless retainsReference operand.2 actual do
            throwError "the direct or requested addition replaced an original operand occurrence"
        unless receipt.association.request.observation.sourceSnapshot.isSome &&
            !receipt.association.request.selections.isEmpty &&
            !family.selections.isEmpty do
          throwError "the direct or requested addition discarded its original typed source meaning"
      for text in #["assert direct = 34 in R", "assert mediated = 34 in R"] do
        let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt text
          | throwError "the original public arithmetic check did not parse"
        let run ← withoutErrToSorry <| session.run ⟨parsed⟩
        unless run.outcome.kind == "holds" && run.published do
          throwError "the public arithmetic check did not observe the computed result: {run.outcome.detail}"
        session := run.session
      let expected := #["op.rings.add", "op.rings.mul", "op.rings.add"]
      unless (← session.kernel.dispatches.get).map (·.operation) == expected do
        throwError "the direct and provider-requested operations changed their actual dispatches"
      let mut observed : Array String := #[]
      for line in (← IO.FS.readFile traffic).splitOn "\n" do
        if line.isEmpty then continue
        let .ok frame := Json.parse line
          | throwError "the independent provider traffic log contains an invalid frame"
        let .ok operation := frame.getObjValAs? String "op"
          | throwError "the independent provider traffic log lost its operation"
        observed := observed.push operation
      unless observed == expected do
        throwError "the provider did not receive the original direct and requested operations"
    finally initial.close
  finally setEnv environment


-- The public file runner exposes its whole trace through a durable file. The original
-- protocol peer supplies independent traffic; neither the log nor these checks supplies
-- an interpretation or a mathematical result to the running session.
run_cmd do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let root ← IO.currentDir
    let contract ← CasCatalogue.Backend.packageDir CasCatalogue.Backend.contractPackage
    let python := (← IO.FS.realPath contract) / ".venv/bin/python"
    let logDirectory : System.FilePath :=
      (← IO.getEnv "CAS_APPLICATION_LOG_DIR").getD "timing/application"
    let nonce := (← IO.FS.readFile "/proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid").trimAscii.toString
    let evidence := logDirectory / "controls" / nonce
    IO.FS.createDirAll evidence
    let traffic := evidence / "peer.jsonl"
    IO.FS.writeFile traffic ""
    let manifest := Json.mkObj [
      ("backends", .arr #[Json.mkObj [("name", "peer"), ("command", python.toString),
        ("args", toJson #[(root / "scripts/probes/kernel_session_peer.py").toString,
          "--reference-add", traffic.toString])]]),
      ("registrations", .arr (#["op.rings.add", "op.rings.mul"].map fun operation =>
        Json.mkObj [("operation", toJson operation), ("input", toJson s!"{operation}#input"),
          ("backend", "peer")]))]
    let manifestPath := evidence / "leaves.json"
    IO.FS.writeFile manifestPath manifest.compress
    let input := root / "tests/runtime/application_log.cas"
    let initial ← liftTermElabM <| KernelSession.start (some manifestPath) (computationOnly := true)
    let readEvents (path : System.FilePath) : IO (Array Json) := do
      let mut events := #[]
      for line in (← IO.FS.readFile path).splitOn "\n" do
        if line.isEmpty then continue
        let event ← IO.ofExcept <| (Json.parse line).mapError IO.userError
        events := events.push event
      return events
    let dataOf (event : Json) : Json := (event.getObjVal? "data").toOption.getD .null
    let isEvent (name : String) (event : Json) : Bool :=
      (event.getObjValAs? String "event").toOption == some name
    try
      let (rows, _) ← CasCatalogue.Language.runFile initial input
      unless rows.map (·.id) == #["logging.direct", "logging.nested"] &&
          rows.all (fun row => row.kind == "holds" && row.attempted && row.published) do
        throwError "the complete public log fixture did not execute its original assertions: {toJson rows}"
      let events ← readEvents initial.kernel.log.path
      for event in events, ordinal in [:events.size] do
        unless (event.getObjValAs? Nat "sequence").toOption == some ordinal &&
            (event.getObjValAs? String "session").toOption == some initial.kernel.log.session do
          throwError "the session log changed its sequence or original diagnostic session"
        let .ok parents := event.getObjValAs? (Array Nat) "parents"
          | throwError "the session log lost its causal event parents"
        unless parents.all (· < ordinal) do
          throwError "a diagnostic event references a missing or later parent"
      for (name, count) in #[("computation.started", 6), ("computation.timing", 6),
          ("statement.started", 6), ("statement.finished", 6),
          ("statement.child.reading", 2), ("statement.child.started", 2),
          ("statement.child.finished", 2), ("binding.retained", 5)] do
        unless (events.filter (isEvent name)).size == count do
          throwError "the public file log lost an original event: {name}"
      for event in events.filter (isEvent "statement.started") do
        let data := dataOf event
        let .ok source := data.getObjValAs? String "source"
          | throwError "a statement log lost its source text"
        let .ok position := data.getObjVal? "position"
          | throwError "a statement log lost its original source range"
        unless !source.isEmpty && (position.getObjValAs? String "file").toOption ==
            some input.toString && (position.getObjValAs? Nat "startByte").isOk &&
            (position.getObjValAs? Nat "stopByte").isOk do
          throwError "a statement log replaced its original source text or position"
      unless (events.filter (isEvent "statement.read")).size == 7 do
        throwError "the public file log omitted a selected source interpretation"
      for event in events.filter (isEvent "statement.read") do
        let .ok scope := (dataOf event).getObjVal? "scope"
          | throwError "a source reading log lost its complete scope"
        unless (scope.getObjVal? "context").isOk &&
            (scope.getObjVal? "selections").isOk &&
            (scope.getObjVal? "nativeExpressions").isOk do
          throwError "a source reading log discarded its native typed interpretation"
      let dispatched := events.filter (isEvent "dispatch")
      let peer ← readEvents traffic
      unless dispatched.size == 3 && peer.size == 3 do
        throwError "the public file did not retain its three actual provider invocations"
      for event in dispatched, received in peer do
        let data := dataOf event
        let .ok selected := data.getObjVal? "selected"
          | throwError "a dispatch log lost its actual selected registration"
        let .ok operation := selected.getObjValAs? String "operation"
          | throwError "a dispatch log lost its actual operation"
        unless (received.getObjValAs? String "op").toOption == some operation &&
            (selected.getObjValAs? String "input").toOption == some s!"{operation}#input" &&
            (selected.getObjValAs? String "backend").toOption == some "peer" &&
            (data.getObjVal? "operands").toOption == (received.getObjVal? "context").toOption do
          throwError "the dispatch log does not match the independent provider's exact operands"
        let .ok occurrence := data.getObjVal? "occurrence"
          | throwError "a dispatch log lost its exact occurrence"
        let .ok request := data.getObjVal? "request"
          | throwError "a dispatch log lost its prepared typed request"
        let .ok native := request.getObjVal? "native"
          | throwError "a dispatch log lost its complete native request"
        let .ok prepared := native.getObjVal? "request"
          | throwError "a dispatch log lost its original prepared request graph"
        let .ok source := prepared.getObjVal? "source"
          | throwError "a dispatch log lost its complete selected source"
        unless (request.getObjVal? "sourceSnapshot").toOption.any (· != .null) &&
            (source.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "selections").toOption.any (!·.isEmpty) do
          throwError "the actual dispatch discarded its source or selected request observation"
        unless events.any (fun candidate => isEvent "request.prepared" candidate &&
            ((dataOf candidate).getObjVal? "native").toOption == some native) do
          throwError "the dispatch did not retain its original prepared execution request"
        for phase in #["reply.admission.started", "reply.admitted"] do
          unless events.any (fun candidate => isEvent phase candidate &&
              ((dataOf candidate).getObjVal? "occurrence").toOption == some occurrence) do
            throwError "the actual reply lost its result-admission event: {phase}"
      let completed := (events.filter (isEvent "computation.timing")).map dataOf
      let #[fileStarted] := (events.filter (isEvent "file.started")).map dataOf
        | throwError "the public file lost its one actual file start"
      let .ok sharedSetup := fileStarted.getObjValAs? Nat "sharedFileSetupMilliseconds"
        | throwError "the public file lost its measured parsing and read setup"
      let mut setup := sharedSetup
      for definition in completed.take 4 do
        let .ok elapsed := definition.getObjValAs? Nat "executionMilliseconds"
          | throwError "a successful source definition lost its actual timing"
        setup := setup + elapsed
      for computation in completed.drop 4 do
        unless (computation.getObjValAs? Nat "cumulativeSetupMilliseconds").toOption == some setup do
          throwError "a later statement discarded its retained source setup after an assertion"
      unless (events.filter (isEvent "file.finished")).size == 1 &&
          (events.filter (isEvent "statement.interrupted")).isEmpty &&
          (events.filter (isEvent "reply.rejected")).isEmpty do
        throwError "the complete original file log recorded an incomplete or rejected run"
    finally initial.close
    setEnv environment
    let emptyPath := evidence / "empty-leaves.json"
    IO.FS.writeFile emptyPath
      (Json.mkObj [("backends", .arr #[]), ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
    let bare ← liftTermElabM <| KernelSession.start (some emptyPath) (computationOnly := true)
    try
      let run ← CasCatalogue.Language.runStatement bare "let a := 17 + 29 in ℤ"
      unless run.outcome matches .noImplementation _ do
        throwError "the public missing-registration control changed its failure stratum: {run.outcome.detail}"
      let events ← readEvents bare.kernel.log.path
      unless events.any (fun event => isEvent "realization.missing" event &&
          ((dataOf event).getObjValAs? String "operation").toOption == some "op.rings.add" &&
          ((dataOf event).getObjValAs? (Array String) "forms").toOption ==
            some #["op.rings.add#input"]) do
        throwError "the noImplementation log omitted the exact unregistered operation and input"
      unless (events.filter (isEvent "dispatch")).isEmpty &&
          events.any (fun event => isEvent "statement.finished" event &&
            ((dataOf event).getObjValAs? String "stratum").toOption == some "noImplementation") do
        throwError "the missing-registration log invented a dispatch or lost its classified outcome"
    finally bare.close
  finally setEnv environment

module

public import CasRuntime.Occurrence
public import CasRuntime.Connection
public import CasRuntime.PreparedRequest
public import CasRuntime.InputResult
public import CasRuntime.Reply
public import Lean.Environment
public import Lean.CoreM
public import Init.System.Promise

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean

inductive TransactionFailure
  | settled | staleSnapshot | staleOwner | pendingCalls | referenceOutsideGraph
  | staleDraft | emptyDraft | invalidCompletion | detached
  | reservation (failure : ReservationFailure)
  | producerError (stratumTag : Option Name) (message : String)
  | producerInternal (id : Nat) (extra : List (Name × DataValue))
  deriving BEq, Repr

/-- The actual producer of a completed demand: one framed provider invocation, or the kernel's
own evaluation of retained code and stored fields, which sends no frame. -/
inductive CompletionProducer
  | invocation (dispatch : DispatchReservation) (scope : RuntimeId .scope) (requestId : Nat)
  | kernel

/-- Observational data from one actual received transport frame, including each
resume of a suspended invocation. Nothing in these observations can select an
implementation, validate a result, or extend a scope's authority. -/
structure RoutineInvocation where
  private mk ::
  occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence
  connection : ConnectionGeneration
  scope : RuntimeId .scope
  requestId : Nat
  observations : Option (Array Json)

/-- Completed native interface admission and its exact provenance.
References point into the ordinary graph; this record owns no second payload heap. -/
structure CompletionAssociation where
  private mk ::
  request : PreparedRequest
  response : PreparedResponse request
  inputs : InputRoleMap
  producer : CompletionProducer
  routines : Array RoutineInvocation

structure StagedCompletion where
  private mk ::
  transaction : RuntimeId .transaction
  private association : CompletionAssociation

structure CommittedReceipt where
  private mk ::
  association : CompletionAssociation
  commit : RuntimeId .commit
  snapshot : RuntimeId .snapshot
  outputBatch : RuntimeId .outputBatch

structure OutputBatch where
  private mk ::
  id : RuntimeId .outputBatch
  commit : RuntimeId .commit
  transaction : RuntimeId .transaction
  events : Array Json
  roots : Array (RuntimeId .value)

/-- The Environment owns the immutable published graph and complete output batches. -/
structure SessionSnapshot where
  private mk ::
  id : RuntimeId .snapshot
  graph : ValueGraph
  outputBatches : Array OutputBatch
  private receipts : Std.HashMap (RuntimeId .occurrence) CommittedReceipt
  private selections : Std.HashMap (Name × Name) ValueBinding := {}
  private receiverSelections :
    Std.HashMap (Name × Name × RuntimeId .value × Array (RuntimeId .association))
      (ValueBinding × ValueBinding) := {}

/-- Inert receipt visibility belongs to this exact immutable Environment snapshot. -/
def SessionSnapshot.receipt (snapshot : SessionSnapshot) (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence) :
    Option CommittedReceipt := snapshot.receipts[occurrence]?

/-- Runtime values are local to this worker and are not exported through .olean files.
Reference: Lean v4.33.0 Lean/Environment.lean, `registerEnvExtension` and `EnvExtension.setState`. -/
private initialize snapshotExtension : EnvExtension (Option SessionSnapshot) ←
  registerEnvExtension (pure none)

opaque SessionSnapshot.current : CoreM SessionSnapshot := do
  let some snapshot := snapshotExtension.getState (← getEnv)
    | throwError "the runtime Environment has not been initialized"
  return snapshot

/-- An explicitly isolated scratch consumer starts its own session. Its caller
must restore the original Environment, not merge the scratch graph. -/
def SessionSnapshot.clear : CoreM Unit :=
  modifyEnv (snapshotExtension.setState · none)

opaque SessionSnapshot.initialize (owners : OwnerRegistry) : CoreM SessionSnapshot := do
  let environment ← getEnv
  if (snapshotExtension.getState environment).isSome then
    throwError "the runtime Environment is already initialized"
  let snapshot : SessionSnapshot :=
    ⟨← owners.identities.fresh .snapshot, ValueGraph.empty owners.identities, #[], {}, {}, {}⟩
  setEnv (snapshotExtension.setState environment (some snapshot))
  return snapshot

private structure ActiveCell where
  parent : SessionSnapshot
  graph : ValueGraph
  roots : Array ValueBinding := #[]
  events : Array Json := #[]
  reservations : Array DispatchReservation := #[]
  leases : Array RequestLease := #[]
  routines : Array RoutineInvocation := #[]
  installedDrafts : Std.HashSet (RuntimeId .draft) := {}
  completions : Array StagedCompletion := #[]
  readySignals : Std.HashMap (RuntimeId .occurrence) (IO.Promise Unit) := {}
  claims : Std.HashMap (RuntimeId .occurrence) CasCompiler.RoleScope := {}
  selections : Std.HashMap (Name × Name) ValueBinding := {}
  receiverSelections :
    Std.HashMap (Name × Name × RuntimeId .value × Array (RuntimeId .association))
      (ValueBinding × ValueBinding) := {}

private inductive CellState
  | active (cell : ActiveCell)
  | committed (snapshot : RuntimeId .snapshot)
  | aborted (failure : TransactionFailure) (drainers : Array RequestLease)

private def CellState.failure : CellState → TransactionFailure
  | .aborted failure _ => failure
  | _ => .settled

/-- Isolated tentative reply fields, rooted in one exact active graph revision.
This is storage for validation, not evidence that validation has succeeded. -/
structure CellDraft where
  private mk ::
  private id : RuntimeId .draft
  private transaction : RuntimeId .transaction
  private identities : IdentitySupply
  private base : ValueGraph
  private graph : ValueGraph
  private roots : Array ValueBinding

def CellDraft.view (draft : CellDraft) : ValueGraph := draft.graph

/-- Retain an existing visible root without allocating a replacement node or installing it.
Reuse: ValueGraph.requiredOwners; installation performs the atomic owner recheck. -/
opaque CellDraft.retain (draft : CellDraft) (binding : ValueBinding) : IO CellDraft := do
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (draft.graph.requiredOwners #[binding]).mapError IO.userError
  return { draft with roots := draft.roots.push binding }

/-- Append only to this immutable draft; the active transaction remains unchanged.
Reuse: ValueGraph.stage, including fresh identities and derived capture owners. -/
opaque CellDraft.stage (draft : CellDraft) (origin : ValueOrigin) (payload : ValuePayload) :
    IO (CellDraft × ValueBinding) := do
  let (graph, binding) ← draft.graph.stage draft.identities origin payload
  return ({ draft with graph, roots := draft.roots.push binding }, binding)

/-- Register a field role only in this isolated reply delta.
Reuse: RecordPrefix.bind and the draft's immutable graph extension. -/
opaque CellDraft.bindField (draft : CellDraft) (record : RecordPrefix) (value : ValueBinding) :
    IO (CellDraft × RecordPrefix × ValueBinding) := do
  let (graph, record, binding) ← record.bind draft.graph value
  return ({ draft with graph, roots := draft.roots.push binding }, record, binding)

/-- Retain a reused result and its prepared stored-field views in this isolated reply.
Reuse: ValueGraph.bindApplication and atomic draft installation. -/
opaque CellDraft.bindApplication (draft : CellDraft) (origin : ValueOrigin)
    (value : ValueBinding) (fields : Array ValueBinding) : IO (CellDraft × ValueBinding) := do
  let (graph, binding) ← draft.graph.bindApplication draft.identities origin value fields
  return ({ draft with graph, roots := draft.roots.push binding }, binding)

/-- Keep a prepared projection association in the same isolated append-only reply delta. -/
opaque CellDraft.bindProjection (draft : CellDraft) (origin : ValueOrigin)
    (value : ValueBinding) (fields : Array ValueBinding) : MetaM (CellDraft × ValueBinding) := do
  let (graph, binding) ← draft.graph.bindProjection draft.identities origin value fields
  return ({ draft with graph, roots := draft.roots.push binding }, binding)

/-- Add only native constructor telescope/field views in this isolated reply graph.
The selected port and its stored descendants retain their original node identities. -/
opaque CellDraft.bindTelescopeTransport (draft : CellDraft)
    (transport : CasCompiler.ConstructorProjectionTransport)
    (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding))
    (selected : ValueBinding) : MetaM (CellDraft × ValueBinding) := do
  let (graph, binding) ← draft.graph.bindTelescopeTransport draft.identities transport
    parameters selected
  return ({ draft with graph, roots := draft.roots.push binding }, binding)

inductive ReuseDecision
  | ready (binding : ValueBinding)
  | pending (reservation : DispatchReservation)
  | running
  | unavailable

inductive DemandClaim
  | producer | waiter

private def CompletionAssociation.select (association : CompletionAssociation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (owners : OwnerRegistry) (role : CasCompiler.RoleId) :
    BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure ValueBinding) := do
  unless graph.worker == owners.worker do return .error (.reservation .wrongWorker)
  let .ok value := association.response.roles.lookup graph role
    | return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
  unless ← graph.isAvailable owners value do return .error .staleOwner
  return .ok value

/-- Reuse a visible committed result at the demanded role's own owner closure. -/
opaque SessionSnapshot.reuse (snapshot : SessionSnapshot) (owners : OwnerRegistry)
    (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence) (role : CasCompiler.RoleId) :
    BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure (Option ValueBinding)) := do
  let some receipt := snapshot.receipt occurrence | return .ok none
  return (← receipt.association.select snapshot.graph owners role).map some

/-- Active staging is cleared on settlement; only status remains in this object. -/
structure CellTransaction where
  private mk ::
  id : RuntimeId .transaction
  private ledger : OccurrenceLedger
  private state : Std.Mutex CellState

def CellTransaction.owners (transaction : CellTransaction) : OwnerRegistry :=
  transaction.ledger.owners

opaque CellTransaction.begin (ledger : OccurrenceLedger) : CoreM CellTransaction := do
  let parent ← SessionSnapshot.current
  unless parent.graph.worker == ledger.owners.worker do
    throwError "the transaction belongs to a different worker"
  let id ← ledger.owners.identities.fresh .transaction
  return ⟨id, ledger, ← Std.Mutex.new (.active { parent, graph := parent.graph })⟩

opaque CellTransaction.activeGraph (transaction : CellTransaction) : BaseIO (Option ValueGraph) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return none
    return some cell.graph

/-- Read the actual producer during authorized preparation, never from a tombstone. -/
opaque CellTransaction.completionFor? (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence) : BaseIO (Option CompletionAssociation) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return none
    if let some result := cell.completions.find? (·.association.request.occurrence == occurrence) then
      return some result.association
    return (cell.parent.receipt occurrence).map (·.association)

opaque CellTransaction.view (transaction : CellTransaction) : IO ValueGraph := do
  let some graph ← transaction.activeGraph
    | throw <| IO.userError "the transaction has settled"
  return graph

/-- Read the actual result of an exact source-selected field in this transaction's snapshot.
The association stores only a reference into the ordinary value graph. -/
def CellTransaction.selected (transaction : CellTransaction) (selection field : Name) :
    BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure (Option ValueBinding)) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let .active cell := state | return .error state.failure
    let value := cell.selections[(selection, field)]? <|>
      cell.parent.selections[(selection, field)]?
    if let some value := value then
      unless ← cell.graph.isAvailable transaction.owners value do return .error .staleOwner
    return .ok value

/-- Publish an association only with the cell that produced it. Abort discards this table;
commit retains its immutable references with the graph and ordinary receipts. -/
def CellTransaction.bindSelected (transaction : CellTransaction) (selection field : Name)
    (value : ValueBinding) : BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure Unit) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let .active cell := state | return .error state.failure
    let .ok _ := cell.graph.requiredOwners #[value] | return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    if let some existing := cell.selections[(selection, field)]? <|>
        cell.parent.selections[(selection, field)]? then
      unless existing.value == value.value do return .error .invalidCompletion
    set (CellState.active { cell with selections := cell.selections.insert (selection, field) value })
    return .ok ()

/-- Read a completed selection of this exact original receiver occurrence. The source name
identifies compiled producer syntax; the node and complete association path distinguish its
actual executions. Both the supplied and originally retained owner views remain live. -/
def CellTransaction.selectedAt (transaction : CellTransaction) (selection field : Name)
    (receiver : ValueBinding) : BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure (Option ValueBinding)) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let .active cell := state | return .error state.failure
    let .ok _ := cell.graph.requiredOwners #[receiver]
      | return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    unless ← cell.graph.isAvailable transaction.owners receiver do return .error .staleOwner
    let key := (selection, field, receiver.value, receiver.associationIds)
    let selected := cell.receiverSelections[key]? <|> cell.parent.receiverSelections[key]?
    let some (original, value) := selected | return .ok none
    unless (← cell.graph.isAvailable transaction.owners original) &&
        (← cell.graph.isAvailable transaction.owners value) do return .error .staleOwner
    return .ok (some value)

/-- Retain only a successfully completed value for one exact source receiver. Publication
and abort use the ordinary cell snapshot. Rebinding may repeat that exact result, but cannot
replace its node or consuming association path with another completed occurrence. -/
def CellTransaction.bindSelectedAt (transaction : CellTransaction) (selection field : Name)
    (receiver value : ValueBinding) : BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure Unit) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let .active cell := state | return .error state.failure
    let .ok _ := cell.graph.requiredOwners #[receiver, value]
      | return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    unless (← cell.graph.isAvailable transaction.owners receiver) &&
        (← cell.graph.isAvailable transaction.owners value) do return .error .staleOwner
    let key := (selection, field, receiver.value, receiver.associationIds)
    let prior := cell.receiverSelections[key]? <|> cell.parent.receiverSelections[key]?
    if let some (original, existing) := prior then
      unless existing.value == value.value && existing.associationIds == value.associationIds do
        return .error .invalidCompletion
      unless (← cell.graph.isAvailable transaction.owners original) &&
          (← cell.graph.isAvailable transaction.owners existing) do return .error .staleOwner
      set (CellState.active { cell with roots := cell.roots ++ #[receiver, existing] })
      return .ok ()
    set (CellState.active { cell with
      receiverSelections := cell.receiverSelections.insert key (receiver, value)
      roots := cell.roots ++ #[receiver, value] })
    return .ok ()

/-- Visible committed receipt, then this cell's completion, then its exact pending locator.
Consumed occurrences never recover a result from the resource ledger. -/
opaque CellTransaction.reuse (transaction : CellTransaction) (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence)
    (role : CasCompiler.RoleId) : BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure ReuseDecision) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let .active cell := state | return .error state.failure
    if let some receipt := cell.parent.receipt occurrence then
      return (← receipt.association.select cell.graph transaction.owners role).map .ready
    if let some completion := cell.completions.find? (·.association.request.occurrence == occurrence) then
      return (← completion.association.select cell.graph transaction.owners role).map .ready
    if let some claimed := cell.claims[occurrence]? then
      unless claimed == role.scope do return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    if let some pending ← transaction.ledger.pendingFor occurrence transaction.id then
      return .ok (.pending pending)
    if cell.claims.contains occurrence then return .ok .running
    return .ok .unavailable

/-- Claim one producer for the retained preparation before realization reservation.
Other demands share its signal; this grants no wire-send right and stores no payload. -/
opaque CellTransaction.claim (transaction : CellTransaction) (scope : CasCompiler.RoleScope) :
    BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure DemandClaim) := transaction.state.atomically do
  let state ← get
  let .active cell := state | return .error state.failure
  unless scope.program.worker == transaction.id.worker && scope.occurrence.worker == transaction.id.worker &&
      scope.preparation.worker == transaction.id.worker do return .error (.reservation .wrongWorker)
  if let some claimed := cell.claims[scope.occurrence]? then
    unless claimed == scope do return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    return .ok .waiter
  if let some receipt := cell.parent.receipt scope.occurrence then
    unless receipt.association.request.roles.scope == scope do return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    return .ok .waiter
  if let some completion := cell.completions.find? (·.association.request.occurrence == scope.occurrence) then
    unless completion.association.request.roles.scope == scope do return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    return .ok .waiter
  if (← transaction.ledger.pendingFor scope.occurrence transaction.id).isSome then return .ok .waiter
  unless ← transaction.ledger.isFresh scope.occurrence do return .error (.reservation .consumed)
  let signal : IO.Promise Unit ← IO.Promise.new
  set (CellState.active { cell with
    claims := cell.claims.insert scope.occurrence scope
    readySignals := cell.readySignals.insert scope.occurrence signal })
  return .ok .producer

opaque CellTransaction.isFresh (transaction : CellTransaction) (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence) :
    BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure Bool) := transaction.state.atomically do
  let state ← get
  let .active _ := state | return .error state.failure
  return .ok (← transaction.ledger.isFresh occurrence)

/-- One waiter has its own detach signal. The shared signal contains no completed result data. -/
structure CompletionWaiter where
  private mk ::
  private transaction : CellTransaction
  private occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence
  private role : CasCompiler.RoleId
  private ready : IO.Promise Unit
  private detached : IO.Promise Unit

/-- Attach to this transaction's exact occurrence without retaining a completed-value cache.
Reuse: Lean v4.33.0 Init/System/Promise.lean, Promise.new/resolve/result?. -/
opaque CellTransaction.watch (transaction : CellTransaction) (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence)
    (role : CasCompiler.RoleId) : BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure CompletionWaiter) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let state ← get
    let .active cell := state | return .error state.failure
    unless role.scope.occurrence == occurrence && role.scope.program.worker == transaction.id.worker do
      return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    if let some claimed := cell.claims[occurrence]? then
      unless claimed == role.scope do return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    let ready ← if (cell.parent.receipt occurrence).isSome ||
        cell.completions.any (·.association.request.occurrence == occurrence) then do
      let signal : IO.Promise Unit ← IO.Promise.new
      signal.resolve ()
      pure (some signal)
    else pure cell.readySignals[occurrence]?
    let some ready := ready | return .error (.reservation .consumed)
    return .ok ⟨transaction, occurrence, role, ready, ← IO.Promise.new⟩

/-- Detach only this waiter; the shared producer and other waiters remain active. -/
opaque CompletionWaiter.detach (waiter : CompletionWaiter) : BaseIO Unit :=
  waiter.detached.resolve ()

/-- Wait for a signal, then read the actual result from the still-active transaction.
Settled cells expose no completed data through their waiter handles. -/
opaque CompletionWaiter.wait (waiter : CompletionWaiter) : IO (Except TransactionFailure ValueBinding) := do
  let ready := waiter.ready.result?.map fun _ => false
  let detached := waiter.detached.result?.map fun _ => true
  discard <| IO.waitAny [ready, detached]
  if ← waiter.detached.isResolved then return .error .detached
  match ← waiter.transaction.reuse waiter.occurrence waiter.role with
  | .error failure => return .error failure
  | .ok (.ready value) => return .ok value
  | .ok (.pending _) | .ok .running => return .error .invalidCompletion
  | .ok .unavailable => return .error (.reservation .consumed)

/-- Begin a reply delta at the currently visible graph, without exposing any new field. -/
opaque CellTransaction.draft (transaction : CellTransaction) : IO CellDraft :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get
      | throw <| IO.userError "the transaction has settled"
    let identities := transaction.ledger.owners.identities
    return ⟨← identities.fresh .draft, transaction.id, identities, cell.graph, cell.graph, #[]⟩

/-- Install the complete isolated delta in one owner-checked active-state update.
The caller validates the whole promised interface before this storage transition.
Revision comparison prevents replacing an intervening append or installing a delta twice.
Reuse: the existing transaction/owner lock order and persistent ValueGraph operations. -/
opaque CellTransaction.installDraft (transaction : CellTransaction) (draft : CellDraft) :
    BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure Unit) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return .error .settled
    unless draft.transaction == transaction.id && cell.graph.sameRevision draft.base &&
        !cell.installedDrafts.contains draft.id do
      return .error .staleDraft
    if draft.roots.isEmpty then return .error .emptyDraft
    let .ok dependencies := draft.graph.requiredOwners draft.roots
      | return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    let installed ← transaction.ledger.owners.atomicallyWhileLive
        (m := Std.AtomicT CellState BaseIO) dependencies do
      set (CellState.active { cell with
        graph := draft.graph
        roots := cell.roots ++ draft.roots
        installedDrafts := cell.installedDrafts.insert draft.id })
    return if installed.isSome then .ok () else .error .staleOwner

opaque CellTransaction.stage (transaction : CellTransaction) (origin : ValueOrigin)
    (payload : ValuePayload) : IO ValueBinding :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get
      | throw <| IO.userError "the transaction has settled"
    let (graph, binding) ← cell.graph.stage transaction.ledger.owners.identities origin payload
    set (CellState.active { cell with graph, roots := cell.roots.push binding })
    return binding

/-- Retain an existing visible root for this cell's commit-time owner check.
Reuse: ValueGraph.requiredOwners and the same active transaction gate as new staging. -/
opaque CellTransaction.retain (transaction : CellTransaction) (binding : ValueBinding) : IO Unit :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get
      | throw <| IO.userError "the transaction has settled"
    discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (cell.graph.requiredOwners #[binding]).mapError IO.userError
    set (CellState.active { cell with roots := cell.roots.push binding })

opaque CellTransaction.emit (transaction : CellTransaction) (event : Json) : IO Unit :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get
      | throw <| IO.userError "the transaction has settled"
    set (CellState.active { cell with events := cell.events.push event })

/-- Track the actual reservation so abort can retire its pending locator.
Lock order is transaction, owner registry, then occurrence ledger; no engine I/O enters it. -/
opaque CellTransaction.reserve (transaction : CellTransaction) (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence)
    (selected : DispatchIdentity) (connection : Connection) (arguments : Array ValueBinding) :
    BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure DispatchReservation) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return .error .settled
    match ← transaction.ledger.reserve occurrence transaction.id selected connection cell.graph arguments with
    | .error failure => return .error (.reservation failure)
    | .ok reservation =>
      let signal ← match cell.readySignals[occurrence]? with
        | some signal => pure signal
        | none => IO.Promise.new
      set (CellState.active { cell with
        reservations := cell.reservations.push reservation
        readySignals := cell.readySignals.insert occurrence signal })
      return .ok reservation

/-- Track a retained native export's actual owner and code under the same abort boundary.
Reuse: OccurrenceLedger.reserveExport and the primitive reservation lock order. -/
opaque CellTransaction.reserveExport (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence) (callable : ValueBinding) (connection : Connection)
    (arguments : Array ValueBinding) : BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure DispatchReservation) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return .error .settled
    match ← transaction.ledger.reserveExport occurrence transaction.id callable connection
        cell.graph arguments with
    | .error failure => return .error (.reservation failure)
    | .ok reservation =>
      let signal ← match cell.readySignals[occurrence]? with
        | some signal => pure signal
        | none => IO.Promise.new
      set (CellState.active { cell with
        reservations := cell.reservations.push reservation
        readySignals := cell.readySignals.insert occurrence signal })
      return .ok reservation

/-- Arbitrate the one-use send decision against whole-cell abort before any engine write.
Reuse: the reserve lock order, active-cell gate and occurrence send commitment. -/
opaque CellTransaction.commitSend (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (reservation : DispatchReservation) (lease : RequestLease) :
    BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure Unit) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return .error .settled
    unless reservation.transaction == transaction.id && lease.transaction == transaction.id &&
        lease.occurrence == reservation.occurrence && lease.owner == reservation.connection &&
        cell.reservations.any (fun tracked =>
        tracked.occurrence == reservation.occurrence && tracked.connection == reservation.connection &&
        tracked.selected == reservation.selected) do
      return .error (.reservation .unknownOccurrence)
    match ← transaction.ledger.commitSend reservation with
    | .error failure => return .error (.reservation failure)
    | .ok () =>
      unless ← lease.markSent do return .error (.reservation .consumed)
      set (CellState.active { cell with leases := cell.leases.push lease })
      return .ok ()

/-- Register the lease of a resume request on an already sent occurrence, against whole-cell
abort, before any engine write. The occurrence keeps its one dispatch right: a resume continues
the suspended invocation, so the ledger is checked, not advanced.
Reuse: commitSend's active-cell gate and reservation tracking. -/
opaque CellTransaction.commitResume (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (reservation : DispatchReservation) (lease : RequestLease) :
    BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure Unit) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return .error .settled
    unless reservation.transaction == transaction.id && lease.transaction == transaction.id &&
        lease.occurrence == reservation.occurrence && lease.owner == reservation.connection &&
        cell.reservations.any (fun tracked =>
        tracked.occurrence == reservation.occurrence && tracked.connection == reservation.connection &&
        tracked.selected == reservation.selected) do
      return .error (.reservation .unknownOccurrence)
    unless ← transaction.ledger.wasSent reservation do return .error (.reservation .consumed)
    unless ← lease.markSent do return .error (.reservation .consumed)
    set (CellState.active { cell with leases := cell.leases.push lease })
    return .ok ()

/-- Stage inert routine observations only at the actual received-frame
boundary. The scope, lease and reservation are already authoritative; the
observation payload never supplies any of these identities. Unnegotiated
observations are absent, not an invented description of a provider call. -/
opaque CellTransaction.recordRoutineInvocation (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (scope : RequestScope) (lease : RequestLease) (observations : Option (Array Json)) :
    BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure Unit) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return .error .settled
    let dispatch := scope.reservation
    unless dispatch.transaction == transaction.id && lease.transaction == transaction.id &&
        lease.occurrence == dispatch.occurrence && lease.owner == dispatch.connection &&
        cell.reservations.any (fun tracked => tracked.occurrence == dispatch.occurrence &&
          tracked.connection == dispatch.connection && tracked.selected == dispatch.selected) &&
        cell.leases.any (fun tracked => tracked.requestId == lease.requestId &&
          tracked.occurrence == lease.occurrence && tracked.owner == lease.owner) do
      return .error .invalidCompletion
    unless ← lease.canCommit do return .error .settled
    if cell.routines.any (fun frame => frame.connection == lease.owner &&
        frame.requestId == lease.requestId) then
      return .error .invalidCompletion
    let frame : RoutineInvocation :=
      ⟨dispatch.occurrence, dispatch.connection, scope.id, lease.requestId, observations⟩
    set (CellState.active { cell with routines := cell.routines.push frame })
    return .ok ()

/-- Install an admitted whole reply and its transaction-local completion together.
Reuse: prepared input/result admission, isolated drafts, actual received leases and owner gating.
The parsed reply and request scope identify the exact transport invocation. -/
opaque CellTransaction.completeReply (transaction : CellTransaction) (draft : CellDraft)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (response : PreparedResponse request)
    (scope : RequestScope) (reply : ImmediateReply) : MetaM (Except TransactionFailure CompletionAssociation) := do
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs draft.view
  let response ← request.admitResult draft.view response.root
  discard <| scope.resolveMany scope.reservation draft.view scope.wireId #[]
  liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return .error .settled
    let dispatch := scope.reservation
    unless reply.scopeId == scope.id && dispatch.transaction == transaction.id &&
        dispatch.occurrence == request.occurrence && request.program.worker == transaction.id.worker &&
        draft.transaction == transaction.id && cell.graph.sameRevision draft.base &&
        !cell.installedDrafts.contains draft.id do return .error .invalidCompletion
    if cell.completions.any (·.association.request.occurrence == request.occurrence) ||
        (cell.parent.receipt request.occurrence).isSome then return .error .invalidCompletion
    if let some claimed := cell.claims[request.occurrence]? then
      unless claimed == request.roles.scope do return .error .invalidCompletion
    unless cell.reservations.any (fun tracked => tracked.occurrence == dispatch.occurrence &&
        tracked.connection == dispatch.connection && tracked.selected == dispatch.selected) do
      return .error .invalidCompletion
    let some lease := cell.leases.find? (fun lease => lease.requestId == reply.requestId &&
        lease.occurrence == request.occurrence && lease.owner == dispatch.connection)
      | return .error .invalidCompletion
    unless ← lease.canCommit do return .error .invalidCompletion
    let outputs := response.roles.references
    let .ok dependencies := draft.graph.requiredOwners
        (draft.roots ++ outputs ++ inputs.references ++ reply.exports.flatMap (·.captures))
      | return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    let dependencies := dependencies ++ dispatch.dependencies
    let outcome : Option (Except TransactionFailure CompletionAssociation) ← transaction.owners.atomicallyWhileLive
        (m := Std.AtomicT CellState BaseIO) dependencies do
      unless ← transaction.ledger.retire dispatch do return .error .invalidCompletion
      let association : CompletionAssociation :=
        ⟨request, response, inputs, .invocation dispatch scope.id reply.requestId,
          cell.routines.filter (·.occurrence == request.occurrence)⟩
      let completion : StagedCompletion := ⟨transaction.id, association⟩
      if let some signal := cell.readySignals[request.occurrence]? then signal.resolve ()
      set (CellState.active { cell with
        graph := draft.graph
        roots := cell.roots ++ draft.roots ++ outputs
        reservations := cell.reservations.filter (·.occurrence != request.occurrence)
        routines := cell.routines.filter (·.occurrence != request.occurrence)
        installedDrafts := cell.installedDrafts.insert draft.id
        completions := cell.completions.push completion
        readySignals := cell.readySignals.erase request.occurrence
        claims := cell.claims.erase request.occurrence })
      return .ok association
    if let some (.ok _) := outcome then scope.retire
    return outcome.getD (.error .staleOwner)

/-- Stored access demands its exact selected field while retaining the full parent input map.
Only a real stored projection has this owner scope. Its result must retain the selected node
and every existing consuming association; all other kernel completions demand their inputs. -/
private def kernelInputReferences (request : PreparedRequest) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (inputs : InputRoleMap) (response : PreparedResponse request) :
    Except TransactionFailure (Array ValueBinding) := do
  let .project operand _ := request.action | return inputs.references
  let path ← request.projectionPath.mapError (fun _ => .invalidCompletion)
  let selected ← (graph.projectionFrontier operand path).mapError (fun _ => .invalidCompletion)
  let some (selected, remaining) := selected | return inputs.references
  unless remaining.isEmpty do return inputs.references
  unless selected.value == response.root.value &&
      selected.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf response.root.associationIds.toList do
    throw .invalidCompletion
  return #[selected]

private def CellTransaction.finishKernel (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (response : PreparedResponse request) (inputs : InputRoleMap)
    (includeInputs : Bool) :
    MetaM (Except TransactionFailure CompletionAssociation) := do
  let graph ← transaction.view
  unless inputs.telescope.scope == request.roles.scope do return .error .invalidCompletion
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners inputs.references).mapError IO.userError
  let response ← request.admitResult graph response.root
  let .ok demanded := if includeInputs then kernelInputReferences request graph inputs response
      else .ok #[]
    | return .error .invalidCompletion
  liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return .error .settled
    unless request.program.worker == transaction.id.worker &&
        cell.graph.sameRevision graph do return .error .invalidCompletion
    if cell.completions.any (·.association.request.occurrence == request.occurrence) ||
        (cell.parent.receipt request.occurrence).isSome then return .error .invalidCompletion
    unless cell.claims[request.occurrence]? == some request.roles.scope do
      return .error .invalidCompletion
    if (← transaction.ledger.pendingFor request.occurrence transaction.id).isSome then
      return .error .invalidCompletion
    let outputs := response.roles.references
    let .ok dependencies := cell.graph.requiredOwners (outputs ++ demanded)
      | return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    let outcome : Option CompletionAssociation ← transaction.owners.atomicallyWhileLive
        (m := Std.AtomicT CellState BaseIO) dependencies do
      transaction.ledger.abandon request.occurrence
      let association : CompletionAssociation := ⟨request, response, inputs, .kernel, #[]⟩
      if let some signal := cell.readySignals[request.occurrence]? then signal.resolve ()
      set (CellState.active { cell with
        roots := cell.roots ++ outputs
        completions := cell.completions.push ⟨transaction.id, association⟩
        readySignals := cell.readySignals.erase request.occurrence
        claims := cell.claims.erase request.occurrence })
      return association
    return match outcome with
      | some association => .ok association
      | none => .error .staleOwner

/-- Complete a claimed demand that the kernel evaluated from retained code or stored fields.
No dispatch right is consumed and no frame exists. The occurrence leaves the fresh state,
so a later demand cannot dispatch it. Later demands in this cell reuse this completion.
Reuse: the claim, owner gate and completion table of completeReply. -/
opaque CellTransaction.completeKernel (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (response : PreparedResponse request) :
    MetaM (Except TransactionFailure CompletionAssociation) := do
  let inputs ← request.admitInputs (← transaction.view)
  transaction.finishKernel request response inputs true

/-- Complete this certified input result with its selected output owner closure. Its sealed
plan retains the already checked supplied input map; only source-proven unused argument slots
may be absent. Unrelated input owners are not execution dependencies.
Reuse: completeKernel's revision, claim, ledger, completion and waiter transitions. -/
opaque CellTransaction.completeInputResult (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (request : PreparedRequest) (completed : InputResultCompletion request) :
    MetaM (Except TransactionFailure CompletionAssociation) :=
  transaction.finishKernel request completed.response completed.inputs false

/-- Settle with plain diagnostic/status metadata, dropping every staged value and completion.
The first settlement wins. Native exception data use Lean's literal KVMap entries, not message callbacks. -/
opaque CellTransaction.fail (transaction : CellTransaction) (failure : TransactionFailure) : BaseIO Bool :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return false
    for claimed in cell.claims.toArray do transaction.ledger.abandon claimed.1
    for reservation in cell.reservations do
      discard <| transaction.ledger.retire reservation
    for lease in cell.leases do lease.cancel
    for signal in cell.readySignals.toArray do signal.2.resolve ()
    set (CellState.aborted failure cell.leases)
    return true

/-- Abort discards staging and leaves every reserved dispatch right consumed. -/
opaque CellTransaction.abort (transaction : CellTransaction) : BaseIO Bool :=
  transaction.fail .settled

/-- Settlement retains only resource drain handles, not the staged graph,
programs, results or source. A cooperative abort can be followed by explicit
force even after the evaluator has returned. -/
private def CellTransaction.drainLeases (transaction : CellTransaction) :
    BaseIO (Array RequestLease) :=
  transaction.state.atomically do
    match ← get with
    | .active cell => return cell.leases
    | .aborted _ drainers => return drainers
    | .committed _ => return #[]

opaque CellTransaction.draining (transaction : CellTransaction) : BaseIO Bool := do
  for lease in ← transaction.drainLeases do
    if ← lease.draining then return true
  return false

/-- Explicit force applies only to the affected request's still-live drainer.
The transaction gate is released before process termination. -/
opaque CellTransaction.force (transaction : CellTransaction) : IO (Array ConnectionGeneration) := do
  discard <| (transaction.abort : BaseIO Bool)
  let mut revoked := #[]
  for lease in ← transaction.drainLeases do
    if let some owner ← lease.force then
      revoked := revoked.push owner
  return revoked

/-- Preserve the released port classifier when a wire failure settles the producer. -/
opaque CellTransaction.failPort (transaction : CellTransaction) (failure : CasCatalogue.Backend.PortError) :
    BaseIO Bool := transaction.fail (.producerError (some failure.stratum.tag)
      s!"{failure.stratum.label}: {failure.render}")

/-- Publish the graph and output batch in one Environment update.
The command worker owns the CoreM Environment. Its transaction gate arbitrates commit/abort;
the owner lock covers the liveness check and the decision. Settlement drops active staging. -/
opaque CellTransaction.commit (transaction : CellTransaction) :
    CoreM (Except TransactionFailure SessionSnapshot) := do
  let environment ← getEnv
  let current := snapshotExtension.getState environment
  let outcome : Except TransactionFailure SessionSnapshot ←
      liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.state.atomically do
    let .active cell ← get | return .error .settled
    let some current := current | return .error .staleSnapshot
    unless current.id == cell.parent.id do
      return .error .staleSnapshot
    unless cell.reservations.isEmpty && cell.claims.isEmpty do return .error .pendingCalls
    let .ok dependencies := cell.graph.requiredOwners cell.roots
      | return .error .referenceOutsideGraph
    let owners := transaction.ledger.owners
    let result ← owners.atomicallyWhileLive (m := Std.AtomicT CellState BaseIO) dependencies do
      RequestLease.commitAll transaction.id cell.leases do
        let commit ← owners.identities.fresh .commit
        let snapshotId ← owners.identities.fresh .snapshot
        let batch : OutputBatch :=
          ⟨← owners.identities.fresh .outputBatch, commit, transaction.id, cell.events, cell.roots.map (·.value)⟩
        let mut receipts := cell.parent.receipts
        for completion in cell.completions do
          let association := completion.association
          receipts := receipts.insert association.request.occurrence
            ⟨association, commit, snapshotId, batch.id⟩
        let snapshot : SessionSnapshot :=
          ⟨snapshotId, cell.graph, cell.parent.outputBatches.push batch, receipts,
            cell.selections.fold (fun values key value => values.insert key value)
              cell.parent.selections,
            cell.receiverSelections.fold (fun values key value => values.insert key value)
              cell.parent.receiverSelections⟩
        set (CellState.committed snapshot.id)
        return snapshot
    match result with
    | none =>
      for lease in cell.leases do lease.cancel
      set (CellState.aborted .staleOwner cell.leases)
      return .error .staleOwner
    | some none =>
      for lease in cell.leases do lease.cancel
      set (CellState.aborted .invalidCompletion cell.leases)
      return .error .invalidCompletion
    | some (some snapshot) => return .ok snapshot
  match outcome with
  | .error failure => return .error failure
  | .ok snapshot =>
    setEnv (snapshotExtension.setState environment (some snapshot))
    return .ok snapshot

end CasRuntime

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
    let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 7]
    let layout ← RecordLayout.ofSource (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close pair))
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
    let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
    let value ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
      { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
    let older ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
    let fields ← liftM (m := IO) <| RecordPrefix.begin owners.identities program occurrence layout
    let draft ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.draft
    let (left, _, selected) ← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.bindField fields value
    let (right, _, other) ← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.bindField fields value
    unless selected.value == value.value && other.value == value.value &&
        !left.view.sameRevision older && !left.view.sameRevision right.view do
      throwError "association-only drafts changed nodes or shared a graph revision"
    if (older.requiredOwners #[selected]).isOk then
      throwError "an isolated association entered its base graph"
    let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.installDraft left
      | throwError "the isolated association could not install"
    match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (transaction.installDraft right) with
    | .error .staleDraft => pure ()
    | _ => throwError "a sibling association draft replaced an intervening graph revision"
    let active ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
    let .ok _ := active.requiredOwners #[selected]
      | throwError "the installed association is absent from its active graph"
    if (active.requiredOwners #[other]).isOk then
      throwError "the active graph recovered an uninstalled sibling association"
    let .ok published ← transaction.commit
      | throwError "the association-only delta could not commit"
    let .ok _ := published.graph.requiredOwners #[selected]
      | throwError "commit lost the installed association"
    if (published.graph.requiredOwners #[other]).isOk then
      throwError "commit published an uninstalled association"
  finally setEnv original

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
    let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
    let origin : ValueOrigin := { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] }
    let child ← liftM (m := IO) <| owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let token ← liftM (m := IO) do
        child.child.stdin.putStr "joint reply resource\n"
        child.child.stdin.flush
        return (← child.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
      let draft ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.draft
      let (draft, portable) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        draft.stage origin (.portable "joint portable field".toUTF8)
      let (draft, native) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        draft.stage origin (.ownedExport child token #[portable])
      let current ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      unless (current.find portable.value).isNone && (current.find native.value).isNone do
        throwError "an isolated reply draft exposed a prefix to the active transaction"
      liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close child.generation
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (transaction.installDraft draft) with
      | .error .staleOwner => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "a joint reply installed a field whose required owner had died"
      let unchanged ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      unless (unchanged.find portable.value).isNone && (unchanged.find native.value).isNone do
        throwError "failed joint installation left a visible reply prefix"
      let clean ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.draft
      let (clean, first) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        clean.stage origin (.portable "first admitted field".toUTF8)
      let (clean, second) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        clean.stage origin (.product #[first])
      let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (transaction.installDraft clean)
        | throwError "the complete portable reply could not enter the active graph"
      let admitted ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      unless (admitted.find first.value).isSome && (admitted.find second.value).isSome do
