        throwError "joint installation lost an admitted field"
      let .ok selected := admitted.project second 0
        | throwError "the admitted record lost its actual preceding field"
      unless selected.value == first.value do
        throwError "joint installation replaced a preceding field's identity"
      if ((← SessionSnapshot.current).graph.find first.value).isSome then
        throwError "draft installation published before whole-cell commit"
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (transaction.installDraft clean) with
      | .error .staleDraft => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "an already installed reply draft was installed twice"
      let stale ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.draft
      let (stale, lost) ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        stale.stage origin (.portable "stale reply field".toUTF8)
      let intervening ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        transaction.stage origin (.portable "intervening field".toUTF8)
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (transaction.installDraft stale) with
      | .error .staleDraft => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "reply installation replaced a newer active graph"
      let latest ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
      unless (latest.find lost.value).isNone && (latest.find intervening.value).isSome do
        throwError "stale reply installation changed the active graph"
      let other ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (other.installDraft clean) with
      | .error .staleDraft => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "a reply draft crossed its owning transaction"
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) other.abort
      let .ok committed ← transaction.commit
        | throwError "the cell could not publish its admitted joint reply"
      unless (committed.graph.find first.value).isSome &&
          (committed.graph.find second.value).isSome &&
          (committed.graph.find intervening.value).isSome &&
          (committed.graph.find portable.value).isNone do
        throwError "whole-cell commit changed the admitted reply set"
    finally liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close child.generation
  finally setEnv original

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let parent ← getEnv
    let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
    let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
    let value ← liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.stage
      { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable "cell payload".toUTF8)
    liftM (m := IO) <| transaction.emit (.str "cell output")
    let staged ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
    unless (staged.find value.value).isSome do
      throwError "a later cell expression cannot see its staged value"
    if ((← SessionSnapshot.current).graph.find value.value).isSome then
      throwError "an Environment query exposed a staged value"
    let .ok published ← transaction.commit
      | throwError "the cell could not publish its complete delta"
    unless (published.graph.find value.value).isSome &&
        published.outputBatches.size == 1 do
      throwError "commit did not publish values and output together"
    let some batch := published.outputBatches[0]?
      | throwError "the committed output batch is missing"
    unless batch.transaction == transaction.id && batch.events == #[.str "cell output"] do
      throwError "commit changed the staged output or its transaction association"
    match ← transaction.commit with
    | .error .settled => pure ()
    | _ => throwError "a settled cell committed again"
    if ← liftM (m := BaseIO) transaction.abort then
      throwError "abort replaced a successful commit"
    let aborted ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let pending ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
    let child ← liftM (m := IO) <| owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "resource-test-manifest"
        registration := { operation := "resource-test", input := "resource-test", backend := "cat" }
        profileDigest := "resource-test-profile" }
      let .ok _ ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| aborted.reserve pending selected child #[]
        | throwError "the transaction could not reserve its invocation"
      let discarded ← liftM (m := IO) <| aborted.stage
        { program, occurrence := pending, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable "discarded payload".toUTF8)
      liftM (m := IO) <| aborted.emit (.str "discarded output")
      match ← aborted.commit with
      | .error .pendingCalls => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "an in-flight call allowed whole-cell publication"
      unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) aborted.abort do
        throwError "the active transaction could not abort"
      let current ← SessionSnapshot.current
      if (current.graph.find discarded.value).isSome then
        throwError "an aborted value became visible in the Environment"
      unless current.outputBatches.size == published.outputBatches.size do
        throwError "abort published a staged output batch"
      let unpublished ← liftM (m := IO) do
        try
          discard <| aborted.view
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
      unless unpublished do throwError "the settled transaction retained a staged graph"
      setEnv parent
      let other ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| other.reserve pending selected child #[] with
      | .error (.reservation .consumed) => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "restoring an old Environment replenished a dispatch right"
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) other.abort
      if ((← SessionSnapshot.current).graph.find value.value).isSome then
        throwError "an old Environment recovered a newer committed payload"
    finally liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close child.generation
  finally setEnv original

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let producer ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
    let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
    let child ← liftM (m := IO) <| owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let token ← liftM (m := IO) do
        child.child.stdin.putStr "reused owner token\n"
        child.child.stdin.flush
        return (← child.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
      let value ← liftM (m := IO) <| producer.stage
        { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.ownedExport child token #[])
      let .ok _ ← producer.commit | throwError "the original owned value could not commit"
      let consumer ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      liftM (m := IO) <| consumer.retain value
      let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
          consumer.bindSelectedAt `ownedConstruction `cone value value
        | throwError "the original owned receiver could not retain its selected result"
      liftM (m := IO) <| consumer.emit (.str "reused result")
      liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close child.generation
      match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| consumer.selectedAt `ownedConstruction `cone value with
      | .error .staleOwner => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "a receiver-scoped selection returned a known-dead original owner"
      match ← consumer.commit with
      | .error .staleOwner => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "commit lost the owner dependency of a reused result"
      let visible ← SessionSnapshot.current
      unless visible.outputBatches.size == 1 && (visible.graph.find value.value).isSome do
        throwError "failed reuse publication changed the prior snapshot"
      let independent ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let portable ← liftM (m := IO) <| independent.stage
        { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable "independent result".toUTF8)
      let .ok published ← independent.commit
        | throwError "a dead prior owner blocked an independent portable result"
      unless (published.graph.find portable.value).isSome do
        throwError "the independent portable result was not published"
    finally liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close child.generation
  finally setEnv original

-- One compiled source selection may execute repeatedly. Equal native values and different
-- consuming association paths remain distinct actual receivers, including across snapshots.
run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
    let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkNatLit 7]
    let layout ← RecordLayout.ofSource (← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close pair))
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let seed ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
    let stage := fun () => do
      let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      liftM (m := IO) <| seed.stage
        { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable "7".toUTF8)
    let receiver ← stage ()
    let equalReceiver ← stage ()
    let firstResult ← stage ()
    let secondResult ← stage ()
    unless receiver.value != equalReceiver.value &&
        receiver.role.source.expression.equal equalReceiver.role.source.expression do
      throwError "the selection control lost its distinct equal-source receiver nodes"
    let draft ← liftM (m := IO) seed.draft
    let firstPrefix ← liftM (m := IO) <| RecordPrefix.begin owners.identities program
      (← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate) layout
    let (draft, _, firstView) ← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.bindField firstPrefix receiver
    let secondPrefix ← liftM (m := IO) <| RecordPrefix.begin owners.identities program
      (← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate) layout
    let (draft, _, secondView) ← liftM (m := IO) <| draft.bindField secondPrefix receiver
    let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| seed.installDraft draft
      | throwError "the receiver association controls could not enter their actual graph"
    unless firstView.value == receiver.value && secondView.value == receiver.value &&
        firstView.associationIds != secondView.associationIds &&
        firstView.associationIds != receiver.associationIds do
      throwError "the selection control lost its distinct association paths"
    let .ok _ ← seed.commit | throwError "the receiver control graph could not commit"
    let beforeSelections ← getEnv
    let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let selection := `sameCompiledConstruction
    let field := `cone
    let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.bindSelectedAt selection field receiver firstResult
      | throwError "the first exact receiver lost its completed selection"
    for unrelated in #[equalReceiver, firstView, secondView] do
      let .ok none ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| transaction.selectedAt selection field unrelated
        | throwError "a construction reused an equal node or another association path"
    let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.bindSelectedAt selection field firstView secondResult
      | throwError "the independently associated receiver could not retain its own result"
    let .ok (some selected) ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.selectedAt selection field firstView
      | throwError "the exact associated receiver lost its result"
    unless selected.value == secondResult.value &&
        selected.associationIds == secondResult.associationIds do
      throwError "the selected result changed its complete actual occurrence"
    match ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.bindSelectedAt selection field receiver secondResult with
    | .error .invalidCompletion => pure ()
    | _ => throwError "a completed receiver selection was replaced by another occurrence"
    let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        transaction.bindSelectedAt selection field receiver firstResult
      | throwError "repeating the same exact selection changed its result"
    let .ok _ ← transaction.commit | throwError "the receiver selections could not commit"
    let current ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let .ok (some selected) ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        current.selectedAt selection field receiver
      | throwError "the committed exact receiver selection is absent"
    unless selected.value == firstResult.value &&
        selected.associationIds == firstResult.associationIds do
      throwError "commit changed the original selected result"
    discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) current.abort
    setEnv beforeSelections
    let branch ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let .ok none ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| branch.selectedAt selection field receiver
      | throwError "an older source branch recovered a newer completed selection"
    let .ok () ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        branch.bindSelectedAt selection field equalReceiver secondResult
      | throwError "the independent branch could not stage its own receiver selection"
    discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) branch.abort
    let afterAbort ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let .ok none ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| afterAbort.selectedAt selection field equalReceiver
      | throwError "an aborted receiver selection became visible"
    discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) afterAbort.abort
  finally setEnv original

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
    let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let first ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let second ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let program ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.identities.fresh .program)
    let firstOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
    let firstValue ← liftM (m := IO) <| first.stage
      { program, occurrence := firstOccurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable "first cell".toUTF8)
    let secondOccurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
    let secondValue ← liftM (m := IO) <| second.stage
      { program, occurrence := secondOccurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable "second cell".toUTF8)
    let .ok _ ← first.commit | throwError "the first cell could not commit"
    match ← second.commit with
    | .error .staleSnapshot => pure ()
    | _ => throwError "a stale cell replaced a newer committed snapshot"
    discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) second.abort
    let visible ← SessionSnapshot.current
    unless (visible.graph.find firstValue.value).isSome &&
        (visible.graph.find secondValue.value).isNone do
      throwError "stale publication changed the visible value graph"
    let owned ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
    let child ← liftM (m := IO) <| owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      let token ← liftM (m := IO) do
        child.child.stdin.putStr "owned token\n"
        child.child.stdin.flush
        return (← child.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
      let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let value ← liftM (m := IO) <| owned.stage
        { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.ownedExport child token #[])
      liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close child.generation
      match ← owned.commit with
      | .error .staleOwner => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "commit accepted a known-dead result owner"
      if ((← SessionSnapshot.current).graph.find value.value).isSome then
        throwError "owner loss published a staged result"
      let cleared ← liftM (m := IO) do
        try
          discard <| owned.view
          pure false
        catch _ => pure true
      unless cleared do throwError "owner-loss settlement retained a staged graph"
    finally liftM (m := IO) <| owners.close child.generation
  finally setEnv original

module

public import CasRuntime.Connection
public import CasRuntime.Transaction
public import CasRuntime.Reply

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean CasCatalogue.Backend

private def sameInvocation (left right : DispatchReservation) : Bool :=
  left.occurrence == right.occurrence && left.transaction == right.transaction &&
    left.connection == right.connection && left.selected == right.selected

private def ownsInvocation (wire : FramedConnection) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (reservation : DispatchReservation) (scope : RequestScope) : Bool :=
  reservation.connection == wire.connection.generation &&
    (match reservation.selected with
      | .primitive selected => selected.registration.backend == wire.backend
      | .native .. => true) &&
    reservation.transaction == transaction.id && sameInvocation scope.reservation reservation

private def DispatchTarget.operation : DispatchTarget → String
  | .primitive selected => selected.registration.operation
  | .native .. => "$cas.invoke_export"

/-- Frame the exact reserved target; native tokens come only from its stored code identity.
Reuse: cas_session._Invoke and _InvokeExport in the pinned public SDK. -/
private def invocationFrame (reservation : DispatchReservation) (scope : RequestScope)
    (requestId : Nat) (arguments : Json) : Json :=
  match reservation.selected with
  | .primitive selected => Json.mkObj [
      ("protocol", toJson (2 : Nat)), ("request_id", toJson requestId),
      ("op", .str selected.registration.operation), ("input", .str selected.registration.input),
      ("args", arguments), ("scope_id", .str scope.wireId)]
  | .native _ token => Json.mkObj [
      ("protocol", toJson (2 : Nat)), ("request_id", toJson requestId),
      ("op", .str "$cas.invoke_export"), ("scope_id", .str scope.wireId),
      ("token", .str token),
      ("captures", .arr ((Array.range scope.captureCount).map fun index =>
        (ScopedReference.scope index).encode)), ("context", arguments)]

/-- The resume of a suspended invocation: a fresh request naming the continuation, with the
declared captures and then the child results as references to the resume scope from zero.
Reuse: cas_session._Resume in the pinned public SDK. -/
private def resumeFrame (scope : RequestScope) (continuation : String) (captures results : Nat)
    (requestId : Nat) : Json :=
  let reference := fun (index : Nat) => (ScopedReference.scope index).encode
  Json.mkObj [("protocol", toJson (2 : Nat)), ("request_id", toJson requestId),
    ("op", .str "$cas.resume"), ("continuation", .str continuation),
    ("scope_id", .str scope.wireId),
    ("captures", .arr ((Array.range captures).map reference)),
    ("results", .arr ((Array.range results).map fun index => reference (captures + index)))]

private def failureReply (id : Nat) (operation : String) (frame : Json) : Except PortError Unit := do
  match ← str frame "status" with
  | "error" =>
    (checkServiceFields #["request_id", "status", "kind", "message"] frame).mapError PortError.protocol
    throw (.backend (← str frame "kind") (← str frame "message"))
  | "unsupported" =>
    (checkServiceFields #["request_id", "status", "op"] frame).mapError PortError.protocol
    unless (← str frame "op") == operation do
      throw (.protocol "the unsupported reply changed its consumed operation")
    throw (.unsupported operation)
  | status => throw (.protocol s!"request {id} has an unknown control status {status}")

/-- A complete successful control frame: an immediate value, an ordered deferred group with
its final template, or a suspension with its continuation, declared captures and ordered child
calls (execution contract v2 §6, python-sdk.md "Generator suspension"). A group is validated
before any child runs. -/
inductive InvocationReply
  | immediate (reply : ImmediateReply)
  | deferred (requestId : Nat) (calls : Array Json) (template exports : Json)
  | suspended (requestId : Nat) (continuation : String) (captures calls : Array Json)
      (exports : Json)

/-- Exact released ordinary and graph-control records. This is framing only; complete
native role and argument admission remains at the original child-execution boundary. -/
private def controlArguments (call : Json) : Except String Json := do
  let operation ← call.getObjValAs? String "op"
  if operation == "$cas.project" || operation == "$cas.apply" then
    checkServiceFields #["op", "args"] call
    let arguments ← call.getObjVal? "args"
    if operation == "$cas.project" then
      checkServiceFields #["value", "field"] arguments
      discard <| (← arguments.getObjVal? "field").getNat?
    else
      checkServiceFields #["value", "arguments"] arguments
      discard <| (← arguments.getObjVal? "arguments").getArr?
    let some _ ← ScopedReference.parse? (← arguments.getObjVal? "value")
      | throw "a graph control requires an actual scoped value reference"
    return arguments
  if operation.startsWith "$cas." then
    throw "an ordinary child call cannot use a reserved graph-control address"
  return (← DeferredCall.decode call).arguments

/-- Read and validate the complete deferred control before any child is scheduled.
Exports retain the original scope; only backward child-result positions remain unresolved. -/
private def deferredControl (scope : RequestScope) (actual : DispatchReservation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (requestId : Nat) (frame value : Json) : IO InvocationReply := do
  IO.ofExcept <| (checkServiceFields #["request_id", "status", "value", "exports"] frame).mapError IO.userError
  IO.ofExcept <| (checkServiceFields #["ctor", "args"] value).mapError IO.userError
  let arguments ← IO.ofExcept <| ((value.getObjVal? "args").bind (·.getArr?)).mapError IO.userError
  let #[calls, template] := arguments
    | throw <| IO.userError "a deferred computation requires its ordered calls and final result template"
  let calls ← IO.ofExcept <| calls.getArr?.mapError IO.userError
  let exports ← IO.ofExcept <| (frame.getObjVal? "exports").mapError IO.userError
  let declared ← ReplyExport.parseControl scope actual graph scope.wireId exports
  for call in calls, index in [:calls.size] do
    let arguments ← IO.ofExcept <| (controlArguments call).mapError IO.userError
    scope.validateReplyTemplate actual graph scope.wireId declared index arguments
  scope.validateReplyTemplate actual graph scope.wireId declared calls.size template
  return .deferred requestId calls template exports

/-- Validate the complete original captures, exports and finite nonempty child group before
retiring its source scope or scheduling a child. Captures use the same exact-address owner as
immediate export captures, retaining distinct equal-valued positions. -/
private def suspendedControl (scope : RequestScope) (actual : DispatchReservation)
    (graph : ValueGraph) (requestId : Nat) (frame : Json) : IO InvocationReply := do
  IO.ofExcept <| (checkServiceFields
    #["request_id", "status", "continuation", "captures", "calls", "exports"] frame).mapError IO.userError
  let continuation ← IO.ofExcept <| (frame.getObjValAs? String "continuation").mapError IO.userError
  if continuation.isEmpty then throw <| IO.userError "a suspension requires its continuation token"
  let captures ← IO.ofExcept <| ((frame.getObjVal? "captures").bind (·.getArr?)).mapError IO.userError
  let references ← captures.mapM fun capture => do
    let some reference ← IO.ofExcept <| (ScopedReference.parse? capture).mapError IO.userError
      | throw <| IO.userError "a declared capture must be a scoped reference"
    return reference
  discard <| scope.capture actual graph scope.wireId references
  let calls ← IO.ofExcept <| ((frame.getObjVal? "calls").bind (·.getArr?)).mapError IO.userError
  if calls.isEmpty then throw <| IO.userError "a suspension requires a nonempty call group"
  let exports ← IO.ofExcept <| (frame.getObjVal? "exports").mapError IO.userError
  let declared ← ReplyExport.parseControl scope actual graph scope.wireId exports
  for call in calls, index in [:calls.size] do
    let arguments ← IO.ofExcept <| (controlArguments call).mapError IO.userError
    scope.validateReplyTemplate actual graph scope.wireId declared index arguments
  return .suspended requestId continuation captures calls exports

/-- Cooperative cancellation settles the cell; its resource leases retain exact frame drainers. -/
opaque FramedConnection.cancel (wire : FramedConnection) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (reservation : DispatchReservation) : BaseIO Bool := do
  unless reservation.transaction == transaction.id &&
      reservation.connection == wire.connection.generation do return false
  transaction.abort

/-- Send an exact selected primitive or retained export once, before value admission.
For a retained export, arguments is its already prepared invocation context.
The native permit spans the entire frame and cancellation cleanup. All process I/O runs
outside transaction, owner and resource-state mutexes. Receipt construction is a later boundary.
Reuse: CasContract framing/negotiation, native Semaphore, RequestScope and ImmediateReply. -/
private def FramedConnection.exchange (wire : FramedConnection) (ledger : OccurrenceLedger)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (reservation : DispatchReservation) (scope : RequestScope)
    (operation : String) (commit : RequestLease → BaseIO (Except TransactionFailure Unit))
    (frameFor : Nat → Json) : IO (Except PortError InvocationReply) := do
  let unavailable := fun reason => PortError.unavailable wire.backend reason
  unless ownsInvocation wire transaction reservation scope do
    return .error (unavailable "request_identity_mismatch")
  let some pending ← ledger.pendingFor reservation.occurrence transaction.id
    | return .error (unavailable "reserved_without_receipt")
  unless sameInvocation pending reservation do
    return .error (unavailable "request_identity_mismatch")
  wire.acquire
  try
    unless ← ledger.owners.isLive wire.connection.generation do
      return .error (unavailable "stale_owner")
    let some graph ← transaction.activeGraph
      | return .error (unavailable "cancelled")
    if let .native code token := reservation.selected then
      let some node := graph.find code
        | return .error (.protocol "the retained native code is outside the active graph")
      let .ownedToken owner actual _ := node.payload.data
        | return .error (.protocol "the retained native target has no actual export token")
      unless owner == wire.connection.generation && actual == token do
        return .error (.protocol "the retained native target changed its actual owner or token")
    try discard <| scope.resolveMany reservation graph scope.wireId #[]
    catch error => return .error (.protocol error.toString)
    let lease ← match ← wire.beginRequest transaction.id reservation.occurrence with
      | .ok lease => pure lease
      | .error error => return .error error
    match ← commit lease with
    | .error failure =>
      lease.abandon
      match failure with
      | .settled => return .error (unavailable "cancelled")
      | .reservation .consumed => return .error (unavailable "reserved_without_receipt")
      | .reservation .staleOwner => return .error (unavailable "stale_owner")
      | _ => throw <| IO.userError "internal: the prepared send lost its transaction association"
    | .ok () => pure ()
    try
      writeFrame wire.connection.child.stdin (frameFor lease.requestId)
    catch error =>
      wire.close
      let failure := PortError.disconnected s!"connection_lost_after_send: {error}"
      let won ← transaction.failPort failure
      scope.retire
      return .error (if won then failure else .unavailable wire.backend "request_already_settled")
    let frame ← match ← readFrame wire.connection.child.stdout with
      | .ok frame => pure frame
      | .error error =>
        wire.close
        let won ← transaction.failPort error
        scope.retire
        return .error (if won then error else .unavailable wire.backend "request_already_settled")
    unless (frame.getObjValAs? Nat "request_id").toOption == some lease.requestId do
      wire.close
      let failure := PortError.protocol "the reply does not answer its exact outstanding request"
      let won ← transaction.failPort failure
      scope.retire
      return .error (if won then failure else .unavailable wire.backend "request_already_settled")
    unless ← lease.readCompleted do
      lease.discardAfterDrain
      scope.retire
      return .error (unavailable "cancelled")
    let some current ← transaction.activeGraph
      | scope.retire; return .error (unavailable "cancelled")
    let status := (frame.getObjValAs? String "status").toOption
    let success := status == some "suspended" || status == some "ok"
    let (frame, observations) ←
      if success then
        match splitRoutineObservations wire.ready.routineObservations frame with
        | .ok (control, routines) =>
          pure (control, if wire.ready.routineObservations then some routines else none)
        | .error reason =>
          let failure := PortError.protocol reason
          let won ← transaction.failPort failure
          scope.retire
          return .error (if won then failure else .unavailable wire.backend "request_already_settled")
      else pure (frame, none)
    let result : Except PortError InvocationReply ←
      if status == some "suspended" then
        try
          pure (.ok (← suspendedControl scope reservation current lease.requestId frame))
        catch error => pure (.error (.protocol error.toString))
      else if (frame.getObjValAs? String "status").toOption == some "ok" then
        let value := (frame.getObjVal? "value").toOption.getD .null
        if (value.getObjValAs? String "ctor").toOption == some "deferredData" then
          try
            pure (.ok (← deferredControl scope reservation current lease.requestId frame value))
          catch error => pure (.error (.protocol error.toString))
        else
          try
            pure (.ok (.immediate (← ImmediateReply.parseControl scope reservation current
              scope.wireId lease.requestId frame)))
          catch error => pure (.error (.protocol error.toString))
      else pure <| match failureReply lease.requestId operation frame with
        | .error error => .error error
        | .ok () => .error (.protocol "the control has no immediate result")
    match result with
    | .ok reply =>
      match ← transaction.recordRoutineInvocation scope lease observations with
      | .ok () => return .ok reply
      | .error .settled =>
        scope.retire
        return .error (unavailable "cancelled")
      | .error _ =>
        let failure := PortError.protocol "routine observation lost its actual received-frame identity"
        let won ← transaction.failPort failure
        scope.retire
        return .error (if won then failure else .unavailable wire.backend "request_already_settled")
    | .error error =>
      let won ← transaction.failPort error
      scope.retire
      if !won then return .error (unavailable "request_already_settled")
      return .error error
  finally wire.release

opaque FramedConnection.invokeControl (wire : FramedConnection) (ledger : OccurrenceLedger)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (reservation : DispatchReservation) (scope : RequestScope)
    (arguments : Json) : IO (Except PortError InvocationReply) :=
  wire.exchange ledger transaction reservation scope reservation.selected.operation
    (transaction.commitSend reservation) (invocationFrame reservation scope · arguments)

/-- Resume a suspended invocation on its supplying connection: a fresh request on the same
occurrence, whose reply is again a control (execution contract §6). -/
opaque FramedConnection.resumeControl (wire : FramedConnection) (ledger : OccurrenceLedger)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (reservation : DispatchReservation) (scope : RequestScope)
    (continuation : String) (captures results : Nat) : IO (Except PortError InvocationReply) :=
  wire.exchange ledger transaction reservation scope "$cas.resume"
    (transaction.commitResume reservation) (resumeFrame scope continuation captures results)

/-- A call deadline aborts its cell while the exact existing reader or queue item survives.
The IO worker retains its permit/reader or queued permit claim and observes transaction abort.
Reuse: the native task/event-loop deadline helper shared with negotiation. -/
private def FramedConnection.before (wire : FramedConnection) (transaction : CellTransaction)
    (reservation : DispatchReservation) (scope : RequestScope) (timeoutMs : UInt32)
    (exchange : IO (Except PortError InvocationReply)) : IO (Except PortError InvocationReply) := do
  unless ownsInvocation wire transaction reservation scope do
    return .error (.unavailable wire.backend "request_identity_mismatch")
  if timeoutMs == 0 then
    let draining ← wire.isDraining
    let failure := PortError.unavailable wire.backend (if draining then "busy_draining" else "deadline")
    let won ← transaction.failPort failure
    scope.retire
    return .error (if won then failure else .unavailable wire.backend "request_already_settled")
  let worker ← IO.asTask (prio := .dedicated) exchange
  match ← awaitBefore worker timeoutMs with
  | some result => IO.ofExcept result
  | none =>
    let draining ← wire.isDraining
    let failure := PortError.unavailable wire.backend (if draining then "busy_draining" else "deadline")
    let won ← transaction.failPort failure
    scope.retire
    return .error (if won then failure else .unavailable wire.backend "request_already_settled")

opaque FramedConnection.invokeControlBefore (wire : FramedConnection) (ledger : OccurrenceLedger)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (reservation : DispatchReservation) (scope : RequestScope)
    (arguments : Json) (timeoutMs : UInt32) : IO (Except PortError InvocationReply) :=
  wire.before transaction reservation scope timeoutMs
    (wire.invokeControl ledger transaction reservation scope arguments)

opaque FramedConnection.resumeControlBefore (wire : FramedConnection) (ledger : OccurrenceLedger)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (reservation : DispatchReservation) (scope : RequestScope)
    (continuation : String) (captures results : Nat) (timeoutMs : UInt32) :
    IO (Except PortError InvocationReply) :=
  wire.before transaction reservation scope timeoutMs
    (wire.resumeControl ledger transaction reservation scope continuation captures results)

/-- An invocation whose prepared consumer accepts only an immediate value. -/
private def immediateOnly (wire : FramedConnection) (transaction : CellTransaction) (scope : RequestScope)
    (control : Except PortError InvocationReply) : IO (Except PortError ImmediateReply) := do
  match control with
  | .error error => return .error error
  | .ok (.immediate reply) => return .ok reply
  | .ok (.deferred ..) | .ok (.suspended ..) =>
    let failure := PortError.protocol "a deferred control is not an immediate result value"
    let won ← transaction.failPort failure
    scope.retire
    return .error (if won then failure else .unavailable wire.backend "request_already_settled")

opaque FramedConnection.invoke (wire : FramedConnection) (ledger : OccurrenceLedger)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (reservation : DispatchReservation) (scope : RequestScope)
    (arguments : Json) : IO (Except PortError ImmediateReply) := do
  immediateOnly wire transaction scope (← wire.invokeControl ledger transaction reservation scope arguments)

opaque FramedConnection.invokeBefore (wire : FramedConnection) (ledger : OccurrenceLedger)
    (transaction : CellTransaction) (reservation : DispatchReservation) (scope : RequestScope)
    (arguments : Json) (timeoutMs : UInt32) : IO (Except PortError ImmediateReply) := do
  immediateOnly wire transaction scope
    (← wire.invokeControlBefore ledger transaction reservation scope arguments timeoutMs)

end CasRuntime

module

import CasRuntime.Transport
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Transport

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasRuntime CasCatalogue.Backend

/-- This peer checks framing and resource controls, not a mathematical computation.
Reuse: the public Python framing functions from CasContract.Port. -/
private def framingPeer : String := "
import sys, signal
from cas_port import read_frame, write_frame
signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_BLOCK, {signal.SIGUSR1})
mode = sys.argv[1]
routines = mode in ('routine_missing', 'routine_invalid')
features = ['scoped-values/2', 'deferred/2', 'suspend-resume/2', 'export-capture-frames/2']
if routines:
    features.append('routine-observations/1')
write_frame({'op': 'ready', 'protocol': 2, 'contract': 'cas-computation/2',
             'features': features,
             'backend': 'resource framing peer', 'backend_version': '0'})
hello = read_frame()
expected = {'op': 'hello', 'protocol': 2, 'contract': 'cas-computation/2'}
if routines:
    expected['routine_observations'] = True
if hello != expected:
    raise ValueError('missing negotiation')
write_frame(dict(hello, status='ok'))
last = -1
requests = []
introduced = set()
discards = []
while (request := read_frame()) is not None:
    rid = request['request_id']
    if rid <= last:
        raise ValueError('request IDs were reused or reordered')
    last = rid
    requests.append(rid)
    if request['op'] == '$cas.discard':
        if set(request) != {'protocol', 'request_id', 'op', 'discard_request_id'}:
            raise ValueError('invalid discard framing')
        if request['discard_request_id'] not in introduced or request['discard_request_id'] in discards:
            raise ValueError('discard changed its original request')
        discards.append(request['discard_request_id'])
        write_frame({'request_id': rid, 'status': 'ok', 'disposed': True})
        continue
    if set(request) != {'protocol', 'request_id', 'op', 'input', 'args', 'scope_id'}:
        raise ValueError('invalid computational request framing')
    if request['protocol'] != 2 or request['op'] != 'resource-test':
        raise ValueError('the transport changed the selected operation')
    if request['input'] != 'resource-test-input' or not request['scope_id']:
        raise ValueError('the transport changed the selected input or scope')
    introduced.add(rid)
    if request['args'] == 'slow':
        signal.sigwait({signal.SIGUSR1})
    if mode == 'error':
        write_frame({'request_id': rid, 'status': 'error', 'kind': 'ResourceFailure', 'message': 'peer error'})
        continue
    if mode == 'unsupported':
        write_frame({'request_id': rid, 'status': 'unsupported', 'op': request['op']})
        continue
    if mode == 'invalid':
        write_frame({'request_id': rid, 'status': 'invalid'})
        continue
    reply = {'request_id': rid + (1 if mode == 'wrong_id' else 0),
             'status': 'ok', 'value': {'ctor': 'valueData', 'args': [
                 {'requests': requests, 'discards': discards}]},
             'exports': []}
    if mode == 'routine_invalid':
        reply['routines'] = [{'role': 'entrypoint', 'qualified_name': 'not-a-complete-observation'}]
    if mode == 'routine_unnegotiated':
        reply['routines'] = []
    write_frame(reply)
"

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| packageDir contractPackage
    let arguments : IO.Process.SpawnArgs := {
      cmd := "/usr/bin/python3", args := #["-c", framingPeer, "valid"]
      env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some (contract / "python").toString)] }
    let .ok wire ← liftM (m := IO) <| FramedConnection.start owners "configured-backend" arguments 5000
      | throwError "the actual framing peer could not negotiate"
    try
      let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
        manifestDigest := "resource-test-manifest"
        registration := {
          operation := "resource-test", input := "resource-test-input", backend := "configured-backend" }
        profileDigest := "resource-test-profile" }
      let first ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let .ok reservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        first.reserve occurrence selected wire.connection #[]
        | throwError "the framing call could not reserve"
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) first.view
      let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[] #[] #[]
      let .ok reply ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger first reservation scope (.str "first") 5000
        | throwError "the actual framed request did not return its parsed control"
      unless reply.requestId == 0 && reply.scopeId == scope.id do
        throwError "the framed reply lost its exact request and scope"
      let unrelated ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      match ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invokeBefore ledger unrelated reservation scope .null 0 with
      | .error (.unavailable _ "request_identity_mismatch") => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "a deadline accepted another transaction's invocation authority"
      unless (← liftM (m := BaseIO) unrelated.activeGraph).isSome &&
          (← liftM (m := BaseIO) first.activeGraph).isSome do
        throwError "a foreign deadline changed either transaction"
      discard <| liftM (m := IO) (scope.resolveMany reservation graph scope.wireId #[])
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) unrelated.abort
      match ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invoke ledger first reservation scope (.str "duplicate") with
      | .error (.unavailable _ _) => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "the transport sent a reserved occurrence again"
      let cancelled ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let pending ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let .ok reserved ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        cancelled.reserve pending selected wire.connection #[]
        | throwError "the cancellable framing call could not reserve"
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) cancelled.view
      let pendingScope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger reserved graph #[] #[] #[]
      let outstanding ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.asTask (prio := .dedicated) <|
        wire.invoke ledger cancelled reserved pendingScope (.str "slow")
      liftM (m := IO) do
        for _ in [:1000] do
          if ← wire.hasOutstanding then break
          IO.sleep 1
        unless ← wire.hasOutstanding do throw <| IO.userError "the actual frame never became outstanding"
      unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (wire.cancel cancelled reserved) do
        throwError "cooperative cancellation did not win the active cell"
      unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) wire.isDraining do
        throwError "cancellation released an outstanding frame's permit"
      unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) cancelled.draining do
        throwError "the settled cell lost its actual request-local drainer"
      let expired ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let waiting ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let .ok waitingReservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        expired.reserve waiting selected wire.connection #[]
        | throwError "the deadline-bound queued call could not reserve"
      let waitingGraph ← liftM (m := IO) expired.view
      let waitingScope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger waitingReservation waitingGraph #[] #[] #[]
      match ← liftM (m := IO) <|
          wire.invokeBefore ledger expired waitingReservation waitingScope (.str "expired queue") 20 with
      | .error (.unavailable backend reason) =>
        unless backend == "configured-backend" && reason == "busy_draining" do
          throwError "the queued deadline lost its busy-draining outcome"
      | _ => throwError "a queued call overtook the outstanding frame or ignored its deadline"
      unless (← liftM (m := BaseIO) expired.activeGraph).isNone &&
          (← liftM (m := BaseIO) (ledger.pendingFor waiting expired.id)).isNone do
        throwError "an expired queue item retained transaction or dispatch authority"
      let later ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let next ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let .ok nextReservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        later.reserve next selected wire.connection #[]
        | throwError "the later framing call could not reserve"
      let nextGraph ← liftM (m := IO) later.view
      let nextScope ← liftM (m := IO) <|
        RequestScope.issue ledger nextReservation nextGraph #[] #[] #[]
      let queued ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.asTask (prio := .dedicated) <|
        wire.invoke ledger later nextReservation nextScope (.str "after drain")
      let released ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.Process.output {
        cmd := "/bin/kill", args := #["-USR1", toString wire.connection.child.pid] }
      unless released.exitCode == 0 do
        throwError "the framing peer's independent release signal failed"
      let drained ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.ofExcept (← IO.wait outstanding)
      match drained with
      | .error (.unavailable backend reason) =>
        unless backend == "configured-backend" && reason == "cancelled" do
          throwError "the drained call lost its cancellation outcome"
      | _ => throwError "a cancelled call exposed its late reply"
      let .ok after ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.ofExcept (← IO.wait queued)
        | throwError "a later call could not use the drained connection"
      let .ok #[traffic] := after.value.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "args"
        | throwError "the framing peer omitted its observed request traffic"
      let .ok sent := traffic.getObjValAs? (Array Nat) "requests"
        | throwError "the framing peer omitted its observed request identities"
      let .ok discarded := traffic.getObjValAs? (Array Nat) "discards"
        | throwError "the framing peer omitted its observed discard identity"
      unless sent.size == 4 && discarded.size == 1 &&
          discarded[0]? == sent[1]? && sent[3]? == some after.requestId do
        throwError "a call overtook the exact frame drain and fresh discard request"
      unless ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.isLive wire.connection.generation) do
        throwError "cooperative cancellation closed the supplying generation"
      if (← liftM (m := BaseIO) (ledger.pendingFor pending cancelled.id)).isSome then
        throwError "cancellation retained a pending occurrence locator"
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) first.abort
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) later.abort
      liftM (m := IO) do
        for _ in [:1000] do
          unless ← wire.isDraining do break
          IO.sleep 1
        if ← wire.isDraining then
          throw <| IO.userError "received reply cleanup remained pending"
        unless (← wire.cleanupFailures).isEmpty do
          throw <| IO.userError "cleanup of received uncommitted replies failed"
      unless (← liftM (m := IO) cancelled.force).isEmpty do
        throwError "forcing a fully drained request invalidated a later owner"
      -- Force the exact still-draining request, not a different transaction or
      -- a generation that has only historical work on it.
      let doomed ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
      let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
      let .ok reservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
        doomed.reserve occurrence selected wire.connection #[]
        | throwError "the force control could not reserve"
      let graph ← liftM (m := IO) doomed.view
      let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[] #[] #[]
      let outstanding ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.asTask (prio := .dedicated) <|
        wire.invoke ledger doomed reservation scope (.str "slow")
      liftM (m := IO) do
        for _ in [:1000] do
          if ← wire.hasOutstanding then break
          IO.sleep 1
        unless ← wire.hasOutstanding do
          throw <| IO.userError "the force control never sent its frame"
      discard <| liftM (m := BaseIO) doomed.abort
      let revoked ← liftM (m := IO) doomed.force
      unless revoked == #[wire.connection.generation] do
        throwError "force did not revoke precisely the affected generation"
      unless (← liftM (m := IO) doomed.force).isEmpty do
        throwError "a repeated force invented a new revocation"
      if ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (owners.isLive wire.connection.generation) then
        throwError "forced generation remained available"
      match ← liftM (m := IO) <| IO.ofExcept (← IO.wait outstanding) with
      | .error (.unavailable _ _) => pure ()
      | _ => throwError "a forced request returned usable data"
    finally liftM (m := IO) wire.close
  finally setEnv original

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let original ← getEnv
  try
    let owners ← liftM (m := IO) OwnerRegistry.new
    let ledger ← liftM (m := BaseIO) (OccurrenceLedger.new owners)
    discard <| SessionSnapshot.initialize owners
    let contract ← liftM (m := IO) <| packageDir contractPackage
    for mode in #["wrong_id", "error", "unsupported", "invalid",
        "routine_missing", "routine_invalid", "routine_unnegotiated"] do
      let arguments : IO.Process.SpawnArgs := {
        cmd := "/usr/bin/python3", args := #["-c", framingPeer, mode]
        env := #[("PYTHONPATH", some (contract / "python").toString)] }
      let .ok wire ← liftM (m := IO) <| FramedConnection.start owners "configured-backend" arguments 5000
        | throwError "the negative framing peer could not negotiate"
      try
        let transaction ← CellTransaction.begin ledger
        let occurrence ← liftM (m := BaseIO) ledger.allocate
        let selected : DispatchIdentity := {
          manifestDigest := "resource-test-manifest"
          registration := {
            operation := "resource-test", input := "resource-test-input", backend := "configured-backend" }
          profileDigest := "resource-test-profile" }
        let .ok reservation ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <|
          transaction.reserve occurrence selected wire.connection #[]
          | throwError "the negative framing call could not reserve"
        let graph ← liftM (m := IO) transaction.view
        let scope ← liftM (m := IO) <| RequestScope.issue ledger reservation graph #[] #[] #[]
        match ← liftM (m := IO) <| wire.invoke ledger transaction reservation scope .null with
        | .error (.protocol _) =>
          unless #["wrong_id", "invalid", "routine_missing", "routine_invalid",
              "routine_unnegotiated"].contains mode do
            throwError "a well-framed execution failure became malformed"
        | .error (.backend kind message) =>
          unless mode == "error" && kind == "ResourceFailure" && message == "peer error" do
            throwError "the leaf execution failure lost its details"
        | .error (.unsupported operation) =>
          unless mode == "unsupported" && operation == "resource-test" do
            throwError "the unsupported outcome lost its exact consumed operation"
        | _ => throwError "the negative framing reply was admitted or misclassified"
        unless (← liftM (m := BaseIO) transaction.activeGraph).isNone &&
            (← liftM (m := BaseIO) (ledger.pendingFor occurrence transaction.id)).isNone do
          throwError "a failed framing call retained its active cell or pending locator"
        liftM (m := IO) do
          for _ in [:1000] do
            unless ← wire.isDraining do break
            IO.sleep 1
          if ← wire.isDraining then throw <| IO.userError "failure cleanup remained pending"
        let live ← liftM (m := BaseIO) <| owners.isLive wire.connection.generation
        unless live == (mode != "wrong_id") do
          throwError "forced protocol close and framed execution failure lost their distinct lifetimes"
      finally liftM (m := IO) wire.close
  finally setEnv original

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftIO do
  let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
  for _ in [:64] do
    match ← FramedConnection.start owners "early-exit" { cmd := "/usr/bin/true" } 5000 with
    | .error (.unavailable backend reason) =>
      unless backend == "early-exit" && reason == "incompatible_protocol: no valid ready frame" do
        throw <| IO.userError "an early process exit lost its explicit startup outcome"
    | _ => throw <| IO.userError "an exited process became an executable v2 connection"
  match ← FramedConnection.start owners "silent-peer" { cmd := "/bin/cat" } 20 with
  | .error (.unavailable backend reason) =>
    unless backend == "silent-peer" && reason == "incompatible_protocol: deadline" do
      throw <| IO.userError "silent negotiation lost its explicit deadline outcome"
  | _ => throw <| IO.userError "a silent process became an executable v2 connection"
  match ← FramedConnection.start owners "failed-start" { cmd := "/dev/null/not-an-executable" } 5000 with
  | .error (.unavailable backend reason) =>
    -- Lean v4.33.0 runtime/process.cpp: exec failure exits the forked child;
    -- the parent observes EOF before ready, rather than a spawn exception.
    unless backend == "failed-start" && reason == "incompatible_protocol: no valid ready frame" do
      throw <| IO.userError "pre-ready child failure lost its unavailable outcome"
  | _ => throw <| IO.userError "a failed process start became an executable v2 connection"

module

import CasCatalogue.TestSuite
import all CasRuntime.Session
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasCatalogue.TestSuite

open Lean Meta Elab Command Term CasCompiler CasRuntime

-- The original native source definition is a closed operation with no published
-- family. Its public #cas consumer must report the missing operation; reducing
-- Nat.gcd in the kernel would turn this check into a retained value instead.
run_cmd do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let initial ← liftTermElabM do
      let root ← IO.currentDir
      IO.FS.createDirAll (root / ".tmp")
      let path := root / ".tmp/unpublished-operation-empty-leaves.json"
      IO.FS.writeFile path
        (Json.mkObj [("backends", .arr #[]), ("registrations", .arr #[])]).compress
      KernelSession.start (some path) (computationOnly := true)
    try
      let term ← `(term| Nat.gcd 84 30)
      let source ← liftTermElabM <| initial.source.define `closedGcd term
      liftCoreM <| KernelSession.install { initial with source }
      elabCommand (← `(command| #cas "let result := closedGcd"))
      let some session ← liftCoreM KernelSession.current?
        | throwError "the public command lost its source session"
      let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
        | throwError "the public command lost the original result binding"
      unless entry.userName == `result do
        throwError "the public command replaced the original source definition"
      if (session.value? entry.id).isSome then
        throwError "the public #cas consumer computed unpublished Nat.gcd in the kernel"
      let run ← CasCatalogue.Language.runStatement session "let again := result"
      let .noImplementation reason := run.outcome
        | throwError "the original missing operation was not retained: {run.outcome.detail}"
      unless (reason.splitOn "Nat.gcd").length > 1 do
        throwError "the missing operation was not named: {reason}"
      unless (← liftM (m := IO) session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "an unpublished operation acquired a provider"
    finally liftM (m := IO) initial.close
  finally setEnv environment

-- Head reduction of an eliminator is computation too. This source must retain
-- its missing operation instead of becoming the literal returned by Nat.rec.
run_cmd do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let initial ← liftTermElabM do
      let root ← IO.currentDir
      KernelSession.start (some (root / ".tmp/unpublished-operation-empty-leaves.json"))
        (computationOnly := true)
    try
      let term ← `(term| Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => Nat) 7 (fun _ n => n) 1)
      let source ← liftTermElabM <| initial.source.define `closedRecursor term
      liftCoreM <| KernelSession.install { initial with source }
      elabCommand (← `(command| #cas "let result := closedRecursor"))
      let some session ← liftCoreM KernelSession.current?
        | throwError "the public command lost its source session"
      let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
        | throwError "the public command lost the original result binding"
      if (session.value? entry.id).isSome then
        throwError "the public #cas consumer evaluated unpublished Nat.rec in the kernel"
      let run ← CasCatalogue.Language.runStatement session "let again := result"
      let .noImplementation reason := run.outcome
        | throwError "the original missing eliminator was not retained: {run.outcome.detail}"
      unless (reason.splitOn "Nat.rec").length > 1 do
        throwError "the missing eliminator was not named: {reason}"
      unless (← liftM (m := IO) session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "an unpublished eliminator acquired a provider"
    finally liftM (m := IO) initial.close
  finally setEnv environment

-- A reducible native constant has the same missing-operation boundary as an opaque one.
-- The source definition may be opened, but its unpublished Nat.add call is not kernel code.
run_cmd do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let initial ← liftTermElabM do
      let root ← IO.currentDir
      KernelSession.start (some (root / ".tmp/unpublished-operation-empty-leaves.json"))
        (computationOnly := true)
    try
      let term ← `(term| Nat.add 84 30)
      let source ← liftTermElabM <| initial.source.define `closedAddition term
      liftCoreM <| KernelSession.install { initial with source }
      elabCommand (← `(command| #cas "let result := closedAddition"))
      let some session ← liftCoreM KernelSession.current?
        | throwError "the public command lost its source session"
      let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
        | throwError "the public command lost the original result binding"
      if (session.value? entry.id).isSome then
        throwError "the public #cas consumer computed unpublished Nat.add in the kernel"
      let run ← CasCatalogue.Language.runStatement session "let again := result"
      let .noImplementation reason := run.outcome
        | throwError "the original missing definition was not retained: {run.outcome.detail}"
      unless (reason.splitOn "Nat.add").length > 1 do
        throwError "the original unpublished declaration was not named: {reason}"
      unless (← liftM (m := IO) session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "an unpublished definition acquired a provider"
    finally liftM (m := IO) initial.close
  finally setEnv environment

-- Instance projection may inspect native constructor fields, but must not run a recursor
-- to obtain the instance. Its unpublished head remains the original missing operation.
run_cmd do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let initial ← liftTermElabM do
      let root ← IO.currentDir
      KernelSession.start (some (root / ".tmp/unpublished-operation-empty-leaves.json"))
        (computationOnly := true)
    try
      let term ← `(term| @Inhabited.default Nat
        (Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => Inhabited Nat) ⟨7⟩ (fun _ prior => prior) 1))
      let source ← liftTermElabM <| initial.source.define `instanceRecursor term
      liftCoreM <| KernelSession.install { initial with source }
      elabCommand (← `(command| #cas "let result := instanceRecursor"))
      let some session ← liftCoreM KernelSession.current?
        | throwError "the public command lost its source session"
      let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
        | throwError "the public command lost the original result binding"
      if (session.value? entry.id).isSome then
        throwError "the public #cas consumer evaluated Nat.rec to obtain an instance field"
      let run ← CasCatalogue.Language.runStatement session "let again := result"
      let .noImplementation reason := run.outcome
        | throwError "the instance's missing eliminator was not retained: {run.outcome.detail}"
      unless (reason.splitOn "Nat.rec").length > 1 do
        throwError "the instance's original unpublished declaration was not named: {reason}"
      unless (← liftM (m := IO) session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "an unpublished instance eliminator acquired a provider"
    finally liftM (m := IO) initial.close
  finally setEnv environment

-- The numeral index alone does not determine an overloaded native numeral. Its selected
-- instance remains an original input, and an eliminator that supplies it must not execute.
run_cmd do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let initial ← liftTermElabM do
      let root ← IO.currentDir
      KernelSession.start (some (root / ".tmp/unpublished-operation-empty-leaves.json"))
        (computationOnly := true)
    try
      let term ← `(term| @OfNat.ofNat Nat 3
        (Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => OfNat Nat 3) ⟨7⟩ (fun _ prior => prior) 1))
      let source ← liftTermElabM <| initial.source.define `numeralInstanceRecursor term
      liftCoreM <| KernelSession.install { initial with source }
      elabCommand (← `(command| #cas "let result := numeralInstanceRecursor"))
      let some session ← liftCoreM KernelSession.current?
        | throwError "the public command lost its source session"
      let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
        | throwError "the public command lost the original result binding"
      if (session.value? entry.id).isSome then
        throwError "the public #cas consumer ignored the numeral's selected instance"
      let run ← CasCatalogue.Language.runStatement session "let again := result"
      let .noImplementation reason := run.outcome
        | throwError "the numeral instance's missing operation was not retained: {run.outcome.detail}"
      unless (reason.splitOn "Nat.rec").length > 1 do
        throwError "the numeral instance's original missing operation was not named: {reason}"
      unless (← liftM (m := IO) session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "an unpublished numeral-instance eliminator acquired a provider"
    finally liftM (m := IO) initial.close
  finally setEnv environment

-- Native frontend adapters may supply the projection-constant syntax directly. It has
-- the same selected instance as the projection expression produced by term elaboration.
run_cmd do
  let environment ← getEnv
  try
    let initial ← liftTermElabM do
      let root ← IO.currentDir
      KernelSession.start (some (root / ".tmp/unpublished-operation-empty-leaves.json"))
        (computationOnly := true)
    try
      let source ← liftTermElabM do
        let original ← initial.source.elaborate Syntax.missing fun _ => do
          let dictionary ← elabTermAndSynthesize
            (← `(term| Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => OfNat Nat 3)
              ⟨7⟩ (fun _ prior => prior) 1)) none
          let expression := mkAppN (mkConst ``OfNat.ofNat [Level.zero])
            #[mkConst ``Nat, mkNatLit 3, dictionary]
          checkWithKernel expression
          return expression
        initial.source.defineTerm `nativeNumeralInstance original
      liftCoreM <| KernelSession.install { initial with source }
      elabCommand (← `(command| #cas "let result := nativeNumeralInstance"))
      let some session ← liftCoreM KernelSession.current?
        | throwError "the public command lost its native source session"
      let some entry := session.source.context.entries.back?
        | throwError "the public command lost its native result binding"
      if (session.value? entry.id).isSome then
        throwError "the native frontend numeral ignored its selected instance"
      let run ← CasCatalogue.Language.runStatement session "let again := result"
      let .noImplementation reason := run.outcome
        | throwError "the native numeral's missing operation was not retained: {run.outcome.detail}"
      unless (reason.splitOn "Nat.rec").length > 1 do
        throwError "the native numeral changed its original missing operation: {reason}"
      unless (← liftM (m := IO) session.kernel.dispatches.get).isEmpty do
        throwError "a native numeral-instance eliminator acquired a provider"
    finally liftM (m := IO) initial.close
  finally setEnv environment

module

public import CasCompiler.Layout
import all CasCompiler.Layout
public import CasCompiler.ConstructorTransport
public import CasCompiler.FieldType
public import CasRuntime.Owner
public import CasContract.Port
public import CasRuntime.CallablePacket
import CasContract.Failure

public section

namespace CasRuntime

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasCatalogue.Backend

private def sameNativeSource (left right : ClosedTerm) : Bool :=
  left.context.exactlyMatches right.context && left.expression.equal right.expression &&
    left.type.equal right.type && left.universeParams == right.universeParams &&
    left.nativeDeclarations.exactlyMatches right.nativeDeclarations

private def sameNativeFieldRole (left right : SourceLayout) : Bool :=
  let sameTerms := fun (left right : Array ClosedTerm) =>
    left.size == right.size && (left.zip right).all (fun (left, right) =>
      sameNativeSource left right)
  let sameProjection := match left.inputProjection, right.inputProjection with
    | none, none => true
    | some left, some right =>
      left.path == right.path && (match left.target, right.target with
        | .argument left, .argument right => left == right
        | .context left, .context right => left == right
        | _, _ => false)
    | _, _ => false
  left.address == right.address && left.kind == right.kind &&
    sameNativeSource left.source right.source &&
    left.contextDependencies == right.contextDependencies && sameProjection &&
    sameTerms left.recordAncestors right.recordAncestors &&
    left.selectionBinding == right.selectionBinding &&
    SourceSelectionScope.exactlyMatches sameNativeSource left.selections right.selections &&
    left.fields.size == right.fields.size &&
    (left.fields.zip right.fields).all (fun (left, right) =>
      left.address == right.address && left.projection == right.projection &&
        left.sourceIndex == right.sourceIndex && left.wireIndex == right.wireIndex &&
        left.precedingDependencies == right.precedingDependencies && left.kind == right.kind &&
        sameNativeSource left.source right.source &&
        sameNativeSource left.typeFamily right.typeFamily &&
        sameTerms left.recordAncestors right.recordAncestors &&
        SourceSelectionScope.exactlyMatches sameNativeSource left.selections right.selections)

/-- One exact record occurrence's prepared source and runtime association identity. -/
structure RecordAssociation where
  private mk ::
  id : RuntimeId .association
  program : RuntimeId .program
  occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence
  layout : RecordLayout
  bindings : Array BindingId

/-- One prepared application's source slots and selected result dependencies.
Actual values remain in the binding below, independently of the original producing node. -/
structure ApplicationAssociation where
  private mk ::
  id : RuntimeId .association
  program : RuntimeId .program
  occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence
  layout : ApplicationLayout
  path : Array Name
  dependencies : Array Nat
  contextDependencies : Array Nat

/-- Original consuming field data, with an optional checked descendant dependency view.
The parameter permits the same data to be retained inside a recursive ValueBinding.
Creating this record cannot attach an association to a value; that boundary remains private. -/
structure FieldInstantiationData (binding : Type) where
  id : RuntimeId .association
  association : RecordAssociation
  field : FieldLayout
  preceding : Array (Option binding)
  view : Option FieldDependencyView := none

def FieldInstantiationData.typeFamily (value : FieldInstantiationData binding) : ClosedTerm :=
  (value.view.map (·.typeFamily)).getD value.field.typeFamily

def FieldInstantiationData.precedingDependencies (value : FieldInstantiationData binding) :
    Array Nat :=
  (value.view.map (·.precedingDependencies)).getD value.field.precedingDependencies

def FieldInstantiationData.projectionPath (value : FieldInstantiationData binding) : Array Name :=
  (value.view.map (·.path)).getD #[]

/-- A native constructor slot has this complete immutable producer context when the same
actual port is viewed at its source-prescribed result field. Parameters remain inert provenance;
only the selected type dependencies contribute owners. As with FieldInstantiationData,
constructing this generic record cannot attach it to a value: inTelescope remains private. -/
structure TelescopeInstantiationData (binding : Type) where
  id : RuntimeId .association
  sourceBinding : BindingId
  transport : ConstructorProjectionTransport
  source : SourceLayout
  selected : binding
  parameters : Array (Option binding)
  path : Array Name

/-- A consuming role retains its underlying binding and actual dependent prefix.
The recursive data keep earlier associations when an existing node fills another role.
Source: the data model's ResultBinding and dependency-ordered DataInterface contract. -/
inductive ValueBinding where
  /-- Issued only by checked input admission or an exact prepared input-result route.
  The displayed consuming role stays on binding; native retains its complete original interface. -/
  | private inNativeInterface (binding native : ValueBinding)
  | private direct (value : RuntimeId .value) (role : SourceLayout)
  | private atRole (binding : ValueBinding) (role : SourceLayout)
      (parameters : Option (Array (Option ValueBinding)))
      (sourceDependencies : Array ValueBinding)
  | private inField (id : RuntimeId .association) (binding : ValueBinding) (role : SourceLayout)
      (association : RecordAssociation) (field : FieldLayout)
      (preceding : Array (Option ValueBinding)) (view : Option FieldDependencyView)
  | private inApplication (binding : ValueBinding) (role : SourceLayout)
      (association : ApplicationAssociation)
      (parameters applicationParameters arguments : Array (Option ValueBinding))
      (callable access : Option ValueBinding) (fields : Array ValueBinding)
  | private inProjection (id : RuntimeId .association) (binding : ValueBinding)
      (role : SourceLayout) (parent : ValueBinding) (path : Array Name)
      (basis : ValueBinding) (fields : Array ValueBinding)
      (dependencies : Array (FieldInstantiationData ValueBinding))
  | private inTelescope (binding : ValueBinding) (role : SourceLayout)
      (instantiation : TelescopeInstantiationData ValueBinding)
      (fields : Option (Array ValueBinding))

def ValueBinding.value : ValueBinding → RuntimeId .value
  | .direct value _ => value
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.value
  | .atRole binding .. | .inField _ binding .. | .inApplication binding ..
  | .inProjection _ binding .. | .inTelescope binding .. => binding.value

def ValueBinding.role : ValueBinding → SourceLayout
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.role
  | .direct _ role | .atRole _ role .. | .inField _ _ role .. | .inApplication _ role ..
  | .inProjection _ _ role .. | .inTelescope _ role .. => role

/-- Read only the explicit admission relation at this exact consuming view. -/
def ValueBinding.admittedInterface? : ValueBinding → Option ValueBinding
  | .inNativeInterface _ native => some native
  | _ => none

/-- The native operation interface is either explicitly admitted or the displayed interface.
No earlier role, payload, or descriptive source is searched. -/
def ValueBinding.nativeInterface (binding : ValueBinding) : ValueBinding :=
  binding.admittedInterface?.getD binding

def ValueBinding.nativeRole (binding : ValueBinding) : SourceLayout :=
  binding.nativeInterface.role

abbrev FieldInstantiation := FieldInstantiationData ValueBinding
abbrev TelescopeInstantiation := TelescopeInstantiationData ValueBinding

/-- Native telescope transports remain in the original role chain, independently of later
field, projection and application views of the same node. -/
def ValueBinding.telescopeInstantiations : ValueBinding → Array TelescopeInstantiation
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.telescopeInstantiations
  | .direct .. => #[]
  | .atRole binding .. | .inField _ binding .. | .inApplication binding ..
  | .inProjection _ binding .. => binding.telescopeInstantiations
  | .inTelescope binding _ instantiation _ =>
    binding.telescopeInstantiations.push instantiation

/-- Source type families are instantiated by these exact references, never decoded Lean terms. -/
def ValueBinding.instantiations : ValueBinding → Array FieldInstantiation
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.instantiations
  | .direct .. => #[]
  | .atRole binding .. => binding.instantiations
  | .inField id binding _ association field preceding view =>
    binding.instantiations.push ⟨id, association, field, preceding, view⟩
  | .inApplication binding .. | .inTelescope binding .. => binding.instantiations
  | .inProjection _ binding _ _ _ _ _ dependencies => binding.instantiations ++ dependencies

structure ApplicationInstantiation where
  private mk ::
  association : ApplicationAssociation
  parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)
  applicationParameters : Array (Option ValueBinding)
  arguments : Array (Option ValueBinding)
  callable : Option ValueBinding
  access : Option ValueBinding

/-- Retain every consuming application in order, including earlier views of an aliased node. -/
def ValueBinding.applications : ValueBinding → Array ApplicationInstantiation
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.applications
  | .direct .. => #[]
  | .atRole binding .. | .inField _ binding .. | .inProjection _ binding ..
  | .inTelescope binding .. =>
    binding.applications
  | .inApplication binding _ association parameters applicationParameters arguments callable access _ =>
    binding.applications.push ⟨association, parameters, applicationParameters, arguments, callable, access⟩

/-- Field and application identities share one ordered role chain on the same actual node. -/
def ValueBinding.associationIds : ValueBinding → Array (RuntimeId .association)
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.associationIds
  | .direct .. => #[]
  | .atRole binding .. => binding.associationIds
  | .inField id binding .. => binding.associationIds.push id
  | .inApplication binding _ association .. => binding.associationIds.push association.id
  | .inProjection id binding .. => binding.associationIds.push id
  | .inTelescope binding _ instantiation _ =>
    binding.associationIds.push instantiation.id

/-- The exact record accesses retained in binding order, through later aliases and projections.
Reuse: the immutable binding chain; no expression or value search selects a parent. -/
def ValueBinding.projectionAccesses : ValueBinding → Array (ValueBinding × Array Name)
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.projectionAccesses
  | .direct .. => #[]
  | .atRole binding .. | .inField _ binding .. | .inApplication binding ..
  | .inTelescope binding .. =>
    binding.projectionAccesses
  | .inProjection _ binding _ parent path _ _ _ => binding.projectionAccesses.push (parent, path)

/-- The selected binding before this access added consuming associations.
Reuse: the exact projection producer, retained parent identities and native paths. This baseline
lets a later reply retain an already visible captured value without naming fresh access IDs. -/
def ValueBinding.projectionBasis (value parent : ValueBinding) (path : Array Name) :
    Option ValueBinding :=
  match value with
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.projectionBasis parent path
  | .direct .. => none
  | .atRole binding .. | .inField _ binding .. | .inApplication binding ..
  | .inTelescope binding .. =>
    binding.projectionBasis parent path
  | .inProjection _ binding _ selected selectedPath basis _ _ =>
    if selected.value == parent.value && selected.associationIds == parent.associationIds &&
        selectedPath == path then some basis
    else binding.projectionBasis parent path

/-- A projection view retains its exact pre-access binding. This relation identifies an
intermediate parent without erasing unrelated field or application associations. -/
private def ValueBinding.projectionParent : ValueBinding → ValueBinding
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.projectionParent
  | .atRole binding .. | .inTelescope binding .. => binding.projectionParent
  | .inProjection _ _ _ _ _ basis _ _ => basis.projectionParent
  | binding => binding

/-- Only the native type's selected actual references contribute owners at this source view. -/
def ValueBinding.sourceDependencies : ValueBinding → Array ValueBinding
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.sourceDependencies
  | .direct .. => #[]
  | .atRole binding _ _ dependencies => binding.sourceDependencies ++ dependencies
  | .inField _ binding .. | .inApplication binding .. | .inProjection _ binding ..
  | .inTelescope binding .. =>
    binding.sourceDependencies

/-- Earlier checked native type roles that introduced actual bound dependencies.
They remain in the existing role chain when a later view changes the displayed source role. -/
def ValueBinding.dependencyRoles : ValueBinding → Array SourceLayout
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.dependencyRoles
  | .direct .. => #[]
  | .atRole binding role _ dependencies =>
    if dependencies.isEmpty then binding.dependencyRoles else binding.dependencyRoles.push role
  | .inField _ binding .. | .inApplication binding .. | .inProjection _ binding ..
  | .inTelescope binding .. =>
    binding.dependencyRoles

/-- Complete parameter positions carried by the displayed source view, when the role
association itself owns them. A direct node obtains its table from its immutable origin. -/
def ValueBinding.sourceParameters? : ValueBinding → Option (Array (Option ValueBinding))
  | .inNativeInterface binding _ => binding.sourceParameters?
  | .direct .. => none
  | .atRole binding _ parameters _ =>
    match parameters with | some _ => parameters | none => binding.sourceParameters?
  | .inApplication _ _ _ parameters .. => some parameters
  | .inField _ binding .. | .inProjection _ binding .. | .inTelescope binding .. =>
    binding.sourceParameters?

/-- Exact complete source views for retaining an already admitted relation.
Identity alone is insufficient: every source table, dependent view and native relation agrees. -/
partial def ValueBinding.exactlyMatches (left right : ValueBinding) : Bool :=
  left.value == right.value && left.associationIds == right.associationIds &&
    sameNativeFieldRole left.role right.role &&
    (match left.sourceParameters?, right.sourceParameters? with
      | none, none => true
      | some left, some right =>
        left.size == right.size && (left.zip right).all (fun (left, right) =>
          match left, right with
          | none, none => true
          | some left, some right => left.exactlyMatches right
          | _, _ => false)
