        unless selected.value == baseline.value &&
            selected.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf baseline.associationIds.toList do
          throwError "the projection changed its retained field reference"
        pure selected
      | _ => pure baseline
  let stored := if origin.role.kind == .record then
      (node.payload.data.storedFields?.getD #[]).size
    else 0
  unless fields.size == stored do
    throwError "projection binding requires its complete stored field views"
  for field in fields, index in [:fields.size] do
    let original ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.project candidate.root index).mapError IO.userError
    unless original.value == field.value &&
        original.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf field.associationIds.toList do
      throwError "a projection field view changed its original stored reference"
  let dependencies ← projectionFieldDependencies graph parent origin.accessPath candidate.root
  let (graph, value) ← if origin.application.isSome then
      graph.bindApplication supply origin candidate.root fields
    else pure (graph, candidate.root)
  let id ← supply.fresh .association
  let binding := ValueBinding.inProjection id value origin.role parent origin.accessPath
    baseline fields dependencies
  let binding := retainAdmittedInterface candidate.root binding
  let projections := if prior.isSome then graph.projections else
    let key := parent.projectionParent.value
    graph.projections.insert key ((graph.projections[key]?.getD #[]).push binding)
  -- Preserve a distinct published access for each exact parent chain. The baseline cache
  -- above deliberately keeps its original binding, independently of these consuming views.
  let previousAccess ← IO.ofExcept <|
    (graph.projectedAccess? parent origin.accessPath).mapError IO.userError
  let projectionViews := if previousAccess.isSome then graph.projectionViews else
    graph.projectionViews.insert parent.value
      ((graph.projectionViews[parent.value]?.getD #[]).push binding)
  let graph := { graph with
    associations := graph.associations.insert id
    projections
    projectionViews
    revision := some (← supply.fresh .revision) }
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners #[binding]).mapError IO.userError
  return (graph, binding)

/-- Retain an original constructor slot at its source-prescribed result field. Every stored
descendant keeps the same node and original field baseline; only checked native source views
and association identities are added. Whole native admission remains the caller's next step. -/
opaque ValueGraph.bindTelescopeTransport (graph : ValueGraph) (supply : IdentitySupply)
    (transport : ConstructorProjectionTransport) (parameters : Array (Option ValueBinding))
    (selected : ValueBinding) :
    MetaM (ValueGraph × ValueBinding) := do
  unless graph.worker == supply.worker &&
      parameters.size == transport.plan.context.entries.size do
    throwError "constructor transport lost its complete original runtime telescope"
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <|
    (graph.requiredOwners (parameters.filterMap id ++ #[selected])).mapError
      IO.userError
  let some index := transport.plan.context.entries.findIdx? (·.id == transport.binding)
    | throwError "constructor transport lost its original native slot identity"
  let some parent := parameters[index]!
    | throwError "constructor transport has no actual supplier for its original native slot"
  let some (original, #[]) ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (graph.projectionFrontier parent transport.selected.path).mapError IO.userError
    | throwError "constructor transport requires an already stored original port selection"
  unless original.value == selected.value &&
      original.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf selected.associationIds.toList do
    throwError "constructor transport selected another original port occurrence"
  let rec visit (graph : ValueGraph) (value : ValueBinding) (path : Array Name) (fuel : Nat) :
      MetaM (ValueGraph × ValueBinding) := do
    let .succ remaining := fuel
      | throwError "constructor transport encountered cyclic original field data"
    let target ← transport.targetAt path
    let source := value.role
    let some node := graph.find value.value
      | throwError "constructor transport lost a stored original port descendant"
    let mut graph := graph
    let mut fields := none
    if target.kind == .record && node.payload.data.storedFields?.isSome then
      let mut retained := #[]
      for field in target.fields do
        if let some index := field.wireIndex then
          let child ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.project value index).mapError IO.userError
          let (next, child) ← visit graph child (path.push field.projection) remaining
          graph := next
          retained := retained.push child
      fields := some retained
    let mut targetParameters := #[]
    for entry in target.source.context.entries do
      let some index := transport.plan.context.entries.findIdx? (·.id == entry.id)
        | throwError "constructor transport lost an original target source binding"
      let some parameter := parameters[index]?
        | throwError "constructor transport lost an original parameter position"
      targetParameters := targetParameters.push parameter
    let role ← IO.ofExcept <|
      (value.withRole target #[] (some targetParameters)).mapError IO.userError
    let candidate ← IO.ofExcept <| (CandidateResponse.ofValue target graph role).mapError IO.userError
    let id ← supply.fresh .association
    let binder ← supply.fresh .sourceBinding
    let instantiation : TelescopeInstantiation :=
      ⟨id, ⟨binder.worker, binder.serial⟩, transport, source, selected, parameters, path⟩
    let binding := ValueBinding.inTelescope candidate.root target instantiation fields
    let binding := retainAdmittedInterface candidate.root binding
    graph := { graph with
      associations := graph.associations.insert id
      revision := some (← supply.fresh .revision) }
    discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners #[binding]).mapError IO.userError
    return (graph, binding)
  visit graph selected #[] (graph.nodes.size + 1)

/-- Ordered actual constructor selections; proof positions retain their formal slots.
This is record storage, not a whole-reply admission or correctness witness. -/
structure RecordPrefix where
  private mk ::
  association : RecordAssociation
  private identities : IdentitySupply
  private selections : Array (Option ValueBinding)
  private sourceDependencies : Array (Array ValueBinding)
  private parameters : Option (Array (Option ValueBinding))

private def RecordPrefix.skipProofs (record : RecordPrefix) : RecordPrefix := Id.run do
  let mut selections := record.selections
  while selections.size < record.association.layout.fields.size do
    let some field := record.association.layout.fields[selections.size]? | break
    if field.field.kind != .proof then break
    selections := selections.push none
  return { record with selections }

/-- Allocate a fresh association before recording any actual field selections.
Reuse: the worker IdentitySupply and complete source-prepared RecordLayout. -/
opaque RecordPrefix.begin (supply : IdentitySupply) (program : RuntimeId .program)
    (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence) (layout : RecordLayout)
    (sourceDependencies : Array (Array ValueBinding) := #[])
    (parameters : Option (Array (Option ValueBinding)) := none) : IO RecordPrefix := do
  unless program.worker == supply.worker && occurrence.worker == supply.worker do
    throw <| IO.userError "record preparation belongs to a different worker"
  let bindings ← layout.fields.mapM fun _ => do
    let id ← supply.fresh .sourceBinding
    return (⟨id.worker, id.serial⟩ : BindingId)
  let association : RecordAssociation :=
    ⟨← supply.fresh .association, program, occurrence, layout, bindings⟩
  unless sourceDependencies.isEmpty || sourceDependencies.size == layout.fields.size do
    throw <| IO.userError "a record requires its complete prepared field dependencies"
  if let some parameters := parameters then
    unless parameters.size == layout.source.source.context.entries.size do
      throw <| IO.userError "a record prefix requires its complete original source parameter table"
  return RecordPrefix.skipProofs ⟨association, supply, #[], sourceDependencies, parameters⟩

/-- Prepare each field's actual bound type dependencies before attaching field roles. -/
opaque RecordPrefix.prepare (supply : IdentitySupply) (program : RuntimeId .program)
    (occurrence : RuntimeId .occurrence) (layout : RecordLayout) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding) : MetaM RecordPrefix := do
  let dependencies ← layout.source.source.withOpen fun bindings expression => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let nativeType ← whnf (← inferType expression)
    let .const name levels := nativeType.getAppFn
      | throwError "a record prefix lost its original native declaration"
    let some information := getStructureInfo? (← getEnv) name
      | throwError "a record prefix requires its original native structure"
    let constructor := getStructureCtor (← getEnv) name
    unless nativeType.getAppArgs.size == constructor.numParams do
      throwError "a record prefix changed its complete native parameter telescope"
    let applied := mkAppN (mkConst constructor.name levels) nativeType.getAppArgs
    forallTelescope (← inferType applied) fun formals _ => do
      unless formals.size == layout.fields.size do
        throwError "a record prefix changed its complete native field telescope"
      let selections ← layout.source.selections.inContext context
      let mut dependencies := #[]
      for formal in formals, index in [:formals.size] do
        let some prepared := layout.fields[index]?
          | throwError "a record prefix lost an original native field position"
        unless prepared.field.sourceIndex == index &&
            information.getProjFn? index == some prepared.field.projection do
          throwError "a record prefix changed an original native field position"
        let references ← if prepared.field.wireIndex.isNone then pure #[]
          else boundContextReferences (some graph) context bound (← inferType formal) selections
        dependencies := dependencies.push references
      return dependencies
  let parameters := layout.source.source.context.entries.map fun entry => bound[entry.id]?
  RecordPrefix.begin supply program occurrence layout dependencies (some parameters)

/-- Bind this same node at the next field and retain every preceding actual selection.
Visibility checks include the whole prefix; owner requirements follow the declared dependencies.
Reuse: CandidateResponse's operational shape check and ValueGraph reference validation. -/
opaque RecordPrefix.bind (record : RecordPrefix) (graph : ValueGraph) (value : ValueBinding) :
    IO (ValueGraph × RecordPrefix × ValueBinding) := do
  let record := record.skipProofs
  let some prepared := record.association.layout.fields[record.selections.size]?
    | throw <| IO.userError "the complete record has no further computational field"
  let value ← IO.ofExcept <|
    (value.withRole prepared.layout
      (record.sourceDependencies[record.selections.size]?.getD #[]) record.parameters).mapError IO.userError
  let candidate ← IO.ofExcept <|
    (CandidateResponse.ofValue prepared.layout graph value).mapError IO.userError
  let id ← record.identities.fresh .association
  let binding := ValueBinding.inField id
    candidate.root prepared.layout record.association prepared.field record.selections none
  let binding := retainAdmittedInterface candidate.root binding
  let revision ← record.identities.fresh .revision
  let graph := { graph with
    associations := graph.associations.insert id
    revision := some revision }
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners #[binding]).mapError IO.userError
  return (graph, ({ record with selections := record.selections.push (some binding) }).skipProofs,
    binding)

/-- Finish only a complete ordered record; no component is installed in a transaction here. -/
opaque RecordPrefix.finish (record : RecordPrefix) : Except String ValuePayload := do
  let record := record.skipProofs
  unless record.selections.size == record.association.layout.fields.size do
    throw "the dependent record is missing a required computational field"
  return .product (record.selections.filterMap id)

/-- Snapshot only the current native field and its already selected original predecessors. -/
opaque RecordPrefix.currentField (record : RecordPrefix) : MetaM NativeFieldPrefix := do
  let record := record.skipProofs
  let some prepared := record.association.layout.fields[record.selections.size]?
    | throwError "the complete native record has no further field prefix"
  unless prepared.field.sourceIndex == record.selections.size &&
      prepared.field.wireIndex.isSome do
    throwError "the current native field lost its original proof/data order"
  return ⟨prepared.layout,
    #[⟨record.association, prepared.field, record.selections, none⟩]⟩

/-- Carry the same original predecessor slots along an already selected native descendant.
Inner fields remain formal unless their own actual prefix is joined separately. -/
opaque NativeFieldPrefix.descend (nativePrefix : NativeFieldPrefix) (projection : Name) :
    MetaM NativeFieldPrefix := do
  let some field := nativePrefix.native.fields.find? (·.projection == projection)
    | throwError "the producing field prefix selected an undeclared native descendant"
  unless field.wireIndex.isSome do
    throwError "a producing data prefix selected a formal proof descendant"
  let native ← field.toLayout
  let frames ← nativePrefix.frames.mapM fun frame => do
    let path := (frame.view.map (·.path)).getD #[]
    return { frame with view := some (← frame.field.dependencyView (path.push projection)) }
  return ⟨native, frames⟩

/-- Join independently retained native ancestor prefixes at their already selected common
field. This validates their source position; actual predecessor identities remain distinct. -/
opaque NativeFieldPrefix.join (nativePrefix other : NativeFieldPrefix) : MetaM NativeFieldPrefix := do
  unless sameNativeFieldRole nativePrefix.native other.native do
    throwError "native field prefixes selected different original result positions"
  return ⟨nativePrefix.native, nativePrefix.frames ++ other.frames⟩

/-- Open every actual predecessor at its original declaration position. The context retains
an opaque typed binder and its original source correspondence; only the bound table carries
the selected runtime occurrence. Proof positions remain formal entries in the same telescope. -/
opaque NativeFieldPrefix.withBoundType (nativePrefix : NativeFieldPrefix)
    (context : OpenContext) (graph : ValueGraph)
    (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
    (action : OpenContext → Expr → Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding → MetaM α) : MetaM α := do
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners nativePrefix.references).mapError IO.userError
  let some first := nativePrefix.frames[0]?
    | throwError "a native field prefix has no original declaration frame"
  let mut root := first.association.layout.source
  for frame in nativePrefix.frames do
    if frame.association.layout.source.address.size < root.address.size then
      root := frame.association.layout.source
  discard <| root.projectionPathTo nativePrefix.native
  let frames := nativePrefix.frames.qsort fun left right =>
    left.association.layout.source.address.size < right.association.layout.source.address.size
  let inputIds := context.bindings.filterMap fun binding =>
    if bound.contains binding.id then some binding.id else none
  let mut positions : Array (Array Name × BindingId × SourceLayout × Option ValueBinding) := #[]
  for frame in frames do
    let parentPath ← root.projectionPathTo frame.association.layout.source
    unless frame.association.bindings.size == frame.association.layout.fields.size do
      throwError "a native field prefix lost its complete original binder table"
    for actual in frame.preceding, index in [:frame.preceding.size] do
      let some prepared := frame.association.layout.fields[index]?
        | throwError "a native field prefix lost its earlier declaration position"
      unless actual.isSome == prepared.field.wireIndex.isSome do
        throwError "a native field prefix changed an original proof/data position"
      if frame.precedingDependencies.contains index then
        if let some original := actual then
          let source ← context.inputProjectionSource
            (← prepared.layout.source.inContext context) inputIds
          if let some (binding, sourcePath) ← boundProjection? context bound source then
            let some parent := bound[binding]?
              | throwError "a native field prefix lost its independently supplied parent"
            let some (current, remaining) ← IO.ofExcept <|
                (graph.projectionFrontier parent sourcePath).mapError IO.userError
              | throwError "a supplied native parent has no retained field interface"
            if remaining.isEmpty then
              unless original.value == current.value &&
                  (original.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf current.associationIds.toList ||
                    current.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf original.associationIds.toList) do
                throwError "a native field prefix disagrees with its supplied parent occurrence"
            else
              unless (← IO.ofExcept <|
                  (graph.projectionBasis original parent sourcePath).mapError IO.userError).isSome do
                throwError "a native field prefix lost its supplied parent's exact projection ancestry"
      let path := parentPath.push prepared.field.projection
      if let some (_, _, _, earlier) := positions.find? (·.1 == path) then
        match earlier, actual with
        | none, none => pure ()
        | some earlier, some actual =>
          unless earlier.value == actual.value &&
              (earlier.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf actual.associationIds.toList ||
               actual.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf earlier.associationIds.toList) do
            throwError "native field prefixes disagree about an original earlier occurrence"
        | _, _ => throwError "native field prefixes disagree about an original formal position"
      else
        positions := positions.push
          (path, frame.association.bindings[index]!, prepared.layout, actual)
  let rec visit
      (positions : List (Array Name × BindingId × SourceLayout × Option ValueBinding))
      (context : OpenContext) (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding)
      (replacements : Array (Array Name × Expr)) : MetaM α := do
    match positions with
    | [] =>
      action context (← root.fieldTypeInContext nativePrefix.native context replacements) bound
    | (path, id, layout, actual) :: rest =>
      let original ← layout.source.inContext context
      let type ← root.fieldTypeInContext layout context replacements
      let continueWith := fun (context : OpenContext) (binding : LocalBinding) => do
        let mut bound := bound
        if let some actual := actual then
          if let some retained := bound[id]? then
            unless retained.value == actual.value &&
                (retained.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf actual.associationIds.toList ||
                 actual.associationIds.toList.isPrefixOf retained.associationIds.toList) do
              throwError "a native predecessor binder changed its original actual occurrence"
          else bound := bound.insert id actual
        else if bound.contains id then
          throwError "a native proof predecessor acquired a runtime occurrence"
        visit rest context bound (replacements.push (path, binding.expression))
      if let some binding := context.bindings.find? (·.id == id) then
        unless ← context.withOriginalSources #[← inferType binding.expression, type]
            (fun types => isDefEq types[0]! types[1]!) do
          throwError "a native predecessor binder changed its original declared type"
        let some source := binding.originalSource
          | throwError "a native predecessor binder lost its original source correspondence"
        unless source.equal original do
          throwError "a native predecessor binder changed its original source position"
        continueWith context binding
      else
        context.withLocalBinding id (if actual.isSome then .result else .hypothesis)
          `nativeField type continueWith (originalSource := some original)
  visit positions.toList context bound #[]

/-- Capture a dependent field's type in its sealed producer prefix, before the whole
record exists. The original role/context stay unchanged; exact predecessor binders live
only in the checked native scope and are retained by the same prefix association. -/
opaque SourceDependencyCapture.capturePrefix (graph : ValueGraph) (source : SourceLayout)
    (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding) (fieldPrefix : NativeFieldPrefix) :
    MetaM SourceDependencyCapture := do
  unless sameNativeFieldRole source fieldPrefix.native do
    throwError "a native type capture changed its original field role"
  let parameters := source.source.context.entries.map fun entry => bound[entry.id]?
  let references ← source.source.withOpen fun bindings _ => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    fieldPrefix.withBoundType context graph bound fun context type bound => do
      boundContextReferences (some graph) context bound type
        (← source.selections.inContext context)
  discard <| IO.ofExcept <| (graph.requiredOwners references).mapError IO.userError
  return { source, parameters, references, fieldPrefix := some fieldPrefix }

/-- Read the prefix at the actual producing node, or follow its explicitly retained
projection when that node has no own native prefix. This traverses only the selected
reference chain; native types and equal-valued nodes never select an ancestor. -/
private partial def producingNativePrefix (graph : ValueGraph) (binding : ValueBinding) :
    MetaM (Option NativeFieldPrefix) := do
  let node ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.require binding).mapError IO.userError
  if let some nativePrefix := node.origin.fieldPrefix then
    discard <| IO.ofExcept <| node.origin.checkFieldPrefix.mapError IO.userError
    return some nativePrefix
  let selected ← IO.ofExcept <| (graph.projectionSelection binding).mapError IO.userError
  let some (_, parent, path) := selected | return none
  let some original ← producingNativePrefix graph parent | return none
  let mut nativePrefix := original
  for projection in path do nativePrefix ← nativePrefix.descend projection
  return some nativePrefix

/-- Capture a projection's dependent type from its actual parent's retained producer.
The old frame identities and occurrences remain unchanged. The resulting seal authenticates
only this parent and path; it cannot authorize a different fresh field producer. -/
opaque SourceDependencyCapture.captureProjection (graph : ValueGraph) (source : SourceLayout)
    (bound : Std.HashMap BindingId ValueBinding) (nativePrefix : NativeFieldPrefix)
    (parent : ValueBinding) (path : Array Name) : MetaM SourceDependencyCapture := do
  unless !path.isEmpty && (← parent.nativeRole.projectionPathTo source) == path do
    throwError "a projected type capture changed its actual parent's native field path"
  let some original ← producingNativePrefix graph parent
    | throwError "a projected type capture has no original producing prefix"
  let mut original := original
  for projection in path do original ← original.descend projection
  let nativePrefix ← source.source.withOpen fun bindings _ => do
    let context ← ContextTelescope.capture bindings
    let selections ← source.selections.inContext context
    discard <| source.selected? context
    let transport := fun (nativePrefix : NativeFieldPrefix) => do
      let native ← nativePrefix.native.inContext context
      unless native.address == source.address && native.kind == source.kind &&
          native.source.context.exactlyMatches source.source.context &&
          native.source.expression.equal source.source.expression &&
          native.source.type.equal source.source.type &&
          native.source.universeParams == source.source.universeParams &&
          native.source.nativeDeclarations.exactlyMatches source.source.nativeDeclarations do
        throwError "a projected type capture changed its original native field role"
      let merged ← SourceSelectionScope.merge selections (← native.selections.inContext context)
      unless SourceSelectionScope.exactlyMatches Expr.equal selections merged do
        throwError "a projected type capture lost an original complete source selection"
      return ({ nativePrefix with native := source } : NativeFieldPrefix)
    let original ← transport original
    let nativePrefix ← transport nativePrefix
    unless original.retainsCapture nativePrefix && nativePrefix.retainsCapture original do
      throwError "a projected type capture changed its original complete native prefix"
    return nativePrefix
  let captured ← SourceDependencyCapture.capturePrefix graph source bound nativePrefix
  return { captured with projectedFrom := some (parent, path) }

/-- The original packet of retained portable data. Native exports and closures have none.
Reuse: the stored literal structure and ValueContainer.fill, as in receiver encoding. -/
partial def ValueGraph.packet? (graph : ValueGraph) (binding : ValueBinding) :
    Except String (Option Json) := do
  let some node := graph.find binding.value | throw "the value is outside the visible graph"
  match node.payload.data with
  | .portable bytes =>
    let some text := String.fromUTF8? bytes | throw "the portable value is not UTF-8 packet data"
    return some (← Json.parse text)
  | .ownedToken .. | .closure .. => return none
  | .container container =>
    if !container.packetExports.isEmpty then return none
    if (binding.role.kind == .function || container.callable.isSome) &&
        !container.callableData then return none
    let mut replacements := #[]
    for slot in container.slots do
      let actual ← match slot.fieldIndex with
        | none => pure slot.binding
        | some index => graph.project binding index
      let some packet ← graph.packet? actual | return none
      replacements := replacements.push packet
    return some (← container.fill replacements)
  | .product fields =>
    let mut packets := #[]
    for index in [:fields.size] do
      let some packet ← graph.packet? (← graph.project binding index) | return none
      packets := packets.push packet
    if let #[packet] := packets then return some packet
    return some (.arr packets)

end CasRuntime

import CasRuntime.Value
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasRuntime.Value

open Lean Meta CasCompiler CasRuntime

run_cmd Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
  let context ← ContextTelescope.capture #[]
  let role ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkNatLit 7))
  let proofRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkConst ``True.intro))
  let functionRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close (mkConst ``Nat.succ))
  let pair ← mkAppM ``Prod.mk #[mkNatLit 7, mkConst ``Nat.succ]
  let productRole ← SourceLayout.ofTerm (← context.close pair)
  liftM (m := IO) do
    let owners ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let supply := owners.identities
    let program ← supply.fresh .program
    let occurrence ← supply.fresh .occurrence
    let origin : ValueOrigin := { program, occurrence, role, parameters := #[] }
    let empty := ValueGraph.empty supply
    let bytes := "retained bytes".toUTF8
    let (firstGraph, first) ← empty.stage supply origin (.portable bytes)
    let (graph, second) ← firstGraph.stage supply origin (.portable bytes)
    if first.value == second.value then
      throw <| IO.userError "independent returned values share an identity"
    if (empty.find first.value).isSome || (firstGraph.find second.value).isSome then
      throw <| IO.userError "staging changed an earlier immutable graph"
    let some node := graph.find first.value
      | throw <| IO.userError "the graph lost a staged node"
    unless node.origin.occurrence == occurrence && node.origin.program == program do
      throw <| IO.userError "the node lost its producing occurrence or program"
    let .portable retained := node.payload.data
      | throw <| IO.userError "the node changed its payload form"
    unless retained == bytes && node.owners.isEmpty do
      throw <| IO.userError "portable payload or owner independence changed"
    let rejected ← try
      discard <| graph.stage supply { origin with role := proofRole } (.portable bytes)
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless rejected do
      throw <| IO.userError "a source proof acquired a computational payload"
    let child ← owners.spawn { cmd := "/bin/cat" }
    try
      child.child.stdin.putStr "native token\n"
      child.child.stdin.flush
      let token := (← child.child.stdout.getLine).trimAscii.toString
      let (ownedGraph, owned) ← graph.stage supply origin
        (.ownedExport child token #[first])
      let (closedGraph, closed) ← ownedGraph.stage supply { origin with role := functionRole }
        (.closure program #[owned])
      let (jointGraph, joint) ← closedGraph.stage supply { origin with role := productRole }
        (.product #[first, closed])
      let projected ← IO.ofExcept <| (jointGraph.project joint 0).mapError IO.userError
      unless projected.value == first.value do
        throw <| IO.userError "projection replaced the retained field node"
      let rebound ← IO.ofExcept <| (jointGraph.rebind owned role).mapError IO.userError
      unless rebound.value == owned.value do
        throw <| IO.userError "an existing input reference acquired a new node"
      unless ← jointGraph.isAvailable owners joint do
        throw <| IO.userError "a live captured owner made the result unavailable"
      owners.close child.generation
      if ← jointGraph.isAvailable owners owned then
        throw <| IO.userError "an owned export survived its supplying connection"
      if ← jointGraph.isAvailable owners closed then
        throw <| IO.userError "a closure lost its captured owner dependency"
      if ← jointGraph.isAvailable owners rebound then
        throw <| IO.userError "rebinding transferred an existing value's owner"
      unless ← jointGraph.isAvailable owners projected do
        throw <| IO.userError "an independent portable field died with another field's owner"
    finally owners.close child.generation
    let other ← OwnerRegistry.new
    let otherProgram ← other.identities.fresh .program
    let otherOccurrence ← other.identities.fresh .occurrence
    let (otherGraph, foreign) ← (ValueGraph.empty other.identities).stage other.identities
      { program := otherProgram, occurrence := otherOccurrence, role, parameters := #[] } (.portable bytes)
    let rejected ← try
      discard <| graph.stage supply origin (.product #[foreign])
      pure false
    catch _ => pure true
    unless rejected && (otherGraph.find foreign.value).isSome do
      throw <| IO.userError "a value graph admitted a reference outside its visible graph"

namespace CasTools

open Lean

/-- One append-only diagnostic stream. It owns no source selection, value or execution
authority. The native mutex keeps concurrent event lines and their sequence numbers together. -/
structure ApplicationLog where
  private mk ::
  path : System.FilePath
  session : String
  private output : IO.FS.Handle
  private next : Std.Mutex Nat

/-- Flush a complete JSON event before returning. A failed log write remains an IO failure;
it is never reported as a successful recorded event. -/
def ApplicationLog.write (log : ApplicationLog) (parents : Array Nat)
    (event : String) (data : Json) : IO Nat :=
  log.next.atomically do
    let sequence ← get
    let row := Json.mkObj [
      ("schema", toJson (1 : Nat)), ("session", toJson log.session),
      ("sequence", toJson sequence), ("parents", toJson parents),
      ("monotonicMilliseconds", toJson (← IO.monoMsNow)),
      ("event", toJson event), ("data", data)]
    log.output.putStrLn row.compress
    log.output.flush
    set (sequence + 1)
    return sequence

/-- Linux supplies an independent diagnostic nonce, so logging does not allocate or change
any semantic identity. The feedback runner places the stream inside its durable run directory. -/
def ApplicationLog.new (worker : String) (metadata : Json) : IO ApplicationLog := do
  let nonce := (← IO.FS.readFile "/proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid").trimAscii.toString
  if nonce.isEmpty then throw <| IO.userError "the kernel supplied an empty diagnostic identifier"
  let directory : System.FilePath :=
    (← IO.getEnv "CAS_APPLICATION_LOG_DIR").getD "timing/application"
  IO.FS.createDirAll directory
  let path := directory / s!"{nonce}.jsonl"
  let log : ApplicationLog := ⟨path, nonce, ← IO.FS.Handle.mk path .append,
    ← Std.Mutex.new 0⟩
  discard <| log.write #[] "session.started" <| Json.mkObj [
    ("worker", toJson worker), ("leanVersion", toJson Lean.versionString),
    ("feedbackRun", toJson (← IO.getEnv "CAS_FEEDBACK_RUN")),
    ("feedbackContext", toJson (← IO.getEnv "CAS_FEEDBACK_CONTEXT")),
    ("feedbackWorker", toJson (← IO.getEnv "CAS_FEEDBACK_WORKER")),
    ("metadata", metadata)]
  return log

namespace Diagnostics

/-- Scope travels in the native elaborator environment, which already isolates concurrent
sessions and saved-state branches. The shared sink records observations only. -/
structure Scope where
  log : ApplicationLog
  parents : Array Nat := #[]

private initialize scopeExtension : EnvExtension (Option Scope) ←
  registerEnvExtension (pure none)

def current? : CoreM (Option Scope) :=
  return scopeExtension.getState (← getEnv)

/-- Restore only the diagnostic scope. Declarations and other native state produced by
the computation remain intact. -/
def withScope [Monad m] [MonadLiftT CoreM m] [MonadFinally m]
    (scope : Scope) (action : m α) : m α := do
  let previous ← liftM (m := CoreM) current?
  liftM (m := CoreM) <| modifyEnv (scopeExtension.setState · (some scope))
  try action
  finally
    liftM (m := CoreM) <| modifyEnv (scopeExtension.setState · previous)

/-- Emit structured data only into the active session's file, without a user message. -/
def emit (event : String) (data : Json) : CoreM Unit := do
  let some scope ← current? | return ()
  discard <| scope.log.write scope.parents event data

/-- Preserve existing native diagnostic details in the same ordered stream. Formatting is
performed only for an active logged session and never supplies mathematical interpretation. -/
def message (detail : MessageData) : CoreM Unit := do
  let some scope ← current? | return ()
  discard <| scope.log.write scope.parents "diagnostic"
    (Json.mkObj [("message", toJson (← detail.toString))])

end Diagnostics
end CasTools

/-!
# Registry export (`lean-categories-export`)

Emits JSON from the Lean registry. The executable reloads the module that owns
the private persistent extension `LeanCategories.registryExt` from
`CasCatalogue.Catalogue.Registry.Extension`, then calls the checked manifest
path `CasCatalogue.checkedRegistryManifest`.

Does **not** read external semantic-seed artifacts.
-/

open Lean Elab Command

namespace CasCatalogue.Tools.ExportFull
open LeanCategories

open LeanCategories CasCatalogue
open Tools

/-- The checked registry manifest of a fresh environment importing `modules`. -/
def manifestOf (modules : Array Lean.Name) : IO CasCatalogue.RegistryManifest := do
  let appDir ← IO.appDir
  let buildOleanRoot := appDir.parent.get! / "lib" / "lean"
  let workspaceRoot := appDir.parent.get!.parent.get!.parent.get!
  let packagesDir := workspaceRoot / ".lake" / "packages"
  let packageOleanRoots ← (← packagesDir.readDir).toList.mapM fun entry =>
    pure (entry.path / ".lake" / "build" / "lib" / "lean")
  Lean.initSearchPath (← Lean.findSysroot) (buildOleanRoot :: packageOleanRoots)
  unsafe Lean.enableInitializersExecution
  let env ← Lean.importModules (modules.map fun module => { module }) {} (loadExts := true)
  let result ← Lean.Core.CoreM.toIO CasCatalogue.checkedRegistryManifestDTO
    { fileName := "", options := {}, fileMap := default } { env }
  pure result.1

/-- The registry the kernel reads: the environment the harness runs the suite in
(`CasCatalogue.TestSuite`), with the standard contract. This is the exporter data source. -/
def readRegistryManifest : IO CasCatalogue.RegistryManifest :=
  manifestOf #[`CasAcceptance.Standard, `CasCatalogue.TestSuite]

/-- The registry `lean-categories` declares: its catalogue root `LeanCategories.Catalogue`, read
in an environment of its own. -/
def upstreamRegistryManifest : IO CasCatalogue.RegistryManifest :=
  manifestOf #[`LeanCategories.Catalogue, `CasCatalogue.Registry]

def loadRegisteredManifest : IO Json := do
  return toJson (← readRegistryManifest)

/-- Validate Lean-authored registry JSON: `j`, parsed back from the emitted text, is exactly the
checked registry state's JSON. -/
def validate (expected : CasCatalogue.RegistryManifest) (j : Json) : Except String Unit := do
  CasCatalogue.Catalogue.Standard.validateStandardManifest expected
  unless j == toJson expected do
    throw "exported registry manifest does not match the checked registry state"
  pure ()

def run : IO UInt32 := do
  let expected ← readRegistryManifest
  -- No row that `lean-categories` registers is lost on the way to the kernel.
  if let .error e := CasCatalogue.validateSameRows (← upstreamRegistryManifest) expected then
    IO.eprintln s!"the kernel does not read the registry lean-categories declares: {e}"
    return 1
  let manifest := toJson expected
  match Json.parse manifest.compress with
  | .error e =>
      IO.eprintln s!"JSON parse failed: {e}"
      return 1
  | .ok j =>
      match validate expected j with
      | .error e =>
          IO.eprintln e
          return 1
      | .ok () =>
          IO.println manifest.compress
          pure 0

def main : IO UInt32 :=
  run

end CasCatalogue.Tools.ExportFull

@[expose] public section

/-!
# The harness: the suite over a leaves manifest (`specs/architecture.md`, "Acceptance")

`cas-harness [--suite DIR] [--report FILE] [--manifest FILE] [--inventory FILE]`
imports, into a fresh environment,
the catalogue and the language, and runs every file of the suite (`tests/acceptance` by default)
with `#cas_tests`, through the registrations of the manifest `FILE` (by default the installed
leaves', `CasRuntime.installedManifest`). The leaves see neither the suite nor the harness:
a leaf is a manifest and the programs it names, imported by nothing (`specs/leaf-registration.md`).
It prints each file's report, writes every result as JSON to the report file, and exits nonzero if
a test fails (`Outcome.fails`). Gaps are its output: the implementations the suite derives.

`--computation-only` computes the same questions through the kernel executor,
without Lean proof discharge. Each result includes the actual runner dispatches made during
that assertion, so required registered execution can be checked separately from its outcome.
Dispatch records do not establish mathematical correctness.
-/

open Lean Elab

namespace CasCatalogue.Tools.Harness

structure Options where
  suite : String := "tests/acceptance"
  report : Option String := none
  manifest : Option String := none
  inventory : String := "CasAcceptance/Permanent/admitted.json"
  computationOnly : Bool := false

/-- The suite command the harness elaborates. -/
def command (o : Options) : String :=
  let manifest := match o.manifest with
    | some file => s!" manifest \"{file}\""
    | none => ""
  let reporting := match o.report with
    | some file => s!" reporting \"{file}\""
    | none => ""
  let computing := if o.computationOnly then " computing" else ""
  s!"#cas_tests \"{o.suite}\"{manifest}{reporting} inventory \"{o.inventory}\"{computing}\n"

/-- Early runner failures still produce one result for each required assertion. This
report carries no interpretation and cannot establish mathematical acceptance. -/
def infrastructureReport (o : Options) (reason : String) : IO Unit := do
  let .ok inventory := Json.parse (← IO.FS.readFile o.inventory)
    | throw <| IO.userError "cannot read fixed assertion inventory"
  let .ok (.obj assertions) := inventory.getObjVal? "assertions"
    | throw <| IO.userError "missing fixed assertion inventory"
  let results := assertions.toList.toArray.map fun (identity, _) => Json.mkObj [
    ("file", toJson o.suite), ("id", toJson identity), ("kind", toJson "internal"),
    ("stratum", Json.null),
    ("detail", toJson reason), ("fails", toJson true),
    ("question", toJson ""), ("proposition", toJson "")]
  if let some report := o.report then IO.FS.writeFile report (Json.arr results).pretty

def main (args : List String) : IO UInt32 := do
  let mut o : Options := {}
  let mut rest := args
  while !rest.isEmpty do
    match rest with
    | "--suite" :: dir :: more => o := { o with suite := dir }; rest := more
    | "--report" :: file :: more => o := { o with report := some file }; rest := more
    | "--inventory" :: file :: more => o := { o with inventory := file }; rest := more
    | "--manifest" :: file :: more => o := { o with manifest := some file }; rest := more
    | "--computation-only" :: more => o := { o with computationOnly := true }; rest := more
    | arg :: _ =>
        IO.eprintln s!"cas-harness: unknown argument {arg}\n\
          usage: cas-harness [--suite DIR] [--report FILE] [--manifest FILE] \
          [--inventory FILE] [--computation-only]"
        return 2
    | [] => pure ()
  -- Start this invocation with no report from a previous run.
  if let some report := o.report then IO.FS.writeFile report ""
  try
    initSearchPath (← findSysroot)
    unsafe Lean.enableInitializersExecution
    let env ← importModules #[{ module := `CasCatalogue.TestSuite }] {} (loadExts := true)
    let inputCtx := Parser.mkInputContext (command o) "<cas-harness>"
    let state ← IO.processCommands inputCtx {} (Command.mkState env {} {})
    let messages := state.commandState.messages
    for message in messages.toList do
      unless (← message.data.toString).startsWith "resolved:" do
        IO.println (← message.toString)
    if let some report := o.report then
      if (← IO.FS.readFile report).isEmpty then
        infrastructureReport o "runner failed before the suite produced its report"
        return 1
    return if messages.hasErrors then 1 else 0
  catch error =>
    let reason := s!"harness infrastructure failure: {error}"
    IO.eprintln reason
    infrastructureReport o reason
    return 1

end CasCatalogue.Tools.Harness

namespace CasTools.InterfaceExport

open Lean Meta Elab Command CasCatalogue CasCompiler

-- These codecs derive from the independently owned records. Adding a field to a
-- record changes the export at compilation; a hand-written field inventory cannot
-- silently discard a new law, choice, parameter, or published action.
local instance : ToJson Name := ⟨NativeExpression.nameJson⟩
deriving instance ToJson for ParameterMorphismId, ParameterKindId, VarianceId
deriving instance ToJson for FibrationId, MethodId, PropertyId, LiftId, LimitId
deriving instance ToJson for AdjunctionId, ObjectId, LiteralId, PowerObjectId
deriving instance ToJson for InclusionId, OperationId, MorphismId
deriving instance ToJson for NaturalTransformationId, PortId, OpaquePortId
deriving instance ToJson for BinderId, ConstructionId
deriving instance ToJson for CategoryFamilySchema, CategoryFamilyTransportSemantics
deriving instance ToJson for FibrationVariance, MethodShape, LiftKind
deriving instance ToJson for InclusionParameterization, ConstructorArgKind

/-- The native indexed expression retains the complete source, intermediate and
target categories, with its actual constructors and all parameters. -/
instance {source target : CategoryExpr} : ToJson (FunctorExpr source target) :=
  ⟨fun expression => NativeExpression.encode #[toExpr expression]⟩

deriving instance ToJson for FibrationEntry, MethodEntry, LiftEntry, LimitEntry
deriving instance ToJson for AdjunctionEntry, ObjectRefinement, ObjectFunctorPresentation
deriving instance ToJson for ObjectComponents, ObjectEntry, LiteralEntry, NumeralEntry
deriving instance ToJson for GraphLiteralEntry, SubsetLiteralEntry, BinderEntry
deriving instance ToJson for InclusionEntry, OperationRefinement, OperationEntry
deriving instance ToJson for PowerObjectEntry, MorphismEntry, CellEntry, PropertyEntry
deriving instance ToJson for ConstructorEntry, NamedCategoryEntry, CategoryFamilyEntry
deriving instance ToJson for ClassifierEntry, FunctorEntry, PresentationComparisonEntry
deriving instance ToJson for ConstructionEntry, StructuralPortEntry, OpaqueCategoryEntry
deriving instance ToJson for SemanticEntry

/-- All authored entry points of a row. Reuse the registry's declaration inventory
and retain the additional object ports used by the public contract exporter. -/
def rowDeclarations (row : SemanticEntry) : Array Name :=
  row.declarations ++ match row with
    | .object object => object.generator.toArray ++ object.application.toArray ++
      object.constants.toArray ++ object.inclusion.toArray ++ object.admission.toArray ++
      object.refines.toArray.map (·.identification)
    | _ => #[]

/-- The data-only ABI is described by its actual public declarations. Its complete
dependent fields remain attached to the same native type; this list creates no
wire grammar, mathematical operation, law, or route preference. -/
def dataInterfaces : Array Name :=
  #[``BackendProgram, ``PreferredRoute, ``Registration, ``Manifest,
    ``Backend.ObjectField, ``Backend.MorphismEndpoint, ``Backend.TypedMap,
    ``Backend.LiftImages, ``Backend.LiftInput, ``Backend.LiftFactorInput,
    ``Backend.CartesianMap, ``Backend.ConstructionField,
    ``CategoryTheory.LiftableCone, ``CategoryTheory.LiftsToLimit,
    ``Backend.CategoryParameter,
    ``Backend.ConstructedCategory, ``Backend.StructuredProjectionAction,
    ``Backend.FunctorParameter, ``Backend.CellComponent, ``Backend.ConstructedCellComponent,
    ``Backend.CoreObject, ``Backend.CoreIso, ``Backend.ConstructionInvocation,
    ``Backend.AdmittedPoint, ``Backend.ConstrainedPoint, ``Backend.PointInvocation,
    ``Backend.PresentationInvocation, ``Backend.ComputationalValue,
    ``Backend.InputPathStep, ``Backend.DeferredCall, ``Backend.DeferredData,
    ``Backend.PortError, ``Backend.Ready, ``Backend.ReadyV2]

def uniqueNames (names : Array Name) : Array Name := Id.run do
  let mut seen : Std.HashSet Name := {}
  let mut result := #[]
  for name in names do
    unless seen.contains name do
      seen := seen.insert name
      result := result.push name
  return result

/-- Include native record constructors and projections. In particular the preferred
route's ordered edges and registration's fields are read from their actual owner. -/
def declarationMembers (name : Name) : MetaM (Array Name) := do
  let env ← getEnv
  match ← getConstInfo name with
  | .inductInfo info =>
    let labels := (getStructureInfo? env name).map (·.fieldNames) |>.getD #[]
    let fields ← labels.mapM fun label => do
      let some projection := getProjFnForField? env name label
        | throwError "public structure {name} has no native projection for {label}"
      return projection
    return #[name] ++ info.ctors.toArray ++ fields
  | _ => return #[name]

def declarationDocument (info : ConstantInfo) : MetaM Json := do
  let env ← getEnv
  let fields ← match getStructureInfo? env info.name with
    | none => pure #[]
    | some structureInfo => structureInfo.fieldNames.mapM fun label => do
      let some name := getProjFnForField? env info.name label
        | throwError "public structure {info.name} has no native projection for {label}"
      let field ← getConstInfo name
      return Json.mkObj [("label", toJson label.toString),
        ("name", NativeExpression.nameJson name),
        ("signature", toJson (← ppExpr field.type).pretty),
        ("documentation", toJson (← findDocString? env name))]
  return Json.mkObj [("name", NativeExpression.nameJson info.name),
    ("displayName", toJson (info.name.toString (escape := false))),
    ("universeParameters", Json.arr (info.levelParams.toArray.map NativeExpression.nameJson)),
    ("signature", toJson (← ppExpr info.type).pretty),
    ("documentation", toJson (← findDocString? env info.name)),
    ("fields", Json.arr fields)]

/-- Prepare a public interface from the current accepted registry and native
environment. No leaf is imported, no provider is called, and no declaration value
or proof procedure is executed. This document is descriptive, never admission. -/
def prepare : MetaM Json := do
  let snapshot ← RegistrySnapshot.snapshot
  match snapshot.validateDerived #[] with
  | .error message => throwError "invalid public registry snapshot: {message}"
  | .ok () => pure ()
  let entries := snapshot.entries.qsort (fun a b => a.stableId < b.stableId)
  let names := uniqueNames (entries.flatMap rowDeclarations ++ dataInterfaces)
  let names := uniqueNames ((← names.mapM declarationMembers).flatten)
  let declarations ← names.mapM getConstInfo
  let documents ← withOptions (fun options =>
      options.setBool `pp.universes true |>.setBool `pp.explicit true |>.setBool `pp.fullNames true) do
    declarations.mapM declarationDocument
  let origins := semanticRowsByModule (← getEnv)
  let mut rows := #[]
  let mut identities : Std.HashSet (String × String) := {}
  for row in entries do
    let entry := toJson row
    let .ok variants := entry.getObj?
      | throwError "public row {row.stableId} lost its native constructor"
    let [(kind, _)] := variants.toList
      | throwError "public row {row.stableId} has no unique native constructor"
    let identity := (kind, row.stableId)
    if identities.contains identity then
      throwError "public registry repeats the typed identity {kind}:{row.stableId}"
    identities := identities.insert identity
    let modules := origins.filterMap fun (name, rows) =>
      if rows.any (fun other => if other.stableId == row.stableId then
          (toJson other).compress == entry.compress else false) then some name else none
    unless modules.size == 1 do
      throwError "public row {row.stableId} has no unique registered module"
    rows := rows.push <| Json.mkObj [
      ("id", toJson row.stableId), ("kind", toJson kind), ("entry", entry),
      ("module", NativeExpression.nameJson modules[0]!),
      ("declarations", Json.arr ((rowDeclarations row).map NativeExpression.nameJson))]
  return Json.mkObj [("schema", toJson "cas-language-interface/1"),
    ("leanVersion", toJson Lean.versionString), ("registry", Json.arr rows),
    ("dataInterfaces", Json.arr (dataInterfaces.map NativeExpression.nameJson)),
    ("declarations", Json.arr documents),
    ("native", NativeExpression.encodeWithDeclarations #[] declarations)]

/-- Render the already prepared document. Refreshing help performs no elaboration,
proof search, provider request, native evaluation, or extensible formatting. -/
def help (document : Json) : Except String String := do
  let rows ← document.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "registry"
  let declarations ← document.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "declarations"
  let mut result := "# Selected language and interfaces\n\n" ++
    "Generated from the checked registry and native declarations in this export. " ++
    "The adjacent JSON retains every registered field and the complete native expression graph.\n\n" ++
    "Use committed inspection to obtain the selected instance, remaining parameters, " ++
    "candidate routes and availability. A registered signature does not assert that a " ++
    "computation is installed or that returned data satisfy its mathematical laws.\n\n" ++
    "The data-only wire protocol and preferred-route registration rules are documented in " ++
    "[kernel-service.md](https://github.com/dzackgarza/lean-cas-dsl-leaf-contracts/blob/main/api/kernel-service.md) " ++
    "and [manifest.md](https://github.com/dzackgarza/lean-cas-dsl-leaf-contracts/blob/main/api/manifest.md).\n\n" ++
    "## Registered language\n\n" ++
    "| Surface | Kind | Stable identifier |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n"
  for row in rows do
    let id ← row.getObjValAs? String "id"
    let variants ← (← row.getObjVal? "entry").getObj?
    let [(kind, fields)] := variants.toList
      | throw "a public registry row must retain one native constructor"
    let arguments ← fields.getObj?
    let [(_, payload)] := arguments.toList
      | throw "a public registry constructor must retain its complete row record"
    let surface := (payload.getObjValAs? String "name").toOption.filter (! ·.isEmpty)
      |>.orElse (fun _ => (payload.getObjValAs? String "token").toOption)
      |>.getD ""
    result := result ++ "| " ++ surface.replace "|" "\\|" ++ " | " ++ kind ++
      " | `" ++ id ++ "` |\n"
  result := result ++ "\n"
  for row in rows do
    let id ← row.getObjValAs? String "id"
    let entry ← row.getObjVal? "entry"
    result := result ++ "### " ++ id ++ "\n\n```json\n" ++ entry.pretty ++ "\n```\n\n"
  result := result ++ "## Native interfaces, laws and choices\n\n"
  for declaration in declarations do
    let name ← declaration.getObjValAs? String "displayName"
    let signature ← declaration.getObjValAs? String "signature"
    let documentation ← declaration.getObjValAs? (Option String) "documentation"
    result := result ++ "### " ++ name ++ "\n\n```lean\n" ++ signature ++ "\n```\n\n"
    if let some text := documentation then result := result ++ text ++ "\n\n"
  return result

end CasTools.InterfaceExport

syntax (name := exportInterface) "#cas_export_interface " str &"help " str : command

/-- Export the selected public registry and inert help through one explicit command.
New output files are required, so an existing publication is never overwritten. -/
@[command_elab exportInterface] meta def elabExportInterface : CommandElab := fun stx => do
  let `(command| #cas_export_interface $jsonFile:str help $helpFile:str) := stx
    | throwUnsupportedSyntax
  let jsonPath : System.FilePath := jsonFile.getString
  let helpPath : System.FilePath := helpFile.getString
  if jsonPath == helpPath || (← jsonPath.pathExists) || (← helpPath.pathExists) then
    throwError "interface export requires distinct new output files"
  let document ← liftTermElabM prepare
  let .ok rendered := help document | throwError "prepared public interface is malformed"
  let modules ← (← getEnv).header.imports.mapM fun item => do
    let path ← IO.FS.realPath (← findOLean item.module)
    return Json.mkObj [("module", NativeExpression.nameJson item.module),
      ("olean", toJson path.toString)]
  let document := document.setObjVal! "imports" (Json.arr modules)
  IO.FS.withFile jsonPath .writeNew fun jsonOutput =>
    IO.FS.withFile helpPath .writeNew fun helpOutput => do
      jsonOutput.putStrLn document.pretty
      helpOutput.putStr rendered

import LeanCategories.Catalogue
import CasTools.InterfaceDocument
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command
meta import CasTools.InterfaceDocument

open Lean Meta Elab Command CasCatalogue CasTools

-- Compare the generated artifact against the original native environment. These
-- checks neither reconstruct semantics from JSON nor admit any backend result.
run_cmd do
  let document ← liftTermElabM InterfaceExport.prepare
  let .ok rows := document.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "registry"
    | throwError "public help omitted its registry"
  let snapshot ← liftTermElabM do RegistrySnapshot.snapshot
  let ids ← rows.mapM fun row => do
    let .ok id := row.getObjValAs? String "id"
      | throwError "a public row lost its stable identity"
    return id
  unless ids.size == snapshot.entries.size &&
      snapshot.stableIds.all ids.contains do
    throwError "public help omitted or duplicated an accepted registry entry"
  -- A category and its opaque-interface row can share a category identifier.
  -- Compare complete typed entries, never collapse them into a map keyed by ID.
  let mut counts : Std.HashMap String Nat := {}
  let mut identities : Std.HashSet (String × String) := {}
  for row in rows do
    let .ok entry := row.getObjVal? "entry"
      | throwError "a public row lost its typed record"
    let .ok kind := row.getObjValAs? String "kind"
      | throwError "a public row lost its native kind"
    let .ok id := row.getObjValAs? String "id"
      | throwError "a public row lost its identifier"
    if identities.contains (kind, id) then
      throwError "public help duplicated a typed registry identity"
    identities := identities.insert (kind, id)
    let encoded := entry.compress
    counts := counts.insert encoded (counts.getD encoded 0 + 1)
  for original in snapshot.entries do
    let encoded := (toJson original).compress
    unless counts.getD encoded 0 == 1 do
      throwError "public help lost or duplicated the complete typed row {original.stableId}"
  let .ok native := document.getObjVal? "native"
    | throwError "public help omitted the native declaration graph"
  let .ok nodes := NativeExpression.decodeNodes native
    | throwError "the complete public native graph did not decode"
  let .ok declarations := native.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "declarations"
    | throwError "public help omitted the native declaration payloads"
  let mut declared : Std.HashSet Name := {}
  for declaration in declarations do
    let .ok nameJson := declaration.getObjVal? "name"
      | throwError "a public declaration lost its native name"
    let .ok name := NativeExpression.nameFromJson nameJson
      | throwError "a public declaration changed its native name encoding"
    declared := declared.insert name
    let original ← getConstInfo name
    let .ok typeIndex := declaration.getObjValAs? Nat "type"
      | throwError "a public declaration lost its type"
    let some actualType := nodes[typeIndex]?
      | throwError "a public declaration has a dangling type reference"
    unless actualType.equal original.type do
      throwError "public declaration {name} changed its complete dependent native type"
    let .ok universes := declaration.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "universeParams"
      | throwError "a public declaration lost its universe parameters"
    let .ok universes := universes.mapM NativeExpression.nameFromJson
      | throwError "a public declaration changed a universe parameter"
    unless universes.toList == original.levelParams do
      throwError "public declaration {name} changed its ordered universe parameters"
    let value := match original with
      | .defnInfo info => some info.value
      | .thmInfo info => some info.value
      | .opaqueInfo info => some info.value
      | _ => none
    if let some value := value then
      let .ok valueIndex := declaration.getObjValAs? Nat "value"
        | throwError "public declaration {name} was replaced by an axiom"
      let some actualValue := nodes[valueIndex]?
        | throwError "a public declaration has a dangling value reference"
      unless actualValue.equal value do
        throwError "public declaration {name} changed its original native value"
  let state ← liftTermElabM do semanticState
  for object in state.objects do
    for name in object.application.toArray ++ object.generator.toArray ++
        object.admission.toArray ++ object.constants.toArray ++ object.inclusion.toArray ++
        object.refines.toArray.map (·.identification) do
      unless declared.contains name do
        throwError "public object {object.id.raw} lost an authored action or law {name}"
  for row in state.functors do
    let candidates := rows.filter fun exported =>
      exported.getObjValAs? String "id" == .ok row.id.raw &&
        exported.getObjValAs? String "kind" == .ok "functor"
    let #[exported] := candidates | throwError "a public functor has no unique row"
    let .ok tagged := exported.getObjVal? "entry"
      | throwError "a public functor lost its entry"
    let .ok wrapped := tagged.getObjVal? "functor"
      | throwError "a public functor lost its native row kind"
    let .ok payload := wrapped.getObjVal? "e"
      | throwError "a public functor lost its original record"
    let .ok expression := payload.getObjVal? "expression"
      | throwError "a public functor lost its indexed native expression"
    let .ok #[restored] := NativeExpression.decode expression
      | throwError "a public functor expression did not decode"
    unless restored.equal (toExpr row.expression) do
      throwError "public functor {row.id.raw} lost a selected or intermediate category"
  for name in InterfaceExport.dataInterfaces do
    unless declared.contains name do
      throwError "the public data-only interface omitted {name}"
  let .ok help := InterfaceExport.help document
    | throwError "the prepared public document cannot be rendered"
  unless help.startsWith "# Selected language and interfaces" do
    throwError "the public help has no language entrance"

module

public import Lean

@[expose] public section

namespace CasTools.NativeExpression

open Lean

-- Reference: Lean 4.33.0 Lean.Elab.Idbg.nameToJson/nameFromJson?. The standard
-- Name JSON instance uses dotted text and cannot preserve hygienic names.
def nameJson : Name → Json
  | .anonymous => Json.null
  | .str parent value => Json.mkObj [("str", Json.arr #[nameJson parent, toJson value])]
  | .num parent value => Json.mkObj [("num", Json.arr #[nameJson parent, toJson value])]

partial def nameFromJson (document : Json) : Except String Name := do
  if document.isNull then return .anonymous
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "str" then
    let #[parent, value] ← fromJson? value | .error "native name str requires two fields"
    return .str (← nameFromJson parent) (← fromJson? value)
  if let .ok value := document.getObjVal? "num" then
    let #[parent, value] ← fromJson? value | .error "native name num requires two fields"
    return .num (← nameFromJson parent) (← fromJson? value)
  .error "invalid native name constructor"

local instance : ToJson Name := ⟨nameJson⟩
local instance : FromJson Name := ⟨nameFromJson⟩

deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for LevelMVarId
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for Level
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for BinderInfo
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for Literal
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for String.Pos.Raw
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for Substring.Raw
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for SourceInfo
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for Syntax.Preresolved
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for Syntax
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for DataValue
deriving instance ToJson, FromJson for KVMap

/-- One exact native constructor. Child expressions are earlier node indices.
Reference: Lean.Elab.Idbg.exprToJson/exprFromJson?; retain metadata through the native
DataValue, Syntax and SourceInfo constructors instead of quotienting it. -/
inductive Node where
  | bvar (index : Nat)
  | fvar (name : Name)
  | mvar (name : Name)
  | sort (level : Level)
  | const (name : Name) (levels : List Level)
  | app (function argument : Nat)
  | lam (name : Name) (type body : Nat) (info : BinderInfo)
  | forallE (name : Name) (type body : Nat) (info : BinderInfo)
  | letE (name : Name) (type value body : Nat) (nondep : Bool)
  | lit (value : Literal)
  | mdata (data : MData) (body : Nat)
  | proj (name : Name) (index body : Nat)
  deriving ToJson, FromJson, Inhabited

structure Builder where
  indices : ExprStructMap Nat := {}
  nodes : Array Node := #[]

-- Native expression annotation equality treats some metadata fields extensionally.
-- Encode the full ordered metadata payload in the cache key, retaining the actual native
-- metadata in Node.mdata. Expr.replace uses the core pointer cache and preserves sharing.
-- Reference: Lean.Util.ReplaceExpr.replace; Lean.Expr.ExprStructEq; native derived JSON codecs.
partial def metadataKey (expression : Expr) : Expr :=
  expression.replace fun node => match node with
    | .mdata data body => some (.mdata
      (KVMap.empty.setString `nativeMetadata (toJson data).compress) (metadataKey body))
    | _ => none

/-- Normalize each complete supplied root once, retaining exact native metadata
and the same child-before-parent interning order. Descending through the
corresponding children of the original and normalized key avoids renormalizing
the entire shared subtree for every child visited. -/
partial def Builder.add (expression : Expr) : StateM Builder Nat :=
  go expression (metadataKey expression)
where
  go (expression key : Expr) : StateM Builder Nat := do
    if let some index := (← get).indices[ExprStructEq.mk key]? then return index
    let node : Node ← match expression, key with
      | .bvar index, .bvar _ => pure (.bvar index)
      | .fvar id, .fvar _ => pure (.fvar id.name)
      | .mvar id, .mvar _ => pure (.mvar id.name)
      | .sort level, .sort _ => pure (.sort level)
      | .const name levels, .const .. => pure (.const name levels)
      | .app function argument, .app functionKey argumentKey =>
        pure (.app (← go function functionKey) (← go argument argumentKey))
      | .lam name type body info, .lam _ typeKey bodyKey _ =>
        pure (.lam name (← go type typeKey) (← go body bodyKey) info)
      | .forallE name type body info, .forallE _ typeKey bodyKey _ =>
        pure (.forallE name (← go type typeKey) (← go body bodyKey) info)
      | .letE name type value body nondep, .letE _ typeKey valueKey bodyKey _ =>
        pure (.letE name (← go type typeKey) (← go value valueKey)
          (← go body bodyKey) nondep)
      | .lit value, .lit _ => pure (.lit value)
      | .mdata data body, .mdata _ bodyKey =>
        pure (.mdata data (← go body bodyKey))
      | .proj name index body, .proj _ _ bodyKey =>
        pure (.proj name index (← go body bodyKey))
      | _, _ =>
        -- This branch cannot arise from metadataKey, which changes only
        -- metadata payloads. An internal invariant violation is not a node.
        unreachable!
    let index := (← get).nodes.size
    modify fun state => { state with
      indices := state.indices.insert ⟨key⟩ index
      nodes := state.nodes.push node }
    return index

def Builder.finish (builder : Builder) (roots : Array Nat) : Json :=
  Json.mkObj [("roots", toJson roots), ("nodes", toJson builder.nodes)]

/-- Encode a collection of native terms without expanding their shared subterms. -/
def encode (expressions : Array Expr) : Json :=
  let (roots, builder) := (expressions.mapM Builder.add).run {}
  builder.finish roots

/-- Encode the complete native declaration payload using the caller's existing expression
table. The same serializer serves exact snapshots and the typed canonical table; it never
substitutes an axiom for a definition or evaluates the declaration's value. -/
def constantInfoJson [Monad m] (encode : Expr → m Nat) (info : ConstantInfo) : m Json := do
  let common := [("name", nameJson info.name),
    ("universeParams", Json.arr (info.levelParams.toArray.map nameJson)),
    ("type", toJson (← encode info.type))]
  let names : List Name → Json := fun values => Json.arr (values.toArray.map nameJson)
  let fields ← match info with
    | .axiomInfo value =>
      pure [("kind", toJson "axiom"), ("unsafe", toJson value.isUnsafe)]
    | .defnInfo value => do
      let hints := match value.hints with
        | .opaque => Json.arr #[toJson "opaque"]
        | .abbrev => Json.arr #[toJson "abbrev"]
        | .regular height => Json.arr #[toJson "regular", toJson height.toNat]
      let safety := match value.safety with
        | .safe => "safe" | .unsafe => "unsafe" | .partial => "partial"
      pure [("kind", toJson "definition"), ("value", toJson (← encode value.value)),
        ("hints", hints), ("safety", toJson safety), ("all", names value.all)]
    | .thmInfo value =>
      pure [("kind", toJson "theorem"), ("value", toJson (← encode value.value)),
        ("all", names value.all)]
    | .opaqueInfo value =>
      pure [("kind", toJson "opaque"), ("value", toJson (← encode value.value)),
        ("unsafe", toJson value.isUnsafe), ("all", names value.all)]
    | .inductInfo value =>
      pure [("kind", toJson "inductive"), ("parameters", toJson value.numParams),
        ("indices", toJson value.numIndices), ("all", names value.all),
        ("constructors", names value.ctors), ("nested", toJson value.numNested),
        ("recursive", toJson value.isRec), ("unsafe", toJson value.isUnsafe),
        ("reflexive", toJson value.isReflexive)]
    | .ctorInfo value =>
      pure [("kind", toJson "constructor"), ("inductive", nameJson value.induct),
        ("index", toJson value.cidx), ("parameters", toJson value.numParams),
        ("fields", toJson value.numFields), ("unsafe", toJson value.isUnsafe)]
    | .recInfo value => do
      let rules ← value.rules.toArray.mapM fun rule => do
        pure <| Json.mkObj [("constructor", nameJson rule.ctor),
          ("fields", toJson rule.nfields), ("rhs", toJson (← encode rule.rhs))]
      pure [("kind", toJson "recursor"), ("all", names value.all),
        ("parameters", toJson value.numParams), ("indices", toJson value.numIndices),
        ("motives", toJson value.numMotives), ("minors", toJson value.numMinors),
        ("rules", Json.arr rules), ("k", toJson value.k), ("unsafe", toJson value.isUnsafe)]
    | .quotInfo value =>
      let kind := match value.kind with
        | .type => "type" | .ctor => "constructor" | .lift => "lift" | .ind => "induction"
      pure [("kind", toJson "quotient"), ("quotientKind", toJson kind)]
  return Json.mkObj (common ++ fields)

/-- Retain local native definitions beside the same shared expression graph. An empty
declaration closure uses the original document exactly. Decode still returns the original
ordered roots; declaration type/value indices refer to this same graph's node table. -/
def encodeWithDeclarations (expressions : Array Expr) (declarations : Array ConstantInfo) :
    Json := Id.run do
  if declarations.isEmpty then return encode expressions
  let build : StateM Builder (Array Nat × Array Json) := do
    let roots ← expressions.mapM Builder.add
    let declarations ← declarations.mapM (constantInfoJson Builder.add)
    return (roots, declarations)
  let ((roots, declarations), builder) := build.run {}
  return Json.mkObj [("roots", toJson roots), ("nodes", toJson builder.nodes),
    ("declarations", Json.arr declarations)]

/-- Reconstruct a stored native value declaration from the shared exact expression graph.
This is a codec, not an admission: callers must use the native kernel's declaration checker.
Ambient axioms and inductive families have no value-declaration replay through this API. -/
def valueDeclarationFromJson (document : Json) (expressions : Array Expr) :
    Except String Declaration := do
  let name ← document.getObjValAs? Name "name"
  let levelParams ← document.getObjValAs? (List Name) "universeParams"
  let expression (field : String) : Except String Expr := do
    let index ← document.getObjValAs? Nat field
    let some value := expressions[index]?
      | .error "a native declaration refers outside its shared expression graph"
    return value
  let type ← expression "type"
  let value ← expression "value"
  let all ← document.getObjValAs? (List Name) "all"
  let constant : ConstantVal := { name, levelParams, type }
  match ← document.getObjValAs? String "kind" with
  | "definition" =>
    let safety ← match ← document.getObjValAs? String "safety" with
      | "safe" => pure DefinitionSafety.safe
      | "unsafe" => pure DefinitionSafety.unsafe
      | "partial" => pure DefinitionSafety.partial
      | _ => .error "a native definition has an invalid safety constructor"
    let hints ← match ← document.getObjVal? "hints" with
      | .arr #[.str "opaque"] => pure ReducibilityHints.opaque
      | .arr #[.str "abbrev"] => pure ReducibilityHints.abbrev
      | .arr #[.str "regular", height] => do
        let height ← (fromJson? height : Except String Nat)
        if height > 4294967295 then
          throw "a native reducibility height is outside UInt32"
        pure (ReducibilityHints.regular height.toUInt32)
      | _ => .error "a native definition has invalid reducibility hints"
    return .defnDecl { toConstantVal := constant, value, hints, safety, all }
  | "theorem" => return .thmDecl { toConstantVal := constant, value, all }
  | "opaque" =>
    let isUnsafe ← document.getObjValAs? Bool "unsafe"
    return .opaqueDecl { toConstantVal := constant, value, isUnsafe, all }
  | _ => .error "the stored native declaration is not a value declaration"

/-- Decode only topological references. Native constructors restore every stored field. -/
def decodeNodes (document : Json) : Except String (Array Expr) := do
  let nodes ← document.getObjValAs? (Array Node) "nodes"
  let mut values : Array Expr := #[]
  for node in nodes do
    let available := values
    let child (index : Nat) : Except String Expr :=
      match available[index]? with
      | some value => .ok value
      | none => .error "native graph has a forward or cyclic reference"
    let value : Expr ← match node with
      | .bvar index => pure (.bvar index)
      | .fvar name => pure (.fvar ⟨name⟩)
      | .mvar name => pure (.mvar ⟨name⟩)
      | .sort level => pure (.sort level)
      | .const name levels => pure (.const name levels)
      | .app function argument => pure (.app (← child function) (← child argument))
      | .lam name type body info => pure (.lam name (← child type) (← child body) info)
      | .forallE name type body info => pure (.forallE name (← child type) (← child body) info)
      | .letE name type value body nondep =>
        pure (.letE name (← child type) (← child value) (← child body) nondep)
      | .lit value => pure (.lit value)
      | .mdata data body => pure (.mdata data (← child body))
      | .proj name index body => pure (.proj name index (← child body))
    values := values.push value
  return values

def decode (document : Json) : Except String (Array Expr) := do
  let roots ← document.getObjValAs? (Array Nat) "roots"
  let values ← decodeNodes document
  roots.mapM fun index => match values[index]? with
    | some value => .ok value
    | none => .error "native graph root is outside its node table"

end CasTools.NativeExpression

module

import CasTools.NativeExpression
public meta import Lean.Elab.Command

open Lean CasTools.NativeExpression

run_cmd do
  let name := Name.str (.num (.str .anonymous "scope@") 7) "field.with.dot"
  let leading : Substring.Raw := ⟨" α ", ⟨0⟩, ⟨1⟩⟩
  let trailing : Substring.Raw := ⟨" α ", ⟨3⟩, ⟨4⟩⟩
  let syntaxValue := Syntax.node (.synthetic ⟨1⟩ ⟨3⟩ true) name
    #[Syntax.atom (.original leading ⟨1⟩ trailing ⟨3⟩) "α", mkIdent name, .missing]
  let metadata : MData := { entries := [
    (name, .ofString "native α"), (`flag, .ofBool true), (`name, .ofName name),
    (`natural, .ofNat 23), (`integer, .ofInt (-7)), (`syntaxValue, .ofSyntax syntaxValue)] }
  let shiftedSyntax := Syntax.node (.synthetic ⟨2⟩ ⟨4⟩ true) name syntaxValue.getArgs
  let shiftedMetadata : MData := { entries := metadata.entries.map fun (key, value) =>
    (key, if key == `syntaxValue then .ofSyntax shiftedSyntax else value) }
  let level := Level.imax (.max (.param name) (.succ .zero)) (.mvar ⟨name⟩)
  let leaf := Expr.const name [level]
  let roots : Array Expr := #[leaf, .sort level, .bvar 3, .fvar ⟨name⟩, .mvar ⟨name⟩,
    .app leaf leaf, .lam name (.sort .zero) (.bvar 0) .implicit,
    .lam `other (.sort .zero) (.bvar 0) .instImplicit,
    .forallE name (.sort .zero) (.bvar 0) .strictImplicit,
    .letE name (.sort .zero) leaf (.bvar 0) true,
    .letE name (.sort .zero) leaf (.bvar 0) false,
    .lit (.natVal 5), .lit (.strVal "α"), .mdata metadata leaf,
    .mdata shiftedMetadata leaf, .mdata { entries := metadata.entries.reverse } leaf,
    .proj name 2 leaf]
  let document := encode roots
  let .ok json := Json.parse document.compress | throwError "native graph JSON did not parse"
  let .ok restored := decode json | throwError "native graph JSON did not decode"
  unless restored.size == roots.size &&
      (roots.zip restored).all (fun (source, target) =>
        source.equal target && reprStr source == reprStr target) do
    throwError "native graph transport changed a constructor, binder, metadata value or universe"

run_cmd do
  let leaf := Expr.const `shared []
  let root := (List.range 24).foldl (fun value _ => Expr.app value value) leaf
  let document := encode #[root]
  let .ok restored := decode document | throwError "the shared native graph did not decode"
  unless restored.size == 1 && root.equal restored[0]! do
    throwError "shared native graph transport changed its complete expression"
  let .ok nodes := document.getObjValAs? (Array Json) "nodes"
    | throwError "the native graph omitted its shared node table"
  unless nodes.size == 25 do
    throwError "the native graph expanded repeated subterms"
  let json := Json.mkObj [("roots", toJson #[0]), ("nodes", toJson #[Node.app 0 0])]
  if let .ok _ := decode json then
    throwError "the native graph accepted a forward or cyclic reference"

-- A shared subtree can carry several different complete metadata records.
-- Preserve the exact child-before-parent wire order, including repeated roots.
run_cmd do
  let leaf := Expr.const `retained []
  let first : MData := { entries := [(`x, .ofNat 1), (`y, .ofNat 2)] }
  let second : MData := { entries := first.entries.reverse }
  let a := Expr.mdata first leaf
  let b := Expr.mdata second leaf
  let pair := Expr.app a b
  let nested := Expr.mdata first pair
  let root := Expr.app nested pair
  let actual := encode #[root, b, pair, a, root]
  let expected := Json.mkObj [
    ("roots", toJson (#[5, 2, 3, 1, 5] : Array Nat)),
    ("nodes", toJson #[Node.const `retained [], Node.mdata first 0,
      Node.mdata second 0, Node.app 1 2, Node.mdata first 3, Node.app 4 3])]
  unless actual.compress == expected.compress do
    throwError "the shared native graph changed its exact metadata or wire order"
