    unittest.main()

"""Dependency preparation follows main and preserves local work."""
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name("ci_chain.py")


class ChainTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_latest_main_and_dirty_checkout(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            remote = root / "remote"
            subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main", str(remote)], check=True)
            def git(*args: str) -> str:
                return subprocess.check_output(
                    ["git", "-C", str(remote), *args], text=True).strip()
            git("config", "user.name", "Chain test")
            git("config", "user.email", "chain@example.invalid")
            git("config", "commit.gpgsign", "false")
            git("config", "core.hooksPath", str(root / "fixture-hooks"))
            (remote / "value").write_text("old\n")
            git("add", "value")
            git("commit", "-qm", "old")
            old = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
            (remote / "value").write_text("current\n")
            git("commit", "-qam", "current")
            current = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
            checkout = root / "consumer"
            checkout.mkdir()
            names = ("lean_categories", "cas_leaf_contracts", "cas_leaves", "nbdsl-worker")
            (checkout / "lake-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({"packages": [
                {"name": "«nbdsl-worker»" if name == "nbdsl-worker" else name,
                 "url": str(remote), "rev": old} for name in names] + [
                    {"name": "third_party", "url": str(remote), "rev": old}]}))
            command = ["python3", str(SCRIPT), str(checkout)]
            result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            for name in names:
                package = checkout / ".lake" / "packages" / name
                actual = subprocess.check_output(
                    ["git", "-C", str(package), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
                self.assertEqual(actual, current, name)
            subprocess.run(command + ["--record-resolved"], check=True, capture_output=True)
            recorded = json.loads((checkout / "lake-manifest.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual([entry["rev"] for entry in recorded["packages"][:-1]],
                             [current] * len(names))
            self.assertEqual(recorded["packages"][-1],
                             {"name": "third_party", "url": str(remote), "rev": old})
            self.assertFalse((checkout / ".lake/packages/third_party").exists())
            (remote / "value").write_text("new main\n")
            git("commit", "-qam", "advance main")
            advanced = git("rev-parse", "HEAD")
            subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True)
            for name in names:
                package = checkout / ".lake" / "packages" / name
                actual = subprocess.check_output(
                    ["git", "-C", str(package), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
                self.assertEqual(actual, advanced, name)
            dirty = checkout / ".lake/packages/nbdsl-worker/value"
            dirty.write_text("local work\n")
            result = subprocess.run(command + ["--record-resolved"], capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads((checkout / "lake-manifest.json").read_text()), recorded)
            self.assertEqual(dirty.read_text(), "local work\n")
            self.assertIn("uncommitted", result.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Isolated engineering checks for existing-runtime preparation."""
import contextlib
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import shlex
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

SOURCE = Path(__file__).with_name('ci_kernel_candidate.py')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('candidate', SOURCE)
candidate = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(candidate)


def git(path, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(path), *args], text=True,
                                   stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL).strip()


def commit(path):
    git(path, 'add', '.')
    git(path, 'commit', '-m', 'Fixture source')
    return git(path, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')


def repository(path):
    path.mkdir()
    git(path, 'init', '-q')
    git(path, 'config', 'user.name', 'Preparation test')
    git(path, 'config', 'user.email', 'test@example.invalid')
    git(path, 'config', 'commit.gpgsign', 'false')
    git(path, 'config', 'core.hooksPath', str(path / 'fixture-hooks'))


def write(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value))


def fixture(base):
    root, dependency, runtime = (base / name for name in ['kernel', 'dependency', 'runtime'])
    repository(dependency)
    (dependency / 'lakefile.lean').write_text('-- test dependency\n')
    write(dependency / 'lake-manifest.json', {})
    revision = commit(dependency)
    repository(root)
    (root / 'lean-toolchain').write_text('leanprover/lean4:v4.33.0\n')
    row = dict(name='sample', type='git', rev=revision, subDir=None,
               url='https://example.invalid/sample.git', inherited=False, scope='',
               configFile='lakefile.lean', manifestFile='lake-manifest.json')
    write(root / 'lake-manifest.json', {'packages': [row]})
    protected = root / 'tests/acceptance/original.txt'
    protected.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
    protected.write_text('original independent assertion\n')
    baseline = commit(root)
    runtime.mkdir()
    selected = {key: row[key] for key in ['name', 'inherited', 'scope', 'configFile', 'manifestFile']}
    selected.update(type='path', dir=str(dependency))
    write(runtime / 'packages.json', {'schemaVersion': '1.2.0', 'packages': [selected]})
    toolchain = runtime / 'toolchain/bin'
    toolchain.mkdir(parents=True)
    lake = toolchain / 'lake'
    lake.write_text('''#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -eu
if [[ "$1" != --packages=* ]]; then exit 9; fi
shift
if [[ "$1" != env ]]; then exit 9; fi
if [[ "$2" == lean ]]; then
  echo 'Lean (version 4.33.0, test fixture)'
elif [[ "$2" == lake ]]; then
  echo 'Lake version test (Lean version 4.33.0)'
elif [[ "$2" == printenv && "$3" == LEAN_SRC_PATH ]]; then
  printf '%s\\n' "$PWD"
else exit 9
fi
''')
    lake.chmod(0o755)
    selection = shlex.quote(str(lake)) + ' --packages=' + shlex.quote(str(runtime / 'packages.json'))
    (runtime / 'lake.sh').write_text('#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -euo pipefail\n' +
        'export PATH=' + shlex.quote(str(toolchain)) + ':"$PATH"\n' +
        'cd -- ' + shlex.quote(str(root)) + '\nexport LEAN_SRC_PATH="$(' +
        selection + ' env printenv LEAN_SRC_PATH)"\nexec ' + selection + ' "$@"\n')
    for name in ['evidence', 'cache-extraction-originals', 'engines', 'artifacts']:
        (runtime / name).mkdir()
        (runtime / name / 'preserve.txt').write_text('original ' + name)
    return root, dependency, runtime, baseline


def files(path):
    return {str(p.relative_to(path)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for p in path.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}


def overrides(runtime, update):
    path = runtime / 'packages.json'
    data = json.loads(path.read_text())
    update(data)
    write(path, data)


def run_case(name, mutate=None, error=None):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='candidate-reuse-') as directory:
        root, dependency, runtime, baseline = fixture(Path(directory))
        if mutate:
            mutate(root, dependency, runtime)
        before = files(runtime)
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            try:
                candidate.prepare_existing(root, runtime, baseline)
            except SystemExit as failure:
                assert error and error in str(failure), (name, str(failure), error)
                assert files(runtime) == before, name + ': failed validation changed runtime/evidence'
            else:
                assert not error, name + ': invalid candidate accepted'
                evidence = runtime / 'evidence'
                after = files(runtime)
                archives = list((runtime / 'evidence-archive').iterdir())
                assert len(archives) == 1
                for preserved in ['evidence', 'cache-extraction-originals']:
                    old = archives[0] / preserved / 'preserve.txt'
                    assert hashlib.sha256(old.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == before[preserved + '/preserve.txt']
                for preserved in ['engines/preserve.txt', 'artifacts/preserve.txt', 'lake.sh', 'packages.json']:
                    assert before[preserved] == after[preserved]
                assert not (evidence / 'preserve.txt').exists()
                assert not list(evidence.glob('*-provenance.json'))
                assert not (evidence / 'candidate-summary.json').exists()
                assert candidate.snapshot(runtime) == json.loads((evidence / 'source-tuple-before.json').read_text())
                config = json.loads((evidence / 'configuration.json').read_text())
                for key in ['manifest', 'toolchain', 'overrides', 'helper', 'wrapper']:
                    assert candidate.record(config[key]['path']) == config[key]
        return name


def changed_revision(root, dependency, runtime):
    (dependency / 'lakefile.lean').write_text('-- later independent revision\n')
    commit(dependency)


def changed_protected(root, dependency, runtime):
    (root / 'tests/acceptance/original.txt').write_text('changed assertion\n')
    commit(root)


def wrong_subdirectory(root, dependency, runtime):
    sub = dependency / 'other'
    sub.mkdir()
    overrides(runtime, lambda data: data['packages'][0].update(dir=str(sub)))


cases = [
    ('valid existing runtime', None, None),
    ('duplicate package', lambda r, d, t: overrides(t, lambda x: x['packages'].append(dict(x['packages'][0]))), 'exactly once'),
    ('missing package', lambda r, d, t: overrides(t, lambda x: x['packages'].clear()), 'exactly once'),
    ('extra package', lambda r, d, t: overrides(t, lambda x: x['packages'].append({**x['packages'][0], 'name': 'extra'})), 'exactly once'),
    ('wrong wrapper checkout', lambda r, d, t: (t / 'lake.sh').write_text((t / 'lake.sh').read_text().replace('cd -- ' + str(r), 'cd -- ' + str(r.parent / 'other-kernel'))), 'different checkout'),
    ('wrong wrapper overrides', lambda r, d, t: (t / 'lake.sh').write_text((t / 'lake.sh').read_text().replace('--packages=' + str(t / 'packages.json'), '--packages=' + str(t / 'other-packages.json'))), 'different checkout'),
    ('wrong revision', changed_revision, 'committed revision'),
    ('dirty dependency', lambda r, d, t: (d / 'lakefile.lean').write_text('-- uncommitted\n'), 'committed revision'),
    ('wrong subdirectory', wrong_subdirectory, 'committed subdirectory'),
    ('wrong config field', lambda r, d, t: overrides(t, lambda x: x['packages'][0].update(configFile='other.lean')), 'committed declaration'),
    ('wrong toolchain', lambda r, d, t: (t / 'toolchain/bin/lake').write_text((t / 'toolchain/bin/lake').read_text().replace('4.33.0', '4.33.1')), 'does not match lean-toolchain'),
    ('dirty kernel', lambda r, d, t: (r / 'uncommitted.txt').write_text('uncommitted'), 'checkout is not clean'),
    ('changed protected input', changed_protected, 'Protected assertions'),
]
class ExistingRuntimePreparationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_preservation_and_rejection_boundaries(self):
        for case in cases:
            with self.subTest(case=case[0]):
                run_case(*case)

    def test_source_change_during_input_reading(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='candidate-reuse-race-') as directory:
            root, dependency, runtime, baseline = fixture(Path(directory))
            before = files(runtime)
            original_git = candidate.git
            changed = False

            def racing_git(path, *args):
                nonlocal changed
                result = original_git(path, *args)
                if path == root and args[:2] == ('diff', '--name-status') and not changed:
                    changed = True
                    changed_protected(root, dependency, runtime)
                return result

            with mock.patch.object(candidate, 'git', side_effect=racing_git):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(SystemExit, 'changed during reuse preparation'):
                    candidate.prepare_existing(root, runtime, baseline)
            self.assertTrue(changed)
            self.assertEqual(files(runtime), before)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

"""Exercise the published package resolver and startup helper under real workspace layouts.

Usage: python3 scripts/test_contract_package_paths.py CONTRACT_CHECKOUT [LEAN]
Run with the compiled public contract on LEAN_PATH, for example from `lake env`.
Every manifest and dependency fixture is temporary. No backend or CAS answers are used.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile


PACKAGE = "cas_leaf_contracts"
PROBE = """module
import CasContract.Port
meta import CasContract.Port
open Lean

public def main (arguments : List String) : IO Unit := do
  let [package] := arguments
    | throw <| IO.userError "expected one package name"
  let directory ← CasCatalogue.Backend.packageDir package
  IO.println (toJson directory.toString).compress
"""
STARTUP = "import cas_port; cas_port.serve('package-path-smoke', '0', {})"


def manifest(package: str = PACKAGE, *, name: str = "consumer", **entry) -> dict:
    return {"name": name, "packages": [{"name": package, "type": "git", **entry}]}


def install_helper(destination: Path, helper: Path) -> None:
    (destination / "python").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(helper, destination / "python" / "cas_port.py")
    shutil.copy2(helper.parent / "cas_session.py", destination / "python" / "cas_session.py")


def resolve(lean: str, probe: Path, directory: Path, package: str,
            override: Path | None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    # Preserve imports when Lake supplied paths relative to the original workspace.
    if environment.get("LEAN_PATH"):
        environment["LEAN_PATH"] = os.pathsep.join(
            str(Path(path).resolve()) for path in environment["LEAN_PATH"].split(os.pathsep)
        )
    environment.pop("CAS_LEAF_CONTRACT_PATH", None)
    if override is not None:
        environment["CAS_LEAF_CONTRACT_PATH"] = str(override)
    return subprocess.run(
        [lean, "--run", str(probe), package], cwd=directory, env=environment,
        text=True, capture_output=True, check=False, timeout=30,
    )


def start_helper(directory: Path, resolved: Path, project: Path) -> None:
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    environment["PYTHONPATH"] = str(resolved / "python")
    hello = {"op": "hello", "protocol": 2, "contract": "cas-computation/2"}
    payload = json.dumps(hello).encode()
    result = subprocess.run(
        [str(project / ".venv" / "bin" / "python"), "-c", STARTUP], cwd=directory, env=environment,
        input=str(len(payload)).encode() + b"\n" + payload,
        capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=10,
    )
    frames, remaining = [], result.stdout
    while remaining:
        length, separator, body = remaining.partition(b"\n")
        if not separator or not length.isdigit() or int(length) > len(body):
            raise AssertionError("the resolved SDK emitted an incomplete frame")
        frames.append(json.loads(body[:int(length)]))
        remaining = body[int(length):]
    if len(frames) != 2:
        raise AssertionError("the resolved SDK did not complete negotiation")
    ready, acknowledgement = frames
    if ready.get("op") != "ready" or ready.get("backend") != "package-path-smoke" or \
            ready.get("protocol") != 2 or ready.get("contract") != hello["contract"]:
        raise AssertionError(f"the resolved SDK did not start: {ready}")
    if acknowledgement != {**hello, "status": "ok"}:
        raise AssertionError(f"the resolved SDK changed its acknowledgement: {acknowledgement}")


def main() -> None:
    if not 2 <= len(sys.argv) <= 3:
        raise SystemExit(__doc__)
    helper = (Path(sys.argv[1]) / "python" / "cas_port.py").resolve(strict=True)
    lean_name = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) == 3 else "lean"
    executable = shutil.which(lean_name)
    if executable is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"Lean executable not found: {lean_name}")
    lean = str(Path(executable).resolve(strict=True))
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="cas-contract-package-") as temporary:
        root = Path(temporary)
        probe = root / "PackagePath.lean"
        probe.write_text(PROBE, encoding="utf-8")
        cases = []

        def add(label: str, content: dict | str | None, target: str | Path | None,
                *, package: str = PACKAGE, override: Path | None = None,
                failure: str | None = None) -> None:
            directory = root / label
            directory.mkdir()
            if content is not None:
                (directory / "lake-manifest.json").write_text(
                    content if isinstance(content, str) else json.dumps(content),
                    encoding="utf-8",
                )
            resolved = None if target is None else (directory / target).resolve()
            if resolved is not None:
                install_helper(resolved, helper)
            cases.append((label, directory, package, override, resolved, failure))

        add("default-git", manifest(), f".lake/packages/{PACKAGE}")
        add("configured-relative", {**manifest(), "packagesDir": "vendor"},
            f"vendor/{PACKAGE}")
        absolute_packages = root / "absolute-packages"
        add("configured-absolute", {**manifest(), "packagesDir": str(absolute_packages)},
            absolute_packages / PACKAGE)
        add("git-subdirectory", {**manifest(subDir="public/contract"), "packagesDir": "vendor"},
            f"vendor/{PACKAGE}/public/contract")
        add("path-relative", {**manifest(type="path", dir="../relative-contract"),
                              "packagesDir": "ignored-packages"}, "../relative-contract")
        absolute_contract = root / "absolute-contract"
        add("path-absolute", manifest(type="path", dir=str(absolute_contract)), absolute_contract)
        add("root-package", {"name": PACKAGE, "packages": []}, ".")
        override = root / "overridden-contract"
        add("explicit-override", "not a valid manifest", override, override=override)
        other = "other_package"
        add("override-is-contract-only", manifest(package=other), f".lake/packages/{other}",
            package=other, override=override)
        add("legacy-directory", None, f".lake/packages/{PACKAGE}")
        add("missing-package", {"name": "consumer", "packages": []}, None,
            failure=f"Lake package {PACKAGE} is absent")
        # An unrelated root can even contain a helper; it still is not the dependency.
        install_helper(root / "missing-package", helper)
        add("invalid-manifest", "not a valid manifest", None,
            failure="cannot read the Lake package manifest")

        for label, directory, package, override, expected, failure in cases:
            result = resolve(lean, probe, directory, package, override)
            if failure is not None:
                if result.returncode == 0 or failure not in result.stdout + result.stderr:
                    raise AssertionError(f"{label}: expected explicit resolution failure; {result}")
                continue
            if result.returncode != 0:
                raise AssertionError(f"{label}: resolver failed: {result.stdout}{result.stderr}")
            observed = (directory / json.loads(result.stdout.strip())).resolve()
            if observed != expected:
                raise AssertionError(f"{label}: resolved {observed}, expected {expected}")
            start_helper(directory, observed, helper.parent.parent)
        print(f"PASS: {len(cases)} package layouts/failures, including real public-helper startup")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Engineering checks for the public port reference implementation, not CAS answers.

Usage: python3 scripts/test_contract_protocol.py /path/to/contracts/python/cas_port.py
Discovery uses CAS_LEAF_CONTRACT_PATH or the checkout selected in lake-manifest.json.
"""

import importlib.util
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch


def helper_path():
    # A unittest discovery argument is not a contract path. Direct invocation
    # retains its explicit source selection; discovery uses the built tuple.
    if __name__ == "__main__" and len(sys.argv) > 1 and not sys.argv[1].startswith("-"):
        return Path(sys.argv.pop(1))
    if selected := os.environ.get("CAS_LEAF_CONTRACT_PATH"):
        return Path(selected) / "python" / "cas_port.py"
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    manifest = json.loads((root / "lake-manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    entry = next(row for row in manifest["packages"] if row["name"] == "cas_leaf_contracts")
    if entry["type"] == "path":
        directory = root / entry["dir"]
    else:
        directory = root / manifest.get("packagesDir", ".lake/packages") / entry["name"]
        directory /= entry.get("subDir") or ""
    return directory / "python" / "cas_port.py"


contract_path = helper_path().resolve(strict=True)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("cas_contract_port_under_test", contract_path)
port = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(port)


def frame(value):
    payload = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    return str(len(payload)).encode("ascii") + b"\n" + payload


def node(tag, *arguments):
    return {"ctor": tag, "args": list(arguments)}


class ContractProtocol(unittest.TestCase):
    def read(self, data):
        with patch.object(port.sys, "stdin", SimpleNamespace(buffer=io.BytesIO(data))):
            return port.read_frame()

    def test_frames_count_bytes_and_reject_bad_headers(self):
        value = {"op": "probe", "args": "ℤ → ℚ"}
        self.assertEqual(self.read(frame(value)), value)
        self.assertIsNone(self.read(b""))
        for header in (b"", b"-1", b"+1", b" 1", b"1 ", b"1.0", "١".encode()):
            with self.subTest(header=header), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.read(header + b"\n0")
        for truncated in (b"1", b"3\n{}"):
            with self.subTest(truncated=truncated), self.assertRaises(EOFError):
                self.read(truncated)
        for payload in (b'{"op":"first","op":"second"}', b'{"value":NaN}',
                        b'{"value":Infinity}', b'{"value":1e999}', b'null'):
            with self.subTest(payload=payload), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                self.read(str(len(payload)).encode() + b"\n" + payload)

    def test_serve_preserves_every_supplied_argument(self):
        sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
        from scripts.test_protocol_v2 import Peer

        arguments = (0, False, [], {}, None, "")
        peer = Peer(self, contract_path.parent.parent)
        peer.negotiate()
        for index, value in enumerate(arguments):
            reply = peer.invoke(index, "echo", value)
            self.assertEqual(reply, {"request_id": index, "status": "ok", "value": value, "exports": []})
            self.assertIs(type(reply["value"]), type(value))
        omitted = peer.send({"protocol": 2, "request_id": 6, "op": "echo",
                             "scope_id": "omitted", "input": "traffic#input"})
        self.assertEqual(omitted["status"], "error")
        self.assertEqual(omitted["kind"], "ValidationError")
        self.assertEqual(peer.invoke(7, "unregistered", {}),
                         {"request_id": 7, "status": "unsupported", "op": "unregistered"})

    def test_typed_maps_keep_both_endpoints_and_callable(self):
        source, target = node("obj.sets.fin", 2), node("obj.sets.fin", 3)
        callable_data = port.opaque_data("owned-on-original-connection")
        self.assertEqual(port.typed_map(port.map_data(source, target, callable_data)),
                         (source, target, callable_data))
        for malformed in (node("typedMap", source, target),
                          node("typedMap", source, target, callable_data, source),
                          node("map", source, target, callable_data)):
            with self.subTest(malformed=malformed), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                port.typed_map(malformed)
        for token in ("", None, 0):
            with self.subTest(token=token), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                port.opaque_data(token)

    def test_point_and_admission_contexts_are_complete(self):
        source, target = node("obj.sets.fin", 2), node("obj.sets.fin", 3)
        invocation = node("apply", "op.probe", [], node("opaqueData", "map"),
                          source, source, target, node("opaqueData", "point"))

"""Exercise the public SDK through real framed child-process traffic."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import select
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
type JsonValue = None | bool | int | float | str | list[JsonValue] | dict[str, JsonValue]


def contract_root() -> Path:
    if __name__ == "__main__" and len(sys.argv) > 1 and not sys.argv[1].startswith("-"):
        return Path(sys.argv.pop(1)).resolve(strict=True)
    if selected := os.environ.get("CAS_LEAF_CONTRACT_PATH"):
        return Path(selected).resolve(strict=True)
    manifest = json.loads((ROOT / "lake-manifest.json").read_text())
    package = next(row for row in manifest["packages"] if row["name"] == "cas_leaf_contracts")
    if package["type"] == "path":
        return (ROOT / package["dir"]).resolve(strict=True)
    return (ROOT / manifest["packagesDir"] / package["name"] / (package["subDir"] or "")).resolve(strict=True)


CONTRACTS = contract_root()


def scope_ref(slot: int) -> dict[str, JsonValue]:
    return {"ctor": "scopeRef", "args": [slot]}


class Peer:
    def __init__(self, test: unittest.TestCase, contracts: Path = CONTRACTS,
                 command: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
        self.test = test
        environment = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=str(contracts / "python"))
        self.process = subprocess.Popen(
            command if command is not None else
            ["uv", "run", "--frozen", "--project", str(contracts), "python",
             str(ROOT / "scripts/probes/protocol_v2_peer.py")],
            stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            env=environment, bufsize=0,
        )
        test.addCleanup(self.close)

    def close(self) -> None:
        assert self.process.stdin is not None
        self.process.stdin.close()
        try:
            self.process.wait(timeout=5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            self.process.kill()
            self.process.wait()
            self.test.fail("the SDK did not settle after EOF")
        finally:
            assert self.process.stdout is not None and self.process.stderr is not None
            self.process.stdout.close()
            self.process.stderr.close()

    def read_exact(self, length: int) -> bytes:
        assert self.process.stdout is not None
        result = bytearray()
        while len(result) < length:
            ready, _, _ = select.select([self.process.stdout], [], [], 5)
            self.test.assertTrue(ready, "the SDK did not produce a complete frame")
            chunk = self.process.stdout.read(length - len(result))
            if not chunk:
                assert self.process.stderr is not None
                self.test.fail("SDK channel closed: " + self.process.stderr.read().decode())
            result.extend(chunk)
        return bytes(result)

    def read(self) -> dict[str, JsonValue]:
        length = bytearray()
        while (char := self.read_exact(1)) != b"\n":
            length.extend(char)
        return json.loads(self.read_exact(int(length)))

    def send(self, value: dict[str, JsonValue]) -> dict[str, JsonValue]:
        assert self.process.stdin is not None
        payload = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
        self.process.stdin.write(str(len(payload)).encode() + b"\n" + payload)
        return self.read()

    def negotiate(self, *, routines: bool = False, backend: str = "protocol-peer") -> None:
        self.test.assertEqual(self.read(), {
            "op": "ready", "protocol": 2, "contract": "cas-computation/2",
            "features": ["scoped-values/2", "deferred/2", "suspend-resume/2", "export-capture-frames/2",
                         "routine-observations/1"],
            "backend": backend, "backend_version": "0",
        })
        hello: dict[str, JsonValue] = {
            "op": "hello", "protocol": 2, "contract": "cas-computation/2"}
        if routines:
            hello["routine_observations"] = True
        self.test.assertEqual(self.send(hello), {**hello, "status": "ok"})

    def invoke(self, request: int, operation: str, arguments: JsonValue) -> dict[str, JsonValue]:
        return self.send({"protocol": 2, "request_id": request, "op": operation,
                          "input": "traffic#input", "scope_id": "scope-" + str(request),
                          "args": arguments})


class ProtocolV2(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_negotiation_and_complete_immediate_frames(self) -> None:
        peer = Peer(self)
        peer.negotiate()
        for request, value in enumerate([0, False, [], {}, None, "", "ℤ → ℚ"]):
            self.assertEqual(peer.invoke(request, "echo", value),
                             {"request_id": request, "status": "ok", "value": value,
                              "exports": []})
        self.assertEqual(peer.invoke(7, "absent", {}),
                         {"request_id": 7, "status": "unsupported", "op": "absent"})

        self.assertEqual(suspended["exports"], [])
        reply = peer.send({"protocol": 2, "request_id": 1, "op": "$cas.resume",
                           "scope_id": "fresh", "continuation": suspended["continuation"],

"""Mechanical gate probes; no mathematical interpretation is admitted by these tests."""
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


class QuestionGate(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        scripts = self.root / "scripts"
        scripts.mkdir()
        self.script = scripts / "check_question_permanence.py"
        shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__).with_name("check_question_permanence.py"), self.script)
        self.base = self.root / "questions.json"
        permanent = self.root / "CasAcceptance" / "Permanent"
        permanent.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.record = permanent / "questions.json"
        self.report = self.root / "report.json"
        self.inventory = permanent / "admitted.json"
        self.base.write_text('{"a":"typed"}')
        self.record.write_text(self.base.read_text())
        self.inventory.write_text('{"assertions":{"a":"text","unread":"text"}}')
        self.report.write_text('[{"id":"a","question":"typed"}]')

    def run_gate(self, args=None):
        arguments = ["--base", str(self.base), str(self.report)] if args is None else args
        return subprocess.run(["python3", str(self.script), *arguments],
                              capture_output=True, text=True)

    def test_unread_is_required_even_without_interpretation(self):
        result = self.run_gate()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("ADMITTED ASSERTION MISSING: unread", result.stdout)

    def test_complete_comparison(self):
        self.inventory.write_text('{"assertions":{"a":"text"}}')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_gate().returncode, 0)
        self.report.write_text('[{"id":"a","question":"different"}]')
        result = self.run_gate()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
        self.assertIn("QUESTION CHANGED: a", result.stdout)

    def test_duplicate_does_not_overwrite(self):
        self.report.write_text('[{"id":"a","question":"bad"},{"id":"a","question":"typed"}]')
        result = self.run_gate()
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("duplicate assertion in report: a", result.stderr)

    def test_record_mutation_has_no_command(self):
        before = self.record.read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(self.run_gate(["--record", str(self.report)]).returncode, 2)
        self.assertEqual(self.record.read_bytes(), before)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Check that provenance labels do not change a production mathematical identity.

Run from a built kernel checkout with its complete LEAN_PATH and an optional Lean
executable argument. Both isolated processes import the same compiled modules.
Only a copied manifest's revision label differs. No admission baseline, source
dependency, leaf, mathematical expected answer, or actual manifest is modified.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile


PROBE = """module
import CasCatalogue.Realize
meta import CasCatalogue.Realize
open Lean Elab Command Term
open CasCatalogue CasCatalogue.Realize

run_cmd liftTermElabM do
  let .ok parsed := Parser.runParserCategory (← getEnv) `cas_stmt "assert Fin(2) in Sets"
    | throwError "the provenance fixture did not parse"
  let question ← interpret {} parsed
  IO.println <| (Json.mkObj [("identity", toJson question.identity.1),
    ("revision", toJson question.mathematicalRevision)]).compress
"""


def observe(lean: str, manifest: dict, revision: str, directory: Path) -> dict:
    directory.mkdir()
    changed = json.loads(json.dumps(manifest))
    mathematics = [p for p in changed["packages"] if p["name"] == "lean_categories"]
    if len(mathematics) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("the fixture requires exactly one mathematical dependency")
    mathematics[0]["rev"] = revision
    (directory / "lake-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(changed), encoding="utf-8")
    source = directory / "QuestionProvenance.lean"
    source.write_text(PROBE, encoding="utf-8")
    result = subprocess.run(
        [lean, str(source)], cwd=directory, env=os.environ.copy(),
        text=True, capture_output=True, check=True,
    )
    observations = []
    for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
        try:
            observation = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if isinstance(observation, dict) and set(observation) == {"identity", "revision"}:
            observations.append(observation)
    if len(observations) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"the production probe emitted no unique observation: {result.stdout}")
    return observations[0]


def main() -> None:
    lean = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) == 2 else "lean"
    if len(sys.argv) > 2:
        raise SystemExit(__doc__)
    manifest = json.loads(Path("lake-manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="cas-question-provenance-") as temporary:
        root = Path(temporary)
        first = observe(lean, manifest, "provenance-mechanics-first", root / "first")
        second = observe(lean, manifest, "provenance-mechanics-second", root / "second")
    if first["identity"] != second["identity"]:
        raise AssertionError("a revision label changed the unchanged typed question's identity")
    if first["revision"] == second["revision"]:
        raise AssertionError("the interpreted question lost its separate source provenance")
    print("PASS: production question identity is independent of its retained revision label")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            root = Path(directory)
            packages = root / ".lake" / "packages"
            revisions = {}
            for name in OWN_REQUIRES:

                subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(checkout), "-c", "commit.gpgsign=false",

    def test_warm_consumer_executes_again(self) -> None:
        manifest = ROOT / ".tmp/kernel-session-leaves.json"
        command = ["just", "loop", "CasRuntime.SessionTests"]
        if not manifest.exists():
            subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        previous = manifest.stat().st_mtime_ns
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, check=False)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, "the original public consumer must pass")
        self.assertGreater(
            manifest.stat().st_mtime_ns,
            previous,
            "a warm loop replayed the previous elaboration instead of executing the consumer",
        )
        record = json.loads((ROOT / "timing/runs.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()[-1])
        self.assert_run_records(record, "CasRuntime.SessionTests", completed=True)
        summary = record["computations"]
        self.assertTrue(summary["complete"], summary["malformed"])
        all_rows = [json.loads(line) for line in
                    (ROOT / summary["record_file"]).read_text().splitlines()]
        fixture = (ROOT / "tests/runtime/application_log.cas").resolve()
        rows = [row for row in all_rows if Path(row["file"]).resolve() == fixture]
        self.assertTrue(rows, "the original public file lost its computation records")
        source_hash = hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        for file_run in {row["file_run"] for row in rows}:
            observed = [row for row in rows if row["file_run"] == file_run]
            top = [row for row in observed if row["unit"] == "statement"]
            nested = [row for row in observed if row["unit"] == "nested_statement"]
            self.assertEqual(len(top), 6)
            self.assertEqual(len(nested), 2)
            self.assertIn("logging.direct", {row["id"] for row in top})
            self.assertIn("logging.nested", {row["id"] for row in nested})
            self.assertEqual(sorted(row["ordinal"] for row in nested), [0, 1])
            self.assertTrue(any(row["id"].startswith("(statement)") for row in nested),
                            "the nested definition lost its own measured record")
            by_key = {row["computation"]: row for row in observed}
            for row in observed:
                self.assertTrue(row["complete"])
                self.assertEqual(row["input_sha256"], source_hash)
                self.assertEqual(row["revision"], record["revision"])
                self.assertEqual(row["environment"], record["environment"])
                self.assertAlmostEqual(row["seconds"],
                                       row["execution_seconds"] + row["setup_seconds"])
                self.assertAlmostEqual(row["inclusive_seconds"], row["seconds"] +
                                       row["shared_setup_seconds"] + row["shared_worker_setup_seconds"])
            for row in nested:
                root = by_key[row["root_computation"]]
                self.assertEqual(row["parent_computation"], root["computation"])
                self.assertIn(root["start"]["sequence"], row["start"]["parents"])
                self.assertEqual(row["completion"]["parents"][-1], row["start"]["sequence"])
                self.assertEqual(row["outcome"], row["completion"]["data"])
                self.assertEqual(row["outcome"]["publication"], "pending enclosing cell")
                self.assertEqual(row["enclosing_outcome"], root["completion"]["data"]["result"])
                self.assertTrue(row["enclosing_published"])
                self.assertGreaterEqual(row["setup_seconds"], root["setup_seconds"])
            ordered = sorted(nested, key=lambda row: row["ordinal"])
            self.assertEqual(ordered[0]["preceding_setup_seconds"], 0)
            self.assertGreaterEqual(ordered[1]["preceding_setup_seconds"],
                                    ordered[0]["execution_seconds"])

        # Corrupt only a copy of the actual native trace. Removing both ends of one
        # executed child must not make its work disappear from timing completeness.
        selected = next(row for row in rows
                        if row["unit"] == "nested_statement" and row["id"] == "logging.nested")
        source_log = ROOT / selected["source_log"]
        original = source_log.read_bytes()
        missing = {selected["start"]["sequence"], selected["completion"]["sequence"]}
        lines = original.splitlines(keepends=True)
        retained = [line for line in lines if json.loads(line)["sequence"] not in missing]
        self.assertEqual(len(retained), len(lines) - 2)
        directory = ROOT / "timing/logs/feedback-tests"
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        control = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="missing-child-pair-", dir=directory))
        copied_run = control / "run"
        copied_log = copied_run / "application" / source_log.name
        copied_log.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        copied_log.write_bytes(b"".join(retained))
        context_file = copied_run / "context.json"
        context_file.write_bytes((ROOT / record["context"]).read_bytes())
        shared_setup = record["preparation_seconds"] + record["phases"]["build"]["seconds"]
        original_record_size = (ROOT / "timing/computations.jsonl").stat().st_size
        status, damaged = self.collect_trace(context_file, shared_setup, control)
        self.assertNotEqual(status, 0)
        self.assertFalse(damaged["complete"])
        self.assertTrue(any("sequence" in failure for failure in damaged["malformed"]),
                        damaged["malformed"])
        self.assertTrue(all(not file["complete"] for file in damaged["files"]))
        survived = [json.loads(line) for line in
                    (copied_run / "computations.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
        enclosing = next(row for row in survived
                         if row["computation"] == selected["root_computation"])
        self.assertIn("completion", enclosing, "a sequence gap erased an actual later terminal result")
        self.assertEqual(source_log.read_bytes(), original)
        self.assertEqual((ROOT / "timing/computations.jsonl").stat().st_size, original_record_size)

    def test_unread_source_form_keeps_its_failure_stratum(self) -> None:
        directory = ROOT / "timing/logs/feedback-tests"

                    if row["file"] == "tests/acceptance/polynomials.cas"

        # The new precise failure must be a regression even though its kind is unchanged.
        base = control / "old-report.json"

                  if key not in {"stratum", "fails"}}

            [sys.executable, "scripts/check_acceptance_regression.py", str(base), str(head)],

        self.assertEqual(bool(result.returncode), any(row["fails"] for row in rows))
        run = ROOT / recorded["run"]
        plan = json.loads((run / "selection.json").read_text())
        self.assertEqual(len(plan["files"]), 1)
        selected = plan["files"][0]
        self.assertFalse(selected["admitted"])
        self.assertEqual({row["id"] for row in rows if not row["id"].startswith("(statement)")},
                         set(selected["assertions"]))
        self.assertIn(" computing\n", (run / "worker0.lean").read_text())
        self.assertEqual((ROOT / source).read_bytes(), original)
        self.assertEqual(baseline.read_bytes(), admitted_before)

class SuiteTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        directory = ROOT / "timing/logs/feedback-tests"
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.directory = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=directory))

    def run_suite(self, selection: Path) -> tuple[int, list[dict[str, JsonValue]]]:
        report = self.directory / "report.json"
        source = self.directory / "consumer.lean"
        source.write_text(
            "import LeanCategories.Catalogue\nimport CasCatalogue.TestSuite\n\n"
            f'#cas_tests "{selection.relative_to(ROOT)}" '
            f'reporting "{report.relative_to(ROOT)}"\n'
        )
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["bash", "-c",
             'source scripts/container.sh; incontainer just probe "$1"',
             "feedback-regression", str(source.relative_to(ROOT))],
            cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, check=False,
        )
        (self.directory / "consumer.log").write_text(result.stdout)
        self.assertTrue(report.is_file(), f"the public command produced no report: {result.stdout}")
        return result.returncode, json.loads(report.read_text())

    def test_empty_selection_is_a_current_failure(self) -> None:
        selected = self.directory / "empty"
        selected.mkdir()
        status, report = self.run_suite(selected)
        self.assertNotEqual(status, 0, "an empty selected suite must not succeed")
        self.assertTrue(any(row["kind"] == "internal" and row["fails"] for row in report))

    def test_missing_input_is_infrastructure_failure(self) -> None:
        status, report = self.run_suite(self.directory / "missing.cas")
        self.assertNotEqual(status, 0)
        self.assertEqual(len(report), 1)
        self.assertEqual(report[0]["kind"], "internal")
        self.assertTrue(report[0]["fails"])

    def test_duplicate_assertions_preserve_rows_and_fail(self) -> None:
        # Duplicate an unchanged admitted assertion only in this rejected input control.
        original = (ROOT / "tests/acceptance/numbers.cas").read_text()
        assertion = next(item for item in original.split("\n\n")
                         if item.startswith("test numbers.integers.sum "))
        selected = self.directory / "duplicate.cas"
        selected.write_text(assertion + "\n\n" + assertion + "\n")
        status, report = self.run_suite(selected)
        self.assertNotEqual(status, 0, "duplicate named assertions must fail the public command")
        self.assertEqual(sum(row["id"] == "numbers.integers.sum" for row in report), 2)
        self.assertTrue(any(row["kind"] == "internal" and row["fails"] for row in report))



class AcceptanceFeedbackTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_interrupted_worker_cannot_reuse_previous_results(self) -> None:
        # This test runs inside the research container, alongside the actual Lean worker.
        subprocess.run(["scripts/accept_files.sh", "numbers"], cwd=ROOT, check=False)
        report = ROOT / ".tmp/accept-run.json"
        prior = [row for row in json.loads(report.read_text())
                 if Path(row["file"]).name == "numbers.cas"
                 and not row["id"].startswith("(statement)")]
        self.assertTrue(prior, "the first real selected execution must produce results")
        directory = ROOT / "timing/logs/feedback-tests"
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        log = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=directory)) / "interrupted.log"
        with log.open("w") as output:
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                ["scripts/accept_files.sh", "numbers"], cwd=ROOT,
                stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,
            )
            try:
                deadline = time.monotonic() + 300
                interrupted = False
                while process.poll() is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
                    pending = [process.pid]
                    while pending:
                        pid = pending.pop()
                        proc = Path(f"/proc/{pid}")
                        try:
                            pending.extend(int(child) for child in
                                           (proc / f"task/{pid}/children").read_text().split())
                            arguments = (proc / "cmdline").read_bytes().decode().split("\0")
                            workers = [arg for arg in arguments if arg.endswith("/worker0.lean")]
                            if ((proc / "comm").read_text().strip() == "lean"
                                    and (proc / "cwd").resolve() == ROOT and workers):
                                current = ROOT / Path(workers[0]).with_name("numbers.json")
                                self.assertFalse(current.exists(), "the interruption was too late")
                                os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                                interrupted = True
                                break
                        except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
                            continue
                    if interrupted:
                        break
                    time.sleep(0.1)
                self.assertTrue(interrupted, f"no actual acceptance worker was reached; see {log}")
                status = process.wait(timeout=60)
            finally:
                if process.poll() is None:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                    process.wait(timeout=30)
        current = [row for row in json.loads(report.read_text())
                   if Path(row["file"]).name == "numbers.cas"
                   and not row["id"].startswith("(statement)")]
        with self.subTest("worker exit"):
            self.assertNotEqual(status, 0, f"the interrupted worker was reported successful; see {log}")
        with self.subTest("current selected result"):
            self.assertEqual(current, [], "the interrupted run inherited previous selected results")
        latest = json.loads((ROOT / "timing/acceptance.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()[-1])
        run = ROOT / latest["run"]
        self.assertEqual(run.parent, ROOT / "timing/logs")
        self.assertFalse(latest["complete"])
        self.assertNotEqual(latest["status"], 0)
        self.assertTrue((run / "output.log").is_file())
        events = [json.loads(line) for line in (run / "events.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
        self.assertEqual(events[0]["event"], "run.started")
        self.assertTrue(any(entry["event"] == "phase.started" and
                            entry["phase"] == "acceptance-worker0" for entry in events))
        self.assertEqual(events[-1]["event"], "run.finished")


    def test_partial_report_cannot_reuse_complete_results(self) -> None:
        # Hold only the owning shell after real workers start. Their computation continues,
        # but aggregation cannot race the mutation of this invocation's generated report.
        directory = ROOT / "timing/logs/feedback-tests"
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        log = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=directory)) / "partial.log"
        run: Path | None = None
        stopped = False
        removed_id = ""
        with log.open("w") as output:
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                ["scripts/accept_files.sh", "ellipses", "numbers"], cwd=ROOT,
                stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,
            )
            try:
                # This deadline bounds test cleanup, not the product's feedback budget.
                deadline = time.monotonic() + 900
                while process.poll() is None and time.monotonic() < deadline:
                    if run is None:
                        for line in log.read_text().splitlines():
                            if line.startswith("Acceptance run: "):
                                run = (ROOT / line.removeprefix("Acceptance run: ")).resolve()
                                self.assertEqual(run.parent, ROOT / "timing/logs")
                                break
                    if run is not None:
                        selected_workers = {
                            str(run.relative_to(ROOT) / f"worker{worker}.lean")
                            for worker in range(2)
                        }
                        pending = [process.pid]
                        while pending:
                            pid = pending.pop()
                            proc = Path(f"/proc/{pid}")
                            try:
                                pending.extend(int(child) for child in
                                               (proc / f"task/{pid}/children").read_text().split())
                                arguments = (proc / "cmdline").read_bytes().decode().split("\0")
                                if ((proc / "comm").read_text().strip() == "lean"
                                        and (proc / "cwd").resolve() == ROOT
                                        and os.getpgid(pid) == process.pid
                                        and selected_workers.intersection(arguments)):
                                    self.assertFalse(
                                        (run / "ellipses.json").exists(),
                                        f"the report appeared before the aggregation barrier; see {log}",
                                    )
                                    os.kill(process.pid, signal.SIGSTOP)
                                    stopped = True
                                    break
                            except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
                                continue
                    if stopped:
                        break
                    time.sleep(0.1)
                self.assertTrue(stopped, f"no actual acceptance worker was reached; see {log}")
                self.assertIsNotNone(run)
                assert run is not None
                while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                    state = next(
                        line.split()[1] for line in
                        Path(f"/proc/{process.pid}/status").read_text().splitlines()
                        if line.startswith("State:")
                    )
                    if state == "T":
                        break
                    time.sleep(0.01)
                else:
                    self.fail(f"the owning acceptance shell did not stop; see {log}")

                selected_report = run / "ellipses.json"
                while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                    try:
                        workers = [
                            json.loads((run / f"worker{worker}.status.json").read_text())
                            for worker in range(2)
                        ]
                        original = selected_report.read_bytes()
                        rows = json.loads(original)
                        break
                    except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                        time.sleep(0.1)
                else:
                    self.fail(f"the actual workers did not finish before cleanup; see {log}")
                self.assertTrue(
                    all(worker["status"] == 0 for worker in workers),
                    f"the unmodified real consumers must finish before report corruption: {workers}",
                )
                expected = set(json.loads(
                    (run / "ellipses.inventory.json").read_text())["assertions"])
                named = [row for row in rows if not row["id"].startswith("(statement)")]
                self.assertEqual({row["id"] for row in named}, expected)
                self.assertEqual(len(named), len(expected), "the original report must be complete")
                self.assertTrue(named, "the real selected report must contain named assertions")
                (run / "ellipses.complete.json").write_bytes(original)
                removed_id = named[0]["id"]
                partial = [row for row in rows if row["id"] != removed_id]
                selected_report.write_text(json.dumps(partial, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n")

                os.kill(process.pid, signal.SIGCONT)
                stopped = False
                status = process.wait(timeout=max(1, deadline - time.monotonic()))
            finally:
                if stopped:
                    try:
                        os.kill(process.pid, signal.SIGCONT)
                    except ProcessLookupError:
                        pass
                if process.poll() is None:
                    try:
                        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                    except ProcessLookupError:
                        pass
                    try:
                        process.wait(timeout=30)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                        try:
                            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                        except ProcessLookupError:
                            pass
                        process.wait(timeout=30)

        current = json.loads((ROOT / ".tmp/accept-run.json").read_text())
        latest = json.loads((ROOT / "timing/acceptance.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()[-1])
        self.assertEqual(latest["run"], str(run.relative_to(ROOT)))
        self.assertNotEqual(status, 0, f"the partial selected report was accepted; see {log}")
        self.assertNotEqual(latest["status"], 0)
        self.assertFalse(latest["complete"], "a missing selected assertion is incomplete")
        self.assertTrue(latest["timing_complete"], "report corruption must not erase actual execution timings")
        timings = [json.loads(line) for line in
                   (ROOT / latest["computations"]["record_file"]).read_text().splitlines()]
        self.assertIn(removed_id, {entry["id"] for entry in timings},
                      "completed statement timing was reconstructed from the damaged report")
        self.assertTrue(all(entry["complete"] for entry in timings))

        errors = [row for row in current
                  if row["file"] == "tests/acceptance/ellipses.cas"
                  and row["kind"] == "internal" and row["fails"]]
        self.assertTrue(
            any(removed_id in row["detail"] and "incomplete" in row["detail"] for row in errors),
            f"the current failure must identify the omitted assertion {removed_id}: {errors}",
        )
        self.assertNotIn(removed_id, {row["id"] for row in current},
                         "an earlier complete result supplied the missing current assertion")
        self.assertLessEqual(
            {row["file"] for row in current},
            {"tests/acceptance/ellipses.cas", "tests/acceptance/numbers.cas"},
            "the selected report merged historical results from unselected inputs",
        )
